title: Ideas antes de leer Magnificat Humanitas [ESP-ENG]
body: El pasado 15 de mayo me enteré que no solo se conmemoraba 135 años de la publicación de encíclica \

del papa León XIII, carta que marcó un hito en la historia de la iglesia y da el paso a lo que hoy conocemos como doctrina social de la iglesia, sino que también me enteré que el papa León XIV firmaba su primera encíclica, que sería publicada 10 días después. 


![cover.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/filoriologo/23xAuKcf7LYSpqCUaLwfKcNbG91R5vcLfGiH46ogR7HdYdVFwnGzZt3zCz7zqjJxehE1t.png)


Debo confesar que aunque no me considero para nada un católico practicante, si de algo estoy atento es a la literatura de la Santa Sede y desde que el PAPA León XIV ocupó la silla de Pedro, me pregunté ¿Cuando publicará su primera encíclica? y ¿Qué temás abordará?  

Con la sobre abundancia de conflictos armados llegué a pensar que se trataría sobre algún tratado de paz, pero, fui no solo muy ingenuo sino que no vi todo el panorama entendiendo el por qué de estas cartas. Para quien no sea católico o no posea el contexto habría que decir que una enclítica es una carta que el PAPA puede escribir al clero o a todo cristiano en general. Con el propósito de educar y hacer un llamado de atención. 

Es en resumen es un texto que pretende exponer perspectivas a la luz de las sagradas escrituras (Biblia). 

Volviendo sobre el tema del texto que lleva por nombre \

o sobre la custodia de la persona humana en el tiempo de la IA. ¿Acaso no era algo obvio? -Pensé. Al igual que León XIII, este PAPA esta en frente de una revolución digital, liderada por la IA que avanza muy velozmente, más de lo que podemos imaginar y como siempre lo he dicho: ¿Estamos pensando la tecnología desde las humanidades?   

Por ello, quiero hacer una invitación a leer esta enclítica y no tienes que ser creyente, ni siquiera católico para hacerlo y a partir de su lectura poder reflexionar desde lo humano a la tecnología que nos arropa actualmente y de cara al futuro.  

Si te gusta la tecnología, o simplemente has usado la IA es conveniente que leas el documento. No necesitas ser un teólogo para comprender el mensaje. Creo está escrita en un lenguaje lo suficientemente claro como para que pueda ser entendida. 

Si algo ha sabido hacer la iglesia católica es interpretar cada época, ha sabido no solo hacer una lectura de los contextos de cada época sino que ha sabido adelantarse a los hechos, no por nada estamos hablando de la institución más antigua de la humanidad, pero eso es otro tema. 

Si deseas leer la encílica puedes visitar el sitio web oficial del vaticano:  https://www.vatican.va o simplemente [haz clic aquí para descargarla](https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/es/encyclicals/documents/20260515-magnifica-humanitas.html) y te ahorras la búsqueda en la pagina. 

Ya he comenzado a leerla, y espero poder compartir con más profundidad los temas centrales de la carta. En una de las noticias sobre la enclítica leí que en un apartado mencionaba las criptomonedas, es algo que aun no puedo confirmar así qué ya veremos. 




***

---

##  ENGLISH VERSION

# Thoughts Before Reading *Magnificat Humanitas*


On May 15, I learned that not only were we commemorating the 135th anniversary of the publication of Pope Leo XIII’s encyclical “Rerum Novarum,” a document that marked a milestone in the history of the Church and paved the way for what we now know as the Church’s social doctrine, but I also learned that Pope Leo XIV was signing his first encyclical, which would be published 10 days later. 

I must confess that although I do not consider myself a practicing Catholic at all, if there is one thing I pay attention to, it is the literature of the Holy See, and ever since Pope Leo XIV took the Chair of Peter, I have wondered: When will he publish his first encyclical? And what topics will he address?  

With the abundance of armed conflicts, I came to think it would be about some peace treaty, but I was not only very naive; I also failed to see the bigger picture and understand the purpose of these letters. For those who are not Catholic or lack the context, it should be noted that an encyclical is a letter that the Pope may write to the clergy or to all Christians in general, with the purpose of educating and drawing attention to an issue. 

In short, it is a text that aims to present perspectives in light of the Holy Scriptures (the Bible). 


Returning to the topic of the text titled “Magnificat Humanitas,” which literally means “Magnify Humanity,” or on the protection of the human person in the age of AI. Wasn’t that obvious? I thought. Like Leo XIII, this Pope is facing a digital revolution, led by AI, which is advancing very rapidly—faster than we can imagine. And as I’ve always said: Are we approaching technology from a humanities perspective?   

For this reason, I want to invite you to read this encyclical—and you don’t have to be a believer, or even a Catholic, to do so. Through reading it, you can reflect from a human perspective on the technology that surrounds us today and as we look toward the future.  

If you like technology, or have simply used AI, you should read the document. You don’t need to be a theologian to understand the message. I believe it is written in language clear enough to be understood.  

If there’s one thing the Catholic Church has always been good at, it’s interpreting each era. It has not only been able to interpret the contexts of each era but has also been able to anticipate events—after all, we’re talking about the oldest institution in human history, but that’s another topic. 

If you’d like to read the encyclical, you can visit the Vatican’s official website: https://www.vatican.va or simply [click here to download it](https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/es/encyclicals/documents/20260515-magnifica-humanitas.html) and save yourself the trouble of searching the site. 

I’ve already started reading it, and I hope to share more in-depth insights into the letter’s central themes. In one of the news articles about the encyclical, I read that a section mentioned cryptocurrencies—something I can’t confirm yet, so we’ll see.

title: 順德開吃(1)
body: 5月25日星期一是佛誕，香港是假期，加上周末就是三天假期了，我就無所事事去了順德開吃。所謂「食在廣州，廚出鳳城」，既然廚師都在順德，好吃的還會少嗎？其實我也沒有去過順德，這次就去一趟吧。 星期四晚上下班後我就坐上了高鐵去順德，其實從香港出發坐船是最方便的，不過每天就只有兩班船，分別是11點跟6點，時間不合之餘還要很快賣光，所以我還是坐高鐵。我是坐高鐵到廣州南，再換乘廣珠城際到順德的，19:50上的高鐵，加上中間換乘等候的時間，在21:56到了順德容桂，找了個摩的30塊錢到了在大良的酒店。
/> 到酒店整頓好後都11點了，很快就睡覺結束第一晚。第二天7點多醒來打算外出找點順德早餐，卻發現我酒店附近的餐廳竟然大多都還沒有開，開了的都不是順德的？我實在沒有想到，終於我等到了8點，去了旁邊的一家茶樓飲早茶。
/> 這茶樓的點心款式不是很多啊，不過價錢真的比香港便宜很多，來到順德一定要點這裡特色的，所以我就叫了個魚片粥、陳村粉，另外再點了自己喜歡的鳳爪和蝦餃。

/>

順德粥出名在夠綿滑，把粥煮到米粒都不見，這一碗粥就沒那麼綿了，還見到米，跟香港的比較接近，但那魚片就真的夠薄，且夠嫩。

陳村粉其實來自順德的陳村鎮，超過100年歷史了，它主打薄而闊，爽而滑，不過在這茶樓我吃不出來，畢竟這裡不是陳村，肯定沒那麼正宗，我吃上去就跟河粉差不多，只是闊了一點。怎的來說，這一餐我還是滿意的，而最讓我高興的，就是這裡的食客和服務員都是說粵語，讓我有在家的感覺，聽起來特別舒服。

埋單96塊，便宜便宜，在香港要150以上了。

飲過早茶回酒店放下幾兩，就開始周圍逛逛了。

title: 人生的意义
body:
早上坐地铁的时候，旁边坐两个老人，一男一女。说是老人吧，但年龄也不算太老，大约六十多岁的样子。

女的先开口了，

“广州这地方人真多啊，好多年轻人。。。”

男的附和道，

“是啊！”

“在我们老家，出门一看，到处都是老年人。。。” 女的说完，侧过头看了下男的，微笑了下。

顺着话，两人便说到老年人话题上。

“我现在一点也不觉得自己老”，男的说，

“我觉得我心态很年轻。。。” 说到这里，男的停顿了下，看了下边上的女人，

“但一想呢，自己都六十多岁，也退休了。。。” 说完，略微有些尴尬地笑了。

我心里在想，自己又何尝不是经常这样想呢？总觉得自己还年轻，但每次照镜子时，发现鬓角的白发，以及前额日渐稀少的头发，还有额头那纹路，大有一种“顾影自怜”的感觉，不得不感叹，

“岁月果真是把杀猪刀啊！”

再过二十年，等到自己也到了别人那年龄，衰老那是自然，但不知道那时候，是否还会依旧保持“心态年轻”？



![IMG20260526092052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdinik9M8q1G2uS8YfgAA8RGaKAwxe2bNKJFofSuCHuNE/IMG20260526092052.jpg)


最近不知道怎么回事？晚上时常半夜会醒来。前天晚上半夜醒来，借着屋里一丝台灯微亮，瞪着眼睛看屋顶，半天反复辗转睡不着，只好打开听书软件，听了最近正在看的小说《主角》，连听了好几集，竟然没有丝毫困意。

昨天晚上半夜时候，又醒过来，一看时间，凌晨三点，依旧昨日“历史重演”，听到小区楼下树上许多小鸟叽叽喳喳的叫声，胡思乱想，觉得人生过的真快，大有那种拼命用手想抓水，水却从缝隙中毫不留情溜走的无可奈何感。


![IMG20260526092055.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYXNzg4eigu5JxahisV9jzxm5cLcMieHsakek4m54o6YF/IMG20260526092055.jpg)


年少时总觉得时间过的太慢，憧憬着未来会如何如何？等到成年后，三十之后，忽然发现时间过的真快，四十之后，时间更像一辆加速的列车，拼命地往前跑。。。

前几日想到，这世上的一切，大约都是这样，无论是有序还是无序，都会变得，再有序的东西，最后都会走向无序；从古到今，多少帝王费尽心思想要长生不老，但后来都被证实是徒劳一场空而已。

人生在世，短短几十年，过得快乐，过得有意义，才算是领悟了人生真谛吧。反之，如果一辈子庸庸碌碌，哪怕活到百岁，又有何意义呢？

</center>
</liketuimages>


不知不觉间，618购物季又开启啦。今年这场大促，我最先入手的是一款小家电。

我在京东北鼎官方旗舰店，买下了心心念念许久的养生壶。家里原本就有一台美的养生壶，是刚搬家时随手选购的款式，本白色，样式平平常常，平日里我只用它烧开水，煲汤啦，炖煮银耳啦这类功能从未尝试过，当初入手的价格很便宜，这就是我嫌弃它的理由😂😂

所以我一直想换北鼎养生壶，但网上有人说北鼎养生壶太贵，性价比不高，算智商税。但我始终相信贵自然有它的独到之处。最打动我的，还是觉得北鼎的养生壶颜值高，其实去年双十一我就动了入手的念头，想到家里原本这个无功无过，断然抛弃不好，结果今年还是没抵得住促销优惠，人果然是喜新厌旧啊！

今年的618优惠活动格外诱人，养生壶还附赠品牌手冲咖啡套装、分装杯与陶瓷小盅等配件，这些物件单独选购也要一两百呢，所以算下来着实划算再三挑选后，我选了经典的K123型号，涵盖养生汤，银耳羹，煮茶等常用模式。

配色上我最终选择了清新的小鹅黄。原本偏向百搭的纯白色，可家中家具大多浅色调，添置一抹不那么亮眼的色彩，反倒能给居家环境增添几分独特，实物到手后，我对外观很满意。

眼下我最期待的就是炖煮银耳羹的功能，如今日常越发注重调养身体，往后炖煮各类养生汤水的频次也会慢慢增多。拥有了心仪的新器具，准备开启惬意的养生日常。


---

title: Photos from a classical concert [Eng/Esp]
body:
>

There are moments that are really worth capturing in photos; the challenge comes when so much is happening at once that you have to decide what to focus on, but I personally tried to take photos of everything so I wouldn’t miss a thing. That’s why I’m sharing these photos from a classical music concert.

Hay eventos que son muy interesantes de capturar en fotografías; lo difícil es cuando están ocurriendo tantas cosas al mismo tiempo que debes buscar en qué enfocarte, pero personalmente intenté hacer fotografías de todo para intentar que no se me escapara nada. Por eso, les comparto estas fotografías de un concierto de música clásica.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tmFR1iCBC7HPNaPSj3D4JuYNNAH4KEikVgodhTpGnjhgxX9hi1Lert761Vrv1UZPjBu.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbq7Ajc8Nu1jm3bGAYv6yL6HKDFMCahYfcn7KBet6grudszqUZgtx6wqkodHJKpgLP2.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGwH3MrcKazhuXQzWZWLoRZki3JPxeKKopSbvgTTkHUuuUvvyfHeqbebyYrQmFZs5aT.jpg

>

Since there were so many musicians, I tried to give each of them their moment in the spotlight in different photos. That said, it’s clear that I took some wide shots—this is because I took the photos from a moderate distance and my lens’s zoom didn’t allow me to get any closer—but even so, I feel that you can still make out that sense of prominence I mentioned earlier.

Al haber tantos músicos, intenté darles protagonismo a todos en distintas fotografías. De igual manera, es evidente que hice unos planos abiertos, y esto porque hice las fotos desde una distancia moderada y el zoom de mi lente no me permitía acercarme más, pero aun así siento que se logra distinguir ese protagonismo que les mencioné anteriormente.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23sx9epAMMf5Br1dNFtVVK9peuVyLGZnX4xMSpDazCWeCkdvCMmVv3d8MMSyGkWGcoG4S.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23t7Fn4QZSbEim8wyVyLcmrgMmYHZTdECKRTv4zXqkbB6psuqN43TM1sWQELap2P4YLzN.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23t7FVbP99xNQmgL6YQBK56MQL5x2rDSKRyVd6Q7PLHoZxsvWdHUaJXJQDfWG41Ae1wF2.jpg

>

When developing the photos, I focused on bringing out the orange tones of the instruments so that everything would look consistent and the photos would have a more professional finish, in my opinion, of course.

Para el revelado de las fotografías, me centré en resaltar esa tonalidad naranja de los instrumentos, para que todo se viese de una forma uniforme y que las fotografías tuviesen un acabado más profesional, según mi punto de vista, por supuesto.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvYCyi4HA4uMLSTmyvU3c7Q3SFz7xRYkSppmjRUnev8fuTU5sTx5Er6gb5yxjkQmBxd.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uEzQgZ4gCot2Unq33mBUNgUtPk1RCm8bRvREhWTiCgmywKTavsujUHwtqfxDFXhzXL9.jpg

>

That's all for today; I hope you enjoy these photos as much as I do. It's interesting to take photos at concerts, but honestly, it's quite a challenge; I'd like to keep practicing to improve my skills with this kind of photography. Thank you for reading and viewing my photos. I hope you all have a wonderful day. See you next time!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; espero que estas fotografías les gusten tanto como a mí. Es interesante hacer fotografías en los conciertos, pero sinceramente es todo un reto; me gustaría seguir practicando para mejorar este tipo de fotos. Gracias por leerme y ver mis fotografías. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente día. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>

title: The Strike
body:
<center> https://images.pexels.com/photos/6250/technology-music-phone-screen.jpg</center>
<sbr>

<div class ='text-justify'>

The last week of May is going great. Still feels like the peak of summer here, while it's going to be winter in some other parts of the world. A friend from down under (Australia) is quite excited to welcome the colder season soon, saying it's her favorite time of the year.

Anyway, we had a bit of fun listening to random tunes from various artists, known and unknown. It's fun to discover something or someone *new* from time to time, and think loudly, \

😁 That's usually what I say whenever something interesting comes up. Although that isn't the case for today's recommendation in the Three Tune Tuesday initiative by Ablaze, since I have already encountered the independent synth-pop band before. Tune #1: ### The Strike - I Wish That You Would
https://youtu.be/SlVvAgyeEx8
Released in September 2024 as the final single of the group's album, A Dream Through Open Eyes, this electrifying yet melancholic 80s-inspired synth-pop ballad is surprisingly good. It has that high-energy, pulsing pop tune, highlighted by vibrant synth lines and a driving tempo that results in an irresistible, feel-good rhythm. And the chorus is stuck in my head, lol! 🎵🎵 *I know that love can only go so far* 🎵🎵 🎵🎵 *We made a promise that night in the car* 🎵🎵 🎵🎵 *Forever minding our manners* 🎵🎵 🎵🎵 *I'll never call you up* 🎵🎵 🎵🎵 *But I wish that you would* 🎵🎵 🎵🎵 *But I wish that you would* 🎵🎵 Anyway, tune two is considered to be the band's most iconic track. ### The Strike - Soundtrack
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ybRAotUXjyQ
Another feel-good 80s-inspired tune that blends nostalgia with a contemporary pop-rock twist. It has an incredibly catchy and explosive chorus. The song, which the group released in 2023, is rhythmic, opening up with an infectious, pulsing synthesizer line and then locking into a driving, danceable drumbeat. The band's frontman, Chris Crabb delivers soaring, optimistic vocals. And the third tune for this week's edition, also from the same indie-pop group: ### The Strike - Miles Ahead
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2TWOhloNbkY
Released in 2020, this nostalgic track features Chris Crabb's dynamic vocals, with a high-energy yet emotionally resonant sound. This is one of the band's most popular tracks, which accordingly has over 11.5 accumulated streams on Spotify. The Strike is one of those whom I could listen to once in a while, especially when I'm just lazing around. And here ends my three for the day.

title: My Actifit Report Card: May 24 2026
body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a48593e3-30e3-477a-843f-d9410175884a.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Just like the day before, we had lots of rain yesterday but it did stop in the afternoon and we could finally spend some time outside. Lots of signs left of all that rain. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/417e0c65-891c-48d2-9b65-d783e32e152e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ac1b6b31-7354-476a-a1b4-5b3214daf455.jpg) Once again, Le Chat found the most muddy and dirty rain water, instead of drinking her fresh clean water. She's funny! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/91d562fc-137d-42d9-b928-d07f95646d0e.jpg) In case you missed it, Kaia is injured and forced to rest for about a month, so our daily walk now is limited to the edge of the small forest behind the front yard. It's beautifully green there now. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d31870aa-494f-471f-b771-25e4fc529239.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bdc17f80-2231-4b0c-a5e0-cd55c7a3f09e.jpg) Of course, Kaia would prefer going inside the forest to explore and chase critters. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d51ae12d-d6b8-4c5d-b393-e928ff4f4226.jpg) But Le Chat is there to remind her she's not supposed to. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5ac6859c-8eb1-4c6a-93bd-65a8e7a93c7d.jpg) And they just hang out together quietly. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/831cb521-e44f-44a9-9da2-9353f574c5dd.jpg) We stayed there for a while, just walking back and forth along the edge. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c76ed1d4-de7d-4170-a025-2ab0d3730ab0.jpg) And finally added our now usual very short loop in the neighborhood. It's so much better when the sun shows up. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/65677264-c6af-478e-90be-c15de8e4bf20.jpg) Even found great reflections. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0d47cbd8-d589-4118-9628-9d4ce7c843f6.jpg) Like I mentioned in my previous report, I really wanted to go for a run and I did! Another short one, just slightly more than 5k. But unlike the last one, I didn't walk at all, bringing my overall pace around 5:30 min/km. Still nothing to brag about but maybe it's getting a bit better. Or maybe it was just easier because the weather was a little cooler. With Kaia out, it's actually a good opportunity for me to really get back into my running training. Let's if that actually happens... As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@manuvert/actifit-manuvert-20260526t023339655z)_

title: Cloud Shadows Over the Mountains/SMASH Round 427
body: >Hello Hivers and Shadow Hunters community!\n
>This is my entry for this week's Shadow Hunters Community Contest / SMASH Round 427. A huge thank you to @melinda010100 for hosting this wonderful contest through SHADOW HUNTER!\n

>I was at Malaybalay City Hall one sunny afternoon and honestly I wasn't planning to take photos. But when I looked up and saw how the clouds were casting shadows across the mountain range behind the city, I just had to pull out my phone. The sky was doing something really nice that day a big white clouds moving slowly, and every time one passed over the mountains the shadow would roll across the ridges like a wave. It sounds simple but it looked amazing in person. I stood there for a while just watching it. Then started shooting.
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/244Ummj3ppWG3v7HzTX6KihK8ruV6r1uX8cuJQLyBA2cUHywRjWj7aUMs33VyZXCHwZbp.jpg) ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/244Ut9UdiQV4LzV5Vfe6Whi73ScXNcSXGDmb1W96wGq7495ej1K6vFefo1Dgn1iwJL9mK.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/246amnXPLoF7J8zgywYEgQ6hLVWuGEyJYP9Y9zjZi3EmtCopDGfyjMa4KawCkMkrPZf5z.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23qrDfUPZaZWcS4TouaLHcVVig43cFZxc647hUmsrHpJrycrnCrz7XYrdDnzT77rZXpWv.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23rB2ztJHi2Wy1MnBYcEkS6PxYV4GyEjwxjw1uCL6aeAP4tCDXZWesranThDaCMBsUf5A.jpg) ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/244y28pTdkA2CGjwMMgVkw3ZyyNqp7c8ohm2RnzjzT4ea586KmxyMGo7tRTtDShpiodWZ.jpg) ![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23qrLUkdLPfn5zS55NhpcYBzmwCzQH9WWFbcFUbtcJi1rnjNRFw19uKiArWbaCGez4FNM.jpg)

>What I like about this kind of light is that it changes every few minutes. The shadow moves, the bright patches shift, and you get a completely different photo just by waiting. Bukidnon's mountains are already beautiful on their own but add cloud shadows on top of that and it's a different scene entirely.
![11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wgMXA74iFkLDY3n6JHPjVGk5PeixrMehGU8WQLEMFDHvQ2a1wRkMALCSZztVeEfs6ku.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/242DETit2rb9kNPNQnvvBRHDNSYneDkQJVLeoxYFgstWxko9HuVXMw71ju3pdZ544hfeg.jpg) ![12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wqnnqfsnKq3JjiDWh1exuskxXHRNJ1JkmrrhT4gUVtswozxbgnHKRrEy4RoLbxo3pJn.jpg) ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/242NghomA6uG2enDnq6U4VphbCfC71N4C4DtAK2eXznmjJXTZLUP92FJUFTQrqb6UXYXG.jpg) ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/244UqW7gAUD59uXFn8WXphjNwuXM3ZHBRyex5nVBPMu6zhMtLiNuToFKmxBn5F9n6tCKi.jpg)

>I also went up to one of the covered areas and shot through the open side. The roof framed the mountains nicely and the shadow on the floor added another layer to the whole shadow theme. Sometimes the best shadows are the ones right under your feet.\n

>The mountains are always there in the background, and on a day with good clouds like this one, you really can't take a bad photo of the sky. All photos taken on my mobile phone and edited in Adobe Lightroom. Boosted the blues and greens a little, brought up the clarity on the clouds. Nothing too heavy, the scene was already good on its own. Thanks for stopping by and happy shadow hunting everyone! ![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dondononardem/23wXQuSaUTNYe46RmTqQkFqNwZ7qfQQk63QdaE41SXDM4PtiABeS6nmjMkC2JQ44qRPVP.png)

**¡Bienvenidos a una nueva semana de talento en la Comunidad Music Zone! Nos encontramos en la Semana 189, Ronda #3 del \

, y una vez más, este espacio se llena de pasión, creatividad y, sobre todo, mucha música. Cada ronda de este concurso representa una oportunidad para que los artistas muestren sus habilidades, compartan sus historias y conecten con una audiencia que valora el arte y la dedicación musical y mas ahora en este año \
vendrán muchas cosas buenas para todos nosotros, el día de hoy voy a interpretarles con la Flauta Dulce la canción de unas de mis películas favoritas, que se llama \
. Si no han tenido la oportunidad de verla se las recomiendo 100%.** \n\n*Welcome to another week of talent in the Music Zone Community! We're in Week 189, Round #3 of the \

and once again, this space is filled with passion, creativity, and above all, lots of music. Each round of this competition represents an opportunity for artists to showcase their skills, share their stories, and connect with an audience that values ​​artistry and musical dedication. And now, in this year \
many good things are coming for all of us. Today, I'm going to play the song from one of my favorite movies, \

on the recorder. If you haven't had the chance to see it, I highly recommend it.* 

![NTy4GV6ooFRmaCXZ8UYgPhoud1kjiNX8QokLEZtbBKLuLWQ9yt7K3o4PLNsJDUUn43MzPjrmG5oDnSxipxA3BA6dr2MF4LeT4KXKraqaj4JUQ9RBs2Z8zGx8TsWeiEdg1AX71ARguuWGEGdECtAFvh3sSUwss98JMif6xGnr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davixesk8/23vsFsHWosbe1maKxkd99XqNCeRjCtdfH67rwMiVG9VSgxsCnQQjh4mUcTTGPBwzccohP.png)

**El tema principal de la banda sonora de La Vida es Bella (1997), compuesta por el italiano Nicola Piovani, es una pieza maestra de la música cinematográfica que logró un Premio Óscar a la Mejor Banda Sonora. La melodía es un vals melancólico y esperanzador que encapsula perfectamente el espíritu de la película de Roberto Benigni: la capacidad de mantener la alegría y la imaginación incluso en las circunstancias más oscuras y trágicas de un campo de concentración. El uso predominante de instrumentos de cuerda y acordes sencillos, pero profundos, permite que la música comunique la vulnerabilidad de la infancia y la fuerza del amor paternal sin necesidad de palabras.** 

*The main theme from the soundtrack of Life Is Beautiful (1997), composed by the Italian Nicola Piovani, is a masterpiece of film music that won an Academy Award for Best Original Score. The melody is a melancholic yet hopeful waltz that perfectly encapsulates the spirit of Roberto Benigni's film: the capacity to maintain joy and imagination even in the darkest and most tragic circumstances of a concentration camp. The predominant use of string instruments and simple, yet profound chords allows the music to communicate the vulnerability of childhood and the strength of paternal love without words.* 


![noticia-frases-la-vida-es-bella.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davixesk8/23tbMFs5PUKxEajBCoLwJcMxjD6ccgMt8z5qL4nC4so5j76maS6txC1e5Lpz8Sp4HUPqK.png)

**Participar en la comunidad #MusicZone es siempre un honor. Este espacio ha demostrado, a lo largo de más de 180 semanas, ser un punto de encuentro para músicos de todo el mundo. Aquí, no importa el género o el instrumento, todos compartimos el mismo amor por la música. Cada ronda del concurso no solo es una competencia, sino una celebración de la diversidad y el talento. La Semana 189 no es la excepción, y estoy emocionado de formar parte de esta edición, mostrando una interpretación que viene del corazón, como todas las demás que he compartido con ustedes unas mejores que otras, unas interpretaciones me cuestan mas que otras pero siempre van para ustedes 100% de corazón.** 

*Participating in the #MusicZone community is always an honor. This space has proven itself, over more than 180 weeks, to be a meeting point for musicians from all over the world. Here, regardless of genre or instrument, we all share the same love for music. Each round of the competition is not just a contest, but a celebration of diversity and talent. Week 189 is no exception, and I'm excited to be part of this edition, showcasing a heartfelt performance, like all the others I've shared with you some better than others, some performances more challenging than others, but always 100% from the heart.* 

![23xVc4BZ4UVrCqwszxwfchsp9196VnDcqJVa4S6yuu6DJ82zREA4NGJDPBZ9XSuu4d78g-Photoroom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davixesk8/23uEx7bbMV8zvz3QDHGiN6oCj6uiiZUDN5E362KqZzKxfX91jPcEAv7dwGZLty5yu8JtU.png)

title: Maqueta sobre el calentamiento global | Model on global warming
body:
Hola, buenas noches a todos, amigos míos. Espero que estén bien. Quiero compartir con ustedes, en esta hermosa noche, cómo elaboré una maqueta sobre el calentamiento global para mi hijo pequeño, ya que le tocaba exponer las consecuencias y cómo prevenirlo. No había tenido la oportunidad de compartir con ustedes debido a problemas personales; he echado de menos esta comunidad y Hive en general.

>Hello, good evening everyone, my friends. I hope you’re all doing well. On this beautiful evening, I’d like to share with you how I made a model about global warming for my young son, since he had to give a presentation on its consequences and how to prevent it. I hadn’t had the chance to share with you all due to personal issues; I’ve missed this community and Hive in general.



![1001319304.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AKArPoJ87n6Nmm8oNPqD9pYf31p7be3eGZ9ge27Be9pdLdMe45vriNhy6QEGzCU.jpg)

Materiales que utilicé:
-Poliestireno expandido (anime)
-Foam
-Silicona
-Papel
-Pintura
-Tijeras
-Esfera de poliestireno (anime)

>Materials I used:
-Expanded polystyrene (Styrofoam)
-Foam
-Silicone
-Paper
-Paint
-Scissors
-Polystyrene sphere (Styrofoam)


![1001319251.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AJkRoLjz9KKSEYotYCMjtZM3ftA8VLPCqVSgxCfimnsybZ2tLKR8CUKdfedr9jy.jpg)

A continuación, los pasos a seguir:
Empecé primero con mi esfera de poliestireno, más conocida como anime, y la utilicé para representar nuestro planeta Tierra. Primero, con un rotulador dibujé el rostro, mitad enfermo y mitad sano o feliz; luego continué añadiendo pintura y color a mi planeta Tierra: mitad enfermo por las consecuencias del calentamiento global y mitad feliz o sano porque estaban ayudando a prevenir este calentamiento. 


>Here are the steps to follow:
I started with my polystyrene sphere, better known as Styrofoam, and used it to represent our planet Earth. First, I used a marker to draw the face, half sick and half healthy or happy; then I continued adding paint and color to my planet Earth: half sick due to the consequences of global warming and half happy or healthy because people were helping to prevent this warming. 



![1001319255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AK9NYUt2K9JZQ7y1mxZ9GgZvmHEZkDzgW33FrC1FFXdt5yVRXc9yfpWUuGm55aR.jpg)

Luego continué con la base que utilicé para realizar la maqueta; como pueden apreciar, también es de anime. Conseguí que tuviera el tamaño perfecto, no hubo necesidad de cortarla. A continuación, continué decorando la base: cubrí la mitad con foamis de color verde que simbolizan la hierba o el césped, realicé un pequeño río con piedras alrededor y, al lado, una carretera. y el otro lado lo seguí cubriendo con papel higiénico y pegamento blanco. 

>Then I moved on to the base I used to make the model; as you can see, it’s also made of anime. I managed to get it to the perfect size; there was no need to cut it. Next, I continued decorating the base: I covered half of it with green foam sheets symbolizing grass or lawn, created a small river with stones around it, and, next to it, a road. On the other side, I continued covering it with toilet paper and white glue. 


![1001319256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AKKSXTnCJUbodyhekYrQvZUYhrMpQ5oHCPkwvNTa35uhuxonrVFtDBPFfDYtZzG.jpg)

A continuación, seguí añadiendo pintura marrón al lado que había pegado con papel higiénico; de esta manera, simbolizará la tierra agrietada y destruida por la cantidad de sol; por eso utilicé el papel para darle un relieve rocoso y agrietado. 

>Next, I added brown paint to the side I’d covered with toilet paper; this way, it would represent the earth cracked and destroyed by the sun’s heat; that’s why I used the paper to give it a rocky, cracked texture. 


![1001319257.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AK55tUi5A93c33NRmDWSCPCK27TyRdWeDMWYhmSYMQsZb8Fmk1vPdwCfifXtE3Q.jpg)


Luego seguí haciendo unas casitas o edificios con materiales de espuma; les cuento que al principio los hice medianos y luego tuve que recortarlos porque tapaban el planeta Tierra  

>Then I made some little houses or buildings out of foam; I’ll tell you that at first I made them medium-sized and then I had to cut them down because they were blocking the Earth  


![1001319305.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AK9QEqcZsGzWt7LiL3FbpE7CPHgfCZkPLkRC9MKc7iBjr6SQe4Yiwh8EBucZkGG.jpg)

A continuación, vamos a pegar en el centro de la maqueta el planeta Tierra, mitad sano y mitad enfermo; luego, en la parte de abajo, seguí pegando los edificios 

>Next, we’re going to glue the Earth—half healthy and half sick—in the center of the model; then, at the bottom, I continued gluing the buildings 



![1001319282.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/EoK4w1qh93QSN1pJuhwKHwafB4g75wC9F9NjVPprxHZTPpsAJS9Mk7yknrVhDE6X1cd.jpg)

A continuación, para finalizar mi creación, seguí pegando en la parte superior del planeta Tierra, en el lado sano, árboles en flor, y en el lado enfermo, ramas secas y botes contaminantes; en la parte inferior del lado que simboliza el planeta sano pegué las piezas que simbolizan cómo prevenir (ahorrando agua y energía, sembrando y no utilizando productos químicos); en el lado contrario, que es el lado enfermo, pegué coches derramando gasolina sobre la tierra destruida, contenedores de basura y basura alrededor para simbolizar las consecuencias de una tierra dañada y enferma, finalizando así mi creación 

>Next, to finish my creation, I continued by gluing flowering trees to the top of planet Earth on the healthy side, and dry branches and polluting cans on the sick side; on the lower part of the side symbolizing the healthy planet, I glued the pieces that symbolize how to prevent damage (by saving water and energy, planting, and not using chemicals); on the opposite side, which is the sick side, I glued cars spilling gasoline onto the destroyed earth, trash cans, and trash scattered around to symbolize the consequences of a damaged and sick earth, thus finishing my creation 


![1001319288.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/AK3eKqwRTZHA7inUFR9yNDoz84eSChpnzEbvyWHZHhberT2SE9YLiqWCdLGEcNt.jpg)

Este es el resultado final de mi preciosa maqueta inspirada en el calentamiento global, ideal para el aula, proyectos de aprendizaje; espero que os sea de gran utilidad.
Créditos: las fotos las tomé con mi Redmi 12 y traduje los textos con el traductor Deepl. ¡Feliz noche, amigos!


>This is the final result of my beautiful model inspired by global warming, ideal for the classroom and learning projects; I hope you find it very useful.
Credits: I took the photos with my Redmi 12 and translated the texts using the Deepl translator. Have a great evening, friends!



![1001186398.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jorgelissanchez/23zkvcknCRkeT2GAMcPW4i6AkFUKQvjw3oZSCwUWzDD4KZ7F2weiZrErWStcBDTKN2HSL.jpg)

Today, my husband and a friend started working on the maintenance of our split-system air conditioner. I bought this unit eight months ago and had never had it serviced before. It started acting up a month ago, right before the rains started—it wasn’t cooling because of the weather. My friend recommended cleaning it, so to do the maintenance, he took down the console and disassembled it, along with the motor. He actually used a pressure washer to clean everything, and now my AC is working great. I can tell you, my room is like the North Pole now—hehehe, really cold.

En el dia de hoy mi esposo con la ayuda de un amigo iniciaron a hacerle mantenimiento al aire acondicionado splin, este aire lo compre hace ocho meses y nunca lo habia mandado hacer mantenimiento estaba empezsndo a fallar hace un mes atras antes de iniciar las lluvia no estaba enfrianďo por el clima mi amigo recomendo lavarlo y para hacer el mantenimiento el bajo la consola la desarmo al igual que el motor lo cierto qie con un hidroyec lavo todo, quedando mi aire fino les puedo decir  ya mi habitacion esta como el polo norte jejeje bien frio.

title: Genus Gesonula | A Small Grasshopper Sitting Peacefully On A Green Leaf
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR8rdToj4atJzUTQAWzcoorjmHCK628TNaDUstdSScCah/1779761342636.jpg)



| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| ------------ | ------------ |------------ |
|     Genus Gesonula      |      May 25, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday afternoon, I saw this little grasshopper sitting calmly on a green leaf and took some pictures of it, which I am now sharing with everyone. When I approached this grasshopper and observed it, I saw that its body color mixed with green and black blended perfectly with the surrounding environment. This camouflage beauty of nature really struck me.

According to iNaturalist, this is a grasshopper of the Gesonula genus. They are usually seen around grassy areas, bushes, and agricultural lands. Although their body structure is quite strong, they move very quickly by jumping. The large eyes and slender antennae of this grasshopper stand out very beautifully, which attracted me even more.

However, taking pictures of grasshoppers is a bit difficult because if you get close to them, they jump very quickly and run away. I approached the grasshopper very carefully and was very careful to take pictures of it, although the grasshopper sat still and quietly, which made it easier for me to take pictures.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this insect below, I hope everyone will like it and enjoy it.

title: Testimonio real: Ansiedad en modo simpático [esp-eng]
body:
<center>![1000028901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQhq1K6UQzQaBjDfSe3NpL7coZ7niRyeunq6ryde7b4PtN2vUrLVWFFqiuciptj7Ao4.jpg)</center> 

Los lunes son el días que dispuse en mi bitácora semanal para hablar de la salud física y mental en la comunidad @holos-lotus. Aquella donde salto desde la salud convencional, la Nueva Medicina Germánica y hasta la biodescodificación; pero en este día, la salud mental en mí no ha estado presente de manera frecuente, cuerda y elocuente, y las emociones caóticas parecen pasar una tras otra sin poder poner una pausa.

​Con base en lo que he expresado en las ediciones predecesoras a esta, el detonante de mi estado actual emerge del motor de todo, es decir, el miedo, el cual pareciera ser que se nutre ganando más espacio en la mente y arrojando a su dueño a la vereda de la simpaticotonía.

<center>![1000028903.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23u5y2K2rP8guoXTRaYZB524eLYAkkKRyVzR8rQYFUkVtYvGoJm1Vm5pV4n4wUyCrGzZn.png)</center> 

​En este punto, donde la **vena carótida**  parece ir en una carrera de caballos pura sangre, siento cómo palpita de manera alterada; esto genera que las palpitaciones en mi pecho aumenten y el corazón bombee más sangre. De ese modo, el oxígeno llega en menor medida al cerebro, provocando el dolor de cabeza.

​Por otro lado, el apetito y la sed desaparecen, ya que el cuerpo está en modo \

. En este estado, el organismo prioriza la necesidad de huir y protegerse por sobre alimentarse e hidratarse; por esta razón, en estas situaciones la persona deja de sentir las necesidades básicas del cuerpo humano.\n\n​En este instante, puedo identificar cómo el píloro ha cerrado la puerta a modo de protección más que por huelga, ya que en estos momentos mi propio cuerpo prioriza mantener la energía en los músculos que ayudan en la \

. En este preciso segundo, experimento el derrape (crisis) de la ansiedad; es decir, me encuentro en el pico alto del estrés, lo que evita que pueda presionar el freno (sistema parasimpático) y volver al cauce.\n\n​Por otro lado, la labilidad emocional presente aumenta el riesgo de deshidratación; por ende, debemos aprender a \
y lograr beber sorbos cortos de agua o, simplemente, humedecer los labios. Este pequeño acto ingresa un mensaje suave al cerebro: \

.

​Siendo casi las diez de la noche de un día lunes, mi revista semanal se vuelve un desahogo. Quizás es un grito que quiere liberar el estrés que he estado cargando hace ya varios meses de forma silenciosa, fingiendo fortaleza y sonriendo cuando las lágrimas quieren salir. Y es que, en este punto de la vida, no puedo caer tan profundo porque el barco necesita a su capitana, y aún no logro llevar a la tripulación a puerto seguro.

​Si estás pasando por un episodio ansioso, te envío un abrazo a la distancia. De vez en cuando nos toca caer para levantarnos más fuertes que antes, darnos cuenta que el camino que estamos cruzando tiene piedras sueltas que nos pueden desestabilizar, pero que a pesar de todo y frenarnos en seco, sentir dolor e incertidumbre, podemos avanzar nuevamente, quizás más lento, pero avanzando de todos modos. 
***
Próxima edición 1 de junio de 2016
***
### <center>English</center>
***
<center>![1000028901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uQhq1K6UQzQaBjDfSe3NpL7coZ7niRyeunq6ryde7b4PtN2vUrLVWFFqiuciptj7Ao4.jpg)</center> 

Mondays are the days I’ve set aside in my weekly blog to discuss physical and mental health within the @holos-lotus community. It’s a space where I explore everything from conventional medicine and New German Medicine to biodecoding; yet on this particular day, my own mental health hasn’t been consistently present, stable or coherent, and chaotic emotions seem to come one after another without pause.

Based on what I have expressed in the editions preceding this one, the trigger for my current state stems from the driving force behind everything, namely fear, which seems to feed on itself, gaining more space in the mind and casting its owner onto the path of sympathicotonia.

<center>![1000028903.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23u5y2K2rP8guoXTRaYZB524eLYAkkKRyVzR8rQYFUkVtYvGoJm1Vm5pV4n4wUyCrGzZn.png)</center> 

At this point, where the **carotid artery** seems to be racing like a thoroughbred, I feel it pulsing erratically; this causes the palpitations in my chest to increase and my heart to pump more blood. Consequently, less oxygen reaches the brain, causing a headache.

On the other hand, appetite and thirst disappear, as the body is in ‘survival’ mode. In this state, the body prioritises the need to flee and protect itself over eating and drinking; for this reason, in such situations, the person ceases to feel the basic needs of the human body.

At this very moment, I can see how the pylorus has closed off the passage as a protective measure rather than a ‘strike’, as right now my own body is prioritising maintaining energy in the muscles that aid ‘flight’. At this very second, I experience the onset (crisis) of anxiety; that is to say, I find myself at the peak of stress, which prevents me from pressing the brake (parasympathetic system) and returning to normal.

On the other hand, the emotional instability I’m experiencing increases the risk of dehydration; therefore, we must learn to ‘trick the survival mode’ and manage to take short sips of water or simply moisten our lips. This small act sends a gentle message to the brain: ‘there is no real, imminent threat’.

It’s almost ten o’clock on a Monday night, and my weekly journal becomes an outlet. Perhaps it’s a cry that wants to release the stress I’ve been carrying silently for several months now, feigning strength and smiling when the tears want to flow. The thing is, at this stage in life, I can’t let myself fall too far because the ship needs its captain, and I haven’t yet managed to steer the crew to a safe harbour.

If you’re going through a bout of anxiety, I’m sending you a hug from afar. Every now and then we have to fall so we can get back up stronger than before, realising that the path we’re walking has loose stones that can throw us off balance, but that despite everything—and even if it brings us to a screeching halt, causing pain and uncertainty—we can move forward again, perhaps more slowly, but moving forward nonetheless. 
***
Next edition: 1 June 2016
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)</center>

title: Indiaunited 🇮🇳 Weekly Contest
body: > This is a very sensitive topic, because online we'll always find those who want to take what we've worked so hard to accumulate. So, let's just say there's no magic bullet, and at the same time, all of us are potential victims, even the most careful; in other words, no one is immune to being scammed. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcbYMB8wAtNwdPFyPiGxpEmtQX1ASwrzyTMvtZPJUPXRd/1779754656295.png) [source](https://www.kaspersky.es/blog/como-actuar-ante-un-fraude-online/6089/?srsltid=AfmBOorV7RlkW3N4R7hmjWYprODYqTSoKSu56kC97___s5VSUUzzhuAO) I generally try not to communicate with anyone online, and especially not to give out personal information. I also never open strange links without a sender, unless they offer information that could help me get extra money or some other great opportunity. Another important tip is to keep my passwords off my cell phone so that, if I become a victim, it's difficult to carry out the transactions that could potentially leave me without my money. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQwJD32Q5pa7aCy9rX8pHuhJHwi7oWjKt3YGm7wTtMxE/1779754794961.png) [source](https://caruncho-tome.com/como-protegernos-de-las-estafas-de-internet/) Right now here in my country, Venezuela 🇻🇪, there are a number of scams, but they aren't exactly online. They're carried out through phone calls, where scammers sometimes impersonate members of the country's security forces or bank employees. They try to steal information that will allow them to withdraw money from accounts or call family and friends to ask for money. It's very common for inmates to use these scams to try to get, let's say, easy money. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYHhomzhdVjog1Msw1w7jAFpprkTojaYGQJ8GNtSM3oaQ/1779754883848.png) [source](https://www.animsa.es/noticias/10-ejemplos-de-estafas-en-internet/) I'm not one to give advice to anyone, but simply be wary, especially when something seems too good to be true and promises quick profits. It could very well be a scam. So far, I've never been a victim of these scammers, but as I said, no one is immune, and we could fall victim at any time. Therefore, we should never think we're infallible, and staying vigilant is the best option for our safety. I'd like to say goodbye, but not before thanking you for the opportunity to participate again here in the @indiaunited community in this #iucontest, which is a weekly favorite where we share interesting information, specifically regarding the security of our digital and non-digital assets, especially banking accounts, to avoid scammers who are always lurking and waiting for any opportunity to attack us.

body: /> Since getting asked to cover my first music festival last year, have tried my best not to pass up an opportunity to take photos of live music. Had only shot a handful of shows before the festival, was definitely taking the 'learning by doing' approach, so extra practice is always nice.
/> Between finding ways to work around mic stands, looking for new angles, and always trying to get closer, there's plenty to practice.
/> Decent light is usually too much to ask for at a show, best to get used to working in the dark.
/> Photos are a mix from a few different events this year, Earth Day on Loving Farm, the recent Democracy Festival and the South End Community Market.

/>\n\nAbout time for me to tune out for the day, but since it is Memorial Day here in the disunited states, should probably leave you with a [song to mark the occasion](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4nXQJ-H8v3Y).

title: A red oasis called marpacífico [Eng/Esp]
body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQb9tkBkGbcT8kerhB1mo7nyUGeBQiCoESa5KyTCVC9pq/1779760475356.jpg)



***
***
I have always been amazed by the marpacífico flower. I have heard it called by so many names: poppy, hibiscus, Chinese rose, but none of those names do it justice, not precisely when you see it here, on this tropical island where I live, Cuba, with the sun falling almost perpendicular all year round.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtqkMmyuzBMsLNV8WD5hCd9CJScqr5To5EHN4Rr6Py9L/1779760787278.jpg)

***
There is a huge plant on the sidewalk where I usually walk to pick up my daughter from school. Among the dust of the road and the untamed greenery of everything else, suddenly, it is an explosion. It looks like a red stain so alive that it seems to float in the air, as if the earth had exhaled a contained flame. Its petals are a red I have never seen in any other flower: deep, velvety, with a center that looks like a dark and luminous secret at the same time, while its stigma is a small golden scepter that rises defiantly.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdsFRebzaa55e6qVZ4t9GRZLg4KMwFcM78M6cTCGjScr/1779760787122.jpg)

***
In Cuba, everything grows with fury, but this flower is a separate miracle because it does not need a pampered garden or daily watering. You see it peeking out from cracks in old walls or defying the hot asphalt, and while the sun falls heavily, it opens completely, without shadows, as if it is not afraid of burning. It is an oasis, but not an oasis of freshness, but of contained passion on an island where everything is music, dance, and sweat.
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSeW5owxodJBCnpQAxtaWg93kfJVmkvZtHz5oSnehwUvJ/1779761089692.jpg)

***
The best part, what takes my breath away every time, is when you hang it in your hair. There is a secret art to it, a small hole between the petals, right at the base of the calyx, and you slide a lock of hair through it. The flower holds on by itself, as if made for that purpose, and suddenly, you stop being who you are and become a domestic goddess. You go out into the street like that, with that living brooch beating next to your temple, and people turn their heads, the elderly smile, and the girls point at you.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxMKCDFUgsRwGNrudfBthcyi6JCNpDuGhaTKZH7uTetQ/1779760787417.jpg)

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcjQBy3QSkvYSMpt9jovKoqFq5AjqUeKGBMhfsCx1wiZy/1779761228154.jpg)



***
Walking under the perpendicular sun while the red of the flower dialogues with the green around it, with the implacable blue of the sky and with the white of your light blouse, makes the chaos of the island fall into order.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdsFRebzaa55e6qVZ4t9GRZLg4KMwFcM78M6cTCGjScr/1779761089459.jpg)
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdf9DFJbFPToPgqRTD8Vd3P4M86Svy47x43BLGn7Zh4Fo/1779761089837.jpg)


***
That is what marpacífico is to me, something like a red reminder that on this island of ours, so dizzying and wild, there will always be an oasis waiting for you to put it in your hair.


<center>🌺</center>
<center>🌺</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1778037185465.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃

## <center>Un oasis rojo llamado marpacífico</center>



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYoqdGK2FhHEkQA1dXmPzp54AL1Z6WkysBhXZDouu97t/1779760475593.jpg)



***
***


Siempre me ha maravillado la flor del marpacífico. La he oído llamar de tantas maneras: amapola, hibisco, rosa de China, pero ninguno de esos nombres le hace justicia, no precisamente cuando la ves aquí, en esta isla tropical donde vivo, Cuba, con el sol cayendo perpendicular casi todo el año.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbtqkMmyuzBMsLNV8WD5hCd9CJScqr5To5EHN4Rr6Py9L/1779760787278.jpg)


***
Hay una planta enorme en la acera por donde suelo pasar a buscar a mi niña del colegio. Entre el polvo del camino y el verdor indómito del resto, de repente, es un estallido. Parece una mancha roja tan viva que parece flotar en el aire, como si la tierra hubiera exhalado una llama contenida. Sus pétalos son de un rojo que no he vuelto a ver en ninguna otra flor: profundo, aterciopelado, con un centro que parece un secreto oscuro y luminoso a la vez, mientras que su estigma es un pequeño cetro dorado que se alza desafiante.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdsFRebzaa55e6qVZ4t9GRZLg4KMwFcM78M6cTCGjScr/1779760787122.jpg)

***
En Cuba, todo crece con furia, pero esta flor es un milagro aparte porque no necesita un jardín mimado ni riego diario. La ves asomando entre grietas de paredes viejas o desafiando el asfalto caliente, y mientras el sol cae a plomo, ella se abre entera, sin sombras, como si no tuviera miedo de quemarse. Es un oasis, pero no un oasis de frescura, sino de pasión contenida en una isla donde todo es música, baile y sudor.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSeW5owxodJBCnpQAxtaWg93kfJVmkvZtHz5oSnehwUvJ/1779761089692.jpg)

***
Lo mejor, lo que me roba el aliento cada vez, es cuando te la cuelgas del pelo. Hay un arte secreto en eso, un pequeño agujero entre los pétalos, justo en la base del cáliz, y deslizas un mechón. La flor se sujeta sola, como si estuviera hecha para eso, y de pronto dejas de ser quien eres y te conviertes en una diosa doméstica. Sales a la calle así, con ese broche vivo latiendo junto a tu sien, y la gente gira la cabeza, los viejos sonríen y las niñas te señalan.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxMKCDFUgsRwGNrudfBthcyi6JCNpDuGhaTKZH7uTetQ/1779760787417.jpg)

***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcjQBy3QSkvYSMpt9jovKoqFq5AjqUeKGBMhfsCx1wiZy/1779761228154.jpg)


***
Caminar bajo el sol perpendicular mientras el rojo de la flor dialoga con el verde de alrededor, con el azul implacable del cielo y con el blanco de tu blusa ligera hace que el caos de la isla se ordene.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdsFRebzaa55e6qVZ4t9GRZLg4KMwFcM78M6cTCGjScr/1779761089459.jpg)
***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdf9DFJbFPToPgqRTD8Vd3P4M86Svy47x43BLGn7Zh4Fo/1779761089837.jpg)




***

Eso es el marpacífico para mí, algo parecido a un recordatorio rojo de que, en esta isla nuestra, tan vertiginosa y agreste, siempre habrá un oasis esperando a que te lo pongas en el pelo.

title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body: >\n\nHello, cinema fans. Today we’re back with another fantastic sequel that revolutionized cinema in the early ’90s. It’s another sequel that this great director left us to show us how to surpass the genre’s classic works with something far more fascinating and special. Terminator 2: Judgment Day is a film co-written, produced, and directed by
>James Cameron himself. The film stars Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton, and Robert Patrick. Discover the sequel that brought one of the best science fiction stories to a close.

>
Hola, fanáticos del cine. Hoy volvemos con otra grandiosa secuela que ha revolucionado el cine a principios de la década de los 90. Otra secuela que este gran director nos dejó para enseñarnos cómo es que se deben de superar a las clásicas obras del género con algo mucho más fascinante y especial. Terminator 2: Judgment Day es una película coescrita, producida y dirigida por el mismísimo James Cameron. La película cuenta con el protagonismo de Arnold Schwarzenegger, Linda Hamilton y Robert Patrick. Conoce la secuela que le dió fin a una de las mejores historias de la ciencia ficción.

>

Plot

The film opens with a vision of a post-apocalyptic future as a voice narrates the events that took place. In this future, much of humanity has been completely wiped out due to a global nuclear attack caused by an Artificial Intelligence known as Skynet. This event is known as “Judgment Day,” and ever since, humanity has been at war with the machines in this dystopian world. Then, the voice narrating the story tells us that the leader of this revolution is none other than John Connor. We then jump back in time to a period when this revolutionary leader was just a teenager.

>

Trama

La película inicia con una visión de un futuro post-apocalíptico mientras una voz nos cuenta lo sucedido. En dicho futuro, gran parte de la humanidad ha sido aniquilada por completo debido a un ataque nuclear a nivel mundial causado por una Inteligencia Artificial conocida como Skynet. Dicho suceso es conocido como “El Día del Juicio Final” y desde entonces la humanidad ha estado en guerra con las máquinas en este mundo distópico. Luego, la voz que nos narra todo esto nos cuenta que el líder de dicha revolución es nada menos que John Connor. Acto seguido, vamos al pasado, en una época en la que dicho líder revolucionario era apenas un adolescente.
>\n\nWe continue with another unforgettable sequel from the past that has left a lasting impression on more than one generation. The main sequel to the iconic film <strong><a href=\

>The Terminator is a work that deserves to be recognized as a masterpiece of the last century. A film that inspired future generations of action and science fiction movies due to its direction and its modern approach to blending practical effects with computer-generated effects. But all of this pales in comparison to the film’s impressive narrative twist and screenplay, which completely transforms what we already knew about the classic ’80s film. Terminator 2: Judgment Day is considered one of the best sequels in the history of cinema. This is evident simply by watching the first half-hour of the film, which continues a story that, in the previous film, primarily featured elements of horror and suspense. This time, James Cameron decides to reimagine everything we knew and offers us a change that really resonated with the story, as well as giving a certain emotional depth to a character who shouldn’t have it. As if that weren’t enough, the director himself also decided to give us a more-than-perfect conclusion to the story.

>
Seguimos con otra secuela inolvidable del pasado que ha logrado calar hondo en más de una generación. La secuela principal de la icónica película de The Terminator es algo que merece ser apreciada como una obra maestra del siglo pasado. Una cinta que inspiró a futuras generaciones de películas de acción y ciencia ficción debido a su dirección y su manera moderna de mezclar los efectos prácticos junto con los efectos hechos por computadora. Pero todo esto no es nada comparado con el impresionante giro narrativo y guión que posee la película, la cual cambia por completo lo que ya conocíamos de la clásica cinta ochentera. Terminator 2: Judgement Day es catalogada como una de las mejores secuelas de toda la historia del cine. Esto se puede confirmar simplemente con ver su primera media hora de película, la cual nos ofrece la continuación de una historia que, principalmente, poseía ciertos matices de terror y suspenso en su cinta anterior. Esta vez, James Cameron decide reformular todo lo conocido y nos ofrece un cambio que llegó a calar muy bien en la historia, además de darle cierto sentimiento a un personaje que no debería de tenerlo. Por si no fuera suficiente con esto, el mismo director decidió también darnos un cierre más que perfecto a dicha historia.

> A conclusion that, unfortunately, the producers of this franchise chose not to honor, instead deciding to exploit it further and further by churning out more and more sequels that strayed quite far from the core concept of the original film James Cameron gave us. When I recently commented on someone else’s post about this movie in this community, I casually mentioned that, after this great sequel, Cameron didn’t really do much else with the Terminator films. The author of the review replied that he “had nothing else to do.” Now that I’ve rewatched this movie, I understand exactly what he meant. Judgment Day is the perfect and well-deserved conclusion to that story; there was no need for yet another sequel, and none of the ones released later had what James Cameron offered us here. Obviously, no one but himself knows how to handle the story and universe he created. There have been dozens of interpretations, some brought to the big screen and others to various streaming platforms, but none managed to convey everything this movie conveyed to us back then.

>
Un cierre que, lamentablemente, los productores de esta franquicia no quisieron respetar y que decidieron explotar cada vez más extendiéndola con más y más secuelas que se alejaron bastante de la idea principal de la obra que nos dió James Cameron. Cuando comenté hace poco en una publicación de otra persona que había hablado de esta película en está comunidad, casualmente dije que, luego de esta gran secuela, Cameron no llegó a particular más en otras películas de Terminator. El dueño de la reseña me respondió que él “no tenía nada más que hacer”. Ahora que he vuelto a ver esta película entiendo perfectamente a lo que se refería. Judgement Day es el cierre perfecto y merecido de dicha historia, no hacía falta tener que hacer otra secuela más y ninguna de las que llegaron a sacar en el futuro tenían eso que James Cameron nos ofreció aquí. Obviamente, nadie más que él mismo sabe cómo manejar la historia y universo que él mismo ha creado. Han habido decenas de interpretaciones, algunas llevadas a la pantalla grande y otras a distintas plataformas de streaming, pero ninguna llegó a transmitir todo lo que nos transmitió en su momento esta película.

> My experience with this series has been an emotional rollercoaster, reaching its peak with the third and most controversial installment of the franchise, which ended up being a “rehash” of this second film. But obviously, it was the visual effects that captivated a young and innocent Natto back then. As has been the case with other major film franchises, Terminator was part of my childhood and adolescence because it was one of the movies I watched most often on TV as a kid. Now, as an adult, I’ve come to appreciate these first two installments of the franchise with fresh eyes. It’s true that the film lacks certain visual details, especially in its use of computer-generated visual effects. But this is largely due to the era in which it was produced and released, which was already a marvel in its own right at the time. In fact, one could say that the film has aged quite well, with those very visual details serving as elements that make this Terminator sequel special. Beyond that, I consider the film itself to be a complete cinematic masterpiece from start to finish that managed to revolutionize the world of cinema.

>
Mi experiencia con esta saga es un viaje de emociones, llegando a su punto máximo con la tercera y más polémica entrega de la franquicia, la cual terminó siendo un “refrito” de esta segunda película. Pero obviamente los efectos visuales fueron los que llegaron a fascinar a un pequeño e inocente Natto en su momento. Como ha sucedido con otras grandes franquicias cinematográficas, Terminator formó parte de mi infancia y adolescencia gracias a que era de las películas que más veía de pequeño en la televisión. Ahora, ya después de grande, fue que logré apreciar con otros ojos a estas dos primeras entregas de la franquicia. Si es cierto que la película carece de ciertos detalles visuales, sobre todo en el uso de los efectos visuales hechos por computadora. Pero esto se debe más a la época en la que fue producida y estrenada, lo cual ya para aquel entonces fue una completa maravilla. Es más, actualmente se puede decir que la película ha logrado envejecer bastante bien, teniendo dichos detalles visuales como elementos que hacen especial esta secuela de Terminator. De resto, considero que la película como tal es una completa obra maestra cinematográfica de principio a fin que logró revolucionar el mundo del cine.

> Not only in terms of its audiovisual elements, but also in its plot and story, which is set more than a decade after the events of the first Terminator film. We meet a teenage John Connor living with an adoptive family because his mother, Sarah Connor, is confined to a psychiatric hospital where she is treated as someone with severe schizophrenic issues. This has caused our young protagonist to act out, spending most of his time on the streets, robbing ATMs, and ignoring his adoptive parents. After a strict upbringing where he spent most of his childhood learning all sorts of strategies and skills to help them survive a global catastrophe, John Connor grew up with a worldview very different from how any other young person his age would see the world. After learning that his mother has been confined for allegedly having psychological issues due to “imagining a post-apocalyptic future with human-exterminating machines,” John is completely disillusioned, viewing his own mother as a lost cause, and seeks to reclaim his lost childhood by doing whatever he pleases.

>
No solo a nivel audiovisual, sino también con su trama e historia, la cual está ambientada más de una década después de los sucesos ocurridos en la primera película de Terminator. Conocemos a un John Connor de adolescente viviendo con una familia adoptada debido a que su madre, Sarah Connor, está confinada en un hospital psiquiátrico donde es tratada como una persona con problemas esquizofrénicos graves. Esto ha hecho que nuestro pequeño protagonista se comporte de manera rebelde andando en la calle casi todo el tiempo mientras roba cajeros automáticos e ignora a sus padres adoptivos. Luego de una crianza severa donde mayor parte de su infancia fue aprendiendo todo tipo de estrategias y cosas que les ayudaría a sobrevivir a una catástrofe mundial, John Connor creció con una visión del mundo muy diferente a como debería de verlo cualquier joven de su edad. Luego de la noticia de que su madre es confinada por suponer que tiene problemas psicológicos al “imaginarse un futuro post-apocalíptico con máquinas exterminadoras de humanos”, John se queda decepcionado por completo, viendo a su propia madre como un caso perdido y busca recuperar su infancia perdida haciendo lo que le dé la gana.

> I think the psychological roles played by both John and Sarah Connor in this film deserve to be highlighted here because of everything they signify. I really liked the abrupt change Sarah underwent in this sequel following the traumatic experience she went through in the previous film. Surviving a killing machine completely changed her life, as you’d expect, but what’s interesting is everything she went on to do to prepare for that catastrophic future. Over time, Sarah went from being a normal, fun-loving girl to becoming a woman dangerously trained to kill. Do you see what I mean by the abrupt change Sarah Connor underwent in this second installment? This character definitely became a great role model for all those “independent” women and mothers of that era—and of today as well. But what caught my attention most about this character is how all her preparation and training were aimed at confronting that “destiny” she envisioned—even in her dreams—of what the future would be. However, after everything we see in this movie, that vision of the future changes, and with it, her personality does as well.

>
Creo que el papel psicológico que poseen tanto John como Sarah Connor en esta película merece destacarse aquí debido a todo lo que esto significa. Me gustó mucho el cambio abrupto que tuvo Sarah en esta secuela luego de la traumática experiencia que vivió en la película anterior. El sobrevivir a una máquina exterminadora le cambió la vida por completo, como es de esperarse, pero lo interesante es todo lo que llegó a hacer después para prepararse para ese catastrófico futuro. Durante todo este tiempo, Sarah pasó de ser una chica normal y divertida a convertirse en una mujer peligrosamente entrenada para matar. ¿Ya entienden a lo que me refiero con el cambio abrupto que tuvo Sarah Connor en esta segunda entrega? Definitivamente, este personaje consiguió convertirse en un gran ejemplo a seguir para todas esas mujeres y madres “independientes” de aquel entonces y de la actualidad también. Pero lo que más me llamó la atención de este personaje es cómo toda su preparación y entrenamiento fue para enfrentarse a ese “destino” que visualizaba hasta en sueños de lo que sería el futuro. Sin embargo, luego de todo lo que vemos en esta película, dicha visión del futuro cambia y junto con ella su personalidad también.

> On the other hand, John Connor is the perfect protagonist for this film, not only because of his rebellious personality, but also because of his emotional intelligence and the moral values he upholds. Despite having had a tough upbringing and a negative view of authority figures, John has a certain moral compass when it comes to life. We see this most clearly in his encounter with the Terminator who came from the future to protect him. By the way, the decision to turn the Terminator—who was the main villain in the previous film—into an ally is such an excellent change that it was even replicated in the franchise’s subsequent sequels. But what’s interesting about this isn’t his role in the film, but the irony that a robot created to exterminate humans receives the order “do not kill” from young John Connor. Yes, it sounds a bit absurd at first, but then we come to understand the reason behind that order. More than a sense of morality, it’s a valuable lesson for our Terminator, who also comes to learn certain things about humanity. One of those things is sadness—or rather, the reason why humans cry. That emotion, despite being something he cannot do, he ended up understanding in the end.

>
Por otro lado, John Connor es el protagonista perfecto para esta película, no solo por su personalidad rebelde, sino por su inteligencia emocional y las morales que defiende. A pesar de tener una crianza dura y una visión negativa de las autoridades, John tiene cierta moral con lo que respecta a la vida. Esto lo vemos más claramente con el encuentro que tiene con el Exterminador que vino del futuro para protegerlo. Por cierto, dicho detalle de hacer del Exterminador -que en la película anterior era el villano principal- en un aliado es un cambio tan excelente que incluso fue replicado en las siguientes secuelas de la franquicia. Pero lo interesante de esto no es su participación en la película, sino la ironía de que un robot creado para exterminar humanos reciba la orden de “no matar” de parte del joven John Connor. Si, suena un tanto absurdo al principio, pero luego llegamos a comprender la razón del por qué dicha orden. Más que un sentido de moralidad, es una lección valiosa para nuestro Exterminador, quien también llega a aprender ciertas cosas sobre la humanidad. Una de esas cosas es la tristeza, o mejor dicho la razón del por qué los humanos lloran. Dicha emoción, a pesar de ser algo que él no puede hacer, lo terminó comprendiendo al final.

> John Connor not only manages to turn the dangerous Terminator into one of the best characters in the entire franchise, but he also manages to teach a robot the meaning of life. Another thing worth noting is the unique and unforgettable bond John shares with the Terminator, which can be compared to the relationship between a father and his son or two close friends. The chemistry they share from start to finish is excellent, as it makes it abundantly clear that even a machine is capable of being a great friend. While the idea of turning humanity’s most dangerous weapon into an ally is common in today’s cinema, it was truly fascinating at the time. James Cameron is a genius when it comes to crafting a story that really hooks us. In this second installment of Terminator, he consistently challenges and subverts everything we thought we knew from the first film. We see this not only in the case of the Terminator ally that John gains, but also in the way the story concludes in a manner that makes perfect sense. This sequel always manages to connect with the previous film, but at the same time it also breaks certain patterns and delivers plot twists that are quite fascinating. Not to mention the film’s main villain, which is another of its marvels.

>
John Connor no solo logra convertir al peligroso Exterminador en uno de los mejores personajes de toda esta franquicia, sino que también consigue enseñarle a un robot el sentido de la vida. Otra cosa a destacar es la relación tan peculiar e inolvidable que tiene John con el Exterminador, el cual se puede comparar a la relación que tiene un padre con su hijo o dos grandes amigos. Dicha química que tienen de principio a fin es excelente ya que nos deja bien en claro que hasta una máquina es capaz de ser un gran amigo. Dicha naturaleza de convertir al arma más peligrosa de la humanidad en un aliado es normal verlo en el cine actual, pero en su momento fue algo fascinante. James Cameron es un genio al momento de crear una historia que nos llegue a enganchar bastante bien. En esta segunda entrega de Terminator siempre consigue desafiar y cambiar todo lo que ya aprendíamos de la primera entrega. No solo lo vemos con el caso del Exterminador aliado que consigue John, sino también en la forma en la que termina todo de una manera en la que consigue tener sentido. Esta secuela siempre consigue conectar con la anterior entrega, pero a su vez también cambia ciertos patrones y nos dan ciertos giros de trama que fascinan bastante. Eso sin mencionar el villano principal de la película, la cual es otra de las maravillas que posee.

> The T-1000 is a model that has gone down in history and defied the film’s lack of logic with its unique design. A machine made entirely of malleable liquid metal that replicates anything it touches that has its own shape or size (except for other machines or weapons). A virtually invincible robot that becomes the main enemy to defeat in this film. Every time it appears, it’s a marvel, especially because it manages to convey that coldness and cruelty in a way that requires almost no dialogue. Its manner of acting, behaving, and attacking alone is more than enough to convey everything a dangerous and intelligent machine possesses. Another highlight of this film is the action scenes, which are perfect for their time, especially because of how James Cameron manages to construct each shot or setting for those moments. The film manages to entertain throughout its more than two-hour runtime, offering scenes that are practically unforgettable. At this point, I think it’s worth mentioning the film’s audiovisual aspects, as Cameron himself managed to outdo himself by producing and directing this sequel. Both the camera work and the use of static and slow-motion shots are fascinating.

>
El T-1000 es un modelo que logró pasar a la posteridad y que desafío el poco sentido de lógica de la película con su diseño tan particular. Una máquina hecha 100% de metal líquido modelable que replica todo lo que toca y que tenga su propia contextura o tamaño (exceptuando otras máquinas o armas). Un robot prácticamente invencible que se vuelve el principal enemigo a vencer en esta película. Cada vez que aparece es una maravilla, sobre todo porque logra transmitir esa frialdad y crueldad de una manera que no necesita de casi ningún diálogo. Con solo su forma de actuar, comportarse y atacar ya es más que suficiente para transmitir todo lo que una máquina peligrosa e inteligente posee. Otra cosa a destacar de esta película son las escenas de acción, las cuales son perfectas para su época, sobre todo por cómo James Cameron logra construir cada plano o escenario para dichos momentos. La película logra entretener en su más de dos horas de duración, consiguiendo ofrecer escenarios que son prácticamente inolvidables. Para este punto creo que es idóneo mencionarles el apartado audiovisual que posee esta película, la cual el mismo Cameron logró superarse a sí mismo al producir y dirigir dicha secuela. Tanto el uso de cámaras como los planos fijos y en movimiento lento son fascinantes.

> The same goes for the film’s cool and varied color palette, as well as its use of light and shadow. Something I really liked about this film is the impeccable quality of every scene, which is perfectly composed so that each character stands out quite well. James Cameron managed to deliver a spectacular audiovisual experience by balancing perfectly composed shots with flawless performances, well-executed practical visual effects, and expertly integrated sound effects. These effects stood out so much that even today they remain a benchmark of excellence. We can’t say the same for the computer-generated visual effects, but they’ve aged quite well nonetheless. The film successfully conveys the tension and action it aims for in every scene with a perfect variety of visual elements and transitions that make a strong impact. There is a certain scene in this film that has become more than iconic, much like Sarah Connor’s dream. That scene, while not the best visually, perfectly conveys the desperation and the terrible fate that awaits this world. The soundtrack, like the sound effects, really stands out, especially in the action scenes. In short, here’s another cinematic gem you simply must see.
Personally, I give it a well-deserved 10/10 rating in the action, science fiction, and suspense genres.

>
Lo mismo sucede con la paleta fría y variada de colores, al igual que el uso de luces y sombras en la película. Algo que me gustó mucho de esta película es la calidad impecable de cada escena, compuesta perfectamente para que cada personaje logre destacarse bastante bien. James Cameron logró darnos un gran espectáculo audiovisual al equilibrar los planos perfectamente compuestos con actuaciones perfectas, efectos visuales prácticos bien hechos y efectos de sonido muy bien añadidos. Los mismos efectos consiguieron destacarse tanto que aún en la actualidad son una completa excelencia. No podemos decir lo mismo de los efectos visuales hechos por computadora, pero igual envejecieron muy bien. La película logra transmitir la tensión y la acción que busca en cada escenario con una variedad perfecta de elementos visuales y transiciones que logran impactar muy bien. Hay cierta escena en esta película que pasa a ser más que icónica como lo fue el sueño de Sarah Connor. Dicha escena, si bien no es la mejor a nivel visual, logra transmitir perfectamente la desesperación y el terrible destino que tiene este mundo. La banda sonora, al igual que los efectos de sonido, logran destacarse bastante bien, sobre todo en escenas de acción. En fin, aquí les dejo otra gran joya del cine que deben de ver.
Personalmente, le doy una merecida calificación de 10/10 en lo que respecta al género de acción, ciencia ficción y suspenso.

>
Tell me, have you seen this movie yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

title: Harmony.
body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g6103a946bcc3974d27358c5f2d0a8d3215ca77dfe66b854196f76db7acf381e924cbed258c7dc0ba468955bfb59cf815308095a1442f79394c15599afb4e1510_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a quaint village nestled between rolling hills, there lived a community known for its unparalleled harmony. The villagers prided themselves on their ability to resolve conflicts peacefully, share resources generously, and celebrate each other's differences. They believed that true harmony was the key to their happiness.

## The Festival of Unity

Every year, the villagers held a grand Festival of Unity, where they would gather to share stories, music, and food. It was a time when everyone put aside their differences and embraced the spirit of togetherness. As the festival approached, excitement filled the air, and preparations began in earnest.

## A New Voice

One day, a traveler arrived in the village. She was a skilled musician and carried a unique instrument. Intrigued by the festival, she offered to perform a song that celebrated the beauty of diversity. The villagers, eager to maintain their harmonious reputation, hesitated. They feared that introducing a new element might disrupt the balance they had cultivated for so long.

## The Dilemma

As the festival day arrived, the villagers gathered in the square, their hearts filled with anticipation. The traveler, sensing their reluctance, approached the village elder and said, \

The elder pondered her words but ultimately decided to stick to the traditional program, believing it would preserve their cherished harmony. The traveler, feeling disheartened, chose to leave the village.

## The Consequence

As the festival commenced, the villagers danced and sang their usual songs. However, as the day wore on, a sense of monotony began to creep in. The laughter felt forced, and the smiles seemed less genuine. The villagers realized that while they had maintained their harmony, they had also stifled their growth and creativity.

The absence of the traveler's unique song left a void that echoed through the village. The villagers began to understand that true harmony requires the courage to embrace change and welcome new perspectives.

## The Lesson

In the weeks that followed, the villagers reflected on their experience. They learned that harmony is not merely the absence of conflict but the presence of understanding and acceptance. They reached out to the traveler, inviting her back to share her music and her story.

Together, they wove a tapestry of sounds, blending the old with the new. The village transformed into a vibrant community where differences were celebrated, and harmony thrived in its most authentic form.

## Conclusion

The tale of the Harmonious Village serves as a reminder that while harmony is a noble pursuit, it must not come at the cost of individuality and diversity. Embracing change and welcoming new voices can enrich our lives and deepen our connections.
