I think the DAARG DEADBLAST card is an addition to my water team. Water units are usually strong and balanced. The DAARG DEADBLAST card makes them even stronger. When I use the DAARG DEADBLAST card with a summoner my whole team gets better. This helps me win ranked matches.

The design of the DAARG DEADBLAST card is also really cool. The artwork is beautiful and scary. You can tell that the DAARG DEADBLAST card is an unit just by looking at it. It is fun to use a card that looks so good. The DAARG DEADBLAST card is not just strong it also looks great.

When I bought the DAARG DEADBLAST card I was really excited. I had been looking for a legendary water card for a long time and I was happy to finally get the DAARG DEADBLAST card. Now I can play the game better. Try new strategies. I think the DAARG DEADBLAST card will help me win battles, especially against tough opponents.

Overall the DAARG DEADBLAST card is really valuable to me. Its attack power, health, speed, abilities and future potential are all great. I think the DAARG DEADBLAST card will make my gaming experience better and help me win battles. As a gamer getting a legendary card, like the DAARG DEADBLAST card is a big deal and makes me really happy.

title.title: The Weight of Moments -  B&W PHOTOGRAPHY - from São Paulo - Brasil II ENG - PT_BR II ( 09 Shots )
title.body:
![TEMPLATE ART ALIEN HIVE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/48Y9RAV9U7DeAZVasBnc2daoy7NnvHu5rvv3qG7CMMqJkvpnMaQijVM4hgGvdynWnb.jpg)










Photographing the street for me has always been much more than producing a pretty picture. There's a feeling that's hard to explain when I walk through the city without knowing exactly what I'll find, just letting my gaze follow everything that happens around me. The street has movement, silence, chaos, memory, and truth. Each place I pass through carries some detail that deserves to be observed more calmly, even if many people cross that same path every day without noticing anything. That's precisely what keeps me hooked on street photography, this possibility of transforming simple moments into something that lasts.





> Fotografar a rua pra mim sempre foi muito mais do que produzir uma imagem bonita. Existe uma sensação difícil de explicar quando eu saio caminhando pela cidade sem saber exatamente o que vou encontrar, apenas deixando o olhar acompanhar tudo que acontece ao redor. A rua tem movimento, tem silêncio, tem caos, tem memória e tem verdade. Cada lugar por onde eu passo carrega algum detalhe que merece ser observado com mais calma, mesmo que muita gente atravesse aquele mesmo caminho todos os dias sem perceber nada. É justamente isso que me prende na fotografia de rua, essa possibilidade de transformar momentos simples em algo que permanece.
------------------------















![_MG_3270pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xL92pwAdMdt4f7aw8jbP6jWRM8jhSr9DxbjhuPknE7pQTkToNZ39svi9JFKT3z2yeQD.jpg)








📷 **01.** / Canon EOS 60D




















![_MG_3273pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wCEE8kUmkkJKe32efdZN2DaxjH37s6QVGBuYVCxwyPEKwb6ZNb6g8LMbsjsXHtpcQ8U.jpg)







📷 **02.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

When I'm photographing, I feel as if the city speaks through the small details. A wall marked by time, a light piercing through smoke, a person standing waiting for the bus, someone crossing the street distractedly, the worn concrete, the wires in the sky, the shops opening early, the shadows at the end of the afternoon—all of this creates an atmosphere that only exists in that instant. And the craziest thing is that no moment repeats itself in the same way. The street changes all the time. The same corner can carry a completely different energy depending on the time of day, the rain, the light, or the people passing by.



> Quando estou fotografando, sinto como se a cidade falasse através dos pequenos detalhes. Um muro marcado pelo tempo, uma luz atravessando a fumaça, uma pessoa parada esperando o ônibus, alguém atravessando a rua distraído, o concreto desgastado, os fios no céu, os comércios abrindo cedo, as sombras no final da tarde, tudo isso cria uma atmosfera que só existe naquele instante. E o mais louco é que nenhum momento se repete da mesma forma. A rua muda o tempo inteiro. A mesma esquina pode carregar uma energia completamente diferente dependendo do horário, da chuva, da luz ou das pessoas que passam por ali.
------------------------


















![_MG_3277pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23w2gVpwvC8MHx1CPVWAiguNUPSqaz75MqSgozHGcyjF1ZARBVxmEbFKYAFK7uuCm7txu.jpg)







📷 **03.**  / Canon EOS 60D
























![_MG_3316pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23vhW5dLPVb6hpbmTnxeSymMBJFu9i7Y4jUMoH8Prcdr1dhvmGjbYbFJ2W2EYJce3Q1AF.jpg)





📷 **04.**  / Canon EOS 60D



















![_MG_3322pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23uQvSgqMTwyGm5RGAenKL7nCrwKQEnFKVYAwX8XNMRmbmhLvWMHFQ64x5Tpb3EWkZ8wU.jpg)





📷 **05.**  / Canon EOS 60D




------------------------

I really like this idea of ​​capturing everyday life in a genuine way, without trying to force anything. The photos end up emerging naturally, as I walk, observe, and feel the environment. Often, the image isn't just in what appears, but in the feeling that the scene conveys. Some days the city seems heavy, fast-paced, and noisy. At other times it seems silent, almost still, as if it were breathing slowly. And photographing ends up being a way of preserving these atmospheres, as if each click freezes not only a scene, but also the energy of that moment.



> Eu gosto muito dessa ideia de registrar o cotidiano de uma forma verdadeira, sem tentar forçar nada. As fotos acabam surgindo no fluxo, enquanto eu caminho, observo e sinto o ambiente. Muitas vezes a imagem não está apenas no que aparece, mas na sensação que aquele cenário transmite. Tem dias em que a cidade parece pesada, acelerada e barulhenta. Em outros momentos ela parece silenciosa, quase parada, como se estivesse respirando devagar. E fotografar acaba sendo uma forma de guardar essas atmosferas, como se cada clique congelasse não só uma cena, mas também a energia daquele momento.
------------------------














![_MG_3337pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23wqiH91zW9x2R3prBtqGeDRYBotRYhwNSYg7uNqE7MbEtPobKEAp5TWezJTaeNMCicr7.jpg)





📷 **06.**  / Canon EOS 60D




Much of my inspiration comes precisely from the streets I frequent, the places I constantly pass through, and the common scenes that are part of real life. I believe there is great beauty in simple things, especially when they carry identity. The street shows the truth without makeup. It shows the marks of time, of people, and of the stories that have passed through there. And perhaps that's what makes me continue photographing, this desire to see meaning in things that would normally be ignored.eously. The camera became a way to freeze these moments before they disappeared into the flow of the city.


> Grande parte das minhas referências vem justamente das ruas que frequento, dos lugares por onde passo constantemente e das cenas comuns que fazem parte da vida real. Eu acredito que existe muita beleza nas coisas simples, principalmente quando elas carregam identidade. A rua mostra a verdade sem maquiagem. Ela mostra marcas do tempo, das pessoas e das histórias que passaram por ali. E talvez seja isso que me faça continuar fotografando, essa vontade de enxergar significado em coisas que normalmente seriam ignoradas.










![_MG_3362pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/242hWe3XbjNhB9oYU6vqE9BDN7WAMeVxKWsWQC3DWJq7GZXmhrHAhFzWWyyKuTGbGtq4F.jpg)




📷 **07.**  / Canon EOS 60D























![_MG_3368pb.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23xKrQDpLzdcRv57oY8SToVdNhcLCNjRsmJ7NTzvgXttVM1p74kfnZZjg69GUmFdbSSfz.jpg)








📷 **08.**  / Canon EOS 60D





------------------------
Each photograph ends up becoming a piece of the journey, a fragment of memory. When I look at some images after a while, I can remember exactly the feeling of that day, the atmosphere, the sounds of the city, the way the light hit the ground, and even the state of my mind at that moment. Street photography has a lot of that for me; it's not just about showing a place, but about conveying presence. It's like creating a record of the connection between me, the city, and everything that happens in it.



> Cada fotografia acaba virando um pedaço do caminho, um fragmento de memória. Quando olho algumas imagens depois de um tempo, consigo lembrar exatamente da sensação daquele dia, do clima, do som da cidade, do jeito que a luz batia no chão e até do estado da minha mente naquele momento. A fotografia de rua tem muito disso pra mim, ela não serve apenas pra mostrar um lugar, mas pra transmitir presença. É como criar um registro da conexão entre eu, a cidade e tudo que acontece nela.

------------------------



















![_MG_3385.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grafvisionsp/23yTjMNn2VrYBNLtCLjgJaSB5GxsWwfkczgtxbkuP9eyq55RjU7XtaguLAic9wcg3UfMA.JPG)






📷 **09.** / Canon EOS 60D


------------------------


Photographing the street is about being attentive. It's about walking without haste, observing more, feeling more, and understanding that there's always a story unfolding, even in the quietest scenes. Because the city never stops, and within that hustle and bustle, there are small moments that deserve to be seen, felt, and remembered.



> fotografar a rua é sobre estar atento. É caminhar sem pressa, observar mais, sentir mais e entender que sempre existe alguma história acontecendo, mesmo nas cenas mais silenciosas. Porque a cidade nunca para, e dentro dessa correria existem pequenos instantes que merecem ser vistos, sentidos e lembrados.





------------------------









------------------------

title.title: There are moments in life. 🇬🇧///Hay momentos en la vida 🇪🇸
title.body:
Eng 🇬🇧 
I want to tell those who are just starting in this world of Hive not to get discouraged. This is a long process, but also a productive one. If you ever need support or advice, don’t be afraid to ask for it. You can also rely on the BBH community 💪💪💪💪
![file_00000000b19471f4a927a298947dc9d7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/241tZ3Dn4Stry9C2JS93XNQbCnaz8rAYJaTKiNpwmzEPVMzwk9x61vQD3sXzJf4kVidFq.png)

There are moments in life when darkness seems stronger than any hope. Days when exhaustion feels too heavy, when emotional wounds, past mistakes, and insecurities make a person feel trapped in a place they cannot escape from. Many times we think darkness is failure, sadness, or pain, but the true darkness appears when we stop believing in ourselves.

Good and evil are not always distant forces or philosophical concepts impossible to touch. They also live within every person in the form of thoughts, decisions, and attitudes. Good appears when we decide to get back up even after falling, when we choose to keep moving forward despite fear, and when we try to improve even in the middle of exhaustion. Evil, on the other hand, can appear in the inner voice that repeats that we are not good enough, that we will never change, or that giving up is easier.

Personal growth begins precisely in that silent battle. It is not about becoming a perfect person or pretending to be happy all the time. It is about recognizing your own darkness without staying trapped inside it. Every person carries wounds, insecurities, and moments of weakness. Denying them does not make them disappear. But facing them with courage transforms pain into learning and failure into experience.

Many times, the worst enemy is not the world itself, but the habit of underestimating ourselves. Some people spend years believing they are incapable of achieving their dreams because someone made them feel small, because they failed once, or because they compare their lives to others. However, every human being has value that does not depend on the opinions of others or on past mistakes. Even in the darkest moments, there is always the possibility of changing, growing, and starting over.

Light does not appear all at once. Sometimes it begins with small actions: getting up on a difficult morning, taking care of your mind, learning something new, asking for help, resting, or simply deciding not to give up. These are small actions that may seem insignificant, but little by little they rebuild confidence and inner strength.

Overcoming yourself does not mean never falling; it means learning to rise again with more wisdom each time. The strongest people are not those who never suffered, but those who faced their darkness and still chose to keep moving forward. Because within every human being there is a constant struggle between the part that wants to give up and the part that still dreams.

And perhaps that is the true triumph of good over evil: not allowing darkness to define who you are. Understanding that even after the worst moments, you can still rebuild yourself, grow, and become a better version of yourself.

As always, I want to ask for support for new accounts such as @milagroscmiranda, who has very good stories.

Thanks to my mom from Canada, @cathyarrow, who is always present even from far away.

And thanks to my wife, the best thing in the world.

God bless you all 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏


![IMG_20260509_184440.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23sUc9x8A2Qqn6mgt7eGV3G9mCNEZQmApgHimF3SZJYMbKhVXTpmy8V5wTqQSYZ8ybTDg.jpg)

Esp 🇪🇸 

![file_00000000b19471f4a927a298947dc9d7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/241tZ3Dn4Stry9C2JS93XNQbCnaz8rAYJaTKiNpwmzEPVMzwk9x61vQD3sXzJf4kVidFq.png)

Hay momentos en la vida 
Quiero decirle a los que recién empiezan en este mundo de hive que no se desanimen que estoy es un proceso largo pero productivo y si necesitan apoyo o algún consejo lo pueden pedir no tengan miedo y también se pueden apoyar en la comunidad BBH 💪 💪 💪 💪 

Hay momentos en la vida donde la oscuridad parece más fuerte que cualquier esperanza. Días en los que el cansancio pesa demasiado, donde las heridas emocionales, los errores del pasado y las inseguridades hacen sentir que uno está atrapado en un lugar del que no puede salir. Muchas veces pensamos que la oscuridad es el fracaso, la tristeza o el dolor, pero la verdadera oscuridad aparece cuando dejamos de creer en nosotros mismos.
El bien y el mal no siempre son fuerzas lejanas o conceptos filosóficos imposibles de tocar. También viven dentro de cada persona en forma de pensamientos, decisiones y actitudes. El bien aparece cuando decidimos levantarnos aun después de caer, cuando elegimos seguir adelante aunque tengamos miedo, cuando tratamos de mejorar incluso en medio del cansancio. El mal, en cambio, puede manifestarse en la voz interna que nos repite que no valemos suficiente, que nunca cambiaremos o que rendirse es más fácil.
La superación personal comienza justamente en esa batalla silenciosa. No se trata de convertirse en alguien perfecto ni de fingir felicidad todo el tiempo. Se trata de reconocer la propia oscuridad sin quedarse viviendo dentro de ella. Toda persona carga heridas, inseguridades y momentos de debilidad. Negarlo no las hace desaparecer. Pero enfrentarlas con valentía transforma el dolor en aprendizaje y la caída en experiencia.
Muchas veces el peor enemigo no es el mundo, sino la costumbre de subestimarse. Hay personas que pasan años creyendo que no son capaces de cumplir sus sueños porque alguien les hizo sentir pequeñas, porque fracasaron una vez o porque comparan su vida con la de otros. Sin embargo, cada ser humano tiene un valor que no depende de la opinión ajena ni de los errores cometidos. Incluso en los momentos más oscuros existe la posibilidad de cambiar, crecer y volver a empezar.
La luz no aparece de golpe. A veces comienza con acciones pequeñas: levantarse una mañana difícil, cuidar la mente, aprender algo nuevo, pedir ayuda, descansar o simplemente decidir no rendirse. Son pequeños actos que parecen insignificantes, pero que poco a poco reconstruyen la confianza y la fuerza interior.
Superarse no significa nunca caer; significa aprender a levantarse con más sabiduría cada vez. Las personas más fuertes no son las que jamás sufrieron, sino aquellas que enfrentaron su oscuridad y aun así eligieron seguir avanzando. Porque dentro de cada ser humano existe una lucha constante entre la parte que quiere rendirse y la parte que todavía sueña.
Y quizás ahí está el verdadero triunfo del bien sobre el mal: en no permitir que la oscuridad defina quién eres. En entender que incluso después de los peores momentos todavía puedes reconstruirte, crecer y convertirte en una mejor versión de ti mismo.
Cómo siempre pedir el apoyo a cuentas que recién empiezan como @milagroscmiranda que tiene muy buenas historias 
Gracias a mí mamá de Canadá @cathyarrow que aún de lejos siempre está presente 
Y gracias a mí esposa lo mejor del mundo 
 Dios los bendiga 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

The Corrupted Wells.
title.body: > After using stealth to eliminate a Ragewalker and a Rainwalker, I cleansed the first corrupted well. A delayed journey forced me to return and recleanse it. Shifting to a fast rooftop route via a Tengu, I reached the second well but was defeated by a Shadow Hunter and its minions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQp3omoJJAWvtdCGSVXTwBRJ1G1u8MDS3ZLcYZGHSgsV/screenshot_1_.png) Yeah, patience gave me good results there as I could take down that Ragewalker in stealth without having any problem, slipping my spell into its weak spot before it could react. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXVB7Svrxa73cgg2xY7fBisATfD6ZJjLRD8GbjoW8nzuB/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcDnTto5LXsRS5AUGAtBofshKaaLMejYE5daK8VVxPVk7/screenshot_3_.png) Then I went for the Rainwalker patrolling nearby, whom I also took down in stealth while staying low behind the overgrown hedges. The demon dissolved silently into dark energy, leaving the immediate vicinity completely empty. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqzG6uvKoeQtgsfo3TgXp45tVEY4qwhXb6X6GYNhbkZD/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRS68paXgJtV1mpmWsbLSX49kfSXxMmzoEhHTJHWhhwBe/screenshot_5_.png) And at last, the area was clear of any demon patrol blocking my progress. But the well was devastated, as you can see, which looked like filled with demons and thick black corruption pooling deep inside. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdo3RJi8GZro6ugVEMUK5CNdYt7j2SReL6D3Hu1rykdFo/screenshot_6_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXzyRw2Q9F9k9a8A4W4pdnznGXsswW5rL9BUnW1hVkt6X/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoech2RbG98pjqmCRkneRTs2aTJT3M89ypfHDY5Ka4wk/screenshot_8_.png) It was locked with a high spell that I had to break using my spiritual strings. And then I cleansed it, channeling my energy into the core of the reservoir to wash away the lingering malice. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZXrG2mMky5zrtYN33TQdKePYKNshsPo6aCzL6FQmnTwd/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNsgCLC6XgkSaJ8wRC5pioo6CHiWnY7uBo3wBqgtZyuep/screenshot_10_.png) After cleansing that well, I had to be fast in cleansing the next one before the spiritual link broke. Otherwise, the first one would be corrupted again, but I took my time to fight and take down some demons on my way. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdPPWptHEr59jwKv9tzsSFE3BKS6XfPWPpiBCTKhu5PC/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb12WRCtaLUF7cDH4hCMy76Qm5chLaDHq1CDsmagT9f2K/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEpfnE8KNgrATnCE23vPmyMugdmLiHCmVwuLjGpnBsPV/screenshot_13_.png) And yeah, I had to get back to the first well again, as I was too slow to get to the other one through the streets. And this time I took down most of the demons around with arrows, and then I cleansed the well again. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaj7rmWyoBDjj6oca2EqEp72wRm1p66THp3XMyqacPnBW/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbaw7ni7nzz9Nk586EeEDcNPzz1uF6zwKGKPRCBJcMhwM/screenshot_15_.png) This time, I didn't delay much to prevent the corruption from resetting a second time. I used a Tengu to grapple up on a roof and reached the second well real fast through aerial route, and I found it was being guarded by more demons. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW7hRp3VagXUVQQ6FKdjWYPDtAGYmmfSfjthbAVY9sqxa/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdo7UDVPkLyr5ahDGrqs2D3WdmzELQSjtw7c4DVLSYcX8/screenshot_17_.png) I noticed this new kind of demon that's called Shadow Hunter, along with some Paper Dolls, a Marionette, and a Rain Slasher. And I was taken down there by the heavy attacks of the demons before I could establish a defense. We'll continue in another post. --- **Thanks for reading. If you like my post, please follow, comment and upvote me. All the in-game screenshots are taken by me, just the games logo is borrowed from deviantart.** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=hrichakar/d148a054)

title.title: Explorando una nueva ruta, ideal para trabajo de cuestas. 🏔️🏔️
title.body: > Domingo de entrenamiento largo. Hoy me reuni con parte del equipo para el entrenamiento largo de la semana, en mi ciudad se iba a dar inicio a las actividada de vuelo en parapentes desde un lugar alto en la ciudad el cual fue el optimo para este deporte. Resulta que este lugar en las alturas esta ubicado apoximadamente 1,5 kilometros de mi ruta de cuesta favorita, hicimos los calculos para cumplir con el entrenamiento largo y apoyar esta actividad, y antes de subir acumulamos 9,5 kilometros, que incluia mi cuesta favorita. Iniciamos la subida de la segunda cuesta hasta llegar al lugar escogido para el lanzamiento de los parapentes, una cuesta muy buena para entrenar, me encanto, espaciosa, con vegetacion abundante, y una maravillosa vista de la ciudad. --- Cuando llegamos al lugar estaban algunas autoridades con hidratacion, y frutas para los runners, ciclistas, que fueron invitados para la inauguracion de los parapentes en la ciudad. Estuvimos alli un rato apoyando el evento, y ambiente muy bonito, deportivo disfrutamos en esta ruta larga del fin de semana. Si que completar esta ruta completa hasta este punto es un buen entrenamiento para fortalecernos como runners, ya que es exigente pero no tanto, por lo cual la bajada no nos va a causar lesiones, ya que esto es lo que mas cuidamos en las subidas, las bajadas que es donde nos podemos lesionar. En total fueron 11 kilometros hasta la ultima cuesta, con un desnivel de 291 metros, y un tiempo total de una hora y treinta minutos cumpliendo asi con el tiempo estimado para los entrenamientos largos. les invito amigos a mi ciudad a conocer este hermoso lugar. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Long training Sunday. Today I met up with part of the team for this week’s long training session. In my city, paragliding activities were set to begin from a high point in the city, which was ideal for this sport. It turns out that this high-altitude spot is located about 1.5 kilometers from my favorite hill route. We did the math to fit in the long training session and support this activity, and before heading up, we covered 9.5 kilometers, which included my favorite hill. We began the climb up the second hill until we reached the spot chosen for the paraglider launch—a great hill for training. I loved it: spacious, with abundant vegetation, and a wonderful view of the city. --- >When we arrived, there were some officials there with water and fruit for the runners and cyclists who had been invited to the opening of the Paparentes event in the city. We stayed there for a while to support the event; the atmosphere was lovely and sporty, and we enjoyed this long weekend route. Completing this entire route up to this point is indeed good training to strengthen us as runners, since it’s demanding but not too much, so the descent won’t cause us injuries—which is what we’re most careful about on the climbs, since the descents are where we can get injured. In total, it was 11 kilometers to the last hill, with an elevation gain of 291 meters, and a total time of one hour and thirty minutes, thus meeting the estimated time for long runs. I invite you, friends, to my city to discover this beautiful place. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/VHSlTJDpr3b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/VHSlTJDpr3b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/explorando-una-nueva-ruta-ideal-para-trabajo-de-cuestas)

title.title: Holozing Fan Art | Healer-Knight of Light and Dragon Emberion inside the cave ✨🔥
title.body:
>

Good evening, my dear readers in the #HIVE art community! Happy Monday and happy start to the week to everyone. I hope you’re all doing very well and that you enjoyed your weekend. Your friend Manuel is here to say hello once again, and I’m thrilled to share a new art post on my blog with you. >*Muy buenas noches mis queridísimos lectores y lectoras de la comunidad artística de #HIVE, feliz lunes y feliz inicio de semana para todos, espero que se encuentren muy muy bien, que hayan disfrutado de su fin de semana, por aquí los saluda una vez mas su amigo Manuel super feliz de poder compartirles un nuevo post artístico para mi blog.*

![48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJhUVPt7rWtMCaP5JyoueDvdsrMrQkVS61rDUgLQHjrB7Lw6JnPRg3LBFbfyMGX.jpg)
This time, I’m sharing a new piece I’ve been working on over the past weekend. It’s a depiction of the Healer of Light from the game created by my dear friends in the #Holozing community, but he wouldn’t be alone—I decided to pair him with the Fire-type elemental dragon (EMBERION), because my idea was to set the piece in a sort of medieval-style world of knights and dragons… I hope you really like my idea, and here I’ll share a bit of the creative process so you can appreciate it better: >*En esta oportunidad les traigo una nueva obra en la cual estuve trabajado durante este fin de semana que paso, se trata de una representación sobre el Sanador de la luz del juego de mis queridos amigos de la comunidad de #Holozing, pero no se encontraría solo, decidí acompañarlo del dragón elemental de tipo Fuego (EMBERION), y es que mi idea fue la de ambientar la obra en una especie de representación medieval de caballeros y dragones…espero les guste mucho mi idea, y aquí los dejare con un poco del proceso de creación para que lo aprecien mejor:* ###
PROCESS / PROCESO
![0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFJ3X924nNzc7YcbLpE373gHxi4FiWxpXDSuWB8TVDFc33DnfHWqpLoLt4m3A.jpg)
Essentially, my idea was to have both the Knight of Light and the dragon (EMBERION) deep inside a dark and dangerous cave. For the Knight of Light, I gave him a battle-ready pose, holding his great knight’s sword in front of him, while the small fire dragon (EMBERION) perches on his right shoulder. After finishing the sketch, I moved on to the coloring process. For the base skin tones, I used shades like salmon and light peach; the idea was to convey the essence of a fairly young Knight of the Light. >*En esencia la idea que tuve fue que tanto el caballero Sanador de la luz como el dragón (EMBERION) estuviesen internados explorando en una especie de oscura y peligrosa cueva, en el caso del Sanadora de la luz adopte una pose como de batalla, sosteniendo su gran espada de caballero frente a él; mientras que sobre su hombro derecho estaría posado el pequeño dragón de Fuego (EMBERION). Habiendo culminado con el boceto proseguí con el proceso de coloreado, en el caso de la base de la piel usé tonos como el Salmon y el durazno claro, la idea era transmitir la esencia de un caballero Sanador de la luz bastante joven.*
![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFF7yVnuAZcgiyZAcktY12JfT9BvEjgnforaubWs32U3TmZYyfo5PVDXcqdgH.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFF7yVo762AP22b33GCMFTtkrKv5TYvqmBJZysc3CNoqMDQfaNa3a5ULAjyCN.jpg) ![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFF7yVo762HBYHDoikYYMZUvM344Wp8VSVBsaT9ysgfcwkq5MJPhT9s5zDhU5.jpg)
As for the clothing design, I tailored it heavily to the knights-and-dragons theme. I chose to use shades of gray to create the base layer of the outfit, which would extend from the neck down to the legs; and then, using very light gray and yellow tones, I created a second outer layer—something like a large, long-sleeved nightgown with a white leather texture; and using yellow and orange tones, I added details to the chest area, such as a large cross, which represents the Healers of the Light. >*En cuanto al trabajo de la ropa adapte mucho el diseño de la ropa a la temática de caballeros y dragones, opte por usar tonos grises para crear lo que seria la base del traje básico que iría desde le cuello hasta las piernas; y luego con tonos grises muy claros y amarillos me encargue de crear una 2da prenda superficial, algo así como una gran camisón de mangas largas con textura de cuero blanco; y con los tonos amarillos y naranjas me encargue de crea los detalles en la zona del pecho como seria la especie de gran cruz, la cual es representativa de los Sanadores y Sanadoras de la Luz.*
![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJdFLdpotCixPiB8nYenFya9XoooCwAkL5QVpZLKZp2gFVhVZM1QMhtpSTqKHAS.jpg) ![19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJg7mM2YWMVWEKvFbD99XN5d88gH4q8FdAodkEEGkcZhNe94Ra529jVLsjnraPD.jpg) ![24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/manuel2395/AJizDDv2znUKGk5eHz6p6D2d6JLYmA4R3eNVjkH2MzB3mkZy5DuernQwifQrdY3.jpg)
In the third stage, I focused on creating the little fire dragon (EMBERION). For this, I used a palette dominated by reds. First, I created the basic shape of the body, preserving as many of the original details as possible, such as the horns. Then, using orange tones, I added some detail to the snout area and the tip of the tail with my gradient brush; while for the eyes I used blue tones to give the dragon a rather friendly look. Finally, I set the scene as if they were inside a cave; using brown tones and a rough brush, I textured the floor and walls of the cave, then with longer strokes I created pillars and stalactites extending upward. >*En la 3ra etapa me dedique a la construcción del pequeño dragón de fuego (EMBERION), para el tome una paleta de colores full rojiza, lo primero fue crea la forma básica del cuerpo, manteniendo en lo posible la mayoría de detalles originales como cuernos, luego con tonos naranjas fui detallando un poco la zona del hocico y la punta de la cola con mi pincel de degradado; mientras que para los ojos use tonos azules dando una mirada bastante amigable para el dragón. Finalmente, ambiente todo el escenario como si se encontrasen dentro de una cueva, con tonos marrones y un pincel rugoso texturice el piso y las paredes de la cueva, luego con trazos mas largo cree especies de pilares y estalactitas hacia arriba.*

title.title: Homemade recipe of pot chicken curry
title.body:
Hello hive blogger ! Warm wishes to you all.

Traditional Clay Pot Chicken Curry — Slow-Cooked, Rich, and Comforting 🍲🍗
Today I made chicken curry in a traditional clay pot, and the result was amazing. Cooking in earthenware gives the curry a beautiful earthy aroma and lets the flavors develop slowly and naturally. The chicken turned incredibly tender, coated in rich spiced gravy. A simple homemade dish, but full of warmth, tradition, and flavor.
Simple ingredients, slow heat, and a clay pot—that’s all it takes to create a meal full of warmth, tradition, and unforgettable flavor.
Ingredients
1 kg chicken, cut into pieces
2 medium onions, sliced
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 tablespoon ginger paste
1 tablespoon garlic paste
3–4 green chilies
½ teaspoon turmeric powder
1 teaspoon red chili powder
1 teaspoon coriander powder
½ teaspoon cumin powder
Salt to taste
½ teaspoon black pepper (optional)
2–3 tablespoons mustard oil or cooking oil
Fresh coriander for garnish
Water as needed
Method
Heat oil in the clay pot and fry the onions until golden. Add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, and spices, then cook until fragrant. Add the chicken and mix well so every piece is coated with the masala. Pour in a little water, cover the clay pot, and let it simmer slowly until the chicken becomes soft and tender and the gravy turns rich and flavorful. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.
Best enjoyed with steamed rice, roti, or naan

title.title: Repairing unusual installations in domestic refrigerators [Eng+Spa]
title.body: > * * * Greetings to my dear Hive DIY community! I hope you're having a peaceful week filled with good ideas and good health. Now that my arm is functioning better and I can walk fairly well, I'm doing odd jobs on the street, which is great for my finances, but it leaves me less time to sit down and write posts. So, please excuse the delay between my last posts. This time, I'm going to share part of a repair I did on a client's refrigerator. I couldn't take as many pictures as I wanted, nor could I document the repair process step by step to explain it as I would in the workshop. But the client was kind enough to take some photos while I was working and shared them with me for my records. I found that the refrigerator wasn't cooling. When I accessed the motor and tubing, I could see that a previous technician had done a very poor installation.

> * * * The compressor was secured with plastic clamps and was larger and of a capacity than that refrigerator should have (standard specifications call for a 1/5 HP low-pressure compressor for R134A, but it had a 1/4 HP compressor installed). More than half of all the soldered copper pipes were leaking. The pipe leading up to the condenser coil (the black iron pipe on the back grill) was almost completely kinked; it looked more like a worm gear.

> * * * The other repair service, instead of installing a complete new pipe to repair the copper pipe that evaporates water into the white plastic drain pan, had simply spliced ​​together pieces of pipe.
> * * * That's doing a job with absolutely no respect or professional attention. I removed the entire installation; it was damaged and poorly done. It had to be completely redone.

> * * * The compressor motor is slightly larger than what that unit should have, but replacing the compressor motor was out of the question; it exceeded the client's budget. I have to be careful when charging the refrigerant in the cooling system. I'm going to fill it with less than usual to avoid future problems.
> * * * In the end, I was able to shape the copper pipes correctly, charge them with refrigerant, and eliminate the refrigerant leaks.

> * * * I would have liked to take more and better detailed photos to share, but I couldn't spend too much time at the customer's house. I'm very grateful that the customer took the photos for me and shared them with me. I hope to share more repairs soon. >

>I used Nightcafe to create an image for the cover; it didn't turn out perfectly with the pipes on the wrong side, but in the end I thought it was funny and used it in the post.

\n\n
> * * * Well, thank you so much for stopping by. Have a wonderful week. Peace. * * *

> * * * * I used Google Translate for the English language. * I used TextStudio for the Spanish header. * I used Nightcafe to generate the cover image. * Unless otherwise stated, all images are my own screenshots. * * * * * *

> * * * Saludos a mi querida comunidad DIY de Hive, espero que estén teniendo una semana tranquila llena de buenas ideas y salud. Ahora que mi brazo dejo de fallar tanto y que ya puedo caminar medianamente bien, estoy haciendo trabajos en la calle a domicilio, lo que alegra y mejora mucho mi economía, pero me deja menos tiempo para sentarme a hacer publicaciones, por eso mis disculpas por lo tardado entre las ultimas publicaciones. En esta ocasión les voy a compartir una parte de una reparación que le hice a refrigerador domestico de un cliente. No podía sacarle tantas fotos como queria ni tampoco llevar el procedimiento de reparación paso a paso para explicarlo como lo haría en el taller. Pero el cliente tuvo la amabilidad de sacar algunas fotos mientras hacia el trabajo y me las compartió para mis registros. Me encontré con un que el refrigerador no enfriaba , cuando accedí a la zona del motor y las tuberías pude ver que previamente un servicio técnico había hecho una muy mala instalación.

>

* * * El compresor estaba amarrado con abrazaderas plásticas y era de una capacidad y un tamaño mayor al que debe llevar ese refrigerador (por norma lleva un compresor de 1/5 HP en baja presión para R 134A y tenia instalado un compresor de ¼ HP) Mas de la mitad de todas las soldaduras en las tuberías de cobre tenían fugas, el tubo que subía al serpentín del condensador (la tubería negra de hierro de la parrilla de atrás) estaba casi estrangulado, parecía mas un tornillo sin fin.

>

* * * El otro servicio técnico en vez de colocar un tubo completo para hacer la reparación de la tubería de cobre que evapora el agua en la bandeja plástica blanca del desagüe, había empatado pedazos de tubería.

>

* * * Eso es hacer un trabajo sin ningún respeto ni atención profesional. Quite toda la instalación estaba dañada y mal hecha, tenia que hacerla completa.

>

* * * El motor compresor es un poco mas grande del que debería llevar ese equipo, pero un cambio del motor compresor estaba fuera de discusión, excede el presupuesto del cliente. Tengo que tener cuidado al cargar el refrigerante en el circuito de refrigeración voy a llenar en menor cantidad de lo normal, para que no haya problemas a futuro.

>

* * * Al final pude darle la forma correcta a las tuberías de cobre, cargar de refrigerante y eliminar los problemas de fugas de refrigerante.

>

* * * Me habría gustado hacer mas y mejores fotos detalladas para compartir, pero no podía ocupar demasiado tiempo en la casa del cliente. Estoy muy agradecido que el cliente tomara las fotos por mi y me las compartiera. Espero poder compartir pronto mas reparaciones. >

>Use Nightcafe para crear una imagen para la portada, no quedo perfecta con las tuberias por el lado equivocado, al final me parecio gracioso y la use en la publicacion.

\n\n

>

* * * Bueno, muchas gracias por pasar a leerme. Que tengan una excelente semana. Paz. * * *

title.title: The Lost Boys (1987)Is One Of The Coolest Vampire Movies Ever Made Because It Perfectly Blends Horror, Comedy, Style, And Eighties Attitude. Even Though It Is A Little Corny At Times, It Is Still A Personal Classic To Me Because Of Its Energy
title.body:
Released in 1987 and directed by Joel Schumacher, The Lost Boys helped reinvent vampire movies for a new generation. Before this film, vampires were often portrayed in a more gothic and traditional way. Schumacher took that formula and mixed it with California biker culture, rock music, teenage rebellion, and MTV era style. The result was something completely unique for its time.

![IMG_2061.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUPkVQWQ4fpv8AVX4K5xPRiMV5eRZmaRrc6eX7ZhuMyJD/IMG_2061.webp)

Jason Patric stars as Michael Emerson, a teenager who moves with his family to the fictional coastal town of Santa Carla after his parents split up. Michael quickly gets pulled into the world of a mysterious biker gang led by the charismatic David, and before long he realizes something far darker is happening beneath the town’s boardwalk atmosphere.

Kiefer Sutherland is fantastic as David and honestly creates one of the coolest vampire villains of the eighties. He barely even needs to raise his voice because his confidence and presence do all the work. Sutherland gives David this mix of danger and charisma that makes it believable why Michael gets drawn toward him.

Corey Haim plays Sam Emerson, Michael’s younger brother, bringing humor and nervous energy to the story. Sam becomes the emotional center of the film because he reacts like an actual terrified kid once he realizes vampires are real. Haim’s chemistry with the Frog Brothers adds a lot of the movie’s comedy.

Corey Feldman and Jamison Newlander as Edgar and Alan Frog became cult icons because they fully embrace the ridiculousness of being comic book obsessed teenage vampire hunters. They are absolutely corny in the best possible way, and the movie would not feel the same without them.

Dianne Wiest also deserves praise as Lucy Emerson, the boys’ mother. She brings warmth and sincerity to the family side of the story, which helps ground the crazier horror elements happening around her.

Joel Schumacher directs the film with maximum style. Neon lights, fog, motorcycles, loud rock music, and over the top visuals are everywhere. The movie completely embraces its eighties identity instead of trying to hide it, and honestly that confidence is a huge reason it still works.

The plot itself is simple but effective. Michael slowly falls under the influence of David’s vampire gang while Sam and the Frog Brothers try to save him before he fully turns. It is basically a horror version of teenage peer pressure and rebellion, which gives the story more depth underneath the surface.

One of the best things about The Lost Boys is its atmosphere. Santa Carla feels dangerous and exciting at the same time. The boardwalk, comic shop, concerts, and hidden vampire lairs all create a world that feels alive and memorable.

The soundtrack is also legendary. Songs like “Cry Little Sister” became permanently connected to the movie because the music helps define the entire tone. The film feels like a giant rock video in the best possible way.

Now yes, parts of the movie are definitely corny. Some dialogue is pure eighties cheese, some fashion choices are hilarious now, and certain scenes lean heavily into melodrama. But honestly, that is part of the charm rather than a weakness.

The movie understands exactly what kind of experience it wants to deliver. It is not trying to be dark gothic realism. It wants to be stylish, fun, creepy, and rebellious all at once. That confidence makes the movie endlessly entertaining.

What also helps the film hold up is the balance between horror and humor. It never becomes too serious or too goofy for too long. Schumacher constantly shifts between laughs, suspense, and genuine horror in a way that keeps the pacing strong.

Over time, The Lost Boys became one of the defining cult films of the eighties because it captured such a specific vibe and era perfectly. You can see its influence on later vampire films and television shows everywhere.

![IMG_2062.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWcJhKdnQzay7Lh4861k2JWHTvzv5r3dNwYMB1eKwaqcW/IMG_2062.webp)

In the end, The Lost Boys remains a classic to me because it succeeds at being exactly what it wants to be without holding anything back. The movie mixes horror, comedy, romance, action, and pure eighties style into one unforgettable experience that still feels entertaining decades later. Kiefer Sutherland delivers one of the coolest vampire performances ever, the soundtrack became iconic, and Joel Schumacher created an atmosphere that feels both dangerous and strangely fun at the same time. Yes, some parts are definitely corny now, but honestly that only adds to the charm because the movie never tries to act cooler or smarter than it is. The Lost Boys embraces its wild style completely, and that confidence is exactly why it still stands as one of the most enjoyable vampire films ever made.

title.title: Mensaje diario de 5  minutos: dar marcha atrás por la calle / 5 Minute Freewrite: reverse down the street
title.body:
>



# Peligro

​

#


La crianza va acompañada de mucho además de la educación, están los valores, principios y normas establecidos en la sociedad así como las costumbres y tradiciones de cada familia. Es muy importante dar esos consejos y orientaciones que te servirán para la defensa y desenvolvimiento en la calle; porque te indican sobre un comportamiento adecuado también es bueno saber sobre lo malo y bueno precisamente por seguridad para estar alerta ante cualquier peligro que puedes encontrar en la calle, en lugares donde estás entre tanta gente conocida o no pueden sorprenderte e intentar hacerte daño; por eso debes estar alerta, prevenida en ese caso y cualquier situación insegura.

Es muy valioso recibir esas orientaciones por parte de los mayores que tienen más experiencia en la vida que nosotros, que son los padres, hermanos mayores, abuelos y hasta profesores que se preocupan y ocupan de cuidarnos a través de un consejo. A veces por estar en esa etapa de rebeldía no escuchas y crees que te fastidian por decirte tantas cosas, quizás por lo joven no ves peligro en ninguna parte; sin embargo, lo mejor es prevenir que lamentar y dejar de lado la terquedad entendiendo que quienes nos aconsejan lo hacen por cuidarnos y porque le importas.

Cuantas veces te han indicado sobre el peligro de caminar sola en la noche por lugares desolados, que no lo hagas si no es necesario, ya que siempre es bueno ir acompañado o quedarte en un lugar seguro hasta que salga el sol. Cunado sientas peligro mientras caminas en una dirección lo mejor es **dar marcha atrás por la calle** e irte para evitar cualquier acto o situación lamentable que ponga tu vida en riesgo.
​

​<center>![WhatsApp Image 2022-05-12 at 3.28.50 PM.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeucn6MeLy6DkeFM7A2nU8vB9xADUBt8Yr6bzbsja2DRK/WhatsApp%20Image%202022-05-12%20at%203.28.50%20PM.jpeg)</center>



#  Danger

​

#
Parenting involves much more than just education; it also encompasses the values, principles, and norms established by society, as well as the customs and traditions of each family. It’s very important to provide the advice and guidance that will help you protect yourself and navigate the world outside; because while they teach you about appropriate behavior, it’s also good to know what’s right and wrong—precisely for safety reasons—so you can stay alert to any danger you might encounter on the street, in places where you’re surrounded by people, whether known or unknown, who might surprise you and try to harm you; that’s why you must stay alert and be prepared in that case and in any unsafe situation.
​
It’s incredibly valuable to receive guidance from those who are older and have more life experience than we do—our parents, older siblings, grandparents, and even teachers—who care about us and look out for us by offering advice. Sometimes, because you’re going through that rebellious phase, you don’t listen and think they’re just nagging you by telling you so many things; perhaps because you’re young, you don’t see danger anywhere. However, it’s better to be safe than sorry and set aside your stubbornness, understanding that those who advise us do so to protect us and because they care about you.

How many times have you been warned about the danger of walking alone at night through deserted areas—that you shouldn’t do it unless necessary, since it’s always best to have someone with you or stay in a safe place until sunrise? When you sense danger while walking in a certain direction, the best thing to do is **turn around and head back down the street** to avoid any unfortunate incident or situation that could put your life at risk.
​

title.title: Del vacío al cielo / From the Void to the Sky
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbwTvv1Sk9RS8jVPodJgFyAiFpdSaq5rG5z7XsF865byt/1779753450318.jpg)

El reloj de la pared sigue su marcha monótona, pero aquí dentro las agujas se han roto.

[*The clock on the wall continues its monotonous march, but inside here, the hands have broken.*]

<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVV2gZfYWyFjZmEd3AY95WD5B4WKNoXBTRzPNQPexkRgT/1779754837880.png)

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​A veces, la fe y la razón entran en una tregua silenciosa, pero esa tregua nace del shock. No entiendes los porqués, no descifras los permisos del cielo, ni encuentras la lógica detrás de la tormenta que te ha robado el aire.

[*​Sometimes, faith and reason enter into a silent truce, but that truce is born of shock. You do not understand the whys, you do not decipher the permissions of heaven, nor do you find the logic behind the storm that has stolen your breath.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​Es el estado de shock: un limbo donde la realidad pesa tanto que el aire parece volverse sólido. Un laberinto emocional que parece no tener salida de emergencia, ni siquiera una ventana para mirar el sol.

[*​It is the state of shock: a limbo where reality weighs so much that the air seems to become solid. An emotional labyrinth that seems to have no emergency exit, not even a window to look at the sun.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavebEym2Dzvh5vLkzNYFot2nzFwJLFzAc4ZzdyqNEQW1/1779754925183.png)

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​En ese silencio absoluto, cae el peso de una certeza amarga que se siente en cada fibra del cuerpo: afuera, el mundo sigue su marcha indomable.

[*In that absolute silence, the weight of a bitter certainty falls, felt in every fiber of the body: outside, the world continues its untamable march.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​Para los demás, el golpe que nos ha estremecido será solo la noticia de un momento, un eco lejano que el viento disipa rápido; mientras tanto, de este lado de la mirada, nosotros nos quedamos rotos.

[*For others, the blow that has shaken us will only be the news of a moment, a distant echo that the wind quickly dissipates; meanwhile, on this side of the gaze, we remain broken.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

 El contraste entre la prisa ajena y nuestra propia quietud se vuelve simplemente insoportable.
​Ese vacío no es ausencia de pensamiento. Al contrario, es el vértigo de sentirse acorralado y comprender que, mientras el universo entero avanza, uno se ha quedado suspendido.

[*The contrast between the haste of others and our own stillness becomes simply unbearable.
​That void is not an absence of thought. On the contrary, it is the vertigo of feeling cornered and understanding that, while the entire universe moves forward, one has remained suspended.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQM9oCRRHxbyVGDtB5F64Pv42b9JuPuZAjFS5M52QTAg/1779755118872.png)

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​Y es que mirar al vacío es, quizás, la forma más honesta que tiene el alma para detenerse a procesar lo que el corazón todavía no puede nombrar. Es ese punto ciego del espacio donde solo queda la pausa forzada. El tiempo se detiene por completo y nos toca, simplemente, respirar la incertidumbre.

[And the truth is, looking into the void is, perhaps, the most honest way the soul has to pause and process what the heart cannot yet name. It is that blind spot in space where only the forced pause remains. Time stops completely and we are left, simply, to breathe the uncertainty.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​Pero el vacío no tiene la última palabra.
​Cuando las fuerzas se agotan de tanto buscar una respuesta en la nada, una chispa callada de esperanza nos invita a cambiar de perspectiva. Entonces, dejamos de mirar el vacío para empezar a mirar al cielo.

[*But the void does not have the last word. When forces are exhausted from searching so hard for an answer in nothingness, a quiet spark of hope invites us to change our perspective. Then, we stop looking at the void to start looking at the sky.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbJiyr9bp8xLVCcvXXFD8uoJa1pF3sHyS3rQE556FP9ma/1779755186166.png)

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

​No porque allí encontremos explicaciones mágicas, sino porque es el único lugar lo suficientemente inmenso, divino, compasivo y lleno de luz como para cobijar nuestras dudas y sanar lo que se ha roto. Una dimensión superior donde la razón se rinde ante la fe y el corazón comprende; donde el alma descansa de sus propias cargas y recuerda su verdadera esencia eterna, hallando consuelo en la certeza de que, aún en la pausa más oscura, nunca estaremos solos.

[*Not because we find magical explanations there, but because it is the only place immense, divine, compassionate, and full of light enough to shelter our doubts and heal what has been broken. A higher dimension where reason surrenders to faith and the heart understands; where the soul rests from its own burdens and remembers its true eternal essence, finding consolation in the certainty that, even in the darkest pause, we will never be alone.*]

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmakzcf13qJda5bofJcKQSzadnqQUacsE4u4Ea62fCKTMe/1779755359203.png)

​<center>─── ◇ ───</center>

Las imágenes que acompañan este texto fueron generadas con Gemini Flash.
La edición y el diseño de la portada fueron realizados utilizando la plataforma Canva.

[*The images accompanying this text were generated with Gemini Flash. The editing and cover design were carried out using the Canva platform.*]

title.title: Let's Play Resident Evil Village - She is back and still not trusted
title.body:
![Resident Evil Village She is back and still not trusted.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tGa8c8QLJuoA7PoGa5iUWBzH2e7EfbCecT6qgn1cCoJEaHJw4aYVJCJjAkUgRwRdzSb.gif)

---

# She is back and still not trusted

Picking up from falling multiple stories to the bottom of the church and having looted the Lady Dimitrescu corpse, I find this rectangle urn sitting around, with few details on it but has the name Eve.

I took it to use later when I know, it will come in handy or be part of a quest. Eve is on it, is that the specimen inside or code for something more sinister?

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.49.14.99.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swib8VjPczGB35g9P8RMJ8eY3jQHrJ5MhjA34MNna9qoX9STKRJE2Ejh2Gz6pSiwFV3.png)

Now I find myself back in the village I start looking around, finding a note about a house with a red chimney and knowing where I have to do next. But I want to ensure I can find anything of value, or clear out this village again in case of any nasties making their way back in again.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.50.30.63.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swcK86wjkPGUTSENDyozuwbAFzx1kf9QxNMsvyZTkKd2KSoPHosnahqawQzT73JaBDU.png)

I make my way into what seems like the cave I am meant to go through as the note said.. but I stop at some fishing before moving out of the cave, as I am not ready to go through it right now. At least I can enjoy some fish if I can cook it on something!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.51.04.23.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swdk25FMr7wkXQSibVeck6cUjEysJ5veVWfAyAFqYwRn6Eb7WKLPb2DUmQcL9vLtnTu.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.51.59.36.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tbHEd8yqB1z4qfy7MdAZyrX4Q2WNk1N8KnRpLkUgRy35q2oYxRModN6HUHSz8o2eSkP.png)

Further into this cave I was surprised to see, none other than the old lady who I was always suspicious off and her stupid riddles.

She had been waiting for me to come through, to explain the giant stone tablet on the wall to me before helping me with the path forward, through those double doors. After those doors were two mechanical doors, activated be a lever which was used and I was now back outside.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.53.45.47.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23t79QJPjP4n5ajSMXfdSkV8rJpJVT7W7Wpj34SK4b2VNjDjs9hVN4urBUYmy8WFV1Ayo.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.53.55.24.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tvAeBCKhSAx6HPKCG3MVoBZUEeinLjv4psM67PPZMZkizYa7XFzpqfaEJf23oXLxPh6.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.55.56.53.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swiDsBnQhpdW8Hz3LfjojDZFUHkvDa8uysBFQyquc1BTdaZ1VfaeP6KZ3x3MqHcNoAz.png)

I find myself now heading outside and onto the Ceremony Site, likely a place to let the enemy sacrifice for more power or something. But it wasn't the concern I had to worry about, but just what will be the next big boss battle or tough fighting to come, since it is only the village I am heading to again, for now.. but who knows what is waiting or whom!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.56.11.35.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23uQNRKa4Sqk6Kj3Q5HqkFzug539tm4f2uBPZsc4Bc2DqaoHGF3srKa3kiJ5yp7eb6FrR.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.57.00.81.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swkfbJSQiRZu1S1S1YeMjsaSvcq77zn4y5z9sTKT1joBdkuKLWTnpF4vxWW8ZLxaCCx.png)

I was able to get a proper use of the sniper rifle, this time, as I lined up a Lycan down on a small bridge and ensured it was down for the count, with a one shot kill.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.04.05 - 21.57.56.09.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swgK4iMCYfzbinLZTZYHV7azouv2VPwYBuTdkkdxrrybnsx1V3wLmuvjZNe9vf6o1br.png)

Was only a few more Lycans that were around the area and I sniped one of them, then killed the other two running up the path for me after hearing the sniper rounds going off.

I was ready to check out this nearby set of ruin style concrete structures, hard to make out what it is but it was cool to go through them among the Lycan attacks, anyway. Once I got through this part, I made my way through more doors and out to an Altar, which is a nice resting spot I think.

title.title: The same old game.
title.body:
<center>[The Atlantic](https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/1997/02/the-capitalist-threat/376773/)</center>
The game imposed by the capitalist system is something that, despite being predictable, works very well to remind us how fragmented society is into quite distinct layers. We all buy to be seen... say those at the top of the food chain who set the rules of the game. We then always buy, out of pure necessity or to feed our own ego. However, when we don't play like that... We are invisible.
Although money maintains its omnipresent power (after all, it is something that somehow needs to be ingrained in all social classes... even if in totally unequal proportions, especially when we talk about underdeveloped countries) and dictates the rules... it is the system that defines how we will spend it (and especially how we will spend it). This doesn't seem fair, but that's how it works on paper and is transposed to shape the society in which we live.
There are those who, in some way, still try to act differently to try to break this \

. On the other hand, the efforts end up being a waste of energy and time. Basically, because the system is too strong to be dismantled by a few people. The top of the hierarchy doesn't want this system to be undone, or even more fair for society as a whole. This only feeds the rotten side of what should be the solution.\nThe capitalist system has been maintained as a temporarily functional \
(there are indeed excellent ideas within the socio-political-cultural context), but it is how it has been \

that brings the real concern about events that haven't even happened yet (but which can already be predicted, and which will certainly result in an even more unequal world in the coming years). The rules of the game may change at some point, but it is the same.
---
<center>**El mismo viejo juego.**</center>
El juego impuesto por el sistema capitalista, a pesar de ser predecible, nos recuerda con claridad la fragmentación de la sociedad en estratos muy distintos. Todos compramos para ser vistos… dicen quienes están en la cima de la cadena alimenticia y dictan las reglas del juego. Compramos siempre, por pura necesidad o para alimentar nuestro ego. Sin embargo, cuando no jugamos así… somos invisibles.
Aunque el dinero mantiene su poder omnipresente (al fin y al cabo, es algo que de alguna manera debe estar arraigado en todas las clases sociales… incluso en proporciones totalmente desiguales, sobre todo en los países subdesarrollados) y dicta las reglas… es el sistema el que define cómo lo gastaremos (y especialmente cómo lo gastaremos). Esto no parece justo, pero así funciona en teoría y así se traduce para dar forma a la sociedad en la que vivimos.
Hay quienes, de alguna manera, aún intentan actuar de forma diferente para romper este “círculo vicioso”. Sin embargo, estos esfuerzos terminan siendo una pérdida de tiempo y energía. Básicamente, porque el sistema es demasiado fuerte para ser desmantelado por unos pocos. La cúpula de la jerarquía no quiere que este sistema se deshaga, ni mucho menos que sea más justo para la sociedad en su conjunto. Esto solo alimenta la podredumbre de lo que debería ser la solución.
El sistema capitalista se ha mantenido como una \
temporalmente funcional (de hecho, existen ideas excelentes dentro del contexto sociopolítico y cultural), pero es su \

lo que genera verdadera preocupación sobre eventos que aún no han ocurrido (pero que ya se pueden predecir y que sin duda resultarán en un mundo aún más desigual en los próximos años). Las reglas del juego pueden cambiar en algún momento, pero la esencia es la misma. ---
**O mesmo jogo de sempre.**
O jogo imposto pelo sistema capitalista é mesmo algo que, apesar de previsível, funciona muito bem para nos lembrar o quanto a sociedade é fragmentada em camadas bastantes distintas entre si. Todos nós comprar para sermos vistos... Dizem aqueles que estão no topo da cadeia alimentar e estabelecem as regras do jogo. Nós então sempre compramos, por pura necessidade ou para alimentar nosso próprio ego. No entanto, quando não jogamos assim... Somos invisíveis. Embora o dinheiro mantenha o seu poder onipresente (afinal, é algo que de alguma maneira precisa estar impregnado em toas as classes sociais... ainda que em proporções totalmente desiguais, principalmente quando falamos em países subdesenvolvidos) dite as regras... É o sistema que define como nós vamos gastá-lo (e principalmente como nós vamos gastá-lo). Isso não parece justo, mas é como funciona no papel e é transposto para moldar a sociedade em que vivemos. Há aquelas pessoas que, de alguma maneira, ainda até tentam agir de modo diferente para tentar quebrar esse “círculo vicioso”. Por outro lado, os esforços acabam sendo um desperdício de energia e tempo. Basicamente, porque o sistema é forte demais para ser desmantelado por poucas pessoas. O topo da cúpula não quer que esse sistema seja desfeito, ou sequer mais justo para a sociedade como um todo. Isso apenas alimenta o lado podre do que deveria ser a solução. O sistema capitalista vem se mantendo como uma “saída” temporariamente funcional (realmente há ideias excelentes dentro do contexto sócio-político-cultural), mas é como ele vem sendo “aperfeiçoado” que traz a preocupação real dos eventos que sequer ainda acontecerem (mas que já podem ser previstos, e que certamente irão resultar em um mundo ainda mais desigual nos próximos anos). As regras do jogo podem até mudar em algum momento, mas ele é o mesmo. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-same-old-game-byh)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 26 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3ee3805b39376c4c6a6abc966eb52f55217da6620fa9effe62084b91fb3e38b43a098ed1ebbe8392d9e5995a5ded58ddc77e3d35f3a0332c134fb8cc1374c216_640.jpg)
Сегодняшняя прогулка была просто великолепной! Я решил отправиться в горы, где воздух свежий, а виды бесподобные. По пути я встретил группу туристов, которые шли с детьми. Они рассказали мне, что это их первый поход, и была так заметна их радость и восторг от природы — это всегда вдохновляет. Также я наткнулся на удивительный водопад, скрытый среди деревьев. Вода падала с довольно большой высоты, создавая радугу на солнце. Я остановился, чтобы сделать несколько фотографий и просто насладиться моментом. Это напомнило мне, как важно иногда останавливаться и ценить красоту окружающего мира. В общем, прогулка прошла прекрасно, зарядил себя энергией на всю неделю! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

body.title: Coliflor con papas gratinadas en freidora de aire [ES][EN]
body.body:
> Siempre que pienso en comer coliflor, me es inevitable no pensar en prepararla gratinada en el horno. Sin embargo, no soy de las personas que prenden el horno para preparar una sola cosa y algo pequeño; considero que es un desgaste de tiempo y recursos. Por eso me encanta utilizar la freidora de aire, que debo mencionar que la mía es cuadrada, tal y como si fuera un mini horno. Sin embargo, hay que tener en claro que no todo se cocina u hornea igual en la freidora de aire que en el horno convencional. > Whenever I think about eating cauliflower, I can’t help but think of making it au gratin in the oven. However, I’m not the type of person who turns on the oven just to make a single small dish; I consider it a waste of time and resources. That’s why I love using my air fryer—which, by the way, is square, just like a mini oven. However, it’s important to keep in mind that not everything cooks or bakes the same way in an air fryer as it does in a conventional oven. ![1000262026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262026.jpg) Pensando en eso, cuando quiero preparar vegetales gratinados en la freidora de aire, me gusta utilizar los vegetales previamente cocidos. No es igual gratinar 10 minutos en la freidora de aire a cocinar y gratinar los vegetales 1 hora en el horno. Hoy te comparto la forma en que los suelo preparar este tipo de vegetales, y que suelo adicionar papas y así no tener que agregar algún otro alimento al plato. > With that in mind, when I want to make vegetable gratin in the air fryer, I like to use pre-cooked vegetables. Baking them for 10 minutes in the air fryer isn’t the same as cooking and baking them for an hour in the oven. Today I’m sharing how I usually prepare this type of dish, and I usually add potatoes so I don’t have to include any other ingredients. ![1000262027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262027.jpg) ![1000262025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262025.jpg) Para preparar esta coliflor y papas gratinas en la freidora de aire, estos son los ingredientes que necesitas: > To make this cauliflower and potato gratin in an air fryer, here are the ingredients you'll need: ![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Ingredientes || Ingredients

- Coliflor - Papas - Salsa bechamel - Pimienta negra - Queso Parmesano - Mantequilla de ajo - Sal en cantidad necesaria - Cauliflower - Potatoes - Béchamel sauce - Black pepper - Parmesan cheese - Garlic butter - Salt to taste
![17338874770083186545070987094077.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/246bKsfbzTQeu6kJmETVNgqsUaKD5PEoEr7VWZd7KJ2ZJPMVRQvdgnHyzwiAnrKsjBdtb.png)

Preparación || Preparation

- Lo primero es cocinar la coliflor y las papas. Puedes cocinar en agua o al vapor. A mí me gusta cocinar en agua y así agregar un poco de pimienta negra y sal al agua. Solo debes tener en cuenta que, si cocinas en agua, debes escurrir muy bien, para evitar el exceso de líquido. Una vez que la coliflor esté cocida y las papas, es momento de armar. > - First, cook the cauliflower and potatoes. You can boil them or steam them. I like to boil them and add a little black pepper and salt to the water. Just keep in mind that if you boil them, you need to drain them thoroughly to remove any excess liquid. Once the cauliflower and potatoes are cooked, it’s time to assemble the dish. ![1000262017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262017.jpg) - En un bol, agregar la coliflor, las papas, mantequilla de ajo y salsa bechamel. Mezclar suavemente y ajustar sal y pimienta al gusto. La idea es que todo quede bien impregnado de la salsa bechamel y la mantequilla de ajo. > - In a bowl, combine the cauliflower, potatoes, garlic butter, and béchamel sauce. Gently toss to combine, then season with salt and pepper to taste. The goal is for everything to be well coated with the béchamel sauce and garlic butter. ![1000262018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262018.jpg) - En un refractario que puedes colocar en la freidora, colocar el mezclado de coliflor y papas, agregar un poco de salsa bechamel por encima y colocar queso parmesano o el de tu preferencia. Llevar a la freidora de aire por el espacio de 7-10 min a 200 °C o el tiempo suficiente hasta que se comience a dorar. Una vez listo, dejar enfriar un poco antes de servir. > - In an oven-safe dish that fits in the air fryer, place the cauliflower and potato mixture, add a little béchamel sauce on top, and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese or your preferred cheese. Cook in the air fryer for 7–10 minutes at 200 °C, or until it begins to brown. Once ready, let it cool slightly before serving. ![1000262020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262020.jpg) Ya la preparación está lista. La cocción en agua o al vapor es de aproximadamente 10 minutos, más 10 minutos en la freidora. En un horno tradicional, todo el proceso de cocción hubiese sido unos 50 minutos. Yo disfruto de usar el horno, pero me gusta usarlo para mayor cantidad; pero en porciones pequeñas, prefiero utilizar la freidora de aire. Si quieres resaltar sabores, puedes agregar un poco de nuez moscada justo al momento de servir. > The preparation is now complete. Boiling or steaming takes about 10 minutes, plus 10 minutes in the air fryer. In a conventional oven, the entire cooking process would have taken about 50 minutes. I enjoy using the oven, but I prefer to use it for larger quantities; for smaller portions, I prefer to use the air fryer. If you want to bring out the flavors, you can add a little nutmeg right before serving. ![1000262028.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/1000262028.jpg) Déjame saber si eres fan como yo de los vegetales gratinados y de la coliflor; también déjame saber si te gusta utilizar la freidora de aire. ¡Hasta una próxima receta! > Let me know if you're a fan of vegetable gratins and cauliflower, just like me; also, let me know if you like using an air fryer. See you in the next recipe! --- ---
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23w2oCU1jrMQb87xKWpLidyqDisfwQEZG5j58s8WspTg4md9pgUiYR7uBSLzFaqhMa5c1.png
Todas las fotografías fueron tomadas por mí con un Realme 7 pro. No autorizo a nadie reutilizarlas. Esta publicación fue escrita en español y luego traducida al inglés. > All photographs were taken by me with a Realme 7 pro. I do not authorize anyone to reuse them. This publication was written in Spanish and then translated into English.

body.title: Hive Open Mic Week 320 || People by Libianca (A Freestyle)
body.body:
>Hello great people. It is a new week, and it is beautiful to be here again for this week's Open Mic. For some reason, I am so much in love with this week's theme. There could be many reasons for that, but I particularly think it's because I am a realist. I believe in bad days; I believe that sometimes we experience misfortune and sad moments. Though I do not pray for that, I accept them as part of life when they eventually come.

>Hola a todos. Empieza una nueva semana, y es maravilloso estar aquí de nuevo para el Open Mic de esta semana. Por alguna razón, me encanta el tema de esta semana. Puede que haya muchas razones para ello, pero creo que, sobre todo, es porque soy realista. Creo en los días malos; creo que a veces nos tocan momentos de mala suerte y tristes. Aunque no los deseo, los acepto como parte de la vida cuando llegan.

---


![1000366049.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ernesto6402/23wMW97vA7uEE9PUXA5UeGLMP3dE4cr25buHCHTs1m6auNaCjwqxF5yBVpKyd3gj3T9yq.png)


---


For this week, I have chosen a beautiful Afrobeat song. Though I have my reservations about the message I think the song might be trying to convey, I love the song so much for some reason. The song I will be performing today is \

by Libianca. But I think I will end up performing an entirely different song in the long run. That notwithstanding, this inspired my performance today, and whatever I am doing is a freestyle of the song.
>Para esta semana, he elegido una preciosa canción de afrobeat. Aunque tengo mis reservas sobre el mensaje que creo que la canción intenta transmitir, por alguna razón me encanta. La canción que voy a interpretar hoy es «People», de Libianca. Pero creo que al final acabaré interpretando una canción totalmente diferente. A pesar de ello, esta me ha servido de inspiración para mi actuación de hoy, y lo que voy a hacer es una versión improvisada de la canción.

\

is a song that conveys very sad emotions. Regardless of the message it originally conveys, it could be considered one of those songs that could be played when one is experiencing a sad moment. But to be particular, the song \
speaks about how unreliable people can be. In her words, \

; they do not see you. And that, for her, explains why you could be in your worst state and those around you would never notice.
>«People» es una canción que transmite emociones muy tristes. Independientemente del mensaje que transmita originalmente, podría considerarse una de esas canciones que se pueden escuchar cuando uno está pasando por un momento triste. Pero, para ser más concretos, la canción «People» habla de lo poco fiables que pueden ser las personas. En sus propias palabras, «la gente no te conoce de verdad»; no te ven. Y eso, para ella, explica por qué puedes estar en tu peor momento y los que te rodean nunca se darían cuenta.

As much as possible, I will make sure the message of the song remains intact, but I cannot promise the same for the lyrics. I will be doing lots of playing around with the lyrics; as a matter of fact, I will be adding some original lyrics myself. The song originally does not have many lyrics, but I will need just the chorus of the original song while I add every other thing that will be said. I did not actually score the original song, nor pay attention to its progression, but I will be using a 6-4-2-3 progression with, of course, some extensions.
>En la medida de lo posible, me aseguraré de que el mensaje de la canción se mantenga intacto, pero no puedo prometer lo mismo en cuanto a la letra. Voy a jugar mucho con la letra; de hecho, voy a añadir algunas estrofas originales de mi propia cosecha. La canción original no tiene mucha letra, pero solo necesitaré el estribillo de la canción original mientras añado todo lo demás que se dirá. En realidad, no he transcrito la partitura de la canción original ni he prestado atención a su progresión, pero voy a utilizar una progresión 6-4-2-3 con, por supuesto, algunas extensiones.

>Hello great people. It is a new week, and it is beautiful to be here again for this week's Open Mic. For some reason, I am so much in love with this week's theme. There could be many reasons for that, but I particularly think it's because I am a realist. I believe in bad days; I believe that sometimes we experience misfortune and sad moments. Though I do not pray for that, I accept them as part of life when they eventually come.

>Hola a todos. Empieza una nueva semana, y es maravilloso estar aquí de nuevo para el Open Mic de esta semana. Por alguna razón, me encanta el tema de esta semana. Puede que haya muchas razones para ello, pero creo que, sobre todo, es porque soy realista. Creo en los días malos; creo que a veces nos tocan momentos de mala suerte y tristes. Aunque no los deseo, los acepto como parte de la vida cuando llegan.

---

>Para esta semana, he elegido una preciosa canción de afrobeat. Aunque tengo mis reservas sobre el mensaje que creo que la canción intenta transmitir, por alguna razón me encanta. La canción que voy a interpretar hoy es «People», de Libianca. Pero creo que al final acabaré interpretando una canción totalmente diferente. A pesar de ello, esta me ha servido de inspiración para mi actuación de hoy, y lo que voy a hacer es una versión improvisada de la canción.

\

is a song that conveys very sad emotions. Regardless of the message it originally conveys, it could be considered one of those songs that could be played when one is experiencing a sad moment. But to be particular, the song \
speaks about how unreliable people can be. In her words, \

; they do not see you. And that, for her, explains why you could be in your worst state and those around you would never notice.
>«People» es una canción que transmite emociones muy tristes. Independientemente del mensaje que transmita originalmente, podría considerarse una de esas canciones que se pueden escuchar cuando uno está pasando por un momento triste. Pero, para ser más concretos, la canción «People» habla de lo poco fiables que pueden ser las personas. En sus propias palabras, «la gente no te conoce de verdad»; no te ven. Y eso, para ella, explica por qué puedes estar en tu peor momento y los que te rodean nunca se darían cuenta.

As much as possible, I will make sure the message of the song remains intact, but I cannot promise the same for the lyrics. I will be doing lots of playing around with the lyrics; as a matter of fact, I will be adding some original lyrics myself. The song originally does not have many lyrics, but I will need just the chorus of the original song while I add every other thing that will be said.
