body.title: LOH #290: A corner of peace and a trade of identity || Un rincón de paz y un intercambio de identidad
body.body:
<center>

![Cream Brown Beige Simple Aesthetic Scrapbook Photo College Memories In November Canvas Print (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQgNdy6R3cJ8RAuGzDs6G3NsLvt5RTMaBxpMmDEhWaXvs/Cream%20Brown%20Beige%20Simple%20Aesthetic%20Scrapbook%20Photo%20College%20Memories%20In%20November%20Canvas%20Print%20(1).png)

</center>

<hr>

<div class=\

> ![Banner web horizontal Con marca Decoración de interiores delicado colores cálidos.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQkB3VqEaMvqMQcmPcbrWPFEfe7BRVqAnP5CbDbqBaupG/Banner%20web%20horizontal%20Con%20marca%20Decoraci%C3%B3n%20de%20interiores%20%20delicado%20colores%20c%C3%A1lidos.gif) ¡Hola, chicas! Qué alegría estar por aquí una semana más compartiendo reflexiones. Antes de adentrarme en los temas de hoy, quiero enviar un saludo especial y un agradecimiento sincero a nuestra querida @saffisara por regalarnos estas dos preguntas tan maravillosas para la edición de esta semana. De verdad que fue un viaje en el tiempo y un mirar hacia adentro de una manera muy bonita. Sin más preámbulos, aquí les comparto mis respuestas. # #### _1️⃣ ¿Cuál es mi paraíso seguro favorito para relajarme y por qué?_ # Si tengo que cerrar los ojos y evocar un espacio donde mi mente encuentra un silencio absoluto y mi alma se alinea, ese lugar es, sin duda, la Isla de Coche, en el estado Nueva Esparta. Es un rincón paradisíaco de arenas tan blancas y finas que parecen talco, bordeado por un mar de aguas mansas y cristalinas cuyo vaivén constante funciona como una terapia para el espíritu. Quien ha tenido la dicha de contemplar un atardecer en Coche sabe que el cielo se convierte en un lienzo donde los tonos naranjas y dorados se funden de una manera casi mística. Sin embargo, más allá de sus imponentes atributos naturales, esta isla es mi refugio seguro por los tesoros intangibles que guardo en mi memoria.

> ![Banner web horizontal Con marca Decoración de interiores delicado colores cálidos (2).gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb1dcHkinQZtXMuYoT2pw17twjab23oqcaccj8HJ15tvj/Banner%20web%20horizontal%20Con%20marca%20Decoraci%C3%B3n%20de%20interiores%20%20delicado%20colores%20c%C3%A1lidos%20(2).gif) Hello, dear Ladies of Hive! What a joy to be here for another week sharing reflections. Before diving into today's topics, I want to send a very special greeting and a warm thank you to our dear @saffisara for giving us these two wonderful questions for this week's edition. You truly made us travel back in time and look inward in such a beautiful way. Without further ado, here are my answers. # #### _1️⃣ What is my favorite safe haven for relaxing, and why?_ # If I had to close my eyes and picture a place where my mind finds absolute silence and my soul finds peace, that place is, without a doubt, Coche Island, in the state of Nueva Esparta, here in Venezuela. It is a little slice of paradise with sand so white and fine it looks like talcum powder, bordered by a sea of calm, crystal-clear waters whose constant lapping serves as therapy for the spirit. Anyone who has had the good fortune to watch a sunset on Coche knows that the sky becomes a canvas where shades of orange and gold blend in an almost mystical way. However, beyond its stunning natural beauty, this island is my safe haven because of the intangible treasures I hold dear in my memory.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc6dV7T5k7Xg9uTpXK4hVi7irho8QJ3vU93dBKkqPLbqy/image.png)

>

Esa isla representa una de las etapas más luminosas y felices de mi vida: la de los viajes en familia. Eran esos tiempos entrañables antes de que mis padres dejaran este plano terrenal y antes de que la realidad nos golpeara con la diáspora, obligando a mis hermanos y primos a marchar por el mundo en busca de ese futuro que, lamentablemente, en nuestro propio país les fue negado.

Existe una frase muy popular y nostálgica que la gente suele repetir: \

. Yo siempre he tenido la firme convicción de que esa sentencia no encaja con nosotros. Nosotros sí sabíamos que éramos felices. Éramos plenamente conscientes de la fortuna que significaba estar juntos, de las risas compartidas en la orilla, de las sobremesas largas y de la complicidad. Lo que jamás cruzó por nuestras mentes fue que la vida nos terminaría llevando por caminos, fronteras y destinos tan drásticamente diferentes.

>

Coche represents one of the brightest and happiest stages of my life: that of family trips. Those were the endearing times before my parents left this earthly plane and before reality hit us with the diaspora, forcing my siblings and cousins to scatter across the world in search of a future that, unfortunately, was denied to them in our own homeland.

There is a very popular and nostalgic phrase people often repeat: \

But I have always firmly believed that this statement does not apply to us. We did know we were happy. We were fully aware of how fortunate we were to be together, of the laughter shared on the shore, the long conversations around the table, and our closeness. What never crossed our minds was that life would end up taking us down such drastically different paths, borders, and destinations.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaoGUPeCxBW2Hkohz1B6uNXEcKaTt5AM152W8PMPoyiLV/image.png)

> Hoy en día, cuando el ruido del entorno se vuelve ensordecedor o la rutina me abruma, activo mi memoria sensorial. Regreso a Coche en mis pensamientos: respiro el olor a mar, escucho el susurro del viento y siento la calidez de ese sol. Esa isla no es solo un punto geográfico en el mapa del Caribe; es el ancla de mis afectos, el lugar donde guardo intacta mi noción de hogar y el espacio mental al que siempre vuelvo para recargarme de buena vibra y paz.

> Nowadays, when the noise of the environment becomes deafening or routine overwhelms me, I activate my sensory memory. I return to Coche in my thoughts: I breathe in the scent of the saltpeter, listen to the whisper of the wind through the palm trees, and feel the warmth of that sun. That island is not just a geographical point on the Caribbean map; it is the anchor of my affections, the place where I keep my notion of home intact, and the mental space I always return to in order to recharge with good vibes and peace. #
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQoK9DEiR17KCLz2B6QWaeZQMmWuvZde3xXzbhJpiBmZw/image.png)

> #### _2️⃣ Si yo pudiera intercambiar vidas con un personaje famoso, ¿quién sería y por qué?_ # Debo confesar que al principio se me enredó un poco el papagayo con esta pregunta. No soy una persona que suela idealizar a las celebridades de la cultura pop actual, ni me deslumbra la fama efímera o superficial. Me costaba encontrar un nombre en ese universo. Sin embargo, si tuviera la oportunidad única de habitar la mente y el cuerpo de alguien por veinticuatro horas, elegiría sin dudarlo a la célebre escritora chilena Isabel Allende. Mi fascinación por ella va mucho más allá de su incuestionable éxito literario; me cautiva su estructura mental, su resiliencia inquebrantable y esa elegancia madura que desborda en cada entrevista y en cada página. Isabel es una mujer que ha caminado por senderos muy complejos: ha vivido la nostalgia del exilio, ha enfrentado pérdidas profundamente dolorosas (como la de su hija Paula) y ha visto cómo su mundo se transforma una y otra vez. Lo extraordinario, y lo que realmente admiro, es cómo ha logrado hacer una maravillosa alquimia con todo ese bagaje, transformando el dolor crudo y las ausencias en historias universales que sirven de bálsamo y sanación para millones de lectores en el mundo.

> #### _2️⃣ If I could swap lives with a famous person, who would it be and why?_ # I must confess that I got a bit tangled up with this question at first. I am not someone who typically idealizes current pop culture celebrities, nor am I dazzled by fleeting or superficial fame. It was hard for me to find a name in that universe. However, if I had the unique opportunity to inhabit someone else's mind and body for twenty-four hours, I would choose the celebrated Chilean writer Isabel Allende without hesitation. My fascination with her goes far beyond her unquestionable literary success; I am captivated by her mental structure, her unwavering resilience, and that mature elegance she exudes in every interview and on every page. Isabel is a woman who has walked very complex paths: she has lived through the nostalgia of exile, faced deeply painful losses (such as that of her daughter Paula) and watched her world transform time and time again. What is extraordinary, and what I truly admire, is how she has managed to perform a wonderful alchemy with all that baggage, turning raw pain and absences into universal stories that serve as a balm and healing for millions of readers around the world.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbchZDRafbE4j4BYVGmz8R8436Th7HnffqXrE16fM8N5L/image.png)

> Para mí, la escritura nunca ha sido un simple pasatiempo; siempre ha sido una herramienta poderosa de introspección, mi catarsis y mi propio espacio de sanación. Es el lugar donde me permito procesar mis emociones, ordenar mis pensamientos y flexibilizar mis rigideces. Por eso, intercambiar vida con Isabel Allende sería una experiencia fascinante: me encantaría experimentar en primera persona cómo funciona su proceso creativo, cómo hila los recuerdos con la ficción, y cómo logra mirar el pasado con tanta ternura y, a la vez, con ese toque de fina ironía y humor que la caracteriza. Vivir un día en sus zapatos sería como asistir a una clase magistral de vida. Ella representa el tipo de madurez al que yo aspiro: una existencia con propósito, donde la vulnerabilidad no se esconde sino que se asume como la mayor de las fortalezas, y donde la paz mental se defiende por encima de cualquier tormenta externa.

> For me, writing has never been a simple hobby; it has always been a powerful tool for introspection, my catharsis, and my own healing space. It is the place where I allow myself to process my emotions, organize my thoughts, and soften my rigidities. That is why trading lives with Isabel Allende would be a fascinating experience: I would love to experience firsthand how her creative process works, how she weaves memories with fiction, and how she manages to look at the past with such tenderness and, at the same time, with that touch of fine irony and humor that characterizes her. Living a day in her shoes would be like attending a master class on life. She represents the kind of maturity I aspire to: an existence with purpose, where vulnerability is not hidden but embraced as the greatest of strengths, and where peace of mind is defended above any external storm.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfWGAYm1EkzKaktfRw2EizSwkVZ3pApYS8ejm8en1E6r5/image.png)

> Participar en esta dinámica ha sido un ejercicio hermoso para el alma. Al final del día, viajar con la memoria a las tranquilas playas de Coche y sumergirme en la posibilidad de mirar el mundo a través de los ojos de una escritora tan admirable, me deja una certeza profunda. La vida está hecha de estaciones; algunas se quedan grabadas en la arena del pasado como un tesoro familiar intacto, y otras se construyen en el presente, transformando cada vivencia en aprendizaje y madurez. Me despido celebrando esos paraísos que nos sostienen y esas mentes que nos inspiran a seguir escribiendo nuestra propia historia con absoluta paz mental. ¡Nos leemos en una próxima oportunidad!

> Participating in this dynamic has been a beautiful exercise for the soul. At the end of the day, traveling with my memory to the calm beaches of Coche and immersing myself in the possibility of looking at the world through the eyes of such an admirable writer leaves me with a profound certainty. Life is made of seasons; some remain etched in the sand of the past as an intact family treasure, and others are built in the present, transforming every experience into learning and maturity. I say goodbye celebrating those paradises that sustain us and those minds that inspire us to keep writing our own story with absolute peace of mind. See you next time! ![Orange and Purple Retro Welcome November Twitter Header (1).gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSrBG5M2TbcKkubtA7MtQiRTibZtD1TPgaHryTuocNu74/Orange%20and%20Purple%20Retro%20Welcome%20November%20Twitter%20Header%20(1).gif)

body.title: How can you buy SPS at a low price without worrying about guessing the exact bottom price? [ES-EN]
body.body:
> Buying SPS at a low price so you can accumulate more over time and increase the amount of SPS you have in staking—thereby also increasing your RSHARES multiplier—is one of the strategies you should implement now if you want to boost your daily earnings over time. Of course, this involves RISKS, so I’m not directly encouraging you to invest in SPS. You should do your own research, as the content I create is purely educational to give you an idea of how to work and approach things. However, after this “Risk Warning,” buying SPS automatically—without worrying about guessing the absolute bottom—is entirely possible and relatively simple once you’ve gained some practice. On the other hand, while no technical knowledge is required to do this, you should at least know the basics of “trading”—nothing too complicated, just “support and resistance”; that’s enough. And, of course, you need to be familiar with the web3 ecosystem related to “DeFi.” This might make some people nervous, but the reality is that the future of cryptocurrencies lies in DeFi. **So, if you're ready to see how this works, you should read this post all the way through. I might also write a second part with a more practical step-by-step guide, but for now I want you to understand all the basics you need to know—including how to do it—without getting too bogged down in the detailed step-by-step instructions.** ![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# What do you need to buy SPS automatically?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> First off, this isn’t some kind of programmed bot or anything like that—it’s simply about providing liquidity to a DeFi “protocol” on any of the networks where SPS is listed. It’s that simple. However, some of you might not be familiar with these terms at all, so I’ll try to break it down in very simple terms so everyone can understand how this works. It’s also essential to explain this first so you have the full context and aren’t going in blind. **Now that everything is clear, let’s move on to explaining the protocol and what happens when we use it correctly:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Access DeFi as a “Liquidity Provider”

This is where it all happens. To put the title into practice, all you need to do is become a “Liquidity Provider” on a “DeFi” protocol that allows you to do so—and where, of course, the token you’re targeting is traded. We already know which one that is, as the main focus of this post is $SPS. But how does this actually work? What does it mean to provide liquidity on a protocol? Well, adding liquidity to a protocol involves investing your own money into a “pool,” and a pool is simply a currency pair—in our case, for example, SPS/USDC or SPS/WBNB. If, for instance, you have USDC, let’s say it’s about $200, depending on the price range you choose, that liquidity is typically split 50/50. That means with that $200, you’ll buy $100 worth of SPS and keep $100 in USDC. In the other case, it’s the same, except this time it would be SPS and BNB. **I imagine you're wondering, \

Well, let's break it down:** >* **Earn commissions:** Here’s the key point: every time you provide liquidity, you earn a share of the fees that the pool distributes to all liquidity providers. This happens because each transaction incurs a fee, which the protocol then distributes to the entire pool. > >* **Reducing risk:** Something not everyone realizes is that by providing liquidity, you protect yourself against a decline in asset prices. This is because holding a cryptocurrency or token is not the same as providing liquidity: if we’re in a bear market, the value of the asset—and thus its value in “dollars”—will drop. However, you can mitigate this risk while earning fees in the process, which limits the impact. > >* **Buy Low and/or Sell High:** This is the main focus of this post, and it allows you to automate buys and sells at key price levels in just a few simple steps.
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saydie/23u5xiwFjL73RxLkcbQBjfTdCWek7tXcDgYZzrgJ8aztjQtJvKRBNn3RFJSyFMvd3Yb4t.png
# How Can I Buy SPS Cheaply Using “Liquidity Pools”? https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> The process is actually quite simple, but I’ll try to break it down step by step so that anyone reading this post can learn. What you need, of course, is the desire to invest. To do this, you have to be immersed in the Splinterlands ecosystem. Of course, as I said, this isn’t an investment recommendation, but if you trust the team and the project—which have been working nonstop for years—this is the best way to invest without worrying about prices. But I’ll explain how to do it: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Step by step and how it works

![IMAGEN 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23t79QLhKs8yGu24fEwgRivTvW4nj8pKeX1mrcHTW96CATWWNisDy7qR4bhtXTbgCVrZe.png) * **The first step is to find the pair you plan to trade, which is basically the “Pool”; in this case, I would select the SPS/USDC pair, first because it’s paired with a stablecoin, and second, because it’s on the BASE network, which is very cost-effective; although you need ETH to cover each GAS transaction, the maximum fee is around $0.05.** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) ![IMAGEN 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/Eo1vRkHPwFgmeRbYaAiK3tpymoFiyaKaoV2bfxZJTTJ1kdJEyvwHVqsQYM1opJP52az.png) * **The next step is to choose a price range that’s very close to the current price action, looking at the nearest “support and resistance” levels. As an example, I’ve selected the price levels you see in the image—it’s not that this is definitive, nor is the range I chose, but, given that context, these are the ones I would choose—always below the support level so it doesn’t break out of the range if the price continues to fall. This will help ensure that the portion in USDC you allocate buys the SPS at lower levels, with a nearby resistance level you believe the price won’t be able to break through and will remain below, or that zone where you’d like to sell to lock in some profits from having bought at a lower price.** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23t76kVtdPsnPv2YAMZH43DG3hVy4xmdbGBmZwy3SGyaeiSDhmg9HuZVq4aCrhzLjfrxg.png|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tuz7xwLsryM2EHAhPPRyyrpjVDMkL2DkGXwaMfYDkFaLbArnqYDncuwtLGDyGZbZb3V.png| |-|-| * **These last images show how to find the pool. To do so, you’ll need its contract address, which is called “Pair.” Once there, go to [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance/deposit?token0=0x578661e9a09eee6b2cd97d4ded1ccbae7b8516b9&token1=0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913&&type=200&chain0=8453&chain1=8453&factory=0x5e7BB104d84c7CB9B682AaC2F3d509f5F406809A) and select “Unknown” as the token type and paste it into the search bar—that’s it, it will show up there.** --- ***NOTE: To set it up, simply select the minimum and maximum price ranges I specified—for example, the ones shown in the previous images—and deposit both SPS and USDT. However, this depends on the ranges you choose, since you can also open a position with a single token; but that requires a different analysis and would be a topic for another post.***

![Separador.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23u5taptEapzzNue7bMpgSFfTdVR9QsYdtt6rtQonQ5t8iCj5Bh3Xxf1yBs5u9aNdxzNy.png)
# Final Thoughts https://i.imgur.com/a2tHTPH.png

> So, this is how you can buy at the absolute bottom or at the point where you think the price might drop—though this will depend on the analysis you conduct. That’s why I mentioned that, while you don’t need a lot of technical knowledge, it’s best to be able to identify strong support and resistance levels to make the most accurate predictions possible about the price range. This way, you’ll be buying and selling at price levels that many others are struggling to predict with precision. **In another post, if you’d like, we’ll look at a practical example of how to do this and some specific strategies you can use. # ¿Qué necesitas para comprar SPS de forma automática?
https://i.imgur.com/7u1AW7Q.png

> Para comenzar esto no es ningún BOT programado ni nada por el estilo, solo se trata de aportar liquidez en un “Protocolo” DeFi en cualquiera de las redes en donde este listado el SPS, así de simple, pero, quizás algunos estos términos no les suena para nada, por lo que, tratare de desglosarlo de forma muy sencilla para que todos puedan comprender como es que esto es posible. Ademas es imperativo explicar esto primero para que puedan tener el contexto completo y no vayan a ciegas. **Así que, ya con todo claro vamos con la explicación del protocolo y que es lo que pasa cuando lo usamos de la manera correcta:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lenonmc21/23tmBC5eMQVv2S84hZLjyP31e3LJz1uiet9K4mUdp2Ezmp3ZkRUCzEWnJpCtPZDdhxnFS.png) #####
Acceder a DeFi como “Proveedor de Liquidez”

Aquí es donde sucede todo, para poder aplicar lo que dice el título, basta con ser “Proveedores de Liquidez” en un protocolo “DeFi” que nos permita realizarlo y donde por supuesto se intercambie el token que tenemos como objetivo, el cual ya sabemos cual es, siendo el foco central de este post el $SPS. Pero ¿Cómo funciona realmente esto? ¿De que se trata agregar liquidez en un protocolo? Pues agregar liquidez en un protocolo se trata de invertir tu propio dinero en una “Pool” y una pool es simplemente un par de monedas que en nuestro caso seria por ejemplo SPS/USDC o SPS/WBNB, si por ejemplo tienen USDC, digamos que son unos $200, dependiendo del rango de precios que elijas, esa liquidez se divide normalmente en un 50/50, es decir que con esos $200 compraras $100 en SPS y dejaras $100 en USDC, en el otro caso es lo mismo, solo que esta vez seria SPS y BNB. **Imagino que te preguntaras ¿Pero en que me beneficia esto? Pues vamos a desglosarlo:** >* **Ganar comisiones:** Esto es lo principal, cada vez que provees liquidez, ganas parte de las comisiones que reparte la pool a todos los que ofrecen liquidez y esto sale porque cada una de ellas cobra una comisión por hacer la transacción, algo que el protocolo reparte a todo el fondo. > >* **Disminuir el riesgo:** Algo que no todos ven es que al ofrecer liquidez te proteges del retroceso en el precio de los activos, ya que no es lo mismo mantener una criptomoneda o token, el cual, si estamos en un ciclo bajista, bajara su valor y por lo tanto su valor en “Dólares”, pero, esto lo puedes mitigar mientras vas ganando comisiones en le proceso, lo que limita el impacto. > >* **Comprar Barato y/o Vender Caro:** Este es el punto focal del post y es que gracias a esto puedes automatizar compras y ventas en ciertos niveles de precios que son claves y con tan solo unos sencillos pasos.

body.title: Flipping Burgers
body.body: Good Morning to all my wonderful friends here at @Asean.Hive. I hope that you're doing well. It is almost the end of May 2026. Burger Ramly ============ This is the type of Burger Patty that is the most sought after in Malaysia. There are stalls like this all over Miri. These are small businesses that operate around the city that I guess, from my view, deserve to be supported. The price of the burgers is quite affordable. USD 1 = RM 3.96, so RM 5.00 = RM 1.25 roughly. They usually serve delicious burgers. These burger stalls are also quite popular. Lots of people nearby come here to the stall and get their orders. The person who orders for the customer is also the chef. He flips the burgers.
/> Chicken Burger and Beef Burger with cheese This is what the end product looks like. These burgers are quite cheesy and you can bite into it and the cheese leaks out.

/> This is the stall to visit after all the shops around the city close for the day. The process Grill these patties on a larger grilling pan. Add some butter, oil, and cheese. The egg is fried in these round aluminium shaped container to give it that very nice shape.
/> Some soy sauce is added to the patty. Frying it to have it crispy.

/> They also make patties at home from fresh meat. They then marinate the meat in a lot of different spices to give it that extra taste. My wife usually orders the beef burger and for me is the chicken burger. I do not usually eat any beef related products.
/> The final touches. Lots of sliced lettuce and cheese. You can also order the double patty edition if one patty is not enough.
/> The mayonaise in huge amounts. Delicious. The final bread is added to the top of the burger. Then, you have the final product. The burger.
/> After a lot of effort and love put into making these burgers, they wrapped up the burgers in paper. I usually enjoy my burger watching a movie on Netflix. Enjoying every single bite .
/> Have you eaten anything like this? Would you want to try? @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

大早上起来，风可真大啊，出了屋子，外面冷飕飕的，这还是夏天么，心里也冰块一样的额，凉了，从下大雨那天开始，生意就一蹶不振，冷啊，我自己都冻的受不了，必须找个外套穿在身上，这鬼天气，真是折磨我这个脆弱的服装主理人啊

昨天晚上沉浸式的看了直播，胡说老王的干货直播，都是各种观点的分享，觉得对我来事，很有受教，学习嘛，什么时候都不晚，说的是，作为一个小生意，小老板，应该关注两个点，牢靠的刻在心里，

销售最大化，所有的事情围绕着销售来做，来展开

费用最小化，能减去的各种部门，都删除掉，围绕销售做文章，所有的部分都必须会销售，以销售为导向。说的很好，销售是一切的根本，如果你说有什么工作可以让你一直做到老，做到退休，那一定是销售了。老王讲的很好。


还说了过去五年中国的变化，过去几年，损失惨重，最可怕的就是被收割的中产阶级，过去的五年，随着房地产的下行，基本上所有的中产阶级全部被收割，基本上所有的中产阶级全部返贫，不上不下的人被ZF收割，全部很惨，现在还处于转型期，未来至少还有三年，所以做任何生意，都要避开不上不下的这部分人。

要么做有钱人的生意，要么做穷人经济，最底层的那部分人，还有钱，就是穷鬼经济。刻骨铭心啊，我不就是妥妥的被收割的人生，我现在还有三套房子在郑州，被收割的一生，弄了三套房，砸上了我一辈子，最后还一身债，可恶的XX，这个游戏规则的最初，就是让你牛马一生，越说越敏感，禁言，不谈了。

努力的意义在于什么，就是做自己，什么是做自己呢，做自己就是，我不是人家的丈夫，不是人家的父亲，不是人家的儿子，不是人家的老板，也不是服装主理人，是夜深人静的时候，我开着车子，在路上放空自己，我觉得这个时候我的，是真实的我，我的状态很安逸，很快乐，很舒服，我不用去想任何的责任和义务，我才是我自己，我开心，我快乐，做自己快乐的事情，就是做自己。

做自己不是为了喜欢什么，做自己的终极就是我不喜欢很么可以理直气壮的说，我不去做什么。有点绕口了

能理解多少，就是多少吧，今天也要好好得奋斗，毕竟我全身只有20块钱了，做自己，让自己一路生花。

body.title: [EN/PT] Dialogue or Physical Discipline?
body.body:
> # [EN] https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/48Um2owDZbepbeHrA4PwHGC3SUvfCGHYRyyNkxYkZvHHrVuSkEuxukfKCLxVw2K4xv.png
Source: Made in Canva
I come from a time when parents used physical punishment to raise their children. If children did something wrong, parents would discipline them physically. Some children would never repeat that behavior and would think twice before doing something wrong again, while others could be punished a thousand times and still continue making the same mistakes. Having grown up with that kind of upbringing does not mean that I fully support it today. Quite the opposite—I believe dialogue is almost always the most important path within a home. Talking, explaining, and guiding usually brings more lasting results than acting out of impulse or anger. Even so, I understand why many parents in the past relied on spanking as a way to set boundaries. It was what they knew, it was how they had been raised, and they believed they were doing what was best for their children. My two brothers and I grew up in that environment. We received a strict upbringing with clearly defined boundaries, and that shaped who we became. I never saw it as trauma. On the contrary, I believe many of the values we carry today came precisely from the way our parents raised us. We came from a humble family, living in a neighborhood surrounded by violence, drugs, and bad influences. Our parents were afraid of seeing us go down the wrong path and, within the reality they lived in, they did everything they could to keep us away from that. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EowGfFBwk7RFdHtSx2BWhpuUim3o4jpKxMh3E9mxCSS4HVf2iCvuXTc1xqgJXfhvkHo.png
[src](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/foto-em-escala-de-cinza-da-mulher-cobrindo-seu-rosto-com-as-maos--O_r72DSnNU)
I clearly remember one situation that I have never forgotten. Our mother always told us that if we came home with anything that wasn’t ours, we would be punished. One day, a friend lent me one of those old Game Boys. I came home happy, holding it in my hands, but my mother immediately became suspicious. She took me to the boy’s house to confirm whether he had really lent it to me. Even after it was confirmed, she told me to return it. The reason was simple: if it broke, we wouldn’t have the money to replace it. That taught me responsibility, care for what belongs to others, and respect for the limits of our circumstances. I am very grateful to my parents for the upbringing they gave me. At the same time, I recognize that times have changed. Today there is a greater understanding of the emotional impact of childhood, along with stricter laws aimed at protecting children and adolescents. Parents can be held accountable when they cross that line, and that is important too, because violence and aggression should never be mistaken for education. The problem is that, in some cases, the absence of any firmer correction also seems to have created another extreme. We see children and teenagers growing up without boundaries, struggling to hear “no,” becoming easily frustrated, and being poorly prepared to deal with the real world. That is not always their fault, but often a reflection of a lack of balance in parenting. That is why I believe the best path lies in the middle ground. Neither violence as a rule nor total permissiveness. Raising children requires presence, patience, dialogue, and clear boundaries. Every child is different and needs to be understood within their own reality. More than spanking or punishment, what truly shapes character is the example set by parents, consistency, and their responsibility to teach right from wrong. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/23u5tR8RSXuZFgpk8XmD9saKCRkgWgUfevxjjBPzjDMBXhVaa7Kc3su4oY8cgNUgCnWDH.png) # [PT] ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/48Um2owDZbepbeHrA4PwHGC3SUvfCGHYRyyNkxYkZvHHrVuSkEuxukfKCLxVw2K4xv.png)
Source: Made in Canva
Eu sou da época em que os pais usavam a força física para educar seus filhos. Se os filhos faziam algo errado, os pais disciplinavam com castigos físicos. Algumas crianças nunca mais repetiam aquilo e passavam a pensar duas vezes antes de fazer algo errado, mas havia também aquelas que podiam apanhar mil vezes e ainda assim continuavam cometendo os mesmos erros. Ter vivido esse tipo de educação não significa que eu seja totalmente a favor dela hoje. Pelo contrário, acredito que o diálogo quase sempre é o caminho mais importante dentro de casa. Conversar, explicar e orientar costuma trazer resultados mais duradouros do que agir no impulso ou na raiva. Ainda assim, entendo por que muitos pais do passado recorriam às palmadas como forma de impor limites. Era o que conheciam, era como haviam sido educados, e acreditavam estar fazendo o melhor pelos filhos. Eu e meus dois irmãos crescemos nesse contexto. Recebemos uma educação rígida, com limites bem definidos, e isso marcou nossa formação. Nunca enxerguei isso como um trauma. Pelo contrário, vejo que boa parte dos valores que carregamos hoje veio justamente da forma como nossos pais nos criaram. Viemos de família humilde, morando em um bairro com muita violência, drogas e más influências. Nossos pais tinham medo de nos ver seguir caminhos errados e, dentro da realidade deles, fizeram o possível para nos manter longe disso. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elderdark/EowGfFBwk7RFdHtSx2BWhpuUim3o4jpKxMh3E9mxCSS4HVf2iCvuXTc1xqgJXfhvkHo.png)
[src](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/foto-em-escala-de-cinza-da-mulher-cobrindo-seu-rosto-com-as-maos--O_r72DSnNU)
Lembro bem de uma situação que nunca esqueci. Nossa mãe sempre dizia que, se chegássemos em casa com qualquer objeto que não fosse nosso, iríamos apanhar. Um dia um amigo me emprestou um daqueles Game Boy antigos. Cheguei em casa feliz com aquilo nas mãos, mas minha mãe desconfiou imediatamente. Ela me levou até a casa do menino para confirmar se era verdade mesmo que ele havia me emprestado. Mesmo depois de confirmado, ela mandou devolver. O motivo era simples: se quebrasse, não teríamos dinheiro para pagar. Aquilo me ensinou responsabilidade, cuidado com o que é dos outros e respeito pelos limites da nossa condição. Sou muito grato aos meus pais pela educação que me deram. Ao mesmo tempo, reconheço que os tempos mudaram. Hoje existe uma compreensão maior sobre os impactos emocionais da infância, além de leis mais rígidas voltadas à proteção da criança e do adolescente. Muitos pais podem ser responsabilizados quando ultrapassam esse limite, e isso também é importante, porque violência e agressão nunca devem ser confundidas com educação. O problema é que, em alguns casos, a ausência de qualquer correção mais firme também parece ter gerado outro extremo. Vemos crianças e adolescentes crescendo sem limites, com dificuldade de ouvir “não”, frustrando-se com facilidade e sendo pouco preparados para lidar com o mundo real. Nem sempre isso é culpa delas, mas muitas vezes reflexo da falta de equilíbrio na educação. Por isso, acredito que o melhor caminho está no meio-termo. Nem violência como regra, nem permissividade total. Educar exige presença, paciência, diálogo e limites claros. Cada criança é diferente e precisa ser compreendida dentro da sua realidade. Mais do que palmadas ou castigos, o que realmente forma caráter é o exemplo, a constância e a responsabilidade dos pais em ensinar o certo e o errado. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@elderdark/enpt-dialogue-or-physical-punishment-5pk)

body.title: Comversando con la naturaleza. Por @ramaco54.
body.body:
>Muy buenos días amigos de Hive, les saluda su gran amigo el pintor Ramaco, quien les trae una nueva publicación artística, una conversación ilustrada entre el ave y la naturaleza que espero les gusten a mis fieles seguidores.
Bienvenidos a ver mis ocurrencia artística o un hermoso paisaje, en el blog digital de Hive.

@ramaco54

La ilustración de hoy se titula.

Conversando con la naturaleza.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQTUFCYE697KLxv1xtYvtiqtUUzsrBtxnE3rFnFAfdRq/diapositiva5.jpg)
MIS MATERIALES.

>Los materiales que utilicé en esta oportunidad fueron: acuarela, tinta china, acrílico blanco, mis pinceles de acuarela, sobre cartulina FABRIANO, Cámara fotográfica Panasonic, Marca LUMIX FZ47, programa de digitalización Adobe Photoshop, para modificaciones digitales y Power Point, para pasar las imágenes a formato jpg.
PROCESO PASO A PASO.

>Amigo espectador, curador y fiel seguidor de mi trabajo artístico, es una ilustración que relata visualmente a un ave en particular que pareciera está conversando con la naturaleza, a partir de este momento daré una breve explicación del procedimiento de como realice esta ilustración:
EL INICIO.

>Cuando se quiere trabajar con acuarela o técnica de la aguada, primero debemos humedecer un poco el papel, luego con un pincel y algo de tinta china, se marca el desplazamiento de la mancha siguiendo el curso del pincel, y extendiéndole en el soporte debido a la utilización de la técnica de la aguada, a parte de algunos trazos que darán forma a algún detalle más adelante en el proceso, como lo muestran las figuras... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW57yUMjsX1PukNwcAs3WUo5Yjnzz725JQ53yvNDTgcXa/diapositiva1.jpg)

>Observen como se han trabajado las manchas y los colores que se han utilizado para ir formando los diferentes planos de la perspectiva del paisaje, además de la realización de todos los detalles desde la formación de los arbustos, el tronco de donde se posa el ave que estoy dibujando, a parte de los detalles de los arbustos floreados de una naturaleza primaveral, reflejándose en las tranquilas aguas del cauce del rio, que embellece cada vez más a el paisaje. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVicXpvs2Wp9wZ4Fdfy14zJFmEz7PKRTnbpcA2bWJJTg/diapositiva2.jpg)
>En esta parte quiero que presten atención a como se fue formando el ave posado en el tronco. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFYU8swVNH4JrwbJDYGcYEEeEko4vENvMxSz32LkZh3N/diapositiva3.jpg)

>Ahora es momento de observar, porque así está quedando este paisaje con todo lujos y detalles, desde el personaje principal que es el ave central posado en el tronco admirando las ramas del mismo floreadas como si estuviese conversando de la belleza de la vida y la naturaleza, mas todo el conjunto de vida silvestre que los rodea. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwWxt6dTD1QkNH8esDZK9uTjHp2sXXqBMEjuNWYb2LZf/diapositiva4.jpg)

>Falta agregar algo que considero importante en la naturaleza como o es el sol, el astro rey que ilumina toda la naturaleza, que rodea la escena de esta bonita ilustración, la cual se titula: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf3Gm5xu9aqUJs48XCZm2Q7XpP3u4eDGNBRwq4DYMR2eU/diapositiva5.jpg)

Conversando con la naturaleza.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQTUFCYE697KLxv1xtYvtiqtUUzsrBtxnE3rFnFAfdRq/diapositiva5.jpg)

>Amigo espectador, curador y fiel seguidor de mi trabajo artístico, es importante decirles que, todo ser vivo tiene la capacidad de comunicarse, por lo tanto, cada vez que el sol brilla y el viento sopla, la comunicación entre la vida y la naturaleza fluyen en el movimiento de las aguas, así como el mirar o cantar de las aves hacia el arbusto floreado, dentro de mi percepción artística, es una conversación pura entre el ave y la naturaleza.
Muchas gracias por su amable atención.
Un abrazo, los quiero mucho.

@ramaco54

_____________________________________________________ >

>Good morning, Hive friends! This is your good friend, the painter Ramaco, bringing you a new artistic post: an illustrated conversation between a bird and nature that I hope my loyal followers will enjoy. >
Welcome to see my artistic creations or beautiful landscapes on the Hive digital blog.
>

@ramaco54

>
Today's illustration is titled:
>

Conversing with Nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQTUFCYE697KLxv1xtYvtiqtUUzsrBtxnE3rFnFAfdRq/diapositiva5.jpg) >
MY MATERIALS.
>

>The materials I used this time were: Watercolor, India ink, white acrylic paint, my watercolor brushes, on FABRIANO paper, Panasonic LUMIX FZ47 camera, Adobe Photoshop for digital modifications, and PowerPoint to convert the images to JPG format.

><center>STEP-BY-STEP PROCESS.</center>
><div class=\

>Dear viewer, curator, and loyal follower of my artwork, this is an illustration that visually depicts a particular bird that seems to be conversing with nature. From this point on, I will give a brief explanation of the process I used to create this illustration: >
THE BEGINNING.
>

>When working with watercolor or wash techniques, you must first dampen the paper slightly. Then, with a brush and some India ink, you trace the path of the wash, following the brushstrokes and extending the ink onto the surface. This is due to the nature of the wash technique. These strokes will shape some details later in the process, as shown in the figures... ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW57yUMjsX1PukNwcAs3WUo5Yjnzz725JQ53yvNDTgcXa/diapositiva1.jpg) >

>Observe how the shapes and colors have been used to form the different planes of the landscape's perspective, as well as the rendering of all the details, from the formation of the bushes and the trunk where the bird I'm drawing is perched, to the details of the flowering bushes in a springtime scene, reflected in the tranquil waters of the riverbed, which increasingly enhances its beauty. landscape. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaVicXpvs2Wp9wZ4Fdfy14zJFmEz7PKRTnbpcA2bWJJTg/diapositiva2.jpg) >
>In this part, I want you to pay attention to how the bird perched on the trunk took shape. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFYU8swVNH4JrwbJDYGcYEEeEko4vENvMxSz32LkZh3N/diapositiva3.jpg) >

>Now it's time to observe, because this is how this landscape is coming together, with all its rich details, from the main character, the central bird perched on the trunk admiring its flowering branches as if it were discussing the beauty of life and nature, and everything else. the surrounding wildlife. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRwWxt6dTD1QkNH8esDZK9uTjHp2sXXqBMEjuNWYb2LZf/diapositiva4.jpg) >

>Something I consider important in nature is missing: the sun, the king of stars that illuminates all of nature, which surrounds the scene in this beautiful illustration, titled: ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf3Gm5xu9aqUJs48XCZm2Q7XpP3u4eDGNBRwq4DYMR2eU/diapositiva5.jpg) >

Conversing with the nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfQTUFCYE697KLxv1xtYvtiqtUUzsrBtxnE3rFnFAfdRq/diapositiva5.jpg) >

>Dear viewer, curator, and loyal follower of my artwork, it's important to tell you that every living being has the capacity to communicate. Therefore, every time the sun shines and the wind blows, communication between life and nature flows in the movement of the waters, just as the birds' gaze or song toward the flowering bush, in my artistic perception, is a pure conversation between the bird and nature. >
Thank you very much for your kind attention.
>
Hugs, I love you all.
>

@ramaco54

body.title: World Cup 2026: My Heart Says Argentina Will Lift the Trophy Again!
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUAtEw7tEDuuiNYeWSwT6mSsa8w5ttBRuJaHPE5mqH2cV/1000706998.jpg 

Seeing the recently released schedule for the 2026 World Cup truly got my heart racing. With 104 matches ahead of us, the excitement is already building up. As a die-hard Argentina fan, my eyes immediately scanned the bracket to map out the path for my beloved team toward the top.
​Looking at the current landscape of world football, I’ve been putting together my own predictions. When I look at the semifinal stage, four names naturally stand out to me: Argentina, France, England, and Spain.
​These four nations have incredible squad depth and world-class talent. England with their young stars, Spain with their elegant possession play, and France with their relentless physical strength. However, to lift the trophy, you need more than just statistics—you need the heart of a champion.
​Many have asked: Can Argentina repeat their glory? To me, the answer is a resounding \

​Seeing the dedication this squad continues to show, paired with that burning passion they display on the pitch, I have a strong gut feeling that Argentina is the team that will bring the 2026 World Cup trophy home. There is something about the way this team plays that makes me believe the dream isn't over yet. Watching them compete isn’t just about the result; it’s about witnessing history being written by the feet of a legend.
​This is my prediction from the perspective of a loyal fan. I know that the ball is round and anything can happen on that pitch, which is the beauty of this sport.
​What about you? Do you share my pick for the final four, or do you have a different team that might pull off a massive upset? Let’s discuss it in the comments below!

body.title: Esperanza: Nuestra Brújula Emocional/ Inic #24 (Esp/ Eng)
body.body:
Así decimos por estas tierras y eso significa que la esperanza viene a ser algo así como ese ánimo a seguir, a continuar con nuestros proyectos, con nuestras búsquedas, esa razón de ser que nos motiva a seguir viviendo. Cuando esta desaparece es cuando caemos en situaciones negativas, como la tristeza, ansiedad, depresión, llevándonos incluso a perder la brújula emocional de nuestras vidas. Como leí en varios comentarios en el [post original](https://peakd.com/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen) en cuanto a la esperanza que manejamos algunos venezolanos, creo que es un sentimiento generalizado, porque se ha convertido en ese agarre que tenemos los que no nos hemos ido del país y los que han apostado a este nuevo despertar y que, como los músicos del Titanic, hemos resistido las embestidas de las olas. Acompañamos este sentimiento con la certeza de que todo va a obrar para bien, pues Dios no se equivoca. Así es que en este caso y en otros ámbitos de mi vida, la fe y la esperanza hacen la combinación perfecta para mantener mi bienestar en perfecta sintonía; cuestión que me sirve para replicar todas estas emociones y sentimientos para con mis semejantes y que, como decía mi abuelita, mientras haya vida, hay esperanzas, en cada respiro, en cada aliento. Por eso pienso que es indispensable mantener vivas nuestras esperanzas, nunca dar nada por terminado o finalizado mientras estemos respirando. Pues todo puede cambiar en un segundo, para bien o para mal, aunque muchos decidimos apuntar siempre para bien y confiar en que, si no se da lo que esperamos, es porque vendrá algo mejor, aunque tengamos que transitar por un proceso y todo lo que este conlleva. Tomando las enseñanzas obtenidas para continuar y seguir adelante. Así es que concluyo que la esperanza es nuestro motor, que le pone color a nuestros días, la brújula emocional que nos mantiene a flote. ¡Saludos, mis queridos amigos!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/brujita18/23xKqydBUvZvyz5Rom39ZtJgSyhygeMdEsChjLRjRT9XzMxPC5Lsc3E5ixKstUBcRVqWX.png)

# Eng “Hope is the last thing to be lost...” That's what we say around here, and it means that hope is something like the drive to keep going, to continue with our projects and our pursuits—that sense of purpose that motivates us to keep living. When hope disappears, we fall into negative states such as sadness, anxiety, and depression, which can even cause us to lose our emotional compass in life. As I read in several comments on the [original post](https://peakd.com/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen) regarding the hope that some of us Venezuelans hold onto, I believe it is a widespread sentiment, because it has become that anchor for those of us who have not left the country and those who have staked everything on this new awakening—and who, like the musicians on the Titanic, have weathered the onslaught of the waves. We accompany this sentiment with the certainty that everything will work out for the best, for God does not err. So in this case and in other areas of my life, faith and hope make the perfect combination to keep my well-being in perfect harmony; a matter that helps me share all these emotions and feelings with my fellow human beings and that, as my grandmother used to say, as long as there is life, there is hope, in every breath, in every breath. That is why I believe it is essential to keep our hopes alive, never to consider anything over or finished as long as we are breathing. For everything can change in a second, for better or for worse, though many of us choose to always aim for the best and trust that, if what we hope for does not come to pass, it is because something better is on the way—even if we have to go through a process and all that it entails. Taking the lessons learned to carry on and move forward. So I conclude that hope is our driving force, the one that brings color to our days, the emotional compass that keeps us afloat. Greetings, my dear friends!

body.title: Google's Agentic Dawn: How Gemini 3.5 Flash Is Rewriting Search After 25 Years
body.body:
![Google's Agentic Dawn: Gemini 3.5 Flash and the AI-First Search Revolution](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmPYhq9q6mu4PruXxtHVYcePPuo4nQPeg966nSGSFSu983)

# Google's Agentic Dawn: How Gemini 3.5 Flash Is Rewriting Search After 25 Years

**The first real overhaul of Google's search box in a quarter-century marks the moment AI stopped being a feature and became the product itself.**

---

If you've used Google Search in the last decade, you know the ritual: type a query into that familiar white bar, hit enter, and scan through ten blue links. That ritual is about to change — for the first time in over 25 years, Google is fundamentally redesigning its search experience, and at the center of it all sits a new AI model called Gemini 3.5 Flash.

At Google I/O 2026 last week, Sundar Pichai didn't just announce a new model. He declared what he called the \

of artificial intelligence — and showed how it would transform the way billions of people find information online.

## The Model That Changes Everything

Gemini 3.5 Flash launched as a general availability model on May 19, and the numbers are staggering. Google says it outperforms its predecessor Gemini 3.1 Pro across multiple benchmarks while operating four times faster than competing frontier models. The pricing is equally disruptive: $1.50 per million input tokens and $9.00 per million output tokens on the standard tier — roughly 25% cheaper than Gemini 3.1 Pro and about 3.3× cheaper on input than OpenAI's GPT-5.5 or Anthropic's Opus 4.7.

But the benchmarks tell only part of the story. What makes Gemini 3.5 Flash genuinely transformative is what Google built on top of it: a complete reimagining of search as an agentic, conversational experience rather than a keyword-matching exercise.

## Search After 25 Years

The search bar you know has been essentially the same since Google's founding. Now, it expands as you type, powered by Gemini 3.5 Flash, and begins generating answers before you even finish your query. Google's AI Mode — which already surpassed one billion monthly active users within a year of launch — is now the default experience worldwide.

The transformation goes far beyond smarter autocomplete. Google introduced \

where the search results page dynamically builds personalized dashboards, data visualizations, and interactive mini-applets based on what you're researching. Ask a question about stock portfolios? You get a live chart. Looking at travel options? An interactive comparison tool appears. The search results page is no longer a list of links — it's a living interface that adapts to your intent.\n\nPerhaps most radically, Google announced \

— always-on AI systems that continuously gather insights and perform actions on your behalf around the clock. These aren't chatbots you summon; they're autonomous agents working in the background, tracking topics, monitoring changes, and surfacing relevant information proactively.

## The Agentic Platform Behind It All

Supporting this vision is Antigravity 2.0, Google's agentic development platform that launched across five product surfaces simultaneously: a standalone desktop app, the agy CLI, Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, Managed Agents in the Gemini API, and a full Enterprise Agent Platform. The default model is Gemini 3.5 Flash, but it supports multi-model orchestration including Claude Sonnet 4.5 and OpenAI's GPT-OSS.

Pichai was direct about the platform's impact: \
\n\nGoogle also unveiled Gemini Spark — a personal AI agent designed to handle long-running background tasks and integrate directly with Chrome, Gmail, Google Docs (now featuring voice-powered \

), and other core products.

## The Scale Behind the Ambition

The infrastructure supporting this transformation is unprecedented. Google announced its annual capital expenditure will rise to approximately $190 billion in 2026, up from just $31 billion in 2022. Much of that spending funds custom silicon, including the eighth-generation Tensor Processing Units (TPU 8t and TPU 8i) that power Gemini's inference.

The usage numbers are equally eye-popping: Google processes 3.2 quadrillion tokens monthly — a 7× increase year-over-year. More than 8.5 million developers build with Google AI models every month, and Google Cloud customers processed over a trillion tokens in the past year alone.

AI Overviews now reach 2.5 billion monthly active users, and the Gemini app has crossed 900 million MAU with over 50 billion images generated through its built-in Nano Banana models.

## What This Means for the Future of AI

Google's I/O announcements represent something more significant than a product update. They signal the moment when AI agents transitioned from developer tools and enterprise experiments to mainstream consumer products — and Google is betting its core business on that transition.

The implications are profound. Search as we know it — a passive tool you consult when you have a question — is becoming an active partner that anticipates your needs, builds custom interfaces for your tasks, and works continuously in the background. The content economy faces a reckoning: if AI generates answers and interfaces directly, what happens to the traditional web?

Google's move also intensifies the frontier model competition. With Gemini 3.5 Flash offering frontier-level intelligence at a fraction of the cost, the barrier to building agentic applications drops dramatically. This could accelerate a wave of AI-powered tools that we're only beginning to imagine.

The agentic era isn't coming. It's here — and Google just turned on the lights.

body.title: For All The Lads Outhere: Skate Is Pure Beauty
body.body:
>Before I ever had some of the best moments of my teenage years and twenties at this skatepark, I had never even heard bands like Bad Religion, NOFX, Flema, 2 Minutos, or Ramones. This place taught me how to do and feel many of the things that still define me as an adult today. One of the clearest examples is that I never truly fit into any social group the way I did inside skateboarding culture. They’re just genuinely good people.

*\n\n*

>People who value authenticity. People without too many pretensions, but definitely not lacking drive or passion. And honestly, do you know what matters most? That feeling of community. That sensation of belonging somewhere, even if only for a moment, and knowing you’re safe there. Nostalgia is really doing its thing while I write this. Thankfully, this skatepark is still the right place for kids and teenagers who practice this sport and just want peace, friendship, and a sense of community.

* https://youtu.be/aqh-pg-Py_I?si=UUi_n32k_yWRuWQ4 *

>People (also) love saying extreme sports are dangerous or irresponsible. And weirdly enough, there are still plenty of social stigmas attached to them, especially in places where society always seems eager to point fingers at anyone living outside the norm. Trust me, I know a little about that. Being a woman who loves skateboarding, graffiti, dirt, sweat, and punk rock isn’t exactly considered attractive everywhere. Maybe in cities like Los Angeles or New York City it would seem cool, but in my city, in my country, it was a very different story.

*\n\n*

>When I look at these photos, it’s almost impossible not to think about the old days. Some of the crazy things we painted on these walls are still there even now. Almost fifteen years later, they survived. And somehow, they still manage to pull smiles out of me while unlocking memories, songs, bands, and moments I thought were buried somewhere deep inside my head. There’s something beautiful about getting older and realizing you were brave enough to be authentic when it mattered most. Back then, as a teenager, I questioned my own tastes constantly. Now, I’m grateful I defended them.

* https://youtu.be/wUxEhn7mhG0?si=zg6bKdTM38Ie--l1 *

>Maybe all you see are concrete ramps and rails made for skating, but I can’t stop smiling when I’m here. And honestly, I’m sure there are places that do the exact same thing to you. I’m not here to give life lessons or tell anyone how to feel, but from my perspective, skateboarding was one of the most underrated ways my generation built real friendships and genuine connections. Like every urban tribe, the bond came from honesty, shared experiences, and equality. Those ideas are embedded into this skatepark just as deeply as its ramps, graffiti, and cracked concrete. Coming back here and reconnecting with something I once loved so intensely has been genuinely beautiful.

* ![1000208941.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23tmB3r4SKcxV1UwkYDmusCgb4yGMMMTKprG64nS8nSZpwj8raS63ehdw7Y7XZVjQUhuL.jpg) ![1000237723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/243qAqDFMoHhPTNSdbt2U6F4asSWhN4tGQ2s9WPtbKSTmZs1SbEuV2uAziUgQHMfaoeKS.jpg) ***

body.title: Curiosiviajes - Channel Review [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![cyuuu.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPQvRsihdJ44Y8UsE1TFse2HArvTof7U2KKYzS67W9JAr/cyuuu.jpg) En algún momento me gustaría viaje fuera de venezuela y conocer lugares turísticos que son una maravilla, pero por ahora solo toca verlos a través de la plataforma de YouTube y muchos canales de viaje se encargan de mostrar ese lugares y esa lista de sitios que uno quiere conocer va creciendo. Por eso el canal de Curiosiviajes, es ese espacio que te hará creer que estás viviendo una gran experiencia única en cada espacio que ellos van recomendando. Aquí desde el primer minuto del video más allá de mostrar un paisaje y es lograr despertar es curiosidad de conocer cualquier sitio como una ciudad moderna, una isla, una construcción o cualquier otra cosa. Este canal apuesta en tener una buena calidad en los videos, y se nota que se toman su tiempo para editar, añadir efectos y mostrar los detalles más pequeños de dicho sitio, lo cual permite mantenerse entretenido en todo momento durante el viaje. Además, a diferencia de otros canales de YouTube que hacen este tipo de contenido de viaje, aquí le colocan una música de fondo y una voz que va narrando todo, haciendo que cada video se sienta casi como una película documental de viaje. >Someday I’d like to travel outside of Venezuela and visit amazing tourist destinations, but for now I can only see them on YouTube, where many travel channels showcase these places, and my list of places I want to visit keeps growing. That’s why the Curiosiviajes channel is the perfect place to make you feel like you’re having a truly unique experience at every location they recommend. From the very first minute of the video, it goes beyond simply showing a landscape; it aims to spark your curiosity to explore any place—whether it’s a modern city, an island, a building, or anything else. # >This channel focuses on high-quality videos, and it’s clear they take their time editing, adding effects, and highlighting the smallest details of each location, which keeps you entertained throughout the entire journey. Additionally, unlike other YouTube channels that produce this type of travel content, they include background music and a voiceover narrating the entire experience, making each video feel almost like a travel documentary film. https://youtu.be/D0u7rmStYfs [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D0u7rmStYfs)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

> Este es un canal que apenas va creciendo y con los pocos videos que tiene Curiosiviajes se nota que tienen mucho más para ofrecer ya que el mundo está lleno de lugares y allí la curiosidad de poder buscar información, leer y a la vez soñar de que algún día se podrá visitar logrando que con cada video pase eso. También es un canal perfecto para todas las edades, ya que el conocimiento nunca está de más, pero a la vez para los fanáticos de viaje y así poder de alguna manera distinta obtener nuevos destinos de viaje. >This is a channel that’s just starting to gain traction, and even with the few videos Curiosiviajes has so far, it’s clear they have much more to offer—after all, the world is full of places, and there’s a natural curiosity to seek out information, read about them, and dream of visiting them someday. Each video helps make that dream a reality. It’s also a perfect channel for all ages, since knowledge is always valuable, but it’s especially great for travel enthusiasts looking for new travel destinations in a fresh way. https://youtu.be/RbRKuv4VjLg [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RbRKuv4VjLg)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

>    


Otro punto interesante de este canal y con ese marca que no todo puede ser lo mismo y es que en algunos videos del canal se enfoca en lugares misteriosos, construcciones de alto nivel, fenómenos naturales o sitios que parecen imposibles de creer, pero que a la vez son parte de un viaje que todos quisieran conocer.


A la final esta canal de Curiosiviajes es ese espacio perfecto para descubrir lo increíble que puede llegar a ser nuestro planeta y tener la facilidad de otros se tomen el tiempo para documentar y publicarlo en un video es algo de admirar. Además, es ideal para todos y una vez que comiences a ver el contenido te darán ganas de ir a ese lugar y tomarte una foto para el recuerdo.




>Another interesting aspect of this channel—and one that shows that not everything has to be the same—is that some of its videos focus on mysterious places, impressive structures, natural phenomena, or sites that seem almost too incredible to be true, yet are part of a journey that everyone would love to experience.

#

>Ultimately, the Curiosiviajes channel is the perfect place to discover just how incredible our planet can be, and the fact that others take the time to document and share these experiences in videos is truly admirable. Plus, it’s perfect for everyone—once you start watching the content, you’ll want to visit those places and take a photo to remember them by.

body.title: God has promised, God will fulfill!!! | Dios ha prometido, Dios cumplirá!!!
body.body:
<center>![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/67386/pexels-photo-67386.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800)
</center>

*Fuente: Pexels.com / [Bible.com](https://www.bible.com/)*

Everything can shine again. Out of nothing Jesus can make everything new. No matter how dark your path looks now, the light always comes.

There are moments in life when things get really heavy. Moments when we have to make really tough decisions or face internal battles that don't let us move forward.

Faith is not seeing to believe. It's believing to see. And when we believe, God acts in ways we could never imagine.

Life has these moments of uncertainty. Moments where we question everything, where the road ahead looks cloudy and the path unclear.

> \

Jeremías 29:11

## God Bless you today and always!!!

**********
**********

Hay momentos en la vida que las cosas se ponen muy pesadas. Momentos que tenemos que tomar decisiones muy difíciles o enfrentar luchas internas que no nos permiten avanzar.

Pero allí es donde debemos recordar esta verdad: la luz de Cristo no compite con la oscuridad, la vence. La oscuridad no puede frenar la luz de Cristo, ni mucho menos apagarla.

No estoy hablando de frases motivadoras baratas. Estoy hablando de la presencia real de Jesús en nuestras vidas, iluminando todo lo que parecía cubierto por la oscuridad. Todo puede ser restaurado.

Cuándo aprendés a soltar y dejar que Dios tome el control, es cuando realmente empezás a vivir. Aquello que para el mundo parece una locura, puede ser tu mayor bendición.

> \

Jeremías 29:11

## Dios te Bendiga hoy y siempre!!!

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   El veneno de la esperanza y la parálisis del cambio.   ||   The poison of hope and the paralysis of change.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***

> El amigo @emiliorios nos ha lanzado un guante en su [iniciativa número 24](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen), invitándonos a reflexionar sobre la esperanza. Sin embargo, me veo en la necesidad de ser el abogado del diablo —como siempre—. Si bien la esperanza se vende como el combustible del alma, hay una cara oculta, mucho más sombría y real, que la convierte en una de las herramientas de sometimiento más eficaces de la historia humana.
# ***
El veneno de la esperanza y la parálisis del cambio.
*** La esperanza, cuando se despoja de la acción, no es más que un mecanismo de defensa negativo. Es, en muchos sentidos, el \
de la modernidad. Karl Marx afirmó en su *Crítica de la filosofía del derecho de Hegel* (1844) que *\

*. Hoy, esa frase podría actualizarse, ajustarse de la siguiente manera: ***la esperanza vacía es el narcótico que nos permite soportar lo insufrible sin rebelarnos***. 

## **La esperanza como parálisis y justificación**

Cuando confiamos ciegamente en que el futuro será mejor por *\
*, por destino o por intervención divina, perdemos el sentido de urgencia, pues, ¿para qué voy a forzar un cambio estructural en mi vida hoy, si tengo la \
de que mañana las cosas se arreglarán? Esta es la trampa del optimismo ingenuo o \

. Ignorar las grietas de la casa bajo una capa de pintura brillante no evita el derrumbe; solo lo hace más catastrófico. De esto hablé hace un par de semanas y lo sostengo.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGxDnh2cmHVJaXV9GqedfHzmsAtjqrwPHGo8c2broGce/615665118_18555705154021354_6191117659375115725_n.jpg)
<sup>[](https://scontent.fccs9-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t51.82787-15/615665118_18555705154021354_6191117659375115725_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=XOAUyDChN-sQ7kNvwF_1rTi&_nc_oc=Adq4_Qngimg1lP6PQFKOjKs1G2oZVmLdLayUgZsqpBayjvuvEU9aV2UiaPmyQE40AvI&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent.fccs9-1.fna&_nc_gid=E2-XRSqYCy0KxQtMloWdEA&_nc_ss=7b2a8&oh=00_Af5E5ddoJ9NeAeKt98Zol89-RYGSmZBo4hHhcvT8K8g5zg&oe=6A1A3892)</sup>
</center>

A lo largo de los siglos, la esperanza ha sido la cadena más fuerte del esclavo. Se le prometía una recompensa en otra vida, o un cambio de suerte en la próxima cosecha, para evitar que tomara el látigo y rompiera sus grilletes. Es una forma de \
; ciertamente, aceptamos situaciones injustas, empleos mediocres y relaciones abusivas bajo la premisa de que ***\

***. Es la resignación disfrazada de virtud.

## **El peor de los males: justificamos el sufrimiento**

Friedrich Nietzsche, en su obra *Humano, demasiado humano* (1878), relata el mito de la Caja de Pandora -de esto hablé en una publicación el año pasado- de una manera brutalmente honesta –aunque el tipo no me cae muy bien–. Según Nietzsche, tras salir todos los males de la caja, Pandora cerró la tapa justo antes de que la esperanza escapara. Pero lejos de ser un consuelo, el filósofo sostiene que:

> *\

*.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbhRECexwqQMBea59wgFhew9hwZbboG1pNhTuH2HkfrG1/image.png)
<sup>[](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Problema_del_mal#/media/Archivo:Pieter_Lastman_-_Jonah_and_the_Whale_-_Google_Art_ProjectFXD.jpg)</sup>
</center>

Desde esta óptica, la esperanza es lo que nos mantiene atados a la rueda del sufrimiento. Es el espejismo en el desierto que hace que el sediento siga caminando hasta morir de agotamiento, en lugar de cavar un pozo donde se encuentra.

## **Pies en la tierra**

Miremos a nuestro alrededor... ¿Cuántas personas pasan décadas en la miseria esperando que el gobierno cambie, que la suerte les sonría o que un milagro económico ocurra? Siempre, ya está por llegar el \
Esa esperanza los mantiene quietos, mansos. La historia la escriben aquellos que abandonaron la esperanza y la sustituyeron por la **voluntad**.\n\nLa esperanza nos dice: \

. \n\nPara que la esperanza sea útil, debe morir como sentimiento y renacer como estrategia, pues, de lo contrario, seguiremos alimentando una fantasía que nos anestesia frente al dolor necesario de la toma de decisiones. No necesitamos más \

que miren al horizonte con fe ciega; necesitamos realistas que miren al barro de sus pies y decidan dar un paso, aunque duela, aunque no haya garantías.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWrUdUPfkXgjVKhrPcQ8KvATB9mwPuB1qEj7B9ApHTKes/image.png)
<sup>[](https://elisahortaliza.com/con-los-pies-en-la-tierra/)</sup>
</center>

Según palabras del amigo @emiliorios en [Resiliencia: ¿Capacidad innata o aprendida?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/resiliencia-capacidad-innata-o-aprendida-esp-eng), enfatiza que la resiliencia requiere ***\
***. Si la esperanza se entiende como \
, choca con su propia premisa de que la resiliencia es una construcción activa. El autor sostiene que no basta con ***\

***. Invitar ahora a hablar de la esperanza sin el peso de la responsabilidad fáctica podría considerarse un retroceso hacia la ingenuidad.\n\nCuidar la esperanza, como sugiere la iniciativa, puede ser peligroso si lo que estamos alimentando es un parásito que nos quita la fuerza para luchar en el presente. A veces, lo más sano que podemos hacer por nosotros mismos es perder la esperanza, porque solo cuando aceptamos que ***\

**, es cuando finalmente empezamos a vivir de verdad.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZyWMSwyBGh6pxVLemMtd6588QM6EMwvE32ERDRStPXWH/llegando_el_verano.png)</center>

***Dejemos de ser esclavos de lo que \
y empecemos a ser dueños de lo que \
. Menos promesas al viento y más decisiones con sangre, sudor y realidad.***

> **Creciendo como persona, busca y encuentra lo que necesitas para ser un mejor humano en la Comunidad [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created). De seguro, hay un tema que te llamará la atención.**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holos-lotus/245n3ai2B1twdEnyzuYXmYiNoGag22e7ZZQ7uz72NKdqPqaR6PyaDrSeA7EMUq9RuNPHc.png Infografía propia de la Comunidad [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created)
*** ***
🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆+++🔆

*** *** ##
Dedicado a todos aquellos que, día a día, hacen del mundo un lugar mejor.
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnceTgTBLgAUkErZfdoePC7twytC1CTcqQYDKkU4Lrrd/1024espa_ol8.gif) ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif) ***

*** *** ***

> Our friend @emiliorios has thrown down the gauntlet in his [initiative number 24] (https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/we-urgently-need-to-talk-about-hope-how-do-you-nurture-and-feed-it-this-is-initiative-no-24-in-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen), inviting us to reflect on hope. However, I find myself needing to play devil’s advocate – as always. Whilst hope is sold as the fuel of the soul, there is a hidden side, far darker and more real, which makes it one of the most effective tools of subjugation in human history.
# ***
The poison of hope and the paralysis of change.
*** Hope, when stripped of action, is nothing more than a negative defence mechanism. It is, in many ways, the ‘opium’ of modernity. Karl Marx stated in his *Critique of Hegel’s Philosophy of Right* (1844) that *‘religion is the sigh of the oppressed creature… the opium of the people’*. Today, that phrase could be updated, adapted as follows: ***empty hope is the narcotic that allows us to endure the unbearable without rebelling***. ## **Hope as paralysis and justification** When we blindly trust that the future will be better through *‘magic’*, fate or divine intervention, we lose our sense of urgency; after all, why should I force a structural change in my life today, if I have the “hope” that things will sort themselves out tomorrow? This is the trap of naive optimism or ‘toxic positivism’. Ignoring the cracks in the house beneath a coat of glossy paint does not prevent the collapse; it merely makes it more catastrophic. I spoke of this a couple of weeks ago and I stand by it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPGxDnh2cmHVJaXV9GqedfHzmsAtjqrwPHGo8c2broGce/615665118_18555705154021354_6191117659375115725_n.jpg) [](https://scontent.fccs9-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t51.82787-15/615665118_18555705154021354_6191117659375115725_n.jpg?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=127cfc&_nc_ohc=XOAUyDChN-sQ7kNvwF_1rTi&_nc_oc=Adq4_Qngimg1lP6PQFKOjKs1G2oZVmLdLayUgZsqpBayjvuvEU9aV2UiaPmyQE40AvI&_nc_zt=23&_nc_ht=scontent.fccs9-1.fna&_nc_gid=E2-XRSqYCy0KxQtMloWdEA&_nc_ss=7b2a8&oh=00_Af5E5ddoJ9NeAeKt98Zol89-RYGSmZBo4hHhcvT8K8g5zg&oe=6A1A3892)
Throughout the centuries, hope has been the slave’s strongest chain. They were promised a reward in the afterlife, or a change of fortune in the next harvest, to prevent them from seizing the whip and breaking their shackles. It is a form of ‘passive slavery’; indeed, we accept unjust situations, mediocre jobs and abusive relationships on the premise that ***‘something better will come along’***. It is resignation disguised as virtue. ## **The worst of evils: we justify suffering** Friedrich Nietzsche, in his work *Human, All Too Human* (1878), recounts the myth of Pandora’s Box –which I discussed in a post last year – in a brutally honest manner– though I don’t particularly care for the man. According to Nietzsche, after all the evils had escaped from the box, Pandora closed the lid just before hope could escape. But far from being a consolation, the philosopher argues that: > *‘Zeus wanted man, however much he might be tormented by other evils, not to give up on life, but to allow himself to be tormented again. To this end, he gave him hope: it is, in truth, the worst of all evils, for it prolongs the torment of mankind’*.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbhRECexwqQMBea59wgFhew9hwZbboG1pNhTuH2HkfrG1/image.png) [](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Problema_del_mal#/media/Archivo:Pieter_Lastman_-_Jonah_and_the_Whale_-_Google_Art_ProjectFXD.jpg)
From this perspective, hope is what keeps us bound to the wheel of suffering. It is the mirage in the desert that makes the thirsty person keep walking until they die of exhaustion, instead of digging a well where they stand. ## **Feet on the ground** Let’s look around us... How many people spend decades in misery waiting for the government to change, for luck to smile on them, or for an economic miracle to happen? Always, the ‘saviour’ is just about to arrive: ‘Kneel down!’ That hope keeps them still, docile. History is written by those who abandoned hope and replaced it with **willpower**. Hope tells us: ‘Wait’. Willpower tells us: ‘Do’. For hope to be useful, it must die as a feeling and be reborn as a strategy; otherwise, we will continue to feed a fantasy that numbs us to the necessary pain of decision-making. We do not need more “dreamers” who gaze at the horizon with blind faith; we need realists who look at the mud at their feet and decide to take a step, even if it hurts, even if there are no guarantees.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWrUdUPfkXgjVKhrPcQ8KvATB9mwPuB1qEj7B9ApHTKes/image.png) [](https://elisahortaliza.com/con-los-pies-en-la-tierra/)
In the words of my friend @emiliorios in [Resilience: Innate or Learned Ability?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/resiliencia-capacidad-innata-o-aprendida-esp-eng), he emphasises that resilience requires ***‘effort, learning and facing reality’***. If hope is understood as “waiting for things to get better”, it clashes with his own premise that resilience is an active construct. The author argues that it is not enough to ***“feel”***; one must ***“act”***. Inviting people now to talk about hope without the weight of factual responsibility could be seen as a step backwards towards naivety. Nurturing hope, as the initiative suggests, can be dangerous if what we are feeding is a parasite that robs us of the strength to fight in the present. Sometimes, the healthiest thing we can do for ourselves is to lose hope, because it is only when we accept that ***“nothing will change unless we force it”*** that we finally begin to truly live.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVM4kn5WyLHT5VQbEHo7ErkVsn7FAEAJHxfTFH4tASwDB/image.png)
***Let us stop being slaves to what “could be” and start taking ownership of what “is”. Fewer empty promises and more decisions made with blood, sweat and reality.***

> **Growing as a person, seek and find what you need to be a better person in the [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created) Community. Surely, there's a topic that will catch your attention.**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/holos-lotus/245n3ai2B1twdEnyzuYXmYiNoGag22e7ZZQ7uz72NKdqPqaR6PyaDrSeA7EMUq9RuNPHc.png Community's own infographic [Holos&Lotus](https://peakd.com/c/hive-131951/created)

body.title: 凌晨大雨
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![A6Bj544Kk4uQmVDG_bxw4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/A6Bj544Kk4uQmVDG_bxw4/A6Bj544Kk4uQmVDG_bxw4.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

孩子妈和孩子周天晚上11点多从北京返回，我到车站接到人已经快11点半了。10点半我就到了车站附近，等了一会外面开始下雨，刚开始雨比较小我没当回事。接到孩子妈和孩子后，雨开始下的大起来了。车刚开到高速上就变成暴雨了，路面时不时有积水，感觉轮胎有打滑迹象，为了安全我只能降低车速。到小区门口，雨依然下的很大，幸好后备箱有雨伞。说来奇怪，天气预报周六周天有雨，可是迟迟没有下，相反周末两天都是大晴天，就是有些闷闷的，没想到都憋在周天半夜12点才下。

我原本以为这场雨会一直延续到周一整天，可是周一早上起床后雨已经停了，而且马上出了大太阳，地面都快晒干了，这天气变化的有点快。早上起来后我把车从小区外面挪到里面，早上有人上班开车出去比较容易停车。去北京的两天，孩子周末作业都没有做，今天回来后要开始赶周末作业。这两天孩子妈带孩子逛了清华，故宫，人民大会堂，八达岭长城，早上4点看了升旗仪式。品尝了北京烤鸭，庆丰包子，铜锅涮肉等等。

虽然现在不是暑假7,8月份，但孩子还是感觉热，尤其是天安门广场。可以理解，毕竟广场上一棵树都没有，也没有可以遮阴地方。除非是阴天，否则大太阳晒着确实不好受。如果是暑假时候，那就更加难以忍受，人又多又晒，简直活受罪。所以说去北京旅游，千万不能选暑假或者寒假，一个热死一个冻死。最好就是4，5月份，不下雨的时候。

---

body.body:

```markdown
물의 노래

조용히 흐르는,  
투명한 시냇물,  
바람에 실려  
속삭이는 소리.

햇살에 반짝여  
무지개를 그리네,  
어디서 왔는지  
알 수 없는 꿈.

산과 들을 감싸  
모든 생명 품고,  
영원히 이어지는  
물의 노래, 나의 노래.
```
