body.title: Shadow Step.
body.body: > Playing as MJ, I tracked Peter through streets heavily patrolled by Hunters and search bots, utilizing stuns and web-shooters. After exploring a house torn apart by symbiote markings, MJ defended herself from an ambush and found Peter was consuming bodies. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWDtNkw9Ro4wmb4PcSQWt5Va776kG6uu1o7nwWjkX7D7f/screenshot_1_.png) So where were we last time? Yeah, Peter took down the hunter who was about to attack MJ, and I had to go after him, playing as MJ to navigate the dangerous, locked-down neighborhood streets safely. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcBdKw6aXaMEfh1FqJpuMQ98Nnw3EwEJS7dWYWtYASAUm/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb6kff9FNpBdNgJkLyF4gdfMGMY1ZRNMKhGaAAHBjXork/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma3S3QKAnSgLdf14vqd4AVBPF1jERmxWujYPDZh6SEWcb/screenshot_4_.png) On the way through the back alleys, I had to take care of some hunters patrolling the area. And taking the last hunter down there was a bit risky, as there were more of them throughout the streets who could hear a struggle. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT7o4baSprsVxneak2WrT9di5y2DYYndqWELHUX8pjuCo/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX53sd16zmYwsneivpPWQuZUQjwewXBmDqpE2ezjfjst8/screenshot_6_.png) I took cover fast after taking down that last hunter. Otherwise I'd be spotted by that hunter bot who found the dead body I left behind. Its searchlight started scanning the immediate perimeter instantly. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKojwJiZpRFc3HDLt4quRQ2zuL7NtG48ePdhRCn1BkAA/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTNEjdwpzxFxL9w4aPhiUgb3dDBfnAFbTTSfqMb5uM1S/screenshot_8_.png) There were two hunters on my way, and when I was stunning one of them, the other one saw me. But I was a lot fast in stunning the other one as well before he took action or shouted. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ12tnNLnn4uhvGA6MxRW1ELqRSbjN1YixUjUpJMjzzAA/screenshot_9_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsUKKcDyrM3LzmSEKHYD3pZtj1rGrirMbtYAngU1NBsu/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRWP9QbDqBT9kj2y9ZMCBhW3g3mDtq1k9TS7ccMLKnx5w/screenshot_11_.png) And at last I reached this side of the neighborhood, where Peter was last seen by the resistance team. And it looked like he was still inside a house as I saw tentacles of the symbiote through an open window. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaRktRVzUw1s6Uvp3BispeuJ8XC4m8ferHSWCf6V47oc/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQWUbtRRkPKgRgeJLHCmuLDAz3sReP9ZFPnqyBB7ReRhB/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPt2UcXuvewafvfrDbVQRc36aWBEYDZsrT4cmhtYgo5QN/screenshot_14_.png) While on my way to the front door, I stunned another hunter, and another one of them found the bodies in the courtyard. So I had to take care of him as well from afar, and I had to use the web shooters this time. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHySx1tqsiuByjW5J6P7uiaVu7hwezixrkE8xYtqAtMT/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQyKps3jJNYTnoAWKmXMS7259vePnkvg8AkgPF8dKy2kk/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWgd3G9fmg5D9BgiNzBQTRoKbsMGQTGg34NpCkvSaqXaa/screenshot_17_.png) After taking down another hunter on my way through the upper balcony, I had to cross from one house to another through a bridge where another hunter was guarding. So I had to take care of him as well to clear my path. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPY1my9BHWPToDybGQcrZjCQeBGHfiYzS6dKTcXL3zPig/screenshot_18_.png) Then on my way out of that building, I noticed there were two hunters below a big shelf that I kicked over from the landing above and injured them, trapping them beneath the heavy wooden beams. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXLdp4kX1LW5yYQmTsVJTARr9bo9QbVAQQyuDHNSxFBLt/screenshot_19_.png) And at last I reached the house from where the symbiote tentacles were seen last. But I didn't find Peter there, instead I found some bodies of hunters and deep, black scratches torn into the hardwood floor. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXrPGpNw9be8DGnW8kNb6fZUVDP7L7qRnVoeZ7tQckxD5/screenshot_20_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbk8X9awggRsx2CXCZH293MTnt7WdhoC6FrRAk9TyozXA/screenshot_21_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTURKb8kcFUmMiHfeLVg6tFRzXEwRPWeHXtYcf9A3oDWE/screenshot_22_.png) After getting out of the building to look for Peter, a hunter got MJ from behind in a tight chokehold. But she was too fast that she could even take down that hunter on her own using her stun gun. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVpg7m8DN5aYdx2NwgV5jYKHTqGM3tfZoCWjXDH8LTPKy/screenshot_23_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4nYvxAVQ5t7NTz6zSQ3hzs647zBzh9zwYaJugfW9HKk/screenshot_24_.png) There came another hunter who'd definitely take down MJ, but suddenly the situation changed. It looked like MJ was seeing a nightmare. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqHdooPiPFwj38jAE15vMdoq25hBAVeHRkDHyhFRCPnk/screenshot_25_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW9Yx7zMPZKnFQh92q2CgoGwkHFv8ySrmWA5Yp7EmRi4A/screenshot_26_.png) The neighborhood Spider-Man who always tried to let the villains live, turned into a beast and he was feeding on those bodies right in front of MJ. It looked like the suit that once helped Peter, is actually helping itself. https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png That's all for now. I'll write about more of this story again soon. Be safe till we meet again. Au revoir/Goodbye. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png ***All the screenshots are my takes from my play using the in-game photo mode, and I tried Canva to edit the thumbnail.*** --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=rashed.ifte/af23d762)

body.title: The acid attack on KontraS activist Andrie Yunus has garnered international attention after the European Parliament passed a resolution urging the Indonesian
body.body:
The acid attack on KontraS activist Andrie Yunus has garnered international attention after the European Parliament passed a resolution urging the Indonesian government to thoroughly investigate the perpetrators and masterminds behind the attack. In its official statement, the EU legislative body called for all parties involved, including those suspected of planning the attack, to be prosecuted through an independent and transparent civil court. The European Parliament also emphasized the importance of ending impunity and guaranteeing victims' rights to justice. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaQG4g9ByHxViaGiKsBTh7YTzQEiSFtySja5SBPcPQF1k/Kasus%20penyiraman%20air%20keras%20terhadap%20aktivis%20KontraS,%20Andrie%20Yunus,%20kini%20mendapat%20perhatian%20inter%201.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZLTCK4VWFuHVwxcE8tBBvAgp6S6TaBSEfXRLUQGeUJaR/Kasus%20penyiraman%20air%20keras%20terhadap%20aktivis%20KontraS,%20Andrie%20Yunus,%20kini%20mendapat%20perhatian%20inter%202.jpg 


In addition to urging a resolution to the case, the European Parliament also called on Indonesia to strengthen protection for human rights defenders, environmental activists, and journalists so they can carry out their duties without intimidation or violence. Meanwhile, based on the latest information provided by the account@kontras_updateAndrie Yunus reportedly suffered permanent damage to his right eye due to severe chemical trauma caused by the acid attack. This case is considered a crucial test of Indonesia's commitment to law enforcement and the protection of civil liberties. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@rsmnndr/the-acid-attack-on-kontras-activist-andrie-yunus-has-garnered-international-attention-after-the-european-parliament-passed-a-resolution-urging-the-indonesian-976)

body.title: The Benefits and Risks of Publicizing Salaries
body.body: In the corporate world, salaries are a powerful tool that companies use to attract employees, keep them committed to their work, and also boost retention. However, many people across different organizations do not always find fulfillment in their salaries alone. In fact, the majority retain their positions not because they enjoy the role but because the wages they are being paid can afford them some of their basic necessities and the job saves them from being idle as well as prepares them for career progression. But in recent times, there have been conversations regarding the idea of publicizing salaries and whether it has any significant advantage or disadvantage to the employee or the company. Personally, I believe this is an argument that has both pros and cons, and choosing one side may be difficult. Now, if a company decides to make salaries transparent to everyone, the action translates to trust and honesty. It becomes proof that they hold strong values and are committed to ensuring the welfare of every staff member. However, making salaries public can only be done by companies that do not exploit their staff and we know that there are only very few of them across the world.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/white-printer-paper-on-white-surface-0k0kxhPmf9s) Another benefit of making salaries public comes into play in the recruitment process. It helps attract exceptional talent to the company while reducing time-wasting. For example, if I am highly qualified for a role at an engineering company and I find 10 organizations whose salaries are made public, rather than reaching for low-hanging fruits, I’ll target those 10 alone and apply strategically to ensure I get an interview with at least 3, from which I would likely get employment from one. Working with such a company, I wouldn’t have to worry about my salary not being enough or not matching my job responsibilities. Publicizing employee salaries can also help reduce the gender pay gap in companies. In the past and even currently, many companies still discriminate based on gender, especially against women. They believe men are more capable of certain kinds of work and hence pay women less. But when salaries are made public, employers will have no justification for unequal pay as they will be under scrutiny and pressure to maintain fairness. For the disadvantages, one would be insecurity. There’s a reason a lot of us frown against the act of displaying one’s cash inflow and outflow from the bank on social media and that applies to this situation. Such transparency can put employees at risk of unwanted attention and social pressure. They could become targets for vices like kidnapping, armed robbery, or fraud and in this case, I believe many people would prefer that their salaries are kept undisclosed.

/> [**Image from unsplash**](https://unsplash.com/photos/focus-photography-of-person-counting-dollar-banknotes--8a5eJ1-mmQ) Another disadvantage is competitors poaching top talents. For every company selling a product, there is a competitor in the same market. So if salaries are made public with employee details, competitors will immediately know how to approach an asset in the company with better benefits. If the offer is enticing enough to the talent in that company, it becomes very easy for them to resign and start up with the competitor, which would mean a great loss for their current employers. I believe the solution to this is to find what works for each company and if possible, anonymize the data of each employee while making sure that the figures and the total compensation benefits are made public. This way, everyone is secure, accountability for the welfare of staff is guaranteed, and cooperation is fostered between every department, which eventually leads to the progress of the company as a whole. * * *

> 
 
Hoy el día ha estado lluvioso, mi jornada laboral tranquila y el clima invitándome a la reflexión.

Escuché una canción de la que me atrapó la frase: \
, me pareció tan certera y significativa que la busqué en YouTube. \n\nAllí descubrí que el título de esta melodía es: \

y su intérprete es Thiago Navarro.

Me tomé el tiempo de escuchar la letra completa y me gustó.

Más allá de gustarme, me quedó en la cabeza esa frase... \

> 
 
Today has been rainy, my workday was quiet, and the weather put me in a reflective mood.

I heard a song with a line that really struck me: \

It struck me as so true and meaningful that I looked it up on YouTube. There I discovered that the title of the song is “Lo que damos” and it’s performed by Thiago Navarro. I took the time to listen to the entire lyrics, and I liked it. More than just liking it, that line stuck in my head… “Love yourself so much that you don’t have to beg for love.” ***
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GP152xzMw-o&list=RDGP152xzMw-o&start_radio=1 [Lo que damos - Thiago Navarro](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GP152xzMw-o&list=RDGP152xzMw-o&start_radio=1)
***

> 
 
Y es que muchas veces nos lanzamos al mundo en búsqueda de alguien que nos ame, cuando ni siquiera hemos sido capaces de amarnos a nosotros mismos.

No vemos el amor desde la entrega, sino desde la carencia.

Queremos encontrar esa \

que en teoría está en alguna parte para complementarnos, cuando nadie podrá llenar el vacío que corresponde a nosotros. Cuando rogamos amor, no tenemos idea del valor que tenemos, nuestra autoestima está tan lastimada, que no puede ver que merecemos a alguien que nos ame bonito.

> The truth is, we often throw ourselves into the world in search of someone to love us, when we haven’t even been able to love ourselves. We don’t see love as a gift, but as a lack. We want to find that “other half” who, in theory, is out there somewhere to complete us, when no one can fill the void that belongs to us. When we beg for love, we have no idea of our own worth; our self-esteem is so damaged that we can’t see that we deserve someone who loves us deeply. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmZyww2cfeaGSsUukD99WED1yyoHW3qibWyJsWDBsTR7Hf/20260525_153746.jpg
***

> 
 
Y es que no es buena idea de buscar amor, cuando no hemos sanado nuestras heridas, porque sintonizaremos con alguien en la misma situación.

Muchas veces es un patrón que se repite y pensamos ¿Por qué siempre nos pasa lo mismo?

Es simple, porque partimos siempre desde las mismas carencias.

\

> The thing is, it’s not a good idea to look for love when we haven’t healed our wounds, because we’ll end up connecting with someone in the same situation. It’s often a recurring pattern, and we wonder, “Why does the same thing always happen to us?” It’s simple: because we always start from the same place of lack. “*Nothing changes unless you change*.” ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmTKg46eJnykLhqp6BeDDVzUZ1RgSsD43QEW4dkgZrUinQ/20260525_153518.jpg
***

> Me ha costado tantos años ver esto... Recuerdo con tristeza tantas veces que lloré por desamor. No lo valía, pero lo peor es que yo sentía que valía menos. Nadie que se ame lo suficiente, se disminuye ante otro que no le ama. Es amor es libertad, puede ir y venir. El amor elige quedarse donde siente que no necesita más. Pero para que alguien nos elija cada día, tenemos que ser suficientes. ¿Qué quiere decir esto? Debemos ser lo que nos gustaría recibir. No me gustaría estar al lado de alguien que requiera validación constante, que expire su inseguridad a través de los celos, que no tenga metas y aspiraciones, que no sea capaz de valorarme. Porque sí, alguien que no se valore, no será capaz de valorarte... Sólo te querrá como un trofeo.

> It has taken me so many years to realize this... I remember with sadness all the times I cried over a broken heart. I wasn’t worth it, but the worst part is that I felt I was worth even less. No one who loves themselves enough would put themselves down in front of someone who doesn’t love them. Love is freedom; it can come and go. Love chooses to stay where it feels it needs nothing more. But for someone to choose us every day, we have to be enough. What does this mean? We must be what we would like to receive. I wouldn’t want to be with someone who needs constant validation, who vents their insecurity through jealousy, who has no goals or aspirations, who isn’t capable of valuing me. Because yes, someone who doesn’t value themselves won’t be able to value you... They’ll only want you as a trophy. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMBE8WEprJX19kZDB5ga5LtDbDyjxNV1qjyAk7D8yepm/20260424_141446.jpg
***
> \n \nEs como dice la canción de Santiago Cruz \
. Porque no se trata de complementarnos, deberíamos ser dos individuos completos que eligen caminar juntos. Sólo desde allí encontraremos un amor sano.

> It’s just like Santiago Cruz’s song says: “I don’t need you; I can live without you.” Because it’s not about completing each other; we should be two whole individuals who choose to walk together. Only then will we find a healthy love. ***
https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZJCf5HRkDZtAwWotuK3xsGEtxKmkhVzn1SWkBT8zYq3/20260525_153810.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To all of you, thank you for joining me on this journey through these words. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much

body.title: I made these cookies with black beans and they are delicious 👌🏼 (ENG-ESP)
body.body:
***Greetings dear vegan community, happy start to the week! 😊💚***

+ ***¡Saludos querida comunidad vegana, feliz comienzo de semana! 😊💚***

---
---
![photo_4947215340861590522_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xeoyKt5NqNErBWTAXofpHeVL2Lo6KzeLZtimskuio4yhiiANXV3JgnDUaP1BFh2T17z.jpg)

---
---
I'm always looking for new cookie recipes; some of you know I love having a good treat to go with my afternoon coffee.

Today I decided to try this recipe, which was once a bit unusual for me. But after realizing I can make sweet and tasty recipes with beans, lentils, or chickpeas, I set out to make these delicious black bean cookies. Here in my country, we usually call them \

(black beans).

I was inspired to make these cookies because of the ingredients: cocoa, peanut butter, oats, and others. It seemed like a pretty healthy recipe and a very different and delicious option. These cookies turned out slightly crispy on top and very soft on the inside.

**Without a doubt, everyone at home will love this recipe 😊**

+ Siempre estoy buscando nuevas recetas para hacer galletas, algunos saben que me encanta tener un buen acompañante para el café de la tarde.

+ Hoy me dio por probar está receta que en algún momento fue extraña para mí, pero después de darme cuenta que puedo hacer recetas dulces y sabrosas con frijoles, lentejas o garbanzos, me dispuse a hacer estás ricas galletas con frijoles negros, aquí en mi país normalmente le decimos (caraotas negras).

+ Me animé a preparar estás galletas por los ingredientes que lleva, cacao, mantequilla de maní, avena, entre otros, me pareció una receta bastante saludable y una opción muy diferente y deliciosa, estas galletas quedaron ligeramente crujientes por arriba y muy suaves por dentro.

+ **Sin temor a equivocarme, está receta les gustará a todos en casa 😊**

***Are you interested in the recipe? Come, let's make it together!***

+ ***¿Te interesa la receta? ¡Ven hagámosla juntos!***

# Ingredients:
**My measuring cup is 250 ml.**
-2/3 cup oat flour.
-1 cup black beans.
-1/3 cup peanut or almond butter.
-1/3 cup plant-based milk.
-2 tablespoons cocoa powder.
-1/4 cup sugar (you can use your preferred sweetener).
-1 teaspoon baking powder.
-1/4 teaspoon salt.
-Dark chocolate chips, to taste.
-Almonds for garnish, optional.

+ # Ingredientes:
+ **Mi taza medidora es de 250 ML.**
+ -2/3 taza de harina de avena.
+ -1 taza de frijoles negros (caraotas, porotos, alubias).
+ -1/3 taza de mantequilla de maní o de almendras.
+ -1/3 taza de leche vegetal.
+ -2 cucharada de cacao.
+ -1/4 taza de azúcar, puedes usar tu endulzante preferido.
+ -1 cucharadita de polvo para hornear.
+ -1/4 cucharadita de sal.
+ -Chips de chocolate oscuro, al gusto.
+ -Almendras para decorar, opcional.

![photo_4947215340861590493_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpT49L4MQmcAW6f7WSvAgf7dghx6F3VAbr3oujaqc1B1VwesXbtPrzaZ5drMsoTbubq.jpg)

---
---
# Let's get started:

Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit).

+ # Vamos con la preparación:

+ Precalentamos el horno a 180 grados.

In a blender, we put the black beans.

+ En un vaso de licuadora echamos, los frijoles negros.

![photo_4947215340861590494_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAe8SWiKAuZzpKNDRGXB6Ddtaur23jrcFcCNdp83Tamfs91P2dPqQA6kqNA8aiccTHK.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590495_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wgQCoifjcQZekJRRAna9atBzzKEYT11DcbpeuhRnzpBNw8QwhXCeaisUwPeYBNVa9A3.jpg)

We add the plant-based milk, I used almond milk, we add the peanut butter and the sweetener.

+ Agregamos la leche vegetal, yo he usado de almendras, añadimos la mantequilla de maní y el endulzante.

![photo_4947215340861590496_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23wCJEwchDXosPhs5bJfyR67w8jddqnpAqhvFBecNZZ91DyfFnt8BF7S9ccMwFbJmpXbM.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590497_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23u66w65YGdJFThBoaA2iVLHtHQkSpqNSGqpqMrCrbbEXHqPAim7vYGWb2uRfmh8XzPrB.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590498_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAVKSKjt75zADebcNmWF25WLH1Dn1c1WXTa6wFPpG2dfgfECPWuw8EyyzwVMNGSDLCi.jpg)

Blend very well until you obtain a smooth and creamy mixture.

+ Licuamos muy bien hasta obtener una preparación cremosa y lisa.

![photo_4947215340861590499_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23u66w8VTtw3LMrfuUDzti7H33kkDuaDVJi8jX7kih4fSQU2WbZh8DbEJwyThtPWiK51g.jpg)

Now we pour the cream into a container and add the other ingredients: the oat flour and the cocoa powder.

+ Ahora vertemos la crema en un recipiente y le vamos agregando los demás ingredientes, la harina de avena, el cacao en polvo.

![photo_4947215340861590500_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eos1KrrcsYzBkX3fwNErKoCQ6HxLh2qURTE6ipJRdsh7DZjABmfAGqWHc2QUkMh6vXV.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590501_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eou8AQMuEoB3DMzEfb7HDcVVbW7R9SFu9U7ePBDumvyVP2g1hjyuVEMMP5Fi8WsiCyE.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590502_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eoc7WR7Emp7bUEHkuMLtj2FE1QDYa7HLHbSmogZCB2EUEmh5AvpkbiaZ5RkFkyi78uv.jpg)

We add the baking powder and salt.

+ Incorporamos el polvo para hornear y la sal.

![photo_4947215340861590503_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EokdeC9gTDACtAxDaEgVobNPbnKoPYMv42BmE96EYoPFTbf1HAa3e9TKu2qM68LytCk.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590504_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eou99PzWQ7G6twPjs9xQHEeVqQPtWmeC3AVwmYvk6MLamR6LuH9jhLXFwCEEp6aMHwd.jpg)

We mix it very well, I used a hand whisk and a soup spoon, you can also use a pastry spatula.

+ Mezclamos muy bien, yo he usado un batidor manual y una cuchara para sopa, también puedes usar una paleta repostera.

![photo_4947215340861590505_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAcGPwucfmGsrrHnGN696aVPCFghecek5ZV4CUnXiHcoad99McTZFM8wSGxiWfmoAC4.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590506_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoGyQw9s5ZqozpkAeqcgbE6aR74VHYNsnB2vEgRHoogjAfMa3z5k25YGXthX9yeUJ6i.jpg)

Add the chocolate chips and mix again until they are well incorporated into the mixture.

+ Agregamos las chispas de chocolate, mezclamos nuevamente que queden bien integradas en la mezcla.

![photo_4947215340861590507_x.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23xAeD9z7Ku6stpqp7xXd9FZRupWvefNiLQ9tayDRdGSjE2tYpwkHY3iMZqm9L371rVyi.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590508_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/48PwaM3rn9MQ9jn5xjjLLsPpT7vnCLPM8SX5ihRNf7zJq4uJJKR6j39PD19bwogbhg.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590509_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eo8ULDCCPewZNmX2PbJhrD3TntPx1tcxu9Pc2ubKooPyzorPGCokbifnCEfUXfouEf7.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590510_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpNoKVsNMxdRKnGSHSxPoTudFWrPWoowSGFbuB3qfDMajCL5A4F2x4qrhuw9yqs4sDE.jpg)

Now we're going to shape our cookies. I've used a very easy method since this mixture is sticky. With a soup spoon, I take a portion and place it on the baking tray, shaping it into a round with the same spoon. Remember to use parchment paper or grease the tray beforehand to prevent the cookies from sticking.

+ Ahora vamos a dar forma a nuestras galletas, yo he usado una manera muy fácil ya que esta mezcla es pegajosa, con una cuchara para sopa, agarro una porción y la voy colocando en la bandeja para horno dándole forma redondeada con la misma cuchara, recuerda usar papel encerado o engrasar previamente la bandeja para evitar que las galletas se peguen.

![photo_4947215340861590511_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eoc8W5dkMVWQYUMWBffDcHB2kmbAuK9wqrkvNN3nXrmTJjs8CN4SR3AUrJF1tMC55Z2.jpg)

Finally, and optionally, we decorate with an almond in the center. I like this idea because it gives a crunchy touch to each cookie.

+ Por ultimo y opcional decoramos con una almendra en el centro, me gusta esta idea porque le da un toque crocante a cada galleta.

![photo_4947215340861590513_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EowH8YtEFWYGGSZudJovcnTEkpZxbeYNhnMi7Yog2k9d73T6E3yb32TPFW6a6NNVY2D.jpg)

We put them in the oven for about 15 minutes, depending on your oven, it may be a few minutes more or less, it is important to keep an eye on them, to make sure they are ready, insert a pastry toothpick into one of the cookies, it should come out dry.

+ Llevamos al horno por unos 15 minutos aproximados, dependiendo de tu horno, pueden ser unos minutos más o unos minutos menos, es importante estar pendiente, para asegurar que están listas, inserta un palillo repostero en una de las galletas, este debe salir seco.

![photo_4947215340861590515_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23x19F3YgzGUvkgfMMbBGsW1rrq5m8CcnzevXpHbpnKF6EnQk8ekoiparNF5sJkGGpuYc.jpg)

***Once they're out of the oven, let them cool before unmolding and enjoying! They're truly delicious, highly recommended 😋😍***

+ ***¡Al sacarlas del horno dejamos enfriar para desmoldarlas y disfrutarlas! son realmente deliciosas, totalmente recomendadas 😋😍***

![photo_4947215340861590516_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Eoc7znrSWc3di2oBDYDP5cYE34mXUviAtoAFaSHpFcNBMk2APU6RdZHp6YiuKwcjb3j.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590518_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EoptpKB2qhLS2o8ye254uZUyQbB5BbgHfjxJtYwZNYK7CXKpcj92iP5L8sAtMdA1eo9.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590519_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/EpA3yBNvbod5w1NeCvkCL94m5xq5uxCzUvm4cd7Bg6FCi4dj7Gc5QKizG5S6ESzL2Pn.jpg)

---
![photo_4947215340861590520_y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/Ep1YJZUB9ZPCAHLpH8qQUmQbAoTa5KkMxjdFyf5e2RR2a1oWBbGqMkAbnz2KtAJq3Pp.jpg)

---
---
**I hope you'll try this recipe, see you soon 💚**

+ **Espero y te animes a probar esta receta, nos vemos pronto 💚**

# <center>Thank you for joining me and for your support, may the Creator bless you generously 🙏</center>

+ # <center>Gracias por acompañarme y por tu apoyo, el Creador te bendiga generosamente 🙏</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carisma77/23tRmZS3sdUh1CH46rTPA2XMrJ8Hi76bJUZaYx5JjmmyWRaRaPi1JjvFQcPwQhRrCG92r.png)






<center><sub>Photos are my own, taken and edited with my Tecno Spark 20C phone.
Separators and shapes from Microsoft Word.
Collage used: CollageMaker.</sub></center>

+ <center><sub>Fotos de mi propiedad tomadas y editadas con mi teléfono Tecno Spark 20C.
Separadores y Figuras de Microsoft Word.
Collage Usado: CollageMaker.</sub></center>

body.title: Bitcoin ETF Exodus Meets Nasdaq Options Approval — A Tale of Two Markets
body.body:
![header](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmVfTYCN3HYSePe1VWnDeuxPbGqnT1pUTkftifrppLuCft)

**The crypto market on May 25, 2026 is defined by a striking contradiction: while institutions are pulling billions from spot Bitcoin ETFs, the regulatory infrastructure for sophisticated Bitcoin derivatives is accelerating forward.**

## The ETF Outflow Crisis

The most pressing story this week is the sustained institutional retreat from spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds. US spot Bitcoin ETFs have now logged **six consecutive days of outflows**, with Friday alone seeing $105.2 million leave the category. The cumulative damage since May 14 is staggering — **$1.55 billion in net outflows**, pushing 2026 total inflows down to just $536 million.

The selling pressure is concentrated in the market's two largest funds. BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) lost $68.9 million on Friday alone, while Fidelity's FBTC shed $36.3 million. Together they account for nearly all of the redemptions, even as IBIT has still attracted $2.7 billion in net inflows year-to-date — making it the category's standout performer by a wide margin.

But the broader picture is sobering. Jane Street reduced its Bitcoin ETF holdings by approximately 70% in Q1, and Goldman Sachs trimmed its position by 10%. These are not retail traders panicking — these are sophisticated institutional players recalibrating their Bitcoin exposure.

The price action reflects this uncertainty. Bitcoin dipped below $75,000 over the weekend to a low of $74,344 — its lowest level in over a month — before recovering to trade around $77,300. The sudden drop triggered nearly **$917 million in futures liquidations** over a 24-hour period, underscoring how leveraged positions amplified the sell-off.

## Nasdaq's Bitcoin Options Breakthrough

While spot flows weaken, a parallel development is reshaping how institutions can access Bitcoin risk. The SEC has granted **conditional approval for Nasdaq to list cash-settled, European-style Bitcoin index options** under the ticker QBTC on the Philadelphia Stock Exchange.

This is significant for several reasons:

**Accessibility.** The QBTC contract uses a 1/100th index scaling factor with a $100 multiplier, giving market participants exactly one Bitcoin of exposure through standard brokerage accounts. Compare this to CME Bitcoin options, which require dedicated derivatives accounts and represent a five-Bitcoin commitment per contract — far less accessible to most investors.

**Cash settlement.** These options settle entirely in US dollars without requiring physical Bitcoin delivery, removing the custody and security concerns that have historically limited derivatives participation.

**Regulatory legitimacy.** This marks another step in the SEC's broader pivot toward crypto-friendly regulation under Chair Paul Atkins, who has championed integrating blockchain technology into mainstream financial markets.

The product still needs final CFTC approval and OCC documentation before trading can begin, but the SEC's conditional green light is a powerful signal that Bitcoin derivatives are moving from fringe to mainstream.

## Ethereum and Altcoins Hold Steady

Ethereum traded around $2,114 on Monday, down 0.5% over the past 24 hours but holding its ground despite the broader market turbulence. The ETH ecosystem continues to face headwinds — concerns about Ethereum Foundation talent retention and questions about its neutrality-first model have weighed on sentiment — but the price has shown resilience.

XRP held at $1.36 and Solana traded near $85.94, both down modestly over the day. The altcoin market is largely moving in sympathy with Bitcoin rather than setting independent trends, which is typical during periods of macro uncertainty.

## The Bigger Picture: Two Markets Colliding

What makes this moment particularly interesting is the juxtaposition. On one side, institutions are reducing their direct Bitcoin holdings through ETFs — perhaps taking profits after the 2025 rally, or hedging against macro uncertainty including Fed policy shifts and geopolitical risks. On the other side, regulators are approving more sophisticated ways to bet on Bitcoin's price movements through derivatives.

This isn't necessarily bearish. Derivatives markets often mature before spot adoption peaks, and the ability to hedge with options can actually encourage larger spot positions by reducing risk. The Nasdaq QBTC product could eventually attract institutional capital that was previously deterred by the complexity of crypto-native derivatives.

But in the near term, the ETF outflows are a real headwind. The $1.74 billion that has left spot Bitcoin ETFs in just two weeks represents genuine selling pressure — money leaving the market, not just rotating between products.

## Looking Ahead

Bitcoin's next major test will be whether it can hold the $75,000 support level. A break below could trigger further liquidations and push toward the $72,000–$73,000 range. Above, resistance sits near $80,000 — a level that would need renewed ETF inflows or positive catalysts to breach convincingly.

The Nasdaq Bitcoin options launch, pending CFTC approval, could be a game-changer for market structure. If it proceeds smoothly, it would represent the most significant expansion of regulated Bitcoin derivatives since the CME launched its futures contracts.

For now, the market is caught between two narratives: institutions exiting spot while building infrastructure for more complex Bitcoin products. The resolution of this tension will likely define the next major phase of crypto's institutional adoption story.

body.title: Making the other person jealous is cruel, and not a game...
body.body:
>

Liking each other is more important than being in love, liking and respect are so important that they really lead to our partner being our best friend. To do this, good communication in a relationship requires listening and talking, but above all it requires time, talking long, deeply and extensively for a long period of time. From my experience with my partner, men tend to be direct and women tend to be indirect. I think that something that can improve communication is for women to be clearer and more direct, because men tend to interrupt women when we talk, I always tell the men around me, I recommend that they get ready to listen to women, to ask, to inquire... To know what the fuck is going on in the relationship. Because one of the great problems of relationships is that we try to change the other. It is always healthy to accept the other person lovingly and unconditionally, and that leads us to change, and naturally, to work on our self-esteem, on the concept of oneself, to set important goals, and that, somehow minimizes jealousy and that excess of self-pity that leads us to feel sorry for ourselves. Since if we deal with important goals we do not have time to think about intrusive, and harmful topics that make us waste time and energy especially when there is jealousy. On many occasions the couples that we were compatible become incompatible, because we grow at different rates and it shows in that they no longer laugh together as before. Friendship goes away, people no longer see each other as friends, they feel obliged to be together, and jealousy comes. If as a couple we have the power to go to Mass together, cook, eat together, shop at the supermarket, travel to be together, walk holding hands, have difficult conversations, make plans, sleep together, save in silence, decide together, live on the same roof, then we are a couple that has more power than we think. Let's not accept a relationship in which we do not enjoy immensely, let's make sure that there is laughter, future, and if incompatibility occurs, we must accept it, for our health and future. No success in personal or public life compensates for failure at home. Because relationships don't break down all at once, rather they waste away when they are left on autopilot. It is much better to set limits at the beginning of the relationship, that is not a guarantee that there will be no conflicts, but it protects it so that the bond does not cool down. They say that jealousy is based on the inferiority complex, feeling that we are not worth enough.What do you value in your relationship with your partner? Janitze 🌹

body.title: [FreePlay] I’ve Joined the Street Racing Club! | GTA: Advance (Game Boy Advance)
body.body:
>**My 3Speaking Today**   Hey, what's up, players! Well my people, I am truly very pleased to be uploading a gameplay once again to this my gaming channel on 3Speak, and for that reason please receive from me the most fraternal welcome to the channel. It is really important, players, to want to improve every day in everything we do. I believe that is a great beacon that serves as a guide for us human beings, since this motivation to improve can truly help us get out of bed and get into action even on our greyest days, and I say all of this because such improvement is valid and valuable even in the most important aspects of our lives. I bring up the above because while doing some research I discovered better results regarding the visual quality in my Game Boy Advance video game gameplays, and these I obtained, at least in my opinion, by using the shader developed by the users and developers of the **mGBA 0.10.5 emulator: Pokefan531 & Hunterk**, who developed a shader that manages to very faithfully emulate the appearance that the Game Boy Advance reproduced on its original screen, which I consider excellent since it helps us emulate the original experience more faithfully. Said shader is called **GBA-Color** and is originally included among the various shaders that the **mGBA emulator** has available by default in its latest version, which is **0.10.5**. Furthermore, if in the shader configuration settings we set the Dark Intensity to 1.000 we obtain a result that I truly find excellent and of much better visual quality than what I was obtaining with the previous shader, that being the **2HQXe**.   Today in this FreePlay we were totally focused on the secondary missions available in GTA Advance, and one of these missions that stands out the most from the very beginning of the story mode is that of the ***Street Racing Club***, which we managed to unlock after completing the second mission for Vinnie and the Liberty Mafia. This Street Racing Club is run by the Asians in Liberty, and the one who assigns us the first circuit to complete is a man of Asian origin who gives us the instruction to complete said circuit within a period of **03:30** minutes aboard a **BF Inject** in order to earn the cash and unlock the next circuit. It is interesting that the first vehicle turns out to be a BF Inject, since for those who do not know, the BF Inject is a buggy or off-road 4x4 vehicle that, although it has a lot of torque and good handling, does not possess as much top-end speed. Therefore the key in this circuit is to take advantage of the BF's characteristic good handling. After completing said first circuit, the Asian man gave us a prize of $2,000, which taking into account the economy of Liberty in this GTA Advance is not much, especially if we consider that a respray of a car at Pay 'n' Spray costs just that, $1k... 😢   By the way, it is important to mention that the Street Racing Club is located in the Harwood area, in the northernmost part of Portland. In the second race things became much more difficult, since the second circuit had as its main characteristic that all the checkpoints of said circuit were distributed randomly throughout the course. That is to say, every time we failed to complete said circuit within the **05:00 minutes** of time given to us, on the next attempt we would find ourselves with a completely different route, which makes things very difficult because we would not have the option of learning the second circuit by memory. Luckily I managed to complete the circuit without too much difficulty aboard a powerful red **Diablo V8**, which looks spectacular in said color and has very good top-end power and excellent torque, characteristics that helped us earn another $3,000 : ) . Well players, with no intention of extending this post any further, I hope you enjoyed the gameplay and as always allow me to thank you for your time and support of this humble gaming channel on 3Speak. Cheers. --- ![3speak bar 2 final.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/paultactico2/23tvW3ikAonGDrfWsXKdRsvgkvadTJ5MCBf6JqAhJ3mP2UPtQwho9AFqoa5mnjK8ff8v6.png) ---- # **Some technical details:** **1.** Video game: Grand Theft Auto: Advance (Game Boy Advance) (USA ROM version) **2.** Emulator used: Action mGBA v0.10.5 (Win x64) **3.** Video capture software: Action V 4.4.0 (Win x64) **4.** Edited and rendered: Capcut (Professional Edition x64) **5.** mGBA Emulator Video Config: > * Display Driver: Opengl; > * Vsync: On; > * Frame Skip: 0; > * Shader: GBA - Color (developed by Pokefan531 & hunterk); > * Enhancements: > *Video Renderer: Opengl*; > *High-res Scale: 2x*; > *Dark Intensity: 1.000*. ---- ![3speak bar 2 final.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/paultactico2/23tvW3ikAonGDrfWsXKdRsvgkvadTJ5MCBf6JqAhJ3mP2UPtQwho9AFqoa5mnjK8ff8v6.png) ----

**FEATURED CARD**:![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2oHf8G3E7NShyGbB4uzoyuD54W5N7Dw4X5CT5CFLipC/1779727381510.jpg)Now to the main topic of this post: **Scales of Justice** is a Rare Fire Saurian unit from the Foundations set in Splinterlands. Designed for the Frontier format,it is a solid, agile fighter that shines in ranked battles,especially when positioned to exploit its key strength: the Dodge ability.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXgJKdJYSXTUFpbDf82dDQV9RC3pZpJ99hhuocqBQT2pc/1779738265334.jpg)

At max level,it has a mana cost of 5,Armor 3,Health 6 aand Speed 5.

**Accurate Abilities on Scales of Justice**:
At level 1,it already have its abilities; **Untrainable and Dodge**.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaYPLGobQYiVm1uH9ZXGepz1YgNPnTmMiignZKg4f2dMn/1779738944899.jpg) **Untrainable**:red crossed-out warrior icon) — Cannot be Weapons Trained (and since it has 0 attack, it will never attack.






![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPwdGi5GW6bkNREXDRAPt8TwJ4dL2Y2Ugy4DoLxvtBee/1779739926219.jpg)**Dodge(Blue swirl icon)**: +25% chance to evade melee and ranged attacks.


With **Dodge** + Speed 5, this unit has a very high chance to completely evade melee and ranged attacks.Frustrating the opponent,wasting their turns, and giving your other units time to finish the game.
Because it has no attack,its job is purely to tank and evade.It soaks up aggression while your damage dealers clean house.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


**Battle**.
Rulesets,plan and lineup.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaAuWGxpD6TGFunyUdhAvoTC4JTw3THJGvcNaKpoYYn7e/1779741011555.jpg)

The total cost of this battle was 25 and you are to choose units from fire, earth,life and Death splinters.
The rules are;
* **Divine Shield**– Every monster started with a shield that absorbed the first hit.
* **Opportunity** – Units with Opportunity could target any enemy position.


My Team (Fire Splinter)
Summoner: **Barthalamas** – Grants  +1 Speed to all my units (huge boost for Dodge and attack order).
Position 1: (Tank): **Scales of Justice** (Level 4) – **Untrainable + Dodge**.
Position 2: **Frankarsgard** – Melee attacker with **Enrage**.
Position 3: **Chaos Furybringer** – Melee attacker with **Reach**.

Opponent’s Team
Summoner: **Thagrimore** – Applied -1 Health to all my units (a strong debuff).
Tank: **Nim Guard Captain** – Melee with Void.
Position 2: **Savage Butcher** – Melee with Reach.
Position 3: **Arcane Curator** – Untrainable monster with Backfire.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)


Detailed Battle Breakdown;
My opponent came with a pure melee-heavy lineup. On paper, it looked threatening,especially with **Thagrimore’s** health reduction with reach attacker.However, **Scales of Justice** became the ultimate leverager and tank.From the very first round:
Thanks to **Divine Shield**, Scales absorbed the opening hit for free.Then its **Dodge ability** (combined with Speed 5 boosted by Barthalamas) went to work.My opponent focused fire on my tank,but Scales dodged approximately in the early rounds.Each miss was a wasted turn for the opponent.**While the Nim Guard Captain, Savage Butcher, and Arcane Curator** were swinging at air, my **Frankarsgard** (with Enrage) and Chaos Furybringer (with Reach) capitalized on the Opportunity ruleset. They tore through the opponent’s backline and eventually overwhelmed the front tank.
**Scales of Justice** stayed alive far longer than expected, soaking pressure and creating the perfect window for my damage dealers to finish the job. It was a classic “tank and spank” scenario where the dodgy lizard single-handedly tilted the momentum.



**Line up**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaoCgGW5w9zPmA1txMapngDBJQTdnJB3oQERzEzkt5ccM/1779742487044.jpg)


**Round 1,Scene 5, first miss and this is how it continues till the final round**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfCsG1WrufRTzwdJWs63QwAsBzVs3J1yEW7jVuGo7ycj/1779742487094.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvu1BwhaTRzuHph3FU7taC4jD8FhqVTV7Qr11SLE3f2n/1779742487135.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpZm3fq2KnywPYqNDR1KSAi36JGJSyn7mXjKaWcJFGpL/1779742487176.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJf5b7g2dG5YrE5KouDtbXAUx3DGDDXGhHvSFLsuQciQ/1779742487219.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbSZod4GSFYJ3Byy7h56KEjZuHpDgYTMpSCFetiZACRAi/1779742519422.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXe2kJH4gwybiDXwPepwqY1mP46scMZViSgtNQb3gU1Dw/1779742519477.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcY4qZ7zWo8aLoG5KCXdE6e4ydfHY5haJQ6MPF63j8VRj/1779742519551.jpg)


**Round 6, fifth and last miss**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmasrfpKuTEXqVgXb3cxiys4tRYUXKG17zfPoCNbffHRHo/1779742519587.jpg)

**Game Over**.![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbEdxJLcctpWtREjXKTWZ5zgy2LPWL1R638PmMomA9cgN/1779742519626.jpg)[Watch the Replay](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_5026ade3c3a564f6918db2b2b26525ea?ref=zusi78)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmerAsdEtbyNb5thEdPrsbfqqFaghQg968GvaG2YUjKkop/1779742461474.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfSPs7mdQTibbmM14FAFzfH3G8oSxj9S92L9K6qezy6GQ/1767438490904.jpg)

There some rulesets you cannot use Scales of justice:
1.Aim True! What it does: All melee and ranged attacks gain True Strike.This means they never miss.
**Effect on Scales**:Its Dodge ability is completely nullified.
Enemies will hit it 100% of the time with physical attacks.

2.Back to Basics Ruleset
What it does: All monsters lose their abilities (except certain summoner-granted ones).
Effect on Scales:
It loses Dodge entirely.

3.Magic is the biggest weakness of this card. Magic-heavy teams (especially Water, Life, or Dragon splinters) will melt Scales of Justice much faster than physical teams.

Overall,all study the rulesets.


Splinterlands is a fun game.If you haven’t joined yet, here’s my referral link to participate:
[Join](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=zusi78)

Thank you for reading and watching my post. @zusi78 signing off.See you in battlefield!

>

body.title: The Blamer  - Zapfic 240
body.body: \nWelcome to our weekly Zapfic 240 short story series. For this week, we'll be writing on the prompt: \

The story I share with you is very much relatable. I hope you'll like it. 

***




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRd5F3XWwsXaUmuhRAXQWRNPaTXmLJc58nVRTLxghFzUa/1779750357135.jpg)

**Created with Meta AI**



Kyle has a way of talking himself out of responsibilities. Whenever a deadline slipped or something else, he always has alibis. But luck ran out of him one day. Mid-excuse, his supervisor cut him off: “Don’t shower me with excuses. Fix it!”





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW6VN4A1nnXmTjbrt7ESMwTS2CbQrLbJa1E97rFfrXptG/1779750357201.jpg)

***
***

People like Kyle are everywhere - at every work place - factories, malls, hospitals, schools, and even in our homes. They always have an excuse ready before you finish asking. Masters at shifting blames on others or situations. To them, taking accountability feels like losing, so they go on . 

Honestly, working with such persons can be risky. You never know when they'll use you as an alibi. 

***

The Blamer

body.title: In the garden of us 🌺
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmay4SY31q3GuQhfGQg3DWjzprx3FyaCjG5uPXC6XK84hA/1779753334053.jpg)
[unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/green-grass-field-with-trees-jf-kMyCffZA)
There’s this flower garden I want to visit with my partner… not because it is beautiful, but because love deserves a place that understands softness.

I imagine us walking slowly beneath trees covered in blossoms, with petals falling around us like silent love letters from nature itself. 

In that moment, nothing else would matter not the noise of the world, not the pressure of life, not the fear of tomorrow. Just two hearts existing gently in a place created to bloom.

I think flower lovers love differently, yes we do not just admire beauty, we feel it deeply. We understand that the most beautiful things in life are delicate.

A proper understanding that flowers bloom with patience, and love does too and you cannot force either of them. You nurture them quietly, protect them carefully, and trust them enough to grow in their own time.

Sometimes I dream about resting my head on my partner’s shoulder in the middle of that garden, surrounded by colors too beautiful to describe. I imagine the breeze carrying the scent of roses and lavender while our hands remain intertwined like roots beneath the earth. Because real love is not always loud. Sometimes, it is found in peaceful silence, in shared glances, in soft smiles, and in moments where words become unnecessary.

A flower garden feels romantic to me because flowers live honestly. They bloom fully without fear of being seen, and maybe that is what love should be vulnerable, open, and alive. Even when petals fall, the tree still stands, ready to bloom again. That alone teaches something powerful about relationships, that love will have seasons, but true connection survives them all.

So when I say I want to visit a flower garden with my partner, I am not just talking about a date. I am talking about experiencing a kind of love that feels calm, intentional, pure, and endlessly blooming, the kind of love that makes two people feel at home in each other’s heart

body.body:
​Hello, community of entrepreneurs! How are they doing? Today I'm stopping by to share with you a topic that has been going around in my head the last few days and that has to do with the evolution of our business models over time.


![343250.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/243LXRHupyTwasDmWtFKhTdgWUAY4UWpbVX7i65bmv96P8vd2eFMdLa1yTTMDTo3Ktv5o.png)


​As I told you in my last post, we recently celebrated the second anniversary of our academy, the Vinotinto Athletic Union. We are happy and proud to celebrate two years of uninterrupted activity [Link](https://peakd.com/hive-140971/@starwarm/del-sueno-a-la-referencia-2-anos-de-resiliencia-en-la-union-atletica-vinotinto). 


![290219.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/starwarm/Eoke8asXKzHjkmRsEy2QUEu6kynWx9duydZqBveDeCNqu8GBhW96unM16mdekuHmFRm.jpg)


Since day one, our key pillar has been to position ourselves as a training academy. What does this mean? That we prioritize comprehensive learning, technical, tactical development and the values of the children above a result on the blackboard.
​During these two years, this value proposition has given us great fruits, reflected in the growth of our enrollment. However, as in any business, the \

or the delivery dates of results arrives. In our case, it's the finals of the tournaments.

​That's where the dilemma arises:
​Our reality: We don't always crown ourselves champions, but we see an incredible technical, physical and human evolution in athletes. The training goal is 100% fulfilled.
​The expectation of the client: Some parents and representatives start pushing for the competitive result (winning the trophy), confusing the success of the process with the final score.

​The challenge of evolving the model (and the clash with the cost structure)
​Analyzing this, I have considered the need to evolve towards a mixed model: maintaining our training essence, but opening a competitive line to respond to that demand of the environment.
​Now, this is where the business model canvas gets complex. To activate a real competitive level, I need:
​More resources: More training hours, better infrastructure and more working time of the technical staff.

​Greater investment: To cover this, the logical consequence in any business would be to raise prices (monthly payments).
​And this is where I collide with the reality of my market: the academy operates in an area of low economic spectrum. The current cost already represents an important effort for families in the sector. Therefore, demanding a high competitive level with such a tight cost structure is a gigantic financial and social challenge. We want to give more, the customer asks for more, but the market cannot pay more.
​I open the debate for the community:
​I know that many of those who undertake in education, services or projects with social impact live this same dilemma between **the real value they deliver and the client's perception of success.** 

That's why I'm asking them:
- ​How have you managed the change in your business model when the market demands evolution but you do not have the capacity to finance it?

- ​How do you educate your clients to value the process (the formative) above the immediate result (winning the tournament)?

- In cases like this, would they bet on looking for external sponsors (subsidizing the model) or would they remain firm in the purely formative niche?

All these dilemmas and thoughts have been coming during these days and honestly I was looking for a space to discuss it, to also express my ideas, I hope you like the post. 

Grateful in advance.

---

Resources:

- Cover edited via Canva
- Photo taken from my Samsumg A07
- Writing on my part

--- 

SPANISH VERSION 

​¡Hola, comunidad de emprendedores! ¿Cómo están? Hoy paso por aquí a compartirles un tema que me ha estado dando vueltas en la cabeza estos últimos días y que tiene que ver con la evolución de nuestros modelos de negocio a través del tiempo.
​Como les conté en mi última publicación, hace poco celebramos el segundo aniversario de nuestra academia, la Unión Atlética Vinotinto. Estamos felices y orgullosos de cumplir dos años de actividad ininterrumpida. [Link](https://peakd.com/hive-140971/@starwarm/del-sueno-a-la-referencia-2-anos-de-resiliencia-en-la-union-atletica-vinotinto) 
Desde el día uno, nuestro pilar clave ha sido posicionarnos como una academia de corte formativo. ¿Qué significa esto? Que priorizamos el aprendizaje integral, el desarrollo técnico, táctico y los valores de los chamos por encima de un resultado en la pizarra.
​Durante estos dos años, esta propuesta de valor nos ha dado grandes frutos, reflejados en el crecimiento de nuestra matrícula. Sin embargo, como en todo negocio, llega el \

o las fechas de entrega de resultados. En nuestro caso, son las finales de los torneos.
​Es ahí donde surge la disyuntiva:
​Nuestra realidad: No siempre nos coronamos campeones, pero vemos una evolución técnica, física y humana increíble en los atletas. La meta formativa se cumple al 100%.
​La expectativa del cliente: Algunos padres y representantes empiezan a presionar por el resultado competitivo (ganar el trofeo), confundiendo el éxito del proceso con el marcador final.
​El reto de evolucionar el modelo (y el choque con la estructura de costos)
​Analizando esto, me he planteado la necesidad de evolucionar hacia un modelo mixto: mantener nuestra esencia formativa, pero abrir una línea competitiva para responder a esa demanda del entorno.
​Ahora bien, aquí es donde el lienzo del modelo de negocio se pone complejo. Para activar un nivel competitivo real, necesito:
​Más recursos: Más horas de entrenamiento, mejor infraestructura y más tiempo de trabajo del staff técnico.
​Mayor inversión: Para cubrir esto, la consecuencia lógica en cualquier negocio sería elevar los precios (las mensualidades).
​Y aquí es donde choco con la realidad de mi mercado: la academia opera en una zona de bajo espectro económico. El costo actual ya representa un esfuerzo importante para las familias del sector. Por ende, exigir un nivel competitivo alto con una estructura de costos tan ajustada es un reto financiero y social gigantesco. Queremos dar más, el cliente pide más, pero el mercado no puede pagar más.
​Abro el debate para la comunidad:
​Sé que muchos de los que emprenden en educación, servicios o proyectos con impacto social viven este mismo dilema entre el valor real que entregan y la percepción de éxito del cliente. Por eso les pregunto:
​¿Cómo han gestionado ustedes el cambio en su modelo de negocio cuando el mercado exige evolución pero no tiene la capacidad de financiarla?
​¿Cómo educan a sus clientes para que valoren el proceso (lo formativo) por encima del resultado inmediato (ganar el torneo)?
​En casos como este, ¿apostarían por buscar patrocinantes externos (subsidiar el modelo) o se mantendrían firmes en el nicho puramente formativo?

Todos estos dilemas y pensamientos han ido llegando durante estos dias y sinceramente buscaba un espacio para debatir sobre ello, para expresar también mis ideas, espero sea de su agrado el post. 

Agradecido de antemano.

---

body.title: Satisfying My Donut Cravings
body.body:
When someone is craving, he/she will go to the place where it craves them like when they were craving about a specific food, they would just go right away because that is his or her craving for that day. 


![ddddd.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23xynCRWfbqYfLXuMHq8W92zUELxmteX5Ujyz5nXQsiSc1on6qVR6eT5fsyfFXUUngv1u.png)


Yep, that is me, I think it was last week that I was craving for food and especially the donut. There were lots of stores that sells donuts in our place but it hits different when the donuts that you like is not from our place but I need to travel to the other city just to buy donuts. 


![dd6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23tbyLnWpQ1ZMkJhgvXU8q26hGbZnLSU44fs2VRwPD68MVsRr59tjjPiMjGYB4raREYgX.jpg)


In my place or we call it a town, there were no fast food chains or even stores here especially to dunkin' but I loved to have one branch here in the place so that I will not go to the other city just to buy donuts here in dunkin for my cravings. 


![dd4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/Eonm2KRrz3VkVVt2ZH2A5ncBs1qjuzAtaHxwHH6XyCPzFnQ8zWvKXsKxjm6vRn7yYmW.jpg)


uh... I remember that there is a donut in the 7/11 store here in our tiny little place but the brand is Mister donut, it's not the donut that I want to eat because the flavor and the taste for the donut in Mister Donut is not the same as the flavor and the taste of the dunkin donuts. 


![dd2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/EoiWAHrUqDw1LJQn3tqGdPGmXN3cVMY7YZc5zpweriCZWjKfR4JfPnc5AG5hJfyFZY1.jpg)


I just went to other city just to find and buy donuts there especially the dunking donuts. hmm.. it was one of my favorite donut that I always go to. Well, before, I don't really like much of the other flavors of their donuts but one donut that I specifically like about the store and that was the Choco wacko. It's a donut that was a chocolate topped with chocolate fillings. 


![dd3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23x1HcQsSWAz4aQ5zFSBEMBXHXJkUS6q8xF7dNqYNiSAtD2HpU5wKSozi7WeWC7Cd626w.jpg)


That donut is one of my biased donut but it didn't include in their little \

promo that they have in their store, so you need to separately buy them aside from the box that you've bought which was the pasalubong for your family.

Hmm... At the time that I went to the store or to the place which was located at Robinson's Place at the ground floor, there were lots of customers that also order and bought in the store. So, one of my goal is to EAT my favorite donut which was the choco wacko. 


![dd1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23wgWVkHyLq2MX9JHzEzgP1EhSJftqircqVbqg1cfFy8HsR5dPds4tWRDB7r7D9goyfka.jpg)


Yeah, I have eaten it and I was satisfied with that donut, too. I just want to buy another one but I was full when coming there because I was eating my lunch in the shopping mall. Also, at the time that I went there, It was lunch time and I just finished eating up my lunch. 


![dd5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vinzie1/23wgSRxa4LpMvuBHcD8zaxNjW4iuXSqwv6yXt5nYtpfb6ch7SEBWZK3kPJtTB2LrGwFqX.jpg)


When I went to the store, I ordered this choco wacko and also the boston creme that I was going to bring it at home because I knew that my family would love to eat this donut, too, because it was a classic kind of a donut but it feels like a premium donut because it had bavarian cream on the inside and dipped with chocolates on the outer side. 

I enjoyed that day eating a donut while my cravings were satisfied on that day even if I traveled for around two hours back and forth just to buy the donut that I like for the cravings.

body.title: Ronda de curacion: comunidades en español que estan dando que hablar
body.body:
Hola a todos! Ultimamente me he dado una vuelta por varias comunidades en español de Hive y la verdad es que hay mucho talento y contenido de calidad. Quiero compartirles 10 posts que me llamaron la atencion, de distintas comunidades, para que se den una idea de lo que se esta cocinando.

---

## 1. Pollo a la parrilla, ensalada y mandioca — @prm4031
**Comunidad:** Cervantes

De entrada una receta que me hizo agua la boca. @prm4031 nos muestra paso a paso como prepara un pollo a la parrilla con ensalada y mandioca. Lo mejor es que arranca desde las brasas, mostrando todo el proceso. Si les gusta la cocina, este post es parada obligatoria.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@prm4031/pollo-a-la-parrilla-ensalada-y-mandioca-baked-chicken-salad-and-cassava)

---

## 2. Global Pizza Party Portoviejo 2026 — @elizabeths14
**Comunidad:** Aliento

Me encanto esto! Resulta que en Portoviejo, Ecuador, celebraron el Bitcoin Pizza Day con una pizza party masiva. @elizabeths14 nos comparte un video del evento y cuenta como la comunidad crypto se reunio para conmemorar ese dia historico donde alguien pago 10,000 bitcoins por 2 pizzas. Imperdible.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@elizabeths14/f74bdebc)

---

## 3. Perfil HIVE: @mercmarg — @hispapro
**Comunidad:** HiveVenezuela

Que buena iniciativa la de los perfiles HIVE. @hispapro entrevista a @mercmarg, una hiver con 5 años en la plataforma que comparte reflexiones, naturaleza y recetas. Me gusta este tipo de contenido porque ayuda a conocer a la gente detras de los posts y crea comunidad de verdad.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@hispapro/perfil-hive-or-mercmarg-esp)

---

## 4. Tu apoyo para la literatura en Hive — @ylich
**Comunidad:** Literatos

@ylich nos cuenta sobre Literatos, una comunidad nueva dedicada a la literatura en español en Hive. La respuesta fue tan buena que ya estan buscando delegaciones para crecer. Me alegra mucho ver que la literatura en español tenga un espacio dedicado, se necesita mas de esto.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@ylich/tu-apoyo-para-la-literatura-en-hive-or-your-support-for-literature-on-hive)

---

## 5. ¿Quién dijo que la solidaridad se ha perdido? — @damarysvibra
**Comunidad:** Holos&Lotus

Una reflexion profunda sobre la solidaridad. @damarysvibra señala que la generalizacion nos hace creer que la solidaridad se ha perdido, cuando en realidad hay mucha gente solidaria, solo que lo malo siempre hace mas ruido. Me hizo pensar y cambiar mi perspectiva. Lectura recomendada.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost)

---

## 6. Fundación avanza en el Torneo Apertura de Futsal — @cetb2008
**Comunidad:** Full Deportes

Si les gusta el deporte, @cetb2008 le esta haciendo un seguimiento impresionante al equipo de Fundación en el torneo de segunda división de futsal. Fotos, detalles de los partidos, resultados. Se nota la dedicación y el amor por el deporte.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@cetb2008/fundacin-avanza-en-el-torneo-apertura-de-2da-divisin-de-futsal--fa5)

---

## 7. Los peluches son protección y amor — @bet1977
**Comunidad:** Top Family

@bet1977 participa en una iniciativa de \

y nos regala una reflexion bien bonita sobre los peluches y lo que significan. Todos tenemos ese peluche que guardamos no porque este nuevo, sino porque tiene historia y recuerdos. Me identifique mucho.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@bet1977/los-peluches-son-proteccion-y-amor-stuffed-animals-are-protection-and-love-esp-eng)

---

## 8. Probé las frambuesas con chocolate de Águila — @mamaemigrante
**Comunidad:** Hive Argentina

Justo habia visto estas frambuesas con chocolate en el super y tenia curiosidad. @mamaemigrante las probó y nos cuenta que tal, desde la presentación hasta el sabor. Sabe que cuando me topé con su review ya me convenció de probarlas. Reviews asi son super utiles.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@mamaemigrante/probe-las-frambuesas-con-chocolate)

---

## 9. Fried cojinoas with arepas — @ramisey
**Comunidad:** Hive Food

@ramisey nos trae una receta de cojinoas fritas con arepas, bien detallada y en ambos idiomas. Las fotos son espectaculares y se nota que sabe lo que hace en la cocina. Una combinacion clasica venezolana que nunca falla.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@ramisey/fried-cojinoas-with-arepas-eng)

---

## 10. Pollo en salsa de tomate y cebolla — @maricrochets
**Comunidad:** Hive Food

Cerramos con una receta sencilla pero deliciosa. @maricrochets nos enseña como preparar un pollo en salsa de tomate y cebolla, con ingredientes que todos tenemos en casa. Las fotos del paso a paso ayudan un monton. Perfecta para un almuerzo en familia.
🔗 [Ver post](https://hive.blog/@maricrochets/recipe-delicious-chicken-in-tomato-and-onion-sauce-receta-delicioso-pollo-en-salsa-de-tomate-y-cebolla)

---

## Comentario final

Esto es solo una pequeña muestra de lo que se encuentra en las comunidades en español de Hive. Hay mucho talento, creatividad y calidad. Los invito a pasarse por estas comunidades, dejar su apoyo y descubrir nuevos creadores de contenido.

Si conocen algun post o comunidad que consideren que deberia aparecer en la proxima ronda, dejennmelo saber en los comentarios.

Un abrazo a todos y a seguir creando!

*— @delirius*

body.title: IT'S GOD OR NOTHING
body.body:
Greetings family, friends and love one...

Sometimes in life, we break ourselves trying to hold others together, sacrificing silently for people who would never inconvenience themselves for us. We give our time, strength, love, money, peace, and even our last, expecting nothing in return, because our hearts were never built on selfishness.

![IMG_20260516_073503_541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKiSaX5EboeRhjNeM4yLHaYrsExrpenBRjmb9t42XY4QFTgt9PS1MFmRK4q6wBq.jpg)


Truth is, many people see us smiling and assume we are okay, assume we have enough, assume we are strong enough to carry every burden alone. But deep down, some of us are fighting battles nobody knows about. Heavy weights. Silent tears. Sleepless nights. Year in, year out, surviving without help, without support, without even a single hand stretched genuinely toward us. Yet we keep showing up for others.

For me personally, everything I have ever done and everything I will ever do has never been because I expected repayment from anyone. My only hope has always been in God for the multiplying effect of every good deed. Because truly, when there is nobody to run to, nobody to lean on, God becomes the only refuge.

And to everyone secretly carrying pain behind their smile, you are not alone. I am there too. But I believe with all my heart that God will not abandon us in this present situation. One day, He will reward every silent sacrifice, heal every hidden wound, and lift us beyond the struggles people never saw.


![IMG_20260512_123804_817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/AKbE9L6nte2XLp9YCiwAdaE49VWSTg8JW8Lmo8LWCtkhgB6zLwTGSwKFoBQ2nfX.jpg)

May God separate us from people who drain us, use us, and leave us empty. May He connect us with genuine souls, favor, peace, and destiny helpers. And wherever negativity, betrayal, wickedness, or fake love exists around us, may God expose and extinguish it completely. 

Let there be healing for the broken, strength for the tired, and unexpected blessings for those who have been pouring into others while secretly dying inside in Jesus Christ’s name, Amen.

You're reading from your handsome friend John Petra!

body.title: Llaves, claves y contraseñas para asegurar nuestros activos digitales / Keys, codes, and passwords to secure our digital assets
body.body:
A veces uno cree que las cosas malas no le van a pasar a uno, pero realmente cuando van a pasar, le suceden a cualquiera, y una de esas es justamente aquellas relacionadas con la seguridad de las contraseñas.


<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmZfUUhUgnLUk4axRc1fvrf6XtiDuobAsyp5SAFiMAGUoS/geralt_registration_3938434_1280.jpg</center>

[Geralt - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/registro-iniciar-sesi%C3%B3n-teclado-3938434/)

Recuerdo que en principio, era algo que se tomaba a la ligera, y que en muchos casos, las personas mayores eran víctimas de estafas por confiar en otros el proceso para la extracción de dinero en los cajeros, confiando en la buena voluntad de quienes se ofrecían a ayudarlos con el proceso, para luego hackear o cambiarles la tarjeta y proceder a vaciarles las cuentas.

En mi caso, hace 19 años, fui víctima de estafa bancaria, pero no producto de una contraseña, sino que por azar, se hicieron dos débitos no autorizados de mi cuenta mientras yo estaba en el exterior. Para entonces, sacar dinero desde otro país resultaba un tanto complejo, y pedían contraseñas especiales que yo ni siquiera tenía, por lo que eso levantó mis sospechas y llamé al banco para hacer el reclamo de inmediato.


<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYN3mj6YK3ZHhmYb4XpqnSGbGXBzFrHkjN8EbY4uDU9Fu/2780243_hacker_4949897_1280.jpg</center>

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hacker-la-ciber-delincuencia-4949897/)

Para cuando regresé al país, el dinero había sido restablecido, y al parecer, todo sucedió por parte de un cajero que al ver la cuenta sin movimientos, pensó que estaba \

.

Desde ese momento estuve mucho más atenta a revisar mis cuentas, cambiar mis claves y toda norma de seguridad vigente.

Y es que para vulnerar las cuentas, hay todo un entramado pendiente de encontrar a alguien desprevenido a quien estafar, por lo que la recomendación básica es que al momento de hacer algo relacionado con la seguridad digital, se preste toda la atención al proceso, pues en un abrir y cerrar de ojos, un solo descuido, puede terminar siendo la puerta al infierno.

Y para muestra, un botón de la primera cuenta que tuve en Hive y que perdí a las 3 semanas de haberla abierto. Cuando yo empecé en este ecosistema, atravesaba por una separación de mi pareja, en términos bastante complicados. Al momento de abrirla, seguí los pasos de quien me guio en mis inicios, y luego, no pude recordar mi llave maestra, no estaba en el correo que me envió ecency, y los entendidos me decían que yo la había cambiado, aunque no recuerdo haberlo hecho. Y si bien no hubo consecuencias graves en cuanto a retiros y accesos indebidos, pagué los platos rotos de haber sido \

por no dormir bien durante esos días en los que era víctima de violencia psicológica, y no resguardar mi llave.

Una modalidad muy actual, es apelar a la ignorancia de las personas sobre algunos programas que copian información sin que lo sepas, o pinchar en enlaces dudosos, logrando con ello, hackearles sus teléfonos o por lo menos alguna red social para luego estafar a sus contactos.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmetikk1aHoFbfux57n3BZfpwpDeSrmXDQ2G1GA9WTxgJY/tumisu_card_6054627_1280.jpg</center>

[Tumisu - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tarjeta-tarot-misterioso-6054627/)

Igualmente, la comodidad de tener una llave única para los diferentes programas, solo por la comodidad de no tener que recordarlas todas o el temor de olvidarlas, es caldo de cultivo para que sucesos negativos se puedan generar en cadena, pudiendo perder el control de muchas cosas en pocos segundos.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

Sometimes we think bad things won’t happen to us, but when they do, they can happen to anyone—and one such issue is precisely that of password security.


<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmZfUUhUgnLUk4axRc1fvrf6XtiDuobAsyp5SAFiMAGUoS/geralt_registration_3938434_1280.jpg</center>

[Geralt - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/registro-iniciar-sesi%C3%B3n-teclado-3938434/)

I remember that at first, it was something people took lightly, and that in many cases, older adults fell victim to scams because they trusted others to help them withdraw money from ATMs, relying on the goodwill of those who offered to assist them—only for those people to later hack or swap their cards and proceed to drain their accounts.

In my case, 19 years ago, I was the victim of a bank scam, but not because of a password; rather, by chance, two unauthorized debits were made from my account while I was abroad. At that time, withdrawing money from another country was somewhat complicated, and they asked for special passwords that I didn’t even have, so that raised my suspicions, and I called the bank to file a complaint immediately.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmYN3mj6YK3ZHhmYb4XpqnSGbGXBzFrHkjN8EbY4uDU9Fu/2780243_hacker_4949897_1280.jpg</center>

[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/hacker-la-ciber-delincuencia-4949897/)

By the time I returned to the country, the money had been restored, and apparently, it all happened because a teller, upon seeing the account with no activity, thought it was “frozen.”

From that moment on, I was much more careful about checking my accounts, changing my passwords, and following all current security guidelines.

The fact is, when it comes to hacking accounts, there’s a whole network just waiting to find an unsuspecting victim to scam. So the basic recommendation is that whenever you’re doing anything related to digital security, you should pay close attention to the process—because in the blink of an eye, a single lapse in attention can end up being the gateway to hell.

And here’s a prime example: my very first Hive account, which I lost just three weeks after opening it. When I first joined this ecosystem, I was going through a breakup with my partner—under pretty complicated circumstances. When I opened the account, I followed the steps of the person who guided me in the beginning, and later, I couldn’t remember my master key; it wasn’t in the email ecency sent me, and the experts told me I had changed it, even though I don’t remember doing so. And while there were no serious consequences in terms of unauthorized withdrawals or access, I paid the price for being “irresponsible” by not sleeping well during those days when I was a victim of psychological abuse, and for not safeguarding my key.

A very common tactic these days is to exploit people’s ignorance about certain programs that copy information without your knowledge, or to get them to click on suspicious links, thereby hacking their phones or at least some social media account to later scam their contacts.

<center>https://i.ecency.com/DQmetikk1aHoFbfux57n3BZfpwpDeSrmXDQ2G1GA9WTxgJY/tumisu_card_6054627_1280.jpg</center>

[Tumisu - Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tarjeta-tarot-misterioso-6054627/)

Similarly, the convenience of having a single key for different programs—simply because it’s easier not to have to remember them all or out of fear of forgetting them—creates a breeding ground for a chain reaction of negative events, potentially causing you to lose control of many things in a matter of seconds.

***
