body.title: Mi Reencuentro con la Fórmula 1 tras 7 Años [SPA/ENG]
body.body:
Finalmente pude ver de nuevo un gran premio de Fórmula 1. Han pasado casi 7 años desde la última vez que pude disfrutar de principio a fin de todo el fin de semana que abarca un gran premio, las pruebas, clasificación y carrera. Con los años se ha vuelto muy difícil disfrutar del deporte, con las grandes corporaciones peleándose los derechos de transmisión, todo se volvió un negocio. >#### My Return to Formula 1 After 7 Years >Finally, I was able to watch a Formula 1 Grand Prix again. It’s been nearly 7 years since I last got to enjoy an entire race weekend—from practice and qualifying to the race itself—from start to finish. Over the years, it’s become really difficult to enjoy the sport. With big corporations fighting over broadcasting rights, it’s all just become a business.
![1000402109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23wX3hGDSVhRFqytyP2pqQUTdg3FHeAxCRaVY6t8JhSekVUGG6vcMNdpTsQR8QUHZcG7s.jpg)
En tiempos como este es que valoro aquellos años donde, gracias a la televisión de señal abierta, sábado y domingo bien temprano veías la Fórmula 1, luego un partido de la Premier League, NBA o MLB por la noche. Ahora hay que pagar no se cuentas suscripciones para poder hacerlo, algo que no es económicamente posible siempre. Finalmente tras pasar por varios servicios de suscripción, llegué a Disney Plus que cuenta con ESPN donde al fin puedo ver la F1. >Times like this make me appreciate those years when, thanks to free-to-air television, you could wake up early on a Saturday and Sunday to watch Formula 1, followed by a Premier League match, or even the NBA or MLB at night. Now, you have to pay for countless subscriptions just to do that, which isn't always financially feasible. After jumping through several subscription services, I finally landed on Disney Plus, which has ESPN, so I can finally watch F1 again. La última vez que pude ver una carrera completa, fue en la época donde Kimi Räikkönen deja Ferrari y lo sustituye Charles Leclerc, que venía de Sauber que luego se convierte en Alfa Romeo, todo esto por allá en el 2019. Desde entonces he seguido el deporte solo por redes y resúmenes. Son muchas las cosas que han pasado en estos años, es raro ver que ahora Racing Point es Aston Martin, Renault es Alpine y a McLaren pasar de ser un equipo de mitad de tabla o pelear por el campeonato de constructores. >The last time I was able to see a full race was back when Kimi Räikkönen left Ferrari and was replaced by Charles Leclerc, who had come over from Sauber (which later became Alfa Romeo). This was all back in 2019. Since then, I’ve only followed the sport through social media and recaps. A lot has changed over these years; it’s strange to see that Racing Point is now Aston Martin, Renault is Alpine, and McLaren has gone from being a midfield team to fighting for the Constructors' Championship.
![1000402111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23zGnzv7Jknq21vvB8TwjDeFnDaYdDrvS5PWfGfZ3ABDeij4nNhwR2J7TJPJVRxBu6pyJ.jpg)
Algo que lamento haberme perdido fue poder ver en vivo, la rivalidad entre Max Verstappen con RedBull y Lewis Hamilton en Mercedes que llegó a su punto más álgido en 2021, definiendo en la última vuelta del Gran Premio final en Abu Dabi. Sin embargo, la vida premia a veces y en el gran premio de Montreal ayer, pude ver a estos dos pilotos pelear por el segundo puesto, como en los viejos tiempos, logrado por Lewis Hamilton pero ahora con Ferrari; quien iba ha pensarlo. >One thing I really regret missing was seeing the rivalry between Max Verstappen and Red Bull versus Lewis Hamilton and Mercedes live. It hit its peak in 2021, coming down to the very last lap of the final Grand Prix in Abu Dhabi. However, life has a way of rewarding you; at the Montreal Grand Prix yesterday, I got to watch those two drivers fight for second place, just like in the old days—though this time, Lewis Hamilton was in a Ferrari. Who would have thought?
![1000402114.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/danielcarrerag/23xKvkjSu2RWoYabXjawBb6wXLQrvQLSZNMDss4wmcLZ8pw479uxYzYFMBRpCDjVchx6N.jpg)
Pero lo que más destaca de esta temporada 2026, es el ascenso meteórico del joven piloto de Mercedes Andrea Kimi Antonelli, que lidera el campeonato con 4 victorias al hilo. También destaca la rivalidad con su compañero de equipo George Russell, que obtuvo la victoria en el primer premio de la temporada en Australia. body.body:
<center>
![EoptpDUg9xH32RQw1PkHnmV1mEn4XgbLmg5BCqexYwehQeovTFMRgoabQUMeD8fwGex.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/EoptpCjYYkb1kmYKsTJ4dNHdYTZpKbCMKU1hPLjDYy9p8JsHZULu4rkMZB8tUDvgyQc.jpg)
 [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tf43zb)</center>

<hr>

For several years, Chef Timateo has been obsessed with perfection: he wanted to create the best Hungarian charcuterie board in the world. He didn't want a simple platter of cold cuts; he sought to serve a dish that was excellent in its exquisiteness, a tribute to European tradition. To make his hands the worthy instruments, he embarked on a journey around the world.

He began in Budapest, where he learned the ancestral secrets of smoking, but he knew very well that he needed to travel the entire continent to find the perfect ingredients for his dream dish.

Timateo traveled to the cold fields of Germany to obtain the exact spices for his liver sausage. The texture had to be creamy, but with the robust character that only the best calf liver could offer. That's why he ventured into the mountains of northern Spain to find a natural casing for his blood sausage. This blood sausage wouldn't be ordinary; he spent a week in a remote village to get his hands on the sweet paprika he had negotiated with an old Hungarian farmer.

After several months, he finally decided to go to his next destination; he needed the perfect counterpoint to so much meaty intensity. So he crossed to the sun-drenched valleys of southern Italy and then to the Balkans, selecting sweet red peppers. These became his famous stuffed peppers, brimming with goat cheese and fresh herbs.

Back home, Timateo assembled the masterpiece. On a dark oak board, he arranged the glistening blood sausage, perfectly sliced ​​liver sausage, and the vibrant stuffed peppers. And at last it was ready, and he christened it ***Disznótoros Tál***.

Upon tasting the first bite, he closed his eyes and gave thanks: For the feast was served.

body.title: A plate full of humanity
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3px8RtfriCfVwwXVzpchkzMZxUWySWHEYyTfh1vjQJX/1779751845505.jpg)q
At first glance, the image looks like nothing more than a traditional plate of Hungarian food, smoked sausages, roasted potatoes, stuffed peppers, pickled vegetables, and dark cooked cabbage arranged together in a rustic bowl. 

The colors are deep and earthy, almost heavy, carrying the warmth of something homemade and historical. But the longer I look at it, the more the meal begins to feel like a reflection of human life itself.

There is something raw and emotional about the plate. It is not decorated to impress or softened to appear perfect. Instead, it presents itself honestly, I mean the dark sausages, especially the blood sausage, immediately create a feeling of intensity and depth. They speak of survival, tradition, and endurance. This is the kind of food made from necessity, from culture, and from generations of people learning how to create comfort even during difficult times.

Looking at it makes me think about people and how similar we are to this meal. 

Humans are not simple or made of only pleasant experiences. We carry dark moments, painful memories, hidden fears, and silent struggles within us. Yet somehow, just like this plate transforms strong and unusual ingredients into nourishment, humans also transform hardship into strength.

The stuffed peppers in the middle feel symbolic to me. They are filled on the inside, reminding me that every person carries unseen emotions and stories beneath the surface. Many people smile outwardly while silently carrying pain, dreams, disappointments, or hope internally. We are all filled with things others cannot immediately see.

The mixture of flavors on the plate also mirrors life itself. The sharpness of pickled vegetables beside the warmth of potatoes reflects how life constantly balances bitterness and comfort. Happiness and suffering often exist side by side, no human experience is made from one emotion alone.

What makes the image beautiful is not perfection but authenticity, that it feels real but aged by history and shaped by culture.

 In the same way, humans are shaped by experiences, environments, and survival. We are all combinations of light and darkness, softness and toughness, emptiness and fullness.

This plate is more than food, it is a reminder that even the heaviest parts of life can still nourish the soul and connect people across generations.

After a trip to the hospital in the morning I found myself with recuperation time at the hotel room afterwards. While my wife explored Scotland I got to explore the GLD realm. Well, actually I just worked on the bot that supports the GLD token but it is working better now. Honestly its pretty much release ready. **What does it look like?** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t76tE6c85Pv4MF4Ssu8t83VQYMThxMgweiEcJRJrWGvcdyCLxtsZx67pfH8TBn7x5As.png) Right from the main screen you can see something that I think is really important. **That every GLD token is pegged at 100 to 1 HBD and that there is sufficient reserve to cash out every GLD held by HIVE users** Yes, you could check out the @merchantsguild and @tergan account to figure that out but the website makes it really obvious. But it does a little more than that. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/EnyoaZaxAHhDdnExqgfYxsnU6X8rMcDa1FTZBavv6F8RgUE6ifAy9VnMUPREZLm4fQJ.png) Push a button and it will show you exactly how many people hold the GLD token and how much they hold. If you really wanted to you could add it all up and see that it matches the \

amount on the main screen.

Now there is another screen which shows things in a little more detail.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t76tFPbfDm948z9MJ2MPrH1SzPNAaCZfkt9GTCuiL1p7MLs2GHRiQk7pfU9itkGgz1z.png)


On this screen you can see a few things.  First how much GLD is outstanding and how much is available for sale.  You can also see that there is only 10 HBD available to buy GLD tokens back at this moment.  However, there is a large stockpile of HBD staked to cover all tokens.  There is also a little bot hiding in the background.  Any day that there is less than $10 HBD to buy GLD the bot removes $1 HBD from savings ... and continues taking that out every day until the float is back where it should be.

Every GLD holder can redeem at the peg value (once this is made public) but if you have a lot to redeem it may take a little longer than expected.  **However** there are still liquidity pools available on tribaldex.com AND a buy wall on hive-engine ... so there are also other options.

Of course that leads to the next window on the page.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23t77FUjrDmYqE8tJAAq7avntsjuGBKsdG7zJNbifdwu81iFv9p3WjiAL1hKPBp4naSYN.png)

The buy and sell page.

If anyone wants to buy GLD it shows how much is available.  If anyone wants to sell it shows how much liquid HBD is available to cover the trade.  The amount is fixed to buy or sell 100:1.  Essentially GLD acts like a Hive Penny :)

### As for the use case?

Still working on getting that operational.  Ideally I would like to make daily distributions available to active GLD members based on holding GLD tokens.  But like many things... It's still under construction.

However, now it is a little closer to reality..

.... One step at a time.

body.title: ​Un día de renovación espiritual, reencuentros y desconexión
body.body:
​
![1000277674.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23w2oQP13pps1rqpA4XDkBz1kVGwMd46EpggqMpQgSoqEvPCVvGYD7k2sZ7nhXtjhCMnk.jpg)



# Un día de renovación espiritual, reencuentros y desconexión en el sur de Brasil

​Hay días que quedan grabados en el corazón no solo por los lugares que visitamos, sino por el alimento que le brindamos al alma. Recientemente, mi esposo y yo tuvimos la oportunidad de asistir a un evento profundamente especial, un espacio dedicado por completo a aprender sobre cosas espirituales y a fortalecer nuestro vínculo con nuestro Creador.


![1000278705.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/244oSfqj1nFs8gmSFiak67CGCfvty56XdNsoNmk7KNW5WWZ1vUjZ34fvc5sYsWefP4UY7.jpg)

​Llegamos temprano, a eso de las 8:30 de la mañana, listos para aprovechar cada minuto. El inicio del día nos recibió con ese frío característico y encantador del sur de Brasil, invitándonos a disfrutar de un clima fresco que, con el paso de las horas, fue templando y regalándonos una tarde notablemente agradable y cálida.

​El entorno natural que rodeaba el evento era simplemente mágico. Estábamos rodeados de paisajes verdes impecables, pérgolas de madera y rincones llenos de vida que se convirtieron en el escenario perfecto para capturar hermosos recuerdos fotográficos. Pero más allá de la belleza del lugar, lo más gratificante fue la calidez humana. Tuvimos la inmensa alegría de reencontrarnos y compartir con muchos amigos entrañables y personas queridas que teníamos bastante tiempo sin ver. 


![1000277706.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23xVK4xuuRiPv4s4ZjjDu2mums1njS5fcaVNCRNDZ7K6is8Cgbc3JJVBo3ZCVPVRNughu.jpg)

Volver a abrazarnos, conversar y ponernos al día hizo que la jornada fuera aún más enriquecedora.
​Compartimos un almuerzo delicioso en el lugar y, entre risas, reflexiones y momentos de paz, el tiempo voló. Cerca de las 4:00 de la tarde nos despedimos con el corazón rebosante de gratitud. 

Nos fuimos renovados, no solo por el valioso conocimiento espiritual adquirido, sino por el amor de la comunidad que nos rodea. Fue, sin duda, un día extraordinario de conexión, fe y mucha felicidad compartida en pareja. ¡Gracias por leer y acompañarnos en este pedacito de nuestras vidas!

![1000277604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alina97/23u64te7UKRH3MGqstSjEc9XRJvPxzvnwptCNmQiYDMEA4U2AH49gVrQKPS8VTeZ6ah4m.jpg)

body.title: Into the Spore Zone.
body.body: > Suspecting Nora saw through her lie, I followed her down to the basement, dodging a guard patrol with Nora's help. After parting ways, I discovered a tragic note among three skeletons, bypassed a locked ICU door, and entered a spore-heavy emergency room, only to find an empty med kit. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmepfo36HxGfvt1MqmfzTEkffLhe2FEfBX4gcYTNe9nQix/screenshot_1_.png) I didn't think Nora bought the compartment syndrome that Abby tried to sell her but she was still acting accordingly, which is my opinion. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQEKerMQrToiuDLkBXzppouS8QEWCTH37i2jCdDDZ6shM/screenshot_2_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQUD7wcbWJpVHo39sGvUU3R73N89KjyfJadN1pg9dPTD4/screenshot_3_.png) We kept moving toward this basement part, keeping a sharp eye on the dark hallways. Abby had to take cover as there were two soldiers below who were going to fetch Abby, but Nora sent them back to grab some boxes for her. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcErg271i5WMnM3LG6fUr3qyUzxV3iEgfxHCy4ft9GzEZ/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEew7woPhoHGiVpuVGDPYExS7NHtaihUCxY1FYdM3hTm/screenshot_5_.png) I continued following Nora and reached this door, found out she would accompany me last to the point of no return. And they both took their goodbye from there, sharing a tense look and Nora hoping Abby would come back in one piece from the lower floors. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNrw49Q2ynhzkEmmVM1CsQ7FRFD9K7FTXjABYNdaGnT37/screenshot_6_.png) Nora suggested I should find some medical supplies in surgery, trauma, or ICU. But I was attracted to this side room first as I saw a dead body from afar slumped against the moldy tile wall. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLihbWAEqy49ZLfKwkeYnGKDWtkcahN5NxAS6ExNUYmA/screenshot_7_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQTcuK2hbb9nxGraxN4NBjxVBr2erkQ1yzim2NKbbYCia/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbUXESNhn1i2EM3DuRD69UkMq4RS5QRtHB9u1ZvcGy76W/screenshot_9_.png) After getting inside the damp office space, I found not one but three skeletons who had terrible death there. And one of them had a letter that says he was called Scott when he was alive, and the letter was for someone named Jake, detailing their final days. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyjRdFgynpeUfWBHVYv6YVVn8f9sM5PFemWa89BRvyy3/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWbzJNmsryy8wvfUa8SB7JzbQMT1BRkHxvkHPAdqkacVb/screenshot_11_.png) After getting out of that room with the note, I went for this door that should've led me to in the ICU section. But the door was locked tight from the other side, so I had to look for trauma and/or surgery next. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsAs2VkPgCJ57noW6SgR1vTqrpzxJYpu2sBLBvht5Ycv/screenshot_12_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLChs32nzpHvMRrsDoQUM5SuiaTNbr3DVUjJxuHPpELD/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdDbwuKK8uxF1SufzZW2itap7YVK9zLcdWo1GNeQyxsch/screenshot_14_.png) After getting down to the ground floor via a collapsed ramp, I checked around thoroughly and I started collecting some supplies. I noticed this door to the emergency room that Abby mentioned where the trauma center should have been located. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZKqbntDHneNAN7uFRxvDYCwjVzaxRjPqT4LtLLkruf1n/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxh2D7FmMmxksMKu7qqiqnHLyZQYQyzTE9mCpARZSXCk/screenshot_16_.png) I walked through that door, having fer inside me personally as the era was thick and there was spores all around. And look what I found, with the walls covered in fungal growths and bodies on medical beds. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZB7NjVGXGgcAzfx4EwxvFoab5uMLPqcmHrM4QvfN2quk/screenshot_17_.png) Well after checking around the place while masking my breathing, I found this kit box resting on a rusted counter. And Abby was hoping should find something inside to save her friend, but it was empty, leaving the search ongoing. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/63a97bb1)

body.title: (ESP/ENG) 💝✍️ Peluches: Un compañero fiel, sin importar la edad / Stuffed animals: A loyal companion, no matter the age 💝✍️
body.body:
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de la escritura creativa! Luego de un día de bazar exitoso, en el que pude tener una grata experiencia ofreciendo mis creaciones, el día frío y el cansancio, me hicieron tener no sólo un leve dolor de cabeza, sino la idea de quedarme en cama... pero no lo hice, había mucho por hacer y por suerte, al momento de escribir estas líneas para el [concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6), ya me siento mucho mejor y continuo animada. Ahora que estoy deseosa de poder elaborar peluches para agregarlos a mi catálogo de ventas, ver vitrinas llenas de tantos muñecos, me reconforta, pues sé que hay un cariño genuino por esos amigos hechos de tela.
![FxX5caie56yoV2jPEs63ESHNPjabC1hfpPxhQk2eVHWMqFUVxfHTyXD36k3CYbNKukjBcK2pBiMf4xeHtTvAThVez17ki71kgAt9tQT2YFEN.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo8TpAT1p5YUqp3D5qoYs2qZdUFtGPPWt1mRoEARLzzRPKh1FvnKENKkh3sQendAs8F.png)
Los peluches. Desde muy pequeña tuve la suerte de contar con muchos juguetes, entre ellos, peluches, hasta el punto de que una parte de mi cama estaba ocupada por ellos. Era algo que me gustaba, quizás me hacía sentir segura, pero también me gustaba lo colorida que se veía mi cama con tantos muñecos juntos. Al despertar, lo primero que hacía era acomodar las sábanas y luego, los peluches. Siempre lo hacía por orden de tamaño, dejando a los más grandes en el fondo y a los más pequeños, adelante. De esa forma, podría decirse que durante mucho tiempo, ellos fueron los guardianes de mi sueño.
Ahora de adulta, no tengo peluches en mi cama, ya que comparto la misma con mi hermana, pero si siento que hay algo que me hace falta. Siento la cama vacía y \

, a lo mejor, algunos muñecos cambiarían eso, no estoy segura jaja.
Por otro lado, no sé si lo he contado antes, pero seguramente si lo he hecho, pero yo comencé a dedicarme a la costura precisamente haciendo peluches. Recuerdo que el primero que hice fue un osezno de oso negro. No tenía la tela, pero mi mamá me dejó usar una camisa vieja que ya no usaba, así como me dió algo de hilo y aguja para coser mi proyecto. No saben lo feliz que fui en todo el proceso y aún a la fecha, conservo ese muñeco, pues es un recordatorio de mi amor hacia los peluches.
Antes, sentir amor por los peluches siendo adulto, era mal visto. Pero ahora, se ha normalizado y en la actualidad incluso, se ha popularizado no sólo el que los adultos compren peluches de series infantiles con las que crecieron, sino que los lleven a las calles como un accesorio más o hasta les tomen fotografías, dándole un espacio en su vida más importante que un simple adorno de habitación.
Eso, podría ser visto como algo tonto para muchos, pero para mí, es encantador ver cómo los amantes de los peluches no sólo los visten, sino también no tienen miedo de sacar su lado \

en público. Hasta recuerdo la vez que un señor, ya mayor, me contó que le encantaban los peluches y que siempre quiso tener muchos, lo contó con tanta ilusión, que me percaté de que era un deseo surgido de su infancia; cuando le dije que podía comprárselos ahora que podía, se rió y mencionó que ya estaba viejo para esas cosas... pero yo opino que no es así, después de todo, la vida es lo suficientemente dura y difícil, permitámonos endulzar nuestras experiencias a nuestro modo.
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![Sticker-hive-sue-con-taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and lovers of creative writing! After a successful day at the bazaar, where I had a wonderful experience offering my creations, the cold weather and fatigue left me with not only a slight headache, but also the thought of staying in bed... but I didn't. There was so much to do, and luckily, as I write these lines for the [contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6), I'm already feeling much better and still in good spirits. Now that I'm eager to make plushies to add to my sales catalog, seeing shop windows full of so many dolls is comforting, because I know there's genuine affection for these friends made of fabric.
![FxX5caie56yoV2jPEs63ESHNPjabC1hfpPxhQk2eVHWMqFUVxfHTyXD36k3CYbNKukjBcK2pBiMf4xeHtTvAThVez17ki71kgAt9tQT2YFEN.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo8TpAT1p5YUqp3D5qoYs2qZdUFtGPPWt1mRoEARLzzRPKh1FvnKENKkh3sQendAs8F.png)
Stuffed Animals. From a very young age, I was lucky enough to have many toys, including stuffed animals, to the point that part of my bed was taken up by them. It was something I liked; perhaps it made me feel safe, but I also liked how colorful my bed looked with so many toys together. When I woke up, the first thing I did was straighten the sheets and then the stuffed animals. I always arranged them by size, leaving the largest ones at the bottom and the smallest ones at the front. In that way, you could say that for a long time, they were the guardians of my sleep.
Now that I'm an adult, I don't have stuffed animals on my bed, since I share it with my sister, but I do feel like something is missing. The bed feels empty and \

Maybe some stuffed animals would change that, I'm not sure, haha.
On another note, I don't know if I've mentioned this before, but I probably have, but I started sewing precisely by making stuffed animals. I remember the first one I made was a little black bear. I didn't have the fabric, but my mom let me use an old shirt I didn't wear anymore, and she also gave me some thread and a needle to sew my project. You can't imagine how happy I was throughout the whole process, and to this day, I still have that little doll; it's a reminder of my love for stuffed animals.
Before, loving stuffed animals as an adult was frowned upon. But now, it's become normalized, and nowadays it's even popular not only for adults to buy stuffed animals from the children's shows they grew up with, but also to wear them around like any other accessory or even take pictures of them, giving them a more important place in their lives than just a simple room decoration.
That might seem silly to many, but for me, it's charming to see how stuffed animal lovers not only dress them up, but also aren't afraid to show their \

side in public. I even remember the time an elderly gentleman told me that he loved stuffed animals and that he always wanted to have many. He spoke with such enthusiasm that I realized it was a wish stemming from his childhood. When I told him that he could buy them for him now that he could, he laughed and mentioned that he was too old for such things... but I think that's not the case. After all, life is hard and difficult enough; let's allow ourselves to sweeten our experiences in our own way.
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![Sticker-hive-sue-con-taza.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK7w4GdH1MPQStuqcVxKZ7aLEz1CNG33KwxnKAnYGM9U9kSYaEBvhSvZfbHwHty.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 22.75% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.063 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.992 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.01983147 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.10961949 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00117246 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.142600 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001586 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 77,364.1 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 350.04 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 52.805 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,567.76 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 78.09 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#100 (among active witnesses only)/485.1k HP in votes/49 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 All 'We Are Alive Tribe' BEE delegations to @bee.voter were recalled in full last night, including our most significant holding of 20,405+ staked BEE on @aliveandsocial. Our total BEE holding across all 'We Are Alive Tribe' accounts, most of which is staked, currently comes to 22,339.015 BEE (*this is not counting our BEE in various diesel/liquidity pools*). With all community BEE delegations now being fully available once again, our community is now benefitting from much more substantial BEE upvotes and post/comment rewards, and we're also now receiving a notably larger income of BEE from curation rewards (*though we have to wait 7 days to see them*). That's a very good thing indeed. Now I want to begin tracking our weekly community BEE income, to clearly assertain exactly how much BEE we're pulling in each week, to better assess how to leverage it best. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260521_152525368.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uExN1Vsu7eN1gwzpbDBrywaBBQcSsyLXPCWXf3DQRXYmxzYGh8T9fuSiZ6x3jrSNDsx.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260521_152740002_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC7MYHVx3x8DyC7e3tD9oJbQwpdrY7yuctLydcQGqGYr7UBdQ92bgEHX8ztbT8j9yWs.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I want to track our new level of BEE income for at least a week, and then decide whether to delegate some of our BEE to @centtoken (*via leases*), for increased daily BEE income, or not. The @centtoken BEE leases would provide around 0.1xxx BEE daily/5 BEE weekly for 500 BEE delegated, 0.3xx BEE daily/10 BEE weekly for 1,000 BEE delegated, and 0.8xxx BEE daily/25 BEE weekly for 2,500 BEE delegated, so I'd just have to see if that turns out to be better than what we would earn with no delegations in place. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_094958222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tm9Z5KZ6KNzNhnaBXVM9MkwmqayQriL5eqs9u34stQyjEiDmCkHMLB9HaMm2sH6QWiV.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_152511604_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQn4McZZER3kXkCAzPLy5Pwa2WKvpKesZ6EJb18H8pu5tGK9T3PqbZixcynp2d2SR3n.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Since our weekly HIVE income was obliterated from collateral damage from the Hive-Engine hack, our staked BEE is now our greatest leverage point for growth and restored economic sustainability, but it likely won't be in the form of HIVE or SWAP.HIVE income, unfortunately. I have two top priorities regarding our increased liquid BEE income, one, to collect sufficient BEE to create the new ALIVE:LBI in collaboration with the LBI project, and two, to generate enough liquid BEE each week to be able to utilize to pay our HP delegators, and to distribute in our daily ALIVE dividends. I'll also look into how much we'd lose to conversions if I tried to swap or convert BEE to SWAP.HIVE and/or HIVE on a weekly basis. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_152844126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tbRcRmtJVYtnEmvaTLRPTkEZs1rvVsRzGGe3HM7chgKRUo4UZeKYuNisPURV38uCxbV.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_153115026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tmJ5JA5pVPCneX1vqDhBUtppPdCZ1c3cQxartSB2ZpM58uDwZGD5JR6r13D458evsyv.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) At the present rate at which we're sending out HIVE weekly to pay our HP delegators, and to distribute in our daily ALIVE dividends, our good chunk of HIVE parked on @aliveandsocial will last us for approximately 22 weeks, or 5.5 months. That gives me a little wiggle room at least to figure all this out, and to get our 'We Are Alive Tribe' economy back to a good place, and on track again. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_153215265_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5zbHPs3C2ywVmY3jaxwL1kA7XK2rBkLbeMSCJNNESHMcHRzto3GVK9B5P1yQkVuxky.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_153930817.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wMYDhrUWEqKEiEXct7z6RWDVzWMWQHWu9PxKAjQzKyJhya7qXAgpiUhoMhmnrNJFZbF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Given that our primary weekly sources for HIVE and SWAP.HIVE have both disappeared within such a short time, over about a month, I'm still just barely picking up the pieces, and making sense of how we might be able to move forward in a good way. With how many important parts of Hive's infrastructure and economy keep disintegrating and disappearing, this is no easy task at all (*it's actually quite daunting*), but I will indeed give it my best shot. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_154228120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xANwhHeEv84DYDXbkd2xFo9NVR8vhUC66xkuBPeaxCQ18bTggsA9CadXGgKiPH11t6P.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_154328724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsSfsUDSGV2Sq5MAbiH9YHz5rBBnfRnguPCCWyxqNfUXuk2LBQTvx5XLT5inESqXTfF.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, Sunday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up most of my numerous important Sunday Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 3:45PM, giving my attention to some photography for my posts first, as then to a few small jungle-community tasks. Once I had those completed, I made a quick food-supply run to Tutu's to restock Wabisabi, then I made myself some food, and with that and my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee in hands, I headed back to the Flow House to begin my evening Hive tasks. Between not feeling well, and my intense frustration around the never-ending loops of Cloudflare verifications when trying to load posts and comments on @ecency's website (*both the release and the alpha versions*), I wasn't able to get through all of my notification, before I made myself stop, and I just went to bed, by a little after 10PM. I woke up around 7AM, having very thankfully slept well, going to prepare my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, returning to the Flow House to prepare my weekly Goals-and-Progress-Update to write later, and finally to write this post. It's now just before 1:30PM, so it's a great time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's manifestation of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_154456928.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2jHq4CrkFHsbeaFWBYsGRrebqj7VHk8uTF5sWoKrWg4aqd5tA57tte6rnmG2pSAVvn.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260523_154657044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wqkWnDzQ33uVhyhA1gqh7S7YyUL8NuW2ysAP5WgLCt6sbvAo6UEHAGWBYF3Af4aTUG8.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) Do regular integral practices again, alone or with others. 2.) Prepare regular batches of my medicinal teas collected from the land again. 3.) Make my plant nursery, and the gardens, beautiful again. 4.) Begin learning relevant coding/programming languages to more fully contribute to the sovereignty-driven technologies where I am active, like Arch Linux, Hive, Qortal, DeSo, and Bastyon. ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) *All photos were taken with my **Motorola G Play 2024 Android Phone**.* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) Thank you all so much who have helped me get to where I am today, and allowing me to share more of the beauty and magic from my life and my world with you, and for your continuous appreciation and support! I am truly deeply grateful! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1RxBbudG9rt2dp1cGCcDqm1HJsmhBZUTJ8yUepXHTDRdUuVF5MhuePSiKAaiqqoQ.png) If you'd like to find me on other alternative platforms where I have accounts (I spend most of my time here on ***Hive***), click on this signature image below to go to my *LinkTree* page. [![Polish_20220714_123613996.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23u5JoRqDidEnrBW7RSo8NuHdjDgUi14wY5a8RwanCQixRuCAXMfavo7nQnQrntXMF8TP.png)](https://linktr.ee/tydynrain) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### Come join us in the ***We Are Alive Tribe*** on [***Hive***](https://ecency.com/created/hive-155221) and on [***Blurt***](https://blurt.blog/created/blurt-161158)! ![hiveandblurt.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benthomaswwd/23u5zfGAYUbiaDq2DeuhpR9STGXwRFvmSi5hhyPaahWQD1oDcK4K42tLwWW8CwRnsxxHn.png) *Image created by @benthomaswwd* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### ***You're invited to provide liquidity in our two ALIVE diesel/liquidity pools, both of which offer daily liquidity rewards:*** * ### [***ALIVE:SWAP.HIVE***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=SWAP.HIVE) * ### [***ALIVE:ALIVEM***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=ALIVEM) * ### [***ALIVE:HEARTBEAT***](https://tools.crypto-dreamr.com/beeswap/pools?input=ALIVE&output=HEARTBEAT) ***There will be more ALIVE pools coming soon!*** ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### ***[Vote](https://witness.the-hive-mobile.app/#/witnesses/@aliveandmmb) for our @aliveandmmb Witness Node!*** [

The higher in the witness ranking we go, the more that we'll be able to grow the We Are Alive Tribe, and the more that we'll be able to share with all of you!* ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ***If you appreciate what we're doing with the We Are Alive Tribe, and feel inspired and motivated to lend a hand in building and growing our decentralized community economy and financial framework, which benefits all of us, community conntributions/donations/investments may be sent to our 'We Are Alive Tribe Sovereign Wealth Investment Fund' account, @waat-swif. body.title: Percent Map travel guild (2026-05-26): Stones Tell Stories of War and Refuge in Ami-dong
body.body:
>Unsplash

Hidden within Busan's colorful houses and winding alleys lies the unique Tombstone Cultural Village. Built during the Korean War, this village was created by refugees who used discarded Japanese tombstones from an abandoned cemetery to construct their homes. These inscribed stones now serve as silent witnesses to history. As May brings warm sunshine with temperatures around 22°C, visiting Ami-dong offers a deeply moving glimpse into a past era of hardship and resilience.

body.body:
![1000197575.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vincenty55/23tGW1dHPkqiBjgbDEkwTYj9Yzzorkq3CzdJU7ZNCtQsvSvsUDxHLDGJRN7ktbpgrGQMQ.png)
The Werewolf Experiment
Near a forest in Da Lat, Vietnam, there was a secret laboratory hidden far from the city. People in the nearby villages often heard strange noises at night, but nobody knew the truth.
A young man named Sungya agreed to join a dangerous experiment because he needed money. He was brave and careless, so he did not think much about the risks.
The scientists injected a strange liquid into his body. They mixed animal DNA with human DNA because they wanted to create a powerful human-beast hybrid.
At first, Sungya felt normal. But after a few days, strange things started happening. His skin hurt, his strength increased, and his eyes changed color at night.
Then, during a full moon, everything changed.
Sungya transformed into a terrifying werewolf. The scientists were shocked and afraid. He lost control and attacked the laboratory workers. Many people died before Sungya escaped into the forest.
Since that night, villagers near Da Lat say they sometimes see a huge wolf-like creature during full moons. Some people believe Sungya is still alive, hiding in the forest and hunting at night.
The government denied the story, but locals still warn visitors:
“Do not walk alone in the forest during a full moon… Sungya may be watching.”

body.title: Was für Tage
body.body:
Hallo Freunde,

ist etwas ruhig geworden die letzten Tage, eigentlich war das die Tage anders geplant. Aber ich hatte mit meinen Kater zu tun. Nicht den vom Bier, sondern so einem felligen kleinen Ding, das mich seit zehn Jahren begleitet und auf dumme Ideen kommt. In diesem Fall ist der Kleine auf die Idee gekommen die Aufsaugeinlage von einer Hünchenpackung zu fressen und leider besteht die auch zum Teil aus Plastik, also musste ich mit ihm zur Tierklinik, in der Hoffnung, dass man das ganze rausbekommt. Und dann ging das ganze los und wir hatten zwei Tage am Stück, einmal sechs Stunden und einmal  acht Stunden in der Tierklinik vor uns und ich bin fast sechshundert Euro losgeworden. Der kleine Idiot hat das teuerste Plastik seiner Karriere gefressen. Anders kann man das ganze nicht bezeichnen. 

____

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 00.04.14.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/satren/23xyRCqZBF1ss4z6anuKDAiP3dVDcYudh5bCSLUQEq2rqhmzU4MoEZDvkz7VzeaWwuqAE.jpeg)

____

Ich fand es nur spannend wie ähnlich so eine Tierklinik zu einer Klinik für Menschen ist, nur das man dort auch die Besitzer mit dabei hat. Bei grünen Patienten wird erstmal geschaut und nach der Triage ein Termin ausgemacht, bei gelben Patienten wartet der Besitzer mit dem Tier auf eine Behandlung und bei Roten Patienten wird das Tier sofort behandelt, während der Besitzer dokumentiert und Formulare ausfüllt. Das habe ich vor Ort beim Einschläfern eines Hundes mitbekommen, der überfahren wurde, er wurde sofort mit einen Zugang versorgt und dann die Besitzer zum Einschläfern nach hinten geholt. 

Ich hatte Glück, dem Kater gehts wieder gut, aber es war eine interessante und sehr teure Erfahrung. 

In dem Sinne, gehabt euch wohl.

body.title: Decentralized™ / Descentralizado™
body.body:
Talking about Hive's DHF is like talking about the former German Democratic Republic — everyone knows that in practice it was never a democracy, but quite the opposite.

The DHF is no different. Although it calls itself Decentralized, and in theory it could be, in practice it is not decentralized at all.

It is public knowledge that proposals can be approved with the vote of a single user. And in fact, that happens quite frequently.

Perhaps that is why users who do not hold a significant stake do not bother to cast their votes. It is like voting in a dictatorship. Your vote means nothing.

While DPoS is a slightly more democratic mechanism than PoW or PoS, it shares the same essence: it concentrates power. Whether economic or technical.

In principle, I believe that using voting power, or HP, makes sense when it comes to rewards, because it is a return on a form of \

.

But when it comes to Governance, I consider the system of 20 Witnesses and stake-weighted voting for DHF proposals to be entirely centralized.

And that should have been improved. Especially considering that Hive forked from Steem precisely to fight against centralization following Sun's acquisition.

Which makes me think that Hive does not actually want real decentralization, despite its words.

My vision of decentralization is one where each person has an equal vote to every other user, regardless of the value of their wallet.

Of course, representative democracy is not a universal panacea — Argentinians are proof that any unhinged individual can reach the presidency under such a system.

But if Hive truly is a Social Network and claims to be decentralized, it must change its voting system — at least for the DHF — so that it is not used as war spoils by the powerful and their acolytes.

But I suppose that improving Hive's Governance would be very inconvenient for some$, though it may be the only way for the community to truly grow, become empowered, and start seeing it as a positive tool rather than a \

.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdC1qALW9jzGT9vuqZcqPoVFM6efiiKb2pMMypaENTwnf/1779750210167.jpg)



Hablar del DHF de Hive es como hablar de La ex República Democrática Alemana, todos sabemos que en la práctica nunca fue una democracia, sino todo lo contrario.

En el caso del DHF sucede lo mismo, aunque se autodenomina Descentralizada, y ciertamente en la teoría podría serlo, en la práctica no es para nada descentralizada.

Es de público conocimiento que las propuestas pueden ser aprobadas con el voto de un único usuario. Y de hecho, eso pasa con mucha frecuencia.

Tal vez sea por eso que los usuarios que no tienen un stake representativo no se molestan en emitir sus votos. Es como votar en una dictadura. Tu voto vale madre.

Si bien el DPoS es un mecanismo un poco más democrático que el PoW o el PoS, tiene la misma esencia: concentra el poder. Sea económico o técnico.

En principio, considero que respecto a las recompensas sí tiene sentido que se utilice el poder de voto, o el HP, porque es una retribución a una forma de \

.

Pero en cuanto a Gobernanza, considero que el sistema de 20 Testigos y el peso de voto en proporción al stake para las propuestas del DHF es totalmente centralizado.

Y eso debería haberse mejorado. Sobre todo teniendo en cuenta que Hive se bifurcó de Steem justamente por luchar contra la centralización tras la compra de Sun.

Lo cual me hace pensar que realmente Hive tampoco quiere una descentralización real, a pesar de las palabras.

Mi visión de una descentralización es cuando cada persona tiene un voto igual al del resto de los usuarios independientemente del valor de su cartera.

Por supuesto, una democracia representativa no es la panacea universal, y los argentinos son la prueba de que cualquier enfermo mental puede llegar a la presidencia con este sistema.

Pero sí Hive realmente es una Red Social y pretende ser descentralizada, se debe modificar el sistema de votación, al menos del DHF, para que no sea utilizado como Botín de Guerra de los poderosos y sus acólitos.

Pero supongo que mejorar la Gobernanza de Hive sería muy inconveniente para alguno$ , pero tal vez sería la única forma de que realmente crezca la comunidad, y se empoderen y empiecen a verla como una herramienta positiva en lugar de como la \

.

body.title: Trillium
body.body:
![Tri color](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFbQdovMqsUkCEswXAYvK4nU1GLs3vM1AbWzmCF62tKT/img_1235.jpeg)

Trillium wild flowers have come and gone for this season.  I got a few photos recently.

![Tri folded](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYNxerXQabhxoy4xKR7ZMUSrYB3UuMgtHgHu4SrwQVX7/img_1233.jpeg)

There are two type in my area.  The white with red splashes are Painted Trillium.  The other is the solid red Trillium.

![Tri close up](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPciz8X9UKf8Y1T5FgAGhhB3DqF9RMA8jAYoFUZMndd6M/img_1232.jpeg)

We found a group of Painted Trillium down by the lake.

![Cluster](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTKx218dTN8TEgJfTwSbp43YeRgBi221X7FSHdqwvyhQc/img_0970.jpeg)

This cluster of Red Trillium is in our back yard.

![Location](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVQqHbKidi4fwBZ5VTZSg9D3MVfeEuEAFaEdN55W6tqAX/img_0969.jpeg)

They are growing in front of a split rock.

![Closeup](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPUaGCXGgvSZAkn9mkSCVrUmh64wwfAULX4HeLWyg8hPP/img_0968.jpeg)

Trillium are founded in shaded areas often on the edge of the woods.  The woods they prefer are beech-maple-oak.  Throw in some pines and thats exactly what you find around our part of Vermont.

![Three](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc4iQZ9VGMsHkK9d8zAnh8AYjLwWCjywQZbapfHASmZfg/img_0967.jpeg)

Trillium hikes are a favorite part of spring.  They bloom in mid to late May usually.  The nature lovers grapevine around here usually lets us know when people are starting to see them 🙂

body.title: Would You Sell Your Memories for Money?
body.body:
In the event that it's possible for one to sell their memory for cash, will I be willing to do that? Knowing fully well how difficult things are, looking at the harsh economy, the rising cost of living, and the overwhelming fear of going broke and becoming poor. Won't one be willing to just let go of the memory and take the money so they can live a more comfortable life where they can live life to the fullest and enjoy anything they need? I think it's a beneficial idea given the fact that the memory doesn't really add much to our finances, but will I do it? ![1000489613.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/EoGyvxDGYoRvEqCkR6tmH9SCMYMHrMkVY5WPULEBixigtgn89uf9g3Eaaaiqtuse7dJ.jpg) Personally, I don't buy the idea of selling my memory for cash, and the reasons for that are what I'd be stating below. While I understand I'm not where I want to be financially and would really need money to change the story around positively, still, I must say that selling my memory won't be a good idea just because it'll pay me to do so. I mean, come to think of it, my first reason for not wanting to sell is because I'll lose my memory after selling it, so what if I sold the memory and ended up forgetting I had such a deal and the person didn't even pay me, and yet I lose my memory? Another integral reason why I won't be seeing my memory is because my memory is my person; that is, my memory is me, and I'm my memory. Without my memory, I'd be a stranger to myself because I'd most likely lose my identity and who I am. I wouldn't remember valuable lessons I've learnt in the past that have shaped my life and that could possibly elevate me in the future. So selling my memory is like selling myself and directly losing myself because I won't remember who helped me, who wronged me, who I am, or what I've learnt, amongst many other things to name but a few. So that's about it on my take on if I'd sell my memory for money or not; like I said, I won't be selling, and that's because my memory is me, and without it, I don't think I'd be myself again. So in a nutshell, I'm not selling my memory; both the good and the bad ones play a key role in who I am today, and that's why I'd cling to my memory above money that I might lose after completing the deal. *** All photos are mine. ***
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@vickoly/would-you-sell-your-memories-for-money-29f)

body.title: Peace, Comfort, Freedom And Mental Balance Are All That Matters In My Safe Haven(#290)
body.body:
What is your favorite safe heaven for relaxation and why?
Hello, gentlemen and #ladiesofhive. Happy new week. I wish above all things that you prosper and be in good health. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNevupnFiMxUmuNF3pAmYcbeJS5f97h4ZUbXEkFUST6RN/image.png) [Darbagan](https://pixabay.com/images/download/darbagan-girl-2304038_1920.jpg) There is a popular saying that no matter how ugly a parent looks, the children must and will continue to love and cherish them. Hence, beauty is in the eyes of the beholder. I do hear people talk about their safe haven, especially during office gossip time. Some of my colleagues will say their church, some hotels, some the beach, while others choose their place of work. Every one of them has their reasons for the choices they made. I have many safe haven, such as the church and sports centre, but my favorite is my room. Yes, my room is my safe haven because after the nearly endless activities at the office, I always look forward to going home, a place to stay away from the endless complaints, requests, and calls from employees, and workload. A place of quietness, peace, comfort, and freedom from the hassles, distractions, and noisy environment. A place that is free of combustion from factory gas generators, vehicle horns, and the emission of carbon monoxide from bad engines. My room is my favorite safe haven, where I lie on my bed every night, quietly reminiscing about my daily activities and taking a deep reflection on my interactions. I also feed my subconscious with the right things I’ve done while condemning the wrongs done in the day and driving an improvement plan. Furthermore, my room provides me with a total disconnect from every form of worry, stress, and discomfort I must have faced during the day. Then, I recharge mentally and physically while I rest. The gospel sound from my MP3 Bluetooth speaker also refuels lost energy and gives me soothing relief from any anxiety or challenge I may have faced during the day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXZDY4gCq9VzDn1LjrAjDN1TE1pWuxvqmtoGjRWJSuw8/image.png) [Fa Barboza](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1582163471165-2346e1d70350?q=80&w=687&auto=format&fit=crop&ixlib=rb-4.1.0&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D) Finally, I cherish my safe haven for the freedom to commune with my God every morning and night in the little corner of my bed away from the noisy world. And each time, I feel like I’m whispering into God's ear. I do not think I can find such a place elsewhere. Everyone needs such a place where they can express themselves without limitation. body.title: A random Monday morning 🙁😕
body.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![A random Monday morning 🙁😕](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/bc1b6ab9-50c8-4e40-9676-f9c52eb42202.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/4E7x2EqCiEZ58ghKeyqpNe) 
 
 My day started well this morning. I woke up by 7am and gave myself enough time to get ready for my 8am class. Since I already prepared my materials and notes the night before, I didn’t rush. I just left the house at a relaxed pace instead of running around. The lecture went smoothly for the full two hours and ended a few minutes after 10am. I felt good that I absorbed everything without stress, it set a nice tone for the rest of the morning.
After class I stayed back in the department and was gisting with my course mates till noon. We talked and laughed a lot, it was refreshing and helped us bond more. When I finally got home, there was nothing in the kitchen to eat. I was already feeling tired from the early start, so I just went to sleep. I woke up around 3pm, that nap really reset me.
In the afternoon and evening I was roaming around with a few of my close friends. We just chilled and enjoyed the time till about 10pm. The day wasn’t too structured after the morning class, it was mostly spontaneous. At the end I ate my only meal of the day — a simple plate of macaroni. It was small but it satisfied me after going so long without food. The day ended on a quiet note. I just reflected on the mix of classes, friends, rest, and the small things that got me through.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***

> Fascinating. I never did an IQ test... I don't want to know my score.

Ah, don't worry babe. Just do it **quickly,** like I had to do it to publish this post in the shortest time possible. LoL

> If its too low then I will assume that I'm a slave of my limited intelligence. If it's high then I will judge myself for not living up to a higher potential. The result might be a lose-lose for me.

Well, then to me, your way of thinking denotes a very high IQ, if anyone asks me. Because Real Life Stuff isn't deciphered solely through geometric figures, you know?

> So this is interesting (not sure I understand why)... ChatGPT 4.5 IQ is 145 at visual puzzle solving, but when it comes to verbal problem solving it is the lowest?

Yeah, that's correct. This could be understood more easily with the following example:

Just like humans, some of us are more visual and others are more auditory. The former use the right hemisphere of their brain more and have already realized it. Therefore, they tend to train and develop it more than the other hemisphere. And as result, they develop a greater ability to interpret abstractly geometric figures and process information holistically, intuitively, and visually, which is fundamental for creativity, emotional expression, music, and spatial orientation.

On the other hand, those who are more auditory tend to use their left brain hemisphere much more than their left. And they've already realized that too. Therefore, they tend to train it more in logical activities of sequential analysis and rational thinking where language skills are the star product of that training and consequently more skilled when it comes to processing and managing cognitive functions such as mathematical calculation, writing and reading.

As you can see, it all depends on the **training** we/they have given to our/their brain. Hence, there are some of us who stand out at visual puzzle solving but get poor scores at verbal problem solving and vice-versa.

body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWH5unGvXSfXnaxhUmt1qZxjdTDXtdNrXkYiHt76NTtCE/splinterlands_in_game_liquidity_pool.jpg) We have exciting news coming to Splinterlands, with two new features. One is about marketplaces and fees, which is quite simple, while the second could have a big impact: the arrival of SPS and DEC pools in the In-Game Liquidity Pools. Come check it out! I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## Splinterlands In-Game Liquidity Pool
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmehcGfq1wyPF9dPPnoLu4Qu35WHmubSFd8UoS8ToDYnN7/image.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Currently in Splinterlands we have several in-game liquidity pools: DEC-Grain, Dec-Voucher, Dec-Wood, Dec-Stone, and Dec-Iron, with around $20,000 in liquidity in each pool, if I'm not mistaken. A highlight is the DEC Grain pool, which has almost $40,000 in liquidity, a very impressive feat, I believe because Grain is a core gameplay element of Splinterlands. Having in-game gameplay means the entire game ecosystem is literally concentrated within the game itself, which makes things easier for players, but places a greater burden on developers regarding internal security. By allowing external pools, this control is outsourced to the DEXs, but by centralizing everything, it increases the single point of failure. However, being one of Web3's oldest games, Splinterlands has always focused on smooth operation above all else, which has prevented problems, and as long as this remains true, it can continue that way. One change regarding pools is that there was a proposal to create a new in-game pool, the first with SPS, with the SPS-DEC pair, and it would start with a considerable value because the DAO would migrate the pool that is in the Hive Engine into the game, something around 25 million SPS tokens and the equivalent in DEC. This will bring great liquidity to the game and facilitate resource management. --- ## Splinterlands Marketplaces
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRjwwmsaXV5ejnbtQtt7Niu17wJCgZq1gMqUVXZk36uf/image.png)
[Source: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Sometimes, even though necessary for organization and control, some proposals end up being unnecessary expenses for the projects themselves, because they are already part of the ecosystem's structure. I'm not sure, but I believe that when someone submits a proposal to Splinterlands, they need to spend a certain amount to avoid spam, I think. Not long ago, there was some kind of change in how marketplace fees work, and it became necessary to submit proposals to all marketplaces that have fees, if I'm not mistaken. In that sense, from what I quickly saw, most of these proposals had the same content, addressing the same subject, and they were all approved. Therefore, at least 5 proposals spent money to be submitted, and in this bear market, any amount saved by the projects can make a difference, since the influx of new users is low, so costs must be reduced as much as possible. Instead of making several proposals, they could have made a single proposal with all the marketplaces. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWH5unGvXSfXnaxhUmt1qZxjdTDXtdNrXkYiHt76NTtCE/splinterlands_in_game_liquidity_pool.jpg) Temos novidades chegando ao Splinterlands, com duas propostas novas. Uma delas é sobre os marketplaces e fees que é bem simples, enquanto a segundo pode ter um grande impacto que é a chegada da pool de SPS e DEC nas Pools de Liquidez In-Game. Venha conferir! Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## Splinterlands In-Game Liquidity Pool
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmehcGfq1wyPF9dPPnoLu4Qu35WHmubSFd8UoS8ToDYnN7/image.png)
[Souce: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Atualmente no Splinterlands temos algumas Pools de Liquidez já In-Game: DEC-Grain, Dec-Voucher, Dec-Wood, Dec-Stone e Dec-Iron, com algo por volta de $20.000 em liquidez em cada uma das pools se não me engano. Um destaque para a Pool de DEC com Grain que está com quase 40mil de liquidez na pool, um feito bem expressivo, acredito que por conta de Grain ser um core da gameplayer de Lands. Ter uma gameplay in-game faz com que todo o ecossistema do jogo esteja concentrado literalmente dentro do jogo, o que facilita por um lado os jogadores, mas coloca um peso maior nos devs com relação à segurança interna. Ao permitir pools externas, esse controle é tercerizado para as DEXs, mas ao centralizar tudo, aumenta o ponto único de falha. Só que por ser um dos jogos mais antigos da Web3 Splinterlands, teve sempre como foco o bom funcionando acima de qualquer outro aspecto, o que evitou problemas e contanto que isso siga sendo verdade, pode continuar desse jeito. Uma mudança com relação as pools é que houve uma proposta para criar uma nova pool in-game, sendo a primeira com SPS, com o par de SPS-DEC, e já começaria com um valor bem considerável porque a DAO migraria a pool qe está no Hive Engine para dentro do jogo, seria algo por volta de 25 milhões de tokens SPS e o equivalente de DEC. Isso vai trazer uma grande liquidez para dentro do jogo e facilitar toda a gestão de recursos. --- ## Splinterlands Marketplaces
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfRjwwmsaXV5ejnbtQtt7Niu17wJCgZq1gMqUVXZk36uf/image.png)
[Souce: Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rimurutempest)
Alguns momentos, por mais que seja necessário por conta de organização e controle, algumas propostas acabam sendo gastos desnecessários para os próprios projetos no geral, porque já fazem parte da estrutura do ecossistema. Não tenho certeza, mas acredito que quando alguém manda uma proposta para o Splinterlands, precisa gastar um certo valor até para evitar algum tipo de spam eu acho. Há não muito tempo, houve algum tipo de mudança na forma que as taxas de mercado funcionam e foi necessário que fossem feitas propostas para todos os marketplaces que tem fees, se eu não me engano. Nesse sentido, pelo que vi rapidamente, a maioria dessa propostas tinha o mesmo conteúdo, abordando o mesmo assunto e foram todas aprovadas. Dessa forma, pelo menos umas 5 propostas gastaram para serem colocadas, e nesse mercado de bearmarket qualquer valor economizado pelos projetos pode fazer a diferença, já que a entrada de novos usuários está baixa, então tem que reduzir ao máximo os custos. Ao em vez de fazer várias propostas poderia ter feito uma única proposta com todos os marketplaces. ---

body.title: LUT Hive Garden Journal 2026 #3
body.body:
I love watching my **lavenders** bloom every day. I have 9 plants in the front of my house and they  grow so fast now. Every time I walk past, (I think) I can smell a faint whiff of its fragrance. It's very satisfying.
![1000058328.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23yJBwpA4iX69J1eXM8NjuUj3QyyxR7ze6LJWNhg5j4Zu28P7Q4goV3qbA26CW9a1XW2P.jpg)


The other flowers I have are the **gadiolus**  planted last year. There are no flowers yet but there are loads of new shoots. Not sure what to do with them, and whether they will suck energy from the mature flowers and slow down their bloom.
![1000058100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23x17JjifJi2VAtpdcJaU82PeuyfypaAKbLEJP7zCnZgteo2a8SgSKfqQuM1fiCyGmt5L.jpg)

![1000058326.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoJyebJLYkxz3QnYiphz8ZwjskjnyrC1ZWezJ3wZWdZMCizsnk3m4Rk8jceRiDXtNHC.jpg)
![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png)
My first harvest this year is the low hanging fruit **radish**. Here's the first few I harvested and the rest were be even bigger. After reading @riverflows post about pickling, I tried it and surprisingly it was quite nice. I might plant some more if I got spare space.
![1000056482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/243BeLzajh32Zu1cKNuMuDnj3MSPvkC9wT2R7UqDjuCmyxmqJS1qsfZPTPWkZMsNcwvso.jpg)

I planted my  **peas** out and apart from one time I caught a slug nibbling on a leaf, so far they're doing ok. The white fluffy stuff around it is sheep wool. Apparently it deters slug. It didn't stop that one nibbling away! Since it's organic and there's been no more incidents, I've left them as mulch.
![1000058316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23yJEc3yLQ7nZ8hm7rdoXXAwM8cqbyM6tsXAz4fgG7UbKhSeeLvvhKqssXFixrirXC1Au.jpg)

Talking of slugs, my first **strawberry** wasn't so lucky today. How very annoying!!😡

![1000058324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/Eonjbj5M7Qg91WyUq9K5y6NdWeMBc5g8VAPtQT3DQEngaQq7twvdxeFpcs14uiVot1f.jpg)

![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png)

Like the rest of Europe, we've had some very hot weather these few days. At last!! I can start to plant things out. My sister gave me a lot of **Chinese Kale** seedlings and I figured I'd test the water and plant them out. Chinese kale is quite expensive, if they all survive, I'd be saving quite a few pennies.  The five plants at the back are **sunflowers**.
<div class=\

> https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23u62hoiASRpSYmYoVFiXyWJbiUN5Y2a5o26sujvfg6yEj9bk3yTpTk8HGPxCPao5aT1Z.jpg The other veggies I like is **bak choi**. The timing for my first batch wasn't very good. I kept them in my greenhouse when I went to Alicante and the lack of sun caused them to be quite leggy. I still managed to harvest enough for one meal. So not all was lost. I'm going to sow more seeds next month. ![1000058319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23wgKLMfKxaWZPDwcVQC7s4hak7TvbTukhJjwpFjyS34gSqH4a1ZVb5nNfMg8fTYhhor7.jpg) In my last LUT garden journal I mentioned I planted a **choyate**. Nothing happened for a whole month and I thought it had died. Then suddenly a few days ago I noticed some green underneath the straw! Look how much the new shoots have grown over 4 days. ![1000058331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/2423ya8fC354m9hsHLFb5sKBE7zuidQ8MBrwMg6Q73gQannUzHs6ZgoXkWrZYGVPQiaLo.jpg) ![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png) In a few days time I'm going to plant out my **tomatoes**. This is just one batch , I have another pot. I have sowed too many seeds and will probably end up giving a lot away. ![1000058318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EpEHE1qQWZ3V3xMHvqmQK1kT4ar4epothBQjT6b2KRipQWtowhHMhEeHNiC8oiAypXE.jpg) The **courgettes** will go out as well next week. I sowed four seeds, gave two plants to my sister, as well as the tray of tomatoes. Then my other sister gave me a few more courgettes today. Now I have to find someone else to give the surplus courgettes away. ![1000058093.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/23ywnkAqvKWeJUSFjoMwCVrdpuwXbQDGKdfqtBACLgBmT9ZRKQycqeP8UbVCbeeVuQY57.jpg) These **green peppers** took forever to germinate, I sowed them two months ago and had nearly given up on them. Maybe I sowed them too early when it was still very cold. Anyway, it looks good now, just need to give them more TLC. ![1000058321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/EoprRwDCqasV8ZBg7EgMaBfPYunU35EVGGcy5vRJd5ZL5GEJ6sczcNxRA4RMHARdrMy.jpg) ![livinguktaiwan divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/fuGLEHxS-livinguktaiwan20divider.png) And finally my herbs, **thyme and sage**, I want to build a herb patch. I could have bought some from the shops, but I like a challenge and there's a lot more satisfaction to grow them from seeds. I'm a bit gutted that only one sage seed germinated,but that's fine. The thyme did well. You win some and lose some. ![1000058322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/livinguktaiwan/2423uvU7JVjUQSo4HMuTdhztEDniV4kM7qHAmeTp61xoaYZd4GEeBjWHUuZndqBLubvTS.jpg) The next few days will be busy as I start to plant things out in my garden. Can't wait for the growing season to start at last. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gardenhive/EoniAy6i3LJQCnPSFugTmdA7AedxBcSac11gLAQYaESDz5HKqer2cXS3oZyQkkfNst5.jpg
