body.title: El Hedor de la Traición
body.body:
Publicado en Español, Inglés y Portugués.

---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZWN6sR6CbbGnnUjkNn1v48ddTFykXTd9a2xgJEw6ZetL/1779749242566.jpg) *Editado en PhotoCollage*
[Fuente](https://proverbia.net/autor/frases-de-emiliano-zapata) *de la imagen y la frase utilizada*
---

Traicionar a la patria no es un error. No es un desliz. No es \

, es una podredumbre que empieza adentro.

El traidor a la patria no es el enemigo de fuera. Es el que comió en la misma mesa, el que juró lealtad con la mano en alto o el bolsillo lleno, el que conocía los secretos, los puntos débiles, las grietas. Y las vendió.

Vendió tierra por monedas, sangre de los suyos por un cargo, por un indulto, por una cuenta en el extranjero. Vendió el futuro de su propia gente por un presente de comodidad o de cobardía.

No hay perfume que tape ese hedor, porque la traición a la patria no es solo un delito legal. Es un delito contra la memoria de los que cayeron defendiendo lo que él regaló. Contra el trabajo de generaciones que construyeron desde el barro y el frío. Contra el hijo que tendrá que vivir en un país más pobre, más débil o más humillado porque alguien, desde dentro, abrió la puerta.

El traidor siempre tiene excusas, esas como que el \
y sin embargo, él se embarró hasta el cuello.\n\
, dice y se consuela, pero es mentira no todos hacen eso. La mayoría trabaja, resiste o simplemente no vende su dignidad porque aún le queda un resto de vergüenza.\nOtra muletilla que se le oye es \

, como si sobrevivir fuera lo mismo que traicionar. No lo es. Sobrevive el que huye, el que emigra, el que aprieta los dientes. El traidor no sobrevive: negocia.

Pongamos las cosas claras. Traicionar a la patria es detestable en cualquiera de sus formas y pongo algunas como, el político que roba fondos públicos mientras la gente no come o el funcionario que entrega información al enemigo por dinero.
Esta también el militar que jura bandera y luego conspira con el invasor, asi lo hace de igual manera el empresario que esquilma recursos nacionales y esconde la ganancia en un paraíso fiscal. Y que decir del ideólogo que un día arenga por la soberanía y al otro día besa la mano del extranjero que lo financia.

Todos apestan igual. El hedor no distingue trajes ni discursos.

Hay quienes piden entenderlos. Quienes hablan de \

. Quienes dicen que la patria es una idea y las ideas no sangran.

Mienten. La patria sangra cuando la traicionan. Sangra en los hospitales sin recursos, en las fronteras mal defendidas, en las fábricas que cerraron porque alguien vendió la industria. Sangra en la humillación colectiva de un pueblo que sabe que su propio hijo le clavó el cuchillo por la espalda.

Los pueblos no olvidan el hedor. Pueden perdonar muchas cosas, la ineptitud, la arrogancia, incluso cierta negligencia. Pero la traición deliberada, la que fue planeada con fría conciencia, esa queda grabada en el hueso de la memoria colectiva.

Por eso los traidores a la patria mueren solos. No porque la ley los condene, a veces ni eso, sino porque la comunidad los expulsa con el olfato. Nadie quiere acercarse a quien apesta a podredumbre moral.

Así que no. No hay excusa. No hay \

. No hay término medio.

Traicionar a la patria es, fue y será una de las acciones más bajas que un ser humano puede cometer. Porque no traiciona a una idea abstracta, traiciona a personas reales que confiaron en él.

Y la confianza, una vez corrompida, despide un hedor que ni el tiempo ni los indultos pueden borrar.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *ENGLISH*

---
---


Betraying one’s country is not a mistake. It is not a slip. It is not “a complex decision in context.”

It is a rot that starts from within.

The traitor to the nation is not the enemy from outside. It is the one who ate at the same table, who swore loyalty with a hand raised or a pocket full, who knew the secrets, the weak points, the cracks. And sold them.

He sold land for coins, the blood of his own people for a position, for a pardon, for an offshore account. He sold the future of his own people for a present of comfort or cowardice.

No perfume can mask that stench, because betraying the country is not just a legal crime. It is a crime against the memory of those who fell defending what he gave away. Against the work of generations who built from mud and cold. Against the child who will have to live in a poorer, weaker, or more humiliated country because someone, from the inside, opened the door.

The traitor always has excuses: “The system was rotten,” yet he waded in up to his neck. “Everyone does it,” he says and consoles himself, but that’s a lie — not everyone does that. Most people work, resist, or simply don’t sell their dignity because they still have a shred of shame.
Another crutch you hear is “I’m just surviving,” as if surviving were the same as betraying. It is not. The one who survives is the one who flees, who emigrates, who grits his teeth. The traitor does not survive: he negotiates.

Let’s be clear. Betraying your country is detestable in any form, for example: the politician who steals public funds while people go hungry, or the official who hands over information to the enemy for money. Also the soldier who swears allegiance to the flag and then conspires with the invader; likewise the businessman who plunders national resources and hides the profit in a tax haven. And what of the intellectual who one day rants about sovereignty and the next day kisses the hand of the foreigner who funds him.

They all stink the same. The stench does not distinguish between suits or speeches.

There are those who ask to understand them. Those who speak of “shades” and “contexts.” Those who say the homeland is an idea, and ideas don’t bleed.

They lie. The homeland bleeds when betrayed. It bleeds in hospitals without resources, in poorly defended borders, in factories that closed because someone sold the industry. It bleeds in the collective humiliation of a people who know that their own child stabbed them in the back.

Peoples do not forget the stench. They may forgive many things — ineptitude, arrogance, even some negligence. But deliberate betrayal, planned with cold awareness, that becomes etched into the bone of collective memory.

That is why traitors to the nation die alone. Not because the law condemns them — sometimes not even that — but because the community expels them by smell. No one wants to get close to one who stinks of moral rot.

So no. There is no excuse. No “but.” No middle ground.

Betraying your country is, was, and will be one of the lowest actions a human being can commit. Because it does not betray an abstract idea; it betrays real people who trusted him.

And trust, once corrupted, gives off a stench that neither time nor pardons can erase.

---
---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

---
---

# *PORTUGUÉS*

---
---


Trair a pátria não é um erro. Não é um deslize. Não é “uma decisão complexa em contexto”.

É uma podridão que começa por dentro.

O traidor à pátria não é o inimigo de fora. É aquele que comeu na mesma mesa, que jurou lealdade com a mão levantada ou o bolso cheio, que conhecia os segredos, os pontos fracos, as rachaduras. E as vendeu.

Vendeu terra por moedas, sangue dos seus por um cargo, por um indulto, por uma conta no estrangeiro. Vendeu o futuro do seu próprio povo por um presente de conforto ou covardia.

Não há perfume que tape esse fedor, porque trair a pátria não é só um crime legal. É um crime contra a memória daqueles que caíram defendendo o que ele entregou. Contra o trabalho de gerações que construíram a partir do barro e do frio. Contra o filho que terá de viver num país mais pobre, mais fraco ou mais humilhado porque alguém, de dentro, abriu a porta.

O traidor tem sempre desculpas: “O sistema estava podre”, e no entanto ele se encharcou de lama até o pescoço. “Todos fazem isso”, diz e se consola, mas é mentira — nem todos fazem isso. A maioria trabalha, resiste ou simplesmente não vende a sua dignidade porque ainda lhe resta um resto de vergonha.
Outro bordão que se ouve é “Eu sobrevivo”, como se sobreviver fosse o mesmo que trair. Não é. Sobrevive quem foge, quem emigra, quem range os dentes. O traidor não sobrevive: ele negocia.

Vamos deixar as coisas claras. Trair a pátria é detestável em qualquer uma das suas formas, por exemplo: o político que rouba fundos públicos enquanto o povo não come, ou o funcionário que entrega informações ao inimigo por dinheiro. Também o militar que jura bandeira e depois conspira com o invasor; assim como o empresário que saqueia recursos nacionais e esconde o lucro num paraíso fiscal. E que dizer do ideólogo que um dia arenga pela soberania e no dia seguinte beija a mão do estrangeiro que o financia.

Todos fedem igual. O fedor não distingue ternos nem discursos.

Há quem peça para entendê-los. Quem fala de “nuances” e “contextos”. Quem diz que a pátria é uma ideia e as ideias não sangram.

Mentem. A pátria sangra quando a traem. Sangra nos hospitais sem recursos, nas fronteiras mal defendidas, nas fábricas que fecharam porque alguém vendeu a indústria. Sangra na humilhação coletiva de um povo que sabe que o próprio filho lhe cravou a faca pelas costas.

Os povos não esquecem o fedor. Podem perdoar muitas coisas — a ineptidão, a arrogância, até certa negligência. Mas a traição deliberada, planeada com fria consciência, essa fica gravada no osso da memória coletiva.

Por isso os traidores à pátria morrem sós. Não porque a lei os condene — às vezes nem isso —, mas porque a comunidade os expulsa pelo faro. Ninguém quer chegar perto de quem fede a podridão moral.

Portanto não. Não há desculpa. Não há “mas”. Não há meio-termo.

Trair a pátria é, foi e será uma das ações mais baixas que um ser humano pode cometer. Porque não trai uma ideia abstrata; trai pessoas reais que confiaram nele.

E a confiança, uma vez corrompida, exala um fedor que nem o tempo nem os indultos conseguem apagar.

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAhAKwyNZZUJMUA7vdruF54aTShX8Mq1ZCs7xYD3C5Sp/1758337351053.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPioZKWPc3STML2a1iV8y8o3y7Ayv6wXZdNk6AeXJaENj/1758503903035.jpg)

***Option 1: What does giving look like when it’s effortless?*** ___ ___ ___ Giving is a lifestyle, giving is meant to be a lifestyle because it is an act of sowing into the lives of someone or people who are in need, people whose only option of survival is you helping them or coming to their aid. Giving is basically to understand that pouring into others, sowing into others is being human and that it should be done with joy and understanding because that is the beauty of giving. It is no longer giving if it is done out of a grumbling mind and when one is being compelled to do so. Giving isn't genuine and joyful, doesn't define what it is meant to be if it is mostly done out of abundance and when one feels like doing it. Most people because a person once didn't do their bidding, once the person is in need and comes to them for aid, they refuse, not because they do not have but because they are trying to take revenge for the person not being on their side. ___ ___ ___
![FB_IMG_17794288439177926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23zkrH2vM5tkxqsrfqajukeFoVtzEZJ5JZ1Hd4aRFtmCcJ31w7eKPuV5H3wSgXxr7nMHi.jpg)
So, let's see effortless giving like this, you were asked to stop giving, or threatened to stop giving, and because you were threatened, you tried to stay away but every day before sleeping, you always feel empty and wondered when you would have the opportunity to go back to giving, inorder words, you miss giving, now the thing is it is probably effortless for you, giving is effortless for you. If you understand the above, you would be able to understand what effortless giving is about. It is your life, something you do without even thinking twice, it is something you could do even with your eyes closed, and even in your dreams. Giving effortless looks like giving without needing applause, is sowing into someone else's life not because you are compelled but because you deeply feel or are pushed to, it is giving because you want the other person to be able not just because you want to feel like a philanthropist or feel like you are a demi-god to anyone, and without you, others won't be able to survive. ___ ___ ___
![FB_IMG_17794288529632926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23wCFsfCHyNMJHQD77N2Ssjw4jD59S6JDjzEP1HCLyDJBEDd8s5ar3mus5KgGRHMst5Ar.jpg)
Such giving is invisible and has no record of the many times they have come through for you when needed, it is driven by genuineness to see someone happy, it is driven by love and empathy towards the other person and humanity at large. It is not that they have in abundance, it is that they enjoy doing it and would do it without waiting for someone to beg them to do it. This particular giving has no strings attached, the giving is done not for a later future favour or expectations of repayment, when you would one day be in need, or because you want them to sing your praises to everyone they come across, it doesn't mean that the collected should not be grateful or appreciative but when you knowingly do it because of those things, it is no longer it. It is simply finding joy in the act of blessing someone else or extending a hand to another person. ___ ___ ___

body.title: Designed to overeat ~daily prompt 3114
body.body:
There was a time in my life when food was not something I could freely choose, it was something I hoped for. I remember days when eating once felt like a blessing and not a routine.

 Hunger was not a diet plan more like a temporary fast; it was a reality I silently lived with.

 Malnourishment slowly became visible in my body. I looked weak, tired, and unhealthy, not because I wanted to, but because access to proper food was difficult.

What many people do not understand is that lack of food changes more than appearance. It affects confidence, energy, emotions, and even the way you see yourself. When your body is constantly deprived, survival becomes more important than balance. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU8ZSs39bitj6kG4az2Z6QZDPZM6YgRUpD8mP3upxY59u/1779749054974.jpg)

So when life finally changes and food becomes available, many people unconsciously begin to overeat not out of greed, but out of fear of returning to lack.

That was my reality.

I started eating more because I wanted to look healthier. I was tired of looking fragile, tired, and underfed. Seeing my body finally gain fullness felt comforting because it reflected a life that was improving. Food became more than nourishment; it became reassurance. Every meal silently reminded me that I was no longer in the same difficult place I once was.

But with time, I learnt something important, healing from hunger does not mean losing control with food. The body needs nourishment, not punishment nor excess. Many people who once lacked food develop emotional eating habits without realizing it. They eat beyond necessity because their mind still remembers scarcity even when their present reality has changed.

We live in a world designed to overeat, advertisements constantly push cravings, social media glorifies unhealthy eating habits, and stress makes people run toward comfort foods. People now eat out of boredom, sadness, anxiety, or pressure rather than actual hunger. Somewhere along the line, eating stopped becoming survival and became emotional escape.

I had to learn balance, I had to understand that eating healthy is not about consuming everything available but giving the body what it truly needs. There is nothing wrong with wanting to look healthy or gain weight after seasons of malnourishment, but it is also important to listen to the body and not let past deprivation control present habits.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSNMe3W2x7nHzBYN3uZrn6MtH9sp1Nf8VwdbDqAZ3YV99/1779749066394.jpg)
Now, I eat with more awareness, not to fill emotional emptiness, not because food is suddenly available, but because my body deserves proper care. I have learned that true health is not found in starving or overeating but in balance.

Sometimes, the greatest healing is learning that you no longer have to eat like you are afraid tomorrow will take food away again.

body.title: Como va mi paso? (Es/En)
body.body:
/>
Ayer fue un día lluvioso, como casi todos de la semana que recién acababa. Uno de esos días en los que te puedes levantar con la sensación de hoy talvez no sea un día y tan propicio para otra cosa que no sea quedarte en casa y esperar que pase. Al fin y al cabo era domingo. Un día que se presta para descansar, más aun cuando puede que hayas tenido una semana agotadora que te deja con la sensación de que las cosas no van al ritmo que uno desea. Lentamente, en el portal, arrastraba su lento cuerpo un caracol, por un piso húmedo. ¡Vaya cuadro! Sin embargo, en mi afán de combatir mis pensamientos de indefensión ante las circunstancias incomodas de la vida que en su mayoría no puede controlar, quizá por eso son incómodas, trate de ocupar mis reflexiones en algo positivo. Que podría hacerme ver aquel caracol, que parecía dirigirse hacia ninguna parte, a pesar de los esfuerzos que parecía hacer para desplazarse? Busque y busque hasta que me llego la idea de que tal vez no estaba mirando la realidad, mi realidad, en toda su extensión. No fue un proceso reflexivo corto, no. Después de largo rato reflexionando sobre el caracol y mi vida. Después de identificar qué era lo que yo podía estar proyectando en aquel caracol? Alguna frustración tal vez? Inseguridades? Etc. Tuve que hacer de tripas corazón. No es fácil mirar hacia adentro y desnudarse, aunque sea consigo mismo. Observaba al caracol y pensaba: que trabajo esta pasando para avanzar! Sin embargo tuve que reconocer: pero sigue adelante! Entonces, una idea fugaz paso por mi cabeza: a lo mejor se me está olvidando que en mi vida han existido etapas en las no he podido ir al ritmo que deseaba. Simplemente porque no estaba preparado para ello. Eso no ha sido tan malo. Al final he seguido adelante, me decía. Y aunque en aquel momento no lo comprendí, poner en juego mi voluntad me sirvió de mucho. Además, no tome en cuenta de que tener periodos en que andas con la carga baja, eso es un indicador de nuestra humanidad. Asi como también es indicador de mi humanidad, el andar con las cargas que en determinado momento no he sabido llevar a cuestas, o que no he estado preparado para llevarlas. Puede que me haya faltado percepción de que esas “cargas” pesaban aun mas porque no las estaba interpretando de modo correcto. Incluso, mirando al caracol y su lento desplazamiento, repensé la idea de que puede que algunas de esas cargas me haya protegido en algún momento. Algo así como cuando te encierras en un escudo. No digo que haya sido la mejor estrategia, sino que puede que deba aprewnder a mirar aquellas zonas oscuras en mí, como indicador de que tal vez este buscando encontrar un equilibrio en un momento determinado, en un área específica. Eso también es de humanos! Agradecido por tu compañía hasta el final, te dejo un abrazo de amigo. Imagen tomada con mi teléfono Xiaomi Redmi. Texto traducido al ingles con Google traductor.
ENGLISH VERSION

/> <div class=text-justify>

Yesterday was a rainy day, like almost every day of the week that had just ended. One of those days when you wake up with the feeling that today might not be a good day for anything other than staying home and waiting for it to pass.

After all, it was Sunday. A day that lends itself to resting, especially when you may have had an exhausting week that leaves you with the feeling that things aren't going at the pace you'd like. Slowly, in the doorway, a snail dragged its sluggish body across the damp floor. What a sight!  
However, in my effort to combat my feelings of helplessness in the face of life's uncomfortable circumstances, most of which I can't control—perhaps that's why they're uncomfortable—I tried to focus my thoughts on something positive.  
What could that snail, seemingly heading nowhere despite its apparent efforts to move, possibly be trying to show me? I searched and searched until the idea came to me that perhaps I wasn't seeing reality, my reality, in its entirety.  
It wasn't a short reflective process, no. After a long time reflecting on the snail and my life, after identifying what I might be projecting onto that snail—perhaps some frustration? Insecurities? Etc.—I had to grit my teeth. It's not easy to look inward and be vulnerable, even just to yourself. I watched the snail and thought: what a struggle it's going through to move forward! Yet I had to acknowledge: but it keeps going!  
Then, a fleeting thought crossed my mind: perhaps I'm forgetting that there have been periods in my life when I haven't been able to move at the pace I wanted. Simply because I wasn't ready for it.  
That wasn't so bad. In the end, I kept going, I told myself. And although I didn't understand it at the time, putting my will to the test served me well. Besides, I didn't consider that having periods when you're carrying a lighter load is an indicator of our humanity.  
Just as carrying burdens that at certain times I haven't known how to bear, or haven't been prepared to carry, is also an indicator of my humanity. Perhaps I lacked the awareness that those \

weighed even more because I wasn't interpreting them correctly. Even watching the snail and its slow movement, I reconsidered the idea that perhaps some of those burdens had protected me at some point. Something like when you enclose yourself in a shield. I'm not saying it was the best strategy, but perhaps I should learn to look at those dark areas within myself, as an indicator that maybe I'm trying to find a balance at a particular moment, in a specific area. That's human nature too! Agradecido por tu compañía hasta el final, te dejo un abrazo de amigo. Imagen tomada con mi teléfono Xiaomi Redmi. Texto traducido al inglés con traductor de Google.

body.title: La magia de viajar al pasado a través de los sabores | The magic of traveling to the past through flavors 🤤🫶🏼 [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
#### La magia de viajar al pasado a través de los sabores.


![1000032460.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/242YSu8Vva9qFmAD4R6kgq6emKDsE2EVEkHHHZRjskUBK4sp8cZAfe1cgm9TEP1yctKoP.png)


Hola, hola! Amigos de la comunidad de Empowertalent, espero que se encuentren muy bien. Siempre es genial poder compartir parte de nosotros a través de las iniciativas de la comunidad. En esta ocasión la iniciativa se trata de viajar al pasado y recordar a través de la comida aquellos momentos de nuestra infancia o durante nuestro crecimiento, que nos hacen reconectar con ese lado de nosotros donde alguna vez fuimos felices. Mi abuela era experta cocinando diferentes platos, hasta algunos que no eran comunes aquí en Venezuela, por lo que está publicación me hará recordar el sentimiento con el que mi abuela hacia cada comida, uniendo el amor y la dedicación. 

En mi casa la mayor parte del tiempo la pasábamos con mi abuela materna, ella era nuestra segunda madre y quien nos cuido desde que nacimos hasta el día en que falleció. Ella era de San Juan de los Morros pero vivió un largo tiempo en Los Teques y luego en Maracay. Siempre la recuerdo entre colecciones de libros de recetas de cocina, tenía tantos que ya no tenía ni espacio para guardarlos y aún conservamos la mayoría de estos. Era amante de la cocina y trabajo la mayor parte del tiempo cocinando. Cuando llegó a la tercera edad, se encargaba de ayudar a mi mamá quién trabajaba todo el día, mientras mi abuela nos cuidaba y nos alimentaba 🥹.

![1000032409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhoR85iAndLCxQxbTVfiMDj4WHWFcX9RzrU9k3b1X5Lwz3mvr53gXT7ZZMWH5nRc4y3.jpg)

Ella fue más hacia la comida salada que a los dulces, si le gustaba el dulce pero era diabética por lo que no podía estar todo el tiempo comiendo tortas o chucherías. La comida que más me gustaba cuando la preparaba era la sopa de plátano verde. Esta es una sopa que ella aprendió a cocinar cuando estaba casada y es de origen colombiano. La sopa llevaba carne de res, cilantro, pero el ingrediente principal eran los plátanos verdes. Para la mayoría al escuchar esta receta les resultaba rara y también creo que se imaginaban que no tenía un buen sabor. Pero es una sopa de las mejores que he probado, aún sigue siendo de mis favoritas aunque lleva una larga preparación. 

La preparación consiste en hacer un caldo con todo lo que lleva una sopa normal, con la carne de res y los plátanos verdes. Al momento de que la carne ya está suave y en su punto, entonces empieza el verdadero desafío. Hay que picar los plátanos en rodajas, pasarlos por aceite y hacerlos como tostones, luego de que estén bien cocinados se van agregando a la sopa. Y después hay que esperar que todos los sabores se mezclen y la sopa se enfríe un poco porque es bastante pesada por la cantidad de plátanos que lleva que ya seria al gusto de cada uno. Es demasiado buena, tanto que aun mi mamá la prepara y es de esos platillos que nunca nos cansamos de probar. 


![1000032414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xAY7vPdCQKQjcStQLu1T47pQc6JPo5asuPCZjZTW7poZA1VSkozgvKLPVTvHU7YsTBE.jpg)

![1000032416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tmHnQDiqVzYwNk1ryo9qHen7LUbDAadApQqAGuv4AuaaVHmL4k9oVqA1NG1P1s4cdQw.jpg)


En la parte de los dulces mi abuela no era de las que hacía tortas decoradas, flans, helados, gelatinas... Pero si que hacía una receta que nos encantaba y eran las arepas venezolanas pero dulces con aniz y fritas. Esas arepitas eran demasiado buenas, recuerdo que ella las hacía algunas veces en las tardes cuando le provocaba cocinar algo rico pero diferente. Aunque estas dos recetas no eran demasiado saludables 🫡😂, pero no las hacía todo el tiempo. Que bonito poder tenerla presente en los momentos de comer alguna receta que ella preparaba, es una manera de conectar con ella y con su pasión por la comida. 

Mi mamá también preparaba cosas muy buenas como pasticho, tortas, quesillos, ponquesitos, helados. Y tiene el mismo sazón que mi abuela, es increíble pero de alguna manera el poder volver al pasado con un bocado es de las cosas más bonitas que existen. Aun recuerdo cada tarde comiendo con mi abuela, también cada cumpleaños donde mi mamá se destacaba por preparar los dulces y los aperitivos. Yo estoy aprendiendo a cocinar cosas que sean diferentes a las habituales, me gusta por ejemplo hacer galletas, tortas y también alfajores que son de mis dulces favoritos. Y aunque no tengo la misma experiencia, poco a poco voy viendo y tratando de hacer cada comida con amor como lo hizo mi abuela en vida y mi mamá en cada ocasión especial. 🥹


![1000032461.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/245cq2ahsHhy6XH9WiM1VYX6dd4dNQpGubfm4ka3ei6kf5hAcUZTLzTLkRDZzzftJtV6w.png)


#### The magic of traveling to the past through flavors.


![1000032459.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/242YSu8Vva9qFmAD4R6ndaGtDM5HuFNJHNDZdbR3d3UDretR9mnmV5381t4k9HE9BLWRA.png)


Hello, hello! Friends of the Empowertalent community, I hope you are doing very well. It is always great to be able to share a part of ourselves through community initiatives. This time, the initiative is about traveling to the past and remembering, through food, those moments from our childhood or as we grew up that make us reconnect with that side of us where we were once happy. My grandmother was an expert at cooking different dishes, even some that were not common here in Venezuela, so this post will make me remember the feeling with which my grandmother made every meal, combining love and dedication.

At home, we spent most of our time with my maternal grandmother; she was our second mother and the one who took care of us from the day we were born until the day she passed away. She was from San Juan de los Morros but lived for a long time in Los Teques and then in Maracay. I always remember her among collections of recipe books; she had so many that she didn't even have space to store them anymore, and we still keep most of them. She was a lover of cooking and spent most of her time working as a cook. When she reached her golden years, she was in charge of helping my mom, who worked all day, while my grandmother took care of us and fed us 🥹.

![1000032409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23vhoR85iAndLCxQxbTVfiMDj4WHWFcX9RzrU9k3b1X5Lwz3mvr53gXT7ZZMWH5nRc4y3.jpg)


She leaned more toward savory food than sweets; she did like sweets, but she was diabetic, so she couldn't be eating cakes or treats all the time. The food I liked the most when she made it was green plantain soup. This is a soup she learned to cook when she was married, and it is of Colombian origin. The soup had beef and cilantro, but the main ingredient was green plantains. To most people, hearing this recipe sounded strange, and I think they also imagined it didn't taste good. But it is one of the best soups I have ever tasted; it is still one of my favorites even though it requires a long preparation.

The preparation consists of making a broth with everything a normal soup has, along with the beef and green plantains. Once the meat is tender and just right, then the real challenge begins. You have to slice the plantains, fry them in oil, and make them like *tostones* (twice-fried plantain slices); after they are well cooked, you add them to the soup. And then you have to wait for all the flavors to blend and for the soup to cool down a bit because it is quite heavy due to the amount of plantains it has, which would be to everyone's liking. It is incredibly good, so much so that my mom still makes it, and it is one of those dishes we never get tired of eating.

![1000032414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xAY7vPdCQKQjcStQLu1T47pQc6JPo5asuPCZjZTW7poZA1VSkozgvKLPVTvHU7YsTBE.jpg)

![1000032416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23tmHnQDiqVzYwNk1ryo9qHen7LUbDAadApQqAGuv4AuaaVHmL4k9oVqA1NG1P1s4cdQw.jpg)

When it came to sweets, my grandmother wasn't the type to make decorated cakes, flans, ice cream, or jello... But she did make a recipe that we loved, which was Venezuelan *arepas*, but sweet with anise and fried. Those *arepitas* were incredibly good; I remember she would make them sometimes in the afternoons when she felt like cooking something delicious but different. Granted, these two recipes weren't exactly healthy 🫡😂, but she didn't make them all the time. How beautiful it is to be able to keep her present whenever we eat a recipe she used to make; it's a way to connect with her and her passion for food.

My mom also used to make great things like *pasticho* (lasagna), cakes, *quesillos* (Venezuelan flan), cupcakes, and ice cream. And she has the exact same touch as my grandmother; it's amazing, but somehow being able to go back to the past with a single bite is one of the most beautiful things that exists. I still remember every afternoon eating with my grandmother, and also every birthday where my mom excelled at preparing the sweets and appetizers. I am learning to cook things that are different from the usual; for example, I like to make cookies, cakes, and also *alfajores*, which are among my favorite sweets. And although I don't have the same experience, little by little I am learning and trying to make every meal with love, just as my grandmother did in life and my mom does on every special occasion. 🥹

Hello all, good day..
‎its very important to protect our phones because if bad hands have access to it, it will be a great disaster, our phone is not only own private but it's like another part of use that shouldn't be share with anyhow people..
‎i could remember when one if my uncle told me that a professional hacker can hack my phone when they are connected to my wifi, I was very surprised when he told me because I have no idea that by that small step, I might lose my phone to hackers..

‎well, some ways which I can protect my phone from them firstly, I will protect my Gmail, by adding a very strong password to it maybe use the Google authentication, to back it up because it really good, email is one of the stronghold of the phone, if it's hacked then the phone is automatically gone..
I will also avoid visiting to many websites that am not familiar with, because by that alone, I may be robbed my email and once that is done, it's finished I can't retrieve it anymore. I just have to sit and watch them take over my phone and also by running away from those sites that promises free things for a long period of time without me putting any efforts.
‎i have been a victim of this before, it all started in an afternoon when I was on my phone then I received a Whatsapp message telling me about a site where I could get about half a dollar by submitting screenshots of some products from their company, just to make sure that I was active in their company's site..
‎i did it and was paid for about some days, and I was added me in their telegram channel where I see thousand of people also doing the same thing I was doing..

body.title: 🌸 A little girl´s make-up || Unos pequeños arreglos de chicas 🌸
body.body:
![A little girl's make-up....jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/24242DqGJGopkVJ4dbCC9VpwM7XnBhgLzg13NqMkqKGthaogRpsmDWwtx4iqe51agPCAc.jpg)


<center>_🎶 And I let my hair down,
 I dressed like a queen,
 I put on heels,
 I put on makeup and I was beautiful..._🎶</center>

>Gloria Trevi

<div class=\

>Hello! My dear beauties and caretakers of the skin, nails, hair, and everything that covers us to look prettier 😊, I greet you hoping that everything is very well.
\n\n

>Beauty is costly; and I’m not only talking about the financial aspect, but also about the cost that our own being suffers.
\n\n

>Just look at history, from milk baths, protective tattoos, to the famous corset used to slim the figure, these are some of the practices we have had to look attractive, even if we didn’t feel that way.
\n\n

>Now, I, following these practices, do subject my body to some rituals, but not only to look good, but to feel good, and that is what is important.
\n\n

>Months ago, I underwent a complete change and here I tell you how I felt in each one of these “enhancements” to which we expose our bodies.
\n\n>

>¡Hola! Mis queridas bellezas y cuidadoras de la piel, uñas, cabellos y todo lo que nos cubre para vernos más bonitas 😊, les saludo esperando que todo esté muy bien. La belleza cuesta; y no solo hablo de lo económico, sino del costo que sufre nuestro propio precio. Basta ver la historia y, desde baños de leches, tatuajes de protección hasta el famoso corsé, para estilizar la figura, son algunas de las prácticas que hemos tenido para vernos agradables, aunque no nos sintiéramos como tal.
>

>Ahora, yo, siguiendo esas prácticas, sí someto mi cuerpo a algunos rituales, pero no solo por verme bien, sino por sentirme bien, y eso es lo importante.\nHace meses, me sometí a un cambio completo y aquí le cuento cómo me sentí en cada uno de estos \

a los cuales exponemos nuestro cuerpo.
![FM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wXSdeCjyWqFNmVJN1CZC5wGmM4zitBAnVVuPtiQs9yubkH9BdzqfuXENZuTAx9Yqzjk.png) ------

>

**<center>Hidratación para el cabello</center>**

Una de las partes que me gusta tratar constantemente es mi cabello.

He entendido que con disciplina y constancia puedo tener un cabello limpio, sano y manejable.

Tengo el mal de la mayoría, que mi cabello se cae en cantidades, pero también soy consciente del olvido al cual lo he sometido durante muchos años, que me está pasando factura.

En mi institución se encuentra una materia de peluquería, por lo que mi amiga Milagros se ha vuelto mi aliada al momento de cuidarlo.

Desde que estoy con ella, mi cabello ha adquirido vida y mi cuero cabelludo está limpio.

A su vez, el cabello me crece muy rápido, por tal motivo, la visito muy seguido para hacer cambios y cuidados en él.

La pollina está de moda y me sometí a su talento para colocarme el look \
, como se conoce en Venezuela. ¿Resultado? Me encantó. Tenía tiempo que no usaba este corte, y el cambio se notó de inmediato, así que estuve muy feliz y lo he mantenido por meses. 💯

>

**<center>Hair Hydration</center>**

One of the parts I like to treat constantly is my hair.

I have understood that with discipline and consistency I can have clean, healthy, and manageable hair.

I have the problem of most people, that my hair falls out in large amounts, but I am also aware of the neglect I have subjected it to for many years, which is taking its toll.

At my institution, there is a hairdressing course, so my friend Milagros has become my ally when it comes to taking care of it.

Since I have been with her, my hair has gained life, and my scalp is clean.

At the same time, my hair grows very quickly, so I visit her very often to make changes and care for it.

The bangs are in fashion, and I submitted to her talent to give me the \

look, as it is known in Venezuela. Result? I loved it. It had been a while since I used this haircut, and the change was noticeable immediately, so I was very happy and have kept it for months. 💯 ------

> **
Uñas en poligel tipo almendras, efecto reflectivo
** Esto suena a quítate tú uña para ponerte quién sabe qué, ja, ja, ja... Resulta que de esta práctica también fui fan cuando era joven, porque yo, desde que salieron las uñas postizas, tenía una peluquería estrella donde me complacían con todo lo que yo quería. Puedo contar que iba cada tres semanas, donde sometía mis uñas a limas, químicos, pegas, esmaltes, lámparas y un sinfín de tratamientos para verme más bonita. Hace 9 años tuve un accidente donde casi pierdo mi uña, porque la uña postiza estaba tan pegada que se desprendió con mi uña natural. Gracias a Dios, mi uña se salvó, pero desde ese momento evito colocarlas. Sin embargo, como una es vanidosa, mis uñas no crecen mucho; confieso que no soy muy asidua de ir a hacerle manicure y, cuando crecen, se me caen; por eso, quise hacerme algo bonito para lucir diferente. ¿Resultados? En el mercado existen diversas técnicas para perfeccionar la uña (todas abrasivas e invasivas), pero el resultado es muy bonito. Yo pregunté, me las hice de esta manera y me quedaron hermosas. La parte negativa fue que, después que me las quité, mis uñas sufrieron tanto que actualmente las tengo muy débiles. Como medida para recuperarla, me he propuesto ir más seguido a limpiar, hidratar y mantener mis uñas lo más alejadas posible de esos tratamientos que, por verme bonita, dañan mi uña natural.

> **
Polygel nails, almond-shaped, reflective effect
** This sounds like 'take off your nail to put on who knows what,' ha, ha, ha... It turns out that I was also a fan of this practice when I was young, because ever since fake nails came out, I had a star salon where they indulged me with everything I wanted. I can say that I went every three weeks, where I subjected my nails to files, chemicals, glues, polishes, lamps, and countless treatments to look prettier. Nine years ago, I had an accident where I almost lost my nail because the fake nail was so glued on that it came off along with my natural nail. Thank God, my nail was saved, but since that moment I avoid putting them on. However, since one is vain, my nails do not grow much; I confess that I am not very regular with getting manicures, and when they grow, they fall off; that is why I wanted to do something nice to look different. Results? There are various techniques on the market to perfect the nail (all abrasive and invasive), but the result is very beautiful. I asked, I did them this way, and they turned out beautiful. The negative part was that, after I removed them, my nails suffered so much that currently they are very weak. As a measure to recover them, I have decided to go more often to clean, hydrate, and keep my nails as far away as possible from those treatments that, to make me look beautiful, damage my natural nail. -------

>

**<center>Cejas laminadas</center>**

Este ha sido otro problema que me aqueja porque cuando era niña tenía muchas cejas; cuando era joven me las saqué como estaba a la moda \

y desde allí, ¡JAMÁS! Me ha salido nuevamente como yo quiero para tener unas cejas más naturales. Por este motivo he tenido que recurrir a pintarme las cejas, pero no me dura mucho. Me han comentado que puede ser un problema hormonal, por lo que estoy pendiente de realizarme unos exámenes. Sin embargo, para mi _falta de vellos_, surgió una técnica que trata de que a la propia ceja se hidrate para que los vellos se vean más nutridos y abundantes. ¿Resultados? Sí se vio el resultado, pero consulté con otra especialista y me comentó que no me hicieron el tratamiento correctamente. Me indicó que se habían pasado de químico e hizo el efecto contrario. Me recomendó hidratarlas y estoy pendiente de ir con ella para poder hacerme un trabajo más bonito, duradero y menos dañino.

>

**<center>Laminated eyebrows</center>**

This has been another problem that bothers me because when I was a child I had a lot of eyebrows; when I was young I plucked them as it was fashionable \

and since then, NEVER! Have they grown back the way I want to have more natural eyebrows. For this reason, I have had to resort to drawing my eyebrows, but it doesn’t last long. They have told me that it could be a hormonal problem, so I am planning to get some tests done. However, for my _lack of hair_, a technique has emerged that involves moisturizing the natural eyebrow so that the hairs look more nourished and abundant. Results? Yes, there was a visible result, but I consulted another specialist and she told me that they didn’t do the treatment correctly. She indicated that they had used too much chemical and it had the opposite effect. She recommended moisturizing them, and I am planning to go to her to get a nicer, longer-lasting, and less damaging treatment. ------

> **
Lifting de pestañas
** En el mismo orden de las cejas, se ofrece este servicio para resaltar las pestañas sin necesidad de colocar unas postizas (que, por cierto, me hicieron daño cuando me las coloqué). Yo estaba renuente, pero como el servicio de las cejas se ofrece con las pestañas, y la joven me convenció de que el cambio se vería con las dos técnicas aplicadas, me dejé hacer el tratamiento. ¿Resultados? Me gustó. No se veían exageradas o artificiales y solo con agua, ya estaban listas para tener una mirada más profunda y levantada 💯.

> **
Eyelash lift
** In the same order as the eyebrows, this service is offered to enhance the eyelashes without the need to put on false ones (which, by the way, hurt me when I wore them). I was hesitant, but since the eyebrow service is offered together with the eyelashes, and the young woman convinced me that the change would be noticeable with both techniques applied, I let them do the treatment. Results? I liked it. They didn't look exaggerated or artificial, and just with water, they were ready to give a deeper and lifted look 💯. ------

>Since I'm not used to all that, I felt pretty because the immediate change was noticeable. However, subjecting my body to so many chemicals, of which I have to be a slave to the consequences, I think is not for me.
\n\n

>Also, a lot of money is invested that I could spend on the gym, clothes, and some makeup that has the same effect of making me look just as pretty 😊.
\n\n

>But since vanity can be stronger, I will surely save it for special occasions, because what would a woman be without adornments? 😍.
\n\n>

>Resultados finales Como no estoy acostumbrada a todo eso, me sentí bonita porque se notaba el cambio inmediato. Sin embargo, someter a mi cuerpo a tantos químicos de los cuales tengo que ser esclava de las consecuencias, creo que no es lo mío. Además, se invierte mucho dinero que me puedo invertir en gym, ropa y algún maquillaje que haga el mismo efecto de verme igual de bonita 😊. Pero como la vanidad puede más, seguro lo dejo para ocasiones especiales, porque ¿qué sería de la mujer sin adornos? 😍.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-17 at 7.33.52 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florecitamejias/23wCBnRbRdRyu1kZPQGwTeCyfVyexEKgk3jE83xn2XCdvDd34cCemGRsxbEgd9JBNj3Vt.jpeg)

Bekerja dengan umur yang sudah tidak muda lagi sangatlah susah. Waktu itu saya berumur 39 tahun. Menurut  kalian bagaimana?  Sekian purnama saya hanyalah seorang ibu dan istri. Meskipun saya lulusan sarjana tapi karena sudah lama tidak diasah yaaah seperti pisau yang tumpul.
Sudah lama tidak pegang komputer jadi sedikit lupa. Sedih loh rasanya saat teman kita tidak sabar membantu kita belajar lagi mengoperasionalkan komputer. Rasanya mau nangis tidak betah bekerja waktu itu. Mungkin karena dia masih muda dan sesama wanita jadi kurang sabar. 
Untung teman pria nya pada sabar. Jadi sedikit terhibur. Dan saya berusaha kuat untuk anak-anak ku.
Waktu bekerja disana saya mendapatkan jadwal masuk 20 hari dan 10 hari libur. Waktu libur itulah saya bertekad belajar lagi kursus komputer kilat.
Berjalannya waktu saya bisa menyesuaikan diri degan pekerjaan baruku, mempunyai teman baru. Dilingkungan pekerjaan mayoritas pekerjanya laki-laki.  Wanitanya bisa diitung dengan jari. Untunglah saat itu kita mendapatkan mess untuk para karyawan.  Ada Satu gedung dikhususkan untuk wanita, namanya Delarosa. Satu kamar diisi 2 orang. Waktu itu saya satu kamar dengan teman sesama clerk tapi dia di bagian produksi. 

Selama 7 tahun saya bekerja di Jambi.dengan gaji yang menurut ku bagus. Saya bisa menyenangkan dan membiayai sekolah anak-anak pada saa itu.Dan anak-anak bangga meliha ibunya bekerja. 

Selama bekerja disana rutinitasku selama 20 hari adalah berangkat bekerja dari jam 6 pagi pulang jam 6 sore. Setiap hari seperti itu sangatlah membosankan bukan?. Jadi hiburan  saya adalah  telpon dengan anak-anak setiap hari. Atau hiburan lainnya hanya melihat TV atau browsing Internet  di kamar.  karena tinggal jauh dari kota itulah hiburan nya.
Atau kadang saat libur tinggal di rumah sepupu i kota  selama masa libur.

Suatu saat waktu browsing d Internet saya nenemukan dating side kalau tidak salah namanya Cupid. Dari situlah nanti saya  berkenalan dengan seseorang berkebangsaan Jerman  yang akan mengisi ruang hati0ku yang selama 5 tahun tidak terisi.

body.title: Phillies lose second consecutive series after falling to Guardians 3-1 | Phillies out west in San Diego tonight, Jesús Luzardo gets the start
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTjS3bHNysmezkQ8R2ZwXXr6wYNfgFUVFTdMajPrkruvS/1779487737644.png)
[Src](https://loodibee.com/mlb/philadelphia-phillies/)

Well after the chaotic up and down early portion of the Phillies' season, the Phillies are now staring down the rest of the year. It's time to really figure out what this team is. Are they the same contending team they've been the past several years? Or are they officially an average or straight up descending team? This team is really hard to read at the moment. 

I still feel as though they're going to be ok, but I am not fully convinced yet and time is slowly but surely ticking. June is only a handful of days away. A hot and cold team just feels a bit unsettling at times. 

Andrew Painter was actually pretty good on the mound yesterday, he's looking better which is cool. He's starting to prove he belongs. He pitched 6 1/3 innings and allowed just two runs. This is his second time pitching at least six innings in his MLB career, and they occurred in his last two outings. Definitely some positive signs from him! The loss was certainly not on him yesterday. 

Yesterday's loss was on the offense. This 1-4 stretch by the Phillies in general has been on the offense as they've averaged 1.8 runs a game in that time. That's not gonna cut it no matter how elite a pitching staff may be. 

But as I said, they're officially in grind mode now. It feels like the team has gone through a sort of adrenaline dump. They've been through a terrible cold streak, a manager change, a hot streak, and now the games keep coming. 

Tonight the Phils are out on the west coast to face the Padres. Jesús Luzardo is on the mound and while he's not a rookie as Andrew Painter is, Luzardo has been showing some improvement as of late similar to Painter, so that's good. 

It's sorta funny that the Phillies are facing the Padres as the A's just faced them! The Padres are one of the better teams in baseball, so this will be a tough test for the suddenly cooling down Phillies. 

Nick Castellanos is set to face the Phillies for the first time since he was released by the Phillies in February. This could definitely be interesting.... I always liked Castellanos for the most part. He definitely provided some big hits and fun moments in his four years as a Phillie. 

Let's see how it goes down!

body.title: Rearranging my workstation
body.body:
<center>
It's a real project, cleaning, rearranging, moving things, throwing stuff out, thinking about how I am going to rotate my desk 180' while also moving all the other furniture around, without getting into a Tetris formation where everything deletes and disappears on me.

------------------

Mid-maneuver I am still strategizing how I am going to complete this, but I have at least moved my reading chair over, after having moved all the portfolio binders into the hallway on extra folding tables I setup for this afternoons adventure. I cleared off another desk that has been shifted in front of the closet, and I have the game-station DVD stand in the middle of the doorway to the room. I vacuumed several cubic feet of carpet but there's more to do.

As I ponder this move, before I commit to the final motions and power off my computer, I am reheating the rest of yesterdays soup on the stove, and plan to plug my air fan back in because it is getting hot in here. When does the temperature drop?? It's not just me, it's up to a sunny 26'C which is quite warm for a Canadian like me.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/darkflame/Eo6NJ51ztbMKiXxACydD4fDatiQGepwCqejtz816HXA6ZPGbrXFCibJMW12ZsmD3ajk.png)


I can't give up now, I am unable to sleep until this is done, but I have an appointment in 2 hours that I will need to leave for. So let me ponder, what must I do before then? Soup, yes, but then what? Well, I bought this plastic 3 drawer organizer for books but already full, it feels like a waste of space. If I can remove the drawers and shuffle it out of the corner, as wel as move my robot AlphaLab to the livingroom temporarily, then I can ponder my next move at least. I need to get the TV to the other side of the room.

Then I can think about unplugging my computer and moving it, so I can try and move this desk across the room. I don't WANT to take it apart, but I might need to if I want to complete this whole project before midnight. How is your workstation setup?

body.title: A coincidence on efootball😕🙁
body.body:
![IMG_3737.jpeg](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/khingaddy/539508c3ade0fb4cad415b238ab949c979fb8276.jpeg)
_______________________________________________
![IMG_3736.jpeg](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/khingaddy/c2cca3664da5a254e91a895de2374c15df01dab1.jpeg)
_______________________________________________
I played a league match earlier today and it was seriously intense right from the opening whistle. I deliberately chose Legend level because I want to keep pushing myself and improve my game. Going up against much stronger teams is honestly the best way to speed up my reactions and help me make sharper decisions when the pressure is on.
They started by sitting really deep for the first three minutes, packing their defence and making it tough to find any clear openings or get a decent shot away. Then they suddenly switched and began pressing high and aggressive all over the pitch. You can’t lose focus for even a split second or they hit you hard. But I stayed switched on, took my chances cleanly when they arrived, and managed to go 2-0 up before they could settle.
After that it turned into a proper battle. They ramped up the pressure and I had to stay calm, play simple passes, and choose the right moments to attack. It would’ve been easy to panic and lose control, but I kept my shape and discipline. They did manage to pull one back though, which made things a bit nervy for a while. Still, I stayed focused and eventually added a third goal to seal it. Finished the match 3-1 up 💪.
That’s how the game went. Non-stop intensity from minute one, and it really showed me you can’t relax or switch off at all in Legend. Felt good to get the win even after they scored, and this is exactly why I’m grinding at this level — to get used to the pace, handle those moments, and keep improving.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​_______________________________________________

body.body:
어제 저녁식사후 운동장을 40분정도 돌았다.  
운동을 하는 사람들이 점점 많아 지고 있다. 
체중을 재보니 77.7이 었다. 요즘에 저녁식사후에 운동한 효과를 보는것 같다.
27일 혈액검사를 다시하게 되는데 당뇨 판정을 받지 않았으면 좋겠다.

주가를 계속 오르고 있는데 암호화폐시장은 계속 내리고 있다.
삼성전자 주식을 7만원이었을 때 잠간 들고 있던 적이 있는데 빼서 전망이 좋을 거 같아 암호화폐을 샀다.  이제는 반대가 돼었다.  작년에 투자한 코인도 반토막이 나서 원치않는 존버를 하고 있다. 다시 원금을 회복할 수 있을까?

body.title: Baião - Santo António de Riba Douro - Ribadouro / Riding Portugal
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245wWdh1Kpz6WZa54RoCwxz3N8gj4V5PRmgUxFPGjn859aF11qmPBuDvhTTsuof5DXFHp.jpg) ##### Hello everyone and welcome to my blog :-) The stop in Ribadouro happened by chance, after a few hours of wandering through Baião and traveling along the narrow roads of that area. We were on our way to another place, already a little dazed by so many twists and turns, when we decided to stop near the river after seeing the small stone church nestled right beside the road. I don't know if I had passed there before in my life. Most likely in my childhood, but if it happened, it got lost somewhere among many other trips and confused memories that remained in the past. ##### PT A paragem em Ribadouro aconteceu por acaso, já depois de algumas horas a passear por Baião e a percorrer as estradas apertadas daquela zona. Íamos nós a caminho de outro local já um pouco atordoados com tantas curva e contra curva, quando decidimos parar junto ao rio depois de vermos a pequena igreja de pedra encaixada mesmo ao lado da estrada. Não sei se já ali tinha passado noutra altura da minha vida. Muito possivelmente na minha infância, mas se aconteceu, ficou perdido algures entre muitas outras viagens e memórias confusas que ficaram lá atrás. --- ![20260404_173324.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vhyMfrpMGxUNkARXqUWE5xxBhhv4hqvzu7L2x37fbMPcUCCfD6z9wpvdda7hwC1ct1p.jpg) ![20260404_173351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244xsXxEHEnj1u7kSPDdcvCyZ6ad9njWP5if3zfGnmRdNazkkr2xzpu1dcg1uPD2kYSMo.jpg) ![20260404_173412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zkkMQrvryfTcFrNYLHz2hHRxS5GKGBAyGFzpmnmp4KyeqKBZa75Mb22WPcpzBpY8R2s.jpg) ![20260404_173422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23uaB6LbETjR91ovSV19YNd2Kykk1LdsJtbpLtm6XanZXxyFL9NX1xHXQ26pMnDGTB3J6.jpg) ![20260404_173429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vPAeJz96mDMzoojjPSTztPVMXAKzvtkFymD64UvKBAxKDuqLdKyJMJNZrcaxpM1VvRs.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The first impact was the tranquility of the place, without much of a crowd of people and well located. A natural calm, which doesn't care about those who pass by, as in our case. The river flowed slowly, wide, with that dark and heavy tone typical of this area of ​​the Douro. On the other side are the enormous mountains, covered in trees, some areas denser, others clearly burned or cut at different times. Everything seemed very distant despite being right there in front of us. ##### PT O primeiro impacto acabou por ser a tranquilidade do lugar, sem grande afluência de pessoas e bem localizado. Uma calma natural, que não está nem aí para quem por ali passa, como no nosso caso. O rio corria devagar, largo, com aquela tonalidade escura e pesada típica desta zona do Douro. Do outro lado estão as montanhas enormes, cobertas de árvores, algumas zonas mais densas, outras claramente queimadas ou cortadas em tempos diferentes. Tudo parecia muito distante apesar de estar ali mesmo em frente. --- ![20260404_173517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245cMXafMpq4eZMdEunwn612HsXsJEHEArGcfybatwJTKStWgweWuTXnRvYRDc9bsY5No.jpg) ![20260404_173624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243BVxDFnupNCKKHL4riUTLFtGYkQii7wkVsswVSN5LCarrBEN7A3m5kvajWVWDnUQmFb.jpg) ![20260404_173650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/245T3PRgj5XZqW4w6LgWJunhzAjsYTGcEMLd23e9u5bZ33wXKaJy2HrFgAaW2pBzyJrj6.jpg) ![20260404_173730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/243q6HZkWkXbJfMwaTUcaNiqDxZPqDz4Kmd83rmntSSwZ4RB8LwcEAaPMdo2BFNWrwjR2.jpg) ![20260404_173744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zbMc9ZPd2jyPnLJb3J3MYuzaBpui2vsdbR8uuuPDNirNrWY8npQw8eYzHQjMHND8wpp.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The Church of Ribadouro is in a rather interesting position. Small, built of light granite already worn by time, without many details. I liked that. The afternoon sun was strong and the sky was clear, intensely blue, with practically no clouds. The heat was more noticeable than I expected for this time of year. There was a mixed smell of water, earth, and stone warmed by the sun. And the constant sound of the river ended up filling all the silences. ##### PT A Igreja de Ribadouro fica numa posição bastante interessante. Pequena, construída em granito claro já desgastado pelo tempo, sem muitos detalhes. Gostei disso. O sol daquela tarde era forte e o céu estava limpo, azul intenso, sem praticamente uma nuvem. O calor fazia-se sentir mais do que esperava para esta altura do ano. Havia um cheiro misturado de água, terra e pedra aquecida pelo sol. E o som constante do rio acabava por preencher os silêncios todos. --- ![20260404_173803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ynL9sivVBDGja5YP8sU74mJRXLXsJgamCKafrT6YnFkuYcr5jgVDDQiZsvdfBPARCK5.jpg) ![20260404_173829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244UoVWJ2g7V5CtTdNjD1YcENpeU5FZMZrmJjwSq4aCLWKCqPUkbtGAQDh98CTiXKGPH1.jpg) ![20260404_173851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wCDrXUZqhex3dkS9R5oHNtRYjJn5bLm4Pu3jqP243JKQQ5QE4er9jZwERr55z5cFaRo.jpg) ![20260404_173903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wWpeuj8UHtFX34J9TNepezD9Mv2sTSp1b5HuWgPxQ1DxpY6GCZ5SabKmJ7issarEnXB.jpg) ![20260404_173925.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2423mGDKHLANoo78E6U82VNw7LN4kAxQFr4sFfJT8NFUTRNPAGTS9hQfby4bwgedJmQu5.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Further up, the enormous railway viaduct completely dominated the landscape. It impresses with its size. The stone arches rise above the trees and small houses of the village with an almost absurd presence for such a small place. I spent some time looking at it. There are old structures that age well because they seem to have been built for that. This viaduct is one of those cases. ##### PT Mais acima, o enorme viaduto ferroviário dominava completamente a paisagem. Impressiona pelo tamanho. Os arcos de pedra elevam-se por cima das árvores e das casas pequenas da aldeia com uma presença quase absurda para um lugar tão pequeno. Fiquei algum tempo a olhar para aquilo. Há estruturas antigas que envelhecem bem porque parecem ter sido construídas para isso . Aquele viaduto é um desses casos. --- ![20260404_174009.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23y8mD1UWjSFcMHp6Pne4RkQeWYDubNRonjWCLUmL2pZGPCo5YjbQoZ6ggbtj9HhJrbD1.jpg) ![20260404_174024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vhsjM1mwXKE4wUszCKDutmy5TFqZM46CUVM5ZAk3JQPrnJjqHRqBqdEBHZogXnB9pGq.jpg) ![20260404_174042.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242D7hRpsRUMjEKHByqveUSyVczLEFRUAkb5ouiH4VkyjPhnqcF4rxduGC4zHt2cE9Wow.jpg) ![20260404_174123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vsHqYWQgcz84U5PSgXL26yKy8pnPojWjsG4ePUTNsxB9qcszqB3gpx5Scseivp8yoBe.jpg) ![20260404_174200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ycwFw42zCuoeg6fVyDzv1EsXsPy5YVTpNLuPGdEqYedgp1tdkrmtBnRK3g6zXX6isCv.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Next to the bridge there was also an old fountain, already quite marked by humidity and moss. The water continued to flow slowly. Few people passed by while we were there. An occasional car. Someone on the other side of the road talking on their cell phone. And, near the river, the unexpected sound of a jet ski cut through all that calm for a few seconds before disappearing into the distance again. ##### PT Junto à ponte havia também uma fonte antiga, já bastante marcada pela humidade e pelo musgo. A água continuava a correr lentamente. Passaram poucas pessoas enquanto ali estivemos. Um carro ocasional. Alguém do outro lado da estrada a falar ao telemóvel. E, já perto do rio, o barulho inesperado de uma mota de água a cortar aquela calma toda durante alguns segundos antes de desaparecer novamente ao longe. --- ![20260404_174216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23y94nVSU4HY3emQ6wS4G4r2NxNBhyVG291TmYehjUwfjba86BgrD1Z4qqnMCVMzFMLEd.jpg) ![20260404_174230.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23uFeSqE4XgghoWGzMAwEQmrWRb85knVcn1vf2hjKE8oPqXYuEMdKCxk9UhcXYgR6UK1M.jpg) ![20260404_174319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xehVGnqQm6oqwnmywt4misBaYQuNYF3N51RoyjkwriQfbtHeEF16TdFn7Fpe9diNiGp.jpg) ![20260404_174334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wgS4nGcg6E4ayydFhsoHPFJeF3wQCZw58Kqzzbhun4oqhx5WNkyFqDkNkYmUrkZTsLk.jpg) ![20260404_174355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/2432FMQWL4LyjPhGJsbkcwiNhh8GU712KAJxcPmTaayYQtvB5v8xe9qodA6kDFg5ZbuxH.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I sat on a small wall near the church looking at the river and the slopes on the other side. Nothing major happened, just the peace and quiet. When we left, I had the feeling that Ribadouro wasn't just a place to pass through. Maybe I'll come back to explore more. ##### PT Sentei-me num pequeno muro perto da igreja a olhar para o rio e para as encostas do outro lado. Não houve grandes acontecimentos, só mesmo o sossego. Quando nos fomos embora, fiquei com a sensação de que Ribadouro não era só um lugar de passagem. Pode ser que volte para explorar mais.
I hope you enjoyed. See you around. Wishing you much peace and health > Those who pass by us do not go alone. They leave a bit of themselves, taking a piece of us.\

body.title: A coincidence in efootball 😕🙁
body.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![A coincidence in efootball 😕🙁](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/969f09a7-ea5f-4ce1-947e-a57d09e5e25d.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/fYsTnz3FZiLo8W1LEmweos) 
 
 I played a league match earlier today and it was seriously intense right from the opening whistle. I deliberately chose Legend level because I want to keep pushing myself and improve my game. Going up against much stronger teams is honestly the best way to speed up my reactions and help me make sharper decisions when the pressure is on.
They started by sitting really deep for the first three minutes, packing their defence and making it tough to find any clear openings or get a decent shot away. Then they suddenly switched and began pressing high and aggressive all over the pitch. You can’t lose focus for even a split second or they hit you hard. But I stayed switched on, took my chances cleanly when they arrived, and managed to go 2-0 up before they could settle.
After that it turned into a proper battle. They ramped up the pressure and I had to stay calm, play simple passes, and choose the right moments to attack. It would’ve been easy to panic and lose control, but I kept my shape and discipline. They did manage to pull one back though, which made things a bit nervy for a while. Still, I stayed focused and eventually added a third goal to seal it. Finished the match 3-1 up 💪.
That’s how the game went. Non-stop intensity from minute one, and it really showed me you can’t relax or switch off at all in Legend. Felt good to get the win even after they scored, and this is exactly why I’m grinding at this level — to get used to the pace, handle those moments, and keep improving.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/fYsTnz3FZiLo8W1LEmweos)

body.title: Descubrí que era adicto al azúcar: 3 semanas sin ella y mi cuerpo me lo agradece. / I discovered I was addicted to sugar: 3 weeks without it and my body thanks me. ESP./EN.
body.body: >Image created by the Ecency AIImagen creada con la IA de Ecency para este post. / Image created by the Ecency AI for this post.
>Descubrí que era adicto al azúcar: 3 semanas sin ella y mi cuerpo me lo agradece
>I discovered I was addicted to sugar: 3 weeks without it and my body thanks me
>Pront: Diseñado para comer en exceso.

>Hace unas tres semanas pasé un mal momento, ya que tenía mucho estrés personal con la situación de salud del viejo y otros problemas en la casa, y cuando terminé de resolver las situaciones y pude sentarme a ver televisión con calma para distraer la mente, me dieron ganas de comerme un dulce, y realmente no tenía nada dulce en casa.

>Y me di cuenta de que el no comer algo dulce me causó una ansiedad tremenda, y eso me puso a pensar y a preguntarme a mí mismo: ¿Cómo es posible que caigas en un alto nivel de ansiedad por no comer un dulce?

>Después hablé con mi mamá y con mi novia, que vino de visita a la casa, y cuando les comenté lo que me había pasado, ambas me dijeron que era algo normal, ya que habíamos acostumbrado a nuestros cuerpos a consumir mucha azúcar y, según mi novia, el consumo de azúcar por individuo en la sociedad es escandaloso.

>Después, mi madre hizo otro comentario que puso muy alerta, ya que dijo que en la casa, las tres personas que vivimos ahí, consumíamos un kilo de azúcar a la semana como promedio, en ocasiones más, pero casi nunca menos.

>Y como siempre, decidí investigar los datos del consumo de azúcar y el daño que ella causa a nuestro organismo, y en realidad, me quedé asombrado del terrible daño que nos causa el azúcar, entre ellos inflamaciones sistémicas, daños cardiovasculares, diabetes, daño hepático e hígado graso, obesidad y aumento de peso, caries, entre muchos otros daños.

>Al leer esto, y al ver el nivel de ansiedad que me había provocado el no comer azúcar o algo dulce, también me di cuenta de que el azúcar y muchos alimentos y bebidas chatarra, que están diseñados para que los comamos en exceso, también nos causan un problema de adicción, y así me di cuenta de que el consumo de azúcar y de ciertos alimentos chatarra era un problema grave al cual había que prestarle atención.

>Así que decidí tomar acciones, y como siempre lo hice de una manera radical, y el día de hoy cumplo ya tres semanas que dejé de consumir azúcar y alimentos procesados, y aunque fue muy difícil las dos primeras semanas, ahora al comenzar a ver los resultados me siento motivado a continuar.

>Entre los efectos más importantes que he logrado ver en mí desde que dejé el azúcar están que puedo dormir y descansar mejor, me siento más energizado, he votado peso y se han reducido los dolores que sentía en las articulaciones de las piernas.

>Y ahora me siento realmente bien, ya que ahora, además de haber dejado el azúcar, también estoy en un programa de ejercicios que me hacen sentir bastante bien, más dinámico y con mayor control del estrés.
>Finalmente, puedo decir que no hay nada mejor que cuidarse uno mismo para poder tener una vejez sana y activa.

>About three weeks ago I had a bad time, since I had a lot of personal stress with the old man's health situation and other problems at home, and when I finished solving the situations and I could sit down to watch TV calmly to distract my mind, I felt like eating a sweet, and I really didn't have anything sweet at home.

>And I realized that not eating something sweet caused me tremendous anxiety, and that made me think and ask myself: How is it possible that you fall into a high level of anxiety by not eating a sweet?

>Then I talked to my mom and my girlfriend, who came to visit the house, and when I told them what had happened to me, they both told me that it was something normal, since we had accustomed our bodies to consume a lot of sugar and, according to my girlfriend, the consumption of sugar per individual in society is scandalous.

>Then, my mother made another comment that made me very alert, since she said that in the house, the three of us who live there, consumed a kilo of sugar a week on average, sometimes more, but almost never less.

>And as always, I decided to investigate the data on sugar consumption and the damage it causes to our body, and actually, I was amazed at the terrible damage that sugar causes us, including systemic inflammations, cardiovascular damage, diabetes, liver damage and fatty liver, obesity and weight gain, cavities, among many other damages.

>When reading this, and seeing the level of anxiety that not eating sugar or something sweet had caused me, I also realized that sugar and many junk foods and drinks, which are designed for us to overeat, also cause us an addiction problem, and so I realized that the consumption of sugar and certain junk foods was a serious problem that needed to be paid attention to.

>So I decided to take action, and as always I did it in a radical way, and today I have already completed three weeks that I stopped consuming sugar and processed foods, and although it was very difficult the first two weeks, now when I start to see the results I feel motivated to continue.

>Among the most important effects that I have managed to see in me since I stopped sugar are that I can sleep and rest better, I feel more energized, I have voted weight and the pains I felt in the joints of the legs have been reduced.
>And now I feel really good, because now, in addition to having given up sugar, I am also on an exercise program that makes me feel pretty good, more dynamic and with greater stress control.
>Finally, I can say that there is nothing better than taking care of yourself in order to have a healthy and active old age.

>Thank you very much for reading me.

body.title: My safe place after every storm ~Loh290
body.body:
The moment I saw the words “Welcome Home,” I felt something I had been missing for a long time and that is rest. Not the kind of rest sleep gives, but the kind your heart desperately looks for after pretending to be strong all day as life can be exhausting at times. 

 Sometimes you move through the world smiling, working, answering people, carrying responsibilities, yet deep inside, you are tired in ways words cannot explain. That is why home became my safe haven.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvrREwmBQAgwqRtjixbFXczEzt3HqvVcgBX9rurG6inF/1779747857082.jpg)
[unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-white-wall-with-a-sign-that-says-welcome-home-zweXU6bahBc)

In here, I was taught something people hardly talk about, that peace begins where you are welcomed without conditions. what lies outside is the world constantly expecting something from you. You must perform, survive, impress, compete, and keep going even when you feel empty. But home is different, home does not ask me to prove myself before allowing me to rest. The simple words “Welcome Home” feel like permission to finally breathe again.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRGNS5RXe1PcAZeTY6zFm646cCskSBaNu5pfUweZRvhX/1779747895244.jpg)
[unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-standing-around-a-living-room-IAEPJ9UqhbI)
My family isn't left out, they reflect exactly how I feel after difficult days. Sometimes I come home mentally drained from life itself, from disappointments, pressure, noise, and responsibilities. Yet seeing my family changes the atmosphere completely. 

People often think healing only happens in hospitals or therapy rooms, but they do not realize healing also happens in ordinary living rooms. It happens in random laughter, in someone asking if you have eaten, in children playing carelessly around you, and in the comfort of knowing you are not alone.

What many people fail to understand is that exhaustion is not always physical, sometimes your soul gets tired. And when the soul is tired, luxury cannot fix it. Money cannot hug you and social media cannot comfort you. The world celebrates independence so much that many people silently suffer because they have no emotional home to return to. That is why family matters. Family becomes the soft place life allows you to land when everything else feels hard.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYFiNoFVtsynFi4KfqdnfXGsh89b44aihRPfKYziGDZcH/1779747929104.jpg)
[unsplash[(https://unsplash.com/photos/white-throw-pillow-on-gray-sofa-mB__zsotOqY)
No place like home, speaks deeply to me because it is true in ways people only understand after facing difficult seasons. Home is where I can remove the invisible weight I carry outside. It is where I can sit quietly without pretending to be okay. Home gives me something rare that is emotional safety.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZfk4p5jvmLmg6ft3mGXDZEVSZ2uiKVHQqK3wBXzk8rvh/1779747964204.jpg)
[unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/brown-home-sweet-home-wall-frame-KUkPXm5weXA)
My home sweet home reminds me that happiness is not always found in big achievements, sometimes the sweetest moments are the quietest ones that is resting on the couch after a stressful day, hearing familiar voices, sharing meals, or simply existing around people who genuinely care about you.

My home is my relaxation point because it restores the parts of me the world drains daily. It is my safe haven because within those walls, I am not just surviving, i am allowed to rest, feel, heal, and simply be human again.

body.title: My first bike ride
body.body:
To start with, I’ll say that when I passed my driving test a good few years ago, I told myself I’d still cycle regularly. As it turned out, I only got back on a bike for the first time in several years recently. To be honest, I’ve rediscovered my love for it, so I thought it was a good time to revive this account.


> Na wstępie powiem, że jak zdałem prawo jazdy już kilka dobrych lat temu, to powiedziałem sobie, że dalej będę jeździł często rowerem. Skończyło się na tym, że niedawno wsiadłem pierwszy raz na rower od kilku lat. Powiem szczerze, że spodobało mi się to na nowo, więc uznałem, że to dobry moment aby ożywić to konto.


![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/42fc6284-3cc9-46de-8699-b6d16a5ba19d.jpg)


For my first ride, I chose a 12 km loop that combines tough and easy terrain. That was a mistake, as I’d left my old bike at my parents’ house and borrowed the one in the photos from my girlfriend. It was hard going because I had some sort of problem with the gears. I’ll need to have a look at that in the next few days. 

> Na pierwszą trasę wybrałem 12 km kółko, które łączy ciężki i łatwy teren. Był to błąd, gdyż mój stary rower zostawiłem u rodziców, a ten ze zdjęć pożyczyłem od dziewczyny. Ciężko mi się nim jechało, ponieważ miałem jakiś problem z przerzutkami. Muszę się temu przypatrzeć w najbliższych dniach. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2904e328-6371-4896-bde8-c2263c938f27.jpg)


The problem was that they kept jumping out of gear on their own. I even took a tumble because of it once... It ended up with a slight cut on my leg. Anyway, I’m planning to go for a few more rides. The whole trip was really good, the weather was on our side and it was well worth it. It’s a shame that Actifit doesn’t count ‘steps’ perfectly when cycling. Have a lovely day!


> Problem polegał na tym, że same mi przeskakiwały. Raz się nawet wywaliłem przez to... Skończyło się to na lekko rozciętej nodze. W każdym razie zamierzam trochę jeszcze pojeździć. Cała wyprawa była naprawdę dobra, pogoda dopisała i było warto. Szkoda że actifit nie liczy idealnie \

podczas jazdy rowerem. Życzę wam miłego dnia!

body.body:

One thing I’ve learned lately is that confidence doesn’t appear overnight. It’s built little by little, through every challenge, every photo, and every moment when you choose to believe in yourself.

Tonight was simple: a good coffee, a nice outfit, and a few minutes to enjoy the present. Sometimes those small moments are exactly what we need to recharge and keep moving toward our goals.

I still have big dreams. I want to keep growing, creating content, and turning my passion into something sustainable. There’s still a long road ahead, but I’m excited for every step of the journey.

For now, I’m choosing gratitude, consistency, and a smile 😊💛

body.title: Esp/Eng [ transformando una caja de lavadora en un hermoso paral ||| transforming a washing machine box into a beautiful shelf]
