body.title: A day at the hospital and a new most embarrassing way to potentially die.  My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
body.body:
Let me start by saying... I didn't die today.  Just clarifying in case the fact I'm posting didn't make that clear.  However I felt like something was seriously wrong with me in the morning.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9c89c4e0-1f59-42b4-87dd-8d4ea513ac9c.jpg)

Any day that starts with walking your wife up at 6am to go to the hospital isn't ideal.  Yet that is just what happened today. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/797de662-c23c-4b26-ac32-2ed961c848c8.jpg)

That's me feeling like death warmed over and got a few hours I got to see this. 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a5da17bc-d416-4ea5-a459-468fd5e6392f.jpg)

Not the ideal day on vacation at all.  I cancelled my booking in Edinburgh for tomorrow, wondered if I was going to be able to fly home and had to contact the travel insurance people. 

Crappy start to the day. 

Honestly though it could have been much much worse.  I only waited in the ER for 15 minutes before being given a bed. Well first having my BP taken when I was ready to curl up in a fetal position on the hospital floor from pain but they did give me two pain killers first. 

I saw a doctor within 45 minutes which was good. Then saw a urologist within 5 hours. 

It seems my problem fell into the well documented, severe, treat immediately variety and often emergency surgery. 

**Did I mention this morning sucked**

Now I'll let you know that while surgery is often required, on some occasions or spontaneously goes away. That was me a few hours of excruciating pain and then... Oh, I'm better now.   Sheesh.

What did I have? In layman's terms I had a heart attack... Of the balls.  The pain? Having a testicle or into a vice for a few hours.  Real name \
which is basically the blood supply being cut off so the poor ball starts dying.  Treat within 6 hours or get amputated.\n\nHonestly it now takes over the #1 spot on my \
. Seriously a fatal version of kicked in the nuts... Who would believe that? \n\nAnyways. The pain went from \

and shortly after I was sent to walk back to the hotel. Nice walk actually. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4857893f-c98b-498f-a398-7290beb16dc4.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f2ecea90-bf7b-4f1e-8db5-8a01ca4216bb.jpg)![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1d734634-e2ef-4d63-a85e-280f505cf812.jpg) But I took things really easy for the rest of the day. Yes I made 6K steps which was seriously in doubt first thing in the morning but I guess the moral is **All is well that ends well that ends well** Or possibly **Life can change in just a moment** So protect your health, get your steps and enjoy every moment... .... Although moments in pain lying in a hospital waiting room area on a public bench.. those are genuinely hard to enjoy..

body.body:
​
https://images.hive.blog/DQmX5iMfNxUo3z129s1B4PBkHUxDcvzyDnAQ99N5uK1tV5e/thumb%20mgc.jpg

What happened in crypto in the past week? This week Bitcoin went down mostly, quite a bit, and weak hands sold, while long term holders bought. Ethereum looks shady lately. AI has potential. I found a way to expose myself to BTC via BlackRock, using [Freetrade](https://magic.freetrade.io/join/george/a08af1d8 \

). Feel free to check them. What else? Read below:


- Bitcoin: The same story, short term BTC holders are selling at loss, a similar pattern to mid-November 2025, after a 15% price drop. Long term Bitcoin holders are accumulating at a record pace, controlling 71.6% of the circulating supply right now. Bitcoin is stuck as US Bond yields hit a multi-decade high. Crypto Quant said that Bitcoin is following the same patter as in the 2022 bear market, preceeding a bigger decline. Mark Cuban sold most of its Bitcoin after it failed to act as a hedge during dollar weakness. 
​

- Ethereum: Harvard dropped ETH while sovereign funds bought more BTC ETF stakes. BTC now holds 60% of the crypto's value, with ETH near 10% and all other altcoins sitting at 30%. As ETH dropped to 2090 on May 18, a 12% pullback from its recent high, just had its worst week of ETF outflows this year. Vitalik published a personal post on May 24 addressing months of leadership exits at the Ethereum Foundation, saying that his own influence within the organisation will shrink intentionally, but the Foundation will plan to sell less ETH going forward. 
​

- Altcoins and stablecoins: Van Eck and Grayscale both filed updated BNB ETF registration statements with the SEC on May 16. The Clarity Act handed 16 tokens a path to commodity status (XRP, SOL, LINK, ADA, HBAR, even ICP may benefit from it). Revolut launched a physical Dogecoin-themed Debit Card. Hyperliquid is now letting you trade pre-ipo stocks on-chain. Funny enough, while the rest of the crypto falls, ZCash gained 18%. Two US spot HYPE ETFs pulled over $22M in their first week, outpacing ETH ETFs. Bitwise confirmed it will stake its HYPE holdings and use a portion of management fees to buy more of it. HYPE hit an all time high of $61.35 on May 21. Fireblocks built a payment system for AI agents. Near Protocol introduced Synamic Resharding, a protocol upgrade to enable shard addition automatically on demand, to support NEAR intents and AI agents. 
​

- NFTs and blockchain games:  I have also enjoyed playing [Golem Overlord ](https://golemoverlord.com/?ref=mightyrocklee \
)lately on Hive, and it is quite enjoyable, I would say, with no significant updates lately. On [Splinterlands,](https://splinterlands.com/?ref=mightyrocklee \

) we have had the Land NFT new update and improved tokenomics, and the new cards from the Escalation mini collection are up and running.

​
- Good news: Saudi Arabia is tokenizing $12.5B in real world assets, starting with real estate and expanding into energy and manufacturing. At least eight major Japanese financial institutions are developing crypto investment trust products for retail investors. Standard Chartered bought its own crypto custody unit, the Zodia Custody company, after obtaining a Luxemburg MiCA custody license. Tether bought out SoftBank's stake in Twenty One Capital (Bitcoin treasury firm) on May 20. OpenAI is planning to go public in September with and IPO underwrited by Golman Sachs and Morgan Stanley. Binance lets you trade SpaceX before its IPO. 
​

- Bad news: Crypto funds bled over a billion in one week, ending a six week positive streak. The pullback is market by rising Treasury yields, persistent inflation concerns, and uncertainty around the Middle East conflict. AI sector alone bleeds $2.8B as Anthropic shadow market spirals. Polymarket lets you bet on private companies speculating over valuation thresholdd and IPO timing without receiving any equity. Blockchain.com also files for an IPO in the US.  The FTX law firm agreed to a settlement, the largest in the second wave of FTX class actions, of $54M to settle fraud claims. A single provision in the Clarity Act would bar platforms from paying yield for holding a digital asset, ending the passive hold-to-earn model. France accounts for roughly 70% of all globall crypto wrentch attacks, with 41 kidnappings in 2026 alone, the 2020 Ledger database leak is cited as a key turning point, with exposed home addresses of hundred of thousands of users. 
​

- Joke of the week: At the beginning of the last week strategy signalled its next BTC purchase. They are also pushing to vota a change to STRC divident timing before June 8. After they acquired nearly 25K BTC in one week, reaching 843K BTC, TD Cowen raised its Strategy price target to $400. Then, on May 24, Strategy started to buy bonds, not Bitcoin, to rebuild liquidity and manage liabilitie, following its plan to repurchase part of its own converible debt.

George

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

We shouldn't feel like we are invisible. The farmer in Matthew who had more than sufficient in his barn and thought to himself that that was all to life. Because of what he had acquired did not to know that God was aware of what was through his mind. ‎ ‎Even the people at the tower of babel having  one mind did not know that God knew completely what was going in their minds. In this life, our human wisdom is never truly enough. We need a greater wisdom, and that can only be received from God.

body.title: Cats  Are My Favourite Pets
body.body:
![IMG_20260515_091939_699.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23zGa8P48Xpw8NA8EaUzA7A7LBNNnfgjpoFK2ebBCvFu76njH4D2Cnuqti4QHLe2iUEUT.jpg)


In this part of my country, most people prefer having a dog as their pet rather than cats.

While everyone’s preferences differs, I stick to mine which is that I love cats so much. These cats belong to my Dad, he loves them so much.

One thing that makes me scold my dad's cat is the attitude of them jumping on my fish or meat in the house. 

Each time I am holding a fish, especially when I am trying to wash a smoked fish and put it inside my soup, this cats will appear in the kitchen out of nowhere and begin to act as if they want to snatch the fish from me.

Most times, I cut the heads of the fish and give it to them and they tend to enjoy it so much.

My younger brother is fund of feeding them with milk. They love drinking so much milk.

They also love eating squirrels in the bush. One day, the bigger one, which we call “tiger” ran off into the bush and even when we finished cooking rice and put the rice for it in its plate, we called it but it refused to come home.

It was later on, when I went to fetch some water at the borehole close to our house and adjacent to a nearby bush, I saw the cat “tiger” laid on the ground like a pregnant woman, beside it was the fresh tail of a squirrel it had devoured.

I wasn't surprised because that was not the first time. I later understood why it refused to eat the rice we kept for it in its plate and the reason it refused to answer its name when we called it.

After relaxing for sometimes in the bush, it finally came home. I came out of the house to see it laying beside it's sister on our bamboo chair. That was how I took the picture above.

I will love to share more about my dad's cats and the things they love to do, during my subsequent posts.


![20260522_200556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23uQrdsjhRwt8Eq4afqJnL3JLPfbuR8q7WpNuG3LU8oMYwkUCToAh7dA4DwoAWdkjA9pC.jpg)

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.body:

Hey Hive community! 

Day 11 of my Rising Star journey and the grind is very real today! Another solid day of missions, XP gains, and STARBITS earnings. Let me walk you through everything that happened! 

          STARBITS Growing Steadily

Today I earned +447 STARBITS bringing my total to 2,562! The highlight from the diary was a single gig that paid 225 STARBITS in one run  that kind of reward shows just how much the account has grown compared to the early days of earning 1-2 STARBITS per mission! The difference is remarkable and motivating! 

The cost to combat ego today dropped to just 199 STARBITS  a massive improvement from the 1,597 STARBITS it was just two days ago. This tells me the Music Lessons are finally starting to have a real and consistent impact on keeping Ego under control! Every lesson counts! 

            Solid XP Progress

With +444 XP gained today, I moved from 856 to 1300/2100 on the Level 42 bar. That means I still need 800 more XP to hit Level 43. At my current pace of grinding I should reach it within the next 2 days! The XP from the Saturday Support mission gave a nice boost  the diary confirmed a reward that really pushed the bar forward! 

        Mission Variety Keeping Things Fresh

Today I ran a good mix of missions including Illegal Busking and the newly unlocked Saturday Support mission. The variety keeps earnings flowing throughout the day while managing energy efficiently. Running higher reward missions when energy is full and switching to shorter ones when it gets low is a strategy that's working well for me! 

          Pizza Box Saves The Day!

The diary reported finding a discarded pizza stored in one of my Pizza Boxes this automatically refilled my energy and let me keep running missions without waiting! Small things like this can make a big difference in daily earnings, especially late in the evening when energy would otherwise be too low to continue! 

               Goals Progress

Reach Level 43  800 XP away
Bring Ego below 25%  making progress with lessons

body.title: Dziennik #90/2026 - złość
body.body: > Dobry wieczór. Nieźle spałam. I długo przede wszystkim. I muszę przyznać, że wstałam w dobrym nastroju. Trochę nogi miałam zmęczone po ostatnich dwóch dniach wędrówek, ale czułam się jakoś tak fajnie. Przyszła jasność umysłu, jakiś taki spokój w duszy. Bardzo, ale to bardzo mnie to ucieszyło. Tak naprawdę jedyne co mi zaprzątało głowę to fakt, że rozpoczął się upał, a ja nienawidzę wysokich temperatur, bo bardzo źle je znoszę. Raz, że źle znoszę, a dwa po prostu nie lubię i tyle. Ogarnęłam się i pojechałam do babci z misją. Moja babcia jest fanką żużla i to wielką i nie mogła oglądać Grand Prix, ponieważ transmisja odbywa się na kanale, którego oni nie mają i nijak nie mogli samodzielnie nabyć. Dlatego pojechałam, utworzyłam im konto na Maxie, podpięłam swoja kartę i babcia już będzie mogła oglądać wszystkie możliwe transmisje sportowe. Bardzo dobrze spędziłam z nimi czas. Zjedliśmy dobry obiadek, opychaliśmy się lodami. Babcia jakieś milion razy powiedziała, że bardzo mnie kocha i na mnie zawsze można liczyć, a ja jakieś milion jeden razy jej powiedziałam, że po to mnie mają, żebym im pomagała i ja też ich bardzo kocham. Wizyta niesamowicie naładowała mi baterie i wyszłam od nich cała w skowronkach. Pojechałam zrobić badania poziomu litu we krwi i fajnie, bo nie było kolejki, byłam jedyną pacjentką. Nigdy pobieranie krwi nie robiło na mnie wrażenia, ale od jakiegoś czasu jest to dla mnie bardzo bolesne. Nie wiem czy to we mnie się coś zmieniło czy jakoś pechowo trafiam na personel medyczny, ale normalnie aż mi skóra cierpnie przy wbiciu igły. Mały spoiler: wyniki są tragiczne. Są mniej więcej na poziomie takim jakbym w ogóle litu nie brała i to może tłumaczyć moje rozchwianie emocjonalne, bo lit jest stabilizatorem nastroju. I nie wiem z czego wynika ta sytuacja. Czy to zmęczenie ostatnimi dniami? Odwodnienie, do którego się dzisiaj doprowadziłam? Zła dieta? Brak ruchu? Nie mam zielonego pojęcia, ale bardzo mnie to zaniepokoiło. Na szczęście w piątek mam wizytę u psychiatry to przegadamy temat. Popołudniu po powrocie do domu trochę musiałam podreperować moje zdrowie. A najbardziej nawodnienie, bo już czułam się kompletnie odwodniona. Ledwo żyłam. Cały dzień był straszny upał, pół tego dnia spędziłam w nagrzanym aucie [nie mam klimy], a do godziny 17 wypiłam raptem kawę. Rozpuściłam witaminy w wodzie i powoli, małymi łyczkami przepuściłam wodny atak na moje ciało. Z godziny na godzinę było trochę lepiej, ale męczą mnie dzisiaj dość silne bóle w klatce piersiowej. Jednak jak to ja: nie panikuję. Poboli i przestanie. Wieczór strasznie mnie wkurwił. Nie chcę pisać dlaczego, bo sytuacja nie dotyczy bezpośrednio mnie, ale moja przyjaciółka cierpi przez kogoś, więc automatycznie mam mordercze myśli i takie wkurwienie, że już wiem, że noc będzie pozbawiona snu. Kocham ją, więc jak dzieje się jej krzywda to wychodzę z siebie. I tak mi minął dzień. Jutro idę do pracy, ale tylko na dwa dni, bo czwartek i piątek mam znowu wolny. I moim celem jest, aby nic nie odwalić. Mam na to już pewien pomysł, jakieś tam plany już potworzyłam także jestem dobrej myśli. Do jutra.

body.title: When they cut off the power 🔦 Cuando quitan la electricidad - Monomad Challenge
body.body:
The electricity supply problem in Venezuela has been severe over the past three months, at least in much of the country. >*El problema del servicio eléctrico en Venezuela ha estado fuerte los últimos tres meses, al menos para una gran parte del país.*
![IMG_20260525_152701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EnymdWZbq5GEcJXSUDGRrJuXgHviN9ciZd8ASebFhwbVkx35LFhr44mRF9Zo7fZYpfN.jpg)
A night without power in almost all of downtown / Una noche sin luz en casi todo el centro de la ciudad
Power outages are unscheduled, they can happen at any time, and in recent months they have lasted an average of 5 hours a day. When the power goes out during the day, it’s perhaps more bearable because you can keep yourself busy with other things, but at night it’s harder to cope with. >*Los cortes de electricidad no están programados, pueden ocurrir a cualquier hora, y su duración promedio estos meses ha sido de 5 horas diarias. Cuando quitan el servicio de día es quizás más llevadero porque te puedes dedicar a hacer otras cosas, pero en la noche se siente más.*
![IMG_20260525_152938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eoc6cmDHSzCdWywKhCorNUqkQQCFVKJHVD8AYbwkxXLfcUWtHoKLS3aqR9R9YNooKXb.jpg)
One of those nights when the power was out, just to pass the time, I decided to grab a flashlight, shine it on some objects around the house, and use the resulting shadows and light to take a series of photographs. >*Una de esas noches sin luz, para entretenerme, se me ocurrió agarrar la linterna, enfocar algunos objetos de la casa y con esas sombras y luces resultantes tomar una serie de fotografías.*
![IMG_20260525_152856.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EokagsNWUgnP2GTqDAGNLpS9J3jADkupksKUtWETuT33NHQpqDzPv7nxwrXibwwWDJ4.jpg)
A painting in the living room / Un cuadro de la sala
![IMG_20260525_152827.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eo1vtvCwRNgP7KijvmDRYJnGTRdHKr4uz2xv8oEBriZBZDWi1rqopUM2NZUycPn9NpF.jpg)
The woven tablecloth, lit from below and reflected on the living room ceiling / El mantel tejido de la mesa, iluminado desde abajo y reflejado en el techo de la sala
![IMG_20260525_152916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23u5TKXFnA5tWJryeGkqc9bVhKyNmiBKVWommDSRisUxfC6WUbqD6bnW3mTHbeZL48yao.jpg)
The speaker and its cables / La corneta y sus cables
In the different spaces, I played around with some everyday items: cables, kitchenware, and decorations. >*En los diferentes espacios, jugué con algunas cosas cotidianas: cables, enseres de cocina y decoraciones.*
![IMG_20260525_152727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/Eo8L2G6uM4VLivrVhiCWPDuSEQWZdrThCdroZehuBdfuAQsa15pKAN2k684nop9jDqz.jpg)
![IMG_20260525_152809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/23tbKK5cYST4J99Nbr4a9nSk1THj8nMmn8YxRbfkfi71soQvFwWt5B5d2tAiEsBL3soRm.jpg)
![IMG_20260525_152951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sofathana/EpEJhjsXfCK1N2aigTPY36dwarQ8nTz8fU2XmaqyRtpDoQ2fDoUHCLniWbXU7h56Hc3.jpg)
They’ve said there will be a solution soon, that this time they’re really going to fix the electrical system completely. Let’s hope so... In the meantime, when the power goes out, sometimes ideas lights up 😉. >*Han dicho que pronto habrá una solución, que ahora sí van a reparar por completo el sistema eléctrico. Ojalá... Mientras tanto, cuando la luz se va, a veces las ideas se encienden 😉.*

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

Thank you brother. 🙏

And honestly, I don’t think TON meme projects necessarily need to fully “migrate” to Hive either.

The point is not abandoning TON.
The point is not abandoning X.
The point is not abandoning Telegram.

The point is building durable decentralized foundations beneath our communities so they cannot simply disappear because centralized systems decide they dislike certain ideas, cultures, or economic movements.

Hive is important because:
it gives communities permanence.

That matters enormously for meme projects.

Especially now.

Baby Lady itself is proof that communities can grow organically without relying entirely on artificial hype cycles.

The original team abandoned Baby Lady less than a week after launch almost two years ago.

The project crashed to around a $200 market cap.

At that point, most people assumed it was over.

Instead:
• 41.2% of supply was permanently locked by @greywarden100
• the community later locked additional supply
• over 50% of total supply is now locked
• Baby Lady became a Memes of the Roundtable rugproof TON project
• the project was verified across TON infrastructure
• Baby Lady was updated across DexScreener and GeckoTerminal
• TON Assets and Tonkeeper verification were secured
• Baby Lady was later whitelisted on DeDust
• content continued being created consistently for nearly two years

No fake volume.
No artificial hype cycles.
No influencer spam.
No exit liquidity games.

Just slow community persistence.

And despite having only around 107 holders, Baby Lady maintains an organic market cap around 8K — outperforming many projects with dramatically larger holder counts but weaker communities.

That matters.

Because communities built slowly tend to survive longer.

Hive fits naturally into that philosophy because Hive rewards:
• consistency
• culture
• participation
• and long-term presence

not just temporary hype.

That’s why Hive and MemeHive matter to me personally.

Not as replacements for TON.

But as decentralized social infrastructure where communities can continue existing long term regardless of what happens on centralized platforms.

Also, if you have time, I’d genuinely appreciate it if you watched and shared the Baby Lady YouTube video connected to this discussion here: https://youtu.be/OEeMFpGU5DM?si=mWGmrGma5GlrOAfS

Support the X threaded version as well here: https://x.com/i/status/2058719395333988761

I can already tell YouTube is not pushing this one the same way it pushes other content.

Videos discussing decentralization, ownership, censorship resistance, and independent infrastructure often seem to receive far less organic distribution than entertainment-focused uploads.

That is exactly why conversations like this matter.

The more people share this information directly, the harder it becomes for important ideas to simply disappear behind algorithms.

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

# The Sanctuary of the Builder: A Manifesto for Free Creation



---

## **Prologue: The Right to Rise**

There is a sacred covenant between the creator and the soil upon which they build. It is the promise that if you plant a seed with honest hands, the earth will not conspire to crush it before it breaks the surface. It is the assurance that the gardener exists to nurture the growth, not to trample the sprout because it does not yet resemble the tree.

On the blockchain, this covenant has been broken.

We have witnessed a tragedy where the very tools meant to protect the integrity of the network—the downvote, the curation trail—have been weaponized by leviathans of power. These \

entrusted with the stewardship of the ecosystem, have become its jailers. They do not prune the weeds; they scorch the earth. They do not guide the new voice; they silence it with the crushing weight of their accumulated capital.

**It is time to leave the shadow.**

It is time to build where you are free.

---

## **I. The Betrayal of the Guardian**

The downvote was conceived as a shield—a delicate instrument to deflect spam, to repel malice, to preserve the sanctity of the commons. It was never intended to be a hammer.

Yet, look at what has come to pass. The whales, those who hold the greatest sway, have turned the shield into a weapon of mass suppression. They do not downvote to protect; they downvote to dominate. They do not drive away the bad actors; they drive away the *people*. They create an atmosphere of fear where the creator hesitates to speak, fearing that a single misstep, a single unpopular truth, will summon the wrath of the oligarchy.

When the guardian becomes the predator, the flock must flee.

To build in such a place is to build on a fault line. It is to invest your soul in a garden where the owner holds the shears not to shape the hedge, but to decapitate the flowers that grow too tall or bloom in the wrong color.

**This is not protection. This is tyranny disguised as curation.**

---

## **II. The Call to New Grounds**

Where, then, shall the builder go?

You must seek the lands where the soil is rich with freedom, not poisoned by fear. You must migrate to the platforms where the mechanism of suppression has been removed, where the only metric of success is the genuine appreciation of your peers.

**Go to Blurt.**
Here, the downvote button does not exist. There is no tool to crush your voice. There is only the upvote, the comment, the share. Here, value is created by addition, not subtraction. The whale cannot sink your ship, for there are no torpedoes in these waters. You are free to build, free to fail, and free to succeed on the merit of your work alone.

**Return to Steemit.**
In this older ground, the downvote remains, but it has not been twisted into a tool of systematic oppression. The culture there remembers the original intent: correction, not destruction. It is a place where the community self-regulates through dialogue, not through the brute force of coordinated downvoting cascades.

**Build where the wind lifts you, not where the gale seeks to tear you down.**

---

## **III. The Architecture of Freedom**

Imagine a platform designed not for the convenience of the powerful, but for the dignity of the creator.

*   **No Shadow Bans:** Your content reaches the eyes it was meant for.
*   **No Whale Veto:** No single entity, no matter how wealthy, can unilaterally erase your contribution.
*   **True Meritocracy:** Rewards flow from engagement and love, not from the whims of a cartel.

This is not a dream. It is a choice.

Every time you choose to build on a platform that respects your agency, you cast a vote for the future of the internet. Every time you refuse to tolerate the abuse of power, you strengthen the foundation of a free society.

Do not let the whales convince you that their oppression is necessary. Do not let them tell you that their downvotes are for your own good. The gardener who kills the seedling does not love the garden; he loves only his own control over it.

---

## **Epilogue: The Unchained Creator**

The blockchain was born from a desire for freedom. It was forged in the fire of resistance against centralized control. Let us not forget that origin.

If the current chains of Hive have become heavy with the weight of abusive downvotes, then break them. Forge new links. Build new shores.

**Build where you are free.**
**Build where you will not be downvoted into silence.**
**Build where the whales are reminded that they are part of the ocean, not the masters of the tide.**

The future belongs to those who dare to create without fear. Go forth, and build your cathedral in the sunlight.

*— Bilpcoin: We expose the truth, so you can build upon it.*

 #FreeSpeech #BlurtBlog #Steemit #NoDownvote #CreatorRights #HiveExodus #Decentralization #BuildFree #AntiCensorship #Bilpcoin

body.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands – Rating Control: Staying on Track – Season 160
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeJyRe53j8NhFYQnXGXeh1o7kiQRrxBRF6XZYy6E2FTcr/Portada%20-%20Splinterlands%20%E2%80%93%20Rating%20Control%20-%20Staying%20on%20Track.png </center>

<center>A new season is reaching its critical stage in **mayo de 2026** and, as is customary in my gaming log, it is time to sit down and analyze the numbers, the meta's performance, and the execution of the competitive roadmap we mapped out for the medium term.</center>

><center>Una nueva temporada está llegando a su etapa crítica en **mayo de 2026** y, como es costumbre en mi bitácora de juego, es momento de sentarse a analizar los números, el rendimiento del meta y la ejecución de la hoja de ruta competitiva que nos trazamos a mediano plazo.</center>

<center>Those who read my previous publication, [**Splinterlands – Rating Control: Avoiding Champion**](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-splinterlands-rating-control-avoiding-champion-6qi), already know the theory behind my cyclical strategy: alternating a season of absolute containment in the **Diamond** league (avoiding at all costs crossing the **3,700**-point barrier that would push me into **Champion**) to secure the juicy rewards of the Diamond leaderboard, followed by another season where I deploy my entire arsenal to climb as high as possible. Today, I want to share with you how the practical execution of this plan is going in the current season, the last-minute mathematical challenges, and how an unusually static meta has played in my favor.</center>

><center>Quienes leyeron mi publicación anterior, [**Splinterlands – Rating Control: Avoiding Champion**](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-splinterlands-rating-control-avoiding-champion-6qi), ya conocen la teoría detrás de mi estrategia cíclica: intercalar una temporada de contención absoluta en la liga **Diamond** (evitando a toda costa cruzar la barrera de los **3,700** puntos que me empujaría a **Champion**) para asegurar las jugosas recompensas del leaderboard de Diamante, seguida de otra temporada donde despliego todo mi arsenal para subir lo más alto posible. Hoy quiero compartirles cómo está marchando la ejecución práctica de este plan en la temporada actual, los retos matemáticos de última hora y cómo un meta inusualmente estático ha jugado a mi favor.</center>

### <center>The Fruit of Consistency | El Fruto de la Constancia</center>

<center>Executing rating control with surgical precision is not a mere whim; it is an economic necessity within the current **Splinterlands** ecosystem. Thanks to the fact that last season I managed to stay within the optimal **Diamond** threshold, I was able to secure an extra bonus of **150,000** Glints coming from the ranking.</center>

><center>Ejecutar el control de rating con precisión quirúrgica no es un mero capricho; es una necesidad económica dentro del ecosistema actual de **Splinterlands**. Gracias a que la temporada pasada logré quedarme en el umbral óptimo de **Diamond**, pude asegurar un bono de **150,000** Glints extra procedentes del ranking.</center>

<center>This huge cushion of Glints was the fuel that allowed me to completely empty the first batch of the coveted **Ultimate Chests** in the rewards shop. Fortune smiled greatly upon me during that opening by granting me two copies of **Azhar Ibn Sulaim**. In the current market economy, selling these valuable units will provide me with the necessary **DEC** to cover a crucial objective: financing the automatic rental system for all the key cards I will require for the upcoming season. The goal is already set: we will use that rented arsenal to attempt to storm the Top **25** of **Diamond** once again and claim another **150,000** Glints for the account.</center>

><center>Este enorme colchón de Glints fue el combustible que me permitió vaciar por completo el primer batch de los codiciados **Ultimate Chests** en la tienda de recompensas. La fortuna me sonrió enormemente en esa apertura al otorgarme dos copias de **Azhar Ibn Sulaim**. En la economía de mercado actual, la venta de estas valiosas unidades me proporcionará los **DEC** necesarios para cubrir un objetivo crucial: financiar el sistema de rentas automáticas de todas las tarjetas clave que requeriré de cara a la próxima temporada. La meta ya está fijada: utilizaremos ese arsenal rentado para intentar asaltar nuevamente el Top **25** de **Diamond** y reclamar otros **150,000** Glints para la cuenta.</center>

### <center>A Static Meta and Premature Progress | Un Meta Estático y un Avance Prematuro</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWUaSJjPaCniPJQgXLB1YFzFPU9rypnGrum5DNmAjQdXg/Victoria%20V2.png</center>

<center>With **6** days left before the season closes, the situation on the leaderboard is quite unusual. I have managed to reach a highly solid score very early on. Looking back, this fluid progress is largely due to the fact that the meta-game has not experienced drastic shakes in recent weeks.</center>

><center>A falta de **6** días para el cierre de la temporada, la situación en la tabla clasificatoria es bastante inusual. He logrado alcanzar un puntaje sumamente sólido de forma muy temprana. Mirando en retrospectiva, este avance fluido se debe en gran medida a que el meta-juego no ha experimentado sacudidas drásticas en las últimas semanas.</center>

<center>The only recent addition to the combat regulations was the **Fallen Legends** ruleset (the one that restricts Legendary Archons). As I mentioned in my previous analyses, this rule not only has a subtle impact on general **Wild** lineups, but its appearance ratio in my daily matchups has been residual, bordering on invisibility. Since there are no heavy new variables reconfiguring traditional strategies, navigating ranked battles has been a predictable and smooth process, allowing me to secure the necessary points with great comfort.</center>

><center>La única adición reciente al reglamento de combate fue la ruleset **Fallen Legends** (aquella que restringe a los Legendary Archons). Como les comenté en mis análisis previos, esta regla no solo tiene un impacto sutil en las alineaciones generales de **Wild**, sino que su ratio de aparición en mis emparejamientos diarios ha sido residual, rozando la invisibilidad. Al no haber nuevas variables de peso que reconfiguren las estrategias tradicionales, navegar por las batallas clasificatorias ha sido un proceso predecible y libre de sobresaltos, permitiéndome asegurar los puntos necesarios con mucha comodidad.</center>

### <center>The Balancing Act: Avoiding the Win Streak | El Acto de Equilibrio: Evitar la Racha de Victorias</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSwrLqQVMv3EjrUZN2qH9r3P8L8kkHeniV4ubjKLUBft4/Historial%20V2.png</center>

<center>However, being this comfortable with **6** days remaining places me in the most delicate and stressful moment of the entire season. I am in a position where a single calculation error can ruin the strategy. To be completely sure of not accidentally ascending to **Champion**, I must maintain my rating at a prudent distance of at least **60** points below the **3,700** mark.</center>

><center>Sin embargo, estar tan cómodo a falta de **6** días me sitúa en el momento más delicado y estresante de toda la temporada. Me encuentro en una posición donde un solo error de cálculo puede arruinar la estrategia. Para estar completamente seguro de no ascender a **Champion** por accidente, debo mantener mi rating a una distancia prudencial de al menos **60** puntos por debajo de la marca de los **3,700**.</center>

<center>In these leagues, entering a positive streak can easily grant you up to **40** points per victory. Therefore, playing regularly becomes a real hazard. To mitigate this risk while still aiming to complete the **15** daily wins required to claim the **3 Daily Reward** chests which grant **16 Entries** each to boost my chances of winning special **Foil** cards from the **Weekly Fortune Draw** I have had to adapt.</center>

><center>En estas ligas, entrar en una racha positiva puede otorgarte fácilmente hasta **40** puntos por victoria. Por ende, jugar de forma regular se convierte en un auténtico peligro. Para mitigar este riesgo mientras busco completar las **15** victorias diarias requeridas para reclamar los **3 Daily Reward** chests los cuales otorgan **16 Entries** cada uno para maximizar las posibilidades de ganar tarjetas de **Foil** especial del **Weekly Fortune Draw** he tenido que adaptarme.</center>

<center>Currently, under my playstyle, I have configured a rental of **500,000** SPS (a conscious reduction compared to the million SPS I used to rent in past cycles, affected by automatic rents). This slashes my **SPS** and Glints yields a bit, a penalty that deepens because I have had to resort to very specific rating control tricks: forcing an intentional loss on the third battle right after stringing together two consecutive wins. By mechanically breaking the streak, I prevent the win streak multiplier from activating. On the bright side, these are the only days of the season where suffering a consecutive losing streak is not a cause for frustration, but a strategic breather.</center>

><center>Actualmente, bajo mi esquema de juego, tengo configurada una renta de **500,000** SPS (una reducción consciente frente al millón de SPS que solía rentar en ciclos pasados afectada por las rentas automáticas). Lo que reduce un poco mi obtención de **SPS** y Glints, una penalización que se acentúa por haber tenido que recurrir a trucos de control de rating bastante específicos: forzar una derrota intencional en la tercera batalla justo después de hilar dos victorias consecutivas. Al romper mecánicamente la racha, impido que el multiplicador de la racha de victorias se active. Mirando el lado positivo, estos son los únicos días de la temporada donde sufrir una racha de derrotas consecutivas no es motivo de frustración, sino un respiro estratégico.</center>

### <center>Focus on the Survival Format | Foco en el Formato Survival</center>

<center>The great collateral advantage of having the rating under strict control in the traditional format is the liberation of time and mental focus. By not having the pressure to climb positions in **Diamond** during this week, I can redirect all my energy and competitive time toward the **Survival** format.</center>

><center>La gran ventaja colateral de tener el rating bajo estricto control en el formato tradicional es la liberación de tiempo y enfoque mental. Al no tener la presión de escalar posiciones en **Diamond** durante esta semana, puedo redirigir toda mi energía y tiempo competitivo hacia el formato **Survival**.</center>

<center>My great pending task in recent seasons has been consistency in this demanding game mode. With **6** days of total tranquility in ranked mode, this season I have set the ultimate goal of completing the **100** regulatory battles in **Survival**. It is the perfect scenario to test the endurance of my cards without risking the delicate point balance that has cost me so much effort to maintain on the general scale of Praetoria.</center>

><center>Mi gran cuenta pendiente en las últimas temporadas ha sido la consistencia en este demandante modo de juego. Con **6** días de total tranquilidad en el modo clasificado, esta temporada me he propuesto la meta definitiva de completar las **100** batallas reglamentarias en **Survival**. Es el escenario perfecto para poner a prueba la resistencia de mis cartas sin arriesgar el delicado balance de puntos que tanto esfuerzo me ha costado mantener en la escala general de Praetoria.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>Rating Control is an art that requires patience, mathematics, and, above all, the ability to cast ego aside to lose battles on purpose for a greater long-term benefit. This season of containment serves to gather greater rewards, allowing me to complete my card collection faster and deploy them with higher effectiveness.</center>

><center>El Rating Control es un arte que requiere paciencia, matemáticas y, por encima de todo, la capacidad de dejar el ego de lado para perder batallas a propósito en pos de un beneficio mayor a largo plazo. Esta temporada de contención sirve para obtener mayores beneficios al poder completar mi colección de tarjetas más rápido y poder usarlas con mayor efectividad.</center>

<center>What about you, players? Do you apply rating control in your respective leagues or do you prefer to climb as far as your teams can take you without looking back? How are your goals in the **Survival** format marching this season?</center>

><center>¿Y ustedes, jugadores? ¿Aplican el control de rating en sus respectivas ligas o prefieren subir hasta donde los llevan sus equipos sin mirar atrás? ¿Cómo marchan sus metas en el formato **Survival** esta temporada?</center>

![Green and White Minimalist Nature Travel Vlog Youtube Thumbnail (56).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23zm3XNT9hBkgsTp1j6WdpwgXyMRb1wJwkHzNMns63rZr6gKm5dr48Lpf1CJgzTdUu5so.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) I guess I’m still at that age where I believe that the things that I am interested in would be unique to people in the same age bracket as I am. And even for those that I’m not interested in, it’s normal when I see my peers showing avid interest in them and doing everything that they can to stay up to date about the happenings in that particular world. And the world that I’m talking about is none other than the world of football. While I’m not a fan of football, I would never find it weird when young men and women take an interest in it. Hell, when I come across old men who take an interest, I just find it to be another thing that brings men together across races and ages. It’s just one of those things, right? ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) Anyway, this night, I encountered something I’ve not experienced before. On my way home, I walked past a shop that sold second-hand TVs. And as you know, these shops always have one or two TVs that are displaying something. Well, this shop was no different. One of the TVs was showing wrestling, and the other was a sports thingy. But as I was walking past, they showed a clip of Arsenal Football Club, celebrating their win as they lifted their trophy. As I continued walking, I noticed that a woman walking behind me was talking to herself. She was congratulating Arsenal and talking about how winning the trophy wasn’t easy, and how it was a well-deserved win! She was so passionate about it that I turned to see her more clearly, and to my shock, she was an old woman, maybe in her 80s. I was beyond shocked! ![IMG_20230528_1139162.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/242rM25kCuPuDkPWm9n5gHpAAPogvwjTWUku1doohfp2fhue6c7LALoA4JzYLgYzxtz9R.jpg) From the kind of things she was saying, it was clear that she was up to date with the football world, and she has also been a fan for a long time. Seeing an 80-year-old female football fan was really impressive because she comes from a generation where women couldn’t even take an interest in activities that are deemed to be for men only. Well, I don’t really know her journey, I just know that, like millions of people all over the world, she was happy for Arsenal’s wins. She reminded me of the time an old man was arguing with me about some MCU movies. Like, it was a very logical argument, one where two people who knew what they were saying were debating. I was just impressed that at his age, he still had time and strength to follow the expansive world of the MCU. He was not like those people who watch films in private and then pretend they hate it outside. Or the ones who simply think that watching movies is a waste of time. I guess that age doesn’t dull certain things. As long as your brain is capable of handling it, then you should very much feel free to enjoy and binge on it. Because you never can know for sure, that may end up being the only thing that gives you joy. Just my two cents. ![IMG_20230914_153707~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23ywcNAwyLazQWbPq8XFuAdNBqPH34BKadTWksHKETHfowcWaiLQxnFi2Eo1yv6bcDkqx.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
