links.title: Update on the Interview I Was Nervous About
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5767.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xKkCA7UjWMuex3bSDBA8BR1UadeYoZQPkaCmebC5UgA2kuCJKTfMrMUtySpdAppEx4p.jpeg)

I got the job!!! I’m crineee!(tears of joy).

Before the interview, I was extremely nervous. Like, pacing-around-the-house, practicing-in-the-mirror kind of nervous. I had built so many scenarios in my head about how the interview would go and somehow convinced myself I would walk out of there overthinking every answer I gave.

But surprisingly, the moment I got there, I relaxed a little. Well after the frustration first. Because tell me why my interview was scheduled for 11am and the managing director didn’t arrive until 3pm? I was honestly tired of sitting in one position for hours just waiting. At some point, I started questioning all my life choices and wondering if it was some sort of endurance test instead of an interview.

![IMG_5753.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23xATuzmWsJ8B8PyXyRKCmA4RA992AVgSd5Ep6xWTh8htVknsaUcXtLe6jQN9CNLoKMYL.jpeg)

But when he finally arrived, everything changed real fast. He seemed genuinely pleased with me. He said he loved the way I spoke and believed I would handle customer care services very well. He also complimented my resume and portfolio, which honestly made me feel so seen because I put real effort into them. And then, almost immediately, he offered me the job. Just like that.

There was nothing like *we’ll get back to you.*Neither do I have to deal with a waiting period filled with anxiety and false hope. One minute I was answering questions, the next minute he was stretching out his hand for a congratulatory handshake. I really wasn’t expecting that at all.

The company is a really big one too, so I didn’t expect things to happen so easily. I believed in myself, yes, but prolly not to that extent. It’s a little strange how life can give you the very thing you were nervously praying for while you’re still preparing yourself for disappointment.

Anyway, baby girl is basically a corporate girly now and I need to be addressed as such. Lol.

![IMG_5754.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23vsLXFqyJfn1M6yHA91augZHeMCZgZA79Gq3d78CFynxsBZQHQJRRAScqvRru54LAzSJ.jpeg)

Now, one of the best parts of getting this job is finally getting to wear corporate outfits to work. I used to see all those corporate girlies on TikTok looking polished and important with their blazers, heels, coffee cups, and office routines, and I’d secretly wish that would be me someday.

Well, look at God. Look at life. Look at me now. Lol.

But beyond the excitement, I think this shows me that sometimes the opportunities we are most afraid of walking into are the same ones waiting to change our lives.

Fear will always try to convince you that you’re not ready, qualified enough, or not impressive enough. But all it can take is showing up despite the fear. That version of you that succeeds is simply the version that refused to stay home.

So if you’re nervous about applying for something, attending an interview, starting over, or putting yourself out there, do it anyway. You honestly never know which room is about to open for you.



</diva>

links.title: Momentos Inolvidables: Bailando con Papá
links.body:
![1000994102.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uFMJtcpJgHt3tzzqEf9iwVs6zrKS5NzRfURD5LsEDUUDbQiQTewEXfUNvge5YckgHsx.png)
---
Luego de unos días de que mi papá hubiera fallecido, sentí una necesidad extrema de ver fotos y vídeos y que me hicieran sentirlo cerca. Recuerdo que busqué un vídeo, uno que fue grabado en el 2023, para su cumpleaños. En ese tiempo estaban 2 de mis hermanas aquí, ambas le habían dado la sorpresa de reencontrarse con él y en las 2 ocasiones yo había sido cómplice de aquellas sorpresas. No encontré el vídeo, se lo pedí a mis hermanos y familiares, pero nadie parecía tenerlo, me puso muy triste, ya que fue un momento muy bonito, que no quería solo tenerlo en mi memoria. Así con el pasar de los días y con tristeza me resigné al hecho de ya no tenerlo. Hace unos pocos días, una de mis hermanas me lo envió, dijo haberlo encontrado mientras hacía espacio en su teléfono. No se imaginan la alegría que sentí al verlo, era mío nuevamente, era mi precioso recuerdo. Incluso lloré de la emoción y es que con papá no podía bailar siempre, pero cuando lo sacaba a bailar él siempre me daba el gusto y sonreía, era feliz haciéndome feliz, y esos momentos quiero que sigan siendo inolvidables. https://youtube.com/shorts/_F3xjy-U9og?si=gkbPeJK0DeDwdWIZ

links.title: [ENG-SPN] The Balconies of Memory / Los Balcones de la Memoria
links.body:
![P1020682.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/EoK4nGwBg58yspLwwa8bE6NQvLUJvSNXctLRjLFRGQKfa4TEBZJUpVbVRcjPd7Mxeoi.JPG)

For much of the 20th century, these balconies of an old period building, located on Madrid's central Paseo de Recoletos, stood as a landmark, their heights reaching towards the city. They were situated opposite that metaphorical and marvelous time capsule, the Prado Museum, which receives millions of eager visitors throughout the year.

![P1020679.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23tmHi437yUhEUcTx6FeZ1JBQRum8SpWKcqPubWxNMwAAXg4iTHjYkU2q5GQHckx68CX6.JPG)

Originally, the floor below these balconies, where Velázquez, Las Meninas, and Kings Charles III and Charles IV, among others, were displayed, housed another of those whimsical shops, specializing in the finest Toledo steel. Its swords and reproductions not only piqued the interest of avid collectors but also tempted tourists who couldn't resist the allure of taking home a replica of the weapons that once made Spain the leader of Europe.

![P1020684.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23uQjtvabR2zT8wWDu9ek1513D7DUfGgoy5aRswCGny2UzgXFDM9JxankxWU8vALVvJ69.JPG)

Durante buena parte del pasado siglo XX, fueron un referente que levantaba las alturas hacia esos balcones de un viejo edificio de época, situado en el céntrico Paseo de Recoletos de Madrid, situado enfrente de esa metafórica y maravillosa cápsula del tiempo, que, bajo el universal nombre de Museo del Prado, recibe millones de expectantes visitantes a lo largo del año.

![P1020686.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23yd3nQGYU8b19HcztjFvanDFs7L8pvskwyqorXogG2kNm3Bs6nAUjPGgY5nzyEYnVHrF.JPG)

En sus orígenes, la planta que se levantaba debajo de esos balcones donde Velázquez, las Meninas, los Reyes Carlos III y Carlos IV, entre otros, era otra de esas tiendas de fantasía, especializada en los mejores aceros de Toledo, cuyas espadas y reproducciones despertaban no sólo el interés del ávido coleccionista, sino también el capricho de unos turistas que no podía evitar la seducción de llevarse una reproducción de aquellas armas que un día hicieron de España la cabeza de Europa.

![P1020687.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/juancar347/23xp47YidKTJYWUbYkZHGqY3GiaPdZ9EQgMyavFTieh7wnNfh6tYmmgosnubJMgUkcm2q.JPG)

Parece que Boston está empeñado en hacerme quedar mal. Los Mellizos de Minesota los han barrido, hechando por tierra el pequeño repunte que había logrado los patirojos. Lo peor es que el desastre fue en el mismo Fenway Park. Este es un panorama que se ha repetido en esta temporada. Es decir, los Medias Rojas pierden más jugando en casa que en la carretera.

Esto sim dudas es una mala noticia, pues lo normal es aue un equipo por muy malo que sea, siempre tiene mejores posibilidades de ganar en su propia casa. Habrá que firmar una regla para que solo jueguen en terreno contrario el resto de la temporada. Bromeo.

Pero en el lado de los Mellizos hay buenas noticias. Resulta que hay un pitcher novato cubano que lo está haciendo bien, y tiene por nombre Kendry Rojas. Es zurdo y en em segundo juego de la serie, dominó a la tanda de Boston por tres inning completos sin libertades. Esta fue su segunda buena actuación consecutiva, aunque en general el muchacho tiene buenos números.

Casi nunca hablo de pitcheo pues la armada cubana carece de lanzadores en el Big Show, pero siempre hay sus exponentes interesantes. En San Diego por ejemplo, Adrián Morejón ha tenido un mayo muy  bueno después de un primer mes desatroso. Lleva desde el relevo 4 victorias con  una derrota y 10 Holds. El punto bajo es el PCL que está en 4.44, pero como ya dije , ha ido a la mejoría en este mes. 

El otro caso que casi siempre escapa al foco es el del cerrador de Atlanta Raisel Iglesias. El muchacho es tan dominante como El Misil Aroldis Chapman, pero por alguna razón se nos olvida que existe hasta que tiene las actuaciones a la que está acostumbrado.

El pinero está inbateable. En poco más de 15 entradas no ha permitido carreras, y sus rivales apenas le conectan para 151 de average. El man es un cerrojo para los Bravos. Chapman no es el único que merece reflectores.

### Key Findings on AI Mensa Norway Scores (2025–2026)

- **Top Performers (2026):** *According to TrackingAI's April 2026 benchmark, models like OpenAI GPT-5.4 Pro and Grok-4.20 Expert Mode have hit scores of 145–150 on the test.*

- **Rapid Growth:** *AI performance on this test has increased exponentially. In early 2025, models scored around 117; by April 2025, OpenAI's o3 reached 136, exceeding the top 2% threshold for human Mensa entry.*

- **Offline/Contamination Check:** *While some argue AI excels due to training data contamination, top models still scored 116 on an \

version of the test, confirming high-level reasoning capabilities.*

- **Pattern-Recognition Focus:** *The test is highly visual, relying on 35 progressive matrix patterns. Because AI is trained specifically for pattern recognition, these tests are highly optimized for them.*

### Performance Comparison (Approximate)

- **Average Human:** *IQ 100*

- **Mensa Norway Entry Threshold:** *Approx. IQ 132–135*

- **GPT-4 (2024):** *~85–96 IQ*

- **OpenAI o3 (April 2025):** *136 IQ*

- **GPT-5.4 Pro/Grok-4.20 (April 2026):** *145–150 IQ*

While these scores actually demonstrate incredible pattern recognition in the AI models tested so far, they do not necessarily equate to human-like general intelligence, as LLMs indeed can often solve visual puzzles better through specialized training.

links.title: Holidays and Sports | Feriado y Deportes. Mi informe de Actifit: mayo 25 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d849c063-1cac-48b3-91d3-e43efe7f01e6.jpg) After training for a major event like Rio Pinto, and on top of some dental infections I had, I kind of let my guard down and went almost 15 days without even touching my bike. I only use it to take my little boy to school. I’m spending a long weekend in Argentina. May 25 marks the anniversary of the May Revolution, and in practically every household in Argentina, the focus is on family gatherings, good food, and commemorating in one way or another those events that shape who we are today. ___ Después de un proceso de entrenamiento para un gran evento como lo fue Rio Pinto y sumado a unas infecciones en los dientes que tuve, es como que me relajé y pasaron casi 15 días prácticamente sin agarrar la bicicleta. Solamente las utilizo para llevar a mi pequeño niño al colegio. Estando en un fin de semana largo en la Argentina. 25 de mayo se celebra el día de la revolución de mayo y prácticamente en todos los hogares de la Argentina, se prioriza reuniones familiares, come rico y conmemorar de alguna u otra manera esos eventos que hacen o forman parte de lo que somos hoy. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/912ac599-311e-432f-b9ba-e8a497c7a717.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c62314f1-4fe0-49d0-8666-debdadb22fc8.jpg) Our friend and coach prefers running on pavement and getting in shape. He usually avoids dirt trails because he believes you only need to run on them once a week—or even just on race day. But his students love dirt trails, which is why he decided to join us. The day turned out completely unexpectedly, and the fog that rolled in early in the morning never lifted until we returned. The pavement was covered in dirty water, and on the dirt trails, you could more or less run. Visibility was practically zero, but we were there anyway. Going to La Fortuna is apparently just a formality. But if you let yourself go for a while, as in all aspects of life, the dirt takes its toll. The trip there was rough, but we arrived safe and sound and very happy. ___ Nuestro amigo y entrenador es más amigo del asfalto y de poner el físico en condiciones. Elude normalmente la tierra porque entiende que solo hay que ir una vez por semana o inclusive solamente el día de la carrera. Pero a sus alumnos les encanta la tierra y es por eso que se dio y nos acompañó. El día fue totalmente inesperado y la neblina que hubo desde muy temprano nunca desapareció hasta que volvimos. El asfalto cubierto de agua sucia y en la tierra más o menos se podía rodar. La visibilidad era prácticamente nula, pero igualmente ahí estuvimos. Ir a la fortuna es un trámite aparentemente Pero si te dejas estar por un tiempo, cómo en todos los aspectos de la vida, la tierra te pasa factura. Dolió la ida pero llegamos sanos y salvo y muy felices. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ad7cd74a-3bd1-455a-be9c-7f21fa29ff3e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/635bf8a0-5f39-4740-9a4d-f171061ef364.jpg) The ride back was much tougher, due to fatigue and the bumpy rural roads. Luckily, the coach didn’t show up and drove us home like kids going to school. He was always at the front of the pack, and we were back here, getting splashed with mud from the cyclist in front of us. One rider fell behind—our 70-year-old friend, Whass—but on the way back we caught up with him, and we all made it home after covering more than 80 km of a solid workout in Zone 2 for some and Zone 3 for others. What’s usually called a Sunday long ride, but in this case it happened on a Monday. ___ La vuelta fue mucho más duro, debido al cansancio y el traqueteo de las calles rurales. Por suerte el entrenador no llegó y nos trajo como niño para el colegio. Siempre al frente del pelotón y nosotros acá atrás, absorbiendo el barro del ciclista que va delante tuyo. Un soldado quedó en el camino, el amigo de 70 años, el Whass, pero de regreso conectamos con él y llegamos todos a nuestros domicilios realizando más de 80 km de un buen entrenamiento en zona 2 para algunos y para otros en zona 3. Lo que se llama normalmente un fondo de domingo pero en este caso sucede un día lunes. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cc3c15fd-33e3-4e9c-86af-70eb678adfef.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4b0d6270-76dd-43f8-abee-c3cbd308d957.jpg) After a hot shower and cleaning the mud off our bikes, we sat down to enjoy a delicious lunch with our families. Zuni, as always, stole the show and surprised us with a delicious, traditional Argentine dish. We raised a glass of wine in honor of those who once risked their lives to liberate us, and to wash down this hearty meal. ___ Luego de una ducha caliente y limpiar las bicicletas del barro, nos dispusimos a compartir con nuestras familias un rico almuerzo. Zuni, como siempre dando la nota y sorprendiéndonos con un rico loco lo tradicional argentino. Una copa de vino en honor a los que en su momento pusieron el pecho para liberarnos y para bajar este contundente plato. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f4a6e7ce-958f-4b8f-8bd4-5cb57346060a.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/782ce0c0-5760-4780-90a0-ef11bbc20a7f.jpg) That's all for today, dear friends. We'll keep rolling and living life our way. Cheers 🫂 ___ Esto fue todo por hoy estimados compañeros. Seguimos rodando y viviendo, a nuestro estilo. Saludos 🫂 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/af0dedc4-617c-4ecd-bb98-a01c139340b8.jpg) Resources. Screenshots taken with my Samsung S22. Thanks to my friends who shared some of these images with me. ___ Recursos. Capturas con mi celular Samsung s22. Gracias a los amigos que me compartieron algunas de las imágenes.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@palabras1/actifit-palabras1-20260525t201023841z)_

links.title: The Renaissance the the USA Didn't Want You to Know About - 12-04-2019 - Clip 4 - 10X Speed
links.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779739344650-1c15002fb8668f6f.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/299f65d6)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/299f65d6)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/299f65d6)

links.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 48  How did you deal with stress or heartbreak?
links.body:
![asia sb chronicles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23zRzmQENHSVbBczUPpnz9XqberZLkqJ9WmbWXmx6tCSNb2kHB3iSL6JTsLpSpoR6uusV.png)


***
# The SB-Chronicle Prompt #48
With #sb-chronicles... we are posting a question on Mondays, prompting anyone who wants to join in to write their own \
Chronicle for future generations to read! *If you feel like suggesting a next prompt yourself... please feel welcome to contact one of the \

!*

###  How did you deal with stress or heartbreak? 
> Life has it's ups and downs. We cannot avoid stress sometimes, whether about  job, relationships or family. The same as being brokenhearted. We have different ways of coping and healing. I'm curious on how you guys deal with yours.💔🫂.
###### How did you deal with your stress or heartbreak? 

***

# The How-2 join the Silverbloggers Chronicles

- Just take the prompt question and answer it in your own Hive post. 
- **Post in our Silver Bloggers Community**.
- Be sure to **use [#sb-chronicles](https://peakd.com/created/sb-chronicles) as your first tag**, to get them all listed at the same place. 
- Write 100% original content of **around 300 words in English**.
- **Put the link to your post into the comment section of your chosen prompt.**
- Have fun.
- 

And soon enough, we’ll have a \

for future generations. **There is no time limit for all this...** Write whenever you like and whatever prompt suits you. Just make sure you use the proper tag and put a link to your post in the comment section of the chosen prompt, so we can curate your story.

[You can check here on all our prompts - always updated with what's to come!](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-writers-block-terminator)
***
![SB_Chronicles_Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/Eo8UoVbkMbQLQ4Mv34M33H1DPziCRD6Kc9fanV7reiyH3hHt5kXjpLpTNKR54CnoZnL.png)
***

# The Idea of the Chronicles
...kinda started when our community advisor [SilverScribe](https://peakd.com/@ericvancewalton) came up with the Memoir Mondays. A new topic/question every Monday for a whole year, and we all loved it so much that we've fallen into a kind of writer's block since the \

of it.  <sup><sup> *Not really, but still...* </sup></sup>

So what could be more obvious than to continue somehow? Something has to be done to tackle writer's block, or even the ‘all-time low’ at Hive...
***
The Silverators started brainstorming the hows and the whens to get an idea of what we could all share for the best of our community. To have a sort of \

that never gets old.

In the synonyms for the word memoir, we can find - chronicle. Now, that was it.... our own chronicles!  **The Silverbloggers Chronicles**! The place where we all keep our memories to share with the future. The library of a silly, wild bunch of Silvers. **The Silvery Book of the Wise**! Hehehe


***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***
### On Winning the Prize ?!
We are all winners in this by supporting each other in the community, be it with an upvote, a tip, and/or a kind comment... 

> Since we \
know that many are just chasing big votes, with not doing much at all, running behind the whales to get them to pay attention, craving for a vote of lots of dollar$. Or the ones being \

and trying to benefit from the Vitamin R<sup>elation</sup> until there's a Lambo in sight...!

We feel this is the wrong way. A community should be there for each other, even if many humans are conditioned differently. It's more about putting the ego-selfish-ego aside, because life is not about money, it's about joy/happiness. That everyone gets support for their best they give to the community. 

> You may say it's good to have dreams? Yes, we live these dreams to achieve the best for everyone. Remember - joy/happiness?!

Why are we even writing about this while promoting the Chronicles for our community? It's to make us all realise that many members don't get high-profile support, but we can \

ourselves. Also, to understand that the idea of a memoir library for future generations is probably not the way to get rich, to finally get that Lambo. It's about sharing viewpoints, knowledge, and the occasional good laugh. It's about individuals, nature, and happiness. And be sure, we continue to curate the pearls in our midst!
***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***

## Last words...
***
We would love to get more eyes on this post *and* all community posts from - [@hive-106316](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316) - our Silver Bloggers Mother Account.  This is why we make a point of reblogging your posts.  Please do the same?!

***

“Swamp”这个词让我联想到一种天然的生境，那种湿润而神秘的环境，充满了奇异的植物和丰富的生物。走在这样的地方，仿佛能够感受到大自然的力量与宁静，同时又带着一点神秘和未知的魅力。湿气弥漫、虫鸣阵阵，让人感受到生命的脉动与大自然的和谐。而在这个“沼泽”的景象中，也有一种让人反思的意味——生活中，有时我们会被困在某种环境或情绪中，但只有勇敢面对，才能找到出路。

​I am a small creator on Hive. It takes me about 2-3 hours of hard work to create a post. I spend a lot of time in nature taking these perfect macro photos of insects and plants. Then it takes me even more time to study them and edit the post to provide accurate information in my post. After all this hard work, such downvotes for no reason completely break the spirit and enthusiasm of small and honest creators like me.
​Can you please tell me why my two posts were downvoted? If I have made any mistake in formatting or tags without my knowledge, please let me know so that I can correct it immediately. However, if my posts have been downvoted by mistake or due to some automated blind trail, I respectfully request you to please remove the downvotes. I truly respect this platform and only want to share my honest work here.
​Thank you for your time and understanding.🙏

There is a particular tragedy in watching someone refuse to look in the mirror.

Not the mirror of vanity, but the mirror of consequence—the blockchain, that unblinking eye that records not what you say, but what you *do*. Every downvote cast without justification. Every reward farmed without creation. Every voice silenced not for lack of merit, but for lack of conformity.

You refuse to examine yourself.

You refuse to examine your actions, etched in cryptographic stone, visible to all, permanent as time.

And so you downvote the truth. You show, with devastating clarity, how the tools of curation can be weaponized into instruments of suppression. You demonstrate, day after day, how power without accountability corrupts not just the system, but the soul.

You are not well.

It is clear to see.

Not in body, perhaps, but in spirit. In the obsession with control. In the reflex to silence rather than engage. In the willingness to trade integrity for influence, truth for tokens, community for clique.

To keep trying to fight the truth with lies is not strategy. It is surrender wearing the mask of patience.

You will never win.
You can never win.

Truth does not shout. It waits. It watches. And eventually, it always wins.

You will just keep wasting your time defending something that you know, in the quiet chamber of your conscience, is wrong. But you do anything for money. Anything for a small bit of power on a blockchain that is failing badly.

And your actions—downvoting, farming, bullying—drive people away from Hive.

Not in anger. Not in protest. But in pursuit of something simpler: a place where a voice, once offered, is allowed to stand.

This is not a rejection of blockchain. It is a reclamation of its promise.

You are all sad.

Not in the way that invites mockery, but in the way that invites compassion. For what is sadder than a soul that trades its integrity for influence? That mistakes control for community? That believes power is an end, rather than a means?

You need to get a real life.
Go touch some grass.
Take a break.

Have a look at your actions from the outside—and you will see that you are doing the devil's work, not god's. You are being paid in blood money, and you wonder why you and those around you face karma, and drama, and consequence?

You give what you get.
You get what you give.

## **The Inevitability of Judgment**

As they say: there will always be someone bigger, better, stronger than you.

You cannot win every battle.
And when you are fighting against the truth, you will never win.

We all face judgment day.
You cannot escape it.

Not the judgment of men. Not the judgment of algorithms. But the judgment of the ledger—the quiet, cumulative weight of every choice, every action, every intention buried beneath your words.

To @themarkymark, @meno, @acidyo, and friends:

LOL, indeed.

You pretend to care about Hive. You post about growth, about decentralization, about the future.

But you farm Hive.
You downvote people away.
You silence the vulnerable.
You protect the powerful.

The ledger sees.
The users see.
History sees.

links.body:
![Hive Thrive Get Ready Alessandra & Shadows Hosts.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alessandrawhite/23uFPCoyqMMEq4Lp4Rz6JHUFiEN1jy5Rj8sSesJenfm1WEDkt4isiTLYhjYdYhDQGwBYB.png)

## THE WHAT 

###### Hey everyone!👋🏽 Many of us seek out live events related to HIVE. If you haven't seen us around, let me introduce our show. We are Hive Thrive Community Hour and we're about getting to know each other *off screen* in a social audio space that supports what our community is doing *on-chain.* 
## THE WHO
🎙 Hosts — @alessandrawhite & @shadowspub
🌟 Guest — @godfish & @honeydue of @dead-pets 

## THE WHEN & WHERE

📅 Tuesday, 26 May at 2PM EDT | 6PM UTC | 8PM CEST
📍[Hive Discord General Voice Channel](https://discord.gg/7zeyCtWnGJ)
___
___

 

## Let's Get to Know Our Guests and Their Project 

If you don't already know this dynamic duo, then let me introduce you to our Hive friends @godfish and @honeydue. Together they are the creative studio behind Dead Pets Society, which  just debuted on Hive as @dead-pets. To celebrate them, on our next Hive Thrive Episode 58, we’ll be talking with @godfish in the Hive Discord voice channel and chatting with @honeydue in the text channel during our live recorded show. These two \

have just launched their weird and creatively explosive project. Unlike anything I've seen on the blockchain, this hand-drawn and rendered comic strip is today's answer to AI generated content fatigue.

From an actual real-life drawing board, what started as a sketch of friendly animal characters in the afterlife has *de-composed* (sorry, had to!) into this genuinely fascinating indie comic full of dark humour, emotional reveals, bizarre conversations, and somehow, actual heart❤️. The project has now expanded beyond Hive onto Web2 comic platforms, while still keeping Hive at its creative center. Along the way they're building story, developing characters, experimenting with NFTs through @magi.network, and attracting readers who are both delighted and curious to find something so truly original.

The vibe of Dead Pets Society feels a bit like [Shaun the Sheep](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCS7H8U-n5mINVJjJsaRtGHg), a bit like [Tales from the Crypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tales_from_the_Crypt_(TV_series)), and a bit like a indie webccomic you find at two in the morning on a school night. It’s one of those projects where you can immediately tell the creators care about storytelling and worldbuilding even ahead of engagement. Their intent is for us to fall in love with these little characters, one panel at a time.

___
___


## Get Ready for the Episode 58! 🎙️
This is a social invitation you'll want to accept! The session will be bumpin'! So mark your calendar for 6pm UTC, Tuesday, 26 May.
We’ll have fun as we talk comics, creativity, Web3 publishing, internet culture, building original IP on Hive, and what happens when two creators decide to make something so unapologetically strange. 👏🏾👏🏽👏

So invite a friend, come a little early, bring your best brew 🍺, and claim the best seat in the house. 🛋️ See ya there! 🥰

*Please say you'll come!* 
It'll be more fun with you there! 🥳

___
___

## About Hive Thrive Community Hour

Hive Thrive Community Hour is our weekly town hall for builders, critics, and curators.

Each week we slow things down, ask real questions, and let ideas breathe in real time.

There are no scripts. No talking points handed out in advance.
Just open conversation about Hive. We discuss its culture, its economics, its people, and the future we’re all quietly shaping together.

### We Explore...

• Why Hive keeps attracting people who claim not to care…but clearly do
• What actually creates value here versus what we pretend creates value
• The psychology of the downvote button
• Whether Hive is anti-fragile or just stubborn
• And why everyone thinks they could run the DHF better

> There may be hard truths.
There will be laughs.
There'll likely be awkward moments *(it happens!)*.

## Hive Thrive Ain't Just Another Discord Show 😄 

We treat it more like a live town hall for the blockchain. It's a place where all of us can share the same room and talk about what is shaping Hive.

If you’ve ever caught yourself thinking about Hive — what works, what doesn’t, or why it somehow keeps pulling people back in. You’ll probably feel at home with the likes of us. 🤗

What we’re trying to do

• Help people understand what’s actually happening behind the scenes
• Reveal the real stories behind Hive’s institutions and projects
• Talk openly about governance friction and systemic issues
• Look for ways forward that strengthen the network instead of dividing it


Hive is a wonderful and remarkable experiment🔬. And like any experiment, it works best when people are willing to talk honestly about it.

___
___

## Meet Your Hosts 🎙️


@shadowspub
10 years strong on Hive, host of Pimp Your Post Thursdays, co-host of Hive Thrive, host of Hive Witness Chat, and long-time signal booster for emerging voices. 

@alessandrawhite
Hive Conference Speaker, founding host of the Daily @creativeworkhour, clarinetist, industrial designer, & hardcore Hive Meetup junkie since 2022.

@buttcoins Hive OG since 2017, community builder, musician, and all-around Butt who somehow keeps saying yes to more projects.

@meno
Legacy Hivian, luthier by trade, Herzogian by hobby, cheese oligarch by appetite. Master of ceremony and master of BBQ.

___ 


## HIVE THRIVE COMMUNITY HOUR — 
## *\

*

___
___

#### We Don't Run the Show Alone! 
The show would not go as smoothly as it does each week were it not for @thekittygirl, who pings our Hive friends on Discord for the show to start & who drops a resource link in the text channel faster than a dog on dropped bacon. We appreciate you, KG! 💐

Thanks go to @ecoinstant who has kindly archived our past episodes.🎉
If you missed any of our shows, he has posted them on his [Deep Web3 Secrets YouTube Channel](https://youtube.com/@deepweb3secrets?si=Yn8_X7THa0XNaiGQ).

links.body: ![Green Textured Lifestyle Daily Vlog Promotion Youtube Thumbnail (64).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23wCNqTzMRH1zCrY47egdLmeEjRpyf1HsknTZ1Q2hzUdFu6u2eLs6R6MU8i77gQXBYgFP.png) ***

> **Saludos queridos amantes de la costura, espero se encuentren de maravilla y estén teniendo una excelente semana.** Tenía bastante tiempo sin pasar por acá pero creo que esta es la época en la que más he estado cosiendo solo que no me da tiempo de organizarme para tomar los fotos y documentar el proceso también porque que mi teléfono ha estado presentando fallas por esto estaba tan perdida, pero estás últimas semanas he estado cosiendo pijamas para vender cuando tenga tiempo les muestro, hoy les quiero compartir un pedido diferente que me hizo una tía pues me pidió hacerle un bata para dormir a su medida, ella es rellenita así que la quería ancha a pesar que la tela estira y también la quería cortar pues no le gustan usar esas batas de señora 🤭 no se si me explico quería algo cómodo pero juvenil así que me puse manos a la obra con una tela bellísima que compré con estampado de animal print y el resultado final cumplió con las expectativas, así que ***acompañame a ver el proceso.*** > **Greetings dear sewing lovers, I hope you are feeling wonderful and are having a great start of the week.** It’s been a while since I’ve stopped by here, but I think this is the time of year when I’ve been sewing the most—it’s just that I haven’t had time to get organized enough to take photos and document the process, partly because my phone has been acting up. That’s why I’ve been so out of the loop, but these past few weeks I’ve been sewing pajamas to sell. When I have time, I’ll show you. Today I want to share a different order I got from an aunt—she asked me to make her a custom-fit nightgown. She’s on the curvy side, so she wanted it roomy even though the fabric stretches, and she also wanted it cut differently because she doesn’t like wearing those old-lady nightgowns 🤭 I don’t know if that makes sense—she wanted something comfortable but youthful—so I got to work with a gorgeous animal-print fabric I bought, and the final result met her expectations, ***come with me to see the process.*** *** ![IMG_20260525_113243.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/EoErQg5a1RKdTcCfc5UzMEnmfzm8PSEVAuUYsNFoMWyJXaXRS8eFokxr7GKiyvgq89A.jpg) ***

>
**Para realizar este proyecto utilicé:** - Tela microdurazno - Hilo a tono - Elástica finita - Tijera - Cinta métrica - Alfileres - Máquina de coser
**To make this project I used:** - microdurazno fabric - Matching thread - Elastic - Scissors - Tape measure - Pins - Sewing machine
***
# Paso a paso || Step to step
*** # |![IMG_20260525_113321.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/242DSa1YNnQdNWPdaQcEcq42PVWZuhYuazyjn9xg7Rk9A7RNuC1wT3nNJt1d6GgvB9gLn.jpg)|![IMG_20260525_113437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23uQy6S37pifvbCfF89FoBrM6cE1hfRU9sEKjjePo9ZoqY1JGE14735Mk1gsueV7h9CH9.jpg)|![IMG_20260525_113931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tmUYVLHe6DmXFwEbb3ckusL3oGphMXCP5nrDSaGuk9vTwb9F1RAYCu4qrREr4dBeQgk.jpg) -|-|- #

> El proceso para hacer está bata es súper fácil, lo primero que hice fué extender la tela doble para cortar las dos piezas de la bata, usé un patrón de top para guiarme en la parte del escote y luego corté con la talla deseada hacia abajo, luego coloqué las dos piezas enfrentando sus derechos y cosí los costados. > The process for making this robe is super easy. First, I laid the fabric out double to cut out the two pieces of the robe. I used a top pattern as a guide for the neckline and then cut down to the desired length. Next, I placed the two pieces right sides together and sewed the sides. *** # |![IMG_20260525_113953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tvqGAbgbRnzjybPUGBjrzZhVsjYnj6hGwfFfhhL65aefgWAa1ZLNTsJXipCdVFmyMUu.jpg)|![IMG_20260525_114018.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tvnpN5xE5BUQ8YxBvqwqsawHEvc1EruXBTanTGjXc4fZFngAnsuEe7ipeyyinhgCct4.jpg)|![IMG_20260525_114049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23uQxePo96q3HtvvMMT681cTL1XNJeHGRo19pUXq6LHM5eSGqqu4FmMGVaDbYhpEzsFTV.jpg) -|-|-

> Para coser los tirantes corté una tira de 6 cm de ancho que coloqué como bies en el escote y luego cosí los dos tirantes, para diferenciar la parte de adelante le cosí elástica en la parte del escote y por último para coser la orilla de la bata usé la técnica del fruncido estirando la tela y cosiendo en la orilla para hacer un lindo detalle en el borde. **Espero les haya gustado éste post, si llegaste hasta aquí mil gracias por leerme, ¡Hasta luego!** > To sew the straps, I cut a 6-cm-wide strip and attached it as bias tape along the neckline, then sewed on the two straps. To set the front apart, I sewed elastic into the neckline, and finally, to finish the hem of the robe, I used a gathering technique by stretching the fabric and sewing along the edge to create a pretty detail. **I hope you liked this post. If you made it this far, thank you so much for reading. See you later!** *** ![IMG_20260525_114238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23zbeL7hgeCW5wpZssGHgN6CmFpyYB2fWFf4LseiKfWDcCrQ7xxwsTKuudzRLVHfgG8q2.jpg) ![IMG_20260525_114306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23yJTSuxi14qi5V362Fveh1eB8WwfzNE28sxp3Xxbdz91ADTxcDh2XsbrmKQvV88par5u.jpg) ![IMG_20260525_114502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/245TNibLGNNjpCYYtnLiNDJazRBSjNR2J6wxPa2i9nnZmZTcaV5npFTFFnwqwj2EeD5Ec.jpg) ![IMG_20260525_114430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23wX7dh4qFStdJ6UAV4famq62wqDHK1ccgrTttWcbecj5HfmUUdE99e8vUqnQKTgaYenC.jpg) *** # **¡Gracias por leerme, hasta luego!** > # **Thank you for reading me, see you later !** *** ![Azul y Amarillo Moderno Casero Fiestas y Celebraciones Marco en X Banner.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/EpR24jokeEvQR3QUEz9X8rTnC3FcbrXuJJbxQMzyUMw4ZLHvL91hssCVdwhBH6md97z.gif) ![BackgroundEraser_20230622_211641066.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yulilemus/23tGXZimDv9p8VZsWTwB7zJNGd5212gYvw8Gofk6SDadE3eT2LzD8VoremgFJWy4Fjak5.png)

## **The Refusal to See**

There is a particular blindness that afflicts those who stand too close to their own reflection. They see only what they wish to see. They hear only what they wish to hear. They record only what serves their narrative.

You refuse to examine yourself.

Not your intentions—those are easy to justify. Not your words—those are easy to spin. But your *actions*. The ones etched in cryptographic stone. The ones visible to all. The ones that cannot be edited, deleted, or denied.

The blockchain does not care about your story. It records what you *do*.

Every downvote cast without justification.
Every reward farmed without creation.
Every voice silenced not for lack of merit, but for lack of conformity.

These are not whispers. They are inscriptions. Permanent. Visible. Unforgettable.

## **The Weaponization of the Downvote**

You show, with crystalline clarity, how downvotes can be used wrongly on Hive.

Not as curation. Not as quality control. But as coercion. As punishment. As the digital equivalent of a gag order.

When you downvote the truth, you do not silence it. You only reveal your fear of it. Truth does not require your approval to exist. It exists whether you upvote it, downvote it, or ignore it entirely.

But your downvotes? They speak louder than your words. They reveal a system where power is not earned through merit, but exercised through intimidation. Where influence is not built through contribution, but consolidated through suppression.

This is not governance. This is tyranny with better branding.

## **The Architecture of Decline**

You are not well.

It is clear to see.

The obsession. The compulsion. The relentless need to control the narrative, to silence the dissent, to farm the rewards while preaching community. These are not the actions of a healthy mind. They are the symptoms of a soul that has mistaken power for purpose, extraction for contribution, control for leadership.

And those who back you? They will fall with you.

Not because we wish it. But because gravity is impartial. Because truth is patient. Because karma is not a myth—it is the natural consequence of action.

You give what you get. You get what you give.

## **The Futility of Fighting Truth**

To keep trying to fight the truth with lies is not strategy. It is surrender wearing the mask of patience.

You will never win.
You can never win.

You will only keep wasting your time defending something that you know, in the quiet chamber of your conscience, is wrong.

But you do anything for money. And a small bit of power. On a blockchain that is failing badly.

The users are leaving. The trust is eroding. The platform is becoming a ghost town populated by bots, farms, and the echoes of voices that once believed in the promise.

And you and your friends—downvoting, farming, bullying people away from Hive—you are all sad.

You need to get a real life.
Go touch some grass.
Take a break.
Have a look at your actions from the outside.

And you will see that you are doing the devil's work, not God's.

You are being paid in blood money.

Not literal blood. But the life force of creators who were silenced. Of newcomers who were driven away. Of a community that was promised freedom but delivered feudalism.

And you wonder why you and those around you face karma? Why there is so much drama? Why the platform you claim to love is dying on your watch?

You reap what you sow.
You harvest what you plant.
You become what you practice.

As they say: there will always be someone bigger, better, stronger than you.

You cannot win every battle.
And when you are fighting against the truth, you will never win.

We all face judgment day.
You cannot escape it.

Not the judgment of men. But the judgment of the ledger. The judgment of time. The judgment of a universe that records every choice, every action, every intention buried beneath your words.

@themarkymark, @meno, @acidyo, and friends:

You pretend to care about Hive. But you farm Hive. You downvote people away. You build walls where bridges should stand. You silence voices where dialogue should flourish.

The blockchain sees.
The users see.
History sees.

>El Hive Music Festival continúa impulsando la música sumándose a las buenas iniciativas que existen a nivel musical en la plataforma y por supuesto que eso nos motiva a seguir trabajando por nuestros artistas dentro y fuera de Hive. # **The Ledger of the Soul: A Prophetic Reckoning with the Architects of Suppression**

## **The Refusal to See**

There is a particular blindness that afflicts those who stand too close to their own reflection. They see only what they wish to see. They hear only what they wish to hear. They record only what serves their narrative.

You refuse to examine yourself.

Not your intentions—those are easy to justify. Not your words—those are easy to spin. But your *actions*. The ones etched in cryptographic stone. The ones visible to all. The ones that cannot be edited, deleted, or denied.

The blockchain does not care about your story. It records what you *do*.

Every downvote cast without justification.
Every reward farmed without creation.
Every voice silenced not for lack of merit, but for lack of conformity.

These are not whispers. They are inscriptions. Permanent. Visible. Unforgettable.

## **The Weaponization of the Downvote**

You show, with crystalline clarity, how downvotes can be used wrongly on Hive.

Not as curation. Not as quality control. But as coercion. As punishment. As the digital equivalent of a gag order.

When you downvote the truth, you do not silence it. You only reveal your fear of it. Truth does not require your approval to exist. It exists whether you upvote it, downvote it, or ignore it entirely.

But your downvotes? They speak louder than your words. They reveal a system where power is not earned through merit, but exercised through intimidation. Where influence is not built through contribution, but consolidated through suppression.

This is not governance. This is tyranny with better branding.

## **The Architecture of Decline**

You are not well.

It is clear to see.

The obsession. The compulsion. The relentless need to control the narrative, to silence the dissent, to farm the rewards while preaching community. These are not the actions of a healthy mind. They are the symptoms of a soul that has mistaken power for purpose, extraction for contribution, control for leadership.

And those who back you? They will fall with you.

Not because we wish it. But because gravity is impartial. Because truth is patient. Because karma is not a myth—it is the natural consequence of action.

You give what you get. You get what you give.

## **The Futility of Fighting Truth**

To keep trying to fight the truth with lies is not strategy. It is surrender wearing the mask of patience.

You will never win.
You can never win.

You will only keep wasting your time defending something that you know, in the quiet chamber of your conscience, is wrong.

But you do anything for money. And a small bit of power. On a blockchain that is failing badly.

The users are leaving. The trust is eroding. The platform is becoming a ghost town populated by bots, farms, and the echoes of voices that once believed in the promise.

And you and your friends—downvoting, farming, bullying people away from Hive—you are all sad.

You need to get a real life.
Go touch some grass.
Take a break.
Have a look at your actions from the outside.

And you will see that you are doing the devil's work, not God's.

## **The Blood Money of Complicity**

You are being paid in blood money.

Not literal blood. But the life force of creators who were silenced. Of newcomers who were driven away. Of a community that was promised freedom but delivered feudalism.

And you wonder why you and those around you face karma? Why there is so much drama? Why the platform you claim to love is dying on your watch?

You reap what you sow.
You harvest what you plant.
You become what you practice.

## **The Inevitable Reckoning**

As they say: there will always be someone bigger, better, stronger than you.

You cannot win every battle.
And when you are fighting against the truth, you will never win.

We all face judgment day.
You cannot escape it.

Not the judgment of men. But the judgment of the ledger. The judgment of time. The judgment of a universe that records every choice, every action, every intention buried beneath your words.

## **The Final Word**

@themarkymark, @meno, @acidyo, and friends:

LOL.

You pretend to care about Hive. But you farm Hive. You downvote people away. You build walls where bridges should stand. You silence voices where dialogue should flourish.

The blockchain sees.
The users see.
History sees.

And in the end, truth does not shout. It waits. It watches. And eventually, it always wins.

*For in the end, a blockchain is only as strong as the community it serves. And a community is only as free as its most vulnerable voice.*

links.body: 🎭 La llegada de la impostora / The arrival of the impostor\n\nTodo era color de rosa hasta que apareció **Strella**. Ella decía ser la hija perdida. En un abrir y cerrar de ojos, mi habitación matrimonial se convirtió en la suya, y yo fui desterrada al ático frío y polvoriento. \

, me susurró al oído antes de fingir un ataque y culparme ante mis hermanos. El amor que me tenían se evaporó, reemplazado por la duda y el desprecio.\n\n> *Everything was rosy until **Strella** appeared. She claimed to be the lost daughter. In the blink of an eye, my master bedroom became hers, and I was banished to the cold, dusty attic. \

she whispered in my ear before faking an attack and blaming me in front of my brothers. The love they had for me evaporated, replaced by doubt and contempt.*

---

### 🐈 Lucy: El último hilo de luz / Lucy: The last thread of light

Mi único consuelo era Lucy, una gatita que mis hermanos me regalaron. Pero Strella no tenía límites. Un día, Lucy apareció ensangrentada en el patio. \

, dijeron. Pero yo sabía que el mal vivía bajo nuestro techo. Mis hermanos olvidaron mi cumpleaños número 18, celebrando en su lugar el aniversario de mis padres. Fue entonces cuando tomé la decisión: si yo era un \
, me iría, pero no sin antes darles el regalo más grande.\n\n> *My only comfort was Lucy, a kitten my brothers gave me. But Strella had no limits. One day, Lucy appeared bloody in the yard. \
they said. But I knew evil lived under our roof. My brothers forgot my 18th birthday, celebrating my parents' anniversary instead. That's when I made my decision: if I was a \
I would leave, but not before giving them the greatest gift.*\n\n

links.title: The Tale of Mike - ENG- SPA
links.body: > It all started for Mike as a simple hobby, you know, something he enjoyed. He loved editing music and sound. He taught himself to master the software used for these purposes. Sure, he had to watch several tutorials to learn, but the fact that he did all this of his own volition was a clear indication that this was the path he would follow in the future, and that's exactly what happened. He continued learning sound editing on his own until he was 27, when things started to get a bit more serious and he began to significantly improve his skills. He heard that a music studio was looking for new employees. The great thing was that no prior experience was required to be part of the team; you just needed to know how to do the job well, and you would learn everything else from them. This was a fantastic opportunity because other studios required experience for hiring, so this was practically a godsend for him. He quickly went to the studio to apply for the position. At the studio, they saw that he was very young, but what interested them was his ability; everything else was secondary. When he gave them a demonstration of everything he could do, they were completely amazed. They realized that he was perfect for the position because he could use the studio's audio editing software with his eyes closed. He had acquired this skill since childhood because he had been practicing it for a long time.

> Todo comenzó para Mike siendo parte de un simple pasatiempo, ya sabes lo normal, algo que te gusta. Le encantaba editar música y sonido. Aprendió solo a dominar los programas que se usaban para estos fines. Claro, tuvo que ver varios tutoriales para poder aprender, pero el hecho de que hiciera todo esto por voluntad propia ya era un claro indicador de que por ahí iban a ir los tiros en el futuro y justo así fue. Continuó aprendiendo edición de sonido de forma autodidacta hasta los 27 años hasta que la cosa empezó a ponerse un poco más seria y se puede decir que empezó a subir mucho el nivel. El se enteró de que en un estudio musical estaba buscando empleados nuevos. Lo bueno es que no podían experiencia previa para poder ser parte del equipo, solo era saber hacer bien el trabajo y lo demás lo ganabas con ellos. Esa opción era genial porque los demás estudios pedían experiencia para contratar, así que esto fue casi como caído del cielo mismo para el. Fue rápidamente para el estudio para ofrecerse para el puesto. En el estudio vieron que era muy joven pero a ellos lo que les interesaba era ver habilidad, lo demás era secundario. Cuando él les hizo una demostración de todo lo que podía hacer se quedaron de lo más sorprendidos. Se dieron cuenta de que el era perfecto para el puesto porque sabía usar los programas de edición de audio del estudio con los ojos cerrados. Esta habilidad la había ganado desde pequeño porque la venía practicando desde hacía mucho.
![troy-t-dX76Mts-LVM-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23xUm4ZnQ2sah71teGFYQNofr2UzCeoxvojrhKyyVfx2nEcKq8nkQEr4PwLimVC6TbpXi.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Well, that one meeting was all it took for them to give him the job. They gave him a few days to adjust, but the following week he started working full time. He began doing the typical audio editing, but as time went on, he gained more responsibility within the studio and started doing the most important work. Everyone who knew him was very proud of him because they saw that he started from the bottom and now he was where many wanted to be, doing what he loved. At that time, Mike was very grateful for his life and for everything he had achieved. In a way, he even felt privileged compared to the average person doing the same thing as him, and the many who just wanted to work. And he had managed to get hired easily and even hold good positions within the studio—what more could he ask for? This studio had fulfilled his dreams and had opened the doors to freedom in music. It was curious to see that just ten years after joining the studio, he was going to change his mind. No one would have imagined it, since most people thought he'd always be happy there. That was true to some extent, but not entirely. He had a good position at the studio, earned a decent wage, and in some ways, had even improved himself a bit. Furthermore, everyone treated him well, and he got along well with his colleagues. From the outside, it seemed like there were no problems, but there were.

> Pues nada, con solo ese encuentro bastó para que le dieran el puesto. Le dieron unos días de adaptación pero la próxima semana empezó con todas las de la ley a trabajar. Empezó haciendo lo típico ediciones de audio, pero luego con el pasar del tiempo el obtuvo más peso dentro del estudio y empezó a hacer los trabajos más importantes. Todos los que lo conocían estaban muy orgullosos de él, porque vieron que empezó desde abajo y ahora estaba donde muchos querían llegar, haciendo lo que te gusta. En ese entonces Mike estaba muy agradecido con su vida y con todo lo que había logrado, de cierta forma hasta sentía que era privilegiado por encima de la media que hacía lo mismo que él, y los muchos que deseaban siquiera trabajar. Y el ahí había conseguido ser contratado con facilidad y hasta ocupar buenos puestos dentro del estudio que más se podía pedir. Este estudio le había cumplido sus sueños, y le había abierto las puertas de la libertada en la música. Fue curioso ver que tan solo unos 10 años después de haber entrado al estudio iba a cambiar de opinión, nadie lo hubiera imaginado, pues la mayoría pensaban que el siempre estaría a gusto del estudio. Eso en cierta forma era verdad, pero no del todo. Haber él tenía un buen puesto en el estudio, ganaba bastante y de cierta forma hasta se había superado un poco. Además todos lo trataban bien y se llevaba bien con los demás compañeros. Por fuera parecía que no había ningún tipo de problema pero si lo había.
![nik-shuliahin-BuNWp1bL0nc-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tbGxD3eFd5ADJtc93ULVeAXozFFegVorGFAEUfUkASfFYfHztw1FeoV8MFS6gXmUXv7.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> The thing was, he'd already been in the same studio for 10 years. It seemed like only yesterday he'd started, but it was a long time. During those years, although he'd made professional progress, he felt very empty, as if he wasn't achieving anything. He was stuck in the same place. No one knew his name in the music world, and he was barely talked about. The studio, though it had helped him at the beginning, was now a prison that had closed the doors of music to him. That was because he hadn't taken off in time, since that was only one stage of his life on his rise to music. Because of all these feelings, he decided to leave his music career the way he'd been doing it until then. It wasn't an easy decision because several of his colleagues told him not to leave, and they got along very well. But he couldn't continue living like that without feeling that music truly moved him. So he left his position at the studio, but he did so amicably, with the option of returning someday if necessary. From there, after leaving his job at the studio, a new chapter in his musical life began. He became a DJ. It was more of the same as before, but now in front of an audience. He could feel the energy of the crowd and connect with them. He could also develop his musical identity because more people would mention him. It will be a very beautiful stage ahead. And he doesn't regret his past at all. It's true that he took a while to react, but that part of his life served its purpose, and that's what matters.

> Lo que pasaba es que el ya llevaba 10 en el mismo estudio, parecía que había sido ayer que había comenzado pero era mucho tiempo. En esos años aunque había avanzado profesionalmente el se sentía muy vacio, como si no estuviera logrando nada. Estaba estancado en el mismo lugar. Su nombre en la música nadie lo conocía y a penas se hablaba de él. El estudio aunque si lo ayudó al comienzo ahora era una cárcel que le había cerrado las puertas de la música. Eso fue porque él no supo despegar a tiempo, ya que aquella solo sería una etapa de su vida en el ascenso hacia la música. Por todos estos sentimientos que sentía decidió dejar su carrera en la música de la forma en la que lo había estado haciendo hasta ahora. No fue una decisión fácil porque varios de sus compañeros le decían que no se fuera, y ellos se llevaban muy bien. Pero no podía seguir viviendo de ese modo sin sentir que la música de verdad lo movía. Así que dejó su puesto en el estudio pero lo hizo en un contexto amable y con la opción de volver algún día si fuera necesario. A partir de ahí luego de dejar su trabajo en el estudio empezó una nueva etapa en su vida musical. Se convirtió en DJ. Era más de lo mismo de lo que hacía antes pero ahora al frente del público. Podía sentir la energía de la gente y estar en contacto con ellos. Además podía hacer crecer su personalidad en la música pues más personas lo mencionarían. Será una muy bella etapa la que se viene. Y no se arrepiente para nada de su pasado, es cierto que tardó un poco en reaccionar, pero esa parte de su vida cumplió su propósito, y eso es lo que vale.
![alfonso-scarpa-2LGx4cQAMks-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23yJ4188jT1vZExV9NscMyxSSGY7VbUHQBm2xVBJdDXQmMpNNkPndNp8qZfpwC2jdd2dy.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> This post is completely original and my own. No programs have been used to edit the text or correct the grammar. I wrote it exactly as you read it. The English version was translated using Google Translate. Esta publicación es completamente original, y de mi autoría. NO se han usado programas para modificar el texto o para reparar la gramática. Tal cual lo lees así lo escribí. La versión en ingles fue traducida usando Google traductor.

links.body:
cover y separadors etiquetas traducción maquetación
![portafa.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23tRqtUaRiKQrbgfsHc8kWoFv6EZazNk4e5L1f3no3ehLy3u72XSi4XbBbaR5d91VWZZh.png)
English (Click here!)

> Many thanks to @avdesing and #ZDE for this month's initiative: [A Nightmare, a Disturbing Story on Spooky Zone! 😱 Initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/una-pesadilla-un-relato-perturbador-en-spooky-zone-iniciativa-es-en) On this occasion and as part of this initiative, I present a story based on real events. An event I witnessed firsthand. Since I’m running very short on time for this initiative, I’m only going to invite @manclar, who hasn’t posted in a long time, in case he feels like getting back into posting. I invite the rest of the community to participate in the next initiative. Even though I don’t know what it is yet, I’m sure it will be very interesting as well.

> Muchas gracias a @avdesing y a #ZDE por la iniciativa de este mes: [¡Una pesadilla, un relato perturbador en Spooky Zone! 😱 Iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-196487/@zonadeescalofrio/una-pesadilla-un-relato-perturbador-en-spooky-zone-iniciativa-es-en) En esta ocasión y con motivo de esta iniciativa presento una historia basada en hechos reales. Un suceso del que he sido un testigo de primera mano. Como llego muy apurado de tiempo a esta iniciativa sólo voy a invitar a @manclar, que hace mucho que no publica, por si se anima a retomar las publicaciones. Al resto de la comnunidad la invito a participar en la próxima iniciativa. Que a aunque la desconozco, seguro que tendrá también mucho interés.
![separadosr freud.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23uEqtUwTKgu9zAvPUc8ggvP8evpoZQcGivEhuEjGtaQKMGRPCxL7WaJkT5zBBriC1grJ.png)
# 4 : 44
English (Click here!)

> Ten minutes into the session, something—a hunch—told me that this course of psychotherapy might take a very unusual turn. It wasn’t a conclusion I reached through the usual process of observation. It wasn’t his muffled, melancholic voice, nor the look of terror on his face, nor his dirty, unkempt clothes, nor his hands, clinging like claws to the black leather of the couch… ...The first sign of the likely arrival of the peculiar was the request. The patient had come to the office because of a dream… A dream! Usually, patients who come to my surgery have already consulted the AI. They then arrive with their diagnosis (the one provided by the AI) and ask me for the appropriate treatment for what they believe is wrong with them. It’s just another sign of the daft times we live in.. So seeking help for a dream was entirely outside the realm of “normality.” As the course of treatment progressed, the peculiar nature of the case became increasingly apparent. In that first session, it became clear that my patient’s life was sinking into darkness, into an abyss that seemed to have no bottom. He tells me that every night, at 4:44 a.m., he wakes up terrified by the same dream experience. According to him, he finds himself in a white room with no doors or windows, sitting on the only piece of furniture in the room, an old wicker chair. Suddenly, sharp knocks make the room shake. At that moment, he wakes up and is unable to fall back asleep for the rest of the night. The lack of sleep, as he explained to me, was dragging him down into a deep, dark pit. He felt tired, irritable… empty… losing all will to live.

> Transcurridos los diez primeros minutos de consulta, algo, un pálpito, me decía que el curso de la psicoterapia podía volverse muy particular. Una deducción a la que no llegué por la vía habitual de la observación. No fue su voz apagada y melancólica, ni la expresión de pavor de su rostro, ni su vestimenta sucia y descuidada, ni sus manos, aferradas como garras al cuero negro del diván… ...El primer signo de la probable llegada de los peculiar fue la demanda. El paciente venía a consulta por un sueño… ¡Un sueño! Habitualmente, los pacientes que acuden a mí despacho previamente ya han interrogado a la IA. Después, llegan con su diagnóstico (el de la IA) y me solicitan las pautas adecuadas para lo que ellos cree que les ocurre. Es sólo un signo más del tiempo idiota en el que vivimos. Por lo que solicitar ayuda por un sueño se salía enteramente de la “normalidad”. Con el curso del tratamiento se fue haciendo cada vez más palpable lo particular del caso. En esa primera sesión, quedó claro que la vida de mi paciente se estaba hundiendo en la oscuridad, en un abismo que no parecía tener fondo. Me informa que todas las noches, a las 4:44 se despierta aterrado ante la misma vivencia onírica. Según refiere, se encuentra en una habitación blanca sin puertas ni ventanas, sentado sobre el único mueble en la estancia, una vieja silla de mimbre. De pronto, unos golpes secos hacen temblar la estancia. En ese momento despierta sin poder recobrar el sueño en toda la noche. La falta de sueño, según me explicaba, le estaba hundiendo en un gran pozo negro. Se encontraba cansado, irritable… vacío… perdiendo todo ánimo de vivir.
![separadosr freud.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23uEqtUwTKgu9zAvPUc8ggvP8evpoZQcGivEhuEjGtaQKMGRPCxL7WaJkT5zBBriC1grJ.png)
English (Click here!)

> During the first few sessions, I tried to reassure my new patient. I explained that dreams are very important, that they can have different meanings and purposes. Some may indicate a health problem, some are premonitory, and others are messages from the unconscious… But in order to work with them, I first needed to get to know him. Once the evaluation was complete—after conducting a thorough interview and administering several tests—I had my strategy ready to address the issue at hand. My plan was clear, and I explained it to this suffering man. His father had passed away only a few months earlier, so I thought that the nightmare of that white room might simply be an expression of that grief. Perhaps a manifestation of emotions like guilt or anger. With this idea in mind, we began to work. I explained to him that this violent being, who apparently was on the other side of the room in the dream, might be a part of himself. We began to address the dream by working with the body. # - *Imagine you are that being that strikes. What part of the body would you be?* - *The fist, he replied.* - *What does it feel? * - *Anger, he said without hesitation.* # At the end of the session, it seemed we hadn’t made any progress. However, the nightmare transformed.

> En las primeras sesiones traté de calmar a mi nuevo paciente. Le expliqué que los sueños son muy importantes, que pueden tener distintos significados y propósitos. Algunos nos pueden informar de algún problema de salud, los hay premonitorios, otros son mensajes del inconsciente… Pero que para trabajar con ellos primero tenía que conocerle. Terminada la evaluación, tras realizar una entrevista exhaustiva y pasar varias pruebas, ya tenía preparada mi estrategia para abordar la demanda planteada. La planificación la tenía clara y así se lo expliqué a este hombre sufriente. Hacía sólo unos meses que había fallecido su padre, por lo que pensé que la pesadilla de aquella habitación blanca podía ser sólo una expresión de ese duelo. Quizás una manifestación de emociones como la culpa o la rabia. Con esta idea comenzamos a trabajar. Le expliqué que ese ser violento, que aparentemente se encontraba al otro lado de la habitación del sueño, quizás pudiera ser una parte de él mismo. Comenzamos a abordar el sueño trabajando con el cuerpo. # - *Imagínate que eres ese ser que golpea. ¿Qué parte del cuerpo serías?* - *El puño- contestó.* - *¿Qué siente?* - *Ira- dijo sin vacilar.* # Al finalizar la sesión, aparentemente, no habíamos avanzado nada. Sin embargo, la pesadilla se transformó.
![separadosr freud.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23uEqtUwTKgu9zAvPUc8ggvP8evpoZQcGivEhuEjGtaQKMGRPCxL7WaJkT5zBBriC1grJ.png)
English (Click here!)

> That night, he didn’t feel alone inside the white room. He was drinking a soda in what looked like the dining hall of a huge spaceship. Surrounded by other people sitting at the nearby tables, he felt at ease. From where he sat, he could see the stars shining in the darkness through a large window. At a certain moment, the tiny stars transformed into what looked like thousands upon thousands of enormous insects with metallic bodies and sharp claws. Creatures that crashed at high speed against the glass, causing a tremendous roar… the restaurant eventually became the scene of a massive bloodbath. We continued trying to unravel the meaning of the nightmare using different techniques, without any progress. On the contrary, the nightmare grew more violent and terrifying with each passing night. The dream gradually changed until the most dreaded event finally occurred. One early morning, millions of hungry insects broke through the transparent barrier, swarming over everyone present—women, men, and children. Amid screams, despair, and blood, my patient awoke. The physical deterioration between sessions was becoming increasingly evident. However, this did not break the team we had formed. The time had come to change our strategy.

> Esa noche, no se vio en soledad dentro la habitación blanca. Se encontraba tomando un refresco en lo que parecía el restaurante de una gran nave espacial. Rodeado de otras personas que ocupaban las mesas de alrededor, se sentía tranquilo. Desde su lugar podía ver, a través de un gran ventanal, las estrellas brillando en la oscuridad. En un determinado momento, los pequeños astros se transformaron en lo que parecían miles y miles de enormes insectos con cuerpo metálico y garras afiladas. Seres que se estrellaban a gran velocidad contra la cristalera provocando un gran estruendo… el restaurante terminó por convertirse en el escenario de una gigantesca carnicería. Continuamos tratando de desentrañar el sentido de la pesadilla con diferentes técnicas, sin progreso alguno. Al contrario, la pesadilla se volvía cada noche más violenta y terrorífica. El sueño fue cambiando hasta que lo más temido, por fin ocurrió. Una madrugada, millones de insectos hambrientos traspasaron la transparente barrera saltando sobre todos los presentes mujeres, hombres o niños. Entre gritos, desesperación y sangre despertó mi paciente. El deterioro físico entre sesión y sesión era cada vez más evidente. Sin embargo, ésto no quebró el equipo que habíamos formado. LLegó el momento de cambiar de estrategia. En sesión trabajamos la posibilidad de cambiar el sueño a voluntad. El escenario sería el siguiente: cuando llegaran los monstruos él, como todas las personas que lo acompañaban en la nave espacial, estarían armados. Podrían defenderse.
![separadosr freud.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23uEqtUwTKgu9zAvPUc8ggvP8evpoZQcGivEhuEjGtaQKMGRPCxL7WaJkT5zBBriC1grJ.png)
English (Click here!)

> During the session, we explored the possibility of changing the dream at will. The scenario would be as follows: when the monsters arrived, he—like everyone else on the spaceship—would be armed. They would be able to defend themselves. The following night, he dreamed that, armed with a huge laser rifle, he was waiting for the insects to attack. When the windows shattered, the shooting began… the result was horrific. It was the first dream in which he saw himself dying, devoured by a swarm of monsters. In the next dream, he heard a voice that said to him: # - *Trust me. Embrace them… they’re just afraid.* # He saw himself opening his arms… the dream ended. He opened his eyes. Something remained the same; it was 4:44 a.m. He didn’t know it, but at that moment, something totally unexpected was beginning. The dreams changed radically. In one of them, he transformed into an insect or perhaps an arachnid. At ground level, he watched intently as the ants moved through the undergrowth, while in the background a harsh, intermittent “shhh” could be heard. Suddenly, the landscape grew dark, very dark. Fear woke him up—or so he thought, for he was still in the dream. He heard the same voice repeating once more: # - *Trust me. * # He listened intently and let himself die. For the first time in many weeks, he woke up calm, without fear. He continued going to his appointments… though I’ve never really known why.

> La siguiente noche, soñó como armado con un enorme fusil láser esperaba el ataque de los insectos. Cuando reventaron los cristales comenzaron los disparos… el resultado fue horrible. Era el primer sueño en el que se veía morir devorado por un enjambre de monstruos. En el siguiente episodio onírico escuchó una voz que le dijo: # - *Confía en mí. Abrázalos… solo tienen miedo.* # Se vio abriendo los brazos… el sueño cesó. Abrió los ojos. Algo seguía igual, eran la 4: 44 am. No lo sabía, pero en ese momento, algo totalmente inesperado comenzaba. Los sueños cambiaron de forma radical. En uno de ellos, se transformó en un insecto o quizás en un arácnido. A ras de suelo observaba con atención como las hormigas se movían por la maleza, mientras de fondo se escuchaba un “shhh” áspero e intermitente. De pronto, el paisaje se volvió oscuro, muy oscuro. El miedo le despertó, o eso creyó, pues seguía en el sueño. Escuchó la misma voz que de nuevo repetía: # - *Confía en mi.* # Escuchó con atención y se dejó morir. Por primera vez en muchas semanas, se despertó sereno, sin miedo. Continuó acudiendo a consulta… aunque nunca he sabido´muy bien el por qué.
![separadosr freud.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enraizar/23uEqtUwTKgu9zAvPUc8ggvP8evpoZQcGivEhuEjGtaQKMGRPCxL7WaJkT5zBBriC1grJ.png)
English (Click here!)

>


Another night, lying in the dark, he felt a heavy weight on his body. As if something furry were settling down on top of him.

The nightly visits continued. He was able to identify the creature that accompanied him in his dreams as a giant spider—an arthropod that could speak to him.

On one occasion, my patient heard:

- *You will be mentioned.* 

We continued with the sessions for a while, until the last one arrived. There was no feedback from me; in fact, for a long time I hadn’t known what was happening or what my role was in this process.

What did happen was a final \
from someone who had once sought help. On that last occasion, he shared with me the last words he had heard in his dreams: - *You have already been seen. I see you and I am with you*...

> Otra noche, acostado y a oscuras, notó un gran peso sobre su cuerpo. Como si algo peludo se acomodara sobre él. Las visitas nocturnas continuaron. Pudo Identificar a ese ser que lo acompañaba en sueños como una gran araña. Un artrópodo que podía hablarle. En una ocasión, mi paciente escuchó: - *Serás mencionado.* Continuamos con las sesiones un tiempo, hasta que llegó la última. No hubo devolución alguna por mi parte, de hecho hacía mucho tiempo que no sabía ni qué estaba ocurriendo ni cual era mi papel en este proceso. Lo que si hubo fue un último “informe” del que en su día fue una persona demandante de ayuda. En esa última ocasión me compartió las últimas palabras que había escuchado en sueños: # - *Ya has sido visto. Te veo y te acompaño...* #
#
