links.title: PC World (October 1996)
links.body:
>
Cover of the October 1996 issue of PC World
The mid 1990s was an exciting time for the PC industry. PCs were rapidly being adopted with nearly everyone having one by 2000. The Internet was just becoming mainstream and that's the biggest part of what drove adoption. The October 1996 issue of PC World includes:

Cover Story

  • The Complete Guide to Free Online Help - Information about web sites, newsgroups, file libraries, and a number of other online sources for getting technical help for free.

Features

  • Internet Overload: Disaster In The Making? - Gloom and doom predictions about the Internet being overloaded never really came to pass...well, except for the occasional DDOS attack.

  • Office In A Box - A look at combo devices that include printing, scanning, faxing, and copying functions. Though most printers have those functions now, this was still early days for such devices. Models looked at here include the Canon MultiPass C2500, HP OfficeJet 350, JetFax 4, Ricoh MV74, Sharp F-2700M, and Xerox Document WorkCenter 250. Prices range from $549 to $1195.

  • Do It All! Tips For Mastering Your Office Suite - Tips for getting the most out of Microsoft Office, Lotus SmartSuite, and Corel WordPerfect Suite.

Special Report

  • Top 10 Network Servers - At the top of the Workgroup Servers list is the Compaq ProLiant 1500 Model 5/133-2100 for $7555. At the top of the Enterprise Servers list is the HP NetServer 5/166 LS4 for $20,238.

Multimedia

  • 20 CD-ROMs Under $25 - Some titles in this list include Full Throttle, Rebel Assault, Civilization, Simcity Classic, Blockbuster Guide to Movies & Videos, Bernard of Hollywood's Pin-Ups, World's Greatest Classic Books, and more.

  • Title Reviews - Reviews of Hind and Longbow helicopter combat sim and Guerilla Marketing.

  • Hardware Reviews - A look at the top five CD-ROM drives (Plextor 8Plex, NEC MultiSpin 6V, Sony CSD-880E, Teac CD-58E 8X CD-ROM Drive Kit, and GoldStar GCD-R580B) and sound cards (Creative Labs Sound Blaster AWE32 PnP, CrystalLake Model 110, Creative Labs Sound Blaster 32, CrystalLake Model 140, and Advanced Gravis UltraSound Plug & Play Pro).

  • Q&A - Questions answered about improving video playback, multisession CD support, creating a screensaver, and more.

>
Table of Contents from the October 1996 issue of PC World

Top of the News

  • How To Get What You Want In Your New PC - PC manufacturers would often use multiple sources for parts so specific parts could vary even on the same model PC. Another common practice was (and still is as far as I know) to use cut down versions of retail parts. This isn't always a bad thing as you could generally get a great deal on something that performed only slightly less well than top end retail components.

  • App Suites Abandon One-Size-Fits-All For Custom Tailoring - For instance, Microsoft, starting with Office 97, will offer three different versions (standard, professional, and small business) and the ability to add applets.

  • Broadcasters Use TV Signals To Send Data - There was this idea that people would want to watch TV split screen with a related web page. This never really caught on...though these days people will scroll on their phones while watching TV.

  • Upgrades to NT Server And Netware Include Web Setup Features - Windows NT 4.0 includes Internet Information Server 2.0 while NetWare 4.11 includes Novell's NetWare Web Server.

>
Table of Contents from the October 1996 issue of PC World (continued)

New Products

  • Compaq Presario 6708 - This PC includes a Pentium 200, combination keyboard/scanner, 33.6 fax modem, 32MB RAM, 2.5 GB hard drive, 64-bit video card with 2MB of DRAM, 15-inch monitor, and more for $3547.

  • Dell Dimension P200V - This PC includes a Pentium 200, 33.6 fax modem, 16MB RAM, 1.6 GB hard drive, 64-bit video card with 2MB of DRAM, 15-inch monitor, and more for $1999.

  • NEC Versa 4200 Series - This notebook features a 100 or 133-MHz CPUj, 810MB or 1.08GB hard drive, a 10.4-inch screen that displays 256 colors, and 6X CD-ROM drive for %2999-$3899.

  • Olivetti Echos - This line features four models ranging from the $2299 Pentium 100 to the $4599 Pentium 133 with all including a 1.3GB hard drive and 6X CD-ROM drives and feature screens from an 11.3-inch dual-scan to a 11.8-inch TFT.

  • TI TravelMate 6000 Series Notebooks - The 6020 ($4199) features a Pentium 120, 8MB of RAM, 1.08GB hard drive, and 11.3-inchd display. The 6030 ($4999) features a Pentium 133, 16MB of RAM, 1.35GB hard drive, and 12.1-inch SVGA display. The 6050 ($5499) is similar but features a Pentium 150.

  • Mitsubishi DiamondPro 91TXM Monitor - Large CRT monitors could be extraordinarily expensive. This 21-inch monitor Mitsubishi was $1899...and good luck lifting it.

  • AV Master Video Capture Board - This $999 video capture board could capture 640x480 video at 30 frames per second.

  • Broadway MPEG-1 Video Capture Board - MPEG-1 was the best video compression available at the time. This MPEG-1 capture card would set you back $995.

>
Table of Contents from the October 1996 issue of PC World (continued)

Top 100

  • Power Desktops - The top PC in this list is the Dell Dimension XPS P200s for $3329 featuring 16MB RAM, 512K secondary cache, 2.6GB hard drive, Number Nine Imagine 128 Series 2 graphics adapter with 4MB VRAM, and more.

  • Budget Desktops - The top PC in this list is the Micron P133 Millennia for $2049 featuring a Pentium 133, 16MB RAM, 2.1 GB hard drive, Diamon Stealth64 graphics adapter with 2MB VRAM, 15-inch monitor, and more.

  • Notebooks - The top power notebook is the Dell Latitude LM P133ST for $3999 featuring a Pentium 133, 16MB RAM, 810MB hard drive, 12.1-inch 800x600 256 color screen, and more. The top budget notebook is the Toshiba Satellite 100CS for $1799 featuring a Pentium 75, 8MB RAM, 540MB hard drive, 10.4-inch 640x480 256 color screen, and more.

  • Top 10 Personal Printers - The top monochrome printer is the Panasonic KX-P6100 for $379 and the top color printer is the HP DeskJet 820Cse for $389.

  • Top 10 15-inch Monitors - The top monitor in this list is the Samsung SyncMaster 15GLi for $408.

  • Top 10 Graphics Boards - The top graphics board here is the VideoLogic GrafixStar 600 for $159.

  • Top 10 Modems - The top external modem is the U.S. Robotics Courier V.Everything V.34. The Courier line were always the best you could get. The top internal modem is the Zoom V.34C for $199. Modems at this time topped out at 33.6 Kbps.

Here's How

  • Answer Line - Questions answered about memory management in Windows 95, using the same e-mail account at home and at work, restoring DOS after removing OS/2, and more.

  • Internet Tips - How to find special interest mailing lists, making web sites more permanent, and more.

  • Hardware Tips - Tips for saving space on FAT drives.

  • Upgrade Guide - A detailed guide for replacing your EIDE hard drive.

At Home

  • Internet Meets The Couch Potato - For a brief moment in time, everybody thought you would be surfing the net via your TV and some sort of internet appliance. While you can certainly do that today, the idea never really took off. Surfing the net was done via desktop, laptop, and later on the smartphone.

  • Top 5 Home PCs - The top \

is the Gateway 2000 P5-166 Family PC featuring a Pentium 166, 16MB RAM, 2.5GB hard drive, 8x CD-ROM drive, 28.8 kbps fax modem, and more for $2444.

Departments

  • Up Front - What happens when what you do depends on the Internet and the Internet isn't working? Still a problem today...

  • Letters - Letters from readers about the best internet browser, Windows 95, free speech online, Compuserve, and more.

  • Consumer Watch - Packard Bell had a policy of putting parts from returned PCs into PCs sold as new but they weren't the only ones.

  • PCW Advocate - Problems with IDT ISP, Sharp battery issues, Packard Bell tech support, and more.

  • Full Disclosure - How new software is often released in beta form...or worse.

>
Back cover of the October 1996 issue of PC World
...and more! --- Check out some of my other recent posts: Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (273-276) https://ecency.com/@darth-azrael/vintage-photos-lot-6-273 Computer Shopper (April 1996) https://ecency.com/@darth-azrael/computer-shopper-april-1996 Vintage Photos - Lot 6 (269-272) https://ecency.com/@darth-azrael/vintage-photos-lot-6-269 Three Tune Tuesday: The most 80s 80s Songs https://ecency.com/@darth-azrael/three-tune-tuesday-the-most ---

links.title: Spoil The Kids.  Spoil The World
links.body:
I won't lie, I still believe strongly in the importance of physical punishment in raising kids because it worked very well during the olden days and during the time I was raised as a child. The only thing I now frown at is how it was done heavily and harshly in those days without proper understanding. Just imagine a situation in school where school fees were to be collected by teachers and they decided to flog the students mercilessly when they fully knew that these children did not have the capacity to pay the school fees by themselves. They chose to use physical beating to pass the message across to their parents. I passed through this myself, and I know how scary it was for us in those days. This is one of the wrong uses of physical punishment that was applauded back then.

But when it comes to the normal and casual physical punishment parents give their children at home, I think that a lot has really gone wrong since the world started implementing the “no punishment” approach in homes. Maybe I haven't moved around enough, but I have seen children of this age behave as if they have no parents controlling them, and it baffles me a lot.

I used to have a family as neighbours, though not direct neighbours. They only had a shop close to us, and they spent most of their day around us. The husband is somehow educated, a policeman, while the woman is a typical village-brought-up woman. She liked using physical punishment to correct her kids, but the dad was never in support of it. Because he was not always around due to his job, anytime she beat the children and he happened to find out, maybe through the children, he would call and rain fire and brimstone. The woman just had to stop because it had led to a lot of fights between them.

Guess what? The eldest child, a boy in his late teens, has dropped out of school and gone into the now very common *yahoo(internet fraud)*. It is not like the money to cater for his education was not there. The money was available because the dad is a salary earner and the mum owns a shop that brings in money for them. He slipped completely out of their control, and the soft and calm warnings the mom later adapted to, did nothing to him. The worst part is that fraudulent activities are now becoming very common and somehow accepted in our society, so parents just let their children be and continue sleeping outside the house.

I am not wishing him or the family bad luck, but with the path he is following, there is a lot of doom ahead, and he needs the positive side of life to help him. 

I am not saying that children of those days who were raised with physical punishment did not go astray; they did, but it was more limited. And before they could completely get out of hand, it was possible that the parents must have really tried their best with a note of 'panel beating'. Lol

Those beatings in those days had a way of resetting our \

and pushing us away from evil.


# Is this affecting the world at large?

Of course it is!

It gives me a headache whenever I remember that we are really adopting the foreign culture not knowing that their lifestyle and environment are totally different from ours.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdahn95VHzfccqwfiztekmxodGmU1u6hsiLbipnrFKzag/1002550172.jpg


Imagine the situation where a boy of 14 years is already bringing his girlfriend home to pass the night and all the parents could do is just to sit the boy down and try to give him s3x education.  And this continues until the girl gets pregnant and ...

Let me stop here.

Thanks for reading.

[Photo](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/black-girl-with-sadness-emotion_2766007.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=0&uuid=e433932d-242f-4d2d-9853-90534b720a91&query=parenting.+physical+punishment)

links.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
links.body:
Slow Day, But Still Moving 🚶‍♂️ Some days are full of energy, and some days are just slow. Today honestly felt like one of those lazy and tired days for me. I did not go outside too much, and most of the time I stayed at home trying to relax my mind a little. Even though my activity was low, I still tried not to sit all day completely. In the evening, I walked a little around the street near my home. The weather was not too hot today, so that small walk actually felt peaceful. Sometimes a short walk helps more mentally than physically. I think many people only post big achievements or high step counts, but real life is not always like that. Some days our body feels weak, sometimes the mind feels heavy, and sometimes we simply need rest. I am learning that consistency matters more than perfection. While walking, I noticed small things around me. Kids were playing cricket in the street, one old man was sitting outside his shop drinking tea, and a cool breeze started coming after sunset. These small moments honestly make ordinary days feel better. My step count today was not impressive, but at least I moved a little instead of staying in bed the whole day. Slowly slowly I want to improve my routine again because health is something we usually ignore until the body starts giving warnings. I also spent some time checking crypto markets and reading a few posts online. The market still looks uncertain these days, and many people seem confused about where things are going. But just like fitness, I think patience is important there too. Anyway, this was my simple low-activity day. Nothing special, nothing fancy, just a normal real day from my side. Hopefully tomorrow will be more active and productive.

links.title: MY SAFEHEAVEN LOH #290
links.body: > My Safe Haven Isn’t a Person, It’s Writing When it comes to having a safe haven, many people immediately think of a person, someone they can run to, talk to, cry with, or simply sit beside in silence. And honestly, that’s beautiful. Having a human safe space is a gift. But for someone like me? My safe haven has never really been a person. Now before you jump to conclusions and label me an introvert which people love doing, by the way. Let me defend myself 😅. I wouldn’t exactly call myself an introvert. I simply love my privacy. There’s a difference. Okay... maybe a tiny difference 😂. Truth be told, I’m not always the best with people, and maybe that’s part of the reason. Human beings are beautifully complex, but they can also be exhausting. People judge, misunderstand, gossip, interrupt, or sometimes simply fail to understand what you’re trying to say. Writing, on the other hand, does none of that. Words don’t judge me. My ink doesn’t gossip. My writing pad doesn’t get tired of my endless rants. It doesn’t roll its eyes when I complain for the hundredth time about the same thing. ![kaitlyn-baker-vZJdYl5JVXY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugenia7499/23tvYHStZxKTbowTHi5RK5dL3x1A56pKYRjy5QJzMRtSCu3Qeh9dbqfcX38myDwVmhQur.jpg) ***[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-using-laptop-vZJdYl5JVXY)*** It simply listens. Naturally, I’m that one person who, whenever I’m going through any kind of emotional discomfort, frustration, stress, or even excitement, the very first thing that crosses my mind is: “Let me write this down.” Someone once said to me, “You claim you’re not an introvert, but you write down everything even the dog that barked at you on your way back from school.” And honestly? Fair enough 😂. But would you really blame me? Because there’s something magical that happens whenever I pick up my pen. It’s almost as if the stress of the day starts oozing out of my body and into the paper. The words begin to flow, one after another, effortlessly like they had been waiting for me to finally let them out. And then something beautiful happens. The world starts to fade into the background. The noise becomes distant. The pressure eases. The thoughts that once felt heavy suddenly become lighter. And for that moment, it’s just me and my words. No expectations. No explanations. No pretending. Just honesty in its purest form. For some people, healing comes through conversations. They need a friend, a phone call, a shoulder to lean on. And that’s perfectly okay. We all process life differently. But for me? Healing comes through writing. Writing is where I make sense of my chaos. It’s where I untangle emotions I can’t explain out loud. It’s where I meet the most honest version of myself, the one without filters, without fear, without performance. Writing doesn’t just help me express myself; it helps me understand myself. So no, my safe haven isn’t a person. It’s not a place either. It’s the quiet companionship of ink and paper. It’s the comfort of words that never interrupt. It’s the freedom of expression without judgment. And maybe that says a lot about me. Maybe it doesn’t. But one thing is certain, when life becomes overwhelming and the world gets too loud, Eugenia doesn’t run to people first. She reaches for her pen. And that is who I am. I’M EUGENIA.

links.title: Un nuevo espacio, los mismos sueños: ¡Estoy de vuelta! ✨/A new space, the same dreams: I'm back! ✨
links.body:
![photo_2026-05-25_14-37-04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/242hWRwKCW6YqsxvgTRTzSRMjhJcyvhRE4AHMVAf1Lf8TEvWmNsd3FENtUqrAvFhQycB7.jpg)

¡Hola, Tenía muchísimo tiempo con ganas de sentarme a escribirles esto. Si han notado mi ausencia por aquí o en las redes, la razón es que mi vida ha estado llena de movimiento, transiciones y muchísimos cambios en estos últimos meses.

Hoy no les traigo un tutorial paso a paso, ni moldes, ni una nueva manualidad para armar juntos. Hoy vengo a abrirles las puertas de mi corazón y, literalmente, las puertas de mi nuevo taller de manualidades. 🏡🎨

De un pequeño rincón a un gran lienzo en blanco
Quienes me siguen desde hace tiempo saben cuánto amor le ponía a mi trabajo, pero la verdad es que ya el espacio me quedaba pequeño. Estaba trabajando en una habitación de 3x3 metros donde ya casi no cabían mis materiales.


![photo_2026-05-25_14-43-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23xemsmJB3cdYUUanTAt8YhYs4w6CcQpMpxzmZ2pesxEBdGwZjGXR4QXwgZ4nRyA8NfxD.jpg)

Hoy, con mucha emoción y agradecimiento, les cuento que me mudé a un espacio mucho más amplio: la sala de la casa de mi mamá. Ella, con su amor incondicional, me cedió este lugar tan cómodo donde ahora puedo estirar los brazos, organizar mis materiales y trabajar con la comodidad que tanto necesitaba. ¡Gracias, mamá! ❤️


![photo_2026-05-25_14-46-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/242DNtVyEPGMA5nRCvgx4GxcKKkyA8rLSzBM1yfDiCRFRFn3NmyXPeVhkL4GUneb5SkYg.jpg)


Este cambio no lo hice sola. Mi esposo y mi hija, que han sido mi pilar y me apoyan en cada idea loca y en cada paso que doy, nos pusimos manos a la obra. Juntos pintamos las paredes y me ayudaron a colocar repisas nuevas para organizar mis pinturas, herramientas y papelería.


![photo_2026-05-25_14-49-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23xVPAZ8o4ET2LS5aoDz7uvzkNiJa9JbfEqQdmU6gq1TjPfVjLJoGfNaZE927QwNDXJGA.jpg)

Además, tras semanas y meses de ahorro, esfuerzo y mucha disciplina, logré comprar dos grandes aliados para mi trabajo: ¡una impresora nueva y un proyector! 🖨️🎬

Quizás para algunos parezcan herramientas sencillas, pero para un artesano, esto significa optimizar el tiempo, mejorar la precisión de los diseños y dar un salto enorme en la calidad de lo que hago. Cada rollo de papel nuevo, cada herramienta que incorporo es un sueño cumplido.

\

.



![photo_2026-05-25_14-58-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23tvcJhhX2rD3Cm42r7hNb8W57LAcCE9aBjNtDxxdUZkvM9noGn5QdZrbccHdZr2a6RKz.jpg)



Esto es solo el comienzo...
Siento que he avanzado muchísimo y me llena de felicidad poder compartir este pedacito de mi día a día con ustedes. El taller sigue evolucionando, sigo acomodando cositas funcionales y, poco a poco, les iré mostrando más detalles de este rincón que me devuelve la inspiración.

Gracias por la paciencia, por seguir aquí a pesar de la ausencia y por celebrar conmigo cada pequeña gran victoria.


¡Nos leemos muy pronto con más creatividad!

Con mucho amor,
Carmen Arteaga
\

___________________________________________________________________________________________


![photo_2026-05-25_14-37-04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/242hWRwKCW6YqsxvgTRTzSRMjhJcyvhRE4AHMVAf1Lf8TEvWmNsd3FENtUqrAvFhQycB7.jpg)

Hi, I’ve been wanting to sit down and write this to you for ages. If you’ve noticed my absence here or on social media, it’s because my life has been full of activity, transitions, and so many changes over the past few months.

Today I’m not bringing you a step-by-step tutorial, or patterns, or a new craft project to make together. Today I’m here to open the doors of my heart to you—and, literally, the doors of my new craft studio. 🏡🎨

From a small corner to a big blank canvas
Those of you who’ve been following me for a while know how much love I put into my work, but the truth is that the space had become too small for me. I was working in a 3x3-meter room where I could barely fit all my supplies anymore.


![photo_2026-05-25_14-43-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23xemsmJB3cdYUUanTAt8YhYs4w6CcQpMpxzmZ2pesxEBdGwZjGXR4QXwgZ4nRyA8NfxD.jpg)

Today, with great excitement and gratitude, I’m happy to share that I’ve moved into a much larger space: the living room of my mom’s house. With her unconditional love, she gave me this cozy spot where I can now stretch out, organize my supplies, and work in the comfort I’ve been needing so much. Thank you, Mom! ❤️


![photo_2026-05-25_14-46-27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/242DNtVyEPGMA5nRCvgx4GxcKKkyA8rLSzBM1yfDiCRFRFn3NmyXPeVhkL4GUneb5SkYg.jpg)

I didn’t make this change on my own. My husband and my daughter—who have been my rock and support me through every crazy idea and every step I take—rolled up their sleeves and got to work. Together, we painted the walls, and they helped me install new shelves to organize my paints, tools, and stationery.


![photo_2026-05-25_14-49-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23xVPAZ8o4ET2LS5aoDz7uvzkNiJa9JbfEqQdmU6gq1TjPfVjLJoGfNaZE927QwNDXJGA.jpg)

Plus, after weeks and months of saving, hard work, and a lot of discipline, I was finally able to buy two great tools for my work: a new printer and a projector! 🖨️🎬

To some, these may seem like simple tools, but for a craftsman, they mean saving time, improving the precision of my designs, and taking a huge leap forward in the quality of my work. Every new roll of paper, every tool I add, is a dream come true.

“Months of hard work come down to looking at your workspace and feeling that it was worth it not to give up.”

![photo_2026-05-25_14-58-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmenarteaga/23tvcJhhX2rD3Cm42r7hNb8W57LAcCE9aBjNtDxxdUZkvM9noGn5QdZrbccHdZr2a6RKz.jpg)


This is just the beginning...
I feel like I’ve made so much progress, and it fills me with joy to be able to share this little slice of my daily life with you. The studio continues to evolve; I’m still adding little functional touches, and, little by little, I’ll show you more details of this corner that reignites my inspiration.

Thank you for your patience, for sticking around despite my absence, and for celebrating every little big victory with me.


See you very soon with more creativity!

With lots of love,
Carmen Arteaga
“DACH”

links.body:
by @samye2 on Simpson Plays 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/simpsonplays1 [![Sierra 7: Renting Premium Gear ⚙](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/f1139e8e-e8dc-4a47-82e4-85552473b69e.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/tRvLGFizhn3g3Y6vny1MSf)

*****
My intention was not to record this mission rather, it was to record the previous one because the previous was more Inter than this. The previous mission was a two in one mission because I had to clear an area full of enemies just to make way to snipe the main targets.
The first part where I am to clear the area for sniping turned out to be harder than the main mission  which is the sniping, it was so hard till the extent I quit playing the game for two whole days because I felt it was impossible to get pass those people without a grenade or shotgun which I haven't purchased due to low ingame currency.
At last I completed phase one and it was time for phase two, there was nobody fighting back at phase two which was why I said it was easy but at the same time it was tricky. If not for my memory I would have thought it would be also impossible to pass the sniping stage, I fail approximately 5 times before I remember a similar scenario in the sniper training section. The mission was to snipe every enemy in that building without letting any of them notice because if any notice I won't be able to kill all since some would run away so after sniping two enemies which would not alert any other I had to snipe the network dish so one would go check out what stopped the service on the television and that was I was able to snipe them without any noticing. It was a bit of brain 🧠 work there.
This mode would have been harder if I didn't rent a premium gear because there were a lot of soldiers, now what I mean by premium gear.  They are the helmet, suits and the gun loadout I'm holding with the scopes. Well just enjoy the action 🎬 😉. 
*****

links.title: Auszug 😂🌶️🫑🍅
links.body:
![-704546862_18394323301084510_7535024375883616805_n.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSdSziZdzccxH9j5jC4z4XpHfAB2o6BVYULbQFLpvUejH/-704546862_18394323301084510_7535024375883616805_n.jpg)

Gestern sind Tomaten, Paprika und Peperoni ausgezogen. Wie jedes Jahr vorher nicht abgehärtet, dafür sind es zu viele Pflanzen und ich habe einfach keine Zeit das alles täglich rein und raus zu schleppen.
Das hat jedes Jahr gut funktioniert, 2-3 Tage bleiben sie noch stehen und dann wird gepflanzt. Meine einzige Sorge sind nun die Schnecken, die fallen jedes Jahr zuverlässig über die Paprika her sobald sie ausgepflanzt sind 😣.
Obwohl in der Anfangszeit viele Paprika und Peperoni der Umfallkrankheit zum Opfer gefallen sind, sind es tatsächlich immer noch rund 130 Pflanzen, die irgendwie untergebracht werden müssen 🤣. Einiges an Peperoni Pflanzen geht zwar noch an den Freund der Tochter, aber selbst dann ist es noch reichlich.
Tomatenpflanzen habe ich nicht mehr gezählt, aber so um den Dreh 180 Pflanzen dürften es sein.
Und das Beste, dieses Jahr nicht eine einzige Laus bei Paprika und Peperoni 😍. Dafür ist mein Mann verantwortlich, der hat sich diesbezüglich sehr gut gekümmert.
Er hat die Pflanzen regelmäßig besprüht mit einer Natron Lösung. Auf ein Liter Wasser ein Esslöffel Natron und ein kleiner Schuss Kombutscha, alternativ Essig.
Zudem hat er auf der Erde etwas Natron verteilt, das hat die Mengen Trauermücken etwas reduziert.

![-703612831_18394323310084510_6263688315848626834_n_1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXPHKFSPsFrYr2RXp8r1isNyjTz6dkwhaejmcsVNzZEHZ/703612831_18394323310084510_6263688315848626834_n_1.jpg)

Einen schönen Tag wünsche ich euch allen 💖.

The NBA Conference Finals have entered their most critical phase. Between May 21 and 24, 2026, the action on both coasts of the United States demonstrated why tactical details and mental consistency determine who survives and who crumbles in the playoffs. While the New York Knicks put a confused Cleveland Cavaliers team on the ropes, in the West the series between the Oklahoma City Thunder and the San Antonio Spurs turned into a high-intensity strategic back-and-forth.

🗽 Eastern Conference: The Knicks impose their will and smell the Finals

Game 2 (May 21): Knicks 109 - 93 Cavaliers (NYK leads 2-0)

Cleveland arrived at Madison Square Garden with the urgency to tighten their defense on Jalen Brunson, but the Cavs’ defensive plan once again fell apart in crunch time. Although Donovan Mitchell (26 pts) and James Harden (18 pts) kept the game close in the first half, the collapse came in the third quarter.

The Knicks punished them with a lethal 18-0 run that completely broke the game open. This time it wasn’t just Brunson dictating the pace (who recorded a double-double with 19 points and 14 assists), but the X-factor of Josh Hart, who exploded for 26 points coming off the bench and punishing them from the perimeter (5-11 on three-pointers). Cleveland fell into a pattern of forced isolation plays and looked exhausted in the final stretch, allowing the New York crowd to celebrate a 2-0 lead.


![gettyimages-2277385307-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tmaYbE9hrHWLVDF29uhHqo75Ni4DN2ybFBNj62zwifHLg3NFFVUTBbFSXhQ8RCtbE3H.png)


Game 3 (May 23): Cavaliers 108 - 121 Knicks (NYK leads 3-0)

The series moved to Ohio, but the change of scenery didn’t alter the script. The Cavs took the court at Rocket Arena forced to step up their defense, but mental consistency was nowhere to be found. The Knicks played extremely fluid and effective basketball (55% from the field), led by an imperial Jalen Brunson, who scored 30 points and dished out 6 assists while running the pick-and-roll at will.

Cleveland tried to respond with Mitchell leading the charge, but New York’s defense cut off passing lanes and dominated the paint with Karl-Anthony Towns (13 pts, 8 reb, 7 ast) and a relentless Mikal Bridges (22 pts, 11-15 FG). Atkinson’s team faltered again in the closing minutes, resorting to “Hero Ball” and finding themselves on the brink of elimination against a Knicks squad that appears to have the maturity needed to seal their ticket.


![gettyimages-2277382724-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tHGBcNc3tkyb1Hh59UEPKhGstimDJQjRmB4EDAuvY7pLpPdf614TgbHH9KdJtrjdw35.png)



🤠 Western Conference: Paycom and Texas Declare War

Game 3 (May 22): Spurs 108 - 123 Thunder (OKC leads 2-1)

After an even start, the series moved to San Antonio’s Frost Bank Center with the Thunder looking to regain home-court advantage. The OKC coach tightened the defensive screws with staggered, hyperactive coverage on the Spurs’ perimeter.

Oklahoma City imposed a fast and relentless transition game that wore down the home team’s defensive rotations, securing a decisive 15-point victory. Despite the flashes of collective maturity that Mitch Johnson’s leadership tried to instill from the San Antonio bench, turnovers and control of the offensive rebound tipped the scales in the Thunder’s favor in the fourth quarter.

Game 4 (May 24): Spurs 103 - 82 Thunder (Series tied 2-2)

Just when it seemed Oklahoma City was taking complete control of the West, the Spurs responded with pride and pure composure on their home court. Mitch Johnson shook up the playbook, ordering a suffocating defense on Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and forcing the Thunder to take awkward shots from long range.


![gettyimages-2277535891-612x612_waifu2x_art_noise1_scale.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agcoeficiente10/23tRzVqZRjBpwyMMFVTpJze2euKPzSgR5soMGtzRawYqqX87eTDWSyEN7ZE7GiXnzpjKq.png)


San Antonio’s defense completely shut down the paint, limiting OKC to one of its worst offensive nights of the playoffs with just 82 points. The Spurs’ collective offense flowed with extra passes and clean transitions, breaking down the Thunder’s pressure from the first quarter onward (a lead they never relinquished). With this statement of authority, San Antonio evened the series and ensured that the battle for the West will return to Texas for a Game 6 that promises to be a true tactical showdown.

In short, one series is dominated entirely by the Knicks over the Cavs, while the other is undoubtedly a game of strategy where whoever makes the best adjustments will reach the Finals—and this is getting more and more interesting at the highest level of professional basketball.

#### Knicks acaricia las Finales y Spurs frena en seco el avance del Thunder

Las Finales de Conferencia de la NBA han entrado en su fase más crítica. Entre el 21 y el 24 de mayo de 2026, la acción en ambos lados de los Estados Unidos demostró por qué los detalles tácticos y la consistencia mental dictan quién sobrevive y quién se desmorona en la postemporada. Mientras los New York Knicks pusieron contra las cuerdas a unos confundidos Cleveland Cavaliers, en el Oeste la serie entre Oklahoma City Thunder y San Antonio Spurs se convirtió en un toma y dame estratégico de alta intensidad.

🗽 Conferencia Este: Los Knicks imponen su ley y huelen a Finales

Juego 2 (21 de mayo): Knicks 109 - 93 Cavaliers (NYK lidera 2-0)

Cleveland llegó al Madison Square Garden con la urgencia de ajustar la marca sobre Jalen Brunson, pero el plan defensivo de los Cavs volvió a hacer aguas en los momentos de apremio. Aunque Donovan Mitchell (26 pts) y James Harden (18 pts) mantuvieron el juego parejo en la primera mitad, el colapso llegó en el tercer cuarto.

Los Knicks castigaron con un parcial letal de 18-0 que rompió el partido por completo. Esta vez no fue solo Brunson dictando el ritmo (quien firmó un doble-doble de 19 puntos y 14 asistencias), sino el factor X de Josh Hart, que se destapó con 26 unidades viniendo desde atrás y castigando desde el perímetro (5-11 en triples). Cleveland cayó en el juego de aislamientos forzados y lució sin piernas en el tramo final, permitiendo que la caldera neoyorquina celebrara el 2-0.

Juego 3 (23 de mayo): Cavaliers 108 - 121 Knicks (NYK lidera 3-0)

La serie se trasladó a Ohio, pero el cambio de escenario no modificó el guión. Los Cavs salieron al Rocket Arena obligados a morder en defensa, pero la consistencia mental brilló por su ausencia. Los Knicks jugaron un baloncesto sumamente fluido y efectivo (55% de campo) comandados por un Jalen Brunson imperial, que clavó 30 puntos y repartió 6 asistencias manejando el pick-and-roll a su antojo.

Cleveland intentó reaccionar con Mitchell a la cabeza, pero la defensa de Nueva York secó las líneas de pase y dominó la pintura con Karl-Anthony Towns (13 pts, 8 reb, 7 ast) y un Mikal Bridges implacable (22 pts, 11-15 FG). Los de Atkinson volvieron a fallar en el cierre de partido, hundiéndose en el \

y quedando al borde de la eliminación ante unos Knicks que lucen con la madurez justa para sellar su boleto.

🤠 Conferencia Oeste: El Paycom y Texas se declaran la guerra

Juego 3 (22 de mayo): Spurs 108 - 123 Thunder (OKC lidera 2-1)

Tras la paridad inicial, la serie se mudó al Frost Bank Center de San Antonio con el Thunder buscando recuperar la ventaja de localía. El coach de OKC ajustó las tuercas defensivas con marcas escalonadas e hiperactivas sobre el perímetro de los Spurs.

Oklahoma City impuso una transición rápida e implacable que desgastó las rotaciones defensivas locales, llevándose una victoria contundente por 15 puntos. A pesar de los chispazos de madurez colectiva que intentó inyectar la conducción de Mitch Johnson en el banquillo de San Antonio, las pérdidas de balón y el control del rebote ofensivo inclinaron la balanza a favor del Thunder en el último cuarto.

Juego 4 (24 de mayo): Spurs 103 - 82 Thunder (Serie empatada 2-2)

Cuando parecía que Oklahoma City tomaba el control absoluto del Oeste, los Spurs respondieron con orgullo y pura sangre fría en su feudo. Mitch Johnson sacudió la pizarra, ordenando un cerco asfixiante sobre Shai Gilgeous-Alexander y obligando al Thunder a tomar tiros incómodos desde la larga distancia.

La defensa de San Antonio cerró la pintura por completo, limitando a OKC a una de sus peores noches ofensivas de los playoffs con apenas 82 puntos. El ataque colectivo de los Spurs fluyó con pases extra y transiciones limpias, desarmando la presión del Thunder desde el primer cuarto (ventaja que jamás soltaron). Con este golpe de autoridad, San Antonio empareja la serie y asegura que la batalla por el Oeste regresará a Texas para un Juego 6 que será un auténtico drama táctico.

En definitiva una de las series tiene total dominio por parte de los Knicks sobre los Cavs y la otra serie sin duda alguna es un juego de estrategias que quien aplique mejor los ajustes será el que podrá llegar a las finales, esto cada vez se vuelve más interesante en el máximo nivel del baloncesto profesional.

# Ing/Esp
## Celebrating My Grandmother's Birthday and Family Unity 🎂✨

Hello, Hive friends and 3Speak users! Today I feel extremely happy to share with all of you a little piece of what is most valuable in my life: family moments. This time, I bring you a very special video that compiles the most significant and joyful moments of the birthday celebration of my beloved grandmother, a being who represents the fundamental pillar and the epicenter of our home.

Life is made of moments, and the most beautiful ones are those we share with the people we love. Celebrating one more year of our grandmother's life is not just celebrating a date on the calendar; it is honoring her roots, her wisdom, and that unconditional love she has given us throughout time. Although the day dawned quite rainy, the warmth of our home and the enthusiasm of being gathered together were stronger than any weather. We managed to organize a beautiful, peaceful celebration filled with a lot of harmony with the closest relatives.

To pamper her as she deserves, we prepared a feast full of love. In the video, you will be able to appreciate the delicious homemade pasticho that we cooked with great care and, of course, a spectacular cake decorated with butterflies and flowers, specially designed for her. There was no shortage of snacks, shared laughs, and the anecdotes that always arise when we sit at the table.

The music, which is the soul of any family celebration, was completely adapted to her tastes. We played songs by the unforgettable Dueto América, some traditional rancheras, and the rhythms of Joropo Central. The music evoked memories and filled the space with a wonderful energy; we sang from the heart, danced, and thoroughly enjoyed seeing the radiant smile on my grandmother's face.

This celebration was the finishing touch to a truly magical season for her. In the previous days, we had already had the blessing of celebrating Mother's Day and also her actual birthday, where she was also surprised with another cake. That whole week was a true wonder for her, feeling sheltered and extremely happy by the constant presence of her loved ones. And although due to distance or time many loved ones were missing from this particular gathering, their messages, calls, and congratulations were felt, proving that family love breaks any physical barrier.

At the end of the day, we said goodbye with a happy heart and everyone returned to their homes with the satisfaction of having built an unforgettable memory. Family is our safe haven and these unique moments are what give true meaning to life.

I hope you enjoy this visual tour of our celebration. I invite you to leave your comments, to value your loved ones, and to remind us always that, no matter how busy the routine is, there is always time to celebrate the gift of life in family. See you in a next video! Chaíto 😚🤗

## Esp:
## Celebrando El Cumpleaños de Mi Abuela y Unión familiar 🎂✨

¡Hola, amigos de Hive y usuarios de 3Speak! Hoy me siento sumamente feliz de compartir con todos ustedes un pedacito de lo que es más valioso en mi vida: los momentos en familia. En esta oportunidad, les traigo un video muy especial que recopila los instantes más significativos y alegres de la celebración de cumpleaños de mi amada abuela, un ser que representa el pilar fundamental y el epicentro de nuestro hogar.

La vida está hecha de momentos, y los más hermosos son aquellos que compartimos con las personas que amamos. Celebrar un año más de vida de nuestra abuela no es solo festejar una fecha en el calendario; es honrar sus raíces, su sabiduría y ese amor incondicional que nos ha regalado a lo largo del tiempo. A pesar de que el día amaneció bastante lluvioso,la calidez de nuestro hogar y el entusiasmo de vernos reunidos pudieron más que cualquier clima. Logramos organizar una celebración hermosa, tranquila y llena de muchísima armonía con los familiares más allegados.

Para consentirla como se lo merece, preparamos un banquete lleno de cariño. En el video podrán apreciar el delicioso pasticho casero que cocinamos con mucho esmero y, por supuesto, una torta espectacular decorada con mariposas y flores, pensada especialmente para ella. No faltaron las chucherías, las risas compartidas y las anécdotas que siempre surgen cuando nos sentamos a la mesa.

La música, que es el alma de cualquier celebración familiar, estuvo adaptada por completo a sus gustos. Pusimos a sonar las canciones del inolvidable Dueto América, algunas rancheras tradicionales y los ritmos del Joropo Central. La música evocó recuerdos y llenó el espacio de una energía maravillosa; se cantó con el corazón, se bailó y disfrutamos al máximo ver la sonrisa radiante en el rostro de mi abuela.

Esta celebración fue el broche de oro para una temporada verdaderamente mágica para ella. En los días previos, ya habíamos tenido la bendición de festejarle el Día de las Madres y también el propio día de su cumpleaños, donde también la sorprendieron con otra torta. Toda esa semana fue una auténtica maravilla para ella, sintiéndose cobijada y sumamente feliz por la presencia constante de sus seres queridos. Y aunque por cuestiones de distancia o tiempo faltaron muchas personas queridas en esta reunión en particular, sus mensajes, llamadas y felicitaciones se hicieron sentir, demostrando que el amor de la familia rompe cualquier barrera física.

Afinal de la jornada, nos despedimos con el corazón contento y cada quien regresó a sus hogares con la satisfacción de haber construido un recuerdo imborrable. La familia es nuestro refugio seguro y estos momentos únicos son los que le dan verdadero sentido a la vida.

Espero que disfruten de este recorrido visual por nuestra celebración. Los invito a dejar sus comentarios, a valorar a sus seres queridos y a recordarnos siempre que, no importa cuán ocupada esté la rutina, siempre hay tiempo para celebrar el regalo de la vida en familia. ¡Nos vemos en un próximo video! Chaíto 😚🤗

# Ing/Esp
## Celebrating My Grandmother's Birthday and Family Unity 🎂✨

Hello, Hive friends and 3Speak users! Today I feel extremely happy to share with all of you a little piece of what is most valuable in my life: family moments. This time, I bring you a very special video that compiles the most significant and joyful moments of the birthday celebration of my beloved grandmother, a being who represents the fundamental pillar and the epicenter of our home.

Life is made of moments, and the most beautiful ones are those we share with the people we love. Celebrating one more year of our grandmother's life is not just celebrating a date on the calendar; it is honoring her roots, her wisdom, and that unconditional love she has given us throughout time. Although the day dawned quite rainy, the warmth of our home and the enthusiasm of being gathered together were stronger than any weather. We managed to organize a beautiful, peaceful celebration filled with a lot of harmony with the closest relatives.

To pamper her as she deserves, we prepared a feast full of love. In the video, you will be able to appreciate the delicious homemade pasticho that we cooked with great care and, of course, a spectacular cake decorated with butterflies and flowers, specially designed for her. There was no shortage of snacks, shared laughs, and the anecdotes that always arise when we sit at the table.

The music, which is the soul of any family celebration, was completely adapted to her tastes. We played songs by the unforgettable Dueto América, some traditional rancheras, and the rhythms of Joropo Central. The music evoked memories and filled the space with a wonderful energy; we sang from the heart, danced, and thoroughly enjoyed seeing the radiant smile on my grandmother's face.

This celebration was the finishing touch to a truly magical season for her. In the previous days, we had already had the blessing of celebrating Mother's Day and also her actual birthday, where she was also surprised with another cake. That whole week was a true wonder for her, feeling sheltered and extremely happy by the constant presence of her loved ones. And although due to distance or time many loved ones were missing from this particular gathering, their messages, calls, and congratulations were felt, proving that family love breaks any physical barrier.

At the end of the day, we said goodbye with a happy heart and everyone returned to their homes with the satisfaction of having built an unforgettable memory. Family is our safe haven and these unique moments are what give true meaning to life.

I hope you enjoy this visual tour of our celebration. I invite you to leave your comments, to value your loved ones, and to remind us always that, no matter how busy the routine is, there is always time to celebrate the gift of life in family. See you in a next video! Chaíto 😚🤗

---

## Esp:
## Celebrando El Cumpleaños de Mi Abuela y Unión familiar 🎂✨

¡Hola, amigos de Hive y usuarios de 3Speak! Hoy me siento sumamente feliz de compartir con todos ustedes un pedacito de lo que es más valioso en mi vida: los momentos en familia. En esta oportunidad, les traigo un video muy especial que recopila los instantes más significativos y alegres de la celebración de cumpleaños de mi amada abuela, un ser que representa el pilar fundamental y el epicentro de nuestro hogar.

La vida está hecha de momentos, y los más hermosos son aquellos que compartimos con las personas que amamos. Celebrar un año más de vida de nuestra abuela no es solo festejar una fecha en el calendario; es honrar sus raíces, su sabiduría y ese amor incondicional que nos ha regalado a lo largo del tiempo. A pesar de que el día amaneció bastante lluvioso,la calidez de nuestro hogar y el entusiasmo de vernos reunidos pudieron más que cualquier clima. Logramos organizar una celebración hermosa, tranquila y llena de muchísima armonía con los familiares más allegados.

Para consentirla como se lo merece, preparamos un banquete lleno de cariño. En el video podrán apreciar el delicioso pasticho casero que cocinamos con mucho esmero y, por supuesto, una torta espectacular decorada con mariposas y flores, pensada especialmente para ella. No faltaron las chucherías, las risas compartidas y las anécdotas que siempre surgen cuando nos sentamos a la mesa.

La música, que es el alma de cualquier celebración familiar, estuvo adaptada por completo a sus gustos. Pusimos a sonar las canciones del inolvidable Dueto América, algunas rancheras tradicionales y los ritmos del Joropo Central. La música evocó recuerdos y llenó el espacio de una energía maravillosa; se cantó con el corazón, se bailó y disfrutamos al máximo ver la sonrisa radiante en el rostro de mi abuela.

Esta celebración fue el broche de oro para una temporada verdaderamente mágica para ella. En los días previos, ya habíamos tenido la bendición de festejarle el Día de las Madres y también el propio día de su cumpleaños, donde también la sorprendieron con otra torta. Toda esa semana fue una auténtica maravilla para ella, sintiéndose cobijada y sumamente feliz por la presencia constante de sus seres queridos. Y aunque por cuestiones de distancia o tiempo faltaron muchas personas queridas en esta reunión en particular, sus mensajes, llamadas y felicitaciones se hicieron sentir, demostrando que el amor de la familia rompe cualquier barrera física.

Afinal de la jornada, nos despedimos con el corazón contento y cada quien regresó a sus hogares con la satisfacción de haber construido un recuerdo imborrable. La familia es nuestro refugio seguro y estos momentos únicos son los que le dan verdadero sentido a la vida.

Espero que disfruten de este recorrido visual por nuestra celebración. Los invito a dejar sus comentarios, a valorar a sus seres queridos y a recordarnos siempre que, no importa cuán ocupada esté la rutina, siempre hay tiempo para celebrar el regalo de la vida en familia. ¡Nos vemos en un próximo video! Chaíto 😚🤗

what are the dumb things that we need to stop doing in this economy to grow. it is going to be interesting one, since I've quite thought people would say it's not that smart but it is, and won't call what it is dumb thing to do.

The smart choices in this era

We are in a new era where smart one's have made it a lot easier for themselves that they say it's a life hack. Like while making decisions it has become a lot easier now, just because we have ai so the smart people would prefer consulting from ai rather than paying to someone to give you consultations Or any sort of legal advices, the new smart is asking ai about it and that'd sort out things more quicker than the lawyer itself. Nowadays building habits like going to a bathroom and just hanging on the rode for pull-ups everyone you go there and come out, followed by pushups Will keep you in a good shape when you're doing it consistently while everyone who's dumb thinks it is hard to build muscles when it is just that simple. Dumb way to go broke

body.title: Compramos una freidora de aire / We bought an air fryer
body.body:
Hola amigos feliz tarde a todos espero se encuentren super bien, hace mucho tiempo mi novio y yo queríamos una freidora de aire ya que no tenemos horno nuestra cocina es súper sencilla y aunque nos resuelve demasiado si quería muchísimo una freidora, la verdad no la habíamos podido comprar por temas de prioridades, necesitábamos una nevera así que ahorramos mucho para comprarla y fue un gran gasto también pagamos alquiler y servicios sumando a mercado y tenemos un carro el cual necesita mantenimiento, a todo esto le sumamos que tenemos varias mascotas que requieren alimentación y cuidados en fin aunque queríamos mucho la freidora no habíamos podido tener el dinero para comprarla.

>Hello friends, happy afternoon everyone, I hope you're all doing well. For a long time, my boyfriend and I wanted an air fryer since we don't have an oven. Our kitchen is very basic, and although it's a huge help, we really wanted an air fryer. The truth is, we hadn't been able to buy one because of other priorities. We needed a refrigerator, so we saved up a lot to buy it, and it was a big expense. We also pay rent and utilities, plus groceries, and we have a car that needs maintenance. On top of all that, we have several pets that require food and care. In short, even though we really wanted the air fryer, we hadn't been able to save up the money to buy it.

![Compramos una freidora de aire_20260525_142614_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb57DNe8gkfSjxZJe5Xx1dQxSP3wvGA9WjM2KZvTrxK9n/Compramos%20una%20freidora%20de%20aire_20260525_142614_0000.png)

Gracias a Dios este fin de semana me fue muy bien en mi trabajo y al fin tenía el dinero para comprar mi amada freidora, junto a mí novio nos fuimos el día de ayer domingo a buscarla , pero no fue tan fácil como pensábamos de verdad yo creí que la iba a conseguir en la primera tienda que entrara y no fue así , yo no quería que fuera muy pequeña ya que aunque somos solo dos quiero poder cocinar cómodamente, las que estábamos encontrando eran de 2.2 litros y para mí solo entraba un muslo de pollo jajajajja y tenían un costo casi de 50$ ya habíamos visitado 3 tiendas y solo tenían de estos , en traki encontré una un poquito más grande pero la marca no la conocía así que no la lleve , encontré una espectacular de buena marca y super grande pero salia totalmente del presupuesto pues costaba 156$ 

>Thank God this weekend went really well at work and I finally had the money to buy my beloved deep fryer. My boyfriend and I went yesterday, Sunday, to look for it, but it wasn't as easy as we thought. I really thought I'd find it in the first store I walked into, but that wasn't the case. I didn't want it to be too small because even though there are only two of us, I want to be able to cook comfortably. The ones we were finding were 2.2 liters, and for me, only one chicken leg would fit in them, hahaha, and they cost almost $50. We had already visited three stores, and they only had these. At Traki, I found one a little bigger, but I didn't know the brand, so I didn't buy it. I found a spectacular one from a good brand and super big, but it was totally out of our budget because it cost $156.

![IMG_20260524_124231.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUMv1jJfyN4eJzXZvG2zmRKdbs3MeRUhjCSz9VHCzYpzp/IMG_20260524_124231.jpg)

Terminamos saliendo del centro comercial y nos fuimos a tiendas dibs y pues fue el lugar correcto tenían una gran variedad, mi novio le encantó una de la marca Oster que tenía un costo de 95$  a mi también me gusto Pero luego encontramos una de la marca Royal que tenía igual capacidad de 4 litros al igual que la Oster y también es buena marca y por un costo de 42$ enserio ya no teníamos más que discutir y está fue la ganadora.

>We ended up leaving the mall and went to Dibs stores, and it was the right place. They had a great variety. My boyfriend loved one from the Oster brand that cost $95, and I liked it too. But then we found one from the Royal brand that had the same 4-liter capacity as the Oster, and it's also a good brand, and it cost $42. Seriously, we didn't have anything else to discuss, and this one was the winner.

![IMG_20260524_130715.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW4LzVzXuHbZeNLs9EpbpwBonZ1Jr3ngsjdMUN58pSXJq/IMG_20260524_130715.jpg)

Al llegar a casa obviamente la revisamos y sacamos de su empaque, procedí a ver muy bien su manual de uso para saber los tiempos de cocción de la comida y el uso adecuado de ella , obviamente tenía que pasar por el control de calidad de nuestra gatita Mikasa y obviamente fue aprobada aunque pensamos que a ella le gustó más la caja 😂 en la noche metí unos muslos de pollo y quedaron espectaculares realmente estoy muy feliz por cada pequeño paso que damos con mucho esfuerzo.

>When we got home, we obviously checked it and took it out of its packaging. I proceeded to carefully read the user manual to learn the cooking times and how to use it properly. Of course, it had to pass our cat Mikasa's quality control, and it was approved, although we think she liked the box better 😂. That night, I put some chicken thighs in it, and they turned out spectacular. I'm really happy with every little step we take with so much effort.

body.title: The Bounty Hunting.
body.body:
>

Hi, I'm back with another contribution to Gaming Photography community and this time I'm going to join [Gaming Photography Weekly Contest](https://peakd.com/hive-185676/@gamingphoto/gaming-photography-weekly-contest-db797dd70f704).

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

Following a high-stakes chase through the wilderness, John and Abigail pursued a fleeing bounty. After a chaotic moment where both John and the target fell to the ground, I tied him up and loaded him onto Abigail's horse. Left alone, I scouted a nearby ridge to inspect a distant bridge.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaaLvyZXVQzHVR212YD94NjzdPKTmQgK5yNmpUF4aiWkM/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUNXyFgnD6hThb82QgXqRu14Mb6qxW5tDv1bzCgxEtm8/screenshot_2_.png)

As our target fled the town at a breakneck pace, we started chasing him through the winding mountain trails. After riding for a while to cover his escape route, Abigail decided to split up to cut off his path through the trees.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQPWUuX7WYQqfVAHm47snYRyGQ671fqzPxuJ8vsofPfoY/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYVgX3SgoNLmg93zL7J43xaJNrkjKb3bdtf9cDkanqTD8/screenshot_4_.png)

Then Abigail joined us after I kept on the trail of our target through the rocky ravines. But she couldn't stop the bounty from the high stake chase on her own, forcing us to push our horses even harder to match his frantic speed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNnYBvo9DvMJD7xMgc1RuH2RFs8E1vLsGjd74Ki95pA5W/screenshot_5_.png)

We kept riding behind him while the man kept trying to say he was innocent. And I could see this big bridge on the way that I guess is the repaired bridge that we blew up in the past.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYP4k4wGjjgLS4F9wNhJkFGkBG1thivHaaBdktEmXDS3S/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMDQHpEdwruFBNCwWuuhtK1WhhHSBf818gDDVGcTJSbC/screenshot_7_.png)

At last, I threw my lasso for my target as I went closer to him alongside his panicked mount. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnb8tfNriHNzkCCjJtywtMddWRs5cQKXaQ4PBxgvuhYL/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzhwA1APEoLs6Ty6SiPZAZyvV95s23aXizMJ1YN1V3Lq/screenshot_9_.png)

While I was walking toward him to tie him up before he could scramble away, I fell as well over something. And there both the bounty and the bounty hunters were laid on the same ground together.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSREoXniE8YRh8w1WtA89DFdJsY9qwVmUaCLSTvonJtuT/screenshot_10_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTY1EQUB4F4DFxwE4ZnoSHHHPZMSLZkRsDLEvAxbtq8gj/screenshot_11_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdUWtQ3La4tWqzMcJF8N9tNmT7aJCtcGca8s7jpguqe3f/screenshot_12_.png)

After getting back on foot, I tied up the man securely with my rope. And I stowed him on the horseback of Abigail, and she took my leave as she had to bring the man to justice.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcDMmGzdKUdRLEBKVyBwgKsbAaFsKn5ZXnDBN3XUcykqE/screenshot_13_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVmfqCQRA4DwZ3MrYtkMjWdr5KFnPwCuDRWMxryZZqG2d/screenshot_14_.png)

As Abigail left me behind in the wilderness, I watched them leaving until they disappeared over the horizon. And then I stopped there for a moment to check around the quiet wilderness area.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTEVDgWdXvkkKHAd5DA1bCyRjfaC2EtHbdt1bLDgHbi79/screenshot_15_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRhMadgG3YgQXBPjAwZtq4s5VG8SBRiWPWbwDid9g5gV/screenshot_16_.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdoVJeitXagjvsq13PXb9H42GTgFSAmBpX5tZGiiiQ5dD/screenshot_17_.png)

Then I rode to the edge of a hill where I spooked this bird resting in the brush. And I could have a good glimpse of the bridge from there, and I realized it's not the same bridge I thought it was earlier.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqzmqSqxuRNbpX9wqjmKyhXH58FYwcK3wXaa32qnHugB/divider.png

Here I'm finishing the post for today and I'll come talk about more special RDR 2 gaming moments in Gaming Photography.

<center>https://images.hive.blog/768x0/https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gamingphoto/23tRvMuLRERuPePNhyEjtaKt46FiKwDBgwVqqAberwmEFA36fPkh2ad6wvB1RYNKTVezR.png</center>

\

**🇺🇸 ENGLISH VERSION**

Being a business administrator sounds glamorous... until you're drowning in spreadsheets. 📉

Managing stock, tracking monthly sales, calculating profit margins, controlling expenses, monitoring supplier delivery times, updating product entry and exit logs... and that's just before breakfast. ☕️😵

Every number counts. Every missing record doubles your work. Every mistake costs time and money. 💸

Behind a successful store, there's someone who spends hours reconciling accounts, checking inventory, and making sure nothing is out of place. 📋

It's hard. It's exhausting. But it's also what keeps the business alive. 🧠💪

✨ *\

* ✨

**🇪🇸 VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL**

Ser administradora de un negocio suena glamuroso... hasta que te ahogas en hojas de cálculo. 📉

Llevar inventarios, controlar ventas mensuales, calcular márgenes de ganancia, gestionar gastos, revisar tiempos de entrega de proveedores, actualizar entradas y salidas de productos... y eso solo antes del desayuno. ☕️😵

Cada número cuenta. Cada registro perdido duplica el trabajo. Cada error cuesta tiempo y dinero. 💸

Detrás de un negocio exitoso hay alguien que pasa horas cuadrando cuentas, revisando el stock y asegurándose de que nada esté fuera de lugar. 📋

Es difícil. Es agotador. Pero también es lo que mantiene vivo el negocio. 🧠💪

✨ *\

* ✨

Hoy fue un día genial para caminar por la ciudad. Empecé mi recorrido por un parque cercano, donde vi a un grupo de niños jugando al fútbol. Su entusiasmo era contagioso y me hizo recordar mis propias aventuras de la infancia. Hablé brevemente con un padre que estaba allí animándolos; me contó que su hijo estaba aprendiendo a jugar y que se esforzaba mucho en mejorar. Continué mi camino hacia el centro, donde me encontré con una pequeña feria de artesanías. Había un artista local que pintaba murales en el lugar. Me detuve a observarlo; su técnica era impresionante, y tenía una manera única de capturar la esencia de la ciudad en su arte. Hablé con él sobre sus inspiraciones y me dijo que le encanta plasmar la vida cotidiana de las personas en sus obras. La caminata estuvo llena de sorpresas y me recordó cuán vibrante y llena de vida está la ciudad. Siempre hay algo nuevo que descubrir y personas interesantes que conocer. ¡No puedo esperar a la próxima caminata! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: The PEPT Game Micro Blog Series - May 25, 2026 - Pilot Episode
body.body:
![pept_microblog.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fjworld/48aZcnyztcELqMPPdJBZFg3k1tF3GnW1VJKsKDZ1ei2KYNtX5GbBi1avkZASkaorRo.jpg)
https://peakd.com/c/hive-102963

Today, I am testing a new idea to help me address daily activities.

Because I have a lot of things on the go, it is necessary for me to work on improving some productivity tools and implementing better work habits. Now, I say work but I mostly mean fun. Having fun and being happy is always a top priority for me, This philosophy has served me well cause the usual byproduct of having fun nowadays is an exponential growth in digital wealth.

## What is it?

A Hive engagement activity for subscribers of The PEPT Game community and a communication series to help educate the world about an evolving Perpetual Economic Power Terraformer platform. 

## Usage

Initial usage will be to make it easier for me to communicate the progress of various process improvement activities related to the continued evolution of The PEPT Game.

Additionally, the feedback and shared engagement from our PEPT community subscribers as well as all Hivers, will help formalize this  series and potentially expand to new series using other Hive accounts.

For now, I created this blogging template via PeakD which I will modify going forward depending on feedback and measured effectiveness. 

## PEPT Micro Blogging Process

Using a defined and scheduled template, a blog will be created to include a primary topic for discussion. I know, it's not new, we all comment on blogs. Nothing micro here.

### It's not the tool but how you use it.
Having looked at and used some of the current microblogging  methodologies on Hive I got thinking I could create my own poor man container for microblogging.

In the context of a container, a long form PEPT Micro Blog Series means I use scheduled templates to create containers to manage some community engagement. The comments/reply for the blog populates the microblogging dataset. 

## Today's Primary Topic
Tell me what you are doing or plan on doing today.

So when you reply to this blog and share your feedback on this PEPT Micro Blog Series idea, share some activities you completed, are doing or plan to do today. 

## Testing The Process

body.title: The Plate That Was Never About Hunger
body.body:
This was not designed with intention by anyone, yet it works like a system. The mom pours another spoon before we finish the one in front of us. The party believes that the amount of food we eat decides our respect for the host. The family function where when we decide to push a food aside, aside it means something about that food. They always told us to eat because if we refuse, we are signaling that something is wrong or broken. Well, these were some of the things I have seen around, and I also grew up with them. Before I noticed it, food stopped being about hunger. And it became something I reached out to when the news was too heavy, when conversation got difficult. That is not a weakness, though. Though I don't do it to everyone, just close people I know. And this is exactly what happens when we have been told that eating is how we show approval to those who we love and belong to. ![248709.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/48PSqY7pmsHDVDLcUzSt2VCjQzfb2cSfcXGaDyj42iWjdQDt1h3VMbdzpUQqwgVaax.png) The food industry as well is not left out because they also deserve their own share of criticism. Their branding, the additional sugar that always makes everything feel unnatural. And some of these deeper designs, especially in this country, have outgrown any corporation. But long before anyone had a marketing budget, it had been built into some kitchens, if not all. Hunger is normal and simple, but those things that surround it are never simple. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.title: Checking out OpenVerse
body.body:
I was in LinkedIn and my eye got caught by an interesting post regarding an ... OpenVerse.

The post was asking people who are professional in XR/VW to join this OpenVerse.

The OpenVerse Observatory project,  is an EU-funded initiative under Horizon Europe.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmatxMsqvkqUdpHWE7Qp9yibT59FLBtEaow5edQXabEmxJ/image.png)
https://open-verse.eu/

To be absolutely honest I was not sure what those meant, so after googling them,  I saw that they mean the below:

XR and Virtual Worlds represent the foundation of the next generation of the internet, often linked to the concept of the metaverse.

> XR (Extended Reality) is an umbrella term that includes:

- Virtual Reality (VR)
- Augmented Reality (AR)
- Mixed Reality (MR)

> These technologies blend the physical and digital worlds, creating immersive experiences that can simulate, enhance, or completely replace real-world environments.

> VW (Virtual Worlds) refers to persistent digital environments where users can:

- Interact with others in real time
- Build and own digital spaces
- Attend events, work, or socialize
- Participate in virtual economies

----

Metaverse was a very hyped term a few years ago, right now it is not been heard and used very often, but I know that there is much work done in the background, both in academic and theoretic but also in coding level.

This project was created back in 2023 and as I saw, it will conclude in October 2026. 

They still invite people over to connect, so I would like to see what is going on over there and how active they are

https://open-verse.eu/get-involved/ 

You can see a number of posts in their LinkedIn page, some of them may seem interesting to you.

They have an open call for Ambassadors and they also invite companies to create their own page

https://www.linkedin.com/company/open-verse/posts

Users can register here: https://observatory.open-verse.eu/user/register 

Would it be something for you to try out? Or do you think that Metaverse is no longer relevant?

I will definitely check this out in more detail, but until I do - I wanted to give you the heads up :)

Let me know what you think!

body.title: Cyclists now get a maximum speed in my country! 😅
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23u5tWYryZF1d9uafV7DcCeruBh9WvrTK8fJqsA11jeK7jWVmgF7JkztsV7Zc8nZ6wF53.png)
Hey all, I have just read an odd article online - in two cities in my country, Amsterdam and Houten, a speed limit for cyclists is being introduced... 😯 These are meant as tests to improve the safety for everyone on the very crowded cycling lanes that apparently are getting more dangerous every year with a lot of different users on them. Old people on electric bikes, youth on fat bikes that are sometimes speeding at 40km/h, children, electric scooters and of course sport cyclists like ourselves. In my country there are a lot of Patronizing little laws like this and this is just the newest, I wonder how law enforcement will be able to handle this, understaffed already so they probably won't, so what's next, licence plates on bikes so we can get caught by speeding camera's? 😅 [Here's the link](https://www.ad.nl/binnenland/amsterdam-en-houten-starten-proef-met-maximumsnelheid-van-20-kilometer-per-uur-voor-fietsers~a2306cd1/?slug_rd=1) to the original article but obviously it's in Dutch but I've translated it using ChatGPT. So, how are the laws and safety situations in the area you cycle in? It doesn't have any impact on me, my house is on the edge of the small city I live in, in 2 minutes I'm cycling between the meadows or when I need to cross the city to get to the other side I need 10-15 minutes to leave the city, so that's not too bad. I personally DO understand why they are trying this, it's simply to lower the risks between all different kind of users but being a sport cyclist as well this poses problems for the ones living in the cities and first have to get out of the city for their rides to start, which will now take even longer. One more reason not to live in any big city. 😅 'Normal' cyclists, without a head unit displaying the speed also have no indication of how fast they are going.
![MTB Banner 5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Ru5F1r3aaFmZzK2DegWTDyuR5XUAgawWt7CLvcwXF76qFZ74gZKQy7v3Y8TdB1.png)

## Amsterdam and Houten to Test 20 km/h Speed Limit for Cyclists Amsterdam and Houten will soon begin a trial introducing a new and unusual traffic rule: a maximum speed limit of 20 kilometers per hour on certain bike paths. The goal is to improve safety on increasingly crowded cycling routes, where cyclists, e-bikes, mopeds, and fatbikes often pass each other at high speeds. The trial is part of the Dutch Multi-Year Bicycle Safety Plan 2025–2029, introduced last summer. Several municipalities showed interest, and Houten and Amsterdam were selected to participate. Where and When the Trial Starts The experiment will begin earlier in Houten, starting on June 8. The speed limit will apply to the Fossa Iberica, a narrow and busy street located behind the Castellum shopping center. In Amsterdam, the trial is scheduled to begin in September. To make cyclists aware of the new rule, traffic signs will be installed. In addition, cameras will be placed along the route to monitor the position, speed, and type of road users. No Fines During the Trial Notably, police will not issue fines for speeding during the trial period. Authorities cite limited staffing and other priorities as the reason for not enforcing penalties. This has led to skepticism among local residents. Some believe the measure will have little impact without enforcement, especially among younger riders on fast e-bikes or fatbikes. One resident commented that introducing a rule without enforcement makes little sense and suggested that local enforcement officers should be present to ensure compliance. Why This Location Was Chosen The Fossa Iberica was selected for a reason. More than a thousand cyclists and moped riders pass through the area daily, and it includes a relatively unsafe intersection. Since 2023, multiple accidents have been reported there. The situation is particularly busy before and after school hours, when large groups of students travel through the area—many using fatbikes or scooters. In addition, shoppers frequently use the route, often with wide cargo bikes, further contributing to congestion. Measuring the Impact Despite doubts, the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management has decided to proceed with the trial. The growing number of e-bikes and fatbikes has made bike paths significantly busier and more complex. The main goal of the trial is to better understand how cyclists behave under a speed limit and how it affects safety. Researchers will collect data through cameras and surveys. Cyclists will be asked about their experience of safety, crowding, and their opinion of the new measure. Public Opinion Divided Early public opinion shows mixed reactions: 44% believe no one will follow the speed limit 44% say it will only work with enforcement 8% think it is a good idea 4% have other opinions This highlights the uncertainty around whether the measure will actually change behavior. Government: Safety Comes First Minister Vincent Karremans emphasized the importance of the trial. He pointed to the rising number of cycling accidents in the Netherlands. Last year, 281 cyclists died, and around 81,000 people required emergency medical treatment following bicycle-related incidents. According to the minister, any measure that could improve road safety is worth exploring. If the trials in Houten and Amsterdam prove successful, similar experiments could be introduced elsewhere in the country. However, he stressed that a nationwide speed limit is not the immediate goal. Decisions will be made on a case-by-case basis. Local Support in Amsterdam In Amsterdam, alderman Melanie van der Horst supports the initiative. She noted that cycling paths in the city have become increasingly unsafe due to higher traffic and the growing number of electric vehicles. She believes that a 20 km/h limit could help protect vulnerable groups, such as elderly cyclists and parents with children, making them feel safer on bike paths. Houten: A Leading Cycling City Local officials in Houten are also positive about the trial. The municipality sees it as fitting its reputation as a leading cycling city. Houten has been named “Cycling City of the Year” twice, in 2008 and 2018, and is aiming for the title again in 2028. Alderman Wouter van den Berg stated that even in a city known for its cycling infrastructure, improvements are always possible. The municipality continues to invest in safer bike paths, fast cycling routes, and wider lanes where needed. Houten is internationally known for its unique traffic design. Each year, students, urban planners, and traffic experts from around the world visit the town for inspiration. The bicycle plays the central role in its layout, while cars are largely restricted to a ring road, giving priority to cyclists within the town.

body.title: Life Goes On
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd8XY6dtxrDvFHsXig5D13gcp47Zd5Yxyx4VpPXLdb4C5/img_0037.jpg)
In whatever you do, don’t let them kill you. A dead man has no hope. Nothing can be done to bring him back because he is gone forever. Stay silent for a week and see who will ask about you. Mostly, people from your workplace will likely notice your absence, and it may not necessarily be because they care deeply, but because the vacuum you left needs to be filled, so they will try to reach out to you.

That’s just life. If you drop dead today, life will move on regardless. It is natural and nothing more. Life is like a journey, and it will surely come to an end someday. No one is too important to be replaced. The impact may be felt for a while, but with time, it will fade and everything will continue as usual.

That’s why it is important to enjoy the moment and not take life too seriously to the point where you refuse to enjoy your own life.

What makes life so unpredictable is that you can never tell when you will breathe your last breath, and many people who die still have plans they are yet to execute. Life is like a box of chocolates; you never know what you are going to get from it. It is what it is, and most likely, none of us will get out of life alive.

The fact that human needs are insatiable makes it difficult to please everyone. Therefore, never think you can satisfy everybody. The moment people stop benefiting from you, many of them move on to the next person.

It is worthwhile to remember that you only live once, and there is no opportunity to live this exact life again. It is simply impossible. Life moves in different directions, and it is left for us to make good use of it.

Don’t be too quick to make harsh decisions, and don’t think less of yourself. Always remember that the only person who can truly limit you is yourself.

Life has a way of rewarding persistence. It may take time, but in the end, it will eventually pay off.

But there was another huge soldier on the roof. He had a large shield in his hand and heavy armor on his body. Normal attacks did nothing to him. He easily blocked all the blows.

Then Bayek used his \

skill. After several hits, the soldier's shield finally broke. Bayek then killed him. He then shot two more archers with arrows.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBJi3M9PsN2w2CqZc85MvTiZmBxLFKexFqpX4wwozbzN/snapshot_7.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYw52ysAAU8fkpdW7npTYVL235ho7i92xVk7DLZQEvnah/snapshot_8.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmba9MG94cFQuQR2Z38v1jgCnkatuEmga1nM276iUzq3QT/snapshot_9.png)

Baek was standing on a place that was the highest part of the entire area. The soldiers were climbing up from below and Baek was standing on top and shooting arrows at them one after another, killing them. His bow was much stronger now. The soldiers were dying with just two or three arrows.

After all the soldiers were dead, Tahaqa came out of her house. He didn't realize that Bayek was hiding upstairs.

Bayek didn't even need to come down. He aimed his bow from above and shot Tahaqa with arrows. A few of the arrows hit him directly, and he died there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6MfrFg8PgwoiZEfpibipgbi61qPoZjPUedDE4r5Sxq9/snapshot_10.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNR9fu3UWEVfK2JhTKEhFc2cPkrUmvxBiH5Mxaupxd38b/snapshot_11.png)

After killing Tahaqa, Bayek went down because he had to \
. But he started fighting with another huge and powerful soldier. This soldier was stronger than before. Bayek had to use \

three times in a row to break his shield. After breaking the shield, Bayek killed him with a quick sword blow.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYJcZvEf8R2yXM4NmakkRJ7qFbiJePw3rNX3rpSGzfQ1/snapshot_13.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYneUaeN51eWYf5XRM6DTGojRnrvPZYgAFoTLc73ZDQmw/snapshot_14.png)

Bayek then silently kills a few more soldiers and finishes off the rest with arrows. When he gets to Tahaqa and confirms the kill, Bayek, as before, falls into a kind of dream or illusion.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXeqzg2EXS7XUQZ4eUCU8HHX3QPkM9Vq5rFvuRVwfzaMZ/snapshot_15.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSZt1CssFy3WdddCjYqMp92n4q9hFFYfCkwnraY7XH7pD/snapshot_16.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWN56cyhpg9LDdasWfxzXM8T4MTYV2T78LKf7JKKzAns/snapshot_19.png)
