body.title: Returning to Chiang Mai
body.body:
Today, I am traveling back to Chiang Mai to continue my wanderings there. It feels nice to say that because Chiang Mai is one of those places that gives me a calm kind of excitement. It is not the kind of excitement that comes from tall buildings, loud streets, or a fast-paced city life. It is more like the feeling of knowing that I will be surrounded again by a slower rhythm, warm people, and a place that still feels close to its roots.


![1000160164.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23rB54pfE2LGo7eD8ZxesSMt3cHSbWhTgBh5wrp9x4NiKmmEF4cTAR4ySL34BgEtrMDXT.jpg)


My journey started at the airport, and as usual, I was already taking photos even before the flight took off LOL. There is something about airports that always gives me a sense of anticipation. Seeing the planes parked outside, the airport vehicles moving around, and the wide open sky above the runway made me feel that another adventure was about to begin.


![1000160143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EppMDVV6cSfn327NpdjTn5DbzXFQtXLMnuocMHZSmYCHpxiXrPDqNQgKuLnCvzXsrFM.jpg)

![1000160147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23tmDn4S3GiSDYBReQYk2qLeaqmtL4EiR1SB9q11PTtkj3PoaFgWZrajtijtyXhxAgWPW.jpg)

![1000160153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/243fmp9Lf6iYGtbofHiMPkkf7bpTXYV9nUbHcVQw9LTuRxrk63E5dhkrJ9FEBE8RD67es.jpg)

![1000160157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/241tXG6sHmYedkAntL1h7j4hJxxoiW8A8L5VKBRF3aAcfiniDJrAbYBWaLr1jk4cfd3bT.jpg)


Once the plane started moving and eventually lifted from the ground, the view outside the window immediately became the highlight of the trip. I was lucky to have a window seat, and I always appreciate that because flying gives a totally different perspective of the world. The city slowly became smaller, the buildings turned into tiny blocks, and the roads looked like thin lines drawn across the land.

As we flew higher, I could see a much wider view of the landscape. From above, everything looks so organized and peaceful. The fields appeared like patches of different shades of green and brown, while rivers curved through the land like natural drawings. It is amazing how different the world looks from a high altitude. Places that may feel busy and complicated on the ground suddenly look calm and simple from the sky.


![1000160167.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23sJmcsmHjbfbBnowoxNk1f3DHddAjLLFHkyKN2NZFxoDmpNhin3mNh4MSDAxKBBn8A33.jpg)


What caught my attention the most were the clouds. Some of them looked soft, bright, and harmless from where I was sitting, but I realized that some of those clouds were probably carrying rain. From above, they looked so beautiful and peaceful, but down below, someone might be experiencing heavy rain. I guess that is also how life works sometimes. Depending on where we are looking from, the same thing can appear very different. It is really all about perspective.

That thought stayed with me during the flight. Traveling always has this effect on me. It resets my mind and gives me new motivation. I remember mentioning this to one of my colleagues before, that traveling gives me fresh energy to keep going, especially when work and routine start to feel repetitive. For me, it is not only about visiting a new place or taking photos. It is also about giving myself a chance to breathe, think, and return with a better mood.


![1000160170.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/241tZWh9JBmc1orPEmd2vgbajNm43cQNobpGYHzqE3ffFCgm7rxRyCyLgGErtn7Ujf5dA.jpg)

![1000160173.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpXKQz7xTjfLdAmh2e4hpixpnGWiPbmcuQ38xBG4BvMK9riADPMpujhsGhv7yhBeqdK.jpg)


Chiang Mai is a perfect place for that kind of reset. Compared to Bangkok, it feels more relaxed and grounded. Bangkok has its own amazing energy, but Chiang Mai has a charm that feels more personal. It is where you can still feel the village community of Thailand, even while modern cafes, malls, and new developments are slowly becoming part of the city.

I honestly feel like Chiang Mai will not become a metropolis like Bangkok, and maybe that is a good thing. Its current state is what makes it special. The calm vibe, the mountain backdrop, the temples, the local neighborhoods, and the slower pace are the reasons why I enjoy coming back.

***As the plane continued its journey, I kept looking outside the window, watching the clouds, the land, and the wing cutting through the blue sky. It felt like the beginning of another meaningful chapter of wandering.***

### Anyway, I am happy to be returning to Chiang Mai once again.

## See you on my next adventures!

body.title: The Balance Between the Rod and Wise Parenting
body.body:
I want to believe that not all children of past generations were physically disciplined and a lot of them still grew up to be responsible and well disciplined. Physical discipline is not the only form of discipline although the Bible stated it clearly that we spoil the child when we spare the rod. It doesn't mean using the rod at all times. And let's be honest, some of our parents in the past generations went extreme in not sparing the rod because a lot of them forgot how to use their words and their own action to teach the children too. The same Bible says fathers *(parents)* should not provoke the child to wrath, God knows there will be parents who use their rods wrongly. No, I'm not against parents using the rod to discipline their children. Even I will make good use of it when it gets to my turn, deciding not to use it at all is where problem will come because the Bible also says, foolishness is bound in the heart of a child and a rod will take it away. We want wise children growing to become adults so. What I am against is parents using the rod as a way for them to relieve themselves off the strong emotion they are feeling and not really about correcting or disciplining the child. I'm saying this because I've seen parents who almost killed their children in the name of discipline when in real sense, they have anger issues not yet worked on. ![file_00000000392072468e4662d3fae0c0e1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/48ikNsJQky3P2oGGcRMS1j95Re9cRWs24qia5iPveYjBUQSv6YDGrdeMX4S7Hijj1r.png) Parenting is more than disciplining by rod, what parents say and what parents do, goes a long way in driving off the foolishness in the hearts of their children. We all know there are children who had constant physical discipline but still turn out irresponsible as adults because the parents failed to teach what exactly they were correcting. And of course, there are the children who got all the discipline they needed through physical disciplinary actions. The difference is simply the parents doing more than just the rod on the kids, focusing on correcting them in love and wisdom. The decision to not physically discipline kids nowadays, is both good and bad, depending on what exactly the parents are replacing with that form of discipline. And from what I've seen, a lot of parents don't have the time and even the wisdom to teach these children the right thing to do. It would breed irresponsible kids, no doubt. Our generation of kids are this way because a generation evolved, saw beyond just physical discipline and there are the parents in the generation who still raise responsible children without the physical discipline. But I don't think using the physical discipline alongside other forms of discipline would cause kids of nowadays to become traumatised, if done right. In conclusion, there is no right or wrong way to raise a child that you want to grow up to be a good representation of you and even better than you. Just decide that you want your child to grow wiser and better than you, you will find the right ways to go about it and it starts with being the wise and better parent for the kids to learn from.
**Image used is AI generated.** Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@merit.ahama/the-balance-between-the-rod-and-wise-parenting-6en)

body.body:

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=valentinaviolin/8fbef88c)


---

El Caballo de Fuego galopa de nuevo.
Y en su estela, las cuerdas de mi violín tejieron el Festival de Primavera.
Este es mi primer latido en este canal: una interpretación en POV desde el corazón del concierto por el Año Nuevo Chino 2026, donde la energía del Caballo de Fuego —símbolo de pasión, libertad y renacimiento— se fundió con la tradición milenaria de esta melodía ancestral.

¿Sabías que el Festival de Primavera no es solo una canción?
Es el susurro de los faroles rojos al anochecer.
El crujido del papel de los sobres hongbao.
El eco de los tambores que ahuyentan lo viejo para dar paso a lo nuevo.
Y hoy, por primera vez en El Salvador, esas notas viajaron a través de un violín occidental… porque la música no entiende de fronteras, solo de almas dispuestas a escuchar.

🎻 Mi alma entre 4 cuerdas
Este video es mi mano tendida hacia ti. No vengo a mostrar perfección técnica — vengo a compartir el temblor antes de la primera nota, la respiración contenida, y esa magia silenciosa cuando el arco toca la cuerda y el tiempo se detiene.
___

body.title: How The Infrastructure for Energy Affects the Growth of Industry
body.body:
**How The Infrastructure for Energy Affects the Growth of Industry**  
Energy infrastructure helps industrial growth to be more rapid and steadier. Countries with dependable electrical grids, fuel transportation systems and advanced energy networks are likely to have better levels of manufacturing production and economic resilience. With the growth of worldwide industrialisation, investment in infrastructure and commodities markets is expanding in importance.  
**Higher energy costs**  
• The price of energy has a big effect on the production of commodities. Mining needs access to transportation, power and fuel. The rise in energy prices also increases the manufacturing costs of gold, silver and palladium.  
• This is why investors are keeping a watch on the [gold price chart](https://aubullion.ca/live-gold-price/), the [silver bullion price](https://aubullion.ca/live-silver-prices/), and the palladium spot price since the energy market is volatile.  
• Reliable industrial power systems are needed to make cars, which means that the palladium market depends on the infrastructure for energy. As a result, changes in the [price of palladium](https://aubullion.ca/live-palladium-prices/) are typically a reflection of expectations for industrial production.  
**Alterations to Renewable Energy**  
Investors think about more than just the [current prices of gold](https://aubullion.ca/live-gold-price/) and silver in US dollars. They also consider what's going on in the economy, inflation, and monetary policy.  
As buyers look at the current US dollar prices of gold and silver, they also think about how the economy, inflation, and monetary policy have changed  
**Top priority for the geopolitical system**  
Infrastructure for energy is becoming a more and more important part of global strategy. As a way to loosen their grip on uncertain areas, countries are competing to get energy sources that they can trust.  
Energy security isn't just about establishing credibility. It also impacts the cost of transportation, spending in the business, and producers' trust. When things are going badly, people want real gold more because they see it as a safe place to be.  
The desire for valuable metals can change a lot when industries grow thanks to new technologies. Long-term industry demand will continue to be met by silver's use in technology and renewable energy systems.  
People who want to buy gold bullion are often told to [buy gold bars](https://aubullion.ca/product-category/gold/gold-bars/) or [silver bullion](https://aubullion.ca/product-category/silver/) instead because the energy market is unstable.

body.title: Problems surfacing after the new government
body.body:
In Tamil Nadu, everyone is very happy with the formation of the new government. So many things have rapidly changed, and we are seeing some great, drastic improvement in the State. But in the last few days, we have noticed a huge change in the way electricity is given to the people. In the last government, we did not have this problem at all, but in the new government, we are seeing frequent power cuts. Initially, this was surfacing, and the Electrical minister provided an explanation for that, but now this is becoming difficult. 

I have two kids at home, and the continuous power cut problems in Tamil Nadu are becoming a nuisance. The weather is also very harsh right now, and we are seeing close to 45 degrees during the daytime, and all we need is a good night's sleep to compensate for the energy loss during the daytime. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXCPWGqruh6ZVegcRUo6vkKk5dzLRHwA8VWzk4g5Adf7H/image.png)

Source - Gemini

If the power cut is going to be a continuous thing, then it reminds me of the game Sim City that I used to play during my youth. When I manage a City in the game, the people of the city used to complain a lot about the power cut problems. If power is not provided properly to the SIMs, they will leave the city and start yelling at the Mayor. I feel like the same situation is happening in reality in our State. 

Some people comment saying that this government lacks experience when it comes to managing a few things. Some of the drastic steps the government is taking are actually creating problems. These are the comments from the opposition party and from a few people. Some houses have an inverter to provide some backup power when there is a power cut, but there are many houses that struggle without that. If this is going to be a continuous problem, then we may not have welcomed a great government, I should say. 

Experts said that even though the political party did not have the experience when forming the government, the IAS and IPS officers were the ones who were managing everything. If the government officials lack the experience, the other IAS officers should have given the right direction, and in the worst case, they should have at least suggested the following things that were followed in the earlier government. I don't know how this problem is going to be handled, but people are not very happy with the way the power cuts are happening. The power problems need immediate fixing.

body.title: The Qihe River In The Deeper Mountains Region Of The Huairou District
body.body:
>

The summer weather is getting hotter and hotter nowadays, and the daytime temperature has reached almost 30 degrees centigrade in recent days in this area where I live. Throughout the whole winter, I have not had any places due to the freezing cold, and I had no cycling sessions during the entire winter season. So, from the spring to the autumn is the best time for me to have some daily activities outside to visit the natural scenic areas in the Huairou district, which is also a great place to explore the natural beauty. 

During this warmer time in Beijing, whenever I get any opportunity, I do not miss the opportunity to go on an excursion to the mountainous region of the Huairou district, where I find the excellent natural beauty of the mountains, lakes and rivers. I found so many breathtaking scenic spots in the area, and the Qihe riverside area in the deeper mountains region is one of the best places to explore the natural beauty of the Huairou mountains.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZZ1QSPiECScrNYCsxSuMTxUwHFFkoYzR15vpjRs64Jw3/img_20260501_161819.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmap2LvGP5HhfSzpdi12yeocA5dcnLmGeHqEEvAqtCaUjq/img_20260501_161636.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvnQpvSLDHgx4x4S2ZMQQ5dCp6UGWXDaasCqFYd69Xoh/img_20260501_161809.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT4t1MqH6kkYFmi5NYe7GymyT8sTan778tiKCXdLkUVPU/img_20260501_162023.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZHuuKE8Jb5MrqHxWGezqjWkAam2amdvVxWdP1TPjyXe8/img_20260501_162119.jpg)

The Qihe River is a water stream that comes from the upper side of the mountains, and it is one of the most beautiful among all the scenic spots that I have ever visited in this western mountains region of the Huairou district. You can find so many stones in the riverbed area and on both sides of the stream. The surrounding mountain area is also made of stones, and so the number of large trees is not visible everywhere in this area. Also, the ups and downs in the mountain hiking routes make the surrounding view extremely beautiful and attractive.

The weather was also very good that day, with a cloudy sky, as you can see in the figures, with white spots in the blue sky, and the surrounding nature is not as clean, so the mountains in the far horizon are clearly visible. The breathtaking beauty of the mountains' greenery made the views more alluring for the visitors in the area.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbw1aE3ZxmhXRRD3CRGErMzUp2ZwEqLYgDVGvj9156BiP/img_20260501_162127.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZFBZ3c8nuPKeoHzkYcU8KwH9BfmqdF5x8bxWmd5FfyTJ/img_20260501_162131.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTVBSARE33sWmincjrVWfScUWWDXcv6raSAFYxAsgPnG/img_20260501_162205.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSmNFo9bFBjSWSk1fsWypUhKadXWzZBV2a71Q4FjyxCS/img_20260501_162219.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNPp75zbwrhWoShWsmyrvAmdgAmiodUCyWkjAWYQKSQyB/img_20260501_162326.jpg)


The forested area of the western mountain region is highly attractive for its natural surroundings, with pure greenery everywhere. The forest in this region is also easily accessible in the deeper area, which is a great place for the common visitors.

I have found a constant flow of water from the upper stream of the mountain, which runs alongside the Qihe riverside area. In conclusion, I can say that the area's natural beauty is soothing, with clean air and a calm environment, as it is at the end of city life, and there are no busy roads nearby, making the area a peaceful place. It was a completely healing environment for a leisurely day in nature.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaXvdBvsN2No3LTN1GqTDmXdHqSUjHNgCaQUyQMYRbHc/img_20260501_162423.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmadtG9XxjWPpz1QMAcThy3bfztykE8yc6MLBWv5fiqLgT/img_20260501_161415.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfDLBoEoiNUAxizV5NPRfD15rMgddU9D69t2mgWYnfToD/img_20260501_161515.jpg)








I hope you enjoy my photos of Huairou's beautiful natural scenic area in the mountain regions, with summer vibes, trees, and the surrounding green canopy, offering sketch-like views of the natural surroundings. The soothing beauty of a winter afternoon is a great time to enjoy outdoor activities in this area. If you have any questions, let me know in the comments, and I will do my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for your time and attention. I will catch up with you at the next one.

Wishing you a good day!

>I took all the photos, and these are my own property.

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.title: A creator builds lasting message.
body.body:
![IMG_20240914_121611_617-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23zGm6AbrRvnzJyseC9MLq3q1ZYJ5WensYTu47G8pwkC2qJxU9dFZ9isVzCunfawU7RKc.jpg)

A lot of creators are posting every day. But almost nobody remembers them.

And that is the real problem.Because visibility without memorability is fragile.People may read your post today…React to it…Even enjoy it…

Then completely forget you tomorrow.

Not because your content was terrible.But because there was no strong message attached to it.

Nothing clear enough to stay in their mind.

You need to understand something deeply…

People do not remember random content.

They remember patterns.

They remember repeated emotions.
Repeated themes.
Repeated perspectives.

That is how recognition is built.

![IMG_20260430_175251_083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/243WU71khB6NsP9Z6xqsosEMAMhay6fvvuHqEu9Ay5BAkE6HPYEbrRushD6FZD75qWMTf.jpg)

When somebody keeps seeing the same core message through different angles, your identity starts becoming stronger in their mind.

That is why clarity matters so much.

If your content keeps changing personality every few days, people may consume it… but they will never truly attach a clear identity to you.

And if there is no identity… there is no strong brand memory.

This is why some creators become unforgettable even with simple content.
Their message is stable.

You always know what they stand for.

You always know the kind of value they bring.

That consistency creates familiarity.

And familiarity creates trust.

Your audience should not have to guess who you are every time you post.

They should feel your message immediately.

The goal is not just to post good content.

The goal is to become mentally recognizable.

![IMG_20260430_170334_367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23zbUBycTSCVwAtiypt9SRSY32dzgb6cmP6w6G2xxdH5eiEKbaf8JHyZcRQU815x8zJKr.jpg)

To make people see certain struggles, ideas, or transformations and instantly think about your page.

That is when your content starts carrying weight.

Not because you shouted louder.

But because your message became clearer over time.
If I was a student starting from zero, this is how I’d learn copywriting and start earning.

Not theory. Not long courses I can’t afford.
Just what actually works.

Because let’s be honest,
Most students are broke not because they’re lazy, but because they don’t know what skill pays.

Copywriting is one of those skills.
And the best part?

You can start with just your phone.
Here’s how
1. Learn the basics (for free), Stop overcomplicating it.

Go on YouTube, Search for: Copywriting for beginners.
How to write to sell.
Learn things like: Headlines, Storytelling, Persuasion.

You don’t need to master everything.
Just understand how words make people take action.

Practice every single day, This is where most people fail.

Don’t just watch WRITE, Rewrite ads you see, 
Turn boring posts into engaging ones, Practice hooks daily.

Start from what’s around you, You don’t need clients first.
Look at: Your friend’s business, Your own WhatsApp status, Small vendors on campus.
Offer to help them write better captions or promos.

Even if it’s free at first, You’re building proof.

Turn your skill into income, Now this is where money enters.
You can: Write for small businesses, Manage WhatsApp/Instagram pages, Sell digital products with your writing.

Build in public, This changed everything for me.
Post what you’re learning, Post your results, Post your journey.

People don’t just pay for skill.
They pay for visibility + trust.

![IMG_2912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23w36Pi6SNA4iCm3jvFpkdj1DCKx8eq3vCzG2YpzqtWjaqtwZUWWtqrHWU8QZParPVmdz.jpg)

Copywriting is not magic. It’s a skill. A learnable one.

If you give it: 30–60 minutes daily, Consistency
And real practice.
You can go from a broke student
to someone who earns from their words.

What's stopping you from learning this skill today?
*All images are mine*

body.title: Memorial Day Melancholy
body.body:
Today is Memorial Day in the United States. This holiday is supposedly a somber occasion where the graves of war dead are decorated and their sacrifices are appreciated. Instead, it seems to be mainly a day for furniture sales and deals on new cars while people eat junk food. On one hand, this crass commercialism disgusts me. On the other hand, the original idea does, too.

Men have killed and died for centuries, usually to enrich the political class which rules them, and rarely for independence. The United States is now a *de facto* empire. The government is openly disregarding its own constitution to allow the President to wage war without the slightest hint of public debate. This makes more war dead, whether there is a declaration of war or not.

An executive with the power to wage war without consulting the public is a tyrant. Even if you don't share my anarchist inclinations, surely you can see how this violates the concept of a limited constitutional republic governing via democratic representation. The Democrat-led \

rally is only half-right in opposing overreach. I just wish they were consistent, and not just advocates of a different ruler. Likewise, MAGA denounced Obama and Biden without grasping the more fundamental principles, and instead rallied behind every Trump trespass.\n\nSo this Memorial Day, drink your cheap beer, eat your bratwurst, wave your damned flags and celebrate the blood sacrifices made at the altar of Uncle Sam. I won't be joining in the festivities. Instead, I'll be grieving senseless death and destruction perpetuated in my name by usurpers, and the unwilling conscripts or gullible patriotic volunteers who died just to feed the *libido dominandi* of those \

in government.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRU_ruqnR6Q

> It's always the old to lead us to the wars,
Always the young to fall.
Now look at all we've won with the saber and the gun,
Tell me, is it worth it all?

—Phil Ochs, *I Ain't Marching Anymore*

body.title: The Invisible Armor: How the Corporate World Forces Women to Choose Between Femininity and Authority [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU2XbJo9kTwK8X1KypRY2xgXSmmnhCdNZZ2rAxr6j7Mj1/1779733402132.png)
*Image generated with Google Gemini*

Hello, everyone! How are you? I hope you're all doing great. I'm feeling great today. It's been a while since I've posted here; between work and school (I'll give you an update on that very soon), I haven't had much free time.
>Hola comunidad, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén muy bien. Yo me encuentro excelente hoy. Hace mucho tiempo no pasaba a expresarme por aquí; entre el trabajo y el estudio (que muy pronto les haré actualización sobre eso) no he tenido mucho tiempo libre.

The thing is, I’ve been thinking for days about a situation that strikes me as both curious and complex: the role and perception of women in the workplace.
A few weeks ago, at work, someone warned me to be careful with an order from a specific client because “that old woman is a real pain.” I kept thinking about that phrase, and it connected me to something I’ve noticed throughout my experience: in the workplace, women in leadership positions or with strong personalities are often labeled “difficult” or “demanding” in a very derogatory way. I’ve had bosses who are practically the devil incarnate, and I also know people whose leaders are an impenetrable wall.
This made me reflect on the “why” behind this situation. In the world we live in, and especially in the professional sphere, it seems that men have implicit permission to be more relaxed or empathetic, because their authority is rarely questioned. In contrast, many women feel they cannot afford that flexibility; there is a latent fear that being “kind” will be mistaken for weakness, lead to disrespect, or, in the worst-case scenario, to sexualization.
I’ve noticed that in order to survive and thrive in a corporate world that has historically been very aggressive, many women end up adopting very rigid, masculine-style behaviors. It seems that the system tells us there is no room to exercise leadership from a feminine perspective without being taken less seriously. It’s as if, to earn respect, we are forced to don a suit of armor made of coldness and absolute authority.
>​El punto es que llevo días pensando en una situación que se me hace muy curiosa y a la vez compleja: el rol y la percepción de las mujeres en el ámbito laboral.
​Hace algunas semanas, en el trabajo, me estaban explicando que tuviese cuidado con el pedido de una clienta en específico porque \

. Me quedé pensando en esa frase y me conectó con algo que he notado a lo largo de mi experiencia: en el entorno laboral, las mujeres en puestos de liderazgo o con carácter fuerte suelen ser tildadas de \
de una forma muy despectiva. He tenido jefas que son prácticamente el diablo en persona, y también conozco personas cuyas líderes son un muro impenetrable.\n​Esto me hizo reflexionar sobre el \

de esta situación. En el mundo en el que vivimos, y sobre todo en el espacio profesional, parece que el hombre tiene el permiso implícito de ser más relajado o empático, porque su autoridad rara vez se cuestiona. En cambio, muchas mujeres sienten que no pueden permitirse esa flexibilidad; existe el temor latente de que ser \

se confunda con debilidad, dé pie a la falta de respeto o, en el peor de los casos, a la sexualización.
​He notado que para sobrevivir y mandar en un mundo corporativo que históricamente ha sido muy agresivo, muchas mujeres terminan adoptando dinámicas muy rígidas y masculinizadas. Parece que el sistema nos dice que no hay espacio para ejercer el liderazgo desde la feminidad sin que eso signifique que no nos tomen en serio. Es como si para ganarse el respeto, obligatoriamente hubiera que llevar una armadura de frialdad y autoridad absoluta.

What do you think about this topic? Do you think it’s a survival strategy in the workplace or a bias we still need to overcome? To be honest, it’s something that’s been on my mind for quite a while, and I’d love to hear about your experiences.
I hope you enjoyed today’s post. That’s all for now—take care, and see you next time! ❤️
>​¿Ustedes qué opinan de este tema? ¿Creen que es una estrategia de supervivencia laboral o un sesgo que todavía nos falta romper? La verdad es algo que ha estado dando vueltas en mi mente por un buen tiempo y me encantaría leer sus experiencias.
​Espero que les haya gustado el post de hoy. Por ahora me despido, ¡un abrazo y nos vemos en la próxima ocasión! ❤️

body.title: MCGI Review Topic | Is Watching Movies is a Sin?
body.body:
I'm asking, is it a sin to watch movies or is it the kind of movie you have to watch that is the problem?

This is a question we have to be asking ourselves. And we have to be asking with a serious heart. Which is the effect of the Bible, which is our guide.

So it's not that, as we got it, whether watching movies is a sin or not. We have also been taught in the Bible to watch our heart.

The scripture says in **Proverbs 4** that once you keep your heart, it's out of the heart. The issues of life are generated. This has also been warned.

Movies can bring about immorality, violence, lies and the worldly lifestyle. Watching movies can facilitate the sin by motivating us. Because what we see is what we feel is reality. This also shows us there are evil movies around.

According to **Philippians 4**, we need to think those things which are true and honest, which are pure. Which are law and of good. Is it safe to watch movies, asking ourselves, when it comes to the moral lesson that we have to learn from this movie.

In conclusion, watching a film is not necessarily a sin. But to the point that we allow those evil and bad parts to part our life, is the most important thing there. When it does out of sin, then it is bad to watch movies.

body.title: Diy cherry 🍒
body.body:
Hello, Hi, Namaste to all HIVE users who have reached this post. I hope you are all doing great. Here I am sharing a cherry made using foam clay / air-dry clay.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSf5CaU3rn5Hix4SAjJWgQ6yp2YDytGXVovNyQsv1DngW/1779730892625.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfZNuF8hn12V3apgjm8dtw6HSMQL3mCkstQzZ5Tkm3Rha/1779730892441.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTFpC4RmbosdjMTuFR3J5TgkD8LYhCGsvnZ7nw9bX5Har/1779730892788.jpg)

Also, I wanted to share something with you - do you remember the rose bouquet I made a few days back?
So, I just inserted it in a keychain tightly and went to my college ( my mother told me not to insert it in a key ring it will not look good). While I was going to submit my assignment, someone just pulled the bouquet from the keyring and I realised it after coming out of the building that the keyring was empty. I am sure that someone pulled it because I attached it tightly and it couldn't fall by itself(though I still checked the area I went to, and still didn't find anything). I felt really bad and realised that I should have listened to my mom.

So, here are the steps of the cherry-

For making the base ( I mean the branch) I used metal bangles. Cut it into pieces and straighten it using pliers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjQUUZpqiLhi41LrGdTJjZ7fGVudcDhBapTmhzf8LdmH/1779731476506.jpg)

Then attached them together using fevibond.( It's a very strong glue)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtVdKUwbKfZpFnjwNJBQ8BRaNr8YrRzyVgqrxWLiCzGo/1779731825970.jpg)

After it is fixed properly, I started covering the above part using clay ( Used brown colour clay but it doesn't matter at all because I coloured it later).
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdpCutFCbjtsGyLpMb4k9JPwApLwviKzJbqnWAV42ykeM/1779731826082.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSMGUg1CEvVaPZtaScsFpejUHCQ4uDwRkXzUMDft6mJe8/1779731826179.jpg)

Then coloured the bottom part with dark green (later on changed it to light green).

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeUctKGiuHgoyvAKHy5jyNgkY5WLDGpA6QJxo4e38AHkM/1779731826266.jpg)
  Made 2 balls using red clay and after drying attached them to the branch.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJQc8ANUgdzFN9vrGaQnzSKHfZ1VPmrp17YF62thLrW9/1779731826379.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd2XdgL4LZ1Db7ghVn9qNofMTqkPY69VLwx83XoquL8xh/1779732814112.jpg)
 Then made leave and inserted a wire in it to so that it would be easy to attach to the branch.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdhuHsLK2nR4ssuxm5cXRJYaxNdvirArbVJW6Jy2Zh4AN/1779732814265.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWELY4xX4JyThj4fD1Way4TKemrGgos3bfdeSEeG9co3y/1779732814406.jpg)
 After this I coloured the balls using red and the branch dark green.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCsjQdkrZ1kCaqsjvrmQchELMKaduaq3L4vS5FPDqTPw/1779732814547.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaA2ipAABi1QcDR3EDX7aqzkLwuBZsuzZz2KzmiDvTuVS/1779733061117.jpg)
Though I made 2 leaves but I attached just 1.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf7AnMFvRojUBnGtfk9cQYP4hGJN8VzkK3z4bubc1ZxG4/1779733061225.jpg)
 Also attached the leave and here the cherry was ready.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTFpC4RmbosdjMTuFR3J5TgkD8LYhCGsvnZ7nw9bX5Har/1779733061446.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTutBa12DbauKpHf2iHMx1Gqw84J6LXEUz8uGYNsr2kED/1779733061545.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSf5CaU3rn5Hix4SAjJWgQ6yp2YDytGXVovNyQsv1DngW/1779733192621.jpg)
Hope you all liked it, do share your opinions with me.
Thank you for visiting my post 😊

body.title: LEARN AI SERIES[#1]-WHY YOUR AI FORGETS EVERYTHING IT LEARNED YESTERDAY
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfVRLBRM8NkPR2ww4wwiEXnJLgQJct35G4NZsxcNrKmB/1779732583669.png)


Artificial Intelligence is becoming smarter every day, yet many people are surprised when an AI seems to \

information from previous conversations. If AI can write essays, solve problems, and generate images, why does it struggle to remember what happened yesterday?

The answer lies in how most AI systems are designed.

Unlike humans, AI does not naturally build long-term memories from every interaction. Most AI models generate responses based on the information available in the current conversation. Once that conversation ends, the AI may no longer have access to what was discussed before.

Think of it like writing on a whiteboard. During a conversation, the whiteboard is filled with useful information. When the session ends, the board is wiped clean unless the system is specifically designed to save important details.

This approach has advantages. It helps protect user privacy and prevents AI systems from storing large amounts of personal information without permission. However, it also means that AI can appear forgetful.

Researchers are actively working on ways to improve AI memory. Future systems may be able to remember important facts, learn from previous interactions, and provide more personalized assistance while still respecting privacy and security.

As AI continues to evolve, the balance between memory, privacy, and usefulness will remain one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence.

What do you think? Should AI remember more about its users, or should it continue to forget most conversations after they end?

body.body:
# TAKANAKUY DOCUMENTARY: THE STRENGTH OF THE ANCESTORS / LA FUERZA DE LOS ANCESTROS [ENG-ESP]
### Documentary Photography / Fotografía Documental

<center>


![_DSC9264.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23tmBcmA9VA4G2HcDPyhvF6VBExSW4KX8tHDdbF356JaXrmBDpyxtTNW3oZWxDbUKoewJ.jpg)

*“A millenary tradition where conflict transforms into celebration, and blows end in community peace.”*
*“Una tradición milenaria donde el conflicto se transforma en fiesta y los golpes terminan en paz comunitaria.”*

</center>

![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

<div class=\

>

### English

Hello, friends of the Black and White community! It has been a while since I last brought you the remaining pieces of what I promised from the \

documentary series. Now in its final fights, final photos, and final reviews, I came across this great fight featuring a young woman named Soto against an opponent whose name I honestly don't know—I assume her name is Soto because it was written on her belt. 

It was an incredibly intense fight. I was deeply captivated by the women's matches because there is something uniquely raw about seeing two young women fighting with such brutality and bare knuckles. They showed immense dedication and emotion, which was palpable both in the ring and through the camera lens, capturing intense facial expressions, raw energy, the crowd's excitement, and relentless blows thrown without mercy. This is what Takanakuy truly means. Then comes the end: the celebration between the groups, the shared happiness, drinking the beer of triumph, and everything merging into an ambiguous Andean world that reminds us of our ancestors and our culture, which is the most important element I want to emphasize here. 

Beyond the fighting, the true meaning of Takanakuy is a millenary custom passed down through generations in the Andean world. It is how ancient civilizations resolved their differences and problems, converting conflict into a festival that ultimately ends in peace, unity, and community progress. A united community is a community that moves forward. 

Since I absolutely loved these shots, today's series is a bit more extensive. It is a pity that this festival only happens once a year, but I am already looking forward to preparing myself better for the next one. For the next Takanakuy, I want to narrow my focus—perhaps focusing solely on close-ups of the fights (though I will need a telephoto lens for that), or purely on portraits and specific details of a single person, rather than trying to cover everything. The framing and portraits from this culture are simply beautiful. 

I hope you enjoy this series. Sharing my art with you is a true honor, and I value every comment deeply. I admire many photographers here and have learned a lot from them. I am always grateful to the MonoMad Challenge because it provides a unique gateway to grow as photographers—a recognition of pure effort and hard work that isn't easily found on other platforms. There is no negative criticism here; when it exists, it is constructive, helping this community and our craft grow. Blessings to everyone, thank you so much, and see you in the next post. Good vibes always!

### Español

¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro! Hace tiempo que no les traía lo que quedaba de lo que les había prometido sobre la serie del documental \

. Ya en sus últimas peleas, fotos y revisiones, encontré esta gran pelea de la señorita Soto contra una rival cuyo nombre desconozco (supongo que se apellida Soto porque lo llevaba escrito en su cinturón). Fue una pelea muy, muy intensa. Me gustaron especialmente los encuentros de las mujeres porque resulta impactante ver a dos jóvenes peleando de una manera tan brutal a puño limpio. Demostraron mucha entrega y emoción; eso se sentía en el ruedo y se transmitía en las fotografías a través de sus facciones: la energía, la expectativa del público, los amigos y los golpes lanzados uno tras otro sin piedad. Eso es lo que significa el Takanakuy. Y al final, llega la celebración entre los grupos, la felicidad compartida bebiendo la cerveza del triunfo, donde todo se convierte en un mundo andino que nos recuerda a nuestros ancestros y a la riqueza de nuestra cultura, que es lo que más quiero recalcar aquí. Más allá de los golpes, el verdadero significado del Takanakuy es el de una costumbre milenaria que ha pasado de generación en generación en el mundo andino. Es la forma en que las comunidades resolvían sus diferencias y problemas, convirtiendo un conflicto en una festividad que al final termina en paz, unión y bienestar para la comunidad, porque una comunidad unida es una comunidad que avanza. Espero que esta serie de fotos sea de su agrado; hoy es un poco más extensa porque estas capturas en serio me encantaron. Ya voy terminando con el material de Takanakuy. Es una pena que sea una festividad de una vez al año, pero ya sigo con las ansias preparándome para el próximo. Para la siguiente oportunidad quiero enfocarme mejor: he pensado en centrarme únicamente en primeros planos de las peleas (aunque necesitaré un teleobjetivo para eso), o solo en retratos y detalles de una sola persona, en lugar de abarcar tanto. Los encuadres y retratos andinos son hermosísimos. Espero que les guste la serie. Como siempre, se las envío con muchas vibras. Expresar mi arte para ustedes es un honor y tomo cada comentario de la mejor manera. Admiro a muchos fotógrafos de aquí y he aprendido bastante de ellos. Agradezco como siempre al MonoMad Challenge porque es una puerta abierta para crecer como fotógrafos, un espacio donde se reconoce el trabajo puro y el esfuerzo, sin críticas negativas; todo lo que hay es constructivo y nos ayuda a evolucionar. Bendiciones a todos, muchas gracias y espero verlos pronto en un siguiente post. ¡Vibras para todos siempre! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

body.title: 狗狗是人类最忠诚的伴侣，它们总是无条件地爱着
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3568639a84d8cfb9bceeb55d4e0292640323c65e3655631fda71f26432166751f4fb4deaa62aea092629831a7a67fd8904142d6a1c3febe6bb6c651e69559c0b_640.jpg)</center>

***

狗是一种非常忠诚和友好的动物，它们不仅是人类的好伙伴，还能带来无尽的快乐和陪伴。每当看到狗狗摇着尾巴、兴奋地扑过来时，总能让人感受到一种纯真的快乐。它们渴望爱与关注，与它们相处的时光总是充满了温暖和欢笑。狗狗用它们的真诚和无条件的爱，教会我们珍惜生活中的每一个瞬间。

body.title: 🥭✨ Refreshing Homemade Mango Juice | A Sweet Tropical Drink 🍹/ 🥭✨ Jugo Casero de Mango Refrescante | Una Bebida Tropical Deliciosa 🍹
body.body: > Hello Amazing Drinks community! 👋🥭✨ Today I want to share with you a delicious and refreshing homemade drink that is super easy to make: a **natural mango juice** 🍹💛. Mango is one of those tropical fruits that brings sweetness, freshness, and an incredible flavor in every sip 😍🌴. Today’s recipe is very simple and only requires a few ingredients that we usually have at home 🏡✨.

> 🍹 Preparation: --------------- 1️⃣ First, wash the mangoes well and peel them carefully 🥭✨. 2️⃣ Cut the mango pulp into pieces and place them in the blender 🌀. 3️⃣ Add water little by little 💧 and sugar according to your taste 🍬. 4️⃣ Blend everything for a few minutes until you get a smooth and delicious texture 😍🍹. 5️⃣ Serve cold and enjoy this tropical delight! ❄️🥭✨

> This juice is perfect for hot days ☀️, to share with family 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦, or simply to enjoy a refreshing natural drink at home 🏡💛. The flavor is sweet, refreshing, and very tropical 🌴🥭. I really enjoy homemade drinks because they feel more natural and delicious 😋✨. Thank you for reading my post! 💕 Let me know if you also love mango juice 🍹🥭✨ * * *

> ¡Hola comunidad de Amazing Drinks! 👋🥭✨ El día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una bebida deliciosa y muy refrescante que es súper fácil de preparar: un **jugo natural de mango** 🍹💛. El mango es una de esas frutas tropicales que aporta dulzura, frescura y un sabor increíble en cada sorbo 😍🌴. La receta de hoy es muy sencilla y solo necesita pocos ingredientes que normalmente tenemos en casa 🏡✨.

></center>

Este jugo es perfecto para los días calurosos ☀️, para compartir en familia 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 o simplemente para disfrutar una bebida natural y refrescante en casa 🏡💛.

Su sabor es dulce, refrescante y muy tropical 🌴🥭. Me encanta preparar bebidas caseras porque se sienten más naturales y deliciosas 😋✨.

body.title: Wen Deal?
body.body:
Alright, I'm getting straight to it because this weekend was absolute chaos. Saturday night Trump comes out and says the Iran deal is “basically done.” Everyone breathes easy. Then the very next day, Sunday morning, he's back: “Don't rush it…Time's on our side.”

 
WHAT WENT DOWN OVER THE WEEKEND

Quick recap. On Saturday Trump announces a deal with Iran is “mostly hammered out.” He even says he made calls from the Oval Office with half the Middle East. Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt, Jordan, Bahrain. Plus Netanyahu, of course.


What's in this deal? First, a memorandum of understanding as phase one. Then within 30 to 60 days, broader discussions. The biggest piece? Opening the Strait of Hormuz.

Just as everyone was waiting for the official announcement, Sunday rolls around. And Trump changes his tune. He posts that talks are going “constructively,” but tells his people to pump the brakes. “Both sides need to do this right. There's no room for mistakes,” he wrote. And he added one more thing. The naval blockade of Iranian ports stays in effect until a deal is actually signed.

What does that mean? Until ink hits paper, nothing's locked in.

You're probably thinking, “okay, if they're almost there, what's the holdup?


Honestly, plenty.

First and biggest. Enriched uranium. The US wants Iran to hand over its stockpiles and never get a nuclear weapon. Iran refuses. The Supreme Leader actually issued a rare public order. No enriched uranium leaves the country. An Iranian source told Reuters the nuclear issue wasn't even part of the preliminary deal.

Sticking point number two. The Strait of Hormuz itself. Trump talks about opening it. But Iran's Fars news agency says the Strait stays under Iranian control. They slammed Trump's announcement as “incomplete and disconnected from reality.”

And there's a third issue. Lebanon. According to Al Jazeera, the memo includes a ceasefire framework for Lebanon. But Israel isn't on board. They're pressing Washington to add language allowing military operations in Lebanon, justified by “any threat.” Iran rejects this and wants a permanent ceasefire. Netanyahu actually said Trump confirmed Israel's right to defend itself “on every front, including Lebanon.”

Rubio, who was in India, said progress was made over the last 48 hours and “good news” might be coming. But he was clear on one thing. Iran can never have a nuclear weapon.
 
WHY WALL STREET CARES

And this is where the markets come in. Oil. This war has hit the Strait of Hormuz, where roughly 20% of the world's oil and LNG flows through. When oil moves, almost everything moves with it. Inflation, interest rates, grocery prices.

So where are we now? Brent closed at $103.94 a barrel. US WTI at $96.60. But check this. Over the week Brent fell more than 5% and US oil more than 8%. Why? Because Trump said he called off planned strikes to let negotiations happen. Just the whiff of a deal is enough to knock prices down.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPHfygWPdV7KBwLE8ocW5iBUzd956vuUebpc6aNt62t6v/img_7888.png)


So where do we go from here? A Bloomberg survey of 126 market experts says most see Brent averaging between $81 and $100 over the next year. So basically a “ceiling” around $100. How does that happen? Something called demand destruction. Put simply, demand drops to offset the missing supply. Hardly a healthy setup.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZd1e5GwJ82KBHfQBgWNRCLr5uQunmYUjvf8BVsxp7q6E/img_7889.png)



On the flip side, there's a big “but.” The International Energy Agency warns that as we head into summer and travel demand picks up, the market could enter a “red zone” soon as global inventories drain. And MUFG goes even further. Oil might not get back to normal until 2027.

So yeah, prices fell on hopes of a deal. But as ING's analysts pointed out, this isn't the first time a deal looked close and then fell apart.

That is a very good point to discus.
I agree that volatility of bitcoin is a very important concern. The beauty of bitcoin lightning is the three points above, but the price changes are problematic. Strike Bitcoin solves this beautifully by changing dollars to bitcoin for the money transfer and bitcoin back to dollars at the other end. Because bitcoin exchanges exist in almost every country, bitcoin dollar-pairs or bitcoin -other fiat pairs exist, so this conversion is universally available. Plus the dollar is nearly universally acceptible.

Stablecoins are also an important point to discus. 
I agree that stablecoins are competition for bitcoin in the money transfer business and point of sale transactions. Only the future will show if they are successful in displacing bitcoin. History shows that a first mover advantage is hard to overcome.So if lightning nodes facilitate this dollar transition they will help bitcoin succeed. 
The problem there may be regulations for the lightning node operators to perform this bitcoin to dollar conversion, such as the requirement for a money transmitter license. In the US you need one for every state, while in other places you need just one, for the country you operate in. So unless the customer conducts the conversion, the laws and regulations limit the number of operators who can provide this service. 

But laws and regulations can change, or processes can be made easier. So as we say here in the US, we have to wait and see what happens!
Thanks for commenting.

body.title: 🌌 SpacePicture of a Day: Thackeray's Globules 🪐
body.body:
![Thackeray's Globules](https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/image/2605/ThackerayGlobs_Hayes_960.jpg)

***

>What are these strange space globs?  Situated in rich star fields and glowing hydrogen gas, these opaque clouds of interstellar dust and gas are so large they might be able to form stars. Their home is known as IC 2944, a bright stellar nursery located about 7,600 light years away toward the constellation of the Centaur (Centaurus). The largest of these  dark globules, first spotted by A. D. Thackeray in 1950 using a telescope in South Africa, is likely two separate but overlapping clouds, each more than one light-year wide. Along with other data, the featured Hubble palette image from the El Sauce Observatory in Chile, indicates that Thackeray's globules are fractured and churning as a result of intense ultraviolet radiation from young, hot stars already energizing and heating the bright emission nebula. These and similar dark globules known to be associated with other star forming regions may ultimately be dissipated by their hostile environment -- like cosmic lumps of butter in a hot frying pan.   Interstellar Jigsaw: Astronomy Puzzle of the Day

body.body:
Eu defendo armazenamento e distribuição local de mídia. Por isso faço experimentos com IPFS. Em particular envolvendo ffmpeg e HLS.

Um dos meus experimentos clássicos envolvia transformar quase qualquer formato de vídeo  em um HLS de 4 resoluções(360p,480p,720p e 1080p), para que o browser pudesse baixar o m3u8 contendo os fluxos, o m3u8 de cada fluxo e os ts com os pedaços de vídeo de cada fluxo. Não sei se já existe suporte nativo nos browsers para HLS, apesar de quase todo mundo usar esse formato.

O que eu gosto nele é justamente que o player do browser é capaz de mudar a resolução no meio da reprodução, baixando um conjunto de ts mais pesados ou mais leves, dependendo do caso. Fora que o ffmpeg tem um mecanismo que recebe um fluxo de vídeo por rtmp ou rtsp e fica modificando o m3u8 periodicamente com fluxos parciais, fazendo com que o browser fique baixando e descartando arquivos ts para exibir uma única vez, se atualizando periodicamente com os m3u8 para saber quais ts baixar.

O grande problema do HLS é que não dá pra baixar(facilmente) os vídeos exibidos nos sites, uma vez que eles estão separados em múltiplos cabeçalhos m3u8 e diversos fragmentos TS. Mas pelo menos tem muitas bibliotecas Javascript para exibir fluxos HLS no browser.

Já faço uso do IPFS para armazenar todos os m3u8 e ts de vídeos completos em HLS, mas minha dúvida seria sobre a possibilidade de, para poder fazer um fluxo contínuo, ficar publicando os TS em tempo real no IPFS, atualizando apenas os m3u8 do fluxo com os CIDs dos tss alimentados no IPFS.

## O que eu descrevi acima:

Tecnologia usada tanto para transmitir vídeos completos(como arquivos mp4) quanto transmissões em tempo real(como rtsp ou rtmp) de um servidor para múltiplos browsers de forma que cada um seja capaz de selecionar a resolução manualmente ou automaticamente dependendo da conexão.

body.title: Are we all hoarders now...?
body.body:
The past several decades of economic globalisation was built on a relatively high level of trust in global markets - with companies generally expecting that raw materials and goods could be sourced for a predictable price in a reasonable time frame. 

But recent events such as Covid and wars have revealed just how vulnerable supply chains are and now there is an increasing tendency for governments and corporations to stock pile reserves of resources. 

And for us ordinary people too, just on a more household-level. 

many countries are now busy building up strategic reserves in oil, gas, microchips, rare earths, you name it.

And on paper this is entirely logical. If trade grinds to a halt, those stockpiles buy you time.

But here’s the catch.

The more everyone hoards, the worse it gets for the system as a whole. Stockpiling pulls goods off the market, pushes up prices, and spooks others into doing exactly the same thing. It’s easy to see how fear and competition can set off a worldwide insecurity spiral.

And we could maybe draw a parallel with The Great Depression cwhich hanged the mindset of a generation; people got into the habit of saving and stockpiling because they’d lived through real scarcity.

And maybe we are seeing a return to this today...?


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23tkjavhzHf3jSSDsCSwbX8v2zpo8JLqYcz8PgAyucJW4tRwSz8BnhaiR5m3fVq97zyv7.png)

What with ao many countries scrambling for the raw materials beihnd AI tech it seems we're a long way from the free trade optimism we saw in the 1990s and early 2000s. 

Now Nation States are acting much more like they are on their own... 

But this isn't so much about greed and ambition, it's more due to uncertainty and fear of future shocks.... 

In fact I think maybe people would think governments irresponsible if they weren't preparing for future shocks, I mean we know their going to be coming, we just don't quite know when or what the nature of them is going to be!

body.title: How to cultivate hope in difficult times? | ¿Cómo trabajar la esperanza en tiempos difíciles?
body.body:
>

<center>**¡Bienvenido a un nuevo post, querido Hiver!**</center>

<div class=\

> **Dicen que la esperanza es lo último que se pierde. Pero, ¿cómo mantenerla viva?** Leía la iniciativa de @emiliorios [Nos Urge Hablar de la Esperanza: ¿Cómo la Cuidas y Alimentas? -Esta es La Iniciativa No. 24 en Domingo de Séptimo Día- (ES/EN)](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen) y pensaba en cuando inicié uno de mis canales de YouTube. Decidí empezar a hablar acerca de inversión, ahorros y generar ingresos online siendo venezolana y viviendo en Venezuela. Y no ha sido fácil. No es un nicho sencillo, porque el que lo empieza primero debe tener contenido de calidad que esa misma persona haya probado antes, además de combatir cada día el pesimismo. Sin embargo, no juzgo a las personas que me han dejado malos comentarios porque los entiendo. En algún momento de la vida he estado en ese lugar, sin trabajo, sin dinero, sin posibilidades de ahorrar, sin nada de nada. También puedo darme cuenta de que ante un panorama como ese no es que se tenga tanta esperanza, tampoco ves la salida. En esos momentos de la vida, la esperanza se reflejó de ciertas formas que me ayudaron a conservarla. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**They say hope is the last thing to die. But how do you keep it alive?** > >I was reading @emiliorios's initiative [We Urgently Need to Talk About Hope: How Do You Nurture and Care for It? -This is Initiative No. 24 on Seventh Day Sunday- (ES/EN)](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@emiliorios/nos-urge-hablar-de-la-esperanza-como-la-cuidas-y-alimentas-esta-es-la-iniciativa-no-24-en-domingo-de-septimo-dia-esen) and thinking about when I started one of my YouTube channels. > >I decided to start talking about investing, saving, and generating income online, being Venezuelan and living in Venezuela. > >And it hasn't been easy. It's not an easy niche, because whoever starts it first needs to have quality content that they themselves have tried before, in addition to fighting pessimism every day. > >However, I don't judge the people who have left me negative comments because I understand them. At some point in my life, I've been in that place: without a job, without money, without the possibility of saving, without anything at all. > >I can also see that in a situation like that, you don't exactly have much hope, nor do you see a way out. > >In those moments of life, hope manifested itself in certain ways that helped me to hold onto it.
![photo_2026-05-25_13-42-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EoAb87RAfvkbJ1vGXFRYka8EBH6at7ovzQZLRyRm2UBSpWucjw3ZtbpLPBVDQsDQ7zU.jpg)

> **Leer la palabra de Dios** Llorar es algo que te ayuda a soltar; sin embargo, leer la palabra de Dios te da dirección. Todos pasamos por malos momentos; lo que hace la diferencia son las acciones que tomamos. Podemos tomar la decisión de llorar cada día, quedarnos en cama, rendirnos por completo. O salir a hacer todo lo posible por lograr un cambio en nuestra vida. Yo elegí la segunda. En gran parte, leer la Biblia fue de utilidad para mí. En ella encontré consuelo, también un estilo de vida y el ánimo que necesitaba para continuar en el momento más difícil. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Reading God's Word** > >Crying helps you let go; however, reading God's Word gives you direction. > >We all go through tough times; what makes the difference are the actions we take. > >We can choose to cry every day, stay in bed, and give up completely. Or we can go out and do everything possible to make a change in our lives. > >I chose the latter. Reading the Bible was very helpful to me. In it, I found comfort, a way of life, and the encouragement I needed to keep going during the most difficult time.
![photo_2026-05-25_13-42-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/Eos2fqPBrWifyXVNhdgDtbVae2QFBAsHAPwHSThHzKjPawjjhz8ywQDGX3wMtPW31Gs.jpg)

> **Tener metas en la vida** Algo importante que hay que decirle a todo el mundo es: + Lee la Biblia. + Ten metas en la vida. Sobre la segunda, es algo que te motiva a seguir adelante, a trabajar por eso que anhelas, y te mantiene lo suficientemente ocupado. Tener una meta te hace obligarte a trabajar por ella hasta conseguirla. *¿Y qué pasa si ya conseguí mi meta?* Vas y buscas otra meta u objetivo. La vida es incierta, ¿por qué no aprovechar todo el tiempo que tengamos en hacer lo que queremos lograr? Nunca hay que limitar; siempre hay que ir por más haciendo las cosas bien. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**Having Goals in Life** > >Something important to tell everyone is: > >+ Read the Bible. > >+ Have goals in life. > >Regarding the second point, it's something that motivates you to keep going, to work for what you long for, and keeps you busy enough. > >Having a goal forces you to work for it until you achieve it. > >*And what happens if I've already achieved my goal?* > >You go and look for another goal or objective. Life is uncertain, so why not take advantage of all the time we have to do what we want to achieve? > >Never limit yourself; always strive for more by doing things well.
![photo_2026-05-25_13-42-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/Eos1G3WCYuXcEWntu8hhKnnoLQD18Cs83SSp2mURmVZRCAtjRenZB3TijiLir8umw6z.jpg)

> **¿En qué me beneficia todo esto?** Mantener la esperanza viva es una decisión personal y la consecuencia de nuestras propias acciones. La esperanza de que las cosas mejorarán, de que lograremos nuestras metas, de que habrá algún cambio positivo debe estar siempre encendida como una vela. Y para que la vela se mantenga encendida, debemos hacer lo posible por lograrlo gracias a cada acción en nuestra vida. Cómo salir de la cama, levantarnos, iniciar un nuevo proyecto. Leer un poco para conseguir inspiración o dirección, salir a caminar para despejar la mente, ir a tomar un café para sentirnos mejor con nosotros mismos. De esa misma manera cada día. Porque sí, la verdad es que la vida tiene sus momentos buenos y sus momentos malos. Sin embargo, tenemos el maravilloso poder en nuestras manos de cambiarlo todo. >! [English version available by clicking here] >**How ​​does all this benefit me?** > >Keeping hope alive is a personal decision and the consequence of our own actions. > >The hope that things will improve, that we will achieve our goals, that there will be some positive change, must always be burning like a candle. > >And for the candle to stay lit, we must do everything possible to achieve it through every action in our lives. > >Like getting out of bed, getting up, starting a new project. Reading a little to find inspiration or direction, going for a walk to clear our minds, going for a coffee to feel better about ourselves. > >In that same way, every day. > >Because yes, the truth is that life has its good moments and its bad moments. However, we have the wonderful power in our hands to change everything. >Texto de mi autoría. > **Imágenes en el post creadas por mi en estos software:** >+ Iconos hechos en Photoshop, usando como referencia los logos de las redes sociales correspondientes. >+ Banners y portada realizados en Canva en la versión gratuita. >+ Todas las fotografías en el post son de mi autoría, las cuales edito con las apps de Lightroom y Meitu.

Soy administrador de profesión, y me dedico al trabajo independiente, también creo contenido online sobre estilo de vida, jardinería y hogar como @zulfrontado. Estoy enamorada del arte, las letras, los tonos verdes de la naturaleza, y de la vida. Por lo que lo verás reflejado de forma reflexiva en mi blog. De antemano, gracias apoyarme y por leer.❤️❤️ --- *Contacto a mis RRSS, o escribe a mi Discord: zulfrontado#2666* |[![Instagram 60x60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/AJeireYYVzuoKcgxpbQ25xX4rApxHTTjSYaX6i1sXb6pPifeb9kRzAagrfcfno5.png)](https://www.instagram.com/zulfrontado/)|[![Facebook 60x60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/AK589Kcqhrq9L2i7yNPhKVKArUdnbv3B87R3yH1Mn69KvC87tJnyBtX5cAFW6pF.png)](https://www.facebook.com/zulfrontado/)|[![Tiktok 60x60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/AK2FPF3otgCr2go3A2Qtsq4xaLApRTkJR8D4c9NSfptJWVrTkRvRsrUjAcB5ad5.png)](https://www.tiktok.com/@zulfrontado)|[![Threads 60x60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/AJhbcjABUBbut9heu6WZL3iynrDHL8VxxDX5aQw1KuS9SoiwutK795yzct2oWfd.png)](https://www.threads.net/@zulfrontado/) | [![Twitter 60x60.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/AK57pyN1mzsHaJRD7KsypZWrqm1mjS2SgKSaR74YVYU8SCSAUXjSty3WvQXQ9Vd.png)](https://x.com/FrontadoZul) | |-|-|-|-|-|

body.title: [TV] T1.E2 ∙ Candy Carrier Chaos! The first mission
body.body:
In this second chapter, Caine decides to send the traumatized Pony, along with Ragatha, Jax, Gangle, and Kinger, to a completely new map: **the Candy Kingdom**, to complete a mission for Princess Candy: to rescue a cart full of honey that was stolen by the Gummigoo Crocodile gang. They succeed, capturing the thugs, but Pony and Gummigoo the Crocodile end up falling under the map.

![MV5BYzBjOTliMTYtYzNiMS00N2I0LWE5Y2EtNzhiYjg0YzhlYmY4XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wCLW1jQDH5xqhrHwGTzc9RTzLHcA9FU9eiU7GdfsGFgfSapveYchnZk5jURF6CvqZXg.jpg)

Pomni and Gummigoo meet on the path and collide. Due to a system error, they glitch and fall through the floor. As they plummet into the void, Gummigoo wanders around the area where he lands and finds a room filled with 3D models identical to himself, his mother, his friends, and his village.

![MV5BMzdlYTJjNDAtZGNhYy00ZDFmLTk1ODMtYzc1N2ZhMTg4ZTkyXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23w2wvvwEY6V5x31Mjjfwm1ZuZkPAx8wqnTR3GHoXNV6fJQspk3wW9ASvbKbY72G5b6GS.jpg)

It is then that the crocodile discovers the truth: his entire life, his childhood memories, and his home are just an illusion created by Caine. He is not a person; he is just an NPC (a non-player character) designed to be the villain of a repetitive mission. Gummigoo enters an existential identity crisis and is completely paralyzed by shock and sadness.

![MV5BYWVlYTE0YmMtYWMyNS00OTI3LTgyMTMtZDUxMDBmYWE2OTdhXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoniZLKhpPSybku4QUPiVjjePuuF4eCm3jjmprue3v6Tn8wQwVoZS76tMy2vRXnmjiQ.jpg)

When the gummy bear realizes it's an NPC, it's shocked because it sees its entire life and realizes it doesn't exist. Pomni, who had become its friend, tells it, \

They leave there and then drive off in the truck full of honey. And Jacks, on purpose, leaves the key in the ignition so the monsters can eat the chocolate kingdom.

When everyone finally reached the Digital Circus through a portal opened by Caine, Gummigoo crossed over with the group and excitedly arrived at the Digital Circus, ready to start a new life... but the happiness lasted only a few seconds.

![MV5BZDU3MDBmYzYtZjg1ZC00NDNjLTgxMGUtNmY2YzUyZmFkMGY1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23xAioJAXDqtSxS1dj3dzgfJjGVmXajTbabXxCJe2jFRjDby6JPA5GEbdRRTUjLbWuiLq.jpg)

Caine saw them, panicked, and uttered his famous line about not being able to distinguish between a human and an NPC. With a snap of his fingers... Caine erases Gummigoo from existence instantly!

And what shocked me was that when the gummy bear Pomny disappeared, she was stunned, seeing how the only friend she'd made since arriving at the digital circus had vanished. Pomny was just as shocked as I was.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/245wFXJh82pxaHd66TfqMw7ZDdLHLVd853ADdta1r6Tw3vqNmvLmGTUB3cb98Yr2BkZcK.png)

https://www.imdb.com/es-es/title/tt27610198/?ref_=mv_close

<details><summary><center>Español</center></summary>



En este capítulo nro 2 Caine decide enviar a la traumatizada Pomni, junto con Ragatha, Jax, Gangle y Kinger, a un mapa completamente nuevo: **el Reino de los Dulces** a completar una misión de la princesa Caramelo, para rescatar un carro lleno de miel que fue robado por la banda de los cocodrilos de goma. Lo logran, atrapan a los maleantes, pero Pony y el cocodrilo Gummigoo terminan cayendo debajo del mapa. 



![MV5BYzBjOTliMTYtYzNiMS00N2I0LWE5Y2EtNzhiYjg0YzhlYmY4XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23wCLW1jQDH5xqhrHwGTzc9RTzLHcA9FU9eiU7GdfsGFgfSapveYchnZk5jURF6CvqZXg.jpg)



Pomni y Gummigoo se encuentran en el camino y chocan y por un error del sistema se buguean, traspasan el piso. Al caer al vacío, Gummigoo camina por todo el sitio donde cae y encuentra una habitación llena de modelos 3D idénticos a él, a su mamá, a sus amigos y a su pueblo.



![MV5BMzdlYTJjNDAtZGNhYy00ZDFmLTk1ODMtYzc1N2ZhMTg4ZTkyXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23w2wvvwEY6V5x31Mjjfwm1ZuZkPAx8wqnTR3GHoXNV6fJQspk3wW9ASvbKbY72G5b6GS.jpg)


Es allí cuando el cocodrilo descubre la verdad: toda su vida, sus recuerdos de la infancia y su hogar es solo una ilusión creada por Caine. No es una persona, es solo un NPC (un personaje no jugable) diseñado para ser el villano de una misión repetitiva. Gummigoo entra en una crisis de identidad existencial y se queda completamente paralizado por el shock y la tristeza.


![MV5BYWVlYTE0YmMtYWMyNS00OTI3LTgyMTMtZDUxMDBmYWE2OTdhXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/EoniZLKhpPSybku4QUPiVjjePuuF4eCm3jjmprue3v6Tn8wQwVoZS76tMy2vRXnmjiQ.jpg)


Cuando la gomita sabe que es un NPC, se queda en shock porque ve toda su vida y se da cuenta de que no existe. Pomni que se había convertido en su amiga le dice: \

. Salen de ahí y después llevan la camioneta llena de miel. Y Jacks, a propósito, deja la llave abierta para que los monstruos se coman el reino chocolate. 

Cuando todos lograron llegar al circo digital  gracias a un portal que abre Caine. Gummigoo cruza junto al grupo y llega emocionado al Circo Digital, listo para empezar una nueva vida... pero la felicidad duró muy pocos segundos.



![MV5BZDU3MDBmYzYtZjg1ZC00NDNjLTgxMGUtNmY2YzUyZmFkMGY1XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/23xAioJAXDqtSxS1dj3dzgfJjGVmXajTbabXxCJe2jFRjDby6JPA5GEbdRRTUjLbWuiLq.jpg)


Caine los ve, entra en pánico y dice su famosa frase de que **\

**. Con un chasquido de dedos... ¡Caine borra a Gummigoo de la existencia instantáneamente! Y lo que me impactó fue que cuando desaparecieron al oso gomita Pomny se quedó en shock, viendo cómo el único amigo que había conseguido desde que llegó al circo digital había desapareció. Pomny nuevamente queda en Shock igual que yo. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dominic1/245wFXJh82pxaHd66TfqMw7ZDdLHLVd853ADdta1r6Tw3vqNmvLmGTUB3cb98Yr2BkZcK.png) https://www.imdb.com/es-es/title/tt27610198/?ref_=mv_close

_Rating: **100/100**_ --- _Originally posted through [scrobble.life/movies](https://scrobble.life/watch/The_Amazing_Digital_Circus?review=dominic1/t1-e2-candy-carrier-chaos-the-first-mission-mpli51fb)._

body.title: Exploring The Dynamics Around Decentralised Hive Fund
body.body:
DHF - Is the DHF truly decentralized, or does it largely depend on whale decisions? How do you think the DHF could be improved to be more decentralized? How do you think making the DHF more decentralized would help the blockchain, its users, and projects?
Hello #qccommunity, I trust you are having an amazing time out there. Even if that deal hasn’t clicked, keep on pushing and keep your eyes on the ball. It will come through someday. Since I joined the Hive blockchain. I have been participating in many activities such as voting for witnesses, joining communities, and voting for proposals. Most often, I read through those proposals and their objectives. However, that moment might really be enough to digest the goals and objectives, but at the end of it all, I will cast my vote, especially when I read a few lines that align with me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPbRNFf4bfq5iw2iyjvQh12dHU3EUhPdr3KF4C6utdzz/image.png) DHF (Decentralized Hive Fund), from my findings, is about requesting funding from the blockchain to develop and run the Hive blockchain smoothly. This is normally submitted in writing, presenting a proposal for such work, stating the cost and justifying why the Hive blockchain should trust the individual/s with such funds. However, the good news is that it is an open activity and everyone on the Hive blockchain has the right to either vote or abstain. There is also a timeline attached to it after which, if it didn’t sail through, it could be returned, and the individual/s left with the option of letting go or trying again. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRcbnaz2NREhL9j9UqpMNKY3GCfxUuwWPrYA43HSJcaWE/image.png) The dilemma is that the majority of stakeholders are still in the entry or middle level of Hiving; on the other hand, some heavy stakeholders can easily decide the fate of these proposals. In other words, irrespective of the fact that it is thrown open, the heavy stakeholders' vote carries the day. This is because HP is a major determinant that gives the voting power percentage. So, from my understanding, the voting received from those heavy stakeholders and a little support from the majority will perform the magic. Though I am still learning the dynamics To balance this equation, lol, I suggest capping voting for heavy stakeholders while allowing those in the lower region to vote without capping. Furthermore, there should be an enlightenment and awareness program for all users on everything about DHF. Though I have joined some online programs about Hive on YouTube and a Discord channel on a few occasions. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtyXXYL8ubm1bfrfz4PKfPQ9oswzUzEEnX9RwVKzrS4R/image.png) Finally, there should be a form of enticement or incentive for stakeholders at the entry and mid-level to encourage mass voting from them. All these points will work towards a better decentralised, repositioned, and transformed Hive blockchain. Feel free to join [here](https://ecency.com/@queercoin/qc-community-weekly-contest-189) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT66pGVYf4ZESvQddY2iD13s38hzQrtvM9JussceRXdAC/image.png)

body.title: GenZ Vs GenX Parental Discipline
body.body:
As intending, proposed or acting parents, there are times we wish that there is a manual basically meant to tutor us on how best we can raise our children to become better or the best children in the world. If only there could be a handout to go through and we could just retrace our steps back should we find any error in the process of our upbringing so that we are not questioned as to how we ended up raising such a spoilt brat as people would say.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWeXmvQuNCWwmhAJU3QdyMX4f7MEt4XWoWpyGDeEKn9v/1779730620142.jpg)

But then, there is none as at the moment of writing this post and everyone has the independence of raising their children in the best way they deem fit either good or bad. As long as they are proud of their upbringing then it's fine.
However, the issue lies in you not suffering the impact alone if that bad upbringing starts springing forth. The community, society, and nation as a whole also suffers therein and that's why it's now a thing to bother about if my neighbor is not training his or her child well.

How do I know or be sure my neighbor isn't raising their children well? Is it because they are posh couples and could not do the physical with their kids by flogging them when they do something bad? Just like my mum and every other African mothers of GenX or something would always flog us when we do something bad.
Even a simple eye sign would give you the hint on the fact that you're in hot okro soup as soon as we get home or when this visitor leaves.

There are times the fingers of my mum would do the scolding and the person beside us won't know anything except if our cry gets bursted and could not be held in any longer. You know those twisting of flesh with just the thumb and index finger, lol. Truthfully, those serious scolding cautioned us from proceeding with bad things because we know we will be dealt with once we are caught in any bad act.

Still, we can't say that everyone who was beaten ended up being good children. Some ended up becoming the opposite of what the parents wished for and till now they are not a product to be proud of. 
So we can't rubbish anyone who decides not to do physical with their kids, counting it as poor upbringing.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZK4VruN8KoCXWT3F7ue3FJT5GJhW3mUCSu7Kp4aS7ePg/1779730620223.jpg)

The only thing I suggest and think is okay is ensuring that you do the right thing at the right time. At this age and era that we are, with diverse exposures manipulating the minds of children and teens even adults that ain't that knowledgeable about life, their good reasoning and manners get shakes like a low stamina leg. 

When you think it's best to use verbal scolding, make use of it and when you think it's worth using a touch of physical then I don't think it's bad. It only helps kids know when they have gone too far and are never going to repeat such mistakes again. Beating a child only becomes abnormal when it turns out to be an abuse, beating a child at every single thing they do whether it's worth being beaten or not. Such children even get to see the beating as something normal and what would only occur for some minutes, they cry and the pain of the flogging stops. It makes them keep repeating the same mistakes and not seeing it as a big deal anymore.

In summary, being physical with a child isn't a priority for good upbringing nor is it supposed to be shunned when necessary.

I'll be dropping my 🖊️ here on the Hive Learners community prompt 

Thanks for reading through 🤗
