body.title: 25 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3114: designed to overeat
body.body:
Designed to Overeat Humans weren't designed to overeat; we learned that along the way when we feel hunger—not always physical hunger, but rather the emotional exhaustion caused by pain, anxiety, sadness, frustration, and a lack of love and calm. We try to fill that void with food, when what we really need is attention, hugs, and kindness. Many times we fall into this anxiety that we can't control; we only feel good when we eat too much, even when we exceed our limits of satisfaction. It's not our mind, but our body that reacts to the many emotions we fight daily, emotions that aren't always ours to bear, but we take them on for ourselves. We forget our own needs and begin to absorb those of others; our energy is consumed, and we believe that only food keeps us afloat. We don't make the best decisions; we lack courage, self-love, and emotional awareness to understand and manage certain situations without affecting our well-being. >Diseñado para comer en exceso Los humanos no fuimos diseñados para comer en exceso, eso lo aprendimos en el camino cuando nos sentimos con hambre que no siempre es física sino ese agotamiento emocional causado por dolor, ansiedad, tristeza, frustración, carencias de amor y de calma, intentamos llenar ese vacío con comida, cuando lo que realmente necesitamos es atención, abrazos, bondad. Muchas veces caemos en esa ansiedad que no podemos controlar, solo nos sentimos bien cuando comemos demasiado incluso cuando superamos nuestros límites de satisfacción. No es nuestra mente es nuestro cuerpo quien reacciona a las múltiples emociones que combatimos a diario, emociones que no siempre nos competen, pero lo agarramos para nosotros, olvidamos nuestras necesidades y empecemos a absorber las de otros, nuestra energía se consume, creemos que solo la comida nos mantiene a flote. No tomamos las mejores decisiones, nos hace falta valor, amor propio y conciencia emocional para entender y gestionar ciertas situaciones sin que afecte nuestro bienestar. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqWu8RW9fZVgkiz34U87FiJkMZSxkMFrNLUmZn6NDNWA/1779730980224.jpg) This writing corresponds to my participation in the daily writing challenge of the freewriters community project of @mariannewest. >Este escrito corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario de escritura de la comunidad freewriters proyecto de @mariannewest.

body.title: La IA como aliada, no como metamorfosis: Por qué la tecnología debe seguir siendo una herramienta....aún siendo Gregorio Samsa
body.body:
En el torbellino de innovación que vivimos, la inteligencia artificial se ha convertido en un tema central de debate. Ante el avance de modelos capaces de escribir, crear arte, diagnosticar enfermedades o conducir vehículos, surge una pregunta incómoda: ¿estamos ante una herramienta de apoyo o ante el inicio de una transformación radical del ser humano? ¿Con tanta tecnología será tan tonto, bobo, anormal o la cubanísima terminología clueco de mente?

Cada vez más voces, especialmente desde el transhumanismo y ciertos sectores tecnológicos, plantean que la IA no solo nos ayudará, sino que nos cambiará. Hablan de aumentos cognitivos, de fusión hombre-máquina, de superación de la inteligencia biológica. También los hay  y como se está desarrollando la cosa....van teniendo razón los que no ven a nosotros como los Simsonps (con monos creando las cosas). Sin embargo, existe una posición más equilibrada y, quizás, más inteligente, dirían los viejos, que consideran la IA como un material de apoyo, no como un elemento que redefine al animal humano.

Ningún humano es peor por usar una calculadora, un procesador de textos o un motor de búsqueda. Estas tecnologías amplían nuestra capacidad de acción, pero no nos convierten en otra cosa. La IA debe entenderse en esa misma línea: como un lápiz avanzado, como un asistente incansable, no como un sustituto del juicio, la creatividad o la conciencia moral y/o manual.
He pensado este artículo desde hace un tiempo y a raíz del reciente baneo en esta página, creo que mejor ejemplo no ha de haber, puesto que nos ataña a todos y Cuba no deja de ser un escenario prolífico para que estos modelos se inserten por muchos motivos.



Si dejamos que la IA se convierta en un elemento que cambia al ser humano, podemos caer en varios riesgos, que voy a enumerar a continuación:

1. Delegación excesiva: Aceptar sin crítica las respuestas de la IA, erosionando la idea griega del pensar. 
2. Pérdida de habilidades: Si la IA escribe todos los textos, ¿se atrofiará nuestra capacidad de redactar, argumentar o sentir el lenguaje? 
3. Desplazamiento identitario: Creer que para ser más eficientes debemos \

nuestra biología con implantes neuronales o conexiones directas a redes de IA, cuando quizás lo que necesitamos es más tiempo para pensar, no más datos por segundo, lo que me recuerda que ahorita vivimos en la Matrix.


Un enfoque saludable propone usar la IA para liberar al ser humano de tareas repetitivas, mecánicas o de procesamiento masivo de información, permitiéndonos dedicar más tiempo a lo que nos hace humanos: la reflexión, la creación artística, las relaciones afectivas, la ética y el ocio contemplativo.

La IA puede redactar borradores, pero el alma del texto sigue siendo humana. Puede sugerir rutas en un mapa, pero el viaje y la experiencia del camino nos pertenecen. Puede predecir tendencias de mercado, pero el juicio estratégico y la responsabilidad corporativa son nuestras.


La inteligencia artificial es un material de apoyo extraordinario, quizás el más poderoso que hayamos creado. Pero debe seguir siendo un instrumento, no un agente de cambio ontológico. El ser humano no necesita ser \

por la IA; necesita ser ayudado por ella para desarrollar mejor aquello que ya es: creativo, compasivo, curioso y capaz de decidir su propio camino. La herramienta está al servicio del artesano, no al revés.\nY sí....estoy dando al berro....porque si antes pensaba ir por los canales hanituales....mejor crear opinión y que te lean y porqué no...qué te den voto.\n

body.title: My son is trying to write at school.
body.body:
> ![BeautyPlus_20260419093824359_save~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVdy2g1A15LVsfeoWqqbkr1pxrehgJUmAY3qZn9VmXtXa/BeautyPlus_20260419093824359_save~2.jpg) My son Eyan is very interested in education, but I have not enrolled him in school yet. That day, he went to my daughter's school and when he saw the classroom environment, a different kind of joy came over him. Seeing the big blackboard there, Ian could not control his greed anymore. Without any fear or hesitation, he went straight to the board. Another little girl was also writing on the board. Ian stood next to the girl, picked up the chalk in his hand and happily started writing the first letters of the Bengali alphabet. This age of children is actually the age to learn freely without any pressure. Seeing Ian's wonderful friendship with the blackboard before going to formal school filled my heart with a strange peace. His first scratch on the board with a piece of chalk will truly be a memorable moment for me. Everyone please pray for my little Ian so that he can move forward with his own interest and joy in every step of his life. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.title: Between Tides & Currents
body.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Between Tides & Currents](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/985ee398-60af-4b3e-8d27-a076aa927795.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/oyHCnJvuk5g382ujRbh5zk) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Lunes 25 de mayo, 2026

Las olas no tienen memoria, pero la arena sí guarda los rastros de quienes se atrevieron a cabalgarlas. Todo comenzó mucho antes de que existieran las cámaras o los patrocinios, en las islas del Pacífico, donde el surf no era un deporte, sino una extensión del alma polinesia. Los antiguos hawaianos lo llamaban he’e nalu, deslizarse sobre las olas, y era un acto sagrado, reservado a veces para la realeza, otras para todo el pueblo, dependiendo de la playa y la tabla. No había cronómetros ni jueces, solo la conexión pura entre el cuerpo, la madera tallada a mano y la fuerza impredecible del océano.

Cuando los exploradores europeos llegaron, quedaron fascinados, pero también confundidos por esa libertad acuática. Con la colonización y la llegada de misioneros, la práctica casi desapareció, sofocada por normas impuestas que veían en la desnudez y el juego algo pecaminoso. Fue necesario esperar al siglo XX para que resurgiera, impulsado por figuras como Duke Kahanamoku, quien llevó el espíritu aloha a California y Australia, sembrando la semilla de lo que luego crecería como una cultura global. Las tablas cambiaron; la pesada koa dio paso a la balsa ligera y luego a la fibra de vidrio y el poliuretano, permitiendo maniobras más rápidas y agresivas.

La década de los cincuenta y sesenta transformó el pasatiempo en fenómeno de masas. El cine, la música y la moda abrazaron la estética playera, creando un estereotipo que aún hoy persiste, aunque la realidad en el agua sea mucho más dura y técnica. Surgieron los primeros campeonatos, las reglas se escribieron y el amateurismo dio paso al profesionalismo. Ya no bastaba con disfrutar la ola; había que dominarla, puntuarla y venderla. El circuito mundial nació, llevando a los mejores riders a rincones remotos del planeta, desde las aguas frías de Francia hasta los tubos perfectos de Tahití.

Hoy, el surfing es olímpico, reconocido por comités internacionales que miden cada giro con precisión milimétrica. Sin embargo, en la esencia, sigue siendo ese momento solitario frente al horizonte, esperando la serie correcta. La tecnología ha mejorado las tablas, los trajes permiten entrar en aguas gélidas y las predicciones de oleaje son exactas, pero la incertidumbre del mar permanece intacta. Cada generación aporta su estilo, desde el longboard clásico hasta el shortboard radical, pero el respeto por el océano sigue siendo la única regla verdadera que no se puede escribir en ningún reglamento. La historia continúa escribiéndose con cada remada, sin principio ni fin definido, solo con el ritmo constante de las mareas.

La elección de la tabla define la experiencia tanto como la ola misma. No es lo mismo buscar la elegancia pausada de un longboard que la explosión vertical de una tabla corta. El longboard, con sus nueve pies o más de longitud, ofrece estabilidad y permite caminar hacia la nariz, ejecutando maniobras clásicas como el hang five o el hang ten. Requiere paciencia y estilo, priorizando la fluidez sobre la velocidad extrema. Por otro lado, el shortboard, generalmente entre cinco y siete pies, está diseñado para el rendimiento puro. Su cola estrecha y su rocker pronunciado permiten giros bruscos, aéreos y una adaptación rápida a las secciones críticas de la ola, exigiendo del surfista una condición física superior y una lectura del mar instantánea.

Entre estos dos extremos existe un universo intermedio. Las funboards o mini-mals sirven como puente ideal para quienes buscan versatilidad, ofreciendo suficiente flotabilidad para remar con facilidad pero suficiente maniobrabilidad para iniciar giros. Para olas pequeñas y débiles, los fish, con su cola de pez y mayor volumen, planchan la superficie con velocidad, mientras que en condiciones de gran tamaño, las guns, largas y estrechas, se convierten en herramientas de supervivencia y precisión, diseñadas para mantener el control a altas velocidades en paredes de agua masivas.

El equipo no se limita a la tabla. El traje de neopreno es la segunda piel del surfista, cuyo grosor varía según la temperatura del agua; desde lycras ligeras para trópicos hasta trajes de cinco milímetros con capucha para aguas glaciales. Las quillas, ubicadas en la parte inferior trasera, son el timón invisible: una configuración de tres quillas thruster ofrece equilibrio y control, mientras que un setup de cuatro o cinco permite mayor sujeción en tubos potentes. La leash, esa cuerda que une el tobillo a la tabla, es el seguro de vida que evita perder el material en la resaca, aunque muchos puristas del longboard prefieren prescindir de ella para mantener una conexión más libre, asumiendo el riesgo de nadar tras su tabla a la deriva. Cada pieza tiene una función específica, pero ninguna sustituye la capacidad de leer el océano y adaptarse a su humor cambiante.

El cuerpo del surfista se forja en la resistencia. Remar contra la corriente y la espuma blanca exige una capacidad cardiovascular que pocos deportes igualan, fortaleciendo el corazón y los pulmones mientras se tonifican hombros, espalda y brazos. No es un ejercicio estático; cada ola requiere un ajuste constante del equilibrio, activando músculos profundos del core que mantienen la estabilidad sobre una superficie inestable y en movimiento. Más allá de lo físico, existe una claridad mental que llega solo cuando la cabeza está bajo el agua o mirando el horizonte. El océano actúa como un filtro natural para el estrés diario, imponiendo una presencia absoluta donde no hay espacio para las preocupaciones laborales o personales, solo el instante presente.

Sin embargo, el mar no ofrece garantías ni perdona errores. Los riesgos son inherentes a la práctica y van desde lo común hasta lo grave. Las lesiones musculares, especialmente en hombros y rodillas, son pan de cada día debido a la repetición del gesto de remar y los giros bruscos. Los cortes con la propia tabla o con las quillas, así como los golpes contra el fondo rocoso o arenoso, forman parte de la realidad física del deporte. Pero el peligro más insidioso es el ahogamiento, particularmente en situaciones de hold-downs, donde varias olas rompen consecutivamente sin dejar tiempo para salir a respirar. La corriente de resaca puede arrastrar incluso al nadador más experimentado si no se mantiene la calma y se sabe cómo salir de ella nadando paralelamente a la costa.

También está el factor humano y ambiental. La congestión en el agua genera conflictos, y un golpe accidental de otra tabla puede tener consecuencias serias. La exposición prolongada al sol aumenta el riesgo de problemas dermatológicos, mientras que la calidad del agua en ciertas zonas urbanas puede exponer a infecciones. A pesar de estos peligros, quienes entran al agua aceptan este contrato implícito con la naturaleza. La adrenalina y la satisfacción de dominar, aunque sea por unos segundos, la fuerza del mar, compensan para muchos los golpes y el cansancio. Es un equilibrio frágil entre el respeto absoluto por la potencia del océano y la confianza en la propia habilidad para navegarlo.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción e información útil de lunes.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

body.title: Splinterlands: Stampeding Calf Can Weaken Your Opponent!
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNo8ouSJpX6dTFJ9YQ3L3weYosJbzTsMAzjzt79EF2rtC/Screenshot%205122.png 

Here in the United States it is Memorial Day, which is a national holiday to remember and honor those military service members who were killed in combat.  It's always a somber day for me, having lost several friends to combat in my years in the military. It is, however, a great tradition to remember those who weren't lucky enough to make it home from the wars.  Today's post will not focus on military service or loss, as I need a distraction from it!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaHmRmoMmxjUF5ndAW5Y7tKVciuezh4YHBZJtzHnFYGkn/image.png 
statesmanjournal.com

Some time ago now my friend @dewabrata introduced me to a card that I had pretty much ignored.  Talk about a serious oversight on my part! That card is the very useful **Stampeding Calf**.  As a result I went out and bought enough copies to upgrade my card to a level five. I will explain why in a few minutes. I also happened to buy a gold foil copy as well you may have noticed. Why? Because, ironically, it was cheaper than buying the regular foil of the same card at the time. Whether or not that still holds true, I'm not sure. But I didn't complain!

But before we dive into today's featured monster, I did have exiting pull from a **Gladius** pack after the last brawl. For a long, long time I've been looking for that one extra **Quora** to upgrade to the next level.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTLhC1HALPJpe9fo9XKcBjBjK3S45DwY5xXqppgx3Bpb9/Screenshot%205106.png 
 
And I finally got the lucky pull!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTtKAbGNLdHHHtztAw6CYe6m5yT2hgGz8kkESTtUHcGc3/Screenshot%205108.png 

I was able to upgrade here to level four! Although she only gained one health, it is one more health added onto **Quora** making her more deadly!


Now back to the card of the day, the small mana **Stampeding Calf**. When I first saw the card I just didn't see a lot of use for it on my **Water** team as I mainly use magic attacks. What I failed to realize is that in addition to **Charge** and level five it picks up a very useful ability, **Weaken**.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVGo9x2C8Zz7xg5pt4kVggezPTt3dBdxwDVmKt4bBeauT/Screenshot%205109.png 

**Weaken** decreases the health of all the opponent's monsters by one. I love to use double **Weaken** on my **Death** teams, but now, I have the option to use in on my **Water** team with a a very small mana price! You might also notice he picks up **Deflect** and level eight and an extra attack at level ten. However, since I don't play in Diamond or Champion that won't be doing me any good!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQS5v7Hs2KzpgwCE3o9C1faEfZN29Em2mHEkqw16KPYYN/image.png 

Now to see the little card in action!

You can view the entire battle by clicking this link  [here.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_1d2c4aeed042e76a0c9f52a1204b17c0) 


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQm5QcP53PECZ2Y22PonyWEA4DZoM1ZaTMY59HEtKLxdT/Screenshot%205111.png 

First off, this is a battle in **Modern** with a mana cap of 32, so not too high or too low. The ruleset for this particular match is **Anemia** which can be a bit of a challenge, as it makes the maximum health at the start of battle only four! No matter how strong the monsters would usually be. 

For my archon I chose to go with **Marlai Singariel** as she increases the magic attack of each magic monster on my team by one For my tank I went with something a little atypical outside of **Frontier** using **Asel Alagosdil**, why? Just to try out something different... Next up I brought in the legendary **Endless Gibbon** followed by  one of my favorites **Mindless Thrall**.  This is  where I decided to sneak in the **Stampeding Calf** right before I placed **Captain Fellblade** with it's **Strengthen** ability . And rounding out the team was the zero mana **Maude Stonefoot**.


My opponent also chose **Marlai Singariel** as archon and used the more typical **Halfling Refugee** as tank. That was followed by **Ironwing Juggernaut** and then ever nasty **Thanalorian Scion**.  Next came another tough card **Abysmal Elemental** followed by **Ujurak Elder** which strengthens the entire team. Last up was the **Mindless Thrall**, not the best position for the card in my experience. Overall a good team though!

The screenshot above was taken after the buffs had been applied, but before the fighting commenced. 


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaqytbv7G8W6NPkmprVWqPy3iWqtZ5xjXPmSionTyX1UW/Screenshot%205113.png 

It didn't take long for **Captain Fellblade** to take out the **Mindless Thrall** thank goodness. That magic attack is nasty!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZJf1abWJ8H5ka7E1zn4DGS23zZzXMpLCHwyMDsVW91DZ/Screenshot%205114.png 

By round two this is how things stood. My opponent was down two monsters already, but still had some tough ones to go!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc8p2iS2rcgnMdYdGvZnPnPUeCYsiU7yBEHfK1x3kS4EJ/Screenshot%205115.png 

By round three my first and secondary tanks are gone as is my opponent's **Ironwing Juggernaut**. Now for the tough cards!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWic9wwxrsU16sRxTmh9rxsjk5Rpq2vpxmSUuYECxLM2w/Screenshot%205116.png 

**Captain Fellblade** finally takes out the **Abysmal Elemental**!


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXdAS1qrLpySyhdkMYfQ4DM4sK25dzyhgvc6JoVP8G16R/Screenshot%205117.png 


But thanks to **Resurgence** ability he's back at full health and armor! And in the process takes one health away from every monster on both sides of the board!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcoxe6NA9BSqnmAnehYVf1uoN86n7qoWiZ2zYD51SsADu/Screenshot%205118.png 


And here you get to see the **Stampeding Calf** take out the **Thanalorian Scion**, definitely earning it's keep!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTfJRHi35UN6iFCS1TXYc5X6uggedmbZDvPoFruF9tGFp/Screenshot%205119.png 

And here we are a the start of round four. Looking pretty good for my right now!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmP11qQzw2JNYMQf4kLyax6dahaXLCRXKQQmU5EUeoVYPt/Screenshot%205120.png 


And once again **Captain Fellblade** takes out the **Abysmal Elemental**, this time for good! 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR27Dduo3iZyiSoguWQjwEzYLwtqD3sk4WdhhMQjR7vjq/Screenshot%205121.png 

The final deathblow is delivered by the **Mindless Thrall**! Good game to my opponent! Here the **Weaken** ability of the **Stampeding Calf** combined with **Strengthen** from Captain Fellblade** really helped me overcome the **Anemia** ruleset. Although my opponent also had **Strengthen** from the **Ujurak Elder** if wasn't enough to overcome the **Weaken**!

The **Stampeding Calf** can be very useful in the right situations, especially with **Anemia**. But you have to be careful where you place it.





If you don't yet play Splinterlands, it is a fun game and free to play in Frontier Mode. So give a try, if you haven't joined in on the fun of playing Splinterlands you can join here: https://splinterlands.com?ref=thebighigg

body.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 47: Midnight call ☎️📞\n
body.body: > If there's one electronic device that has changed our lives and that we've seen evolve over the years, it's the telephone. From public phones on every street corner that required coins or cards to work, we've gone to mobile phones with internet access, allowing us to make video calls, manage our bank accounts, shop online, order taxis—everything. Without a doubt, it's one of humanity's greatest inventions, and it still surprises us today. To be honest, I have many stories related to the telephone. Like when my first boyfriend lived in another city, and it was the only way we could communicate: he would call me every day at 7 p.m. and the call would end at 9 p.m. My ear would hurt afterward, but I was happy to talk to him. I also have stories about how we would call the radio every day to request songs or because there were contests, and several times, an artist would be invited to a television channel or radio program, and I was lucky enough to speak with them and ask them a question.

> But if there's one story I remember clearly, it's how we were punished by our parents for not making a phone call. Back then, we were used to going to the movies, but that time the tickets had gone up in price, and for some strange and crazy reason, we'd spent all our money on them. Our plan was to call our parents at the end of the movie so they could pick us up, but when we went to make the call, the phone was broken. It was after 9 p.m., and the only thing we could think of was to walk around and look for a working phone.

/> We walked and walked, two of my sisters and I, but we couldn't find a phone. When we finally found one, we called, but no one answered at home. Obviously, when my parents saw the time and realized we hadn't arrived, they went out desperately to look for us, leaving the house empty. When we got to the movie theater and saw that it was already closed and there was no one around, my parents panicked, imagining the worst. According to them, they started asking around, but no one had seen us. They got in the car and drove around the city, looking for us, but when we didn't get an answer at home, we went back to the theater, assuming our parents had gone out looking for us. We sat in a plaza across from the theater and waited. Thank God, a local man, whom my parents had asked about us, saw us and told us that our parents were looking for us. He also let us use his home phone to call. It was around 11 p.m. when my dad answered the call immediately. His voice was obviously relieved to hear us, but also angry. In the end, we were grounded and couldn't go to the movies for a long time. Obviously, only our generation can tell a story like this. Nowadays, none of this would have happened because everyone, no matter how humble or poor, carries their cell phone everywhere they go. Back then, we had to have coins to make a call or hope the phone dispensed them, but that's a story for another day.
>The first image was made in Canva and the others are from my personal gallery. The text was translated with Deepl
>Thank you for your support, reading, and comment. Until next time, friend. Regards\n\n

body.body: > Presentamos la trayectoria de **Wahala**, la agrupación que irrumpió en la escena venezolana con un sonido refrescante de ska y reggae, logrando en tiempo récord compartir tarima con las figuras más influyentes de la música latina y global.

> We present the career of **Wahala**, the group that burst onto the Venezuelan scene with a refreshing ska and reggae sound, sharing the stage in record time with the most influential figures in Latin and global music. --------
[English version below!](#contenido-english)
--------- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/musicavenezuela/AJebvfFU5pSPy3iT2V7cLcg1kHiu7xCGybwgTk8h3cNrwX2mWK5XKLpcXGxNzvQ.png) # Wahala: Ska, reggae y proyección internacional

>\n\nLa agrupación **Wahala** se fundó en Caracas, Venezuela, a mediados de 1997, integrada originalmente por **Gustavo Casas**, **Javier Marín**, **Ricardo Martínez**, **Antonio Casas** y **Luis Ignacio Márquez**. El nombre de la banda proviene de un término del dialecto ibo nigeriano que se traduce literalmente como \

. Desde sus inicios, su propuesta musical estuvo influenciada por las tendencias contemporáneas del ska y el punk californiano, así como por las raíces del reggae clásico jamaiquino. Su debut oficial ocurrió en junio de 1997, compartiendo tarima con la agrupación **Desorden Público**.

Tras grabar de manera independiente seis temas originales a finales de su año de formación, el grupo fue seleccionado en junio de 1998 para participar en el **8vo Festival Nuevas Bandas**, destacando entre más de cien agrupaciones a nivel nacional. Tras obtener el primer lugar en dicho certamen, su exposición mediática aumentó considerablemente, lo que les permitió participar en el **Festival Rock en La Base** ante una audiencia de 50.000 personas. En este contexto, formaron parte del concierto aniversario de **Amnistía Internacional**, donde compartieron escenario con figuras como **Willie Colón**, **Rubén Blades**, **Los Fabulosos Cadillacs** y **Aterciopelados**.

Entre 1998 y 1999, **Wahala** consolidó su presencia en el circuito nacional participando en ciclos como los \

en el **Teatro Nacional** y el festival **Ska de Acá**, además de alternar con bandas internacionales como **Molotov** y **UB40**. En 1999, recibieron tres nominaciones a los **Premios Venezuela Pop & Rock**, incluyendo las categorías de Mejor Disco de Ska-Reggae, Mejor Percusionista y Mejor Vocalista. Ese mismo año, la banda emprendió una gira internacional que los llevó a ciudades de Estados Unidos y México, tales como Los Ángeles, San Francisco y Tijuana. Un hito relevante en su carrera fue su selección para el **1er Caracas Pop Festival** en 2001, donde compartieron cartel con artistas como **Oasis**, **Sting** y **Rubén Blades**. La trayectoria de la banda se registra como un referente de la movida alternativa venezolana, con sus integrantes continuando su labor en la música: **Gustavo Casas** con su proyecto solista en España y **Ricardo Martínez** consolidado como ingeniero de sonido y productor. ------

> 


### Wahala: Ska, Reggae, and International Projection

The group **Wahala** was founded in Caracas, Venezuela, in mid-1997, originally composed of **Gustavo Casas**, **Javier Marín**, **Ricardo Martínez**, **Antonio Casas**, and **Luis Ignacio Márquez**. The band's name comes from a term in the Nigerian Ibo dialect that literally translates to \

From its beginnings, its musical proposal was influenced by contemporary trends in ska and California punk, as well as the roots of classic Jamaican reggae. Their official debut took place in June 1997, sharing the stage with the group **Desorden Público**.

After independently recording six original tracks at the end of their formation year, the group was selected in June 1998 to participate in the **8th Nuevas Bandas Festival**, standing out among more than one hundred groups nationwide. After winning first place in the contest, their media exposure increased considerably, allowing them to participate in the **Rock en La Base Festival** before an audience of 50,000 people. In this context, they were part of the **Amnesty International** anniversary concert, where they shared the stage with figures such as **Willie Colón**, **Rubén Blades**, **Los Fabulosos Cadillacs**, and **Aterciopelados**.

Between 1998 and 1999, **Wahala** consolidated its presence on the national circuit by participating in series such as \

at the **Teatro Nacional** and the **Ska de Acá** festival, in addition to alternating with international bands like **Molotov** and **UB40**. In 1999, they received three nominations at the **Venezuela Pop & Rock Awards**, including categories for Best Ska-Reggae Album, Best Percussionist, and Best Vocalist. That same year, the band undertook an international tour that took them to cities in the United States and Mexico, such as Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Tijuana. A relevant milestone in their career was their selection for the **1st Caracas Pop Festival** in 2001, where they shared the bill with artists like **Oasis**, **Sting**, and **Rubén Blades**. After a period of geographical dispersion due to personal projects, the group managed to complete its first full-length recording titled *Wahala* (2005), under their own label, **World Musical Madness**. The band's career is recorded as a benchmark of the Venezuelan alternative scene, with its members continuing their work in music: **Gustavo Casas** with his solo project in Spain and **Ricardo Martínez** established as a sound engineer and producer. #

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
body.body:
After yesterday’s messy schedule, today felt like getting the rhythm back again. Kept things simple this morning. Started with a calm walk, then mixed in some light jogging once the body loosened up. Added a few short running bursts and basic exercises in between, mostly just trying to stay active without overthinking the session. Nothing dramatic happened today, honestly. No huge distance, no crazy energy boost… just steady movement from start to finish. And maybe that’s why it felt good. By the time I wrapped up, I’d landed right on 10k steps — challenge target secured 😄 I’m realizing consistency isn’t built from perfect days stacked together. It’s built from recovering quickly after the imperfect ones. Day 18 complete ✔️ Only a few more days left now. If you’ve fallen off your routine recently, don’t wait for motivation to magically return — restart small and rebuild from there.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ghouse25/actifit-ghouse25-20260525t173157772z)_

Greeting Summoners

We meet again today here on my Splinterlands post, and I have a great news... for myself of course lol.

In the last few months I have seen so many negativities around and about Splinterlands. I could understand it regarding the token price keeps dipping, both for SPS and DEC. I feel sad too about it, but the difference between me and those players maybe... I just like to play this game. So if monetary doesn't talk the good, the fun will talk.

And I believe bad luck and bad fortune won't last forever. Yes it is the same as vice versa, this Splinterlands was awesome in the past, 200-300% APR for months. But everything changed and they will keep changing, whether for good or for bad.

And today it is not my bad day...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23tkhmsLZdmbUbEsDeacFsSG9vRctU2soXHqRQTopeMjXT8Jt5T3SBtzfV56Y5GQxJiG2.png

I never thought my useless 125 DEC per week would give me this Saltwraith Bulkhead. It is an awesome cards for high level battles, but too bad I am playing in silver to gold level cap, so I would not be able to exploit his full potential here.

I have dedicided to put him on market...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dewabrata/23u5XNE5DTYPhhEkDp6PhB9g8UrggbTadQ6xCjbLE3kRAy6NFAXt3cqGeBG7neUytD2Xd.png

See there, my Salthwraith Bulkhead is actually #1 mint. It's the first one, but drawn later by me. I sell it at $59, I do not know if someone will get that at my price tag, or not, but hopefully I would not need to wait for days.

Initally I do not wish to post about this one, but yesterday I read someone complaining about Splinterlands in Reddit. Saying Splinterlands is dead, none can earn from this game.

Another person said something bad too, it was about lack of the depth in tactical and strategy in Splinterlands posts. Huh?

I really do not get that kind of people. First, if you feel you get less or it is unprofitable to play Splinterlands for you, I would not debate about how you should do it better. You can just liquidate all your assets and go out there find other games. Maybe your luck and fortune are out there, not in this game. Nothing wrong with that, there are plenty fishes in the ocean anyway.

Second if you think Splinterlands posts are about tactical and deep ingame strategy, something is off from your brain. Splinterlands is a blockchain game, it is not a legit financial instrument. If we need to talk about this game, it should start from how you enjoy playing it, it is about how people feel passionated with the game. it is not about APR, High Winrate, and lose-proof tactics.

I believe most of the time, people just curious if this game is still worth to play or not, it is not about if this game is still giving you high APR or not. And if you have drained all your feeling from this game, just pack your bag and walk out with a happy face. whinning outside won't make this game any better, neither make you any good.

It is never about perfection. Just be happy when you play it, share your fun and passion, and hopefully I see you next time with a smile and big grin!

body.title: MLB: Solo, no se hace montaña  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
body.body: <div class= 'text-justify'>\n\n      Nadie descubre el agua cuando afirma que el béisbol es un deporte de conjunto. Y también es un lugar común: \

. Dicho esto, pasaron 32 años para que se repitiera una barrida en Fenway Park, sufrida por los Medias Rojas de Boston cortesía de los Mellizos de Minnesota éste fin de semana. Tal acontecimiento puede colocar en perspectiva la pésima temporada que están teniendo los patirrojos. Que os barra un equipo puntero en su división, bueno, es pasable. Pero que lo haga un equipo de una división relativamente débil y que se encuentre jugando por debajo de .500, pues, debería ser una señal enorme de alarma. Sí, digamos que en descargo de los indígenas, sólo lanzó Sonny Gray ayer (su abridor número 1) y los dos primeros juegos fueron afrontados por la parte baja de la rotación. Pero aún así, han debido llevarse el del honor. ¡Por Dios! Es vuestro número uno quien está en la lomita. Para colmo, el aporte del primera base venezolano Willson Contreras, fue desperdiciado durante TODA la serie. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     No one is reinventing the wheel by stating that baseball is a team sport. It is also a cliché to say, \

That being said, it took 32 years for a sweep at Fenway Park to happen again, suffered by the Boston Red Sox courtesy of the Minnesota Twins this weekend. Such an event puts the Red Sox's abysmal season into perspective. Because getting swept by a division leader, well, that is acceptable. But getting swept by a team from a relatively weak division that is playing sub-.500 ball should be a massive red flag. Yes, in defense of the Twins, only Sonny Gray pitched yesterday (their number one starter), while the first two games were handled by the back end of the rotation. But even so, they should have taken the finale to avoid the sweep. For God's sake! Your number one ace is on the mound. To make matters worse, the offensive production from Venezuelan first baseman Willson Contreras was completely wasted throughout the ENTIRE series.

# ---

![Willson.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23uFVmZL4gMiu7FgG4qQV3VAJnQ3QpjHZWBcZi13SnjrmKPUxzjBf5KL5b4CQpLdFAZuN.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/twins-vs-red-sox/2026/05/24/824759/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     El mayor de los hermanos Contreras, ha estado bateando muchísimo. De hecho, probablemente sea nombrado jugador de la semana, porque sus últimos 7 días han sido muy calientes: de 27-12 con 2 jonrones, 8 impulsadas, AVE .444, OBP .464, SLG .852 y un grosero OPS de 1.316. Ayer, bajo una pertinaz lluvia, la botó por encima del \

del Fenway con Wilyer Abreu en segunda, significando su onceavo cuadrangular de la temporada. El estacazo empató las acciones a 3 por lado y le entregó una nueva oportunidad a los Medias Rojas de llevarse el del honor. Y casi logran los patirrojos empatar de nuevo el juego en la novena entrada, pero corrieron mal las bases y sacaron out en la goma al corredor que empataría, en caso de que el tiro hubiese sido malo. Así las cosas, Boston vuelve a caer en la fosa del sótano del este de la Americana (de donde había salido) a 13 juegos de los Rays (quienes empiezan a tomar distancia en la vanguardia), mientras los Mellizos continúan batallando desde el tercer lugar de la división Central de la misma liga. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      The older of the Contreras brothers has been swinging a red-hot bat. In fact, he will likely be named Player of the Week because his last 7 days have been absolutely scorching: going 12-for-27 with 2 home runs, 8 RBIs, a .444 AVG, .464 OBP, .852 SLG, and an outrageous 1.316 OPS. Yesterday, under a persistent rain, he crushed a big fly over Fenway's \

with Wilyer Abreu on second, marking his eleventh round-tripper of the season. The blast tied the game at 3 apiece and gave the Red Sox another shot at avoiding the sweep. And the BoSox almost knotted it up again in the ninth inning, but poor baserunning resulted in the tying run getting gunned down at the plate on what could have been a wild throw. Consequently, Boston drops right back into the cellar of the American League East (where they had just climbed out of), sitting 13 games behind the Rays (who are starting to pull away at the top), while the Twins keep fighting from third place in the AL Central.

# ---

![Martín.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/EoASRyvMuEetuDapRuZz8xkxZrWk9pXmPGGJHt7atZqr1G1535xUQKcMKfKFCvsvfGt.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/nationals-vs-braves/2026/05/24/824921/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Otro a quien le desperdiciaron una buena salida al morrito, fue el abridor criollo Martín Pérez de los Bravos de Atlanta, quienes recibían en el Truist Park a los Nacionales de Washington. El talento de los visitantes se puso de manifiesto al maniatar a la ¿peligrosa? batería de los tomahawks. Fue un marcador pequeño de dos carreras a 1 y Martín se encargó de mantener competitivo a su equipo, entregando otra salida de calidad. 5 episodios y un tercio de 5 cohetes tolerados, una carrera aceptada, dos boletos e igual número de ponchados, fue la actuación del veterano. Matt Olson, Albies, Acuña y cia. no fueron capaces de carburar, dejando nueve hombres en las almohadillas. Acuña Jr. no bateó imparables, pero se embasó par de veces por dos boletos. O sea, cumplió su trabajo de estar en las bases. Pero Atlanta parece haber entrado en un breve letargo, algo que han aprovechado sus perseguidores para acercarse a 9 juegos. De todas maneras es mucha ventaja en la vanguardia del este de la Nacional, mientras que los Nacionales demostraron el porqué son los perseguidores del equipo de Georgia. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     Another player whose strong performance on the bump was completely wasted was Venezuelan starter Martín Pérez of the Atlanta Braves, who were hosting the Washington Nationals at Truist Park. The visitors' talent was on full display as they shut down the supposedly dangerous Tomahawk lineup. It was a low-scoring 2-1 affair, and Martín did his part to keep his team competitive, delivering yet another quality start. The veteran's final line featured 5.1 innings of work, allowing just 5 hits, 1 earned run, 2 walks, and a pair of strikeouts. Matt Olson, Albies, Acuña and company failed to click, leaving nine men stranded on base. Acuña Jr. went hitless but reached base twice via a pair of walks, meaning he did his job as a table-setter. However, Atlanta seems to have hit a brief slump, which their pursuers have used to climb within 9 games. Regardless, it is still a massive cushion at the top of the National League East, while the Nationals proved exactly why they are chasing the Georgia-based ballclub.

---

![Pérez.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/23xVPai5gsADtsp3syJ44zTn35HgzFW13NEpNRxnQxv7knwz35JagGc4bJr7nF4oqsLnB.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/mariners-vs-royals/2026/05/24/824108/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
     Y alguien de quien sí le aprovecharon su aporte, fue al capitán de los Reales de Kansas City, el valenciano Salvador Pérez. Perdiendo por una en el cierre del quinto episodio y con las bases llenas, \

bateó una sinker de 86 MPH a la altura de los tobillos, sacando una línea de hit entre segunda y campocorto, para impulsar dos anotaciones que voltearon la pizarra. Dos más en ese propio episodio pusieron a los Royals con ventaja de 4 a 1. Luego, en el cierre de la 7ma., Pérez se encargó de ampliar la ventaja de los nobles, con otro sencillo impulsor. Al final, los Reales ganaron por 8-6 y Salvador se fue de 4-3, con tres impulsadas y una anotada. Kansas City salió del sótano y dejó a los Tigres en ese lugar (increíble). Mientras que los Marineros de Seattle, a pesar de perder, siguen a 2.5 juegos de los Atléticos en el oeste de la Americana. Volveremos. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     And someone whose contribution was definitely capitalized on was the captain of the Kansas City Royals, Valencia native Salvador Pérez. Trailing by one in the bottom of the fifth inning with the bases loaded, \

hacked at an 86-MPH sinker down at his ankles, ripping an RBI single through the 4-3 hole to drive in two runs and flip the scoreboard. Two more runs in that same frame put the Royals up 4-1. Later, in the bottom of the 7th, Pérez took care of extending the Royals' lead with another RBI single. Ultimately, the Royals came away with an 8-6 victory, and Salvador went 3-for-4 with three RBIs and a run scored. Kansas City climbed out of the cellar, leaving the Tigers down there (unbelievable). Meanwhile, the Seattle Mariners, despite the loss, remain 2.5 games behind the Athletics in the American League West. Greetings beloved reader.

body.title: LAS DOS CARAS DE UN DÍA DOMINGO (Reflexiones)
body.body:
>

**ESPAÑOL**
---

#

Hola a todos, feliz día. Quiero hablar de la connotación del día domingo. Los domingos, están considerados universalmente, nuestros días de descanso, y los únicos que nos permiten salir un poco de la cotidianidad, del estrés acumulado durante la semana laboral y en lo posible, alejarnos un poco de los oficios diarios del hogar... pero para muchos, más allá de ser considerado el momento de descanso por excelencia, o para salir de paseo o hacer reuniones familiares, es un día más de nuestra cotidianidad, de trabajo, de quehaceres, de crear nuevas ideas y proyectos para la semana que está por comenzar, de seguir normalmente las típicas actividades de lunes a lunes, y de echar a andar en lo posible el motor productivo. 

La cotidianidad vienen a ser todas esas cosas que hacemos a diario, las que se repiten, bien sea personales, de trabajo, estudio, o del hogar, y la mayoría de las veces se convierten en un sistema de vida caracterizado por las costumbres y la cultura de los pueblos donde habitamos, o de la formación y la crianza de muchos hogares que ven en cada miembro, la necesidad de estar activos cada día de la semana porque de eso depende su subsistencia.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWTKdoayQY16HyZa2oCyYgin421CStp6Kfa5FWrhpNKXW/01f73389_7742_4a29_9c61_bb8a5d861b43.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbHnprDpVee4Pj9mzWmNb2VrHZX3GeUQaQPbicepH8eQP/04ddc877_7048_491a_9033_538a270c92bf.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSPd1YzExukTJ8g78pfa2z3oJNrLmn8CD3NxchMsPLBK3/7f53de56_b526_404a_8809_acfa0ea8d4d2.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWuvvJuQ5gJiqHj5cWaEg4Ev43z4UYjBMtRQEhK1qLrvi/08bb9480_d8c8_43d7_87c3_03c2a443d500.jpg)

</center>

<div class = \

> Ayer en la mañana quise salir a observar cómo se mueve un pueblo un día domingo, cómo sus habitantes se levantan al igual que cualquier otro día a rebuscarse la vida, a ser la opción que se encarga de atender a quienes salen a pasar un rato de esparcimiento, a comer en la calle, tomar un café, un jugo, o simplemente hacer compras que no se lograron durante la semana. Desde una barbería de calle, hasta una vendedora ambulante, desde el que atiende el abasto hasta los que venden la leña para esa barbacoa o parrilla familiar que se va a preparar ese domingo… la que prepara un desayuno, la que ya va preparando el almuerzo en diferentes restaurantes, todos activos un domingo como cualquier otro día de la semana. Son las distintas caras del pueblo, un día domingo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHZvhjdRjyCkmov2DNMu1ABWyEub12YomeJBnq8RW1Va/annafenix_2.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVcg2FwzwWv8NL644q6MhLJsaoMW97yuEziBnSrrezE2A/45cb34a5_e18b_4cd3_bce4_9fb2bd2d423a.jpg)

**ENGLISH** --- # Hello everyone, happy day. I want to talk about the connotation of Sunday. Sundays are universally considered our days of rest, the only ones that allow us to escape the daily grind, the stress accumulated during the work week, and, if possible, get away from our daily household chores... but for many, beyond being considered the quintessential time for rest, or for going out or having family gatherings, it's just another day in our daily lives, a day of work, chores, creating new ideas and projects for the week ahead, following the usual Monday-to-Monday activities, and trying to get our productive engines running as much as possible. Daily life encompasses all those things we do every day, the repetitive tasks, whether personal, work-related, study-related, or household-related. Most of the time, these become a way of life characterized by the customs and culture of the communities where we live, or by the upbringing and values ​​of many families who see in each member the need to be active every day of the week because their survival depends on it.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSEtfwZWbBbAhcKfnvGCgGxXw8xeRTWaxW713r7Xd9agx/8e219230_67b6_4f57_892d_bc21b0f99c27.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXfAduiUogWBzeCs6v9SgSBdhGcnWqbo1y3nw6FpGyNUP/43b04e27_6f04_4f8b_8b21_c7078d219984.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXGs82Qvm6xhrSgNaoeidB2LARo5LUNMpUdPJm2Tkst82/15003ef9_0d11_4645_a454_b239042898ce.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPWvPGVUfBgSvZvsbg2ohmv9rRmLVbjq8gUGZz5MVedrJ/aa62e612_e580_40a0_9697_5f010313a3d9.jpg)

> Yesterday morning, I wanted to go out and observe how a town moves on a Sunday, how its inhabitants get up just like any other day to make ends meet, to be the option that takes care of those who go out to spend some leisure time, to eat on the street, have a coffee, a juice, or simply do shopping they couldn't manage during the week. From a street barber to a street vendor, from the grocer to those selling firewood for that family barbecue or grill planned for Sunday... the woman preparing breakfast, the one already getting lunch ready at different restaurants, all busy on a Sunday like any other day of the week. These are the different faces of the town on a Sunday.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVoUwRh4NGFWZXmPzD8HWFxEG83qUChVLXBt4KJddiHr/annafenix.png)

body.title: Am I improving or just getting lucky? My current experience in Mobile Legends【 🇪🇸 - 🇺🇸 】
body.body:
> 

Saludos, estimados gamers que dan vida a #HiveGaming. Esta semana tocada post sobre mis avances dentro de Mobile Legends Bang Bang. Sigo sintiéndome Noob en este juego y desde hace tiempo que no ganaba una partida, así esta que les traigo es especial porque es la primera partida que gano en mucho mucho tiempo.

> Greetings, fellow gamers who bring #HiveGaming to life. This week's post is about my progress in Mobile Legends Bang Bang. I still feel like a noob in this game, and it's been a while since I won a match, so this one I'm sharing is special because it's the first match I've won in a very, very long time.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>

<center>

<center>![Screenshot_20260520-210025.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23yTWoz9yE3fGD7cNhMttaGcu5K8ZMVGkx4qeemKNho2cpnRox5GAPqsZmp1Zmw1v2Hm7.png)</center>


</center>

<div class=\

>

Obtuve este logro apenas terminé la partida y sí, actualmente soy nivel 15. No he jugado más desde entonces porque me ha ido mejor en League of Legends Wild Rift y mi vicio por aquel otro juego ha acrecentado un poco más ya que aquí sólo perdía y perdía.

Y eso que lo juego en la versión sencilla, no en modo clasificatorio, que es más exigente. Pienso que debo jugar mucho más para poder aprender a usar ciertos personajes y a matar al enemigo como es debido.

> I got this achievement as soon as the match ended, and yes, I'm currently level 15. I haven't played since then because I've been doing better in League of Legends: Wild Rift, and my addiction to that other game has only grown stronger since I kept losing here.
>
> And that's even though I play on the easy version, not ranked, which is more demanding. I think I need to play a lot more to learn how to use certain champions and how to kill the enemy properly.

<center>![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23w2aHrUir84oL8HfUc3QVUoPZdyuHgbT2eQd68GoWpnqfGFdAB9U7bhUnvsZPLfHL9MM.png)</center>

Como pueden ver, en esta partida jugó otra Layla que la usa mejor que yo, y en esta oportunidad también me tocó un compañero tanque así que luego de jugar un par de veces con mi amigo @takeru255 aprendí que debo quedarme siempre atrás del tanque para protegerme y hacer el daño correctamente.

Sin embargo, me emocioné y me dejé llevar por las ganas de acabar con el enemigo en ese instante y acabé obteniendo la primera sangre y también la primera muerte del equipo. Es decir, que me mataron justo después de que yo maté al enemigo.


>As you can see, in this match, another player played Layla who uses her better than I do, and this time I also had a tank teammate. So, after playing a couple of times with my friend @takeru255, I learned that I should always stay behind the tank to protect myself and deal damage effectively.
>
> However, I got carried away and let my desire to finish the enemy off immediately get the better of me, and I ended up getting first blood and the first kill on the team. In other words, I was killed right after I killed the enemy.


|![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo45oqvBsAwe9kBwo7BjEeJV7wFzVLMWXDTPsQrYJxUn5aT3udmYGu9r4WsEewXhpAZ.png)|![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPdEw7KKBVS94sDCRZ2XBKMqcKiWZjxoaetqCt9orTrizLPGaeKGVNCqUf6jGe7zxQ.png)|
|-|-|
|![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23t79LNgG3Jo2ykRyXGNSAvMSWMSP8PBmeD7P9RkJe3A4wiCT57iUrDuQiawMRFK7o5Vn.png)|![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tGcJV21vT9N9JvL5AdEtqx9qXyiR1QqYoDsMde4XEL3k91VNDrVrGq82he5s66RpnH5.png)|



Mi compañero no lo hizo tan mal, de hecho, jugó mejor que yo en varios aspectos. Así que le tendré más fe a los próximos jugadores que me toquen como tanque porque sé que podrían saber jugar más que yo y hacerlo mejor también. Pero compreéndanme, tenía varias partidas perdiendo, era inevitable tener fe en ese momento.

> My teammate didn't do too badly; in fact, he played better than me in several aspects. So I'll have more faith in the next players I get as a tank because I know they might be more skilled than me and do a better job too. But understand me, I had been losing several games, so it was impossible not to have faith at that point.


|![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tkpGuF2HRmjbLA6Gxr7cWNxK2GwW8szcHy7EsrM9CbYVPUsutwK4RbyqxXrqsFcq4Hy.png)|![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/Eo6DBNXkggkZipPJ6cjH7R89H4x2JekHwiWuCFu83jhyvCFFgTGxCKmTREDVCPWGGVT.png)|
|-|-|



<div class=\

>


Por otro lado, quise matar a varios enemigos con mi super rayo láser ultra largo y poderoso, pero no lograba matar a nadie incluso usándolo, así que en esa parte fue algo frustrante.

> On the other hand, I wanted to kill several enemies with my super ultra long and powerful laser beam, but I couldn't kill anyone, even using it, so that part was somewhat frustrating.

<center>![12.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23wC177CSdfndpqTNGpLntpcVtdUC6YyuHN5KAfW5TnVPaY5c8PJjtqh3MAk8SMb9oENq.png)</center>

Además, el equipo en general jugó bastante bien ya que el junglero acabó con la Tortuga en varias ocasiones, lo que nos daba ventaja ante el enemigo. Esto me hizo sentir más segura para querer jugar con un mejor desempeño.

Y aunque morí varias veces, también logré matar varias veces al enemigo, incluso colaboré a matar a varios del equipo contrario, lo que me coloca en una posición de que no jugué tan bien pero tampoco lo hice tan mal, ¿no creen?

> Furthermore, the team as a whole played quite well, since the jungler took down the Turtle several times, giving us an advantage over the enemy. This made me feel more confident and motivated me to play better.
>
> And although I died several times, I also managed to get several kills on the enemy team, and I even helped eliminate several members of the opposing team. This puts me in a position where I didn't play exceptionally well, but I didn't play terribly either, don't you think?



|![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tv4V3STXAMmnL2Makg72fUMZHHyZ4DdTV3CBXpuj1P1HtWgCoN1McmbuasnucjCq9JF.png)|
|-|
|![11.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tRzSvNyr1KTyhSU8sGRi2DMNoGtYDMsrvYkbv8j2d2nBzUwB7HHFPcomqBCiEQhUj7S.png)|


Al final al enemigo sólo le quedó defender su base puesto que lo atacamos por todos los flancos, no tenía escapatoria y quedó acorralado. Al final no tuvieron más oportunidad que perder ante nosotros porque todos estaban muertos y su base quedó indefensa.

>In the end, the enemy had no choice but to defend their base, as we attacked them from all sides. They had no escape and were cornered. Ultimately, they had no option but to lose to us because they were all dead and their base was defenseless.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dm7AFpXAExs

<div class=\

> También estoy enviciada con League of Legends versión PC. Para la próxima semana tal vez les traiga un post sobre mis avances por allá, por ahora le toca a League of Legends Wild Rift. Y si me quieren agregar como amiga por MLBB, les dejo mi foto de perfil para que me busquen por allá como **Lady Pi**. ¡Hasta la próxima! 🌸 > I'm also hooked on League of Legends on PC. I might post about my progress there next week, but for now, it's League of Legends: Wild Rift. body.title: When Productivity Becomes a Burden
body.body:
![geralt-silhouette-10214009_1920 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeDA4LH9JhBHqYj74G8S87FBPfKcEA62wVyKKpbv5goT5/geralt-silhouette-10214009_1920%20(1).jpg)

image source :: https://pixabay.com/

Hello friends, how are you? Today's topic is going to be a bit unique—basically about productivity: why productivity starts to feel difficult or like torture. 

In today's world, productivity has been made the yardstick of success. Everyone is running in this race to work more, achieve more, and always look busy. But this demand for productivity, instead of freeing people, has chained them in an invisible pressure. 

You may have noticed that people who earn more or have more work are also more distracted. On the surface they seem happy, but inside they're very stressed. So at first productivity feels good—you think you're in control of your life and your goals. achievements are happening, but over time he realizes that if it becomes an obsession, rest is seen as wasted time and taking a break feels unnecessary. He ends up dropping everything and focusing solely on his productivity. 

And what happens is that, friends, most people ignore their mental and physical energy and get stuck just checking off their to-do lists. They need less sleep, stress increases, and creativity plummets. The mind turns into a machine—it just has to keep churning out output no matter what the circumstances. 
Friends, I don't know why this happens: even if someone has two valleys of gold, they'll still want a third. The most dangerous point is when a person starts to detach their self-worth from their productivity. If a day doesn't pass with productive activity, it feels like life is b This thinking slowly makes him anxious and ill. The truth is that humans aren't machines; they need rest, a bedroom, and emotional space. But some people keep working just because they believe their circumstances will improve. They keep pushing productivity, and when they succeed at productivity… have already been achieved, then they have nothing left except illness. Everything they've poured into productivity and earned ends up going back into their diseases. So, friends, whatever work you do, you shouldn't have an obsessive, never-ending drive—don't take on too much burden. Don't take on too much work or too much worry. Just work at your own pace. Whatever is meant for you will surely come to you, no matter where you are in the world.

body.title: Europe's Persistent Reliance on Fossil Fuels: Progress, Vulnerabilities, and the Road Ahead
body.body:
Europe has long been one of the world's most energy-import-dependent regions. Despite ambitious climate goals and rapid growth in renewables, the continent remains heavily reliant on fossil fuels for its overall energy needs. This dependence carries significant economic, geopolitical, and environmental costs, even as the electricity sector shows promising signs of transformation.

### The Current Energy Landscape

In 2023, the European Union produced only about 42% of its own energy, importing the remaining 58%. Fossil fuels continue to dominate the primary energy mix: petroleum products accounted for roughly 37-38%, natural gas around 20%, solid fuels (mainly coal) about 9-10%, with renewables at approximately 19-20% and nuclear at 12%.

Oil and petroleum products remain the largest single component, powering much of the transport sector and industry. Natural gas is critical for heating, power generation, and industrial processes, while coal, though declining sharply, still plays a role in some member states like Poland.

Overall, fossil fuels still represent the majority of gross available energy. Renewables reached about 25.2% of final energy consumption in 2024, showing steady but gradual progress.

### Electricity Sector Breakthroughs

The power sector tells a more optimistic story. In 2025, wind and solar together generated a record 30% of EU electricity, surpassing fossil fuels (29%) for the first time. Solar output grew dramatically, while coal fell to historic lows below 10%. Renewables and nuclear combined supplied around 71% of electricity in some assessments.

This shift marks a structural change. A decade earlier, fossil fuels produced nearly three times as much electricity as wind and solar. Countries like Sweden, Latvia, and others lead in renewables shares, though the picture varies widely across the EU.

### Import Dependence and Geopolitical Risks

Europe's fossil fuel reliance translates into heavy imports. Oil comes primarily from the United States, Norway, Kazakhstan, and others. Natural gas supplies have diversified since the 2022 energy crisis triggered by Russia's invasion of Ukraine: Norway leads pipeline gas, while the US dominates LNG. Russia’s share has plummeted but has not disappeared entirely, particularly in LNG. Coal imports come mainly from Australia and the US.

This dependence exposes Europe to global price volatility, supply disruptions, and geopolitical leverage. The 2022 crisis caused energy prices to spike, highlighting how reliance on imported fossils undermines energy security and economic competitiveness. Billions continue to flow outward for these imports, funds that could support domestic clean energy industries.

### Challenges in the Transition

While electricity decarbonizes quickly, sectors like heating, cooling, and transport lag. Buildings and industry still rely heavily on gas and oil. Intermittency of renewables requires grid upgrades, storage, and flexibility. Permitting delays, investment gaps, and uneven progress across member states slow the shift.

Initiatives like REPowerEU and the Fit for 55 package aim to accelerate renewables deployment, energy efficiency, and diversification. Targets include at least 42.5% renewables in final energy consumption by 2030. Yet achieving this demands faster deployment, infrastructure investment, and addressing public and political hurdles.

### A Path Forward

Europe's fossil fuel dependence is not inevitable. The electricity milestone in 2025 demonstrates that scaling clean energy is feasible. Continued investment in wind, solar, heat pumps, green hydrogen, and grid modernization can reduce imports, lower emissions, enhance security, and create jobs.

Diversifying supplies provides short-term stability, but true resilience lies in domestic clean energy production and efficiency. As global competition for fossil resources intensifies and climate impacts grow, accelerating the transition is both an economic and strategic imperative.

Europe stands at a crossroads. The progress is real, but sustained political will, investment, and innovation are needed to finally loosen the grip of fossil fuels and secure a sustainable energy future.

body.body:
![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPNw8UPbpvEC3bW8Fi1hZ4tMFmyN2CrzeBeXVzVnqT7xk/imagen.png) Muchas sociedades están diseñadas para comer en exceso, después de guerras y limitaciones surgen muchas propuestas para saciar el hambre de la vida misma. ¿A quien no le gusta comer? creo que a todos nos gusta. Esa necesidad de completar el estomago hasta el final. Mi madre decía que había que dejar espacio, pero también decía que había que dejar el plato vacío, votar la comida para ella era un pecado con niños en la calle con hambre. ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPk7YU7JB7hCn5nzWKKcuNTUATSqoMAmMrHzDUWt5Am9z/imagen.png) Estuve mucho tiempo esperando poder disfrutar de algunas comidas pendientes, no puedo negarlo comí con ganas de comer y llenar ese espacio que había vacío. De solo pensar en gastarme ese dinero mientras podría comprar otras cosas necesarias en casa no me caía nada bien. Hay muchas cosas que disfrutar en España, tengo una lista de pendientes y aunque las preparo también en casa, aquí tienen un sabor diferente y muy especial. Estuve visitando algunos parientes y colocaron en esa mesa gran cantidad de comida, pizzas, queso, jamones, vino, refresco y para cerrar café. Hasta una sopa con carne osobuco o lagarto como lo llamamos nosotros, estaba deliciosa no lo puedo negar. Las comidas aquí resultan abundantes y los precios para mi son números bajos, aunque mis hijos dicen que todo ha subido mucho. Tengo muchas fotos de variadas comidas, la verdad es que quiero dejar un espacio entre cada comida.
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario de los amigos @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano y @mariannewest [Post 25 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3114: designed to overeat](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/25-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3114-designed-to-overeat)
ENGLISH VERSION ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPk7YU7JB7hCn5nzWKKcuNTUATSqoMAmMrHzDUWt5Am9z/imagen.png) Many societies are designed to overeat; after wars and periods of scarcity, many proposals arise to satisfy the hunger for life itself. Who doesn't like to eat? I think we all do. That need to fill our stomachs to the brim. My mother used to say that we had to leave room, but she also said that we had to leave our plates empty; wasting food was a sin for her, with hungry children in the streets. I'd been waiting a long time to finally enjoy some meals I'd been meaning to try. I can't deny it, I ate with gusto, really looking forward to filling that empty space. Just thinking about spending that money when I could be buying other things I needed at home made me feel uneasy. There are so many things to enjoy in Spain. I have a long list of things I want to try, and even though I make them at home too, they have a different and very special flavor here. I was visiting some relatives, and they laid out a huge amount of food on the table: pizzas, cheese, ham, wine, soda, and coffee to finish. Even a soup with osso buco, or \

as we call it, was delicious, I can't deny it. The meals here are plentiful, and the prices seem low to me, although my children say everything has gone up a lot. I have lots of photos of different dishes; I really want to leave some time between each one.
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of friends @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest. body.title: Physical Discipline: A Harmful Tradition?
body.body:
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/23xL2eUd4Uc7dnma7K8YW9Mc4iryNDPB24EG1BKCQeFFmH4tiSgiFENfkjqZ9GKNdjzdS.png)

Hello everyone, I'm back with another most debated topic which has been going on for years and that is physical discipline. So, most of the I've seen in my surroundings, older people who are millennial, they say that children of nowadays has become disrespectful and they believe it's because many parents has stopped hitting their child or giving corporal punishment. On the other hand few people of Gen Z believes that hitting children will only create a traumatizing childhood for a child.

I personally think that hitting anyone should not be allowed even if it's a child. Physical punishment may stop a kid from doing something but the duration might be short. It will create fear and curiosity in them. It will not completely truly teach them how to behave in a good way. They might do it again out of curiosity because they don't know the reason why they were being hit as they are not taught.

I grew in a family where hitting childrens was never allowed. Whenever, I drew on a wall or was misbehaving they taught me with calmness, they taught me how to control my intrusive thoughta. They only corrected me by explaining my mistakes so that I could acknowledge and take the responsibility. They did not try to discipline by being physical instead they had set some rules for me, some ethics which I should follow. These helped understand what was right and wrong.  

My parents truly had patience for handling me so well. Even if their life was not going well they never shifted the anger on me. In recent time I'm an independent girl who knows how to talk with confidence and always stood against the wrong things. I am free to make my decisions. My parents never said \
like they never used such words for me. They always said \

for that reason I do what I like but never misused their trust. To be honest, what I feel for my parents is respect and love not fear.

On the other hand, I have few friends who were physically punished since childhood. Whenever, they talk about how their parents used to hit them it gave me goosebumps, they talk about it casually as being hit is something normal. 

So, they never questioned it because they grew up believing that parents punishing means they loves their kids more, that's why they hit their kids for their own betterment. Like it's the only way parents could correct their children. And, I asked them if they didn't think that their parents physically harmed them because they were kids and can not defend. My friends were smiling and said, \

However, I noticed that each one of them was always afraid of making any kind of small decisions like they always needed their parents permission to do something. Even if it's a simple decisions, they would get nervous because they always had to worry about making their parents angry. Instead of building confidence such parents has made their kids fearful and dependent on them. Like they always need approval to go out, even if it's a boy. Usually girls has such restrictions in Bangladesh but the boys also has such restriction because they normalized it. These kids when they will grow up, most of them will become violence towards their life partner. Like they would hit their partner and think of it as love. While physical punishment might make someone obedience for a short time but it does not always build a good character. Like these kids are being obedient so they do not get hit not because they did wrong thing and realized they should not do it. So basically they will end up neglecting their mistakes. And that's not a good habit. So, I believe discipline is very important, like there should be rules and guidance but no hitting. And I believe humanity has not lost discipline, I think society has found a new way to raise children. ____ The thumbnail is created with [Gemini](gemini.google.com) ____

body.title: Stronger Through Pain: A Weird Meta That Actually Dominates
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpAxgZCyztoYs8QKVbqQzCusi5dPgq9tTncczdF2uuQ7/thumbnail_battle_of_the_day.png)

Greetings, Splinterlands warriors—strap in, because today’s match was the kind that turns a casual grind into a full-on “what did I just witness?” moment.

There are monsters that crumble the more they get hit… and then there are monsters that go absolutely feral the more you beat them down. Today’s battle? Yeah, it was all about the second type. And honestly, I didn’t expect to watch a unit scale into something as terrifying as mounting online debt—just getting worse every round.

We dropped into a match with the *Are You Not Entertained?* and *Fog of War* rulesets, rocking a hefty 65 mana cap. It’s a spicy combo: Gladiators are allowed, but all those sneaky backline tactics like Sneak and Snipe? Completely useless. Fog of War shuts that down hard. So what’s left? Pure frontline chaos—tank vs tank, brute force vs endurance.

I rolled in with what I thought was a solid long-game comp:

* **Ulundin Overseer** as my main tank
* **Ujurak Brave** to suppress enemy magic with Silence
* **Mindless Thrall** and **Gravebrand Warlock** for steady magic damage
* **Arachne Weaver** as my lifeline healer
* And **Liza Fox** from the Gladiator squad

Simple plan: let Ulundin soak damage while Arachne keeps him alive, and let my backline slowly melt the enemy.

Yeah… about that plan.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdSXRK7xk1cnKL7snYwFrw19AJyf8hc28tpAgqJQQr6rc/round_1.png)


My opponent showed up swinging with:

* **Blue Wyrm Travesty** as their tank
* **Relenor Cleaver** (Gladiator)
* **Abyssal Elemental**, **Mystic Scaleweaver**
* **Torrent Sniper**
* And **Runic Skychonk**

And right there, I spotted something interesting.

**Runic Skychonk** had *Reckless*.
**Torrent Sniper** had *Painforge*.

If you’re not familiar with this combo, here’s the deal:

* *Reckless* causes a unit to damage adjacent allies when it attacks
* *Painforge* boosts a unit’s power when it takes certain types of damage

Translation?
Torrent Sniper is basically that guy who gets punched and responds by going Super Saiyan.

---



The fight opened brutally. My Ulundin Overseer got obliterated almost instantly by enemy magic—didn’t even get to enjoy the arena. But hey, their Blue Wyrm went down too, so I thought, “Okay, we’re even.”

Nope. Not even close.

In the backline, Torrent Sniper started taking friendly fire from Runic Skychonk’s Reckless… and every hit made it stronger.

It was bizarre.

Normally you’d feel bad watching a unit get smacked by its own teammate—but this guy looked like he just got a salary raise. Damage started creeping up.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV5dx1C75C8ug1ftQeSH4jkB16U69PBv5NCe3tMZdpYvs/round_2.png)

Shields started slowing my damage output, but I managed to take down Relenor Cleaver. Small win. Ujurak Brave was still alive, getting healed, and I started to think I could stabilize.

But the combo on their side? It was ramping up. The longer Torrent Sniper stayed alive, the scarier it got. That’s when it hit me. Torrent Sniper reached **7 magic damage**.

That’s not an attack—that’s someone throwing a refrigerator at your face from the third floor.

My team started dropping one by one. No one could tank that kind of output. It felt like watching dry leaves get blown away—no resistance, just gone.

And the craziest part?
This monster became a nuke because it was being *hurt by its own ally*.

Most Splinterlands strategies are about synergy through protection. This one? Synergy through suffering.

Low-key philosophical, honestly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYLBsc4WdCpgG3D2j4D1jyr2NZTK3sLpLBvmTCLEg9dzA/round_4.png)



Next round, Torrent Sniper hit **8 magic damage**, and I knew it was done. Even before my last unit fell, I already felt like a moviegoer who realizes the villain isn’t losing this one.

Victory went to my opponent.

But weirdly? I enjoyed the loss.

Battle replay here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_c2156eae472ed48fde15ee6942561ccd?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>

Seeing *Painforge* and *Reckless* in action like that was wild. Torrent Sniper is clearly built for this kind of strategy. With a solid 8 HP pool, it can endure enough “friendly abuse” to transform into an absolute destruction engine.

By round five, even with low HP, it was hitting **9 damage**—enough to delete almost anything before it could even react.

For newer players, here’s the big lesson:
Don’t judge abilities in isolation.

Some abilities look useless—or even harmful—on their own. *Reckless* seems like bad design at first glance. But pair it with *Painforge*, and suddenly you’ve got a self-scaling damage machine.

Sure, winning is great.

But discovering weird, borderline insane combos that actually work?
That’s way more fun.

So don’t be afraid to experiment—even with strategies that seem “wrong.”

Because in Splinterlands, sometimes the most dangerous monsters are born from what looks like a mistake.






![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)



Talk about Splinterlands,
If you haven't tried out this fantastic game called Splinterlands yet, I invite you to [**Join**](https://splinterlands.com?ref=rqr4).
It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens. 

___


If you already joined the splinterlands, and are looking for a place to grow. We need **YOU**. We are a chill, social guild looking for a few more active members! If you think you might be a fit, join us in our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/5u638vHPVh)

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZAXaBtYPQQcQ4fDb2DMaFETkzmZ5DNhevYHW4pANVaM2/banner.png)</center>
