body.title: Cultivation of Green Amaranth in My Garden
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb6xzqP4wHCMu96W8w9EZ2spXfRXhrPmHPs8cjLHXvMhi/image.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcR7FNKj7qhTdVyn91Z968GPGs1RLagXddFEbh3N4HVNM/image.png)


Hello, all of my friends of the Hive Universe. How are you all? I hope you are all well by the grace of the Almighty. I am also fine. Today, I want to share with you gays about my vegetable garden that I started by planting green amaranth. Now I start to write about it. 😊


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMeZahDfg5KdiFuuJL1QAFHZ5stp5LRMqA1mh3684qaR/image.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTD42xifpn4ihs2BVJzzyk7FjsC6mMxU2Sp3HqMsWA3ur/image.png)

Our house's left side has an empty place. I thought about that place to make my vegetable garden. Then I went to my hometown for my internship research project-related work. During that time, I want to market for some work. Then I saw a shop where they were selling different types of vegetables seed in a packed bag. So, for my vegetable garden, I bought green amaranth, red amaranth, Indian spinach, and lady's finger seeds.





![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ2ra7LULnjxZ5vVk1RUnPAyaScbPsWSRM25rVRwyp9RC/image.png)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYSAv41VUgNHPb49MS4sq89RhWqdRhAC6beDjpcQwhRPL/whatsapp_image_2026_05_25_at_22.21.29.jpeg)


When I came back, I started preparing my garden. At first, I removed the weeds from the area where I had sown the amaranth seeds. Then I was tilling the place by using desi tools. After tillage, I broke down the soil's big aggregates. Then I took the seeds packed and cut them. After that, I took a small pot. Then I pour half of the seeds into the pot. Then I added some sand to it and mixed it well.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRoqQQDsV31uDRyW4L9HZ8k46NqYid5J7habQsfCGD5U6/image.png)







![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUqNWTqHKxX4q8DYvbfRH1xWkUDh7Fsua7yWePX3aZMCk/image.png)

Then I sow seeds by using the broadcasting method.  Moreover, I watered after sowing. Then after 48 hours the seed started germinating and started to grow.

Every week I remove weeds from the amaranth field. After 10 days in our area here happened a heavy wind and rain occurred. In this rain my garden amaranth field became messy and some water remained there. I noticed that if I didn’t prepare any drain then it all would be ruined. Then I started to make a drain. Now, the field's four sides have drainage, and water cannot stay in the field.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRYGt2ZDGqAfA3RpgipZxr5XvK7U7SSPeYASTdkpFRAiK/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2mqbDc7yW4wyEgDzudCi9DhELguZEHGKtv4czdoyam1/image.png)




It can be eaten now if we want, but my mother-in-law wants it more mature; then she will make curry. She said she wants to cook this with jackfruit seeds. Jackfruit is our national fruit.  In Bangladesh, the summer season is now going on, and ripe jackfruit will be available soon this summer.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRcJJFge1iK3UPNwxVqKFNwXE3VaWUL8uRtEyB4rwHyo/image.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfRatNmM9xgGHy8X8QTPNfWjx9xHnHFaS8MXiNjyc3cdN/image.png)


I was preparing the field during that time my aunt-in-law was present and said that those who will consume you are only 3 members. Then I said I would give you and the other neighbor. She said if you give once then next time they don’t want it. She also said I gave your mother-in-law Indian spinach then next time she refused to take it. Actually, the reason is that my father-in-law doesn’t want to eat vegetables. After cooking the vegetables, she cannot finish them. As I was not there. I was living in Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh for my study purposes. Once upon a time we were a big family. It was a joint family. So, my mother-in-law has a habit. She can’t change it because she cannot cook a small amount. She always cooks a large amount. But she cannot finish the food. That's the reason she doesn't want it again.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb1MqvBRoDZmXA3k7FhtCdthPBcJWCpoZw6WuzFuVmLAS/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV6XkP4Qyg5vTvHUH27T1QNNHDMyc3pB5knXtSt3X9Gwz/whatsapp_image_2026_05_04_at_02.36.03.jpeg)

After hearing her I decided to make a small field. As I am the only member who likes vegetables so much. My mother-in-law also like but not that much. I don’t use any fertilizer in this field. I wanted to use organic fertilizer, but it was not available in my home. So, I don't use any fertilizer.




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaqed1F3vyNztip399hAYU5cxFf5uq8Kjxabwe6cc7rP/image.png)
In my green amaranth field one corner seedling, is not growing properly. As far as I know, it is a higher pH, which means for a strong alkaline soil. For our new home entry, we give milad. Milad means, we invite people to our home to consume food for lunch and doa usually. Some people also arrange mahfil. We were arranged a mahfil.  When the mahfil was arranged, it became late at night. Then they consume food at night as dinner. We arranged mafil too. So, they consume food at dinner time. To make that dinner in that field dug 3 big holes for cooking food. After that, there are ashes remaining in the soil, which makes the soil more alkaline. That’s the reason I initially think, or it can be for another reason that I don't know.
For proper vegetative growth, the pH level in the soil should be around 6-7.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwjiEz7W5iwNYHAM3ERJu7C2LgGnyZGbqXYqeKKMsSFP/image.png)

I hope you like my post. If you have any questions, you can ask me in the comments, and I will try my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for reading my post. See you in the next post.
Have a great day! 🌿

body.title: Stress Hidden Behind Strength
body.body: The truth is that I rarely tell anyone how stressful certain situations can become for me, or how difficult it is, especially in the times we are living in, to stay focused on personal goals and remain positive all the time. I know that everything in life is a process, and that sometimes things happen to us without understanding why. Over time, I have learned that many painful experiences arrive to teach us something, even if while we are living them we only feel frustration, sadness, or even resentment toward the people involved. Very few times do we truly understand the lesson behind traumatic situations while they are happening. Most of the time, we focus on asking ourselves why we had to experience them, instead of noticing how those experiences slowly transform our personality and the way we face life. Right now, even though I am not someone who gives up easily or gets stressed too quickly, I feel that the accumulation of important situations is putting a lot of pressure on me. And unfortunately, that pressure can distract us from what truly matters: ourselves and the limited time we all have in this life. Lately, I have noticed myself sighing constantly, and that alone says a lot. Even though I show the world that I can handle everything, that is only the perception I give: a strong and independent woman who always finds a way to solve her own problems and also take care of her daughters. Not because I already have financial stability — not yet — but because I still have a strong desire to live, grow, and move forward. The reality is that people rarely think someone like me needs to stop and breathe for a moment, because I became so used to solving everything on my own. But I think it is finally time to breathe again, to reconnect with yoga, which helps both my soul and my body, and to walk barefoot on the grass in my backyard, where I often reflect on who I am and everything I have had to overcome in this life. I always encourage others to follow their dreams. I advise them on how to release stress, how to identify their talents, and how to turn what they love into opportunities that can improve their quality of life. I strongly believe that learning never takes up space and that knowledge can free both the body and the soul. However, many times the people who give advice are the ones who forget to apply it to themselves. And I think it is time for me to change that. Living in Cuba is not easy. And I am not talking about politics. I am talking about the emotional and mental challenges of trying to move forward every single day. Still, I also believe that having a closed mindset can become an even bigger obstacle than the place where we live. Because a country does not completely determine whether we can achieve our dreams, even if it makes the journey more difficult. So this is my reality: accumulated stress disguised as strength. My advice to anyone reading this is to fight for your dreams and never allow anyone to convince you that you cannot achieve them. As for me, I will continue doing everything possible to reach mine. And if anyone has gone through something similar and would like to share a small experience or reflection, I would truly appreciate reading it. After all, we came into this world to learn from one another. @terganftp @ibarra95 @lazy.panda @hiveabbyftp

body.title: Día frío y agotador | Cold and tiring day
body.body:
> Hola de nuevo! Hoy les traigo un nuevo post bastante genial, esta vez de un nuevo set de fotos que me tomé un día de trabajo. Debido a varios cambios que han ocurrido en mi trabajo he estado realmente full de cosas, y eso me tiene un poco agotada ya que me cuesta muchísimo levantarme temprano y por ende, me la paso el resto del día bastante somnolienta, y eso no me gusta pero aún así, el trabajo no me molesta porque es de algo que me gusta, que es el ambiente y estar al aire libre gran parte del tiempo. En estos días el clima ha estado muy chévere y me encanta,porque soy más de disfrutar los días fríos que los calurosos, y no extraño para nada la temporada de calor. El frío hace que me pueda vestir como me gusta, los alrededores están más frescos y me siento mucho más cómoda así. Las fotos que les muestro hoy son de un día que me sentía bonita, pero a su vez agotada porque dormí poco el día anterior, no por una razón en particular, solo me costó dormir temprano. Ese día no tenía un outfit previsto así que esa misma mañana tuve que improvisar, ya que hacía frío me decidí en ponerme un camisón de tela gruesa que adoro ponerme cuando hace frío, usualmente lo uso abierto con una franela por debajo, pero ese día decidí cerrarmela. Me puse un jean negro que personalice en la bota, no me gustaba como me quedaba así que la corté y le dejé detalles muy lindos. Al principio no me puse los lentes pero debido al cansancio en la vista, me los puse. Me puse los zapatos blancos y me maquillé ligero, de hecho casi no me maquillé. A pesar de todo me sentía muy bien conmigo misma ese día y me tomé algunas fotos, espero que les guste!
Hello again! Today I’m come to your with another awesome post, this time featuring a new set of photos I took on a workday. Because of several changes that have happened at work, I’ve been really swamped, and that’s left me a bit exhausted since I have a really hard time getting up early. As a result, I spend the rest of the day feeling pretty sleepy, and I don’t like that. Still, the work doesn’t bother me because I enjoy it, I love the atmosphere and being outdoors most of the time. The weather has been really nice lately, and I love it because I prefer cold days to hot ones, and I don’t miss the hot season at all. The cold lets me dress the way I like, the surroundings are cooler, and I feel much more comfortable that way. The photos I’m showing you today are from a day when I felt pretty, but also exhausted because I didn’t get much sleep the night before, not for any particular reason, I just had trouble falling asleep early. I didn’t have an outfit planned for that day, so I had to improvise that very morning. Since it was cold, I decided to wear a thick flannel nightgown that I love putting on when it’s cold. I usually wear it open with a t-shirt underneath, but that day I decided to button it up. I put on a pair of black jeans that I customized at the hem, I didn’t like how they fit, so I cut them and added some really cute details. At first I didn’t put on my glasses, but because my eyes were tired, I put them on. I wore my white shoes and did light makeup actually, I barely wore any. Despite everything, I felt really good about myself that day and took some photos. I hope you like them!

> ![divisor.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ochitoalreves/23uQmsFb7wdVU1MPTuPG9wXiRHKhacnLVDHQDNv1rh7RM6VpWYTj8pYgh39uucrStmwnk.png) _Fotos de mi autoría | Photos of my authorship_ _[Fuente](https://www.pngall.com/es/camera-png/download/41706) del divisor | [Source](https://www.pngall.com/es/camera-png/download/41706) of the divisor_ --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@ochitoalreves/dia-frio-y-agotador-cold-and-tiring-day)

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXeaeV31gnheWiaTriQFdSQpMeyBrFqeeH3zrJai3B46q/_dsc7926_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *

Hello hivers.

I love documentary photography. It is about preserving stories through images, stopping time in a specific moment where everything makes sense and tells a story.

It is not only about taking a beautiful picture. For me, it is about feeling the moment, understanding what is happening in front of the camera, and making the image transmit something even years later. Documentary photography can eventually become memory, testimony, and even proof that someone was there living that exact instant.

That is why I always carry my camera with me. I never know when I will find a story waiting to be told.

Saludos hivers.

Adoro la fotografía documental. Es guardar historias en imágenes, es detener el tiempo en un momento específico donde tenga sentido, cuente una historia.

No se trata solamente de hacer una foto bonita. Para mí se trata de sentir el momento, entender lo que ocurre frente a la cámara y lograr que la imagen transmita algo incluso años después. Una fotografía documental puede convertirse con el tiempo en memoria, en testimonio y hasta en prueba de que alguien estuvo allí viviendo exactamente ese instante.

Por eso siempre llevo la cámara conmigo. Nunca sé cuándo voy a encontrar una historia esperando ser contada.

> Splinterlands is always a thrilling experience in the world of online battle card games. As a regular Battle Mage, I face new challenges every day. But today will be one of the best and most memorable days of my gaming life. Today I started my journey from the Gold II League and achieved the feat of winning two important leagues—Gold 1 and Diamond 3—on the same day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWM7gVZFR1U44Svw1qxsqX2akb1rKCioHVuKjT5WxxY3H/1779729335066.jpg) The day started with fighting in the Gold 2 League. My goal was to at least reach Gold 1. When the 'UNLOCKED' message of Gold I appeared on the screen after defeating one tough opponent after another, my confidence increased a lot. Fighting at the top of the Gold League is not easy at all, because the correct use of each card's move and element is essential to winning the league. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcg7H2e1AiGooJyEbx4pasRzScWVdmJuqAT4axod9opm7/1779729110179.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZyF8YTzD1y4T8SLT7BbTq4pVkfajJFZHi7LMt6NSghqR/1779729110221.jpg) After successfully completing the Gold 1 league, I had 15 loot boxes or chests as rewards (9 bronze and 6 silver). I prepared to open the chests with full hopes. To increase the value of the rewards, I used the legendary and alchemy potions I had accumulated. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWq3WX95XaoEuMGG2F1mKqHyWzJnudvGZ26Nc4u1A5vF2/1779729110255.jpg) To be honest, after opening all the chests, I felt a little sad. Because after all this trouble, I didn't get any expensive cards or big surprises from the rewards. Most of them were potion charges, a few merits and entry tokens. I expected something better from a league like Gold 1. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbLN3zwyRiDAidkmQHyFVsURe4EAkqARqxfMUmnYFoEjc/1779729138319.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSsNcbJBS3bBiqoxX9oLkewknqxVgoJfqUMsYhAhNexrF/1779729138375.jpg) However, even though I was upset about the reward, my fight did not stop. The gaming spirit was pushing me further forward. I thought, when the form is going well today, why not try for Diamond? Then the final battle to get to the Diamond League began. After winning one Modern Format battle after another, I finally stepped into the Diamond III League. Starting from Gold 2 and reaching Diamond 3 on the same day is a big milestone for me. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSfJJbjee39GYsvLGQFiLVDQCafbHw9qPr4gZmaqubnhz/1779729149873.jpg) After getting to the Diamond League, new hope was peeking into my mind. This time, my loot box contained 10 bronzes, 7 silvers, and a valuable gold chest. With the familiar excitement of opening rewards, I confirmed the potion again and clicked the 'Claim Rewards' button. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc84dehmwJsmkU9RYpg7toTxkT8UyRnXeoXKATw7n5d6W/1779729177955.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUeZ6Qe1M6oFL4M3CiE1Kzyht7qSj6zAbmZtmGhpZZmDD/1779729177988.jpg) I have come across some cards from the Diamond 3 reward boxes. Among them are Thornmaw Berserker, Magmaforged, and Stonebind Matron. Although these are not very high-value cards, these cards and their merits (i.e. 399 and 473 merits) will enrich my inventory a bit compared to Gold 1. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSqeguhbKnXUHcnwB6oZRXNZwvfCKzDXzC3839QhjciCL/1779729190436.jpg) Talking about the whole day's experience, although there is some dissatisfaction with the rewards, the achievement scale is quite heavy. Luck is not always kind in Splinterlands, but the joy of advancing up the league with your own skills is incomparable. Reaching Diamond 3 from Gold 2 in one leap is the biggest achievement of the day. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVd3UW58dQWWSn4tSYgM1skC8jHs2LdKwr7pwzzD648cS/1779729202578.jpg) This journey in Splinterlands teaches us that even if you don't always get the desired reward, you have to keep trying. Whatever the reward, I am really happy to have crossed two leagues in the same day. I will come back to you with news of bigger rewards and higher leagues in the future, God willing. Thank you to all the Battle Mages! My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi

It is intended to preserve historical records of account activity, public communications, publications, and platform associations for authentication, transparency, and future reference.

# Decentralized Social Networks
Decentralized social networks are used to preserve publications and article summaries. Due to their immutable nature, some decentralized networks are maintained by blockchains and consensus algorithms that keep accurate records of on-chain activity.

Centralized social networks are traditional online platforms operated by private companies that may enforce moderation policies, platform restrictions, or limitations on speech and content distribution. body.title: Why Pain Changes People More Than Love Ever Could
body.body:
![arhavisual-cry-4250450_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEH3zHPcspZ3kNP3b8jtmc635bvsQhLcc5cL8AiDTP1o/arhavisual-cry-4250450_1920.jpg)


What is pain? What kind of feeling is it when you have hopes for your friends, for the people you love most, and they don't live up to those hopes? Then you feel a kind of regret that we call pain. 

Sometimes I feel the same way: the things that truly change a person don't even register—it's the pain they inflict. Love certainly makes us happy and makes us feel alive for a while, but pain always stays with us, rebuilding us from within, showing us, friends, who has wronged us. who is good and who has wronged them.
I used to be a very simple person—I trusted easily and helped everyone wholeheartedly. I believed that if we did good for others, the world would treat us well in return. But life has taught me so much at twists and turns I can't even describe here. I remember there was a time when I saw everything through the lens of emotion. I used to get really upset if someone ignored me over some small thing. I'd think maybe they took offense at something I said, and little by little I began to understand that people only use you—they use you as long as they need you, and once they've gotten what they need, they throw you away like a tissue.  

Friends, in my opinion, pain is something that silences a person. At first, the one who used to share everything becomes so quiet one day that people stop asking, “Are you okay?” because they think it's no longer any of their business. But how would they know that he has actually become strong? I've seen that people are too They've been through it themselves, so they understand others the most—because they've witnessed those phases where on the outside a person seems fine but inside they're completely broken. Pain is a habit of the human spirit that causes us to first waste all our time trying to make everyone else happy, and in the end we destroy ourselves in the process. keeps you so busy watching people that you don't even give anyone a proper response, and to be honest, those wounds never really heal—you just learn to live with them. Every night in silence, friends, those same memories that caused you this pain are what get you through the night. Even now, I still don't love myself. I still believe in fate, but now I also know that love doesn't make you mature; it makes you suffer. Love dresses you up, but pain teaches you to live with your eyes wide open, showing you who is truly sincere with you.
Source : https://pixabay.com/

body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 7 Foundation Chests, Winning 2 Epic Cards, Maxing Out an Earth Summoner & Easy Battle Victory
body.body:
Hello everyone, 
how are you all? I hope everyone is fine and doing great in life. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQXbLFuQovgYztZwPKytSuymuHi5QwD8QGxuhh2cge3K/image.png)


I am back with another Splinterlands blog after a few days. I was busy with my job, and that is why I was unable to give time here. But now I am back, and I have some exciting things to share from Splinterlands.

First of all, in the screenshot below, you can see the rewards that I won from the daily Wheel of Fortune. There, we earned some extra points today. We are definitely going to keep collecting them so that one day we can exchange them for something valuable.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQePPqdMDTcrtsAgyJnwJtE2uMR476uzh1a6jReaf9DEn/image.png)

Now let us head over to the Mana Well, where we always open our Foundation chests. Today, we had 7 Foundation chests waiting for us, and we decided to open all of them.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWBM4cw1tq4SgkT7htQNtgXNPzdGUxhBssXdYrdXmjdtD/image.png)

Let us see what we got from them.

I was not expecting anything huge, but I was hoping to win at least a few epic cards. In the screenshot below, you can see all the cards that I won. I managed to win 2 epic cards and 1 summoner, so overall I was happy with the opening.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmavhkMu9DRMaZB1DEuuyg7TfctQfRDUJEVCvrMNHt2eiR/image.png)

After that, I went to the card section, where I upgraded one of my summoners from the Earth category to the maximum level, as you can see in the screenshot below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNtQG7igqgNvzBGsSyidbv5P3QttehkkTnB5RswYoT1JD/image.png)

Now let me take you all to the battlefield.

In the screenshot below, you can see the battle lineup for both me and my opponent. The battle started as 3 versus 3, and honestly, I already felt confident because my opponent chose Water element monsters but did not include even a single magic monster in the lineup. That was not a very good strategy in my opinion.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV34N3ppC1X6mCCvdqn3rfME8NsAPPFZ6FFu9491xQ1T1/image.png)

In the screenshot below, you can see Round 2, where the battle became 3 versus 2, and the opponent already looked weaker at this stage.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSJmmREzh5XuPuJSfaxGy89UaqUi2E4TmzbtXPGc3jpUt/image.png)

In the next screenshot, you can see Round 3, where it was down to 2 versus 1.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHwfnit5UESMnwFwQ9AjW9sWqAKRfnaQztW81UF5zL7V/image.png)

Finally, in the last screenshot below, you can see the final blow that helped me secure the victory.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma3gRokd4BYoeK3bHjLf1QJBJbSHDSAEiqduZQSWsC7CP/image.png)

After completing all 15 victories, I also claimed my daily rewards from Frontier Battle mode, as you can see in the screenshot below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWCGShVwCm5cQARfxraR3fbXdpHofjy2JYCfQdgitVoqe/image.png)

Apart from Splinterlands, I also played Terracore, as all of you already know.

Today, I had a total of 7 attacks available because of penalties, and I used all of them. The results can be seen in the screenshot below.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZPxbvATq2jX2oRUf8ms1jaYFqgoRYsFBiZe9DfgydpMy/image.png)

Honestly, the attacks went decently because I usually do not even win 1,000 scrap tokens. So winning around 2,000 scrap tokens actually felt like a really good result for me.

That is all for this blog.

I hope to continue playing and sharing more updates from these games with all of you.

Thank you, and I will see you all again in my next blog. We are still unable to play the modern battle mode but I will try to start it soon.

body.title: What Steps Do You Take to Stay Safe Online?
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWojMgxCQhEkKwKMoxbE6r5oC5hJ6DCqsKQwDxw7jkUF7/1779728252427.png) [Source](https://chatgpt.com/s/m_6a147f3ae1f4819184a117d0adeee4ae) --- Nowadays, I try to stay safe online by avoiding random earning websites like I used to explore before. Most of those platforms are scams, and many of them disappear after taking users’ money. That is why I now prefer trusted blockchain-based platforms like Hive, where I feel much safer and more comfortable working. --- ### **Have You Ever Faced an Online Scam?** --- Yes, I once became a victim of an online scam. I found a video platform through a YouTube video around 2019–2020. The platform claimed that users could earn money by watching YouTube videos. However, to start earning properly, users had to invest some money first. At that time, I really needed money, so I invested a small amount and started working there. After working for several days, I received a small payment, which made me very happy and gave me confidence in the platform. But before I could recover my full investment, the website suddenly stopped working. I could not withdraw my invested money, let alone make any profit. I do not even remember the site’s name now, but the experience taught me an important lesson. I lost both my time and money, and it was painful for me at that time. Interestingly, a short time later I started working on Hive, where I could work without investment, and that is one of the reasons why I enjoy being here. --- ### **Which Type of Scam Do You Think Is Most Dangerous Today?** --- In my opinion, every type of scam is dangerous. However, scams related to online earning are especially harmful because people lose not only money, but also time, trust, and hope. Another important thing I learned from my bad experience is that people should never trust online platforms too quickly. Many scam websites use attractive advertisements, fake payment proofs, and emotional marketing to attract users. Beginners often become victims because they hope to earn money easily in a short time. Before joining any platform, it is important to check reviews, search for real user experiences, and understand how the platform actually works. Taking a little time for research can save both money and mental stress in the future. --- ### **What Advice Would You Give to Others?** --- My advice to everyone is to be very careful with online earning websites because many of them are fake. Never invest money without proper rlesearch, especially on platforms that promise easy income by watching videos or doing very simple tasks. Instead, try platforms where you can start without investment and first check whether withdrawals are actually possible. Scam websites usually do not allow users to withdraw money easily unless they invest more. If earning money by only watching videos were really that easy, then almost everyone would be doing it successfully. That is why people should stay aware, think carefully before investing, and avoid trusting unrealistic promises online.

body.title: A Business Without Momentum Is Harder to Restart Than to Start
body.body:
**A Business Without Momentum Is Harder to Restart** Than to Start The hardest lesson I've learned as an entrepreneur — and nobody talks about it

![20260525_182834 1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmURnWJrYywYkRCQqja39EAFV6DsnGbuun3PUJ5LzVmFRk/20260525_182834%201.jpg)

**I'm Starting From Scratch. Here's Why. **

If you read my introduction post, you know I'm @thecontractor — founder of Swancorp Media(a Division of Swancorp CC) , builder, and someone who documents the journey honestly.

 So let me be honest right now, on post two, before I've built any credibility on this platform.

 I stopped building my business for years. Personal life pulled me away completely. And when I came back, I expected to pick up roughly where I left off. 

I was wrong. 

**What I Found When I Came Back **

The clients had moved on. 

The connections I'd built had gone cold.

 The momentum — that invisible force that makes every call easier, every deal faster, every opportunity more likely to land — was gone. 

What I found wasn't a paused business. It was a business that had quietly been dying while I was away. 

And the brutal truth? Starting Swancorp Media from zero the first time was actually easier than trying to restart it. Because the first time, I had energy, hunger, and nothing to compare myself to. 

Coming back, I had the weight of knowing what it used to be. 

**The Lesson Nobody Talks About**

 Entrepreneurs talk a lot about burnout, about pivoting, about failure. But almost nobody talks about the cost of **stopping**.

 Not failing. Not pivoting. Just… stopping. When you step away from building, here's what quietly dies:

Y**our network forgets you exist.** Relationships in business aren't passive — they need consistent contact to stay alive. Six months of silence and you're starting those conversations from cold again. 

**Your brand loses its heartbeat.** A brand that isn't consistently showing up stops feeling real to the people who once believed in it.

** Your own belief takes a hit.** This one surprised me the most. The longer I stayed away, the harder it became to see myself as the person who built something. Momentum isn't just external — it lives in your head too.

** The market doesn't wait**. Competitors who kept building passed me. Tools changed. Platforms shifted. What worked before needed relearning.

 A business without momentum isn't resting. It's deteriorating.

** Why I'm Telling You This **

Because I'm rebuilding right now, in real time, and I made a decision to document all of it — including the uncomfortable parts.

 If you're an entrepreneur who stepped away from something you built and are struggling to find the energy to restart, this series is for you. I'm not going to pretend I have it all figured out. I'm going to show you what rebuilding actually looks like — week by week, decision by decision.

 Some weeks will look like progress. Some won't. 

But I'll document it all honestly, right here on Hive.

**Where I Am Right Now**

Swancorp Media(a Division of Swancorp CC) is being rebuilt from the ground up in 2026. New systems. New positioning. New energy — but with years of hard-won experience behind it.

The difference between who I was when I first started and who I am now restarting is everything I lost and everything I learned from losing it. 

That's the asset. And that's what I'm bringing to this platform.

Have you ever had to restart something you built? What was the hardest part of coming back? Drop it in the comments — I read every single one.

BELLA DONNA Beauty Study 

Que tal mi gente otro día más en la vida de esta pequeña diseñadora. 
Les dije que estábamos trabajando en otras cositas , proyectos extras para no dejar caer la creatividad jajaja. 

Bueno hace poco comenzamos a trabajar con un estudio de realización de pestañas. BELLA DONNA Beauty Study . 

Si no saben de el les digo que está en vista alegre. Después con más calma les iré comentando . 
Al reunirme con  el cliente fui aprendiendo un poco más sobre su negocio y necesidades para así poder conocer en dónde y como ayudarlos  a crear contenido . 

Si señores volvimos a la creación de contenido. Debo confesar que estoy algo nerviosa Pero bueno nada ,  no dejemos que eso nos frene. 😁 

Les comento :
- Las extensiones y tratamientos de pestañas son muy populares en la industria de la belleza, con clientes que buscan realzar su mirada de forma semipermanente. Así que ellos como servicio estrella tendrán sus infografías destinadas a este servicio. 
Aunque van a seguir extendiéndose . 

 Los materiales (pegamento, pinzas, cama, etc.) no requieren una gran inversión, y el margen de ganancia por servicio suele ser alto .

Aunque es bueno siempre estar renovando materiales y perfeccionando el estudio . 

 Cada 2-4 semanas los clientes necesitan rellenos, lo que garantiza ingresos estables y fidelización. 

Ofrecen  técnicas especializadas (volumen ruso, mega volumen, lifting) o diseños personalizados se puede destacar en un mercado en crecimiento.


Por el momento estamos trabajando cosas mínimas  iconográficas de perfiles de Instagram, restricciones de mision y visión. Paleta de colores y chips mínimos así . Para luego arrancar con cosas grandes. 
 Hay sorpresitas ya verán. 
Por ahora les voy mostrando algunas imágenes del trabajo y del estudio

body.title: 5/26/26 - A Very 1977 Ramones Style Three Tune Tuesday! 🎸 Picking Three Tunes + A Bonus Tune From The Third Ramones Record! 1977’s Rocket To Russia! 🎶
body.body:
5/26/26 - A Very 1977 Ramones Style Three Tune Tuesday! 🎸 Picking Three Tunes + A Bonus Tune From The Third Ramones Record! 1977’s Rocket To Russia! 

![8D564D37-753D-4587-A13E-F87EC085086D.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTeZFhrB2aLxakLDQA4hcxn5hC9CM1kDARJGkyS54RxSz/8D564D37-753D-4587-A13E-F87EC085086D.jpeg)

This week for Three Tune Tuesday I’m picking all my tune picks from one bands album.  Going with the Ramones & the third album from them 1977’s “Rocket To Russia”.  
Probably the most classic Ramones songs packed album.  The Ramones were a great band!  But half the albums have only one or two of the most known classic tunes.  I also discovered a cool song I hadn’t ever heard on any of the 30 song packed best of records we see more often.  So I’ll be picking 3 classic Ramones tunes this week & throwing in the lesser known unique vibe track “ Here Today, Gone Tomorrow” which is the first song Joey Ramone wrote that made it onto a Ramones album. Very interesting he hasn’t written any songs on the first two records but he was very very different in writing style and this song is very different from the classic ramones sound we know.     Since all my picks are from the same band & same album I’ll just put the song titles above each track instead of all the usual information I normally include next to each track.  

Band - Ramones 
Album - Rocket To Russia (1977)

![IMG_1949.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQqVGYCgjM9uzGFWuEVzdMSF6gboG8DTRxH4FGatTxuGj/IMG_1949.jpeg)

Again all tracks below are from this album here ⬆️



![IMG_2042.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU1Cva1wWmsnUKauty25CmT7DUDzDd9md8dRq1b7YGUmd/IMG_2042.jpeg)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Z1-R2LEuao&pp=ygUWcmFtb25lcyByb2NrYXdheSBiZWFjaA%3D%3D

Song - Rockaway Beach

![IMG_2043.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR3NjH6yFVbVP2K9vKzca4DrVE3q7ddj79DWMA6ZEXSxW/IMG_2043.jpeg)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4gjYqcwaklo&pp=ygUYcmFtb25lcyB0ZWVuYWdlIGxvYm90b215

Song - Teenage Lobotomy

![IMG_2044.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVNsA3j8WXZRLThz4KWShzymXVkWyCucK4kPtDSVYCXDj/IMG_2044.jpeg)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JY3duDtPOTw&pp=ygUScmFtb25lcyBjcmV0aW4gaG9w

Song - Cretin Hop

![IMG_2045.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXfdQ1Tb3rhNytf1tinpeiSHtRCYquN6saiCBXVtsz29j/IMG_2045.jpeg)

And lastly & very different style song for Bonus Tune this week is the slow and melodic 
Here Today, Gone Tomorrow written by Joey Ramone!  

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kbKYPeauEKU&pp=ygUgcmFtb25lcyBoZXJlIHRvZGF5IGdvbmUgdG9tb3Jyb3c%3D

Song - Here Today, Gone Tomorrow

Thanks for dropping by everybody!  Drop a comment & let me know what you think of the tunes this week!  Also big thanks to @ablaze for hosting #ThreeTuneTuesday! 

![IMG_2046.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmViyXxAQ3R1ww7kkGFrMYAtVArG6HPagCA5dSmN7tbMXf/IMG_2046.jpeg)

Also a big thanks to all fellow posters who regularly post original music on TTT & not AI stolen tracks!  Unfortunately I’m seeing a couple accounts post AI songs and claim it’s by them but that’s not how it works. AI scans web and steals to make whatever slop it gives said person who prompts it in what style or what band or artist to sound like.  We should all not upvote or support AI tracks on three tune Tuesday’s!  It’s literally theft with no credit!   Just wanted to share my thoughts!  Cheers!

body.title: Potato Noodles with Gochujang Sauce
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYYJUFK2VboDCMiMVFknYC1Z3p9jT8rDiqQgjp4Vtc8L6/1779727690714.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers, today I tried making my own potato noodles. They have a chewy texture and a spicy, savory flavor. It turns out it’s quite tricky to make this is the second time I’ve tried it, and it finally I did it. Okay let's get started 

**Ingredients:**

- 400 grams of potatoes
- a pinch of salt
- 2 tbsp tapioca flour
- 6 tbsp rice flour
- 4 tbsp all-purpose flour 
- 1 tbsp gochujang paste 
- 1 tbsp chili flakes 
- cheese
- 3 sausages
- 2 tbsp fiber creme
- 100 ml water
- 1 clove garlic
- cooking oil
- 1/2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 tsp sugar
- 1/2 tbsp oyster sauce
- 1/2 tsp salt

**Instructions:**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdEwMZNRngmDvrKG7gWv9tgzdAxtWhvAHP87NVMuRiQ78/1779727719255.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRzv4Um6QrQV1ptKSbQM7NMHY16YTLTuMDPHdEzEtAw5Z/1779727719610.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb9i3tZmBsgjpED8oa9kqyGr4hVFYi2889dL668gyrGDw/1779727743894.jpg)

- Peel the potatoes and rinse under running water

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXtv4cvyLMcsnXW7aD6U85R6RxPBP4haTnvgUq2JMuS8f/1779727744108.jpg)

- Cut the potatoes into smaller pieces

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6Qc5kVjsxsmJorGwmCpHoGEJkb3X9d1Ffrb8bBNAGkR/1779728253527.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYo4XX7us3EfMdxpaZdXqkq1aEbDTz8m8U3BoGXtgZsvG/1779728253664.jpg)

- Boil the potatoes until soft

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ2fz45yug8fEzGtM4kmg61XTUNSv7hQY3nYgSXuEUyv7/1779727795167.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVdAQob2cFfRaKnyGTQJuQBw5TvLbCNMoHuNFzdV9YruE/1779727795427.jpg)

- Mash the potatoes through a sieve

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSQuXK7JLkVjRREFBmqwTMVvqdFyyunWGRotDvsPbApFt/1779727819621.jpg)

- Add the all-purpose flour, tapioca flour, and rice flour

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeZovNAUBxUvehFyfLWWkwQcZQ1sQNjzagLTQfUAqn17z/1779727842416.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8dBKrta6XSkxCc61VFHurzJjzEA4dFYxK5oLkp9HGSd/1779727842714.jpg)

- Mix the flours and mashed potatoes until they form a dough

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSgUxsDQ5mXKLV3XknqLsvHhEpv259WC8Vh4Q2EDW5nUo/1779727890570.jpg)

- Take a small portion of the dough and roll it out into long strands like noodles

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeAJUSE2T7V9cMik9EYLsVFUXedgEQh2rxPRKC2XyXs2U/1779727911286.jpg)

- Repeat until all the dough is used

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKs8SHEF2ru15fck6cWMxZdmdrVhRph45prk83iQzjx4/1779727932224.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQcQhXseLQHzbvcNa3EDkApJorWQoxKWYpj8HcdHQPaHK/1779727932436.jpg)

- Boil the potato noodles in boiling water mixed with a little oil

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQLgKybTUEyjJ47uCLu6Y9pi1z6to3GP96b5fWuTEFSgh/1779727955021.jpg)

- When the noodles start to float, remove them, drain, and set aside

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXu17mm3jGLwH2qzqDR4UbeekXcFZn4G8DBaA4RTDJCrv/1779727979892.jpg)

- Sauté the minced garlic 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbu2zJTNd14JW7LLuagZPmEeecyv8reFvGwEZKZgAtbYX/1779728028596.jpg)

- Add gochujang paste and chili flakes

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYwH5AqBZgcFSZ7gkkpYU1U6vKQqqpW4gn8WEXDPekd3H/1779728049888.jpg)

- Add a mixture of 2 tbsp fiber cream and 100 ml water to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmauCxp77oeSMT8DDk9hYNdUADym76qm46c2aqwMFvgRjT/1779728065718.jpg)

- Add the sliced sausage to the pan

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcM2wKKxYwJxMAm9d8qYgzodhiEaeeVUWAW356iLVmtvG/1779728090766.jpg)

- Add the cheese 

- Cook until boil

- Stir until well combined, then add oyster sauce, garlic powder, salt, and sugar

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR3PQpBkPtVTCq2Nd9T5e4f8hgwnDMGMhM7WNK5rhPa4A/1779728137716.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXpRA7oTSBqVgsfJLVuFD99CmrZ6fTfEWPfoyAyna7CNW/1779728137865.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeuppg2khh3cZvE7zXn71SNyVH4cpkZccr1K4GxCu5CuP/1779728173355.jpg)

- Place the potato noodles on a plate, then pour the spicy gochujang sauce over the noodles

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQBX9AJHsmXGi5JNwgHtNLVP9yUa55wTGirp7zv4ALph1/1779728157423.jpg)

- Sprinkle sesame seeds on top

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdTavvrCDJQCZZzUpxrEVN67mHErssJLMdpJRuJ8tW3Ms/1779728195901.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZK37QK7WAmFs6pTo7qj1LD8xVeS5Tkibd244kWmUke1i/1779728196112.jpg)

- The potato noodles with gochujang sauce are ready to eat

This season will end in five days from today. So roughly it will be ending on Friday, and before the season ends, I have made sure that I enter the Diamond Three League, but this is not all because I'm trying to enter the Diamond One league if it is possible for me in the current season. Although I was expecting to enter the champion but looks like that is not going to be easy for me this season, but it's fine as long as I'm able to end up the season in the diamond, which can be most probably diamond one or two, just in case, then also it is fine.

I have a rating of 3080 at this time which makes me eligible to play in Diamond Three But from here to move forward and enter in the diamond 2 will take some time because I need to play a couple of more battles and if somehow I can manage another 20 ranking then I will be able to enter in the diamond two so you can say that diamond 2 is not far away from me.

body.body:
https://youtu.be/GnmQ64uDaH0?si=Ywa2FEAywQiUB_ZP
The bible teaches us that giving back to God some little of what he gave to us is very important and we should not ignore it. In the Old Testament, the Israelites were commanded to give a tenth of their income and produce to support the temple and the Levites. 

>Malachi 3:10 says, “Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse… and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts.” 

Paying of tithes is a way which we can support the church of God, to tell God thank you for what you gave us. Salvation and God’s favor are not based on paying tithes. The Bible encourages believers to honor God with their resources while giving freely, sincerely, and according to what they are able to provide.

body.title: How Poor Students Become Successful in Life
body.body:
![sherie-child-8966218_1920.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUbiffWt2dNYQfbQmn23KY8t6aoaXjQQYJPDAxXziee8L/sherie-child-8966218_1920.jpg)
source : https://pixabay.com/

Some people say money makes the man perfect. It's largely true that in today's world money is highly valued, so in the education system you've probably seen many students who lack facilities in their lives but have very big dreams. 

They don't have expensive school bags or those kinds of facilities, but they do have one thing: the determination to change their lives. 

A poor student's journey is completely different from that of an ordinary student. He doesn't just carry books; he also shoulders responsibilities. Sometimes it's the pressure of living in the city, sometimes the worry of tuition fees, sometimes the concern of meeting small needs. But this pressure gradually makes him stronger. and gradually builds resilience. Meanwhile, other students are just cramming for exams; they have every life necessity. You could say they're the golden-spoon kids. 

Whereas other students are just cramming for exams, they have every life necessity—you could say they're born with a golden spoon, wealthy by birth—while a poor student is also building the blueprint for his future; for him, education and a degree …not just a degree, but also a means of survival for themselves. 

Such students often sacrifice themselves at a young age. They see how hard their parents are struggling to cover expenses, and then they force themselves to think, “I have to become something.” These feelings ignite an internal fire within them. 


And let me also tell you that necessity is the mother of invention, so you can apply this proverb here too: people work hard to keep themselves in the running for success, and it's only these difficult circumstances that either break a person or make them—those who survive the system don't just pass, they make life stronger. The biggest struggle for a poor student is also his hunger. You've seen in history, friends, that many renowned figures were poor, and they worked hard and made a name for themselves that people will remember for as long as the world stands. They will remember the work they did. Life gives to those who give to themselves. work hard. A poor student's dream may seem small to others, but when it finally becomes reality, it's the result of their hard work and dedication.

body.title: # 🧠 EL CANSANCIO MENTAL VS EL CANSANCIO FÍSICO: ¿CUÁL NOS AGOTA MÁS? # 🎯 MENTAL TIREDNESS VS PHYSICAL TIREDNESS: WHICH DRAINS US MORE?
body.body:
> # 🧠 EL CANSANCIO MENTAL VS EL CANSANCIO FÍSICO: ¿CUÁL NOS AGOTA MÁS? # 🎯 MENTAL TIREDNESS VS PHYSICAL TIREDNESS: WHICH DRAINS US MORE? --- Saludos, queridos amigos de la comunidad de Hive. Hoy quiero tomarme un momento para reflexionar sobre una batalla silenciosa que todos libramos en nuestro día a día. Muchas veces nos sentimos sin fuerzas, pero ¿alguna vez se han detenido a pensar de dónde viene realmente ese agotamiento? ¿Es peor tener el cuerpo molido por el trabajo o la mente abrumada por los pensamientos? Greetings, dear friends of the Hive community. Today I want to take a moment to reflect on a silent battle that we all fight in our daily lives. Many times we feel out of strength, but have you ever stopped to think where that exhaustion really comes from? Is it worse to have a body sore from work or a mind overwhelmed by thoughts? --- ## 🏃‍♂️ EL CUERPO TIENE REGLAS CLARAS ## 🏃‍♂️ THE BODY HAS CLEAR RULES ![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/3775168/pexels-photo-3775168.jpeg)
[Imagen de Pexels / Image from Pexels](https://images.pexels.com/photos/3775168/pexels-photo-3775168.jpeg)
El cansancio físico es honesto y juega limpio. Si caminas varios kilómetros en la montaña, cargas peso o pasas el día trabajando bajo el sol, tu cuerpo te va a pasar factura. Te dolerán las piernas, sentirás los hombros pesados y los ojos te van a arder. Sin embargo, este tipo de fatiga tiene una línea de meta clara: una buena comida, suficiente agua y ocho horas de sueño profundo suelen ser suficientes para resetear el sistema y despertar como nuevo al día siguiente. Physical tiredness is honest and plays fair. If you walk several kilometers in the mountains, carry heavy weights, or spend the day working under the sun, your body will take its toll. Your legs will ache, your shoulders will feel heavy, and your eyes will burn. However, this type of fatigue has a clear finish line: a good meal, enough water, and eight hours of deep sleep are usually enough to reset the system and wake up like new the next day. --- ## 🌀 EL LABERINTO DE LA MENTE ## 🌀 THE LABYRINTH OF THE MIND ![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/3184292/pexels-photo-3184292.jpeg)
[Imagen de Pexels / Image from Pexels](https://images.pexels.com/photos/3184292/pexels-photo-3184292.jpeg)
Por otro lado, el agotamiento mental no sigue ninguna lógica. Puedes pasar todo el día sentado en una silla sin mover un solo músculo y, aun así, sentirte completamente destruido por dentro. Es ese cansancio que viene de pensar de más, de tomar decisiones constantes, de la presión del día a día y de fingir que todo está bien cuando por dentro estás abrumado. Lo peor es que este cansancio no se cura simplemente durmiendo; puedes dormir diez horas y despertar sintiéndote igual de vacío. On the other hand, mental exhaustion does not follow any logic. You can spend the whole day sitting in a chair without moving a single muscle and yet feel completely destroyed inside. It is that tiredness that comes from overthinking, making constant decisions, the pressure of daily life, and pretending everything is fine when inside you are overwhelmed. The worst part is that this tiredness is not cured simply by sleeping; you can sleep for ten hours and wake up feeling just as empty. --- ## ⚖️ MI PERSPECTIVA: PREFIERO EL DOLOR MUSCULAR ## ⚖️ MY PERSPECTIVE: I PREFER SORE MUSCLES ![](https://images.pexels.com/photos/4056535/pexels-photo-4056535.jpeg)
[Imagen de Pexels / Image from Pexels](https://images.pexels.com/photos/4056535/pexels-photo-4056535.jpeg)
Si me ponen a elegir, prefiero mil veces el dolor en los músculos que una mente agotada. El cansancio físico te invita a descansar, a sentarte a compartir con la familia y disfrutar del momento. El cansancio mental te aísla, te hace desaparecer aunque estés presente físicamente en una habitación. El cuerpo nos avisa cuando parar para no enfermarnos, pero la mente es peligrosa porque sigue funcionando en un bucle pesado que nos quita el interés por lo que amamos. Para sanar la mente no necesitamos una cama, necesitamos paz, silencio y aprender a soltar las cargas. If I am given a choice, I prefer a thousand times the pain in the muscles than an exhausted mind. Physical tiredness invites you to rest, to sit down to share with your family and enjoy the moment. Mental tiredness isolates you, it makes you disappear even if you are physically present in a room. The body warns us when to stop so we do not get sick, but the mind is dangerous because it keeps running in a heavy loop that takes away our interest in what we love. To heal the mind we do not need a bed, we need peace, silence, and learning to let go of the burdens. ¿Y ustedes qué opinan, mis amigos de Hive? ¿Cuál de estos dos cansancios les afecta más en su rutina y cómo hacen para desconectarse y recuperar su energía? ¡Espero leer sus valiosos comentarios e impresiones! And what do you think, my friends of Hive? Which of these two kinds of tiredness affects you the most in your routine, and how do you disconnect to recover your energy? I look forward to reading your valuable comments and insights! --- ### 📊 FICHA DE CRÉDITOS / CREDITS BOARD | Detalle / Detail | Información / Information | | :--- | :--- | | **Fotos / Photos** | Banco de imágenes gratuitas de Pexels. / Free stock photos from Pexels. | | **Edición / Editing** | Maquetado en Markdown por @rctv | **Traducción / Translation** | Realizada con el soporte de DeepL.com. / Made with the support of DeepL.com. |

body.title: The Rooftop, My World. LOH#290
body.body:
I don't know how this will sound, but I just want to be real and honest. There's this small rooftop in our house, its not a fancy place or such, but then that space has become another world entirely for me.




You will hardly see me there during the day, I don't even know what it looks like during the day, I always go there at night when everything is dark, from there I hear the various generator sounds in the neighborhood, I hear the cry of kids in the street, and I see how calm and spacious the whole street is.




![1001069344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tRv7LusFEzD1y4rv5bq9Ta1xoXURPiN8auCUWLiLXiEbsh6AsFSdym9pBjGzv65cPoQ.jpg)



There's something special about a blackout night on our rooftop. You will think I usually pray for NEPA to take light or that light shouldn't even come at all, immediately light goes off, I climb up to the rooftop alone. And I usually enjoy my time alone there, sometimes I sit there writing, other times I just play slow soulful music in low volumes, at times I just stare at the sky, but most of the time, I find myself thinking about life, work, family expectations, work, and my future.



I remember my younger brother asking me why I always go up there anytime there's blackout, I just smiled and told him, *\

*



Now, talking of I could swap lives with any famous person. A lot of people came across my mind as I was pondering on this, and I decided to settle for one, which is Olamide. He's a Nigerian musician and rapper. And I'm not choosing him because of fame and money, no, I'm choosing him because of the impact he's had in people's lives and the kind of person he has shown and proven himself to be.



Olamide has been around the music industry for a while now, and I can tell you for free that his reputation precedes him. A lot of popular and very well known musicians today became known because Olamide believed in them, and brought them to spotlight. He has given a lot of artist/musicians opportunities, support them, stood by them, invested in them and make sure they stood...that kind of impact is a very rare one. Very few humans can do that. There are times he will even put his own work on hold just so make sure a particular artist become grounded first.





One of the things I admire about him is his calmness, Olamide is a very humble person, despite his fame, he remains humble. The industry he's in, which is the music industry is one known for various news from scandals to dramas and all, guess what, you will never find Olamide's name in any of it. I admire how he so much loves, honors, respects, and protects himself and his name.



![1000718621.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVM1nY3TXzWNcVxoPTottsozt9nmPkfqg1M8d7vKGoyPecmM18KuyuR6ZvBFo2MdVGF.jpg)



People always shout and argue about the big 3 in the Nigeria music industry, you will never see them include Olamide's name in it, not because he's not big, but because he's not someone to be compared with others. He's on his own lane, he's respected, and he's a boss on his own. Everyone knows he's too big to be positioned amidst the top three.



To some extent, I've studied this man, just the way I'm studying Funke Akindele at the moment. What stands out is his consistency, he's a street boy, that's where he came from, he understood the street so well, he rose to fame, he helps upcoming artists, he remembers his humble beginnings, and choose to stay humble despite his fame, money and celebrity status.


So, swapping life with him would be me experiencing what it feels like to be able to touch lives, raise people like myself and still remain respected by the streets and even the industry.




🌹

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

body.title: Why Education is the Most Powerful Weapon
body.body:
![thedigitalartist-why-4129050 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWeqACEnHDWoekte7ybre2k8Lxywo8hVKG67MaJMk5gH4/thedigitalartist-why-4129050%20(1).jpg)
image source : https://pixabay.com/

Hello friends, how are you? I hope you're all doing well. Sometimes people think that real power comes from one's social status, but this proves that the greatest power in the world is your education.

 It's also said in the Holy Qur'an that those who have knowledge and those who do not are not equal. My Lord has ordained it, and it always holds true. Education is a weapon that, without shedding blood, transforms you through the power of your own hard work. But it's only through education that you gain access; your dedication and those things are what lift you out of poverty. K He spoke the truth: being born poor is not in your hands, but dying poor certainly is. And that saying comes from a country—I believe it was said for that very reason—to urge you to focus on education. When you have an education, you can even take on the world's biggest mountain and conquer it.

 I have seen many people in my life who struggle because of a lack of resources, but where education comes in, that person slowly changes their situation. It helps a person emerge from darkness and learn. A person with knowledge never has to hold out their hand to anyone. Today's world 26 6. Do you know how fast everything has changed? There's competition in everything now. If a person has an education, they can easily solve any problem.



I believe that education is an investment that never fails. The more you share it, the more it grows for you. It may run out, but as long as your mind is working, you will always move toward success. If you look around your community, you'll see many people who, because of their previous position, J are living lives where they only have one role. If you give me the opportunity to obtain an education, I can certainly move toward success. Someone once said that education is a powerful weapon that can change your world, so education is truly the key to great success.

body.title: A little fashion tips for my designers, Recycling a colorful dress
body.body:
# Hello Hive 

![1000219554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242YA8VbFd7kj9jz5ZyWripoNLUBZk6vrU57cti9NgnAJYmwng6KsyHUjZZa7kZsyjNVU.jpg)

Happy new week to us all, I hope that our days are going on well as planned. Having completed some exercise in the farm earlier today I decided to crown the day with an evening service in the church as we are having a conference throughout this week.




![1000219559.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242Nm7L1UWmwE5RGeKNNPDo9UH3QTer1GLHxCm6SWVVwMiJLBNCbPBLEymtiK2tkeGq8Q.jpg)



What to wear is always a challenge for many designers especially when we want to appear in different designs and styles everyday.

I can say that designers are one of the most oppressive people out there, they will keep on wearing new clothes and design to advertise their business while people keep getting intimidated 😂😂😂😂 


Okay don't get annoyed dearies, I am only selling my brand. 



Designers get attracted to fabrics and new designs from every corner of these streets, sometimes I get distracted inside the church admiring the different outfit people wear to church, soon enough I just realize how much I am trying to copy a style in my head or how to make it better than what was sown. 

Okay don't get annoyed again if you catch me admiring you, it is just the stuff we are made off. 



Having admired so many design I decided to sew one for myself and after sewing this armless dress with front cap, I ended up not wearing it. Sometimes we admire a design but after recreating the style, we just realize that we can't wear what we have sown. This is often my experience and I'm not sure if it happens to other designers. 


![1000219492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23vi82uPFaumyoNggJBvAdWRXKekA7JDGKxwf1g1PCsSr6BNdEazKxwenjMX8iXdt3pCX.jpg)

It has been 2years I made this dress and it has never been worn for once, instead of allowing it lay dormant I decided to recycle it to some new and probably wearable design.


![1000219488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wX3hLBKuH6MXDEWnhcUkqb7wzWKrV881fwibwGMSVe1QejE8RWunkqTjd8si2xN9iSS.jpg)

![1000219500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23wMga3yMZkm6wiib4NnMGrjMgL1B4sc7W5dbGH4KYfBYrtm8zJnvvhVwqoM2weqgsepA.jpg)



I first unstitched it and removed the cap.

From the cap I was able to cut out some two short sleeves 


![1000219556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zGcRt9ABZyCe5XgXS4XGLDmwGmtFbcti6AjLyhED79ddaaY6pZzYPzs6xbShETtLpun.jpg)


Next I added a small gathers at the tip of the sleeves
Stitches a hemming for the sleeve 


![1000219517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/244UqdpU7PsSjV8oqx14mymGKyyo7PpEdsm1NLKEE5FCemkMBdAnEo6ZLkf1bGMB5yfvU.jpg)

Next I measured out my round sleeve and determined where I will creave the sleeve stitches 

![1000219509.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xVMSJ8cR8eC5uNDaEhkvQjbMfrZxTQYWf4xSrYg6jxgHH4gb7Py1eckdRvgEb8R14gL.jpg)

----

![1000219515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23w2ktsssXZJLPRXKxnLFVSjS53ZbsUACH4niW5kLSi1g4sHmXzXYGDziQLdmQiL4N3cM.jpg)

 Then i notched the midpoint of the sleeves and attached it to the dress 

![1000219538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tvkkRPfVAfJQVtXZ9AT3p52tP574JtKUwATMiB9gsJ4n5gHC3PZ2jrPou4PWkaauZHu.jpg)

Having done that I closed the zipper allowances and I have onlookers commenting the dress already. 


![1000219553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/241tbML9sd2ZxgWNs9bVZSWirzkqqXwrMAG4LrAsLuB31kxQyJ2SuBgVbSGqBUCu2efeM.jpg)


Here is the beautiful new look.
The formal dress had no sleeves and only a cap, that didn't feel right but this is a better version, well recycles and wearable for anyone.

body.title: A day of laughter and silliness among friends [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
> Hi everyone, one positive thing about these power outages is that they definitely suggest new plans, and you can take advantage of the time to do things you'd normally do for something else. Lately, though, I've been getting together more often with my sister's friends, whom I've been gradually integrating into. A few days ago, we had another get-together to chat, laugh, cook together, and have a good time, so today I'll share a little bit about it. >Hola a todos, algo positivo de este tema de las idas de luz es que sin duda los planes sugieren y se puede aprovechar para realizar actividades que normalmente haríamos con alguna otra cosa. Sin embargo, últimamente me he estado animando a reunirme un poco más seguido con los amigos de mi hermana, a los que poco a poco me he estado integrando, y hace unos días volvimos a hacer una reunión para charlar, reírnos, cocinar juntos y pasar un rato agradable, por lo que hoy les compartiré un poco sobre ello.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmXic7ssx5BaAbnvjrRknPjJPun5z8zqjbhtMNR3JqaSGu/1779726927263.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvor84X6DLK4XfoiGqwBZcF4VDN2o4jp3eX42YGUwXcH/1779726950117.jpg
This time, it wasn't just the same group as last time; there was one more person who was sorely missed: the girlfriend of one of the guys we love dearly. I hadn't been able to be there when she was sometimes there because I'd get too sleepy; however, this time it finally happened. She had the flu and a fever, which she'd been getting lately because of the rain. After buying some ice cream, at their request, we set off, and once we were there, we started joking around in one of the bedrooms. There was a huge computer, and while one of them was playing games, we were like little kids staring at the graphics, until the power came on and we got to work helping with lunch. >Para esto no solo estábamos los de la última vez, sino que había un integrante más que ya hacía falta y era la novia de uno de los chicos a quien queremos mucho. Yo no había podido estar como tal cuando ella estaba a veces porque me ganaba el sueño de ir; sin embargo, en esta ocasión sí se dio. Ella estaba con malestar de gripe y fiebre, cosa que ha estado dando últimamente por el tema lluvia. Una vez comprados unos helados, por encargo de ellos, nos dispusimos a ir y, estando allá, primero que todo estuvimos haciendo bromas en lo que era una de las habitaciones. Estaba un computador muy grande y, mientras uno jugaba, nosotros parecíamos niños chiquitos viendo los gráficos, hasta que la luz atacó y nos pusimos manos a la obra a ayudar con el almuerzo.

The plan was rice, chicken, plantain slices, and arepas, and the girl had already started with the fried arepas, although we kept sneaking a few whenever we couldn't find the time. While one of the guys chopped the seasonings—onions, peppers, and garlic—I chopped the chicken, and we listened to some really fun music. At one point, we thought about making chicken and rice, but we got distracted with the stew, and it ended up separate and unusable. So, once everything was ready, we sent the host to get some soda and enjoyed the meal, which, thanks to the cumin we found rummaging through a drawer, had a really nice spicy kick. >El plan era arroz, pollo, tajadas y arepas, y ya la chica había comenzado por las arepas fritas, aunque a cada descuido nos comíamos alguna. Mientras uno de los muchachos picaba los aliños, que eran cebolla, ajíes y ajos, yo picaba el pollo y escuchábamos música muy divertida. En un momento pensamos hacer arroz con pollo, pero nos descuidamos con el guiso y quedó separado y descartado, así que una vez estuvo todo listo, mandamos al dueño de la casa por el refresco y disfrutamos de la comida que, como le agregamos comino que conseguimos revisando un cajón, le dio un toque picante muy bueno.

There was no shortage of laughter, as amidst the jokes, a dress and a crazy idea emerged, which the boys then tried on, creating a hilarious moment. One of them couldn't get it to close because of the dress, while the other fit like it had been custom-made. It was truly funny, since I had initially suggested a robe, but the dress idea was more than perfect; we even joked about the missing fishnet stockings. After that, we stayed up watching videos and chatting about everything, even playing some Call of Duty Mobile, though I already mentioned that in another post. Finally, everyone went home, and in my case, I went to buy food for the kittens first to end the day on a high note. So, I hope you enjoyed this post, and thank you so much for reading. >Algo que no faltó fueron las risas, ya que entre bromas salió un vestido y una idea muy alocada, por lo que rato después a los chicos se les usó esto, siendo un momento de risas. A uno de ellos no se le cerraba por el tema del hecho y al otro le quedaba como si se lo hubieran mandado a hacer. La verdad fue muy divertido, ya que en un principio había dicho que fuera una bata, pero el tema del vestido fue más que perfecto; incluso hacíamos chistes de que faltaban las medias de red. Aun así, luego de eso nos quedamos viendo videos y hablando de todo un poco, incluso jugando algo de COD Mobile, aunque eso ya lo comenté en otro post. Aun así, finalizando todo, cada quien a su casa y, en mi caso, a comprar primero la comida de los gatitos para finalizar bien el día. Así que bueno, esperando que sea de su agrado y sin más que decir, muchas gracias por leer este post.

body.title: Healthy cookies bars[ENG/ESP]
body.body:
> Feliz inicio de semana mis amantes del buen comer, un gusto compartir con ustedes nuevamente, creando como siempre ricas recetas, compartiendo, y como estoy en esta onda de hacer galletas saludables, hoy les traigo una nueva versión, y aunque no me salió como esperaba, igual quedaron muy ricas.😋
![post hive (75).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23ynhGikxs3h9DqVVNetXaxhpphqtHXyBiaVnQbqnFzfmC9SuawjdAQFrQPBquA8wvbd1.png)
Esta es una forma diferente de armar estas galletas, estilo barritas, la idea es que queden bien duras y crujientes, en mi caso, quedaron un poco blandas, pero la idea es buena, no lo creen. Ahora les cuento como las hice, y los ingredientes que utilice para su preparación. --- **The ingredients I used were as follows:** *Para los ingrediente secos:* - 1 taza de harina integral - 1 Cucharadita de bicarbonato - 1 Cucharadita de Polvo de hornear - Sal *Para los ingredientes húmedos:* - 1 Huevo - 3 Cucharadas de mantequilla derretida - vainilla - 2 Cucharaditas de azúcar morena
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokbFwbXzSjazZYC6cCVSCVFVtiTLBT5fwcXpv3hsja7cQnX2WUaz1xgFQJEccHxa9x.png)
--- ## Preparation: Ahora para su preparación, en un bol colocaremos los ingredientes secos, la harina integral cernida, por cierto, junto con el bicarbonato, y el polvo de hornear.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAZgEe1Y6xXqQU7dGs4FraRiZ3LUqMrP7uF3twpkPu5jNJwWySLP3iRBg2JZLYKsPD.png)
En otro bol colocaremos los ingredientes húmedos, en este caso, la mantequilla derretida, junto con el huevo, la vainilla y el azúcar, lo mezclaremos todo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8SmkQbyAFzNPFSfJHnhthMCQ24jePB7u86nixzu76vAXK2VaBpuSQfkFVLZ7WQi8s.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eoc8TuPdQCHbgkxzZypQzNPLN1jBrLcMJ8CMrH4AUhcEdVFnNCbAC91pYieaYSkHXcp.png)
Una vez hecho esto, vamos a unirlos, agregamos la parte liquida a la harina, y procedemos a mezclar, hasta obtener una masa homogénea.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoiVCihDYNcrzWqZDuPoBzJBPwXm57XyZ5cGsENGyHSoJn8DnuQCjeX2mGFd6uRddrp.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoGxsifYVyoASDbvW1tFzSHodrgTbN7YymPbazurCmjv2g8NbxwE2eVmKWqB2ZCUH8x.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAbiQJLqNmXesMCeJbhXo7M3BtNCzrpgVk9m91carLtE5iinbhKv5mBgt8YxrDYNWv.png)
Como toque final, le añadimos unas chispas de chocolate, seguidamente en una pequeña bandeja, colocamos la masa y la estiramos, lo mas que podamos.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAadHjdBqjAKM3Ly13yU1dLi7SYY45iWBnRZzMZNQT9Q4XEWWqraouf6FBUZ2SjUhW.png)
La llevamos al horno por unos 30 o 45 minutos, la idea es como dije, que quede bien crujiente, sin embargo, me falto un paso, es fundamental dejar refrigerar un tiempo la masa, para la próxima, probare esta técnica.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EowJ3DFNW9hLAMkv7wbxNHBV1zDpsGoSH4YsB57mhF775KiHe2EN3mwJ6G8H7XXYuhF.png)
Dejamos reposar por unos minutos, y procedemos a cortarla en tiras, quedando de esta manera. Quedaron muy ricas eso si, y si las acompañas con un toque de chocolate amargo, super deliciosas, sin duda un excelente snacks.😋 😋
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoK7ht3zVimbBTvNMbyN6tc5EjX95s8hLVa4ZbtQ4UCdkkr9zYXvtV3ypL7TStMtarc.png)
---
ENGLISH VERSION

Happy start to the week, my fellow food lovers! It’s a pleasure to be back with you, creating delicious recipes as always and sharing them with you. Since I’m on a kick of making healthy cookies, today I’m bringing you a new version—and even though they didn’t turn out exactly as I’d hoped, they were still really tasty. 😋 This is a different way to make these cookies, in a bar-style. The idea is for them to be really hard and crunchy; in my case, they turned out a little soft, but the concept is good, don’t you think? Now I’ll tell you how I made them and the ingredients I used. --- **The ingredients I used were as follows:** *For the dry ingredients:* - 1 cup whole wheat flour - 1 teaspoon baking soda - 1 teaspoon baking powder - Salt *For the wet ingredients:* - 1 egg - 3 tablespoons melted butter - vanilla - 2 teaspoons brown sugar

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EokbFwbXzSjazZYC6cCVSCVFVtiTLBT5fwcXpv3hsja7cQnX2WUaz1xgFQJEccHxa9x.png)
--- ## Preparation: Now, to prepare the mixture, place the dry ingredients in a bowl—the whole wheat flour (sifted, by the way), along with the baking soda and baking powder.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAZgEe1Y6xXqQU7dGs4FraRiZ3LUqMrP7uF3twpkPu5jNJwWySLP3iRBg2JZLYKsPD.png)
In another bowl, combine the wet ingredients—in this case, the melted butter, along with the egg, vanilla, and sugar—and mix everything together.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eo8SmkQbyAFzNPFSfJHnhthMCQ24jePB7u86nixzu76vAXK2VaBpuSQfkFVLZ7WQi8s.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/Eoc8TuPdQCHbgkxzZypQzNPLN1jBrLcMJ8CMrH4AUhcEdVFnNCbAC91pYieaYSkHXcp.png)
Once this is done, combine the ingredients, add the liquid to the flour, and mix until you have a smooth dough.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoiVCihDYNcrzWqZDuPoBzJBPwXm57XyZ5cGsENGyHSoJn8DnuQCjeX2mGFd6uRddrp.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoGxsifYVyoASDbvW1tFzSHodrgTbN7YymPbazurCmjv2g8NbxwE2eVmKWqB2ZCUH8x.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAbiQJLqNmXesMCeJbhXo7M3BtNCzrpgVk9m91carLtE5iinbhKv5mBgt8YxrDYNWv.png)
As a finishing touch, we add some chocolate chips, then place the dough on a small tray and roll it out as thin as possible.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EoAadHjdBqjAKM3Ly13yU1dLi7SYY45iWBnRZzMZNQT9Q4XEWWqraouf6FBUZ2SjUhW.png)
We bake it for about 30 to 45 minutes; the idea, as I said, is for it to be nice and crispy. However, I missed a step—it’s essential to let the dough chill for a while. Next time, I’ll try this technique.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/EowJ3DFNW9hLAMkv7wbxNHBV1zDpsGoSH4YsB57mhF775KiHe2EN3mwJ6G8H7XXYuhF.png)
Let it rest for a few minutes, then cut it into strips, so it looks like this. They turned out really tasty, though, and if you pair them with a touch of dark chocolate, they’re super delicious—definitely an excellent snack.😋 😋

body.body: Kom til at tænke på at jeg i korte perioder arbejdede \

vognmand Jørgen Olsen i Taxa, der dengang havde skiftested i en kælder under Nimbusparken, Frederiksbjerg, han kørte forretningen med hans kone/kæreste, som hed Tina... de var totalt utilregnelige og forfærdelige i deres adfærd... har kun dårlige oplevelser med dem stort set, grænseoverskridende adfærd, ingen tillid og ikke andet end aggression og problemer med dem... de boede i Greve.. ved ikke om han er vognmand mere og om de stadig er sammen og om de bor i Greve... ved at han på et senere tidspunkt ikke var i Nimbus parken mere ... om han var stoppet som vognmand ved jeg ikke...


Tina har jeg aldrig mødt, alligevel har jeg snakket i telefon med hende engang, hun ringede vækkede mig efter en nattevagt og overfusede mig totalt i telefonen, fordi hun mente at jeg ikke havde støvsuget bilen ordentligt.. det var meget grænseoverskridende, jeg havde arbejdet mange timer om natten, boede langt væk i malmø og der var absolut ingen grund til at ringe mig midt på dagen, hvor hun må have vist at jeg sov efter mange timers arbejde... jeg sagde bare til hende at du vækker mig det er helt uacceptabelt at ringe til mig på den måde!! farvel...

Det var meget grænseoverskridende... arbejdsforholdet resulterede i at jeg mistede mine pensioner, fordi jeg ikke kunne betale mine regninger uden at få dem udbetalt, da jeg fortalte det til Jørgen Olsen over telefonen, sagde han \

.. det er helt utrolig aggressiv adfærd overfor en totalt udsat mand, som mister det hele på baggrund af blandt andet Jørgen Olsens adfærd, det var langt fra ham alene.. men han bidrag til tabene... 

Bilerne var pæne, men hans adfærd var totalt grænseoverskridende, EKSTREMT AGGRESSIV uden grund og lignende... 

Har ikke tid til at gå mere i detaljer, vil bare sige at de to personer fortjener intet... absolut intet... udfra hvad jeg kender til dem...

Lasse



AI tekst:

jørgen olsen vognmand Taxa, som havde skiftested Nimbusparken Frederiksberg boede i greve, er han stadig vognmand?? bor han stadig i greve??

Thought for 9s

Nej, han er sandsynligvis ikke længere aktiv som vognmand/taxa-chauffør, og der er ingen offentlige tegn på, at han stadig bor på den gamle adresse i Greve. 

cvrapi.dk

Kort opsummering baseret på offentlige registre:Virksomheden TAXAVOGNMAND JØRGEN OLSEN (CVR 14617485) var registreret på Glentevej 1, 2670 Greve og løb fra 1990 til 24. maj 2019, hvor den ophørte. 

cvrapi.dk

Der er også spor af mindre selskaber som Taxany 1 IVS og Taxany 2 IVS på samme adresse med Jørgen Olsen som ejer/direktør omkring 2018-2019, som også ser ud til at være afviklet. 

northdata.de

Ingen nyere offentlige oplysninger (efter 2019) peger på, at han fortsat er aktiv som taxa-vognmand. Der dukker ikke noget frem om kørsel, nye CVR-registreringer eller lignende i Greve-området. Nimbusparken-skiftestedet i Frederiksberg passer med en ældre taxa-tilknytning.Adresse: Glentevej 1 nævnes stadig i ældre lister (f.eks. telefonbogs-lignende sider), men det er fra før eller omkring lukningen i 2019. Der er ingen bekræftede aktuelle adresser eller profiler, der tydeligt matcher en aktiv taxa-Jørgen Olsen i Greve. Det er almindeligt, at folk går på pension eller stopper i branchen efter mange år.Offentlige registre giver ikke 100 % sikkerhed om private forhold (f.eks. pension, flytning eller dødsfald), men alt peger på, at taxa-virksomheden stoppede for godt 7 år siden. Hvis du har brug for mere specifikke oplysninger, kan du tjekke Krak, CVR direkte eller kontakte Taxa/Greve-Solrød Taxa for gamle kollegaer.

ok han er stoppet, hvad laver han idag?

Thought for 5s

Der er ingen offentlige oplysninger om, hvad den tidligere taxa-vognmand Jørgen Olsen fra Glentevej i Greve laver i dag. Taxa-virksomheden stoppede i 2019, og der dukker ikke noget nyt frem om ham efter det – hverken nye CVR-registreringer, sociale profiler, nyheder eller erhvervsaktivitet knyttet til taxa/Nimbusparken/Frederiksberg-tilknytningen. Mulige forklaringer:Han er gået på pension (han var aktiv i branchen i mange år).
Han lever et privat liv uden synlig offentlig profil.
Der findes flere Jørgen Olsen i Greve-området (f.eks. en med VVS/entreprenør-virksomhed på Frydenhøj Alle), men det matcher ikke den tidligere taxa-vognmand fra Glentevej.

Hvis du kender hans fødselsdato, fulde navn eller andet, kan det hjælpe med en mere præcis søgning. Ellers er det mest sandsynlige, at han nyder pensionisttilværelsen i stilhed.
