body.title: Everyone Gets Targeted. Not Everyone Has To Fall For It.
body.body:
Imagine your phone buzzes on a random Tuesday morning and it's a message from what looks like your bank. The message states there's been some suspicious activity on your account  and you need to verify your details immediately else, your account will be frozen. Your heart jumps and you immediately click the link provided. And just like that, someone somewhere has all your important information. 


![1001430911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23tRtaACJJeRqc96kmKyvbLEcnQQ8TNkJzhBtn6BT2qpew6k747QHqGD5SZcsEHG6W68q.jpg)


This isn't a hypothetical horror story, but something that has happened and is still happening to many people every single day. Irrespective of whether a person is smart, educated or very careful, that slight moment of panic or emotional connection is what scammers count on. 



> **What Do Scams Look Like?**


The internet currently is not the same as it was a decade ago. 
Back then, many people could spot a scam from a mile away because there were usually obvious red flags. Those scammers still exist today, but they've just graduated to better approaches. 


Today's scammers can use artificial intelligence to create flawless emails, clone voices using audio deep fakes  to impersonate people, build fake websites and some even go as far as infiltrating your social media. Scamming to some people is a full time job. 


___

***Almost everyone has been targeted but not everyone falls  for it.*** 
___





Recently, I came across a video on one of my social media platforms where a user was warning the masses about a new pattern scammers use to  basically hack a person's device and gain access to important information. The person mentioned that these people use strange numbers to send a video or an image to you. Naturally, you'd want to download to see what the image contains and once you've downloaded this image, your device is hijacked.  The people who fall victims to these are those whose apps are set to automatically download images or those quick to download images. 



Just like clockwork, about three strange numbers texted me just last week and all of them had either a video or picture for me to download without even a formal introduction of themselves.  After doing my necessary research to ensure these weren't acquaintances, I blocked these numbers. But the question is, what if I didn't see the warning earlier? Or what if I just wanted to see the content of the video? 


___

If you ask me which scam type is the most dangerous today, I'd say two are battling for the top spot:

**AI-Powered Phishing**

These are emails, texts and messages that are personalised using data gotten from your social media or public records. Things like your full government name, your bank and sometimes your home location.  These scammers can capitalise on this information and gain access to more intricate details which can  be used to extort money from you directly or indirectly. 



**Romance Scams**

These ones destroy people financially and emotionally. Here, a scammer creates a fake persona, builds a genuine relationship with you over weeks or months, earns your trust  and then either requests money for one important gig or something else. Some scammers start small and then increase their requests while others “hit it big” the first time.  Then one day, the persona vanishes alongside all the money you \

them.

The damage from scams is not just financial. People lose their sense of reality or their trust in human connection. They can easily slip into depression or even worse. 


> **How Can One Actually Stay Safe?**

General advice like \
is useless most times. However, certain other precautions can be taken. \n\nFirst, urgency is a red flag not a call to action. Once a message says \

, I  slow down and actually reassess the entire situation. If need be, I reach out to people and also do intensive research. 

I also verify through separate channels. If I get a message from my bank, I don't click the link  instead, I check my bank app  and proceed from there. 


Another thing that saves a lot of people is the two factor authentication (2FA). It takes nothing to turn on this setting in many applications we use regularly or preferably use authentication apps. 


One other thing that saves people from being targeted by scammers is the things they post on their social media.  People should be extremely courteous of what they share publicly because these little details can just be the only thing these scammers need. 


![1001430912.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wongi/23ywgX64pcG3JyXm8rWcssB3zTCMdxmjKFmLJsZPHt1EBxewC9aCW47yLT3yLYhTwZo85.png)

The truth is, scams work partly because people are embarrassed to admit they almost fell for one or they indeed fell for one. Talking about it with family, friends and even finding a way to sensitize the masses goes a long way. Online scammers are consistently improving their means of exploitation and it's our sole duty not to be caught off guard. 

So, next time your phone buzzes with a message that feels off, trust your gut feeling.

body.title: Spare the Rod or Spare the Child?
body.body: I heard my dad’s voice bellowing out my name and that of my other siblings. With the tune of that Voice, I knew that something was definitely wrong. With trembling feet, I walked towards the center of the flat were we lived. ![IMG_5462.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNcfokRFnadq9FY7eB65h5615H1XtPGGh9Et9VA4piKgV/IMG_5462.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/parenting-discipline-silhouette-9528352/) I stood facing my dad while awaiting for my tot her siblings to join the judgement queue as it obviously looked like. I didn’t know what we had done but this was the first of its kind. Well, my dad was the disciplinarian of the family and my mum was the easy going one. So she passes the discipline aspect of the family to dad. And on this occasion, it’s obvious that she has senses a foul okay and had called dad’s attention to it. Who tampered with the meats in the stew pot? Dad asked. Well, it was a Sunday and mum had cooked delicious rice and stew with chicken. We had been well fed but you how it is that as kids, you are always tempted to get an extra chicken bite. That day I had breezed past the stew pot, opened it and touched one or two chicken hoping to get a little skin here and there but I knew it must be noticed, so I had to close the pot and moved on with little success. So when the question came, my heart jumped into my mouth but I know I didn’t do much damage that would warrant a court session. Who tampered with the meat? Dad asked again. Just when I stood there wondering what could have transpired after I left, my kid sister owned up to the fact that she had tampered with the meat to my relieve. Well, she had actually visited the pot in her child like adventure and skinned the chickens. Hahaha, she so much skinned them that they were looking pathetic 😂. The result was that dad got a long cane, put her on the bed and gave her some lashes of the cane that at the end, the cane shapes were showing on her buttocks. It was such a painful experience that she couldn’t sit down with her buttocks for days and I couldn’t help but sympathize with her. Well, the essence of this story is that that disciplinary action carried out by my dad stuck with me and definitely all my siblings for a long time. ![IMG_5463.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdhD6Nia7bjA7ok2oJyBW3mF2vk6Jrp1LvwvPfuo1UYdx/IMG_5463.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/cry-harm-accident-pain-suffering-2764843/) There was never ever any case of meat pilfering or stealing recorded in the family again. My dad didn’t spare the rod to spoil the child. We were brought up very strictly and you get physically disciplined when you misbehave especially after some warnings. That physical discipline goes along way to instill some measures of discipline in children and most parents today do not discipline their children and we have seen more moral decadence in our time more than ever. There are some children that may never learn no matter how much you talk. Corporal punishment and physical disciplining of a child should come into play when needed as would warrant some occasions but I am of the opinion that it should be watched. There should be a balance to how physical discipline can be applied to a child to avoid abuse, physical wounds and emotions abuse or psychological damage to the child. But we cannot say that because we want to avoid the above mentioned, hence a child shouldn’t be disciplined physically when it’s required. It’s also should be to the discretion of the parents to know when to get physical with the child when it comes to discipline. If a child would turn out well, it’s good to not spare the rod and spoil the child.

body.title: HOW TO OVERCOME PEER PRESSURE BIBLICALLY?
body.body:
https://youtu.be/2ZwCg2PWJP0?si=bIUP1Xpu6Ql0fcpL

I've been hearing about peer pressure. What is truly peer pressure and how it affects us?

We always want to be around people, have people around us, want to connect, want to stay. Seeing it alone can feel so overwhelming and hard. This can cause depression. But we are not also going to be fulfilled in our life when we don't keep people around us. And also, even though we love to keep people around us, we have to be mindful of the kind of people who keep around us.

Let us be informed about people who keep around us. So, what we mean is that we ourselves, we are at the same time, might turn out to be the kind of people we spend time with.

We need people in our lives. But the most important thing here is we need God the most to guide us. We need the Spirit of God to guide us. We must not allow bad company to take over us. We should run after God more than going after people.

 God and His Word will make us a better person and it will lead us to fulfillment.

body.title: Return of the Blue Calamintha Bee (Osmia calaminthae)
body.body:
Thought to be extinct 

The Blue Bee has made a return. 

Why are so many Extinct Species returning to the Earth ? 

What is making this happen ? 

https://youtube.com/shorts/6WEHp4MdTUk?si=_HHAqtPRW9i1XINR

>The Blue Calamintha Bee (Osmia calaminthae) is a critically imperiled species endemic to the sandy pine scrub habitats of central Florida. Measuring only about 1 cm long with a striking metallic indigo coloring, it is highly dependent on the threatened Ashe's calamint plant for pollen.

Rediscovery: 

>Described in 2011, the bee went unseen for several years before being miraculously rediscovered by researchers in 2020, sparking renewed hope for its preservation. 
 
Unique Behaviors & Ecology

Head-Bobbing: The bee is known for a unique pollen-gathering behavior where it bobs its head back and forth against the calamint flower. This transfers pollen directly onto the dense, specialized facial hairs on its head.

Solitary Nature: Unlike honeybees, they do not live in hives. Female bees build individual nests to lay their eggs.

Source: https://www.smithsonianmag.com/science-nature/blue-bee-feared-be-extinct-found-florida-180974957/

body.title: The Yellow Castle at the End of the Trail – Seußlitz
body.body:
![IMG_1118.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Eq7LuTmgWWw4b71mfQuJ2GCe7j8mGmtBPH7FqYL9AZGdSKucdombHkvPEGVa2UyPnxD.jpeg)
Some places do not announce themselves. They simply appear, as if the landscape only decided at the very last moment to reveal them. Seußlitz Castle is one of those places.

After hours along the Saxon Wine Trail, winding quietly through hills, small villages, and bare vineyards, it suddenly stands before you—larger, broader, almost unexpectedly monumental. The park opens wider than anticipated, and the estate itself feels less constructed than gently placed into the landscape.
![IMG_1119.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Epzxf3R5orZ22FV4axgSyFzWk2EWsEwF7oZmohfahNcPYoDUHLrHURrm1ayJpsZdeYB.jpeg)
The warm yellow façade still glows, even where plaster has begun to peel away. Above it, the red-tiled roof, the rich ornamental sculptures, the playful details—all speak of a time when representation still aspired to permanence. And strangely, the traces of decay diminish none of its dignity. Quite the opposite: history here is visible, not concealed.
![IMG_1122.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/23zGaHVCJkqegU4zgu5sDMEzmpRTW3iqNAKYRv2XPZXhoumdiNnn5p47ijqvB2yLNia7X.jpeg)
The people of Seußlitz seem to have arranged their lives around this place, as if the castle were less a landmark than the quiet center of local existence. Perhaps because this is also where the Saxon Wine Trail comes to an end—a route truly worth walking for its scenery alone. Especially in spring, when the air still carries a chill and the hills feel slightly unfinished. Curiously though, opportunities to actually drink wine along the way are rather scarce. The trail’s name promises more hospitality than the season can deliver.
![IMG_1120.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EqBbBVn6RvMPwFzjEWWntbkMKxs92beyPUoCf1cMR5BQ9E4jRwq34y8Dp8CVBKowgDb.jpeg)
And perhaps that is perfectly fine. Because the true reward waits at the end anyway.

After Lauterbach, where a castle slowly began to speak again, Seußlitz feels like an old storyteller whose voice may have grown fragile, yet still fills the room. A final, unexpected highlight at the end of a road that lingers precisely because of such moments.
![IMG_1121.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/23vsSgwjqzmQ18U4tnwzvWG3bq6q9rwUgMdEXVcmhBk9UpYZb6KQXzsbK8wAJDR86jJCF.jpeg)


- - -
# Das gelbe Schloss am Ende des Weges – Seußlitz
![IMG_1118.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Eq7LuTmgWWw4b71mfQuJ2GCe7j8mGmtBPH7FqYL9AZGdSKucdombHkvPEGVa2UyPnxD.jpeg)
Manche Orte kündigen sich nicht an. Sie tauchen einfach auf, als hätte die Landschaft sie erst im letzten Moment freigegeben. Schloss Seußlitz ist so ein Ort.

Nach Stunden auf dem sächsischen Weinwanderweg, der sich still durch Hügel, kleine Dörfer und kahle Reben zieht, steht es plötzlich da – größer, ausladender, beinahe überraschend monumental. Der Park öffnet sich weiter als erwartet, und das Schloss selbst wirkt wie ein Bauwerk, das weniger errichtet als in die Landschaft hineingelegt wurde.
![IMG_1119.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Epzxf3R5orZ22FV4axgSyFzWk2EWsEwF7oZmohfahNcPYoDUHLrHURrm1ayJpsZdeYB.jpeg)
Das freundliche Gelb der Fassade leuchtet selbst dort noch, wo der Putz bereits bröckelt. Das ziegelrote Dach darüber, der reiche Figurenschmuck, die verspielten Details – all das erzählt von einer Zeit, in der Repräsentation noch etwas Dauerhaftes sein wollte. Und gerade die kleinen Spuren des Verfalls nehmen dem Anwesen nichts von seiner Würde. Im Gegenteil: Geschichte wird hier sichtbar, nicht versteckt.
![IMG_1122.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/23zGaHVCJkqegU4zgu5sDMEzmpRTW3iqNAKYRv2XPZXhoumdiNnn5p47ijqvB2yLNia7X.jpeg)
Die Menschen in Seußlitz scheinen ihr Leben um diesen Ort herum organisiert zu haben, als wäre das Schloss weniger Sehenswürdigkeit als Mittelpunkt einer stillen Ordnung. Vielleicht liegt das daran, dass hier auch der sächsische Weinwanderweg endet – ein Weg, der landschaftlich unbedingt zu empfehlen ist. Besonders im Frühjahr, wenn die Luft noch kühl ist und die Hügel etwas Unfertiges haben. Nur Wein zu trinken findet man unterwegs erstaunlich selten. Der Name des Weges verspricht mehr Einkehr, als die Jahreszeit halten kann.
![IMG_1120.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/EqBbBVn6RvMPwFzjEWWntbkMKxs92beyPUoCf1cMR5BQ9E4jRwq34y8Dp8CVBKowgDb.jpeg)
Und vielleicht ist das gar nicht schlimm. Denn das eigentliche Ziel wartet ohnehin am Ende.

Nach Lauterbach, wo ein Schloss langsam wieder zu sprechen begann, wirkt Seußlitz wie ein alter Erzähler, dessen Stimme zwar brüchig geworden ist, aber noch immer den ganzen Raum füllt. Ein letztes, unerwartetes Highlight am Ende eines Weges, der genau deshalb in Erinnerung bleibt.

body.title: Creating my First AI Image Generation LoRA
body.body:
The past few days I was spending time with AI, learning a few things, and playing with it. One of the things I tried is making my own image generation LoRA!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZBmTGVJBZcaL4vY4STyqZqq4PRr9bBu69Y5HvF2kqR29/ImageGen%20Training%20Subaru%202026-05-20%2014-14IMG.png 



Natsuki Subaru LoRA is an adapter for Anima Preview 3 to generate Subaru from Re:Zero more accurately. [**You can download it here!**](https://civitai.red/models/2636151/natsuki-subaru-anima)

> [LoRA (short for Low Rank Adaptation)](https://www.docker.com/blog/lora-explained/) is a technique that trains AI models on new data while keeping what the model already knows. LoRAs must be added to the model on inference time to activate, and in image generation, LoRAs are great tools to teach the base model new characters, styles or concepts.

I trained this LoRA using this [Google Collab](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1wEaWbfkKbawdjfgpBVojaTKg5WYYXVa-#scrollTo=420e1df3) by the CivitAI's user [CitronLegacy.](https://github.com/citronlegacy/citron-colab-anima-lora-trainer) I used the default settings, changing the number of Epochs to 8 and the number of repeats to 4. The whole run took about 4 hours.

The dataset 27 images focusing on Natsuki Subaru taken from anime screenshots and official art I took from ReZero's Wiki.

### Observations

The result is better than I expected but worse than I hoped. This LoRA makes generating Subaru's eyes closer to the anime and way more consistent. Without a LoRA, Subaru's eyes look more generic, so I'm happy I got at least one thing right.

Even with this LoRA, the model has tendency to give him feminine features. I get better results when I specify the 1boy tag...

Creating this takes all of Google Colab's Free plan's usage. If I'm gonna create a better LoRA, I must master the dataset tagging, and even then, there's a limit of achievable quality using the free tools. I guess paying money is unavoidable if I want to make something worth using.


### Dataset
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaznwkJXRRQgfvxWm6Jk3hyxUgfdV92eNhjaaZCL2vEDn/image.png 


Disclaimer: I didn't own any of the images I used to create the LoRA, so I won't be sharing the dataset, but here's an some examples of the dataset tags I used:

```
subaru_rz, natsuki subaru, 1boy, solo, male focus, anime, full body, front view, flexing pose, right arm raised, fist clenched, left hand on hip, smiling expression, looking at viewer, pose anchor: flexing front with bag

tracksuit, hoodie, white and black zip-up jacket, orange trim, N logo on chest, black pants, anime clothing, casual wear, full outfit, fabric folds, visible zipper

outdoor terrace background, stone tiles, low wall, green foliage, distant town with red roofs, hillside houses, blue sky, white clouds, daytime, outdoor, scenic view, depth of field

anime style, clean lines, cel shaded, soft shading, full body shot, character focus, expressive face, cinematic lighting, pose anchor: flexing front with bag, angle: front view
```

### What do you think?

I don't know if I'll be making LoRAs for other characters or a better version of this one, but I wanted to share this one and my process doing this. Hope you enjoyed reading this as much as I enjoyed going through this journey.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ahmadmanga/creating-my-first-ai-image-generation-lora-2vz)

body.title: Brachymeria podagrica
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Brachymeria podagrica*** | May 19, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6g9btfPRwNtK2Ewk6VRdFBw2pWPeCWvuge7tawvRbhJ/mix_20260525_211858.jpg)


I saw this insect sitting on a green leaf. They usually move around alone and are in search of prey.

​Name and identification:
After taking the picture, I searched i-Naturalist and Google to find out its scientific name ***Brachymeria podagrica***. It is basically a **parasitic wasp** or wasp of the '**Chalcididae**' family. If you look at the picture, you will see that its hind legs are quite swollen and reddish-brown in color, which is like a teardrop. Even though the whole body is black, they are very easily recognized because of these legs.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTpXSaAisvoRFmCsCDy4Di9ZwpaLrdKiqnCCwcse7X6sf/mix_20260525_211819.jpg)

​Size:
They are smaller than a grain of wheat! They are only 5 to 7 millimeters (mm) long. Due to their small size, taking a perfect picture of them is quite challenging.

​Habitat and habitat:
They do not build a hive in groups like bees or common wasps. They are mainly solitary and are usually seen where there is a high infestation of harmful flies or insects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVTjaQXFbJa9VQ92xXYH8ANYbhbLXueA2b87Jtb8G8N4L/mix_20260525_211729.jpg)

​Food and Prey:
Their main target or prey is various harmful flies (filth flies) and the larvae or pupae of other insects.

​Reproduction:
Their reproduction process is quite strange. The female insects lay their eggs inside the pupae (shells) of harmful flies or other insects. After the eggs hatch, the larvae grow inside by eating that fly and come out as full-fledged insects.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNs7YWShakVyDfNEtLkU5taxfSqjasx9MBuFfvc3Euq4/mix_20260525_211550.jpg)

​Benefits:
By destroying the larvae of harmful flies and other insects, they naturally maintain the balance of the environment (biological control). They are a very beneficial friend of farmers and nature.

​Harmfulness:
When we hear the name wasp or wasp, the fear of being stung comes to our mind. But the interesting thing is, they do not cause any harm to humans or domestic animals. They do not have any stings or teeth to bite. So it can be said that they are not malicious.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY7hhEcsVKxPZmCenEhiKxhuqLT61LMzouiTiVPuDRjub/mix_20260525_211633.jpg)

​It was quite challenging to capture the details of such a small insect on camera, but I tried to highlight its true beauty. Do let me know in the comments how you liked the pictures of this useful friend, smaller than a grain of wheat.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

I came to know from many people around that one of our elder brother works online and earns money from there. When I was sure about this from others, I took my elder brother's number. After taking his number, I contacted him. At one point, he disappointed me but after special request, he created an opportunity for me to do that work. And then he informed me about the hive platform. I spent a total of $ 17 to create an account. Because the first payment I made failed and I made a second payment and created my account. After creating the account, a completely new interface appeared in front of me. At that time, I had only heard the name Blockchain and I had no idea about it. I was very curious because I could now make an income online. So I started working with focus. I used to write regular posts on the hive platform every day. Along with this, I used to comment on other people's posts with great pleasure. However, the comments there gave me a lot of trouble. After about three months of commenting, an account called bancontent started messaging me constantly under the post. body.title: GTA 6 could spark a massive expansion - Take-Two has 29 planned games [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vi425RdHerCGK8VTMDkuLtWbD9E3PtY4e4KWBkVPjrN3zsLd7CEZNzkH6TWCT94iWSH.png)


---

The launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI* is poised to become not only the biggest release in video game history but also the driving force that could completely transform the future of Take-Two Interactive.

The company—which owns Rockstar Games—is already preparing an extremely ambitious strategy for the coming years; all signs indicate that the massive commercial success of *GTA 6* could serve as the catalyst for acquiring new studios and expanding even further within the industry.

During the most recent investor call, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick made it clear that the company is currently navigating one of the most pivotal moments in its history.

---



![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/243M7c1eAvxhVv8ddDNASNC9H8N23DNU2nFHTqJBr5JEjV8vmNhpgqCST6M8a9AnA9aQn.png)

---


Currently, the company holds some of the most successful franchises on the market, including *Grand Theft Auto V*, *Red Dead Redemption 2*, and the *NBA 2K* series. *GTA V*, for instance, has already surpassed 230 million copies sold since its original launch in 2013—a figure that is virtually impossible for most modern games to match.

With *GTA 6* scheduled to debut on November 19, 2026, Take-Two expects to achieve record-breaking revenue during the upcoming fiscal year. The company's internal projections point to earnings of between $8 billion and $8.2 billion, driven primarily by the launch of Rockstar's new title. ---



![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xVD4xa6NQQsaNfo2fbQpU4VkFAxmbXaQnUyGtvjeGwVXPgBE57yMtPN9ZA18s1cwwPq.png)



---


Analysts and investors believe the game could break multiple sales records and quickly become one of the most profitable entertainment products ever created.

However, the real interest lies in what Take-Two will do after receiving such a massive influx of cash. As Zelnick explained, the company has three main objectives for utilizing these revenues. The first will be to continue funding the development of new video games and keeping its most important franchises active.


The second will consist of returning a portion of the capital to shareholders. But the third point was the one that garnered the most attention: Take-Two is considering making new acquisitions of studios and creative companies to continue growing within the industry.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wMeXQy1T3swVuj9akViPvFA8tfBm8Qd1pqhnHfhutMawYnMhgi7zmWF67UTRieoZtN4.png)



---

Although the executive clarified that they do not plan to buy companies \

he did acknowledge that the success of GTA 6 could open the door to further expansion in the future. Take-Two has already made significant acquisitions in previous years, including the purchase of Zynga and Gearbox Software—the studio responsible for highly popular franchises such as *Borderlands*. The intention now is to find studios with creative talent capable of contributing fresh ideas and successful franchises. At the same time, the company is already working on one of the most ambitious release schedules in its history. Take-Two plans to publish 29 video games before March 2029—a massive figure, even for a company of its size. That catalog features sequels, remakes, remasters, sports titles, and entirely original new intellectual properties. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xep6zFgoXohABWEnB9V41vf79fzuKNiTSBA11pTKWfi1uonb5he2YdwWzFMJcbRzjiR.png) --- Among the most notable projects is *Judas*, the new game directed by Ken Levine, creator of *BioShock*. *Project ETHOS* also makes an appearance, alongside future sports installments such as *NBA 2K27*, *WWE 2K27*, and *PGA Tour 2K27*. The company also confirmed that it is working on new mobile games and several sequels to established franchises. That said, Take-Two cautioned that some projects could see their release dates shift—or even be canceled—depending on their development progress. Nevertheless, the message to investors was clear: the company believes it stands on the threshold of a new era of massive growth, and *GTA 6* will be the centerpiece of that expansion.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23vi425RdHerCGK8VTMDkuLtWbD9E3PtY4e4KWBkVPjrN3zsLd7CEZNzkH6TWCT94iWSH.png) --- El lanzamiento de Grand Theft Auto VI no solo apunta a convertirse en el mayor estreno de la historia de los videojuegos, sino también en el motor que podría transformar por completo el futuro de Take-Two Interactive. La compañía propietaria de Rockstar Games ya prepara una estrategia extremadamente ambiciosa para los próximos años, y todo indica que el enorme éxito comercial de GTA 6 podría servir como impulso para adquirir nuevos estudios y expandirse todavía más dentro de la industria. Durante la más reciente reunión con inversores, el CEO de Take-Two, Strauss Zelnick, dejó claro que la empresa atraviesa uno de los momentos más importantes de su historia. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/243M7c1eAvxhVv8ddDNASNC9H8N23DNU2nFHTqJBr5JEjV8vmNhpgqCST6M8a9AnA9aQn.png) --- Actualmente, la compañía posee algunas de las franquicias más exitosas del mercado, incluyendo Grand Theft Auto V, Red Dead Redemption 2 y la saga NBA 2K. GTA V, por ejemplo, ya supera los 230 millones de copias vendidas desde su lanzamiento original en 2013, una cifra prácticamente imposible de igualar para la mayoría de los juegos modernos. Con GTA 6 programado para estrenarse el 19 de noviembre de 2026, Take-Two espera alcanzar ingresos récord durante el próximo año fiscal. Las previsiones internas de la empresa apuntan a beneficios de entre 8.000 y 8.200 millones de dólares, impulsados principalmente por el lanzamiento del nuevo título de Rockstar. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xVD4xa6NQQsaNfo2fbQpU4VkFAxmbXaQnUyGtvjeGwVXPgBE57yMtPN9ZA18s1cwwPq.png) --- Analistas e inversores consideran que el juego podría romper múltiples récords de ventas y convertirse rápidamente en uno de los productos de entretenimiento más rentables jamás creados. Sin embargo, el verdadero interés está en lo que Take-Two hará después de recibir semejante flujo de dinero. Según explicó Zelnick, la compañía tiene tres objetivos principales para utilizar esos ingresos. El primero será continuar financiando el desarrollo de nuevos videojuegos y mantener activas sus franquicias más importantes. El segundo consistirá en devolver parte del capital a los accionistas. Pero el tercer punto fue el que más llamó la atención: Take-Two contempla realizar nuevas adquisiciones de estudios y compañías creativas para seguir creciendo dentro de la industria. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23wMeXQy1T3swVuj9akViPvFA8tfBm8Qd1pqhnHfhutMawYnMhgi7zmWF67UTRieoZtN4.png) --- Aunque el directivo aclaró que no planean comprar empresas “a lo loco”, sí reconoció que el éxito de GTA 6 podría abrir la puerta a más expansión en el futuro. Take-Two ya realizó adquisiciones importantes en años anteriores, incluyendo la compra de Zynga y Gearbox Software, responsables de franquicias muy populares como Borderlands. La intención ahora sería encontrar estudios con talento creativo capaces de aportar nuevas ideas y sagas exitosas. Al mismo tiempo, la compañía ya trabaja en uno de los calendarios de lanzamientos más ambiciosos de su historia. Take-Two planea publicar 29 videojuegos antes de marzo de 2029, una cifra enorme incluso para una empresa de su tamaño. Dentro de ese catálogo aparecen secuelas, remakes, remasters, títulos deportivos y nuevas propiedades intelectuales completamente originales. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xep6zFgoXohABWEnB9V41vf79fzuKNiTSBA11pTKWfi1uonb5he2YdwWzFMJcbRzjiR.png) --- Entre los proyectos más destacados se encuentra Judas, el nuevo juego dirigido por Ken Levine, creador de BioShock. También aparece Project ETHOS, además de futuras entregas deportivas como NBA 2K27, WWE 2K27 y PGA Tour 2K27. La empresa también confirmó que trabaja en nuevos juegos móviles y en varias secuelas de franquicias ya conocidas. Eso sí, Take-Two advirtió que algunos proyectos podrían cambiar de fecha o incluso cancelarse dependiendo del progreso del desarrollo. Aun así, el mensaje para los inversores fue claro: la compañía cree que se encuentra a las puertas de una nueva etapa de crecimiento masivo, y GTA 6 será la pieza central de esa expansión.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

红烧肉是一道让我欲罢不能的美味。那块嫩滑的五花肉在低温慢炖的过程中，充分吸收了酱油、糖和八角的香气，肉质软糯、肥而不腻，每一口都充满了浓郁的味道。尤其是当它与米饭搭配时，醇厚的汁液渗透进每一粒米饭中，简单却让人无比满足。对于我来说，红烧肉不仅是一道菜，更是温暖的记忆，仿佛可以唤起许多家的味道。

body.title: Should Parents Still Spank Their Children Today?
body.body:
Good day Everyone happy Ramadan Kareem I be writing on this week prompt: Physical discipline is something that has caused arguments for many years because different people have different experiences when it comes to how they were raised. 

![1000444679.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mathewdaddywah/23yJfjFaGSuHWb4gYxzhf8gcwvq3KyuTf7inqg9RhWVwZKPgoAAqJC7nKy1fwBc6FNQU4.jpg)

Images Generated with Meta AI

Some people believe spanking and corporal punishment helped them become respectful and disciplined adults, while others believe it only created fear and trauma inside them.

Honestly, this topic is not something with only one correct answer because every child is different and every parent also handles situations differently.

Growing up in African homes especially, physical discipline was very common. Many parents believed that the only way a child could listen was through beating or punishment. In fact, some children feared their parents more than they respected them. 

Back then, if a child misbehaved outside, another adult could even punish that child before the parents arrived. Society believed discipline was necessary because children were expected to obey instructions without questioning anything.

When I look at children today, I honestly feel the world has changed a lot. Many parents no longer want to touch their children because they fear becoming too harsh or traumatizing them. Some parents now prefer gentle parenting where they explain things calmly instead of using force. While that sounds good, I also think some parents have misunderstood it completely. 

Discipline is still important because if children grow up without correction, they may become disrespectful, stubborn, and uncontrollable.This much is true 
At the same time, I do not believe excessive beating is the answer either. 

There is a huge difference between correcting a child and pouring anger on them. Some parents beat children out of frustration instead of teaching them what they did wrong. That kind of punishment can damage a child mentally and emotionally.

A child who is constantly beaten may become fearful, aggressive, or even distant from their parents. Some children carry those painful memories into adulthood.
I think one of the biggest problems today is balance. 

Some parents are too harsh while others are too soft. Children need discipline but they also need understanding. Sometimes talking to a child, removing privileges, or making them understand consequences can work better than physical punishment. Not every mistake deserves beating. 

There are children who become better through communication while there are others who only take correction seriously when punishment is involved.

Another thing people forget is that children today are growing up in a completely different generation. Social media, technology, peer pressure, and the internet influence them heavily.

Parents now face challenges that older generations never experienced. Because of this, discipline today requires more wisdom, patience, and communication than before.

Personally, I do not think humanity has completely lost out because parents reduced corporal punishment, but I do think some homes have lost proper discipline. Respect and responsibility should still be taught strongly to children. 

However, I also believe parents should avoid turning discipline into abuse because traumatized children often grow into damaged adults.

In the end, I believe the best parenting comes from balance. A child should understand love, correction, respect, and consequences at the same time. Discipline should build a child, not destroy their confidence or mental health and also it puts them in the right tracks.

Thanks for taking your time to read my post hope to see you again @mathewdaddywah blog

body.title: A Short Visit At The Optical Shop  With Mother : Got Our Eyeglass Update Together
body.body: Hello 👋 @aseanhive🤗 How are you? I hope you're doing alright..\nI wanted to share to you all today my product activity together with my mom. I'm happy that were both successful in changing our eyeglasses lenses.\n
>\nTogether with mama, were heading to EO optical shop to update our eyeglasses and at the same time change its lenses..\n
>\nSo while I'm inside can't helped but to look at the beautiful and affordable eyewears. Theyre on sale and offered discounts to customers.\n
> I was the one being examined by the optometrist. She asked me to sit down and let my eyes be placed on the machine. While the optometrist trying to perfectly fit what was my vision.

> The optometrist was able to changed my lenses and let me read the Snellen charts with letters sized from smaller to biggest. And oh yeah, my vision really changed it went higher this time compared to the previous.. Mine is 50 now..so that's why sometimes I felt blurry when reading some small texts.

> So after examining my both eyes, I was given the recommendations on what will be the eyewear fitted to me..But I decided to use my old frames I just wanted it that lenses will be changed and updated. So the optometrist agreed on me.. Everything's changed except for my frames..
> And so after 15 minutes of waiting, finally my eyewear is now ready to be released..So I tested it infront of the mirror, walked to and fro, and there you go.. I'm happy I comfortable wearing it..
> And so it's my mother's turned to see also the optometrist and have her both eyes checked..

> Mother also happy that after 2 years we both visited EO optical shop. She's grateful that I brought her and have her lenses changed too. Mother's eye need to be checked by Opthalmologist. Her eyeglasses already reached to a higher grade which is 300+ so that's why she must visit the eye clinic as soon as possible.
> And so finally when she's done with her eye checked she then trying to fit her glasses and choose a case.
> She's happier now that she clearly see things from afar.. I also bought some lens cleaner to keep Eyeglass lens last long and free from dirt or any scratches.
> And afterwards we went hope happy and full of gratitude carrying the bags with our new glasses inside.

>
Indeed it's a productive day to both of us mother and daughter experienced this get together in an optical shop 😍☺️


This would be all for now and see in my next blog journey 👋☺️Bye..

body.title: Invisible inheritances [EN/PT]
body.body: > We are becoming increasingly aware of the harmful effects of our behaviors. Society has not evolved only in the technological aspect, but also in the understanding of life through psychological and emotional perspectives. The way we raise children is something that has been improving over time and, although we now have more knowledge about better ways to guide them, we still make mistakes, but perhaps not as many as our parents made with us. Or do we? I remember one time when I had a test to take and, for some reason, I simply did not want to study. My mother was very strict when it came to anything related to school, and I remember that when I refused to study, she would hit me. Well, I always got excellent grades in school, but behind that high performance, scars remained. Was my mother a bad person or did she simply want the best for me while using the wrong methods? I know that my grandparents used to hit my mother, and perhaps I did not even suffer one tenth of what she suffered from her parents. And me, well, I never hit my son. Could this lack of harsh correction be what is making today’s society the way it is? I hope so, because we are a better society than previous generations when it comes to raising children. Violence will never be the solution to anything unless your intention is to leave painful consequences in your child’s future. I do not want to say that previous generations were bad people. They simply did not have the necessary knowledge to raise children in the right way. Of course, that does not mean we are exemplary parents or that children today are being raised in the best possible way without mistakes. No, not at all. But we can clearly see that there is now more awareness and concern about the impact parents’ actions have in the eyes of their children, and that our behavior as parents directly reflects on the next generation. Looking at the generations before mine, at the way my great-grandfather raised my grandfather, who consequently raised my mother, this more physical form of punishment gradually lost strength. My mother would hit me on “necessary” occasions, but I remember that most of the time the punishment came in the form of taking away something I liked. A method that was perhaps more innovative for that time, and one that still makes sense to me in certain situations when it becomes necessary to educate my son in some way. Maybe when it is his turn, other methods will be even better, but here I have tried to spread the method of dialogue, teaching, and balanced responsibility. I believe that today we already have enough knowledge to guide the education of our children in a better way, but that things can still improve in the future. I think every generation will have more references and more understanding to apply to this process. Maybe a few decades from now, today’s children will look at us the same way we look at our parents and grandparents. Maybe they will notice mistakes, exaggerated attitudes, or outdated ways of dealing with certain situations. But I believe the most important thing is precisely this gradual change, this constant attempt to do better than the generation before us. No father or mother is born knowing perfectly how to raise a child, but the fact that today there is more dialogue, more emotional awareness, and less violence already shows that, little by little, we are breaking cycles that once seemed normal within families. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png) Estamos cada vez mais conscientes sobre os malefícios de nossos comportamentos. A sociedade não tem evoluído apenas no aspecto tecnológico, mas também na compreensão da vida em aspectos psicológicos e emocionais. A educação dos filhos é algo que vem melhorando com o decorrer do tempo e, apesar de termos mais conhecimento sobre os melhores direcionamentos, ainda cometemos erros, mas talvez não tanto quanto nossos pais cometiam conosco. Será? Eu me lembro de uma vez em que eu tinha uma prova para fazer e, não sei por qual motivo, eu não queria estudar. Minha mãe era muito rígida com coisas relacionadas aos estudos e me lembro que, quando eu não estudava, ela me batia. Bem, sempre tirei notas excelentes na escola, mas por trás dessa alta performance ficaram sequelas. Será que minha mãe era uma pessoa ruim ou apenas queria o meu melhor usando métodos ruins? Eu sei que meus avós batiam na minha mãe e talvez eu tenha apanhado nem um décimo do que ela apanhou dos pais. E eu, bem, nunca bati no meu filho. Será que essa falta de correção é o que está tornando a sociedade de hoje como ela é? Espero que sim, pois somos uma sociedade melhor do que fomos nas gerações anteriores em relação a educar filhos. Agredir nunca será a solução para nada, a não ser que sua intenção seja deixar consequências ruins no futuro do seu filho. Não quero dizer que as gerações anteriores eram pessoas ruins, elas apenas não tinham o conhecimento necessário para realizar a educação dos filhos da forma certa. Claro, isso não quer dizer que somos pais exemplares e que os filhos deste mundo são criados da melhor maneira possível, sem erros. Não, nada disso. Mas podemos ver que existe uma evolução e uma preocupação maior com os atos dos pais aos olhos dos filhos e que nosso comportamento como pais reflete diretamente na próxima geração. Olhando para as gerações anteriores à minha, para a forma como meu bisavô educava meu avô, que consequentemente educava minha mãe, esse ato punitivo mais físico foi perdendo força. Minha mãe me batia em ocasiões “necessárias”, mas eu me lembro que, na maior parte das vezes, a punição era o castigo, me privando de algo que eu gostava. Um método talvez mais inovador para aquela época, que ainda faz sentido para mim quando é necessário, de alguma forma, educar meu filho. Talvez, na vez dele, outras formas sejam melhores, mas aqui eu tenho propagado o método do diálogo, do ensinamento e da responsabilidade dosada. Acho que hoje temos conhecimento suficiente para direcionar da melhor maneira a educação dos nossos filhos, mas que isso ainda pode melhorar no futuro. Acho que cada geração terá mais referências e mais conhecimento para aplicar isso. Talvez daqui algumas décadas os filhos de hoje olhem para nós da mesma forma que olhamos para nossos pais e avós. Talvez percebam erros, atitudes exageradas ou maneiras ultrapassadas de lidar com certas situações. Mas acredito que o mais importante seja justamente essa mudança gradual, essa tentativa constante de fazer melhor do que a geração anterior. Nenhum pai ou mãe nasce sabendo educar perfeitamente um filho, porém o fato de hoje existir mais diálogo, mais preocupação emocional e menos violência já mostra que, aos poucos, estamos quebrando ciclos que antes pareciam normais dentro das famílias. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png)

body.title: Sun-Drying Bananas to Make Traditional Chips
body.body:
Hello hive👋
Good evening everyone.
Let me introduce myself, my name is Djisamsoe. I'm new to the hive/ecency platform and I'm thrilled to finally join this community full of creativity, ideas, and a spirit of sharing.



***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme5rEWZ5cQSFefVYF3VBQqvEWG6zXgPAQxrMJG4eUy4ax/1779714194036.jpg)


Watching this process reminded me that making banana chips requires patience and meticulousness. The bananas must be selected from good quality, then peeled and sliced to the right size for even frying. Afterward, the banana slices are dried in the sun to reduce their water content and create crispier chips.

***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaeUyiKdU4FsWQfACPkVoGz4nQjZYWsQQBCRXMXtjXXob/1779714290635.jpg)

In our village, this kind of activity is still often done traditionally. While it may seem simple, the task is quite tiring, requiring each banana slice to be neatly arranged. However, the results are truly satisfying when the chips are cooked and ready to be enjoyed with the family or sold to supplement income.

***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPgrtuj77V1wuo5HnV1UiJSM2rMzhYEFdZE5JmTDgwZRz/1779718903740.jpg)





I'm so happy to see my wife's enthusiasm this morning. After I get home from work, the house feels more lively with the activity of drying bananas. Hopefully, the drying process goes smoothly and the banana chips will be savory and delicious.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRLxkEbmEMzGQAEvYnJTHDLSMeA3Qnf8Z3AkzLpFT9Z3U/1779725564491.jpg)



Thank you to everyone who has taken the time to read this post. I'm very open to suggestions and feedback to help me become a better writer on the hive. Nice to meet you, Djisamsoe, and I hope we can support each other 🙏

body.title: The feast of St. Jude's Eve
body.body:
The air outside grew warm from laughter, and the damp feet of the dancers. The cold air didn't just bite; it settled into the bones like a permanent frost. For Caleb, the only cure for a freeze that deep wasn't a coat or a cigarette—it was the traditional feast where hot sausages were served.

Tonight, the market hall was a sanctuary of laughter, steam, and the heavy scent of roasted spices. Caleb and a few of his friends sat on a long wooden bench; they were eager to taste the delicacies set before them. He picked up a red, seasoned grilled sausage known as Hungarian sausage, one of his favorites, which reminded him of his mother's kitchen, and took a bite. For a minute he chewed it with his eyes closed, allowing himself to enjoy the taste.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3px8RtfriCfVwwXVzpchkzMZxUWySWHEYyTfh1vjQJX/1779725470289.jpg)

[Photo source](https://ecency.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tf43zb)


Before him sat steak potatoes—to others it was their usual meal, but to him it was heritage. He started with the sausage, tasting every meal on the black skillet-lined white paper, then proceeded to the blood sausage, steak potatoes, purple cabbage, and finally to the mixed pickle vegetables.

While the cold breeze settled on their skin, the hot steaming meal was the cure. Satisfaction rested on their faces as they munched the meal before them.

body.title: A strange and beautiful guest arrives in the rooftop garden: Amata cyssea (Handmaiden Moth) 🌿🦋
body.body:
> ![IMG20260522123448~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNe7MKN8qfd47xCj3mfqzFUFJeiDRhmCxgbceLQkKCvSH/IMG20260522123448~2.jpg) Good luck to everyone. Hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share with you a wonderful and exciting experience of my rooftop garden. Nature presents us with new wonders every day, and today my rooftop garden was a witness to that wonder. While taking care of the plants in the garden, a strange and beautiful insect suddenly came to my attention. It is basically a type of moth, whose scientific name is Amata cyssea. However, many people also call it Handmaiden Moth or Baghmoth or Bolata-moth in Bengali. The insect was sitting quietly on a young tip of grass. The transparent spots on its beautiful blue-black wings and the bright yellow-orange striped spots on its body will catch anyone's eye at a glance. It is as if nature has decorated it with the perfect brushstrokes of a skilled artist. ![IMG20260522123446~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV3DERqRF7t6ZHWJgGJcMcW17JSCjumKYghtgwywrCdKH/IMG20260522123446~2.jpg) As the moth was swinging on the tip of the grass, I didn't want to miss this opportunity. I tried to take several macro photos of it very carefully with my mobile phone. I was afraid that the slightest movement might make it fly away. But this beautiful creation of nature seemed to pose for me for a while to take pictures. Below I share another close-up shot I took, where its fine hairs on its body are visible. This body structure, which is usually bright in color and looks like a beetle, is called Batesian mimicry in scientific terms. These moths cannot actually bite or sting and are completely harmless. But to escape from nature's predators, they adopt such a form that the predators are afraid to attack them, thinking that they are poisonous beetles. This self-defense technique of nature is truly remarkable. ![IMG20260522123424~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR6NBAs1yLzbQLZXjeQLoFpmtM5f81fzNW3igrtCSk8f5/IMG20260522123424~2.jpg) In the midst of busy urban life, the green plants of the rooftop garden already give peace to the mind. And when I see such a diverse range of small creatures there, the joy of gardening increases many times over. I hope you enjoyed these macro photos I took and this little story of nature. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

body.body:
/></center>

[source](https://static01.nyt.com/athletic/uploads/wp/2026/05/24142621/EPL_2526_Estimated-1.png)





Arsenal secured the Premiership title last week and guarantees them a massive financial windfall that should see them surpass Manchester City's record breaking 2023/24 £715 million or $960 million season. This has been very much a long term project when Artetta joined Arsenal in December 2019 so nearly 7 years in the making.

You would expect winning trophies would equate to big bucks and I honestly expected winning the Premier League to be worth far more than it actually offers when comparing against those coming second or third. 

The Premier League title is going to net the club approximately £198.7 million made up of the base fee of £97 million for every team in the Premier League ,£53 million for winning the title plus the broadcast fees broken down by how many live matches were televised. The table above shows that if you are in the top 4 or 5 contesting for the title is that you receive more live television broadcasts which boosts your merit payments.

The commercial revenue via sponsorships with the main ones being Emirates and Adidas add an additional £290 million per annum and gate matchday revenue another £165 million. The club is also still in the Champions League playing the final against Paris St Germain. Arsenal have already earned £120 million by reaching the final and will earn an additional £4 million if they win this show piece.

The earnings do not include bonuses via sponsors for winning the league and if they win the Champions League. Winning these trophies does trigger bonuses which are not publicly available, but one can presume these are worth tens of millions.

This even though will turn out to be a bumper year for Arsenal may see them still register a loss after having been busy in the last transfer window and having renegotiated players contracts. Players are also in line for bonuses for winning the Premier League at roughly £6K per match and £125K if they win the Champions League.

This is not necessarily about making profit, but more about covering costs like debt repayments and growing the Arsenal brand in monetary value. Back in 2023-24 Forbes valued the club at $3.4 billion and now having won the league after a 22 year drought the value is expected to surpass $4 billion. The increased revenues has boosted the overall club value. This is good news for the owners who purchased the club for around £1.8 billion when 30% shares were bought for £550 million. This is roughly a 70% increase in return of investment over 8 years and why if the club runs at a small loss is not the end of the world. Sounds totally absurd really and why the wages of the players are not really in sync with the rest of football. The players are highly overpaid and clubs having  a wage cap enforced on them will be good for the sport which happens this season. 

Over the Premier League winning season Arsenal secured another 25 additional sponsorship deals which will only become more lucrative if the club can continue winning trophies. Another side effect is the player squad value has also risen with the players now having a Premier League title on their resume.

As Premier League winners and possibly the Champions League the club can charge more for tickets next season as the fan base will be growing globally. Demand for home games will increase and could see revenues rise by an additional 10%. The club can not rest on their laurels and will need to continue to purchase top end players for next season trying to ensure this success is not a once off.

links.title: The Fine Line Between Discipline and Harshness
links.body:
Things around us are changing very fast and we might not even realize this. When I was in school, you say when I were small, I am talking about 20 years ago (yes I am old guy), now think like this, at that time teachers used to beat the children a lot if they did not do their homework or if they were given any kind of punishment. But now things have changed a lot because nowadays if any teacher raises his hands on the children or even scolds them then the parents file a case against the UN and sometimes teachers have to face some consequences also if they show even a little disrespect towards the children. See, sometimes it is necessary to scare the children but sometimes even the teachers cross their line. I feel that it is better if everything is done within limits. Many times we have seen such cases where teachers beat the children so badly that they lost their lives. (Now the opposite happens if teachers beat the student then teachers are in fear xd. )


![then.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23wgDc8qMe5xFQtksCTfFZej3QfMYhFPorpqJQXaE4pt3GVBnaHTD9RdbQYi9YmLUv6s2.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)




See how some times have happened where teachers are very harsh but it is not like that everywhere because sometimes we have to scold children and sometimes it also gets done with love it depends on what kind of child is. If you hit or scold a child then after some time he gets used to it and he understands how to deal with the situation. If I talk about myself then I have been hit very rarely scold or beaten by the teachers sometimes everyone gets beaten but I will not say that much. Look, if I were to speak for myself, I was a average student, not one to lag behind, nor was I particularly intelligent. Many teachers probably didn't even know me, though I could have been in the class for several years, but I never knew if my teachers recognize me (maybe they did ,I am kind of introvert ). 



Now a lot has changed, parents do not want teachers to hit them or scold them but all this has happened because of parents love for their children and the children get used to it like this and they get used to all these things. Many times it happens that when there is pressure on the teacher that he cannot scold the children, you cannot do any kind of thing which would scare or embarrass the child, then there is a lot of pressure on the teacher also. Everyone has a different way of teaching, some people are very aggressive, some people teach with a lot of love and the children understand. 



![now.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23xefjfGiW4pe9tN9JVBvTPWHCN9HzLCRFYRNsbQRfec4nnS5Cr6jAFk98uig3ezhWPns.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)



I will not say at all that beating and scolding children has a bad impact on them (Sometimes it is not even necessary ) or they do not become good because we also had so many children whose parents were very polite and they might not have even scolded the teachers but still they were quite good in studies and in everything else. I will not say that a child learns things only by scolding. They understands only if they are explained with love but some children are like that and everyone is treated accordingly. Sometimes it is necessary to listen to scolding. Not so much that children get scared of it and stop going to school or college.




Because due to all these things the child gets very stressed and he becomes mentally ill and sometimes the stress becomes so much that he is not able to share his thoughts with anyone. You should keep chatting with the children, from time to time you should ask them how things are going in the school, how is which teacher, is no one troubling them and try to chat with your children in a friendly way, if you make them chat as parents then they may not share any things with you, you have to behave with the children from childhood itself that they share all kinds of things with you, no matter what they are, everyone has secrets, you too will have them, I too will have them, but there should be some chatting. 



![thn nwo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23yJLc6UrxBH4vCD75QCXZxZ5FYSxNQqCUStVHnZj4UHpScdfmaqRCgrvmwCVKZZca6s3.png)


[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


It's very important to have a balance. If you can't do that, then you should pay attention to all these things. If children's are ready for the easy way then why treat them the other way. What do you think about the this?

links.title: The sky kept stealing my attention 🌥️
links.body:
Greetings lovely members of the community. I hope you all are doing great and enjoying quality time with your loved ones.

>समुदाय के प्यारे सदस्यों को नमस्कार। मुझे आशा है कि आप सभी अच्छे होंगे और अपने प्रियजनों के साथ गुणवत्तापूर्ण समय का आनंद ले रहे है।




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPrYdgXq9UkWofikbEk6REs1ei9HZSDQwRgeBCpSj2EXv/img_4368.jpg)


It was really cloudy that day while I was out running errands around town. The sky looked heavy with dark clouds, but every now and then the sun would peek through them. The light spreading across the clouds looked so beautiful, almost glowing against the grey sky.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUEPaQz1CTyT1cXmUHDb8WvH4GARtSovdknnE6xNMp3yD/img_4369.jpg)

At first, I noticed it from a distance and clicked a few pictures, but the sun wasn’t really visible then only the dark clouds with a soft glow in the middle of them.

>शुरुआत में मैंने इसे दूर से देखा और कुछ तस्वीरें भी क्लिक कीं, लेकिन उस समय सूरज ज़्यादा दिखाई नहीं दे रहा था बस गहरे बादल थे और उनके बीच हल्की सी चमक दिख रही थी।

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfB4SXipvr6bNwHvR9G7XXFrx95CzaSWoJtezN7nSRhW1/img_4367.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUzs3ypYBeDFjRfo9TVogw1dSvdhnxFZRNyDxd3PbQqTp/img_4366.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWnv7YZ9LZGw9zrd1fWRfWuD1rMb2GJUfYMXUL2FajxsY/img_4365.jpg)

Later, as I walked further ahead, I got a much clearer view of the sun peeking through the clouds, and it looked really cool.

>फिर थोड़ा आगे चलने पर मुझे बादलों के बीच से झांकते सूरज का और अच्छा नज़ारा दिखा, और वह सच में बहुत खूबसूरत लग रहा था।


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdcSvuDgUkhwofGG3y4Bq1UmPZ3cYaXZAUpV6keZ27zvQ/img_4370.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLYYM2EtMfEFQUnyqDwnvdgct7HEMibeNo5A5RzGFLXM/img_4371.jpg)

Finally, when I reached the busy market street, I noticed it again because the sun was visible even more clearly by then. Even with all the hustle and bustle..the people, electric poles, buildings, and banners..my attention kept going back to the beautiful sun in the sky.

>आखिर में जब मैं बाज़ार की भीड़भाड़ वाली सड़क पर पहुँची, तब भी मेरी नज़र उसी पर गई क्योंकि अब सूरज और भी साफ दिखाई दे रहा था। लोगों की भीड़, बिजली के खंभे, इमारतें और बैनरों के बीच भी मेरा ध्यान बस उस खूबसूरत सूरज पर ही जा रहा था।



That's all for today folks. Happy snapping. 💜💙

Thankyou for visiting 🌸


>आज के लिए बस इतना ही दोस्तों। तस्वीरें लेने का आनंद लें। 💜💙 आने के लिए धन्यवाद 🌸



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZVfCZbjEv4MdMfCeF9XX4tGWD4rLzAVGZtSXB7qhyfhq/1751131868454.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZHZA7rzEkMpaePgb8aXi1Zr5Vvn4oE3xtaFNVfYFuoXx/1751132194624.webp)

最近在做夜班，下午两点感觉肚子好饿，米特这个懒虫还想让我出门去打包食物回来给他吃。我说要吃就出门，别总赖床上。 然后他就被我带到了这间 **SĒN Teppan** ，刚好那时是下午两点，还能去吃个“午餐套餐”。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/Ep7v6o4LbwBeSsB4icgbLgEKDvMnP7T89LxRDhPZjxBSKWRRiYaQqEHpZS4m13qje1p.jpeg) **SĒN Teppan** 是位于云顶 Sky Avenue 四楼的一间日式餐厅，隔壁就是泰式餐厅，隔壁的泰式他们都能帮忙点了拿过来这间餐厅吃。我感觉两间店是同个老板开的…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23xVPJEpF3feXek1YXhzQ2RDcEhM248MpGDurxV8RYJ7sqmQ3jtUY6GoktdpgQz8DUba8.jpeg) 原本我们就是为了“午餐套餐”而来，结果两点半来到，你猜店员说了啥？ 店员：Set Lunch Finish 然后有个 auntie 就讲： “your set lunch say from 12 until 3, now only 2.30 you say finish ar?” 怼得那个店员哑口无言，最后也改变不了套餐没了的事实。套餐没了就没了吧~ 我们照样进去普通点餐就好。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EouA6sqAAsvND7DzJHqjtpW8Th4sH1KjR95UpwyTZWqebRk54Ly8Nfbg4p36BZmEzGs.jpeg) ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EogPFJBdu1osopaGeYJEtw5FCRSoi47GxU5re6yA85tiG4zGJ9LWaH9D9JGJ2VypqRU.jpeg) 两点半这时间是用餐高峰期吧？店内坐着蛮多人的。 ## Drinks 饮料 * **Thai Milk Tea** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EopuNSjfr6cpxmNr66ePEQwdd6GMZNZpBiGUFpAhFZsp85ne8P2H5XjfQRs4fJfqpPV.jpeg) 我点的 **泰式奶茶** 齁甜！甜到入心入肺！ * **Coffee** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoGzKa4WaseGctaym3KsdWSabj5LFPbnkdHRmG3QDVo9jtTA1fWqXMBwsBFVdyEv4tX.jpeg) 米特点的 **咖啡** 他们的咖啡也够特别的，放着咖啡包在杯子上，然后倒热水进去咖啡包里面，就变成咖啡了。米特喝了一口就说“好甜”，我怎么看都没看到有糖，我就拿起那杯咖啡喝了一口，TMD 米特骗我，明明苦得要死。 ## Food 食物 我等食物上来的时候发生了一件很无语的事情，就是店员上错餐啦！我点的食物是 Yakiniku Slice - Pork (猪肉片)，结果上的是 Yakiniku Slice - Beef (牛肉片)。 万幸的是食物上桌，我顾着帮食物摆造型拍照，还没开始吃的时候店员就过来让我先别吃，他上错了牛肉的餐。 * **Yakiniku Slice - Beef** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23x1Hui3VdZ5fCh9NQ232F2KKqGprLMir6znHyQSCw3YaAPKK2sn6hZuiTqsaoD8QNGJf.jpeg) ▲ 这是上错的牛肉片 **Yakiniku Slice - Pork** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EowJ4waJsAm5dkQikCvnMy8puVBJCcakmCCQqHTF62EMSkNgXbg8ZLQpXKG7tZFymtS.jpeg) ▲ 这是上对的猪肉片 是不是因为外观看起来很像就直接上错了？幸好还没吃，因为味道一定有区别！ 猪肉片的味道煮得很好吃，饭也特别软，猪肉沾点酱配饭吃，超好吃！ * **Kimchi Slice Teppanyaki - Pork** ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EoyRQYgFUT66YQsxDieeYiCtXcrCKLuNwog3DtHEBY4WdwEJKfxrKufvXMnBNUpmzZ4.jpeg) 米特点的 **泡菜猪肉片** 米特还在嫌弃怎么没看到有泡菜？难道只是用泡菜酱煮猪肉片而已？我~~偷偷~~光明正大的夹了一块泡菜猪肉片来吃，味道也还不错…… **价钱：RM109.95** 这顿饭，原来是我打算请客的，毕竟是我把米特拉出门来陪我吃。隔了一天，米特又转回 RM100 给我让我收下，变成这顿饭是他请客了。

---------------------- As shown on Tribaldex: https://tribaldex.com/trade/CHAOS ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbZzBuWfVc5cbn7MQr8NNdnmns3JBgfpgEscseWBu1gX/image.png) -----------------------
CHAOS is an older set but one that still has some trade volume. Nothing compared to when it first launched. However that is the nature of the card sets from Splinterlands. Alpha and Beta that command higher price points rarely see trades for their Card Packs. There is allot that factors into such. For example ALPHA is very scarce and those who hold Alpha packs don't want to let them go nor won't let them go at undervalued prices. The same is true for the BETA set. While BETA was a larger set compared to ALPHA it (BETA) packs and cards are second in scarcity only to ALPHA. UNTAMED/ CHAOS and beyond all had much higher print rates. Personally I like keeping an eye on the CHAOS pack set. The header for this post is a candlestick graph that shows sales volume for the CHAOS Pack. The most recent CHAOS Pack sold for just over 30 cents. The BID amount has fell to just over 20 cents although I don't suspect anyone will sell into it (stranger things have happened). The current ASK price sits at near 35 cents which is up roughly 5 cents since our last post about CHAOS just over a week ago. You can read that previous post by clicking the following highlighted link: [CHAOS For 30 Cents A Pack](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@rentmoney/chaos-for-30-cents-a-pack). The CHAOS set cards do contain DEC (Dark Energy Crystals). ------------------------
Image Source: https://tribaldex.com/trade/CHAOS ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTmvbLQ9vZuJbwA4ArQd76Dr6EUreuF1xvnmBw3duzPPJ/image.png) -----------------------------------------
Above you will see the orders book template. 3.25 Hive Tokens per CHAOS Pack on the Buy Orders side and 5.55 Hive Tokens per CHAOS Pack on the Sell Orders side. Looks like the Hive Token has a 4-5% increase in USD value within the last 24hours. Of course this still leaves us at a very affordable price for the Hive Token. I have been busy lately so I haven't been glued to the markets as usual but it does seem to me that the Hive Token might have bottomed. When the climb upwards comes in full motion is anyone's guess but if there is one thing I learned from this cryptocurrency experience of mine its that changes can happen fast and abruptly. Plan for the worst and hope for the best is a good mindset with anything. Never invest what you can't afford to lose. The chips will fall where they fall after that. The current (2026-05-25) Hive Token value is $0.06235 USD per token. Hive Price quote taken from Coin Market Cap. For up to date price point on the Hive Token click here: https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hive-blockchain/. -------------------------------
Hive Token Chart Source: https://coinmarketcap.com/currencies/hive-blockchain/ ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUZNVcbWSeV7CuFyiopA7hrjFy7qYSvrDeNK3PkR3muAh/image.png) ---------------------
I can't create a post about CHAOS without opening a pack or two so lets do that now. As I noted in previous posts, no potions were used in the opening of these packs. No reasons as to why - that is just how I do my CHAOS pack openings. Our last pack featured in a post was the standard one rare and four common pack. Will we beat the odds this time? There's only one way to find out. Lets get to opening :) -----------------------------
### Pack One: ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNzpATZ1JcMN8GoVBtmobyo86ddGnm9gSo7zCdVhePaTC/image.png) ### Pack Two: ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWrPw1AXabosFisCPaYsugxsPnNjkoXQF8BFKwLVCpRDd/image.png) ---------------------
Look at that - GOLD in our first pack opening. Sure it's a common GOLD but I'll take it. Our second pack opening we weren't as lucky and flipped open the standard pack. We did manage to get a nice wide range of cards in that second pack with two being from the Earth Splinter, One from the Death Splinter, One from Water Splinter and One from Life Splinter. Two or there of the cards are of the lower MANA cost which is nice. Overall no complaints here about my opening. If I can flip a gold in as little as two packs that counts as a win in my books. That's it for this post. Thanks for reading. We hope to see you at the next :) Sign up for Splinterlands here: https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=rentmoney or here: https://splinterlands.com/. -------------------------

links.title: More Than Hunger
links.body: Some things aren’t made just to satisfy hunger but are crafted in a way that keeps pulling a person back to them again and again. Glowing advertisements enticing aromas and a magic of flavor that makes a person forget everything for a few moments. This is the world that’s perhaps called “Designed to Overeat,” where food becomes not just a need but a habit. In today’s life, most people don’t eat to fill their stomachs but to entertain their hearts. Sometimes exhaustion, sometimes loneliness and sometimes just boredom leads a person to the fridge. The strange thing is the more you eat the more the craving grows. As if some flavors take hold of a person’s mind. Fast food, sweet treats and snacks available at all times have quietly changed our habits. There used to be a time for eating now there’s an excuse to eat all the time. While scrolling on mobile watching a movie or sitting with friends the hand automatically reaches for something or the other. But real strength lies in the person who recognizes their own desires. Behind every beautiful packaging there isn’t always a need. Sometimes it’s just a trick. Controlling yourself isn’t easy but this is the very difference that stands between habit and awareness. “Designed to Overeat” isn’t just a phrase but a silent reality of today’s life. A reality that reminds us that everything that instantly pleases the heart isn’t necessarily good for us.

links.title: The Writing on the Wall - Horror Short Story
links.body:
>KELLEPICS on Pixabay ___ Benjamin Leitner, son of General Reinold Leitner, grandson of Count Dietrich Leitner, stepped from the stagecoach and lit his pipe. The night was cold, the sky a vast black emptiness. The moon, if it had shown itself at all that night, was gone, and nothing but the light cast by Benjamin’s lantern offered solace from the creeping dark.
He’d reached the graveyard, home of his family tomb and its historic dynasty. It was a forbidden place, the site of his late mother’s suicide, where Leitners were entombed stretching back centuries. He hated this place, more than anywhere else on earth. But he’d come, alone as ordered to. He’d come, as he had no other option but to do so. And he’d brought the gold.
The letter was written in her typical style. Loquacious, expounding on the nature of their relationship, apologizing for her affairs, thanking him for standing by her throughout it, remaining at her side despite all the controversy of the town. Despite even her own parents telling him to abandon her as a lost cause.
She’d not only dragged herself down into the mud. But him as well. Benjamin the financier, of Wolfstone and Kauffman, now the cuckold of all of Austria. But worst of all, she’d tarnished the name of Leitner.
And when the accusation came, of witchcraft and devilry, of black magic and the most bestial of sacrilege, of whoring in the night endowed with opiates unto madness. Well, it was no wonder when Kauffman wanted out.
And still he stood by her.
Should he have been surprised when the letter came, demanding the last of his finances or else she’d accuse him in the papers of having masterminded it all? Of being an original scholar of the black arts? That would render the Leitner name into devilry.
No. He couldn’t allow that.
Benjamin finished his pipe, the tobacco charred and ashen. He cast the ash into the wind then slipped the cherry wood pipe into his coat pocket, beside the letter crested with her seal.
Melinda. Oh, you wench.
I’ll be in the crypts, waiting.
He suspected she wasn’t alone. Benjamin suspected the whole carnal tribe to be down there, waiting for her.
Well, so much the better. Let them all wait for his arrival. Let them all see the truth, the forbidden history denied to the world. Stretching back into the foundation of the soil. Let them know who it was that the Leitner’s may be.
He stepped across the grass, peering at the graves of his forbears till he reached the central crypt. The iron gate was ajar and the darkness seemingly impenetrable. They were down there, waiting for him.
“Melinda,” Benjamin said to himself. “It could have been different. So different. But you threatened my name. For that, I cannot forgive you.”
He entered the crypts.
“Time to meet the family,” he thought to himself, almost with a laugh.
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
Mist beaded teardrops of obsidian crystal from the roof of the crypt. Silence muffled his thoughts, interrupted every few seconds by the soft fall of a water droplet onto the damp floor. Marble edifices lined the mausoleum hall. The stern countenance of his ancestors watching his every move. Alexander Leitner, his great, great uncle. Marble mustache dripping from that cruel face. Hard dark eyes, deep set and maniacal. Maximilian Leitner his great, great grandfather. Known as the butcher of Amstetten, hired by Maria Theresa to put the whole town to the flame in a strategic sacrifice. Johanna Leitner his great, great grandmother. Who poisoned her lovers with Nightshade and Hemlock from the castle gardens. Suddenly a high orgasmic keening echoed from the inky blackness ahead. Benjamin stopped dead. Dust shivered a curtain of motes from a moon beam that encroached into this place of death. The light faltering just up ahead, a gaping portal of nothingness. A scratching shocked him out of his contemplation. He turned, dead stone eyes of his great grandmother burned cold white light freezing his bones to the marrow. The statue held his gaze as it scratched a message on the wall. ```Time to feed!```
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
He felt them possess him. All of the cursed Leitner dead. As they had when he was a boy, coaxed down into these stinking tombs with the promise of something at the edge of imagination. The raw energy of their spirits raked him from the inside. *Fire and steel in the sacred night. Fire and steel in the sacred night.* The words echoed through his mind, words chanted in another time and place. He saw matchstick scarecrows flailing around in the dust as his hands picked up the pitcher of oil and doused the farmers into living beacons. They shrieking like pigs at the slaughter as flesh melted from their bones. He felt the flames. He felt the flesh crisping and the smell of his own brain boiling. Benjamin Leitner howled as those spirits inhabited him.
₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪₪
\

Melinda's voice quavered as she screamed into the darkness from the alter room. That pig Simon had run away at that unearthly howl and taken the lamp with him. A good lover but a complete coward. \n\n\

*She loved to tease and torture him, such a weak and ineffectual man.* Melinda let loose her own unearthly howl into the darkness as she fumbled with the candle. *Better not drop it or I will be in trouble.* 

She listened as the echo of her howl died away. Silence.

\

No answer. 

Suddenly an icy breeze rushed into her face, the candle sputtered out and dropped to the floor. 

Melinda groped in the darkness for it before taking a deep breath and waiting for her eyes to adjust. Nothing, she couldn't even see her hand in front of her face. 

\

She screamed into the endless night. 

She heard a low gurgling noise as the echo of her scream died down and moved toward it where a dim glow could be seen. 

As she rounded the corner of the tunnel she could see a feral figure crouched low in the corner. Glistening ropes of dim flesh in its hands, a gurgling grinding noise filled her world. Benjamin turned to look at Melinda, Simon's entrails spilling from his hands and mouth. Blood covered his face and torso, clotting at the corners of his mouth. In one hand he held a severed arm, splintered bone jutting a pale smear of cream in the nightmare dark. A green glow burned in his eyes at he looked at her and spoke in a rasping wet voice, gore spittle flying.

\

**The end.**
