links.body:
>

#### <center>Saludos amigos de Holos&lotus</center>

#

![Post de Instagram horóscopo minimalista azul_20260525_104234_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRH5d3DwkdZ7W481eK3TtwRaNyd9GLnoqgEG2vQccRQxD/Post%20de%20Instagram%20hor%C3%B3scopo%20minimalista%20azul_20260525_104234_0000.jpg)



Hace unos dias estuve viendo un video sobre el comportamiento de una manada de monos. Estaban sobre las copas de los árboles de una selva, no especificaba en que lugar del planeta. Dos monos adultos se agarraban de la cola y de las manos traseras de las ramas de árboles continuos  y  con las manos delanteras se sujetaban de manera tal que formaron un puente. Esto ayudo a que los monos mas pequeños y el resto del grupo pudiera atravesarlo y continuar su camino. 

Estos ejemplo de ayuda entre los miembros de otras especies animales, es un mensaje muy importante para nuestra especie, porque  esta cooperación es imprescindible para la supervivencia de la manada. 

En días pasados @emiliorios, con el tema de su columna: **Pedir ayuda y ser vulnerables** [  ](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/pedir-ayuda-y-ser-vulnerables-por-que-nos-cuesta-tanto-ni-deudas-ni-molestias-es-desarrollo-personal-esen), me llevó a reflexionar sobre como concientizamos el pedir ayuda y si esto nos hace sentir vulnerables. 

Creo que la sociedad ha ido cambiando para darle mucha importancia a la individualidad, que ha ido sustituyendo en muchas áreas de la vida, a la comunidad y al comportamiento grupal. Se nos dice desde que somos niños que debemos valernos por nosotros mismos, ser fuertes ante la adversidad y resolver los problemas sin ayuda. En nuestra sociedad tiene exito el que es capaz de cumplir con estas condiciones. 

La vulnerabilidad y la debilidad ante determinadas situaciones que nos agobian no son considerados como convenientes mecanismos de supervivencia, la llamada ley del mas fuerte. La ley de la supervivencia del más apto. 

Pero esto no es completamente cierto, porque en muchas especies animales, los más fuertes cuidan de los más débiles. Inclusive entre  animales y vegetales hay muchos ejemplos de ayuda mutua donde ambas especies se benefician. 

<center>![simon-berberaffen-299.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV3HdzaEpRYnajHuRfYtN7iR1SPhev64n5PsL6gpkz6M8/simon-berberaffen-299.jpg)</center><center>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/berberaffen-monos-piojo-india-299/)</center>

***

El  paradigma de pedir ayuda te hace débil y vulnerable, también me ha afectado en muchas situaciones de mi vida. Tratar de solucionar los problemas por mi misma, en algunos casos fue gratificante y me hizo sentir muy bién en mi ego, pero en otras situaciones fue muy doloroso. Necesitaba de ayuda y no lo consideré. 

<center>![kei_therapeutic_art-depression-7448936.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXSsSXmfwdExE9QHRVRfZVeg49cPiCdy5pwTGWHREyPyb/kei_therapeutic_art-depression-7448936.jpg)</center><center>[fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/depresi%C3%B3n-salud-mental-apoyo-7448936/)</center>

***



Hoy la vida me ha enseñado que ayudar y recibir ayuda forma parte de nuestra naturaleza como seres humanos, como animales que somos. 

Pero también he comprendido que esos sentimientos de empatía, de solidaridad y de amor hacia otras personas están relacionados con nuestra espiritualidad, con nuestra razón de ser. 

Debo reconocer que me costaba mucho pedir ayuda, inclusive a mi familia. Mis pensamientos eran \
No es justo preocupar a otras personas\
No quiero que nadie se entere por lo que estoy pasando\

body.title: Lazy Day - May 24, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Gloomy rainy day crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpA1UaWz4D76fQyrV1ZXBfoMJX6YLRZpLJZkaBEDbjPjAUCZ77ysRzG38y9HSFi12S9.jpg)

Sunday I got up and fed the cat at 6AM so he’d be quiet and went back to bed and didn’t get up until 9:30AM. I got my posts up and sat down for a while. 

![Seedlings - 4.mesclun crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/Ep5mEj7wYWGyxChM5hsxKetJRHzc4rE3VKL88Kf1Ue7w1Sdxw22tuPPTeQaif6weCQh.jpg)

*Mesclun #4 seedlings*

Then I got up and raised lights for the seedlings and watered them all. I made some lunch and sat down to watch the next Audrey Helpburn movie, ‘Sabrina’.

![Sabrina old crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wMexaSG7KPRHuD8wSFEU8R5L1XECNJbukMt2pUcKaGVcEHZ3DH1FWtqZHHibc2k9VYU.jpg)

It had just finished when the contractor arrived to do a couple small jobs inside.

![Jobs done collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23yToMb81qiDPNbtJmc39Lsbf6r882EBYUzYgM7ec9i2yMwuUzsQrL4cB7zjMEoVUXtFj.jpg)

I needed a towel ring for my general helper so we figured out where to put that. And the drawer in the office table had a messed up track, so he fixed that.

When he left I sat down to read my Sue Grafton book, ‘K is for Killer’. I made some supper and finished the book afterwards.

I’d kept the wood stove going all day and the masonry heater did its job in the addition. I got the shades pulled and was in bed at 8:30PM.

On Monday I have to remember to finish the butter as I forgot it on Sunday. I need to do laundry and finish cleaning up the kitchen. I need to get the winter clothes washed and ready to put away. And my #1 intern and I should do something about getting the bedroom ready for my general helper. It’s to be another gloomy rainy day…

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

title.title: Zombie Adventure - Game 118 (Keyless Entry) - Sign up here
title.body:
Rumor has it that there is a secret room in town that has no visible access and is filled with gold bars!
Do you think you have what it takes to recover the gold?

A new game will start as soon as we have enough players. Please sign up in the replies section below.

![ZombiPlayers3.png](https://steemitimages.com/DQmcQyoCrZuaeq5b7N6aApg7v69nKXa6GaRzJB3h6fbELWq/ZombiPlayers3.png)

This is sort of a board game that can take up to 12 players at a time. It will require daily participation. If you are interested in playing, please sign up as a reply to this post. The first 12 players to sign up get to participate. If there are less than 12 players signed up after 24 hours of this post going up, it will either begin with those players or be postponed if less than 3 sign up.

# Rules

Each player will have 3 actions per turn. An action is a move of 1 space, a trade with another player in the same square, an offensive action (fighting), picking up an objective or item, a search or breaking down a door or other barrier.
After all players have completed their 3 actions the zombies will take their turn. Zombies will spawn at locations marked \

and any zombies already on the board will move or if in range, attack. Runners (R) can move 2 squares per action. Walkers (W) and Hulks (H) can move one square per action. ALL zombies get just 1 action per turn and will move towards noise made by the players or those in sight. All zombies will inflict 1 damage to players if they make a successful hit and can only fight if they are in the same square as a player. * If a player is in the same square as a zombie, they MUST engage in combat and cannot run away. * Runners and walkers can be killed with a successful hit using a weapon that does 1 damage (or 2 bare-handed hits). * The hulk requires 2 damage points to kill it. One hit with a weapon that does 2 damage or multiple hits with less-lethal weapons will kill it. Players can take 3 hits before they die. Dead players will re-spawn at the starting square and lose all their inventory. Ranged weapons cannot be used against zombies in your square when there are other players in the same square (hand to hand combat only). If you are the only player in the square with a zombie you may use a ranged weapon. Shooting INTO a space where other players are will result in the players being hit before zombies are hit. With multiple targets in a space, the order of taking damage from a successful hit with a ranged weapon will be as follows: player, walker, runner, hulk. Note that you may shoot **past** a space with potential targets in it without hitting anyone/thing by accident. Simply state which space you are targeting and which weapon you are using (of course ONLY a long-range weapon can do this). Please pay attention to the moves that have transpired before you, so that your choices are based upon facts as they are and not as they were before (the people that played before you, just altered the situation). ### Weapons * Axe does 2 damage and can be used to open doors by attacking them. If swinging at enemies that have less than 2 health, the axe can chop down that enemy and continue through to a 2nd enemy (swing-through), dealing the remainder of its 2 damage points to any enemy that is also in the same square. * Bare hands can do only half a point of damage (so it takes 2 successful hits to kill a 1-point enemy). * Baseball bats, pistols, rifles and crossbows do 1 damage. Pistols and crossbows have a range of 1 square. Rifles can reach 2 squares. * Sawed-off shotgun or scattergun: Since buckshot scatters, it would make a big hole shooting in the same square (hence 2 damage); at one space distance it loses momentum and scatters, doing less damage, but can hit 2 targets (dealing 1 damage each). * CZ 550 is an Elephant Rifle and can do 2 damage at a range of 1 square (or less) and 1 damage at a range of 2 squares. * A Molotov Cocktail kills everything in the square it is thrown into and cannot miss. It has a range of 1 square. Combining gasoline and a torch makes a Molotov Cocktail. When a Molotov is thrown, it will burn for the entire day and the following day, essentially blocking access for the rest of the day and the next day for BOTH zombies and players. * To determine if attacks are successful or not, use my [on-line tool](https://github.com/happymes/ZombieGameTool2) or do a manual roll. A roll of 1 to 3 is a miss. A roll of 4 to 6 is a hit. * Ranged weapons cannot shoot through walls. Out in the street it is possible to shoot straight lines-of-sight a distance of 2 squares, however, inside buildings, you can only shoot what you would be able to see from the doorway (1 square beyond your room). Shooting is only possible at 90 degree angles (no diagonal shots into adjacent spaces). * All weapons have unlimited ammunition. (The Molotov Cocktail is thrown and is a single-use item.) All players will start without any inventory unless they have a permanent or single-use item from a previous game. ### Searching * Searches might uncover a hiding zombie! Items found will be drawn randomly from my [on-line tool](https://github.com/happymes/ZombieGameTool2). * Searches can only be done in rooms, vehicles or dumpsters and only 1 search per player per turn. If a player searches using a torch, additional items will be found depending on the number of torches entered into the search script. There is no limit to the number of times any particular area can be searched. * Players need not take everything they find and are free to swap items found for inventory items without using another action to do so. For instance, if I find a rifle and everyone in my team already has a ranged weapon, I would drop my x-bow or pistol and take the rifle in its place. * Players can carry up to 5 types of items each. * Picking up an objective is NOT a search; it is a guaranteed action. ### Spawning * Each day will spawn new zombies at the spawn zones based on dice rolls as described below. * When a door is opened, zombies will be spawned in each room of the building based on dice rolls. The player opening the door should roll to populate the rooms. * 6 spawns a Hulk, 5 spawns a runner, 4 or 3 spawns a walker and 2 or 1 spawns nothing. ### Teleporters (Blue T) / Tunnels (Green T) * Where such items exist, it will require an action to use/open them. In the case of a teleporter, only entering one will take an action and the player will be moved into the square of the other \
. In the case of tunnels, players will spend ONE ACTION running through the tunnel before emerging at the other \

.
* Entering a locked room via tunnel or teleporter triggers a room-spawn as if the door had been opened.
* A dice roll will be used to see if each zombie following players into a teleporter is smart enough to follow or gets confused and simply loses the trail of the player that disappears into a teleporter. Success or failure is the same as for attacks (1 to 3 = fail & 4 to 6 = success)

### Player actions
Each player will announce their daily actions in the replies to each daily post.
Tell me your player number, what your actions are and the outcome of those actions.

For example: Player 3; move west 1; shoot at zombie in next square west, rolled 1 and missed; move back.
Alternatively: Player 3; move west 1; shoot at zombie in next square west, rolled 1 and missed; shoot again, rolled 5 and hit.
In both cases, player 3 made 3 actions and their turn is over.

Trading between a pair of players (both must be in the same square) may include any number of items in 1 transaction but still only counts as 1 action by 1 player (the player initiating the trade).
Players are free to collaborate and plan their strategies; this is a cooperative game.

<div class=\

>https://cdn.steemitstageimages.com/DQmTkBjWyxREKaNxFFjFGv13zEThmnZs2xrxTVvzs2ERWrf/Rolld20.JPG **Additional twist:** Before each player takes their daily turn, roll a D20 to see if you get any bonus. **Please note** that the bonus must be used during the CURRENT TURN. If you do not specify to which action you wish to apply the bonus, it will be applied to your first action where applicable.   ![TextDivider4.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmU1cbWrWS9nYoKk1Fh4uQjTk2tVz9G49zbgMX5dYooipg/TextDivider4.jpg)   I will update the board with new player positions and zombie positions for the next day's play. The object of the game is to retrieve the objective(s) and may also have other requirements that will be specified for each game depending on the number of players. title.title: Las pizzas más caras de la historia | [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
# 🍕 ¿Qué es el Bitcoin Pizza Day?

![28.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EqJ2sm8ReHimxeFY2ck51U7Kz3pyVhbs31867d2gPbu4tHX8NAkR5xGFLcVEoBSZ9dV.png)
Laszlo Hanyecz y las 2 pizzas compradas con BTC. *(Imagen obtenida de [El Economista](https://www.eleconomista.es/mercados-cotizaciones/noticias/11772855/05/22/No-me-arrepiento-asi-piensa-ahora-el-hombre-que-cambio-10000-bitcoins-por-dos-pizzas.html) y editada en Canva).*

Cada 22 de mayo desde el 2010 se celebra en todo el mundo el Bitcoin Pizza Day, un día muy especial que en mi opinión es el inicio de todo este ecosistema web3.

Resulta que ese día, una persona que conocía sobre bitcoin y tenía sus reservas decidió realizar una compra con esta cripto, así que escribió en un sitio web si alguien le vendía pizza por 10.000 btc. Otra persona de una pizzería aceptó esto y le enviaron dos pizzas.

Sin saberlo esto marcó un gran hito en la historia ya que fue la primera compra de un producto real con bitcoin, a partir de ahí se fueron abriendo más posibilidades para todo este mundo.

Quizá no en ese mismo momento, pero se vio la importancia y la utilidad que le podías dar a este tipo de monedas, pero aun así las personas seguían pensando que era algo irreal, una estafa más.

Fue con el paso del tiempo y todo lo que ocurrió después que se vio a bitcoin como algo importante, como lo llaman el “oro digital” que te ayuda a guardar valor para un futuro, funcionando similar a lo que sería el oro, su cantidad es limitada y por lo tanto su valor es mayor.

Les cuento todo esto para que tengan una idea de lo importante de ese día, por eso, desde entonces es que en todo el mundo se celebra ese día, pero también creo que sirvió para que más personas conozcan sobre el ecosistema en general.

# 🎉 Cómo vivimos el evento en Bolivia

![29.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/Eq5Gry7BrUWHRdUufT5uxKML48h2DVjCS8MPMWroDXJ6E42LLAVmVyNreksU4N3koeX.png)
Mi experiencia y la merch del evento. *(Fotos y edición de mi autoría).*

Cada país vive esta fiesta a su manera, pero con el toque único de compartir una pizza con la comunidad, aprender sobre web3 y cripto, pasar un buen rato y disfrutar.

En mi caso yo la pasé con la comunidad boliviana, este año fue en un lugar grande donde asistieron alrededor de 80 personas, o quizá más. Todo comenzó desde las 7pm recibiendo a todos los asistentes con una dinámica de bienvenida, tenían que tirar un dado grande donde les tocaba un reto por realizar, como bailar, caminar en cámara lenta o hacer algo divertido.

Como todos los años, estuve apoyando en la organización de este bonito evento con varias comunidades que se unieron para celebrar este día. Luego comenzaron las dinámicas para que los participantes puedan ganar merch como gorras, poleras, pines y stickers.

# 🎲 Juegos y dinámicas

Uno de los juegos fue responder preguntas acerca de bitcoin, como quién fue el creador, qué era la prueba de trabajo, entre otras. Algunos fueron muy rápidos en responder, otros recién estaban aprendiendo sobre el ecosistema.

![poaps gifs (5).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/AJrCgDmLcnHGcX2ChBo8rLPtwpmh18qoDyMbLiF9oN76RGANPWiDXjoCre4VufA.gif)
Participantes del Global Pizza Party. (Video y GIF de mi autoría).

Y llegó la primera tanda de pizzas, cada participante recibió su porción y su vaso de jugo, parecía que la fila nunca terminaba, llegaban más y más personas. Algo que siempre me gusta de este tipo de eventos es que puedes encontrar a personas de toda edad, área, experiencia y demás, pero lo que nos une es la educación y web3.

Luego pasamos a otro juego que era un bingo web3, cada asistente tenía una tarjeta para poder marcar el bingo y estuvo muy movido ya que ni bien gritaban las palabras ya había un nuevo ganador, lo bueno es que había premio para todos jeje.

Otra dinámica fue postear una foto en redes y etiquetar a los organizadores, aquellos que se sacaban fotos grupales tenían la oportunidad de ganar una caja de pizza completa para toda su mesa. Aquí sí hubo que sortearlo porque no había para todos, creo que todo estuvo muy parejo porque todos se fueron muy felices con algún premio.

# 🌎 Una celebración mundial

![30.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EpCEeQZiERbb2QSSYdWHdsVGPboF6jeHaxtTaTtmXLdSA63BEzH9yuEXe47nzUsnTz8.png)
Regalos digitales por el 22 de mayo. *(Collage editado en Canva).*

La noche estuvo muy entretenida y todos se divirtieron mucho, también se notó que varias personas habían aprendido mucho sobre el por qué se festeja este día, por qué es importante conocer sobre bitcoin y lo que implica formar parte de web3.

También generó varias amistades y contactos para posibles proyectos o colaboraciones, esto es lo que más me gusta, tanto la experiencia como lo que puedes lograr asistiendo a los eventos y aprendiendo nuevas cosas.

Algo así se debió vivir en otras partes del mundo, es muy emocionante pensar que ese día todos estábamos reunidos por un mismo objetivo, esta gran celebración del Global Pizza Party.

Gracias por leerme y espero que hayan celebrado ese día comiendo una rebanada de pizza y recordando lo que pasó ese 22 de mayo.

Que tengan una estupenda semana.

![31.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/waralotito/EprYqJvLn3HaktaqBydMp7UfJ3wUgQVutoqyemHWtWHTMgMsegmczCDmRsKYkoQvo9r.png)
*(Imagen creada en Canva).*

<details>
<summary> Read in English</summary>

# The Most Expensive Pizzas in History

### 🍕 What Is Bitcoin Pizza Day?

Every May 22 since 2010, Bitcoin Pizza Day has been celebrated around the world—a very special day that, in my opinion, marks the beginning of this entire Web3 ecosystem.

It turns out that on that day, a person who knew about Bitcoin and had some reserves decided to make a purchase with this cryptocurrency, so he posted on a website asking if anyone would sell him pizza for 10,000 BTC. Someone from a pizzeria accepted the offer and sent him two pizzas.

Unbeknownst to them, this marked a major milestone in history, as it was the first purchase of a real product with Bitcoin; from there, more possibilities began to open up for this entire world.

Perhaps not at that very moment, but the importance and utility of this type of currency became apparent, yet people still thought it was something unreal, just another scam.

It was only with the passage of time and everything that happened afterward that Bitcoin came to be seen as something important—what they call “digital gold”—which helps you store value for the future, functioning similarly to gold: its supply is limited, and therefore its value is higher.

I’m telling you all this so you can get an idea of how important that day was; that’s why, ever since then, it’s been celebrated all over the world. But I also think it helped more people learn about the ecosystem in general.

### 🎉 How We Celebrated the Event in Bolivia

Every country celebrates this event in its own way, but with the unique touch of sharing pizza with the community, learning about Web3 and crypto, having a good time, and enjoying ourselves.

In my case, I spent it with the Bolivian community; this year it was held in a large venue attended by around 80 people, or perhaps more. It all started at 7 p.m. by welcoming all attendees with a welcome activity: they had to roll a large die to see what challenge they’d have to perform, such as dancing, walking in slow motion, or doing something fun.

Like every year, I helped organize this wonderful event with several communities that came together to celebrate this day. Then the activities began so participants could win merchandise like hats, T-shirts, pins, and stickers.

### 🎲 Games and Activities

One of the games was answering questions about Bitcoin, such as who created it and what proof-of-work is, among others. Some were very quick to answer, while others were just starting to learn about the ecosystem.

And then the first batch of pizzas arrived; each participant received their slice and a glass of juice. It seemed like the line would never end—more and more people kept arriving. Something I always love about these kinds of events is that you can meet people of all ages, backgrounds, and levels of experience, but what unites us is education and Web3.

Then we moved on to another game, which was a Web3 bingo. Each attendee had a card to mark off the bingo numbers, and it was really fast-paced—as soon as the words were called out, there was already a new winner. The best part was that there was a prize for everyone, haha.

Another activity was posting a photo on social media and tagging the organizers; those who took group photos had the chance to win a whole pizza box for their entire table. We had to raffle that one off because there wasn’t enough for everyone, but I think it all worked out pretty evenly since everyone left happy with some kind of prize.

### 🌎 A global celebration

The night was very entertaining and everyone had a great time. It was also clear that many people had learned a lot about why this day is celebrated, why it’s important to know about Bitcoin, and what it means to be part of Web3.

It also led to several new friendships and connections for potential projects or collaborations—this is what I like best, both the experience itself and what you can achieve by attending events and learning new things.

Something similar must have happened in other parts of the world; it’s very exciting to think that on that day we were all gathered together for the same goal: this great celebration of the Global Pizza Party.

Thank you for reading, and I hope you celebrated that day by eating a slice of pizza and remembering what happened on May 22.

Have a wonderful week.

*(Translated with DeepL)*

</details>

title.title: HYPE Just Hit an ATH!!! Here’s Why it’s Absolutely Flying
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNoW2FMjdPefK13XBj4qVoyFZ86QRe4dK1aqZGpYSrXRM/1779723444529.png)


What’s up, fellow degens! If you’ve been holding HYPE (Hyperliquid) lately, I bet you’re having a pretty good week. This coin is straight up crushing it. I mean, we're talking about an 85% rally in just a week.

A lot of people are sitting on the sidelines feeling major fomo right now, while analysts were already hinting at how strong this momentum was. And look at where we are HYPE just smashed its All Time High, hitting price levels that nobody saw coming.
But the real question is. Why is HYPE mooning while everything else is just sideways? Let’s break it down without the boring wall street talk.

**The Short Squeeze Effect**
First, let’s look at the derivatives data. This is where the magic happens.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGH7xGiR7Nt4X4HwqptzrmaEByzyfbQvLVkuQVS7qDkj/1779724159528.jpg)



If you’re confused by the numbers, here’s the scoop. Any number below 1.0 (like 0.76 or 0.56) means there are way more people betting on the price to go DOWN (shorts) than UP (longs).

Basically, everyone thought, It's gone up too much, it's gotta crash now. So they piled into short positions. But the market had other plans. Whales kept pushing the price up, and all those shorters got completely trapped. This is a classic Short Squeeze. Because the shorters were forced to buy back their positions to stop the bleeding, it just acted like rocket fuel, sending the price even higher.

**Liquidations & Volume Going Crazy**
What happens when a short squeeze hits? A bloodbath for the bears.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUqYVQwQDxN1hbfUvejNiLouXTR5ypjyyNiyjza9fCAt3/1779724305925.jpg)


Look at May 14th on the chart those massive red bars? That’s millions of dollars in short positions getting liquidated in seconds. When those shorters get wiped out, it adds even more buying pressure to the market. ​And you can see this in the volume spike, too.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVghMp7sRAPFphjSJnDJxVKqWQDXWqCEagnkgq9pUxjYt/1779724221160.jpg)



The volume went totally parabolic, hitting over $600 million in no time. It’s not just a few people trading; it’s a massive wave of money coming in, with late comers finally jumping in because they don't want to miss the boat.

**Technicals: The $63 Breakout**
Now, look at the 1Day chart. It’s pretty simple.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSoMR88gUWDg3eckGXiBezt9GTUeSLXVxDJkgUo688Cco/1779723666538.jpg)


After the slow grind in late 2025, HYPE finally found its footing around $34. The best part? It just broke through the major resistance at $63.

​Right now, we’re seeing a retest of that $63 level. If it holds, this is no longer a resistance it’s now our new floor. If we stay above this, the path to $70 or even $100 looks wide open.

​The Bottom Line? HYPE’s rally isn’t just hype (pun intended). It’s a perfect storm of trapped shorters, insane volume, and a clean technical breakout. The retail crowd is still skeptical, which honestly just gives the whales more room to keep pushing.

​If $63 holds as support, this ride might just be getting started. As always, keep your risk in check and don't go all in unless you're ready for the volatility. Let’s see how this plays out.

Source
[Ajaib Sekuritas Indonesia](https://ajaib.co.id/belajar/berita-kripto/breaking-news-hyperliquid-meroket-hingga-tembus-rp11-juta?hl=id-ID)

title.title: How Tesla Battery Diagnostics and Repair Works
title.body: >Electric vehicles rely heavily on advanced battery systems that require careful monitoring to ensure consistent performance and safety. Understanding how Tesla battery diagnostics and repair work helps explain how these systems maintain efficiency over time. Modern battery packs are designed with multiple layers of monitoring that track temperature, voltage, and overall energy flow. When irregularities appear, specialized diagnostic processes are used to identify the source of the issue. This approach allows technicians to pinpoint whether a problem is related to individual cells, wiring, or software calibration, ensuring that the right corrective steps are taken without unnecessary intervention. over time safely.

>Battery health assessment begins with continuous data collection from sensors embedded within the battery pack. These sensors measure voltage consistency, thermal behavior, and charging cycles to build a detailed profile of performance over time. Engineers use this information to evaluate degradation patterns and identify early signs of imbalance among cells. Through <a target=\

>Tesla battery diagnostics and repair methods, technicians can interpret these readings to determine whether performance issues are temporary or indicative of deeper structural concerns. The assessment process also considers how the battery responds under different load conditions, which helps predict future efficiency. By analyzing trends rather than isolated readings, the system ensures a more accurate understanding of battery condition and remaining useful life. This improves long-term reliability further.

>Diagnostic systems rely on integrated software and hardware tools that constantly evaluate battery performance in real time. These systems collect data from multiple points within the battery pack and compare it against expected operating thresholds. When deviations occur, alerts are generated to indicate potential faults. This may include fluctuations in voltage stability, unusual heat distribution, or irregular charging behavior. Advanced algorithms filter normal variations from true anomalies to reduce false positives. Once a potential issue is confirmed, the system maps the affected area within the battery structure, allowing for targeted inspection. This structured approach improves accuracy and reduces unnecessary disassembly, supporting more efficient troubleshooting and system reliability overall. Machine learning enhances detection speed and overall system precision significantly over time.

>Repair processes focus on restoring balance within the battery pack by addressing inconsistencies among individual cells. After a diagnostic evaluation identifies the affected areas, technicians may recalibrate or replace specific components to improve overall performance. In many cases, cell balancing techniques are used to ensure that each unit within the battery charges and discharges evenly. This is where Tesla battery diagnostics and repair practices play a crucial role in guiding precise corrective actions. The process is controlled to prevent stress on the system and to extend the lifespan of the battery. By maintaining uniform energy distribution, the system reduces strain on weaker cells and supports stable output. These interventions are designed to be minimally invasive while achieving performance improvements over time.

>Long-term battery performance depends on consistent monitoring and proactive maintenance strategies that reduce the risk of unexpected failure. Systems are designed to track usage patterns over extended periods, allowing for early detection of gradual performance decline. Regular data reviews help identify shifts in efficiency, temperature behavior, and charging consistency. When subtle changes are detected, adjustments can be made to maintain stability and prevent further degradation. Predictive modeling also plays a role in forecasting future battery conditions based on historical trends. This enables more informed decisions about usage and care. Over time, continuous monitoring contributes to improved reliability, ensuring that the battery system remains stable and efficient throughout its operational life. Maintenance extends the overall system lifespan.

<center>**Title: HAVE YOU EVER WANTED TO QUIT HIVE?**</center>

This week, we will love you to be you, like...be real. Was there ever a time you got tired, felt unmotivated, and you just felt like quiting hive.

We know there are times we take breaks, maybe due to one thing or the other, or other times we get so busy with other things online or offline that we are not able to be always available here. That's not what we are saying... We are talking about a point you get to and you feel... *\

I've seen those who have quit hive before; some are back again, while it seems some really, really quit and are not looking back. 

To those who have left before... Why did you leave? For how long were you away? What brought you back?

To those who haven't and have never left but are thinking of quitting...why did you want to? What happened exactly?

title.body: X is unmatched for real-time market intel and accountability — post a wrong TA call there and the replies are brutal. That pressure creates better analysis. Hive's slower pace has the opposite effect: more thoughtful discussion, but less immediate feedback.\n\nThe interesting middle ground is using X for discovery and distribution, then funneling the deeper analysis to Hive where the content persists. Acidyo's point about people leaving for X misses the nuance — most successful Hive creators I see use both, just for different layers of the workflow.

https://youtu.be/yqJOY0SOcwk?si=PDKW7jFazkL0L-n1
Some believers believe that reincarnation is a way which a person is reborn again into this world in another body. The Bible does not support the idea of reincarnation. Scripture teaches that human beings live once, die, and then face judgment before God. 

>Hebrews 9:27 says, “And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.” 


The Bible teaches resurrection instead of reincarnation. Jesus Christ spoke about eternal life through faith in Him, where believers will be raised again by God, not reborn as another person on earth. 

>John 11:25, Jesus said, “I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.”

title.title: Architectural Masterpiece Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque
title.body: > Today, I want to share our last visit to the Grand Mosque in Muscat, Oman. It stands as a symbol of rich Islamic culture, showcasing a contemporary architectural style that beautifully blends Omani, Persian, Central Asian, and Indian Mughal influences. Hello, friends, world travelers, and community! I hope you are all doing well and enjoying quality time with your loved ones. Last winter, while traveling from Northern Europe to India, we flew with Oman Air. Given the dark winter nights and challenging weather, the timing of our flights worked well for us. However, we didn’t realize until last week that we had a long layover at Muscat Airport. We arrived early in the morning, around 5 o'clock, and spent about two hours discussing visa and hotel options at the service counter. Once we completed all the necessary procedures, we hired a taxi to take us to our hotel, eager to relax and explore what we missed at our last visit to the city of Muscat. The road from the airport passes by the Qaboos Grand Mosque, which we didn’t have time to visit on our last trip. After discussing with the taxi driver(he was a good guide as well), we decided to visit the mosque before heading to the hotel since it is open to tourists from 8 AM to 11 AM. The entry is free.

> We arrived exactly at opening time, and the crowds were manageable, with only a few foreign groups present. It was a huge parking area. Very few vehicles, a clean and neat place, together with flowers and trees.
> However, I was stopped by security because my short scarf did not meet the requirements for entry. After some discussion about how to gain access to the mosque,
> I ended up renting a scarf from a tourist souvenir shop to cover my head and enter the premises.

> The area is soo beautiful stared with a nice, colorful garden, small fountains, lots of green trees, and extremely clean. According to the information, the total site span is ca 102 acres. and the mosque structure with the surrounding complex is ca.10 acres.

>Outer view of mosque. The mosque is made of different kinds of stone, but mainly uses sandstone and polished marble from India, imported around 300,000 tons. The doors, windows, and all decorative interior elements were made of glass and wood, precious stones, and metal like gold. The total capacity of the mosque is up to 20,000 worshipers. That includes 750 in the women's prayer hall. 6,500 in the men's prayer hall, and the pavilion of the garden carries 8,000.
> The main minaret from distance. It The mosque is surrounded by five minarets/towers. The main tower is around 90 meters tall. The other four are almost half the size of the main tower.
> The entrance to the mosque. After entering these arches, we came into the main structure
> Before I just turned around from the stairs and clicked this beautiful view of the area.
> The beautiful hand-carved wooden door made of precious teak, we can see many like this all around.
> The wooden ceiling, hand-carved panels richly decorated with calligraphy and arabesques, reflects traditional Omani ceilings and also serves as acoustic diffusers to improve sound quality.

> The main door to the women's prayer hall. An instruction board outlines the rules and regulations for the prayer hall. The space has a 14-carat gold clock and crystal chandeliers, along with simple yet elegant teak wood furnishings. It is attractive, but very simple compared to the men's prayer room.
> Walking through the archway is very nice. We can see many different designs with information about which architectural style and classifications of material.
> From here, I tried to cover the whole mosque.
> Another archway/corridor brings us to the washrooms for women and men.
> Some places are made for ritual cleansing before prayers.
> The main tower/minaret from inside the mosque. After entering the archway, the men's prayer hall is located.
> Entering the Main prayer hall is amazing; it brings us into another world. Everything is just wow. See this tall, hand-carved teak-wood door. Praiseworthy effort.

> Here is the world's biggest carpet up until 2018, hand-woven by 600 workers in three years quiet difficult task.1.7 billion knots is unbelievable. The carpet covered the entire prayer hall, which is 74x74 meters.

> The hall is very quiet, clean, and beautifully arranged. The main area is covered with a prayer carpet divided into individual prayer spots. To maintain the sanctity of the space, a blue barrier tape protects the prayer area, preventing visitors from stepping on the carpet.

> The 50-meter-high central beautiful dome has a geometric and floral design with Arabic calligraphy that beautifully fuses traditional Omani, Persian, and Islamic artistic styles to represent the heavens.
> And the world's largest Swarovski crystal chandelier, which contains over 600,000 crystals and is heavily gilded with 24-karat gold. It weighs around 8 tons. hanging in the center of the main dome.
> Beautiful mosaic work on walls and around the arches. Some smaller matching chandeliers are hanging in the hall. Everything is amazing.

> These corridors feature pointed and intricately decorated archways and stretch for hundreds of meters to encompass the central courtyards and prayer halls. Along with beautiful open places for worshipers during Ramadan or Friday prayers. There are more entrances and a big open place. I like how the place is clean and peaceful.

> Behind the arch, the main taller minaret looks incredible. There is lots more to talk about this Grand Mosque, which is the Islamic culture, together with beautiful architecture and art, makes it very special. The experience is unforgettable. Thank you for stopping by. All images are taken by me, and a few I used from my husband's camera. Before composing the article, I used information from our guide (taxi driver). I went through several websites to collect more information. Please do not use any photos from this post without my permission. [//]:# ([//]:# (!worldmappin 23.58381 lat 58.38864 long d3scr))

title.body:
> Hello friends, how are you? Happy start to the week! Today I'll share a delicious vanilla cake recipe, perfect for afternoon snacks. >Hola amigos como estan? feliz inicio de semana, hoy les compartire un rico bizcocho de vainilla especial para las meriendas.

![1000997342.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1000997342.jpg)

> 🍒 **Ingredients:** 1-1/2 cups sugar. 150 grams margarine. 3 eggs. 2-1/2 cups all-purpose flour. 1 tablespoon vanilla extract. 1 teaspoon baking powder. 1/2 teaspoon baking soda. 1 cup milk. >🍒 **Ingredientes:** >1-1/2 taza de azucar. 150 grms de margarina. 3 huevos. 2-1/2 taza de harina de trigo. 1 cucharada de vainilla. 1 cucharadita polvo royal. 1/2 cucharadita bicarbonato. 1 taza leche liquida.

![1000997266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maricrochets/1000997266.jpg)

> 🍒 **Preparation:** Measure and prepare all the ingredients, grease a baking pan, and set aside. In the bowl of a mixer, cream together the margarine and sugar until light and fluffy. Then, add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add the vanilla to the milk, and sift together the baking powder, baking soda, and all-purpose flour. Using a hand whisk, alternately mix the flour and milk until fully incorporated. The batter should be thin. Pour it into the prepared pan and bake. Baking time and volume will vary depending on your oven. Thank you so much for sharing! Best wishes. 🫂🫂🙏🏻🙏🏻 >🍒 **Preparacion:** >Medimos y preparamos todos los ingredientes, engrasamos un molde para horrno y reservamos. >En el bol de la batidora colocamos la margarina con el azucar y la cremamos un poco, luego vamos agregando los huevos uno a uno y batirlos bien, la vainilla la agregamos a la leche y el polvo royal y el bicarnonato lo cernimos junto con la harina de trigo. >Con un batidor de mano mezclamos la harina y la leche alternada hasta consumilas, obtenemos una mezcla no muy espesa y la agregamos en molde que ya tenemos preparado y llevamos a hornear, el tiempo y volumen depende de cada horno. title.body:
> Hola amigos de @hivemargarita ¿Cómo están todos? Siempre es un gusto para mí, compartir con ustedes y ser parte de esta familia tan bonita que resalta a nuestra hermosa isla de Margarita. Gracias por todo lo que hacen. Este 2026 tuve la alegría de participar por segundo año consecutivo en la Global Pizza Party, una celebración mundial organizada por PizzaDAO que une a personas de todas partes del mundo para compartir, aprender y disfrutar. Me alegra mucho que esta actividad también se realice aquí, en la isla de Margarita, porque demuestra que nuestra comunidad está presente y activa con iniciativas globales. El Pizza Party se celebra alrededor del 22 de mayo, fecha conocida como el Bitcoin Pizza Day, que recuerda la primera compra registrada con Bitcoin, dos pizzas que marcaron un antes y un después, un momento histórico en el mundo de las monedas digitales. Es una fecha simbólica que une a quienes creemos en la tecnología y la innovación. El año pasado organizamos el evento entre varios miembros de Hive Margarita, pero este año por diferentes circunstancias, no pudimos coordinarlo. Aun así, gracias a un amigo con quien he coincidido en actividades de criptomonedas, supe que él sí iba a llevar adelante la actividad. Me uní con mucho gusto e invité a @rlathulerie, quien a su vez invitó a @emilypino y @denissemata. Así terminamos formando un pequeño equipo de apoyo que trabajó con mucha disposición y cariño. La actividad se realizó en el restaurante Uvas Beach, en Pampatar, Municipio Maneiro, desde las 6:00pm hasta las 10:00pm. Rosa y yo estuvimos en la entrada colocando los brazaletes y guiando a las personas hacia la estación donde recibían sus tickets de pizza y bebida. Aunque pasamos casi toda la tarde allí, desde arriba podíamos ver lo animado y bonito que estaba todo. El ambiente fue realmente especial, a la orilla de la playa, la brisa del mar y ese toque mágico que solo Margarita tiene. A pesar del calor, la energía del evento era increíble. Hubo emprendedores locales, patrocinantes, sorteos, música y muchas personas compartiendo, conversando sobre tecnología, comunidad y el futuro digital. Me llena de orgullo que la isla de Margarita forme parte de esta actividad mundial y más aún haber contribuido como parte del equipo organizador. Son experiencias que unen, que fortalecen a la comunidad y que nos recuerdan que desde nuestra isla también podemos ser parte de iniciativas globales. Para mí, haber participado nuevamente es un honor y una alegría enorme. A ustedes gracias por leer mi post y apoyarme. Saludos y Bendiciones. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRsPDEA52MEU3VbkNsi5MHo3bGCbCyzhpWLdzwMJHVzXk/separadores_28.png)
Hello, friends at @hivemargarita! How is everyone doing? It’s always a pleasure for me to connect with you and be part of this wonderful family that showcases our beautiful island of Margarita. Thank you for everything you do. This year, 2026, I had the pleasure of participating for the second consecutive year in the Global Pizza Party, a worldwide celebration organized by PizzaDAO that brings people from all over the world together to share, learn, and enjoy. I’m so happy that this event is also taking place here on Margarita Island, because it shows that our community is present and active in global initiatives. The Pizza Party is held around May 22, a date known as Bitcoin Pizza Day, which commemorates the first recorded purchase made with Bitcoin—two pizzas that marked a turning point, a historic moment in the world of digital currencies. It is a symbolic date that unites those of us who believe in technology and innovation. Last year, several members of Hive Margarita organized the event, but this year, due to various circumstances, we weren’t able to coordinate it. Even so, thanks to a friend I’ve met through cryptocurrency activities, I learned that he was going to go ahead with the event. I gladly joined in and invited @rlathulerie, who in turn invited @emilypino and @denissemata. That’s how we ended up forming a small support team that worked with great enthusiasm and dedication. The event took place at Uvas Beach in Pampatar, from 6:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. Rosa and I were at the entrance handing out wristbands and guiding people to the station where they received their pizza and drink tickets. Although we spent almost the entire afternoon there, from up above we could see how lively and beautiful everything was. The atmosphere was truly special—right on the beach, with the sea breeze and that magical touch that only Margarita has. Despite the heat, the energy at the event was incredible. There were local entrepreneurs, sponsors, raffles, music, and lots of people connecting and talking about technology, community, and the digital future. It fills me with pride that Margarita Island is part of this global event, and even more so to have contributed as part of the organizing team. These are experiences that bring us together, strengthen the community, and remind us that from our island, we too can be part of global initiatives. For me, participating again is an honor and a huge joy. Thank you all for reading my post and supporting me. Greetings and blessings.

title.title: Laïko Mix
title.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Laïko Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/3e51bb4a-f7b7-40ee-8e2d-bff8f3fcc59d.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/18Zra65zjEjSbTh68NiNPr) 
 
 El Laïko no nació en un estudio de grabación pulcro, sino que emergió del humo denso de las tabernas y los barrios populares de Atenas y El Pireo, arraigado profundamente en la experiencia cotidiana de la clase trabajadora griega. Sus orígenes se entrelazan indisolublemente con el Rembetiko, esa música de los marginados y los exiliados que llegó a Grecia tras el intercambio de poblaciones de 1923, trayendo consigo las melodías melancólicas de Asia Menor. Sin embargo, mientras el Rembetiko conservaba una cierta crudeza bohemia y una instrumentación más reducida, el Laïko comenzó a tomar forma distinta a medida que la sociedad griega se urbanizaba y buscaba nuevas formas de expresión que reflejaran tanto la nostalgia por lo perdido como la dureza de la vida moderna.

Durante las décadas de 1950 y 1960, el género experimentó una transformación crucial. Los compositores empezaron a incorporar instrumentos occidentales, como el violín, el acordeón y, más tarde, la guitarra eléctrica y los teclados, suavizando las aristas más ásperas del estilo anterior para hacerlo más accesible al gran público. Figuras como Stelios Kazantzidis y Grigoris Bithikotis se convirtieron en las voces emblemáticas de esta era, interpretando letras que hablaban de amor no correspondido, pobreza, emigración y destino, temas que resonaban con fuerza en el corazón de una nación que aún se recuperaba de la guerra civil y la ocupación. La voz del cantante laïko no buscaba la perfección técnica académica, sino la autenticidad emocional, a menudo cargada de ese \

o dolor profundo que define tanta de la música balcánica y mediterránea oriental.\r\n\r\nLa evolución del género no fue lineal ni estuvo exenta de tensiones. Hubo un periodo en el que la industria discográfica intentó comercializar el sonido, creando lo que algunos puristas llamaron \

, más cercano a la canción pop europea pero manteniendo la estructura rítmica y melódica tradicional. Aun así, la esencia del género resistió. La introducción del bouzouki eléctrico y la ampliación de la orquestación permitieron que el Laïko llenara grandes salas de baile, convirtiéndose en la banda sonora obligatoria de bodas, bautizos y celebraciones familiares. No era solo música para escuchar, sino para bailar, específicamente el zeibekiko y el hasapiko, danzas que requieren una conexión casi física con el ritmo y la letra.

Con el paso de los años, el Laïko ha demostrado una capacidad notable para absorber influencias externas sin perder su identidad nuclear. En las décadas posteriores, se fusionó con elementos del rock, la disco e incluso la electrónica, dando lugar a subgéneros híbridos que mantienen viva la llama de la tradición mientras hablan el lenguaje musical del presente. Los nuevos intérpretes continúan explorando las mismas heridas humanas que sus predecesores, aunque con una producción más sofisticada. Lo que permanece inalterable es la función social de esta música: actúa como un espejo colectivo donde la gente reconoce sus propias luchas y alegrías. No se trata simplemente de una categoría estilística, sino de un fenómeno cultural vivo que respira con la ciudad, adaptándose a los tiempos pero negándose a olvidar sus raíces en el dolor y la resistencia de la gente común. La persistencia del Laïko radica en esa honestidad brutal, en la capacidad de convertir el sufrimiento individual en una experiencia compartida y catártica bajo la luz tenue de una pista de baile.

La huella del Laïko trasciende los límites del pentagrama para impregnar la narrativa visual y literaria de Grecia, actuando como un hilo conductor que une la estética con la emoción colectiva. En el cine, especialmente durante la época dorada de la producción fílmica griega entre los años cincuenta y setenta, la música no era un mero acompañamiento, sino un personaje más. Directores como Giannis Dalianidis o Finos Film integraban las canciones laïko en tramas que reflejaban la división de clases, el choque entre lo rural y lo urbano, y las aspiraciones de una sociedad en cambio. Las escenas de tabernas, con el humo del cigarrillo flotando sobre las mesas mientras el bouzouki lloraba una melodía, se convirtieron en iconos visuales que definieron una era, estableciendo una atmósfera de nostalgia y realismo social que el espectador reconocía instantáneamente.

Esta conexión cinematográfica alimentó a su vez la literatura contemporánea. Autores griegos comenzaron a incorporar la jerga, los ritmos y la filosofía del Laïko en sus obras, utilizando la música como metáfora de la condición humana. La letra de una canción laïko, con su poesía directa y desgarradora, resonaba en las novelas que exploraban la vida en los barrios marginales de Atenas. La narrativa literaria adoptó esa cualidad oral y confesional, donde el destino y el amor fatalista eran temas centrales, reflejando la misma sensibilidad que predominaba en las composiciones musicales. No era extraño encontrar referencias a cantantes legendarios o versos completos entrelazados en la prosa, sirviendo como anclajes emocionales para los personajes que navegaban por la complejidad de la vida moderna griega.

En el ámbito de la moda, la estética asociada al Laïko creó un estilo distintivo que mezclaba la elegancia tradicional con una cierta rebeldía urbana. Los hombres que frecuentaban los centros nocturnos donde se tocaba este género adoptaron un look caracterizado por camisas abiertas, pantalones de corte amplio y accesorios llamativos, proyectando una imagen de masculinidad vulnerable pero orgullosa. Las mujeres, por su parte, abrazaron vestidos que permitían el movimiento fluido necesario para las danzas tradicionales, a menudo adornados con detalles que capturaban la luz de los escenarios. Esta indumentaria no era solo ropa, sino una declaración de identidad cultural, una forma de vestir que comunicaba pertenencia a un grupo social específico y una actitud frente a la vida marcada por la pasión y la expresividad.

La influencia del Laïko en otros estilos musicales es igualmente profunda y duradera. Su estructura melódica y sus progresiones armónicas han sido absorbidas por el pop griego moderno, creando un puente entre la tradición y la contemporaneidad. Artistas de rock y indie han sampleado ritmos de zeibekiko o han utilizado la escala dromos, típica del Laïko, para añadir una capa de profundidad emocional a sus composiciones. Incluso en la música electrónica y el dance, productores internacionales han encontrado en los lamentos del bouzouki y la intensidad vocal del Laïko una fuente de inspiración para crear fusiones que respetan la raíz mientras exploran nuevos territorios sonoros. Esta permeabilidad demuestra que el Laïko no es una reliquia estática, sino un lenguaje musical vivo que continúa dialogando con otras formas de expresión, enriqueciendo el panorama cultural global con su capacidad única para transformar el dolor en belleza compartida.

El Laïko se erige como un pilar fundamental de la identidad griega moderna, funcionando mucho más allá de una simple categoría musical para convertirse en un archivo vivo de la memoria colectiva. No se trata únicamente de melodías que se escuchan, sino de un código emocional compartido que ha permitido a generaciones enteras procesar traumas históricos, migraciones forzadas y transformaciones sociales aceleradas. En este sentido, el género actúa como un mecanismo de resistencia cultural, preservando la lengua, los modismos y las narrativas populares frente a la homogeneización global. Cada vez que suena un bouzouki en una celebración o en un momento de duelo, se reactiva un vínculo ancestral que conecta al individuo con su comunidad, recordándole que sus experiencias personales de pérdida, amor o alegría forman parte de un tejido social más amplio y resiliente.

Este hito cultural se manifiesta con particular fuerza en la forma en que estructura el tiempo social y los rituales cotidianos. El Laïko marca los ciclos de la vida griega, desde los bautizos hasta los funerales, pasando por las bodas y las fiestas patronales, donde la música dicta el ritmo de la interacción humana. No es un espectáculo pasivo; exige participación. La danza, ya sea el zeibekiko solitario e introspectivo o el hasapiko communal, sirve como una válvula de escape física y espiritual, permitiendo la catarsis a través del movimiento. Esta dimensión performativa transforma espacios ordinarios en lugares sagrados de expresión colectiva, donde las jerarquías sociales se difuminan y la empatía fluye libremente entre los presentes.

Además, el Laïko ha demostrado una capacidad extraordinaria para adaptarse sin perder su esencia, lo que le ha permitido sobrevivir a cambios políticos drásticos, dictaduras y crisis económicas. Durante periodos de censura o represión, las letras codificadas y las metáforas musicales ofrecieron un lenguaje subterráneo para expresar disidencia y solidaridad. Esta dualidad entre lo popular y lo político, entre el entretenimiento y la protesta sutil, consolidó su estatus como un artefacto cultural indispensable. Hoy, mientras las nuevas generaciones reinterpretan estos sonidos mediante fusiones digitales y experimentaciones vanguardistas, el núcleo del Laïko permanece intacto: la necesidad humana de dar voz al sufrimiento y celebrarlo juntos, afirmando la vida frente a la adversidad. Su legado no reside solo en las grabaciones archivadas, sino en la continuidad de esa práctica social que mantiene viva la conciencia histórica y emocional de un pueblo.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental.

title.title: Sweetness with a Purpose
title.body:
Some people speak so sweetly that you instantly feel connected to them.
Their words, their attitude, and their fake care seem so genuine that you start considering them your own. But time has a strange way of revealing the truth hidden behind every face.

I have met many people in my life who only come close when they need something.
Morning and evening messages, asking how you are, giving compliments, making promises of support — everything feels real until their purpose is fulfilled. Once they get what they want, their behavior slowly changes. The attention fades, the warmth disappears, and the connection no longer feels the same.

At first, it used to hurt me a lot.
I would wonder if maybe the problem was in me, or maybe I was just bad at understanding people. But with time, I realized that not everyone builds relationships from the heart. Some people only stay as long as they are benefiting from you. The moment the benefit ends, the relationship ends too.

I once had a friend who always stayed around me.
He would contact me over the smallest things, talk about big dreams, and make me feel like he truly cared about me. But one day, when I actually needed him, he disappeared completely. No call, no message, not even a simple question asking if I was okay. That day felt strange and heavy. When someone you truly trust suddenly changes, even silence starts to feel loud.

Slowly, I learned one important thing:
not everyone who speaks sweetly is sincere. Real people are the ones who stay beside you during hard times, whether there is any benefit for them or not. The rest only come close for temporary comfort or personal gain.

These days, I do not let people into my heart too quickly.
First, I give them time. I observe their behavior and try to understand their intentions. Words have become very cheap nowadays, but sincerity is still rare and expensive.

Life has taught me that not every changing person is evil; some people simply reveal their real face with time. And maybe that is better, because recognizing fake people early can save you from bigger pain later.

Now, I prefer greeting such friends from a distance…
because the heart does not have the strength to break again and again.

title.body: Bitcoin, nonostante le guerre anti-cripto scatenate da Bruxelles, dalla Cina, dalla Bolivia, dalla Nigeria (e l'elenco è lungo), occupa una posizione privilegiata tra le *monete alternative*. Ma non così purtroppo per le altcoin (eccezion fatta per ethereum e pochi altri progetti un minimo *ragguardevoli*) e men che meno per i token di *seconda linea* o addirittura memecoin. Bitcoin ora ha la stessa valenza degli stock quotati in borsa, ma lo stesso destino non è toccato neppure a ethereum, la regina delle altcoin. Stable coin discorso a sè, invece. Resta comunque il fatto che in parecchi paesi in cui vige il ban totale neppure bitcoin ha senso (in Bolivia, tra l'altro, la detenzione di cripto è pure criminalizzata). A che serve accumulare valute non spendibili? Parlando di paesi del quarto mondo in cui si fa fatica (e spesso nemmeno si riesce) a procurarsi tre pasti al giorno, puoi esserti intascato pure un bitcoin per intero, ma se non puoi scambiarlo con la tua cena ha la stessa utilità di un soprammobile decorativo in un'officina meccanica. Purtroppo in parecchi paesi del mondo (specie del sud) il contante ha tutt'altro che perso la guerra (e dove l'ha persa è stato sostituito da pagamenti elettronici in moneta FIAT tracciabili immediatamente dalle Agenzie delle Entrate locali come sta avvenendo nel mio paese).

title.body:
: Why Standing Up Makes These Meatballs Taste 100x Better!

### 🇬🇧 Review by Sakol, The Food Storyteller

**What is up, my hungry friends!** Sakol is back on the streets, and today we are ditching the chairs! That’s right, put your seating arrangements on hold because we are diving headfirst into one of Thailand’s most iconic and electrifying street food experiences: **\

** (Standing Meatballs)!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRVJbsY13YrX4yotgZgajwVwaWNfvDxhRhTkWu8hoLa4Z/image.png)


If you think a meatball is just a meatball, you have never stood in front of a sizzling cart with a bamboo skewer in your hand. Let me paint this delicious picture for you:

* **The Vibe is Electric:** Imagine standing shoulder-to-shoulder with locals around a small cart. The golden oil is bubbling, the air smells like sweet tamarind and fried goodness, and the energy is just pure, fast-paced fun! You pick, you dip, you eat. It’s an interactive sport!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZgg2UfDDFFYgizL1kQXL7d7mU1srq6ayYUzYYZqcn75J/image.png)


* **The Golden Bite:** These aren't your average soft meatballs. Oh no! They are deep-fried to a glorious, crispy golden-brown on the outside, while staying incredibly bouncy and juicy on the inside. Every bite gives you that satisfying **\

** before releasing the savory flavor.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX65nNF85rA9zAFSsq8fxheuvTUdDAyGBGCJ7wMJ9eU5K/image.png)


* **The Magic Sauce:** This is the game-changer! The sauce is a thick, glossy masterpiece of roasted chili, sweet palm sugar, and tangy tamarind. It coats the meatballs perfectly. You drizzle this thick lava over your skewer, take a bite, and your brain just explodes with the sweet, sour, and spicy symphony!
* **The Veggie Chaser:** To balance the richness, you grab a handful of fresh, crunchy cabbage and cucumbers right from the cart. It cools your palate just enough so you can grab another skewer... and another... and another!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPiVPUogAvcpMaNMVdd9EcnjxBp6cGrEFESb12Lo7Szt9/image.png)


**Sakol’s Verdict:** There is an unexplainable magic that happens when you eat these standing up. It’s casual, it’s chaotic, and it is **outrageously delicious!** You blink, and suddenly you have 15 empty skewers in your hand. An absolute must-try!

title.title: Robbing a bank with my team
title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779712074815-592c3706a4feed4d.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/98af4db9)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/98af4db9)


---

Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also very well by the grace of God. So friends, today I will introduce you to a very nice and interesting game. The name of the game is Armed Heist. In this game, you basically have to rob a bank and loot the money there through bank robbery and escape from there.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPLFV44tA4Dbjc3ZEMEaZN7UBxUmpQBL9DpKV8uYrWt6b/img_3234.jpg)

In armed heist,your opponent will be the police.You have to fight against those police officers with guns, that is, shoot them, kill them, loot money from there and escape. This is the rule of this game, and sometimes you will need a lot of time to collect that money, until then you have to fight against the police officers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdnRTyhxJwSQR9RaYzNSVZ2MSuV4E1QY5BFDXH134JS2o/img_3240.jpg)

So every moment here is very challenging and exciting because the police will suddenly come and you will have to fight your way out of there with your intelligence. In this game, you will be given a team with which you will go to rob a bank.The game features numerous missions and robbery maps, each with its own unique challenges.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUg4doEXNjM4UPokwQVv1hUzp9ieeXTaAAgBqc6w23iyE/img_3237.jpg)

And sometimes it takes time to collect the money to loot here, and you can't do it alone. The members in your team will do one, and you will do one, and you will have to collect the money this way.Basically, there is a drilling process to collect money from the bank. You have to complete that process and loot the money.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSkioMCf6sWKJmoRVzvm1jm8mBC9czNzWsr6ypWwvP2yW/img_3238.jpg)

Sometimes you have to quickly loot money and escape, and sometimes you have to engage in intense gunfights with heavily armed police. Players can use a variety of weapons, such as assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, and pistols. There is also the ability to customize weapons, which allows you to add skins, silencers, and various attachments.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKjwMMDuDbeS9PLTgQqQ3xDZZ57QeTcUCR3gB98uh64J/img_3239.jpg)

The most fun and interesting aspect of it is its graphics and excellent character build-up. Each character is portrayed so beautifully that it seems completely realistic and real.Also, the gun sound system, then the police car sound, the kind of sound system that has an allergy system in the bank, everything is very extraordinary and realistic.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFZYEshSzaD1XcJ6GWNg58XpJTsTyCCNBircowPw3Y6h/img_3235.jpg)

Armed Heist can be played in two modes, online and offline. It is the best choice for those who love to play such aggressive and shooting games.And this game is basically a third-person shooting game.Then if you want, you can play this game at least once. I personally like this game very much.

👉Image and thumbnail source: Captured by me during the gameplay.

Thanks for watching my video.

@likhon420

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/98af4db9)

title.title: Spring means revival
title.body:
/>

Spring means revival. Revival of everything that was once taken away from us, but now, finally, the period of loss is over. The phase of trauma is gone. My heart is filled with new hopes and dreams. A new sense of direction and a new feeling of power and a great sense of calm and joy.

For me, spring was the time when I got out of depression a couple of years ago.

The spring of my life was full of new aspirations and the beginning of a new era. The period in which I recovered and healed from my traumatic past injuries and saw the light in the darkness.

My mom used to say that there is a morning after every night, and I say that there is a spring after every autumn. We just need to be patient enough to experience a renewed sense of control in our lives.

A new beginning and a feeling of liveliness where the decayed emotions transform into the fresh new soul with beautiful ideas to work on yourself. This is the way life works.

title.body: A tanto, è necessario aggiungere che non vivete in un paese anglosassone e di conseguenza, perfino la vendita di anche 100 copie è un traguardo ragguardevole. Con l'aggravante, anzi due aggravanti, che l'italiano medio non compra opere, ma compra grandi nomi (dove per grandi qui si intende famosi o comunque popolari ed ecco il motivo per cui Fedez ha venduto, ma scommetterei il collo su una ghigliottina bene affilata senza alcun timore di perderlo che se lo *stessissimo* titolo fosse stato pubblicato da Pinco Pallo Qualunque sconosciutissimo perfino ai media della borgata di paese non avrebbe venduto nemmeno mezza copia **per le vie tradizionali**) più l'ulteriore aggravante che sin dal terzo millennio, specie dal 2010 in avanti, l'italiano medio **non legge più**. O meglio, preferisce leggere (come si affermava in un blog a tema nel quale mi ero imbattuta tempo fa) come si fa a pulire un cesso piuttosto che *perdere tempo* con letture creative. Ai tempi in cui andavo a scuola (ma erano i *magici* anni ottanta e novanta), l'abitudine a leggere ci veniva inculcata dalle stesse scuole (per quanto pietose fossero e seguitano a essere le scuole pubbliche italiane). A ogni fine anno scolastico e se non ricordo male pure per Natale, ci veniva stilato un elenco di grandi classici tra i quali sceglierne sei o sette. Per non parlare poi delle antologie riportanti stralci di queste opere (e di più moderne, all'insegna del realismo trasmesso sotto forma di favola) che se eri un minimo secchione (ai miei tempi si diceva così, lol, oggi nerd) non vedevi l'ora di accaparrarti l'opera completa. Fu così che la mia libreria di casa si riempì presto di *Orgoglio e pregiudizio* (zia Jane è la mia preferita, lol!), *Madame Bovary, Marcovaldo ovvero le stagioni in città, Poirot sul Nilo* (sempre stata appassionata di gialli), tra i millemila. Ma a partire dal 2010 cominciavo ad ascoltare tra la mia cerchia di amici che arrivavano a casa con la schiena a pezzi dopo una giornata di lavoro massacrante (ricordando che i tagli selvaggi al personale sia nel pubblico che nel privato hanno fatto diventare i doppi turni la norma rispetto agli anni ottanta e novanta) e allora volevano solo andare a dormire. Le letture *estemporanee* sono rimaste relegate dunque ai tempi delle scuole, quando hai ancora i genitori che ti allacciano pure le scarpe. Quando ancora hive *e cugini* erano pura fantascienza, nella mia cerchia di amici avevano comprato quasi tutti il mio primo giallo (*Il bibliotecario francese*, che allora si trovava su Google Play Books), ma solo uno, che al momento era disoccupato, era riuscito a leggerlo tutto. Poi nel 2020 ho conosciuto *publish0x* ed è stata tutt'altra storia (anzi, tra il 2028 e il 2019 mi trovavo su camTV, una piattaforma che ricordava hive, ma purtroppo presto fallita, trascinandosi pure a fondo le migliaia di euro degli investitori che avevano comprato account premium: ovviamente c'ero stata *aggratiss* dal primo all'ultimo giorno). Non ho mai speso un solo centesimo per pubblicare, ovunque fosse (ovviamente sempre in formato elettronico), date le premesse. Ricordando che pure che in mancanza di una cittadinanza *gringa*, la vita di uno scrittore è dura. E in America latina è pure peggio. La popolazione è composta da pessimi lettori che arrivano alla terza pagina di un libro e già sono stremati. Non è proprio aria. Fuori *terre gringhe*, quel po' che si legge, è di preferenza di derivazione *anglo* e in quest'ultimo caso si compra pure *monnezza* perchè la *monnezza* *made in USA* è più figa e nobile del trattato filosofico scritto da *Fulano de Tal* o *Zé-ninguém*.

One thing life has taught me is that confidence doesn’t appear overnight.

It grows little by little.

It grows when you take chances, when you learn from mistakes, when you keep moving forward even when things don't go exactly as planned.

There were times when I felt unsure about myself and my future. But every challenge taught me something valuable. Every sale, every customer, every small victory helped me become stronger.

Today, I still have goals I want to reach.

I still want to grow my business.
I still want more freedom.
I still want to create a better future for myself.

But instead of worrying about how far I have left to go, I’m learning to appreciate how far I’ve already come.

Life isn't perfect, and neither am I.

But I'm proud of the woman I'm becoming. 💖

title.title: The alibi
title.body: Greg had just finished work at the office. Him and his colleague, Ashley were the only ones left in the office. It was 5pm. Greg packed his things and made his way out of the office.\n\n\

Greg said. Greg decided to branch at a bar to just have some drinks and relax. He had been overwhelmed with stress that day and he just felt he needed to unwind. He ordered some drinks and he was given a receipt. He casually put the receipt in the pocket of his coat. When he was done with his drinks, he made his way home. When he got to his door and tried to open it, he heard police sirens. Suddenly, a police car stopped in front of his house and police officers came out. Their faces looked very serious.

the police man said.

Greg was in shock. His coat fell from his hand. He couldn't believe what he just heard.

Greg quietly got into the police car and went with them to the police station.

When he got to the police station, Greg was led to the room where he would be questioned. Suddenly a strange looking man walked in. It was obvious the man was going to interrogate Greg.

\

The man asked.

Greg thought for a while.

\

the man replied.

Within a few minutes, the coat was recovered and given to Greg.

Greg immediately searched the pocket and found the receipt. He gave it to the man immediately. The man took it out of the room and came back a few minutes later.

\

.

Greg got home that night. He went to the kitchen. Then he opened the kitchen counter to bring out a knife covered in blood. Greg had in fact killed Ashley, and he tried to cover his tracks by hiding the murder weapon, and going to the bar to get an alibi.  
The plan worked perfectly. He never liked Ashley, especially because of the fact that she took his job and he had to be relegated to a lesser role. Greg had a wicked heart and he did a good job of masking it.

As he held the knife in the kitchen, wanting to clean it, the police broke in.

\

said the police.

Greg was startled, and when he saw that he was surrounded, he surrendered. The police handcuffed him and he was taken to the station to be prosecuted. The murder weapon was secured to be used as evidence in his prosecution.

The police let him go earlier because they wanted stronger evidence that he committed the crime, so they released him just so that he would lead them to concrete evidence. Now he had been caught and he would definitely spend the rest of his life behind bars.

description.body:
Hello there! It is great to see you again. For now, we have a nice group of hosts, so no need of any new application. For the next hangout, we will have no one as invited host. Also, don't forget that 3 posts from our members who participate in the new hangout will be considered for curations Last session, we discussed the topic: --- ### **MENTAL STRESS OR PHYSICAL STRESS?** --- Last week, we discussed in general about health and the different types of health. Mental and physical health are connected to each other, but play different roles in our lives. The community was very interested and provided some good insights about the topic, especially with mental health, which sometimes suffers from a stigma in society. We all agreed how important is to have a mind at peace that is mostly affected by our traumas from youth, and it continues to be damaged by our daily life in society. Physical health is equally important, so the community also agreed that sometimes we are focused on our daily routine and just exclude it from our lives. We agreed that it is also important to implement some tasks that would improve health in general. --- **THIS WEEK'S TOPIC:** --- ##
Could Another Pandemic Happen Again?
--- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23xyteUzrnFQV3o3XWSH2VM5kksrTZyR4VHkYof4ixuoFy1c1L4UJoKr8zoMu4ZU9in3h.png) We all suffered with the COVID-19 pandemic between 2020 and 2023, when it was declared as over. Many big events were cancelled and we changed our routines, avoiding social interaction. After returning to a regular routine, we see again the phantom of other possible pandemics that can menace our world. The current hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks look like affecting small populations around the world but some of us start to fear that it is possible to see another pandemic in the near future. **Discussion Questions:** -Do you believe love alone is enough to sustain a relationship today?
