description.title: What a Cliffhanger!!! I Watched Kaijuu No. 8 S1 and S2...
description.body: It's been ages since I posted something in this community. To be honest, I haven't really watched new anime recently... though I've been rewatching some of my favorites and I've been reading a bunch of Webtoons... XD However, I decided to tick off some items on my long and ever-growing list, and watched Kaijuu No. 8 yesterday and also finished the second season today. The first season has 12 episodes while the second one has 11.

> [IMAGE SOURCE](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt21975436/mediaviewer/rm2363115521/?ref_=ttmi_mi_22_4)
In this anime's setting, Japan is attacked by gigantic monsters called \
. To counter them, the country created a militarized organization, the Defense Force.

> [IMAGE SOURCE](https://gamerant.com/how-shonen-jump-ruined-its-own-formula/)
Mina and Kafka are childhood friends whose hometown was destroyed by kaijuu. They swore to become captains of the defense force and stand side-by-side in the future, defeating the monsters that once destroyed their home. However, only Mina succeeded, and Kafka ended up working for the organization that cleans up the remains of the slaughtered kaijuu.

> [IMAGE SOURCE](https://www.crunchyroll.com/news/features/2024/4/30/kaiju-no-8-episode-3-recap-summary?srsltid=AfmBOooYYTAvSZyOJBA81lWzVSb8OK_g6KMXlt-8KOe2hAJAdq1i4R8T)
In his job, he met Reno, who applied as a part-timer. Reno aims to join the defense force/ While in their job, they encountered a kaijuu... and Kafka, with his innate nature of protecting others despite not having enough skills, tried to protect Reno. They both survived the attack, but had to be sent to the hospital.

> [IMAGE SOURCE](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt38134221/mediaviewer/rm298169602/?ref_=tt_ov_i)
While recovering, Kafka was attacked by a small kaijuu and ended up being a humanoid kaijuu with strength equal to or greater than the monsters terrorizing the country. With this power, he and Reno applied to become part of the Defense Force... though they'd have to keep Kafka's kaijuu form a secret. XD ![BORDER canva-Photoroom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tegoshei/23tbH2Xeo3xCavYj1UkKGMfRrav9LM1Vu9YMDmhPCA4AWNw2nGB3FSyjv9yWhRuYmqiyW.png) The premise of this story is actually interesting, but I don't understand why people still live in an area where humongous monsters can attack at any time of the day. I don't think I could live normally unless I'm in the defense force. The story itself was good. It's quite similar to World Trigger, in my opinion, though the pacing is very different. Kaijuu No. 8 is too fast, but I don't mind since I enjoyed the fight scenes. However, it would be awesome if they showed more of the strategic team battles and military politics for the story to have more depth. Still, it's understandable since planning to counter a surprise attack is almost impossible. The characters in Kaijuu No. 8 work more on instinct, with support from people from the office/laboratory. XD Speaking of characters, I love them! *hahaha* It's fun to see an amusing blend of characters, from seasoned veterans, young prodigies, underdogs, and a 32-year-old guy who became a kaijuu. *LOL* I found two favorite characters in this anime, so far. I'm a sucker for gap characters, and I'm blessed with two of them. They're both very eccentric but are really powerful. One seems like a happy-go-lucky sadist, but is great with melee and swordfighting, while the other is a lazy otaku gamer, but is one of the strongest captains among the defense force. If you've watched this series, guess who my faves are based on my description above... :D Anyway... I finished two seasons in two days, and that's while working, so you can imagine how fast-paced the story is. *hahaha* But really, I hate the cliffhanger at the end of season 2. There's an upcoming movie, but I doubt I could wait, so after posting this, I'm going to start reading the manga. *haha* So, have you watched this one yet? What do you think? Comment down below... ^^ ![BORDER canva-Photoroom.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tegoshei/23tbH2Xeo3xCavYj1UkKGMfRrav9LM1Vu9YMDmhPCA4AWNw2nGB3FSyjv9yWhRuYmqiyW.png)

description.body:

Тема прощения всегда меня глубоко касалась.Ведь каждому из нас есть кого прощать  и есть за что прощать.А иногда нам самим нужно прощение,чтобы перестать себя винить в том ,что уже не в наших силах изменить.Прочитав книгу «Хижина» У.П.Янг я не раз к ней возвращалась.
‎
‎Вкратце:Папа с детьми едет на отдых.Пока двое старших катаются на лодке,младшая рисует картину на берегу.
‎
‎Ребята начинают раскачивать лодку,и один из них падает в воду.Папа ринулся спасать ребёнка в воде.В это время его младшую дочь похищает маньяк.Этот человек озабочен маленькими девочками.
‎
‎Наступают длительные поиски.И вот в заброшенной хижине,находят окровавленное платье доченьки.
‎
‎Я -мама,но мне даже и представить страшно,что испытывал её папа.Это «великая скорбь» полностью овладела его сердцем.Чувство вины,которое грузом легло на него,ненависть,жажда  мести ,непрощение.
‎
‎Однажды он получает письмо с приглашением посетить эту хижину.По пути он попадает в аварию.И здесь начинается самое интересное...
‎
‎Я продублирую Вам его разговор с Богом.
‎
‎«Папа, я никогда не смогу простить сукина сына, который убил мою Мисси. Если бы сегодня он был здесь, не знаю, что бы я с ним сделал. Я понимаю, что это неправильно, но я хочу, чтобы ему было больно, так же больно, как больно мне... Если я не могу добиться справедливости, я все равно жажду мести.
‎Я не в силах забыть того, что он сделал! Да разве такое возможно? взмолился Мак.
‎
‎Простить не значит забыть, Мак. Это значит перестать душить другого человека.
‎
‎Но мне казалось, ты забыл наши грехи?
‎
‎Мак, я Бог. Я ничего не забываю. Я знаю все. Поэтому  забыть для меня означает сознательно себя ограничить. Сын мой, голос Папы сделался совершенно спокойным, и Мак взглянул прямо в его глубокие карие глаза, благодаря  Иисусу больше нет закона, требующего, чтобы я держал в голове все ваши грехи. Они исчезают, когда речь заходит
‎о тебе и обо мне, они никак не влияют на наши с тобой взаимоотношения.
‎
‎Но ведь тот человек...
‎
‎Он тоже мой сын. Я хочу его спасти.
‎
‎И что потом? Я прощаю его ,и все у нас прекрасно? И мы становимся приятелями? 
‎
‎Прощение не означает начало взаимоотношений. Через Иисуса я простил всем людям все их прегрешения против меня, но лишь немногие выбрали взаимоотношения со Мной. Макензи, разве ты не понимаешь, что прощение-это невероятная сила, сила, которую ты разделяешь с нами, сила, которую Иисус даровал всем, в ком Он живет, чтобы стало возможным воссоединение? Когда Иисус простил тех, кто прибивал Его к кресту, они перестали быть в долгу перед ним и передо мной. В своих взаимоотношениях с теми людьми я никогда не вспомню, что они сделали, не стану стыдить их, не стану обвинять.
‎
‎Мак.Сомневаюсь, что смогу это сделать, тихо ответил.
‎
‎Но я хочу, чтобы у тебя получилось. Прощение нужно прежде всего тебе, прощающему, сказал Папа, оно осво бождает от того, что пожирает тебя живьем, что убивает в тебе радость и способность любить в полной мере и открыто. Думаешь, этот человек представляет, через какую боль и страдания ты прошел? Нет, он же упивается ими, как ничем другим. Разве тебе не хочется прекратить это? А чтобы это сделать, тебе придется освободить его от груза, который он несет, сознавая это или не сознавая. Когда ты решаешь простить другого, ты правильно любишь его.
‎
‎Я его не люблю.
‎
‎Сегодня не любишь. Но люблю я, Мак, и не того, каким он стал, но сломленного ребенка, которого изуродовала собственная боль. Я хочу помочь тебе обрести ту природу, которая черпает силу в любви и прощении, а не в ненависти.
‎
‎Значит, прощение не требует от меня притворяться, будто всего этого никогда не происходило?
‎
‎Разве ты смог бы? Ты простил вчера своего отца. Разве ты забудешь когда-нибудь о том, что он с тобой сделал?
‎
‎Сомневаюсь.
‎
‎Но теперь ты можешь любить его, несмотря на это. То, как он изменился, позволяет тебе любить его. Прощение нисколько не требует, чтобы ты верил человеку, которого прощаешь. Но если он признается и покается, то в твоей собственной душе свершится чудо, которое позволит тебе протянуть руку и начать строить между вами мост исцеления.И иногда, хотя сейчас подобное может показаться невероятным,эта дорога может привести тебя к чуду полностью  восстановленного доверия.
‎
‎Он закрыл глаза; слезы лились ручьями. Снова заполнили сознание воспоминания о Мисси, видения, где были раскрашенные картинки, карандаши и разорванное, окровавленное платье. Он плакал, пока не выплакал из себя всю темноту, всю тоску и опустошенность, пока не осталось ничего.
‎
‎Сидя с закрытыми глазами, раскачиваясь взад и вперед, он умолял:
‎
‎Помоги мне, Папа! Помоги! Что мне делать? Как я могу его простить?
‎
‎Скажи ему.
‎
‎Мак поднял голову, почти ожидая увидеть, что человек, которого он ни разу не встречал, стоит перед ним, но никого рядом не оказалось.
‎
‎Как, Папа?
‎
‎Просто скажи это вслух. В том, что утверждают мои дети, есть сила.
‎
‎Мак зашептал себе под нос, сначала вполсилы и запинаясь, но затем со все нарастающей уверенностью:
‎
‎Я прощаю тебя. Я прощаю тебя. Я прощаю тебя.
‎
‎Папа притянул его к себе.
‎
‎Макензи, ты такое счастье!
‎
‎Когда Мак успокоился, Папа подал ему платок, чтобы он утер лицо. Мак неуверенно поднял голову.
‎
‎Ого! - проговорил он сипло, пытаясь отыскать слово, способное описать то эмоциональное усилие, которое он только что совершил. Он ощущал себя живым. Он отдал платок Папе и спросил: «Так значит, ничего страшного, что я все еще злюсь?»
‎
‎Папа ответил тотчас же:
‎
‎Абсолютно ничего! То, что он совершил, ужасно. Он причинил невероятную боль множеству людей. Это неправильно, и злость верный ответ на то, что настолько непра вильно. Лишь не позволяй боли и опустошенности помешать тебе его простить и оторвать руки от его
‎шеи. 
‎
‎Сынок, ты можешь говорить о своем прощении сотню раз в первый день и столько же во второй, но в последующие ты станешь делать это все реже и реже, пока однажды не почувствуешь, что простил его окончательно. И тогда ты помолишься за то, чтобы он обрел целостность, и передать его в мои руки, чтобы моя любовь выжгла из его жизни все следы испорченности. И как бы невероятно это ни звучало сейчас, ты, возможно, когда-нибудь узнаешь этого человека с совершенно иной стороны.»
‎
‎Этот разговор с Богом просто невозможно читать без слёз. 😭
‎
‎Не знаю даже зачем  я так много сегодня  вам написала...
‎
‎Возможно,кому-то это нужно прочитать именно сейчас...
‎

description.title: Monomad: A Monday on the streets [Eng/Esp]
description.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy start to the week, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography; I hope you had a wonderful weekend. I’d like to kick off the week with some street photography, as has become something of a tradition for me; I hope you enjoy each and every one of these photos.

Feliz inicio de semana, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro; espero que tuvieran un estupendo fin de semana. Quiero iniciar la semana con algunas fotografías callejeras, como ya viene siendo cierta costumbre para mí; espero que disfruten de cada una de las fotografías.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xKkCbzCozEG48Kwmq88jitzpa1rDtDu1s3wWLGEczy3HT5nGUQCniQ8V5Gc1WyiS7DS.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23vsBVCHZmAKnp6iXDbAozVZmBJn78BE8As8UbBd8GuXDg1tgcknbbpCZDhQcRqwkLftM.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23u5tic7pyWiYMMcsc65bhf8AYyoUaLn8VbEt5oGoV9iUX4VkFXaYV9aLEmkWYrTVjMri.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGZbrPyNrwRbYb9Bd68MHoSaE9VpoQ9H61BeKdrPFxi7bfddHAWJtRvUtiDVQGhWhCV.jpg

>

There are certain compositional techniques that can really enhance a photograph, whether through the way you use natural light, shadows, or the objects you incorporate into the shot. Personally, I rely heavily on light and shadow to create more striking photographs that tell a story.

Hay ciertas composiciones que suelen aportar mucho a las fotografías, ya sea por la manera en que utilizas la luz natural, las sombras o aquellos objetos que vas integrando en las fotografías. Yo, personalmente, me ayudo mucho de las luces y sombras para generar unas fotografías más llamativas y con más historia en ellas.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wzxssANskK68viEfw8ET9RMtURVzwK5HbE7fXbV4ebvk83MFuyc6bimg5eUrjFCmqL5.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQfg6dZQdU1UeYLqHws9ZLw8SQyEUvoKA2fsRKvtYg1ajZ21Fnx4vtXvLPfoKQZtpNm.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQLUbaUSRn3vUPbJck3NJ6fA5dWbGzcjqgVrRmHGuzuJUQK8Y3s3KYs2Lahj4apL76b.jpg

>

The end result of these black and white photographs was exactly what I was looking for: a type of photograph that holds certain stories, which each viewer can interpret in their own way. I feel that each one has that intriguing touch of anonymity and mystery.

El resultado final de estas fotografías en blanco y negro era lo que buscaba, un tipo de fotografías que guardan ciertas historias que cada uno de los que ven las fotografías puede interpretar a su manera, y me parece que cada una tiene ese toque de anonimidad y secretismo interesante.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tGeHfBpfUitRaqWfLzkcVjAAAWYMPPi3Ywa2zapWAXGbtMKKKjt3hfBzjeeJQqmP2WG.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tkmq7bwc3JqTQF6PUwoeNdgVNW2hH483xxqhb2mdotAtq1A5NCv9bg7hmVDC24WYcPt.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wMPqm1qdFafRREtvLCWPfj4xEeyFRDjXdR6rKmHko5PYvbp5VeRvaCHmwwjJQoiH5bJ.jpg

>

That’s all for today; as always, thank you so much for taking the time to look at my photos and read a little of what I’ve written. I hope you all have a great start to the week. See you next time, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; como siempre, muchas gracias por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente inicio de semana. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro!

/>

\n

title.title: De la Panadería al Código: Lanzando Z-PRO para digitalizar Los Teques 🇻🇪
title.body:
Hola, comunidad de Hive! Soy Darwin Zamora (@darwinz1987). Algunos ya conocen mi historia: soy panadero en la Panadería Ebenezer en Caracas, pero mi pasión por la tecnología me ha llevado a emprender un camino digital desde mi teléfono celular.

Hoy no vengo a hablarles de pan (aunque el olor de los hornos siempre me acompaña), sino del nacimiento oficial de Z-PRO Caracas - Los Teques. 

¿Qué es Z-PRO?
Es mi proyecto para ayudar a los comerciantes y emprendedores de mi zona a dar el salto digital. He aprendido a programar HTML desde mi móvil, he creado mis propios menús interactivos con QR y hasta mi propia tienda digital en Gumroad. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTuiSU6zH9sBknrinmFEXLGo1CcY6iyhbbrAc9rVRubS1/1779721296736.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQZ9ZZbX2zc69grG3pqgeKtoqxqWoLb5vTmK9BswkG9ez/1779721447877.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUgir1U4ZzR7btQsMFfT2jmSHqvaPfn6jgDjVFiSmqShc/1779721648659.jpg)



Mi meta es simple: que ningún negocio se quede atrás por falta de herramientas.

¡Tenemos casa nueva en Discord! ⚡
Para que esta comunidad crezca de verdad, he creado un servidor de Discord donde quiero reunir a todos los interesados en aprender, colaborar y digitalizar sus negocios. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPoVJEPccAeT2h9EFQ37U7kgMtdNkRyogmiYJQh2RdFHW/1779721089768.jpg)


Únete aquí: https://discord.gg/xN7tumwdbU

Este es solo el comienzo. Con el apoyo de esta comunidad, espero recaudar los fondos necesarios para fundar nuestra propia Comunidad de Hive oficial y seguir impulsando la economía digital en los Altos Mirandinos.

¡Gracias por leer y por creer en este proyecto que sale de un horno pero apunta a la nube!


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaexvEHpcghxLTuS2kHXsBMLKf2yQNnzsLa6WtV9UsZX6/1779720554575.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQhSShDcvmEyaBzzfijyMyPgxrK4uFQibprj82UskvF6g/1779720756046.jpg)

title.body:
Hello photography lovers!
I hope you're all still healthy out there.

I'd like to take this opportunity to share some of my photos.
The photos I'd like to share are of mushrooms.
I found these small mushrooms a few days ago in my yard. It's been raining a lot in the past few weeks, and the weather has been a bit cooler and fresher.
So, the small mushrooms have been growing scattered around my yard.
I took advantage of this opportunity to take some photos with my phone, using my macro lens, since these mushrooms are quite small.

title.body:
I really enjoy doing black-and-white photos of zebras, as they seem like the perfect subject. It's like I almost don't see any color with them. I do wish they had a more open enclosure at the zoo, as a few shots like this are some of the only ones I could get without the fence blocking everything. I waited hoping they would move to another spot, but they seemed pretty content sticking close to each other here, and now when I go again I'll have another reason to try and get some more shots; for now these ones will have to tide me over.

----

**A**nd sometimes I even dare to see the town in color. Because in color, the essence of the forms and their meanings is adorned and seems a little less somber. Although perhaps it also loses some of the typical, precise narrative of monochromatic photos. But be that as it may, the people here in my town also like to see their streets in color, so I think it's good to do this from time to time and share this vision with them...

>**Y** algunas veces también me atrevo a entender el pueblo a colores. Porque en colores la esencia de las formas y sus significados, se adorna y se comporta un poco menos triste. Aunque quizás también se le escapa un poco la narrativa típica y precisa de las fotos monocromáticas. Pero sea como sea, a la gente de aquí de mi pueblo también le gusta reconocer sus calles a colores, entonces creo que es bueno hacer esto de vez en cuando y compartir con ellos esta visión así...

title.title: Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026 - Two Cities, One Legendary Day (Bucharest & Luxembourg) 🍕
title.body:
# May 22 is one of the best days in the Bitcoin calendar. This year it happened in two places at once.
![Millewee post(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/AK3eFM6PbQWV7vtYtWFWSS6uteFjaS2tjstaLqMtbkU1DgsCHsYWktrJaDEQmdq.png)


![pizzas.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/23uR5YYzGsjU3j5YjTf5wtz4nzBCf27kRwQ3C6zGxQHMRaiCmDdoRebxvhYqa5negFYDa.jpeg)


Thanks to PizzaDAO, Bitcoin Pizza Day came alive in Bucharest and Luxembourg: two very different events with the same spirit running through both.

The original story, for anyone who hasn't heard it before: on May 22, 2010, Laszlo Hanyecz posted on the Bitcoin Talk forum and offered 10,000 BTC for two pizzas. Someone delivered. That transaction, worth fractions of a cent at the time, became the first documented purchase of a physical good with Bitcoin. Every May 22, the community sits down to eat pizza and remember that moment.
Sixteen years later, the tradition is global.

Bucharest took place at Zen Bar, a venue that is hard to describe without sounding like you're making it up. Custom metal sculptures everywhere, a full-size welded motorcycle on the main wall, a mural of rock legends behind the bar, and a chess board covered in metal pieces sitting under a beer and a slice of pepperoni pizza for most of the night. There was live music, a guitarist and a singer, performing while the room filled up with builders, holders, and newcomers eating their way through a serious stack of pizza boxes.

![fefefefe.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/23zRyKZjaKtXnQkjn3o52vfnjPbQGz6gF4hJaBtqQxzddtZJNnvfTQCQcDHFM8kfBSbbv.png)


![IMG_0694.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/23xp6gbsZjHfCYWJA85XQLDARt2eftQDFFsume93dY1YsUmHvmPLTh9Gyatye4hzcQZbT.jpg)


![IMG_0690.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/EorzLJGWnhXMXf3VCuKc8vYYZ5igWFtDoccUJWPPXeoCyzfD8B5J9CqRMJ5zw7eV4Vo.jpg)

Luxembourg was organized by the team at Offchain on a restaurant terrace in the city center (at Al21, one of our partners!). Sunny afternoon, packed tables, Roman-style flatbread with salami coming out of the kitchen in waves. The crew closed the night on the boulevard in matching blue OffChain hoodies (with the Innopay logo on the back).

![1779715193196.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/innopay/23wqfxAcsXzAXtAnfSqLPGCbZ9W38ygrGYqTkz8TkbfEwMJrCzwbRspi9Bbrnc6UjUd4m.jpg)

Two settings. Two crowds. One shared tradition that keeps showing up year after year.
If you want your city on the map for Bitcoin Pizza Day 2027, reach out to @PizzaDAO ,they've built a model that works anywhere.
Until next year. 🍕
#BitcoinPizzaDay #PizzaDAO #Bitcoin #Hive #Web3 #Blockchain #Bucharest #Luxembourg #CryptoIRL #ZenBar #OffChain #Bitget #GlobalPizzaParty

title.title: One Sunday by the ocean 🌊
title.body:
> Sunday, 3:00 p.m. As the sound of the ship drifting away from the harbor filled the air, I sat down in one of those white chairs, gazing out at the blue horizon, and simply began to read in solitude. I had read books in many places, but this was my first time reading on a boat—a boat taking me home after a wild adventure spent entirely alone, because, curiously enough, it was also the first time I had traveled alone. The Stories of Eva Luna, written by Isabel Allende, were my only company—lighthearted and sometimes bittersweet stories that soothed my anxiety in that chair, because, like any return from a journey, there is a return to your life, a return to normality that is both exciting and a reminder that the magical days have passed.
![IMG_20260412_154927[1].jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/244xoEJGwWsiUduwubBjVs49BegY8Kqkwa1cromJfKqxpWnWQgGMviAJeGLsj6Sz4ZVCt.jpg)

> As I read, it was impossible not to gaze at the vastness of the sea, so blue that it blended into the sky. At times, my thoughts and reflections would wander, and at other moments I would simply lose myself in the movement of the tide—so hypnotic and constant that my mind, usually racing and overstimulated by thoughts, fell into a peaceful silence and serenity.
![IMG_20260412_151656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23zkGrJwHaXq1u9dETSyXC9JKQrdrzX4yKN6MiiFbPonMRE5XfkYR6AuMxBKcH5bvwiVP.jpg) ![IMG_20260412_174003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23qrL7288MzWiaVAdwxtyhxBpLjJJxunDN8PcVLQDvxiGwT4T81uFTTpzC8TiDn4phjUC.jpg)

> That Sunday, I gave the sea everything that hurt and weighed me down, and I thanked the book for being a refuge and a travel companion; I could say it became my favorite place to read, and I also passed the test of not getting seasick. That Sunday, the sky gave me a beautiful gift: a brilliant, yellow sunset. There was no romantically pink and blue sky; on the contrary, it was a sun that gradually hid itself without losing its color, a sky that I was certain would return the next day brighter than ever.

![IMG_20260412_182115.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/Ep3ePjoqxDGecXamEb9ej7NLbn5AWy2LmrcAksaeUsaxqvAUY6P2cJtfw69tQ675wYv.jpg)

title.title: Arvejas con pollo y sofrito de curry/Peas with chicken and curry sauce 🫛🥣
title.body:
> Hello foodies, feliz inicio de semana! Arrancamos el día con una de las legumbres que no pueden faltar en casa, y es que por lo menos una vez en la semana comemos arvejas, y el día de hoy te comparto mi receta de **arvejas con pollo y sofrito de curry picante**, una sopita súper cremosa, con mucho sabor y por supuesto nutritiva.
Hello foodies, happy start to the week! We’re kicking off the day with one of those vegetables that’s a must-have in our home – we eat peas at least once a week – and today I’m sharing my recipe for **peas with chicken and spicy curry sofrito**, a super creamy soup that’s full of flavour and, of course, nutritious.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbYLraXfddkejybwgezg8qzD7CYrYq9i16QyFkvfea7xm/1779721490027.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Para esta receta usé arvejas verdes que son mis favoritas, y es que creo que tienen el mejor sabor de todas y además de su textura súper cremosa se cocinan bastante rápido, y aunque generalmente las preparo con huesos ahumados o chorizo, en esta oportunidad decidí incorporarle pollo y darles un toque extra de sabor agregando un sofrito con curry picante y la verdad es que quedaron realmente deliciosas.
For this recipe, I used green peas, which are my favourite – I think they have the best flavour of all, and as well as their wonderfully creamy texture, they cook quite quickly. Although I usually make them with smoked pork ribs or chorizo, this time I decided to add chicken and give them an extra touch of flavour by adding a spicy curry sauce, and they really did turn out absolutely delicious.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkp5AFZLwUXr5RHy6cjyuoALS8ZFdWbuYSYLi1dbiKam/1779720901456.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) ## Ingredientes 400 grs de arvejas 1/2 pechuga cortada en trozos pequeños 1 cebolla pequeña 3 dientes de ajo 2 ajíes dulces Cilantro 3 cucharaditas de curry 1 batata grande 150 grs de auyama 1 plátano maduro Sal Pimienta
## Ingredients 400g peas 1/2 chicken breast, cut into small pieces 1 small onion 3 cloves of garlic 2 sweet peppers Coriander 3 teaspoons of curry powder 1 large sweet potato 150g pumpkin 1 ripe plantain Salt Pepper
## Procedimiento/Procedure Para la preparación de nuestras **arvejas con pollo y sofrito de curry picante**, lo primero que hice fue poner a ablandar las arvejas en agua caliente con un toque de sal y mientras hacía esto aproveché para cortar en cubos las verduras que utilizaría para las arvejas (auyama, batata y plátano maduro).
To prepare our **chickpeas with chicken and spicy curry sauce**, the first thing I did was to soak the chickpeas in hot water with a pinch of salt to soften them, and whilst I was doing this, I took the opportunity to dice the vegetables I was going to use with the chickpeas (squash, sweet potato and ripe plantain).
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUXMKUzKphPmjbGvEj1h8uSbmSbsG498nwtS91dX9PDcn/1779720438755.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcUAGmEs3omJ5yMpjw7r36ARmbjvEhapP9C2ghmknp9bC/1779720439143.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRK1ZRXudB6dFooUE2DBjVgpAgsPXKyF98NkdQyuoLe4j/1779720438942.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Seguidamente corté finamente los vegetales para el sofrito, y el pollo lo corté en trozos pequeños y reservé hasta el momento de usarlos.
I then finely chopped the vegetables for the sofrito, cut the chicken into small pieces, and set them aside until I was ready to use them.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUeqXMrvDhsMcpZx1kXBMyGh2kWPq9wvn8rjidsnBV9v/1779720439352.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNTchKQgY4kKZqWjoEcbB3toszdzXiDjckWCiU739cktu/1779720439549.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeXZqr7JBMNh4C7EbfTDdLYdQhJrD9U39wBrN74EtYgjk/1779720510695.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXNQQinRJYFbu8xNyTC1HfUrup79UiXb8WwUNmvAtAwh1/1779720510971.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez las arvejas comenzaron a ablandar agregué todas las verduras y de inmediato comencé a trabajar con el sofrito, así que en una sartén caliente agregué una cucharada de aceite junto con los vegetales, dos cucharaditas de curry y un poco de sal.
Once the peas had started to soften, I added all the vegetables and immediately began preparing the sofrito, so I heated a frying pan, added a tablespoon of oil along with the vegetables, two teaspoons of curry powder and a pinch of salt.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRoZE35XHjaWaNMA5hAPCRU8eKh9SvQ2NfxhAYB28Ey3z/1779720578244.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Una vez la cebolla estuvo cristalizada la agregué a las arvejas y en la misma sartén del sofrito agregué el pollo que fue condimentado con la cucharadita restante de curry cilantro y ají. Doré muy bien y finalmente incorporé a las arvejas y dejé cocinar por 15 minutos más, tiempo en el que las arvejas hicieron su magia y crearon una crema llena de muchísimo sabor.
Once the onion had caramelised, I added it to the peas, and in the same pan I’d used for the sofrito, I added the chicken, which I’d seasoned with the remaining teaspoon of curry powder, coriander and chilli. I browned it thoroughly, then added it to the peas and left it to cook for a further 15 minutes, during which time the peas worked their magic and created a creamy sauce bursting with flavour.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdGEBkwKKScJ5rCTat2pkTjuytdXw147v9nNJMC6TKrXH/1779720578456.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV4TwwskNjQnsNcU7C9pAEx9Uk7hkmhg7Kv7i7qn53voj/1779720578680.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbmURcjqaQ78axgGGy68Kc6A5z8jgfkeS3rVcoccrawL2/1779720579120.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf8gDL45TzMwHP4xNdxTxy5LKHtgwaikKEr1Q3xD7o4oy/1779720901201.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmab4deH9rUW1fTcKDpDuxaPJcwFoNYHkQzVV9NbvxBaY7/1779720716033.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8pTuWbj6jaE6DsifHrPW3StFKE6h7N2AYiUtqxRaugF/1779720716268.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrAtDwCbtQWhspQ3fZXZeAUy9hLt9oKpPonMJbvaGuui/1753392698151.png) Antes de servir agregué una rata de cilantro, dejé rear 5 minutos y disfrutamos de un almuerzo no solo muy nutritivo, sino delicioso. >Before serving, I added a tablespoon of chopped coriander, and we enjoyed a lunch that was not only very nutritious but also delicious.

title.title: Mental Tiredness VS Physical Tiredness
title.body:
I have a question today.....
Which one is more worse, mental tiredness or physical Tiredness?? 
Must Share your Perspective.....

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXDxbXQLSfYacesYMNvntw5KbpR9DRstDPMum74fV6qng/1779563426172.jpg)
**Images from Pinterest **
Lemme share my thoughts....


I’ve been both kinds of tired. There was the physical kind after hostel days. Running between my clincial Job , cooking food that sat heavy, going to gym, Second clinic...hence no proper sleep for weeks, carrying laundry, and my own mood up three flights of stairs. My legs would ache. My back would hurt for days..oh goodness sometime it become worse. My eyes would burn. But I knew what it was. I could point to it. “I’m tired because I didn’t sleep. I’m tired because I walked 12,000 or more steps. I’m tired because I lifted.” 

Then there’s the mental kind. The one that came after coming home. No exams. No hostel routine. Just sitting. Just thinking. And somehow feeling more drained than I did when I was running on 4 hours of sleep. 

**If you ask me which is worse, I’ll say it without thinking: mental tiredness. **

First ...letz talk about physical tiredness. Physical tiredness has rules:

Physical tiredness plays fair. It tells you why it’s there.There can be several reasons but surely with a solution that you can avail yourself. You skip sleep, you feel it. You train, you feel it. You fast, you feel it. Cause and effect. Clean.....! It also has a solution. Rest. Food. Water. Sleep. I’ve tested this. In my hostel stay...when After two and a half months in hostel, I came home and slept for 11 hours straight. I woke up and my body felt different. Not perfect, but lighter. My shoulders weren’t locked. My head didn’t throb. I ate home food and my stomach stopped complaining. 

Physical tiredness is honest. It doesn’t lie to you. If you’re sore, you’re sore. If you’re hungry, you’re hungry. You can measure it. You can fix it. 

I remember one night in hostel we had a group project till 2 AM, it was my sisters thesis project and i was helping her. I went to bed at 2:30, woke up at 6:00 for my job. All day I was dead. Legs heavy, brain foggy, yawning in the middle of my shift. But I knew: “Okay, tonight I sleep early and I’ll be fine.” And I was. One good night fixed it. 
**
There’s relief in that. You know the end exists. You know rest is coming. 
**


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc82D4BgmfScEXnqhoAFeTca7bCiCQgPUMzua8pdQsRKK/1779564010313.jpg)

**Image from Pinterest** 
But,
In other case, Mental tiredness has no clock:

Mental tiredness doesn’t follow rules. You can sleep 10 hours and still feel like you didn’t sleep at all. You can take a day off and still feel exhausted. You can be sitting on your bed, doing nothing, and feel like you ran a marathon. Its like something is eating from inside your body and trust m its te worst feeling ever then physical pain.

It doesn’t tell you why it’s there. Sometimes it’s overthinking. Sometimes it’s nothing. You just wake up tired of being you. Tired of deciding. Tired of pretending you’re okay. 

The worst part about mental tiredness is You can’t explain it. If someone asks “why are you tired?” and you say “I don’t know,” they think you’re lazy. They think you’re dramatic. But you’re not. You just can’t find the words because the tiredness is inside, not outside. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXTszbxJtyLKVch48r75YZ7ewpw7TkbNAmPjqUBJ3go91/1779563981171.jpg)
**Image from Pinterest** 

I think....Physical tiredness ends. Mental tiredness repeats,its just like a loop and its too difficult to come put of it... obviously not impossible but near impossible.


**Lets Comapre**

1- If I’m physically tired, I can see the finish line. “Finish this assignment, then sleep.” “Complete this workout, then eat.” There’s a last step. 
On the other hand
Mental tiredness doesn’t have a last step. You finish one thing and your brain gives you three more. You rest for a day and the guilt tells you’re wasting time. You try to relax and your thoughts, overthinking won’t shut up. And this is the terrible feeling ever. It's like the whole self is stuck at a point where no longer is the way but want to come out of this loop.That’s exhausting. To be your own pressure and your own judge. Physical pain stops when you stop. Mental pain doesn’t stop even when you stop. 


2- You can hide physical tiredness. You can’t hide mental tiredness....If I’m physically tired, I can fake it. I can smile, stand straight, finish the task. People see me working, they think I’m fine. And I am fine. Just tired. No one can have any idea whats going on with my body. Because my fake expression will never let anyone know about my pain.
On the other hand
If I’m mentally tired, faking it takes more energy than the thing itself. When Mentally tired.. 99% time facial expressions show that tiredness. I smile, but it’s heavy. I talk, but my words are slow. I laugh, but it doesn’t reach my eyes. And then I go home and collapse, not because my body is tired, but because pretending was exhausting. Its like talking , smiling even each facial expression tale alot of energy.


3- Physical tiredness makes you sit down.You can be around anyone, can still talk to anybody but Mental tiredness makes you disappear while you’re still sitting there. Its like lost in another dimension.

4- Recovery is different

To recover from physical tiredness, I need sleep. Maybe some yoga, exercises. Maybe protein. Maybe a day with no stairs. Simple.....or sometime just a pain killer is enough.
On the other hand 
To recover from mental tiredness, I need more than sleep. I need quiet. I need to not decide anything. I need to not be useful for a while. I need to feel safe, not just rested. 

 
5- Physical tiredness limits your body. Mental tiredness limits your life. You can work through sore legs. You can’t work through a sore mind. Not well. Not honestly. 

6- The dangerous one

Physical tiredness can hurt you. You can injure yourself. You can get sick. So you respect it. You stop. 

Mental tiredness is dangerous because it doesn’t look dangerous. You can function. You can show up. You can say “I’m fine.” And slowly you stop caring. Slowly you stop trying. Slowly you think this is just who you are now. Slowly you lost your internet in every thing and then a moment comes when you lost your internet in own self.

That’s what scares me. Because no one brings you soup for mental tiredness. No one tells you to rest your brain. They tell you to “cheer up” or “be positive.” As if that’s a switch. 

So, 
In my perspective 
I don’t think you have to choose. We’re not supposed to pick one. We have both a body and a mind. But if I have to pick which one I’d rather deal with, I pick physical. 

Give me sore muscles over a numb mind. Give me a day of rest over a week of pretending. Give me a body that hurts because it worked, not a mind that hurts because it can’t stop working. Being a Physiotherapist, most of the time i myself deal with my physical pains but For mental tiredness: I’m still learning. Sometimes I go for a walk alone. Sometimes I sit with my sister and say nothing. Sometimes I write it out, like this. I’m trying not to fight it. Fighting makes it heavier. 
So, 
Physical tiredness is worse for your body. Mental tiredness is worse for your life. And I’d rather be sore than empty. So yes. Mental tiredness is worse. By far. 


What do you think???

title.body: There is another aspect to scarcity too, and you alluded to it with the Llama/Yodin/Kitty \

, an individual card can be scarce AND high demand, a well know feature of the meta game ( Scarce in itself means.
 nothing without demand, I have several 1/1 artworks stuck to my fridge :-) )

I'm undecided if this aspect of scarcity is good, on one hand it creates true chase cards, on the other it's a bit of a lock-out spec for meaningful play.

I mention it because , not only are cards proliferating but abilities are also growing, there is usually a plan B and C for any key card. I feel the size of the reward card set adds to the issue.

I like Black Foils, I think they should be rarer, I personally don't see the need for Arcane versions, but I'm not a collector, so I appreciate that aspect is lost on me.

There are places that feel like a warm embrace and a source of positive energy, and that’s exactly what happens when you walk into Café 11:11, a hidden gem in Medellín that calls itself “the neighborhood café.”

From the moment you walk through the door, the atmosphere draws you in. The vibe is completely bohemian, relaxed, and has that polished yet cozy aesthetic that invites you to stay for hours, whether to work, read, or simply watch life go by with a good cup of coffee in hand.

But Café 11:11 is much more than just caffeine. One of its biggest surprises is its culinary offerings: they prepare spectacular homemade lunches. Forget about fast food or soulless fare; here, the dishes have that rich, honest, and comforting flavor of food made with love—perfect for recharging your batteries midday.

And as if great coffee and delicious food weren’t enough, the place doubles its charm as a concept store. They sell a selection of super cute shirts, with unique designs and plenty of style, perfect for taking home an authentic souvenir of the city or refreshing your wardrobe with local talent.

Verdict: Café 11:11 is the perfect hangout in Medellín if you’re looking to eat well, support independent design, and immerse yourself in a space with its own magic. A place where good vibes and good times come together!

Hay lugares que se sienten como un abrazo y una manifestación de buenas energías, y eso es exactamente lo que pasa cuando entras a Café 11:11, un joyita escondida en Medellín que se hace llamar \

.

Desde que cruzas la puerta, la atmósfera te atrapa. El ambiente es completamente bohemio, relajado y con esa estética cuidada pero acogedora que te invita a quedarte por horas, ya sea para trabajar, leer o simplemente ver la vida pasar con una buena taza de café en la mano.

Pero Café 11:11 es mucho más que cafeína. Una de sus grandes sorpresas es su propuesta gastronómica: preparan unos almuerzos caseros espectaculares. Olvídate de la comida rápida o sin alma; aquí los platos tienen ese saborcito rico, honesto y reconfortante de la cocina hecha con amor, ideal para recargar energías a mitad del día.

Y como si el buen café y la comida deliciosa no fueran suficientes, el lugar duplica su encanto como concepto concept store. Tienen a la venta una selección de camisas súper lindas, con diseños únicos y mucho estilo, perfectas para llevarte un recuerdo auténtico de la ciudad o renovar el clóset con talento local.

Veredicto: Café 11:11 es el punto de encuentro perfecto en Medellín si buscas comer rico, apoyar el diseño independiente y sumergirte en un espacio con magia propia. ¡Un lugar donde los buenos deseos y los buenos momentos coinciden!

title.title: /ˈtwɪt.ə/
title.body:
Yes, today I'd like to write about X or ex-twitter, which is working like a magnet, attracting people like any other place where rumor has it that there's money to be made. Acid has a post about the topic not long ago, about someone who left Hive and joined X, hoping to earn more there.

As I've mentioned before, I'm using the platform because of the news I can get there, content related to trading and markets and I'm also sharing my charts there as I don't know a better place to share technical analysis. It helps me a lot and it keeps me focused as well, because this is a brutal area, accountability is much higher than on other areas. For now, getting my account monetized is not a priority, but I'd like to grow it slowly, organically obviously.  

![alexander-lunyov-H9JTsJ6B3do-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23z7FvneK88YgS4rER8X4FLNqJkKLvcJvygAiPdSQsjsUY3hMqY9Mnyksz3wJXyfaR1jV.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash To participate in their revenue sharing program, they have a set of rules, which, compared to other platforms, is not much at first glance as you only have to meet three requirements, but as nothing is as easy as it seems, this isn't either. Getting verified by subscribing to Premium is easy, you pay, follow the instructions and it's done. Getting 500 Premium followers and having at least 5M impressions on your posts within the last 3 months is not as easy though. Some time ago I saw a post about the user getting their account monetized and today I went to check their content out as well as check how they are doing. Not because I want to copy what they're doing or get inspired by their action (oh God, no, I would never sink to that level), just out of curiosity. As suspected, things are not looking good for them, but knowing their behavior, I saw what I suspected I'll be seeing. ![jason-leung-CrJ5XMAlQA0-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23sxT3J9KoZ93ebAqRs5MNmWPCVA5aCoc4s59bXdoY59HWniDmR1ccRDpbPZJm4j51EBA.jpg) Photo by

>Unsplash Knowing the user's background, it wasn't a surprise to see they are doing what they are doing on Hive, which is sharing their opinion on different matters. Is this a bad thing? Nope, not at all. Is it enough to get other people's attention? Nope, not at all. Just like in any other area, you need to do your research, in order to succeed. Hive is a small place, active users are not so many and if you're active, provide decent content and engage as well, you can build your followers and get support too. You can share your opinion on anything and everything, you can show off with your theories, no matter how crazy they seem or how full of yourself it makes you look. That's not a problem on Hive, but X is a different platform with different userbase and taste. You can share your opinion there too, no matter how stupid is it, but no one gives a 💩, unless you're a well known person with influence and sharing your opinion on a matter that can bring some benefits to many. People are mostly looking for information that can benefit them, make them money if possible and give them an advantage in certain areas. Sharing videos about stupid people doing stupid things can take you so far. ![theodor-tietze-hErQP_8XQfk-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uFK5gcagn1W7kXxMn4kNuVDdVS6AvS1FMWNvgyCgyQ31MK4beZUYJ5NCKYwMpSQxfR4.jpg) Photo by

is a concept they don't really understand, or should I say they try to bypass it by cutting corners and choosing shortcuts. Unfortunately getting 20 - 30 likes and 100 views on X won't take you far as likes don't count when it comes to earning. Asking your friends to like your posts, follow for follow and vote for vote is not going to give you what you need to earn. Congrats to them for giving it a try though, but I also feel sorry for them as at some point they have to face reality and it's going to hurt. 

The sad thing here is when you see some people can't see further than their nose and their ego is totally blinding them. 5M impression in 3 months means 55k impressions per day and trust me, that's a lot. I can get 3k - 4k on a single post and between 40 - 50 likes (that don't count by the way), with only knowing 2 or 3 of my followers and they only vote on some of my posts, I have 175k impressions for the past 3 months and I only started posting a month ago or so, but that can change.  

![clay-banks-KQp3tHY_T-4-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23uFRcfKQzfcURncvVUWWA6eZqB7bu7QLcufJX3sUBYgrL8LRVrq8ZxksocnLBumHf1kv.jpg)
Photo by <a href=\

>Unsplash Unlike the person in acid's post, my subject has not left Hive, they are posting on both platforms, but less on X as I think reality has already kicked in. In this case I think their country of origin and upbringing plays a role too. Confusing the world with your small village life is a fatal mistake. What works there may not be interesting in the big world anymore. What is sad here is to see them fail because they refuse to see reality. Congrats for trying, but when your goal is to make money, your only chance is to adapt. Learn some skills, share something people are looking for and you're gold. Thinking you know everything and you're better than anyone else is the fastest road to nowhere and stats are going to prove it. I'm happy I finally have a place where I can share TA, but other than TA, I'm not interested in sharing on X. There are other ways to make money, 10x easier as well. I'm curious for how long they are going to resist. I know the answer, but let's get the proof as well.

></center>

title.title: Holy week is it biblical// Mcgi topic review
title.body:
https://youtu.be/pPci63IrEQs?si=BRRBZh3BN84AxMWb

Holy week is the days when Christians remembers the suffering and sorrow of Jesus Christ while on earth. It usually begins with Palm Sunday and ends with Easter Sunday. While the Bible does not specifically command Christians to celebrate Holy Week as a yearly tradition, the events remembered during the week are clearly biblical. 

The triumphal entry of Jesus into Jerusalem, His crucifixion, and His resurrection are all recorded in the Gospels. This is the time believers uses the opportunity to remember and reflect on how Jesus Christ have come to save our soul.

The Bible teaches believers to remember the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Jesus Himself told His disciples, 

**“Do this in remembrance of me” (Luke 22:19).**

Because of this, many Christians believe it is proper to dedicate time to prayer, repentance, fasting, and worship during Holy Week. However, the Bible also warns against empty religious traditions that focus more on outward ceremonies than genuine faith and obedience to God.

title.title: The meaning of life and our unwavering faith, My Actifit Report Card: May 25 2026
title.body:
> Hello friends, how are you? I hope you are all having a good day. You know, lately I like to think about very small things for some reason. When the monotony of life is pressing down on us from all around us, even the simplest thing can act as a great healing for us. I read one such thing a few days ago, written by William James— 'Believe that life is worth living and that your belief will help create the truth.' ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9ae6582b-a189-43e0-90af-8e8df32b7388.jpg) I sat silent for a long time after hearing that. To be honest, our life is a reflection of our thoughts. I myself have gone through many battles within myself where I felt like everything was over. When something is not going well, when even the people around us feel strange, then living feels like a burden. But at that moment, it is very necessary to hear a small 'yes' from within. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd2fa062-bf44-4bf7-823b-f545f9fedb11.jpg) Actually, we are not robots, our feelings will always go up and down. I have noticed that when I believe in my heart that something good is ahead, my work style strangely changes. I then look for a solution instead of drowning in despair. It is not a magic wand, but a battle of our perspectives. If your faith is shaky, the world will seem like a dark cave to you. But if you can insist once that—no, my life is very precious and every moment of it has a different meaning—you will see that the world around you will be perceived differently. I am not giving you any motivation today, but rather speaking from my own experience. Many times, we forget the small joys of life while running after many big successes. A cup of hot tea, the smile of a loved one, or a ray of sunshine in the afternoon—these small things make life beautiful. And to enjoy them, first of all, we need an unwavering faith in life. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/40cd6db2-46dd-4a1a-be00-f37a217e88cb.jpg) Our life is like a white canvas. The color of faith we paint there, the picture will be exactly the same. If you paint your canvas with positivity and a thirst for life, you will find peace even in the midst of sorrow. It is my personal belief that we get exactly what we want. So what I am saying is, sometimes put aside all worries and have a little faith in yourself. Believe that this life of yours will be worthwhile. With the power of this faith, you will one day be able to touch your desired reality. Life is very short, but its possibilities are very big. Just take a deep breath and tell yourself— 'I love being alive'. You will see how the paths open up by themselves. Be very good. Take care of yourself and always try to be happy.

title.body:
> **The spotlight is dimming, and that is okay.**

*Is it simply a surrender to the inevitable? We convince ourselves that accepting the shadows is a sign of maturity, but perhaps it is just weariness. The ‘now’ does not need a spotlight; life is better lived in the twilight, where you do not have to put on a show for anyone. A legacy is a consolation for those who fear being forgotten, but for those who live in the present, oblivion is a liberation.*

> **We spend so much of our lives trying to be seen.**

*That effort to be seen is the greatest waste of human energy. We seek a reflection in the eyes of others to confirm that we exist, when the only real validation is the weight of our own footsteps today. The ‘now’ becomes tainted when you try to get others to look at it with you.*

> **Our children are the new spotlight.**

*Projecting our need for light onto our children is not passing on the torch; it is turning them into tools for our own lingering relevance. They should not be our ‘spotlight’; they should be their own blaze. If humans have only the ‘now’, living through the next generation is merely a sophisticated way of failing to be present in one’s own life.*

> **What does it matter if we are remembered in 100 years?**

*Exactly... It doesn't matter. Posterity is just a marketing ploy to get you to behave yourself today. In a hundred years, the atoms that make up your body today will be in a burger or in a puddle. The only thing that's real is the pressure of your fingers on the keyboard right now. History won't put food on your table, nor will it keep you warm tonight.*

***We’re still here today, but who knows about tomorrow... That’s why we live in the moment – perhaps a hug, a word of comfort.***

# Hello everyone 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTVZZuLnouWS9XRCDgqZ7CuM8SBGU9P9cwt6avPxbRps8/1779709883361.jpg)

Good day to you all on this beautiful day, is so nice to be here in this community to share with you all this beautiful iro and buba traditional outfit made with white fabric for my grandma. I hope you are all doing great in your respective places and I pray that this week bring us positivity in all ramifications.

Iro and buba is a traditional outfit worn by women, it is mostly worn by the westerners in Nigeria but as it is now, it is generally worn by almost all the ethnic groups in the country. For my gandma, amost all are outfit is made of this particular style because that is what she was used to in the olden days I have tried sewing different designs for outfit for her but she mostly preferred this particular iro and buba especially when the fabric is expensive. One of her son will be celebrating his birthday and he bought grandma this particular fabric to wear for the event, this is what gandma asked me to sew for her.

title.title: Hamburguesas y momentos inolvidables con mi familia 🍔✨|Burgers and unforgettable moments with my family 🍔✨
title.body:
> A veces no hace falta planear grandes eventos para tener un día especial. Últimamente le he pedido a Dios la oportunidad de compartir más salidas a comer con mi familia y me hace muy feliz ver que poco a poco lo estamos haciendo realidad.
Sometimes you don't need to plan big events to make a day special. Lately, I've been asking God for the chance to go out to eat with my family more often, and it makes me so happy to see that, little by little, we're making it happen.
​Hace unos días salimos a comer hamburguesas y más allá de la comida que estaba deliciosa me quedo con la magia de ese rato juntos. Disfrutar de una buena hamburguesa en compañía de mi mamá, mi hermano y mi hija Sophia es un regalo maravilloso. Esos espacios son vitales porque funcionan como una desconexión total donde el trabajo las clases y la rutina se quedan fuera para darle paso a nuestras risas y conversaciones.
A few days ago, we went out for burgers, and beyond the food—which was delicious—what really stuck with me was the magic of that time together. Enjoying a good burger with my mom, my brother, and my daughter Sophia is a wonderful gift. Moments like these are vital because they allow us to completely disconnect; work, school, and daily routines are left behind to make way for our laughter and conversations.
​Ver a mi mamá feliz y a Sophia disfrutando de estos detalles me llena el corazón porque sé que estos instantes son los que atesoraremos con más cariño en el futuro. Agradezco enormemente poder tener estos espacios. La vida se nos va volando entre tantas obligaciones y estas salidas son mi forma de recordarme que la familia es la prioridad absoluta.
Seeing my mom happy and Sophia enjoying these little moments warms my heart because I know these are the moments we’ll cherish most in the future. I’m so grateful to have these moments. Life flies by amid so many obligations, and these outings are my way of reminding myself that family is my top priority.
​No importa el lugar porque lo que realmente le da sabor a la comida es la compañía. ¡Aprovechen siempre que puedan para regalarse un momento especial con sus seres queridos!
It doesn't matter where you are, because what really makes a meal special is the company. Take every opportunity you can to treat yourself to a special moment with your loved ones!

title.title: Cycling Down the Baja - Break-in to Ensenada
title.body:
The first leg of my journey took me from Tecate to Ensenada. In total 112 km from the hotel to my host's house. Not an easy ride, especially for the first day. Immediately I noticed how much heavier it was than I remembered from my last long bike trip. But this time I am also lugging video equipment around with me, so I'd be a fool not to get a bunch of audiovisuals out of it, hopefully decent ones.

![ensenada.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23wgFZTE2vxmsmK1sUiMTgDjC7EtZWofV7Y3UznRzxyMkjz65wNjmCuqJTZPUNnA2kSjw.jpeg)

When I reached Ensenada my whole body was hurting, so I asked to stay another night. No problem with my host. He even had a scale I could step on and finally put a number on what I only felt was HEAVY as. Standing on the scale and holding my bike, with all my gear, bottles all filled, measured up to 120 kg. Out of this my pure body weight is 64 kg. So I'm carrying close to my own body weight around with me! It makes me feel like an ant.

![bajadventours.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23y8vEzugMEhgunDZoBaaL5ks7FoGMPu8JqaXe4u8yscQvfsU4LNfMvDw3cFQAXBcfdDz.jpeg)

In Ensenada I made a bit of adjustments to my front wheel I had recently built, as it developed a bit of a squeak over the last few kilometers. New wheels may have to be re-trued, nothing new about that. The squeak went away, still I wanted to visit a bike-shop I had only heard about: At [Bajadventours Bike Shop & Lounge](https://www.instagram.com/bajadventours.tienda/) they combine three of my favorite things: bikes, burgers, and beers. 

![bike restaurant.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23tvgJ51w1tVNMST1USuDYYQCha2GaFRmzg1cMuwqzkdHF8qGznoKthZDJhgJW9oxQXjp.jpeg)

I had them look at my bike to make sure I did not overlook anything, and in the meantime I sat down for a meal. When we were finished, the verdict was that the Red Fox was in top condition. Checking the bike was going to cost me 300 pesos, but in the end they decided to do it for free. Thank you very much! 

![burger.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/stortebeker/23u6Br3iXR2pM148gmwsSneQb8KvPxJEkS5pHuJninHTu3wpbj9yXwYYjx86AuhZweo8n.jpeg)

Now that my body is hopefully well broken in, my next destination is the beach: La Playa Calavera.

title.title: El tiempo avanza - Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
>  


La reunión con el equipo de Risignstar Portugal se extendió más de los que ellos pensaban, pero las ideas era maravillosa y la Banda 17 no podía creer lo que estaba pasando. Michelle anotó cada palabra, Dani seguía golpeando la mesa imaginando sonidos, Lucas concentrado escuchando, pero afinaba la guitarra y por un extremo de la mesa Stewie grababa pequeños videos y dando grandes opiniones.


Para terminar la reunión uno de los productores portugueses se levantó —Tenemos una propuesta para ustedes, queremos lanzar una canción junto a RisignStar Portugal, pero solo tenemos menos de 24 horas— dijo en voz alta. —¿Veinticuatro horas? —preguntó Dani. Mientras que Michelle intercambió miradas con Lucas, sin embargo, era una gran oportunidad y no se podía dejar pasar.


>The meeting with the Risignstar Portugal team went on longer than they expected, but the ideas were wonderful, and Band 17 couldn't believe what was happening. Michelle jotted down every word, Dani kept tapping the table imagining sounds, Lucas listened intently but tuned his guitar, and at one end of the table, Stewie recorded short videos and offered insightful opinions.


#


>To wrap up the meeting, one of the Portuguese producers stood up. \

Dani asked. Michelle exchanged glances with Lucas, but it was a great opportunity, and they couldn't let it pass.



![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23w2j3uE2frEoHAi9FbfF8kY1vLTaRxSh8DZf9EusjBWeEybr2GMzqoQp5jVYMNJgFfQd.jpeg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/musical-instrument-string-instrument-1283358/)




Horas después, al salir de allí la Banda por fin lograron subir a sus habitaciones para descansar un poco. Pero fue casi imposible, ya que Michelle permaneció mirando la ventana y por su cabeza pasaban melodías incompletas, frases sueltas y la presión de que el tiempo corría. A las siete de la mañana la Banda completa fue a un estudio privado que RisignStar había preparado para ellos, donde era un lugar enorme, lleno de computadoras modernas, las paredes cubiertas de aislamiento acústico y lo que llamó más la atención era una pantalla gigante con un reloj y tenía la cuenta regresiva: 23:12:44.




Lucas conectó la guitarra y empezó a tocar unos acordes para probar, Dani se sentó y probó la batería electrónica mientras los productores portugueses discutían ideas en voz baja. Michelle caminaba de un lado a otro, ya que las ideas no eran buenas y nada encajaba. Además, el tiempo corría y allí uno de los productores comentó —Necesitamos algo que haga explotar el lugar apenas suene, algo que nadie haya oído—



>Hours later, after leaving the studio, the band finally managed to go up to their rooms to rest a bit. But it was nearly impossible, as Michelle remained staring out the window, her mind racing with incomplete melodies, disjointed phrases, and the pressure of time ticking away. At seven in the morning, the entire band went to a private studio that RisingStar had prepared for them. It was a huge place, filled with modern computers, the walls covered in soundproofing, and what caught their eye most was a giant screen with a clock displaying a countdown: 23:12:44.


#


>Lucas plugged in his guitar and started playing a few chords to test things out. Dani sat down and tried out the electronic drums while the Portuguese producers discussed ideas in hushed tones. Michelle paced back and forth, as the ideas weren't working and nothing felt right. Time was running out, and one of the producers remarked, \

![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23tS37BCQ93GWYK2nMjqMCELyRssiYFrfYYM6RqcK5Ee49vQEddTZEjFJKUykSv129Akc.jpeg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/drum-set-drums-musical-instruments-1839383/)






Luego de tres horas sin poder hacer nada, uno de los técnicos portugueses colocó un viejo audio y en cuestión de segundos, por los parlantes del estudio sonó la melodía y una mezcla entre guitarra portuguesa y un bajo urbano oscuro. Todos se quedaron mirando. Michelle se detuvo de caminar, Lucas dejó de tocar y Dani sonrió por primera vez en horas —Esperen —susurró Michelle—. 



El productor lo volvió a repetir y ese momento la Banda 17 escuchó algo que en ese preciso instante acababan de encontrar el sonido que podía cambiarlo todo, aunque nadie imaginaba que era la pieza para poder avanzar, ya que el tiempo en el rojo seguía corriendo.


>After three hours of being unable to do anything, one of the Portuguese technicians played an old audio track, and in a matter of seconds, the melody and a blend of Portuguese guitar and a dark, urban bass line filled the studio speakers. Everyone stared. Michelle stopped pacing, Lucas stopped playing, and Dani smiled for the first time in hours. \

Michelle whispered. # >The producer played it again, and at that moment, Band 17 heard something—they had just found the sound that could change everything, though no one imagined it was the piece they needed to move forward, as time continued to tick away.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
**Post de risingstar**

title.body:
This was a compilation over the weekend. We have a several days of public holidays crashing in this week and the coing week. Since it is also school holiday, we decided to pack everything and leave Kuala Lumpur so we can spend some time with the kids.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRvGLfXnE3eqR4Lvjxtm8pfeqGKF1RMfiqmhTQ5seE4yc/1779718710706.jpg)

Before the actual trip taking place it was the havoc weekend we had to anticipate. I started my Saturday morning as usual, a long walk a the park. Wilst doing my walk, I am also responsible for thinking through what's need to bring during the holiday we've been planning for months.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX38p3vkuazfD553RfjrWbJBeWdtScPDea3dB7tz4o2tm/1779718710760.jpg)

After the full day at home doing chores, we went t attend sunset mass in town. One of the main reason I choose this church, and especially sunset mass is because this is probably one of the very few churches that doesn't do the cha-cha with their musical instrument. I like music, I just prefer a more solemn proceeding.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcxTB5x9WT7QodkKnAqBtmVQ7W1sALTu7XXSfZeSWQeFm/1779718710863.jpg)

After church, we went to dinner with my god parents ad his family as well. We took a long drive, slightly out of the way from where we usually drive homez and had a dinner at the mall. It's so cute that the restaurant made an iceteddy bear trying to climb out from the tea.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCFtsxfTGTNoKdqS2v5x64JNzY7dtRYzKmpFLKjojSAp/1779718710898.jpg)

Don't worry about the bear, it will fall back into the drink once the bear paw melted 😂 what I enjoyed the most was this plate of pan fried - roasted pork with garlic. Technically it's the type of \

being used to own fry with garlic. Set dinner also complement with tea and a huge bowl of spicy and sour mustard leaf(with pork), technically this is the Chinese version of adobo 😂

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVh1ExUawhwhZAq4JRXonVfqKPJp8AK3VSYr88Z1JobH8/1779718710932.jpg)

Snday was a little heavy since I had a blast the night before, with the amount of roast pork in the system, I can feel the medication is fighting within my body. Trust me, it's absolutely NOT feeling any good. Nevertheless, I still managed to climb the damn hill with the assist of my walking sticks.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcpgLgL9J4peaFS7bsnZrA89jMebHqVeQK6QWUWn8Nj4Q/1779718749342.jpg)

And I also started to get the gist of it. I was complaining that I couldn't get my heartbeat up after I've started medication. Now that I realize the blood thinning medication does change how my body react to stress, so I push it a little harder. My walking is now even faster than many jogger, which pushing towards 8 kilometres per hour. I think for brisk walking,and my short legs, this speed is way above and over many 5'6 guys. I'm not proud of it, but now I can finally have a slightly normal heartbeat a an average 135bpm.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRKGcFyeYQe2RXrpDsEsvyqGFL9ngbQ65nfpE6CscPJvR/1779718749418.jpg)

There was an event in the afternoon which I have took some pictures of it, but it was stuck with my other phone which is now charging, and I'm too lazy to walk over and copy the photos from that side. Perhaps next time I will make a dedicated post about that event. Right after the event, me and home minister both are very hungry. We went to one of our favourite restaurant for porridge.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmStX2jidTPBxvBvbv4m8q18fx1CRii9wDMUhmUTce1ftW/1779718749461.jpg)

I think within 10 minutes, the pile of sper hot claypot porridge were gone. The tofu is so soft, the fragrant egg taste so good, and the salted egg, so... High cholesterol 😂 overwhelmingly, even the home sister who choose to eat braised pork rice, had to ask me share a slice of tofu with her.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma4FczXyPndUGd1LriTNsiWfW2dSWEtVv6JhuvbsJGQyq/1779718749499.jpg)

The day concluded as I am preparing to hit a few more buttons as I was playing with #drugwars the Blockchain game. This is probably one of those very few occasions that I hit more than 20k steps in a day.

title.title: A Day Filled With Good Food And Simple Joys!💗
title.body:
A Beautiful and Wonderful day to each and everyone!👋😊

Hello to all of my friends here and of course to all my dear fellow hivers in this lovely @dailyblog community!😍

How are you all today? I hope everyone is doing well and happy right now. Here I am again, @lj1728 to share another simple life story with you all.💕

![April 2026 Blogs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23yJTRu8XiWmVReNwu3azajFzrieZXs4F8wq7chkUxcmcjwryS8upwtMxPrzaaDDhtsjv.png)

Today turned out to be one of those simple yet happy days that made me appreciate the little things in life. My husband came home from work around lunchtime, and before he arrived, I asked him to buy some sushi platter from my sister-in-law because I have been craving their sushi for days already. Their sushi business is only a sideline, but honestly, I really love their homemade sushi because it always tastes fresh and delicious. I also feel happy whenever I get to support their small business in my own little way.

![IMG_8424.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMeamaA2LH2DNjRDxfPiUKRCpfmZ9b1JHUHVfRWjg4ywynwdWTE3YsLSTTbxXyQrCW3.jpeg)

![IMG_8427.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23x1DgRFqs7zJNkU5dKJFuJwrSiHLax79RkjqC3QyN7A46em9jX1kekrEEZjvz3dpdyGC.jpeg)

![IMG_8428.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi6VAJjf7nnNnWDJWpPYHc82QtPTL2HiYtBSySrZGWFFqUAoT5FVQACFfpP4YHP3FUn.jpeg)

![IMG_8429.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23xyZ9dNVQmCRA5BKLL7WmVzw4sg459P9Krm47aDXmu8fFGz3XcgcDx8697zg4nFnm2q5.jpeg)

When my husband arrived, we immediately opened the sushi platter and shared it together with the family for our lunch. I ordered a mixed-flavor platter so we could try different kinds, and every single piece tasted so good. Some were creamy, some had a slightly spicy flavor, while others were rich and savory. It was such a satisfying meal, and even the presentation looked beautiful and appetizing.

![IMG_8365.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wX1LoEskmeDagD7KyDPWt8WcF6ptGSq2ueFcLEetgoPxHeorWuczFiBrBJXFG8ooxBw.jpeg)

![IMG_8373.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vi3hmM2AzgcNqWrsfWLqg2vkvV4CqF68ZNbAy2a72PHRcQ77WH6DjEMiPnxJGafNSKJ.jpeg)

![IMG_8374.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wMcyJ4VodgNiBmWTEQTcHiS9QyvVwa6x979YrRDua9UFs2ssQD37Nj33qGX48Hpa2q7.jpeg)

In the afternoon, another thing made me excited because my parcel finally arrived. I ordered a pair of pump sandals from Crocs online. I decided to buy online because I was able to use vouchers and discounts, making it much cheaper compare to buying in stores. I have always like comfortable pump sandals, and the moment I saw this design and color on their page, I instantly fell in love with it. Seeing the actual item made me even happier because it looked exactly as nice as I expected.

![IMG_8534.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vsWmU4GnAjtpnpvRzKxnYmt1XsSBqPxh4aKc5Mc1RWuSvFdkqMEecNrWELJaBTyd8mJ.jpeg)

![IMG_8549.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23vsZ4ciWF6kQB78S4cA9umep8gwt7UmFB3HmHgjddjiKk1MT6eCGkZQkeLMTxDqXxnAE.jpeg)

After some time, I also remembered to take my vitamins for the day. I have been trying to stay consistent with taking care of my health and boosting my immune system, especially with how busy daily life can get.

![IMG_8449.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lj1728/23wCL4WTdoezUeSmtL9UnFpFyH1WRTZJKUY1P9qr1auYoJQR4vhNS6LDaZxaWQx4WRzsi.jpeg)

By dinner time, my cousin invited us over to their house for a small gathering. Of course, we happily went because family get-togethers always feel warm and comforting. They prepared many delicious foods, and we spent the evening eating, chatting, and simply enjoying each other’s company. It was truly a simple but meaningful day filled with food, family, and happiness.

And that's it for today's blog! Thank you so much for dropping by and taking the time to read my simple life story. This means a lot to me! I hope you enjoyed it and see you on my next one. Have a nice day ahead to all of us.😍

These photos were mine and taken with my iphone13pro and the lead image was edited through Canva.✍️👩‍💻

Lots of love,
LJ💗

title.title: Splinterlands - Sorriel the Bale VS Calamity
title.body:
![cs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uFcHZvXdrd9kLsY5vPC3hn1X4fCjUzgTZfvjyF6zHrBzAJaDofEQaNURkoLxXJundBi.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will show you a wild battle from a tournament I participated in. In this battle, the Keep Your Distance modifier is active, so only units with magic and ranged attacks will be allowed; and all units will have their armor reduced to 0 due to the Unprotected modifier. By the way, this is a novice tournament, so all cards will be level 1.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23w2cSENayk4zuArGLwfjviccHJCetKBnQBVJp9cKRMb9pG8J2AC1y1gQuDSC3bqNqTdK.png)</center>

---

This time, I used my reliable archon, Lorkus who will grant +1 attack power to my magic units. And thanks to his left-tactics, I granted the Life Leech and Affliction abilities to my two units in the last position, so that they can gain health based on 50% of the damage they deal, and they will have a 50% chance of applying afllicted to enemy units, so they cannot be healed.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/EoGvTVfr3AM4pCNGL9TDhjdfxUM6BWSU5wQFeZowLCZ5RuAdVbca1K8TABCTEQJRVbZ.png)

---

<div class=\

> https://images.hive.blog/240x260/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/beta/Peaceful%20Giant_lv1.png In the first position, I put the 1 mana undead unit, Shadowy Presence, which may not have attack power, but it has 4 hit points, which is really great for a unit of only 1 mana. In the second position, I put the neutral, Peaceful Giant, another unit with no attack, but which has 8 hit points. ---

> https://images.hive.blog/240x260/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulbound/Skok%20Duskblight_lv1.png In the third position is Will-o-Wisp, which also has no attack power, but will have it thanks to my next unit. It has the Flying (has a 25% chance to evade physical attacks from non-flying units) and Weaken (reduce the health of all enemies by 1) abilities. In the fourth position is Skok Duskblight, who thanks to its Weapons Training ability, will give 2 magic attack power to its adjacent allies with no attack power. ---

> https://images.hive.blog/240x260/https://d36mxiodymuqjm.cloudfront.net/cards_by_level/soulbound/Sorriel%20the%20Bale_lv1.png In the fifth position is Riftwing, who, like Will-o-Wisp, has the flying ability. It also has the Scavenger ability, so it will gain 1 max health each time any unit is defeated. In the sixth and last position is Sorriel the Bale, a powerful legendary unit that has 2 magic attack power and can attack twice thanks to his Double Strike ability. --- ## Battle In the first round, the enemy Calamity defeats my Shadowy Presence. Then, my Skok Duskblight defeats the enemy Voidmaw. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tm76yVBxCMKM78o64qHvDP96Dibh3HZ7SYHriRXFv3XQmhKdQWXEgPNK8iPQnPmoJFq.png) --- In the second round, the enemy Calamity defeats my Peaceful Giant. Then, my Sorriel the Bale defeats the enemy Almo Cambio. After that, Skok Duskblight defeats the enemy Aves Sturgis. ![r2.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRzfZHnKGF8W6YvSes32P76CbHzBTkb1wLqfgKeKaf1RQGQj1zCmBvsgu8hajz3FSyD.gif) --- In the third round, Calamity defeats another one of my units; this time the victim is Will-o-Wisp. And then, Skok Duskblight defeats the Gelatinous Cube. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uExLb3o1yd5ceVu58mDzzHyqMUydtCSiLD9TLPtcRaJcL1dBRmJpjbAUi4z35RnUgxw.png) --- In the fourth round, Skok Duskblight is defeated by Calamity. Then, Sorriel the Bale defeats the enemy, Forked-Tongue Sage. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uEwxyyGH3EWx6uqEdUpCieqRCCComxVXwEVKHvebxzPYgJQZfacs9BcfFrPAj32d3Xp.png) --- After many rounds, finally in the sixth round, Sorriel the Bale ends the battle by defeating the powerful Calamity.
![r6.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/48K62jhLpUeQdFoy65t9EJn4rPJgerJwLUCz4vwpp5zKY18uxyUzk2wRf5hvpibEyo.gif) [Full Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_u2bEzCLCLSMLEXdHKaVs?ref=langice)
--- This time, the opponent used the newest archon, Dragonlord Mancer, who not only granted the scavenger ability to his saurian and bruteborn allies, but also granted the Bloodlust and Corrupted Healing ability to Gelatinous Cube and Calamity, so they gained +1 to all stats each time they defeat any unit, and were also pable to restore 70% of the max health to their other allies. The enemy Calamity did a good job defeating four of my units, but it wasn't enough to face my Riftwing and Sorriel the Bale, whom, thanks to Lorkus granting them the Life Leech ability, had a lot of health and together were able to defeat Calamity. A nice victory for my wild units against Dragonlord Mancer and Calamity, who are very strong in the modern format. --- Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook. That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield! --- Other hive games: Terracore: https://terracoregame.com?ref=aubryd Moonkarts: https://moonkarts.arcadecolony.com ![a1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23w2iyaFnGeFxMUfVZJq3tnHydC7hguGuQKC4gaA73Gk3FEjy3L6uTWNNJFgB8LvSNfai.png)
