title.title: Multimodalidade Real: Quem Processa Áudio e Vídeo Nativamente em 2026
title.body: virou termo de marketing. Quase todo modelo lançado em 2026 se descreve como multimodal. Mas há uma diferença técnica fundamental entre um modelo que aceita imagens via módulo adicionado após o treinamento e um que foi treinado com todas as modalidades desde o início. Em produção, essa diferença se manifesta em qualidade de raciocínio, coerência de resposta e, especialmente, capacidade de processar áudio e vídeo — não apenas imagens estáticas.\n\nO Que \

Significa Tecnicamente
-------------------------------------

Modelos multimodais podem ser construídos de duas formas.

A primeira é a **fusão precoce (early fusion)**: dados de texto, imagem, áudio e vídeo são convertidos em tokens desde o início do pipeline de treinamento. O modelo aprende representações conjuntas de todas as modalidades simultaneamente. Quando você pergunta ao modelo sobre o conteúdo de um vídeo, ele raciocina sobre vídeo da mesma forma que raciocina sobre texto — não é uma operação separada.

A segunda é a **fusão tardia (late fusion)**: um modelo de texto recebe inputs de outros encoders como \

como módulos adicionais. É mais fácil de construir, mas o modelo não aprende relações profundas entre modalidades durante o pré-treinamento. O resultado tende a ser raciocínio multimodal mais superficial e menor robustez quando as modalidades precisam ser integradas.

A maioria dos modelos multimodais de 2024 usava fusão tardia. Em 2026, os líderes migraram para fusão precoce — mas a adoção não é universal.

O Mapa das Capacidades em Maio de 2026
--------------------------------------

**Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google):** O líder atual em multimodalidade nativa completa. Processa texto, imagem, áudio, vídeo e PDF em uma janela de contexto unificada de 1 milhão de tokens. É o único modelo de fronteira que aceita todos os cinco tipos de input nativamente na mesma chamada de API. Contexto de 64K tokens de output. Custo: US$ 2,00/US$ 12,00 por milhão de tokens. GPQA Diamond: 94,3%.

**GPT-5.5 (OpenAI):** Texto, imagens e áudio. Suporte a vídeo é limitado — o modelo não processa vídeo diretamente como stream; extração de frames ainda é necessária para a maioria dos casos. Computer use aprimorado é o destaque da atualização de abril.

**Claude Opus 4.7 (Anthropic):** Texto e imagens apenas. Áudio e vídeo nativos não são suportados. O foco da Anthropic tem sido raciocínio, código e agência — não expansão multimodal. Para uso cases que requerem processamento de áudio ou vídeo, Claude não é a opção em maio de 2026.

**Llama 4 Scout/Maverick (Meta):** Texto e imagem via fusão precoce — o primeiro modelo aberto com MoE multimodal nativo. Vídeo e áudio não são suportados. Para modelo aberto, o nível de integração texto-imagem é superior ao que estava disponível antes.

**Gemma 4 E2B/E4B (Google):** Os únicos modelos open source com vídeo e áudio nativos, via fusão precoce, projetados para rodar em dispositivos edge. A limitação é o tamanho: são modelos de 2 e 4 bilhões de parâmetros efetivos, com capacidade geral mais limitada do que os modelos maiores.

**Grok 4.3 (xAI):** Texto, imagem e vídeo nativo — processamento direto de arquivos de vídeo sem extração de frames. Áudio não está listado como modalidade suportada. Este é um dos diferenciadores do 4.3 em relação ao 4.20.

Por Que Áudio Nativo Muda Casos de Uso
--------------------------------------

A maioria das aplicações que processa áudio hoje usa um pipeline separado: transcrição via Whisper ou equivalente, seguido de processamento de texto pelo LLM. Funciona, mas tem limitações.

A transcrição perde informação paralinguística — entonação, pausas, ênfase emocional. Um modelo com áudio nativo pode inferir humor, certeza ou hesitação diretamente da forma como algo foi dito, não apenas do que foi dito. Para análise de chamadas de atendimento ao cliente, entrevistas, reuniões, essa dimensão é relevante.

O pipeline de transcrição+texto também adiciona latência e custo. Para aplicações de tempo real — assistentes de voz, transcrição live com análise simultânea — a latência do pipeline duplo pode ser proibitiva. Modelos com áudio nativo eliminam uma etapa.

Por Que Vídeo Nativo Muda Casos de Uso
--------------------------------------

Vídeo é composto por frames (imagens) mais áudio, mais a dimensão temporal entre frames. Extrair frames e processar como imagens individuais perde o contexto temporal — o que mudou entre frame 1 e frame 100, o movimento, a sequência de eventos.

Processamento de vídeo nativo captura a dimensão temporal. Para análise de segurança (câmeras CCTV), monitoramento industrial, análise de esportes ou procedimentos médicos gravados, a sequência importa tanto quanto o frame individual.

O Gemini 3.1 Pro no contexto de 1 milhão de tokens pode processar vídeos longos, não apenas clips curtos. Para revisão de documentação em vídeo, análise de treinamentos ou auditorias de processo, isso abre casos de uso que antes exigiam análise humana completa.

A Fronteira de 2026: Vídeo em Tempo Real
----------------------------------------

O que ainda não existe em nenhum modelo comercialmente disponível de forma confiável em maio de 2026 é processamento de vídeo ao vivo — stream de câmera em tempo real com raciocínio simultâneo.

Há demonstrações técnicas e previews em alguns laboratórios. Mas para produção estável, a fronteira atual é vídeo gravado, não stream ao vivo. Para IoT industrial com câmeras em tempo real, ainda há dependência de pipelines híbridos com processamento especializado de visão computacional antes do LLM.

Essa é a próxima barreira — e a corrida para ultrapassá-la já está em andamento.

title.title: White sauce Creamy pasta
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP6h8sgyGkLSZiqnW6Nxus5d6z3HtAk91DFbjQ8yGp6a6/1779718988057.jpg)

Hey guys, what’s up?
Today I’ve come with a very delicious and easy recipe that everyone will love. It is white sauce pasta, but the special thing is that this version is very simple and quick to make. You don’t need to spend too much time in the kitchen 😉
Most of you must have eaten white sauce pasta before, but today I will show you an easy homemade style that saves time and still tastes very creamy and yummy. My children really love this pasta, and I am sure that both kids and adults will enjoy it a lot. So let’s start without wasting any time.

# Ingredients:
2 packets pasta (you can choose any shape you like)
Milk (1 box or fresh milk) – it makes the pasta creamy and rich
Spices: salt, red chili, chicken cube, black pepper, turmeric, onion powder
Chicken pieces
Capsicum (2 medium size)
Carrot (3 medium size)
Green onion
Soy sauce
Ketchup
Butter (1 tablespoon)
Cheese (for creamy texture)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUoBqXCpha9CthiQ31GTZ1szTfhdtGXkbbNx95rbfp9Mn/1779719057748.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRiNCeNhjck5AYHqwtL979XHatFTwHKr2GuuAp9yMFVFJ/1779719058165.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVjrEk1PET9igSmaayZ9UDPCoMb12eRrYKfnx2DrEGuM1/1779719058581.jpg)

# Preparation:
First, wash and cut the vegetables. Cut carrots into long thin strips.
Cut capsicum in the same long shape so it looks nice after cooking.
Cut green onions into small pieces as shown in the picture.
Take the cheese and crush or grate it so it melts easily later in the pasta.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBffeKEegxeA1GgdUUteCdGGZHhvKuqem3vmXWZNWmPU/1779719118523.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaHoeRZ45ik6t6gXwPtTrpARtkrYehbtUZADP7yzLgZuj/1779719118887.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPdwU8byzVKjfmRBj7nYWqDv5fNCuQHuBkCfTfUeTx6hu/1779719119222.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTtVn52aTLMAxFP914GdNUjkEt8Y8pC8bzmuF7Tf3x7f3/1779719119564.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXA76a1L9PD9QQSX289dEokb6utnLYQ8sDy6jSFnHGCje/1779719119895.jpg)

# Cooking Method:
Now take a large pot. Add 2 packets of pasta into it. Pour milk and add the same amount of water so that the pasta is fully covered. This will help the pasta cook properly and become soft and creamy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcYAg11DcU3Fw3gG5s2ertexqox31mpdDesGSUTYLtaDu/1779719169671.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP9zn8JGHHQhDRadzasEZpFuRZkDTRJu8VPhSJ1XPAKbF/1779719170035.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWt8dJDcFmGVdzcT1uprGY8MfkmUjjRkT8HLfjKbVQzpH/1779719170357.jpg)

Now add all the spices including salt, red chili, black pepper, turmeric, chicken cube, and onion powder. Also add 1 tablespoon of butter. Cook it on medium flame and keep stirring sometimes so it does not stick to the pot. Cook until the pasta becomes soft and the liquid starts getting creamy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcfn27KTJqqRR6rPuyrsbDTYjrxtAgUg4Ex8qZv3zzm3g/1779719218448.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP7YK9pA7Lov5rzNsr9YyNvBDGzTYhRxEC7Z3fSHUQUF4/1779719218760.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXGuUWCv4qExvfEBtGgcoAR5k5fHeCq31Wdy5okcJAu2/1779719219042.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYtGqkxug3oGykEgD3gndqDMSABDHCHjH86KmausMFFLK/1779719219371.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7g1nWdNixCa1ENCHaPtTFSieLYCRyFfDG9ZPpzXh3CF/1779719219713.jpg)

On the other side, take a pan and fry the chicken. Add red chili and black pepper for taste. (If your chicken is already cooked, you can directly use it like I did.)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUHzxa8LvB1aHBXEaGNLtZ1pCRsEHng2YgWkiGnqaejHG/1779719252431.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVMsGJkxRZiHYYmj9rE886uZTsqdjxBfkiZZQ21PZmtiw/1779719252776.jpg)

Now add carrots and capsicum into the chicken. Cover the pan and let it cook for a few minutes until vegetables become soft but still slightly crunchy. At the end, add soy sauce, ketchup, and green onions to give it a nice flavor.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqQC76XBqpyqbvs7GJhnSv5Q7ReSUfgjtphJoNXYAVU4/1779719315757.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYTnbbcWTBH8jGAW6P6XxyVp1qSPJN8KgQMnYm8Go4y6M/1779719316127.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR1k96BpDo33uvBAUKm7ECgKhL6dSJjacsfmyKH4ZxsfE/1779719316475.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR6Q8YJiDWdYoMxVvJDMuHaesRsWghxhWuysyFW7AEPsE/1779719316811.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQB6aicZWdA8qNodP3JaEMKh6itAVsHnM8hE2J2DRoffi/1779719317149.jpg)

Now check your pasta. If it is soft and cooked, turn off the flame. Make sure a little liquid is still there because pasta absorbs it and becomes more creamy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTudxy5qrYG82mTi4qc3ENgoHU31vbqTDcyLSVqz6To9c/1779719346057.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS2G4WTDfMVBv96gGTd1vfZaMRXtF1GfgedtD5PJo8MKc/1779719346340.jpg)

Now add cheese into the hot pasta so it melts and makes a rich creamy texture.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR5ioy2Lw3SLfagr7z1UsqtCtyehNEpfndAgQSv6wPbmD/1779719368142.jpg)

Finally, add the cooked chicken and vegetable mixture into the pasta and mix everything well.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNYHoCHL32vhZCyTqXAHf7qTc2bBwqCDtsTyeMehuMy5T/1779719399766.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSTqVp7dUmnaE6k5XcKhGsgm5rNT1kJAnp5UgJhE8BBW8/1779719400131.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXdZ9rhgrag7v8gfEshi3U59TDKpxCgZkHxkgwpVPuaNP/1779719400459.jpg)

Your creamy white sauce pasta is now ready!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdu54YZRomJYDWD6DFbS8tZuowCA55V9bPDSePsyJpjRK/1779719413856.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQ1W38KCzD9D8nEZMNqKgof4HcH3fuvqawHPdH6HCQiv/1779719425233.jpg)

Wow, it looks so delicious 😍 The smell is amazing and the taste is even better. Try this recipe at home and enjoy it with your family. Everyone will love it for sure!

title.title: Protect your social media space
title.body:
---



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULfAFwNoBtXEqXMQq1XjVLMW3xygQN3N7ughj5KHfMwj/rnfetchblobtmp_qe08xtjnabhi2lp5f623ha.png)


---


The rate of social media theft this days is alarming. Hackers are internationally hacking and taking people's account in order to use and scam others. Some will do it in such a way that you can never regain access to your account again. This is why everyone should be intentional about protecting their social media account if and only if it's important to them.
‎
‎There are different ways of protecting your account these days and we should all make good use of it, if not we stand a chance of loosing our account.  The following ways can help ;
‎
‎Use a strong and  passwords and it must be very unique, you can even make it long passwords combine with uppercase, lowercase, letters, symbols nd numbers.
‎Do not make use of  the same password across platforms. And ensure it's not your birthday or simple words combined with your name. 
‎
‎
‎Two factor authentication adds an extra security layer and protection to your account
‎Even if someone gets your password, they still need a verification code from your phone or your email, which is why you should have an active email linked to your social media account. Your email controls password resets for most social media accounts. Because that's where they will contact your Incase of password reset. So if  hackers access your email, they may access everything else. Therefore are you are trying to keep your account safe , ensure the email link to those account is also safe.
‎
‎Do not click suspicious links to claim prizes. Anytime I remember how I lost about 59 pie, just because of clicking a link, my heart bleeds. All my pie was wiped out.  We love free things and give away, so at times it is necessary to avoid free wifi. Some people fall for give away easily. And most of these people give links for one to follow, and that alone can expose your account to danger if it's not a legit link.
‎
‎So protecting your social media account is very necessary and  protecting your social media accounts requires careful online habits and proper security measures. Therefore, one must be very careful and watchful while doing social media.
‎

title.title: [ENG/ESP] Geodiversity of the Escambray Mountains and its impact on sustainable tourism (AN)
title.body:
> We recently took a relaxing trip to the most important mountain range in the center of the country, and we were amazed by the natural beauty of this area and everything we were able to appreciate. On the trip, only the author was a specialist in Geography and Geology, but my wife and the couple of friends who accompanied us also contributed to this post, which I share here, about this imposing mountain system.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1TbwU7qt3g9qFfBA23tuCpda8ZSmKpHJir498Zi8sBV/1779711867593.jpg) Heading to the Highest Peaks of Central Cuba The geodiversity of the Guamuhaya massif, popularly known as Escambray, is one of the pillars that explain both the unique landscape of the region and its growing importance for sustainable tourism in Cuba. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJsGAC2UwomfxVBYjdUSeU4F8MnXFMVJrdEKKHs5xE4Y/img_20231016_122928.jpg) This territory, where Topes de Collantes is located, is a geological mosaic formed by metamorphic, sedimentary, and volcanic rocks that tell the story of complex tectonic processes that occurred over millions of years. The presence of serpentinites, schists, limestones, and sandstones creates a landscape where each formation tells a different story about the origin and evolution of the Cuban archipelago. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSejK2wgtbk37ZdjCTAPtk2cr3F1tS1STWGtFoMMtY5jY/1779711340311.jpg) The rugged topography, with rounded hills, deep valleys, cliffs, and natural terraces, creates a variety of microclimates that favor the coexistence of diverse ecosystems. This geological and geomorphological richness not only defines the landscape but also influences the flora, fauna, and human uses of the land. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3W2Jr2YtCUR4FgzU2HyhWxjrBpkSfW4e9FFkaXUYK9j/1779711316613.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6RrGMbtjxmtLEjKy2T6mGzaVsMKGjxsgKmyMVqkg3Cv/1779711975772.jpg) In Topes de Collantes, for example, the combination of fertile soils, high humidity, and cooler temperatures than on the plains has allowed the development of rainforests, mountain pine forests, and endemic plant communities that attract researchers, hikers, and nature lovers. In Topes de Collantes, for example, the combination of fertile soils, high humidity, and cooler temperatures than on the plains has allowed the development of rainforests, mountain pine forests, and endemic plant communities that attract researchers, hikers, and nature lovers.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqNJArij1fvGxXmodziXUNg9NqLsYdn8hRZUv6hPUtM4/1779711857101.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRGHAtBw9cmLMY4x3kMVcCCbX1Grbc8475qmYZsiUL9G/1779711817030.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTTgqh4hodmjxk7QCVz95erBK5swQAh5DnvZUsbXA4Vh/1779711801380.jpg) From a tourism perspective, the geodiversity of the Escambray Mountains becomes a strategic resource. The trails that wind through the Hourglass Formation, the Flower Shade, the waterfalls, and the natural caves allow visitors to directly experience the interaction between geology and life. Each route offers opportunities for environmental education, landscape interpretation, and appreciation of natural heritage. This approach, when properly managed, fosters a form of tourism that not only observes but also learns and respects. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePKBoKSwEWgMFV3CoryR2KbLwAcnUgpwedacdP2FFWaH/1779711654810.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbZfQFEhRXFHywZiuRx7JH9j5PfSMsjphdqiZ7j2w1CV/1779711662720.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSkogb5ioGpPGEc27E15qma9G8vmjoNBiubHDaZWp2yU6/img_20231016_122934.jpg) Sustainable tourism finds an ideal setting for its development in the Escambray Mountains. The existence of protected areas, the regulation of access to certain trails, and the participation of the local community in guiding, crafts, and complementary services allow for a more equitable distribution of economic benefits. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNq73D4kbx7UZdwYC3Je13mxE89c8Ja6ekW7arHVoBcMc/1779711565456.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcavcdz76RMBByK3JRyKxuiTm1RKDiL3dTgfrDfCZTdc/1779711553288.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPCJVjNqHuHZXqjo9J2ZptpWcixhP3MGKtn4uRHnEoPw9/1779711956916.jpg) At the same time, pressure on the most fragile ecosystems is reduced. The presence of the Kurhotel and tourist facilities integrated into the landscape demonstrates that it is possible to combine infrastructure with conservation when ecological limits are respected. Geodiversity also drives research projects, environmental monitoring, and education, strengthening the sustainable management of the territory. Every rock, every landform, and every soil type becomes an open-air classroom where students, scientists, and visitors can understand the importance of protecting a heritage that does not renew itself on a human timescale. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3ghcLwY6EKmzmcFkkRSS8pCSXxPELMABz5DUaJCK2DP/1779712062091.jpg) **A final comment** The geodiversity of the Escambray Mountains is not just a physical feature: it is a driving force for identity, knowledge, and responsible development. Its proper valuation ensures that future generations can continue to enjoy this exceptional landscape without compromising its integrity. *Note: I used DeepL Translate*. *The images are my own*. ***ESPAÑOL*** **Una introducción necesaria** Recientemente tuvimos un viaje de descanso al macizo montañoso más importante del centro del país y, nos quedamos maravillados por las bellezas naturales que alberga este espacio natural y por todo lo que pudimos apreciar. En el viaje, solo el autor era especialista en Geografía y Geología, pero mi esposa y la pareja de amigos que nos acompañaron también aportaron para esta publicación que aquí les dejo, sobre este imponente sistema montañoso. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT1TbwU7qt3g9qFfBA23tuCpda8ZSmKpHJir498Zi8sBV/1779711867593.jpg) **Rumbo a las alturas más elevadas del centro de Cuba** La geodiversidad del macizo Guamuhaya, conocido popularmente como Escambray, constituye uno de los pilares que explican tanto la singularidad paisajística de la región como su creciente importancia para el turismo sostenible en Cuba. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJsGAC2UwomfxVBYjdUSeU4F8MnXFMVJrdEKKHs5xE4Y/img_20231016_122928.jpg) Este territorio, donde se enclava Topes de Collantes, es un mosaico geológico formado por rocas metamórficas, sedimentarias y volcánicas que narran procesos tectónicos complejos ocurridos durante millones de años. La presencia de serpentinitas, esquistos, calizas y areniscas crea un escenario donde cada formación cuenta una historia distinta sobre el origen y evolución del archipiélago cubano. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSejK2wgtbk37ZdjCTAPtk2cr3F1tS1STWGtFoMMtY5jY/1779711340311.jpg) La topografía accidentada,con lomas redondeadas, valles profundos, farallones y terrazas naturales, genera una variedad de microclimas que favorecen la coexistencia de ecosistemas muy diversos. Esta riqueza geológica y geomorfológica no solo define el paisaje, sino que condiciona la flora, la fauna y los usos humanos del territorio. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3W2Jr2YtCUR4FgzU2HyhWxjrBpkSfW4e9FFkaXUYK9j/1779711316613.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ6RrGMbtjxmtLEjKy2T6mGzaVsMKGjxsgKmyMVqkg3Cv/1779711975772.jpg) En Topes de Collantes, por ejemplo, la combinación de suelos fértiles, humedad elevada y temperaturas más frescas que en el llano ha permitido el desarrollo de bosques pluviales, pinares de montaña y comunidades vegetales endémicas que atraen a investigadores, excursionistas y amantes de la naturaleza.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqNJArij1fvGxXmodziXUNg9NqLsYdn8hRZUv6hPUtM4/1779711857101.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXRGHAtBw9cmLMY4x3kMVcCCbX1Grbc8475qmYZsiUL9G/1779711817030.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTTgqh4hodmjxk7QCVz95erBK5swQAh5DnvZUsbXA4Vh/1779711801380.jpg) Desde la perspectiva turística, la geodiversidad del Escambray se convierte en un recurso estratégico. Los senderos que recorren el Reloj de Arena, el Umbráculo de las Flores, los saltos de agua y las cuevas naturales permiten que el visitante experimente de manera directa la interacción entre geología y vida. Cada ruta ofrece oportunidades para la educación ambiental, la interpretación del paisaje y la valoración del patrimonio natural. Este enfoque, cuando se gestiona adecuadamente, fortalece un turismo que no solo contempla, sino que aprende y respeta. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmePKBoKSwEWgMFV3CoryR2KbLwAcnUgpwedacdP2FFWaH/1779711654810.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRbZfQFEhRXFHywZiuRx7JH9j5PfSMsjphdqiZ7j2w1CV/1779711662720.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSkogb5ioGpPGEc27E15qma9G8vmjoNBiubHDaZWp2yU6/img_20231016_122934.jpg) El turismo sostenible encuentra en el Escambray un escenario ideal para su desarrollo. La existencia de áreas protegidas, la regulación del acceso a ciertos senderos y la participación de la comunidad local en actividades de guiado, artesanía y servicios complementarios permiten que los beneficios económicos se distribuyan de manera más equitativa. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNq73D4kbx7UZdwYC3Je13mxE89c8Ja6ekW7arHVoBcMc/1779711565456.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcavcdz76RMBByK3JRyKxuiTm1RKDiL3dTgfrDfCZTdc/1779711553288.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPCJVjNqHuHZXqjo9J2ZptpWcixhP3MGKtn4uRHnEoPw9/1779711956916.jpg) Al mismo tiempo, se reduce la presión sobre los ecosistemas más frágiles. La presencia del Kurhotel y de instalaciones turísticas integradas al paisaje demuestra que es posible combinar infraestructura con conservación cuando se respetan los límites ecológicos. La geodiversidad también impulsa proyectos de investigación, monitoreo ambiental y educación, lo que fortalece la gestión sostenible del territorio. Cada roca, cada relieve y cada suelo se convierten en un aula abierta donde estudiantes, científicos y visitantes pueden comprender la importancia de proteger un patrimonio que no se renueva a escala humana. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ3ghcLwY6EKmzmcFkkRSS8pCSXxPELMABz5DUaJCK2DP/1779712062091.jpg) **Un comentario final** La geodiversidad del Escambray no es solo un rasgo físico: es un motor de identidad, conocimiento y desarrollo responsable. Su adecuada valoración garantiza que las futuras generaciones puedan seguir disfrutando de este paisaje excepcional sin comprometer su integridad. *Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate*. *Las imágenes son de mi propiedad*.

Decidi aplicar una mezcla exótica de varios tejidos, creando un estilo aesthetic único y original.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRtxtf3D9Q2D5F49CCdxxS7QY6kG6GBS34w17jg8PfZUo/1779717641296.jpg)
🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️

Materiales / Materials

  • Hilo y aguja
  • Elastico

    • 🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️🧵✂️ >Fabric Scissors Thread and needle Elastic Measuring tape Pins Sewing machine 🩶🖤**Procedimiento/ Procedure:**🩶🖤 **#1** *I started by drafting each piece using samples of a pullover for the top and shorts for the bottom, always leaving a 1cm seam allowance.* *This resulted in four pieces for the shorts and three for the pullover, with short ribbons added for a decorative touch.* **#1** >*Comence sacando cada pieza con ayuda de unas muestras de un pullover, para la parte de arriba y un short para la parte de abajo, dejandole 1cm de margen de costura siempre.* >*Obteniendo cuatro piezas para el short y tres para el pulover, con listones cortos para darle el toque estético.*
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVRvst5pBvYdeWJzHAm1SjMK2KkgnwCdRyeAg7VfSwpQy/1779708008427.jpg)
    **#2** *Once each piece was cut, I proceeded to begin sewing the garment. For the front, I used two different pieces of fabric. In the case of the black piece with yellow lettering, I made a sort of arch at the front to join it to the sleeve and shoulders of the other piece.* *Then I sewed the pieces together with a long, straight stitch 1 cm from the seam where the two fabrics meet. I made loops from the ribbons and placed them in a cross shape at the seam.* *Then join the front and back pieces at the shoulders and then at the sides. Finishing with a small cuff at the cuffs, as well as at the collar.* **#2** >*Ya picada cada pieza procedo a iniciar la confección de la prenda. Para el delantero tome dos piezas diferentes de tejido, en el caso de la negra cn letras amarilla le hice una especie de arco en el frente, para unirlo al desmangado y hombros del otro tejido.* >*Luego unidos asiento la costura dandole una puntada larga y recta a 1cm del empate de las dos telas. Con los listones hice trabillas y las coloque en forma de cruz en dicho empate.* >*Luego uni delantero con trasero por los hombros y luego por los laterales. Culminando con un puñito en las bocamangas, al igual que el cuello.*
    ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRTLd2p3LkirwpxzHymPhq9y3Hst1bo5FzvbqKg8mGRwq/1779708033451.jpg)

Next, I joined the side seams and finished all the seam allowances with a zigzag stitch.* **#3** >*Para el short uni dos piezas diferentes para la parte de alante, haciendo una especie de arco. 🍀💚 Tio tigre y Tio conejo, son personajes populares en cuentos infantiles por toda Venezuela, existen muchos cuentos, con variedad de temas y en algunos se involucran otros animales también Hola comunidad #Needleworkmanday hoy les vengo a contar y mostrar un poco de estos personajes

title.title: Angerona, una historia en el silencio. - Angerona: A Story Woven in Silence [Esp - Eng]
title.body: /> Angerona es considerada en la mitología como la diosa romana de la angustia y del miedo; pero no solo lo generaba, sino era también quien aliviaba esas penas, se buscaba consuelo en ella y en las plegarias que se le dirigía. En otra versión de su historia, es considerada la diosa del silencio, algo así como la protectora de los grandes secretos que debían guardarse de por vida. Bajo esas ideas se erigía la figura mitológica en la antigüedad. > In mythology, Angerona is known as the Roman goddess of anguish and fear—yet she was not merely a source of dread, but also the one who soothed it. Those who suffered turned to her, seeking solace in whispered prayers. In another telling of her story, she becomes the goddess of silence, the keeper of profound secrets meant to be guarded for a lifetime. It was through these intertwined notions that her ancient figure took shape.

/> Por otra parte, conocía la existencia en la cercanías de Artemisa (¡casualidad o no! Esta ciudad lleva también el nombre de una de las diosas mitológicas) de un lugar llamado Angerona, un lugar envuelto en una historia de amar, de silencio, de misterio y de ruinas, un lugar que respira historia, que posee una espiritualidad increíble a pesar de los avatares del tiempo y el castigo de la indiferencia y el abandono. La verdad es que estas ruinas, de lo que fuera uno de los cafetales más próspero de la regional occidental de Cuba y el segundo de toda la isla, contiene una misticidad donde conspiran juntos la diosa y sus personajes principales: Cornelius Souchay y Ursula Lambert. > I had long known that near Artemisa—fittingly named after yet another mythological goddess—there stood a place called Angerona, a site enveloped in a tale of love, silence, mystery, and ruins. A place that breathes history, carrying an uncanny spirituality that survives the passing of time and the harshness of indifference and abandonment. > > These ruins, once part of one of the most prosperous coffee plantations in western Cuba and the second largest on the island, hold a kind of mysticism where the goddess herself seems to conspire with the two central figures of the story: Cornelius Souchay and Ursula Lambert.

/> Todo esto suena romántico: una hacienda protegida por la diosa de la angustia/el miedo/ el silencio, protegiendo un amor imposible para aquella época entre un alemán y una negra libre. Todo parece un grito silencioso hacia las nuevas generaciones por venir ¿cuántas veces la sociedad no ha frenado, con sus prejuicios lo que pudiera ser una amor entrañable digno de las historias recogidas en los libros de antaño, lo que solo dos personas sienten y que solo los valientes se lanzan a perpetuar? Cuenta el historiador del lugar, un anciano carismático, que hasta Cirilo Villaverde visitó la hacienda y se inspiró en aquel misterio sin certezas para escribir una de las novelas cumbres de la literatura cubana cubana: Cecilia Valdés. Una historia cargada de pasiones prohibidas, de bodas irrealizables, de mestizaje, de hijos bastardos regados por doquier y coronado con una historia dramática que logra sacar lágrimas a quien se atreva a leerla. > There is something undeniably romantic about it all: an estate watched over by the goddess of anguish, fear, or silence—depending on which myth you choose—sheltering a love that should have been impossible in its time, between a German man and a free Black woman. It feels like a silent outcry aimed at future generations. How often has society, with its prejudices, smothered what might have become a profound and tender love—one worthy of the old stories, one felt only by two souls, and carried forward only by those bold enough to defy the world? > > The local historian, a charismatic elder, tells that even Cirilo Villaverde once visited the estate and drew from its uncertain mysteries the inspiration for one of the great novels of Cuban literature: Cecilia Valdés. A tale steeped in forbidden passions, impossible unions, tangled lineages, scattered illegitimate children, and crowned by a dramatic ending that can move to tears anyone who dares to enter its pages.

/> El viaje por el lugar, entre barracones, murallas, poblado de esclavo, área de castigo, dialogo con el historiador te va trasladando hacia el pasado y va creando en tu mente imágenes casi tangibles de como era la vida en el lugar, de las fiestas que se hacían, del ambiente que se vivía en el día a día la hacienda. Allí entre cuentos nos enteremos de la descendencia del apellido Souchay de los esclavos y la vigencia que tenía hoy en la ciudad de Artemisa en las nuevas generaciones. También de las extrañas reglas que dominaban el lugar como que en la casa principal no podía pernoctar nadie, solo el dueño de la hacienda, incluso si un familiar venía de visita, existía en las afuera de la casa central otra pequeña morada para recibir a los visitantes pero en la casa principal solo podía dormir ese alemán misterioso. > As you move through the place—past the barracks, the stone walls, the slave quarters, the punishment grounds—and fall into conversation with the historian, the past begins to rise around you. It shapes itself into almost tangible images: the life that once pulsed there, the festivities, the daily rhythm of the estate. In the midst of his stories, we learned of the Souchay lineage carried by the descendants of the enslaved, a surname that still survives in Artemisa among the younger generations. He also spoke of the peculiar rules that governed the estate, such as the prohibition against anyone sleeping in the main house except its owner. Even if a relative visited, a small dwelling outside the central residence was used to host them, for only that enigmatic German man was allowed to rest beneath the roof of the great house.

/>\n\nYa por último, les puedo contar que el lugar fue declarado Monumento Nacional por la importancia cultural y económica que representa en la historia de nuestro país. Allí también si firmó una parte de la película \

, si mal no recuerdo y ha sido lugar de obligatoria visita para todos los artemiseños y todos que visiten esta tierra. Yo, aunque sabía de su presencia demoré mi visita por varios años. Cada vez que tomaba la carretera de Cayajabos observaba a lo lejos las hermosas columnas que desafiaban el tiempo y a la gravedad, observaba como se levantaban en medio de aquel terreno llano sin sentido aparente. > And finally, I should say that the site was declared a National Monument, a recognition of the cultural and economic weight it carries in the history of our country. Part of the film Café Amargo was shot there—if memory serves—and it has long been a place of pilgrimage for the people of Artemisa and for anyone who sets foot on this land. I myself knew of its presence, yet postponed my visit for years. Each time I drove along the Cayajabos road, I would catch sight of those elegant columns in the distance, defying time and gravity, rising inexplicably from the flat earth as if summoned by some ancient will.

/> Allí hay muchas historias ocultas, historias resguardadas por la diosa pagana, incluso cuentan que hay un gran tesoro escondido, un tesoro incalculable que nadie ha encontrado. Dicen. Quizás ya se encontró. Quizás el tesoro que todos buscan son joyas y oro sin saber que le verdadero valor de todo aquello radica allí: en la historia que ha trascendido a cientos de años y que se mantiene viva aún en nuestras generaciones. El tesoro en sí en todo lo que rodea y envuelve su atmósfera de silencio, amor y angustia. > Many hidden stories linger there, stories sheltered by the pagan goddess. Some claim that a great treasure lies buried—an immeasurable fortune no one has ever uncovered. Or so the tale goes. Perhaps it was found long ago. Perhaps the treasure people imagine as jewels and gold is something else entirely: the true worth lies in the history that has crossed centuries and still breathes within us today. The treasure is, in truth, everything that surrounds the place—its atmosphere of silence, of love, of anguish.

/>

title.title: More chess, more fun - Hivechess S22 R7  Recap
title.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR7PmNoYHYWj7fy58mY6iCehDzptBszr7Y7j1z5YerLCY/10.png)</center>



Hello everyone.
After 6 round we were finally all together during Friday Hivechess Tournament. More players in the tournaments means more games of chess plazed.
**Winner of round 7 was @eniolw (eniolw). Second place went to @fcastro177 (FCastro17) with @southgamer (SouthGamer) finishing third. Congratulations to all.** 
I finished 6th in this round. Win in the last seconds in berserk mode to make nice jump in the standings. 
**<center>
Top 10 Round 7 </center>**

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRAJCv8Nn4ZJY83wtgUBGpTtkev92CttrhPsSai13q8Ni/11.png)</center>





**<center>More chess, more fun</center>**

Playing fast chess means more games played but quality play is not what you my find. It works for me as more games mean more fun and funny enough it most time looks good on standings. 
This round I managed to play 19 games total which was most this round. Win percentage was only 37% but it was good enough for 6th place. In top 10 8 players had win rate of 50% or more. In conclusion more games with less win rate was more productive - worth noting is that I berserked 6 games and won 4 of them.
Also round 2 and round 6 I had most games played while in first round I was tied for first. 
Slowing down game play and improving can be one direction to go but for now playing fast is fun. 

**<center>Overall standings</center>**

Standings in both groups are close. In masters section 4 players are within 6 points from second to forth place. 
In Challengers group almost same as top 4 players are within 5 points. 
Competitive three round to go. 

**<center>Some games from the Round 7</center>**

Playing fast and making blunders. 
My game against @vasigo (vasigo).
This was position before the wrong move. I did not pay attention to the back rank. Went for a pawn grab on b2. Which was a very good move for my opponent. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmabtZjQXE6JQ8FdcDBrv8ZWPDj1nQzZkdW3DWiwLyV3ng/1.gif)</center>

 @vasigo saw it and it was game over. Good game.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ1fjb1U4RqLo6baQDh3RTLRhb2oWCKNVg3gRUbU5QHyD/2.gif)</center>

**Game link
https://lichess.org/kvWH4kma/black#0**

The next game was last game of the tournament against  @stranger27 (stranger27). 
Both of us berserked as there was a bit more than 2 minutes to the end of the tournament. 
Fast forward to this position. Here @stranger27 (stranger27) has 5.3 seconds left and tournament ends in 6 or 7 seconds. So I had to play fast in order to flag and get win in time. 



<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZSTYWyor15rsCd98vnN2aVwDfYxfQZCm3HBeKJ61uGr1/3.png)</center>

I went for a several sacrifices to try to use as much his time as possible.
First was bishop takes f5 check.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYNnUaWLCQf4ZboSZiyjRXT3Tng4izTD3WmjZ1zjpr2Yi/6.gif)</center>

Next one was Rock to g7 check. More free pieces.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeo8znbuXAFo6hXuubBYKNxQ6gHsawq4JFa4mjxrSaLGk/5.gif)</center>


Last move was Queen to e7 check where my opponent run out of time and this win counted and boosted my spot in the standings. 
It was exciting game especially in the end.


<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMSbt77zMoNS76pKiEP4yb16RpvKmnQUiqfCmkpMv3Lf/4.gif)</center>

**Game link
https://lichess.org/6phyFxCH/white#0**

I did similar thing back in high school days during tournament. Game was played over the board and my opponent did not pay much attention to the clock. When he was low on time (several seconds if I remember correctly) I just made fast moves that forced him to take my pieces and he run out of time. 

Clock is part of the game. Sometimes winning in losing position is good but not that much if you are on receiving end. 
What do you think about these type of chess positions and endgames?



15% of the post payout goes to @badge-646464

title.title: The Joy of Manggahan 🥭 Colorful Street Dance - Part 1
title.body: /> It was a sunny afternoon when my husband and I scrambled our way to the sidewalk. The pavement was packed with people waiting for the street dance. This is one of the awaited events during the Manggahan Festival. People waited patiently for more than an hour. Suddenly, the loud beats of the drums echoed through the streets. Everyone was so excited that they started clapping. The very first ones to perform are the blue clusters. They were wearing white t-shirts with the new Manggahan logo. They also have native woven straw hats with big blue ribbons. Ladies were wearing puffy light-blue skirts made of shiny fabric. The men were wearing light-blue pants with layered pleated fabric that swayed with their moves.

/> * * * * * * The next cluster is more colorful than the first one. They also wear straw hats, but instead of ribbons they put a plaid band with mangos on the front. They also wear white t-shirts, but they added ruffled layers of yellow, green, blue, purple, and red fabric. The men wore off-white pants with plaid bottom. The women wore layered skirts. Flip-flops are their footwear. They moved gracefully in every beat.

/> * * * * * * The third cluster is more energetic than the first two. They have more arm movements and louder cheers. People love them and even mimic their cheers. Their costumes are composed of three colors: green, white, and red. They have a green bandana headband and green fabric in their hands.

/> After the three colorful clusters, it was followed by the employees of the Provincial Administrator's Office. They wore white t-shirts with the Manggahan logo. The first 3 performers did great. People were cheering for more. I'll share more in the next part 😊 * * * * * *

>Texts and Images by @vvodjiu

All photos were edited on Lightroom for minimal enhancements

title.title: Push ads networks
title.body:
Push advertising has become one of the easier formats to integrate into multi-channel campaigns because it works well for both testing and scaling phases. I’ve seen campaigns perform steadily when creatives are kept simple and landing pages load quickly on mobile devices. A lot of advertisers focus only on CTR, but delivery consistency and audience freshness matter just as much over time. While researching different traffic sources, I checked [Push ads networks](https://dao.ad/traffic-volume/push) and found the traffic volume data quite informative for comparing available reach between networks. It helps to understand where campaigns can realistically scale before launching larger budgets. Push ads still work effectively for subscriptions, utilities, e-commerce, and mainstream offers when targeting and frequency settings are adjusted carefully instead of relying purely on aggressive bidding strategies.

---

body.title: Eid atmosphere at the village cattle market
body.body: > Our village's cattle market seemed to have regained a whole new lease of life ahead of this year's Eid. The crowd of people and the lowing of cows had created a different atmosphere since morning. Even from a distance, you could tell how much diversity there was in the market. Small and large cows of various colors were standing in rows. It felt like a living exhibition. Traders from different parts of the country had brought cows. Some cows were big and healthy, while others were small but quite fidgety. Buyers were looking at the cows with great attention. Some were looking at the teeth, some were touching the body, and some were bargaining over the price. This whole scene is very familiar, but it feels new every year. ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-25 at 20.06.16.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQx8x4gKzoTY1aanjwUPSmFikf7nH5LTh6FqG29UxtMeU/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-25%20at%2020.06.16.jpeg) This time, the price of cows seemed to be quite good. The sellers had smiles on their faces because they were getting the right price for their hard work. Many buyers were also satisfied because they were able to find the cows they wanted. While walking around the market, I realized that this market was not just a place for buying and selling, but a kind of gathering place for the people of the village. ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-25 at 20.06.17.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPNorbeuZTyfEcBARstZCCncN2b7MskifpbpkP5JeZFLr/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-05-25%20at%2020.06.17.jpeg) It was a really great experience to walk around the market with friends and see the cows. We stopped at times to have tea and enjoy the hustle and bustle around. The little children were jumping with joy at the sight of the cows, which made the whole atmosphere even more beautiful. --- Location | Nandail, Mymensingh ---|--- Photographer | @haideremtiaz --- --- Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@haideremti/eid-atmosphere-at-the-village-cattle-market-drh)

body.title: Me di mi Descanso - Mensaje diario de 5 minutos
body.body:
Me di un descanso del amor, y curiosamente lo que más encontré quedándome sola, fue amor. 

Me volví paciente conmigo porque lo estoy intentando, porque me estoy esforzando, porque estoy sanando y no es fácil, porque lo estoy haciendo bien y lo hago a mi ritmo. 

Me volví exigente con las personas que entran a mi vida, ya no hay espacio para cualquiera, al corazón ya solamente entra quien lo cuida y quien se lo gana con acciones todos los días. 

Me volví buena conmigo, me llevo a lugares bonitos, tomo el café con calma, me dedico mi tiempo y soy mi prioridad porque al final la única persona que sí va a quererme toda la vida, soy yo.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPNLaB8VMNnAHUTKPmjVjpDzDbiXWehRQoc936mToaPSs/1779718140935.jpg)


ENGLISH

I took a break from love, and curiously enough, what I found most while being alone was love.

I became patient with myself because I'm trying, because I'm making an effort, because I'm healing and it's not easy, because I'm doing well and I'm doing it at my own pace.

I became demanding with the people who enter my life — there's no longer room for just anyone. Only those who take care of my heart and earn it with their actions every day get to come in.

I became good to myself. I take myself to beautiful places, I drink my coffee calmly, I dedicate my time to myself, and I am my own priority, because in the end, the only person who will love me my whole life is me.

body.title: Chicken with Ketchup: Simple, Delicious & So Easy To Make
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSpbhSbPEc7QBms8QwX8TPqG9HoWkoiZeZ5wjpHaCfYo3/1779718000656.png)

Hello dear foodies! 💛
‎
‎Hope everyone's having a wonderful day. 
‎
‎Last Sunday, I craved chicken with ketchup. Normally, we'd just go for our chicken adobo, but this time I want ketchup. 🤤
‎
‎And I'm happy as it turned out amazing. Exactly how I imagined it would be! 
‎
‎So now I'm sharing this super-easy recipe with you all today.
‎
‎**Ingredients:**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUbYUCpb2JAvKJKPDeEAuYYhL4Pnq6YMjRosXt4jLJ5ZW/1779718039005.jpg)

‎• 500 grams chicken
‎• 1 cup banana ketchup 
‎• 4 cloves garlic
‎• 1 medium tomato
‎• 1 Knorr chicken broth cube
‎• 1 teaspoon black pepper 
‎• 1 tablespoon sugar
‎• 1 cup water
‎• 2 tablespoons cooking oil
‎• salt and pepper 
‎
‎**Let's cook!**
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPyh73gjVFoDjzfA6AegUGwwrqcJDeDNZdJQ3AJ7isxN9/1779718063171.jpg)

‎• First, I heated some oil in a pan. Then I put in the chopped garlic and sliced tomatoes. I cooked them until they became soft and fragrant.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYJXa8uzt61dxfGZuzc6LNanMJtZCf26oixbRZm9dXnfT/1779718089417.jpg)

‎• Next, I added the chicken pieces. I let them cook while turning them over from time to time until they turned light brown on all sides. That took about 5 to 7 minutes.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfV5recRy6H75nsRzfwM3qRJwPpc4duo6sPbLerf5NzQW/1779718109452.jpg)

‎• Once the chicken was browned, I poured in the ketchup. I mixed it well together with the water so everything was evenly combined.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamo2MNhrLV77pa5ERYNhdq5Wjadj9r6QXNSt2RFbc3VJ/1779718162592.jpg)

‎• Then I added the seasonings: black pepper, Knorr cubes, sugar, and salt. I put just enough to make it taste perfect. But you can adjust according to how you like it. I turned the heat down low, covered the pan, and let it cook for 30 minutes. I just left it to simmer until the chicken became tender and the sauce got thick and yummy.
‎
‎And that's it! 
‎
‎My chicken with ketchup is ready to serve!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8ZsUSMtniwqSZEgrmVioDh49UHTmBqZNo4FAgiDJ7Mu/1779718228635.jpg)
‎
‎I really love how it turned out! The ketchup gives it such a nice taste which is sweet. The sauce is perfect when poured over hot steamed rice. And my family loved it too. 
‎
‎Until my next chicken dish...
‎
‎**Thanks for the visit! Have a lovely day. Buh-bye. 💗🌸**
‎
‎*All images used in this post are my own unless stated otherwise.*
‎
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXwGy1PepFwdzckxAm8fJT2BtNG3DHPuCTBsrcmCAb78j/1778497869588.png)

En esta ocasión le hice como un homenaje a uno de sus trabajos que, desde que salió; me ha cautivado con el tiempo. Y a medida que pasa el tiempo, cada vez sus dibujos me van pareciendo mejores. > One day, I decided to do this, since it had been a while since I’d done a drawing inspired by the work of my mentor, Wataboku—a Japanese artist known for his wonderful pieces that, to a certain extent, convey feelings and emotions. This time, I created a tribute to one of his works that has captivated me ever since it was released. And as time goes by, I find his drawings more and more impressive. --- --- Esto es importante para mi porque desde el año 2019 es que conocí a Wataboku en redes sociales y recuerdo muy bien que para aquel tiempo no estaba muy activo con su arte, pareciendo que había abandonado su trabajo dejando así sus maravillosas obras disponibles que hubiesen. Pero un día empezó hacer dibujo tras dibujo y eso me impresionó mucho y hasta el día de hoy cada nuevo dibujo que sube, lo descargo y lo guardo en una carpeta que tengo con su nombre. > This is important to me because I first discovered Wataboku on social media back in 2019, and I remember very well that at the time he wasn’t very active with his art; it seemed as though he had given up on his work, leaving behind whatever wonderful pieces he had created. But one day he started creating drawing after drawing, and that really impressed me. To this day, every new drawing he uploads, I download it and save it in a folder I have named after him. --- --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/richjr/23tGyUoAAHfgLh68ZeiCkXmYtD3jzM1Su7sF8L2GM3ejfbA35bd13JEkzkcbA3Qnzyvfe.png) --- --- Así que gracias a Wataboku, es que estoy haciendo este tipo de dibujos y que sigo adelante. 这一段，我是被训斥的，不是在早上还没睁眼，就是晚上准备睡觉的时候，导致我心情很郁闷，一堆邪火发不出去！

我是一个老司机了，开车一直都是稳字为主，之前那么多年从未被扣过分。最近，是接二连三的违规被扣，每次都是压线，一连五次，气的我想晕过去！再加上我家先生那劈头盖脸的训斥，真是让我更加的窝火，那个隐隐作痛的牙痛一下子又来找我了。

真是压死骆驼🐫的最后一根稻草啊！我承认我视频里我的一个车轮压线了，但是我们这的路况那是啥路况啊！大窟窿小眼睛，没有一片是好路！当时我的腿骨折，也是路中间有一个大坑，好好的走个路也把自己摔骨折。

今天晚上回老家时又被训斥了一顿，心情糟糕透了！

Hello, my dear creative friends, I hope you are all well. 🙏
I believe that the most romantic and elegant birds are the beautiful swans, and that's why I was inspired to draw them against a dark background and add my own personal touch to the image I used as inspiration.
I used a white crayon to start and then added color to highlight their beauty in a small stream where the mysterious yet beautiful moon is reflected. 🌑
The black of the night conveys tranquility and softness as the swan settles into its comforting sleep, accompanied by the subtle glow of the stars.
This beautiful drawing can be framed and displayed in our room or perhaps in our favorite corner of the house. 🏠

When I scroll through social media and find a drawing that catches my eye, I immediately start drawing it. What I love most is making a few changes to give it my own personal touch without straying too far from the original. My friends and family also send me drawings they know I like, and I take them into account when creating my own and sharing them with everyone. So, take note of the materials and pay attention to the step-by-step instructions because it's very easy and fun to make.

>Hola, mis queridos amigos creativos, espero se encuentren bien. 🙏 
Considero que las aves más románticas y elegantes son los hermosos cisnes y es por eso que me inspiré a dibujarlos en un fondo oscuro y darle un toque personal a la imagen que tomé como inspiración. 
Utilice un crayón color blanco para hacerlo y luego darle el color que llegue a resaltar su belleza en un pequeño riachuelo donde se refleja la misteriosa pero también bellísima luna. 🌑 
El color negro de la noche que nos transmite quietud y suavidad al momento de que el cisne toma su reconfortable sueño acompañado del brillo sutil de las estrellas.
Este hermoso dibujo lo podemos enmarcar para colocarlo en nuestra habitación o quizás en nuestro rincón favorito de la casa. 🏠
>Cuando reviso mis redes sociales y encuentro un dibujo que me llama la atención, enseguida comienzo a dibujarlo, y algo que me encanta es hacerle algunos cambios para darle ese toque personal sin salirme del todo del original. También mis amigos o familiares me envían alguno de esos dibujos que saben que me gustan y los tomo en cuenta para hacerlo y mostrarlo a todos. Así que tomen nota de los materiales y presten atención al paso a paso porque es muy fácil y divertido de elaborar.

Materials:
One sheet of black paper
Crayons
One white crayon
One white highlighter

>Materiales:
Una hoja color negro
Creyones
Un creyón color blanco
Un resaltador color blanco

body.title: BEYOND THE TOURIST TRAIL
body.body:
![Kopia – Beyond the route.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wgd3W79UTDduZQdqnQ6beQKZsdkCh62Aqabvh7K1z3Lsjyf88RGUh3GFJxYEn38Ydqk.jpg)

When we think of southern Italy and Calabria in particular, most of us probably first picture beautiful landscapes, postcard-perfect views and stunning cliffs, which you have already had the chance to see on my profile. However, while staying in that region, we wanted not only to visit the most famous attractions but also to discover the true face of Calabria—the side that rarely appears in travel guides, yet has the power to capture your heart.

One such place was the town of VIBO VALENTIA. It was located not far from where we were staying, making it a perfect choice for a day trip. We did not find crowds of tourists there. Instead we found an atmosphere that felt unmistakably Italian. Everyday conversations taking place on the streets, people returning home with their shopping, cafés and old buildings with characteristic balconies that seem to belong to another era.

We were even a little lucky and happened to visit on market day. To our surprise, the prices were incredibly low. The only thing we could regret was that we could buy at most one or two items, as we had flown there with hand luggage only.

>Kiedy mówimy o południowych Włoszech, a w szczególności o Kalabrii, większość z nas w pierwszej kolejności na pewno pomyśli o przepięknych widokach, pocztówkowych kadrach i wspaniałych klifach, które już też mieliście okazję zobaczyć na moim profilu. Będąc jednak w tamtych rejonach zależało nam nie tylko na zobaczeniu tych najciekawszych atrakcji, ale również na poznaniu prawdziwego oblicza regionu, takiego, które nie pojawia się zbyt często w przewodnikach, a które potrafi ująć za serce. 
>
>Dokładnie takim miejscem było miasteczko VIBO VALENTIA. Znajdowało się ono w niedalekiej odległości od naszego miejsca zakwaterowania. Także idealnie wpasował się w nasz wybór. Nie znalazłyśmy tam tłumów turystów. Za to panowała tam niezwykle włoska atmosfera. Zwykłe rozmowy na ulicach, ludzie wracający z zakupów, kawiarnie i stare kamienice z charakterystycznymi balkonami, które pamiętają zupełnie inne czasy. 
>
>Miałyśmy nawet trochę szczęścia i natrafiłyśmy akurat na targ, ku naszemu zaskoczeniu ceny były naprawdę bardzo niskie. Mogłyśmy tylko żałować, że możemy kupić maksymalnie dwie rzeczy, gdyż przyleciałyśmy tylko z bagażem podręcznym.



![20260418_110120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243MDgnud4M8FNgH7hpKvVeoZN5ThJ42v13Tq9cfXH8MDuaQcYAF1XNzz1fVYrhzC5y5i.jpg)

![20260418_110127.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23y8xJzn9ZoxjZzxnFyYEg4YUZBM68CRZSY3kT4Tdb4Hrs9Bz4DmxyCGsH6LjF6z6QJmH.jpg)

![20260418_111005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23ynd8DNe12iXeQ68HVjsWVW66nySybdki5AMKenEhPZcR3PESukBV97jV7PH2Vj72U6n.jpg)


VIBO VALENTIA may look like a quiet provincial town today, but its history began in ancient times when the Greeks founded a colony here called Hipponion in the seventh century BC. The city quickly became an important trading center of Magna Graecia and, over the centuries, came under the rule of various civilizations, including the Romans, Byzantines, Normans, and Spaniards.

VIBO VALENTIA is situated on a hill, which is why many of its streets climb steeply uphill. This can make walking around a little tiring, but at the same time it offers opportunities to admire the surrounding landscape and, on a clear day, even catch glimpses of the Tyrrhenian Sea coastline. Unfortunately, I had not checked in advance where the best viewpoints were located, and somehow we never managed to find them on our own. That was probably because we tended to choose the less steep routes whenever possible.

Above the town stands the Norman-Swabian Castle, which was built in the sixteenth century. Unfortunately, we did not manage to visit the castle either, as we simply did not have enough energy left to climb even higher. It was the last day of our trip, and during those few days we had already covered quite a lot of kilometers on foot.


>VIBO VALENTIA wygląda na bardzo spokojne, prowincjonalne miasto. A jego historia zaczęła się już w starożytności, kiedy to w siedemnastym wieku przed naszą erą Grecy założyli tutaj kolonię o nazwie Hipponion. Miasto to szybko stało się ważnym ośrodkiem handlowym Wielkiej Grecji. I kolejno przez wieki przechodziło pod panowanie 
>
>VIBO VALENTIA położonE jest na wzgórzu. Dlatego też wiele ulic prowadzi stromo pod górę, czyniąc tym samym spacer nieco męczącym, ale z drugiej strony dając również okazję, aby podziwiać panoramę okolicy, a przy dobrej pogodzie nawet fragmenty wybrzeża Morza Tyrreńskiego. Niestety wcześniej nie sprawdziłam sobie, w których dokładnie miejscach można zobaczyć te widoki, a same jakoś tam nie trafiłyśmy.Pewnie dlatego, że wybierałyśmy mniej strome podejścia. 
>
>Nad miastem znajduje się również zamek normańsko-szwabski, który został zbudowany w szesnastym wieku. Zamku jednak również nie udało nam się zobaczyć, gdyż zabrakło nam już sił, aby wspiąć się jeszcze wyżej. Był to ostatni dzień naszego zwiedzania, a przez te kilka dni zrobiłyśmy naprawdę już sporo kilometrów.


![20260418_111011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242Nqmip8NEtJEjqG5eoFzdUHEVPDnNTX7g6VnevvXtkoK56fjC1WC1J5fUzQYQDFAmrL.jpg)

![20260418_111058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xp8dGTMQ7NPLWMu4Uhi5ogyY1kZqeiVLcZhpmcDqdUjKcLJWV4cbp31CbpgKykE8bje.jpg)

![20260418_111652.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23yd5n64VZCmj1mHrE5rqc3ZsTX4MnmWZg4aVohXn2QRGA6GBjwKqZYJC5fKHNj68GxD7.jpg)

I must admit that places like this often stay in my memory longer than postcard-perfect views. I truly value authenticity, and VIBO VALENTIA is exactly that. You can stroll peacefully through its streets, observe the daily lives of its residents, and experience the unique atmosphere of a town that lives far away from the tourist crowds.

>Muszę przyznać, że właśnie takie miejsca często zapadają mi w pamięć bardziej niż pocztówkowe widoki. Bardzo cenię sobie autentyczność, a VIBO VALENTIA jest właśnie takim miejscem. Możemy spokojnie spacerować ulicami miasteczka, obserwować codzienne życie mieszkańców i poczuć niezwykłą atmosferę miasta, które żyje własnym rytmem z dala od turystycznego zgiełku.


![20260418_111430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23zbTpNqPoLrZuxGmsKPS5JgaYTdsfCrkEvBwLZpWjqDAJHGsD7z1rFFKQcCGp3z3F2KG.jpg)

![20260418_111959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAbtnJbe6TXe24GCibPd8GjTBBXtWe4reS5skW2UaYvrjAANDefoDSUhy8jsvNEUpAh.jpg)

![20260418_112049.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23xAgCLpVGUDTM8a8EZuGmcQLxVChimWptAs5kionJEiuG2BbuqTWcRQxu5dQNSmsbCms.jpg)

body.title: Shadows to the rhythm of rock and roll! | My entry for #Monomad Challenge [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
> Hello black and white photography lovers! I return to this magical space, filled with the energy that music and dance weave through frames, and the chiaroscuro contrasts that the night intensifies. ***
![183870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wgBFLRXSWBZ8oJcYfFo8d3UMFBvBcwXvqt61Zi81aEDKENoBXMXHnHycdZDpBQD4AFq.jpg)
*** It was just another night in my city shrouded in a complete power outage. Even so, the hope of many of us, who longed for the announced concert to finally take place, remained undiminished. *** |![183871.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wWpwsPrzDdREaN93RDS2GyWuuXbxRFBMRwQG8Y6FLRGdHwzPLyaWjc46SGKtUR3K2h3.jpg)|![183869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23xAVU4QhgqrNhR9YCZZmeC5hd8HFUu6uvAgFMSjFFKruM1PwgoNZBg5f5akFQz6SDg2j.jpg)|![183867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23xVGnoZjDEPH5LSoRM7zQZBHcaLR1RvoqfZkJynLhZky3T5QKAjMqNq1KM8ouCNQmHDD.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** It was Blinder's turn, a rock band that had scheduled a show in the middle of Las Arcadas park, outdoors, to give the entire urban center their strident chords as if seeking to make the light vibrate on every skin. *** |![183866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23tGy7aNKtCpUeijj6ca8adcaqoT6YeH7SB6x9pVV2LoS4yvSSY4z9v2B4VatNov6LsN1.jpg)|![183865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23tS12fRVvvc1569wraHX6eXWnEeE7Z3zXE9AgMKzBLxkX6aL4DFJnWyQcNjxjH7Vog21.jpg)|![183864.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23u5bbYAvX5BZ57ppQVxj6tNq5S3mcgwrG7gwLkGTUSa3HTiiPRgby6La4DtYAxNMMTu1.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Kids of all ages—teenagers, young adults, and not-so-young adults—waited there... And then, the lights came on! Black and white began to blend with the music, a pretext for a ritual punctuated by seemingly chaotic dance steps. Perhaps some of these kids have no idea who Sid Vicious was, but they still let themselves be carried away by the music, releasing all that adrenaline that grips them and transmitting a joy worthy of admiration and applause. *** |![183863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wWnRn7VtHWBKVmFnBpKs63MXWfSn7iH4U8N7ptK59ukk35N9UkHv7vZDxP3UmRczq9H.jpg)|![183862.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wX5mpGzDBsSziEyxtMfws8Dgwt3B8ZeX2uCFtULTn3wJ9NsmCn7PfqSjvFvbPwGdks3.jpg)|![183861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wX13XM2HXtvHnJDdEqMNdBtxBBNEHazwARvtPizp7sPjYc2J9TXqjEoWf3TGqqTevbd.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Each image attempts to capture moments from that Slam, also known as slam dancing or mosh pit, which reminded us of the Sid Vicious era, even before he was part of the Sex Pistols, but he was already leaving his mark for eternity. These contrasting images seem eternal to me, and I hope you enjoy them as much as I do. So, all that's left is to dance and smile until the next frame. In the meantime, each of you receive a hug of light! ***
![183860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wMaevpji4Tvtu1sjQd6ywADf8kNcpJF168te4Hm1uaUntK5Nf3ozQeMfherpxvfKZdm.jpg)

![183868.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wg9PJTyoUYnpBjBWvLDMeD3pnaoMQCpi9PrmhzM41NYQtzazUdVQpFcYSG3fLivvUH1.jpg)
***

> ¡Hola amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro! Retorno a este espacio mágico con la energía que la música y la danza entretejen a través de fotogramas y los contrastes del claro oscuro que la noche profundiza en sus efectos. ***
![183870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wgBFLRXSWBZ8oJcYfFo8d3UMFBvBcwXvqt61Zi81aEDKENoBXMXHnHycdZDpBQD4AFq.jpg)
*** Una noche más en mi ciudad, cubierta por un manto de total ausencia de servicio eléctrico. Aún así, la esperanza de muchos, que ansiábamos se pudiese concretar el concierto anunciado, no disminuía. *** |![183871.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wWpwsPrzDdREaN93RDS2GyWuuXbxRFBMRwQG8Y6FLRGdHwzPLyaWjc46SGKtUR3K2h3.jpg)|![183869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23xAVU4QhgqrNhR9YCZZmeC5hd8HFUu6uvAgFMSjFFKruM1PwgoNZBg5f5akFQz6SDg2j.jpg)|![183867.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23xVGnoZjDEPH5LSoRM7zQZBHcaLR1RvoqfZkJynLhZky3T5QKAjMqNq1KM8ouCNQmHDD.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Llega el turno de Blinder, una banda de rock que tenía programado un espectáculo en pleno parque de Las Arcadas, al aire libre, para regalar a todo el centro urbano sus acordes estridentes como quien busca que la luz vibre en cada piel. *** |![183866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23tGy7aNKtCpUeijj6ca8adcaqoT6YeH7SB6x9pVV2LoS4yvSSY4z9v2B4VatNov6LsN1.jpg)|![183865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23tS12fRVvvc1569wraHX6eXWnEeE7Z3zXE9AgMKzBLxkX6aL4DFJnWyQcNjxjH7Vog21.jpg)|![183864.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23u5bbYAvX5BZ57ppQVxj6tNq5S3mcgwrG7gwLkGTUSa3HTiiPRgby6La4DtYAxNMMTu1.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Chicos de varias edades, adolescentes, jóvenes y no tan jóvenes, ahí, a la espera... ¡Y se hizo la luz! Y el blanco y negro comenzaron a mezclarse con la música como pretexto en un ritual que la danza marca con pasos aparentemente caóticos. Quizás algunos de estos chicos no tienen idea de quién fue Sid Vicious, pero igual se dejan llevar por la música y sueltan toda esa adrenalina que les abraza y nos transmiten un júbilo digno de admirar y aplaudir. *** |![183863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wWnRn7VtHWBKVmFnBpKs63MXWfSn7iH4U8N7ptK59ukk35N9UkHv7vZDxP3UmRczq9H.jpg)|![183862.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wX5mpGzDBsSziEyxtMfws8Dgwt3B8ZeX2uCFtULTn3wJ9NsmCn7PfqSjvFvbPwGdks3.jpg)|![183861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wX13XM2HXtvHnJDdEqMNdBtxBBNEHazwARvtPizp7sPjYc2J9TXqjEoWf3TGqqTevbd.jpg)| |-|-|-| *** Cada imagen intenta perpetuar instantes de ese Slam, conocido también como slam dance, slamdancing o Mosh pit, qué nos hizo recordar aquellos tiempos de Sid Vicious, aún cuando no formaba parte de Sex Pistols, pero ya venía dejando huellas para la eternidad. Como eternas se me tornan estos juegos de contrastes que espero ustedes disfruten tanto como yo. Entonces, solo queda bailar y sonreír hasta un próximo fotograma. Mientras, reciban cada uno de ustedes, ¡un abrazo de luz! ***
![183860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/roswelborges/23wMaevpji4Tvtu1sjQd6ywADf8kNcpJF168te4Hm1uaUntK5Nf3ozQeMfherpxvfKZdm.jpg)

body.title: IV: El horizonte de los sueños genuinos | 4 lunes de escritura 🌅✨
body.body: ¡Feliz último lunes de mayo! Ha sido un viaje muy transformador, hemos compartido, reído y también llorado. Si te perdiste alguna de nuestras estaciones anteriores, aún puedes recorrer el camino completo y hacerlo a tu ritmo: [I: Donde habitan las raíces](https://ecency.com/@sweetval/i-donde-habitan-las-raices),[II: Tras el rastro del destello](https://ecency.com/@sweetval/ii-tras-el-rastro-del) y [III: La arquitectura del refugio.](https://ecency.com/@sweetval/iii-la-arquitectura-del-refugio)\n\n

>Hoy no escribimos para protegernos, ni para buscar una luz perdida. Hoy escribimos para proyectar. Mayo nos ha enseñado que, aunque el enemigo silencioso intente quitarnos el brillo, nosotros tenemos el candado más seguro: nuestra propia voluntad de florecer. Tras la puerta de casa, allí donde guardamos lo más puro, los sueños han dejado de ser vagos y ahora tienen forma, tienen nombre y tienen un horizonte claro.
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.

></center>

Para cerrar nuestro ciclo, nuestra última palabra es:

<h5 style=\

>Imagina que hoy abres la puerta de tu refugio y el sol de la mañana ilumina todo lo que tienes por delante. Puedes responder estas preguntas:

\n\n*

>¿Qué es lo primero que ves? No pienses en las pruebas o retos de los demás, piensa en tu poder de superación.

\n*

>Describe esa versión de ti que lo quiere todo y que, tras haber descansado y sanado este mes, está lista para dar el siguiente paso.

\n*

>¿Cómo se ve tu éxito hoy?

\n*

>¿A qué distancia está ese horizonte?

\n\n
>Imagen creada con inteligencia artificial Gemini.
> Celebremos el camino juntas en nuestro último lunes del reto, por eso, me encantaría que hiciéramos ruido con nuestra luz: *

>Escribe: Declara tus intenciones para el próximo mes basándote en lo que descubriste de ti misma.

\n*

>Comparte: Una foto de tu visión board, de tu diario abierto o de un paisaje que te inspire libertad.

\n*

>Etiquétame: Quiero celebrar contigo que terminamos este reto y que estamos listas para lo que viene.

\n\n

>Vislumbro muy cerca el final de una etapa materializada, tras mucha felicidad, lágrimas y risas. Se siente la tranquilidad de haber cumplido, pero sobre todo, la satisfacción de ir a por uno de millones de sueños, apostar por el futuro y a la vez, estar llena de ilusión y atreverse mil veces, sin saber el resultado del destino, o cuál cara de la moneda caerá, a favor o en contra. Te encuentras, no sabes cuándo, ni cómo, y tal vez, no viene como un soplo de qué todo valió la pena, ni como una señal a las 11:11 pm o unas palabras de admiración de alguien que quieres mucho, pero llega en el momento indicado.

>De pronto, es la paz lo que llena tu corazón, no hacer las cosas por inercia, ni como un robot; brotan del corazón las decisiones y sin quererlo, ni esperarlo, ni buscarlo, te encuentras centrado en el proceso más conmovedor y transformador del alma, al servicio de una sociedad rara, cegada por los distractores modernos, que ramifican la atención de lo vital, lo esencial, lo real. Pero tú, abres los ojos, suspiras y te reconfortas en la sensación de plenitud, pero al mismo tiempo, de curiosidad insaciable, porque la senda del diario vivir, es cada despertar, un nuevo aprendizaje.

\n\n
>Que este cierre sea solo el inicio de tu mejor versión🌿📔

>Happy last Monday in May! It’s been a truly transformative journey—we’ve shared, laughed, and even cried together. If you missed any of our previous installments, you can still explore the entire journey at your own pace: <a target=\
>II: In Search of the Glimmer, and

>Today we’re not writing to protect ourselves, nor to search for a lost light. Today we’re writing to look ahead. May has taught us that, even if the silent enemy tries to take away our radiance, we have the strongest lock: our own will to flourish. Behind the door of our home, where we keep what is purest, dreams are no longer vague—they now have shape, they have a name, and they have a clear horizon.
>Image created with Gemini artificial intelligence.
>To wrap up our series, our final word is:

>Imagine that today you open the door to your sanctuary and the morning sun illuminates everything that lies ahead of you. You can answer these questions:

\n\n*

>What is the first thing you see? Don’t think about other people’s trials or challenges; think about your own resilience.

\n*

>Describe that version of yourself who wants it all and who, after resting and healing this month, is ready to take the next step.

\n*

>What does your success look like today?

\n*

>How far away is that horizont?

\n\n

>Let’s celebrate this journey together on our final Monday of the challenge, so I’d love for us to shine our light and make some noise:

\n\n*

>Write: State your intentions for the coming month based on what you’ve discovered about yourself.

\n*

>Share: A photo of your vision board, your open journal, or a landscape that inspires a sense of freedom.

\n*

>Tag me: I want to celebrate with you that we’ve finished this challenge and that we’re ready for what’s next.

\n\n

>I can see the end of a chapter coming into view, after so much happiness, tears, and laughter. I feel the peace of having accomplished something, but above all, the satisfaction of going after one of millions of dreams, betting on the future, and at the same time, being full of hope and daring to try a thousand times, without knowing what fate has in store, or which side of the coin will land—heads or tails. You find yourself—you don’t know when or how—and perhaps it doesn’t come as a sudden realization that it was all worth it, nor as a sign at 11:11 p.m. or words of admiration from someone you love dearly, but it arrives at just the right moment.

>Suddenly, it is peace that fills your heart—not doing things out of inertia, nor like a robot; decisions spring from the heart, and without wanting it, expecting it, or seeking it, you find yourself centered in the most moving and soul-transforming process, at the service of a strange society, blinded by modern distractions that divert attention from what is vital, essential, and real. But you open your eyes, sigh, and find comfort in the feeling of fulfillment, yet at the same time, of insatiable curiosity, because the path of daily life is, with every awakening, a new learning experience.

\n\n
>May this chapter be just the beginning of your best self🌿📔

body.title: El Getafe de Bordalas se mete en competiciones europeas / Bordalas' Getafe qualifies for European competitions
body.body:
Contrario a lo que hubiera esperado al inicio de la temporada, dado por el estilo de juego y las dificultades que tuvieron en el mercado veraniego para reforzar su plantilla, el Getafe de Bordalas lucia como un equipo claro como material de descenso, pero en contra de todo pronóstico, no solo tuvieron una gran temporada, sino que además se metieron en posiciones europeas, superando a otros equipos como el Atlhetic de Bilbao. 

> Contrary to what I would have expected at the start of the season, given the style of play and the difficulties they had in the summer market to strengthen their squad, Bordalas' Getafe looked like a clear relegation candidate, but against all odds, they not only had a great season, but also got into European positions, surpassing other teams like Athletic Bilbao.

<center>![celebracion-del-getafe-en-el-coliseum-16-9-aspect-ratio-default-0_da39.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdbo6fo8BJbxnN2mnHrYi3kqckamDaMozkZqFCRsNfcWg/celebracion-del-getafe-en-el-coliseum-16-9-aspect-ratio-default-0_da39.jpg)</center>

<center> <a href=\

>Fuente En la última jornada, Rayo Vallecano y Valencia se jugaban sus posibilidades de arrebatarle el puesto a los madrileños, y aunque lograron un cierre de torneo muy bueno, con un par de victorias en las últimas jornadas, el mejor papel general de los azulones terminó por asegurar su ventaja. Lo sorprendente, fue como el Valencia logró superar a la Real Sociedad y al campeón Barcelona, mientras que el Rayo Vallecano, pese a meterse en la final de la Conference League, cerró con un par de victorias frente al Villarreal y el Deportivo Alavés. > On the final matchday, Rayo Vallecano and Valencia were vying for the top spot from Getafe, and although both finished the season strongly with a couple of wins in the final matches, Getafe's superior overall performance ultimately secured their victory. Surprisingly, Valencia managed to overtake Real Sociedad and the eventual champions, Barcelona, ​​while Rayo Vallecano, despite reaching the Conference League final, only managed two wins against Villarreal and Deportivo Alavés. Y aunque el Getafe perdió en la penúltima fecha, dejando alguna opción a sus rivales, la victoria por la mínima frente al Osasuna fue suficiente para asegurar su séptimo puesto en la tabla general, una de las mejores clasificaciones de su historia. Lo más sorprendente es que su mejor puesto en los 10 últimos años lo logró en el 2018 /2019, cuando terminó quinto bajo las órdenes del mismo Bordalas en su primer ciclo, antes de que provocará suerte en el Valencia. > And although Getafe lost in the penultimate match, giving their rivals a chance, the narrow victory against Osasuna was enough to secure seventh place in the overall standings, one of their best finishes ever. What's most surprising is that their best position in the last 10 years was achieved in 2018/2019, when they finished fifth under Bordalás in his first spell, before he went on to play for Valencia. En esta temporada los azulones consiguieron victorias de mucho mérito, siendo la más prestigiosa frente al Real Madrid en el Santiago Bernabeu, además de que también logró vencer a otros equipos de peso como el Atlhetic de Bilbao por partida doble, a o el Villarreal en su estadio. La mayor decepción del año pienso que fue la eliminación temprana por la Copa del Rey en los 16avos de final, más aun logró de lograr una goleada de escándalo frente al débil Inter de Valderomo por 0 a 11, logrando su 2do mejor resultado en la historia de la competición. > This season, Getafe achieved some impressive victories, the most prestigious being against Real Madrid at the Santiago Bernabéu. They also managed to defeat other strong teams like Athletic Bilbao twice, and Villarreal at their own stadium. The biggest disappointment of the year, in my opinion, was their early elimination from the Copa del Rey in the Round of 32. However, they did manage a stunning 11-0 thrashing of Valderomo's weak Inter Milan, achieving their second-best result in the competition's history.
![captura-de-pantalla-642-1779473624686.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbooh7u4dC4hyvsGdUMQWCSMa5fVEAd8e8ABPzynRBBB5/captura-de-pantalla-642-1779473624686.png)

>Fuente Analizando numéricamente fue lo que su temporada, es fácil entender porque es uno de los equipos que menos me gusta como juega, pues solo el Real Oviedo, uno de los peores equipos de la historia reciente de La Liga, marcó menos goles que ellos. Únicamente sumaron 32 goles en 38 fechas, con un promedio de 0,82 por partido, el peor de cualquier equipo en la zona alta de todas las grandes ligas europeas. > Analyzing their season numerically, it's easy to understand why they're one of the teams whose style of play I like the least. Only Real Oviedo, one of the worst teams in recent La Liga history, scored fewer goals. They only managed 32 goals in 38 matches, averaging 0.82 per game, the worst of any team in the top half of any major European league. Entendiendo la garra que define el estilo de juego del Getafe, es entendible ver que entre los jugadores más destacables tengamos dos uruguayos, Mauro Arambarri, capitán e insignia del equipo ya desde hace varios años, quien no sólo es indispensable para el equilibrio del equipo, sino que además suele llegar al área rival con peligro y es el goleador del equipo, y el otro fue Martin Satriano, delantero cedido en enero del Olympique de Lyon, que logró anotar 6 goles en esta media temporada, llegando a ser el segundo goleador del equipo. > Understanding the grit that defines Getafe's style of play, it's understandable that among the most outstanding players we have two Uruguayans: Mauro Arambarri, captain and emblem of the team for several years now, who is not only indispensable for the balance of the team, but also often reaches the opponent's area with danger and is the team's top scorer; and the other was Martin Satriano, a striker loaned in January from Olympique Lyonnais, who managed to score 6 goals in this half-season, becoming the team's second top scorer. Pero creo que el MVP de la temporada fue Luis Milla, mediocampista español que repartió 10 goles en la liga, siendo el motor de juego de un equipo, que justamente no destaca en este apartado. Atrás Djene Dakonam fue el líder de la defensa, promediando buenos números en despejes y cortes, mientras que David Soria se consolidó otro año más como el ángel azulón, cerrando la temporada con 11 portería invictas y varias atajadas de mucho mérito. > But I think the MVP of the season was Luis Milla, the Spanish midfielder who provided 10 assists in the league, being the driving force of a team that doesn't exactly excel in that area. At the back, Djene Dakonam was the leader of the defense, averaging good numbers in clearances and interceptions, while David Soria cemented his status as Getafe's guardian angel once again, finishing the season with 11 clean sheets and several impressive saves.
