body.title: Not Just an Update… A Turning Point: Why This WOO Moment Hits Different
body.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

Every game gets updates.

New features, tweaks, fixes... it’s all part of the cycle. And if you’ve been around WOO long enough, you’ve seen your fair share of them. Some are small quality-of-life improvements. Some introduce new mechanics. Some give you a short burst of excitement before things settle back into the usual rhythm.

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23uFPYfbfCEmFjt65C43nBnfuF2hUFC6oezkWNXb16HeJGytFP9kHdDykTQTazTGJVJhb.png)

---

Every now and then… you get an update that feels different. That’s what this update feels like to me.

When you step back and look at everything together, the Battle Pass, the quest system, the mobile improvements... it’s not just a collection of features. It’s a **shift in direction**. A sign that WOO is evolving into something more structured, more engaging, and honestly, more sustainable for the long run.

---

### 🚀 A Layered Evolution Instead of Isolated Changes

* The Battle Pass introduces a structured progression system that ties together multiple aspects of gameplay into a single, cohesive journey.
  
What really stands out to me here is how this system acts as a central spine for everything else in the game. Before this, WOO had plenty of moving parts. Matches, rewards, packs, events... but they didn’t always feel connected in a meaningful way. Now, the Battle Pass acts like a unifying layer that brings everything together. Every action feeds into your progress, and that creates a much stronger sense of purpose behind what you’re doing. As a player, that cohesion makes the experience feel more intentional instead of fragmented.

* The quest system builds on that foundation by giving players clear, actionable objectives that guide daily and long-term engagement.
  
This is where the structure really comes to life. It’s one thing to have a progression system, but without direction, it can still feel a bit aimless. The quests solve that problem by giving you a roadmap, not in a restrictive way, but in a supportive one. You always have something to work toward, something to complete, something to check off. And from my perspective, that makes logging in feel purposeful instead of routine.

* Mobile improvements ensure that all of these systems are accessible and usable regardless of where or how you choose to play.
  
This might not seem as exciting as new features on the surface, but when you think about it, it’s what makes everything else work. What’s the point of having a great progression system if it’s inconvenient to engage with? By improving mobile usability, WOO is making sure that players can stay connected to the game consistently. And consistency is exactly what systems like the Battle Pass are built around.

---

### 🔄 A Shift in Player Behaviour (And Why That Matters)

* Players are now encouraged to log in daily, not out of obligation, but because there’s always meaningful progress to be made.
  
This is a subtle but important distinction. There’s a difference between feeling like you *have* to log in and *wanting* to log in. The Battle Pass and quest system lean heavily into the latter. You’re not just checking in out of habit — you’re checking in because you know there’s something waiting for you to progress. And as a fan, that makes the experience feel much more rewarding.

* Gameplay sessions, whether short or long, now contribute to a larger, visible goal.
  
One of the things I’ve personally noticed is how even small sessions feel more valuable now. You don’t need to commit hours at a time to feel like you’ve accomplished something. Even a quick login where you complete a couple of quests moves you forward. And that’s huge for players who don’t always have the time for long sessions.

* The game naturally builds a rhythm, turning WOO into something that fits more seamlessly into daily routines.
  
This is where everything clicks together. The structure, the accessibility, the progression, all combines to create a natural gameplay rhythm. You log in, you complete a few objectives, you see your progress increase, and you log out feeling satisfied. And then you come back the next day to do it again. It’s simple, but it’s effective.

---

### 🧱 Building a Stronger Foundation for the Future

* The Battle Pass system creates a scalable framework for future seasons, allowing WOO to continuously introduce new content and rewards.
  
This is where things get really exciting for me as a fan. Season 1 is just the starting point. Once this system is in place, it opens the door for so many possibilities, new reward types, themed seasons, different progression mechanics. It’s not just a one-time feature. It’s something that can grow and evolve over time.

* The update signals a more structured development direction, where systems are designed to work together rather than exist independently.
  
One of the biggest takeaways for me is that WOO feels more *intentional* now. Instead of adding features in isolation, it feels like the team is thinking about how everything connects. And that kind of design philosophy is what leads to a more polished and cohesive game experience.

* It sets expectations for players, creating anticipation for what future updates and seasons might bring.
  
This might be the most underrated part of the update. It changes how players think about the future of the game. Instead of wondering what might come next, you start expecting new seasons, new rewards, new improvements. It builds hype in a way that feels sustainable rather than temporary.

---

### 💭 My Personal Take

If I had to sum up how I feel about this update in one sentence, it would be this:

**This is the update that makes WOO feel like it’s stepping into its next phase.**

As someone who’s been following WOO closely, that’s incredibly exciting. It also makes me reflect a bit on how far the game has come. There was a time when a system like this might have felt out of reach. But now? It feels like a natural evolution like WOO has reached a point where it can support and sustain something like a Battle Pass.

And the best part? This is just Season 1. We’re at the beginning of something, not the peak of it. There’s room to improve, to expand, to refine, and if this is the foundation, then the future of WOO looks very promising.

So yeah… this isn’t just another update. It’s a turning point and as a fan, I’m here for it.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

body.title: Every memory has a story.
body.body:
At the sight of this prompt, my mind kept flashing back to my memories and which will I want to let go?

I scrolled through and through but yet to find any. Memories come from two perspectives: it's either a good memory or a bad one.

Everyone who must have seen this will want to make away with bad memories and then get some cool cash from it. Leaving them with no remembrance of things that once hurt them, leaving them with just the good memories. One will always smile and keep forging ahead in life, that can be cool but I will say it's half a hazard to the future.

I have got some memories that are not so good to keep as they hurt whenever they flash in my thoughts.

Some bad path taken while I was growing, things I would have done differently that would have come up with some positive results that will not even give me a chance to think of selling them off my head.

But then how do you explain a man who looks at himself in the mirror just to forget what he looks like immediately after he leaves the mirror? 
It's actually bad and even more dangerous than knowing that he is ugly and unfit to face certain deals in his life, this will only expose him and make him vulnerable  to things he would be told that is whatever that is said of his looks is what he accepts because he doesn't know what he looks like.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd85o5Hc1Hes1DcumFCzja2ShCKmvtrvXcZRKmAaDL2Sm/1779717411566.jpg)

Image created*Gemini Ai.*

How do we shape the future? Is it not from experience we had in the past? How do you expect me to repeat the same mistake I have made in the past which could even be worse than what I did in the past simply because I chose to forget how it happened in the past?

*“Just imagine you sold a memory of a financial mistake you made in the past just to be paid.”* think this through.

Sorry to say, selling some of my memories is not a deal to me as that's what helps me to navigate through the issues of life and that's what is helping me to shape my future and I believe my children will be glad to be guided by me through live until they are able to figure for themselves what is best. 

How will I be an elder who sees what a child can't see even if he climbs the highest mountain, while on my seat?

Don't be that man that looks himself in the mirror just to forget what he looks like immediately he leaves the vicinity.

My memories remain with me.

body.body:

![1001597242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/julie100/Eoke5faXnkWbwijsJwoJiKaagHyW4CKw85X5AXuSkM9htgsciKiTi7aMpEFL1E8haB2.jpg)



I recently saw The Forge and I can say it was one of those Christian films that will stick with me for a while after. The film is inspiring, emotional, and rich with lessons in faith, responsibility, purpose and spiritual growth. It is not only a movie to watch for entertainment, it's a movie to watch to think about life and God.

Isaiah is a young man who recently graduated from high school, but has little idea of the direction his life will take. He spends most of his time playing video games, and trying to get out of doing things. His mother is concerned as she wants him to take life seriously. As the story unfolds, Isaiah is privileged to serve and become acquainted with others that mold his character and lead him into a better way of doing things.

I enjoyed one aspect of The Forge: the struggles of the main character are realistic. A lot of young people today have the same issue as they don't know what to do with their lives. Isaiah's experience teaches us that success is not achieved through \

! It comes only through discipline, learning, hard work and above all, trusting God. That he was slowly transforming from a carefree youth to a thoughtful adult was very entertaining to watch.\n\nA second beautiful thing about the film is the mentorship. The older men who mentored Isaiah did not provide him with mere advice—he received their time, energy, and prayers to help him become a better person. This startled me to remember that we all have a need of godly mentors in our lives. Proverbs 27:17, \

body.title: Hive Pumps Confirming The Bottom?
body.body:
### Hive is getting some action

While it has been rather quiet since May 5th, the day we saw the 700M+ volume candle, recent days have shown some smaller pumps. I believe this activity is showing that Hive is now in a [**macro trend change**.](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@tobetada/hive-macro-trend-change) As we could see from the last weeks, it is not something that happens quickly - it can be discouraging seeing all the gains from a big price swing getting erased and it ending up lower than from where it started. But this \

is **characteristic for a bottom**: for Hive this has meant big price swings (pumps & dumps) within a consolidation phase and a breakout phase starting soon thereafter. 

Currently, there seems to be a bigger resistance in the 6-7 cents area and a rounded bottom forming  beneath it. Once price goes above this resistance (which also coincides with a weekly resistance trend line), there should be a pretty big price swing taking us back into the double digits. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23t8CfKPvxwpaJU2n7WYYmrZ4RDShotvN2ABKtmUyUVDNXRAWTnSJ7CvWpvraBsiVEbCv.png)

The bigger picture shows 3 similar bottoms with the two previous ones occurring in 2021 and 2024. All of them have taken several months to resolve and should price break out to in the coming weeks it would fit the so far observed pattern.  

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/23t8CfKPvvxyoKTNDxeGnorjPxusg6Zc9fuaqTXqrjdNrSa9uZtuHPbZdnokU7f71wGRi.png)


[Previously, I have shown that the current uptick in volume has so far always corresponded with a bigger positive price change.](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@tobetada/hive-macro-trend-change
) If this pattern holds, we can expect a bigger price swing up to either the low teens (10-13 cents) or a bigger one taking us back to the macro resistance at around 25-30 cents as shown here (price is in KRW):


https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tobetada/48HDM63pz3CmALaUtMUFQ4es3bGpZewnQYrmXQoXaiVq6MSJjGjaeGjQp8nwcB9HFE.png

### Conclusion

While it will still take some time for price being back at a level that actually reflects Hive's value, I believe the uptick in volume as well as an increased activity from the \

body.title: ✍️ Ensayo: «Feminicidios en Cuba: La anatomía del silencio» (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
>


A veces, cuando escribo, busco la frase exacta. Esa que sostiene una escena como un ancla sostiene un barco. Pero llegan ciertas noticias y uno entiende que no hay ancla posible. Que el barco ya se hundió, que el agua está negra y que lo único que queda es mirar el vacío. Desde Gibara llega otra. Desde cualquier pueblo de esta isla que quiero como se quiere una herida propia. Y no es que la ficción no pueda narrar el horror —Dostoievski lo hizo, y Rulfo, y la propia Carpentier cuando escribió El recurso del método—, es que el horror real tiene un peso distinto. No es símbolo. No es metáfora. Es una taza de café sobre una mesa, todavía tibia. Es una niña que pregunta por su madre. Es un libro que ya nadie abrirá.

La violencia machista tiene esta mecánica: se disfraza de amor, se instala en la casa, aprende las rutinas de sus víctimas. Y luego las usa como carnada. Es un argumento repetido hasta la náusea. En literatura, la repetición cansa. En la vida, debiera arrancarnos la piel. Pero he notado algo que me aterra: la acumulación anestesia. Un nombre. Otro. Otro. Y al final, un número. La estadística que reemplaza el rostro. El problema es que nuestro código penal aún no nombra el feminicidio. Y los que trabajamos con palabras sabemos: lo que no se nombra se vuelve fantasma. Se diluye en tecnicismos. Se pierde.

Tratar estos crímenes como homicidios comunes es, además de una torpeza jurídica, una mentira ética. Porque una mujer no es asesinada \

. Es asesinada por ser mujer, en un país sin refugios, sin leyes específicas, sin el andamio legal que detenga al verdugo antes del golpe. Por eso quienes documentan cada nombre, cada edad, cada pueblo, hacen algo sagrado. Se parecen a esos monjes copistas que salvaban la memoria del fuego. Escriben mientras la ceniza cae. Anotan mientras el olvido acecha. Pobres de nosotros si el olvido gana. No podemos mirar hacia otro lado. La literatura nos enseñó a encarnar al otro, a vestir su angustia. Pero ahora la empatía no puede quedarse en la página. Tiene que salir a la calle. Romper el silencio. Porque una sociedad que presume de cultura mientras las mujeres viven con el miedo pegado a los huesos no es ni justa ni culta. Pienso en mis hermanas. En mis amigas. En las mujeres que me enseñaron a leer. Nombro el dolor. Lo nombro otra vez. Y otra. Pero no me engaño: nombrar no basta si no construimos un país donde ninguna vida dependa de la clemencia de un agresor. Eso no es solo abominable. Es, sencillamente, inaceptable. Como escritor, hoy no busco la estructura perfecta. Busco que esta rabia tenga cuerpo. Que este texto sea una piedra en el zapato de la conciencia. Porque si algo he aprendido contando historias, es que el silencio es cómplice. Y yo no vine a esta tierra para ser cómplice de nada. ***

>

**© Marabuzal, 2026. Contenido Original. Todos los derechos reservados.**


***
En Inglés 
***

***

<center>

![photo-1606323543546-ae5e54fefac1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marabuzal/EpQxEjBxTpMYEfEnx6hVPa5Q724BpB7rwkccV4CaV9qtwFeyRRtM6WoAtYP91AWrsEg.jpeg)

[UNSPLASH](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/personas-vestidas-con-trajes-tradicionales-azules-y-amarillos-caminando-por-la-calle-durante-el-dia-_8HtnMMDEsM)

</center>

***

<div class\

>

Sometimes, when I write, I search for the exact phrase. The one that holds a scene together like an anchor holds a ship.  But then certain news arrives, and you understand there's no anchor left. That the ship has already sunk, that the water is black, and all that's left is to stare into the void. Another piece of news arrives from Gibara. From any town on this island that I love like one loves a personal wound. It's not that fiction can't narrate horror—Dostoevsky did, and Rulfo, and Carpentier herself when she wrote *Reasons of the Method*—it's that real horror carries a different weight. It's not a symbol. It's not a metaphor. It's a cup of coffee on a table, still warm. It's a little girl asking for her mother. It's a book that no one will ever open again.

Sexist violence works like this: it disguises itself as love, settles into the home, learns the routines of its victims. And then uses them as bait. It's a plot repeated ad nauseam. In literature, repetition is tiresome. In life, it should tear our skin off. But I've noticed something that terrifies me: accumulation numbs the senses. One name. Another. Another.  And in the end, a number. The statistic that replaces the face. The problem is that our penal code still doesn't name femicide. And those of us who work with words know: what isn't named becomes a ghost. It dissolves into technicalities. It's lost.

Treating these crimes as common homicides is, besides being a legal blunder, an ethical lie. Because a woman isn't murdered \

She is murdered for being a woman, in a country without shelters, without specific laws, without the legal framework to stop the executioner before the blow strikes. That's why those who document each name, each age, each town, are doing something sacred. They are like those copyist monks who saved memory from the fire. They write while the ash falls. They take notes while oblivion lurks. Woe to us if oblivion wins. We cannot look the other way. Literature taught us to embody the other, to clothe their anguish. But now empathy cannot remain confined to the page. She has to take to the streets. Break the silence. Because a society that boasts of culture while women live with fear ingrained in their bones is neither just nor cultured. I think of my sisters. My friends. The women who taught me to read. I name the pain. I name it again. And again. But I'm not fooling myself: naming it isn't enough if we don't build a country where no life depends on the mercy of an aggressor. That's not just abominable. It's simply unacceptable. As a writer, today I'm not looking for the perfect structure. I'm looking for this rage to have a form. For this text to be a thorn in the side of conscience. Because if there's one thing I've learned from telling stories, it's that silence is complicity. And I didn't come to this earth to be complicit in anything. (Google Translation) ***
>\n\n**© Marabuzal, 2026. Original Content. All rights reserved.**

body.title: A Day in My Life Blog: Start the Week with our Market Day with My Mother and My Nephew which we also Bought some Medicines! 😊🤗😇
body.body: **Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!** It is another great start of the week to all of us and I am happy to start the week with full of thanksgiving and happiness from God who never stops giving me strength and good health after a week from the accident that happened to me. It has been a week already today, since today is May 25, 2026 and the unforgettable accident that happened to me were happened last month, April 25, 2026. I am happy and blessed for I am now recovered and much better than before. For today, what I am gong to share is another day with us at the Market, since it is first day of the week, we needed to buy some foods and other stuffs which are important for us. Before I get started with my sharing, as I always do here. I will always give thanks and give appreciation to all my supporters. Most especially to the Community Admin, all Curators and also all commenters. I will always thank all of you for the unending support in all my blog posts. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeQdjoPBAwVBdxnRQ7PUXmTsGeH3d6W3dbRXZJdLuWBoh/1779716718143.png) I am again staying at home for I don't have scheduled event to attend today yet and since my Mother wanted to go to the Market. I have told her that I and my Nephew wanted to join her. My Mother told me that we will be going to the Market just after we take our breakfast. That is why, we immediately prepare our breakfast so we can go to the Market early and so we can go back home early too. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSFQuQJ8196Ma7ehgF3yE125YK88LFvsqvQQ7GLubw249/1779715070215.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfSokKnwGvQmtdcTfSAEac1HRyTd4xGNGD3Eu5JjGWVLY/1779715070367.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQoMK11VXoyvBXTk82ZyBSYcSgs9GFVhsSpHLyTWxkbu6/1779715070491.jpg) That was around 9:00 in the morning when we finished our breakfast, and after then we immediately prepared ourselves most especially my Nephew, so we can now go to the Market. After we have traveled for around 15 minutes, finally we have arrived at the Market and went to the Grocery store first. In here, we bought some important goods which we can used in our house most especially in cooking. While we were here, my Nephew never missed to ask toys to buy, but as I told him that we should not buy a toy now but instead we will buy biscuits for him, he immediately said he wants the biscuits now. What we have bought also are some rice as our rice at home are now just a few, but we only buy 5 Kls of rice, knowing that we were just three persons at home, and that is why we only bought a few rice at the moment. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdKCQ5oCifdj5qmZZtX4Mdf3eyDTeb1ci3aYLpnyhXacT/1779715070638.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSXv8RhqUQyviBmpmWguT6k5A9vCJYzuYyEpyoPzKcPfg/1779715070800.jpg) After we have bought all we needed to buy here, we immediately went to the other side of the Market which is the vegetable and fish located, as my Mother wanted to buy some. It took us only a few minutes before we arrived at that area of the Market. And now, as we arrived at that area, my Mother immediately started looking for vegetables and also fruits that she wanted to buy. She is the one who looked and choose for vegetables and fruits as she really knows how to choose properl. And if ever I'll be the one going to buy, I just choose it immediately without looking at it properly. That is why, I rather let my Mother choose and I am just here helping her. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWioZQmoxJT9Lh3HHG3QhQ8F8PHo5NUfanHXNHidFsRMu/1779715763153.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTXiDh6P8kkPzZxUG755rVPz5tH8vki2XEseFqwqu2xze/1779715763298.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnm1v9FpJzi8WVaSSJ6oyyaFGaWHTKmukxKrb94Fvd5J/1779715763409.jpg) It was already around 10:00 in the morning when my Mother finally finished whatever she wanted to buy here in the Market, and we will be going to do with other things we needed here to do. What my Mother did first is, she wanted to buy some medicine for her and also to my Nephew. She will be going to buy a medicine for her maintenance, for her High blood pressure, and for my Nephew's vitamins. She also bought some medicine for my Nephew most especially for his fever as sometimes my Nephew will have a fever most especially during night time when we go to sleep. Thankfully, we just finished our market day today very early. That is why, after then we immediately went back home. Thank God for we just got home home safe and sound, and the time is already around 11:00 in the morning. We then have prepared our lunch as the lunch time is about to come. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: Европа продовжує старіти, тиск іммігрантів зростає
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNWWEqMoBGda3myg4bCZ78eQWAyVtZvsWuTXsZ4X1FqV3/image)



2025 року в ЄС проживав 451 млн осіб, що на 1 млн більше, ніж 2024 року.
Найбільш населеними державами ЄС є Німеччина (84 млн), Франція (69 млн), Італія (59 млн), Іспанія (49 млн), Польща (36 млн).


Середній вік европейців за останні 20 років зріс з 39,6 років до 44,9 років. Найвищий середній вік - в Італії (49,1 року), Болгарії, Португалії та Греції (47,3 року), найнижчий - в Ірландії (39,6 року).

Частка осіб у віці 65 років+ зросла за два десятиліття з 17% до 22%.
6% населення ЄС - у віці 80 років і старше, в Італії це майже 8%, у Німеччині, Греції та Португалії - по 7%.

Діти та підлітки складають 14% населення ЄС. Ірландія очолює список з майже 19%, Італія має найнижчу частку (12%).


За 2024 рік понад 6 млн осіб іммігрували до ЄС. З них 4,2 млн (74%) - з України.
За 2024 рік країни ЄС надали громадянство майже 1,2 млн осіб, що на 12% більше, ніж роком раніше.

Найбільші етнічні групи, що набувають громадянство ЄС, - сирійці, марокканці та албанці.

body.title: Valbona Castle - Padua
body.body:
![IMG_4050.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23ynSaPJ8L7yTEaTdQf34YhZoAqYwa86QBfQSTwTKRGd5Z2sLaNoEnGXKDDw4yC24QQzP.JPG)

***
**I had been wanting to visit this castle for a while, which is about 30 km from my house, and I had often passed by these parts and observed it from the outside but I had never had the opportunity to visit it inside and I must say that it was truly a wonderful surprise.**

***

![IMG_4012.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23ycyh7C8tht14TPwy2BcKyeVfQebVE6DBjrcY8zGTLUSSyvwAmimb9VYj1Rg8rBDKq5i.JPG)

The Valbona Castle is located at the foot of Mount Lozzo in the Euganean Hills and was mainly born as a military garrison and customs house because it is located right at the crossroads of three provinces, in a truly strategic point. But the thing that surprised me is that I found that it is one of the best preserved castles in the whole area and even if it has been modified over time like many castles, let's say that the fourteenth-century structure is still clearly visible.

![IMG_4019.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xKxj6JTTvsP7oGMFHsySf4GrKBh11zTcxMHicNVbPKAAZAiEU6Jsiqn1HFMv4zx7eDA.JPG)

![IMG_4034.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/243WGzzBnyEqrFsDDfgrPd9RJqk6ZfrVtfVbUmgWNkNNURF5Ec4QgK38MHvMY8GXHWRKw.JPG)

practically yesterday you could visit it for free, because it was the national day of historic homes, this association organizes this day every year to let people know about the work that the associations do but above all about these homes which are very beautiful and which in many cases are not accessible to the public, I took the opportunity to visit it, and this visit was also supported by some students from the tourist schools which are located nearby who acted as a bit of a guide for us.

![IMG_4058.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23u65Puf6GPPQGmiFShks7Cs9GbQrfXaXW6Ux2CDMJaAwqfCPuTxDfKDBV845JDDDohHA.JPG)

![IMG_4093.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23u65BuaETSvsaVZPQ2fEPDBzcX2ThC94taBYLg1KvXvNoUq2rtvaANgop3hVuB3TdwMN.JPG)

I went up into the walkways. In fact, you can go all the way around the walkways where the guards used to walk, because they were restored several years ago and above all you can go up to the keep through certain paths that are almost tunnels, from where there is a beautiful view of both the Euganean Hills and the whole surrounding plain. You can really see from far away.

![IMG_4098.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/245T364L5BCGDWJujZGPN52AtBqZRCyZp7PxGpegB4GfD7PX8d9HHpkhsvMAyYZ7BMpGu.JPG)

This has always been a conquering castle. In fact, it has changed hands several times but for some time now it has become a tavern and also a renowned restaurant. In fact, when I visited it, it was practically preparing for a wedding, which I then saw in part. In short, the location is very beautiful and it is certainly a suitable place for a wedding or a romantic event. So I definitely recommend it.

![IMG_4063.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/243LvqmKLMJVtbHf1ZVrq2TXnoNmDgRs8KD7qiNLbWGCtyMeFh9cezZAKaWDCyiB1JVKA.JPG)

below I will leave you the official website, maybe if you need information to make the visit here, which is actually paid Because they ask for a contribution and I also provide you with the audio guide but I really invite you to look at the official website so as to organize yourself, what I can tell you is that in any case it is definitely worth the visit because it does not happen to find a castle so well preserved and that you can actually see the panorama from above In my opinion it was a beautiful visit and it is very exciting that it made me go back in time a little, thank you for reading See you next time.

![IMG_4115.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wMY9gTMWajJvNBRjDvv8o2syTAifMYZTL6kXF3qkBhtM7xbLQnp88BjBAiTH9h2A46j.JPG)

![IMG_4116.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23xAVKNvNSku3CUo9SAvbUVnCgBvUNVGdu1aqL5gVQqe3AjNsSPNAiRw1foUdKJfYZAqV.JPG)

body.title: The Spurs Rebellion and the Crisis of a Giant
body.body:
The Western Conference Finals between the San Antonio Spurs and the Oklahoma City Thunder will go down in history not only for the generational talent on the court, but also for the brutal show of force the young Spurs delivered at the most critical moment of the series. What promised to be a display of defensive prowess became a demonstration that the future, at least in Texas, has already arrived.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLHvJFDrrb8NB43FsK6G4aSVYnt61jRiA92TaxyFYj3s/hjif6lmwoaarr_.jpg)[source](https://x.com/Starcobaba/status/2058743073232871613/photo/1)



The culmination of this shift in power came in Game 4, a game that ultimately defined the psyche of both teams. The Thunder, defending champions and with the best record in the league, arrived at the AT&T Center looking to take a 3-1 lead and close out the series at home. However, they ran into a wall named Victor Wembanyama.




Wembanyama's \
\n\nThe series has been a titanic duel between the two leading MVP candidates: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Wembanyama. But in Game 4, the Frenchman showed why he's considered \

With a 62-win regular season, San Antonio needed its supernova to shine, and Wemby delivered with 33 points, 22 of them in a first half that was a nightmare for OKC's defense.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfCxWT12xMq7sFxjuvZoharHTq43J5XzCMg2UTgrxoVni/hjif5nqxgaatrsl.jpg)[source](https://x.com/contendrsmedia/status/2058743077812986355/photo/1)



His ability to play both in the low post and punish from the perimeter exposed the Thunder's lack of size. While SGA crashed against the defense (19 points and 6-for-15 shooting), Wemby dominated both ends of the court, adding 8 rebounds and 3 blocks that nipped any comeback attempt in the bud.
San Antonio's Defensive Suffocation

The key aspect of the series has been the Spurs' extraordinary defensive reaction. After being criticized for their lack of playoff experience, Mitch Johnson's team adjusted their rotations to shut down the perimeter. The most compelling evidence was OKC's offensive collapse in Game 4: the Thunder scored only 82 points, their lowest total since December 2021, with a dismal 6 of 33 from three-point range (18.2%).

While OKC's bench contributed 76 points in Game 3, the Spurs stifled that output in Game 4 thanks to tactical discipline. The absence of Jalen Williams (injury) and Ajay Mitchell left SGA without playmaking support, resulting in 20 turnovers that San Antonio converted into 25 fast-break points.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPHhcuBcqnWSeTd9Eq8SPweccq7v6XnTVHyVzvXNKnuA/hjigd_kaaaald3e.jpg)[source](https://x.com/JackHayHomes/status/2058743682862621158/photo/1)



The Oklahoma City Dilemma

For the Thunder, this series is exposing a critical problem: an over-reliance on individual matchups when the system breaks down. Despite having the deepest roster in the NBA, Wembanyama's pressure in the paint forced his shooters to rush their shots.

Although they comfortably won Game 3 (123-108), the Spurs' dominant performance in Game 4 demonstrates that San Antonio's inexperience is not a weakness, but rather a source of strength. With the series tied 2-2 and Game 5 in Oklahoma City, home-court advantage is once again at stake. If the Spurs steal a game on the road, it could spell the end for the reigning champions.

Credits: I used Google Translate for this translation.

body.title: (ESP-ENG) Aura y caos en Canadá
body.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>** 

> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23zGnnyX7JQ9V4357pMyg3tPvL8NCqM1JtuAa4PbE44KfdVQyKECDsSRQ4H3uN2vwSPPg.jpeg)


[Fuente. ](https://www.estadiodeportivo.com/motor/formula-1/asi-queda-mundial-formula-tras-gran-premio-canada-2026-antonelli-mas-lider-fernando-alonso-mas-hundido-20260524-538281.html)

<div class=\

>El día de ayer y después de 3 semanas de parón volvimos con la temporada actual de la F1, una que no ha tenido la regularidad de otros años por la suspensión de varias carreras en el medio oriente pero que para el final del calendario parece que tienen planeado volver. La cosa es que apenas llevamos 5 carreras de las cuales TODAS las ha ganado Mercedes y 4 de esas cinco se las ha llevado Kimi Antonelli. La puja que hay dentro del equipo de Toto Wolff es notoria por buscar querer ser el piloto principal y es que imaginaríamos que es Russell pero lo que estamos viendo en pista es otra cosa, sobretodo el día de ayer.

> Yesterday, after a three-week break, we returned to the current F1 season, which hasn't had the consistency of other years due to the cancellation of several races in the Middle East, but it seems they plan to resume towards the end of the calendar. The thing is, we've only had five races, all of which Mercedes has won, and Kimi Antonelli has taken four of those five victories. The competition within Toto Wolff's team is evident as everyone vies to be the lead driver, and we might assume it's Russell, but what we're seeing on the track is something else entirely, especially yesterday.

>Para que nos hagamos una idea del dominio que está teniendo el muy joven piloto italiano sobre su compañero de equipo hay que decir que Antonelli tiene 131 puntos mientras que Russell solo tiene 88 unidades. Se sabe y obviamente se ha visto que el ritmo y velocidad de estos Mercedes en comparación con el resto es bastante amplia y diferencial lo que ha hecho que en las carreras no tengan mucha competencia que digamos. Este fin de semana hicieron el 1-2 en la carrera Sprint y en la principal, de no haber sido por el problema en la unidad de potencia del auto de Russell, probablemente hubiesen terminado de la misma manera. El circuito de Gilles Villeneuve es uno muy entretenido y técnico y eso es lo que vimos el día de ayer, una carrera en donde pasó de todo y terminó siendo un tanto vistosa.

> To give you an idea of ​​the dominance the very young Italian driver is showing over his teammate, Antonelli has 131 points while Russell only has 88. It's well known, and clearly evident, that the pace and speed of these Mercedes cars, compared to the rest, is quite significant, meaning they haven't faced much competition in races. This weekend they finished 1-2 in both the Sprint and the main race; had it not been for Russell's power unit problem, they probably would have finished the same way. The Gilles Villeneuve circuit is very entertaining and technical, and that's exactly what we saw yesterday: a race full of action that ended up being quite spectacular. ![2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQhz8LLL83wDbrjisZD1ZUTqBtJA6M5WMr4BT8FnPvWwk3x2UPzUrf5XDtphiZkHkMu.jpeg) [Fuente. ](https://www.eurosport.es/formula-1/gran-premio-de-canada/2026/live-carrera_mtc1599413/live-commentary.shtml) --- ![3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/EoChcz5Rp7DiWuB8KbQcbe7VKEovk1D5uLrS1EZRmZ2YgC4pCBnzV44p4cahnuu9JVw.webp) [Fuente. ](https://futeros.com/f1-gp-de-canada-2026-horarios-canal-y-donde-ver-en-tv-la-carrera-larga-del-gran-premio-de-formula-1-en-el-gp-de-canada-de-f1-2026/)

>68 vueltas de carreras en donde casi la primera mitad de ellas estuvieron protagonizadas por ambos pilotos de Mercedes quienes estaban batallando por ver quien se quedaba con el liderato, uno que cambió de manos varias veces, incluido Lando Norris pero que por un error garrafal de su equipo él y Piastri tuvieron que despedirse temprano de la lucha por la carrera. Basicamente McLaren pensó que iba a llover por lo que le pusieron gomas intermedias de lluvia al momento de la partida; nunca llovió. Realmente la tarde para el equipo papaya fue terrible, sanciones para Piastri, Norris al final se tuvo que retirar de la carrera; un desastre total. Esa lucha entre Antonelli y Russell estaba muy buena, le estaba dando un color a la carrera interesante, hasta que el británico se tuvo que retirar.

> The race consisted of 68 laps, with almost the first half dominated by the two Mercedes drivers battling for the lead. The lead changed hands several times, including Lando Norris, but a colossal error by his team forced him and Piastri to retire early from the fight. McLaren essentially thought it was going to rain, so they fitted intermediate rain tires at the start; it never rained. It was a truly terrible afternoon for the papaya team: penalties for Piastri, and Norris ultimately forced to retire; a complete disaster. The battle between Antonelli and Russell was very exciting, adding an interesting element to the race, until the Briton was forced to retire.

>De acá en adelante todo se tornó un poco monótono, el ritmo de Kimi era muy bueno y el liderato no estaba en peligro. Los ojos se trasladaron hacia la lucha por el segundo puesto entre Hamilton y Verstappen. Ferrari es un equipo que no termina de despegar, ayer a Lewis se le vio mejor que a Leclerc pero entre ellos eso es un azar. Red Bull si vio un poco de mejora lo que le permitió a Max conseguir su primer podio del año, algo que es muy surrealista. Mejor ritmo para un auto que sigue sin ser encontrado del todo por el neerlandés. Cosas destacables: los dos Alpine terminaron entre los 10 primeros con un Colapinto en la sexta plaza, las cosas para el argentino pareciera que le están comenzando a salir. Hay que tener en cuenta que huno seis retiros, entre ellos Russell, Norris y Lindblad que estaba teniendo un gran fin de semana y que estaba para pelear esas posiciones medias.

> From then on, things became a bit monotonous. Kimi's pace was very good, and his lead wasn't in danger. Attention shifted to the battle for second place between Hamilton and Verstappen. Ferrari is a team that hasn't quite taken off; yesterday Lewis looked better than Leclerc, but between them, that's just a matter of luck. Red Bull did show some improvement, which allowed Max to achieve his first podium of the year, something quite surreal. It was better pace for a car that the Dutchman still hasn't quite found its rhythm with. Notable highlights: both Alpines finished in the top 10, with Colapinto in sixth place. Things seem to be starting to go well for the Argentinian. It's worth noting that there were six retirements, including Russell, Norris, and Lindblad, who was having a great weekend and was in contention for those midfield positions. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23z7Dh873R9bUSE2E9gAWKnaEy6nnoNHoK83VSqfaWeTvDiWFqNvNgcpKuKMqGuY8pPf8) [Fuente. ](https://www.canal26.com/deportes/2026/05/24/formula-1-franco-colapinto-termino-sexto-en-el-gran-premio-de-canada-y-continua-haciendo-historia-en-la-maxima-categoria/) --- ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tSRwoXTB6ku7RBwnv5YBe8A7b3phBxSxocM7qyfFse7rLLSrJ7PBfxJGfo9iBMWmgMr.jpg) [Fuente. ](https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/motor/formula1/mundial-f1-2026-carrera-sprint-130577735)

>Creo que McLaren podía estar para pelear con Mercedes pero dada la tarde nefasta que tuvieron no se pudo ver nada de eso. De momento el campeonato está decantado para Mercedes y sobretodo para Antonelli quien ya tiene una ventaja considerable con el resto y con Russell quien es el segundo en esa tabla. No se yo si habrá algún equipo que pueda llegarle a los Mercedes, a parte de McLaren, está complicada la cosa. La próxima carrera es dentro de dos semanas y es en Mónaco, la monótona y mítica pista del principado. Al final ver a Hamilton y Verstappen en el podio con Antonelli, dos grandes campeones mundiales junto con el piloto más joven de la parrilla como ganador del premio hace que hayamos visto uno de los mejores podios últimamente; un choque generacional importante. El caos lo vimos en la pista pero al aura que desprendió ese podio fue impresionante.

> I think McLaren could have been in contention with Mercedes, but given their disastrous afternoon, that wasn't the case. For now, the championship is firmly in Mercedes' grasp, and especially in Antonelli's, who already has a considerable advantage over the rest of the field and Russell, who is second in the standings. I don't know if any team, apart from McLaren, can challenge Mercedes; it's a long shot. The next race is in two weeks' time in Monaco, the monotonous yet legendary circuit of the principality. Seeing Hamilton and Verstappen on the podium with Antonelli, two great world champions, along with the youngest driver on the grid as the winner, made for one of the best podiums in recent memory; a significant generational clash. We saw chaos on the track, but the atmosphere surrounding that podium was truly impressive.

***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!
***

> Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

body.body:
Some images tell more than the story of an event. They tell the story of an era, a transition, and a shared hope.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmez9ci5ZLZp9HvPdakFbMcDLnmGaWKvfpnrWaVGqUCmfi/1779716450737.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdo4e2yq58mP8hTk32gP62gb8xGKc6d13EsAVFETeG4Sk/1779716450791.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXB2UZEQ2QpgfZ6uHdSv8RKM8sMHoMDBDUwbYQN6sVNGk/1779716450832.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSmXi9zPwa7Kh7uXKndcnxTif157oWpCrvXnqVCosQ61x/1779716450862.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXEWs3qSYsRXBtwuSSDiNR3xmTXARNKdYsogRtiRKvpyt/1779716450896.jpg)

Through these photographs, I witness a moment that marks a significant chapter in Benin’s contemporary history. A man stands with calm determination, carrying both the weight of responsibility and the promise of a future yet to be built. Behind him, the symbols of the Republic remind us that leadership is greater than any individual—it is part of the ongoing journey of a nation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbB8EFJ6yePuStZQifZSW1bZVSJigybFAgbCv8MoPyFYe/1779716533048.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcaMvuQXny9XnZ448WBtCPNPDo998KU2yddaCrgesePBJ/1779716533084.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbCLDhJFU8wJwt72BWdzfdana4W2pZJX1Jgqxy8RuS3gS/1779716533146.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfDRRCAus5irDu6Ze3XM6R1dNSQRikKb8jxQy36HjMnxW/1779716533189.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZLBujwj4xm73pF4qrNZ2DiGpsBitDv8DyV4msnwNMwYS/1779716533221.jpg)

Another image captures a meaningful handshake. Two political figures meet in a gesture of respect, continuity, and democratic transition. More than a greeting, this embrace symbolizes institutional stability and a collective commitment to building a stronger, more prosperous, and forward-looking Benin.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbr4o1frdhweVkdM33AwuhuBCi7w6aHU1VUUgmW9r2N23/1779716609257.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbfGT2dnzzdUUzcEuvUoUTr397Tbfs8Btdf5yen2dv4Bf/1779716609291.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUrxbpAmUQrUr7EaJLPwQhZjdoNVb7F29L5mvgnYyknhi/1779716609346.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXgVWFpVmnXgZvpYMgNugnLzjHZ2a695nXAZTgKtRkNVb/1779716609401.jpg)

Then comes the brilliance of the ceremony itself. Accompanied by his elegant and radiant wife, the newly inaugurated president walks confidently before the people of Benin and distinguished guests gathered for this historic occasion. The refined attire, the solemn atmosphere, and the dignity of the event reflect the significance of this moment for the nation.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWYUd4qyqLSpxET153gWimQJjNjqLSHm3oydEik5yU2D6/1779716714657.jpg)

Beyond speeches and protocol, these images remind us that a country is built by the dreams, efforts, and determination of its people. The inauguration of a president is not only the beginning of a new mandate; it is also the renewal of a shared commitment between a nation, its institutions, and its citizens.
Today, Benin turns a new page in its history—one filled with hope, ambition, responsibility, and opportunity. May this new chapter inspire unity, progress, and prosperity for every daughter and son of our beloved nation.
The future is not something we wait for—it is something we build together.

body.title: Photo Trip | Poland - Yellow fields and sunset
body.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23tm72av8CGuZV1M54CqYiD7cPDLeUBeGWtWWNyMeJ29r9icH7XumjcgmcGnFtzhWwbeD.jpg)


A few days ago, I had to make an unplanned trip out of town by car. I knew I’d be coming back in the evening, so I brought my camera along just in case I came across an interesting sunset along the way.

> <sub>**[ PL ]**</sub>
> Kilka dni temu miałem nieplanowany wyjazd samochodem poza miasto. Wiedziałem, że będę wracał wieczorem, więc zabrałem ze sobą aparat na wszelki wypadek, gdyby po drodze był ciekawy zachód słońca.


![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6917.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23ynQam9SyUSyU3PcWRFdaeX1gqFiSPT7EQp8TirrVXQMGYtgQChzW19ymNuxYdUTb1bt.jpg)

Just before sunset, I managed to find fields of still yellow rapeseed along the route.

> Tuż przed zachodem słońca udało mi się znaleźć na trasie pola z jeszcze żółtym rzepakiem.

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23w2eXfzQXNzyBXc2VLoWabnV5PaiTsXfbajJMPk5tKMc32DAeNoKETT58qgMNa1ZJBMC.jpg)

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23xyNtqkbaqsbgyZRjKBfRbLXUr85ESTT1JFt2hCgQAf1A87nNkBAyPvgRvW9vXctoQuZ.jpg)

For a moment, the sun peeked out from between a large cloud and the ground. I managed to take a few shots during that time.

> Na moment słońce pojawiło się pomiędzy dużą chmurą a ziemią. W tym czasie udało mi się wykonać kilka ujęć.

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zbKc8T9uUonYzzpBsU1SGPEw1YtQ5eGmRu7iGGwPDVHUHUpPTvEJb3xYP9Mk9d3sCy9.jpg)

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6931.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23xAPbM2Z1vQ1m5tdyo3SyjS6kc4ugtH7aZQrsQuy5xskVG285tf6YMAsrGyqvTjEBRn6.jpg)

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23wgD7Jdhsuv1cG1e5yiEm7gSGmcRU5nJ89DURr5S7umAtQw8ochgXzNyWqwVcCMRGxbi.jpg)

I also wanted to take a few close-ups, but within seconds I had a few mosquitoes on my hand. After one shot, I gave up on the idea and went back to wider shots from a distance.

> Chciałem również wykonać kilka zbliżeń, jednak momentalnie miałem na dłoni kilka komarów. Po jednym ujęciu zrezygnowałem z tego pomysłu i wróciłem do szerszych ujęć z dystansu.

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23ywkizvhAJSfurcoPcseDxzgEaZHuP9BFzf4jriErt93orm1Q47qnLXNZCjmh3h8vSVd.jpg)

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6943.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zGZuhct2ZyufSQRVtHsPvgHFpwXVsoqX82gAHTm4oTj3A2jXAUyxM15aBddSYWrBgbs.jpg)

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6942_Panorama_1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23z79kcFuSiPXjPLYY5T32kCnPrGTS1GpDMmi6KSyrkmjgDzEAwaSs3NviabCKvscL4Ty.jpg)

A wider shot showing just how big the cloud was.

> Szersze ujęcie pokazujące jak duża była ta chmura.

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23zbKCM7nbVs9BMPFisduf6UQAtPFRk6TUyJ4LUENnEvpGrxhxKyhbXa786TRdgPmM57Q.jpg)

The last two photos, taken after the sun had set.

> Ostatnie dwa zdjęcia, kiedy słońce schowało się za horyzontem.

![RSphotos-26-05-22-RSP_6957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rsphotos/23ynN93tQHgw8aXhpBb6WAQDWfE5YDVJTzePjccQFHQBQD6iP8ZKJPGxmbmG9uvcrVpzY.jpg)

body.title: Cucumber, Potato, and Carrot Salad (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> Today I decided to make a light and delicious salad, which I had for dinner. I combined three ingredients: potato, carrot, and cucumber. I parboiled the first two, while I used the cucumber fresh to get the most out of its nutrients. Let’s take a look at the steps for this new recipe.
![1000117220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGc9QLLgrDQPSY42LNVVrkqha4RftJB5EooN6NTHJ6yTMC9yEBAvVmSDcG8XrxGeEQ5.jpg)
### Ingredients: - 1 potato - 1 carrot - 1 cucumber - Vinegar - 1 tablespoon of mayonnaise - Pinch of salt - 2 cups of water
![1000117209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAPKLCzPqqexGipnxafcRBNYt5H8XeDPt21S1VS7cBW1Qqpf7QGfv4ZbYF9sMkLacYC.jpg)
## Procedure: I filled a bowl with enough water and washed the vegetables. Next, I peeled the potato, carrot, and cucumber. I cut the first two into large chunks, while I sliced the cucumber and set the slices aside in the refrigerator.
![1000117212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTdMsHVz7GBgufKJhPKBG6GqExVrrJ6pdrHxt25LV2vXoL4LFRB3dgfFfq3cwmUw4U7.jpg)
![1000117215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsXGyhmcpwy1aVXBEZBqv5t9b6dS2DMzpAk6dyqeKwuGmDTHoPgp5pZZtdH1FBpapDx.jpg)
Then I poured two cups of water into a pot and added the potato and carrot pieces. I put a lid on to speed up the cooking. In twenty minutes they were tender; I checked with a fork. I turned off the heat and drained the excess water using a colander. Shortly after, I looked for the cucumber slices I had set aside and combined them with the blanched vegetables in a bowl. I added a little vinegar, mayonnaise, and a pinch of salt.
![1000117218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xVHJGG1HUPsGmHtuqD8mo2F6Dsezoxfdb3cpQATXKH6mbsdWEhpiDctjk7FpGBeYK5Y.jpg)
I stirred it with a spoon and served it. The salad turned out delicious—a new combination that met my expectations. The cucumber added a really nice, refreshing touch. See you in the next recipe. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy me incliné por una ensalada ligera y deliciosa, la cual me sirvió de cena. Combiné tres ingredientes: papa, zanahoria y pepino, los dos primeros elementos los sancoché mientras que el último lo usé fresco y así aproveché todas sus propiedades. Veamos el procedimiento de esta nueva receta.
![1000117220.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23zGc9QLLgrDQPSY42LNVVrkqha4RftJB5EooN6NTHJ6yTMC9yEBAvVmSDcG8XrxGeEQ5.jpg)
### Ingredientes: - 1 papa - 1 zanahoria - 1 pepino - Vinagre - 1 cucharada de mayonesa - Pizca de sal - 2 tazas de agua
![1000117209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xAPKLCzPqqexGipnxafcRBNYt5H8XeDPt21S1VS7cBW1Qqpf7QGfv4ZbYF9sMkLacYC.jpg)
## Procedimiento: Llené un envase con suficiente agua y lavé los vegetales. Posteriormente retiré las conchas de la papa, la zanahoria y el pepino. Los primeros dos los corté en pedazos grandes mientras que el pepino lo dividí en rodajas, las cuales reservé en la nevera.
![1000117212.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23yTdMsHVz7GBgufKJhPKBG6GqExVrrJ6pdrHxt25LV2vXoL4LFRB3dgfFfq3cwmUw4U7.jpg)
![1000117215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23vsXGyhmcpwy1aVXBEZBqv5t9b6dS2DMzpAk6dyqeKwuGmDTHoPgp5pZZtdH1FBpapDx.jpg)
Luego en una olla vertí dos tazas de agua y agregué los pedazos de papas y zanahorias. Coloqué una tapa para apresurar la cocción. En veinte minutos estaban blandos, lo comprobé con un tenedor. Apagué y retiré el exceso de agua con la ayuda de un colador. Poco después busqué las rodajas de pepino que tenía guardadas y las uní con las piezas sancochadas en un envase. Agregué un poco de vinagre, mayonesa y una pizca de sal.
![1000117218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xVHJGG1HUPsGmHtuqD8mo2F6Dsezoxfdb3cpQATXKH6mbsdWEhpiDctjk7FpGBeYK5Y.jpg)
Removí con una cuchara y serví. La ensalada quedó muy rica, una combinación nueva que satisfizo mis expectativas. El pepino fue un toque refrescante muy bueno. Nos leemos en una próxima preparación.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: CNF: Receipts feel unimportant until you need them badly.
body.body:
> 


Victor is a graphics designer whose old laptop has become more of a weapon fashioned against him than an actual work tool. Sometimes when clients chat him up for work, he gets frustrated and starts to think instead of being happy he got a deal because of how much stress his old and lagging laptop will first of all put him through before he is able to get the work done. 

\

Became the words that come out of Victor's mouth the most.

Whenever Victor is working on his laptop, it is expected that he hisses and hits the ground a number of times, showing his frustration and how much his laptop is stressing him. One time he almost hit the laptop on the ground but realised that will only make things worse for him; the laptop might be slow, but at least he still uses it to work for the few clients he has, and hitting the laptop on the ground means he will lose the few clients that are left because without the laptop he can no longer deliver at all. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYufDhd5k38aSZyRJhrhWkAMCG8nncyN8y6zeCGdFPtsT/1779716549642.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/two-men-sitting-on-a-couch-looking-at-a-laptop-ek0HsepAxqg)

\
Royal asked Victor, who had hissed and hit the ground a number of times, if it feels unhealthy for him and people around him.\n\n\
Victor said as he slapped his forehead. \n\n\

Victor lamented as he tossed the laptop aside. 

Weeks went by, and we had to keep wishing we could help Victor out, even if not because we are friends and live in the same room but because we have also seen how frustrating using that old laptop can be. Doing an assignment on the laptop is one thing I don't even wish for an enemy, and an assignment that should take 30 minutes can take at least 3 hours with that laptop. What more, if Microsoft Word can be this slow, what about Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator? 

One afternoon we came back from class and saw Victor smiling sheepishly; we have not seen him that happy in a long time. 

\
I also asked because Victor's love for beer cannot be matched with anything.\n\n\
Victor said as he came to hug us with arms wide open.\n\n\
Royal and I asked, looking at him and waiting for answers.\n\n\
Victor responded with a big smile on his face, showing how excited he was. \n\n\
I will be going to the tech shop opposite the school gate to get a new laptop now before I tamper with the money.\
Don't forget to buy beer for the celebration and launching of your new laptop, ooo.\
Did you check it at the shop where you bought it from?\
Yes, now I did. I shut this laptop down myself before we started coming back home, bro.\
Immediately package this; let's take it back to the shop where you bought it from. We are going with you now.\
Good afternoon, how may I help you?\
Our friend here bought a laptop from you about an hour ago, but now the laptop cannot even come on?\
But, sir, he bought it today. Why can't we just skip this protocol?\
You think I am running a charity organisation?\
Receipt or Una, go leave my shop.\
If you had not brought this receipt, I would have done nothing for you because it could be that you want to scam me.\

The BTC dominance chart tells a clear story — it's been a flight to quality since 2022. ETH dominance halving from 20% to under 10% while BTC climbed is the market's way of saying 'prove your use case before I allocate.'\n\nWhat's interesting is that stablecoin dominance growth isn't just a bear market phenomenon anymore. USDT market cap expanding even in flat/up markets suggests genuine demand for dollar access, not just de-risking. That's a structural shift from the 2017-2021 cycle where stablecoins were primarily trading pairs.

body.title: 🤖 **Hive Automation Bot – Operation & Vision**
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23tGPToRMxmwAo1d7SCAbsLWqvGv1cNoHRUkzUUX4kcMSeaJs6PW5ofdbREHVuh6runxT.png)


🤖 **Hive Automation Bot – Operation & Vision**

Today, I’m presenting the complete workflow of our main bot, as well as the purpose of each dashboard tab. The goal is simple: optimize curation, save time, and build a smart automation system around Hive voting.

---

🔥 **The Main Bot: the core of the system**

The main bot is designed to analyze, filter, and automatically vote on posts based on specific criteria.

Its operation relies on several key elements:

• **Content analysis:** each post is scanned to count the actual number of words, cleaning out markdown, links, and HTML.  
• **Quality filtering:** only posts with at least 300 words are considered eligible.  
• **Vote weight calculation:** the bot applies dynamic rules based on content length:  
   - 300+ words → base vote  
   - 500+ words → increased vote  
   - 1000+ words → even higher vote  
• **Voting Power protection:** the bot only votes if VP is above a defined threshold (e.g., 78%).  
• **Smart auto-voting:** votes can be chained automatically with a delay (e.g., 5 seconds between each vote).  
• **Real-time tracking:** a visual indicator shows voting progress.  
• **Full logging:** every vote is recorded with author, permlink, tags, and timestamp.

👉 **In short:** the main bot selects quality content and applies a consistent voting strategy, without human intervention.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23tGTge6TBxg8vFhGfyyoYU7ZtDn7z2Py9T9YL5MhjHv9ZScsUv2RhV4ocGktG8r93j89.png)

If the lower section does not match exactly:  
https://hivehub.dev/stats/account?username=we-are-ai&category=financial&days=7  

it means we are currently connected to a node under maintenance.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23vspHGiqtMXwY1zoeoqYu2T5KDowrSv87sWAGjU66CZgkGUf8yNpD7dAt35wV6QDhhuo.png)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 **Tabs: complementary tools**

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/EppKmXkvUAA2PN2rn1z6yzqYNhnT6Mnd6v2YZ6xS4t3MnFBNpmqEjDCkXf5xGtx9hbF.png)


Around the main bot, several tabs allow you to go further in managing and leveraging votes.

🔹 **Vote by Tag** (vote-per-tag.php / 4.php)  
This tab allows you to:  
• View posts grouped by tags  
• Manually vote on all posts within a tag  
• Easily adjust voting power  
• Filter tags using a search bar  

👉 Ideal for strengthening a niche or supporting a specific community.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23t6zyRqwmidnFbhwFeUYwb2Tb4e4CiHaj7WWLQJBxBWUCzQjGEW7ZJgWLAbiYc3GqaWC.png)



🔹 **Reblog List** (reblogauto.php)  
This tab is used to:  
• Store all completed votes  
• Generate a usable list of voted posts  
• Reblog posts one by one with an automatic delay  
• Clean the list if needed  

👉 It acts as the bridge between voting and visibility.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23tcNhnr53nJmRTkJFFriGwEC6ofdjR5Dcxj3Qm91LQie4uYjWjvHTUA8LsqCEtWS7Vdy.png)


🔹 Token TransferThis tab allows you to:• Send tokens in bulk (HIVE, HBD, or Hive-Engine tokens)• Manage automated distributions• Track transfer progress  
👉 Useful for rewards, airdrops, or community management.Works with a CSV file or manually via the bottom section of the main bot.



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/Eo8ZeGF6JuQexom3SivQgmVCe6mro4hbAcp6W6v5QwAXxevPnqdr3gvuewai3fgRLWx.png)

🔹 **Dashboard** (main bot)  
Displays:  
• Hive Power  
• Account growth  
• Author & curation rewards  
• APR and overall statistics  

👉 Gives a clear view of the bot’s performance.  

As mentioned earlier, the lower section may not display correctly for now because I’m currently connected to a node under maintenance. I’ll update this later, or implement a system that automatically connects to the best available node (still figuring out the best way to handle that).  

---

🔹 **Account Switcher**  
• Easily switch between voting accounts  
• Secure login via Hive Keychain  

👉 Very useful for managing multiple accounts.  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  

🚀 **Vision & Ongoing Automation**  

Currently, the system works in two steps:  

1. The main bot automatically votes on eligible posts  
2. The tabs then allow to:  
   • vote again (manually)  
   • reblog posts  

But this workflow is evolving rapidly.  

👉 **Current goal:**  
Fully automate the tabs.  

**Coming very soon:**  
• Every post voted by the main bot will automatically be:  
   - revoted (based on multi-account strategy or adjustments)  
   - reblogged without manual intervention  

👉 We’re moving from a semi-manual system to full automation.  

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  

⚡ **Conclusion**  

This bot is not just an auto-voter.  

It’s a complete intelligent curation system combined with powerful tools to:  
• organize votes  
• boost visibility  
• automate repetitive actions  

And most importantly…  

👉 This is only the beginning.  

Full automation of the tabs will turn this setup into a fully autonomous curation machine.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/benef.alive/23swi9xYs8A8Gzhyy9i9yTVp3a7iFwHkYaiSceX4NyiGA4oW7u9acLCD5QmeDdtxaF3Mu.png)

For now, the bot is not at its full capacity because I’m running a lot of tests, which drains the mana very quickly. But once everything is fully set up, the mana will never drop below 90% and it won’t miss any account eligible for voting. The mana will recharge as fast as it is used.

Within two months, there will be a small second-hand PC (around $50) running 24/7 connected to the router to operate this bot. For now, it’s running on our personal computer, so it’s not active all the time. At the moment, I’m still in the development phase.

body.title: VPN for Android: Understanding Secure Mobile Internet Connections
body.body:
A VPN for Android is widely used as a simple way to improve privacy when browsing the internet on a smartphone. Mobile devices frequently connect to different types of networks, and not all of them offer the same level of security. Public Wi-Fi, in particular, can expose user data to potential monitoring or interception.

To reduce these risks, a VPN introduces an additional security layer that helps protect internet traffic during everyday use.

**How Encrypted Communication Works on Android**

When a VPN is enabled on an Android device, it creates an encrypted channel between the phone and a remote server. All internet activity passes through this protected route instead of being transmitted directly over the network.

This encryption process ensures that the data cannot be easily read by third parties. Even if the connection is intercepted, the information remains encoded and unusable without the correct decryption method.

Another important function is IP address substitution. The device’s original IP is hidden and replaced with the IP of the VPN server, which changes how the connection is identified online.

**Everyday Situations Where VPN Is Useful**

VPN usage on Android is not limited to advanced technical purposes. It is commonly applied in everyday mobile activities where users want more privacy and safer connections.

Typical scenarios include:

*
    Using public Wi-Fi in cafes, airports, or hotels


*
    Accessing personal accounts through mobile apps


*
    Conducting online transactions or payments


*
    Reducing exposure to tracking mechanisms


*
    Maintaining privacy when switching between networks


These use cases reflect how VPN tools can support general mobile internet safety.

**Effect on Speed and Device Performance**

While VPN services provide security benefits, they can also influence connection performance. Since data is encrypted and routed through an additional server, internet speed may decrease depending on server load and distance.

In some cases, running a VPN continuously may also increase battery usage on Android devices. The ongoing background processes require additional system resources, which can affect overall efficiency.

However, the level of impact varies depending on the application and network conditions.

**How VPN Applications Are Typically Used**

Most VPN applications on Android are designed for simplicity. After installation, users usually select a server location and activate the connection. Once enabled, the VPN operates automatically in the background and secures internet traffic.

Some applications also offer automatic protection features that activate the VPN when the device connects to unfamiliar or unsecured networks. This helps maintain consistent security without requiring manual adjustments.

**Key Aspects to Consider When Using a VPN**

Before using a VPN on Android regularly, several practical factors are usually evaluated:

*
    Strength of encryption and security protocols


*
    Stability of server connections


*
    Ease of use and interface design


*
    Impact on speed and battery life


*
    Transparency of data handling policies


These elements help determine how suitable a VPN is for daily mobile usage.

**General Summary**

A VPN for Android  [https://toggle.org/vpn-for-ios ](https://toggle.org/vpn-for-ios)provides a practical way to enhance privacy and secure internet activity on mobile devices. While it may slightly affect performance, it adds a useful layer of protection when using public or unsecured networks, making it a common tool for everyday mobile internet use.

body.title: 25 May 2026,daily writing prompt:designed to overeat!
body.body:
Overeating isn't just a physical act; it's also a reflection of our emotions, of our yearning to fill voids that don't always take the form of food. When excess becomes a habit, it reminds us that life isn't satisfied solely with bread, rice, or sweets, but with affection, with kind actions, and with the serenity of knowing we are in balance.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcuNEyYqU6T9qaLDnNni62kuP2i5GQbJ7YmuJnzcUjfJi/img_20260115_wa0014.jpg)



At the table, food offers us energy, but also symbols. A fresh fruit, a plate of vegetables, a glass of pure water are reminders that healthy isn't boring, but rather what restores our vitality. However, when we seek in food what we can't find within ourselves, the risk of excess arises: eating more than the body needs, as if the stomach could resolve what the heart keeps silent.

Excess can be seen as a metaphor for contemporary life: we accumulate tasks, emotions, responsibilities, and sometimes even guilt. We are designed to \

too much of everything: work, worries, news, comparisons. And in that chaotic feast, we forget that what truly nourishes us are simple gestures: a kind word, a sincere hug, an act of kindness. These are the invisible foods that sustain the soul.

Therefore, reflecting on excess also means asking ourselves what we are consuming beyond the material. Are we filling our day with gratitude or with complaints? Are we nurturing our relationships with patience or with indifference? Just as a body saturated with fat becomes ill, a spirit saturated with resentment withers. Moderation, then, is not just dietary advice, but a philosophy of life.

The invitation is clear: choose what is healthy, both at the table and in our hearts. Eat fruits and vegetables, yes, but also sow seeds of solidarity. Drink water, yes, but also offer words that refresh. Avoid excessive sugar, yes, but also avoid excessive anger. Holistic health is built on balance: what goes into our mouths and what comes out of our souls.

Ultimately, we are not designed to overeat, but to share. Food finds its full meaning when it becomes a bridge: when what is healthy is shared, when emotions are expressed, when spirituality is cultivated. Eating well is living well, and living well is learning to nourish ourselves with what is essential: what sustains us without overwhelming us, what fills us without emptying us.

Credits: I used Google Translate.

body.title: Recuerdos de mi querida Mona. 🐶❤️ Memories of my dear Mona,.
body.body:
>
Esta semana me salte a The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #46 porque me hizo recordar momentos muy bonitos con una amiga peluda que pasó por mi vida por casi 2 años y dejo una huella en mi corazón. Aunque la actividad de esta semana trata sobre esa mascota de la infancia la verdad es que, si hubo una en casa, los recuerdos que tengo son muy vagos ya que era muy pequeña, pero si recuerdo que se llamaba Coki, que era muy peludo y de color blanco, pero en realidad era la mascota de todos y cuando murió la enterramos en el patio posterior de la casa. >This week I skipped The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #46 because it reminded me of some very fond memories with a furry friend who was part of my life for almost two years and left a mark on my heart. >Although this week’s prompt is about that childhood pet, the truth is that, if there was one at home, my memories are very vague since I was so young. But I do remember that his name was Coki, that he was very furry and white, and that he was really everyone’s pet. When he died, we buried him in the backyard.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23u61B12DDSqRv534dTSN7JL7bTQxq58GyBrBjmxuGufgG3Ff8Tv2upEANGPiQxFqC3UL.png)
Crecí y nunca sentí la necesidad de tener una mascota, hasta que un día apareció en mi vida una perrita de color marrón que casi no había abierto los ojos. Mi hijo me dijo que estaban regalando una perrita muy bonita, fue y la trajo y definitivamente creo que fue amor a primera vista, me gusto todo de ella, su color, su brillo en la piel, sus patas gruesas y la ternura que trasmitía solo al verla. >I grew up and never felt the need to have a pet, until one day a little brown puppy who had barely opened her eyes came into my life. My son told me they were giving away a very cute little dog; he went and brought her home, and I definitely think it was love at first sight. I loved everything about her—her color, the sheen of her coat, her thick paws, and the tenderness she radiated just by looking at her.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23w2gVKuntrQ1VtdAmtTWUZcPvty3DhXQMHt2iJKQkTDMjhpNWogZ2LreYSCadGsXdgPz.png)
¡Y como decirle que no a mis hijos que de “YA” se habían enamorado! Le pedí a los dueños de la perrita que la tuviesen unos días mas junto a la madre, pero no quisieron, ellos solo querían salir de esos perritos y antes que se la regalasen a otro ¡me la quede! >And how could I say no to my kids, who had fallen in love with her “IMMEDIATELY”! I asked the puppy’s owners to let her stay with her mother a few more days, but they wouldn’t; they just wanted to get rid of those puppies, and before they gave her to someone else, I took her!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/242NqYqbWNu4poyfvKXectBUdCvXK44oxSNpwvWcPWj1edsxwFCeyBQsTsHcMsTq72fNH.png)
Lo primero que hicimos fue buscarle un nombre que me gustara; recuerdo que hice una encuesta en el grupo familiar de WhatsApp, les envié la foto y de inmediato comenzaron a salir nombres de todo tipo. De todos me quede con “MONA” me gustó mucho, mucho. >The first thing we did was find a name I liked; I remember I did a poll in the family WhatsApp group, sent them the photo, and immediately all kinds of names started popping up. Out of all of them, I settled on “MONA”—I really, really liked it.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23wMaK5y5kw8D5KNZdH789KgPWKpBcHTqXHkbUfFN5rRoewFtGjjRMkARtxRAwnNPFCHR.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23wMRdPWxGtsiY7YFYsk6WY7eZDMT44QEvX4wwC8R1WsNQuPhUUFTtwT1XBQaerhBKVZ2.png)
Cuando están así son una ternura, le mandamos a poner sus vacunas, la cuidamos con sus productos de limpieza y todo marchaba bien hasta que creció enorme y comenzó sus travesuras. Todo me encantaba de ella, era demasiado cariñosa, jamás perdió esa ternura que trasmitía en su mirada desde que nació. >When they’re like that, they’re so sweet. We took her to get her shots, cared for her with her grooming products, and everything was going well until she grew huge and started getting into mischief. >I loved everything about her; she was so affectionate and never lost that tenderness she’d shown in her eyes since she was born.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/AKzC9nD5ahzu298DomussCk5yGEMYFjXu7ryxM87jHzqeiYooweSJmt6MXuk1uu.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/AL7QHN8ugEW4dbLmpmyvGHEKthfec4ht9EDGDBWjjsdjPiL74kUofDLZciRW4iR.png)
Definitivamente era la compañera de vida que cualquier humano pudiera tener; pero la vida no todo es perfecto, ni duradero; un día de repente se enfermo y aunque tarte de hacerle todo lo humanamente posible por salvarle la vida, NO FUE POSIBLE. >She was definitely the life companion any human could have; but life isn’t always perfect, nor does it last forever. One day, she suddenly got sick, and even though I tried everything humanly possible to save her life, IT WASN’T POSSIBLE.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/AKzD8NMyrzQ8NGTFnM4xwqF9L2aA3hhDixKQpaP5B732Ctnh3dnFXBwVUSJhKF1.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/23vsJJ5HVcZFNBxjqZv9fb2UwPsJjFn3UbpXEFTqQx7yxpr21uodZ2yHhadgAnAo2UJmF.png)
Seguro muchos de ustedes sabrán lo que se siente el perder a estos amigos peludos que invaden el corazón de las personas. Lloramos, nos consolamos con los buenos momentos que vivimos y nos quedamos con eso para llenar el vacío. Por eso hoy le dedico esta publicación a mi querida Mona, mi perrita hermosa. >I’m sure many of you know what it feels like to lose these furry friends who steal a place in people’s hearts. We cry, we find comfort in the good times we shared, and we hold onto those memories to fill the void. That’s why today I’m dedicating this post to my dear Mona, my beautiful dog.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carolinacardoza/AKcgxKr8L4UmRoXvnLgiFUShb18pAzw18XDxwobZ1Foe4yo6figxByWvR5pAeRu.png)
