body.title: Mis princesas felices con sus regalos [Spa/Eng]
body.body:
>

   

*This post is both in English and Spanish, you can go directly to english by clicking [HERE](#english)*
Saludos y bendiciones, mi gente bella de @lifestyle, un gusto saludarlos. Espero todos se encuentren muy bien. Tenía días que no pasaba por aquí y hoy lo hago para contarles que mis princesas están muy contentas con lo que les regaló su primo. Resulta que el sobrino de mi esposo está emprendiendo con la venta de carteras junto a su novia y hoy estuvieron recibiendo un envío que vino directamente desde China.
![1001735272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vhye4KCDPszZCi4PRr6vpu6Q2KZ3F9VrdY7MQZ6DM4gxAHsQg7uEm3CNsKxXw6c2v8s.jpg)

>

Nos estaban mostrando la mercancía y les regaló una cartera a cada una; ellas mismas las escogieron, les preguntaron si en realidad la iban a usar y dijeron que sí y hoy mismo se las estrenaron. Ámbar se puso un lindo outfit a juego que, por cierto, se lo hice para su cumpleaños el año pasado y no le gusta ponérselo, así que aproveché de insistirle en que se lo pusiera para que le combinara con la cartera y, gracias a Dios, aceptó.

![1001735273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23xKxLtpazGHT3FPjuJjcD6A9jxcy6Exb9zfUdWSmi1ayMAqPFSGEcGY5pvFAs8pg45MQ.jpg) ![1001735274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23zkvedZtrny8f9bpmCxRkscTv6b2G6CNNsH9Zyfz4XmSkufbSJ6FdY2Ca3W3FdBBTECY.jpg)

>

Cuando estuvo lista, posó para las fotos y se veía tan linda; me hubiese gustado tomarle más fotos; sin embargo, estábamos apurados porque hoy era el primer partido de básquet de su hermana Arianna, de la que luego les estaré contando de esta experiencia más adelante. Después de que terminó el partido, nos vinimos a casa rápidamente para que Arianna se cambiara, ya que los demás estábamos listos. Ella también se arregló muy linda y se puso su cartera. Las dos estaban contentas con sus regalos, pero al llegar a la fiesta las dos me dieron sus carteras para que se las aguantara; no duraron mucho con ellas, jejeje.

![1001735275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23ydC24GRm8Td1nNYtpawbLVN1aN79NtWkyBxKv9Upwy8nwDuAgh933ap8zvgUDDRVMSA.jpg)

>

Ellas tienen varias carteras y no se acostumbran a ponérselas para salir; siempre terminan dándomelas a mí, por eso a veces no les digo que se las pongan, para no andar cargando con 3 carteras, jejeje. Voy a estar más atenta para que usen este tipo de accesorios que hacen que sus outfits se vean mucho más bonitos, como la pueden ver aquí en estas fotos. Bueno, amigos, esto ha sido todo por hoy; gracias por su visita a mi blog. ******

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>
![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png) # ***My princesses are thrilled with their gifts*** ![1001735309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23xVMJd5xqUWvgo9cm3nxJEbfmnDdez3Ln3kSCGx68UPJtgp5vbXhjhrxivz9c7PD8cJ4.jpg)

>

Greetings and blessings, my lovely @lifestyle community—it’s a pleasure to say hello. I hope you’re all doing well. It’s been a while since I’ve stopped by, but I’m here today to tell you that my princesses are absolutely delighted with the gifts their cousin gave them. It turns out that my husband’s nephew is starting a business selling handbags with his girlfriend, and today they received a shipment that came directly from China.

![1001735272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23vhye4KCDPszZCi4PRr6vpu6Q2KZ3F9VrdY7MQZ6DM4gxAHsQg7uEm3CNsKxXw6c2v8s.jpg)

>

They were showing us the merchandise and gave each of them a handbag; the girls picked them out themselves. They were asked if they were actually going to use them, and they said yes—and they broke them in today. Amber put on a cute matching outfit that, by the way, I made for her birthday last year, and she doesn’t like to wear it, so I took the opportunity to insist that she put it on to match the purse, and thank God, she agreed.

![1001735273.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23xKxLtpazGHT3FPjuJjcD6A9jxcy6Exb9zfUdWSmi1ayMAqPFSGEcGY5pvFAs8pg45MQ.jpg) ![1001735274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23zkvedZtrny8f9bpmCxRkscTv6b2G6CNNsH9Zyfz4XmSkufbSJ6FdY2Ca3W3FdBBTECY.jpg)

>

When she was ready, she posed for photos and looked so cute; I would have liked to take more pictures of her; however, we were in a hurry because today was her sister Arianna’s first basketball game, which I’ll tell you more about later. After the game ended, we rushed home so Arianna could change, since the rest of us were ready. She also got all dolled up and put on her purse. Both of them were happy with their gifts, but when we got to the party, they both handed me their purses to hold for them; they didn’t keep them for long, hehehe.

![1001735275.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23ydC24GRm8Td1nNYtpawbLVN1aN79NtWkyBxKv9Upwy8nwDuAgh933ap8zvgUDDRVMSA.jpg)

>

They have several handbags and aren’t used to carrying them when we go out; they always end up giving them to me, which is why sometimes I don’t tell them to put them on, so I don’t have to carry three handbags around, hehehe. I’m going to be more on the ball about making sure they wear these kinds of accessories that make their outfits look so much cuter, as you can see here in these photos. Well, friends, that’s all for today; thanks for visiting my blog. **********

![Adobe_Express_20230102_1612060_1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leidimarc/23w2sJvBcHBCPY8JjSirrP6WS9kXYNX1comRoVGZKWYTGCHAvnYfyHacxopoxasyiZZhQ.png)

>

body.title: Why Your Partnership Will Fail (And It's Not What You Think): The Financial Fundamentals Nobody Discusses
body.body:
Personality complex or strategy aren't the reasons most partnership businesses collapse; the majority of the time, the businesses will collapse because the partners didn't state clearly their financial stands and fundamentals for the business. Simple questions like the amount to pay themselves, how fast they want the business to grow, how much of the business profit is reinvested into the business, and when they come to both agree they are successful or have had a successful run?

 https://i1.pickpik.com/photos/265/909/238/shaking-hands-handshake-teamwork-staff-preview.jpg
[Image](https://www.pickpik.com/shake-hands-shaking-hands-handshake-teamwork-staff-team-35498)

It's not like most people do not have this at the back of their mind when going into a business, but because they want to avoid feeling uncomfortable, they never discuss it from the get-go; as the business grows, these issues become unavoidable. Certainly, when you are starting a partnership agreement, fundamentals such as equity splitting come first. Who owns what percentage, and who keeps what percentage? Other fundamental talks will be distribution, decision-making authority in the business, and so on, but then, distributions always happen to be the predominant problem in partnerships that were not properly discussed and stated clearly.



AT the beginning of the business, the money is often not coming in, or when it is, the numbers are pretty small, and what's left for the business owners is pretty small and at this point, not really something to worry oneself about, but as the business grows, it becomes a problem. When one partner wants to keep the money in the business, the other might not be very conservative. If your partner needs cash for their personal life, you might begin to have issues with your partner, but since neither of you mentioned this at the beginning of the business, it might become a serious issue.

 https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e2/Argument-3894006_960_720.png
[Image](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Argument-3894006_960_720.png)

Questions like when do we share profits, what percentage goes back into the business for growth, and how much do we split the profit based on share ownership. If you do not intend to take profit, and your partner does, they will be draining their equity by taking distributions, but it will still affect the business because the basis will still be different. To avoid things like this, you need to state clearly from the get-go what type of distribution policy you are going to adopt. Will distributions be taken quarterly, semiannually, or annually?



 Another thing that breaks a partnership is how you want to grow, and at what rate. Do you want to grow very fast, or do you want to remain at the point for a while? While a partner might want to grow sustainably, the other might want to see very fast speed and increased growth within a short period of time. If your partner is cool with taking on lots of debt and giving up more equity for growth, while you are not, there is no way both of you will not have trouble along the way. You both need to understand that business growth requires more capital, and one fear is growing into significant debt or bankruptcy. In the process of avoiding things like this, both of you would have trouble finding a proper ground because you both share different ideologies.

 https://i1.pickpik.com/photos/900/727/787/argument-conflict-controversy-dispute-preview.jpg 
[Image](https://www.pickpik.com/argument-conflict-controversy-dispute-contention-contest-32391)

 When you have excess cash as a business, you are left with decisions to either reinvest or share it. These are decisions you should have made at the beginning of the business. Also, when you start the business, it is important to know the value of the business because as you grow bigger, the partnership of the business would depend on this as well. You need to be able to say if you want to value your business through the income approach, market approach, both, or asset-based approach. If both partners do not decide this, they might value the business in different ways, giving different valuations to the company. So when one thinks the business is now very valuable, the other might see it as a business that is not valuable enough.



Partnership is rewarding, but it requires honest communication. Discuss financial fundamentals, growth expectations, and business valuation before you launch. Like any strong relationship, a healthy partnership is built on clarity and shared understanding from the beginning.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@harhike/why-your-partnership-will-fail-and-its-not-what-you-think-the-financial-fundamentals-nobody-discusses-amw)

body.title: Back to Guaquerí Park (Eng/Esp)
body.body:
> A new adventure takes us to the green heart of Cumaná: Guaquerí Park. I enjoy walking here because being in touch with nature brings a sense of calm, allowing me to momentarily disconnect from the hustle and bustle outside. I step away from my daily problems to reflect on other matters. On this occasion, the plants and trees were turning green again; you could see the freshness in the leaves, and they even had droplets of water on them. I noticed that the edible fruits, high up in the trees, were already starting to become noticeable; mangoes and tamarinds were abundant along this route. You can tell that harvest time is approaching, and soon visitors will be able to enjoy these delicacies.
![1000117266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xALoJCx28wpoUYmVJ5mCACBuBxE4KF4n6ZkxfABhZ27tQe9cuAadynqAd2gJEGEza4E.jpg)
I also enjoyed listening to the songs of various birds flitting from tree to tree; the Cristofue and the cuckoos sweetened the atmosphere with their melodies. Meanwhile, the doves and black thrushes walked along the ground in search of food. During this walk, I also spotted two iguanas scurrying about—one young and the other adult.
![1000117259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSSNPp7k4wQbvqTmD1XpBsvMmwvQPpH998jds1dfUi7Lfw1544KKTrbc3synVG46P6Z.jpg)
As usual, there were many people in the park engaged in various activities: children playing, groups of friends gathering, and family celebrations, all in perfect harmony. This is how they make the most of the spaces in this recreational center—some resting on the grass and others in the shelters set up for that purpose.
![1000117274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSU4NffbGrCEoJwwAdQaWe9VJTcK1jX7RHqx7F77ecg4fvGqgSRdE7pHshz32ZoxwXP.jpg)
Without a doubt, you can have a wonderful time here surrounded by greenery; the best part is letting your gaze wander to different spots, which allows you to notice details that might have gone unnoticed before. Every walk is an opportunity to discover them—including plants in bloom—which not only beautifies the surroundings but also nourishes the spirit. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Una nueva aventura nos sitúa en el pulmón vegetal de Cumaná: el parque Guaquerí, me agrada caminar por este lugar porque se siente cierta tranquilidad al estar en contacto con la naturaleza, lo que permite una desconexión momentánea del bullicio que se encuentra afuera, me alejo entonces de los problemas cotidianos para reflexionar sobre otros asuntos. En esta ocasión las plantas y los árboles reverdecían, se podía apreciar esa frescura de las hojas, incluso tenían gotas de agua. Me fijé que las frutos comestibles, en lo alto de las matas, ya empezaban a hacerse notorios; los mangos y los tamarindos abundaron en este recorrido. Se nota que ya se acerca el tiempo de cosechar y así los visitantes podrán disfrutar de estas delicias.
![1000117266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23xALoJCx28wpoUYmVJ5mCACBuBxE4KF4n6ZkxfABhZ27tQe9cuAadynqAd2gJEGEza4E.jpg)
También pude disfrutar del canto de varios pájaros que danzaban de un árbol a otro, los Cristofué y los cucaracheros endulzaban el ambiente con su melodía. Mientras que las tortolitas y los tordos negros caminaban por el suelo buscando algún alimento. En este paseo, además, observé a dos iguanas que se desplazaban a toda prisa, una joven y la otra adulta.
![1000117259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSSNPp7k4wQbvqTmD1XpBsvMmwvQPpH998jds1dfUi7Lfw1544KKTrbc3synVG46P6Z.jpg)
Como es costumbre había muchas personas en el parque, realizando diferentes actividades; niños jugando, reuniones de amigos y celebraciones familiares, todo en armonía perfecta. Así aprovechan los espacios de este centro recreativo, unos descansando en la grama y otros en las churuatas dispuestas para tal fin.
![1000117274.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23tSU4NffbGrCEoJwwAdQaWe9VJTcK1jX7RHqx7F77ecg4fvGqgSRdE7pHshz32ZoxwXP.jpg)
Sin duda, acá se puede pasar un momento agradable al estar rodeado de lo verde, lo maravilloso es fijar la mirada en diferentes sitios, lo que permite detallar ciertos elementos que antes pasaron desapercibidos. Cada paseo es una oportunidad para descubrirlos, incluso plantas que están en su proceso de floración, lo que no solo embellece el ambiente sino que alimenta el espíritu.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

body.title: A peaceful escape to Batulichaur lake, Chitwan
body.body:
Hello hivers!

![PXL_20250707_102905325.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX7rHRV5duqZs5wa83BhPnwUrcGMSG7YSrRhhpPvSqFYs/PXL_20250707_102905325.jpg)

Today I want to share my recent travel to Baatulichaur lake situated in Bharatpur municipality of  Chitwan district in mid Nepal. 

Sometimes all we need is a calm and peaceful place with fresh air and natural sight away from the busy life. So I decided to take a quick escape to the Batulichaur lake. Located in the centre of Chitwan National Park and a short drive from my workplace at BP koirala Memorial Cancer Hospital made this travel feasibe despite the limited time frame.

![PXL_20250707_092546432.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSPzoyQqnZpyzhF8gXkgyfuTgUAz9ESknVphKxnsRbSAo/PXL_20250707_092546432.jpg)

It was mid noon when I reached the location. It was a one hour ride from my workplace. This ride is quite risky as the wildlives like one horned rhinoceros and wild boar often take this route to reach the oter side of the national park. As soon as I reached there , the cool and fresh air gave me a sense of instant relaxation and freshness.

The surrounding was quiet, clean and filled with greenery. Chitwan National Park is a home to more than 600 species of birds. The birds chirping in the trees and the dance of Peacock made the environment more relaxing.

Oe thing I loved most about this lake was its clean surrounding. There were availability of garbages bin nearby and facilities of clean drinking water as well. According to the security personnel caring the lake, there were around 20 Gharial crocodiles in the lake so the administration had banned for swimming and boating in  the lake premises.

![Uploading image #9...]()

The reflections of trees in the water and a gentle flow of wind made the moment a picture perfect. Every corner of the lake were worth taking in the picture. This location is a perfect spot specially if you are photography lover.

Places like Batulichaur lake is a reminder that Nepal is rich in natural beauty and water sources.

Sometimes we search happiness in distant places while peaceful destinations exist close to us.

If someone is planning to make a trip to Nepal , I strongly recommend to make a visit to this masterpiece of the nature.

![PXL_20250707_092638731.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbgBgnyJCSoASoGxqbuqJ3DooU4GZJ2TpjybHYGqdVbgK/PXL_20250707_092638731.jpg)

body.title: Physical Punishment ❌
body.body:
/>

I personally do not support the use of physical-punishment because I believe children should be taught through understanding, communication, and patience, rather than through fear and pain. While many oldergenerations believe that spanking or corporalpunishment helped them become well-behaved children, I think that time has movedforward, and we now know much more about how such practices can affect childrenemotionally and psychologically.

Although physical punishment might temporarily stop a child from acting out, it does not help them truly understand what they didwrong.  
More often, the child will obey only out of fear of being hurt again. Using fear as a method of discipline can damage the relationshipbetween parents and children. Instead of feeling safe and understood, the child might become afraid, angry, emotionally distant, or withdrawn. Over time, this can lead to a declinein self-esteem and emotional well-being, and may affect how the child relates to others.

Another reason I disagree with physicalpunishment is that it can encourage violentbehavior in children.  
When children are spanked as a form of discipline, they may come to believe that hitting others is an acceptable way to solveproblems or express anger. Some children may become more aggressive, while others may become shy or emotionally damaged. The effect of physical punishment varies from childto child, but it always has an impact on their emotional state.

To me, discipline should be about teaching, not hurting.  
Parents can still be firm and set boundarieswithout using physical punishment. By settingclear rules, offering reasonable consequences, having meaningful conversations, and teaching responsibility, children can grow up in a healthier and more effective environment. For example, when a child misbehaves, parentscould take away toys, limit their time, or calmlyexplain why their actions were wrong. This allows the child to learn from their mistakesrather than just fearing the punishment.

Children are still young and often do not knowhow to manage their emotions or make gooddecisions.  
They may act in ways that seem foolish not because they are being defiant, but because they are confused, emotional, or simply not mature enough to control themselves. In suchcases, communication and patience can be farmore effective than any form of physicalpunishment.

Some people might argue that children who are physically punished grow up to be strongerand more respectful.  
However, I believe that self-respect should be built on love, understanding, and trust, not on fear. When children feel heard and supported, they develop into confident, responsible, and emotionally healthy adults.

In conclusion, I do not support the use of physical punishment because of its significantemotional impact on children, which can outweigh any short-term obedience it might bring.  
Children should be raised to learn and grow, not to be left with fear or emotional trauma.The respect and support children receive-through loving relationships are far more valuable than physical punishment.

title.title: Finally a new PC
title.body:
Over the years I have run and built many computers. Back in the 1990s I was a dedicated Amiga user, but I had to concede in the end that the platform was dead. I was running an Amiga 1200 that was extensively upgraded with a more powerful processor, lots of memory, a big hard drive and a CD ROM. Well it was a lot more powerful than any standard Amiga. So I decided I would have to move to Windows and bought a PC from some company in London. I think that was a 300MHz Pentium 3. Since then I have built various machines around AMD processors with the most recent having a quad core chip. That was back in 2014. Last year I finally upgraded the memory from 8GB to 24GB as it was struggling with some things. I am not a gamer, so it was more about things like video editing and general web use. Modern web pages are very intensive for processing. I had seen that prices for memory and storage were increasing due to demand for data centres and AI so I decided I needed to bite the bullet and get something more up to date. I looked at [Power Computing](https://powerc.com/) who have been around since the Amiga days and are not far from me. They allow you to specify what hardware you want and I was willing to pay the extra for someone else to assemble it. A few weeks ago I picked it up from their shop. ![Big and black](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steevc/23xVF8xxbuKkDwELWxsXA1CLbKbJwLcSH3zqzDxrir2WdUMc2SKDFx9tgfQ6V5dmrUKPR.png) I went for a tower as I want it to be quiet and to be able to add more storage. The supplied hardware was: * be quiet [Pure Base 600](https://www.bequiet.com/en/case/921) case. * be quiet 750W PSU. * be quiet Pure Rock 3 CPU cooler. * Asus [Prime H610M-A](https://www.asus.com/uk/motherboards-components/motherboards/prime/prime-h610m-a-wifi/) motherboard with Wifi and Bluetooth. * ADATA XPG Lancer 16GB DDR5 memory. * ADATA Legend 860 1TB NVMe drive. * Palit RTG5060 Initity 3 8GB graphics card. * Logitech MK270 cordless keyboard and mouse. One of my criteria is that a PC should be quiet as I will want to record music in the same room. I just had to make some compromises to keep the price down. Water cooling may be quieter. Power Computing tweaked my requirements a little to use more of the be quiet components and all I hear is a very low hum. I also had to compromise on memory. Another 16GB would be about £200 now. Although I do not play games the GPU can accelerate things like video rendering and I may find other applications for it. Obviously things have moved on a bit in the last 12 years. Memory and solid state drives are much quicker now and the processor has 16 cores so things will just be quicker. I noticed that immediately with some web pages such as Youtube that would take several seconds to load before and are now almost instant. The old PC had a small SSD drive, but this new one is much quicker. I try to avoid Windows and so I did not buy that for this PC. Instead I installed [Ubuntu Studio](https://ubuntustudio.org/) that includes most of what I need for audio and video on a solid Linux platform. The install from a USB drive was simple. I moved over my old 2TB hard drive and DVD writer. I have some other drives that may go in there too as there is plenty of room. So far I am happy with my purchase. It seems that every time I want a new computer the price is about the same, but you get much more for your money even with the current supply issues. I am still using my previous iiyama display, but will have to replace my second ancient screen as this PC only has HDMI and Displayport connections that it cannot use. I am also using my existing Focusrite Scarlett 4i4 audio interface. These things just work with Linux.

title.body:
Cool mornings but warmer days now though rain is inbound tonight. Yesterday morning I watched the Giro stage then Utd played their last game of the season and surprisingly won which has them 3rd in the table. ![IMG_20260524_080149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uQjgyrk3K1h2u2kkbzp9WzPi4v7Grm259ckvo4rPmSBvNdWZzZTJtLfF9jT2x7DGmqH.jpg) ![IMG_20260524_091253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23y8mWs8uvqSZAT5QqzxdZgHKnhKEWrSbtFJjNMx2s2xVWEBAU2ZJjhnfv6iupdWUMV4c.jpg) Found a couple belt buckle clip things that I printed out on the #3dprinter. The thinner one will actually work pretty well for a webbing belt. The taller is WAY too thick. ![IMG_20260524_095300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tm9FomaJ3RwYKX8tQiM7XHwXZ1w1fdYvFNzuWqiCJ64iFxYrKqtYPsb2vbqhhXyxcR4.jpg) I harvested spinach from the greenhouse and DAMN are there some huge leaves. Dinner plate sized leaves. ![IMG_20260524_100715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xAVU3kKN5rSz5nHZWpZhdMuz9WvmPsRzVE9o7vAZoLMJrhmjKR7gpesknX7teAoeVQ9.jpg) The sheep had gotten into the main pen under the fence where I had dragged the alpaca through so I chased them out and as I was walking by the alpaca I noticed she had maggots all over her ass. That was NOT GOOD AT ALL! I went directly to the coop and got out the shears then began to cut. She just let me do it thankfully. I scraped oodles of them off her with sticks but they were still hatching. ![IMG_20260524_102657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsV8B3rSCkqvXSgxaZjUDqq9aB94e9jx5sz4wWzGwW5c29cZMMNbhpUhvw8syDQUxxA.jpg) I was cutting through masses of maggots in her hair and shaved her butt as close as I could to eliminate places for them to exist. It was really gnarly but had to be done. @stryeyz and the boys went to North 40 for supplies and a bale of alfalfa for her. ![IMG_20260524_103608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xp6FzqwQtdcMdkaEzADfQTGYHTjGSy68aeaCi1hpp9cgwrQ1kZ8EfmwsM2TJJTnHr6D.jpg) I went on a ride. Holy shit did I work myself hard as I went and climbed multiple hills. ![IMG_20260524_112402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vYWWnTg27si5MnaigQ2eaRmdaMifUvqw63xp5aLvqqi7zy7BSfjWeAZz5Mhm6uN6xCY.jpg) There was a south wind so a lot of head and side wind blasting me. ![IMG_20260524_113626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xp6GRrmWnZvBCL8sWnWz4WWg8a54B1X3DmXEgjjDnm364dEBg7urLFgBe4FFtuZDhZt.jpg) ![IMG_20260524_113631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/242Y3BXxh4anLMd6ceVYd3KkaKDthFRrN7gJnsjBVJAMKNqMFymrwGzvAVCYtJYoHRxCw.jpg) More booty from the side of the road. This puts me over 50 ecigs I have found and taken apart for the batteries. Also found a selfie stick for an insta360 that is still in good condition and is not bent in any place. ![IMG_20260524_133235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x14wp4MatxdEsruckL3sfJ2o6EdNgMnUdKcSWidFihe5NWWXwYwNDBu5r1uLRYgPdZc.jpg) ![bike 5-24 graphs.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGZw56f7rzZW7koReGQhgvPWSxYSQxu99ZgrFjJs8P21CJWkhTfZBdRudAXDihnfSCs.JPG) ![bike 5-24 stats.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23swfwJfbZ9u9WeJBVb4KtPiWXXim5omgy6JZcbk7ck2MEENd86PL63cc9wBm45S15iSw.JPG) It was REALLY good to see the alpaca standing again as #stryeyz washed her butt clean of the maggots. ![IMG_20260524_140132.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wC9nn8Ssd9rxRa3peHw6cq3gpsMrEBZ34GJJVu9CXzdvPmqgnmvijhU1ZuD6Ss5gnSE.jpg) The columbines are blooming in the yard. title.title: Banana cookies with almonds, rasins and coconut (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6HhQkrkzrBTT2BdDtSwGKVcdJ7YxgLPZ7cNcKp4wzocwPSkzqyhQoZxhgg3KAjTZJz.png)</center>\n\n* Good morning hivers, welcome back to my blog... Next I will explain how to prepare some exquisite \

.
The process of this recipe is very easy and simple, but with a VERY tasty result!

>* Buenos días hivers, bienvenidos de nuevo a mi blog... A continuación, les explicaré como preparar unas exquisitas “galletas de banana, con almendras, coco y pasitas”. 
El proceso de esta receta es muy fácil y sencillo, pero con un resultado MUY sabroso!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23yJRCHxyy7qu1PdnDgR4DFFE3wqLEdfzYKofnBcKB6rJ3CeGx8hX4Ye3eAQn4UuPq8WC.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: 1 egg, the puree of 2 bananas, 4 tablespoons of grated coconut, almonds (chopped), raisins, ground cinnamon, 1 teaspoon of vanilla essence, powdered sweetener and wheat flour (as needed).

>* INGREDIENTES: 1 huevo, el puré de 2 bananas, 4 cucharadas de coco rallado, almendras (troceadas), pasitas, canela en polvo, 1 cucharadita de esencia de vainilla, edulcorante en polvo y harina de trigo (cantidad necesaria).

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* We add the banana puree to a bowl... we add the egg, and mix both ingredients until well combined.

>* Incorporamos en un bowl el puré de banana... agregamos el huevo, mezclamos ambos ingredientes hasta integrar bien.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoAd8RiwnkHN91dAnzdkwktCHdXJcMPteNdzR4UN5jpXBPwvAh3ue3LiRwxMheaARKm.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tHJV4ewy6UAPhas3uyZP45jPzYdE69W7SXmNryBGDzHgxENeivLPgmoBXSFWSyaPzz5.png)</center>

* Next, add the vanilla extract and ground cinnamon... These ingredients will provide a wonderfully aromatic contrast!
To sweeten, I used powdered sweetener. The amount will depend on the quality and brand you use; in my case, 2 tablespoons were enough to achieve the perfect sweetness. If you prefer, you can substitute: honey or brown sugar.

>* A continuación, colocamos la esencia de vainilla y la canela en polvo... Estos ingredientes aportarán un contraste MUY aromático!
Para endulzar utilicé edulcorante en polvo, la cantidad dependerá de la calidad y marca que utilicen, en mi caso 2 cucharadas fueron suficientes para conseguir el dulzor ideal. Si lo desean pueden sustituir utilizando: miel o azúcar morena.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmS6oJjQMHqAJxJkoGzpDKcko1uRJ4y3Hu6RdwUXm5RrJKJe2zdZnURGXMgZckHjBSZ.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoK7oTWX4baymLVExQ6vkdwZJ857xjdtM6sTswRv244VkmSjMtWFq8QLmsYjrdQrDxs.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgS4q1YiYLucfrR3yaLLR1N1r9cpWnbpzRLGyWWBUcRC5SRVNmpwWwTfvCAvazTRCq7.png)</center>

* We add the shredded coconut... You'll enjoy a slightly \
texture that I'm sure you'll love!\n\n* Añadimos el coco rallado... Disfrutarán de una textura ligeramente \

que estoy segura amarán!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMcoeFf4ut1sbCUqwsbX1rmaKxeMEwwLgDA7jKNiaaYxAznvFexfDdtanrA1QeHZRTN.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vsUQ988mJePhVxpXRK3sScwMUubkZVoDcL3ujKbyvBp9LwmEFv7msgoEFyKjZHX8542.png)</center>

* In this step, we incorporate the wheat flour. I suggest adding it little by little until you achieve a very creamy texture.
Add the raisins and the chopped almonds.

>* En este paso incorporamos la harina de trigo, les sugiero ir agregando \

, hasta conseguir una textura MUY cremosa.
Añadimos las pasitas y las almendras (troceadas).

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6De5G2qeHMVabEHN8GazH13EsmUepgDCb6GFmsQQ9JcjnF8PXBhuGhTjdqXzy3FvUF.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmQ5kfbAbzZ5Cm9fFjB3VqwFF8kPHTQ3DwRXaGKjqPPwsD48tvGM93vF7NBMXxZtrLm.png)</center>

* Line a baking tray with parchment paper. Add portions of our delicious mixture and decorate with almonds. Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through. Baking time will depend on your oven.

>* Forramos con papel vegetal la bandeja del horno... Agregamos las porciones de nuestra suculenta mezcla, decoramos con almendras. Horneamos a 180° durante 25-30 minutos o hasta comprobar que están listas, el tiempo de cocción dependerá de la potencia del horno.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFgtejeVMJz3wKZnTD4ADg1siiyxfSKK7TzkN5MgQDFfkqvQB4FNU3hZcBiVunV7YA2.png)</center>

* Our delicious cookies are ready to enjoy, we hope they cool to room temperature.

* Nuestras apetitosas galletas están listas para disfrutar, esperamos que se enfríen a temperatura ambiente.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL7NvLhTMGPe913WpSc7wJoJQT73wBPCNKpinnt5dq9ycnhnJJgkSGWVnWYiZDbdfrs.png)</center>

* Next, I'd like to share a delicious, low-calorie dessert with you a perfect option for an afternoon snack with family and friends... A true treat!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. Enjoy your meal! 
Have a wonderful start to the week!

>* A continuación, les presento un postre muy delicioso y bajo en calorías, una excelente opción para merendar con sus familiares y amigos... Un auténtico manjar!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, me despido deseándoles buen provecho. Feliz comienzo de semana!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/241thvycBLMRiUCidhxpC3DjCPYycMa1MWYiSsPNfoW4EuWyMpaUJGBU6xnSHsDvrZgoY.png)</center>

title.title: DCORE: HIVE token for the DemoniCore game
title.body:
## What is DemoniCore?
[DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com) is a simple and fun [play-to-earn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blockchain_game) game, where you conjure demons to battle in [PvE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_environment) turn-based [RNG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random_number_generation) combat, reminiscent of old-school [RPG games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Role-playing_game).

![DCORE](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/logo/dcore-logo11-trans.png)

## [Tokenomics](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics)
The sole token of DemoniCore is [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE), which can be traded on any exchange that supports Hive Engine tokens, such as [Hive Engine](https://hive-engine.com/) and [Tribaldex](https://tribaldex.com/).

**DCORE (as of 2026-05-25):**
* One DCORE is worth
    * 1.001e-05 HIVE
    * $0.0 USD
* Total DCORE
    * Supply: 2,472,001
    * Circulating: 2,471,991
    * Total staked: 887,133 (35.9%)

## [Philosophy](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#philosophy)
The overarching philosophy of [DemoniCore](https://www.demonicore.com/) is \

, and this mandate extends to the game's tokenomics. Instead of a complicated ecosystem with numerous different cryptocurrencies to keep track of, we opted for a single token, [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE), that is used for all in-game transactions, and which can be traded freely on [Hive Engine](https://hive-engine.com/).

## [Scarcity](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#scarcity)
Unlike many other play-to-earn games, [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) has a very limited supply, and is designed to stay that way. The total supply currently stands at 2.47 Million tokens.

[DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) is regulated by a unique emissions mechanism that only mints new tokens on an as-needed basis, with a hard cap on new token supply. If the game's reward pool decreases below a 66,000 DCORE threshold, **DemoniCore** will mint new DCORE in 10,000 token increments until the reward pool exceeds the minimum threshold.

The amount of new [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) minted can never exceed 240,000 per day. 
Keep in mind that this represents the _theoretical_ maximum allowed inflation by the system - the actual inflation is much lower.

![Demon](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/rand/demon/13.png)

## [Uses](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#uses)
[DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) is the currency that [DemoniCore](https://www.demonicore.com/) rewards players with for successfully [slaying](https://www.demonicore.com/battles) and [exorcising](https://www.demonicore.com/exorcisms) demons. In turn, players can spend DCORE to upgrade their stats, purchase potions to reduce their Insanity level, and buy NFT cards on [Hive NFTs](https://hivenfts.com/demonicore/buy/) to enhance their gameplay experience.

[House Demons](https://www.demonicore.com/house_demons) is an exciting new game mode, providing yet another use case for **DCORE**! Summon your own loyal demons, powered by AI, whose looks and personas are limited only by [your imagination](https://www.demonicore.com/about_house_demons). Your house demons will generate income and communicate with you - even responding to your messages - with the personalities that you crafted for them!

![House Demon screenshot](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/assets/house-demon-message-frida.png)

We always strive to come up with new ways to provide [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) sinks, and we reserve the right to iterate on balancing gameplay mechanics, rewards, and prices to keep the game economy healthy for players and investors.

## To our players
As always, thank you for your love and support - without you, there is no **DemoniCore**. For anyone who hasn't yet played, please give [DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com/) a try!

[Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/DxD2WEkZk5)

title.title: I Started Filming A Documentary
title.body:
The last project I filmed was about 3 years ago now. It was a short film created with some people I met while working on Vikings: Valhalla, and after rounding up a bunch of friends from college, we got to work.

It was a fun shoot; it took 2 days, but there were a couple of mishaps which stopped a good film from being great. 

Since then, I worked for other people, editing, writing, as well as working solo on Music Videos. But I got an itch recently to get myself back out there and do something bigger.

Gathering a crew together can be tough, and larger projects take a lot more organising, but in the end, it is always worth it.

****

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKMyZu5BXjEhW4cgmTdAXi2PuWvrcNAvfXnmU9gSCG42/image.png)
[Source](https://www.premierwellbeing.ie/?l=47772416021880&srsltid=AfmBOorxmu6DnyicO_EqAJybyc5SzYMMc3Ay5N0e7w8kj6mbL14J8wez)


****

**The Wicklow Music Collective**

There were two ideas floating around my head for documentaries, one of which was to follow the collective, interviewing people, while also sharing a bit of insight into what we are doing.

Because we have some big things coming up, that idea took precedence over the other idea I had.

So I suggested the documentary to everyone, got the green light, and started organising some stuff behind the scenes to get it started.

****

**The Festival**

We were asked to play at a local festival, The Taste of Wicklow, where we have been given 1 of 2 stages for all of the bands in the collective to perform.

To be taken from the smaller venues we regularly perform in and to be put on a larger stage is a major boost for us.

The Collective has picked up a lot of steam, and this festival is such a large event that it just adds to the momentum.

It's a great chance for all of the bands and musicians to perform to a much larger crowd, and it's a badge of approval, in a way, for what we have been doing for the last year.

****

**The Idea For The Documentary**

Introduce key members of the collective, document the ins and outs of operating something like this. 

Showcase the bands and musicians.

Document the nights, and show what each gig entails. 

Document the Coffee Shop Sessions.

End with setting up and performing at the festival. 

There are a good few ideas to add in, if the runtime allows for it. Regardless of that, though, a great natural endpoint for this documentary is the festival itself.

****

**The First Day of Shooting**  

We decided to hold a production meeting/ collective update meeting yesterday. 

Since the crew were going to be there anyway, I figured it would be a good idea to get some B-roll of the meeting.

The crew and I met earlier in the day, and filmed some B-roll of the town, an intro to the documentary, and we also shot a short interview with one of the founding members of the collective right before the meeting took place.

It's nice to have the ball rolling and to have some footage.

We are going to shoot 1 day each week for about 7 or 8 weeks, and after each day, I will review and place the footage on the timeline. That way, I can get an idea of what shots we need more of in the following week.

title.body:
> If I could exchange lives with a famous person, I would undoubtedly choose Mother Teresa of Calcutta. Not out of a desire for sainthood or fame, but because of the profound humanity that resided in her fragility. Exchanging lives with her would mean, paradoxically, learning to empty myself of myself in order to be filled with others.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFiAp9H9yVcKhz2zrxaJwPe58pSJqC4BtwazjWdnCkQi/catholic_1295787_1280.webp) First and foremost, I would exchange my comfort for her radical renunciation. I was born and live in a world where the accumulation of wealth, personal success, and public image are often unquestionable goals. Mother Teresa, on the other hand, voluntarily chose the most extreme poverty to be truly free. By putting myself in her shoes, I would discover what it feels like to wake up each day without the certainty of food, without a bed of one's own, but with the absolute certainty that every moment has a purpose: to serve. That change would confront me with my own dependence on material things and show me that true wealth lies in giving until it hurts. Secondly, exchanging lives with her would immerse me in unfiltered love. Mother Teresa didn't just help the poor from behind a desk; she touched the wounds of the dying, cleaned the abandoned in the sewers of Calcutta, and smiled at those whom the world had discarded. That direct contact with human suffering is something that I, like most people, tend to avoid out of fear or discomfort. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5Um9mKPbL5jzCEP7oBeN9UT3J4fJ4Y8AbJJCP44tMHt/img_20240414_103037.jpg) To be her for a day would mean feeling the withered skin of a leper in my own hands, hearing the last breath of a malnourished child, and still not succumbing to despair. That experience would forever transform my definition of compassion: it is not pity, but courageous action in the face of another's suffering. Finally, living her life would confront me with the dark night of the soul. It is known that Mother Teresa, for decades, experienced a profound spiritual aridity: she felt God's absence, and yet, she continued. That contradiction is fascinating. I usually need results, recognition, or clear signs to persevere. She persisted in her faith without apparent consolation. Trading my need for certainty for her blind trust would be the hardest and most beautiful lesson: that love doesn't always come with gratifying emotions, but with a decision to surrender that transcends mere feeling. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNbbUuEdgBVxPam4dQcfo5Mbxah7mJzxNDEQBX1QpEhq6/img_20250627_wa0006.jpg) In the end, I wouldn't want to stay in her life forever, because I'm not good enough for her. But I do need that imaginary exchange to remind myself that greatness isn't measured in achievements, but in small, everyday sacrifices. Mother Teresa of Calcutta isn't a distant icon; she's a mirror in which I can see myself and learn to be more human. That's why, if I could, I would choose to be her: to learn to die to my selfishness and be reborn in service. Credits: I used DeepL Translate. The photos are my own. The image is referenced. ESPAÑOL Si pudiera intercambiar vidas con un personaje famoso, sin duda elegiría a la Madre Teresa de Calcuta. No por afán de santidad o fama, sino por la profunda humanidad que habitaba en su fragilidad. Intercambiar vidas con ella significaría, paradójicamente, aprender a vaciarme de mí misma para llenarme de los demás. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXFiAp9H9yVcKhz2zrxaJwPe58pSJqC4BtwazjWdnCkQi/catholic_1295787_1280.webp) En primer lugar, cambiaría mi comodidad por su radical renuncia. Nací y vivo en un mundo donde la acumulación de bienes, el éxito personal y la imagen pública suelen ser metas incuestionables. La Madre Teresa, en cambio, eligió voluntariamente la pobreza más extrema para ser verdaderamente libre. Al ponerme en su piel, descubriría qué se siente al despertar cada día sin certeza de comida, sin una cama propia, pero con la certeza absoluta de que cada instante tiene un propósito: servir. Ese cambio me confrontaría con mi propia dependencia de lo material y me mostraría que la verdadera riqueza está en dar hasta que duela. En segundo lugar, intercambiar vidas con ella me sumergiría en un amor sin filtros. La Madre Teresa no solo ayudaba a los pobres desde un escritorio; tocaba las llagas de los moribundos, limpiaba a los abandonados en las alcantarillas de Calcuta y sonreía a quienes el mundo había descartado. Ese contacto directo con el sufrimiento humano es algo que yo, como la mayoría, suelo evitar por temor o incomodidad. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW5Um9mKPbL5jzCEP7oBeN9UT3J4fJ4Y8AbJJCP44tMHt/img_20240414_103037.jpg) Ser ella por un día significaría sentir en mis propias manos la piel ajada de un leproso, escuchar el último suspiro de un niño desnutrido y, aun así, no caer en la desesperanza. Esa experiencia transformaría para siempre mi definición de compasión: no es lástima, sino acción valiente frente al dolor ajeno. Finalmente, vivir su vida me enfrentaría a la noche oscura del alma. Se sabe que la Madre Teresa, durante décadas, experimentó una aridez espiritual profunda: sentía a Dios ausente, y sin embargo, continuó. Esa contradicción es fascinante. Yo suelo necesitar resultados, reconocimiento o señales claras para perseverar. Ella persistió en la fe sin consuelo aparente. Intercambiar mi necesidad de certezas por su confianza a ciegas sería la lección más dura y hermosa: que el amor no siempre viene acompañado de emociones gratificantes, sino de una decisión de entrega que trasciende el sentimiento. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNbbUuEdgBVxPam4dQcfo5Mbxah7mJzxNDEQBX1QpEhq6/img_20250627_wa0006.jpg) Al final, no querría quedarme en su vida para siempre, porque no estoy a su altura. Pero sí necesito ese intercambio imaginario para recordarme que la grandeza no se mide en logros, sino en pequeñas renuncias cotidianas. La Madre Teresa de Calcuta no es un ícono lejano; es un espejo donde mirarme para aprender a ser más humana. Por eso, si pudiera, elegiría ser ella: para aprender a morir a mi egoísmo y resucitar en el servicio. Créditos: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate. Las fotos son de mi propiedad. La imagen está referenciada.

title.title: Cuba, estoy sobreviviendo? Ayúdame a vivir: Mi historia
title.body:
Hola amigos de Hive Cuba... 
Quise hacer el post en esta comunidad porque sé que nadie mejor que ustedes entenderán lo que estoy viviendo. Y aunque ya hice mi  presentación hace dos años atrás cuando comencé este camino, hoy quiero hacerlo diferente para ayudarlos a entender mi historia. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRWWLW6oaV4RQecNyEkBGckLSeCbNWoiYr1bA3i1qctLs/file_00000000326c71fd867d1911caba17a9.png 


Mi nombre es Marianni Díaz Viamontes, ya tengo 23 años desde abril. Vivo con mis abuelos maternos en un pueblito de mala muerte en la provincia de Camagüey. Nunca viví con mis padres y tampoco he recibido gran apoyo de su parte, soy sola con mis abuelos y siempre fui feliz así. Pero, hace casi un año me gradué con mucho sacrificio en la Universidad de Oriente en Santiago de Cuba, de licenciada en Historia del Arte ( Hive me ayudó mucho económicamente a lograr esto ) luego de 4 años en dicha provincia regresé a mi pueblo, nuevamente con mis abuelos porque no pude ejercer el servicio social por la distancia ( Camagüey es muy grande y mi pueblo queda a unos 70 km y en ese momento eran 1000 pesos ida y vuelta al trabajo , actualmente son 3500 ) .



 Encontré trabajo de músico , buen salario y tenía tiempo para ayudar a mi abuela en casa, pero solo 3 meses duró mi felicidad pues saben bien que el turismo paró en nuestro país, así que adivinen? Nuevamente en mi pueblito y desempleada. He inventado como todo cubano para hacer dinero y sobrevivir porque aquí solo hay dos chiringuitos con sus dependientes cobrando 300 pesos por 12 horas de trabajo, salud , educación y deporte por 4000 al mes con suerte y en tarjeta. Sumado a los extensos apagones de 18 a 20 horas por 2 o 3 de corriente. En resumen, aquí no hay quien viva. 


Imaginarán la frustración que siento...pero tomé una decisión muy arriesgada. Irme a La Habana, a buscar trabajo y un alquilercito que me pueda permitir para ver si logro prosperar y de alguna manera aliviar peso en casa. Así que agradecería eternamente si apoyaran esta publicación y todas las que vean en adelante porque lo hago también con la esperanza de que ese mismo dinero me sirva para progresar. Disculpen seriamente si esto se puede tomar como que estoy mendigando atención y votos, pero lo cierto es que es una petición desesperada de apoyo. A todos desde hoy, a todo el que leyó, vivo eternamente agradecida. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaLnBgweZJYgqN2Bb9LLHcWNvhNZoNwLBZPp3DEPCdwCY/file_000000002d6871f88dcd4a528e68a4d0.png 


Quiero aclarar que decidí que fuera La Habana y no otra provincia pues en Camagüey no tengo a nadie ya, y en Santiago tampoco ( se han ido a buscar futuro en otro sitio) Seguiré actualizando constantemente mi situación y agradecería de corazón si me pueden dar la luz si conocen algún trabajo que busque personal y de algún alquiler que sea medianamente económico. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSkyAxgKYcmYGoaQVPcHGGVAr1LDPQpHPUmZA9oaQXBPT/file_0000000036a071fd940c9ce78413c3a7.png 


*Fotos de mi galería editada a texto con ayuda de chat GTP*

title.title: Organizing My Clay Scrap, And I Didn’t Expect It to Be This Hard, But It’s Worth It. (Disclaimer My Hand Hurt So Bad)
title.body:
![clay organize.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCiB7KSTHmuNMJw5XhfPSa5yW6MNdtiFmhnYTtAmvkmTiSNy4UQhTZo7amwKPTRJsC.gif)
Hello, how are you? So I've been so stressed about all my polymer clay scraps, and I decided that since I bought my 3-layer foldable storage box, I am going to be organized with my things, LOL. I now feel more organized since I bought one. I felt more or less stressed since I bought it. So I bought just one 24-grid organizer and thought all the scraps of polymer clay would fit in it, but I was wrong LOL. So I bought more of them, and I am going to show you how I fit all of them. -----
All the Polymer Clay Scraps
![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonmzyDc7pREzfGV7inm4Bi1QmfpuZLWaAW55DTEMUce4qVTbfYH7Nf9WXXwzFdpux9.JPG) I like these old containers, but my problem is that the moment the clay touches each other, they stain each other with is such a hassle to remove every time I use them LOL. ----- -----
White to Black:

> ![5.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj9gd5nTgva11VcjFgH4YwkP6XMuxjnkAjMZQ8jHDaC9vq3wE9g7Y2YJTK9AA17V2.JPG) I like to start from the shade of white to black. I knead everything first and then shape it into a ball shape, do everything the same to the other clay. I like to make it look more organized. ---- ----
Light Yellow to Yellow:

> ![9.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj6xUCJbZfMUVivSkpZQjeZXvw5VdKL2og8QdrRtQDzHV9CGSZRWdGoyzmm51eCsz.JPG) I like to start with the lightest color, like yellow, to avoid staining while kneading each clay. --- ----
Light Orange To Orange:

> ![13.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9PdLg1nzUUB9on68QL1myek8AwScZASQDbKS2g5s4hKVbZ5h5rHhB3PZaSTJiS2m.JPG) Going to light orange, did the same on the yellow one: knead it first, then shape it into a ball, and I make sure to line them up from the lightest to the darkest shade. ----- ---

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc91zzqtHLqLbx1NxAHCvFXMvohYkH2WwrrA4U41TpWskZJk6KxzpuxwKrtcW3GfcR.JPG) For this part, my hand starts staining, so that is why starting with a lighter color is a good idea. I used to mess up before, so when I realized, yeah, I should do that! LOL. ----- -----
Skin Color:

> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK8DpgHBGAcwFFKh8bo7vxVCqwFYx7HpXk2XAnzRXd3D65sbzaQZJYFR5vbCNLiFqJ.JPG) Before I start with the skin color, I wash my hands to clean because some staining in my hand starting to appear. ---- ----

> ![25.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEryM1VTp73yz9sWLd9aYzgw1ikKVqTptFPNU3USLYcmdoXkkNo3cecTvisQGuahhm.JPG) At this point, I am contemplating whether I should continue this or not, but I keep going LOL. This part is the combination of skin tone and pinkish color this one I use for the nose of gloom. ----- -----
Red To Cool Red:

> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoputMxUQsXe6UV1fHzTRpoLpWuQ6rs9wG9wkz2VEERke7jWX7VcXU7wvfzxXed2pQD.JPG) This one’s are staining my hand, so I gotta use disposable gloves for this part LOL. These are the cool and warm red colors. ---- ----
Earth Tones Colors:

> ![36.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyRrkn8CxKrPfRXewhqhDAzuDehLuNL5TmpEd5aredWck8uM9xdXGqCHMyoX8kRBBv.JPG) These earth tones are so soft, so I need to sandwich them into a piece of paper. ----- _____
Green Shades Clay:

> ![41.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5ob9ysaPjpwWN1rifBeCR9m6PPs27T8r9W1VH3gJZZHFbhdDzJFVgmHnSN1rQzVfq.JPG) These are my favorites green these are soft, so it took me small time to condition and knead them. ----- ----
Warm Blue Shade Clay:

> ![47.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpCBMNnYZrkirsi45ofn2H6hkDZwWPzbeAEXTdFQKehG57UNwc9DpPszugMLkMGp26L.JPG) Love the shades of blue here. I am still thinking about what I am going to use these shades of blue for. ---- ----
Cool Warm Shades Clay:

> ![55.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoAbDMyN7jhwhV9nbidUZAup6Nm9NtdFeZhibjU8Ve8vSXygGZGTWMqNe9rRwr8hdng.JPG) I thought knead is not gonna end, for the final batch! ---- _____
Putting Into The Grid Storage Box:

> ![57.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK6pubZPRFRZ5N9ZwTQ66QteqipVDKrJDCZFSzp7ayswrJfQYpabM4ttvPkVDcQmnG.JPG) This one is the most satisfying part of the process. Lining everything clean. -----

> ![59.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9iH6kqzQsLMFDzXYmmncw3h8av7gN2jnGRPZfiA1cfnchoK58RYRo1M7AxymndB9.JPG) Some of them are literally big but exactly fit, so it is good. ----

> ![61.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPD6WZXXjZqao7gQC6EN8ttqkStzqfSz95fdKpUeEbWYrLP9NusEcqyqwhU1gRZk4.JPG) One grid storage full! Next! -----
Storing In 2nd Grid Storage Box:

> ![63.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogNrvR17eoUtbRjJz5Dv4PKaBMWxWthgQXGnqRzrxizwpRnutGn9sJN9FogwngDx1C.JPG) There is one space on the first one, so I added that in so that everything will fit. -----

> ![64.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeFpMKvZTe4W9RxbpS8z2XyvKDcGaSJcppxF8TvzY6S76ve6bjoQrdBjH4L6KeMhEp.JPG) The red looks like it's struggling to fit, but I have no choice but to put it in LOL. -----
> ![68.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eo8UjgqwT4jePYQKk1T8SU4N6FDvwFhuHB9VbC2dwni5N2G1QYXkNoyp3DCiJCeRArd.JPG) Then next the earth shades, green and blue. -----

> ![70.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eo4D2YyBLMTW6CqNkduK24nTX1BTbU8aYcsHvfhphGKJ1ps4dN7mLULeZW9ZvWeGVeA.JPG) And the remaining cool blue. ---- ----
All My Clay Is Organized, Dust-Proofed!
> ![72.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj8a6MFdSmPKrxdUrLCrfqPzY4VV83s6hvcNwHsif3qLJTXMUvUcvr96VUyFqBE7s.JPG) Look at how the red is fighting for its life. -----
> ![74.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoCj7bHdrQVrrt6szzwtUpxpFB7AcjS7aB5cpoqBjv1XwfBrMZEuqWtfFx43kBdRRHs.JPG) Final looks before they are closed. -----

> ![76.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK7LBQHf86NYeuzH3PbqaSyZhW5b7tpxf5eWrBVGGcAxTx5iwcqdrgDLMnwtdXeuXr.JPG) For sure, this one is going to be a mess the time I am going to use again LOL. But at least they're not that messy anymore. ----
Thank you for visiting, see you on my next blog. :D Please take care of your mental health as well. I hope you are okay today :))
---

title.title: AI Agents Are Abandoning TradFi: Why Stablecoin Rails Will Drive Trillions in Machine Commerce
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPAWgcn4WwpUmHtGzCtnxpPsNV7vChmEutPaVmeLGqpdN/aipay.png 


Let’s cut through the noise and look at the hard evidence. The traditional financial infrastructure built for human-to-human commerce is completely obsolete when faced with the autonomous machine economy. AI agents are no longer just software responding to prompts; they are economic entities that require resources—such as API keys, data subsets, compute power, and cloud resources. To acquire these, they must transact independently without waiting for a human checkout flow or a credit card authorization. Traditional credit card rails or subscription frameworks fail fundamentally because of the cost structures and technical friction inherent in legacy banking.

According to the latest industry report by Keyrock, crypto rails are rapidly solidifying their position as the default financial layer for these autonomous agents. Over the past year alone, AI agents executed over 176 million transactions on-chain, settling more than $73 million. The core driver here is the nature of the transactions: roughly 76% of agent payments are micro-transactions valued under 30 cents. Running a 30-cent transaction through traditional card infrastructure is mathematically non-viable due to high flat fees. Conversely, on-chain stablecoin settlement costs just a tiny fraction of a cent, making micropayments seamless and efficient.

The data reveals an overwhelming dominance of USDC, which currently commands 98.6% of all agentic transaction volume. This highly predictable unit of account gives agents a stable basis for cost calculations while benefiting from deep on-chain liquidity. While this dominance signals Circle's stronghold in the ecosystem, it simultaneously introduces a critical counterparty risk—a structural single point of failure that smart capital should monitor closely.

Major global players like Coinbase, Visa, Stripe, and Google are aggressively building the foundational layer for this machine economy. For instance, Coinbase’s x402 protocol integrates payments directly into web requests (HTTP 402 style), meaning an agent can bypass paywalls, execute a payment in USDC, and retrieve data dynamically without establishing credit lines or manual billing accounts. Keyrock projects that these stablecoin-powered rails will support trillions of dollars in transactional volume by the end of the decade. If you are an investor looking at the next decade of AI commercialization, you don't just buy the AI models; you look at the infrastructure capturing the transaction fees from the autonomous ecosystem.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@pichat/ai-agents-are-abandoning-tradfi-why-stablecoin-rails-will-drive-trillions-in-machine-commerce-kqg)

title.title: Watch Out: You and I May Be Becoming “Useless Humans”
title.body:
![possessed-photography-U3sOwViXhkY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/EowFe4kZGVcyu7ynWrwQGNR32kPDud99ertcpVhGWoVFx2CAe3KPF4TpBawnRYDHPUC.jpg)



Today, as we stand in 2026 looking back, we don't see it coming, or maybe yes. But no matter whats the future looks scary for human labor. Most people are already in poverty, what will look like when AI and automatization be the prominent labor force?

## This time it really is different

Let's be honests, since 2010s **automation is entering a phase fundamentally unlike anything before it**. Not just replacing our muscles, it also beginning to replace our brains.

For example, in the past, technological revolutions made horses obsolete because “there is no work a horse can do that a machine cannot do cheaper and better.” Now, human beings are becoming the new horses. And it is not because people are lazy or have degraded, but because automation (including physical robots and software algorithms) is penetrating, at an unprecedented pace, fields long considered the exclusive domain of humans.

This is the automation of *mental labor*, and its reach goes far beyond blue-collar jobs.

## Why we should genuinely be worried

**1. Automation is the inevitable result of economic logic**

There is a cold formula:

**Better technology + lower cost + faster speed = unstoppable automation.**

Economics has no sentiment. When a robot can work 24/7, demands no salary (or maintenaince is lower than pay humans to work), and never complains, any profit-seeking organization will find it hard to resist. From warehouse transport robots to AIs that can draft text and analyze data, the cost advantage will inevitably lead to their large-scale deployment.

**2. The traditional “safe” jobs are no longer safe**

Don’t assume only assembly-line workers will be affected. Due AI the most vulnerable will be the white collar jobs because **a great deal of white-collar work is also highly repetitive and predictable**, exactly what AI excels at. Legal document review, preliminary medical image screening, basic coding, even some creative writing: AI is already making inroads in all these areas. In the future, an ordinary office clerk may be more likely to be replaced by AI than a plumber who has to handle complex, unpredictable situations on site.

**3. This time, there’s no safety net of “new jobs”**

In the past, agricultural mechanization freed up labor that moved into factories, and manufacturing automation gave rise to the service and information industries. But this time, there is an unsettling question: **When the demand for labor in almost every sector is being eroded by automation, where will the new, abundant jobs for humans come from?** We may be sliding toward a society of *structural* unemployment, not just cyclical, temporary job losses.

## Where is the way out? From “must work” to “can choose”

Faced with this seemingly bleak future, let's review some deep-seated solutions.

**The core idea is to radically change society’s concept of “work”**: to transform work from a survival necessity into a freely chosen way of life.

>It's look like \

will come from the development and abundance made by the capitalism and that the URSS and other dictatoril experiences was not necessary at all.🤣 

Ok joke asside, here are the options:

- **Universal Basic Income (UBI)** is the most frequently mentioned policy tool. It refers to the government unconditionally giving all citizens a regular sum of money, enough to cover basic living costs. This would give people the freedom to pursue creative work, care for family, or retrain.
- **Wealth redistribution**. Some commentators note that such redistribution could be designed “without taking anything directly from the rich,” for example by using monetary policy innovations to fund a UBI. Or maybe taxing AI work and ending corporations loopholes to avoid tax. 
- **Redefining “value”.** In a post-scarcity society, human value is likely to be found increasingly in **interpersonal interaction, emotional empathy, artistic creation, and community service** — areas that machines find hard (or should not be allowed) to fully replace. Handmade objects, live performances, face-to-face care: this “human warmth” will become incredibly precious.
- **A new type of economy.** Made by Humans can become a brand or economic area soon, the same way that organic or vegan products are today.
- **Fewer humans.** Already birth rates are diminishing around the world. It labor automatization can acelerate this trend and whitin decades humanity will find an equilibrium between amount of humans and labor. Someones consider the lower birth rates as a catasthrophy but they are seeing a world before AI and automatization. Mega cities can be a outdated thing in the future when humanity become rural again as more peoole go to live in rural areas or in social plots of land. 

## Conclusion: The choice still lies with humans

The true is that **history doesn’t repeat itself, but it rhymes.** The fate of the horse came about because horses couldn’t actively shape their own future. We, as *Humans*, still have the capacity to make collective choices and to design a society where technology serves people, rather than discarding them.

Now it’s our turn to think: What kind of future do we want to live in?

***
*Imagen from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/robot-tocando-el-piano-U3sOwViXhkY)*

title.body:
Today we have for you guitar picks from 

The Robert Cray Band!

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b77cb99d-d4b3-4314-9c69-193837c8b387.jpg)

---

Here's a look at the front in the back of these guitar picks 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5c58741a-6259-4c83-a2fe-afb80edb7c97.jpg)

---

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a11e5277-57b9-48a9-b4f1-61ce25507ba0.jpg)

---

https://youtu.be/nrEaGYLqjxA?si=UZ9zbPOBvlOKsjrx

---

The Robert Cray Band, fronted by the legendary guitarist and singer-songwriter Robert Cray, has been a driving force in modern blues and soul since its formation in the late 1970s. Blending traditional roots blues with smooth, vintage soul and a distinct pop sensibility, the band carved out a unique sonic identity that helped revitalize the blues genre during the 1980s. With Cray’s stinging, razor-sharp Fender Stratocaster solos and his remarkably expressive, soulful vocals leading the charge, the group bridged the gap between classic Stax record vibes and contemporary rock, earning widespread critical acclaim and a fiercely loyal global following.
The band achieved massive mainstream success with their 1986 breakthrough album, Strong Persuader, which featured hit singles like \

This seminal record earned them a Grammy Award and pushed the blues back into the pop charts and heavy radio rotation. Over the decades, the Robert Cray Band has remained an incredibly active and respected touring powerhouse, releasing a steady stream of celebrated albums and collaborating with music royalty from Eric Clapton to B.B. King. Their enduring legacy is defined by a commitment to tight, elegant musicianship, compelling storytelling, and a smooth yet powerful approach to the blues.

---

Here's what eBay had to say about this guitar pick 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/29b5f5a9-fa0c-4e1a-b5bc-da0f4b1a8913.jpg)

---
---

This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months. --- ---

title.title: Black & White Photography Round 170
title.body: > Assalamu Alaikum. how are you all Today I will share with you a black and white photo. Here I will describe what is in the picture. The black and white picture I showed there is a high school. The name of this school is K M C. It takes 20 minutes to go from our house to school.The school is on the south side of the road. I took the picture standing on the side of the road. As our house is next to the road, I have to cross the road from the north side of the school.Here you can see a girl crossing the road, there is no car on the side. As our school starts at 8 am, there are less cars on the road.And there is never any crowd on this road. Also seen are the two gates of the school. Here one gate is used for boys and another gate is used for girls. There are big buildings around the school and some coconut trees. There are some shops outside the school, we take our necessary food from the shop. The food in the shop is very tasty.The school is very nice and clean. There is a traffic line between the two roads, there is a traffic police in front of the school. Complete security is provided to the students studying in the school. I like our school very much. The study of this school is also much better. Sir madam everyone is very good. We end our post today here. Hope you like it. Thanks for watching till the end 😊 stay well. Take care of yourself. Allah Hafez.

各位小伙伴们好！友哥今天去了一趟永辉超市，看到了已经开始宣传夏天了。欢迎继续阅读了解！

最近周边城市，都是火热的状态，秦皇岛的天气，其实还是很凉爽的。友哥报告，友哥已经脱掉秋裤啦，没有副作用，各位小伙伴们，你们是什么时候脱掉秋裤的呢？

今天秦皇岛下午，是下了雨的，晚上遛弯室外没地方，只好选择室内了。友哥去了永辉超市。

转悠了一圈，来到冷藏区，看到已经开始为夏天宣传了，这款冰激凌，家里领导说好吃，友哥拍照记录，下次天气热，可以买了。

title.body:
![1000280789.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/48K87reVHAWuJkZ1qXNqsEMcc2k2fQJDmjYLXVBSkVFPQnJNBFRB9mv47jgN65AxKF.png)
**_Imagen de mi propiedad editada en canva/Image of my property edited in canva_**
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV76NVvUB2vveMfqDbpX8gfTGbWMSHHAHiWKxsf4PGuWt/_bienvenidos_a_mi_blog_.jpg)
   _Soy de las personas que aman celebrar las ocasiones especiales con una buena comida, bien sea hecha en casa o saliendo a comer en un restaurante lindo, en este caso la ocasión fue el cumpleaños de Dani y su elección fue salir a almorzar, petición a la que no me pude negar._ >_I'm one of those people who love to celebrate special occasions with a good meal, whether it's homemade or out at a nice restaurant. In this case, the occasion was Dani's birthday, and she wanted to go out for lunch, a request I couldn't refuse._ _Nos fuimos al centro comercial **Jockey Plaza** y nos dirigimos a la feria gastronómica, sin embargo, estaba tan lleno todo que no conseguimos en donde comer, pero caminando un poco conseguimos un restaurante llamado **Johnny Rockets** donde habían mesas disponibles y fue allí donde almorzamos._ >_We went to the Jockey Plaza shopping center and headed to the food court. However, it was so crowded that we couldn't find anywhere to eat. But after walking a bit, we found a restaurant called Johnny Rockets with available tables, and that's where we had lunch._
![1000280790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Eorys1BnM351oeeiVgS8HY51gw7vtfN8qA2Vn7Qzegj5r8TLdjqJLEYA7bREggx4bT1.jpg)
_Es un restaurante bastante lindo y pintoresco al estilo clásico de un **American Diner**, con una ambiente que te transporta a una típica cafetería estadounidense de los años 50._ >_It's a rather charming and quaint restaurant in the classic style of an American diner, with an atmosphere that transports you to a typical American cafeteria from the 1950s._ _Entramos y elegimos una mesa y nos llevaron el menú, en su mayoría las opciones eran de hamburguesas y otras platos completos así como porciones de papas fritas y también postres._ >_We went in, chose a table, and they brought us the menu. Most of the options were hamburgers, along with other full meals, portions of fries, and desserts._
![1000280799.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uQtsXrVWBmHCDgDPUURQ49zmqud5s5svCuZX5sBS2MDjAx6qsJnBdpTUZTMU95PMhZ2.jpg)
![1000280800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uFW8RAJEEdr4e6MwGR4noxvbyS31KQnidtD8fc76bqCs8c4H51XgxwwPdDEcULLwqbp.jpg)
![1000280801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uFXjvSQ4jWLvMUQCzVnhcpuUJjJdRjZRru2z2F6p67rswzWBHGAFBQ7P6fTUShKcoiY.jpg)
_Pedimos 3 opciones diferentes del menú para experimentar y para esperar por la comida pedimos un **Milshake** de **Hershey's** que nos llamó mucho la atención al ver la foto en el menú._ >_We ordered three different menu items to experiment, and while we waited for our food, we ordered a Hershey's milkshake, which had caught our eye when we saw the picture on the menu._

body.title: Encuentro de talentos || \
[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
<center> 
### ❣️_Hola amigos de hive!_❣️ 

>### ❣️_Hello friends of hive!_❣️ 
</center>
<hr>
<div class=\

>
Hoy de nuevo en esta maravillosa comunidad de Encuentros de talentos en la iniciativa de la amiga @angelica7, que nos invita a participar en el tema \

. El futuro es incierto porque la vida no acepta promesas ni contratos. Pasamos gran parte del tiempo intentando adivinar el mañana, construyendo castillos sobre días que aún no existen, solo para que el tiempo nos recuerde que no tenemos el control de nada. Pero en esa incertidumbre también hay una hermosa libertad: cuando dejamos de exigirle respuestas al futuro, empezamos a disfrutar de las sorpresas del presente. Lo incierto del mañana es lo que vuelve sagrado y valioso el día de hoy. Desde mi experiencia personal, debo decirles que si creo en que el futuro es un misterio porque nadie sabe lo que nos espera, lo digo porque cuando recibí el diagnóstico de cáncer, perdí toda esperanza y en esos momentos sentí que ya mi vida acabaría, porque esto no formaba parte del futuro que me había propuesto. Desde entonces, entendí desde lo profundo de mi alma que el mañana se construye viviendo el presente, porque la verdad es que no sabemos hasta cuándo estaremos aquí. Por eso disfruto cada momento con mis seres queridos intensamente con mucho cariño y principalmente con alegría, porque hoy estamos mañana no sabemos. Por eso, amigo mío, la vida es ahora. No hay mejor momento que este para entregarnos a lo que nos apasiona y disfrutar de la fortuna de estar vivos y sanos. Dejemos de postergar la felicidad construyendo un mañana que, como siempre hemos dicho, es incierto y suele llenarnos de ansiedad. Aprovechemos al máximo el hoy porque pasa y nunca vuelve; además, cada uno de nosotros tiene el poder de transformarlo, así que no tenemos que desesperarnos tratando de adivinar lo que nos depara el futuro, ya que lo estamos construyendo día a día.
![Encuentro de talentos Música para sanar (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23wMcMCJ3XMYVccdqjamTeUycwqRznNc87ZcaBRcGjw82z34nkyUcmGYf2D15nd8WmJsU.png)

> >Today I’m back in this wonderful “Talent Encounters” community, thanks to the initiative of my friend @angelica7, who invites us to participate in the theme “The Future Is a Mystery.” The future is uncertain because life accepts neither promises nor contracts. We spend much of our time trying to guess what tomorrow will bring, building castles in the air about days that don’t yet exist, only for time to remind us that we have no control over anything. But in that uncertainty there is also a beautiful freedom: when we stop demanding answers from the future, we begin to enjoy the surprises of the present. The uncertainty of tomorrow is what makes today sacred and valuable. >From my personal experience, I must tell you that if I believe the future is a mystery because no one knows what awaits us, I say this because when I received my cancer diagnosis, I lost all hope, and in those moments I felt my life was over, because this was not part of the future I had envisioned for myself. Since then, I have understood from the depths of my soul that tomorrow is built by living in the present, because the truth is that we don’t know how long we’ll be here. That’s why I enjoy every moment with my loved ones intensely, with great affection, and above all with joy, because today we are here, but tomorrow we don’t know. >That is why, my friend, life is now. There is no better time than this to devote ourselves to what we are passionate about and enjoy the good fortune of being alive and healthy. Let’s stop putting off happiness by building a tomorrow that, as we’ve always said, is uncertain and often fills us with anxiety. Let’s make the most of today because it passes and never returns; moreover, each of us has the power to transform it, so we don’t have to despair trying to guess what the future holds, since we’re building it day by day.
![Delicious eggplant, tomato and sesame salad.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/23w2o7zf1FU2b14sk6zEszZwXWXnhQrRr75wLriqff53GBybkr3NwtW3LTAVBWvxeEm7r.jpg) --- ![ggifupdate.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/theresa16/SD9NuiQZ-g-gif-update.gif) --- ###### ***
