body.title: Coffee and Lunch by the Canal at the Wheatcroft's Wharf Café
body.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTG8yxyU56krq79c2fRvGCNNPu5Gvo2Yp86f8cG5fmsa9/InCollage_20260525_132411423.jpg

We visited a café called 'Wheatcroft's Wharf' by the Cromford Canal, Derbyshire, UK, for a relaxed lunch and coffee stop. We sat inside right next to the canal.  We'd tried various cafés, but all were shut, so this was our last hope.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoHA3C7SGbTc2VKXqo7HK8zz4jn8kmXpujf6QdzmEfbQ/file_00000000b11c71f4a13852460a706c56.jpeg

The old warehouse and wharf area have been carefully restored and are now looked after by the 'Arkwright Society'. The second old warehouse, built in 1824 and once used for storing goods, has also been restored and is now the café. The building has a lot of character and feels full of history. It’s well kept and fits nicely with the canal. I'm glad they didn't just leave it to deteriorate.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmV3EiXiXWwfNT6o51PoASG9q5caE8N2ARJKsWZbCJ8aSa/Messenger_creation_43FD9FF9-284A-4809-8F5C-E52453512B74.jpeg

To drink, we ordered two cappuccinos, one made with oat milk and one decaffeinated. Both were good and arrived quickly.  As it was mid morning on a Monday, we were the only people in the café. It was probably a good job really, as it gets quite busy at times, so you can be waiting a lot longer. I haven't got a lot of patience when I'm waiting for food. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmSPV1KwQEqqJrSYaNx3ftUq3PCWWxotYraHjuhVRukCgz/20260518_113516.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmZHkMrpLJBkZfWYYiKFpDVg6RPJZVBpEpFX2XWCv1fVXE/Messenger_creation_F6B4EDEE-33C2-413B-8666-8D73A76C60EB~3.jpeg

For food, we had a veggie sausage cob and an Eggs Benedict with ham. The veggie sausage cob was very basic but filled a gap, and the Eggs Benedict was nicely cooked. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmd8hsXvKiyzjTh9guP5ApLRQtU7p8UVq1TjmPToTBg8CG/20260518_113247.jpg

The café had outdoor seating as well but it was too hot to sit outside.  

https://images.hive.blog/DQmQwdR9rSyef18EZJVWJPCD6XZvZmTXz5CVESuxgWEZpRW/20260518_112515.jpg

It’s a nice place to stop if you’re walking along the canal, especially with the views. There are other things to do as well, such as birdwatching, canoeing, or hiring a restored narrow boat throughout the year, that is run by the 'Friends of Cromford Canal'. 
 
https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

body.title: 《2049：未来10000天的可能》书中的镜像世界为什么不叫元宇宙
body.body:
![kk.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1779713956025-oriww.jpg)

《2049：未来10000天的可能》是KK对AI等未来世界的预想，就迫不及待地买来读哦。只是翻完后，倒没什么太大感触，远不及他的科技三部曲的深度。里面的很多概念其实现在都在流行，好像也没什么超前的想法吧。特别是里面的“镜像世界”这个说法，远不如“元宇宙”来得科技性感 。


## 镜像世界
镜像世界是凯文·凯利提出的**下一代互联网**概念，其核心特征是：
1. **现实世界与虚拟世界的叠加**：通过智能眼镜等设备，在真实物理世界之上叠加一个数字孪生的虚拟世界，实现\
的无缝融合 \n2. **以物理空间为锚点**：虚拟内容不是独立存在的，而是\
在真实世界的物体和空间上。例如看向冰箱时，眼镜实时显示食材保质期；走在街头，导航指引线直接浮现在视野中 \n3. **空间智能**：虚拟世界遵循现实物理定律——虚拟球会弹跳、液体会流动、有前后遮挡关系。无人车Waymo行驶时在\

中构建的虚拟表征，就是镜像世界的一种形态 
4. **人机交互革命**：告别键盘、鼠标和触摸屏，未来通过语言、手势甚至眼神与机器交互 


## 与元宇宙的区别
| 维度 | 镜像世界 (Mirror World) | 元宇宙 (Metaverse) |
|------|------------------------|-------------------|
| **空间关系** | 虚拟叠加于**现实之上**，物理空间是核心 | 人进入**独立的虚拟空间**，脱离物理环境 |
| **存在方式** | 用户仍以真实身体存在于真实世界，看到虚拟信息叠加 | 用户通过**数字化身（Avatar）**存在于虚拟世界 |
| **核心体验** | \

|
| **技术基础** | 以AR（增强现实）为主，强调**混合现实** | 以VR（虚拟现实）为主，强调**沉浸式虚拟** |
| **镜像关系** | 虚拟世界镜像现实，**双向映射**——现实变化反映到虚拟，虚拟操作影响现实 | 虚拟世界可以独立于现实存在，未必与现实一一对应 |

用凯文·凯利自己的话说：元宇宙像电影《头号玩家》那样，你可以进入一个逼真的三维空间；但镜像世界更重要的是**\
**——它不是让你离开现实进入虚拟，而是让你**留在现实中，但看到更多、知道更多、做到更多**。这正是他拒绝使用\
这个已被泛化和商业化的词汇，而坚持使用\
的根本原因。不过，这对于未来科技的幻想却缺乏点冲击力啰。

body.title: It Is Easier to Build a Child Than to Fix a Broken Adult
body.body:
> *Childhood is the learning phase, the stage where children are taught right from wrong, where they learn what is good and bad, and the consequences of their actions.*
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRW3amMWfcYwAaRtCxUNmwiau2Z8ETVkcJxKkHZmzXGiF/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/child-boy-smile-father-dad-beach-5489290/) *Some parents give their children everything except discipline, often because of what they themselves went through while growing up.* *Some grew up in poverty without three square meals a day, while some grew up with very strict parents and felt their childhood wasn’t enjoyable because of it. So they promise themselves that their own children will never go through the same thing.* *But sometimes they only remember the strictness and discipline, forgetting the result of it. They became responsible adults who could distinguish right from wrong and knew the consequences of their actions, yet that is the same thing they now want to take away from their children.* *If you don’t let your children understand the consequences of their actions, if you make them see the world as only a good place without preparing them for the hard parts of life, they may grow into adults who cannot take care of themselves without their parents. And the blame will fall on you.* *When it comes to physical discipline, I don’t believe it is as bad as some people paint it to be, but there must always be limits. It should never become a habit whenever a child makes the slightest mistake. A child can eventually grow beyond that pain, and the cane or whatever is used for punishment will no longer scare them.* *I had a childhood friend whose father was an extreme disciplinarian. His children feared him because of how physically abusive he was.* *There was nothing he wouldn’t use to punish them: a cane, a horsewhip, iron, fists… everything. And this isn’t hearsay; I saw it myself many times. He didn’t even hide it. He beat them both inside and outside their house.* *That same childhood friend later became a hooligan in school. His father’s beatings made him fearless in the worst way possible. I still wonder where he is today because the last time I saw him was about 17 or 18 years ago.* *That is a clear example of how extreme physical discipline can damage a child. It can push them to go rogue at some point. But at the same time, I don’t believe that means physical discipline should be completely ruled out.* *I can count how many times my dad beat me*.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ6HTFL87Pzya7CsyNsYiNLqJb6rsMFRiR6sss33hMxRh/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/father-son-walking-child-boy-2770301/) *The first time was when I was very little. I was crying unnecessarily, and he used a wire to scare me and gave me just one lash. That alone kept me quiet.* *The second time was during my teenage years. He was angry with my mum and wrongly passed the aggression onto me with a very hot slap that left my ears ringing and my eyes red.* *The third time was when I went to play football and came back home very late while it was raining heavily. He had warned me not to go out that day, but I disobeyed him. When I came back, he dealt with me seriously.* *Even though it only happened those few times, I still remember each one vividly because they were rare. If it had happened constantly, I probably wouldn’t even remember most of them. My father loved his children and never abused us with extreme physical discipline*. *Now that I am a father, when it comes to raising children, my eyes will do the talking, my silence will give the warnings, and sometimes I may go physical depending on the offence, but I will never let discipline become a nightmare for my son.* *A little slap on the butt can sometimes be enough correction, but physical abuse will never be a thing in my family. I will make sure we have understanding, love, and discipline together*.

body.title: Solidarity, a bridge to build bonds of support and friendship (Eng - Esp)
body.body:
>

**<center>INGLÉS</center>**



Hello friend of the @holos-lotus community, it's a pleasure to greet you and contribute to the important topic addressed by our friend @damarysvibra [Who said solidarity is lost?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost). When we talk about solidarity, we generally refer to the support we receive in adverse situations and those where, due to our various commitments, a helping hand would be very welcome. Solidarity arises from empathy and the will to help those in vulnerable situations, suffering, pain, and more. This reminds me of my time studying at university, where I had the opportunity to share a residence with several girls, all of whom came from different states across the country.

I think the main point for connecting and establishing bonds of support was coming from different homes and arriving in a city alone without our families and in a place none of us knew. There's a very true saying that I think fits this idea perfectly: \

In the residence, we applied this completely, because having our parents or relatives nearby who could help us in a given situation, we came together, creating a support network that arose without any planning and grew stronger every day. We were all looking out for each other, especially during menstruation. Many girls suffered from chronic pain and had to go to the clinic for a very common painkiller, Novalcina. In fact, several doctors and nurses knew us because we went several times a month for the same reason: menstrual pain. Also, with the night class schedules, we were attentive to the girls' arrival, and we even planned group meals and movies on the weekends.

>

**<center>ESPAÑOL</center>**




Hola amigo de la comunidad @holos-lotus, es un placer saludarles y hacer mi aporte al importante tema abordado por la amiga @damarysvibra [¿Quién dijo que la solidaridad se ha perdido?||Who said solidarity is lost?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost) cuando hablamos de solidaridad por lo general se hace  referencia  al apoyo que recibimos en esas situaciones adversas y en aquellas donde por las diversas ocupaciones una mano amiga nos vendría muy bien;  la solidaridad  surge de la empatía y la voluntad de ayudar a aquellos situaciones vulnerables, de sufrimiento, dolor  y más, lo cual me recuerda mi época de estudio en la universidad, donde tuve la oportunidad de  compartir residencia con varias chicas,  todas teníamos en común que proveníamos de diferentes estados del país.

 Creo que el principal punto para conectar y establecer lazos de apoyo fue  el venir de diferentes hogares y llegar a una ciudad sola sin   nuestra familia y en un lugar que  ninguna conocíamos, hay una frase muy cierta y creo que va muy bien con este planteamiento: \

, en la residencia lo aplicamos al cien, pues al tener cerca a nuestros padres o familiares que pudiesen auxiliarnos en una determinada situación, nos unimos creando una red de apoyo que surgió sin ninguna planificación y cada día se fue fortaleciendo, todas estabámos pendientes de las otras especialmente en los días de menstruación, muchas chicas sufrían de dolores crónicos y debíamos ir al ambulatorio por un análgesico muy común La Novalcina, de hecho varios doctores y enfermeras nos conocían porque al mes asistiamos varias veces por la misma causa, dolores menstruales, también con los horarios de clase nocturnos estábamos atentas con la llegada de las chicas, incluso planificabámos comidas en grupo y películas los fines de semana. ![Anfiteatro (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/Eq373T3N99o9xudKrAPi9rEhJXxQRTbJuJ7RKrg7MKUMnU6yREs3KAHoC9BMisyhh6o.jpeg)

> Our time living in the residence felt more like siblings and family than strangers. Of course, at first there was a bit of mistrust, shyness, insecurity, and a lot of sadness because we missed our families. I often fell asleep crying because I wanted to go home. These are the kinds of experiences that teach us to grow, mature, and see the kind and compassionate side of people. During my time in the city, where I had the opportunity to study, I met wonderful people who were supportive in many different situations. On the day I had to sign my graduation certificate, the girls offered me their full support. They helped me with my hair, my outfit, and my nails. At that time, I was working; I had just started and didn't have time to go to the hairdresser. Besides, it wasn't practical to ask for time off to go to the hairdresser one day and then attend the signing ceremony the next. Thanks to these girls, they got to work late that night after I got home from work, and very early the next morning I went to sign the book. Their support was so kind, and I am truly grateful.

> Nuestra convivencia en la residencia parecía más de hermanos y familia que chicas desconocidas, claro al principio había un poco de desconfianza, timidez, inseguridad y mucha tristeza porque extrañábamos a nuestros familiares, yo en muchas ocasiones me quedaba dormida llorando porque quería volver a casa; estas son las experiencias que nos enseñan a crecer, madurar y ver el lado amable y solidario de las personas. Durante mi estancia en la ciudad, donde tuve la oportunidad de estudiar, pude conocer personas maravillosas que fueron solidarias en diferentes situaciones, el día que me tocaba firmar el acta de graduación las chicas me brindaron su apoyo en todo, me ayudaron con el peinado, el vestuario y las uñas, para esa fecha estaba trabajando, recién había comenzado y no tenía tiempo para ir a la peluquería, además no era prudente pedir permiso, para un día de peluquería y al otro asisir a la firma del libro; gracias a estas chica en horas de la noche, luego que llegué del trabajo se pusieron manos a la obra y muy temprano me dirigí a firmar el libro, fue muy bonito el apoyo que me brindaron y lo agradezco de corazón. ![mixta (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xen7Q5vJMXveVTvDnRpjCkPCP8Sr5xcTmYePZBtj2mzu5sfWXYjZTaQ4WeasRPUYPSg.jpeg)

Introduction


Hey, hey! This is @gabrielatravels, and I am pleased to bring you a brand new edition of #TravelDigest! ❤️ Today's post is going to take you on a virtual tour with stops on an ice kayaking adventure in Alaska, some hidden trails in Indonesia, and a museum in Italy. We also have the honourable mentions list, where you can get a few more travel postcards from Colombia, Argentina, Venezuela, and Philippines, so don't forget to check these posts too! 😊


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Ice Kayaking at Meares Glacier, Alaska by @dtam

Once we finally had enough of working hard in the ice, we found a pocket of clear water, and just sat and soaked in the amazing views. Its times like this that it is so hard to believe that we have this place all to ourselves. That is Alaska, still true wilderness to be explored. That can be hard to find these days. When we made it back to the boat, it was hot beverages for all, and a change into bathing suits.... for the polar plunge was next!

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Hidden Trails & Shallot Harvesting Adventure in Mount Wilis by @macchiata

Somewhere along the winding path, The son of the family started telling me that there was a famous coffee plantation and factory in the area. He pointed to the remnants of the factory as well as some abandoned villa all around these foothills of Mt. Wilis. One thing that came out of my mouth was \

, considering it was ages ago and even today this place is still considered remote.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Visit to the Vidotto museum - Italy by @davideownzall

The largest part of the museum is the uniforms section, it is really well done, there are uniforms from various periods and nations, from WW1 up to more recent times, some complete with equipment. Some were real armored suits and it makes you think about how heavy all that stuff must have been to wear, especially in certain conditions; or the uniforms of the Italian soldiers in Russia during the Second World War, although winter uniforms they were clearly unsuitable for a Russian winter.

body.title: Why Buying EASY Pushes the Price Up — And Keeps It There
body.body:
To understand this, you need to know one simple fact: **all 21 million EASY tokens already exist inside a liquidity pool on Alcor Exchange, paired with a stablecoin (like USDC or USDT).** There was no presale, no team allocation, and no tokens sitting in anyone's private wallet waiting to be sold. Every single EASY token is inside that pool from day one.

### The Pool Works Like a Seesaw

A liquidity pool on Alcor uses a mathematical formula called the **AMM (Automated Market Maker)**. The rule is simple:

> **EASY tokens in the pool × stablecoins in the pool = a constant number (k)**

Think of it like a seesaw. On one side you have EASY tokens, on the other side you have stablecoins. The two sides must always balance to the same total weight.

### What Happens When Someone Buys EASY

When a buyer sends stablecoins into the pool to get EASY tokens, two things happen simultaneously:

1.  **Stablecoins go IN** — the stablecoin side of the pool gets heavier.
    
2.  **EASY tokens come OUT** — the EASY side of the pool gets lighter.
    

Because the formula requires the product of both sides to stay constant, removing EASY from the pool automatically makes each remaining EASY token worth **more stablecoins**. In other words, **the price goes up.**

### Why the Price Cannot Come Back Down on Its Own

Here is the key insight: **there are no EASY tokens outside the pool that could be sold back into it.** No early investor, no team member, and no insider holds a private stash of EASY waiting to dump on the market. The only EASY tokens that exist are the ones inside the pool.

The only way the price goes down is if someone who already bought EASY decides to sell it back into the pool. But every time they do, they receive fewer stablecoins than the current price — because selling pushes the price in the opposite direction.

### The Reflection Tax Makes It Even Stronger

Every time EASY is transferred or traded, a **2% tax** is collected and redistributed to all holders. This means:

*   Buyers who hold EASY accumulate more EASY over time.
    
*   More EASY in their wallet means they earn even more from future transactions.
    
*   This creates a natural incentive to **hold rather than sell**, which reduces selling pressure and supports the price.
    

### A Simple Summary

<table style=\

>

No one outside the pool holds EASY to dump

>

Price is structurally supported

The more people buy EASY and hold it, the fewer tokens remain in the pool, and the higher the price climbs — automatically, by math, with no manipulation possible.

body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> The phrase **‘designed to overeat’** was originally coined by experts in nutrition and neurobiology (such as Dr David Kessler) to describe how the food industry designs ultra-processed products with precise levels of salt, sugar and fat to override our feeling of fullness. However, I will apply this concept to slot machines, as it makes for a perfect metaphor: both industries use a “reward design” to hack the brain’s dopamine.
# ***
The bulimia of chance
*** The neon light of ‘La Fortuna’ flickers over my now-cold coffee. Here, inside this carpeted room that smells of confinement, time stands still; it dissolves amidst the metallic clinking and the frantic spinning of the digital fruits on the screen. My fingers, slightly yellowed by tobacco, know the worn texture of the max bet button by heart. I’m not after the jackpot; I’m after the trance, that electric void where the outside world and its debts cease to hurt.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wgPfXQ65M2bjjnE5VheqJfmVDBrMEaTgg4VWdQhLophibwHe2bAtQ6GwLnhyz5FwbiP.png) [](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
I once read that ultra-processed foods are **‘designed to make us overeat’**, scientifically engineered to override our sense of fullness and force us to devour food without actually being hungry. Looking at that coin-slotting machine, I realise that the engineering of desire is exactly the same. It’s no coincidence; it’s a ruthless algorithm designed so that our brains never utter the word ‘enough’. The machine doesn’t expect me to win; it expects me to overfeed on adrenaline and false hope until I’m exhausted. Every time the bells ring after a narrow loss — the famous ‘I almost won’ — my reward system lights up like a fairground. It’s a feast of cheap dopamine. I sit in front of this box of lights and consume spins like someone gobbling down empty calories in the solitude of a dark kitchen. The hunger persists, but my pocket and my soul are stuffed with nothing. I step out onto the street with the bitter taste of the artificial, knowing I was the perfect prey for a design that knows no bounds. My willpower was the main course. *** ***

Sin embargo, aplicaré este concepto a las máquinas tragamonedas, ya que será una metáfora perfecta, pues, ambas industrias utilizan un \

para hackear la dopamina del cerebro.
# ***
La bulimia del azar
*** La luz de neón de \

parpadea sobre mi café ya frío. Aquí, dentro de este salón alfombrado que huele a encierro, el tiempo no corre; se diluye entre el tintineo metálico y el girar frenético de las frutas digitales en la pantalla. Mis dedos, algo amarillentos por el tabaco, conocen de memoria el relieve desgastado del botón de apuesta máxima. No busco el premio mayor, busco el trance, ese vacío eléctrico donde el mundo exterior y sus deudas dejan de doler.

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wgPfXQ65M2bjjnE5VheqJfmVDBrMEaTgg4VWdQhLophibwHe2bAtQ6GwLnhyz5FwbiP.png)
<sup>[](https://chat.qwen.ai/)</sup>
</center>

Leí una vez que los alimentos ultraprocesados están **\

**, fabricados científicamente para anular la saciedad y obligarnos a devorar sin hambre real. Al mirar esa máquina traga níquel, comprendo que la ingeniería del deseo es exactamente la misma. No es azar, es un algoritmo despiadado diseñado para que nuestro cerebro nunca pronuncie la palabra «basta». La máquina no espera que yo gane; espera que me sobrealimente de adrenalina y falsa esperanza hasta quedar exhausto. Cada vez que las campanas suenan ante una pérdida por poco margen —el famoso «casi gano»—, mi sistema de recompensa se enciende como una feria. Es un festín de dopamina barata. Me siento frente a esta caja de luces y consumo giros como quien engulle calorías vacías en la soledad de una cocina a oscuras. El hambre persiste, pero el bolsillo y el alma están empachados de nada. Salgo a la calle con el sabor amargo de lo artificial, sabiendo que fui la presa perfecta de un diseño que no conoce límites. Mi voluntad fue el plato principal.

Hola, amigos de Hive Hoy les quiero compartir un lindo tema titulado \

, una hermosa pieza de la autoría del compositor Ramón Castillo que interpreto en el tono de Re Mayor. En esta ocasión, tengo el gran honor y el gusto de contar con un acompañamiento de lujo: el Maestro Ramón nos acompaña magistralmente en la ejecución del cuatro, mientras que mi querido tío, Víctor Morales, le pone todo el sentimiento y el sabor tradicional a la música con las notas de la bandola. Es una verdadera alegría poder unir este talento familiar y musical para dar vida a una melodía que resalta nuestras raíces y la esencia del llano. Como siempre, aprovecho este espacio para enviarle un saludo muy especial, cargado de cariño y buena energía, a toda la maravillosa comunidad de @music, agradeciendo desde el fondo de mi corazón el constante apoyo que le brindan a los creadores de contenido y a la música folclórica. Espero que disfruten muchísimo de esta presentación que preparamos con tanto esmero, respeto y dedicación para todos ustedes. Sin más que agregar, les mando un fuerte abrazo, les deseo el mayor de los éxitos en sus proyectos y recuerden que por aquí siempre les manda un saludo muy afectuoso su gran amiga de siempre, @Yoxibeth. Que viva la música y que disfruten el tema.

[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779580887518-f3f1f0f2fb428218.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidosunamusic/e281ea8a)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidosunamusic/e281ea8a)


---

Un gran clásico que resuena en la gran voz de Ella Fitzgerald. Un estándar del jazz que ha trascendido generaciones y fronteras musicales.
>A great classic that resonates in the magnificent voice of Ella Fitzgerald. A jazz standard that has transcended generations and musical borders.

\
nos cuenta la historia de cómo la vida de un niño estadounidense común es realmente fantástica mientras pesca con sus padres en días tranquilos y soleados.\n>\

tells the story of how the life of an ordinary American child is truly fantastic while fishing with their parents on quiet, sunny days.

La canción nos presenta una escena de paz doméstica, de calidez familiar, de esas pequeñas alegrías simples que construyen los recuerdos más hermosos de la infancia.
>The song presents us with a scene of domestic peace, of family warmth, of those small, simple joys that build the most beautiful childhood memories.

Sin embargo, hay algo particularmente especial en esta pieza: una especie de melancolía en la melodía que por alguna razón nos resulta fantásticamente hipnotizante.
>However, there is something particularly special about this piece: a kind of melancholy in the melody that, for some reason, we find fantastically hypnotic.

Esa dualidad entre la letra alegre y la melodía nostálgica crea una tensión emocional única que ha cautivado a oyentes durante casi un siglo.
>That duality between the cheerful lyrics and the nostalgic melody creates a unique emotional tension that has captivated listeners for nearly a century.

La canción nos deja ver esa belleza agridulce que tienen los momentos perfectos cuando sabemos, en el fondo, que son temporales y preciosos precisamente por eso.
>The song allows us to see that bittersweet beauty that perfect moments have when we know, deep down, that they are temporary and precious precisely for that reason.

\
ha sido interpretada por innumerables artistas a lo largo de la historia, desde Billie Holiday hasta Janis Joplin, pasando por Miles Davis y Louis Armstrong.\n>\

has been performed by countless artists throughout history, from Billie Holiday to Janis Joplin, including Miles Davis and Louis Armstrong.

Por supuesto, junto con mi banda, me vi tentado a hacer mi propia versión de este clásico inmortal, aportando nuestro estilo personal sin perder la esencia original.
>Of course, together with my band, I was tempted to make my own version of this immortal classic, adding our personal style without losing the original essence.

Cada músico que interpreta \
encuentra algo nuevo que decir dentro de su estructura aparentemente simple, y nosotros también quisimos aportar nuestra voz.\n>Every musician who performs \

finds something new to say within its seemingly simple structure, and we also wanted to contribute our voice.

Espero que disfruten esta versión que les comparto, hecha con el respeto y la admiración que este estándar del jazz merece.
>I hope you enjoy this version I share with you, made with the respect and admiration that this jazz standard deserves.

¡No olviden comentar, rebloguear y votar si \
también los transporta a esos días de infancia que viven para siempre en el rincón más cálido de la memoria!\n>Don't forget to comment, reblog and vote if \

also transports you to those childhood days that live forever in the warmest corner of memory!

body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779562892941-48969117e8f99bbd.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=alexbit/5b7c4f35) ▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=alexbit/5b7c4f35) ---

The Paths of Terror: Searching for a way out in the supply sector / Black Mesa (Eng/Esp)

> Hey everyone at Hive Gaming, AlexBit here with a new post for the community. This time, we continue our journey through Black Mesa, where we'll be crossing another extremely dangerous area of ​​this laboratory. If you thought the military had made it tough for us, think again, because what's coming next will force us to use our wits, our reflexes, and withstand radiation levels capable of making anyone glow in the dark. Join me on this odyssey!

>

After going through absolute hell on the surface thanks to those soldiers, I managed to slip away and hide again deep within the facility. With this action, I naively thought the danger was over and that walking through the underground corridors would give me some respite. How wrong I was.

As I made my way through rubble and past flickering emergency lights, I came across a surviving scientist who could barely keep his cool. His voice trembling, he revealed a vital piece of information: there was another way out of this sector, right through the old rails used for transporting heavy supplies. Without hesitation, I head towards that place hoping to find a quick escape route.

<div class=\

> I continue to advance cautiously, avoiding the chaos, until I finally reach a loading platform where a motorized railcar is parked. It seems like the perfect solution to get out of this place at top speed. I climb in, start the engine, and take off, finally feeling a moment of control. However, the joy is short-lived. Halfway through the journey, the tracks abruptly end in front of a gigantic pit filled with radioactive waste. A green, glistening, and lethal sludge floods the track, completely blocking my path and forcing me to abandon the vehicle before I'm melted.

> The danger of contamination is imminent, but give up It's not an option. Desperately searching for an alternative at ground level, I luckily spot a huge hole in a broken pipe. I slide down it, praying it doesn't lead to a dead end. Emerging on the other side, I discover the next area is an even greater nightmare: the ground is flooded with radioactive waste, and to make matters worse, the place is infested with hostile creatures that seem to thrive amidst the toxicity. Dodging corrosive pools and blasting my way through the mutants, I miraculously survive.

> After leaving the chemical danger behind, I manage to enter a section of the The laboratories are quite peculiar and massive. The structure is vertical, composed of circular metal platforms surrounding a central pit. As I peer over the edge, my breath catches in my throat: in the middle of the facility rises a strange and gigantic worm-like creature with claws.

> Three colossal tentacles emerge from the abyss, blind but extremely sensitiveThey are vulnerable to the slightest noise. Every time I make a false step, their claws strike the metal with brutal force, tearing everything apart. I'm trapped in their territory; silence is my only weapon, and I know that a single mistake will mean being ripped to pieces by this monster from outer space. How will I manage to overcome this new horror? We'll find out in the next post, my friends!

>

✨Español✨

Las Vías del Terror: Buscando una salida en el sector de suministros / Black Mesa (Eng/Esp)

> Muy buenas mi gente bella de Hive Gaming, aquí AlexBit en una nueva publicación para la comunidad. En esta ocasión continuamos con nuestra travesía en Black Mesa, donde estaremos cruzando por otra zona extremadamente peligrosa de este laboratorio. Si pensaban que los militares nos lo habían puesto difícil, prepárense, porque lo que viene a continuación nos obligará a usar el ingenio, los reflejos y a soportar niveles de radiación capaces de hacer brillar a cualquiera en la oscuridad. ¡Acompáñenme en esta odisea!

>

Después de pasar por un auténtico infierno en la superficie por culpa de esos militares, logro escabullirme y esconderme nuevamente en las profundidades de las instalaciones. Con esta acción, pensé ingenuamente que el peligro había terminado y que caminar por los pasillos subterráneos me daría un respiro. Qué equivocado estaba.

Mientras avanzaba entre escombros y luces de emergencia parpadeantes, me topo con un científico superviviente que apenas puede mantener la calma. Con la voz temblorosa, me revela un dato vital: hay otra forma de salir de este sector, justo a través de los viejos raíles que se utilizan para el transporte de suministros pesados. Sin dudarlo dos veces, me dirijo hacia ese lugar con la esperanza de encontrar una vía de escape rápida.    

<div class=\

> Sigo avanzando con cautela, sorteando el caos, hasta que finalmente llego a una plataforma de carga donde descansa una vagoneta motorizada. Parece la solución perfecta para salir de este lugar a toda velocidad. Me subo, enciendo el motor y arranco, sintiendo por fin un momento de control. Sin embargo, la alegría dura poco. A mitad del recorrido, las vías se cortan abruptamente frente a un gigantesco pozo lleno de residuos radiactivos. Un lodo verde, brillante y letal inunda el camino, bloqueando por completo mi paso y obligándome a abandonar el vehículo antes de terminar derretido.

> El peligro de contaminación es inminente, pero rendirse no es una opción. Buscando desesperadamente una alternativa a nivel de suelo, logro divisar por suerte un enorme agujero en una tubería rota. Me deslizo por ella rezando para que no me lleve a un callejón sin salida. Al salir por el otro extremo, descubro que la siguiente zona es una pesadilla aún mayor: el suelo está anegado de desechos radiactivos y, por si fuera poco, el lugar está infestado de criaturas hostiles que parecen sentirse como en casa en medio de la toxicidad. Sorteando los charcos corrosivos y abriéndome paso a tiros contra los mutantes, logro sobrevivir de milagro.

> Tras dejar atrás el peligro químico, logro entrar a una sección de los laboratorios bastante peculiar y masiva. La estructura es vertical, compuesta por plataformas metálicas circulares que rodean un foso central. Al asomarme al borde, se me corta la respiración: en medio de las instalaciones se alza una extraña y gigantesca criatura con forma de gusano con garras.

> Tres tentáculos colosales emergen del abismo, ciegos pero extremadamente sensibles al menor ruido. Cada vez que doy un paso en falso, sus garras golpean el metal con una fuerza brutal, destrozando el entorno. Estoy atrapado en su territorio, el silencio es mi única arma y sé que un solo error significará ser despedazado por este monstruo del espacio exterior. ¿Cómo lograré superar este nuevo horror? ¡Lo descubriremos en la próxima publicación, mi gente!

>

body.title: 📸 PhotoFeed Contest - Landscape Photography #171 : Hiking a live volcano
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTMKtTXeVYFvKoSBBPcoaFqSfiWKG6WMiw3N8sXTPi2yL/dsc_01.jpg)
The volcanic landscape on the photo, is one of the most active volcanoes in the world. The name is Piton de la Fournaise and you will find it on the island of La Reunion in the Indian Ocean. This small island is a paradise for hikers. The island is all about mountains. This volcano was added to the UNESCO List of national treasures in 2010. The hike if you have to walk all the way to the main crater, it will be a 10 kilometer walk to and from the top. It happens quite often that the top is covered in clouds or fog ( as on the photo). The white paint you see is the marking of the trail. Even if fog appears, you will still be able to see the paint and you won't get lost on your way back. The landsscape is rocky and quite challenging, but the landscape is truely amazing. This photo is my entry to @photofeed contest https://ecency.com/@photofeed/photofeed-contest-landscape-photography-round-171


Please do follow if you want to keep up with my next photo shoot. Any upvotes or reblogs are hugely appreciated!

body.title: The after effect
body.body:
**This is my entry to the Hive Learners weekly contest.**

This PTSD is not an easy one; we might have seen the seen and unseen, and of a truth, the effect of it keeps ringing like a bell in one way or the other, however in which we might find it. Personally, this PTSD might come in various ways in people's lives and it tends to flash back sometimes, but in all, we keep hoping for the best. It might not have happened to my very self so personally, but that does not mean that we do not see it in people who might be around us in one way or the other in life.

Dako sleeps in fear; just a footstep and he is awake and grumbling in great fear. You dare not enter his room for anything. When it comes to that area, he is more than harsh and won't tolerate it from people. What exactly might be the problem? He has been living like that and still continues, but probably a change is needed around him, at least so things would be normal, as he said that his life is a situation. A total situation at large, in which no one exactly would be happy and rejoice over in one way or the other in life. He would lock the doors over and over again and still look as if someone was around in great fear.

This continued, but what exactly was the issue? When he was little, as he told, his father locked him up in a wardrobe, and peeping, he could see how his father was chased inside the house with a gun, and the rest was history to him. This really made an imprint on him and made him to be that way, so that each time he just feels that those set of people are still looking for him and trying to chase him like they did, and of a truth, it has not really been easy for him at all.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSmpFVeQKzW6kCmJkD59agoZ7kosP1VRvGypQ3kxXb9Ds/ai_generated.webp)

One thing in life is that there might be problems, but still, solutions would also come in one way or the other in order to help solve those issues people might be going through.

Another thing is this: LOVE. Love is really an amazing thing and helps in various ways to supersede some things in life. He was able to overcome it by meeting someone he loves, and the nightmares disappeared. Another thing is that we should try always in life to understand that it happened and must not repeat itself in our time. That was an occurrence to others, or still probably we ourselves, but still yet, it does not mean that it must still repeat itself in us all. All we have to do is to focus greatly on the brighter side of life and never relent in whatever in which we are doing while hoping for the best in life by God's grace and mercy.

**We keep hoping for the best.**
**Thanks for visiting my blog.**
**Positivity is our watchword.**

> **English** ###
**Moving Around the City**
Warm greetings to all my fellow Black and White community members. Admiring the city through a window is captivating, especially when you're on the move. A multitude of images unfold before you, compelling you to capture them instantly; you don't want to miss the everyday life of the streets and the buildings that rise with their striking architecture, the defining features of a city like ours. >***Español*** >#####
**Desplazándome Por La Ciudad**
>Mis saludos cordiales, amigos amantes de la comunidad Black And White. Admirar la ciudad a través de una ventana es fascinante, más cuando vas en movimiento. Se te despliega una cantidad de imágenes que quieres capturar a la velocidad del rayo; no quieres dejar escapar la cotidianidad de las calles y los edificios que se levantan con llamativas arquitecturas, que son las estructuras principales en una ciudad como la nuestra. ![IMG_20260518_084121~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eqb29EzxR5VcMoLrAgNhP4DZmoxaEhV6wACZup6BnexdKDYvHq1t3CScpE9QJ1Z6Fy6.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084126~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zbRusDiyoYzcVDgvec58fyjYWN8a7B9S8mEoGUnoT44uoQXpjwYh9JPGnoN7zkN7na5.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084248~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/244KSyyZRJFGR16VuMR2hpzLMriwFqpKRqV3j6xncGGfPrZu53PaA5uiL8xGp9Six9aEJ.jpg) I find it fascinating because you see it differently, from another perspective, and the best part is that you can photograph the entire surroundings from close range. You can capture the urban landscape where nature blends in, giving the atmosphere a fresh feel; the wide avenues, where for the first time we are the protagonists. We are part of it, not just crossing it, and you feel good when you accomplish that feat. Along the way, you find buildings whose facades evoke memories of their creators and the history of their surroundings. You discover the beauty hidden behind each architectural structure. >Me resulta fascinante porque lo ves diferente desde otra perspectiva, y lo mejor es que puedes fotografiar todo el entorno desde poca distancia; puedes captar la parte urbana donde se integra la naturaleza, dándole al ambiente frescura; la amplitud de las avenidas, donde por primera vez somos los protagonistas. Vamos dentro de ella, no estamos cruzándola y te sientes bien cuando logras la hazaña. En la vía encuentras esos edificios que, cuando ves sus fachadas, te llegan a la memoria sus creadores y la historia de su entorno. Descubres la belleza que se encuentra detrás de cada arquitectura. ![IMG_20260518_084255~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23r1nzGWGreSuUxkcjGTdsMXXwdcQNticCfgMm6rGTVes8kLM1RwbCL1ZmwWkF1BmSMGL.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084359~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EqDkbYmTwsQyqR2UVNzBXY2k4anPqXgHhEYPukqfZmn6bfqtvT5BpyYr2ZKJKctqyuo.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084437~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EqSWQrF5Hj8rZwQ2zggjQS3fSFfsNhpUS9yVjtxHPAJwstGDQ4mYu4Ww2Q4dKrvRJX7.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084313~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/243M7K2ecSB7RrLVEgVrNn79q1xc4XJncSMmm6XMqiHrqReDqW3ncgigQ18V33Aecd6sn.jpg) When I decided to get on this ride, I was heading home; I had already run some errands very early in the morning, coming from an area with buildings that have a lot of history in Caracas. I was a little pensive because I hadn't achieved my goal. While the van was filling up, I realized I had to make the most of those moments, but by the time I decided to get on, it was already starting to move. Nevertheless, I didn't hesitate to take out my phone and start taking pictures. The ride was unique, and the day was beautiful. The photos were perfect for participating in the #monomad contest, which I love. >Cuando decidí montarme en este transporte, regresaba a casa; ya había hecho algunas diligencias personales muy temprano, precisamente venía de un sector donde también habían edificios que tienen mucha historia en Caracas. Estaba un poco pensativa porque no logré mi cometido. Mientras que la camioneta se llenaba, me di cuenta de que tenía que aprovechar esos instantes, pero cuando me decidí, comenzaba a desplazarse, sin embargo, no dude en sacar mi celular y comenzar a tomar mis imágenes, el recorrido era único, más que el día estaba hermoso, las fotos eran las adecuadas para participar en el concurso de #monomad, que me encanta. ![IMG_20260518_084139~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EowG7G3D9H6oGMBMcqyEk2TC1YZ5VoBr3DVtvAcoynviZQ1S8NsMsLJN6SXPsXCvxw6.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084235~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EqQP5a18FWjPnSpVSAdu52tLsbYPmq2iwruMLVzQLibQY5cdyRgECzHFEbmZtcePny1.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084255~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23r1nzGWGreSuUxkcjGTdsMXXwdcQNticCfgMm6rGTVes8kLM1RwbCL1ZmwWkF1BmSMGL.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084303~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/244xz4G4GJh2uqJNfMQ9KkRLT4XZyYsrKav6qFWmJSKjP79yuZeMFRUyGVpCqLmKtD8tC.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084516~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpNnzctoq11TtMfedB3Qg4oC6m1Qe8E7vnPpT3obESz9fFYKnUZGCyysBsVqSuiL3Cb.jpg) The city always offers us favorable settings to capture those diverse and authentic images of an ordinary day. Within its walls, we find the old and the new, dynamism and tranquility. We see perfect compositions for capturing striking visual contrasts in seconds. You also discover places you've never visited, despite living in the city, and the moment opens up the possibility of exploring them on foot another time. >La ciudad siempre nos ofrece escenarios favorables para poder capturar esas imágenes diversas y auténticas de un día habitual, en ella encontramos lo viejo y lo moderno, el dinamismo y la quietud. En ella vemos composiciones perfectas para poder captar en segundos contrastes visuales. También descubres lugares que nunca has visitado, a pesar de estar viviendo en la ciudad y el momento te abre la opción de explorar a pie en otra oportunidad. ![IMG_20260518_084051~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zkpR4iAotW4woAsrWiPahd3LZKTg4f4D6UP7LxqHxHrZtcC8we7RFcS3aztzSbRpswW.jpg) ![IMG_20260518_084343~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eq9VDJPCv4fHkGCnJSerVzVQFqkqxfzQyJcAA8qNWjSxzaKT68Kmsuwp8SVHVoBfmfR.jpg) ![5s4dzRwnVbzGY5ssnCE4wXzkeAEXyVtgk1ApQTwHMTp6y5PvEo1yennAbzQkJ9G8uVvM1WjDyTeCvUuTiNFbfpF1J9yKTEBESC7RtqAxoD6Bxcoo9NaddDxcS5uE8yY95UEuz59CpRNk6DkRm9KA8gUJKK44W396P5RhjnE.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23tvASVrTgFFPYz1s62q3C9eFbkQRo9rWE2uxH6GMt4TsfTQCNqzbmpm3djenunLN6PA8.png)

body.title: Pan esponja para torta tres leches [ESP/ENG]
body.body: # Pan esponja para torta tres leches [ESP/ENG]\n\n<div class=\

>

Hola amigos del buen comer y del buen paladar que me leen en la comunidad de @hivefood, espero que todos hayan pasado un excelente fin de semana. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ydCPoKnzCw9s4EXAagdzeNQYvTdFeDJjwZCdVAHudF6yJMF84abd5yrp2bwqMV941HW.jpg)

Hoy les traigo una delicioso pan esponja o biscocho esponja que es espectacular para hacer el biscocho base para una torta tres leche. Hoy estuvo de cumpleaños el novio de mi hija y como se ha ganado el cariño de la familia decidí hacerle una torta tres leches que a el le encanta.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAbgfBPskNe4xS6vRWBjQh6HDzw23aN4PSFH2UfQmru1GXfJtwdGhpDR1dG84dSoBr.jpg)
![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouA9pgEHqVReGuiZBeaasNw4LabTM6Nmit4JJvueavKHGBjU76QyG5FPGwEFK4VfA3.jpg)

Realmente yo he hecho muchas tortas tres leche pero con otro tipo de biscocho, hoy decidí probar con esta nueva técnica que es muy parecida a las otras, el pan esponja, me pareció increíble, la textura que queda, muy suave, esponjoso y maleable al momento que le vamos a dar los pinchazos para que absorba mejor la crema tres leche.

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiWiCRunUP1dE9Ewkoq8b3LzzTRMQZJyZsjBj31s9QJP4gKR1vShXkJymrzW1o2bX9.jpg)

esta torta tres leches quedo deliciosa nada de empalagosa, super jugosa, con un sabor rico, demasiada rica, gracias a Dios que era para el novio de mi hija a quien le encanto.

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuLMdyUGRiueZwRDBFBHbem8YAPoWk8pFzVDeohrbP18nRJkB54shPUR6fQ6E6K6Q.jpg)

![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmB3S9VQ9RPceGPREe1HFEAu3GrJhHUcvtV3C1YEQ3NDy2ijNVthVrEZtP7ub32Tc7E.jpg)

Me voy a detener mas en la receta del pan esponja, ya que la crema tres leches es igual que las que ya les he explicado anteriormente en otros post. solo le nombrare los ingredientes para la crema tres leches y para la decoración.

# Ingredientes
* 8 huevos
* 2 y 1/2 tazas de harina
* 2 tazas de azúcar blanca refinada
*  6 gotas de extracto natural de naranja o limón
* 1 cucharadita de ralladura de limón o naranja 
* 1/2 cucharada de extracto de vainilla
* 1/2 cucharada de bicarbonato
* 1 cucharada de canela en polvo

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EptbQQjAEcNrPoochQ5CQNPYEGnL3jxuch7p8NAfw2QGCynK9fLrHbcVASFmCjKHxXJ.jpg)

# preparación
Tomar un bool, extraerle las claras a los huevos, Batir con batidora eléctrica las claras, cuando estén a punto de nieve agregar el azúcar, luego las yemas de los huevos, seguir batiendo, agregar por 5 minutos. de huevo a punto de nieve, agregar el azúcar poco a poco, batir por 3 minutos mas.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeEtcCKTqBFQfsndvQfpfPYGUAuFpdQztqtTzzbbcJKr8D6ULNBwg3Eoezxx4M5Ar4.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242Y7qtuu25ArHKDYfqNFhprRdqugTDHZz3exVTjHPwiXZCriWy23fKgaHQ7poa9ZrxVw.jpg)|![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynX4DxHQZ4XUzU3qhNNdDaKSyN2PzybSYeKJbQ4EcLQ96hhXnfz7i1yzwQiPMuct4ZH.jpg)
-|-

Agregar poco a poco la harina, el extracto de naranja o limón, ralladura de naranja o limón, la canela, el extracto de vainilla y seguir batiendo pero con paleta de madera hasta disolver los grumos, verter la mezcla en un molde engrasado y enharinado de 30 por 22 de alto. introducir al horno y dejar cocinar  por 25 minutos.

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpAUuafAL6axwXcxGyBQYizRWhDyFVbS6UEpXpVFTunJnYp9BGDHpTEtTjeXSi25bgA.jpg)| ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokezPS1DeU7F8vXyqdYr747P7T1kK7DgeuvpM36sEWoewcs1ChGEYBESQChd4mtmiZ.jpg)
-|-

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xp8dNGo4izaostYLQJoAQNoBUJBDqRMZBjUytoLHaQtaJwy6ChuTJX3hhrokYbipyAL.jpg)|![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAeLRebzLoShudrLptcK7n738hhMQuh1GNdrEvyYYri8dVBUkvHhdXbEaUmLEdgjhi9.jpg)
-|-

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/244xz4MxTphjdK8yfbqeiWxsXstPDAzLuJdhPxFnMPb38CeWEQzgopmAYjaVjn4HSF7oZ.jpg)

Para finalizar deje enfriar y desmolde, pinche con un palito de altura todo el biscocho para que absorbiera bien la crema que se hizo con las tres leche (leche condensada, leche evaporada y leche empolvo, Lleve a la nevera tres veces ya que este procedimiento de colocarle la crema de tres leche se hace varias veces hasta que este bien húmedo, decore con claras de huevo batidas a punto de nieve y le coloque grajeas de color azul. 

![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiWiCRunUP1dE9Ewkoq8b3LzzTRMQZJyZsjBj31s9QJP4gKR1vShXkJymrzW1o2bX9.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuMS3BxvA3ZB7sh5ybyQvp9H2SxLGgNXNxtpwjGhQaqJXL5Y7vu39JfvCy5eYvojK.jpg)
-|-

![20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wqkWBjCxq7nwjfNYdKgzYuXi8EhF121YVLS15htWjtaUa8fT9n4WSGaiK59XJhtN5ua.jpg)|![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouA8jPPefX6iYCY3orCSLVfvKqjHuTQBCycB1Dy7E1DPi5W4xuk44tF5tTXQSYfeSQ.jpg)
-|-

![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouA9pgEHqVReGuiZBeaasNw4LabTM6Nmit4JJvueavKHGBjU76QyG5FPGwEFK4VfA3.jpg)

![26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonmsT6JNfZEJkwwSjgEjvzpo6QU8zMkCfNfPtHUa8xCfUYfKrFtEmCXZ8ZQEYRYBL5.jpg)

En la noche cantamos el cumpleaños feliz al cumpleañero y picamos el pastel. 

![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmB3S9VQ9RPceGPREe1HFEAu3GrJhHUcvtV3C1YEQ3NDy2ijNVthVrEZtP7ub32Tc7E.jpg)

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuLMdyUGRiueZwRDBFBHbem8YAPoWk8pFzVDeohrbP18nRJkB54shPUR6fQ6E6K6Q.jpg)

Hasta a qui mi contenido, espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en una nueva receta. saludo cordiales para todos.

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Sponge Cake for Tres Leches Cake

> Hello, fellow food lovers and connoisseurs reading this in the @hivefood community! I hope you all had a wonderful weekend. Welcome to my blog. ![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ydCPoKnzCw9s4EXAagdzeNQYvTdFeDJjwZCdVAHudF6yJMF84abd5yrp2bwqMV941HW.jpg) Today I’m sharing a delicious sponge cake that’s perfect for making the base for a tres leches cake. Today was my daughter’s boyfriend’s birthday, and since he’s won the family’s affection, I decided to make him a tres leches cake, which he loves. ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoAbgfBPskNe4xS6vRWBjQh6HDzw23aN4PSFH2UfQmru1GXfJtwdGhpDR1dG84dSoBr.jpg) ![25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EouA9pgEHqVReGuiZBeaasNw4LabTM6Nmit4JJvueavKHGBjU76QyG5FPGwEFK4VfA3.jpg) I’ve actually made many tres leches cakes before, but with a different type of sponge cake. Today I decided to try this new technique, which is very similar to the others—the sponge cake—and I thought it was incredible. The resulting texture is very soft, fluffy, and pliable when we poke holes in it so it absorbs the tres leches cream better. ![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiWiCRunUP1dE9Ewkoq8b3LzzTRMQZJyZsjBj31s9QJP4gKR1vShXkJymrzW1o2bX9.jpg) This tres leches cake turned out delicious—not at all cloying, super moist, and full of flavor. It was absolutely delicious! Thank goodness it was for my daughter’s boyfriend, who loved it. ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EopuLMdyUGRiueZwRDBFBHbem8YAPoWk8pFzVDeohrbP18nRJkB54shPUR6fQ6E6K6Q.jpg) ![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23tmB3S9VQ9RPceGPREe1HFEAu3GrJhHUcvtV3C1YEQ3NDy2ijNVthVrEZtP7ub32Tc7E.jpg) I’ll focus more on the sponge cake recipe, since the tres leches cream is the same as the ones I’ve already explained in previous posts. I’ll just list the ingredients for the tres leches cream and for the decoration. # Ingredients * 8 eggs * 2 1/2 cups flour * 2 cups refined white sugar * 6 drops natural orange or lemon extract * 1 teaspoon lemon or orange zest * 1/2 tablespoon vanilla extract * 1/2 tablespoon baking soda * 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EptbQQjAEcNrPoochQ5CQNPYEGnL3jxuch7p8NAfw2QGCynK9fLrHbcVASFmCjKHxXJ.jpg) # Preparation Take a bowl, separate the egg whites from the yolks. Beat the egg whites with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form; then add the sugar, followed by the egg yolks. Continue beating for 5 minutes. Once the egg whites are stiff, gradually add the sugar and beat for 3 more minutes. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoeEtcCKTqBFQfsndvQfpfPYGUAuFpdQztqtTzzbbcJKr8D6ULNBwg3Eoezxx4M5Ar4.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/242Y7qtuu25ArHKDYfqNFhprRdqugTDHZz3exVTjHPwiXZCriWy23fKgaHQ7poa9ZrxVw.jpg) |![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23ynX4DxHQZ4XUzU3qhNNdDaKSyN2PzybSYeKJbQ4EcLQ96hhXnfz7i1yzwQiPMuct4ZH.jpg) -|- Gradually add the flour, orange or lemon extract, orange or lemon zest, cinnamon, and vanilla extract, and continue beating with a wooden spoon until the lumps are dissolved. Pour the mixture into a greased and floured 30 x 22 cm (12 x 8.5 inch) baking pan. Place in the oven and bake for 25 minutes. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpAUuafAL6axwXcxGyBQYizRWhDyFVbS6UEpXpVFTunJnYp9BGDHpTEtTjeXSi25bgA.jpg) | ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EokezPS1DeU7F8vXyqdYr747P7T1kK7DgeuvpM36sEWoewcs1ChGEYBESQChd4mtmiZ.jpg) -|- ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xp8dNGo4izaostYLQJoAQNoBUJBDqRMZBjUytoLHaQtaJwy6ChuTJX3hhrokYbipyAL.jpg)|! [10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xAeLRebzLoShudrLptcK7n738hhMQuh1GNdrEvyYYri8dVBUkvHhdXbEaUmLEdgjhi9.jpg) -|- ![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/244xz4MxTphjdK8yfbqeiWxsXstPDAzLuJdhPxFnMPb38CeWEQzgopmAYjaVjn4HSF7oZ.jpg) Finally, let it cool and remove it from the pan. Pierce the entire cake with a long skewer so it absorbs the three-milk cream (condensed milk, evaporated milk, and powdered milk) well. Refrigerate it three times, as this process of adding the three-milk cream is repeated several times until it is thoroughly moist. Full Metal Ox Day 1912
Monday 25, May 2026

Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.
Will America Fall? 
I asked the quicksearch-bot, Why is the US bombing Somalia? Here’s the spin. 
“The United States is conducting airstrikes in Somalia primarily to target Islamist militant groups like al-Shabaab and ISIS-Somalia, which pose threats to both regional stability and U.S. national security. This military action is part of a broader counterterrorism strategy aimed at degrading these groups' capabilities to plan and execute attacks.” 
Here are a couple of “coincidences” I noticed. Somali-Americans in Minnesota get busted. Then Africom is bombing in Somalia. 
But here’s the funny thing. ISIS is like an American franchise. Like the Hard Rock Cafe. You have Hard Rock Nashville, Hard Rock Vegas, maybe Hard Rock Miami. 
There’s ISIS-Somalia, ISIS–Khorasan in Pakistan. There’s a whole list. Maybe there are more ISIS franchises, that Hard Rock Cafes. 
ISIS‑West Africa Province (ISWAP) — Nigeria/Lake Chad region.  
ISIS‑Congo (ISC) — Democratic Republic of Congo (also called Allied Democratic Forces/ADF affiliate).  
ISIS‑Somalia (also called ISIS‑K/ISIS‑Somalia or ISIS–Barqa sometimes) — Somalia.  
ISIS‑Yemen (Wilayat al‑Yaman) — Yemen.  
ISIS‑Syria/Iraq (core provinces: Wilayat al‑Raqqa, Baghdad, etc.) — the original core territories.  
ISIS‑Khalid ibn al‑Walid/ISIS‑Gaza — local Gaza‑area affiliate (emerged 2019–2021).  
ISIS‑Sinai (Wilayat Sinai) — Egypt’s Sinai Peninsula (formerly Ansar Beit al‑Maqdis).  
ISIS‑Libya (Wilayat Libya) — Libya.  
ISIS‑Philippines (Wilayat al‑Furqan / various) — notably in Mindanao (Jolo/Basilan).  
ISIS‑Afghan/Pakistan splinters beyond Khorasan (local cells).  
I wonder if they sell t-shirts. 
You know what snow blindness is? 
All you see is White. 
But the question is, “Will America Fall?” 
I don’t think it will. But I don’t think it will change significantly either. There are those that argue, including yours truly, that the US has been changing, drastically, since 9 11. Maybe 9 11 was the first straw, and Covid was the last. Twenty year cycles, more or less, is how the simulation rolls out. 4 Turnings, if you believe the generational historians. It’s as good a way of looking at history as any other. 
It’s legit to mark 2001, as the first year of this century. Just like it’s legit to recognize March one of this year, (2026), as the beginning of the Persian World Order. 
Without turning this into a book that’s already been written, let’s stretch this framework out to the next  turning. When you think about it, every turning, (20 years) is a fourth turning depending on when you start. The 21st century is a good place to start, and lucky us, we have a globe-shaking event to mark it. 
Lucky us again, we have another turning exactly 20 years later with the crescendo of the Covid plandemic psy-op. That was America’s, “I’m-as-mad-as-hell-and-I’m-not-gonna-take-it-anymore” moment. 
Next turn, 2041. That’s 14 years from now. 2040 is an election year. There are three presidential elections scheduled between now and then. Probably for the first time, in over 100 years, it’s necessary to look at other countries to determine the position the US will have in the world. 
China may very well be the undisputed global hegemon, however she won’t behave the way the Anglo-US-Euros did when they were at the top of the heap. Taiwan will probably be fully “re-integrated” into China. “Re-integration” meaning that foreign nations like the US, Japan, South Korean, and maybe Australia, will finally get the picture that Taiwan had always been a part of China. 
China’s government makes 5 year plans. So they’ve probably already got 2041 penciled in. Xi Jinping will be 87 that year and if he still alive he will probably be both celebrated and revered. I can amost guarantee you that China is already searching for its Chairman for the 2040s. He, or she, is in their mid-thirties right now. Can already speak English and is working in government. 
Russia, is a tough call. There will never be another Putin. Putin is give or take, six months older than Xi. He will be revered by some, and highly criticized by others for allowing the SMO to drag out for so long. That’s based on what we’re hearing about what’s coming out of Russia. There’s a Russian academic, and former advisor to the Kremlin who has written publicly arguing, controversially, for limited/tactical nuclear strikes on Western Europe. Something like this could really shake up the timeline.  
Despite the drama of the Y2K computer bug. Most of the humans I knew were excited about getting out of the 20th Century. Then, BOOM! Quite literally. 
So depending how Russia comes out of this, “War,” (which is now, de facto against NATO), we will see which direction that country goes. Russia’s next generation of leaders, also mid-30s to early 50s, (most who have never known the USSR), will harbor ill feelings towards Europe, the EU (if it still exists), NATO (if it still exists), And maybe even the US, if my Tri-World Order, CRU alliance doesn’t emerge.  


America will be lucky to be number three on the list of world powers. But maybe that term, “world powers,” will fall out of use. You know how Americans are. “If we can’t be the world’s ‘Super Power’ than we are just going to have to retire the word.” 

America’s 2041 president is currently between the ages of mid-thirties and early sixties. If you turn 65 this year, you will still be younger than the current president of the United States at this moment. However, speaking of one-of-a-kind, there will never be another Trump. We can go into that deeper at some point. 

I’m thinking after the Geriatric two-one-two punch, of Trump-Biden-Trump, America won’t be tolerating any old (white) men in 1600. Notwithstanding America’s median age has been on the rise, expecting to be about 39 years in 2040. The population of 80-something men is projected to increase by 45-65%. Because of Covid, (the op, not the “virus”), the 21st Century wars of aggression America participated in, veteran, and other suicides, drug addiction/death, autism, various vax-damage, Iatrogenesis, and turbo-cancer, there will be a big gap between elders and youngsters in 2040. The youngins might just start looking to octogenarians for guidance and perspective. Especially if the geezers can keep their teeth in their mouth and don’t have that “old man” smell. 

Finally. Iran in 2040. Very prosperous thanks to revenues generated from trade, including Belt-n-Road commerce and the administration of the Strait of Hormuz. We also suspect, that Iran will “project power” in the region through their practice of Shia Islam. 

Epilogue. European nations will continue to fight with each other. They will largely be ignored, unless Islam catches on.

body.title: How Often Should Your Tech Company Redesign the Website?
body.body:
A tech company’s website can quietly fall behind long before anyone inside the business notices it. The design may still look “fine,” but users start leaving faster, pages load awkwardly on mobile, or the messaging no longer reflects what the company actually offers.

In tech, where products evolve quickly, websites can age faster than expected.

The better question is not how often you should redesign your website, but why your site needs professional branding and graphic design services.



![image.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/6a2c3ad8c6638a66171ff4d3987270a8003e33a9343e252ce99809b6c9380fc9)



## **Redesign or Refresh? What’s the Difference?**

Many companies confuse a website refresh with a full redesign, but they solve different problems. 

A refresh updates the visual layer of the website. This could mean improving typography, adjusting colors, replacing outdated graphics, or reorganizing sections on the homepage. Think of it as improving the experience without changing the foundation. A refresh is useful when your branding still works, your website structure is functional, and users are converting well enough. 

A redesign goes deeper. It rethinks the site architecture, user flow, messaging, navigation, and sometimes even the brand identity itself. This usually happens when the business has changed significantly or when the website no longer supports growth.

For example, many modern tech brands now simplify their website to improve user journeys rather than adding more content. Experienced creative design teams, like Copa Design, apply thoughtful storytelling and visual identity to shape user engagement without overwhelming the audience. 

## **5 Signs Your Tech Website Needs a Redesign**

The clearest signals usually come from user behavior, not opinions in a meeting room.

*   **High bounce rates on key pages**

If users land on your site and leave within seconds, something isn’t connecting. It may be slowing loading times, confusing navigation, weak messaging, or an outdated layout.

*   **Declining conversion rates**

If demo bookings, sign-ups, or contact inquiries are dropping while traffic stays stable, the problem may be the experience itself. A website should guide users naturally toward action.

*   **Website doesn’t support mobile users properly**

Mobile traffic dominates most industries now, especially SaaS and tech services. If your mobile experience feels cramped or inconsistent, visitors notice immediately. 

*   **Brand inconsistency**

Tech companies evolve fast, and websites often fail to keep up with positioning changes. Maybe your company started as a startup tool, but now serves enterprise clients. If your website still speaks to the old audience, trust can weaken.

*   **Internal frustration **

If your team avoids updating the website because the CMS is difficult to manage or pages break easily, the site is becoming a liability instead of an asset.

This is where experienced teams offering [branding and graphic design services in Santa Clara, CA ](https://www.copa.design/services/graphic-design)often focus first. Not on visuals only, but on identifying friction points that hurt usability and trust. 

## Is Redesign the Better Investment?

Calling a [creative design agency in Santa Clara, California](https://www.copa.design/), makes sense when multiple issues stack together. A redesign becomes necessary when small fixes don’t produce meaningful results.

For example, if your business has gone through a merger, launched new services, shifted target markets, or changed positioning entirely, patching the old website rarely works. The structure itself may no longer reflect the business.

The same applies when websites are built on outdated systems that limit performance, SEO, or scalability. Sometimes companies spend more time fixing design inconsistencies than they would rebuilding strategically.

A full redesign can also support long-term marketing goals. Better page structures improve SEO performance, cleaner navigation increases conversions, and stronger branding creates consistency across campaigns.

In the Bay Area, tech website redesigns aren’t waiting years between updates! Subscription-based creative models are also changing how redesigns happen. Growing startups now use subscription graphic design services in Santa Clara to continuously improve their websites over time. 

A simple way to evaluate your website is to step back and ask a few honest questions.

Does the website still reflect your company today? Can users understand what you do within seconds? Is the mobile experience smooth? Are conversions improving or slowing down? Is your site easy for your internal team to manage?

If several answers feel uncertain, your website may already be overdue for change. After all, a website should evolve alongside the business it represents.

The strongest websites aren’t the flashiest ones. They are the ones that make users feel confident, informed, and ready to take the next step. 

FAQs:**
**
**1. What is a graphic design subscription service?**

A graphic design subscription service, like Copa Design, is a flexible, cost‑effective way for businesses to access professional design support on demand without hiring full‑time staff or managing freelancers. It offers unlimited requests, fast turnaround, and a dedicated creative team at a predictable monthly rate.

**2. What is the difference between a website refresh and a redesign?**

A website refresh updates superficial visuals like typography, images, icons, and colors. A redesign rethinks the core architecture, navigation, and brand positioning when a website no longer supports business growth.   

**3. How do ongoing graphic design services keep a website fresh?**

Ongoing graphic design services help prevent website obsolescence by keeping your brand’s digital presence fresh, relevant, and aligned with evolving trends. For example, Copa Design’s subscription model ensures that businesses can continuously update visuals, layouts, and campaigns without waiting for a major overhaul.

body.title: How menu visuals influence food ordering decisions online
body.body:
I’ve noticed that people pay much more attention to restaurants where the menu looks visually clean and modern. Even good food can lose appeal when the presentation feels outdated, overloaded, or inconsistent.
These days customers often decide within a few seconds whether something looks worth ordering, especially in delivery apps or digital menus where people scroll very quickly.
I came across https://www.splento.com/splentify recently, and the interesting part is the focus on how menu structure, visuals, and presentation influence engagement and ordering behaviour.
Honestly, good photos and a clean layout probably affect conversion far more than many restaurants realise.

My aunt gave us a slice of cake and some quesillo to sweeten our afternoon not just for the moms, but for everyone there. ![20260510_160846.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaZTK63xMjFnAXQooU9PsJpMyJHQFTsJUXhiZQ1hnXXVt/20260510_160846.jpg) ![20260510_161201.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwBSHbAwhsfzuxUSZuUSHXRWBhrVL5pPSQ8xRUyCBGf5/20260510_161201.jpg) ![20260510_161207.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPPnCF8gij8QfzLFnoPQ2Bj3kjTVxEvUySRH6SYYfU2Zu/20260510_161207.jpg) Then we took some photos, always thinking about preserving memories for the future, since I feel that’s the only thing we have left to keep alive the memory of every moment shared with those we love. ![20260510_171707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUpaadEWuvWpCZ2qpwVvWdjVU2irof3aXQS3XYS2teFa/20260510_171707.jpg) ![20260510_171817.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaxP7MNR5ZvRryccWnjMqstaUFcFLfTjmvWA3BeqJQ3Uz/20260510_171817.jpg) My mom and dad danced merengue and salsa nonstop for a while; they love to shake it, and even though I don’t like to dance, watching them do this gives me years of life, which makes me feel grateful to God and also lucky to have them with me. ![20260510_172257.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ1M6sjA7ZVBsEgAxzc2jHVDFXHYMge8FUCLDgXF2YdE2/20260510_172257.jpg) At the end of the afternoon, my aunt and I fried some snacks, including some pastries filled with meat and potatoes, which we ate later; they were very crispy on the outside and tasty on the inside. ![20260510_184737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZTytPqkyKPgLjNEmVMqbDZhG2D35avPj294kZc8CTWxg/20260510_184737.jpg) What a wonderful day! Full of celebration, good times, and gifts from my uncles, my dad, and my mom. Even though I know Mother’s Day could be every day, it’s always important to celebrate this date that’s marked on the calendar for us. ![20260510_204723.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbMQsDmJET7Dz3dC8yJtBkFTzoEPaRyZBpHQ5UK3NvHaG/20260510_204723.jpg)

--- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Buenos días, amigos y familia de Hive. Feliz y bendecido inicio de la última semana del mes de Mayo, deseo que sea de provecho para todos ustedes.

![InShot_20260524_062322158.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRNYr8FhJYW2oSAFRSwNQi646pf9qcPDnC5t9p4h51pYg/InShot_20260524_062322158.jpg)

Quería compartirles un poco de lo que fue mi Día de las Madres, un día para celebrar y compartir en compañía de las mamitas de mi familia, mi abuela, mi tía, la suegra de mi tía y la más importante mi mamá, este momento se desarrollo al mismo tiempo que el cumpleaños de mi pequeña Abby, mientras las niñas tomaban una siesta en la tarde.

![20260510_171834.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZmbdSPygHPzDYDbUnVp23vwWSjN6dPmCSrTXhzAqm7Sp/20260510_171834.jpg)

Mi tío nos preparó una torta de tres leches, debo mencionar que se le da muy bien la repostería y cada vez le quedan más deliciosos y llenos de dulzura sus postres, mi tía nos dió un pedazo de torta y quesillo para endulzarnos la tarde, no solo a las mamitas sino a todos los presentes. 

![20260510_160846.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaZTK63xMjFnAXQooU9PsJpMyJHQFTsJUXhiZQ1hnXXVt/20260510_160846.jpg)

![20260510_161201.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwBSHbAwhsfzuxUSZuUSHXRWBhrVL5pPSQ8xRUyCBGf5/20260510_161201.jpg)

Luego tomamos algunas fotos, siempre pensando en mantener los recuerdos para el futuro, ya que siento que eso es lo único que nos queda para mantener vivo el recuerdo de cada momento compartido al lado de quiénes amamos.

![20260510_171707.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUpaadEWuvWpCZ2qpwVvWdjVU2irof3aXQS3XYS2teFa/20260510_171707.jpg)

Mi mamá y mi papá bailaron un rato merengues y salsa sin parar, a ellos les encanta mover el esqueleto y aunque a mi no me gusta bailar, verlos a ellos hacer esto me da años de vida, lo cuál me hace sentir agradecida con Dios y además afortunada de poder tenerlos conmigo.

Al final de la tarde, freimos algunos pasapalos mi tía y yo, entre los cuáles se encontraban unos pasteles rellenos de carne y papa, que después comimos y estaban muy crujientes por fuera y sabrosos por dentro.
