title.title: The Role of Online Manuals in Using Brother Devices Efficiently
title.body:
Electronic devices have become essential tools in homes, offices, and educational environments. Printers, scanners, label makers, and multifunction systems are expected to work reliably every day, but users often need guidance to unlock all available features. Online manuals provide an effective way to access technical information for Brother devices without relying on printed documentation.

**Convenient Access to User Guides**

One of the biggest advantages of online manuals is accessibility. Users can search for a specific Brother model and quickly find setup instructions, troubleshooting guides, and maintenance recommendations. This saves time and helps users solve problems independently.

Digital manuals often include:

*
    Installation instructions


*
    Wireless setup guidance


*
    Device configuration details


*
    Error code explanations


*
    Maintenance and cleaning recommendations


*
    Software and driver information


Because these documents are stored online, users can access them from computers, tablets, or smartphones whenever needed.

**Support for Different Types of Brother Equipment**

Brother manufactures a wide variety of office and home devices. Each product category has unique functions and technical requirements, making detailed documentation extremely important.

Users commonly search for manuals related to:

*
    Laser and inkjet printers


*
    Multifunction office systems


*
    Label printers


*
    Sewing and embroidery machines


*
    Fax machines and scanners


Having model-specific documentation helps users correctly configure devices and avoid common setup mistakes.

**Troubleshooting Made Easier**

Technical problems can interrupt productivity, especially in office environments. Online manuals provide practical solutions for issues that users may encounter during daily operation.

Troubleshooting sections often explain how to:

*
    Clear paper jams


*
    Improve print quality


*
    Fix network connection problems


*
    Replace toner or ink cartridges


*
    Reset device settings


*
    Resolve scanning errors


Step-by-step instructions help reduce the need for professional repairs or lengthy customer support calls.

**Why Maintenance Information Is Important**

Proper maintenance is essential for keeping printers and other electronic devices in good condition. Manuals frequently include recommendations for cleaning internal components, storing supplies correctly, and performing regular maintenance procedures.

These instructions can help users:

*
    Extend device lifespan


*
    Prevent hardware damage


*
    Maintain stable print quality


*
    Reduce unexpected breakdowns


For businesses that rely on printing equipment every day, preventive maintenance can improve efficiency and reduce operational costs.

**Access to Manuals for Older Devices**

Many users continue using older Brother devices because of their durability and reliability. However, finding printed manuals for discontinued models can be difficult. Online documentation libraries make it easier to locate archived manuals for older equipment that may no longer be officially promoted.

This can be especially useful for:

*
    Small businesses


*
    Repair specialists


*
    Educational institutions


*
    Home office users


*
    Collectors of older technology


Archived documentation allows users to continue repairing and maintaining devices long after their release.

**The Future of Digital Technical Support**

Modern technical [Brother printer manuals](https://manualmachine.com/brother/) support is increasingly focused on digital solutions. In addition to downloadable manuals, many platforms now offer interactive help centers, searchable FAQs, and video tutorials. These tools improve the overall support experience and help users resolve issues more quickly.

As office and home technology continues to evolve, online manuals will remain an important resource for understanding device functions, improving maintenance, and helping users get the most from their Brother equipment.

title.title: Why Timeless Outdoor Furniture Design Matters More Than Trends
title.body:
Outdoor spaces are often designed with the hope that they will remain enjoyable and inviting for many years. A patio or backyard seating area should not feel outdated after only a short period of time. While trends in outdoor design continue to change, the most successful outdoor spaces are usually built around furniture that feels balanced, comfortable, and lasting rather than temporary. This is one of the reasons timeless outdoor furniture design matters more than trends.  
Trend-driven furniture can attract attention quickly, but timeless design tends to create spaces that remain visually comfortable and practical over time. Outdoor living works best when the furniture supports long-term use, natural comfort, and a sense of quiet refinement that does not rely on constantly changing styles.  
**Timeless Design Creates Longer-Lasting Outdoor Spaces**  
Outdoor furniture is an investment in how a space will function and feel over many seasons. Furniture designed around short-term trends can begin to feel dated once those styles change. In contrast, timeless outdoor furniture continues to feel relevant because it is built around proportion, simplicity, and usability rather than temporary visual trends.  
[Luxury outdoor furniture](https://luxuryoutdoorfurniture.com/) often achieves this through clean lines, balanced shapes, and restrained detailing. Outdoor chairs, seating arrangements, and outdoor tables that avoid excessive styling tend to integrate more naturally into different types of homes and outdoor settings.  
A timeless patio feels more relaxed because it is not trying too hard to follow changing design movements.  
**Simplicity Supports Visual Balance**  
One of the defining qualities of timeless outdoor furniture is simplicity. This does not mean the furniture feels plain or lacking in character. Instead, it means the design focuses on balance, proportion, and comfort rather than unnecessary decoration.  
Luxury patio furniture designed with simplicity in mind often creates a stronger visual impact because each piece feels intentional. Outdoor tables with balanced forms and outdoor seating with clean silhouettes help patios feel calm, open, and refined.  
Simplicity also makes it easier for outdoor spaces to evolve gradually over time. Accessories, landscaping, or decorative elements can change without making the furniture itself feel out of place.  
**Timeless Furniture Works Across Different Architectural Styles**  
Trends often become closely associated with a specific moment in design. Timeless furniture tends to adapt more easily to different architectural environments because it relies on enduring design principles rather than novelty.  
Luxury outdoor furniture with balanced proportions and durable materials can complement modern homes, transitional spaces, and more traditional architecture without appearing disconnected. Outdoor tables and seating designed with restraint feel more flexible because they support the overall environment rather than dominating it.  
This versatility helps homeowners create outdoor spaces that remain cohesive even as the home itself changes over time.  
**Durable Materials Support Timeless Design**  
Timeless design is closely connected to material quality. Furniture that looks refined but wears down quickly rarely maintains its appeal for long. Lasting outdoor spaces require materials that can support both visual elegance and long-term durability.  
Aluminum outdoor furniture is often valued because it combines strength, weather resistance, and a clean architectural appearance. Outdoor chairs and tables built with durable aluminum frames maintain their structure and finish while continuing to support modern outdoor living.  
Well-chosen materials allow outdoor furniture to age gracefully rather than deteriorate quickly. This long-term reliability is one of the reasons timeless outdoor furniture feels more valuable over time.  
**Trends Can Limit Long-Term Flexibility**  
Highly trend-driven outdoor furniture can sometimes make patios feel overly tied to a specific style or period. While trends may initially feel exciting, they often limit how easily a space can adapt in the future.  
Timeless outdoor furniture offers greater flexibility because it creates a stable foundation for outdoor living. Outdoor seating, tables, and layouts built around classic proportions allow homeowners to refresh surrounding elements without needing to replace the furniture itself.  
This flexibility supports outdoor spaces that continue to feel fresh without requiring constant redesign.  
**Comfort Never Goes Out of Style**  
One reason timeless outdoor furniture remains relevant is because comfort itself never becomes outdated. Outdoor spaces are meant to support relaxation, conversation, dining, and everyday living. Furniture that feels uncomfortable or impractical quickly loses its appeal regardless of how fashionable it may look.  
[Luxury patio furniture](https://luxuryoutdoorfurniture.com/) often focuses on creating lasting comfort through supportive seating, practical layouts, and balanced proportions. Outdoor chairs that encourage relaxation and outdoor tables that support everyday use contribute more to long-term outdoor enjoyment than temporary visual trends.  
Comfort is one of the most enduring qualities in good outdoor design.  
**Timeless Design Creates a More Relaxed Atmosphere**  
Outdoor spaces often feel more welcoming when they are designed with restraint and confidence. Furniture that is timeless tends to create a calmer environment because it avoids competing for attention. The patio feels more natural, more open, and easier to enjoy.  
Luxury outdoor furniture designed with long-term use in mind helps outdoor living feel less performative and more authentic. The space supports real routines and everyday moments rather than existing primarily for visual impact.  
This relaxed atmosphere is one of the reasons timeless outdoor spaces continue to feel appealing year after year.  
**Long-Term Value Beyond Appearance**  
Timeless outdoor furniture often delivers greater long-term value because it remains visually and functionally relevant for much longer. Outdoor tables, chairs, and seating arrangements that continue to feel appropriate season after season reduce the need for frequent replacement or redesign.  
Luxury outdoor furniture built around durable materials and balanced design helps homeowners create patios that remain attractive and comfortable over time. Instead of chasing trends, the focus shifts toward creating outdoor spaces that feel dependable, refined, and easy to live with.

title.title: A Moment Between Light and Clouds
title.body:
Hello Photography Lovers! Today I want to share a photo that instantly caught my attention. Sometimes nature creates scenes that feel powerful without needing any filters or special effects. This was one of those moments.
![file_00000000315071fabc55a5d54987fd01.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR98PRhAVuobApBBAeuah2ivkp2zHkmyhUoWZLwwGJgZJ/file_00000000315071fabc55a5d54987fd01.png)

As I looked toward the sky, thick clouds were covering most of the sunlight, but the sun still found a way to shine through. The rays breaking between the clouds created a peaceful and dramatic atmosphere at the same time. The silhouette of the tree above also added a natural frame to the image, making the sky feel even more beautiful.
What I enjoy most about photography is that every picture can tell a different story. For me, this photo feels like a reminder that light always finds its path, even when clouds seem heavy. Nature has a unique way of showing beauty in simple moments.

title.title: Why Is a Jibhi and Tirthan Valley Trip from Gurgaon Perfect for Nature Lovers?
title.body:
#

![Why Is a Jibhi and Tirthan Valley Trip from Gurgaon Perfect for Nature Lovers .jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/e03cc7b9321adc887b24d4e36649314c026f3aad826e2948425c8df5bda7baae)



A [Jibhi and Tirthan Valley Trip from Gurgaon](https://63a036b0e04e4.site123.me/articles/jibhi-and-tirthan-valley-trip-from-gurgaon) is a perfect getaway for nature lovers who want to escape the busy city life and enjoy the peaceful beauty of Himachal Pradesh. Surrounded by green forests, snow-covered mountains, rivers, waterfalls, and fresh mountain air, Jibhi and Tirthan Valley offer a relaxing and refreshing travel experience. These beautiful destinations are ideal for families, couples, solo travelers, and groups looking for peace and adventure together.

Jibhi is famous for its wooden cottages, scenic cafes, and peaceful atmosphere, while Tirthan Valley is known for trout fishing, trekking, camping, and the Great Himalayan National Park. Tourists can also explore Jalori Pass, Serolsar Lake, and hidden waterfalls during the trip. The pleasant weather and natural beauty make this destination popular throughout the year.

Traveling from Gurgaon becomes more comfortable when you book a Tempo Traveller for your group journey. It provides spacious seating, luggage space, air conditioning, and a smooth road trip experience. Whether you are planning a weekend vacation or a long mountain holiday, a Jibhi and Tirthan Valley Trip from Gurgaon gives you unforgettable memories close to nature and adventure.

\#jibhi #tirthanvalley #jibhitrip #himachaltrip #naturelover #mountaintrip #travelhimachal #roadtrip #tempotraveller #tempotravellergurgaon #grouptravel #familytrip #weekendtrip #travelindia #hillstation

title.title: Hive Philippines Travel and Nature Photography #1157 - by Allmonitors
title.body:
#1157 - Lubong Water Falls Shots for Monday. 

A bright Monday dearest amazing Hive family everywhere! I hope this new week finds you feeling refreshed and ready to tackle new challenges. Wishing everyone a productive and safe Monday ahead. May you find inspiration in the little things and have plenty of reasons to smile. Stay awesome and keep shining🌞☀️. 

Now for our daily shots one gloomy noon with my wife, three friends, their dog and I went at Lubong Waterfalls in San Felipe, Zambales. The sky was moody cloudy over the landscape. We were all eager to reach the water but with a bit of a journey ahead from the main road. We rode a carabao drawn carriage. It felt like a step back in time when we were kids. The dog sat alertly on the floor of the carriage. The ride was bumpy but it was a fun and unique way to travel. 
![1000008165.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23sdbXBmyy5RqUGGHgNFfUHn1eLGQBL7YSqF8mPgCVHb2FAuvsknMcVYzrdyzhbRwg3ks.jpg)

When we finally arrived at the falls, there was that sound of rushing water. The water was coming down from the mountains, it was cold and a fresh pool at the bottom. The moment we stepped into the water, there was a shock of cold rushed over. It was freezing but it was incredibly refreshing. 
![1000008259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23tbncYjXHRrxPv3i9L1RWMUrVegJwf2YR8XSBBbTo1EvW3P4jrveanxHuYxTB24Age22.jpg) 

![1000008585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EoEpakZaAVmMtJmoBzHYRtQekpReGtEMKdZXGNL5Zaw5GMXYdCeXhiAKeH7C2pLWCTU.jpg)

We spent a good amount of time just dipping around. The cold water seemed to wash away all our stress. We laughed, splashing water at each other while the dog also splashed. 
![1000008522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23u5vMvgGxBNMJxZiRznsBGSWufVzcbzA8jHRMvT2rK55a5DP9GwcihKLE3qcuffBJpPK.jpg)

Of course, we made sure to capture the memories. We took turns posing on the rocks near the falls and snapping group photos too. We explored the area looking for different spots to dip our feet and just enjoy the environment. It was a perfect afternoon getaway. All were happy!😊 
![1000008359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wC1UJGR7AuoXvpYPQHZCn2TkVPVxP1hkJ34eHGsAgoCYno2aW2D4Mert5J6iZJUVq32.jpg)

Follow me on my nature travels.
Shot taken in Zambales, Philippines.


<center>Image/s were shot using Samsung Z5 flip phone. ~rex</center>

title.title: Shadows, Secrets and Survival
title.body:
https://youtu.be/N1JH-dakkbY?si=7F4duJsHh8E39F4h
Watch on YouTube 

The gameplay of Tomb Raider Shiva's Shadow feels like an expedition where every path leads to a secret. The dark caves, ancient walls and silent atmosphere make it seem as if time itself has stopped. As Lara moves forward, both danger and curiosity grow with every step.

The most special thing about this game is its atmosphere. In some places you see ruined temples and in others mysterious shadows that force the player to stay cautious at every moment. Shiva's Shadow isn't just an action game but a world where every scene tells a story.

Lara Croft’s style appears confident and brave as always. Jumping across difficult paths finding hidden secrets and facing enemies makes the game even more exciting. After every mission it feels like the next stage will be even more dangerous and thrilling than the last.

The real beauty of this gameplay lies in its sense of adventure. Sometimes the silence creates fear while other times the sudden action makes your heart race. Tomb Raider Shiva's Shadow is an experience that isn't just played but felt.

title.title: Making some quesillo for a snack.
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Feliz noche para todos, deseo hayan tenido un excelente fin de semana donde hayan podido descansar y recargar energías para esta nueva semana que está por comenzar; les comparto la #receta de un quesilo que prepare el día de hoy en casa para la merienda familiar.

> **
ENGLISH
** Good evening, everyone! I hope you all had a wonderful weekend where you were able to rest and recharge your batteries for the new week ahead. Here’s the #recipe for a quesillo I made today at home for our family snack. ![1000907762.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23zkk43AKpj4Cb1UvYhEbBSkz3ZGp6vwrrJ31SuEsMJXVDiLtz3xdDFGoubNk3phtdNfK.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** 5 huevos, una lata de leche condensada, 250 ml de leche líquida, 125 gr de leche en polvo

> **
INGREDIENTS
** 5 eggs, 1 can of condensed milk, 250 ml of milk, 125 g of powdered milk ![1000907455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EogLpHpwRwq5LGAb29np3ihbqSnNKPWSqR3yBR5uU4xCZDm5AaaMFRfWUfTFGmKGUgA.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** Llevamos todos los ingredientes a la licuadora: los huevos, la leche líquida, la leche condensada, la leche en polvo y mezclamos muy bien por aproximadamente 3 minutos. Luego preparamos un caramelo en la quesillera, incorporamos la mezcla y, llevé al horno a 180 grados por 65 minutos; también puedes prepararlo a baño maría

> **
PROCEDURE
** Place all the ingredients in a blender: the eggs, milk, condensed milk, and powdered milk, and blend thoroughly for about 3 minutes. Next, make a caramel in a small saucepan, pour in the mixture, and bake at 180 degrees for 65 minutes; you can also bake it in a water bath. ![1000907456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wCE1gteLkTxqPW7euJ4kiN7caHPFgN8e1ByzMCeGXr8ojMbQ59AaqbVajzFyt8tbsek.jpg) ![1000907457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFXnGWvUkLsDy9JN66jg89vSpg1ghqVLK5BdyDMUq52V9Ck1mDZS7RupA8Mm68tiMhS.jpg) ![1000907458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23u65PtLYVGyFYudiCVJ8BHKVZroHkiaVHS9Cwpp9uT3ZB2YoFaqT6CbdyXdDdZeXPAsr.jpg) ![1000907459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23uFRuwy338Etif9gHBRWXT3wih36QF7TNrp2ffMRBagMM3qyp5oW6QsEMZqKUL755TfD.jpg) ![1000907465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23u5zfkSFskmXytK4Sfrtd2XfbhTXeSyfdLhJBAm3NZwYNPc1x39cEyDU3wvHi5EnRKtY.jpg)

title.title: The Wonderfools (2026) [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>Today I'm coming with a 10/10 recommendation. I truly loved and enjoyed watching this K-drama. It had comedy throughout, intrigue, romance, and lots of laughs. You really won't regret it. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073630_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EonkyaTSLTfZc3ToYhzPXWgnbZSNA9AczocAyWuBykHr1zb8F4bEDioGYvBNGVX4PcR.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm33933570/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_3) ---

>Premiered in mid-May, this 8-episode series was directed by Yoo In-sik, written by Heo Da-joong, and created by Kang Eun-kyung. It's a superhero comedy action-adventure series starring Park Eun-bin, Cha Eun-woo, Choi Dae-hoon, Im Seong-jae, Kim Hae-sook, and Son Hyun-joo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073743_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyNSLJGjf2k57rftH3JjhKJhjWs6v2MxRJ7R9fznaQ4saFAjRVop71ycSdLDUqN6Kgq.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm1193332226/?ref_=ttmi_mi_9_2) ---
> # What's the plot about?… --- The story transports us to the year 1999, giving it that nostalgic and chaotic vibe of the time, under the shadow of conspiracy theories and the fear of the \
where we follow a group of ordinary, rather imperfect residents of a town: Eun Chae-ni, whom the townspeople nickname \
and who has health problems; Son Gyeong Hun, nicknamed \

who is a regular complainant at the Town Hall's Complaint Center for various things; our third member of this group is Kang Ro-bin (the puppet), a shy employee who works at the protagonist's grandmother's restaurant; and last but not least, Lee Un-jeong, a mysterious and reserved employee of the town hall. Their relationship begins when, after an unexpected accident, Chae-ni, Gyeong, and Ro-bin gain powers and turn to Un-jeong, since he possesses the power of telekinesis and can guide them in learning how to control their new abilities.

---

<div class=\

>Unlike comic book heroes, these characters don't have perfect costumes or complete control over their newfound abilities, which are often as absurd as they are hilarious. However, all this talk of powers has a darker undercurrent than it seems, and Chae-ni's grandmother was involved long ago, putting her young granddaughter in danger. Will they be able to control their new abilities and avoid causing disasters in the process? How did these people with powers come about? What secrets does the city of Haeseong hold? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073859_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xKqwHMC41dtm2vFF6sAkQCtbKDE9Q5Y55YBda1CTn76opDzYAERBRowAHEUzbtAc5kq.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm0379138/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2) ---

>I loved this K-drama, and I already mentioned that at the beginning, but I should clarify that the first episode might seem slow to you. Even so, give it a chance, because the laughs won't stop from the second episode. However, I don't just want to say that it has comedy and is enjoyable; I feel that this series is quite good for other reasons. For example, the fact that it transports us to the 90s, especially towards the end of the decade, makes it incredibly nostalgic and works very well with the plot. The fear of the \

aligns perfectly with the identity crisis of the characters, who don't know what will happen to the world or their own lives. By the way, if you're curious like me, I suggest you look into what the Y2K bug was; you'll find it interesting. ---
>Another thing I liked about the narrative is that there's no sense of duty or desire to save the universe. The protagonists are outcasts, people considered \

or ordinary by society, and seeing how these powers don't solve their problems but instead complicate their daily lives creates brilliant comedic situations. The pacing is brisk, and while the mystery behind the accident that gave them their powers structures the plot, the true heart of the series is watching this dysfunctional \
learn to work as a team. I truly loved this aspect. ---

>Now, about the acting, I must say it was incredible. Eun-bin's acting range surprises me; no two characters are alike. Each one has its own unique touch, and Chae-ni was undoubtedly the freshest and funniest character she's ever played, demonstrating her versatility. I've always loved Cha Eun-wo, and I don't understand why he was criticized for not being an actor. Goodness, since Island, he's shown how much he's improved and that he can portray any character brilliantly. I also loved the other two actors' performances, and they clearly showed all the love they poured into this K-drama. And I can't finish without mentioning the special effects. Wow! I must say they're used in a clever and cartoonish way. There's a clear conscious use of practical effects and very comical sound editing (exaggerated bangs, wind effects when someone runs fast) that pays homage to TV shows from the end of the last century. The color palette is warm, tending towards sepia and pastel tones, which reinforces the feeling of looking at a memory or an old photograph from 1999. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074310_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xp225SWBpNX1AFHhy94jLrsyhLin2o2NmBVnJ4RfUcJ4dhfpSXaFCKQSyAEue5ict23.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm1376241922/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2) ---

> - The cast's chemistry and versatility: The contrast between Park Eun-bin's chaotic energy and Cha Eun-woo's rational rigidity works perfectly. - Excellent performances: Everyone gave memorable performances; in my opinion, each one became distinct and full of personality. - Originality in the use of powers: It's incredibly fun to see superpowers applied to everyday, absurd, and mundane situations. - Impeccable 90s nostalgia: The 1999 setting is meticulously crafted. - A light and comforting tone: By moving away from overly dark or complex plots, it becomes the ideal drama to relax and binge-watch without unnecessary stress. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074339_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmBQgnSH1pWK3A9imqepX3JkCX2C37GYx86B7Tj8aN1GGd5ivdU5Y4Pe31nEMK3C74L.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm990234882/?ref_=ttmi_mi_8_3) ---
structure: If you've seen Korean neighborhood action comedies (like The Uncanny Counter or police comedy films), the \

structure will feel quite familiar and predictable. - Modest visual effects: Those looking for impressive visuals or high-budget CGI action scenes may find the effects somewhat basic or cartoonish. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074404_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyZ9fsPEsBGGBgAqmx5dU57Hgh6tAs3hbZ15fihb12yV1eX1i3dURsCRdKoHFJN4g93.png) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm2047199490/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1) ---
>9.5/10 Story │ 10/10 Acting │ 9/10 Sound │ 10/10 Stage Design │ 9.8/10 Overall ---

>The Wonderfools isn't an otherworldly series, but it has its own unique way of showing us things. It's a reminder that the best superhero stories aren't those where entire cities are destroyed, but those where the characters use their extraordinary abilities to mend the small cracks in their own humanity. It's a nostalgic series, full of moments that were largely enjoyed in the 90s, even with its crises. ---

<div class=\

>Hoy vengo con una recomendación 10/10, realmente amé y disfruté viendo este k-drama, teníamos comedia en todo momento, intrigas, romance, risas nuevamente, de verdad que no se arrepentirán. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073630_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/EonkyaTSLTfZc3ToYhzPXWgnbZSNA9AczocAyWuBykHr1zb8F4bEDioGYvBNGVX4PcR.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm33933570/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_3) ---

>Estrenada a mediados de mayo, esta serie de solo 8 episodios fue dirigida por Yoo In-sik, escrita por Heo Da-joong y creado por Kang Eun-kyung, es de genero superhéroe, comedia y aventura de acción, protagonizada por Parque Eun-bin, Cha Eun-woo, Choi Dae-hoon, Im Seong-jae , Kim Hae-sook y Son Hyun-joo. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073743_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyNSLJGjf2k57rftH3JjhKJhjWs6v2MxRJ7R9fznaQ4saFAjRVop71ycSdLDUqN6Kgq.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm1193332226/?ref_=ttmi_mi_9_2) ---
>La historia nos transporta al año 1999, dando esa vibra nostálgica y caótica del tiempo, bajo la sombra de las teorías conspirativas y el temor al \

, donde siguen a un grupo de residentes comunes, corrientes y bastante imperfectos de un pueblo que, estos son Eun Chae-ni, a quien el pueblo la apoda como la catastrófica y quien tiene problemas de salud, Son Gyeong Hun, apodado “La pesadilla” quien es denunciante habitual del Centro de Quejas del Ayuntamiento por diversas cosas, nuestro 3 integrante de este grupo es Kang Ro-bin (el títere) un tímido empleado que trabaja en el restaurante de la abuela de la protagonista y por último, pero no menos importante, Lee Un-jeong un misterioso y reservado empleado del ayuntamiento. Su relación comienza en el momento que, tras un inesperado accidente, hace que los Chae-ni, Gyeong y Ro-bin obtenga poderes y que recurran a Un-jeong ya que el poseía el poder de la telequinesis y puede guiarlos en saber como controlar sus nuevas habilidades. ---

>A diferencia de los héroes de los cómics, estos personajes no tienen trajes perfectos ni control total sobre sus nuevas habilidades, las cuales a menudo resultan tan absurdas como divertidas. Sin embargo, todo esto de los poderes, tiene un trasfondo más oscuro de lo que aparente y que, la abuela de Chae-ni estuvo involucrada hace tiempo, por lo que esto hará que su pequeña nieta corra peligro ¿Serán capaces de controlar sus nuevas habilidades y no ocasionar desastres en el proceso? ¿Cómo surgieron estas personas con poderes? ¿Qué secretos guarda la ciudad de Haeseong? ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_073859_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xKqwHMC41dtm2vFF6sAkQCtbKDE9Q5Y55YBda1CTn76opDzYAERBRowAHEUzbtAc5kq.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm0379138/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2) ---

>Amé este kdrama y ya se lo dije en un inicio, pero debo aclarar que puede que, el primer episodio les resulte lento, aun así, denle una oportunidad, porque con el segundo episodio no pararan las risas. No obstante, no solo quiero manifestar que tendrá comedia y es disfrutable, siento que esta serie es bastante buena por otros puntos, por ejemplo, el hecho de que nos transporte a la década de los 90, sobre todo ya para finalizar esta misma, lo vuelve sumamente nostálgica y hace que funcione muy bien con la trama, el temor al \

(Y2K) se alinea perfectamente con la crisis de identidad de los personajes, quienes no saben qué pasará con el mundo ni con sus propias vidas; por cierto les sugiero, si son curiosos como yo, que investiguen que fue eso del Efecto 2000, les resultara interesante. ---
>Otra de las cosas que me gusto, en cuanto a la narrativa es que aquí no hay un llamado al deber ni un deseo de salvar el universo, los protagonistas son marginados, personas consideradas \

o corrientes por la sociedad y ver cómo estos poderes no resuelven sus vidas, sino que complican sus dinámicas cotidianas, genera situaciones cómicas brillantes. El ritmo es ágil, y aunque el misterio detrás del accidente que les dio los poderes estructura la trama, el verdadero corazón de la serie es ver a esta disfuncional \
aprender a trabajar en equipo, amé de verdad este toque. ---

>Ahora con las actuaciones, debo decir que fueron increíble, Eun-bin me sorprende su rango actoral, ningún personaje se parece a otros de los que ha trabajo, cada uno tiene su toque y Chae-ni fue sin duda el personaje más fresco y super gracioso que ha hecho, demuestra lo versátil que es. Cha eun-wo siempre me ha encantado y no entiendo porque lo criticaban con que no sabia actuar, por Dios, desde Island ha demostrado cuanto ha mejorado y que puede llevar cualquier personaje muy bien logrado; a los otros dos también amé sus actuaciones y demuestran todo el amor que le pusieron a este kdrama. Y no puedo terminar si hablar de los efectos especiales, whoaa, debo decir están utilizados de manera inteligente y caricaturesca, se nota un uso consciente de efectos prácticos y una edición de sonido muy cómica (golpes exagerados, efectos de viento cuando alguien corre rápido) que rinde homenaje a los shows de televisión de finales del siglo pasado. La paleta de colores es cálida, tirando a tonos sepia y pasteles, lo que refuerza la sensación de estar viendo un recuerdo o una vieja fotografía de 1999. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074310_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xp225SWBpNX1AFHhy94jLrsyhLin2o2NmBVnJ4RfUcJ4dhfpSXaFCKQSyAEue5ict23.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm1376241922/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2) ---

> - La química y versatilidad del elenco: El contraste entre la energía caótica de Park Eun-bin y la rigidez racional de Cha Eun-woo funciona a la perfección. - Excelentes actuaciones: todos nos dieron entregas memorables, al mi parecer, cada uno se volvió distinguible y llenas de bastante personalidad. - Originalidad en el uso de los poderes: Es sumamente divertido ver superpoderes aplicados a situaciones cotidianas, absurdas y mundanas. - Una nostalgia noventera impecable: La ambientación de 1999 está sumamente cuidada. - Un tono ligero y reconfortante: Al alejarse de las tramas excesivamente oscuras o complejas, se convierte en el drama ideal para relajarse y maratonear sin tensiones innecesarias. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074339_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23tmBQgnSH1pWK3A9imqepX3JkCX2C37GYx86B7Tj8aN1GGd5ivdU5Y4Pe31nEMK3C74L.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm990234882/?ref_=ttmi_mi_8_3) ---
: Si ya has visto comedias coreanas de acción vecinal (estilo The Uncanny Counter o películas de comedia policial), la estructura de \

te resultará bastante familiar y predecible. - Efectos visuales modestos: Quienes busquen un despliegue visual impresionante o escenas de acción con CGI de alto presupuesto pueden encontrar los efectos un tanto sencillos o caricaturescos. ---
![Opera Instantánea_2026-05-25_074404_www.imdb.com.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yaslenysofia/23xyZ9fsPEsBGGBgAqmx5dU57Hgh6tAs3hbZ15fihb12yV1eX1i3dURsCRdKoHFJN4g93.png) [Fuente](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt34440854/mediaviewer/rm2047199490/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1) ---
>9.5/10 Historia │ 10/10 Actuaciones │ 9/10 Sonido │ 10/10 Escenario │ 9.8/10 General ---

>The wonderfools no es una serie de otro mundo, pero tiene su propio estilo de mostrarnos las cosas, es un recordatorio de que las mejores historias de superhéroes no son aquellas donde se destruyen ciudades enteras, sino aquellas donde los personajes utilizan sus habilidades extraordinarias para arreglar las pequeñas grietas de su propia humanidad. Es una serie nostálgica y llena de momentos que se disfrutaron en gran medida de la década de los 90, aun con las crisis de las mismas. ---

title.title: Hardcore Townsmen! #5 Medical Supplies [ENG🇬🇧|ESP🇻🇪]
title.body:
>

Hello Hive Gamers! Today I bring you the 5th part of my hardcore journey in Townsmen. After the constant pressure of previous days, it seems the bandits have finally decided to give me a small break. Taking advantage of this rare moment of peace without raids, I decided it was the perfect time to tackle some pending administrative tasks and secure the health of my village before things go south again.

#

![](Uploading... 1779710132755.jpg)

I focused on completing one of the missions that had been sitting in my log: building a medicinal herb garden right next to the infirmary. In this eternal winter, it’s logically impossible for herbs to actually grow in the frozen soil, but the game mechanics rewarded my effort anyway. Completing this mission granted me much-needed prestige points and a solid stock of 40 units of medicinal herbs. Knowing how the market works here, I decided to sell 10 units immediately to boost my gold reserves, while keeping the remaining 30 tucked away in the warehouse just in case a sudden epidemic decides to hit my townnies.

#

On the industrial side, there is finally some good news. The wool production, which was a total mess after the previous fires and bandit raids, has finally stabilized. The flow of raw materials is constant again, and the tailor shops are working at full capacity. In fact, we’ve managed to produce enough clothes that I now have a surplus of finished garments to sell to the merchant. This is a huge relief for the village's economy, as processed goods fetch a much better price than raw wool.

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNgZaUuMcXsfo6ewFabB9L8STNTAe81utDErsug8pyD94/1779710147534.jpg)

My next big objective remains the completion of the smelter. I am eager to start manufacturing ingots, as their market value is significantly higher and could provide the financial breakthrough I need to finally upgrade the city guard and improve the quality of life for my people. Despite the iron mine crisis mentioned before, I am managing my resources to keep the construction moving. If I can get those ingots flowing, the \

might actually become a sustainable settlement. Let's hope the bandits stay away a little longer while I finalize these industrial upgrades. # ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZtpkdg8z1aSKQQWeUahXcxq4Fm5yMasYRPfLvxrLixD7/1779710166456.jpg) |
Español
| |-| ------

>

¡Hola Gamers de Hive! Hoy les traigo la 5ta parte de mi aventura hardcore en Townsmen. Tras la presión constante de los días anteriores, parece que los bandidos finalmente han decidido darme un pequeño respiro. Aprovechando este raro momento de paz sin saqueos, decidí que era el momento perfecto para atender algunas tareas administrativas pendientes y asegurar la salud de mi aldea antes de que las cosas se vuelvan a torcer.

#

Me enfoqué en completar una de las misiones que tenía acumuladas: construir un huerto de hierbas medicinales justo al lado de la enfermería. Con este clima invernal eterno, lógicamente es imposible que las hierbas crezcan en el suelo congelado, pero las mecánicas del juego recompensaron el esfuerzo de todas formas. Completar esta misión me otorgó puntos de prestigio muy necesarios y un stock sólido de 40 unidades de hierba medicinal. Sabiendo cómo funciona el mercado aquí, decidí vender 10 unidades de inmediato para aumentar mis reservas de oro, mientras que me quedé con las 30 restantes bien guardadas en el almacén en caso de que alguna epidemia repentina decida azotar a mis townnies.

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd85tffzLu5g2wa7FXoZAF4auWQwxBkv8HppV7AFh3Usb/1779710181042.jpg)

En el lado industrial, finalmente hay buenas noticias. La producción de lana, que era un desastre total tras los incendios y ataques pasados, por fin se ha regulado. El flujo de materia prima es constante nuevamente y las sastrerías están trabajando a toda máquina. De hecho, hemos logrado producir lo suficiente como para que me sobren prendas terminadas para vender al mercader. Esto es un gran alivio para la economía de la aldea, ya que los bienes procesados se pagan mucho mejor que la lana cruda.

#

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmat2M7p1wDn4WFydSGsEfHQHuj7QCpCyfpYpqpJtZNL78/1779710196388.jpg)

Mi próximo gran objetivo sigue siendo terminar la construcción de la fundición. Estoy ansioso por empezar a fabricar lingotes, ya que su valor en el mercado es significativamente más alto y podría darnos el empujón financiero que necesito para finalmente mejorar a la guardia de la ciudad y elevar la calidad de vida de mi gente. A pesar de la crisis de las minas de hierro agotadas que mencioné anteriormente, estoy gestionando los recursos para que la obra no se detenga. Si logro que los lingotes empiecen a salir, el \

podría convertirse realmente en un asentamiento sostenible. Esperemos que los bandidos se mantengan alejados un poco más mientras finalizo estas mejoras industriales. ------ ---- |

Wedding bells! I'm getting married! I'm getting married! I'm getting married! Anita announced to her friend one evening as she danced and waved her fingers about to show her friends that she has finally gotten engaged. 

\

Alia added as she rushed to the bar in one corner of the sitting room to get drinks and cups for the five, including the bride. 

They danced, gossiped, made merry, and got drunk. The celebration lasted throughout the night, and in the morning, the wedding plans and arrangements began. 

Anita went back to her fiancé's house so they could discuss one or two things about their wedding day, especially the date, venue, and dress codes. After much deliberation, Andrew, who is the groom-to-be, drove his potential bride to her home, where they departed so each could have enough time to prepare with their families.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU64cYR4o3is3Nfhia4ZyKe6i4zoHKfqUt1R33hewaG5j/1779710100745.png)
[canva](https://canva.link/4i36yyxkqiseqai)

Anita also broke the news to her family—her lovely mother, dad, and two siblings. Of course, she was the eldest and the only daughter in the family. They were so happy for her. In two months, Anita will be the latest bride.

Unfortunately, a week before their wedding, something unpredictable happened. Anita went to spend the weekend with Andrew, her soon-to-be husband. After they both had dinner, Anita went to the bathroom to shower. 

She saw Andrew's clothes littered on the bed. He must have forgotten to put his clothes in the laundry after returning home from his one-week trip. 

As she was picking up the clothes, some pieces of paper fell out. She picked them up. \

she mused as she sat on the bed to check. 

To her amazement, the papers were receipts from a popular hotel in the city, and the dates were recent—specifically from the previous week—when Andrew had told her that he was going for an official meeting that could earn him more money for their wedding.

The trip was supposed to be to Abuja, but here was a receipt showing Lagos, even a renowned place. Anita couldn't hold her anger, so she barged into the sitting room to find Andrew receiving a call and saying the words, \
to the person on the other end. \n\n\
Anita said, tears gathering in her eyes. \n\n\
Andrew begged, gesturing in a persuasive manner. \

Anita cried and left in tears. 


Her friends received her warmly and tried to cheer her up, but all to no avail.

The following day, Andrew traced her to her friend's house; the four of them lived in a flat rented by them. Andrew screamed her name for hours so she could come out and hear his side of the story, but there was no response.

 He kept going back there until one day, while standing at the door of Anita's friend's house, he said, \
He said this as a final note and was about to enter his car when Anabel opened the door. \n\nShe's Anita's best friend out of the four. \
she said and left the door open. \n\n\

\n\nI wasn't aware that the date was different. The mistake was from the hotel; they issued a receipt for the same week I paid instead of the next week. Babe, I'm so sorry; it was meant to be a surprise because I know you love the hotel,\
Who were you talking to on the phone five days ago?\

body.title: Lunes Motivacionales, con los ¡Buenos días! 25/05/2025 / Motivational Mondays . With the Good morning!
body.body:
# “disfruta el día y no confíes en el mañana”
<sup><sup>Esta frase - del poeta romano Horacio</sup></sup>
</center>

----------


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png)

<div class=\

> # Mi amanecer de todos los lunes # Hoy lunes 25 de mayo, cuarto lunes del mes, este día solo me da un motivo para agradecer, agradezco por eso y por mucho más, porque llegué, porque estoy aquí, porque respiro, doy gracias al universo y a mi vida cuántica por todo, por mi hogar, por mis hijas y por mi esposa, y por supuesto por mi familia y familiares y amigos. Mis amigos y panas, abrir los ojos en este último tramo de mayo me pone a pensar en lo rápido que nuestro tiempo pasa volando, apenas nos descuidamos un segundo y ya estamos en el cuarto lunes del mes, casi sin darnos cuenta, hemos recorrido cinco meses enteros de este año 2026 y estamos a las puertas del sexto mes, estamos prácticamente a la mitad del año, y es justo aquí que uno se toma un tiempito con café para mirar hacia atrás con el corazón lleno, ver el camino recorrido y darnos cuenta de que, a pesar de los tropezones, aquí seguimos de pie, echándole pichón y después del 3 de enero mucho más. Por eso, hoy me levanté sacudiéndome la flojera con más ganas, me recordé que a la mente hay que ganarle la partida desde tempranito, como siempre aprendí de Conny Méndez, porque si la dejas, te arma el drama con los años y te tranca el juego antes de colar el café, así que, antes de que aclare, moví el cuerpo, decreté en positivo y puse la mirada en lo bonito a pesar de que el cielo este nublado, si el año va volando, que no te quede duda de nosotros tenemos que volar con él, pero llenando el viaje de cosas buenas. Para este inicio de semana tenemos que hacer una pausa consciente en esta mitad del año que ya asoma, no dejes que la rutina te apague la chispa cuántica, porque la vida se nos va en estos segundos, así que sal hoy a la calle con la firme convicción de hacer una pequeña buena acción, súmale una sonrisa al vecino, una palabra de aliento a quien la esté pasando rudo o un detalle con tu gente, mis hijas y mi esposa son mi motor, y por ellas y por este hermoso universo, yo elijo que estos meses que faltan valgan la pena día tras día. Yo solo deseo para ti que me lees, que el universo les multiplique en salud y bendiciones cada paso que den este lunes motivacional. # Como dice el refrán… El sol no espera por nadie. Pero siempre sale para todos. Así que me levanto, tomo esta foto del cielo que no se rinde, y escribo para recordarme que aún estoy aquí. Y mientras esté aquí, hay camino. Solo dedícate a ser feliz. Encuentra tu luz, segundo a segundo. --------------- ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxUivGR4Y3wCqxfRozB4rXNKyPyhYvrwGsP2ndueh2p6/imagen.png) # My Monday Morning Sunrise

> # Today, Monday, May 25th, the fourth Monday of the month, this day gives me a reason just to be grateful. I am thankful for this and so much more—because I made it, because I am here, because I breathe. I thank the universe and my quantum life for everything: for my home, for my daughters, and for my wife, and of course, for my family, relatives, and friends. My friends and buddies, opening my eyes in this final stretch of May makes me think about how fast our time flies by. The moment we lose focus for just a second, we are already on the fourth Monday of the month. Almost without realizing it, we have traveled through five whole months of this year 2026 and find ourselves at the doorstep of the sixth month. We are practically halfway through the year, and it is right here that you take a little time with a cup of coffee to look back with a full heart, see the path traveled, and realize that, despite the stumbles, here we are, still standing, pushing forward—and even more so after January 3rd. That is why today I woke up shaking off the laziness with extra drive. I reminded myself that you have to win the game against your mind from early morning, just as I always learned from Conny Méndez. Because if you let it, it will create a whole drama over the years and block your path before you even brew the coffee. So, before dawn, I moved my body, made positive decrees, and set my eyes on the beautiful things despite the cloudy sky. If the year is flying by, have no doubt that we must fly right along with it, but filling the journey with good things. For this start of the week, we need to make a conscious pause in this mid-year that is already showing up. Do not let routine dim your quantum spark, because life slips away from us in these very seconds. So, go out to the streets today with the firm conviction to do a small good deed: share a smile with your neighbor, a word of encouragement to someone going through a rough patch, or a kind gesture for your people. My daughters and my wife are my engine, and for them and for this beautiful universe, I choose to make these remaining months worth it day after day. For you who are reading this, I only wish that the universe multiplies health and blessings into every step you take this motivational Monday. As the saying goes… The sun waits for no one. But it always rises for everyone. So I get up, take this photo of the sky that never gives up, and write to remind myself that I am still here. And as long as I am here, there is a path ahead. Just dedicate yourself to being happy. Find your light, second by second. ##### ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png) ---------- Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad ## Ahora te invito a visitar el proyecto [DRIP - WITNESS NODE - BPUD](https://inleo.io/@bradleyarrow/drip-witness-node-bpud-2a2)

body.title: Introducing Myself - Ayomide
body.body:
I've always wanted a place where I could just... exist and be seen by a community. I don't know if this is it yet, but I'm here already. That should count as something... I guess.


My name is Oluwasola Ayomide David, From Nigeria, precisely Kwara state. But I was born and raised in Abuja where I've lived most of my life.
Presently, I'm in my early 20s, figuring and building my life. Working towards and hoping for a great future.


A little background on me. 
I'm a firstborn... (hope I've got some first borns in the house 🤭.)... and like every first born knows, it's a hectic load of responsibilities, but I manage somehow.

My family... God, I really love them.
From my Dad, mum and two siblings, I'm really grateful for 
having them. We're Christians and believe in Jesus christ and his teachings. Also try to live a godly life and live right.


What I love to do.

Alot. I love to do alot of things.
Though presently I'm still facing my education, which details I'll spare for now, but I really have so many interest.

Firstly, I deeply love writing. Not just writing... I mean the kind that involves pouring your heart, soul and mind to it. I love expressing myself through words.
Over the years I've tried to build an audience on other social media platforms like Facebook which didn't work out well due to inconsistency which was cause I had phone issues at the time.

But right now, I'm building something... On Facebook. I share wonderful and mind blowing stories, the kind that makes your imaginations run wild. So if you are a lover of such... Please check out my profile... Link is on my Ecency profile.


Asides writing... I also love developing websites. Though it's a recent affection, but I've grown to love it.
Working with html, Javascript and Css to Design front ends.

Also, I'm currently working a project, Taskpay-rewards.
A platform where people can pay and create any kinds of tasks and other users complete them to get paid.
I'll share more details once I've completed.

Other little things I also spend my time on include script writing, Ai video generation and other minor things that count as hobbies.


Speaking on Hobbies...
I love to cook. Really.
Not trying to sound boastful but, I'm a really good cook... And I'm always eager to learn new dishes.
My favorite food, doesn't exist... I don't have one. Any food goes. Though sometimes in order of preferance.


I also love reading books. Novels mostly. Then educational motivational or academic literature. Anything that helps me develop my writing skills

.
And lastly, I'd say, I love mobile games.
Shhh, don't tell my mum 🤭😂
But seriously, I love them alot.

Thirdly, I want to be able to share with you all, some my writing. Either a story, or crypto related or just anything about my experiences which I really hope would connect with everyone and build  a wider audience both here and even on other social media platforms.

So that gives an idea of what I plan to post. Fiction and real-life stories, crypto related talks, Nigerian lifestyle or just what ever I love to share.




Well I guess that's about it.
I don't really have a grand plan for all these yet... I just want to write and connect and see where it goes.
And if you've read this much... Hey, I already like you.

body.title: Attending the First Day  Seminar Regarding New Revised MATATAG Curriculum
body.body:
Hello hivers in this prestigious community @hiveph. 
Hope everybody is doing fine here specially admins in this community . 

Despite of my  busy life  , I had just finding my time to make content regarding this trending revised Deped Curriculum ,which will be started this school year 2026-2027. 
There are lot of questions to ponder regarding this new curriculum . Exciting to adapt it  at the same feeling the pressure to implement it in order for it to realize. 

![1000090712.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/AKCGxmAQawPadcekU6CbhEnZDEidepuGkATnme36iVorDvPXpKxbgjbvu2qDtA3.png)

The objectives of this new curriculum is to focus on decongesting the learning contents, strengthening  the foundational competencies like reading and math  , and making the graduates more employable. This sounds pretty good to make Filipino graduates more prepared and skilled to compete for their future career . 

![1000090658.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Ep1WWArPS5TvaNMnSLCWQXoJevBjRTdDKR4MJFHH77WfotviwK9aXQP7TtVB4xcfaGQ.jpg)

![1000090659.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpXKy6KLxT9KCwGjvW8MWCX5BxpP55jwye6tDd7FwbHpPbYpmzHtHtqW8rXhNwNnrE9.jpg)

Teachers are the main factors in educating learners . Educators must be equiped everything to produce quality graduates . Educational system also need to be revised to have a clear blue print of education . One significant changes here is the reducing four quarters into trimester or 3 quarters in one school year. There are subjects being deleted from old competencies and new subject subjects entered in new competencies every semester. So there is a realignment of relevant competencies from previous to current course of study .  This school year is more on observatory period . Department of Education Secretary Sonny Angara plays an important role for this revision of curriculum to strengthen the senior high school graduates . The revision plan was started by year  2022-2023 . DEPED Order  No. 010, s. 2024 stipulates the policy guidelines and frameworks for the gradual  rollout of MATATAG CURRICULUM , which stresses on decongesting subjects and focuses on foundational skills of learners . I agree and happy for this revision of curriculum for based on my experienced in previous curriculum , the competencies are very congested and very hard to attend due to time constraint to finish it ahead of time. 

![1000090677.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Ep3dPyGs8bF1w7TH43cKZ2dQLfuyRC3zEvTjkfrbjQ9MGfTGmyETnqeFsd2gmdfat7c.jpg)

![1000090698.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EqFsWZiwmKaxfYXP2qqfPKSu7zUicVUBZcKhEEPLiKXXvXot9koN9xAgPvQ5TFgF7p4.jpg)

![1000090702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpEGoScdvUVrYhLrt4QoHFAkcwgvAfe8vLQ53kWEUjxfJTpuJ43gVpvz74rL2L1vpfJ.jpg)

During the seminar, I felt bored really and sleepy . But I told myself to focus on this seminar for I am the bridge to implement this one . 
The DEPED really gave  big budget for this seminar specially for our foods and snacks for morning and afternoon sessions and pack lunch. So, no need for us teachers to go outside to take our lunch or snacks.

![1000090686.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/23uFY5Bthr34xu1ndwYaL7zysSi5U9SdjhrafYv4zRZV8JAVcNaLP6tY6V4WYjiKDEKe8.jpg)
 

Whatever changes and revision of curriculum is nothing once the educators would not fully applied this changes. Teachers play an important role for the success of this new revision. Being resourceful and fully equiped for the new trend of education , I guess we can make more quality graduates , more confident and more equipped learners for this new education era . 

![1000090668.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpNpMM6g38owpeC2r259dxBUmh4c7SpCXtJBdb6e5ZLGRY66ppRRKPJuFfYQeKts63F.jpg)

Thanks everybody here who will be reading by content . 
Till my next blog friends . 

I used canva to edit the lead pictures and all are mine . 

God bless us all🙏

body.title: Even in the warm summer weather, cucumbers can be grown
body.body:
![1000004371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23wC1CNRuTge7GMaLdDTKDYUToNAq7ZuhCyV2dtPArXm68iTao6SQi1xLWSE9wSyKnbzR.jpg)
Cucumber growing can be difficult in hot weather but if it is done with care and preparation a good crop can be obtained. Cucumber is one of the most favourite vegetables that are cultivated in home gardens due to its versatility in use, short growth period and variety of dishes that can be made from it. Cucumbers like warm temperatures and sunlight, but too much heat can impact the growth of the plants by evaporating the soil too rapidly and causing wilting. Therefore it is essential that gardeners use correct planting methods and ensure adequate watering and shade to allow plants to weather the heat. The preparation of the soil, preparation of the seedlings, and the various stages of production from planting to picking fresh cucumbers are all important to the production of healthy plants and good quality fruit.

The first thing to consider when planting cucumbers is where the garden will be. The best environment for cucumber growth is where they can get a sufficient amount of daily sunshine. They need about 6-8 hours of sunlight every day. 

![1000004374.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23ywis9twAXLvN7RfTLsGetsVo5AMMQYB3R6H1ywWcRCfGrVEkM7rySk6oJ6UairYqiDQ.jpg)

Once the site has been chosen, the soil needs to be prepared for planting. The importance of soil preparation in gardening is one of the most paramount, since healthy soil ensures excellent plant growth. Weeds, stones, sticks, and grasses need to be removed from the soil before planting cucumber. Weeds compete with the plants for water and nutrients; they should be removed carefully. After the area is free of rocks and debris, the soil should be forked, hoed, or shovelled with a shovel to loosen it. A loose soil also permits good root development and water and nutrient uptake. Soil should also be mixed with organic matter like compost, dried leaves or manure. They are organic materials that enhance soil fertility and have moisture conserving properties, particularly in hot weather. Gardeners might also establish raised beds in parts of the garden where flooding has been a problem to allow better drainage and prevent root damage from standing water.

![1000004370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23wgBZ9mVoGQcWhJWfwravXvZLcy9rDWvtFLxpTqzE6o2PyqSA1hfrVNnJXFHbyVsuZXf.jpg)

After the soil is completely ready, the seeds of cucumber can be sown. Ideally, plantings should take place early in the morning or late in the day, when temperatures are cooler. Small holes should be dug in the soil; the size is about one inch deep, and 2-3 seeds can be dropped into each hole, to avoid the quick drying out of soil and seed under the hot sun. The seeds should be planted, lightly covered with soil and watered lightly. Spacing is also important, as each vine of cucumber will grow rapidly and become a large plant. Good air circulation which helps prevent diseases and ease the way for the plants to get sunlight will result from having enough space. Plants growing too closely together can fight for nutrients and water, leading to reduced plant growth and fruit size.

Watering is another necessity of cucumber production, particularly in the hot summer months. Since high temperatures cause water to evaporate quickly, cucumber plants need regular watering to keep the soil moist. Excessive dry soil may lead to wilting of the plants, and also lead to a bitter taste or improper growth. Water should be given early in the morning or late in the afternoon as watering in the middle of the day could cause evaporation before the plants have absorbed the water. Water the soil and not the foliage to prevent soil-borne diseases. The soil should be moist, but not too wet, as excess water can also harm the roots. It is strongly recommended to add mulch around plants during hot weather. Use dried leaves, rice straw or grass clippings as mulch. This keeps the soil cooler and drier, helps to keep soil weed free, and aids in keeping soil cooler.

Cucumber plants as they grow require support to maintain healthy vines and an organized plant. Cucumber is a vining plant, which means it will spread out on the ground when not supported. Bamboo sticks, wooden poles or trellises are frequently used by gardeners to help the vines grow. Training the cucumber vines up eliminates the need for a trellis, which will keep the cucumbers clean and prevent rot. It also increases the circulation of air around the plants and thus prevents moistures and heats causing diseases. Soft strings or cloth strips can be used for gentle support of the vines. Supporting the plants helps to make the harvesting of the cucumbers more convenient when they are ready.

![1000004373.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/arikamillan/23vhs95u713hhGMFFrCDvkJKuoVyVQN6BbYRmiEeeds83UshrvSRgvnEnV86UQU8xNKUv.jpg)

In the growing season, it is important that gardeners monitor the plants for pests and diseases on a regular basis. Insects like aphids, beetles and mites are attracted during hot weather and can cause damage to the leaves and fruits of the cucumber. Diseases can manifest as yellow leaves, holes in leaves or wilting plants. It is important for gardeners to check daily for serious damage, and to cut away infected leaves immediately. Avoiding the use of chemical pesticides, and keeping the garden clean and free of weeds will also help to reduce pests. Water spraying with mild soap or natural insect repellents can also be used to prevent pests without affecting the environment. Good garden maintenance will result in a healthy cucumber plant which is more resistant to pests and diseases.

Following good management practices, the cucumber plants will start to flower and fruit in several weeks. Typically, cucumber plants take about 40-60 days to mature after planting, depending on the variety and conditions. Avoid picking late when the fruit has grown too mature in color, shape, texture and flavor. When the cucumbers are overripe, they can turn yellow, hard and bitter. If harvesting, gardeners are advised to use scissors or a knife, to prevent damaging the vines. The fruit may be damaged or the vines broken if it is removed from the plant. You'll get more cucumbers throughout the season when you harvest the ones regularly. Cucumbers can be consumed right away, put in a salad with the rest of the harvest or sold in the market.

body.title: A Central Park with Cuban Soul (And Way More Flavor)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZMG2ufeys9b5W7FKASgx1zaUVanxptKb8j9GseWWJQum/1779575629211.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX14aVEqkWcBB9xqxHYoYTttNr65amrkrUuUZ2cQVJsdD/1779575629664.jpg)


Hey, did you know Havana has its own **Central Park**? But forget about that massive, squirrel-filled forest in New York—the one here is a completely different vibe, packed with color, history, and a ton of rhythm.
The first thing that’ll catch your eye is the **28 royal palm trees**. They have a super cool meaning: they represent the birth date of José Martí, Cuba's National Hero. (Though, just between us, we're short about four palms for a complete tribute! 😂). Still, it’s an awesome reminder of what being Cuban is all about and that endless journey toward freedom.
As you stroll around, you'll run right into the statue of Martí himself, surrounded by buildings that will honestly blow your mind. Right next to you, you've got the spectacular **Gran Teatro de La Habana** and the iconic **Hotel Inglaterra**. That’s why the park is always buzzing; locals and tourists absolutely love hanging out here.
But beyond the photo-ops and the history, the absolute best part of Central Park is its **incredible vibe**. It’s the perfect meeting spot to sit down for a chat, catch some live music, people-watch, and just soak up the island's energy. Long story short: it’s the beating heart of Havana—a warm, welcoming place that hooks you right away and definitely gives New York a run for its money.

body.title: Protective Measures
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFtp1cTxBDTMWfu3Unw9mqHVfySUnaSQgLmU7gq9kipc/1779702464844.jpg)


 Staying safe online has become very important because scammers now use different tricks to deceive innocent people. Infact they are improving in their tactics of deceit every day, and it's painful that many people are falling victim to them through their fake links, hacked accounts, and fake online businesses. They will send fake links that can hack ones phone, or steal ones personal information once they click on them. 

Other scammers will promise people quick money and ask them to pay a certain amount before receiving double in return, but after payment, the scammers disappear with the money. There are also fake online sellers who advertise attractive products online, but once payment is made, they either deliver a completely different item or fail to deliver anything at all. Ponsy schemes are also there with their different methods of deceit. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUBWa2925XdBY9t8qf6ixJGZpbb7WgXi23co1BRsLP7vf/1779702744319.jpg)

I have faced online scams before, expecially from fake online sellers. On different occasions, I received products that were completely different from what I ordered. On two different occasions, scammers collected my money and never delivered anything. Ponsy schemes has also shown me 99.1

Sincerely speaking, all forms of online scams are dangerous because they can destroy lives financially and emotionally. I remember hearing about a man who clicked on a fraudulent link and was convinced to invest a huge amount of money, promising to double the money. The man had earlier borrowed money from a microfinance bank for his business, he invested the money into the sole called business. After paying the money, he later discovered that he had been scammed. When he went to the address given to him by the scammers, the place was locked up and abandoned. The shock was too much for him, and he collapsed. And that was the end. That's the damage online scammers can cause. 

What steps have I taken to stay safe from online scammers? I have potected myself from online scammers by avoiding unknown links and suspicious websites. I do not click on random messages or links sent by strangers. I also prefer payment on delivery whenever I want to buy products online because it is safer than paying before seeing the product. Another important step is avoiding greed. Many scammers succeed because people are tempted by offers that seem too good to be true. I mean they want to earn where they did not work, so if people learn to be careful and patient, they will avoid many online scams. 

 My advice to others is simple, be careful, be content with what you have and don't be greedy, don't click on unknown links, don't share personal information carelessly, avoid those offers that promise quick money. Buy only from trusted online sellers. 
The pictures are mine.

body.title: Demutskrankheit. Ich kann an meinen Fingernaegeln sehen vor allem dem rechtem Daumen, das es mir seit Wochen gesundheitlich Besser gehen muss!!! :-)
body.body: Das hat mich gerade sehr Gefreut, normalerweise, ist mein rechter Daumenfingernagel, kein schoener Anblick, denn man sieht den chronischen Vitaminmangel in Form haesslich groeßer Rillen, die ja, auch Schmerzen, zeitweilig weil sich dadurch der Fingernagel verformt und eben auf das Nagelbett drueckt.\n\nDurch diesen Schmerz habe ich mir den gerade nochmal angesehen und das ist wie mit Jahresringen bei einem Baum, da sieht man, eine definitv, viel viel glattere Oeberflaeche, also fast schon \

zu der Spitze hin nach vorne nachwachsen.

Das ist fuer mich Paradox zu verstehen, weil meine Ernaehrung, sich eher wieder verschlechtert hat in der aktuellen Lage.

Da muss also auch mit dem Gesammthaushalt meines Koerpers zusammenhaengen, der sich ja seit meiner Eigentherapie immer weiter veraendert.

Ins Gute.

Ich fuehle mich Wohler, als sonst, meine Kreislaufprobleme, werden weniger.

Das merke ich ganz eindeutig, also das mir weniger Oft schwindelig ist.

Ich denke also, das ich durch die Losloesung der Verstopfung meiner Nasennebenhoele, obwohl ja die Verstopfung noch drinnen ist und ich die auf keinen Fall nochmal operieren lassen will nach meinen Erkenntnissen, die Aktivitaet des Fasziennetzwerkes in meinem Koerper trotzdem schon erhoehen koennte.

Mir laeuft zwar nicht die Nase, aber ich rotze mehr rum als gewoehnlich und zu meinem Erstaunen, ist auch bisheriger Pollenflug, der mich jedes Jahr in die Apotheke treibt, nichtmal aufgefallen bisher. 

Ich denke also das die Dinge hier weit groeßer und effektiver zusammenhaengen, als ich mich wirklich trauen wuerde festzulegen. Noch. :-)

Weil beweisen kann ich nur einen kleinen Teil meiner Therapie bisher und das ist nun mal was ich schon aufgeschrieben habe.

Das mit den Naegeln, kann ich viel viel schlechter Beweisen, freut mich aber.

Es motiviert mich, am Ball zu bleiben, denn auch ich vergesse meine eigene Heilung immer wider im leider derzeit nicht normalem \

und muss immer wieder von Vorne anfangen sie aktive zu starten mit meiner Demutshaltung und der Bewegung.

Ich moechte das alles einfach nur Dokumentiert haben und auch zugaenglich gemacht haben, damit sich vielleicht die Profis damit beschaeftien, wenn ich nicht in der Lage dazu sein sollte.

Ich kann es also nur behaupten! nicht sicher sagen, das ich die Ergebnisse sogar daran sehen kann.

Mein Darm hat sich auch beruhigt, ich mache wieder halbwegs sowas wie eine normalen Stuhlgang! 

Das ist auch Besonders auffaellig.

Naja ich hoffe das war jetzt nicht zu ekelig.^^

Beste Wuensche

Alucian

body.title: Streamers, Subpoenas, and a Government That Sees Dissent as a Threat
body.body:
![Screenshot 2026-05-25 at 7.31.04 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/EoGvvDKZTTZJ62v7TDnWRbgG1gzKyPp2ccxsW2pLf4JDpsW5FgKGztygsaukHWY2Voc.png)

The recent news that Hasan Piker one of the most prominent political streamers has been subpoenaed by federal authorities over a humanitarian aid trip to Cuba should set off alarms far beyond internet culture. What might look like just another online controversy is, in reality, a window into how the current Trump administration is wielding state power and against whom.

According to reporting, Piker joined a March 2026 aid convoy organized by anti-war group CodePink, delivering humanitarian supplies to Cuba amid a worsening economic and fuel crisis tied to renewed U.S. restrictions. Now, the U.S. Treasury Department’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is investigating whether that trip violated sanctions laws, issuing subpoenas to Piker and others involved. At the center of the case is a legal gray zone. While U.S. sanctions on Cuba restrict financial transactions and exports, there are explicit exceptions for humanitarian aid, education, and journalism.


![Screenshot 2026-05-25 at 7.30.03 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/244KZs387cAqeregnhDLTLp2zhSBYbuUSStuByz12jxgFPUVWp6MrVP2xL8y9i8n7cV1A.png)


That distinction matters because it raises a fundamental question.
Is this really about enforcing the law, or about sending a message? This isn’t the first time Piker has found himself in the crosshairs of federal authorities. In 2025, he was detained and questioned at an airport, reportedly about his political views including his opinions on Trump. Taken together, these incidents begin to look less like routine enforcement and more like a pattern were a government increasingly comfortable targeting outspoken critics.


![Screenshot 2026-05-25 at 7.30.11 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cryptictruth/23wWwK8oJpWhV3caWtLwm2qBxM1c3Q7Y5proDugDJnfDR5JVLrg3iyucfK7wuvSWRfTwn.png)

Piker isn’t a fringe figure. He represents a growing class of digital commentators who reach millions especially younger Americans outside traditional media structures like myself. Subpoenaing people for delivering aid, medicine, food, basic supplies to civilians in crisis crosses a line for me. Even if the administration argues it’s enforcing sanctions, the optics are unavoidable. The same policy framework that restricts Cuba’s access to fuel and goods has been widely criticized internationally for contributing to humanitarian strain. So when individuals attempt to fill that gap and are met with legal threats it raises a deeper contradiction. The U.S. claims to support human rights, but penalizes those attempting to provide relief...

body.title: Iroha Karuta 21: Adding Insult to Injury
body.body:
![IrohaNa3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hirohurl/23wqnMgKhaALK9hemg6Jk59jVqnQaMHJZNcw7YK44v6ZCrcooYpi35cPW6kShFnKECn9z.jpg)

The twenty-first syllable in the iroha hiragana sequence is *na* (な), represented in both of my two iroha karuta sets by the same proverb:

> 泣き面に蜂
> *Naki tsura ni hachi*

or, in fuller form:

> 泣き面に蜂が刺す
> *Naki tsura ni hachi ga sasu*

Literally:

> “A bee stings a crying face.”

The proverb refers to a situation in which somebody already suffering receives yet another blow. In English we might say:

> “When it rains, it pours.”

or

> “Adding insult to injury.”

But the Japanese expression is far more vivid and memorable than its English equivalents. Rather than speaking abstractly about bad fortune, it gives us a concrete little scene of almost comic cruelty: somebody already in tears suddenly gets stung in the face by a bee.

## Breaking Down the Expression

Okay, let's look at the proverb bit by bit.

### なき= 泣き = naki

From the verb:

> 泣く (*naku*) — “to cry,” “to weep.”

Here, *naki* means “crying” or “tearful.”

This is not abstract sadness but visible distress.

### つら = 面 = tsura

\

literally means “face,” but is rougher and more earthy than the more neutral Japanese word *kao* (顔). It can mean something closer to “mug” in English.

So *naki tsura* is more like:

> “a blubbering mug.”

Some dictionaries and modern renderings write the expression as:

> 泣きっ面 (*nakittsura*)

with a small っ producing a stressed pronunciation of \

. Interestingly, however, neither of my card sets uses the small っ.

The higher-quality Angel™ iroha set writes the proverb in all hiragana without the contraction, while the Daiso version also avoids the small っ and abbreviates the proverb.

That difference is revealing. The contracted version, *nakittsura*, feels more colloquial and emotionally forceful, whereas *naki tsura* appears cleaner and more classical.

### に = *ni*

The particle indicating direction or target.

The misfortune is happening *to* the crying face.

### はち = 蜂 = *hachi*

Usually translated as “bee” though in Japanese it can also refer more broadly to stinging insects.

### が = *ga*

This is the subject marker. The bee is the subject of the proverb, something to keep in mind when translating it into English.

### さす 刺す = *sasu*

This sharp physical verb means “to sting” or “to pierce.”

Taken together, the full proverb paints a painfully vivid image of somebody already crying getting stung in the face by a bee.

## Two Card Sets, Two Interpretations

My two iroha karuta sets interpret the proverb visually, but in completely different ways.

The Angel™ card, with its green border, takes a subtle, atmospheric yet literal approach.

![IrohaNa1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hirohurl/23xpCdhTfTMowzXSFT2GTJ9S9etyzHUv4C9BN2ZqqQCwzmWQiZJyN9DHEY6QyKif2TgDE.jpg)

The illustration shows a man — or perhaps an older boy — crying because his straw sandal has broken. Hovering ominously above him is a large insect which, to my eyes, looks more like a horsefly than a bee.

The image captures the *moment before* the second misfortune arrives. The blubbering boy is about to be stung. 

The broken straw sandal already tells a story of hardship, inconvenience, or vulnerability. Straw sandals evoke travel, poverty, fatigue, and old roads. Then comes the hovering insect, a threat descending upon somebody already distressed.

## The Daiso Cartoon Version

The cheap and cheerful Daiso card takes a completely different approach and embraces full cartoonish chaos.

![IrohaNa2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hirohurl/243BedR27ZzMsfUhQoZs1mhf8cogkiDqTu5TFSBaRrHoGk8wPhNemSwmrD3xkhSAXKhcP.jpg)

Here, a young boy is already crying because a savage little dog is biting his leg, while at precisely the same moment a flowerpot is falling toward his head.

The bee has disappeared entirely. The artist has freed himself from a literal interpretation and allowed his imagination to run riot, and in doing so seems to capture the visceral impact of the proverb.

## My Translation

Given all that, here's my considered translation of the proverb:

> **The bee stings the crybaby in the face.**

- As I mentioned, the subject of the sentence is \

so it makes sense to begin with the bee in English.

- The ten hiragana characters of the original are represented by the ten syllables of my translation. 

- The phrase \
better conveys the idea of someone who is apt to \
since the function of the proverb is to decry crying in favour of the good old Japanese spirit of \

- enduring troubles without complaining.

- I went with direct articles (The... the...) rather than indirect articles to give the proverb more immediacy in the spirit of English proverbs such as,

> **The** early bird catches **the** worm.

and

> **The** pen is mightier than **the** sword.

## Chatgpt versus Google Translate

I gave Chatgpt the kotowaza and instructed it to give its best translation, just ONE translation without any notes or alternatives, and it gave me this dynamic equivalent:

> “Trouble comes on top of trouble.”

When I put the hiragana version - なきつらにはちがさす - into Google translate it gave me gobbledigook, as it did when I put in the romaji version - naki tsura ni hachi ga sasu. It interprested \

. 

However, when I gave it the full Japanese version using kanji - Chinese characters - with hiragana, then it gave me a satisfactory literal translation:

> A bee stings a tearful face.

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 8.20.26 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hirohurl/23u6Z4b1jheNmt45ZGbwSB6CczQFAFvyKHMQhob7C18wbcbaBFcGKdTx1gNDwQeDJUxku.png)

Google translate went for the indirect article each time - a random bee stings a random tearful face - so a slightly slacker translation than mine, if I may say so, but a good literal translation, and better than Chatgpt's vague dynamic equivalent.

So Google Translate beats Chatgpt this time! 

Cheers!

DH
