body.title: The Best Laid Plans...
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wgFUEvHUBDjU47WpcGxNWXGJTMVxw1isYvDtUk4hfyqBvt9JrX8tULxYeA53MSVALN4.png)</center>

--------------------------------

Last week was one of those weeks were virtually nothing seemed to go right.  In between the minor inconveniences, there were a couple major issues, and at the end of it all I was really looking forward to just get away over the long holiday weekend and relax.  It started off on Monday when @mrsbozz and I got home from work and she realized that she had left her purse in her office back at work (30 minutes away).  It wasn't a huge deal, but she kind of needed her keys and license since we were supposed to drive separately to work the next day. 

I'll be honest, I am human and I wasn't the most gracious, but I did get in my truck and drive back up to work to pick it up for her.  Only one problem... There was a massive storm cell bearing down on our area and while I was initially thankful to be home ahead of it, it quickly turned into me driving pretty much right through the middle of it.  Thankfully, when I went back up I took the truck so I didn't have to worry about getting blown off the road.

It was intense to say the least.  I was cruising down the expressway on my way home when suddenly from the West you could just see a wall of rain, dirt, and debris heading into our path.  The torrential rain hit, and I quickly exited the expressway thinking the back roads might be safer.  Of course I got stuck behind every single person driving 5 mph on the back roads.  I got flipped off more than once as I passed them, and if I am being honesty, I likely deserved it.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xouoaJvfq2JszR1eWEqwqERm3nZcmPofHjwq49uYay4V1UuqXJL2JjuUGz6rMWa1fiH.png)</center>

--------------------------------------

So Monday was an unexpected late night.  Then, on Tuesday, I had to go take care of a computer issue at a clients business.  I hadn't been looking forward to it, but I was able to get his problem taken are of in about fifteen minutes which was a pleasant surprise for me.  Then he said oh, I have a list of other stuff for you to look at.  No big deal, I will do what I can.  He was having an issue that prompted me to update the BIOS on his laptop.  Little did I know, if you update the BIOS on a computer that has BitLocker enabled, it is going to ask for the recovery key. 

Also little did I know, he hadn't backed up the recovery key anywhere.  So after sitting there for an hour trying to figure out how to tell the guy his last two months of data were basically lost, I finally did a complete restore of the laptop and started from scratch reinstalling everything.

Of course it took something like four hours to get him sort of back to normal.  Four hours that I didn't feel right charging him for since it was kind of my fault the data was lost in the first place.  Now I know to check BitLocker before doing a BIOS upgrade and if BitLocker is enabled to make sure there is a recovery key!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23ywqErLbZT8SHTd5uWqta7vCqbLAvxAza1USYFFBZtqQCwXgJFgdnLBAscLttCWjY91z.png)</center>

-----------------------------

So Tuesday was a much later night than Monday.  Then on Wednesday, I had to go back yet again to do even more work on his laptop at which point I just disabled BitLocker all together because it was causing more problems than it was worth.  I still have to go back at some other point in the future, but I pushed it until after this long holiday weekend.  After I finished up that on Wednesday we had to go to @mrsbozz's parents old house that they are getting ready to sell and do some more work there. 

Another late night.

Mind you, we planned on camping this past weekend and I still had a ton of stuff I had to go with the trailer to get it ready for us to leave on Friday. Finally, Thursday night I was able to get those things accomplished.  We headed off to the campground after work on Friday, and it has been nothing but cold and rain the majority of the time we have been here.  On top of that, I seem to have picked up a Spring cold and I have been pretty miserable between the coughing, runny nose, and sneezing!

Don't get me wrong, we have squeezed out some enjoyable times, but if we were going to just sit in out of the rain and read or watch TV, we could totally be doing that at home.  

I shouldn't complain though, in our many years of camping, we have gotten pretty lucky as far as weather goes.  The rainy days have been far fewer than the sunny days, and I know this summer season has a lot of sunny days in store for us.  


I guess I should just be happy the trailer isn't leaking.... At least that I know of!

body.title: ARE WE FINANCIALLY RESPONSIBLE TO OTHER PEOPLE?
body.body:
The bible teaches us to love and care for those who are suffering and not able to afford the things of life most especially food, clothes and water. God encourages generosity and kindness because helping others reflects His love. In the early church, Christians shared what they had so that no one lacked necessities. This shows that supporting others financially when possible is part of living a godly life.

However, the Bible also teaches wisdom and personal responsibility. Helping others does not mean encouraging laziness or irresponsibility. 

*2 Thessalonians 3:10, Paul said, “If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat.”*

Christians are encouraged to work hard, provide for their families, and help others from a willing heart, not by force or pressure.

body.body:
Con la esperanza hay una posible rara paradoja: se necesita suficiente de ella para que la vida sea vivible, pero demasiada de ella en causas perdidas hace que la vida sea una tortura.

Tomando el viejo mito griego, hay que recordar que en la caja de Pandora estaban toda clase de demonios, pero el que estaba encadenado al fondo (y no pudo escapar junto a los demás) fue el que hizo el pacto de cazar a los demás para ganar su libertad. El nombre de esa criatura que serviría a los humanos y traicionaría a su propia raza era Esperanza.

Sin esperanza, todos los eventos negativos del mundo nos parecerán barreras impasables, y la depresión es una cosa constante. Así que, por pura supervivencia y un mínimo de salud mental, necesitamos mantener la esperanza en que las cosas futuras siempre podemos hacerlas mejorar.

Lo paradójico viene de que si se tiene una esperanza vana en una mejora que es descabellada o imposible por definición, entonces es simple ceguera y locura, que nos empuja a un infierno autoinducido que solo llenará cada día de dolor. Es como el caso que recuerdo de una pareja con problemas de violencia; la víctima siempre mantuvo la esperanza ciega y loca de que su pareja iba a cambiar y que podrían ser felices... En fin, el desenlace de esa situación fue fatal y digno de una crónica roja policial en la sección de Sucesos de un periódico.

Toca entonces recordar que hay necesidad de una esperanza con los pies en tierra, que nos sirva de guía para trabajar y avanzar en pos de una meta, pero sin cegarnos a las cosas de la realidad que puedan contradecir aquello que tenemos esperanza de lograr. Si toca aceptar que la meta no es posible con lo que tenemos a mano o que simplemente estamos persiguiendo un espejismo, toca aprender a rendirse y dejar atrás toda inútil esperanza en esa meta, para buscar la propia supervivencia.

body.title: Beautiful Mountainous Area.
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYaEp489qHdpdCrgNwunoZZvi2ciVYL8rMmEC1QbTFinG/1_1.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. My favorite subject for posting in the Photography Lovers Community is natural scenery. In which I have presented the high mountains of Ladakh and its beauty today. The photograph presented above beautifully depicts the serene and majestic beauty of the mountainous region of Ladakh. Located in the northern part of India, the land of Ladakh is famous for its high mountains, deep valleys, rocky landscapes and peaceful atmosphere. Which is also evident in the first photograph above. In this photograph, a vast valley surrounded by high barren mountains can be seen under a cloudy sky. A narrow river can also be seen flowing peacefully through the valley from between the mountains. This river adds life and beauty to the harsh terrain.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbENvUomSBYH6oAMvzaG2yY8FGmP9SDmSXKAutP5HcGCX/2_2.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmccPPvbpV1tLix9TCy2Z4joHjSeF1HzGobEiSnkDR7Rh8/3_3.jpg)

As Ladakh is famous for its mountains, its roads also describe the beauty of this place well. In the first photograph, a winding road passing through the mountains can be seen. This photograph depicts the captivating beauty of the winding mountain roads of Ladakh. As can be seen in this photograph, the narrow road passing through the dry and rocky mountains makes sharp turns. Surrounded by towering cliffs, barren slopes and tranquil valleys, the road looks like a long ribbon carefully woven along the mountainside. This beautiful scene reflects both the ruggedness and charm of Ladakh, one of India's most unique mountain regions.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekpfTRZmpu6eTJ2Z3uzNqZWiRJVoNnfigCNaepuyRMtU/4_4.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXezmEK9TRm5UFbE99pDNMePStiJ3gLTZBMjmNygfiu25/5_5.jpg)

Ladakh is also often called the land of high roads because it is surrounded by some of the highest mountain ranges in the world. One similarity in the above photograph is that this region is dry. You will not see any trees for a long distance. The mountains here have rough surfaces, sharp edges and various shades of brown, gray and golden colors. The sunlight falling on some parts of these mountains makes them shine brightly. While the shadows on some parts of the mountains create depth and mystery.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRJVzsErp2AxzeeBqJ9LwytSAeCk69nycZUjnaaPZdEzc/6_6.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmauDnCsVph7tUN4W7ToUC6ph6jqNkHiZ7QTmxvpLUwrqg/7_7.jpg)

One of the striking features of the photograph presented here above is the vast open sky of this region which is filled with thick clouds. The cloudy atmosphere gives a dramatic and peaceful look to the entire landscape. Being a mountainous region in Ladakh, the weather here changes rapidly. Sometimes the mountains shine under the bright sunlight. And in a few moments, dark clouds cover the sky. This changing weather makes the scenery more attractive for tourists and photographers. As seen in the second photograph above, the winding river flowing through the valley looks small from such a height. But it plays a very important role in the life of Ladakh.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMrvx4m8sNnxSG8ubGcTEV9TnEQw5Ac2SDLCJRjtX2at/8_8.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaZF9zpGzbWFMdx4yvbGk5N2zSxXq6cN6SB2Zhd3e5txi/9_9.jpg)

Both the photographs above show the untouched beauty of nature. There are no big buildings, busy roads or crowds of people in these photographs. Everything here looks calm and natural. This kind of serene atmosphere makes Ladakh a perfect place for people who love adventure and nature. Visitors often feel a deep connection with nature while standing among these mighty mountains. Traveling through these mountains is not always easy due to the altitude, cold weather, and rugged roads. But such challenges make the journey more memorable and adventurous.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf9htYso3byStztMx55PGhfXFeFqLbnQznJmGYkT21BRM/10_10.jpg)


As seen in the photograph above, the serenity of the mountains and the endless expanses of nature give peace to the mind. Seeing the views of the high peaks and deep valleys, one realizes how vast and powerful nature really is. In each of the photographs presented here, the mountains stand proudly like guardians of the land. As seen in each of these photographs, the clouds slowly move over the mountains. Which creates a picture that almost seems like a dream.

Each of the photographs presented here presents the magnificent and wonderful landscape of the mountainous region of Ladakh. The towering rocky mountains, winding river, dramatic clouds, and peaceful atmosphere seen in each of these photographs combine to create a scene of extraordinary natural beauty. Anyone who visits this region carries memories of its breathtaking views in their hearts forever.

I hope you liked my today's post on Beauty of the Mountains. I will end today's post here.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

body.title: National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN
body.body:
>
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-110-img_20260517_101830059-jpg)
So... my first ever trip to Taiwan! And thankfully, the powers that be behaved themselves and no funny global superpower business happened whilst I was there... ... and this modern looking building was the venue for the second concert of my little trip. But I'm posting it first... and it is a more Western looking building than the other place... and more recent. And in some ways... a little bit disappointing, as it could be a cultural centre in any city on Earth... a touch generic... and as one of my fellow musicians pointed out... a concrete hellhole... especially with the hot and humid weather!
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-703-img_20260517_102303066-jpg)
... but on the inside, nicely air-conditioned... and as usual with these multi stage venues... a complete rabbit warren of featureless identical looking corridors to get lost in! Thankfully, it was a good deal less maze-like than other places that I've been in and there was a pretty clear artery corridor that was easy to recognise and navigate!
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-642-img_20260517_102532409-jpg)
And so, one of the smaller concert halls... and quite a nice one, with comfortable raked seating for the audience...
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-784-img_20260517_102556381-jpg)
... and a really decent stage with great acoustic feeling.. and adjustable acoustic panels as well! A really really nice place to play in!
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-690-img_20260517_173129765-jpg)
What was quite unusual though... was that the place seemed to attract quite a decent little crowd in the evenings... nothing to do with anything else that was happening... and that this outdoor terrace area had a piano whose sound would bounce all around and then out into the open air! A really nice touch...
![National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts-Weiwuying: TAIWAN.jpg](https://img.travelfeed.io/bengy%2F2026-05-25-11-05-172-img_20260517_192528320-jpg)
... and it does look significantly better at night than in the stark light of the daytime!
View this post
>on TravelFeed for the best experience.\n\n[//]:# (!pinmapple 22.62379 lat 120.335187 long d3scr)

body.body: > Hola querida comunidad de @Topfivefamily un gusto participar en este nuevo [Concurso](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6) en esta ocasión de peluches. --- ![peluches.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/Eo8Tio46hy22URVVaqVzmKSKvGdDUh8D719ZfisEYm5q6qGRvam8CaNFT29tAiTFrAP.png) **IMAGEN PROPIEDAD DE @lanzjoseg** ---

>Un regalo especial, hay detalles que pueden causar mucha alegría, como un peluche, aunque creemos que siendo niños es el momento en el que más nos encanta este tipo de detalles, también aunque ya estemos grande un peluche es bien recibido, recuerdo que pequeña no me daban mucho por la alergia que tenía que alejarme de cosas peluditas, pero ya luego del control que me hicieron añoraba mucho tener peluches conmigo y dormir con ellos, así que cuando cumplí 15 años me regalaron uno grande, uno tipo perrito a quien llame Sammy, me encantaba, para dormir súper cómodo, un regalo muy especial para una época también especial, un lindo detalle que realmente no esperaba pero que me dio mucha alegría recibir, mis padres se esmeraron mucho en ello. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

>Los peluches entre su variedad, colores, formar y manera en que lo quieres dar se vuelven un compañero en las noches, para abrazar, sentirte acompañada y bien por el detalle que te dieron, un regalo que se vuelve con el tiempo importante porque cada vez que vez otro diferente lo quieres tener, un estante completo de puros peluches jeje, que no solo te acompañan sino que decoran el lugar, aunque se piense que pueda ser solo para niños, a la final también sirven a cualquier edad, se vuelve especial y duradero. Los peluches que he tenido desde pequeña aun los conservo conmigo, algunos hasta he prestado a mi hijo para jugar, a él también le gustan, se acuesta encima de ellos, se siente tranquilo a su lado. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png) **Invito a @yaslenysofia a participar.** ---

> Hello, dear @Topfivefamily community—it’s a pleasure to participate in this new [Contest](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6) this time, stuffed animals. --- ![peluches.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/Eo8Tio46hy22URVVaqVzmKSKvGdDUh8D719ZfisEYm5q6qGRvam8CaNFT29tAiTFrAP.png) **IMAGE COURTESY OF @lanzjoseg** ---

>A special gift—there are little things that can bring so much joy, like a stuffed animal. Even though we tend to think that childhood is when we love these kinds of gifts the most, a stuffed animal is still always welcome even when we’re older. I remember that when I was little, I didn’t get many because of my allergies—I had to stay away from fuzzy things—but after I got checked out, I really missed having stuffed animals around and sleeping with them. so when I turned 15, they gave me a big one—a puppy-type stuffed animal I named Sammy. I loved it; it was so comfortable to sleep with. It was a very special gift for a special time in my life—a lovely gesture I really didn’t expect but that brought me so much joy to receive. My parents put a lot of thought into it. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png)

>With their variety, colors, shapes, and the way you choose to give them, stuffed animals become a nighttime companion—something to hug, to feel comforted by, and to appreciate the thoughtfulness behind the gift. It’s a present that grows more meaningful over time because every time you see a different one, you want to have it—a whole shelf full of stuffed animals, haha. not only do they keep you company but they also decorate the space. Although people might think they’re just for kids, in the end they’re for all ages—they become special and last a lifetime. I still have the stuffed animals I’ve had since I was little; I’ve even lent some to my son to play with. He likes them too—he lies down on top of them and feels calm by their side. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFbk2yZR1qEQdWzZQRw3aYmGgaGHoHoW1ZG74EuwfFmqRefi6zpGzN.png) **I invite @yaslenysofia to join us.** ---

body.title: 签合同-圆满达成
body.body:
昨天下午的时候在香周路冰山集团的产业园那里想去看看有个亚洲地理映像展，结果到了之后被告知展区正在装修，暂时只有一小部分接待，而且还需要门票，一想算了，只是一小部分，不太划算，于是就没看成。 

出来的时候看到了一个大牌子上面写着“幸福都是奋斗出来的！” 这个牌子说的好，的确如此，我们每个人的幸福不都是自己奋斗出来的吗？至理名言啊！
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPYSGMHmDWfp7SY5AGzxpo9LACqa6F5SPbaLvZyCeeb1b/_.jpg)


在一条街道上看到了一个团队的小孩，大约小学刚上学的年纪，在训练跑步，一组一组的进行，跑完了孩子们原地休息，正在跑的小孩努力的训练着，看到孩子们精力旺盛，积极参与的样子感觉真好！我觉得小孩子们从小就该接受一些正规的训练，这对他们将来的成长都至关重要。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdsyxoLUzBsEkNgy2WebuBQchmvqZEDkUi19vjm7tLSm6/_.jpg)

这个时候，手机的微信响了，是租房的小王，她问我晚上有没有时间，如果可以的话，可以到老房子那里，她带着儿子看看，如果孩子满意的话，就签合同。我说可以啊，于是便急急忙忙的往家走，同时也告诉老头子准备好一起过去。 

我们到的时候，小王已经带着儿子在家门口等着了，我们爬上了楼，孩子看了看房间，没说什么，后来我听到他跟妈妈小声嘀咕了一下，意思是房子是不是有点旧了，他还是喜欢新装修的那种大理石地面的房间。 

不过她妈妈跟他解释说首先这个房子离他的学校比较近，走走5分钟就到了，特别方便，其次这个房子的面积大，比看到的那些都能宽敞些，最最主要的原因还是这个房子的出租价格很便宜，起码要比其他的那些便宜了400 元不止呢！孩子听后不出声，也就默认了。 

其实我的心理也一直在做斗争，对我来说这个价格租出去已经到了底价了，用妹妹的话说就是城里的房子，租了个农村房子的价格。 哎，但是也是没办法，房客少，她还将自己的情况反复跟我商量，让我价格上再优惠，我也只能咬牙同意了。 

我跟她说，可能这就是缘分吧，这个价格估计是第一次也是最后一次，毕竟我还要交暖气费，物业费，去掉这些也没剩多少钱了。 

然后我和老头子还将房间里的水电燃气挨个又检查了一遍，有点问题的又都重新整了一遍，还将房间清扫了一遍，最后将钥匙给她。将合同拿出来，双方坐下来将合同签完，这个事儿就这样定完了。 

合同的细节又重新敲定了一下，其中起止日期又给她延长了一个星期，也就是现在是五月末，计费是从6月份开始，我感觉自己又被扒了一层，但是既然已经答应，也只能这样了，如果她能善待我的房子，不是像上一个租户那样霍霍房子，我觉得就是幸运了。 

一个女同志带着一个孩子，我想总不至于不会收拾，更何况看起来她还挺干练的，应该没问题。她也保证不会违反合同上的规定，一定会好好照看房子的。 

签完合同之后，她和孩子离开了，我和老头子又将厨房的插排抽油烟机重新安装和清理了一下，其实这个动作是多余的，因为插排老头子已经按完了，但是觉得更美观一下，又重新整了一下，这次贴合在厨房台面上更加美观一些。 
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXcEB7LKX65qTMhWAnQeuKvtMiAYKrs8Z591fE4DUKYcH/_.png)


而我则将抽油烟机的过滤网换了，外面又擦了一遍，觉得彻底干净之后，也才停下。 小王也很感谢，说这样她就省了找人清理的钱，她白天上班没有时间，她想着实在不行就请个钟点工打扫一下。没想到我给她做了一下保洁，所以对我说能够租到这个房子也是她的运气。

其实我的内心还是有很多的不舍，毕竟自己在这住了那么多年，如果不能碰到善待房子的人，我觉得自己会很难受，而我现在做这些，其实很大程度上也是让她知道，自己住的地方，好好收拾一下，心情也会很好，虽然房子旧了一些，但只要干净整洁，住着就舒服。 

合同签完了，先签一年的，又将里面的款项都敲定了一下，这件事情就算完美收官了，小王是这个房子的第三任住户，希望她能好好的，在这里住的舒心，也希望我们都多做好事儿，好人一生平安！

Understanding how a portfolio works and why it’s important can be incredibly valuable. This is absolutely true for many valid reasons. Now, I’m at a point where I want to manage things in a much smarter way.

## All of this is incredible

Understanding why we can find exact results can be something that changes the way we see things, and I understand that many people don’t see it that way. For now, I believe I’m right, even though many of you may not see the difference.

A reliable company focuses mainly on motorcycle expeditions instead of regular sightseeing tours. Experienced Motorcycle Tour Operators in India understand the expectations of riders far better than general travel companies.

body.title: [Eng/Indo] May Musings | Is Ethereum Looking for a New Vibe?
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXkS1kxUMupaZ49Geq6gYnCwqrx2UpTheLRdA3ByKt5g6/1000009453.png 


May 2026 has been a pretty wild ride for us, especially if you’re holding Ethereum (ETH). If you take a look at the daily charts, you can tell that ETH is going through a bit of a rough patch.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPGDqYbnH39UmmxVTfy2uX1LJ6WpLo7JQjdhiyPtidtXk/1000009424.jpg 

*Caption: Here’s the chart showing that Supply wall and the FVG area we’ve been watching all month.*

As you can see, ETH has been stuck in a bit of a tug of war. That Supply zone up top is acting like a massive ceiling, and that FVG area is just there to remind us of the crazy moves we’ve seen lately. Right now, price is just hanging out near some important support. It feels like the market is holding its breath deciding whether to bounce back or slide a bit further. If you’re trading, it’s probably best to just stay patient and watch those levels, no need to rush things while the market is still trying to figure itself out.

**Big Changes at Home**
But honestly, the drama on the charts isn’t even the most interesting part. The real talk right now is about what’s going on inside the Ethereum Foundation.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma8tHbT12KYaEsLqcLrjeymagM6KGPF12TwCcLoLD2qhH/1000009438.jpg 

*Caption: Vitalik’s latest take on the future of the Foundation.*

Vitalik Buterin just dropped some news that really caught everyone’s attention. He basically said that the Ethereum Foundation is changing how it works. He wants to step back and have less influence on the board. His big idea? He wants the Foundation to act as just one node in the ecosystem not the boss or the main coordinator.
Why does this matter to us? Well, it’s a big move toward true decentralization. The whole point is to make sure Ethereum doesn't rely on just one person or one group to run the show. It’s a bit of a shift, and it’s definitely a new era for the project.

There’s also been some talk about a few senior researchers leaving the Foundation this month. People might think that’s a bad sign, but in the world of open source projects, people coming and going is pretty normal. It’s just part of the process.

At the end of the day, May has been all about change whether it’s the price charts acting up or the structure of the project itself. It’s all part of the growing pains, I guess. Stay cool, keep doing your own research, and let’s see what June brings.

-----

Indonesia

Mei 2026 ini benar benar bulan yang cukup bikin deg degan, apalagi buat kamu yang punya simpanan Ethereum (ETH). Kalau kita lihat grafik hariannya, jelas banget kalau ETH lagi mengalami fase yang agak berat.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPGDqYbnH39UmmxVTfy2uX1LJ6WpLo7JQjdhiyPtidtXk/1000009424.jpg 

*Caption: Ini tampilan grafiknya, kelihatan banget tembok Supply di atas dan area FVG yang terus kita pantau sepanjang bulan ini.*

Seperti yang bisa kamu lihat, ETH lagi terjebak dalam aksi tarik ulur. Zona Supply di atas sana bertindak seperti langit langit yang susah ditembus, dan area FVG itu cuma jadi pengingat betapa liarnya pergerakan pasar akhir akhir ini. Sekarang, harganya lagi nongkrong di dekat level support penting. Rasanya pasar lagi menahan napas lagi nunggu kepastian apakah bakal rebound atau justru meluncur lagi ke bawah. Kalau kamu lagi trading, mending sabar dulu dan pantau terus level level kunci itu, nggak perlu buru-buru ambil keputusan pas pasar lagi cari arah kayak gini.

**Perubahan Besar di Rumah Ethereum**
Tapi jujur saja, drama di grafik itu sebenarnya belum seberapa dibanding apa yang lagi terjadi di balik layar Ethereum Foundation. Kabar yang paling hangat sekarang adalah soal apa yang lagi dirombak di dalam organisasi itu.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQma8tHbT12KYaEsLqcLrjeymagM6KGPF12TwCcLoLD2qhH/1000009438.jpg 

*Caption: Pandangan terbaru Vitalik tentang masa depan Ethereum Foundation.*

Vitalik Buterin baru saja melempar kabar yang cukup menyita perhatian banyak orang. Dia bilang kalau Ethereum Foundation bakal berubah cara kerjanya. Intinya, dia mau pelan pelan mengurangi pengaruhnya di jajaran pengurus. Ide besarnya? Dia pengen Foundation itu cuma jadi satu node atau bagian kecil saja dalam ekosistem yang luas bukan jadi bos atau koordinator utamanya.

Kenapa ini penting buat kita? Soalnya ini langkah besar menuju desentralisasi yang sesungguhnya. Tujuannya jelas: supaya Ethereum nggak bergantung sama satu orang atau satu kelompok saja buat menjalankan operasionalnya. Ini transisi yang lumayan besar, dan jelas ini era baru buat proyek ini.

Oh iya, sempat ada juga kabar soal beberapa peneliti senior yang memutuskan keluar dari Foundation bulan ini. Mungkin ada yang mikir ini pertanda buruk, tapi di dunia proyek open source, orang keluar masuk itu hal yang biasa banget. Anggap saja itu bagian dari proses regenerasi.

Kesimpulannya, bulan Mei ini isinya penuh dengan perubahan mulai dari grafik harga yang bikin pusing sampai perubahan struktur organisasinya sendiri. Semuanya cuma bagian dari proses pendewasaan, saya rasa. Tetap tenang, jangan lupa DYOR (Do Your Own Research), dan mari kita lihat kejutan apa yang dibawa bulan Juni nanti.

body.title: What Are the Legal Requirements to Start a Company in Dubai?
body.body:
## Introduction: Why Dubai Remains One of the World’s Top Business Destinations

Every year, thousands of entrepreneurs and investors ask the same question: how to start a company in Dubai? The answer is both straightforward and layered Dubai offers one of the most business-friendly environments in the world, yet navigating its regulatory framework requires careful planning, accurate information, and ideally the guidance of experienced business setup consultants in Dubai.

Dubai sits at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, and Africa. It operates as a global logistics, finance, and commerce hub with world-class infrastructure, a stable political environment, and a tax regime that makes it genuinely attractive for international business. Whether you are a solo entrepreneur, a small business owner, or a multinational company looking to expand, Dubai provides multiple pathways to get established legally and efficiently.

![What Are the Legal Requirements to Start a Company in Dubai - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*_9d5li-NGn1DbbwLNDPSvQ.jpeg)

In this comprehensive guide, you will learn the legal requirements to start a company in Dubai, the types of business structures available, the step-by-step registration process, estimated costs, free zone versus mainland considerations, and how Takween Advisory can guide you through every stage of your business setup journey.

## Understanding the Business Landscape in Dubai

Before diving into legal requirements, it is important to understand how Dubai’s business environment is structured. Business activity in Dubai is broadly divided into three jurisdictions.

Mainland Dubai, regulated by the Department of Economy and Tourism (formerly DED), allows companies to operate anywhere in the UAE and bid on government contracts. Free zones are designated economic areas more than 40 of them across the UAE each governed by its own authority and offering specific benefits such as 100 percent foreign ownership, customs duty exemptions, and streamlined setup processes. Offshore structures, such as those offered through JAFZA Offshore or RAK ICC, are typically used for holding assets, international trade, or tax planning purposes rather than conducting business inside the UAE.

Each jurisdiction has its own legal requirements, permitted activities, and cost structures. Choosing the right one is arguably the most important early decision when setting up a business in Dubai.

## Legal Requirements to Start a Company in Dubai Step by Step

![Legal Requirements to Start a Company in Dubai Step by Step - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*u2aiVAstN6jF0sqAPPvEsA.jpeg)

### Step 1: Choose Your Business Activity

The first legal requirement when establishing a company in Dubai is determining your business activity. The UAE’s licensing system is activity-based, meaning your license type depends entirely on what your business does. The main categories include commercial, professional, industrial, tourism, and e-commerce activities, among others.

The Department of Economy and Tourism maintains an official list of more than 2,000 approved business activities. Selecting the correct activity is critical because it determines your license type, applicable regulations, and in some cases the jurisdiction where your company must be registered.

### Step 2: Select Your Legal Structure

Once the business activity is confirmed, the next step is choosing a legal structure. The most common structures for businesses in Dubai include the following options.

A Limited Liability Company (LLC) is the most popular structure for mainland businesses. It requires a minimum of two shareholders and allows up to 50 shareholders. Following the UAE Commercial Companies Law amendments that took effect in 2021, foreign investors can now own 100 percent of an LLC in most commercial and professional activities, a significant change from the previous requirement of having a UAE national hold 51 percent ownership.

A Sole Establishment or Civil Company is suitable for individual professionals consultants, lawyers, engineers, or doctors who wish to practice under their own name. These structures are common in the professional services sector.

A Free Zone Company (FZC or FZE) operates within a designated free zone and typically offers 100 percent foreign ownership, zero import and export duties within the zone, and simplified setup procedures. Each free zone caters to specific industries; for example, Dubai Media City focuses on media and communications, while Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) serves financial services firms.

A Branch Office allows a foreign company to establish a presence in Dubai without forming a new legal entity. The branch carries out the same activities as the parent company and is 100 percent owned by it.

An Offshore Company is ideal for international holding, trading, or investment structures where the company does not conduct business inside the UAE.

### Step 3: Reserve Your Trade Name

Trade name reservation is a formal legal step in the UAE. The business name must comply with UAE naming conventions; it cannot include offensive language, references to political or religious entities without approval, or names identical or similar to already registered companies. The reservation is done through the Department of Economy and Tourism for mainland companies or the relevant free zone authority for free zone entities.

### Step 4: Apply for Initial Approval

Initial approval is an official clearance from the relevant authority confirming that the government has no objection to the proposed business activity. For mainland companies, this is issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism. For free zone companies, the respective free zone authority issues this clearance.

Certain activities such as healthcare, education, financial services, food and beverage, and legal consultancy require additional approvals from sector-specific regulatory bodies before or alongside the initial approval stage.

### Step 5: Draft and Notarize the Memorandum of Association

For an LLC or partnership, a Memorandum of Association (MOA) must be drafted, specifying the company name, shareholders, ownership percentages, share capital, and management structure. The MOA must be notarized before a registered notary public in Dubai. For sole establishments or civil companies, a simpler form of partnership agreement or declaration may be required.

### Step 6: Secure a Physical Address

Dubai law requires every registered company to have a physical office address. Depending on the jurisdiction and the nature of your business, this could be a flexi-desk in a business center, a coworking space, a dedicated office, or a warehouse facility for industrial activities. Free zones generally offer a range of office solutions that satisfy the legal address requirement, while mainland companies must lease premises from a licensed real estate provider and register the tenancy contract through Ejari Dubai’s official tenancy registration system.

### Step 7: Obtain Your Trade License

The trade license is the core legal document authorizing your company to conduct business in Dubai. It is issued by the Department of Economy and Tourism for mainland companies or by the relevant free zone authority. Licenses are renewable annually.

The main license types are as follows. A commercial license covers trading, buying, and selling of goods or services. A professional license covers service-oriented activities such as consulting, IT, marketing, and management services. An industrial license covers manufacturing and production activities. A tourism license covers travel agencies, hotels, and tourism-related services.

### Step 8: Complete Corporate Bank Account Opening

Opening a corporate bank account is technically a post-licensing step but is essential to start operations. UAE banks require the full set of incorporation documents, shareholder KYC (Know Your Customer) documentation, a business plan in some cases, and proof of address. Banks in the UAE conduct thorough due diligence, and the process can take several weeks depending on the institution and the nature of the business.

## Mainland vs Free Zone What Are the Key Differences?

![Mainland vs Free Zone What Are the Key Differences - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*GSw2ehlIUBzBdjMtzqjSSw.jpeg)

One of the most common questions entrepreneurs have when exploring how to start a company in Dubai is whether to set up on the mainland or in a free zone.

Mainland companies can trade freely within the UAE domestic market, bid for government contracts, and operate from any location across the emirate. Following the 2021 foreign ownership amendments, 100 percent foreign ownership is permitted for a broad range of activities, though some strategic sectors still require UAE national participation.

Free zone companies benefit from simplified setup, dedicated regulatory support, tax holidays on corporate and personal income, full profit repatriation, and customs duty exemptions within the zone. However, free zone companies that wish to conduct business directly within the UAE mainland must either appoint a local distributor or agent, or obtain a dual license that extends their activities to the mainland.

The right choice depends on your target market, the nature of your business activity, your cost parameters, and your long-term operational goals. Speaking with business setup consultants in Dubai can help clarify which jurisdiction best serves your specific needs.

## Dubai Business Tax What You Need to Know

![Dubai Business Tax What You Need to Know - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*7VPF0LPGtmbqheKjGgdihg.jpeg)

A significant draw for international investors is Dubai’s historically favorable tax environment. Dubai business tax obligations have evolved in recent years and it is important to understand the current framework.

The UAE introduced a federal Corporate Tax at a rate of 9 percent on net business profits exceeding AED 375,000, which came into effect for financial years starting on or after June 1, 2023. Businesses earning up to AED 375,000 in net profit continue to benefit from a zero percent rate. Qualifying Free Zone Persons who meet specific conditions may benefit from a preferential 0 percent tax rate on qualifying income.

Value Added Tax (VAT) was introduced in the UAE in January 2018 at a standard rate of 5 percent. Businesses with taxable supplies and imports exceeding AED 375,000 per year are required to register for VAT with the Federal Tax Authority.

There is no personal income tax in the UAE. Customs duties may apply to goods imported into the UAE mainland, though goods entering free zones are generally exempt.

Businesses should seek professional tax and legal advice to ensure compliance with the latest UAE tax regulations, as the tax landscape continues to develop.

## Estimated Costs of Setting Up a Business in Dubai

![Estimated Costs of Setting Up a Business in Dubai - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*0yaX_HSQJT4bljy0JCBGMw.jpeg)

One of the first practical questions investors ask is: what will it cost? While providing a single fixed figure is not possible costs vary based on business activity, license type, visa requirements, office space, chosen jurisdiction, and approvals required from government authorities understanding the general cost components helps with financial planning.

Mainland company setup costs typically include trade license fees, name reservation fees, initial approval fees, MOA notarization, and Ejari registration for the tenancy agreement. Professional service fees charged by business setup consultants in Dubai are generally separate from official government charges and vary between service providers.

Free zone setup packages often bundle the license, a flexi-desk or shared office, and one or more residence visas into a single annual fee. Different free zones have different fee structures, and promotional packages are periodically available. Costs differ significantly between premium free zones such as DIFC and more cost-effective options such as IFZA or SHAMS in Sharjah, which are popular among budget-conscious entrepreneurs looking for a business setup near me type of solution across the UAE.

Additional costs to factor in include immigration and visa fees for employees and shareholders, medical fitness tests, Emirates ID registration, establishment card fees, and corporate bank account charges. For businesses requiring sector-specific approvals healthcare, education, financial services, food establishments additional regulatory fees apply.

It is important to note that government fees, regulations, and policies may change over time without prior notice. Consultancy charges, professional service fees, and third-party costs differ between service providers and are usually separate from official government charges. Always request a comprehensive, itemized cost breakdown from your business setup advisor before proceeding, and seek updated pricing at the time of your application.

## Special Licenses and Additional Approvals in Dubai

Certain business activities in Dubai require approvals from sector-specific regulators in addition to the standard trade license. Healthcare businesses must obtain approval from the Dubai Health Authority (DHA). Educational institutions require licensing from the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA). Financial services firms operating in the DIFC are regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). Food and beverage businesses must secure approvals from Dubai Municipality. Real estate companies operating on the mainland must be registered with the Real Estate Regulatory Authority (RERA).

Understanding which additional approvals apply to your business activity early in the planning process helps avoid delays and unexpected costs.

## Visa and Immigration Requirements for Business Owners

Starting a company in Dubai typically entitles the owner and key employees to apply for UAE residence visas. The number of visas a company can sponsor is linked to the size of its office space and the nature of the license.

Investor visas are available to company shareholders. Employee residence visas can be sponsored by the company once it is registered and has obtained an establishment card. The UAE also offers long-term Golden Visas to qualifying investors, entrepreneurs, and specialized talent, providing residency of 5 or 10 years.

The UAE residence visa process involves a medical fitness test, Emirates ID registration, and immigration entry permit procedures, all managed through the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA) in Dubai.

## A Real-World Example A Consulting Firm Established in Dubai

![Dubai Business Tax What You Need to Know - Takween Advisory](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1000/1*qvAF92X1u0c06rZbLnkoCQ.jpeg)

Consider a European management consultant wishing to establish a professional services firm in Dubai. After assessing the options with a business setup company in Dubai, the consultant evaluates mainland versus free zone structures. Given the intent to serve both local UAE clients and international clients, and the desire to maintain a professional office presence, a mainland professional license under a sole establishment structure proves most suitable.

The process involves trade name reservation, initial approval from the Department of Economy and Tourism, drafting of the required declarations, securing a serviced office through an Ejari-registered tenancy contract, obtaining the professional trade license, and applying for an investor residence visa and Emirates ID.

The consultant is operational within approximately three to six weeks from the commencement of the setup process, with all legal requirements met and documentation fully compliant. Timelines vary depending on the specific activity, additional approvals required, and the completeness of documentation provided at each stage.

## Pros and Cons of Starting a Company in Dubai

Understanding the advantages and challenges helps entrepreneurs set realistic expectations before beginning the process.

On the positive side, Dubai offers a strategic geographic location connecting global markets, a world-class infrastructure ecosystem including ports, airports, and logistics networks, a stable and transparent legal framework, 100 percent foreign ownership in most sectors, no personal income tax, access to a highly skilled international workforce, and a dynamic fast-growing consumer and business market.

On the challenging side, the initial setup process involves multiple government touchpoints and documentation requirements. Office space costs in prime Dubai locations can be significant. The banking onboarding process can be time-consuming for new companies. Compliance with UAE-specific regulations including corporate tax, VAT, and labor law requires ongoing professional attention.

Having a reliable business setup company in Dubai to guide you through the process significantly reduces friction and the risk of costly errors at every stage.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Can a foreigner own 100 percent of a company in Dubai?

Yes. Following amendments to the UAE Commercial Companies Law that came into effect in 2021, foreign investors can own 100 percent of a mainland LLC across most commercial and professional business activities. Free zones have always permitted 100 percent foreign ownership. Certain strategic sectors may still require UAE national participation; a qualified consultant can advise based on your specific activity.

### How long does it take to register a company in Dubai?

For free zone companies with standard documentation, the process can take as little as a few days to two weeks. Mainland company registration typically takes two to four weeks. Activities requiring additional sector-specific approvals may extend the timeline further.

### Do I need to be physically present in Dubai to start a company?

Many business setup procedures can be initiated and in some cases completed remotely, particularly for free zone entities. However, certain steps such as biometric enrollment for Emirates ID and residence visa stamping require physical presence in the UAE at some point during or after the process.

### Is there a minimum share capital requirement?

Minimum share capital requirements vary by business activity, legal structure, and jurisdiction. Many mainland and free zone structures do not impose a mandatory minimum share capital for standard commercial activities, though banks may have their own minimum deposit expectations for account opening purposes.

### What is the difference between a free zone and mainland license?

A mainland license allows you to operate across the UAE, deal directly with government entities, and serve the local market without restriction. A free zone license is generally restricted to operations within the designated zone or with international clients, though dual licensing solutions exist. Each has distinct cost structures, regulatory environments, and strategic advantages depending on your business model.

### What taxes apply to businesses in Dubai?

The UAE introduced a 9 percent federal corporate tax on net profits exceeding AED 375,000 effective from June 2023. VAT at 5 percent applies to businesses with taxable turnover above AED 375,000 annually. There is no personal income tax in the UAE. Free zone entities meeting specific qualifying conditions may benefit from a preferential 0 percent tax rate on qualifying income.

### Do I need a local sponsor in Dubai?

The requirement for a UAE national sponsor or service agent has been significantly reduced following the 2021 foreign ownership reforms. Most mainland commercial and professional activities no longer require a UAE national partner. However, certain regulated activities particularly in security services, oil and gas, and a limited number of other sectors still require specific local participation or service agent arrangements.

body.title: Star Trek: Discovery Season 1, Episode 13, Review
body.body:
>

How are you all?

Today I am going to share with you my feelings about the 13th episode of the first season of Star Trek: Discovery. The way the story stopped at an exciting place at the end of the previous episode, I honestly couldn't wait to watch the next episode. And since this episode started, I feel like I made the right decision.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWpV4B3DDEdsLi3WXVMJ8nmyem97GQPQyqHRY1R2iVqs3/IMG_20260525_191139.png 

The situation was completely unstable from the beginning of the episode. The power game in the Mirror Universe has reached a point where no one can be fully trusted. The character of Lorca in particular surprised me the most. When the true intentions of the person I had seen so far as a strong and experienced captain became clear, I rediscovered the character.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRSNHhVjivr7vK6SUu9FbKrY7SenheYECjkVfDbiawzr9/Screenshot_20260525_190849.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNaBJA7oiGss4KkpZy4aEHq3CMJJZwuiUvKKFNT6uYQMg/Screenshot_20260525_190855.jpg 

In Lorca's eyes, I saw not only the greed for power, but also a kind of ambition that has been accumulating for a long time. He is not willing to accept any boundaries to get what he wants.  That point is very clearly revealed in every dialogue and decision he makes.

On the other hand, Michael Burnham's situation also made me think. Because he finds himself in a situation where there is a big risk behind every decision. When a person is stuck between his own morality and reality, how difficult it can be for him to find the right path, is shown through Burnham.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdSMy7K9VJt4HriWfqypkgPc3oByQbe2TPfXSchd5WU12/Screenshot_20260525_190905.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdAMFwzFsnfQx27K1Le4Zdjk7qvunk3pRV87JGLzHDw5m/Screenshot_20260525_190922.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNSdfmsF2LkUcgApsjSvbeTxHwEu19oMY6q6eDcSEiJvv/Screenshot_20260525_190932.jpg 

Something must be said about Empress Georgiou. The character is as scary as it is interesting. A different feeling is created when her presence appears on the screen. The most interesting thing is that one cannot completely hate her nor can one completely support her. This dual feeling is what makes the character seem more real to me.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcE6w2spV29sSeFAh7ogmMDzmrnDBbavG4JbFzUUQEvd5/Screenshot_20260525_190938.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfGa9cK2dsoh1cF78yptD7AzvRst3CEmHVS3fxhzTC1up/Screenshot_20260525_190944.jpg 

Among the other members of Discovery, I also liked Saru separately. The change I saw in her after taking on the responsibility is really commendable. Although she seemed a bit hesitant in many previous episodes, she is shown to be much more confident here.

Stamets' parts also seemed quite important to me.  The events surrounding the Mycelial Network not only moved the story forward, but also laid an important foundation for the future of the entire series.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfGa9cK2dsoh1cF78yptD7AzvRst3CEmHVS3fxhzTC1up/Screenshot_20260525_190944.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaR9v8MVrCj3oooSoek4kCNdvPECUQFpXCXPXJDG8xyKs/Screenshot_20260525_190959.jpg 

The biggest strength of this episode was its pacing. Nothing felt redundant. As soon as one scene ended, the desire to watch the next one was building. Especially the events towards the end moved so quickly and dramatically that there was no chance to take my eyes off it.

And the last few minutes...

To be honest, I was not at all prepared for that ending.

Just when it seemed like everything was finally falling into place, the story took a turn that left me stunned for a few seconds. At that moment, there was only one question in my mind—what is going to happen next?

Personally, I would call this episode one of the best episodes of the entire first season. There is action, there is emotion, there is character development, and most importantly—it has the ability to surprise the viewer.

 My rating: 9.5/10

After watching this episode, I couldn't wait any longer and immediately started the next episode. Because the story ended at a point where it's really hard to stop the curiosity.

Thank you everyone. I'm ending today's review here. See you again with a new episode to share my personal feelings and experiences.

body.title: Magical mountain views...
body.body:
...and it's always a pleasure to see how the clouds fold over the peaks.
![002.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/48RPTRDZncrJBA2QKiHo6q1Pt8RfEohn6Ri8xhrhLiVbAhzYuAjo11YRFTo6TzjMtz.jpg)

Early morning shots and at the time I saw a band of cloud developing below the top of the mountains. I took some lovely landscapes of the band, as I had an idea what the views would look like later in the day, that I will show you in another post. So, we returned later in the afternoon, and we were happy to see what happened with the band of cloud. If you love mountains and landscapes as much as we do, then you will also like the views in here. 
But for now, let me just show you some of the morning shots.
Come and see.

![003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243WKW9tDwjpbRn41f3w2Q5AJBAjs8BPZ8eEjHpUNyfrL9tqRVRDWbQcQX7CJvk6wJfeK.JPG)

See that band of cloud above the ground, that is what I was talking about to get later in the day. 
![004.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eq9VCqfBUXLvXEaco1fBV2mzkkmdjXSjz4CT7LE5SoXLyQz73R1bpwgQbtxRH75ZoNi.JPG)

![005.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uaEtE3VSmJFCLEE8g574oMkiCPyh8nLEu6L53A363Wdrxe2QnfShop86tiGu9jkyR1g.JPG)

![007.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/243zi2fzFFBgHgrssHGUC7tZZLFehs7iB68ueozSqrdzrkwYpKebxrMNjtM8bUQoGroEo.JPG)

The weather was holding up today, and although it was a cool day, as we are in winter here now, a weak winter sun was also shining on occasion. I have said in the previous post that the mountains can form their own clouds, and this was another of such occurrences. Beautiful to see how the clouds blanket the mountains. Thankfully a gentle wind was in action, and none of those hair-raising wind gusts.

On the other side of these mountains are some even higher mountains further inland, and can you believe that they are in the summer rainfall area. We have a Mediterranean climate here and the Atlantic Ocean is just a few kilometers away from us. So, the ocean also has a great effect in our weather patterns. Long white sandy beaches are packed with the visitors during the holiday periods.    

![013.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Ep7uaRuRko5idhQ5TmMrs5yjvqecjFxFYyUgsmN2vNDz6dwpDrAixQFeGsWe3Hf9DNe.JPG)

![017.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23xySn2BScvAGZpuB1fSZoA1LsPQesoqHk7vMdSVedBd975fueKCXTJjc5vXS28kP3TT8.JPG)

![018.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/244KNmAHMoWqhH2u9pkR9kYWzLehMbe7khog7WLBph8gsQqyHn4RxmB9hJtDPLEkWz9D4.JPG)

![024.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23yTYxsWd4odhZM3NV4Dfq8sdrtoQ8tijk3yNHZtH9DfbK5LEYsDy6SE3y83SHXNbmKqh.JPG)

Finally, just a look at a single mountain towards the north of our mountain range. Lovely how that cloud rests on the left-hand peak. 
![020.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/245cRyNiUP3oyD2DoNqWqGkrt9w7h5NoXaD4yGtMcoRvEyDwG63FhSwL7K51suTWVAGrv.JPG)

As human beings we are so strange, as most of us are born with a want. I want this, I want that, and if I get it then I am not satisfied as I want more. Striving after our wants is a waste of time as we miss out on life and how it was supposed to be. Every new generation comes along with new things and most of it requires a faster response of adaption for the older generations. Just the other day I had to make calls through a switchboard operator and nowadays I can make a direct call on my wife's mobile phone. 

Unheard of in the 50's. I still have a turntable and a pack of records in a cupboard, and also an original old telephone. But those days, along with its strict ethics and morals, have now been binned, as anyone can do just what they like, whether it is legal or not. The media is filled with horror stories that fills one with dread, and things are really becoming a madhouse. That's one of the reasons that we like to visit the sanity of nature, as it is almost a doctor's treatment every time. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved. 

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Until next time, cheers!

**Basic Procedure:**
• Outline or sketch your painting reference.
• Paint using a lighter background shade by creating a beautiful texture. 
• On the middle ground, paint the first layer of the subject. 
• The same procedure as the foreground. 
• Once the first layer is completely dry, you can proceed to paint with a darker shade of coffee.

Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente refrescante. El clima estaba perfecto, con un cielo despejado y una brisa suave que hacía que cada paso fuera más agradable. Mientras paseaba por el parque, conocí a un artista callejero que estaba pintando un mural vibrante. Nos detuvimos a charlar un rato y me contó que se inspira en la cultura local y en las historias de las personas que conoce. Su energía era contagiosa, y me dejó pensando en cómo el arte puede transformar espacios urbanos. Más adelante, vi a un grupo de niños jugando a la pelota, riendo y disfrutando del momento. Me hizo recordar lo importante que es mantenernos activos y divertidos, sin importar la edad. También observé a varios ciclistas y corredores que pasaban, todos disfrutando de la misma energía que yo sentía en ese momento. Cada día en la ciudad es una nueva aventura, llena de sorpresas y encuentros que hacen que cada caminata valga la pena. body.title: Last Man Standing THE FINAL Results
body.body:
>

## Forty entered. Two survived. Neither won. Both walked away paid.

The Last Man Standing — Premier League 2025/26 ran the full route. Thirty-eight gameweeks. Forty fixtures of nerves, autopicks, and ruined Saturday afternoons. By the final day, the field was down to two: **@gwajnberg** and **@onemanonewrite**.

Both still alive. Both still backing themselves. Both stared at the same list of remaining clubs and reached for the same name.

**Liverpool.**

Liverpool drew.

## The cleanest tie in LMS history

There is no tiebreaker in Last Man Standing. There is no \

. They both survived 9 gameweeks. They both went out on the same call in the same week against the same opponent. The eliminator that took them both didn't even win the match.

So the pot splits.

| Co-champion | HIVE | MEDALS |
|-------------|------|--------|
| @gwajnberg | 100 | 2,500 |
| @onemanonewrite | 100 | 2,500 |

Two names on the board. One shared scar. A finish that could not have been scripted tighter.

## What you learn from a season this long

LMS rewards patience over flash. The players who lasted the longest were the ones who saved the obvious clubs for the obvious weeks — and didn't blow Liverpool or Arsenal on a Tuesday night cup hangover in October. By March, the contenders were down to people picking Brentford at home and praying.

By May, it was two people picking Liverpool on the final day.

## Respect

To **@gwajnberg** and **@onemanonewrite** — you outlasted thirty-eight other entries and 9 weeks.  The board says co-champions. Read it however you want.

To everyone who got knocked out in GW3 by Wolves — there's always next season.

## Next up

Has everyone entered our World Cup contest???

Or we have a Fantasy Test Cricket Contest Coming up Soon as well 

LMS Premier League 2026/27 opens for entry ahead of the new season. New rules under consideration: tiebreaker round, paid entry pool, higher MEDALS ceiling. Watch this space.

Pure Sports. Real Rewards.

body.title: May Blooms and a Memory of my Dragon Collector
body.body:
May 22nd 2026 marked a year ago that Danny had passed away. The sense of sadness still lingers my heart every time I go through the pieces he sent me as gifts that he knew deeply interested me. 
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23tvqBPjydW6qVV1H2Gc2otV4rswzxUDqPRP4YffJgnTEx7a66BK5f4sKGsRuMt5Bkfo7.png)</center><center></center>
>“Black birds tend to like shiny things.” ~ The Bloody Raven.

I had began a journey researching into my family's Asian side. Sharing with Danny of the silver [Republic of China coins](https://peakd.com/hive-167922/@kerrislravenhill/1919-republic-of-china-20-cents-the-three-principles-of-the-people) brought over by my ancestors, piecing together the stories that I could barely remember tying them with some of the anecdotal claims by relatives and the historical context of the [Chinese community in Western Canada](https://archive.org/details/saltwatercityill0000yeep). 

One story is of three brothers, related to my mother's side, who smuggled their way into Hong Kong hiding in the bottom of a Junk hauling a shipment of Soy Sauce before finding more legitimate and comfortable passage over to North America. One brother remembers that tense evening, they could hear the Hong Kong coast guard over the bull horn demanding the Captain declare his cargo manifest, how the captain answered may result with officers boarding to inspect the paperwork or warranting a cargo search. 

I'm still sorting some of those details of this particular story.

<center>![2026Columbine1600x900.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23uQtaiBNWotoVWfA7zhTGp2MiNDZpH34RvUuBTRSdM1z1Z442B7Qngf8vQgEvApgYgi5.jpg)</center><center>Planted last year in memory of Danny, I am happy that this perennial [Columbine](https://www.almanac.com/plant/columbine) survived it's first winter. The second Columbine perished over the winter but I attribute that to the poor soil condition since they are sensitive to poor soil conditions. I've since remediated that issue and replaced the lost plant.</center>


Danny was more a collector than a Stacker, his theme is undoubtedly the Asian Dragon that dominated his New York State ranch house residence. Coins, authentic Chinese vases, statues even the [golden flag of the Qing Dynasty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_the_Qing_dynasty). He recalled his tours of duty as a naval Medical officer that took him through numerous ports of call around south east Asia that included Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore, etc. 


### The 'almost' One Tael 37g Wedding gift silver bar ###

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23x1HuHgseugjbdvkP848yqMjpNjfPUCsH48H7amBtJtrMm5xXsuGWf4G6ULE2vkgkiCk.png)</center><center>Top Front seals;福 “Fortune” / “Good luck”, 囍“Double happiness”  </center><center>Center Symbols; 招財進寶“Attract wealth and bring in treasure”,足銀“Fine silver” / “Pure silver” </center><center>Bottom symbols; Representing the Merchant and mint.</center><center>35.7mm x 30.9mm x 4.8mm</center>

Exotic Chinese silver, this subject was our common interest. Danny knew I loved to discover mysteries behind Chinese silver and sent me an odd piece to research to my heart's content regardless if it had relevance to my ancestors there in a transitional era following the last days of the [Qing Dynasty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Qing_dynasty). One piece I wish to share from Danny is an old, but not genuine dynasty old, little 37g silver bar. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23w2qd9e9EXXgnP6TxqFkAz9faRtJJuYom1cX4dyrQCywCSkq2EMvk8N2KhtKLwwVF5ks.png)</center><center>My big bright Rhododendron is breaking out in blooms much healthier than last year. A helping of fertilizer partly fixed that but this old shrub should have been planted away from the house for better sun exposure.</center>

As a quick review, the 兩 Traditional [Tael weight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Liang_(mass)) standard is different depending on the region; A Mainland China Tael is 37.3g while a Taiwan Tael weight is 37.5g and Hong Kong and Singapore is 37.79g. This 'Qing Dynasty' inspired bar has the typical characteristics of poured silver art bars. It's toning appears natural based on my long familiarity and knowledge base with poured silver and the mass feels about right in my hand. An old ingot that felt smooth from decades of handling and ownership by unnamed couples. No pedigree, no mintage numbers, just a private handcrafted piece of tradition secretly locked away inside it. The top edge appears to be damaged by someone filing or cutting into this ingot as if to physically verify it's authenticity. Too bad regarding the damage however it does add to the character and story of this ingot.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23vsZ9PnuYVNuybfWr12ansgZyeGwgQ3tbdiNDYtuiMCWqUVEujyJToVRL67bdvTLQYoa.png)</center><center>Back side, nothing here but a missed opportunity? Perhaps regret🥀</center>

### Adding my own story to this ingot ###

Ben of [H.K.Colonial Coins in Hong Kong](https://www.instagram.com/hkcolonialcoins/) verifies this as an traditional silver gift given to the new couple. He dates this ingot/bar originating from the 1960s and 1970s. The seals on the top of this bar especially 囍 “Double happiness” Is often seen at many wedding banquets and seeing one of these pieces in my hand gave me pause to think of the ramifications. *\
* This was like a veiled proposition. I've been so independent for so long, the thought of coming into fork in my life's path left me dumbfounded. *\

* Was it cold feet? Was it the pain and hurts of relations past?  

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/23xVLzpQHrym6SruhifD7c4NgJfKu8TyqwZ3ZvM3VdLJtGNNG9UhWhbJeKkVesYhwDmAm.png)</center><center>My 25+year old late blooming Queen Anne located just left of my front door rose seems ordinarily plain compared to the explosion of the varieties now available in the market. Yet somehow this old rose keeps saying, “You’re home.”  I plan to plant a cutting at a more sunny location on my property. </center>

I told him that I was delighted with this gift, thanked him again and filed it away for research at a later date. I can almost feel his disappointment of my non-response. I often thought back at that moment. Wondering if I could have chosen the new path putting my responsibilities on hold. If I were only free of those responsibilities then. This feels ironic now that I am retired, that door had closed. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kerrislravenhill/EoK4MqrkdLeRspXjcnsf6Qyq2qkV4G7LBBzvVhQ2NijuJnXHhq5AipKWW2FBfBW1rHY.png)</center><center>*\

*❤️ Thank you my friends for coming aboard my blog today. ### Stacking Precious metals and Crypto for those dark stormy days! ###

body.title: Bangladesh Corruption: The Silent Crisis Affecting Millions
body.body:
Corruption in Bangladesh is not a new phenomenon. It has become deeply embedded in the social, political, and economic fabric of society. While international headlines focus on high-profile cases of embezzlement and financial crimes, the everyday corruption that ordinary citizens face remains largely unaddressed. This post examines the state of corruption in Bangladesh and its impact on development.

![](https://www.cato.org/sites/cato.org/files/styles/pubs_2x/public/2023-12/government%20corruption%202.jpg?itok=WGhmL_UA)

## The Scale of the Problem

According to Transparency International's Corruption Perceptions Index, Bangladesh consistently ranks among the countries with high corruption levels. In 2024, the country scored 26 out of 100, placing it among the bottom performers globally. This is not merely a statistical issue—it reflects the lived experiences of millions of Bangladeshi citizens who encounter corruption in their daily lives.

The World Bank estimates that corruption costs Bangladesh billions of dollars annually in lost development opportunities, inefficient public services, and reduced foreign investment. These resources could have been invested in education, healthcare, and infrastructure development.

## Corruption in Daily Life

While large-scale corruption makes headlines, systemic corruption affects ordinary people at every level:

**Government Services:** Citizens seeking basic documents face delays and unofficial demands for payment. Obtaining a driving license, land ownership certificate, or utility connection often requires navigating a web of informal payments.

**Healthcare:** In public hospitals, patients sometimes face unofficial charges for essential services. Quality healthcare becomes available primarily to those who can afford private institutions or bribes within the public system.

**Education:** Admission to better schools and colleges often depends on connections rather than merit. Teachers sometimes demand private payments for tutoring essential to pass examinations.

**Judicial System:** Court cases are delayed deliberately, with faster resolution available to those who can afford to pay judicial officials. This undermines justice and creates a system where the wealthy have better access to fair trials.

## Institutional Corruption

The challenge runs deeper than individual actors. Institutional corruption—where corruption is embedded in organizational systems—makes reform difficult:

​

1. **Weak Accountability:** Institutions lack independent oversight mechanisms. Internal controls are often ineffective, and whistleblowers face retaliation rather than protection.
2. **Inadequate Compensation:** Government employees receive low salaries relative to living costs, creating financial pressure to supplement income through informal means.
3. **Political Influence:** Political connections often protect individuals engaged in corrupt practices. Investigations may be politically motivated or stalled depending on the accused's political affiliations.
4. **Lack of Transparency:** Government procurement, budgeting, and decision-making processes lack adequate transparency, making it difficult to monitor for corruption.

![](https://www.publicdomainpictures.net/pictures/170000/nahled/dollar-banknotes-and-judge-gavel-1461999767kH6.jpg)

## The Cost to Development

Corruption undermines Bangladesh's development goals:

​

- **Economic Growth:** Foreign investors view corruption as a risk factor, reducing investment and economic opportunities.
- **Poverty Alleviation:** Resources intended for poverty reduction programs are diverted through corrupt channels.
- **Public Health:** Healthcare systems become less effective when resources are misappropriated.
- **Education Quality:** Educational institutions struggle when budgets are compromised by corruption.

## Efforts to Combat Corruption

Bangladesh has established institutions to address corruption:

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) investigates corruption cases and has prosecuted numerous officials. However, critics argue the commission's effectiveness is limited by political interference and resource constraints. The judiciary's role in trying corruption cases is crucial, but lengthy trial processes and case backlogs delay justice.

Civil society organizations and media outlets play an important role in exposing corruption and advocating for reform. International pressure and conditional aid have also incentivized some anti-corruption measures.

## The Path Forward

Addressing corruption requires comprehensive approaches:

​

1. **Institutional Reform:** Strengthening independent agencies, improving transparency in government operations, and implementing merit-based systems.
2. **Salary Enhancement:** Providing competitive government salaries to reduce financial incentives for corruption.
3. **Legal Reform:** Streamlining trial processes, protecting whistleblowers, and ensuring consistent enforcement of anti-corruption laws.
4. **Public Participation:** Fostering a culture where citizens actively report corruption and demand accountability from institutions.
5. **Technology:** Implementing digital systems for government services to reduce human discretion and opportunities for corruption.
6. **Education:** Teaching ethics and civic responsibility from early education levels.

## Conclusion

Corruption in Bangladesh is a systemic challenge that requires sustained effort to overcome. While the scale of the problem is daunting, progress is possible through institutional reforms, political will, and active civil society participation. Citizens, government officials, business leaders, and international partners all have roles to play in building a more transparent and accountable society.

Change will not happen overnight, but it is essential for Bangladesh to achieve sustainable development and fulfill its potential as a nation.

_This post reflects on corruption as a social and developmental issue. Addressing corruption is crucial for Bangladesh's progress toward a more equitable and prosperous society._

body.title: Moby Dick  [literary Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Pink Yellow Aesthetic Collage Travel Diaries Vlog YouTube Thumbnail.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23wX5MBbknaK6UwbWJVCDpHsEctPLNrHfncoJRrf79KHyaho5tim8pJ88tBNPqqFUYwZM.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

Ishmael is a young man seeking refuge at sea, desperate to escape his depressing life. He arrives at an inn looking for someone to help him board a ship. There he meets Queequeg, a Polynesian harpooner who appears hostile but is actually a kind soul. The two become great friends and travel to Nantucket, boarding the Pequod, a whaling ship. But once they have set sail and are on the high seas, the captain, Ahab, reveals his true intentions. He doesn't want to catch just any whale for commercial purposes; what drives him is his unwavering obsession with capturing and destroying an albino whale that once tore off one of his legs. He offers a gold coin to the first person to spot it, but Starbuck, the first mate, disagrees, considering it an obsessive act and even blasphemous. The hunt intensifies, the crew is compromised, and the ending... well, I'll let you discover that for yourselves. >Ismael es un joven que busca refugio en el mar, necesita escapar de su vida depresiva, de esta manera llega a un posada en busca de alguien que lo ayude a embarcar algún navío, allí conoce a Queequeg, un arponero polinesio de aspecto hostil pero que realmente es una buena persona, los dos se vuelven grandes amigos y viajan a Nantucket y se embarcan en el Pequod, un barco ballenero. Pero cuando ya zarparon y se encuentran en altamar, el capitán, Ahab revela sus verdaderas intenciones, él no quiere atrapar cualquier ballena con fines comerciales, lo que lo mueve es su férrea obsesión por atrapar y destruir a una ballena albina que en una ocasión le arrancó una de sus piernas, así que ofrece una moneda de oro al primero que la aviste, sin embargo Starbuck, el primer oficial al mando no está de acuerdo por considerar que es un acto obsesivo e incluso una blasfemia. La cacería se extiende, la tripulación se ve comprometida y el final... bueno, dejaré que ustedes lo descubran por sí mismos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tRxSK1wEauoz8BXTg6mr5WXyMaC8bVb3gGjy6uQKFHTbQB8oXPTjDbGPcbGvfqApZcE.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/1143773636625781971/)

The story tells us how far the untamed river, obsession, and thirst for revenge can lead. Human beings, for the most part, confront nature, ignoring their own fragility, and in the end, nature proves impossible to defy. However, there are characters like Starbuck and Ishmael who represent the conscious side, the voice of reason, that voice that tells the captain that although he is in charge of the ship, he has lost his way in life and his control. The book constantly shifts between dualities such as calm seas and rough seas, day and night, reason and irrationality, all as a representation of the complexities of life itself.

>La historia nos habla de hasta donde pueden conducir el rio desmedido, la obsesión y la sed de venganza, el ser humano la mayor parte del tiempo se enfrenta a la naturaleza ignorando su propia fragilidad y al y al cabo esta le demuestra que es imposible desafiarla, sin embargo hay personajes como Starbuck o Ismael que son más o menos como el lado consciente, la sensatez, esa voz que le indica al capitán que aunque está a cargo del barco ha perdido el rumbo de su propia vida y de su control. El libro se mueve constante entre dualidades como el mar calmo y el mar picado, el día y la noche, la sensatez y la irracionalidad, todo esto como representación de las complejidades de la vida misma.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23uQpe8NbYi3y81RwT7sXpvHB3Z98HzdRx6FtircfwwmwU4BQjc8xVE33tkh128P3wbDe.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/4599512328659905664/)

I feel that after reading this book, I now have a broader knowledge of the sea and whale anatomy, as it's full of details. These details don't make the reading dense; on the contrary, they're narrated in such an interesting way. All of this, combined with Ahab's personal story and his desire for revenge, makes the story captivating. It's sad to see that many people don't understand nature, even though we ourselves, as human beings, are part of it. For some, Moby Dick (the whale) was a god enraged by the challenges of men; for others, it was an evil creature that had to be eliminated; but for others, like Star or Ishmael, it was nothing more than an animal defending itself and its territory.

>Siento que al haber leído este libro ahora tengo conocimientos más amplios sobre el mar y la anatomía de las ballenas, ya que está lleno de detalles al respecto, y estos detalles no hacen que la lectura se vuelva densa, sino todo lo contrario, están narrados de manera tal que resulta muy interesante, todo esto mezclado con la historia personal de Ahab y su deseo de venganza hace que la historia sea atrapante. Es triste ver que muchas personas no comprenden a la naturaleza, siendo que nosotros mismos, como seres humanos somos parte de ella. Para algunos Moby Dick (la ballena) era un Dios furioso por los desafíos de los hombres, para otros era una criatura malvada que se debía eliminar, pero para otros como Star o Ismael, ella no era más que un animal defendiéndose y defendiendo su territorio.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tmFiqUjfcycvTJyyKkgaHE3W8gZiX6dDm3TRwABXVduHK9ddWhiaif4EERPBrqSPt8x.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/997828861191222218/)

Thank you so much for taking the time to read my post. I hope you enjoyed this story as much as I did. See you next time, God willing.

>Muchas gracias por detenerse en mi publicación a leerla, esper que les haya gustado esta historia tanto como a mi, nos vemos en otra oportunidad, Dios mediante.
![Brown Beige Cream Modern Illustration Coffee Project Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23u6FdQ2j9v8DRjnGY86szgGFgnNavrFjBHMZrFV9aDdSAH4iQ5F3XMeJj7iYpz2d18ok.jpg)
