body.title: Sin Tetas No Hay Paraíso [Book Review] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![miniatura de youtube minimalista oscuro amarillo.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uFU4LHmG3GpDU75ydYiFp1CCWbB14VGyMLx9YhBov6UQK4AAUr4RKkbFAUr7cTe1oGv.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Today I would like to talk to you about a book that caused quite a stir at the time because of the television series of the same name, Sin Tetas no Hay Paraíso (Without Breasts There Is No Paradise). The book is by Gustavo Bolívar, a talented Colombian writer, in which he represents the outcry of a society plagued by vanity and violence. >Hoy me gustaría hablarles de un libro que en su momento causó mucho revuelo por causa de las series de televisión homónimas, Sin Tetas no Hay Paraíso, el libro es de Gustavo Bolívar, un talentoso escritor colombiano en el cual representa el clamor de una sociedad azotada por la vanidad y la violencia.

Overview/Resumen

Catalina is a young woman who lives in Pereira, Colombia. She lives comfortably with her mother and brother, but she always dreamed of having a lot of money and being admired by everyone, like the girls in her neighborhood. Some even dropped out of school, and their work allows them to buy the best clothes and even make significant improvements to their homes. They leave on weekends and return on Mondays laden with gifts and money. But according to \

for these girls), Catalina couldn't achieve that dream unless she got breast implants. La Diabla was nothing more than a pimp working for a group of pedophile drug traffickers, yet Catalina was willing to do anything to achieve her goal.

\n\n>Catalina es una jovencita que vive en Pereira, Colombia y sin pasar mayores necesidades vive junto a su mamá y su hermano, pero ella siempre soñó con tener muchísimo dinero y ser admirada por todos, como las chicas de su barrio, que incluso dejaron la escuela y su oficio les da para tener la mejor ropa, y hasta hacer mejoras significativas a sus hogares, ellas se van los fines de semana y regresan los lunes cargadas de regalos y dinero, pero según \

de estas chicas) Catalina no podría alcanzar ese sueño a menos que se opere el busto. La Diabla no era más que una proxeneta que trabajaba para un conjunto de narcotraficantes pedófilos, sin embargo Catalina estuvo dispuesta a todo con tal de alcanzar su cometido.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 12.01.29 PM (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/Eou9eUCCxSSJ9QLwBpCCbmfu8Y2RV2PyuDjy34dcZCNHGQ4kdhQeec8rcWtZai4akks.jpeg)

My Opinion/Mi Opinión

The title itself is a metaphor representing the idea that success is conditioned by appearance, even though appearance is subjective. The book portrays the sad reality of many women from impoverished areas of Colombia who work in the marinade, where they are judged by their physical attributes and traded like objects, even though they often expose themselves to these situations due to poverty and lack of opportunities.

>El propio título en sí es una metáfora que representa el hecho de que el éxito está condicionado por la apariencia, aunque en realidad la apariencia es subjetiva. El libro retrata la triste realidad de muchas mujeres marinadas de sectores empobrecidos de Colombia, en la cuál se les califica por sus atributos físicos y son comerciadas como si fuesen objetos, aunque ellas mismas se exponen a estas situaciones muchas veces motivadas por las carencias y faltas de oportunidades.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 12.01.26 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xL39sqSAU1DfLzE7ZNYmnqeQMTTDmh2NY8vJU99Bkq62LTripJqSFiGVQkpJdBicKNg.jpeg)

What I like about this novel is that Gustavo Bolívar (the author) doesn't try to glorify or romanticize the world of the mafia, but quite the opposite: he exposes it and shows it in its rawest essence, how they use and discard people, how they see girls as mere merchandise or pieces of meat. However, I remember one scene that caught my attention because it completely broke with this paradigm: one of the drug traffickers rejected Catalina because she was the same age as his daughter, so at least he showed a little more sense than the rest. All these abuses and outrages happen practically in plain sight because they've reached the dangerous point where violence is normalized; people seem to meekly accept their fate as if it were predestined (the girls will become prostitutes and the boys hitmen 😕).

>Lo que me gusta de esta novela es que Gustavo Bolívar (el autor) no pretende glorificar o romantizar el mundo de la mafia, sino todo lo contrario, exponerlo y mostrarlo en su más cruda esencia, como usan y descartan a las personas, como ven a las niñas como si fuesen mera mercancía o trozos de carne, aunque, recuerdo una escena que me llamó la atención porque se salía completamente de este paradigma, y es que uno de los narcotraficantes rechazó a Catalina porque ella tenía la edad de su hija, así que al menos tuvo un poquito más de sensatez que el resto. Todos estos abusos y desmanes cometidos suceden prácticamente a la vista de todo el mundo porque llegaron al peligroso punto en el que se normaliza la violencia, la gente parece aceptar dócilmente su destino como si estuviese predestinado (las niñas serán prostitutas y los niños sicarios 😕)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 12.01.29 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EokeXwvCS1scaLp8yRN2vXW8ZY3pMHFntbX63SgcaF4NNjYP7Mbcv7zfWZydWiqqJo3.jpeg)

Another point Gustavo Bolívar makes in his novel is how social pressure plays a significant role in shaping young people. It can lead them to believe they have certain needs or deficiencies that they don't actually have, or that they should strive to live a certain way, to do things they don't really want to do. But he also criticizes the role of parents and society in general, who should be the main guarantors of young people's safety, but instead are either immersed in their own world or simply normalize and accept the situation even though it harms them, just because they benefit financially from that atrocity.

>Otra cosa que Gustavo Bolívar expone en su novela es como la presión social juega un papel importante en la formación de los jóvenes, les pueden hacer creer que tienen ciertas necesidades o carencias que en realidad no tienen, o que deberían esforzarse por vivir de cierta manera, hacer cosas que realmente no quieren hacer, pero también critica el rol de los padres y de la sociedad en general, quienes deberían ser los principales garantes de la seguridad de los jóvenes, pero en lugar de eso o están sumergidos en su propio mundo o simplemente normalizan y aceptan la situación aunque los perjudique, solo porque ellos se benefician económicamente de aquella atrocidad.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 12.01.29 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EonmYmW8GayDgY159cBz39veKo4C2oyKh4WUCrzBnemrYqK61QPbqboiCsBnJH9BZAD.jpeg)

Without going into too much detail to avoid spoilers for those who haven't read the novel yet, I'll say that Catalina's ending is cautionary; it shows us the potential consequences of obsession and highlights the reality for many women not only in Colombia but in all countries where violence and greed are normalized.

>Sin entrar en muchos detalles para no hacer spoiler en caso de que aún no hayan leído la novela, les diré que el final de Catalina es aleccionador, nos muestra cuales pueden ser las consecuencias de la obsesión y pone en evidencia la realidad de muchas mujeres no solo en Colombia sino en todos los países donde la violencia y la codicia están normalizadas.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 12.01.26 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23y8xEeNnY98kZ3B4fZoyGUaj1GhTDpUAbSTC1iocCXx3xgxxK42hZep6hj1LANyjbZgk.jpeg)

Thank you so much for reading, I hope you enjoyed my review. Share your thoughts with me! Have you read the novel or at least seen any of the TV series?

body.title: Pink Peonies 🥰
body.body:
Pink Peonies 🥰
I was given a bouquet of peonies. At first, they were still closed, but on the second day, they opened. It wasn't a large bouquet, but now it's huge. It creates such a beautiful look in the room, and the scent is so pleasant. The whole house is filled with the scent of peonies.

I love flowers; all flowers are beautiful in their own way. But peonies are so delicate, so beautiful.
Peonies come in red, pink, and white.
The white peonies have already bloomed in my garden; I'll take a photo later and show you. They're very beautiful—white on the outside with a pink center.
The early peonies have just bloomed. There are also late and mid-season peonies. Mine are the first white ones to bloom; they're early; the others haven't bloomed yet.
I love that peonies last a long time and decorate the yard. Even a bouquet of peonies lasts a long time in a vase, longer than roses, for example.
Peonies are not picky flowers; they can easily be grown at home, in your garden, or in a flowerbed. Peony bulbs can be stored, and they grow again the following year after winter. I love flowers that don't need to be planted every year.
Tulips are not only beautiful but also have a pleasant scent.

body.body: /> Greetings, everyone! I hope you’re all having a wonderful day. Every new day gives us another chance to smile, learn, and appreciate the little things that make life special. Whether it’s enjoying good food, spending time with loved ones, or just taking a moment to relax, there’s always something to be thankful for. Join me as I share the highlights of my simple, happy life — filled with small joys, positive moments, and everyday adventures. Let’s celebrate life together, one moment at a time! 😊 * * * **Going to Work 🚍** It's another morning to go to work. I got to the station quite late and waited for a few minutes before the jeepney arrived. I hopped inside and paid for my fare. It took me about 20 minutes of travel before I got to the store.

/> * * * **Lunch Time 🍽️** For lunch, I only bought some fish cake and teokbokki for myself. I went to the Korean food stall and bought this. When I got back to the office, I played my favorite drama series while eating my lunch. It's a great way to spend my quick break at work.

/> * * * **Coffee Break ☕** In the afternoon, I was feeling hungry and lightheaded. I needed to grab a cup of coffee to make my mood better. I prepared my coffee and bought some banana turon for my afternoon snack. It was enough to make me feel more alive.

/> * * * **Project Proposals 💻** When I got home from the office, I opened my laptop and checked my Upwork account. I just submitted some project proposals for job postings. I was looking for a part-time job. I aim to land on one before this year ends.

/> **Everyday Snapshots** by @charmingcherry is a daily blog that features a series of travel, food, and lifestyle stories from her. [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Brown and Cream Illustrative Pet Shop Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uQvaRnT4W544EeQ6ZDizgcXgFvbFnrWLdmJzxqd4ARBwWuSh3B9uWoNj4F321c9Tthv.jpg)

Hello, hello, internet people! How are you? A few days ago, my cousin had the opportunity to visit us. I say \

because she currently lives in Barcelona, ​​Spain, but to avoid visiting family members from house to house, she came up with a brilliant idea: to have a thanksgiving mass said, which all of us in the family (aunts, uncles, cousins, nephews, etc.) would attend. The place she chose, of course, was the sanctuary of Don Bosco School, which is the school where both she and I studied (although she's older than me). She chose that place because she still has many contacts there. In fact, William, a boy I met when we were in the school marching band, ended up becoming a priest, and he was the one who officiated the mass. It was a somewhat strange but incredibly beautiful experience to see him dressed as a priest officiating a mass, after having seen him joking and playing around with everyone at band practice. >¡Hola, Hola, gente de internet! ¿Cómo están? Hace unos días tuvimos la oportunidad de recibir de visita a mi prima, digo de visita porque ella actualmente vive en Barcelona, España, pero para no estar visitando a la familia de casa en casa se le ocurrió una idea brillante, mandar a hacer una misa de acción de gracias a la que asistiríamos todos en la familia (tíos, primos, sobrinos etc) y el lugar elegido por ella obviamente fue el santuario del colegio Don Bosco, el cuál fue el colegio donde estudiamos tanto ella como yo (aunque ella es mayor que yo) Eligió ese lugar porque ella quedó con muchos contactos allí, de hecho, William, un chico que yo conocí cuando estábamos en la banda show del colegio, terminó siendo sacerdote y de hecho fue él quien ofició la misa, fue de verdad una experiencia un tanto rara pero sumamente bonita verlo vestido como sacerdote oficiando una misa, luego de haberlo visto bromeando y jugueteando con todos en la práctica de la banda.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.05.17 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EqBcDsM52TW2JYTndnvern6j6WH13tG5TssKNkvnP5nT5A4QcN6i4BhBCMWyhiqbA6G.jpeg)

Walking into my old school, I felt a mix of emotions: joy, excitement, and a lot of nostalgia. In that huge courtyard, I used to walk around with my friends in my free time, play kickball in PE class, and on Saturdays, we practiced formations and drills with the school band, and even learned new dance steps 🤗 The school was almost the same, except for a few things that weren't there before, like a new chapel for prayer (since it's a Catholic school) and some murals, but everything else was just as I left it.

>Al entrar a mi antiguo colegio sentí una mezcla de emociones: alegría, emoción y mucha nostalgia. En ese enorme patio yo solía caminar con mis amigos en mis ratos libres, jugar al kicking ball en clases de educación física y los sábados era allí donde practicábamos formaciones y esquemas con la banda show del colegio, y también nuevos pasos de baile 🤗 La escuela estaba casi igual, salvo algunas cosas que antes n estaban, como una nueva capilla para rezar (ya que es un colegio católico) y algunos murales, pero el resto sigue tal como lo dejé.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.29 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EogMP5Gz6Gc9ve3zfZEknyqKkZ44J3ooNQ73cAftnfvPwBRUZwcNknrM48MVuhGQ8b2.jpeg)

This was one of my favorite benches. I would sit there, surrounded by my friends, watching a soccer or kickball game. Seeing the tree behind me brought back many memories and a touch of nostalgia, because it was always used—and from what I see now, still is—to display hopeful messages throughout the school, messages like this: \

I always loved Don Bosco School because its ideals are very appealing to young people. The idea is to evangelize through sports, music, and other activities that draw children and young people closer to the Lord and away from bad habits.

\n\n>Este era uno de mis bancos favoritos, allí me sentaba yo, rodeada de mis amigos mientras veíamos algún partido de futbol o Kicking ball. Ver el árbol detrás de mi me trajo muchos recuerdos y nostalgia, porque siempre se acostumbraba, y por lo que veo ahora también, a repartir mensajes esperanzadores por todo el colegio, mensajes como este: \

. Yo siempre amé el colegio Don Bosco porque sus ideales son muy atractivos para los jóvenes, la idea es evangelizar a través del deporte, la música y demás actividades que hagan que los niños y jóvenes se acerquen al señor y se alejen de malos hábitos.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.30 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/EogQC7mNFqJexyeGqGwWFWupeyUY13V4sR9wnu8oNFyfkUsVJFz1hNtPgXzsqkW99Eu.jpeg)

Being there with my family was priceless; it had been a while since we'd all been together and enjoyed each other's company. That day we shared stories, laughed at my uncle's funny antics (the one in the background making faces), had a delicious breakfast in the school's common room, and best of all, we were able to hug and reunite with my cousin. We hope she comes back soon.

>Además estar allí en pleno junto a mi familia no tuvo precio, teníamos tiempo sin reunirnos todos y disfrutar de la compañía mutua, ese día contamos anécdotas, nos reímos con las ocurrencias de mi tío, el gracioso (El que está allá de fondo haciendo caras) tuvimos un rico desayuno en la sala común del colegio, y lo mejor de todo fue que pudimos abrazar y reencontrarnos con mi prima, esperamos que vuelva pronto.
![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-03 at 7.06.12 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23xediPfCPGYwGQhYMRZQtMKUHBP7M3fivNGkramNZDY1k1BUNqJfxJ8Ts9jqoe9sWSfq.jpeg)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post
![Miniatura de YouTube Ilustrativo Niños Naranja Amarillo Blanco.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23wggpJxc7pQATGzLcLTp9GjDNd3VfauwAPHDRxoZ8EmXsU7zoEGH9nhDKFtEYUji1Fvf.jpg)

body.title: Beating impacts a lot on children.
body.body: /> Greetings everyone! Today's generation is very frank and open. Every parent and child is very open with each other but that's not the issue its good everyone should stay like this. But when children makes some mistake parents have stop beating in today's time I have seen, and when I was a kid at my time every parents use to beat there children a lot. I think still now even in today's time when a child makes some mistake he should get beaten by their parents it impacts a lot in their mind and even in their character. Well If I share about my past yeah! I have get beaten by my parents a lot even for the smaller mistakes at that moment I use to get lot of angry on them. But now when I go back from today's time I feel like it was a blessing yeah! I mean it was good that they use to beat me because it impacts me a lot in many ways mainly they beat you because either you made a mistake and take care that you will never do some kind of shit in future. Which affects a lot on your character too. Even in today's time no parents are beating or getting physical for discipline with their children. Well I think when you are getting beaten it's making you a man, it feels like now I can face anything or anyone without any fear. Like I can feel a well grown man, and children who never get beaten they always have a fear in their mind of someone about something they are not a man or a male they should be. So there is a huge difference, from my side every parents should get physical for discipline with their children . Parents should not beat them every now and then, but when a child is making some mistakes or even after some warning or getting out of discipline then a strict action should be taken. I have literally learn from my parents and I believe it's a good way to keep your children in your hand. They should never get beyond your limits always make them in your control until they are mature enough to make their own life decisions. Parents should not over physical with them everything should be balance equally. They should also know that their parents even love them a lot. All I want to say is don't either beat them lot or don't over love them, everything should be balance. Well children will learn from parents and apply with their upcoming generation. When a child is getting beaten his mind changes he get habitual of such things and when things come up in life with other people it doesn't make them scare. I have really experience such thing and it is amazing. So at the end every parents should get physical discipline for their children but balance things and even love them and make understand about everything.

/>

body.title: Television Review: The Long Bright Dark (True Detective, S1x01, 2014)
body.body:
![(source: tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/lnludtHZ9CUbXvyFk1ZnoOsXp6o.jpg)

**The Long Bright Dark (S1x01)**

Airdate: 12 January 2014

Written by: Nic Pizzolatto
Directed by: Cary Jo Fukunaga

Running Time: 60 minutes

HBO's *True Detective* arrived in 2014 with considerable fanfare, yet its opening episode reveals a series that appears somewhat adrift from the premium network's typical sensibilities. Rather than conforming to the glossy, immediately accessible template that HBO had perfected, this debut instalment feels as though it has wandered in from a competitor's slate—specifically, it resembles an American transplant of those relentlessly grim, atmospherically oppressive Nordic crime dramas that had come to dominate European television. The Danish *Forbrydelsen* (*The Killing*) springs immediately to mind, and one cannot help but note that such shows had already proven their viability for American audiences through successful remakes.

What distinguishes *True Detective* from its Scandinavian predecessors, at least structurally, is its temporal complexity. The narrative refuses to unfold in linear fashion; instead, it shuttles between 1995 and 2012 via flashbacks and interrogation-room narration. This temporal dislocation is not merely a stylistic flourish—it serves as the episode's primary dramatic engine, compelling the viewer to piece together not only the central mystery but the intervening years that have so fundamentally altered the two protagonists.

The choice of Louisiana as the series' backdrop raises inevitable questions about creative versus financial motivations. The cynical observer might dismiss this as yet another production chasing Louisiana's generous tax incentives and filming subsidies, a practice that has drawn Hollywood southward with increasing frequency. Yet this scepticism ought to be tempered by the knowledge that series creator Nic Pizzolatto hails from the state himself. For the time being, at least, the setting carries an authenticity that transcends mere fiscal convenience.

Regarding the plot proper—the investigation into a ritualistic murder that promises to spiral into a hunt for a serial killer—there is little here that feels genuinely innovative. Such premises have become staples of the crime genre, and experienced viewers will recognise familiar territory. However, wisdom dictates that anthology crime dramas of this ilk ought not to be judged solely upon their opening chapters. With seven episodes remaining in this initial run, there exists ample opportunity for subplots to emerge and dramatic reversals to complicate what initially appears straightforward.

Where the episode truly distinguishes itself is not in its narrative architecture but in its characterisation—and, crucially, in the performers entrusted with bringing those characters to life. Woody Harrelson and Matthew McConaughey represent something of a coup for television casting; both men enjoyed legitimate stardom on the big screen, and their migration to the small screen reflects both the shifting economics of the entertainment industry and the increasing creative respectability of long-form television. What proves most intriguing is how the series' structural conceit—its temporal bifurcation—enables these actors to explore dimensions of their characters that would prove impossible within the compressed timeframe of a feature film.

The episode presents us with two versions of each man: their 1995 incarnations, during the initial investigation, and their 2012 selves, being interviewed by detectives who may have uncovered connections to the original case. This doubling allows Harrelson and McConaughey to construct performances that invite the audience to speculate about the intervening decades. What forces could transform these men so profoundly?

At first glance, the character dynamic appears to rely upon well-worn buddy-cop conventions. Harrelson's Detective Martin Hart is introduced as the grounded counterpart—diligent in his professional duties, devoted father and husband, the ostensibly stable presence. McConaughey's Rustin \

Cohle, by contrast, arrives as the damaged philosopher, self-medicating his familial trauma through alcohol, narcotics, and occasional outbursts of violence or nihilistic philosophising that visibly unsettle his more conventional partner. It is the archetypal pairing of the straight man and the loose cannon.

Yet the 2012 sequences introduce a delicious irony that complicates this initial impression. The men we encounter seventeen years later appear to have effectively swapped positions. Hart, who adhered so scrupulously to the rules, now carries himself with the wearied demeanour of someone who has suffered the consequences of his rectitude. Cohle, the unbalanced loser who seemed destined for self-destruction, presents a different face entirely—though precisely what that face signifies remains tantalisingly unclear.

This inversion suggests that Pizzolatto has constructed something more sophisticated than the standard procedural partnership. The episode plants seeds of doubt about our initial assessments. Perhaps Hart's apparent normalcy concealed deeper fractures; perhaps Cohle's dissolution masked a peculiar integrity that would ultimately prove more durable than conventional respectability.

The ritualistic elements of the murder—antler crowns, cryptic symbols, the swampy Gothic atmosphere—establish a visual vocabulary that distinguishes the series from more pedestrian crime dramas. Director Cary Joji Fukunaga employs the Louisiana landscape not merely as backdrop but as active participant, the humidity and decay seeming to seep into every frame.

Ultimately, *The Long Bright Dark* succeeds not because it revolutionises the crime genre—it manifestly does not—but because it establishes a framework within which its exceptional performers can explore the complexities of masculinity, partnership, and moral compromise. The central mystery, whilst competently constructed, functions primarily as a vehicle for character study. As with many ambitious television dramas, the journey promises to prove more compelling than the destination. The episode leaves us with questions worth pursuing—not merely whodunit, but who these men were, who they have become, and what price they paid for the difference.



RATING: 7/10 (+++)


*(Note: The text in the original Croatian version is available [here](https://draxblog.com/2014/01/13/pravi-detektiv-prvi-dojmovi/.)*

body.body:
#

![7 Days Trip to Shimla and Manali from Gurgaon in This Summer.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/9dda36ba0742e71d1eee684a1a5c3126081cae049e36b4749c33f32a279558f9)



Planning a [7 days trip to Shimla and Manali from Gurgaon](https://medium.com/@Gurgaontempotraveller/7-days-trip-to-shimla-and-manali-from-gurgaon-in-this-summer-d5b903967359) in this summer is one of the best ways to enjoy the cool weather and scenic beauty of Himachal Pradesh. Shimla and Manali are among the most popular hill stations in India, offering snow-covered mountains, green valleys, waterfalls, adventure sports, and peaceful surroundings. This summer trip is perfect for families, friends, couples, and corporate groups looking for relaxation and adventure together.

During the trip, travelers can explore famous attractions like Mall Road, Kufri, Jakhoo Temple, Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, Hidimba Devi Temple, and Manu Temple. Adventure lovers can also enjoy paragliding, river rafting, camping, and trekking activities in Manali. The pleasant weather during summer makes sightseeing more enjoyable and comfortable.

Traveling from Gurgaon becomes easier and more comfortable when you hire a Tempo Traveller for the journey. A Tempo Traveller offers spacious seating, air conditioning, ample luggage space, and a smooth ride for long-distance travel. It is the ideal travel option for group tours and family vacations. A 7 days trip to Shimla and Manali from Gurgaon gives you unforgettable mountain memories, beautiful landscapes, and a refreshing break from city life.

**Hello Hive Fam!** Most especially to my beloved co-Filipino Hive friends, I’m excited to share a simple yet meaningful story that reminds me of the warmth of our culture and the joy of community, both offline and here on Hive.

![16e28a0d-b55a-47a5-8540-79e7a32f2239.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23zRw12DzNGU6G2tqgboeFEG91M4H5d4FRpuUpP2nzGkJRhVzBTF8hguKDWwSKHBCo5xH.jpeg)

Today, my generous neighbor handed me a bowl of **dinuguan** and a plate of **puto cheese**. There was no occasion in their family, but she never fails to share with me whatever food she prepares for merienda. This thoughtful gesture touched me deeply. It’s not about the food alone, but the kindness behind it, a reminder that generosity is a cornerstone of Filipino values.

![8147a722-e5f4-46bb-bc5c-1212907cf815.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23xAJvT71wRghUZ1ZmuVCeknTn8qAtoPMFSAvwvoqHSLBJrcNxfAzwQmiXnAHs4UxMUAt.jpeg)

Moments like these make me grateful not only for the people around me but also for the Hive community where we share stories, support one another, and celebrate life’s little blessings. Just as my neighbor shares her food, we share our experiences here, nourishing each other with positivity and connection.

![c49e5c62-3187-41cc-b8df-27a89ed8060b.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23uFW43upZRb4UTWtNPpbKkQ2DxDEJqWLTBebANbDgRrwYtJDsXZ72npZSdpnXhziHPZr.jpeg)

**Maraming salamat, Hive Fam, for taking the time to read my story.** I hope this little slice of my day brings a smile to yours. Let’s continue to uplift one another, both in our neighborhoods and in our Hive journey. Until next time, ingat lagi and keep spreading kindness!

body.title: claudelog: scrobble & holozing survival game
body.body:
#### Scrobble.life

After the big updates yesterday: built-in music player and Audius search & play as well as playlists
Today I just did a few small changes fine-tuning things. Playlists are now also sharable with others! 

After doing the usual security check I decided to also do a speed check, to make sure pages are loading quickly and not trying to overload information on the get go. Found some that were lagging behind so fixed them up and they're now a lot faster than earlier! 

Try it at https://scrobble.life

Extensions are also public and easily installable now in case you missed it! 

Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hive-scrobbler/nmiakhpbilkpimeohngjbjickchkcpio 

Firefox: https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/hive-scrobbler/

Keep in mind this mainly works for browsers on the PC, not for players that are installed/apps or mobile currently. However the player should work on mobile as well if you login using the @keychain browser, just that it won't save scrobbles for now. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23tRxawdyU2xr8HEgV92udYaJk87S34dv16T6Zu2HmBdEPYATd4vmqMR4sXgJij8vRs4L.png)

#### Holozing Survival Arena (Tower Defense)

A lot more progress here lately. 

You start off with 50 coins to purchase one creature, you can pick between 3 creatures that always guarantee at least one tank and two dps: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23tSWqqTNQrE5ZNiUCJwXxcTqan9PmdpzuLTwhexob2Z9G2HAnCesf3yx16XELKvD3mHx.png)

Once you place the creature out, you wait for enemy creatures to approach you. You can click on creatures to target them, this allows for you to cast heals on them using action button 1 or 5: 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23w2sdoY3EaSZvajWxk9wq3kPTn2iysVDsTVwCCTJKGFcxVQbBJjeMvcW2GSdcZqHUXro.png)

You have your mana bar and xp/level progression in the upper left corner, coins and wave info in the upper right one and your target info in the lower left corner. Quite simplistic starting out. You can also control you creature to go towards different places by rightclicking when you have it targeted. 

When enemy creatures approach, they aggro each other, usually going for the tank as they have the highest aggro with abilities such as taunt that they do automatically every 3 seconds if an enemy creature isn't targeting them. 

I decided to record the rest of gameplay to give you an idea of how it looks rather than spamming screenshots throughout the whole ordeal, keep in mind it's still not very fine-tuned in terms of difficulty/progression. 

https://youtu.be/33oztrCEW70

Still a lot of work left to do, I'm thinking creatures that are the same are going to be able to \

at some point to prevent overcrowding. I.e. if we select another Walle, you'd automatically place it on top of the current Walle along with a mixture of leveling up creatures rather than just constantly looking to buy and place more of them.

The cards are currently being migrated in from the TCG game I built a few weeks ago so there's not a big selection there yet either. 

Anyway, just a first look, let me know what you think. 

The idea is that the game will be playable on the browser so we're not aiming to add to high of a polycount since we don't want it to be laggy and we want it to work on mobile as well. Some animations are still missing from creatures as well such as running which is the obvious one when you look at the gameplay, our animator is from Cuba so she's had some internet/electricity issues lately which we hope resolves itself soon as that must be terrible for the people living there.

body.title: Chronicles of a Street Photographer, Day 4. / Monomad Challenge [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![1000478214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23vPJhU8rw1Wyah8GFqFbX7T4m6pefwaCWfeceE5gRDmSCeNeSajxxToANCSjq9wvWbSj.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

> Hello, friends of the #blackandwhite community—how are you all doing? For the past few days, I’ve been posting some personal reflections and stories from my photo shoots, sort of like a diary, and I’ve really enjoyed the idea; so much happens on the streets of Havana, especially for a street photographer who has to deal with people and everything around them.

> Saludos, amigos de la comunidad #blackandwhite, ¿cómo les va? Desde hace algunos días he estado publicando algunas consideraciones personales, experiencias de mis salidas fotográficas, a modo de crónicas, y la verdad me ha gustado la idea; son muchas las cosas que suceden en las calles de La Habana, y más a un fotógrafo callejero que tiene que lidiar con las personas y todo lo que le rodea. ![1000478218.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wC1GDgyxvz1C1kXfWUSZqvas3Wah2J68NbtT8gnx6d61w2raawgHzukj8QCR1aWm7v7.jpg)

> Just yesterday I was talking to a friend, and she asked me what settings I use on my camera when I’m out on the street. My answer was a bit odd because, honestly, most of the time I don’t even know—I don’t really pay much attention to that.

> Ayer precisamente estaba conversando con una amiga, y ella me preguntaba qué parámetros utilizo en la cámara cuando estoy en la calle. Mi respuesta fue un poco rara porque, la verdad, en la mayoría de las ocasiones ni sé, no estoy muy pendiente de eso. ![1000478216.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/242rniaALDg6CGc9joF7ZsEwzibi5BxBUT1DwXpEJLFow5mzmceNmHDTQK2XHwPQ34nVG.jpg)
> It’s just that everything happens so fast that if I start fiddling with the settings, I’ll miss the shot; there are moments that last only seconds, and I have to be ready for them.

> Es que todo sucede tan rápido, que si me pongo a estar cambiando los parámetros, se me va la foto; hay imágenes que duran segundos y tengo que estar listo para ellas. ![1000478215.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wMQ8fBH5HuGnkzNZJHGtV1j7Tt4qRdrTMQtaFhQDmpcmkY9RguSoW1D5VFgaudTFhSS.jpg)

\
> What do I do? I set the camera to aperture priority mode, adjust the F-stop, and let the camera handle the rest; I don’t know if it’s the best setting, but at least it’s worked for me.

> ¿Qué hago? Pongo la cámara en modo prioridad de apertura, para ajustar F y que la cámara ponga lo demás; no sé si será la mejor configuración, pero al menos me ha dado resultados.  ![1000478213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23w2kqTN7BKnoNAMvsnZwfbkH1jyvHXdUxRWQAoLbq9E7bdioE4JnZhqaFEKdaB1D4hLK.jpg)
> And that’s how I get by, as we Cubans say—some days are calmer, others more hectic, some are sweltering hot, and others involve very little walking.

> Y así voy tirando, como decimos los cubanos, unos días más tranquilos, otros agitados, días de pasar mucho calor y otros de caminar poco. ![1000478211.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23u62k9UGW3fYWWLeUbJ2hYNwA2JS2zAxNhMzrQa5NmfvpduYtrPa7sT9SbL21w6smZPV.jpg)
> These are some reflections on my experiences on the street; I hope you found them interesting. Thank you so much for your time and kind company; I read your comments. Hugs, and see you soon.

> Estas son algunas consideraciones de mis experiencias en la calle; espero les haya resultado interesantes. Mil gracias por su tiempo y amable compañía; leo sus comentarios.  Abrazos y nos vemos pronto.

body.body:
# Monochrome Monday a few shots from recent walks I had the post prepared and perhaps sharing MONO images is kind of somber and appropriate for today being Memorial today But I decided to add this first photo and these thoughts for the day ***To the brave souls who never came home, thank you, the debt of gratitude will never be forgotten Remember them this memorial day***
![raandom-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48J9Sdos6UJAPTC8Jd6EMFLvcWkLDbyzcVvsPxuNpifhgNzAxc19vpawYgeTpj5onT.jpg) **Sony A7iv 259mm F10 1/125 Sec ISO 160** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/48J9Sdos6UJAPTC8Jd6EMFLvcWkLDbyzcVvsPxuNpifhgNzAxc19vpawYgeTpj5onT.jpg)**

I hope your weekend went well and wishing you a good week ahead. I am starting the week as I tend to do by sharing a few Monochrome Photos from recent walks. I was just thinking I am not sure I have ever discussed how I go about choosing photos to edit in mono, and for the most part I am not sure I have a deep thought process, just when I come to a photo and are ready to edit it, sometimes my mind clicks try this in MOnochrome. But thinking about it more this morning I said to myself, myself I said :) What is it about the photos that make smy brain tell me to try a Monochrome edit and this is what I came up with I fele a lot to do with it is if the photo has strong contrasts, intricate textures, and interesting and or compelling geometry thats what draws me to try monochrome editing. Stripping away color forces the viewer to focus on light, shadow, and form rather than being distracted by a messy over overwhelming color palette. And this first shot of the old Bridge out to Popes Island here in New Bedford is a good example of that
![mono from recent walks-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tH81Ld38aBAuEDHvGvFmVqCcHQq6ioSoFS9BUCHgx8YYMVECLAnaVb12SJVfSDx4JhN.jpg) **Sony A7iv 21mm F10 8 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tH81Ld38aBAuEDHvGvFmVqCcHQq6ioSoFS9BUCHgx8YYMVECLAnaVb12SJVfSDx4JhN.jpg)**

and for this next shot in color the eyes would be drawn to the color sin the tree and or sky, and yet I think the belgian block streets are the real start of this shot and in color they dont grab the eye as much as I fele they should
![mono from recent walks-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tGwCgdAS9LAWpuEyZ4cLm3DVFoAyaSwZnGkGv2Z8sSry7zKT2U9EYVKrX16uZiJu1Rc.jpg) **Sony A7iv 20mm F8 13 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23tGwCgdAS9LAWpuEyZ4cLm3DVFoAyaSwZnGkGv2Z8sSry7zKT2U9EYVKrX16uZiJu1Rc.jpg)**

and this next one may perhaps go against what I am saying a little, what caught me was the shape of the tree but in color it sort of faded into the background so I tried a Mono edit and here it is
![mono from recent walks.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wWyQ2XynmaddCebTB4koQurnf4pN4jHDfJWG7ym9xXGXw4UCRMeRL4bv1TBzSFHFBdb.jpg) **Sony A7iv 50mm F8 1/250 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23wWyQ2XynmaddCebTB4koQurnf4pN4jHDfJWG7ym9xXGXw4UCRMeRL4bv1TBzSFHFBdb.jpg)**

What caught my eye was the way the metal ramp coming off the pier was catching the light from the restaurant off to the right and not in shot, but when I tried editing it in color, it sort of faded into everything else, so I came up with this
![mono from recent walks-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xAK64GaAszuU9bxw17AYN8ZGbiRAw4kwixBuxMsXp7Akr4sXLZaGKetxVquko1Mu3M6.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F4 30 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23xAK64GaAszuU9bxw17AYN8ZGbiRAw4kwixBuxMsXp7Akr4sXLZaGKetxVquko1Mu3M6.jpg)**

body.title: Beautiful Nature in Queen Sirikit Park
body.body: /> Queen Sirikit Park is a perfect destination for a relaxing weekend. It’s shady with a lot of trees and ponds. The weather is nice and tranquil where you can easily spend hours strolling through. Especially when walking beside the ponds, you will feel refreshed and everything around seems to slow down. You will hear birds singing their sweet songs and butterflies flutter. The water was really still and the reflections on the water were awesome and attracted my eyes very much. Queen Sirikit Park is great for strolling and taking photos or simply relaxing.

/> [https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oDlyjIh8ACA](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oDlyjIh8ACA) [https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7643703936184077589](https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7643703936184077589) One of the favorite spots for people are bridges where you can see nice nature; wonderful trees and gorgeous flowers, etc., on both sides of the ponds.

/> [https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7643735004580711700](https://www.tiktok.com/@user5092674948674/video/7643735004580711700) I miss Queen Sirikit Park and do hope I can visit there again some day.
/>\n\nP.S. Luckily, I still have some more photos of Queen Sirikit Park in my phone which I will show you from time to time.

body.title: Tasty Bites, Happy Stomach, Happy Life: Made Some Potato Omelette with Malunggay and Had Three Crispy Margarine Toast
body.body:
>

![1000036824.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoH1nDeY2ozEW1gDKCkG1btNt2YeHYbL8HTokvwCLqUxxmn3naEfpNjcaRVNsfPQmB9.png)

Its a good thing I already planned yesterday my lunch today. You see, I decided to buy potato because its been a long time already since I last eat a dish with lots of potato in it. Although Batchoy has it, but there's really not much so I can't enjoy it to the fullest. At first I want to sautee this potato with hotdog and banana ketchup but I changed my mind. In my head I should cook the hotdog and potato separately because I can save more with that, haha. Good thing I thought about that. And another thing, Mommy D visited her sister in Bulbugan so its just me and Mommy F here, I can't just leave Mommy F alone in the store. So yeah, it made me feel good coz of this luck I have today. Happy Stomach, Happy Me ƪ⁠(⁠‾⁠.⁠‾⁠“⁠)⁠┐

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK6Ht3BpwvyTaCEFCeMkwic46XQHNquDrzmjJ4292Sssf9uP79LqVaTZhxWYntLBB1.jpg And so, with this two ingredients, I will make potato omelette but with Malunggay leaves to make it a lil healthier, sadly I don't have garlic, huhu.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EogLpCR73P6gX6115wQk4YQEGEedBHf2yriyPcQmSTR6N7xdKt3JJqLR3CZwcQzYQZr.jpg I usually boil my potato whenever I make potato omelette but this time I stir fried it with just a bit of oil and a pinch of salt. Just a lil bit and enough to cook the potato. Yep, I cut them into smaller sizes of cubes.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoiVj6115Ejct3sJVeqCa8KvcNT5kRWypbPUZ7oBG8H3MfWuj4tMhjFmbVqwjUVn38q.jpg While waiting for the potatoes to soften a little, I took care of the malunggay and pick every leaves on its stem. I also crack two eggs and put salt, msg, and ground pepper in it

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoprS47aEGUvMTkADa1UAucci6P6wrHoc9aMoUeT96NLDpSkAf5TxAYER9wABkz1ZUh.jpg I just beaten the egg and mix the malunggay leaves. While i'm doing that,I checked the Potatoes and its ready. And so, without cooling it down, I put it immediately in the beaten eggs.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoEpUcQvZZsjtBsso3m6sUeXw7JFkSpqZh7nTD4Y4Z4CzHAVzHJX8umR4rr3CHGjgip.jpg By the way, i'm in the middle of preparing when I suddenly feel so hungry. Good thing I have toasted sliced bread that I bought the other day in the market, crispy and with margarine and sugar on top. Some will call it Butter Toast, but this one used Margarine so I should call it Margarine Toast no? Hehe. And with this, I am once again fueled with more energy, lolol

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoEoyufAtD59YeMTDAkCEzBauoUQpnH5jrkcQKyJkgCYqvxBktSjmLS7RHk2Ms9GCKk.jpg Going back to our recipe, before moving the potatoes, I sauteed the garlic with the potatoes just to give it a nice smell to it

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EpJX8eM3yXezMmHtDLaT1LiUmRTirsPbcwmt9bzevkMkGfwx2cQbc3jAX2hPMy8AUjC.jpg And there we have it, its ready for frying. The Malunggay leaves really put a nice color into it no?

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK4x7QfMRjoubXmimcxFMyjPc6pq1h4NVEySas145f1FaUnsnhn9sJXxdHwGETgYsU.jpg I just cook it like how I made omelette. Because I don't want it with too much oil, I didn't put much of it there, you can see it? Despite the small amount of cooking oil, it didn't stick to the pan, lucky ＼⁠(⁠^⁠o⁠^⁠)⁠／. The secret? Just make sure that the pan is hot when you put the oil. Anyways, cooking this doesn't require much time. We flip it after one minute

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoGwYvBDrjnYiU3fa1ds8UD7Msac41wADeuwUtcfspoeGCjbRaLFKFqH5WhqfhP9Q9C.jpg Tadaaaaan, and it's done! What do you think guys? Do you want some? UwU. I actually live how I cook my potato, not too hard, not too soft either, just like how I want it. (⁠ ⁠/⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠)⁠/⁠♪⁠♪

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/EoK5mqKkmUThSh9JM7vbwJm2pKLFWkk73g7E3s95KoNWF4W2DYsUhL1jNbueSZwxY1Z.jpg Yum, yum, I ate less rice today because of this Potato Omelette. Just one of this is already fulfilling you know ୧⁠(⁠＾⁠ ⁠〰⁠ ⁠＾⁠)⁠୨

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eoc8w636Th2E4t6gMiekUWDAUvpyPii14fPaa9CjvhpD8VhAwHf9LTL7Yq2SAgGeRcH.jpg And after a nice and heart lunch, next s a good dessert. Its a Polvoron, this one cost me 5 pesos and it has Pinipig in it, yum, yum! Some lady go house to house to sell her sweets including Polvoron and Mommy D bought a pack of it. 12 pieces for 50 pesos. Polvoron really is addicting no matter who make it, as long as its good and sweet ♪⁠ ⁠\⁠(⁠^⁠ω⁠^⁠\⁠ ⁠) ----- Lead Image Edited in [Canva](https://canva.link/lw0gte0imiqb54r)

body.title: Fresh Beetroot Juice – A Natural Energy Boost
body.body: Hello amazing drink lovers! Today I want to share one of my favorite healthy drinks — fresh beetroot juice. It is not only colorful

>pixabay

refreshing but also packed with nutrients that support a healthy lifestyle. Beetroot juice has a naturally sweet taste and is known for containing vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Many people enjoy it because it may help support energy levels and overall wellness. The deep red color also makes it one of the most beautiful natural drinks. Ingredients: • 2 fresh beetroots • 1 apple • 1 carrot • Half a lemon • 1 glass of water • Ice cubes (optional) Preparation: First, wash and peel the beetroot and carrot. Cut all ingredients into small pieces and blend them with water. Strain if needed, add lemon juice, and serve fresh with ice cubes. The taste is refreshing and slightly earthy with a natural sweetness. It is a great drink for hot days or for starting your morning with something healthy.

body.title: Dimmed Spotlights
body.body:
>

> # Clean energy creation
># Environmental pollution reduction
># Human wellbeing

Rather than wars and data centres for processing of AI uselessness, The majority of resources that lay outside of daily survival should be pushed into these three areas. *Clean energy* because energy consumption ultimately will continually go up and it is a huge resource stumbling block for design. *Pollution reduction* (including what is already in the environment) because regardless of whether climate change is man-made or not, we should engineer our environment to be supportive of our best. And then, *Human wellbeing,* as ultimately that is the most important aspect of our species, *bar none.* 


---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23ydTMvyhzKMaE6GLwPGotbFsTyn43BwRZfxmzyHJ3PV3uLJPokYbx66MgpwWx3xTevJY.png)


---

It saddens me that so much of our effort is put into nonsense that doesn't matter, that doesn't improve our lives, that doesn't take us forward as a species to open up more potential, more possibility, more of our best. Instead, we spend our resources on not only holding the status quo, but trying to hold onto a past that was already broken. One where wealth and power are the underlying motive for our activity, drawing lines on maps, enacting violence, supporting division. 

> A tale as old as human time?

*Perhaps.*

But what makes it difficult to change the story for the future is that we keep on repeating all the mistakes of the past, never learning, never practicing, never investing into what leads us to an environment supportive of human growth potential. We run counter to our best, with the economy driving supply and demand behaviours that crush human potential in order to increase bottom lines, making it increasingly difficult for any individual to improve, because the environment they are raised within is degrading. 

> We are products of our environment.

Where and the way we are raised, the community we are within, the beliefs we are instilled with, the programming we are influenced by - everything that happens to us, and everything we do, shapes us. And we are not getting better, we are not improving the ecosystem of life for the next generations, and we are not even making our lives better now. 

> Do you think you are?

You might be. At least, you might *believe* you are improving the world for yourself or your children, but ultimately, it will amount to nought. Because no matter who you are, or how much you have, you, like all of us, are destined to be within the world we have. No one is outside it, no one is larger, no matter how much wealth and power held. We are all trapped here, *together.*

You might have designs on heading into space to escape the rest of us, but that path is not a saviour. One might survive, but that doesn't mean freedom. Instead, the sins of the past will forever weigh heavy, the failure. And if it does not, then that speaks volumes also - *but it will.* 

> None of us get out unscathed.

As I see it, survival as a human isn't about maintaining life, it is about building the species outward in ways that make it increasingly robust and able to deal with experience. It is not about who makes the most money, it is about how much wellbeing *we make* as a society. To do this, we need to apply skills and resources in the right locations, to invest into what matters, even if it is \

compared to the legacy economic practices. > Efficiency isn't the goal, human impact is. That isn't to say we shouldn't look for efficiencies, because we should. But where we apply process for efficiency is in areas that improve humanity, not profits. If we still have to have a monetary system and let's assume that we must for some time still, then we have to align it with our wellbeing, where success is directly tied to human improvement. > That requires *energy, environmental security, and human wellbeing.* We can do better, but doing better personally isn't enough, if it is leading to others doing worse. We have to be a net positive, and the investment focus should be toward increasing the gap between good and harm, where we are continuously adding positive value, whilst decreasing negative. The challenge isn't in being able to do it, because we could start doing it today. The challenge is having the will to make the changes necessary, to let go of the many attachments we hold onto to maintain our sense of self - our broken identity. The wars of and environmental issues aren't at the hands of tyrants and dictators, our suffering isn't caused by them - it is all a symptom of our warped minds, our failing behaviours, and our unwillingness to do better, to support better, to demand better. > The solutions are easy. The hard part is breaking all the habitual practices that hold us back. body.title: A Meaningful Day at the MFAT Training for Grade 1 Teachers
body.body:
***Teaching is more than just giving lessons in class. It means knowing each child’s needs, strengths, and struggles. As teachers, we are here to guide, support, and create chances for all students, especially those who need extra help. Recently, I attended the MFAT (Multi-Factored Assessment Tools) Training for Grade 1 teachers. This experience stood out in my blog because it helped me understand the true needs of students with developmental challenges and those who need special education.***

![mfat.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/48UHr4jiqpt9TQwR3mGLZqVNMEW59XHchxzYb1grD7HNBH8rUBBDhnSSFxsezwQVf2.jpg)

**The training was designed to help teachers spot students who might need extra help or different teaching approaches.**As a Grade 1 teacher, I realized how important our role is in a child’s early years of learning. Grade 1 is an important time when children begin to develop skills in reading, math, talking, and making friends. The MFAT training reminded us that every student is different, and not all children learn in the same way or at the same pace.

![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xyZj1eVxUikDv4PNPDBjWySreCJxh4NVV8BDEQLSvek8NiefdNrbdHVofFNVqZpTWi7.jpg)

**The training day began early with registration and welcoming remarks from the facilitators.**The room was filled with excitement as many teachers eagerly learned new strategies to help their students. Even with our busy schedules, everyone actively participated because we knew this training would benefit our students.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xp8Z2kvQXKwBkdcF1kkvT9dUEBQM1sAsfKmQSKnJcz2sz8qkk8yrjPdGmrPMj2nGG96.jpg)

**An important part of the training was learning to recognize signs that a child might need special education support.** Some children have trouble with reading, writing, talking, understanding, paying attention, behavior, or social skills. Others may experience developmental delays or learning difficulties that can go unnoticed in regular classrooms. MFAT helps teachers check students carefully using the right tools and observations. These checks are not meant to put labels on children but to understand their needs and give the right support.

![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/241tdW8oy9usyvMhaW1hLh14kprJGkZVuCPFULnKPfeawQbDBgK8q38GPwcpk7NeeuaD8.jpg)

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/241tdDGGk7wwYoVXyw2dzeWn4yb8E1TT2W2ZSMZ3xPchnTajEKrdmLkGXHL8Hddez7ipp.jpg)

**As the talks went on, I understood how important it is to help children early.** Many students struggle quietly because their needs are not noticed right away. Sometimes, these children are seen as lazy or inattentive, but their behavior often masks problems that require patience, understanding, and special help. The training reminded us to create classrooms where every child feels accepted, valued, and encouraged to learn. The training was on the value of teamwork among teachers, parents, and school leaders. Education works best when everyone supports the child together. Parents help their children learn at home, while teachers guide and support them in class. Good communication and coordination make sure children get the help they need. 

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xAiMKJf8g7xGPvc6H6Srf3j1RRJSbTF36fCbnHEMorss3FLzNJpqE7u2R84SanmY3o9.jpg)

![10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23w2qS7bHbbJ8gqniXGLz96gP9a5SkvQJFnodh9AG3zBLJN6hRC4U3Rvqk9xcaM2GcAoi.jpg)

The facilitators also taught us ways to support students with special educational needs over time. We learned about using different teaching methods, making classroom adjustments, giving positive feedback, and offering individual support. These strategies help all children join in class activities. It was inspiring to hear real stories from teachers about students who got better with the right help and patience. From our own classroom experiences, many of us realized that we may have missed students before because we lacked the right knowledge or skills.

![13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23vsScYWtt5bwzJ5P8jgdQDzYtwDGinvfHKSy3ktsjZfaPiiXJqkm6Yg13WFKjez6HRUv.jpg)

![14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23yTmAwZ5K37xMjUjXkLpZpFGiMFq6K4VnKwEzgwrJMvmkoMALGUiYaDLmoizTpHLRkfB.jpg)

In group activities, we reviewed example student cases and discussed ways to support them. This made us think about our own classrooms. The training opened our eyes as teachers and encouraged us to keep trying.ing.

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23x1HYVNsGtGpkF9EfT9u8W5ddsyg8Yz6d4Qd5ZSXfiFHR2zzx8Qa8W3ridcTB8tdaEBP.jpg)

As I left the training, I reflected on everything I had learned that day. I felt thankful because the seminar gave us valuable insights to help us become better, more caring teachers. The training also reminded me that no child should be left behind. Every student deserves a chance to learn, grow, and succeed, no matter their challenges. This helps me better meet the different needs of children in the classroom.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teacherlynlyn/23xL7BDU8t5G98YHgQ8potLz5iHk84nd2BVmiSwZUGmKGUya9UX8b4kneAutapqwHPHB6.jpg)

***Attending the MFAT Training for Grade 1 teachers was more than just a seminar. It was a meaningful experience that deepened our understanding of inclusive education and reminded us of our mission as teachers: to nurture every child with care, compassion, and hope for a brighter future.***

body.title: Cheese Maggie - cheesy & Delicious Breakfast
body.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🇮🇳🙏🏻</center>
____________________________________


Hello Friends, How are you all ?? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life Ahead.

Today i would like to share the recipe of **Cheese Maggie** in which maggie is cooked with the flavours of cheese and Milk. It is basically an alteration to the popular masala maggi recipe where cheese and chilli flakes are added. There are many ways of making maggies depending on your choice and liking, for the beet first time i have tried cheese Maggie but seriously it came out to delicious and Yummy. Usually maggie is morning breakfast but you can eat it anytime especially during mid-night carving. It is easy & quick recipe with less ingredients, try this recipe you gonna like it for Sure.



![1000682571.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242Nsqr5J7Rku4cYrZZNLmfNfAxuj5VUHPZhkBPuoYZ431TVyK8hqymx1K8Mk6QVz6hfG.png)


____________________________________
# <center> Timming 🕡</center>
____________________________________

|Preparation Time| 1 Minutes|
|-|-|
|Cooking Time |20 Minutes|
|Cuisine|Indian|
|Course|Breakfast|
|Serving|2 Person|




____________________________________
# <center> Ingredients 📃</center>
____________________________________

• 2 Pack of Maggi with Sachet.
• 1 cube of cheese.
• 1 cup of Milk.
• 1 tbsp of Oregano.
• Water as required.
• salt (option).


____________________________________
# <center> Process 👨🏻‍🍳</center>
____________________________________


![1000674875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yThQYbHoxZHaQZ3Tb5rhokK5SdzuW98qkYY32zTmtRoqLBf5oUGabCo9NHHBD4qWTrB.jpg)

Boil in water in a pan/Kadai, when water start boiling  then drop in the Noodles cakes.

![1000674869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wqper5hc3PFfgXastDi5FVzKDpipyPZRJukZHQ8TLAZKAE2h3aeEKKX4Uoe6YeZfZ7x.jpg)

Simmer on medium-high cook it for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally until the noodles are soft.

![1000674872.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/244A6UQzrWfQ37f4miGsMcVuHA5bjXrqrjDinUuYne1JjQTGoDrssKhz2gQdrRZ1BJXpC.jpg)

Add the Maggie Tastemaker. Mix well so that there will be no lumps of tastemaker.


![1000674873.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yd81JpBRJ6U3GDiek4encXaLsGgNDMuiyNrLoApNLz9ZESAvhsVW9p43ixNErQCQpZW.jpg)

Cook it for another minute.

![1000674865.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/2423zKVRWXSezbFA5C62xAGY1cYiu22DSSfYE3pTfWq5EpLc4SqHM5Githwx27of3esmJ.jpg)

title.title: Why Does the Amarnath Ice Shivling Melt and Reform Every Year? 🕉️
title.body:
![Why Does the Amarnath Ice Shivling Melt and Reform Every Year.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/a9392805cf6425bba20b8c5e2bd6890f3d3e9146fe74fd242e6f945ccc8c6de6)




The Amarnath Ice Shivling is one of the most extraordinary natural phenomena in the world, a naturally forming ice stalagmite inside a high-altitude Himalayan cave at \~3,888 metres (12,756 ft). Every year, without any human involvement, it grows through winter, reaches its peak during the yatra season (July-August), then melts completely by autumn only to reform again the following winter.The process is driven by freezing meltwater and moisture seeping through the cave ceiling. What makes it spiritually significant is that its cycle closely follows the Hindu lunar calendar; the Shivling typically peaks around Shravan Purnima (full moon of the month of Shravan).Scientists attribute it to a controlled cave microclimate, drip patterns, and temperature gradients. Devotees see it as Bholenath's divine presence manifesting in physical form. Both perspectives make this one of India's most discussed natural and spiritual wonders.
Share your yatra experience answer any or all:1. Which month did you visit: and how big was the Shivling when you saw it?2. Did the altitude, cold, or trek difficulty affect your darshan? Any AMS symptoms to warn others about?3. Which route did you take: Pahalgam or Baltal? Would you recommend it for families/seniors?4. How far in advance did you book your tempo traveller on rent for the base camp journey from Delhi?
We booked through Delhi Tempo Travels  last year and the experience was smooth, comfortable tempo traveller, punctual driver, zero vehicle hassle. Recommend booking at least 4-6 weeks in advance.

title.title: Me Time ala Salma …
title.body: /> This weekend was very busy, starting on Friday, after 2 PM, I had appointment with my bestie, Oma Molly. She is a very good mom and Oma. She has two daughters and one granddaughter, very cute and funny, always keeps her busy all the time. We went to The Park Mall in Sawangan near our house and had lunch together. It was a very sunny day, over 32°C. We ate at a Restaurant called Dapur Solo which serves Javanese foods.

/> We ordered the same menu: Nasi Kuning Complete ( Yellow rice with spicy potatoes and coconut grilled meat ). The food was very nice and delicious, Traditional Javanese food from Solo with sweet, and spicy flavours. While eating, we recalled beautiful memories of our travel to Javanese. Its been a wonderful experience.

/> For desert I ordered Es Campur Solo ( small ice with some jelly and coconut in it with syrup and milk). It was really nice, sweet and refreshing desert. We talked for more than two hours, discussed about parenting, feelings and our travel experiences. I also heard sad news that her friend has cancer and she felt very sad so I tried to encouraged her and gave her some mental support. I am hoping that her friend will get better and cured, since it has been a hard time for her and her friend so they need a good support system from her family and friends.

/> After our lunch, we walked around the mall looking for gifts for our friends. From one store to another store and discussing different items, but we kept considering and looking around again. I finally got my gift.

/>

We had a very good time together. It was time to say good bye for a while and continue our lives. This is me time Ala Salma, sometimes at home, work, malls, friends or learning new things. I enjoyed my me time.

I hope you are happy reading my me time stories. Wishing you all very good health, lot of happiness.

title.title: Celebrating Gastronomy
title.body:
May 22nd is celebrated as Venezuelan Gastronomy Day.

![covergastronomia.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23y92chEBgMoAD6Gisqe5X66csxWuAeCCt62c94MvKh7eoCgfH4fjJ9N6nhuvuqMfcDFs.png)


 

> Edit in Canva & Photoshop

------



<div class=\

> Last Friday was Venezuelan Gastronomy Day, a date established long ago by various individuals, guilds, and associations related to the culinary world, to celebrate Venezuelan cuisine and the work of all those who make it possible to preserve the country's culinary culture. To celebrate, I attended the activities held at the Cortulara headquarters, in what is known as La Casa Bonita, a place that was restored some time ago. In the past, the Friends of Barquisimeto Foundation operated there, and I remember teaching theater classes there a long time ago. That house is now the headquarters of the Lara State regional tourism agency. The place is very beautiful, very well maintained, and there was even an art exhibition; perhaps I'll show it in another post. ---- > El viernes pasado se celebró el Día de la Gastronomía Venezolana, una fecha establecida hace tiempo por diversas personas, gremios y asociaciones relacionadas con el mundo de la gastronomía, para celebrar la cocina venezolana y la labor de todos aquellos que hacen posible preservar la cultura culinaria del país. > Para celebrarlo, asistí a las actividades que se llevaron a cabo en la sede de Cortulara, en lo que se conoce como La Casa Bonita, un lugar que fue restaurado hace algún tiempo. En el pasado, allí funcionaba la Fundación Amigos de Barquisimeto, y recuerdo haber impartido clases de teatro allí hace mucho tiempo. > Esa casa ahora es la sede de la agencia regional de turismo del estado Lara. El lugar es muy bonito, está muy bien conservado e incluso hubo una exposición de arte; tal vez se la muestre en otra publicación. ![IMG_20260522_105608_569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpVD3DBJpmTbPsr7MrgMNPgcVzV1My8L9P2XZT4prWz8eoA4YF5EBEeou6nprLqEHKv.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260522_092323_006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EowH6oLZUykyr4CZ7a6opjG2h4uM889j4kSY41N2uzCYSWwMVhkikD7PN5tNeFci5CD.jpg)|![IMG_20260522_092143_301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpA41tmeefu1NoWFEkBJb8zC2ZvzpCocPVpw7eiHBizdWmCqqEG6jaVRsc9HzA3PUYc.jpg) || ![IMG_20260522_085116_703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Ep1WyNoXtnz6xDbPv73Fp7kREhjJX5BZeFo98kKYpDQNkKCQcJ8snL4AYryu4T6TKFb.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_085122_657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/Ep7yPhVMbtYLakthDvzrLUWAhQDsNLGaGx7AvPiHFiwhHGdDPisfSp2ejLV67rvRoUV.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_085257_832.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpLgyF4EU6MxqqatTcc8bPB98nnTp1oBYBTuCAGcpNqnttPgBuVETiWzxYXvvfGfrPb.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_085356_111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpvhxEQn9ws9Cnwcph9YJ89Uw24AQAsxx3AEL3MDc4acHhz4g1BbWNbZjbMxwoFdk9N.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_085450_085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpT63vjoEvpV48DHNUgsLUJQq2wASd8BmwZykxXCFP9LjaVzuRSaVyp1N6m2pJpehqT.jpg)
----
At the entrance were the protocol staff, mostly students from the INCE (National Institute of Educational Cooperation) specializing in tourism and protocol. A diverse group of entrepreneurs from the region were present with their stalls. There I ran into my friends from Vios La Portentoza, whom I had seen at other events. There was a local brand from the Río Claro area, specializing in coffee. The coffee was very good; you can really taste the difference with specialty coffee, which has a sweet flavor even without added sugar. Real coffee doesn't need sugar. It's nothing like those bad, dark coffees they mix with other things, but since I'm poor, I have to buy that bad coffee at the Chinese supermarket. There were also several stalls selling sweets, with cookies, catalinas (a type of sweet bread), corn cakes, and rice pudding. The selection was very varied, and everything was delicious. And of course, there was music: a group of local musicians gave two performances to delight our ears with local music. ---- > En la entrada se encontraba el personal de protocolo, en su mayoría estudiantes del INCE (Instituto Nacional de Cooperación Educativa) del área de turismo y protocolo. Un grupo diverso de emprendedores de la región estaba presente con sus puestos. Allí me encontré con mis amigos de Vios La Portentoza, a quienes había visto en otros eventos. > Había una marca local de la zona de Río Claro, especializada en café. El café estaba muy bueno; se nota la diferencia con un café de especialidad, que tiene un sabor dulce incluso sin azúcar añadido. El café de verdad no necesita azúcar. No tiene nada que ver con esos cafés malos y oscuros que mezclan con otras cosas, pero como soy pobre, tengo que comprar ese café malo en el supermercado chino. > También había varios puestos que vendían dulces, con galletas, catalinas (un tipo de pan dulce), tortas de maíz y arroz con leche. La degustación era muy variada y todo estaba delicioso. No podía faltar la música: un grupo de músicos criollos ofreció dos presentaciones musicales para deleitar los oídos con música local. ----- ![IMG_20260522_101556_676.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23xpFJ1MAG4nqDGnu7tx8Zdbn7iuPwCPZyyUDuy2DAsXPAPRAx9FrS94SuNqh57o4ZTFW.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_100932_437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpA26vqZeGFjZpSGVMfkfa8uCtMsAfTW6CjbrQn7edZugPvPYLdau9wQpTndMVbmikv.jpg) |||| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20260522_104508_497.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpT72x5L5XNtVdiKYXy9dHkvcEi2ZwZyDLfqFS58hgrRjTd419JZZUBhqnrFhErr9G6.jpg)|![IMG_20260522_095904_423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EouA6sMoEXPT1VdVudf9r32A16171jfHH64cpHKykTFHcv9F8xbzzuQoD9jssXm7aov.jpg) || ![IMG_20260522_101310_236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EqDjWrU8frKLGbcDpfGSGsNjaowHL5TCfnxyuUGik3U2pNmR2zjwMgwQnGxUBoYZiuf.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_101925_948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EprVWN11gEyVzz72bLPN9rCUEPawGmmfdp9gtsPHS2nn8ySMSqJzbAkj6Nsc6voajW5.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_112452_805.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EpnCJj9hSvtbjP1HAvjeTRzyMUKpWvAMn6fEx1ScEt2YRS2RBnQ2AfNXtmcWPoabS7t.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_095421_580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/EqNEnrKZUVGvivRRybSJfBtfeMwHGNbKyHytGxgoroEtrhWcrWwD6u3jxdthsCBSZzL.jpg) ---- In the final part of the event, a chef and cooking instructor began preparing a dish live, demonstrating the techniques he uses to make it. After the demonstration, a small tasting was offered. Presentations were also part of the activities, where the importance of tourist establishments, such as the region's main hotels, including local dishes on their menus was discussed. Many tourists visiting the area want to try a typical dish, and many hotels don't offer this option. Furthermore, all professionals in the tourism and gastronomy sector were invited to join the association to collaborate on their planned projects. Representatives from the gastronomy community, tourism authorities from the regional government, and the circle of journalists specializing in gastronomy were present. It was a very productive morning and a celebration of our cuisine. ---- > En la parte final, un chef e instructor de cocina comenzó a preparar un plato en vivo, demostrando a los presentes las técnicas que utiliza para elaborarlo. Al finalizar la preparación, se ofreció una pequeña degustación. > Las presentaciones también formaron parte de las actividades, donde se debatió la importancia de que los espacios turísticos, como los principales hoteles de la región, incluyan platos locales en sus menús, ya que muchos turistas que visitan esta zona desean degustar un plato típico, y muchos hoteles no les ofrecen esa opción. Asimismo, se invitó a todos los profesionales del sector turístico y gastronómico a unirse a la asociación para colaborar en los proyectos que tienen previstos. > Estuvieron presentes el gremio gastronómico, las autoridades turísticas de la entidad gubernamental regional y el círculo de periodistas especializados en gastronomía. Fue una mañana muy productiva y una celebración de nuestra gastronomía. ---- **Photographs taken with mobile phone Tecno Neo 2 - Cover made with the Canva application - Gifs and separators made by me in photoshop** ![bannerjc (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/23ydNhQkF3nzktNsBY1ibWXpop8Yk6PHgAdZvB1yNp7LqWrGnWNVEwnUxrQUGdfnXD1yh.jpg)

title.body: ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ4U26dPuTK8XVPZTQDFRy5xdhBQi84yUmvN9wuYYJ4qN/Shukan.webp) ## North Korea champion in... South Korea In a historic match played last Saturday at the Suwon Sports Complex, Naegohyang Women’s FC etched its name into the history books of Asian women’s soccer. The team from the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea edged out Tokyo Verdy Beleza by a narrow margin (1-0) thanks to a goal by Kim Kyong Yong, who was also named the tournament’s MVP. The match highlighted North Korea’s defensive solidity, as they managed to neutralize the Japanese attack despite having lost 4-0 to the same opponent in the group stage. Naegohyang completed a flawless run in the knockout rounds: a victory over Vietnam in the quarterfinals and over host Suwon in the semifinals. This victory marks the first continental title for a North Korean club in the competition’s modern era and earns them a spot in the upcoming FIFA Women’s Champions Cup. For Tokyo Verdy Beleza, the runners-up, there is the consolation of having reached the final as a testament to the high level of Japanese soccer. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/F%C3%BAtbol.webp) ## Al Nassr Celebrates Its League Title Al-Nassr FC has won its 11th Saudi league title (Ronaldo’s first in Saudi Arabia) after a season in which it clearly dominated the Saudi domestic league. With key goals from the Portuguese star in the final stretch, including braces in decisive matches, the team led by Jorge Jesus clinched the championship. The rivalry with Al-Hilal went down to the wire, but the Yellow-and-Blacks withstood the pressure. Ronaldo celebrated his first major trophy in the SPL, scoring more than 25 league goals. This success reinforces the elite Saudi project and sets the club up for continental competitions. ![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfU7Mmo3zLmtuNsfnPQr4AJqgmPoUeMiFXwpgLkK1ujc3/F%C3%BAtbol.webp) ## Takefusa Kubo Focused on the World Cup Takefusa Kubo Focused on the World Cup Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) continues his rise as an Asian star. A recent Copa del Rey winner with his club, the “football genius” has been key in attack and is poised to lead Japan at the 2026 World Cup, especially with Mitoma out. At 24, Kubo combines technique, speed, and maturity, attracting interest from major European clubs. He has had a standout season in La Liga, making decisive contributions, and now faces his true test to take a step forward in his leadership with the Samurai Blue.

title.body: I'm not an Arsenal fan but with the way everything has been since last week, it's as if everyone in the world has been supporting Arsenal for a long time even when they have their different clubs as number 1. It feels so good to have seen Arsenal win the Premier League after a long while of 22 years of trying. When they won it in 2004, I wasn't into football, so I didn't know but with the way the narration has been going, it shows really well that it's been a very long time waiting for the Gunners. That Tuesday night when Manchester City took on Bournemouth and it ended in a draw, I rooted greatly for Arsenal that night, I wanted Manchester City to lose or draw with Bournemouth so that it could be sealed for Arsenal. It happened, just like a joke, the 'almighty' Manchester City who were very much ready to trash Bournemouth to at least 3 unanswered goals, failed to win. They almost won Manchester City until towards the end of the match when Haaland scored an equaliser.

/>

不知不觉来到了五月的下旬，也迎来了夏日里的第一个高温天气，最高气温38度左右，接下去会连续几日，气温在38度左右，对于户外工作的人们不是很友好，大家也要做好防暑措施，家里早就备好了藿香正气水。

关于藿香正气水，肯定是夏日必备药之一，大部分情况是用不到的，以防万一！！冰箱里也多了好几瓶冰水，虽说女性不建议吃冰，但天气这么热，喝冰水，那可是一种享受啊，偶尔喝之，也没啥的。

太阳很是热烈，阳光充足的情况下，户外出片效果还是很NICE的，随手一拍都是一幅美景，东街口大厦门前小夜市又有所改动，这小门面还整挺好的，看着就是小巧玲珑的，却也是应有尽有，有吃喝，也有鲜花艺术，还有各地工艺品，手工类品最多，当然附近的酒楼也包了三个铺位做外卖，生意也还不错。。

酒楼外卖摊位，我在他们家买过几次，从主食面条，包子，再到福州荔枝肉，再有鲜榨果汁等等，果然，酒楼出品菜品确实比较美味，再说这个一级地段，食品各类的也是有保障，吃得放心。

每次经过干果类连锁店，都忍不住买两袋，这次不买花生米了，该换换口味了，买了红枣核桃糕，再来一份水蜜桃干，价格有点小贵，品质确实很OK，媲美山姆会员店内购买的干果类，关键是他们给的试吃品类全啊，而且大方的很，你可以随意吃，爱吃多少都行，有点儿干果自助餐的那味了。。。当然，我每次有试吃都有购买，嘻嘻。

走到南街这一块，不经意发现一处，咕咚咕咚冒泡的小温泉盆景啊，好家伙，还连着好几个呢，(⊙o⊙)…我呢，不自觉地拿出5毛钱的硬币投币去，就把它们当做是许愿池了，哈哈，一投一个准，可好玩了！！！关键是投完之后，可以把硬币再捞出来放回口袋，主打一个夏日里玩水有趣，还能顺便许个美好愿望---许愿2026年快乐丰盛旅行，上海，成都，广州，洛阳等等地，顺利成行，玩得开心。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周一愉快，愉快一周。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**

As I am currently in learning mode (exam next week), today just a short post on my view about the development of cryptos.
These are the top cryptocurrencies as of today: 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zuerich/23t8CfKPvxwkJQ23dmuM5WCTXcTARbsXqqys91HCpkbPQiBKW5NfyNnnTCAuutLaUC158.png)

Privacy coins are also on the rise; I think Silbert is right [here](https://u.today/crypto-king-barry-silbert-privacy-era-is-here). I am not sure how long-term privacy coins' rise will be though. Here you have a 1-year chart of Zcash:

So where will be 5 years from now?
My estimation:
1. BTC with a market dominance of >70% (today 58.2%)

What do you think?

Have a great holiday (either Pentecost or Memorial Day),
zuerich
