>التمرين الثامن: تمرين تحرير العصب الوركي بوضعية الاستلقاء لعلاج الديسك وعرق النسا

\n\n
>Exercise 8: Sciatic Nerve Flossing in a Supine Position for Disc and Sciatica Relief

>نتابع اليوم التمرين الثامن في السلسلة العلاجية الخاصة للتخلص من الم الديسك والانزلاق الغضروفي نهائيا بلا عمليات جراحية

\n\n
>Today we continue the eighth exercise in our therapeutic series to permanently get rid of disc pain and herniated discs without surgeries
>تمرين اليوم مختلف وهام جدا لاننا لن نستهدف العضلات او الفقرات بل سنعالج العصب الوركي المضغوط نفسه الذي يسبب لك التنميل والكهرباء والوجع الممتد في الساقين

>Today's exercise is different and very important because we will not target muscles or vertebrae but we will treat the compressed sciatic nerve itself which causes you numbness electricity and extended pain in the legs
>هذا التمرين يعمل مثل الخيط الذي يسلك ويمدد العصب بلطف داخل القناة العصبية ليخلصه من الالتصاق بالفقرات واهمية التمرين تكمن بان الوجع والتنميل سيختفي فورا بعد التطبيق الصحيح

>This exercise works like a thread that glides and stretches the nerve gently inside the spinal canal to free it from adhesion to the vertebrae and the importance of the exercise lies in the fact that pain and numbness will disappear immediately after correct application
>طريقة تنفيذ هذا التمرين سهلة جدا وتحتاج القليل من التركيز فتابعو معي
>The method of performing this exercise is very easy and needs a little focus so follow along with me

>في البداية استلقي على ظهرك بالكامل بشكل مريح واثني ركبة رجلك السليمة واجعل قدمها على الارض لكي تحمي اسفل ظهرك وتريحه تماما ثم قم برفع فخذ الرجل المصابة وتمسكه بيدك الاثنتين من الخلف اي من تحت الركبة مباشرة حتى يصبح فخذك عموديا بزاوية قائمة مع جسمك وتثبت يديك في هذا الموضع

>In the beginning lie down completely on your back comfortably and bend the knee of your healthy leg and place its foot on the ground to protect your lower back and rest it completely then raise the thigh of the affected leg and hold it with both hands from behind meaning right under the knee until your thigh becomes vertical at a right angle with your body and fix your hands in this position

>بعد ذلك تبدا بفرد ساقك ورفع القدم للاعلى ببطء شديد حتى تستقيم الرجل بقدر الامكان وقبل ان تصل لمرحلة الالم تتوقف هنا وتبدا بتحريك مشط قدمك فقط حيث تسحب اصابع رجلك ببطء نحو وجهك ثم تفرد مشط قدمك للاعلى نحو السقف وكرر حركة المشط لعدة مرات ثم تنزل ساقك للاسفل ببطء

>After that you begin to straighten your leg and raise the foot upwards very slowly until the leg is as straight as possible and before you reach the pain stage you stop here and start moving your foot ankle only where you pull your toes slowly towards your face then extend your foot ankle upwards towards the ceiling and repeat the ankle movement for several times then lower your leg down slowly
>هذه الحركة لمشط القدم مع رفع الساق بهدوء يحرر العصب المضغوط ويعيد له المرونة قم بتكرار هذه الحركة ببطء عشر مرات لكل رجل مصابة وسوف تلاحظ ان الوخز والتنميل بدات ينحسر تدريجيا

>This movement of the foot ankle with raising the leg calmly releases the compressed nerve and restores its flexibility repeat this movement slowly ten times for each affected leg and you will notice that the tingling and numbness began to subside gradually
>جربوه الان بشرط الهدوء والتركيز وبدون عجلة واخبروني في التعليقات عن مقدار الراحة التي ستشعرون بها بعد التمرين ولاي استفسار انا معكم دائما وبالشفاء والعافية

>Try it now on the condition of calmness focus and without rushing and tell me in the comments about the amount of relief you will feel after the exercise and for any inquiry I am always with you wishing you healing and wellness

title.title: HivePulse v1.6.0: Multi-Account, Full Wallet & Smarter Notifications! 🔔💼
title.body:
Hey Hiveans! 🐝

We are thrilled to announce that **HivePulse v1.6.0** is now LIVE on the Chrome Web Store! This is our biggest update yet — one that transforms HivePulse from a handy companion into a true power-user cockpit for the Hive blockchain. If v1.5.0 gave you your wallet, v1.6.0 makes it yours across every account you manage.

![image.png](https://usermedia.actifit.io/MPKZHS829V67WPOHEYEHJMGWN8GB0G)

---

## 👥 Multi-Account Support: Switch Instantly, Stay in Control

For the many of you juggling multiple Hive accounts — creators, curators, developers, and teams — this one is for you.

- **Account Switcher Dropdown:** A new account switcher lives right in the header. Tap it to add, select, or remove accounts without ever opening a new browser tab.
- **Per-Account Session Storage:** Each account stores its own session tokens independently. Switching accounts is instant — no re-login required as long as your session is still valid.
- **Add Account Modal:** Adding a second (or third!) account is a breeze. Just enter the username, authenticate via Keychain, and you are in.

---

## 💸 Wallet: Transact Directly from the Extension

Your wallet is no longer just a read-only dashboard. You can now act on your assets without ever leaving HivePulse.

- **Quick Send:** Transfer HIVE or HBD to any Hive account — complete with recipient validation (including debounced lookup), amount input, optional memo, and a Max button. Powered by Keychain, so your keys never touch us.
- **Quick Receive:** Instantly display your Hive address with a one-click copy button. Share it with anyone, anywhere.
- **Transfer History:** Browse your last 20 transfers with clear in/out indicators. Need to go further back? Hit \

for cursor-based pagination through your full history.
- **Claim Rewards in One Click:** The portfolio pending section now features a **Claim All** button. When viewing your own account, claim your HIVE, HBD, and HP rewards in a single Keychain action — no frontend needed.

---

## 🏦 HBD Savings Dashboard: Put Your HBD to Work

HBD savings is one of Hive's most powerful — and underused — features. We have built a full dashboard around it.

- **Accrued Interest Estimate:** See how much interest your HBD savings have built up since your last payment, calculated in real time from chain data.
- **Claim Interest Button:** Trigger your interest payment directly from the extension. The button is intelligently gated on the 30-day compound interval, showing a countdown timer when you are not yet eligible.
- **Interest Payment History:** Review your last 5 interest payments at a glance.
- **Live APR Display:** The current HBD savings APR is fetched live from `condenser_api.get_dynamic_global_properties` and shown right alongside your balance.

---

## 💡 Earning Explainer: Understand Your Hive Income

New to Hive earnings, or just want a refresher? The **Earning Explainer** in the Wallet tab breaks down all four income streams with a clean, collapsible 4-card module:

- **Content Rewards** — author payouts from posts and comments
- **Curation Rewards** — rewards for voting early and well
- **Savings Interest** — passive yield on your HBD in savings
- **Governance** — returns from witness and DHF proposal voting

Each card includes the current live rate where applicable.

---

## 🔔 Notifications Tab: The Pulse, Fully Realised

The Stats tab has been completely rebuilt as a dedicated **Notifications** hub — no more cluttered gauges and search boxes, just the information that matters.

- **Unified Feed with Smart Filtering:** The Pulse now has four filter tabs — **All**, **Social**, **Finance**, and **Votes** — each showing exactly the notifications you care about, grouped by recency (Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month, Older).
- **Full Finance History:** We now pull from `condenser_api.get_account_history` in addition to the bridge API, surfacing notifications that were previously invisible:
  - Interest payments
  - Reward claims
  - Power-ups and Power-downs
  - Savings deposits, withdrawals, and fills
  - Proposal payments
- **Background Notification Polling:** The extension now silently checks for new Hive notifications in the background. When something arrives that you haven't seen, a **red badge** appears on the extension icon with the unread count.
- **Configurable Badge & Filters:** In Settings, you can toggle the notification badge on or off and choose exactly which notification types trigger it. Votes are off by default to keep things focused.
- **Finance Pagination Fixed:** \
in the Finance tab now correctly pages through your account history using a sequence-number cursor — it was silently broken before.\n- **Accurate Counts:** The total count shown next to \

now reflects the true combined total from both data sources, capped at 99+.

---

## 🌱 Onboarding & UX Polish

- **First-Run Banner:** New users are greeted with a friendly, dismissible onboarding banner that introduces key features on their very first open.
- **Contextual Tooltips:** Hover over VP, RC, HIVE, HBD, and all portfolio asset labels to get a quick explanation. Tooltips are viewport-aware — they never get clipped by the extension boundaries.
- **Version Number in Settings:** The current version (\

) is now shown at the bottom of the Settings screen, so you always know exactly what you are running.

---

## 📥 Get it Now!

If you already have HivePulse installed, your browser should update it automatically soon. If you haven't joined the pulse yet, now is the perfect time!

👉 **[Download HivePulse on the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hivepulse/hakcpohpejoejmlhiphpkjobpjeckdlg)**

### We Want Your Feedback!
HivePulse is built for you. If you have suggestions, find a bug, or want to see a specific feature, let us know in the comments below or join the conversation on Ecency Chat!

---


**Keep Hiving,**
*@hdev team*

title.title: Faith, Tradition and Brotherhood | Annual Urs Celebration in Pai Khel
title.body:
Asslamoaleku and hello to my #WeekendExperiences community. Welcome to another blog. I hope you people are doing well and having a great time. I am also doing pretty well. Today's blog is a special one. Last Sunday we celebrated Annual ceremony of Urs celebration of Pir Dada Mian Muhammad Wirali sb. 

Dada Mian Muhammad Wirai sb was a famous sufi saint of our area Pai Khel. His tomb is situated at Pai khel hills. Pai khel is my nativa village which is located in district Mianwali province Punjab of Pakistan. 

Urs is a word of urdu language that means marriage. But here it means anniversary of a sufi saint. 

We celebrate Urs rituals every year with zest and zeal. We pay homage, offer fateha and arrange a religious program on this day. We cook a special meal beef curry on this day and invite poor, needy and orphans children of the society. We also invite adult, old men , young men and women on this special day. 

We invite a religious scholar who delivers a speech on the topic of importance of sufi saints services to sprad Islam. Sufi saints spread Islam by love, peace and brotherhood. They were true Muslims. They never tried to spread Islam with weapons. They were true well wishers of Muslims. 

Pir Dada Mian Muhammad Wirali sb was also one of the famous and notable sufi saint of our area. He belonged to Malik family. 

All our family members were well dressed. My daughters Javeria Javed Khan and Shehrbano Khatoon also wore wonderful dresses on this sacred day. Look at their dresses in the pictures below. They were looking very beautiful. Their smiles were treat to watch. I like the way they were dressed up.

***

當然可以！以下是一個關於自然的部落格文章範本，使用Markdown格式：

```markdown
# 自然的奇妙世界

自然是我們生活中不可或缺的一部分，它不僅提供了我們所需的資源，還讓我們感受到生命的美好與奇妙。無論是壯麗的山脈、寧靜的湖泊，還是繁茂的森林，自然總是以其獨特的方式吸引著我們。

## 自然的美

在大自然中，我們可以看到各種各樣的美景。例如：

- **山脈**：高聳入雲的山峰，讓人感受到大自然的雄偉。
- **湖泊**：清澈的湖水映照著藍天，讓人心曠神怡。
- **森林**：樹木繁茂，鳥語花香，彷彿進入了一個世外桃源。

### 四季變換

自然的美在四季的變換中展現得淋漓盡致：

- **春天**：萬物復甦，花朵爭相綻放。
- **夏天**：陽光明媚，生機勃勃，適合戶外活動。
- **秋天**：樹葉變色，金黃的稻穀讓人心生感慨。
- **冬天**：白雪皚皚，靜謐而美麗。

## 保護自然

隨著人類活動的增加，自然環境面臨著許多挑戰。保護自然是我們每個人的責任。以下是一些可以採取的行動：

1. **減少塑料使用**：選擇可重複使用的產品，減少一次性塑料的使用。
2. **參加植樹活動**：通過植樹來增加綠地，改善空氣質量。
3. **支持可持續產品**：選擇環保產品，支持可持續發展的企業。

## 結語

自然是我們的家，我們應該珍惜和保護它。讓我們一起努力，讓這個美麗的星球變得更加美好！

---

感謝您閱讀這篇有關自然的文章！希望能激發您對自然的熱愛與保護意識。
```

這篇文章簡要介紹了自然的美、四季的變化以及保護自然的重要性。您可以根據需要進行修改和擴充！

title.body:
Traducido del Español a Inglés - Portugués

\n\n

> In anonymity
***It feels like I fell asleep on a Friday night and woke up on a Sunday morning...*** What the hell happened to the weekend.? flew by in the blink of an eye, it seemed to say HELLO AND GOODBYE.! Like some things lately, haha. 2:48 am in the peace of the night, the silence of the early morning. \

Then I regret it at 6 am when I have to get up to fulfill my obligations. 😒 You know how it is! Same old story, lack of sleep at night. I'll finish this and go get some rest before my alarm bothers me. I hate it so much...! But, it's punctual. ⏰ - Now that I think about it, it'll be a holiday for some people here, right? - I just hope it doesn't rain when we wake up because it'll be hard to get this blanket off me. 🥴 Have a great day and start to the week, everyone!
Postscript: What a disaster... In the previous lines I said I was going to sleep. 4:48 am, almost minutes until dawn. I got caught up in something else and forgot to post.
> **The photos are my own and I took them with my Redmi cell phone.** > **AI was not used to write the post; Google Translate was used to write the English and Português parts.** **

>

***Acaso me dormí el viernes por la noche y desperté un domingo por la mañana...?***
Que diablos pasó con el fin de semana.? Se fue como un pestañear de ojos, pareciera que me dijo HOLA Y ADIÓS.! cómo algunas cosas últimamente jajaja.


2:48 am en la paz de la noche, el silencio de la madrugada. \

Luego me arrepiento a las 6 de la mañana cuando debo levantarme a cumplir mis obligaciones. 😒 Ya sabes.! Lo mismo de siempre, falta de sueño por las noches. Terminaré esto y me iré a descansar un poco, antes de que mi alarma me moleste. La detesto tanto...! Pero, es puntual. ⏰ - Ahora que recuerdo, será feriado para algunos aquí, cierto.? - Solo espero que no amanezca lloviendo porque será difícil despegar esa cobija de mi cuerpo. 🥴 Qué sea un excelente día y comienzo de semana para todos.
. . . . Que desastre... En las líneas anteriores dije que me iría a dormir. 4:48 am casi minutos para que amanezca. Me ocupé en algo más y olvide publicar. > **Las fotos son de mi autoría y las tomé con mi teléfono celular Redmi.**
> **No se utilizó IA para escribir la publicación, se utilizó Google Translate para escribir las partes en inglés y português.** **

>

***Talvez eu tenha adormecido na sexta à noite e acordado no domingo de manhã....?***
O que aconteceu com o fim de semana? Passou num piscar de olhos, parece que disse OLÁ E ADEUS! Como algumas coisas ultimamente, hahaha.


2h48 da manhã, na paz da noite, no silêncio do início da manhã. \

Aí me arrependo às 6h, quando tenho que levantar para cumprir minhas obrigações. 😒 Você sabe como é! A mesma história de sempre, noites mal dormidas. Vou terminar isso e descansar um pouco antes que o despertador me perturbe. Odeio isso...! Mas, pelo menos, ele sempre toca na hora certa. ⏰ - Pensando bem, para algumas pessoas aqui vai ser feriado, né? - Só espero que não chova quando a gente acordar, porque vai ser difícil tirar esse cobertor de cima de mim. 🥴 Tenham um ótimo dia e uma excelente semana, pessoal!
. . . . Que desastre... Nas linhas anteriores eu disse que ia dormir. 4h48 da manhã, quase minutos para o amanhecer. Me distraí com outra coisa e esqueci de postar.
> **As fotos são de minha autoria e foram tiradas com meu celular Redmi.** > **A inteligência artificial não foi usada para escrever a postagem; o Google Tradutor foi usado para escrever as partes em inglês E português.** **

title.title: i283 ww39x, Drawing step by step /Rising Star
title.body: > Good morning everyone, I'm happy to welcome you back to one of my drawings. Today I've drawn one of the spectacular cards from the game. It's a new microphone, the i283 ww39x. As you can see, it's a lovely blue microphone. In fact, blue is the most predominant color in the entire drawing; it's present in almost every shade. So, if you're a fan of that color, you'll surely like the drawing. On the cover, you already saw a preview of how it turned out, but now I'm going to show you the whole process step by step from the beginning so you can see how I did it. To start, I drew what would be the inner frame. ![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JkCmxfZTBich6x3QdZyY6p5MQHPF8Kd7F6xGZoEKFXg8eN42ZhsJ41RYNxb79SW4.jpg) After drawing the frame, I then drew the handle and the top part, which includes the ball that protects the internal components of the device. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo4JhGpWhq8meW6CssThZJMp2YWPStvSn7CYyeynXyLxwrLv6R46FyLnunLbMWoKhHi.jpg) ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsw3tTGB4qDWYxox1wGjpdhJPyjtCNXWaGQPantTfWyppcw3DjwsbDSg.jpg) After that, I drew on the bottom part, which contains part of the microphone's power cable, and inside the microphone, I drew several internal lines to divide it into sections, making it look nicer and easier to paint. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eo6S6U3zkTDdsw3tTGB5K6D2NbunJvb1mVGAbQY7QoEh4Nd1dDJzCpdeoi4UjhGnhpd.jpg) Now comes the painting. As I mentioned before, the predominant color is blue, so you'll see it a lot. I started with the outer background, for which I chose a light blue, reminiscent of common playing cards. For the frame, I used a slightly more intense blue. For the inner background, which I painted next, I used various shades of blue. And the microphone itself is light blue, gray, and black. See it now in the photos. ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EocARNSU5xC9iEgS4aSdpBiYnmYp2RFmiKvJrXntd4H4cnuMuKS52EQcN14UCThByHb.jpg) ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/Eqqm9bUk3pEoXeRE1tWrpdbK22idXVcLrUWMP3r2z3U57EQxMnjN39DZzMCszc23JZF.jpg) ![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqmFVQ5PVTuYGooB8VcCfQPvpBDHuVumt6ptCAzvwA9A45H9brMzhk67RzRP9GKE5w.jpg) ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/EqqkiVEayHp3xYPZGow3pgho5HwVC1gKKma3Cs45uetJktkJVKe3PghWyd9d9LAYF1a.jpg) And to finish, here's the final result. See you in the next one. ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dharma1/244daT5zQ2B6pWGyYq5bnWRqQxLMkwmFqqoETnK2mAAcXPqtUeCxM6h3m7pcZLe9DevH7.jpg)

title.title: Where Nobody Knocks Twice #290
title.body:
My safe place is not so beautiful a space. There is no view, no proper arrangement of cushions, and no music. It's the bathroom. Specifically one of our bathrooms when everything has totally gone silent… I know how that sounds anyway. But if you grew up in my country and a household like mine, where at least each room has two people in it, though there's no noise, the privacy is not really something to negotiate about. You will understand why I chose the bathroom as my safe place, something close to sacred, and it is always neat. That is one thing I love about it. While I was growing up, I shared a room with my little brother. And we share a bathroom too. Well, the sitting room is unpredictable because it is an open space for everyone. And outside the house can be filled with visitors I don't have the energy to interact with, and all these small, small flies that always bite. And the room where I can easily sit, be myself, and enjoy my time alone, there is always a sister that will need my attention. So, sometimes and not for any big or particular reason, I'd go in and sit. Just to think about some things bothering me. Sometimes I am just there to clear my head, my thoughts and not think about anything. And the feeling I usually get those few moments behind the door is the relaxation itself. Not what I did inside. ![248189.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/248189.png) Though I still do this now. Because it kind of resets my buttons. When I have had a very long and stressful day. When things are weighing on me. When I just require some moments and minutes that truly belong to only me, I always go sit there. We all have different feelings about relaxation sometimes, and for me, it's always a place that looks peaceful from the outside. And most times, it is this first quiet corner that life gives me, and I never forgot what that felt like. --- Thank you for reading. >

title.title: Idemo na nameštaj sa Pinteresta
title.body:
Mesecima sam čuvala Pinterest slike savršenog nameštaja po meri i bila u fazonu: „Ovo želim u stanu.“ 😄 Problem je bio što mi je skoro svaki majstor kojem sam pokazala slike govorio da je to „previše komplikovano“, „preskupo“ ili da ne može da ispadne tako kako zamišljam.

Sasvim slučajno sam otkrila [Daibau](https://www.daibau.rs/) i odlučila da pokušam. Objavila sam upit, ubacila nekoliko Pinterest inspiracija, napisala dimenzije i okvirno šta želim — i vrlo brzo su mi se javili majstori sa konkretnim ponudama. Na kraju sam pronašla nekoga ko je stvarno razumeo ideju i uradio sve po korektnoj ceni.

Moj savet za objavu upita je da budete što precizniji. Ubacite slike inspiracije, napišite mere, materijale koje želite i okvirni budžet. Što više detalja date odmah, manje su šanse za nesporazume kasnije. I obavezno na profilima majstora pogledajte prethodne radove to mi je mnogo pomoglo pri izboru.

title.title: Calles vacías, silencio y oscuridad. (ES-EN)
title.body:
> --- Olor a humedad con una sensación de frío, fuera de este mundo, en la piel. El amanecer ilumina la soledad. > The smell of dampness and a cold, otherworldly sensation on the skin. Dawn illuminates the solitude. --- ![Image_1779622268109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zSBUgJCDNqTmU4azshVHHuheBneyNKQsYvWbS1ZqTCbAy5QY2xyQjawiijWtg6jYvTu.jpg) ![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) --- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YGCCSToraPc Para escuchar mientras se lee la historia – To listen to whilst reading the story [Fuente](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YGCCSToraPc) ![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png)
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

I wander through the empty streets; reflections in the damp pavement appear as the first light of day breaks. There are no colours, only the shadows of nothingness itself, with no footsteps, no words, not a soul to be seen. It was not yet dawn, but the light was peeping through, whilst silence settled upon every brick, every building, every pavement, behind the windows and doors. No one was looking through them. Only unsettling darkness and solitude. It was not a solitude sought out, but the feeling that no one inhabited this place, or any other. >I walked without seeing anyone, only empty buildings, knowing that no one was there. No birdsong, nor the sound of a gentle breeze, no scent of flowers, only the dampness on the ground, which reflected a few glimmers, but without any sign of life. Suddenly I found myself in a house, with no furniture to be seen. Instead, countless drawers were stacked high against the walls. Simple wooden drawers, yet inside they contained what had once been alive and which, from one moment to the next, were now merely lifeless bodies. --- ![20180823_152154.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYmq7wvSmfdDTpeptYQ1Kk9eoBJShM8mwadojotn8TFo16K6E1VrbVNF8pw4vb94LGp.jpg) ![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) --- >Horror flooded my vision when I saw their faces, their final poses as they died; in my mind I could hear the screams, the pain at the sight of those bodies contorted in agony. Unrecognisable faces, as if in the final second something had filled their last vision with terror, and what they saw or felt was torment never before experienced on earth. They were all the same, as if mummified in that position of visual and sensory torture, as if they had been frozen at the very moment they were suffering intense pain within, their insides being torn apart by something they could not control but which was tearing them apart from within. I looked at their faces and thought I could see those final moments: men, women, children, there was no distinction; it had taken them all, without exception. >Back on the street, walking amidst the silence and solitude of a city sleeping the eternal sleep from which it would never awaken. Thus I arrived at what looked like a bar or a café, where the scene was more desolate than terrifying. Black and white was the colour; it was a nightmare, yet in the first person, I was it. Inside, people of all ages lay as if asleep, in seas of blood and agony, where there was no longer any life. From their ears and noses, strands of the vital fluid that flows through the veins now formed pools around their expressionless faces, devoid of joy or sorrow. ---

![20180823_151234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eJunEWU8S9YzByHkdtSU9X4aHR8oF2zUyiyG824XPDcFd4CB7Y437Ri41s6pLBc2DY.jpg)
![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) --- >It took them in an instant, without suffering; they simply fell asleep. The only colour I could see was the blood-red that had already stopped flowing on the ground. They had been there for some time, as if waiting to come back to life in a world where words, colours and life would no longer flourish. The feeling I had, seeing those scenes everywhere, is indescribable; I didn’t know whether I too had gone, or whether I had been granted a glimpse of what was to come. All I know is that my heart was tightening fiercely, whilst sorrow flooded over me. It was already done; nothing could be done to change it; humanity was gone and the planet seemed empty. At that moment, I felt only the need to find someone else still alive, someone who had escaped that catastrophe. My eyes filled with tears, and when I awoke, they were still streaming down my face.

Recorro las calles vacías, reflejos en la humedad de las mismas aparecen tras las primeras luces del día. No hay colores, sólo las penumbras de la nada misma, sin pasos, sin palabras, sin un alma que por ellas atravesara. No era la madrugada, sino que la luz atisbaba, mientras el silencio se plasmaba en cada ladrillo, cada edificio, cada suelo, tras las ventanas y puertas. Nadie miraba a través de ellas. Sólo inquietante oscuridad y soledad. No era una soledad buscada, sino la sensación de que ya nadie ese lugar ni ningún otro habitaba. >Caminaba sin ver a nadie, solo edificaciones vacías, sabiendo que allí nadie había. Sin trinos de pájaros, ni el sonido de la suave brisa, falta de olores a flores, sólo la humedad sobre el suelo, que algunos reflejos devolvía, pero sin alguna vida. De pronto en una vivienda me encontré, sin muebles que ver. En cambio, sobre las paredes, se apoyaban infinidad de cajones hacia lo alto. Cajones de madera simple, pero que dentro contenía lo que antes tuvo vida y que de un momento otro solo eran cuerpos sin energía. --- ![20180823_132349.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vPTXM232Va8tM7yofLVDT99esRcNzMdFuaSsDgRMs95Aao4dYbC47JaAMtn65dPPdVi.jpg) ![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) --- >El horror inundo mi vista, cuando vi sus rostros, sus poses finales al morir, podía en mi mente escuchar los gritos, el dolor al ver esos cuerpos retorcidos del martirio. Caras irreconocibles, como si en el último segundo algo hubiera llenado de terror su visión final y lo que vieron o sintieron fuera el tormento jamás experimentado en la tierra. Todos estaban iguales, como momificados en esa posición de tortura visual y sensitiva, como si hubieran sido congelados en el mismo momento que sufrían intenso dolor en su interior y sus entrañas se desgarraban intensamente por algo que no podían controlar pero que por dentro los destrozaba. Miraba sus rostros y creía poder ver esos últimos momentos, hombres, mujeres, niños, no había distinción, a todos se había llevado sin excepción. >Nuevamente en la calle, caminando entre el silencio y soledad de una ciudad que dormía el sueño eterno del no despertar jamás. Así llegué a lo que parecía un bar o una cafetería, donde el panorama era desolador más que aterrador. El blanco y negro era el color, pesadilla era, más en primera persona yo era. En el interior personas de todas las edades yacían como dormidas, en mares de sangre y agonía, donde ya no había vida. De sus oídos y narices hilos del líquido vital que corre por las venas, ahora formaban charcos alrededor de sus rostros sin expresiones, sin alegrías ni penas. ---
![20180823_152921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vsNB5RxQYb7sUGhFTZX4p7dQYc9DjmehzJduPPVATD2Xrv3Q9UL18D5DswfbpCgF7hE.jpg)
![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) --- >Se los llevó en un momento, sin sufrimiento, simplemente se durmieron. El único color que pude ver, fue el rojo sangre que en el suelo ya dejaba de correr. Hacía tiempo estaban allí como esperando reverdecer en un mundo donde las palabras, los colores y la vida ya no han de florecer. Es indescriptible la sensación de mi ser, al ver esas escenas por doquier, no sabía si también yo me había ido o si ver anticipadamente eso se me había permitido. Sólo sé que el corazón se me apretaba fuertemente, mientras la pena me inundaba. Ya estaba hecho, nada podía resolver, la humanidad se había ido y el planeta parecía vacío. En ese momento sólo sentía la necesidad de buscar alguien más vivo, que de esa catástrofe hubiera huido. Mis ojos se llenaron de lágrimas y al despertar ellas aún corrían por mi alma. --- ![separador sangre.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xyLavpsC6UFevyftDZ9nego9qqgS3Ys2aohVYeowcv6uw89kdQxQk9E5SABcyCMuwEQ.png) ---

Good day,

This is an application to @deathwing for another Claude application. It ends on 26th May, and I want to proactively apply so I don't get downtime.

I am going to include the GitLab stats on what I have been working on for Hive. Please note that while the repos here are open-source on https://gitlab.syncad.com/hive/, they are far from ready. This is across 30 days. Special thanks to @blocktrades for creating the repos and to @gandalf for the runners in the pipeline (they have been a super value-add).

## Headline numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| **Commits** | **826** |
| **Lines added** | **135,442** |
| **Lines deleted** | **18,229** |
| **Net** | **+117,213** |
| **Active window** | 2026-04-26 → 2026-05-25 (30 days) |
| **Pace** | ~27 commits/day · ~3.9k LOC/day net |



## Per-repo breakdown

| Repo | Commits | Lines+ | Lines- | Net | First | Last |
  |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
  | velocity | 87 | 18,471 | 1,551 | +16,920 | Apr 26 | May 14 |
  | velocity-bridge | 33 | 9,975 | 463 | +9,512 | Apr 30 | May 13 |
  | velocity-bridge-ui | 60 | 11,997 | 9,274 | +2,723 | Apr 26 | May 4 |
  | velocity-chain-schemas | 233 | 9,327 | 1,458 | +7,869 | Apr 26 | May 14 |
  | velocity-codegen | 16 | 16,150 | 493 | +15,657 | May 13 | May 14 |
  | velocity-explorer | 119 | 28,077 | 1,672 | +26,405 | Apr 26 | May 12 |
  | velocity-identity | 116 | 12,763 | 186 | +12,577 | Apr 26 | May 13 |
  | velocity-js-sdk | 45 | 10,920 | 2,395 | +8,525 | Apr 26 | May 14 |
  | velocity-ops | 20 | 2,563 | 301 | +2,262 | May 13 | May 14 |
  | velocity-unity-sdk | 84 | 9,953 | 215 | +9,738 | May 3 | May 4 |
  | velocity-wallet | 13 | 5,246 | 221 | +5,025 | Apr 27 | May 13 |


This month was more isolating what worked vs what did not. And this resulted in addition of more siblings. Please note that there are 14 more repos that are experimental and not part of the open source repos in Hive gitlab.

# Tangible Results

A major success with my game app on google play able to send a transfer to any hive account from inside the game to hive-engine or Solana.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/23swcDKjJrYTwyZYiPkf4vZWkhkmvtkwrBtnS3xQHX1FckZnwtPyuDzqcVL6kvQ4a9AeZ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/23swcK4G6CkwPtTtk7EDHsKMKHEN6LupTycLzZgxHa6Vyyy5PifUAQT2u8hNYuHq7MYQf.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/48FDq9gbw8L2DjnAPi4gcFAVn1Emm7LEzHguG9a1ShG6yN9EbeZK6TVdMf8PRsp8Wp.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/EoEwhEyvrDj4nRRLwMniLkUiVqjBNtLFc2PmBRLDLHJ2afPCEMNxx2qVJn638oeDJU4.png)





![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/Eo1vTqFSELc7Aw2TEVCYZ9p7bLr38sF2dRHgiNTisqaum27tLKAvJPiPhoACSZLrjXQ.png)


Status bar pinned across every page: current height (`#1,447,298`), committee size,
  block count, fuel reserve (`998,400`), default namespace (`astralwars`). The latest
  finalised blocks land on the left as they finalise. Recent bridge events show
  `from-account → destination → amount` on the right. Search box accepts block height,
   block hash, namespace, or account.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/23t76kWDavtJkTwg9oVtktC7ud4uU4DuXs1AKPACwcGT4VXLgCqQaBKXF1y13XVfAZVgT.png)


Every cross-chain event has its own page: emitted-block, source account, destination
   pubkey, epoch/nonce, and an attestation progress bar that fills as committee
  members sign off. Event `8d5c28b8...403d7cffb68b` shown — 20 STELLARUM from
  `bf72a417` to `0eff85d1...35b5`, fully attested.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/spiritsurge/23t75BUM7n7VNdhkZNw3mYWwoHCbixA6WA1PiHLMRFjZhXqp3uH7pxv2ZUeCKqFbhFpmr.png)

Three tiers, committee-updatable, read live from chain state:
  - **Fixed-shop pools** — free, Phase 3, intra-namespace swaps at admin-set rates
  - **AMM pools** — 10M fuel, Phase 4, constant-product market-makers with LP shares
  - **Flash loans** — 50M fuel, Phase 5, atomic borrow-and-return; requires AMM pools

I am not explaining any major tech info, until I am done building everything. But we have a working chain system and with a devnet launched at https://velocity.surgentgaming.com/health with a working bridge system that works with both Hive and Solana. 

There are 2 ways that my game app could communicate with Velocity. 
a) A Unity SDK, as it is a game made with Unity
b) A JS SDK, as my game uses a Node.js backend. 

There is much more to build, but this is the start of what has been achieved. And in time, I want there to be a way where a microwave running skyrim can connect to hive.

# What is Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations?

Microsoft Dynamics 365 project operations is a software designed to handle and streamline the project based business. It can provide a unified approach to project management. Microsoft Dynamics 365 project operations is a relatively recent addition to Microsoft suite of project management software products. It began as Microsoft Dynamics AX, with project management features, but part of a broader enterprise resource planning(ERP) suite. After acquiring project service automation(PSA), the two software products were integrated and it evolved into Microsoft Dynamics 365 project service automation.

# Core Features of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations

The project operations tool from Microsoft boasts many features. Here are some of the Dynamics 365 Project Operations features.

*   Project Management: Project operations can easily handle the tasks, arrange the events, create interactive Gantt charts and design work breakdown structures. This tool helps like a planning tool not an execution tool.

*   Project Accounting: Project operations offers essential accounting functions according to the GAAP and IFRS requirements. This version can’t be recommended at any cost.

*   Resource Management: This software features a built- in resource profile tool that allows you to match resources as per skill sets to project requirements.

# Top Benefits of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations

Here are a few Dynamics Project Operations benefits which are mentioned in the below.

*   Increased Profitability: Project management handles the accounting like multi-currency and project financials. They can increase the profit of many companies.

*   Well-Optimized Resources: You can easily track the resources and its availability in real time.

*   Equip Project Managers with perfect Tools: Invest in the appropriate tools for project managers, manage the project efficiently. Dynamics project operations create a project planning and scheduling with its capabilities like dashboards and interactive charts etc.

# Cons of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations

These features and benefits show the advantages, but there are some disadvantages of Microsoft D365 Project Operations.

*   Complicated setup and configuration, plus there’s a steep learning curve that might require comprehensive training and onboarding.

*   It is very expensive for small and mid businesses, if you add some premium features, so you can pay additional fees.

*   Customization is very challenging and resource intensive with its integration, but outside of the Microsoft product suite is difficult.

# What are Some Alternatives to Dynamics 365 Project Operations?

Project Manager is award-winning project and portfolio management software, it’s perfect for Microsoft Dynamics 365 project operations alternatives. There are many features and much more features are found in Dynamics 365 project operations with its price.

## See the Real Time Progress and Costs

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Operations has some dashboards, but users can build them. Busy project managers don’t waste the time in the project management software. That’s why it can choose the project manager. A real-time project dashboard automatically collects the live data and it shows the colourful graphs and charts. You can easily understand, on time track the cost and workload etc.

# Conclusion

In the end, Dynamics 365 Project Operations is a game changer, they can manage multiple projects. But it provides a comprehensive set of project management tools and functionalities. It can improve the resource allocation and enhance the collaboration across the teams. It can optimize the project performance, reduce costs and deliver the project on time according to your budget. Project operations allows businesses to improve the project operations and make data driven decisions.

title.title: Cafe Crowd
title.body:
![1779697132834.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jadung/23wMsaBcjViQ19s7LTZsTAbZTYPnZeVAesX3SSuDqkDB7VGJu3NVihQwBjyXXCcpqBMQ4.jpg)

There is something about a bustling place like a coffee shop that I am drawn to. The background noise from people the chaos of moving in and out and curious faces that I just couldn't resist sketching out. I was trying to capture that specific energy the way groups gather around small, circular tables, seemingly miles apart in their own private conversations, yet all sharing the same space.

The process of drawing this one was a bit of a marathon but my subject today is quite easier to handle. No one seems to be making major movements the people are sitting still and quiet. I don't usually do this but their stillness made me pull out my penup and draw. I am still keeping those color blocks simple so the focus stays entirely on the people. I wanted to make sure those wobbly, hand drawn lines really popped against the warm background. You know, I kept redrawing the table settings because I wanted the coffee cups to look just right not perfect, not symmetrical. Each little wobbly line is just me trying to translate the feeling of a real place, real people, and real life. I really prefer these imperfect edges in this day and age. It was built by hand, stroke by stroke, in the middle of all that ambient noise and conversation.
I think that's the real joy of this process which is taking a scene that feels completely ordinary and deciding it's worth documenting. 
Instead of taking a quick snap, a hurriedly sketched picture would be best option. It kept me busy for ten minutes or more enjoying myself creating.

title.title: Cactus 🌵 in pots decorated with the animated characters Flork and Bigli-Migli in their love versions for a romantic touch. (Tutorial) [ENG] [ESP]
title.body:
> Did you know? Cacti have very special meanings. They are associated with resilience, protection, strength, and lasting love—they thrive in difficult conditions with lots of sun and survive with very little care. Today I want to share with you the decoration of some romantic flower pots as a gift for your favorite person, featuring cheerful Flork and Bigli-Migli designs. I hope you all like it and enjoy the step-by-step tutorial in the Diyhub community. Join me!
¿Sabías qué? Los cactus tienen significados muy especiales. Se asocian con la resistencia, la protección, la fortaleza y un amor duradero, prosperan en condiciones difíciles de mucho sol y sobreviven con pocos cuidados. Pues el día de hoy quiero compartir con ustedes la decoración de unos maceteros románticos para un regalo hacia tu persona favorita con animados flork y bigli-migli. Espero sea del agrado de todos y que disfruten del paso a paso en la comunidad Diyhub. ¡Acompáñame!

></center><hr>

These images were taken from Pinterest to represent the search for a unique love gift for your partner, with ideas drawn from some animated designs by Flork and Bigli-Migli to carry out the decoration of the pots.

<blockquote>

Estas imágenes fueron tomadas de Pinterest en representación de buscar un regalo de amor único para tu pareja, con ideas de captar algunos diseños de animados de flork y bigli-migli, pues para llevar a cabo la decoración de las macetas. <A HREF=\

>
Next, I'll show you step by step how I created my work. To begin, I'll list all the materials used:
A continuación les mostraré paso a paso la realización de mi trabajo. Para empezar, mencionaré todos los materiales utilizados:

>

Materiales / Materials

  • Pintura acrílica Blanco / White acrylic paint
  • Pintura acrílica Negro / Black acrylic paint
  • Pintura acrílica Azul / Blue acrylic paint
  • Pintura acrílica Rojo / Red acrylic paint
  • Pintura acrílica Rosado / Pink acrylic paint
  • Pintura acrílica Violeta / Violet acrylic paint
  • Barniz mate acrílico / Acrylic matte varnish
  • Pinceles anchos y finos / Paintbrush fine and broad
  • 6 Macetas / 6 Planters
  • Lápiz / Pencil
  • Goma / Eraser
  • Puntero / Dotting Tool

>

STEP/PASO 1

In the initial phase, I start by painting the base of blue and violet, giving the design a fine tone. I use a wide brush for longer strokes and a nicer finish. Always in the same direction for a curious result.
En la fase inicial comienzo pintando la base de color azul y violeta dando un tono fino al diseño. Utilizó el pincel ancho para un trazo más largo y acabado más bonito. Siempre en la misma dirección para una terminación curiosa.

>

STEP/PASO 2

Well, with the pencil I draw each lively little flork and bigli-migli in their cutest, most loving versions, nicely framed, and that way it’ll be easier for me to paint the pot.
Pues, con el lápiz dibujo cada animado flork y bigli-migli en sus versiones más tiernas de amor, bien enmarcados y así me resultará más fácil pintar la maceta.

>

STEP/PASO 3

Once the pencil process is finished, we paint the loving expressions and the little figures with a fine brush, using white, black, pink, and red acrylic paint to highlight their details.
Una vez finalizado el proceso con lápiz, pintamos con el pincel fino las expresiones amorosas y los muñequitos, utilizando pintura acrílica blanca, negra, rosada y roja para resaltar bien sus detalles.

>

STEP/PASO 4

Finally, we move on to the final touches on their faces and letters, using shades like white and black. Then we add a coat of matte acrylic varnish to give it more shine. This design is a bit more complex, as the parts to paint are smaller.
Ya por último pasamos a los retoques finales en sus caras y letras, utilizando tonalidades como blanco y negro, luego agregamos una pasada de barniz acrílico mate para darle más brillo. Este diseño es un poco más complejo, pues son más pequeñas las partes a la hora de pintar.

>

RESULT FINAL / RESULTADO FINAL

It should be noted that this design was searched on Pinterest; but the realization of the decorations are made by me, with dedication to make the cactus look more beautiful. The final step is to plant it, choosing from a small size one.
Cabe destacar que este diseño fue buscado en Pinterest; pero la realización de las decoraciones son hechas por mí, con dedicación para que luzca más bonito el cactus. El paso final es plantarlo, eligiendo de uno de tamaño pequeño.

>
If you liked it, don't forget to leave a comment and follow me for future posts. I'd love to know your opinion and ideas for the next one. Regards >Si te ha gustado, no olvides dejar tu comentario y seguirme para próximas publicaciones. Me encantaría saber tu opinión e ideas para el siguiente. Saludos

></center>

<center><sub>All photos were taken by my IPhone 12 Pro and edited at InShot. English is not my native language, I used www.DeepL.com/Translator.</sub></center>

title.title: Ice Kayaking at Meares Glacier, Alaska
title.body:
![IMG_7259.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqQPZt1s7D8MDxwQm3riJ5952JJX11Cd4FEtaRTe26tHa6tvGdRQMyWXP5uAo52q54N.jpeg)*Team bonding in front of Meares Glacier. It was tough work, but we finally made it to the face of a glacier. We had been iced out until now this trip. You can see the pure joy in the guests' faces as they posed for this picture.*

   Today's adventure was one of the guests and crew favorites. We were at Meares Glacier, in northern Prince William Sound, where a massive glacier tumbles out of the tall mountains and flows into the end of a beautiful fjord. It is a rarity among glaciers these days, in that it is one of the few that is currently advancing. It is bulldozing its way through the forest, taking old trees down as it goes. It also dumps an amazing amount of ice into the fjord, which is what made this morning's kayak such an adventure. 
 
  Kayaking is always a great way to experience a tidewater glacier, and sometimes you have to pick your way through a little bit of ice, but today was an exception. We had so much ice, that our paddles would just skip across it instead of dipping down in the water. The ice packed in around us the farther we got, but onward we pushed. Sometimes I would look behind and see that I had made a nice path through the ice for the guests. Other times, when I looked, the ice move back in so fast that there was no path at all. Luckily the group was up for the challenge, and they were rewarded with a truly wild, Alaskan experience. These are the days that you remember, and tell stories about, long after getting home. 

Once we finally had enough of working hard in the ice, we found a pocket of clear water, and just sat and soaked in the amazing views. Its times like this that it is so hard to believe that we have this place all to ourselves. That is Alaska, still true wilderness to be explored. That can be hard to find these days. When we made it back to the boat, it was hot beverages for all, and a change into bathing suits.... for the polar plunge was next! 

Never a dull moment on the Safari Explorer.

![IMG_7246.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Ep1XsEkPk5m6nB99zZocapRqgX8FLLzBQVdjchcvB1gHPSbqXLfdcaBiPn5zsPi62hS.jpeg)*Paddling through the ice here at Meares Glacier is a wild, adventurous feat. You can blast right through the small chunks, but you need good navigation to avoid the bigger pieces. They will stop you in your tracks very quickly.*

![IMG_7267.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqSVyW3TJRMYTzug4Xe8Fhoh2hst7iCFEqVjcGqGEyMcgLB4LZjbX1QbPwHhF5YfUj3.jpeg)*A little drizzle didn't stop my group from kayaking across the fjord to Meares Glacier, a tidewater glacier that calves off giant chunks of ice.*

![IMG_7264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqHzpAWL5DmSJZWoHVHrs7qoJoSoe1eUQT33aXnSUtLLuNZ52rwmyQ9yBG3TNEgnR9m.jpeg)*We had been paddling through ice for a while before finally breaking free into this section. It seemed almost too easy after what I put them through.*



![IMG_7254.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqQNWvxzfZdZyTZZKrHFk4eurtU18EguQEMPcPnbakQuU84RnbnKkmoDdrPPibLp6sb.jpeg)*Always say, 'yes', when asked if you want to kayak in front of a glacier.*

![IMG_7253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Ep1VVeCBMeNvHPri1brsmBKCRgoLWqQZWMrGiVLijjwg5CxcSrc9T5Hbcod5CXKC8gG.jpeg)*Our skiff tour pushed even farther ahead this morning. They enjoyed some really nice calvings when pieces of ice fell a hundred feet off the face of Meares Glacier.*

![IMG_7250.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eqd8zURRYN74mhPL5KGggEvKgtgahVDq4sAsuCDs2wy2pKsddVdnk8vQa4GcMPyH9po.jpeg)*At some points in this morning kayak, we stopped paddling and just took everything in.*

![IMG_7247.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Ep5kERtAgvWPwBkBYG7nDQjPA64dkbn3h83XzKmxZVfaGfsWz6GkFTKak7FTYno8PFW.jpeg)*The ice started to pack together pretty densely towards the end of our paddle across the fjord. I really made these guys work for it today.*



![IMG_7244.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpnCiemCVTLuhaHzD3ZdQhJx6m3UzxC9AFjUrkHLSuCbrHtpmB1dXrLu3zbVqqLQzCV.jpeg)*Taking a break from our ice kayaking to take some photos.*

![IMG_7239.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eq36YXwaw53YfFyFZsVjuqt4ZHyv6dHsdodxUJJmW8XdnwVnLiVp1UASXy5qEJu388p.jpeg)*This kind of ice was quite easy to make it through. It got thicker though, shortly after.*

![IMG_7238.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EnaZDJwe2Q7kE6n4PTBV9SwnQ8yQvS7C2ZZt2WX72AZSbQUTjJEKC9iiv9t52SSsH8T.jpeg)*Kayaking is one of my favorite ways to experience Alaska. This morning, at Meares Glacier, was an absolute blast. We kayaked through so much ice, and made it close enough to watch ice calving off the face of the glacier. Sea otters and seals looked on, as kittiwakes flew overhead. Luckily our rain gear held solid, and the old saying, 'there is no such thing as bad weather, only bad clothing', held true.*

![IMG_7235.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eou8EtoSqD8fMHBNUxHEt3aGr5F2fA8W6dmYRQc4ypMKSqDU2wjyoozQ6t4TXHsdVP6.jpeg)*Meares is a unique glacier in that it is advancing, bulldozing the forest as it goes.*

![IMG_7234.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/244e85EMEmgz8HNNP2RL54f2SqA3XQ23UxFLS4Fn1Hg8QRYMe2RQgCLesJEF6apwhbB1k.jpeg)*Meares panorama.*

![IMG_7232.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoyPZAe1DXp4GRJGCf6TyPEBApRybGKFtYhsCC2uPyZvg19E8A9UxYPBBHTyqFraArE.jpeg)*Rain, ice, and rainforest.*

![IMG_7231.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eq9UnvYdrjauzzyC9zfG4jXFtZdGYVR9SBACEgzECqXfjgKeLsg3cjegGUC6W5NyPm6.jpeg)*The mist hung to the tops of the forest trees as we made our way through acres of ice.*

![IMG_7226.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqL7k5isi3yKA7EYUhHeSCQFuVYUkQtAhbCK3uMW1d2iEgyh5yEbd3n4rYLRdyiJSp3.jpeg)*Chris and Alan soaking in the rain, and the views.*

![IMG_7225.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EqFs1czockctH6oWpQFSVxQHiTypWgvyVnKxmJx1UReowgXnomuSGoWyLFnEmwChszG.jpeg)*Ice, ice and more ice.*

![IMG_7222.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoAaDvmNUnZ3c5Hg73v48kXFr74N2XmHRaaEkMctNeFBUQzUc4Tzw3Uqq5stNgLQh3u.jpeg)*Just keep paddling.*

![IMG_7209.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoK6p8i9KtutJWFoivpg5wy9Mze8BzRvksdwU1MvbrtD73hQpfULtc5EBZ3TGNjJeqf.jpeg)*Sending out kayakers at Meares Glacier in Prince William Sound.*

![IMG_7203.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eq38TUxWSf1RNZS98G84seRosHySFWv8yqw4Tx6aXP6DVzSuPsXg6xAQCMrtu12aHhp.jpeg)*Me, guiding the morning kayak, ready for some icy adventure.*

![IMG_7199.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/242DJWW6dsCntiWSTJCnBqc3HWoqu6sgbbpSubFggrgneKRvihJtR1tEn93c4pTDne3uJ.jpeg)*This seems like true expedition cruising doesn't it. Definitely not your big cruise ship vibe.*

As always, keep traveling and keep posting.
- Dai Mar

## I absolutely love the idea of being able to fully understand everything 

Everything is created by the mind, and that is highly satisfying for many reasons—and I like that. But on the other hand, I’d like to tell you that the things right in front of us are more likely than other events; at least, that’s how I see it. I know very well that I’m doing the right thing, and that is highly satisfying and true to me!

Now that we really know how to manage all our resources, we’ll surely be able to put all this into practice more easily, and to me, that’s worth its weight in gold.

title.title: Three Powerful Modifiers Made This Battle Unforgettable — Sneak Ability Monsters Ruled the Battle
title.body:
![night reaper.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wWttFvqKKraz66uKSR43LooEjVAhvMnevGb1F9BXYjfXa7GtVDMiGQ5cKrKsgovqPu5.png)


Today I got to play many battles but among all of them the battle I liked the most is the one I am sharing with you people. Even though I lost this battle but I still selected it because its modifiers were very interesting and challenging.

This was a 56 mana battle that is considered a high mana battle where both players got a full chance for selection. I also selected six monsters and my opponent also selected six units. 

In high mana battles the real skill is how you keep your team balanced because here only attack is not enough, defense, support and combination all must be kept in mind. Every mana battle has its own different strategy which you must follow it.

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 103121.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tvAVR2iC2YRbWBHFKzNfY9MQeg4XDp24qpLiknXveucitgdam8ryqwgjojJt89HZZsb.png)

In low mana battles we mostly select aggressive monsters so that enemy units can be eliminated quickly through continuous attacks. In mid mana battles the effort is to keep the defense line strong so enemy attacks cause less damage. 

But in high mana battles the real challenge is to keep your defense line strong, make the attack line balanced and also include support monsters that keep giving benefits to the whole team.

I also followed the same strategy and used the best melee attackers, strong tank monsters, and an excellent support Archon that kept giving +1 armor to my team in every round.

In this battle there were three modifiers that were very interesting and thats the interesting part of the battle as well.

The first modifier was Up Close and Personal. Under this rule only units with melee power could be selected that means monsters that attack from close range. In such battles it becomes very important to use melee attackers that have abilities like Sneak so they can also attack enemy units in the back line.

The second modifier was Cripple. According to this rule whenever a unit successfully attacked the enemy then after the damage the enemy’s maximum health would reduce by an extra -1. 

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 103317.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tmL4SfgqSyp9kzFR3D9qA6NKNaaV9VdN3MmRFLWzziQYMpJ9L6Za8gzeirN1D1JvTQq.png)

For example if a monster gave -2 damage then immediately after that the Cripple ability would reduce an extra -1 health. In this way after every successful attack the enemy kept becoming weaker.

The third modifier was Outsider under which only one wild unit was allowed to be used. These three rules made this battle very unique and strategic because every selection had to be made very carefully.

In the starting rounds of the battle my tank monster showed amazing performance and survived for a long time. But unfortunately my opponent had many monsters with the Sneak ability which kept continuously attacking my back line. As a result my support units got eliminated one by one.

Since health was continuously decreasing on both sides the battle was becoming quite slow but extremely interesting. I kept watching this battle till the end because after every round the situation was changing. 

In the end it reached two versus one,where only one monster was left on my side while the enemy still had two units in the field. Although my last monster tried its best because of the opponent’s better attack it was also eliminated and in this way I had to face defeat.

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 103422.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tRvZw4zaAuzAqtm969Nf9hzTXA4dwK9WCa7gQvbLeTLNs6FTdWFc39hJf48B73uF2Sx.png)

Even though I could not win this battle but because of its rules, strategy and interesting combinations this remained my favorite battle of today. These are the kinds of battles that truly make Splinterlands more interesting and challenging.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

> Así que, el que piensa estar firme, mire que no caiga.

1 Corintios 10:12

##### Estoy seguro que más de una vez hemos visto a un hermano trastabillar y ceder al pecado y también estoy seguro que puede ser muy tentador juzgarlo pero ahí es cuando debemos recordar que en algún momento nosotros hemos pasado por lo mismo.

##### Hay temporadas en la vida que pareciera que todo se nos viene encima. Momentos de prueba, de aflicción, de incertidumbre. Pero es precisamente ahí donde debemos aferrarnos más a la Palabra de Dios.

#### Ésa es la herramienta que usa el enemigo: utiliza nuestra debilidad y nuestra vulnerabilidad a tropezar. No debemos descuidar nuestros pasos y mucho menos nuestros pensamientos.

title.title: Challenge Diary (after 20 weeks)
title.body:
Hi!

At the beginning of this year, I started a challenge related to Splinterlands Market Pools. You can read about it in [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@peter.quill/the-became-a-merchant-challenge)

In this article, I would like to share the status after the first 20 weeks. 

## What do I do every Sunday? 

As I described in my initial post, I provide 10k DEC worth of liquidity to the five pools (2k each) each week. I also try to maintain the balance between them (20% each), so if one liquidity contains more value, I will put less DEC into that.

Steps for each pool:

1. Calculate how much DEC I will invest in the pool (e.g., 2000 DEC)
2. Buy the particular asset for half of the DEC (e.g., GRAIN for 1000 DEC)
3. Put the remaining DEC and the asset into the corresponding pool (DEC-GRAIN)

## Why are we starting immediately with a -10% loss?

title.title: Why we do what we do?
title.body:
/>

It's a very interesting question. A very philosophical question that says that there are underlying causes or reasons for what ever we do in our lives.

We have to find the root cause of our actions if we really want to know what motivates us and drive us to take action in all areas of our lives.

It's a very interesting field that makes us able to transform our thoughts into our actions!!

The inner motivation and driving forces induce a kind of desire, willingness, and readiness to do what we do.

There is a lot of research on intrinsic motivation and extrinsic motivation.

Actually, the question I selected today for my write-up is very intriguing and very complicated at the same time.

If we want to change our habits, we will have to ponder on this question thoroughly.

There are basic human needs and a desire to achieve more. Sometimes, the temptation to get rewarded while at other times is the fear of loss and punishment.

All these factors play a great role in making us do certain things in certain way.

Some people are more aggressive. Some are more ambitious, and there are many more qualities that we inherently have in us.

Some people are more passionate while others are more complacent.

All these differences play a vital role in determining our direction and choices in life!

Last but not least, external factors like our environment, the people we spend more time with, our climate, our culture, and finally, our circumstances, these influences shape our personality and our lifestyle.

Lastly, I personally think that we should do more work in this field of study as the answers we will explore will help us better understand the motives and reasons behind why we do what we do.

I have played many crypto games just like many others from 2021 and that time they promised the future of games on a blockchain. Sadly started from last year I had to leave a lot of them behind, because the leader of the projects left or shut down their projects. 

My only two games left (*which I play daily*) is GO and Rising Star and within the last two months I learned that these two games is shutting down soon as well... This is really sad and gives me the real feeling that HIVE is indeed dying. It is sad to see you go as well and I think my experience from the last few years will make me stay away from blockchain games and not because I lost money with them (*more or less I made profit on them*), but because not many people understands them and know about them, so it is hard to get new audience. Plus big companies are not even trying to use the blockchain, which is also pretty sad.

Anyhow thanks for everything; it was a good journey and wish you a good luck in life and in your future projects! 😇

最近阴雨天气，无事来到小菜园看看。一是家里没有小葱了，过来拔点，在看看下雨前我洒下的鸡毛菜出的咋样，还想看看番茄🍅黄瓜🥒的挂果情况……我妈也不过小菜园来，天天问我黄瓜可以吃了没哈哈~

第一个看到的就是鸡毛菜，它的位置在边边上，看着出的还不错，洒的还算均匀哈哈😃雨后之前洒下的紫苏也长大了不少，不知道是不是土太干了，洒完好长时间都没见冒苗，前不久才发现小紫苏长出来了，但是也就星星洒洒一点。上次洒鸡毛菜种子时又追洒了一些紫苏种子，但今天看还没出来。

番茄🍅长得好凶啊！好大一棵棵😍挂果情况也不错，目前看大概率是对版了，老品种千禧和普罗旺斯，不对比好像都是圆圆的没啥区别，我爸在菜场买的番茄苗挂的果子颜色青白，普罗旺斯则更青一些！今年差不多种了近20棵番茄😂

十多棵茄子🍆也开始挂果了，分了两批种，有大有小刚好。黄瓜长势好像有点慢，不过挂果还行，只有一个瓜王，在长个两三天就可以吃了，其余还太小呢！豆角苗长势也是真好！唯一不太长得是辣椒苗，雨后稍微长了点，之前太干了 严重缺水。

title.body:
你会发现人教人教不会，事教人肯定会，很多人都有这样的经历，包括我，多年前听人家讲述自己的经历感受，即便你当时可以理解但你很难感同身受直到自己正的去经历才明白那种刻骨铭心，不晓得其他人有过这的经历么…


     现在很多00后都不太喜欢那种说教式的沟通方式，但有有些场景还真得说教，可能这个词有这肯定，但我找不到一个更合适词了。


        工作场合有些老同事如果提醒或批评一些新同事，在做事情情层面那是希望新同事不要犯同样的错误，或者最好不要犯错，同常会出现两种情况一种对方虚心接受，今后尽量避免，另一种是为自己辩解，还有一种直接不对方接受直接表现是不耐烦！

  最好这种今天发生了，小邱被领导在群里直接点名要求自动离职！


   这个事情其实并不突然，小伙来了2个多月，在同样的事情层面直接的领班有批评过他，其其他同事也有善意提醒，我还告诉你怎么操作，他的反馈是消极应对或不耐烦，我也就不么有再说了，省得人家说你太啰嗦，



   一个星期后的今天，他被直接点名了，这是现实工作中特别鲜活的例子…

   一个人懂得反思和总结是任何年龄都必须具备的能力，尤其是在职场！！

title.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 82 - Our Gratitude
title.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 29! This is the final rest before the final battle. Takuma and his friends look back on their journey, and look forward to overcoming the master!***


----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXTZqi3isf4W6sLhNpCvNxHVyDUEgsuMgkEtnB6ff5saM/1000072759.webp 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

https://youtu.be/lyicM1HjEZU


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

This is the first time we see the shrine maiden of Minase's family. Haruchika's sister who he thinks have abandoned him. Miyuki finds her, and inherits her final wish...

title.title: Challenge #04894-M145: Making the Effort
title.body:
![nikola-bacanek-Wo9800C-j6U-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/245wUQ1NZfzJPDU2MjFCW3C6MA3qxNsXeA2qRmeMVETQ1Zc7MuUw2TAuB5vd3r2qvCCkg.jpg)

> After grueling practice with Trudy and Wraithvine, the Swan Prince Odilio Magustine Jestarion Francas is… more acceptable than previously. However, he still must find love and Gods above and below know neither of them are on offer. It seems an ill fit at first, but, perhaps a hot headed warrior maiden from the north in need of a flying scout can find something in him to like and it may do him some good to find a woman who can argue right back…
> Follows on from [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04874-m125-educating-a-royal-pain](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04874-m125-educating-a-royal-pain) -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

The best that could be said about Prince Odilio was that he had worked hard to become more tolerable than when they met him. Which was quite a struggle, and helped by Odilio recognising that he had - _very much_ - hit rock bottom.

He'd learned, at long last, to read others' ire at his actions. He'd learned - eventually - to apologise for his misdeeds _and_ to ask for suggestions on how to improve his behaviour.

And that was why he was following Wraithvine's augury to someone who might just be amenable to breaking his curse. 

It manifested as a glowing arrow that only Odilio could see.

As he flew, he recited his lessons. \

It was the best Trudy and Wraithvine could do for him. She had an anxious family to return to and Wraithvine preferred to help more than one person at a time per century.

So Odilio flew north during the wrong season to fly north. His food was a small amulet that produced a good berry whenever he needed it. He flew for days and rested thanks to the grudging acceptance of The Green. He flew north for weeks, until the arrow suddenly jinked to the left.

Odilio squawked in alarm, wheeling around to follow the direction of the arrow. It took him three circuits to pinpoint a woman field dressing a Dire Bear. He circled closer and closer, careful to make sure she saw him and wasn't alarmed. Or tempted to bag something else for dessert. He touched down, bowed, and said, \

\n\nThe woman was as muscular as a Harukh, taller than most horses, and had a face like a mallet. Her manner was efficient and gave off a menacing aura. She dropped the last of something bloody and rubbery into a hole and straightened up. \
_Don't ask about her virginity. Don't ask about kisses. Earn them._ \
One bloodied hand pointed it out to him. Just in case he'd missed a bear the size of a small hut.\n\n\
he allowed, settling his feathers a little. \
\n\nThe arrow still pointed to her. Odilio decided on vulnerability. \
\n\nHe took it as a fair warning. It wasn't much of a start, but was _a_ start. \
he squeaked, and took wing.\n\n[Photo by <a href=\

title.body:
La ciudad de Buenos Aires es realmente inmensa y hay muchos lugares hermosos para visitar y descubrir, como este apasionante lugar que nos enseñas. 

Qué bueno que tengas una lista de lugares a los cuales visitar; será genial acompañarte a esos rincones.

Creo que valió la pena todo el viaje que has hecho con tus hermanas; el barrio de La Boca es pura pasión. Cuando se trata de fútbol, los argentinos podemos ser muy apasionados, y podemos discutir a muerte por nuestro equipo favorito, salvo cuando se trata de la selección; es cuando todos nos sentimos argentinos y estamos unidos por la pasión de la celeste y blanca.  

Me encantó esta visita a los lugares que has visitado. Muchas gracias querida amiga @lauramica, por compartir este apasionante momento.

Que tengas una feliz y próspera semana.

Un cariño grande para todos tus seres queridos.  

 
The city of Buenos Aires is truly immense, and there are so many beautiful places to visit and discover, like this fascinating place you're showing us.

It's great that you have a list of places to visit; it would be wonderful to join you in exploring those hidden gems.

I think the whole trip you took with your sisters was worthwhile; the La Boca neighborhood is pure passion. When it comes to soccer, Argentinians can be incredibly passionate, and we can argue to the death about our favorite team, except when it comes to the national team; that's when we all feel truly Argentinian and are united by our passion for the sky blue and white.

I loved this tour of the places you visited. Thank you so much, dear friend @lauramica, for sharing this exciting moment.

Have a happy and prosperous week.

Sending lots of love to all your loved ones.

## WHITE PAPER FOR THE BBH PROJECT

Here it is, the updated [THE BBH PROJECT WHITE PAPER.](https://peakd.com/bbh/@bbhstrategy/bbhstrategy-the-bbh-project-updated-white-paper)

## CURATION TRAIL

No new members to the [Curation Trail](https://peakd.com/hive-155221/@bradleyarrow/joining-a-curation-trail-updated) over in the last 24 hours. But I did spend time last evening updating things as I been slack with the trail.



The new goal of 800 members by the end of 2026.

What is the point of a curation trail and why should I join?

Any post that I up vote, everyone that is upto 448 possible upvotes.

When you join the trail you can set your trail vote to what ever you want. Even if you set the up vote to 0.01. Imagine if we had 1,000 people in the trail that would be 10.00 to the post. Fantastic stuff. A little difference can end up making a giant difference to a Hiver.

That being said, we do have 448 members, I know not all are active, some have passed, but the majority of use are still here.

Imagine if we could get 100 people doing just 1 blog post about the curation trail. Do you think the membership would go up quickly?

Give it a shot, the more, the better for everyone.

And if you are following the trail please support our witness. @thebbhproject. 

## DRIP DAY 

Saturdays are Drip Day. That means it is/was drip day. Now if you are not a regular reader of mine you are wondering what is drip day.

I run a income token and tipping bot all in one. The token is BBH. Every Saturday I payout the people holding BBH tokens. Passive income if you like. I like to call it a 'drip' of a token(s) to the people that own BBH tokens. And unlike some all you have to do is own it. No staking, no nothing.

If you own 10 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive.
If you own 1,000 or more BBH tokens you get a drip of swap.hive and TOOFUCKEH.
If you own 5,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive and the PIMP token, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER and CTP Tokens.
If you own 10,000 or more BBH tokens you got a drip of swap.hive, PIMP, TOOFUCKEH, GLITTER, CTP, and LEO tokens.

If you stake 20,000 or more BBHO tokens you get a drip of swap.btc, and ALIVE tokens
If you stake 5,000 or more BBHO tokens you got a drip of ALIVE tokens.

All just for owning BBH. There are two ways you can get BBH. First you can buy them from the open market. I use TribalDex myself.

Or they can be tipped to you. The great part about BBH tipping is that when you tip a token to someone else you do not loose any of your own. There is a central pool that supplies them.

And a third way to get BBH would be people gift them to you. There was an update to the tipping bot. If you now tip 1 BBH you get 1 BBH also. How facking awesome is that.

And now a forth way to get BBH with the BBH Miner.

I now set the release price of BBH to the markets daily. It is an open market so sometimes you can pick up deals when others are selling cheaper than my set price. The goal is to have 1 BBH = 1 Satoshi. I do a bit of math and get the price. If Bitcoin is stronger than Hive then the price of one BBH goes up and if Hive is strong than Bitcoin then the price goes down.

## BBH AND BBHO TOKEN DIFFERENCE
It seems some people are still confused. So I am putting this section into my daily post.

BBH token was my first token. It is a tipping bot and a passive income token. You only need to hold it, hold 10 or more to get a drip on drip day(below).

BBHO token is the native token of The BBH Project Tribe. The same as LEO is the native token of InLeo.

It is that simple. I did add drips to stakers of BBHO also as I work on building out use cases for the token.

Hope this helps.

In a 24 hour period, reset at new day UTC. There are currently five levels of tipping.

Level 1 = 1000 BBH holdings = 1 tip per day you can send
Level 2 = 5000 BBH holdings = 5 tips per day you can send

title.title: MCGI Topic Review | Is Polygamy Allowed By God?
title.body: > https://youtu.be/fK9Fo0xgtlE?si=8WBKLOrPgUjjN7P3 As I ponder upon the subject of polygamy, I am aware that it is a question many sincere Christians ask themselves. There were several men who had more than one wife in the Bible. For instance, these are the facts about the practice of polygamy among the Israelites: Abraham, Jacob, David and Solomon have all been polygamous in different ages of their lives. As a result, some people think that God approves polygamy. However, when I carefully study the Scriptures, I see that God's original plan for marriage was different. God created the first man and first woman. The Bible says, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). In Matthew 19:4-6 Jesus again taught that marriage is between one man and one woman, proving that God's plan for marriage was monogamous. This shows the perfect will of God about marriage. In the Old Testament, God allowed for some having more than one wife but the Bible also records many difficulties arising from such marriages. Many polygamous families were jealous, competitive, conflictive and sorrowful. A family split occurred among Jacob's household and as Solomon became the father of numerous wives, their influence led him away from God (1 Kings 11:1-4). From these examples, I learn that not everything that is written in the Bible is God's best plan. When I think of this issue I think God wants marriage to be based on faithful love, unity and commitment between one man and one woman. The New Testament also gives the qualification of being “the husband of one wife” (1 Timothy 3:2) to a church leader. This continues the trend of monogamous marriage among believers. This in particular reminds me of God's wisdom which is always greater than our human thinking. Despite change in culture, His design is still the best. When I think about the plan of God, I am encouraged to trust God's plan because it brings peace, faithfulness and true love into the home. In prayer and through a genuine examination of the scriptures, I feel we can all gain a better understanding of God's purpose for marriage and be better able to honor Him in our relationship.

最近一直在给娃选英语先上课，马上快期末考，期末考完暑假还远吗，总不能荒废了，想选点课程让他暑假里上上课，不然他每天玩游戏都要废了。

我娃自觉性太差，如果不管着他，他能一直玩游戏，其他什么都不做，别提主动写作业什么的，你只能对他说写完了奖励玩游戏，不能对他说玩好游戏写作业，不然就没完没了。

我上班下班都在选，感觉这家的英语课程也好，那家的也不差，但是又不能全报，不然真的要跟他拉仇恨了。真不知道应该选哪个，纠结雅思还是剑桥英语，就是好像什么都想学，好像他什么都需要上一样，看的我脑袋疼。

另外暑假要到了总归要安排出去玩，我又要选地址安排时间，养娃废妈啊，太远的我也去不了，我爸身体也不能支撑带他远游，也是个麻烦事，所以到处选到处看，期待他再大点可以跟同学一起出去，这样我也省事儿。

每天都是围着娃转，这是这娃情商低，就活的没心没肺，周六我总算是把冬被收起来了，冬天的衣物也都干洗完了全部换季收起来，该压缩的压缩，该挂衣柜的挂衣柜，再把夏天的拿出来，先跟娃说帮我一起 结果下午他说他要睡觉 一下子睡了三小时，等我干完这些事他醒了。

一开始我以为假睡，看了几次是睡的真香，也不愿意打扰他，只能默默地一个人干活，换季真累人。

---

title.title: A least some azaleas =/= Wenigsten ein paar Azaleen 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
title.body: ![IMG_9238.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EoK6Ptia2TYnEqTns8u61CqBTswDGGCDoAeRhq1UYvuN9gNwvNGUPz1p6ZmvfbF5cWf.JPG) In recent years, in May we always visited a park where, at that time, countless azalea bushes were blooming in the most amazing colors. But when we were there this spring, everything was still pretty green. At first I thought the azaleas might be a little late this time, but even a few days later, not much had changed. And that was despite the fact that the azaleas were in full bloom in other parks. Well, I still don’t really know why the bushes here didn’t want to play along this year. But since they had bloomed in a few spots after all, I was at least able to take a few photos, which I certainly don’t want to keep from you. This time, it was mainly pink flowers, which naturally stood out quite clearly against all the green around. In previous years, there had been other colors as well, which I missed a bit this time. But well, since the azaleas were blooming in other parks, it is alright if they want to took a break here at this place. Instead, the bamboo was growing furiously—which isn’t actually supposed to grow here at all. But someone must have forgotten to remove the early shoots, and now it was already standing several feet tall. And in the last picture we also see the green bushes, which are holding back a bit this year. But as I said, it’s okay if they want to take a rest once in a while... ![IMG_9239.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23wCE8KyCvdrXPGQYo5pThXvEveYgxyHLmvGNzht2cnWbyeqtCPHUk7rwrGGavoVjxdMJ.JPG) DEUTSCH In den letzten Jahren hatten wir im Mai immer einen Park besucht, in dem zu dieser Zeit unzählige Azaleenbüsche in den tollsten Farben am Blühen waren. Aber als wir in diesem Jahr dort waren, war irgendwie alles noch ganz schön grün. Zuerst dachte ich, dass die Azaleen diesmal etwas spät dran sein würden, aber auch ein paar Tage später hatte sich noch nicht viel verändert. Und das obwohl in anderes Parks die Azaleen in voller Blüte standen. Nun ja, so richtig weiß ich immer noch nicht, warum die Büsche hier in diesem Jahr nicht so richtig mitspielen wollten. Aber da es an ein einigen Stellen dann doch geblüht hatte, konnte ich zumindest ein paar Fotos machen, die ich euch natürlich nicht vorenthalten will. Diesmal waren es hauptsächlich rosa Blüten, welche aus dem vielen Grün natürlich ganz deutlich hervorstachen. Aber in früheren Jahren waren es auch noch andere Farben gewesen, die ich diesmal ein wenig vermisst hatte. Aber gut, dafür blühten die Azaleen dann eben in anderen Parks, während sie hier eine Pause machten. Und dafür wuchs dann eben der Bambus, der hier eigentlich gar nicht wachsen sollte. Aber jemand hatte wohl vergessen, die frühen Triebe zu entfernen, und nun stand er eben bereits meterhoch neber den Wegen. Und hier sehen wir auch noch einmal die grünen Büsche, die sich in diesem Jahr dann eben ein wenig zurückhalten. Schon in Ordnung, das dürfen sie auch mal... ![IMG_9240.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23yTf8Sx2z8CkuWYaVy255JvtYrzh9ahFfgT1mz9eietrwm2GTjWP2oaUgTTDSEJ3aVWC.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)
