body.title: Splinterlands: Upgrading 3 Arcana Cards to Level 2!🔥
body.body: >Since I had completely stopped purchasing Common and Rare draws for the past 3–4 seasons, I wasn't acquiring any cards of these rarities; consequently, the upgrading of these cards—a crucial process—was also not taking place. Now, in this very season, I purchased 10 Common and 10 Rare draws, after which I accumulated enough copies of certain cards from both these rarities to combine them and advance them to the next level. Among these is a Common card named Magmaforged—a low-Mana-cost, ranged attacker card belonging to the Fire element.

>At Level 1, it possessed 1 Ranged Attack power, 4 Health, and an impressive Speed ​​of 3. In terms of speed, this card was already as fast as any above-average card; furthermore, when evaluated alongside its Mana cost, its Health was also quite decent. Now, after combining 5 copies of this card, its Speed ​​has received a +1 boost, making it even faster. Look, I won't exaggerate, but the truth is that this card can prove extremely useful to me in low-Mana battles. This is because, in such battles, the cards on both sides are largely basic in nature—meaning their Health stats aren't particularly high—so having Speed ​​on your side can give you a distinct edge right from the very start of the game. For this reason, I am satisfied with this upgrade to a considerable extent.

\n\n

>The second card is the Pixie-knife Hurler from the Life Element. This is a Rare card belonging to the Ulund bloodline, and given its substantial Mana cost, it cannot be viewed solely from the perspective of low-Mana battles. Initially, at Level 1, this card possessed 2 Ranged Attack power, 2 Armor, 6 Health, and 2 Speed; it also featured the \

ability, which grants the card the freedom to launch attacks even when positioned at the very front of the lineup. Now, by combining five copies of this card, its stats have been significantly enhanced: firstly, it has gained +1 Speed; and secondly, another fantastic feature has been added—the \

ability—which gives the card a 25% chance to evade physical attacks. This is truly a valuable ability that, in a sense, elevates the card's overall strength to a higher tier. After all, being positioned at the very front of the lineup means being directly in the enemy's crosshairs; in such scenarios, you typically require superior Health and Armor, making abilities like this a highly effective shortcut. Furthermore, since this card belongs to the Ulund bloodline, its power can be further amplified by utilizing it in conjunction with its corresponding Archon and other allied cards. I certainly intend to devise a new strategy centered around this card—and I will be sure to share it with you.

\n\n

>The third card I have leveled up so far is the Gravebrand Warlock. This is a Rare card of the Death element that boasts an impressive Magic Attack power of 3 right from Level 1. However, its health is quite low, making it a prime target for enemy cards possessing the \

ability. Furthermore, its extremely slow speed often results in it being knocked out before it even gets a chance to perform an attack. For these reasons, I have rarely used this card in battles until now. However, with its recent upgrade to Level 2, it has gained a powerful new ability called \

The Swiftness ability directly increases the speed of all allied cards by +1. Consequently, this ability not only doubles this card's own speed but also boosts the speed of every other card in the team—without exception—by +1. As a result, I now feel I can utilize this card with much greater confidence. Even if—despite the increased speed of 2—this card doesn't survive for many rounds (since a speed of 2 isn't exactly considered fast), the fact that it boosts the speed of the entire team ensures that all my attackers will be able to perform at their absolute best. Therefore, rather than relying solely on this single card, utilizing it strategically to bolster the strength of the entire team can yield significant advantages. How well this plan actually works will be reflected in my future battles—something I will certainly keep you updated on in my upcoming posts.

\n\n

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n
>If you also want to enjoy this amazing game and you have not yet signed up, <a target=\

Please don't think that anything I have written in this blog has been copied from somewhere or is AI-generated.` 2. `Paragraph Dividers and all the photos are from #Splinterlands.` 3. `All the other content images and words are mine unless otherwise stated.`

body.title: ‎Football Can Be Brutally Unfair Sometimes
body.body:
‎
‎A lot of drama really happened on the final day of the Premier League season. There was drama everywhere, but the part I will be discussing right now is regarding the relegation battle.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSe3akZr5Uw3DXQVTqq75XMD3YLJkZbBnkb5xbeAtuBjY/images%2034.jpeg 

‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DYuvoMvjh-o/&ved=2ahUKEwjOh4qH8dOUAxWQXkEAHT3FFMEQr4kDegQIWRAA&usg=AOvVaw11RTYoEs35DbUVXqKsYLqo)
‎
‎Honestly, it was painful watching how everything ended for West Ham United.
‎
‎The crazy thing is that they actually did their part and fought until the end. They went out there and comfortably beat Leeds United 3-0. At that moment, you would think a win like that should be enough to survive. But football does not always work that way.
‎
‎Despite the victory, West Ham still ended the season with 39 points and were relegated to the Championship.
‎
‎At the same time, Tottenham Hotspur were playing against Everton knowing fully well that their Premier League future  really  hinge on that match. The pressure must have been unbelievable. One mistake could have changed everything.
‎
‎But Spurs managed to get the job done with a narrow 1-0 win over Everton. Even though it was not a flashy performance or some dominant victory, but it was enough. And sometimes in football, “enough” is all that really matters.
‎
‎And that single win took Tottenham to 41 points and confirmed their Premier League status.
‎
‎I can only imagine the emotions after the final whistle.
‎
‎Tottenham players and fans celebrating survival like they had won a trophy, while West Ham players probably felt empty even after winning their own game. That is the painful side of football people do not talk more about enough.
‎
‎Sometimes you can do what you are supposed to do and still not get the outcome you wanted because other results did not go the way you really wanted.
‎
‎That is why the relegation battle is always one of the most emotional parts of football for me. It is raw, tense and unpredictable. No hiding place. Every goal matters. Every mistake matters as well.
‎
‎In the end, Tottenham survived.
‎
‎West Ham did not.
‎
‎And that is football. Cruel, emotional and unpredictable till the very last day.
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/football-can-be-brutally-unfair-sometimes-a7w)

</center>
</liketuimages>

說起來人真的挺奇怪，待在家裡相處時不一定可以聊到天，反而出門用餐或是隨意找個地方坐坐時反而會談天說地，很可能取決於當時餐廳的用餐氣氛或是在等餐中間的不經意談話而開啟了聊天模式，就這樣可以聊到平常不太會開啟的話題。

像是平日上班遇到的問題啦?或是在創作時遇到的問題啦?甚至是平日只在自己腦海中出現的規劃等等等，可能都會因為氣氛而打開了話閘子，然後順著話題聊下去，談話內容反而深入許多，變成了一個很好的開動方式。

若是平日在家中問起，反而可能有防備心，以為我們想要窺探甚麼，但若是出外用餐吃吃喝喝聊聊，卻更容易打開心防，尤其話題是從別人的身上開啟再延續到自己身上，防備心就可以完全卸下，因為會覺得談論的是別人的問題。

所以說深入話題其實在社交之間也是件危險的事，因為我們可能在深入聊天之後不自覺地把自己的很多平日不想讓人知道的想法給不經意透露出去，之後離開現場或是隔天便會覺得有點懊惱，覺得自己似乎話太多了......哈哈。

總之，大家想要多了解家人可以多多出去用餐，找個適合聊天的地方，這樣就可以更接近彼此的內心喔~~(這才是這篇文章的結論啦)

body.title: Needlework Sales Success!
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnHmdwTsmBD3LeUCNVQCmZjJWwEqLFCPzy6Kznhm2Jrw/1779687621977.jpg)

### We had THE most successful opening night of this *mostra* in the Galleria Artemis!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUdwhXyDEvjZgy4ryeeBbdnK1FQ7Vuwhazmxeb4vrw736/1779688048601.jpg)

The most reinvented clothing I ever 'sold'! It had to be done in a fairly clandestine manner however, as someone locally had complained to the council, about artists selling their works... So I was discussing with the owner, how to stand in Sovereignty - to not engage with offers to contraction, as the system was beginning to reach into her space, offering dreamspells of 'licensing' and 'permissions'. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdFf7X3Za1D6ewTkeduD4yyoJiNBjwURStYwvxvGJ7umT/1779687622433.jpg)

As you may already be aware if you follow my blog or podcast, I know enough of how govern-ments and the hierarchy work, to be very clear that I am not willing to fund them. In this context, we had fun with a large family group from Canada (who were on a trip to Guardia Sanframondi together): asking them to not be so visible in our 'reciprocal gifting' of money and clothing...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaZThVCacPxkvMr1wwaJcuqwd7dLASvueqCLp5rHGJtUS/1779687622746.jpg)

In fact, they had been enjoying the wine tasting at the opening, and this emboldened th all to make quite a game of it! @vincentnijman and ended up really connecting with them all - we chatted and laughed and shared for over an hour. And they even wanted to see th Arthouse for sale listing 🥰🤗💝

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUNbbdmT9oRzecgWuUXydMk2L6u8him1wqc143k9PPH2m/1779690797539.jpg)

They bought **four** pieces! Including the white-orange-pink-yellow dress, above. Each was chosen by a sister, of which there wer four, encouraged by the whole group (and myself and Vincent, of course) - it turned into a very special kind of a personal shopper/ styling/ self confidence ritual, with much emotion being expressed all round. 🙌🔥💫

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPvQ9dTtt6CBEHWokqwEJbKgFfBwXjuAEQNPofkzAov1P/1779691074186.jpg)

The weekend was exhausting but so wonderfully full-filling: it felt like the peak of how I want to (re)connect people with clothing as a meaningful aspect of our modern reality, as a vital part of cocreating the new world. 🌞🎨🌟😄👋

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZnqkZrVhJ423wY7AwqAvFHReStcAeV7LnjjF3sBNnz16/1779691307798.jpg)

The 'Janis Joplin' trousers as they were termed by the first sister to model - the blue and embroidery ones in the middle of the photo below - went down very well, and started the dynamic unfolding of a sequence of transformations...

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSrcW6nq58uBhDWei5BfNLM9EVVQ4XdKxXntLBUYS5V85/1779691428204.jpg)

Which culminated in the last, more timid sister, being eventually convinced by much pressure from the whole group to 'just try it on!' - my special white dress made from vintage aprons and pillow case 🥰🤗🥳

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXkBNh7eNX9A8cWz2RvFqpnSWYFu9UXSVJFn73xwXqepy/1779691945040.webp)
*this is me wearing the white dress, from the expo last year*

The women looked truly fabulous in each garment, and were super happy! This made it a VERY special event for us, it being the first proper money earned between us since... probably last year. The energy of that evening was key in unlocking some stuckness that I've had recently: primal fears around stability and survival 🙏🪷❤️‍🔥We also had two other happy money-related shifts of energy at the weekend, which gives us at least a few months of momentum with our vision: halleljah indeed!!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmauqjVWT6jwnV2vWSdtBToXCHofaP3mhLs69YRs31wRV1/1779692974736.jpg)

> **Though I haven't (yet!) found outlets for my creations near our new home, the expo gave me a serious boost towards what I hope will develop.... Here's to the next weekend!**

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![UhjrQqcHgYFNffEN_IMG_20260523_192057.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/UhjrQqcHgYFNffEN_IMG_20260523_192057/UhjrQqcHgYFNffEN_IMG_20260523_192057.webp)
![6n45jLnxSC7l1jDk_IMG_20260523_191956_1.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/6n45jLnxSC7l1jDk_IMG_20260523_191956_1/6n45jLnxSC7l1jDk_IMG_20260523_191956_1.webp)
![NIqGAzeBZkXxRPxi_IMG_20260523_192734.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/NIqGAzeBZkXxRPxi_IMG_20260523_192734/NIqGAzeBZkXxRPxi_IMG_20260523_192734.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我们这边最近一直在下雨，前两天趁雨停的一个晚饭后时段，我带着娃去附近的一所大学遛弯闲逛。
 
之前几年我很少提起这所大学，是因为从2020年左右疫情开始后，学校就一直不对外开放，只有校内师生、校内商户能凭证进出。我们住在周边的居民，平时吃完饭想进去散步、跑步都特别不方便，又是预约又是各种手续，限制很多。
 
所以这五六年里，我基本没怎么进去过，中间也就跟着一位在江汉大学当老师的朋友，进去过一两次。前段时间政策调整，学校终于重新对外开放了。
 
刚下过雨，校园里空气格外清新。我们绕着整个校园走了一圈，这所学校规模很大，足足有五个食堂，还有一片超大的湖。我还看到学校新增了不少新专业，其中有智能建造相关方向，和3D打印有关，正好赶上院系同学做课题展览，展出了不少3D打印小作品，我和孩子都看得很感兴趣。
 
我们在里面逛了将近两个小时，实在走累了，就从另一个校门出来，骑共享单车回了家。现在大学可以随时进出，以后跑步有了好去处，图书馆也能办证进入，真的太方便了，我心里特别开心。

body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing great and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today I wanted to do another card spotlight post because honestly I have been using this card alot recently and it keeps surprising me in battles. The card is called Abyssal Elemental and its a really fun Water unit to play with. This card is an Epic Water unit and at max level (Level 6), it gets two very strong abilities that can completely change battles. At first I didnt really pay much attention to this card because there are many strong Water cards already in #Splinterlands. But after seeing this card clutch multiple battles for me, I started liking it alot more. The design of the card also looks super cool. It literally looks like a giant monster made from deep ocean water. 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐬 𝐀𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐱 𝐋𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥 ========================================== * **Mana Cost**: 6 Mana * **Attack Type**: Magic Attack * **Max Level Stats**: **3** Magic Damage, **3** Speed, **3** Armor, **6** Health Its stats are honestly pretty balanced. Not too tanky but not too weak either. The real strength of this card comes from the abilities.

> 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟏: 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 ======================================= **Resurgence**: Self-resurrects once per battle with 100% health and armor. All magic debuffs are removed, and all magic buffs are reapplied. Skips turn. Deals 1 physical damage to all units.

> This ability can completely change battles at the last moment. Imagine your opponent thinks they already won… then suddenly this card comes back to life with full stats lol. I actually won a crazy battle recently because of this exact ability. The extra damage to every unit is also very underrated. Sometimes enemy units are already low HP and this extra damage helps finish them off. Especially in rulesets like Global Warming, Resurgence becomes even more scary. 𝐀𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝟐: 𝐁𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐭 ============================= **Blast**: Deals an additional 50% damage to units adjacent to the target.

></center>

This ability is sooo annoying for opponents because even if you attack one target, nearby enemies also get damaged.

This becomes super strong against tightly packed teams.

If Abyssal Elemental attacks weak backline units, Blast can destroy multiple enemies together.

I personally love combining Blast with magic damage because magic attacks ignore armor. So the splash damage can become really deadly.

Sometimes one attack damages like 3 units together.

* * *

What I like most about Abyssal Elemental is that it feels very unpredictable.

Your opponent might think they are winning, but then:

*   Resurgence activates
    
*   The card resurrects
    
*   Deals damage to everybody
    
*   Then Blast starts damaging multiple enemies
    

Suddenly the whole battle flips around.

I also think this card works really well in mid mana battles. 6 mana is not too expensive and not too cheap either.

It fits nicely into many Water teams.

Another thing I noticed is that many opponents forget about Resurgence. They think killing the card once is enough. Then BOOM… it comes back again.

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Overall I honestly think Abyssal Elemental is one of the most fun Water cards to use in #Splinterlands right now.

The combination of:

*   Magic damage
    
*   Blast
    
*   Resurgence
    

makes the card feel super chaotic and dangerous.

Its not just a normal damage dealer. It can literally create clutch comeback moments out of nowhere.

I will definitely keep using this card more in future battles because its honestly really entertaining watching opponents panic after it resurrects.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

<hr>

Steve was a man with more jobs than most. Every morning, he went to the office to print documents on a printer that only worked intermittently. At midday, he changed out of his suit and into an apron and chef's hat: he became a burger cook at a food truck, where his specialty was putting cheese on the meat.

After serving the last dinner at the last table, he rushed to the supermarket to stack cans, scan barcodes, and dodge runaway cars, all while humming 80s songs to keep his spirits up. But his day didn't end there: at night, Steve put on his amateur baseball uniform, where he stood out for his incredible ability to throw the ball straight into the crowd.

His friends said Steve had more energy than a car battery, although in reality... Despite the exhaustion, Steve always smiled and said, \

And so, between short naps and many cups of coffee, Steve continued unstoppable as a productive worker.

body.title: Lắp camera hành trình 70Mai: Cách nhận diện địa chỉ uy tín để tránh rủi ro kỹ thuật
body.body:
**Nếu bạn đang tìm địa chỉ lắp camera hành trình 70Mai cho xế yêu, thì việc “lắp đúng kỹ thuật” quan trọng không kém “mua đúng sản phẩm”. Một chiếc camera tốt như 70Mai chỉ thật sự phát huy giá trị khi được thợ am hiểu kỹ thuật xử lý gọn gàng, đảm bảo an toàn điện và hình ảnh ổn định. Không ít chủ xe từng “vỡ mộng” vì lắp ở chỗ làm ẩu, gây nhiễu sóng, rung hình, thậm chí chập điện làm hỏng thiết bị.**

╰┈➤ **Xem ngay:** <https://akauto.com.vn/camera-hanh-trinh/70mai>

## **Vì sao chọn đúng chỗ lắp camera hành trình quan trọng?**

Lắp camera 70Mai không chỉ là gắn thiết bị rồi cho chạy thử. Hệ thống điện ô tô phức tạp, mỗi dòng xe có cách đi dây riêng. Nếu người thợ không hiểu nguyên lý nguồn ACC, dây mass, hoặc chỗ bắt cầu chì phù hợp, hệ thống dễ sinh ra:

*   Rò điện, hao bình sau vài ngày không chạy xe.

*   Nhiễu tín hiệu GPS hoặc Wi-Fi, khiến video bị giật lag hoặc sai vị trí.

*   Hình ghi bị rung, mất nét, do đặt vị trí không cân hoặc cố định sai góc.

*   Dây nổi, ẩn dây cẩu thả, gây vướng tầm nhìn và mất thẩm mỹ nội thất.

Một trung tâm uy tín sẽ hiểu rõ những vấn đề này để xử lý triệt để, thay vì “làm cho xong” như những nơi làm ẩu.



![z7673430130681_854529972a0da3916fd45786425d2f5c.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/a6c2d0824e6f81b24d19e19b51516c6d1361eee41709aead241cc7ca706ee0f8)

## **Dấu hiệu nhận biết trung tâm lắp 70Mai uy tín**

Nếu bạn lần đầu lắp camera hành trình 70Mai, dưới đây là những “tín hiệu” nhận biết địa chỉ đáng tin:

1.  Kỹ thuật viên tư vấn rõ ràng, giải thích được nguyên lý nguồn, vị trí gắn, và phương án đi dây cho từng dòng xe. Không né tránh câu hỏi.

2.  Quy trình làm việc bài bản: kiểm tra tổng thể xe trước khi lắp, test nguồn và tín hiệu sau khi hoàn tất, hướng dẫn sử dụng cho khách.

3.  Không gian làm việc gọn gàng, có dụng cụ chuyên dụng.

4.  Có thương hiệu và địa chỉ rõ ràng: trung tâm có website, bảng hiệu, cập nhật review thật từ khách hàng đã dùng.

5.  Chế độ bảo hành, hậu mãi rõ ràng: như 1 đổi 1 trong thời hạn, hỗ trợ cập nhật firmware, xử lý lỗi vặt nhanh chóng.

6.  Sản phẩm chính hãng có tem nhãn và phiếu bảo hành rõ ràng; không dùng hàng trôi nổi để lắp cho khách.

Trái lại, “tiệm làm ẩu” thường có những biểu hiện dễ nhận: giá rẻ bất thường, không xuất hóa đơn, làm nhanh trong vài chục phút, không test kỹ, hoặc không cho khách kiểm tra lại.

╰┈➤ **Xem thêm:** <https://www.blockdit.com/posts/6976d4e3489d0a7c9b3bc30f>



![z7673430269278_b7a3d1e34bfe268eac084253a2ab510b.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/11a0d09a19f2ab6084f4fbe4062c12912e83270ee595704161144db4cc5be2f8)

## **Quy trình lắp camera hành trình 70Mai chuẩn kỹ thuật**

Một quy trình lắp camera hành trình Xiaomi 70Mai đúng chuẩn thường gồm 5 bước rõ ràng:

1.  **Khảo sát vị trí lắp:** xác định chỗ gắn camera phù hợp góc nhìn và thẩm mỹ - thường là giữa kính lái sau gương chiếu hậu.

2.  **Đi dây nguồn gọn gàng:** dây được đi âm dưới viền trần, cột A, xuống hộp cầu chì. Không để dây thừa hoặc hở.

3.  **Kết nối nguồn đúng thông số:** lấy điện từ cầu chì ACC hoặc phích cắm bật lửa ô tô (tùy loại xe); không nối sai cực (+/-).

4.  **Kiểm tra tín hiệu ghi hình:** bật nguồn kiểm tra độ nét, góc quay, độ ổn định video, âm thanh, và kết nối app.

5.  **Hướng dẫn sử dụng và bàn giao:** cài app 70Mai, hướng dẫn tải video, cập nhật firmware, kiểm tra lại góc quay khi xe ra nắng hoặc di chuyển.

Quy trình này đảm bảo camera hoạt động ổn định, không ảnh hưởng hệ thống điện xe, không rung hình, và thẩm mỹ cao.

## **Những lỗi dễ gặp nếu thợ lắp sai kỹ thuật**

Nhiều người lầm tưởng camera 70Mai bị lỗi do thiết bị, nhưng thực tế phần lớn nguyên nhân lại đến từ lắp đặt sai kỹ thuật. Một số lỗi phổ biến gồm:

*   Camera không ghi hình liên tục, do nguồn ACC ngắt sớm.

*   GPS không hoạt động, do đặt sát tấm phủ kim loại hoặc sưởi kính.

*   Video rung, hình lắc, do không cố định chắc vào kính lái.

*   Không chia sẻ được Wi-Fi hoặc xem lại video trên app, do nguồn điện yếu hoặc đặt sai hướng anten.

*   Chập nguồn hoặc cháy cầu chì, do thợ đấu sai cực hoặc dây không đủ chuẩn.

*   Bình điện hao nhanh, do lấy nguồn trực tiếp từ đầu DVD thay vì cầu chì ACC.

Những tiệm làm ẩu thường không kiểm tra lại sau khi lắp, khiến chủ xe chỉ phát hiện lỗi khi đã ra khỏi gara.

╰┈➤ **Đọc thêm:** <https://tooter.in/akautosaigon/posts/115959173039917044>



![z7673430414235_e0d98e738cccb659d7a09adb7ca4e561.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/49abcbfd2acf4cf24a5a58282d0dcb29f51eb848efc4486b91a2d1675e526c37)

## **Kinh nghiệm chọn nơi lắp camera hành trình 70Mai theo nhu cầu xe**

Tùy loại xe và nhu cầu sử dụng, bạn có thể chọn trung tâm lắp phù hợp:

*   **Xe gia đình:** ưu tiên thẩm mỹ, độ bền dây và hình ảnh rõ nét. Chọn nơi có chế độ bảo hành tốt, hướng dẫn sử dụng app dễ hiểu.

*   **Xe dịch vụ hoặc công ty:** cần chế độ lưu trữ dài, GPS ổn định, hỗ trợ khắc phục nhanh khi gặp lỗi. Nên chọn trung tâm có quy trình quản lý thiết bị cho nhiều xe.

*   **Xe sang hoặc xe mới:** chỉ nên lắp ở trung tâm chuyên xử lý dòng xe cao cấp, vì hệ thống điện có độ nhạy cao. Cần thợ hiểu chi tiết dây nguồn, tránh can thiệp nhiều gây mất bảo hành xe.

Một ví dụ thực tế: khách hàng tại AKauto khi lắp camera hành trình 70Mai cho xe Mercedes được đội ngũ kỹ thuật kiểm tra nguồn điện riêng, lắp dây ẩn hoàn toàn, đồng thời đảm bảo camera hoạt động ổn định cả khi xe tắt máy. Sau 6 tháng, khách vẫn hài lòng với độ nét hình ảnh và kết nối app ổn định đó là giá trị của việc “lắp đúng kỹ thuật”.

## **Lời khuyên dành cho người đang tìm nơi lắp camera 70Mai**

*   Đừng chọn nơi chỉ vì giá rẻ. Camera 70Mai là thiết bị điện tử, lắp sai có thể gây rò điện hoặc ảnh hưởng đến hệ thống của xe.

*   Hãy xem kỹ đánh giá thật trên Google Maps hoặc các diễn đàn ô tô trước khi chọn.

*   Khi đến nơi, đừng ngại hỏi quy trình lắp, chế độ bảo hành, và kinh nghiệm của thợ.

*   Luôn yêu cầu test thiết bị sau khi lắp, kiểm tra lại video, GPS, Wi-Fi, và góc quay trước khi rời gara.

Một trung tâm uy tín sẽ luôn cho bạn cảm giác yên tâm từ cách tư vấn đến quy trình làm việc chuẩn chỉnh.

Có thể nói, camera hành trình 70Mai là lựa chọn thông minh cho mọi dòng xe, nhưng “lắp đúng kỹ thuật” mới là yếu tố giúp thiết bị phát huy hết công năng. Khi chọn trung tâm uy tín như AKauto Saigon, bạn không chỉ nhận được hình ảnh sắc nét, an toàn hệ thống điện, mà còn được chăm sóc hậu mãi chu đáo với chính sách 1 đổi 1 và hỗ trợ firmware chính hãng. Bởi lẽ, chất lượng lắp đặt thể hiện sự chuyên nghiệp và đó chính là cách trung tâm “vẹn tròn giá trị xế yêu” cùng bạn trên mọi hành trình.

body.title: Hidden Trails & Shallot Harvesting Adventure in Mount Wilis
body.body:
![mac property.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xVMEJGF7DkvNnSF2M6yWp8mCCtjDgsguG1HaQ8ShWGPYRN9brCw3UWHKzuBdsD7ZYx4.png)




<div class=text-justify>

There are quite a number of volcanic mountain in East-Java including the famous ones such as Bromo and Semeru but actually, there are many older volcanic mountain in the region that is dormant and worth exploring, such as  Mount Wilis. Unlike the popular hike in the region, Mt. Wilis is not commercialized due to its access that are still challenging and raw. If you enjoy quiter hike and untounched trails, this is one of the place to be. 

Last Saturday, I got the opportunity to visit deeper part of the foothills to experience shallot harversting. A close friend of my mother owned a few hectares of farmlands tucked away deep in the mountain. I heard from their son that it was harvest season, so I immeditely volunteered for the adventure. 




![DSCF1948.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wWu6rYofQxgsjbwJxPGBy24VstHhmT3Zf9GQynbh72B9LyXPVVVgKSi19VjsU5tT2Re.JPG)

We started the journey at 5 AM with regular car then switch to different car fitting for the mountain rough terrain. On our way to the harvest area, we passed through thick jungle where it feels like we were sandwiched between the lush greenery and the dangling roots all around it. 

Somewhere along the winding path, The son of the family started telling me that there was a famous coffee plantation and factory in the area. He pointed to the remnants of the factory as well as some abandoned villa all around these foothills of Mt. Wilis. One thing that came out of my mouth was \

, considering it was ages ago and even today this place is still considered remote. ![DSCF1950.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23vsQDEB1ar6wcuDhdGoEbSA5YmDaSu6Ft3Y7e8haaVNiXvWLL2bnsBzn86kczX6mtoq5.JPG) So, how did the dutch even scouted it? Whoever did that back in the day certainly has no fear of anything. I also heard that today, you can still find a lively wild animals animal including smaller sized tiger once in a while. As we pressed on, our 30 minutes bumpy ride, eventually come to a fruition. We started seeing rows of shallots. ![DSCF1956.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/245cWZREnfTi9gkwQQ226ZhSEQwww3gKLW12jCen8WkmKNQjWHJ6JMSSFbeApo59yQT3o.JPG) The family owns the biggest hut in the area. Practically, you can live there as it has a room, a bathroom, a common kitchen with a view like this. ![DSCF2044.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23qrBx5QDH2m7R4y7pWjH5bDgWEMJP9AYxg7LUYNZtPxcwpYSc5Je75kLte4nEpNekD1V.JPG) Before we start the harvest, the workers and us had the chance to fuel oursevles with packed lunch. They also served me a coffee, famous from the region. It was good! ![DSCF1981.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/244ofQkQqsAR5wv8Y74hkPDTthivZqVMgq9JRJ45AdckHnJobKU3xh7A7kz9n21XgRYGt.JPG) ![DSCF1988.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23ywyiXpEuhd4cCYKN7ALMbsZTDdiz7YPikedz2R3yfpLoXNZFapSuhrnaP6ThkvxPeZn.JPG) I walked around further to explore the trails all around the places. Locals told me about different paths we could take to explore it as well as places we we could do bike trails. So, I walked around because they don't need me to harvest yet. I found these beautiful spots all around the area that looks so untounched and raw. ![DSCF2078.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/244eCfGKqKVL4yABFAHJD5repNvJYrZQiEj2ZFGAKYK4civERhkJ7XrYRyGDiuvM6k2QP.JPG) ![DSCF2085.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23s9TKcJvENbeai8xpjRpmajArXtreXfKmpw7zGC8oy2CCXbypcQW411tjgFAAKHJiRBR.JPG) After I got tired exploring around, I joined the workers to pick shallots, filling up the bag with laughters filled the air to pass the time. It was really fun to pluck out the shallots and do the harvest.
![DSCF2090.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23uQnVtVUz6854uHLoZKj7GXuhCztM7tkegm24uXMKie8nvgHrTHnNRZY5dvqA7KWT3ph.JPG)
![DSCF2034.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23yJLysBiWcShvJPdCsDFJuaEwrzgzhsfWgq4nk9ryzuBPrEXjyPbkiTaTrqvC9SzPxxH.JPG)
This is once in a lifetime opportunity for me to experience this activity. After some rest, I took pictures of the workers who was waiting for lunch time. ![DSCF2101.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xpCmxNn1hwyp8nvmNGWhR3DFzBBZewPzNVpWcrTfscFgbonkr5mKeStR3PxqmXsf6S6.JPG) Once we finished the row in the back of the hut, I explored another rows in front of it there's this beautiful blooming flowers of shallots. ![DSCF2067.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23tbnq6j1QQhyAEaosCNTZRHG8vQyNQBqTzvYC1FbqQQ3S8LXWL1NL3Fth12Uix29npPr.JPG) The mist started to appear during noon and it was time for us to also go down from the mountain. It was my first time exploring this mountain and didn't know it was hikeable at first. If you enjoy hiking or trekking, this is one of the most underrated, untounched places in East-Java and around. Many people who passes this city don't even know this place existed, including myself. This is why, I wondered how did they dutch even found it and built an empire of coffee plantation in this region? ![DSCF2152.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/246GBHrM84d9wPKMfqovUq9EJpk21RzSvB4HgLkGGJER8Qax77W8wjynjBFAfFWCS3yoP.JPG) This was the adventure that left me with more questions than answer. I wanted to go back there again and hoping I could get another chance to visit and explore more of the area. I saw some waterfalls around it that I didn't get the chance to look at. On the map, this place is also called Mt Liman too ( which is the highest peak of it) and the Mt Wilis itself is the name of the mountain range of the area because it connects several places in the region. body.title: MegaETH Terminal Weekly Recap: S01 - W02
body.body:
The second week on MegaETH is already wrapped up and looking strong! We’ve been diving deep into the MegaETH Terminal and stress-testing an ultra high-performance EVM.

The new Layer 2 blockchain built on top of Ethereum officially went live last week with $MEGA, aiming to make crypto apps feel as fast and responsive as traditional web apps.

Since day one, the Terminal has been the execution-layer playground where we experiment, iterate, and push the limits of what onchain performance can feel like.

The core thesis behind MegaETH is simple... real-time execution. The goal is creating an environment where onchain interactions feel reactive, fluid, and alive.

Got some skin in the game and my new rank is 3,158th, which pushed me up 514 spots. As they said.. I am climbing the leaderboard and got a strong position! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeGqYg79rJXT38LbXHPK1nbUe2rsTqyGQiF82FrkLooXt/image.png)


MegaETH is watching for behavioral signals that suggest you’ll become a meaningful long-term participant in the ecosystem. It's a step-by-step discovery in the ecosystem.

The bet is less about farming activity, more about identifying users who naturally engage with the network as real applications emerge. Stablecoin farms are the best! 

It’s still incredibly early for MegaETH, and much of the current attention comes from its technical promise: ultra-low latency, real-time execution, and massive throughput.

Infrastructure alone isn’t enough in today's market! The real unlock happens if developers ship applications compelling enough that users don’t just try them once... they stay.

I discovered all 30 dapps and explored seven of them, going deeper and expanding my views of the ecosystem. [Pump Party](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) is a real-time onchain game that's totally random! 

It's an experimental arcade-style mini-games with gambling mechanics layered in. Players pay $ETH to launch the rabbit and may win prizes depending on the outcome.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbrJHE6kzGpHqWNbeZj7owY3wKXX5wAUYZzzBcoktyznf/image.png)


We’re playing the pattern-recognition game! Transactions hitting near-instant execution with ultra-low latency and extreme throughput, instead of forcing users to sit around waiting for block finality.

Over $40 million will be distributed over the next 8 weeks for Terminal users. Depending on how you rank against others, you will receive a share of the total airdrop!

There's 2.5% of [$MEGA ](https://x.com/search?q=%24MEGA&src=cashtag_click)supply so let's do it together and show what team work is the best. I started my MegaETh journey and I need to learn and adapt to the game! 

Farming requires you to burn some capital unless you play it super safe by providing USDm/USDT0 liquidity. Pokémon packs, Fantasy Football, perps ... expect losses.

This is why Kumbaya, [Pump Party](https://cannon.pumpparty.com/?ref=YCFY3PH4&chain=megaeth) and World are the three apps I've boosted. I applied multipliers to them for a strong and focused approach! Activity counts in this game! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcEthoKfw2ZTB2Gnp6s7ts26zkg9EBxZ4WUoyJUVj9rXg/image.png)


I thought [Prism](https://prismfi.cc/?ref=PVMBOSS) will be my main playground but it's built on top of Polymarket and that's not available for UK users! So I moved to opening pokemon packs on [Mnstr](https://mnstr.xyz/?ref=PVMIHALACHE)!

Packs are priced between $50 and $1,250 USD, and expect an average loss of 10-20% per pack... unless you get lucky! You connect to [Mnstr](https://mnstr.xyz/?ref=PVMIHALACHE) your X account. Good luck!  

What about the new cohort of dapps added this week? I don't do perps so had to look for the easy ones! No-loss scratch cards? You got my attention with this one! 

My 35 points for the week got me a nice rank so the show must go on! I made a strategy to slowly build a stash of $MEGA, and the plan is to add 100 tokens into Flux weekly! 

There are six more weeks and I need to tap into the MegaETH ecosystem as hard as possible! I want a big slice and that slice comes only if the game is played smart! 


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVoC3yDwEstXQroSvi2t7vpgjPSUWPMioRBATZFy2RjFj/image.png)

body.title: Запилючена Міка
body.body:
![міка.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23y92BAm7SSgXiRpbvEAMrKRm7SWoX6r6Rz8qLPZ6FAPhfgJNoRfJLytrdKu5apx6NJjK.jpg)


Привіт, друзі!

Я вже, здається, писала в одному з попередніх дописів, що висадила огірки в маленький парничок. Такий простенький — не теплиця, а саме парничок: дуги й спеціальна тканина, яка допомагає утримувати тепло, але водночас пропускає воду. Тобто якщо падає дощ, то волога потрапляє всередину, на відміну від поліетилену.

Але зараз і без того доволі спекотно, тому я щоранку трохи припіднімаю тканину, щоб було провітрювання і огірки не запарилися. Ну і посуха, про яку я вже писала, теж дається взнаки — ґрунт на полі сухий, дуже сухий, просто порох.

І от помітила, що Міка дуже полюбляє ті огірки. Точніше — сам парничок. Уже кілька разів бачила сліди всередині. Спочатку подумала, що вона ходить туди в туалет, бо любить рити ямки в землі, але схоже, що вона просто приходить туди \

- тобто полежати на теплій землі в затінку. Земля тепла, тканина дає затінок від сонця — ідеальне місце для котячого відпочинку.

Проблема тільки в тому, що там, окрім висаджених огірків, я ще й посіяла насіння, яке вже може сходити. А вона може все те поламати, тому доводиться виганяти цю хуліганку.

От позавчора теж вигнала її з парничка, а вона, ніби на зло, одразу пішла качатися по полю. Типу: «Ах так? Тоді я просто вся в пилюці виваляюся!» 😂 Була після того вся сіра від пороху, страшне просто.

Я вже думала, що доведеться її мити перед тим, як пустити до хати, але ввечері вона прийшла чистісінька. Мабуть, порох сам повитрушувався, або вона себе добре вилизала. Добре, що пил був сухий і дрібний — не перетворився на болото.

![IMG_20260522_174802.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23wX3hBjo6v5DQCeCK8cBTJ2L3j6nyFDYs1ryYEZWpJzptzBACy8T3wALaC5Qu3fDFZCx.jpg)

![IMG_20260522_174816.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23uFa9cXwz3xfKiXukrKcTTqCdTPbfgxgPpiw3cKwn4Mut9BYqKUhoMCRkLbT3w5qgbQV.jpg)

![IMG_20260522_174823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/23w2nsYM5W9UBtxM2MXB8wHQkCFoHyV4Fr7y5rxKgi7HcQ542YckL9NeBnALhnCb97TkG.jpg)

上周六和对象看了这部电影，这个原型是那个消失的孩子，还好我们俩都没有看过，不然去看了就很气，因为那电影情节简直是一模一样，只不过对于细节的处理不同而已，整个影片呢给我的感觉还行，不是很失望，李晨和郑恺演技还是在线，还有刘浩存的演技也是很不错，是一个宝藏演员
周六晚上打球很累，周末一觉醒来10点多了，因为外面下着小雨，很舒适的睡觉氛围，又眯了一会，今天有普通话考试，我想着下午去考的，又在床上打了一会游戏，大概12.40左右吧，外面还是下着雨，但是时间有点紧了，老师说2点必须到，于是匆匆忙忙的去洗了个澡，洗完澡吹完头发，打着把伞就出去了，明显的这雨挺针对我的，一出门就变大了，无奈硬着头皮走到考试的楼，先是检录，然后同行的有三个人，一个老师和我们一起，第一次考这个，流程也是很少，等了一会就开始了，一共是四道题，一个单音节，一个双音节，第3个是读一段文字，第4个是两篇作文，选一个，然后进行三分钟的短文，选了个我喜欢的植物，实在想不到该说什么了，就选了个梅花，然后就硬着头皮说完了
考完试，走出门的时候雨停了，去吃饭，到了饭店，天气还行，吃完饭出了门，雨又开始飘了，只能喊苦，硬着头皮回去了，有时候挺烦雨天的，有时候也挺喜欢的，人真的是个性情，看心情去评定标准，标准由心情定

---

body.title: Important abilities for the 'Anemic' ruleset
body.body:
<center>
![temp1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23tSKhtpD8SY5vwQzv1JZXqwTmFTNHn5HPNqFfV2VQiZDkEaGRBRGvqMPwtgqdWdnLmfH.jpg)
</center>

Good morning everyone! Another morning where I start of easy by playing a couple of Splinterlands battles, it's how I like to start my days off. 😊
This morning I pushed in to Diamond League for the fourth season in a row, I would have rather stayed in Gold to get the nice leaderboard rewards but it is what it is, and I have to say the great SPS and Glint rewards at this rating are pretty nice as well, now that something apparently has changed and in the second week of the season I'm at a higher rating that in previous seasons, I've delegated 10k extra SPS to this account to boost the earnings but it's still not enough to keep the boost at 10x

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23sweDUEHUa8dPf4EhJ2rSUBQ3eefrZWYGgZxCehRN5m5gSQL7mSdxMBJXZkN2xwSrBRa.png)
</center>

Would another 10k help? let's find out live while I'm making this post 😅

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Enynb6GF9etCCkuwarcig5T8jiuZPjfjQ1GKVqz9cDUToue92ZFSANpZuWNoPmgTnBT.png)
</center>

It's quite crazy how much SPS a player needs at the higher levels, the SPS is coming from my main account which is playing in Wild and needs a ton of SPS as well so for now I have to settle with these earnings, that isn't bad at all!

<center>
![teeth banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2kqTN8gBpWz7rz7ZmFQEDWAiPGQLJues1o7u42f9bzzU4qSUaFjgPSVQRN5NV5UDFV.png)
</center>

# The Anemic ruleset

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23t7DReh9sFeb9fWxDjanZEyAeQhArV2DhoncukKYmCS1ybNcaaaHsLwZHpRNz2Zg3qc6.png)
</center>

So, one of the first fights once I got in to Diamond was against a higher level player, which happens a lot now because I'm playing two leagues above my deck level so I can't complain about that I guess...

It was an interesting ruleset combination of Anemic and Weak Magic, in general I like to use units with Void Armor in the Anemic ruleset, so that it's harder to quickly get through my front line, other stats that are important here is obviously speed and high damage, when you're the one who strikes first and do high damage with that strike, chances are you're going to kill the first unit straight away before it can move itself.

Commander Slade with Elias is great for this because it strikes twice and packs a serious punch, combined with *Piercing* makes it extra lethal.

Another ability which is awesome for the Anemic ruleset is *Bullwark* which gives the unit +8 health and +8 armor once it gets to the first position, especially in this ruleset combo with Weak Magic it was a perfect combination but... *spoiler alert* you will later see it didn't even get to that point. 😅

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23t7BZbfALvyQbtuywnUUiNAvv6R9L8qciBJ8GQ3cTsvLLGPGhDyC4ASuD3jkD4Y64iMn.png)
</center>

My opponent thought Slade was the biggest threat as well, and they decided to poison him at the start of the fight, not cool! 😅 But still, it would take two full rounds before Slade is killed, and by that time he already did some serious damage, with the Sentry behind it as a third tank and my Tsunamist repairing armor, it looks like I'm okay for this battle.

At the start of round two, both the tank as the taunt had been killed, unfortunately now two of my units have been poisoned.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo45FjUPxJLTxqn3a5rwzuNZx1HqLFVMs5nxWtqp2qyjyAjHYocBgQJKaEsVzDqagbY.png)
</center>

Slade's damage was too much for the enemy front and although both of the poisoned units died at the start of round 3, it was already too late for the other team.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo6CGXaCixpu7Fc4QSw9inszrvLLRnQbd8xE44cEfic6YR1mxNNUvns5oD8nFY7DYwj.png)
</center>

At the start of round 4 only the Hemlig was left and it couldn't get through my Void Armor combined with Repair and soon after, the battle was a win for me with some really nice rewards.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23wLxMk14YsxUwfXHh939LyyJpRKxK4GfrkU8wzvB5LuoKWvLZSCmYPrmVUwNAWxovu8w.png)
</center>

[You can watch the battle unfold for yourself here.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_3ada056e8323b283319caca5a3bc3ca1?ref=nozem)

<center>
![splinterlands banner.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmagiEh4dRsLX9ZHCSzcach2kTjRd6FGc8HgRaGZRcosAf/splinterlands%20banner.png)
Thank you for reading!!!

If you haven't made an account already, please consider using my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com?ref=nozem01) to sign up, let me know if you have done so and I can help you with any questions you have and personally guide you.

Have a great day!

body.title: Splinterlands: Increasing Speed is nice in Explosive Weaponry
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I saw a battle where I took advantage of the ruleset.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23w2aSWQwMS7cFmz34begoEji6wGe9RqkxMggKPKoWieGs5KcegtJ8LYacrTSDn1vhyxE.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are High Five and Explosive Weaponry. This means that only 5 monsters can be used and all monsters gain the blast ability. There is also 27 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for water or dragon.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Barthalamas|6|Summoner|+1 speed|
|Frankarsgard|7|1st||
|Chaos Furybringer|6|2nd|Reach|
|A'lan Musketeer|8|3rd|Double Strike|
|Total Mana:|27|||

My summoner is Barthalamas for the +1 speed. I have Frankarsgard as my tank. After that is Chaos Furybringer with reach. Finally, I have A'lan Musketeer as my ranged damage dealer with double strike.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. I am relying on the speed and damage to take out my opponent. It's a gamble, but I think that is the best chance of winning this type of match.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tviGHbGZQ4j5GhgkqoGiR33whqdMmWo8wFnAdZy3TuSB5bsirSwanuJW2vJSWctwkAF.png)
At first glance, I think that this match can go either way. My opponent is focused on outlasting me, but my lineup is focused on damage and speed. I do haave a fairly decent speed advantage so it does improve my chances.

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFXmqBxdAWrruJfFyYnpekUVpbSbAkE84vkM51DEpuAqCvtru2tC4qQQ24tskQ8X4jv.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent is down to 1 monster, while I still have 3. This is my win because I can't miss due to the speed advantage.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23uFXmqBxeWbifinscMXqfNgLi7hU5E9hbEkZajuD7RGCXoCnq6NdjHxj6tXk6MGB7r4o.png)
I won later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle did go exactly as planned. The extra speed helped me out quite a bit in this match as it ensured that my monsters went first. By doing so, I was able to capitalize on the blast from the rulesets, and wipe out my opponent.  

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_9b9badcc40ad9c2abb7ed4b730e9027f?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@jfang003/splinterlands-increasing-speed-is-nice-in-explosive-weaponry-hyx)

Floral carpets, flower and plant exhibitions, traditional cuisine, and cultural activities throughout the day on May 16 were the festivities organized by the City Council for the city of Coimbra, Portugal.

Staking through a bear market is the part most people get wrong. The instinct is to cut positions when USD value drops, but if the thesis hasn't broken — same project, same team, same utility — then lower prices mean higher yield on cost for new stakes.

The key metric to track isn't portfolio USD value. It's token balance growth rate. If your stack is growing 30%+ annually through staking rewards, the USD value is a lagging indicator that will correct itself when the cycle turns.

What's your split between Hive-native staking vs external protocol staking?

body.body:
The Arsenal vs Guardiola comparison captures something that applies beyond sports — the hardest transition isn't from contender to champion, it's from champion to repeat champion. In crypto terms, it's the protocol that launches successfully vs the one that sustains dominance across market cycles.

The 5% swing you mention is the key variable. In football it's fixture luck, injuries, refereeing decisions. In markets it's timing, liquidity conditions, regulatory shifts. You can control the 95% and still lose on the margin. The question isn't whether you can eliminate the 5% — you can't — it's whether your system is resilient enough to absorb it and still be in position when the next window opens.

Arsenal's young squad is the right structural answer. In crypto, that means building during the down cycles so you're ready when attention returns.

body.body:
Tja, wer nicht hoeren will, muss Fuehlen.

Hier eben der Beitrag, der ALLE Berliner betrifft und vielleicht auch noch andere Staedte, mit einem aenlich gebautem System.

Die Terminvergabe des Service Portals Berlin, ist durch eine mehrklassensystem geregelt, in digitaler Form.

Dieses System, kennen die Beamten nicht, sondern nur die Macher.

Im Senat, hat man abgestritten, auf meine Vertraulichen Nachrichten, das man so ein System ueberhaupt nutzen wuerde, was ich schlich dreißt und frech finde.

Ich verfuege ueber Beweise, das dieses System umgangen werden kann und zwar von mir, und den Menschen, die es gebaut haben.

Das ist die Fast Line, die ich mir da zunutzen machen kann.

Ich bekomme nicht nach drei Wochen einen Termin fuer meine Sachen, sondern quasi direkt, wie man das erwarten duerfte, waehre man nicht so Stur, und wuerde sich dabei helfen lassen.

Aber hier, lasse ich euch auch alle weiter im Dunkeln, weil ich schulde niemandem was.

Geht mal weiter Wochenlang auf Termine warten, oder mich hoeflich fragen, ob ich nicht doch eventuell nochmal kooperationsbereit bin.

Die Loesung fuer das Problem habe ich naemlich sowohl schon gebaut, als auch mit dem Senat geteilt, aber hier wird weiter abgestritten, statt zuzuhoeren.

Das wird auch noch in anderen Themen fuer spaeter mal Sorgen bereiten.^^

Salve

body.body:
The Pathological Cascade of DNS

Brain White Matter & Demyelinating Events: The hallmark pathological feature of DNS is extensive demyelination, where the protective myelin sheath surrounding nerve fibers in the brain's white matter is destroyed. This halting of nerve signaling prevents normal communication between different brain regions.

Basal Ganglia Injury: The basal ganglia (specifically the globus pallidus) are highly metabolically active and among the first structures damaged during severe systemic hypoxia. Ischemia and metabolic failure here contribute significantly to motor and cognitive deficits.
Hyperintense Lesions: On neuroimaging (T2-weighted MRI), this tissue damage and cellular edema appear as bright or \

white matter lesions. These signals highlight areas of active inflammation, demyelination, and fluid buildup.

Neuroinflammation: The initial hypoxic injury triggers a severe secondary immune response. Microglia become activated, releasing inflammatory cytokines that perpetuate the breakdown of the blood-brain barrier and cause ongoing damage to oligodendrocytes (the cells responsible for producing myelin).

Psychiatric Psychosis: When the demyelination and neuroinflammation affect the frontal lobes, limbic system, and basal ganglia, the brain's complex neural networks are disrupted. This leads to the psychiatric manifestations of DNS, which can include sudden-onset psychosis, catatonia, severe paranoia, and disorganized behaviors.

body.title: The Hospitable Side of Us: When Our Relatives Visited Us in Leyte
body.body: > Happy Sunday Hivers! ## One of the traits Filipinos are known for is being hospitable. Many foreigners who have visited the Philippines have also noticed this. It is one of the reasons why many of them love to come back for vacation or even choose to live in the Philippines. Whenever we see new faces in our area, we approach them with a smile and offer help if needed. We never just leave them on their own. This is why people say that in the Philippines, you are never alone, Filipinos will always extend a helping hand within their capacity. It is one of the traits we are truly proud of. Last Saturday, the daughter of my cousin from Cebu arrived and visited us before heading to the place they originally came to Leyte for. They will be attending a wedding this week, but instead of going directly to the southern part of Leyte, they decided to stop by our house first. She informed me three days ago that they would visit us on their way. It also made us happy because it’s not often that relatives from my father’s side get to visit us, ## ![IMG_4251.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23x17JdpRZK2XaXkWeKyYWrf9xVfYLK71ZxKxCkBFQ79rUiL8WJnxgG1Lc68zFFAEBMq6.jpeg) ## When I informed my mother about their visit, she immediately became excited. In fact, as soon as she found out, she already started planning what food to prepare for them. That’s actually one of the common traits of Filipinos, we instantly think about what we can serve our guests. ## ![IMG_4253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/EoK7Dc9C4RjRsCmuPC4nD57PfC7GRUJJM7MRXhrE2zrjJr7mcgeFnreWxTMXphL57cG.jpeg) ## While we were chatting, they also informed us that they would be staying at our house for 2 nights. Of course, we were happy to have them sleep at our place. As soon as we learned about it, we prepared a room for them. Although we regularly clean it, my mother still made sure that everything was spotless. She prepared the pillows and bedsheets to make them feel comfortable. ## ![IMG_4259.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/243fmpVL34tiqTXAtg8QFcmEU617SVSWg7RYDo3uacCYjz3NXzntNtkZo5hfoc1EbYAQd.jpeg) ## However, one day before they arrived, my mother got sick. Because of that, the food she originally planned to prepare was no longer possible, so we just bought roasted chicken from the market instead. ## ![IMG_4264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kellyane/23ynPveP8eYkPb3XGGYP6ZB17wQteL18gC1ikeNEeyCNct7fDbCauDbmRs2V9UNXTbZUf.jpeg) ## When they arrived, my mother mostly stayed lying down because she was not feeling well, so it was only my brother and me who entertained them. They also brought their son, which made the house feel lively because he was very playful and noisy. As soon as they saw the sea, they immediately spent time at the beach. The next day, they woke up very early and went straight for a swim. They kept saying how beautiful our place was because they really loved the peaceful view and surroundings. Their visit may have been short, but it brought happiness and warmth to our home. Even though my mother got sick and we were not able to prepare everything we originally planned, we still did our best to make them feel welcome and comfortable. Moments like this remind me how deeply rooted hospitality is in Filipino culture. Whether through preparing food, arranging a room, or simply spending time together, Filipinos always try to make their guests feel at home. ##

>

Thank you for reading and see you on my next blog. Cheers!

body.title: I am my difference
body.body:
>

![1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tkfFkCmbnW2U3EAtX8UApPkFwFC1Lryd6G92XL85v7GDocCiHuQi1NjdvBmM6D7GtpT.JPG)

___

There is an idea, if it comes from Maurice Merleau-Ponty or from Hans-Georg Gadamer I am not sure, that simply states: unity-in-difference. The African philosophy of ubuntu for some scholars hold a similar position: even the person whom I find reprehensible still constitutes part of who I am. I am difference to the other, and in that difference, we constitute each other. 


<div class=\

> ![3.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23vYawC9qRqxrNyfS5cFt9YZkpJJKuMn1Snk5uFTW2DWkcshtdAH19ZLL8JXXjsWPXA6V.JPG) For many, difference is something that poses a threat, something that they need to get away from. For many, the idea of someone different strikes fear in their hearts. We accept difference as long as we can bend and shape it into something that we can recognise. Difference, alterity, the strange, can only be accepted if it can be understood. Understanding is a violent concept, it allows the other to moved from their horizon, from their context - which is never easily understood - into my own that I know intimately. It is always this one-way street: the other is to be understood from where I am standing. This is probably, to some extent, human; that which is strange and may upset my house is something we want to keep out. Security in knowing, perhaps. But am I not wholly different for others? Am I not my difference in their eyes? I have been thinking about this term for a while: I am my difference. To myself, I am not fully known, I am difference inherent. My own mind, always told by others as being transparent to myself, is itself not known in its entirety. I am constantly looking out for the familiar - familiar routes to walk, my favorite food - because it is the most obvious choice. There is no unexpected detour, no expectation not met. But how is this the case? How can the familiar keep me grounded in what I know? For are differences not the foundation of what makes us, us? For if we did not consist of difference, we would seamlessly blend in with out backgrounds. If we did not consist out of the differences we are, we would become unrecognisable even to ourselves. ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wgBPVVraGDEH937ftu8syNX2ip8yjYEvSfoT3c21mN6UEdJn6agSeadJapwGHLZBDex.JPG) ___ *All of the musings and writings are my own. The photographs are also my own, taken with my Nikon D300.*

info.title: HiveReactKit & HiveSuite Development Update: 3Speak Player Integration, Feed Unification & Navigation Improvements
info.author: sagarkothari88

content.description:
HiveReactKit improves 3Speak playback while HiveSuite unifies feeds, navigation, and auth handling.

## HiveReactKit — 3Speak Player Improvements

### Native 3Speak Player Integration

- Added native `ThreeSpeakPlayer` with:
  - HLS playback support  
  - CDN fallback support  


- Uses `json_metadata.video` as the primary video source.  

- Removes duplicate iframe embeds and unnecessary 3Speak links from post body content.  


### Fallback & Rendering Improvements

- Added fallback DOM replacement for embedded 3Speak links when needed.  

- Added automatic aspect ratio detection to fix player size mismatches.  

- Improved thumbnail handling:
  - Thumbnail visible only before playback  
  - Added `hideThumbnail` option support  


### Feed-Specific Player Behavior

- `HiveDetailPost` now uses:
  - Single clean player view  
  - No duplicate thumbnail rendering  


- Snaps feed uses the same player while preserving thumbnails for feed browsing.  


### CSS & Layout Improvements

- Improved responsive player layouts.  

- Added centered player alignment.  

- Fixed modal overflow issues for embedded media playback.  


- Outcome:
  - Cleaner 3Speak playback experience  
  - Better media rendering consistency  
  - Improved responsive video handling across Hive applications  


Native ThreeSpeakPlayer & Responsive 3Speak Playback

---

## HiveSuite App — Feed Unification & Sidebar Improvements

### Unified Blog Feed Navigation

- feat(blogs): unify feeds under dropdown selector.
- Unified blog-related feeds under a single dropdown selector:
  - Blogs  
  - My Communities  
  - My Friends  


- Added reusable `BlogFeedSelector` dropdown component.  

- Dropdown automatically adapts to authentication state:
  - Logged-out users only see Blogs feed  


### Sidebar & Navigation Refactor

- refactor(nav): simplify sidebar + active route handling.
- Cleaned up sidebar navigation:
  - Removed standalone “My Friends”  
  - Removed standalone “My Communities”  


- Unified navigation structure under Blogs section.  

- Improved active route handling throughout the application.  


### Feed View Improvements

- `BlogFeedView` now supports dynamic `ReactNode` titles.  

- Updated pages to use dropdown selector directly as page title component.  

- Added observer support for My Friends feed loading and updates.  


- Outcome:
  - Cleaner navigation structure  
  - Better scalability for future feed additions  
  - Improved feed accessibility and organization  


Unified Blog Feed Selector
![Unified Blog Feed Selector](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23tbK71P3zPJuHyNcNRFKjeDUfeXxaGfxRntU3r5CwvXQ5bNm7JZ5zj6Ybt2fwSs7kWaD.png)

---

## Authentication & Route Protection Improvements

### Auth Flow & Redirect Handling

- feat(auth): restrict feeds + add global logout redirect.
- Added feed access restrictions for authentication-only sections.  


- Implemented centralised logout redirect handling across all protected routes.  


- Users are automatically redirected to:
  - `/dashboard/blogs`  


- Improved authentication consistency across navigation flows.  


- Outcome:
  - More reliable protected route handling  
  - Cleaner logout experience  
  - Better navigation stability after auth state changes

body.title: Heatwave Alert (25 May – 2 June 2026): Stay Safe with These Tips...
body.body:
Hey All,

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gungunkrishu/23z7UNv3zrjT68PQbg4ktz6j7R8gqd7Ak1yoeHq6Fjde8wHJ72JbQJ5yDEpeDQ3gaQREA.png)


Its summer season here in India and alomst all the cities may it be in the nothern, western or soutern region all of them are recording daytime highs between 40°C and 44°C, while southern and coastal cities range between 25°C and 35°C. In brief, there is a heatwave going across many regions, and we need to be extra careful during the next 9 days which from today till 2nd June. Also these days are called - **Nopatapa (नौतपा) is a traditional Indian term referring to the 9 hottest days of summer**. What is important during these 9 days is to stay hydrated, avoiding direct sunlight during peak hours [12 PM to 5 PM] avoid going outside as much as possible, and taking proper precautions can help us stay safe and healthy. Lets us now look at the tempratures of the major ten cities of India..just to give you all the glimpse of summers that we have in the country..

***India Heatwave Alert: Temperature Range Across Major Cities During Nautapa 2026..***

| City      | Temperature Range (°C) |
| --------- | ---------------------- |
| Delhi     | 43–46°C                |
| Ahmedabad | 42–45°C                |
| Mumbai    | 33–36°C                |
| Kolkata   | 37–40°C                |
| Chennai   | 36–39°C                |
| Bengaluru | 32–35°C                |
| Hyderabad | 39–42°C                |
| Pune      | 37–40°C                |
| Jaipur    | 43–45°C                |
| Nagpur    | 44–47°C                |


### Nopatapa (नौतपा)  -  Stay Safe with These Tips...

Now that we know that the next 9 days require safety measures to stay protected from the heatwaves, which can cause N number of problems lie dehydration, skin related issues, heat exhaustion, dizziness, and even heatstroke, it becomes very imperative to take proper precautions and care for ourselves and our loved ones. Based on the above thumbnail image, I am highlighting the important - ***Heatwave Safety Tips During Nautapa 2026*** that one should definately try to follow and ensure their loved ones are also following the same and at the same are keeping themselves safe, hydrated, and protected during these extreme summer conditions. Kindly refer the table as below...

### Heatwave Safety Tips During Nautapa...

| Safety Tip                     | Why It Matters                      |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| Drink plenty of water          | Prevents dehydration and heatstroke. Try having buttermilk at least two to three times a day, as it helps keep the body cool |
| Avoid direct sunlight          | Reduces risk of overheating, if possible apply sunscreen lotion         |
| Wear light cotton clothes      | Keeps the body cool; Preferably wear light-colored or white clothes and avoid black or dark colors              |
| Use caps or umbrellas outdoors | As it protects from harsh sun rays        |
| Eat light and cooling foods    | Helps maintain body temperature     |
| Avoid outdoor activity at noon | Peak heat can be dangerous          |
| Keep ORS[Oral Rehydration Solution] or electrolytes handy | There are tetrapacks avaiable of ORS. It helps restores lost minerals and salts    |
| Stay indoors during peak hours | Minimizes heat exposure as much as possible            |
| Take frequent rest breaks      | Take rest and prevent exhaustion and fatigue     |
| Check on elderly and children  | Help children and ealderly parents. They are more vulnerable to heat    |

Now that we know how these simple steps outlined above can help from the heatwaves. It is also important to note that building our future is our responsblity only. No one is going to come and help us out. Therefore, for a better future and a healthier environment, we need to start planting more trees and also try to save as much energy as possible for the well-being of future generations and our planet. Living a healthy and disciplined life is the way to build a stronger future, maintain good health, and stay mentally and physically balanced in today’s fast paced world. Well this should be it for todays post on - \

Stay Safe and Healthy.... Cheers


#Heatwave2026 #Nautapa2026 #StayHydrated #SummerSafetyTips #BeatTheHeat #HealthyLiving

Best Regards
Paras

body.title: Кіт-винищувач
body.body: Маємо такого домашнього улюбленця, якого хочеться посадити у в'язницю зачиненого дому і ніколи більше не випускати на вулицю. Бо цей броварський босяк з віком все більш і більш набуває рис справжнього жорстокого хижака. Природа навколо нього скоро залишиться пустелею, так багато живих істот він винищує. Причому це робить тільки заради полювання, лиш зрідка може понадкушувати якусь особливо смачну для нього здобич...\nІ якщо проти винищення мишей та пацюків на підконтрольній Мейсону території я не маю нічого проти, то, вибачте, всі інші його \

мене гірко засмучують. Особливо коли це відбувається навесні, адже саме тепер все живе у природі вирощує своє потомство. І, побачивши зранку на порозі дому чергову вбиту Мейсоном пташину, одразу хочеться його просто знищити. Адже ясно, що чиїсь пташенята тепер можуть не вижити, бо не буде кому їх вигодувати...\nЗараз пішов \

ящірок.
Приніс вчора. Вже безхвостою. Така красуня, ну навіщо вона коту, скажіть!😱
Відібрати вдалося, але чи виживе вона тепер без хвоста - питання. Та й чи не зловить наш винищувач її знову - теж...

body.title: Staatswachstum: Er kann nicht anders
body.body:
>Hetze gegen den Staat nimmt immer größere Ausmaße an, je mächtiger der Staat als Beschützer und Betreuer der Menschen wird. Eine Lösung für das Problem haben die Behörden noch nicht gefunden.


Es ist schon eine haarsträubende Logik: Während die Wirtschaft seit fünf Jahren wie ein Marathonläufer mit Sandalen durch Treibsand stapft, wächst der Staat munter weiter – wie ein Bambus im Gewächshaus der Steuerzahler.   Der alte Adolph Wagner hätte seine Freude daran. Schon 1892 formulierte der Mann aus Erlangen sein \

. Seither haben sich sämtliche Regierungen - beinahe weltweit - daran gehalten. In Deutschland entpuppt sich der Leitfaden gerade als Überlebenshandbuch für Krisenzeiten: Je mehr Arbeitsplätze die Wirtschaft abbaut, desto mehr neue schafft der Staat.

>Der Staat baut Luftschlösser 

Die Devise? Wenn die Wirtschaft hustet, baut der Staat Luftschlösser – und damit es nicht auffällt, nennt er sich Zukunftszentren. Eigentlich sollte der Staatsapparat Wagner zufolge nur proportional zum Volkseinkommen wachsen. Doch Not kennt kein Gebot und Ausweglosigkeit muss sich über ökonomische Gesetze hinwegsetzen. Der Staat ist im Staate Deutschland die
>letzte Wachstumsbranche. Selbst der neue Kanzler, der angetreten war, viel zu kürzen und Unnötiges wegzuschneiden, setzt seinen großen Entbürokratisierungsplan auf EU-Art um:

>Er schafft neue Stellen.

Dahinter steckt eine kühne Strategie. Je schwächer die Wirtschaft, desto dringender braucht sie unsere Hilfe, sagen Parteien, Ministerien und Behörden. Arbeit schaffen heißt nicht mehr, Innovationen ermöglichen. Sondern neue Förderrichtlinien und Berichtspflichten etablieren. Corona war dabei der perfekte Katalysator. Plötzlich durfte der Staat nicht nur die Lufthansa retten, sondern auch noch Impfstoffentwickler umsorgen wie Hotelgäste mit All-inclusive-Paket, Banken übernehmen, Musiker unterhalten und Chemiebetriebe finanzieren.

>Fortlaufender Anstieg der Staatsquote 

Die Peacock-Wiseman-Hypothese erklärte den fortlaufenden Anstieg der

>Staatsquote, der alle gesellschaftlichen Änderungen, alle Reformversuche und jeden Angriff auf die Bürokratie überlebt: Nach jeder Krise bleibt der Staat dicker zurück – wie ein Bär nach dem Winterschlaf, der vergisst, dass er eigentlich schlank bleiben wollte. Erstmals haben Staat und Sozialversicherungen in Deutschland im vergangenen Jahr

>zusammen mehr als 400 Milliarden Euro für ihr Personal ausgegeben. Je Einwohner  gerechnet kostete der Staat seine Bevölkerung 4.873 Euro im Jahr. Im Vergleich zum Vorjahr waren das knapp 34 Milliarden Euro oder stolze neun Prozent mehr.

Macht doch nicht, merkt doch keiner.

>Genauso schafft es der öffentliche Sektor, selbst in Rezessionszeiten zu expandieren. Still. Leise. Ohne große Glocke. Peacock und Wiseman gingen Anfang der 60er Jahre davon aus, dass soziale und wirtschaftliche Krisensituation der Nährboden sind, auf dem der Staat am besten gedeiht. In Kriegen, Pandemien oder sonstigen Krisen hält das Volk immer verzweifelt nach Rettern Ausschau. Eher über kurz als über lang fällt - zumindest in Deutschland - der sehnsuchtsvolle Blick auf den Staat. 

Der ist gern bereit, schließlich rettet er mit dem Land auch sich selbst. Dazu braucht er allerdings Geld. Doch justament wenn es schlecht läuft, ist Widerstand der Bevölkerung gegen höhere
>Steuern und die damit einhergehende Erhöhung der
>Staatsquote gering. Sondervermögen können binnen Tagen herbeigezaubert werden. Rüstungsausgaben lassen sich ohne jede Diskussion dauerhaft verdreifachen.

>Die Leute gewöhnen sich 

Sobald die Krisensituation beendet ist, hat sich die Bevölkerung an die hohen Abgaben gewöhnt. Es wird ein wenig gejammert. Es wird ein wenig geschimpft. Aber an ein Zurückfahren der Staatsmacht ist nicht zu denken -

> Ämter arbeiten emsig und mit großem Erfolg.

Heute betreibt etwa das Nationale Zentrum für Umwelt- und Naturschutzinformationen (NZfUN) eine Internetseite. 25 Mitarbeiter liefern auf

. Es gibt Tage, da hat die Seite 160 Besucher. Die Außenstelle des Umweltbundesamtes, dessen Personalbesatz seit 2016 von 40 auf mehr als 500 Beamte gestiegen ist, gilt als schlagender Beweis dafür, wie kein Bedarf erzeugt wird, den niemand hat. In fünf Jahren wird die Unterbehörde der Unterbehörde des Umweltministeriums mit Sicherheit keine 25 Mitarbeiter mehr haben. Sondern 50.

>Es endet nie 

Wer würde wagen, ein solch gelungenes Experiment zu beenden? Nein, jede gerettete Krise wird zum Nährboden für neue Behörden. Wenn die Deutsche Bahn nicht pünktlich fährt, hilft eine

. Das Budget beträgt zwölf Millionen Euro, das Personal umfasst 23 Beamte, die akribisch dokumentieren, warum Züge nie pünktlich sein können. 

Das Ergebnis ist ein 800-seitiger Bericht, der beweist, dass Verspätungen systemimmanent sind. Das bröckelnde Rentensystem und die außer Rand und Band geratene Pflegekasse, die Krankenhäuser, die so viel Geld fressen wie noch nie und doch dauernd pleite sind - eine Kommission hilft beim Vertagen des Eingeständnisses, dass niemand mehr weiter weiß.

>Arbeit dehnt sich aus 

Cyril Northcote Parkinson wusste schon 1955, dass Arbeit sich ausdehnt, \
Das zweite Parkinsonsche Gesetz besagt zudem:  \

Die des Staates haben faktisch keine Grenzen. Das bedeutet im Umkehrschluss, dass ein Staat wachsen kann, so lange er will. 

Deutsche Behörden haben daraus ein Kunstwerk gemacht. Nehmen wir den „Digitalisierungshelfer 4.0“ – ein Programm zur Vereinfachung von Antragsverfahren. Das Ergebnis sind mindestens drei neue Abteilungen in einer untergeordneten Behörde, die PDF-Formulare in zwölf Farbvarianten erstellen und jährlich 120 Schulungsworkshops zum Thema \

>Einfluss der Überbürokratisierung 

Herbert Haase vom Climate Watch Institut (CWI) in Grimma – nicht zu verwechseln mit dem 2011 viel zu früh verstorbenen Politiker Hans-Herbert Haase – hat das Phänomen über Jahre erforscht. \
, sagt er. Herausgekommen ist eine Grunderkenntnis: \
veröffentlicht, führt der Wissenschaftler prägnante Beispiele an. Ein Heizölantrag erzeuge durchschnittlich 23 Kilogramm Papier, hat sein Team errechnet. \

Kein Einzelfall, wie Haase erforscht hat. Ein wachsender Staat - und es gebe nur wachsende Staaten - sei der Garant für nachhaltige Bürokratie. Ein Bauantrag für einen Radweg bindet Haase zufolge so viel Bürokratie-Energie, dass nebenbei drei Windräder gebaut werden könnten. Dass die Umstellung einer Armee wie der Bundeswehr von Friedens- auf Kriegsbetrieb für einen Dimensionswechsel bei der Bürokratisierung stehe, erkläre sich von selbst.

>Behördenansiedlungsprogramm der Bundesregierung 

Das Nationale Zentrum für Umwelt- und Naturschutzinformationen (NZfUN), finanziert aus den Mitteln des
>Behördenansiedlungsprogramms der Bundesregierung, startete etwa im Januar 2023 und ging schon im Februar 2025 in den Regelbetrieb. \

, umschreibt Herbert Hasse die Arbeit an einer gemeinsamen Linksammlung mit Bundes- oder Landesbehörden, wissenschaftliche Einrichtungen und zivilgesellschaftlichen Organisationen. 

Klimaneutralität ohne Bürokratie wäre vorstell-, aber nicht umsetzbar. Krisen sind wie Dünger für beschleunigtes Behördenwachstum. Jede Katastrophe ist ein Startschuss für den Aufbau neuer systemrelevanter Verwaltungen. Die wiederum sind die Grundvoraussetzung dafür, am Staat zu sparen: Um Verwaltung abzubauen, muss man sie erst aufbauen. Dass weder die EU-Pläne zum
>Schrumpfen der Vorschriftenfabriken um 25 Prozent noch Friedrich Merz'
Erfolg haben, hat einen guten Grund. Ohne eine \
(BfEB) kann ein solches Vorhaben nicht gelingen.

>Der Staat als Mäzen 

In der Phase des Aufbaus aber läuft alles automatisch. Lahmt die Wirtschaft, springt der Staat als Mäzen ein. Planmäßig werden Subventionen dorthin vergeben, wo die eigenen Visionen buchstabengetreu umgesetzt wird. Dann scheitern die unterstützten Firmen an den Förderrichtlinien. Zu spät. Zu langsam. Falsche Prämissen. Anschließend werden Rechnungshöfe in Marsch gesetzt, um die Subventionsverwendung zu bemängeln. Es kommt zum Showdown im Parlament, mehrere junge, hoffnungsfrohe Redenschreiber haben ihr Bestes gegeben, um den Skandal anzuprangern. \

springen auf, auch Mario Barth und der SWR.

Bei gescheiterten Unternehmen entstehen auf diese Art mehr Arbeitsplätze als bei denen, die reibungslos laufen. Damit es dazu nicht kommt, wächst die Zahl der Überwacher wie im Gewächshaus: Referatsleiter für transversale Resilienzsynergien und Abteilungsleiter für fachlich-organisatorische innere Führung vermögen aus jeder neuen EU-Richtlinie fünf neue Stellen zu zapfen. Drei für die Umsetzung, zwei für die Dokumentation der Nicht-Umsetzung.

Der Bürokratie-Whirlpool entsteht in der finalen Phase des Extremwachstums. Die Wirtschaft produziert weniger, die Steuereinnahmen sinken, der Staat erhöht die Steuern, um die Ausgaben zu decken. Unternehmen zahlen mehr und können noch weniger investieren. Die Wirtschaft schrumpft weiter, der Staat muss noch mehr ausgeben, um die Krise zu bekämpfen. Ein Perpetuum Mobile der Staatsverschuldung, wie es Adolph Wagner vorhergesehen hatte, als er beschrieb, wie bei fortschrittlichen \

.

Mit jedem neuen Formular, jeder zusätzlichen Stelle, jeder surrealen Förderrichtlinie wächst das Bollwerk gegen den Kapitalismus. Herbert Haase, ein überzeugter Schüler Wagners, bringt es auf den Punkt: \

body.title: Difference Between Attention And Respect
body.body:
> There was this businessman that lived in the place where I stayed before. This man constantly showed off expensive items and luxury lifestyle on social media just to attract attention and appear like he has abundance of wealth. True, he was among the subject of discussion in media, but the people who knew him, and even the neighborhood, did not respect him because he was dishonest in his business and was unreliable. However, in the same street, there was another businessman who lived a quiet life, but he treated his customers well and right, kept his words, maintained integrity, and worked hard. It was not long and he began to earn genuine and loyal customers, and people respected him. In life, earning respect is far better than just seeking for attention.
![pexels-nano-erdozain-120534369-26835498.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbuHFsLxbCgyJzy7PwEhdQXwZFBbBH5vC7nkiQphuS6ZL/pexels-nano-erdozain-120534369-26835498.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/group-of-people-sitting-together-listening-26835498)
A lot of people confuse attention with respect, but the two of them are different in many ways. Attention is when people notice you, or talk about you, or focus on you for maybe a moment or so. But respect is way deeper than that. This is because respect is earned through your character, integrity, behaviour, and how you treat people. You cannot treat people the way you like and expect to earn respect. You may need to know that someone can get a lot of attention, maybe because of what they do, but they may not even earn respect. You need to understand this, so that you will not spend your whole time chasing after attention while forgetting the characters that will earn you respect. Attention is often temporary and short-term. It can come as a result of how you appear, your popularity, social media showoff, the amount of money you spend, controversy, etc. In the world of today, it has become so easy to create attention. I once saw a post of someone whose post got viral by just standing on the junction to hail drivers who drive luxury cars as they pass, and they may tip him some money. At that moment, he was commanding attention. In fact, the people who stay are around that neighbourhood knew him. It is true he got attention, but the question is, what about respect? That you are noticed does not meant that you are valued or that you are automatically trusted. It is worthy to note that respect is built over time. It is built through discipline, dedication, consistency, honesty, good character, and the responsibilities you take. Unlike attention that is based on what people see publicly, respect is based on who you truly are; on your personality. This is why respect lasts so long because it is built on substance and not on appearance. You may not even have as much as someone else who has a lot of money to spend, but you can command a far bigger respect than them through your character. One of the major dangers of chasing attention is that it can force someone to indulge in unhealthy habits and behaviours. I know someone who would borrow clothes and other wears just to look good to impress people and to flaunt on social media. Everyone who knows her knows her as the one who borrows often, yet online she will be commanding attention. All these for the quest and desperation for attention and approval. They can do just anything to feel relevant and for others to see them. But when they are not getting the attention, they will begin to be dissatisfied with life, and insecure. They forget that who they are is not a function of what people think of them.
![pexels-ketut-subiyanto-4963437.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNvj1QxUfzXtFEyBW6aB5aMvkq1S4mB6c6APBNrAGEMzo/pexels-ketut-subiyanto-4963437.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/two-people-shaking-hands-4963437)
Respect does not require you to force it or to live to impress people, neither does it need constant performance. You do not have to force people to notice you to gain respect. Your actions, behaviour, and integrity should speak for you. Attention may seek for visibility, but respect brings credibility. When you earn respect, you will build trust and people who also value you. Respect also has a way of influencing relationships in a positive way. When you build respect, people will trust your words, and you will become more dependable. You also need to know that to earn respect, you also need to respect others and respect yourself too. It is what you give others that will come back to you. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all
