body.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures: A Netflix Gem Worth Your Time
body.body:
So I don't usually watch Netflix, but I checked Rotten Tomatoes and saw it was doing pretty well. The cover made it look like some cheerful feel good thing, so I figured why not, might be a good way to kill some time. Turns out it's way better than that.

**Real Emotional Stuff**
Honestly, the emotional vibe of this movie is unlike anything else I've watched this year. \

is the only other thing that comes close, but this one hits different. The twists and turns feel magical, not forced. Like, you actually feel stuff.

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQWNtVThxViAXJy3SCiAoNdRWS7ubwDK3E6MEAezgCswL/Remarkably_Bright_Creatures_poster.jpeg 
 [Wikipedia link](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Remarkably_Bright_Creatures_(film)#/media/File:Remarkably_Bright_Creatures_poster.jpeg) 
**What It's About**

It's basically about two people who are trapped. There's this older woman who lost her son and now works at an aquarium. She takes care of an octopus and helps it move around. But the crazy part is, the octopus feels her pain too. Like they're both stuck in their own worlds, and they just get each other without even trying.
Then there's this random dude, just some guy with nothing going on, who shows up. His whole thing is chaotic and weird, and it takes a minute to understand what's happening when he meets these two. It's kind of messy but in a good way.

**Just Watch It**

The octopus narration is really something else. You're seeing everything through this creature's eyes, and it's honestly beautiful. What gets you is the genuine stuff in this movie: a struggling artist trying to find a reason, an old woman who has lost everything but keeps going anyway. Those quiet moments stick with you.
This movie is about people trying to keep moving when life has knocked them down. If you want something that actually makes you feel something real, watch it. Trust me.

**Some details about the movie:**
*Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again*.

*Genre: Drama, Mystery*

*Actor: Sally Field, Lewis Pullman, Colm Meaney*

body.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps:  First impressions
body.body:
It's been a long time since I played Ori and the Blind Forest but I do remember it being a bit of an artistic masterpiece that I never finished because there was some sort of ice-jumping level that required pinpoint accuracy to make it through the event and I stopped playing one day and thought I would come back the next day then never did come back or if I did it was even harder because I had lost familiarity with the controls and then I just walked away forever.  I still have that game too but I really feel that attempting it again would be a waste of time because the same exact progression would likely occur.  

In *Will of the Wisps* they have a difficulty selector and I already really enjoy this because I feel like a game should be experienced first and then if you want it to be more difficult you can do that.   When I was younger, or even in my 30's, I was ok with games being hard as nails but now I don't really feel that way.

<center> https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/9/94/Ori_and_the_Will_of_the_Wisps.jpg
[src](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/9/94/Ori_and_the_Will_of_the_Wisps.jpg)</center>

One of the things that people enjoy about the two Ori games is that while there is a story there, it is not always terribly clear exactly what it is.  There is mostly a bunch of moving around with an ominous voice telling you a couple of vague things about the world that you occupy, but what is actually going on in its entirety is often left up to the user to fill in the blanks.

The gameplay starts out really easy, as one would expect, and then it gets progressively more difficult, which I think one would also expect.

Now my memory of *Blind Forest* might be a bit muddled but I don't recall there being a great deal of offensive attacks going on and it was more about a platforming experience than anything else.   In *Will of the Wisps* you collect a bunch of things and it has more of a metroidvania sort of feel to it that the original game had in some capacity, but it was overall a lot more linear.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23uQfg4Z2tR1monoJRm59tTq76F1hHqeTFwKMdnjn6ccMPAivTdbyEodeGXq5EWYP26Sn.png)
[src](https://oyster.ignimgs.com/mediawiki/apis.ign.com/ori-and-the-will-of-the-wisps/e/e0/Ori_And_The_Will_Of_The_Wisps_3_7_2020_9_09_39_PM.png)</center>

You get your first weapon pretty early on and then the game slowly but surely introduces you on how to use it.  It's a pretty simplistic thing.   Then you have a couple of semi-boss fights, I guess sub-bosses and none of those are very difficult either.   Mostly, the battles I think are meant to be kind of a pushover and the real meat and potatoes of this game are you doing a bunch of platforming in order to get new unlocks that I am yet to really understand.  I would imagine that they have something to do with you being able to unlock new abilities and that is fine by me.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23wWpHD5EkyzPR7LXyWjdHU8AAMmkctQwKw74U57L3umyBAdjrtYfuaifBusMri43dbAt.png)
</center>

The lighting, color, and the sound are just outstanding in this game and I don't feel as though many other games are on the same level as this one.  Just getting a torch early on seemed like a real adventure and it quickly opened up new avenues for exploration and this is the sort of backtracking that I do not mind at all.  

There isn't really XP in this game, so there is never going to be any grinding per se, but there are incentives to revisit areas that you have already been in because there are areas that you will be able to access once you acquire a new skill that you couldn't reach before.
<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23uEjXEeCFZJNLaf7iCAUAWkeNwJyZyqBudCmc3MdTbfZaE9otV8qSRqb2TRykRhtvm22.png)
</center>

I just love how new abilities are shown to you in the tutorial part of the game and how it becomes immediately obvious what you are supposed to do with these skills.  The only thing that really gives you any trouble at the start is mis-timing a jump here and there that sends you back a little ways but since this is a rarity, you don't really mind doing it, and the game again, is so beautiful that none of this ends up feeling like a chore.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/23tGRVMrJEYFJciGFVct5vHRF6gPmX9DMgWUTQzBRB8Cx5LPqzBXZtFfsBWWbPX1bNrG6.png)
</center>

I can already tell after just an hour of playing that the explorable areas are going to be absolutely massive and this could be, but I am not yet sure, a way to prevent me from getting frustrated at a particular part that I simply cannot get past the likes of which I encountered when playing *Blind Forest*.   Many metrodvanias have employed this idea such as Hollow Knight as well as the the \

games *Ender Lilies and Ender Magnolia* where if you got to a part that was too hard, there was plenty of other places to explore before you return.

in my mind this is damn near perfect metroidvania thus far but I will have to wait and see if something changes along the way.  At the moment I have only partially explored a couple of regions and I am quite certain I will need to return to grab the things that I couldn't yet access.  I will kind of look forward to it when that time comes.   

I can't really say that this is true for me as far as Nine Sols is concerned because the map system as well as simply getting around is pretty confusing in that game and I will actually  be a bit surprised if I ever return to it.  Kind of unlikely seeing as how I am already aware of the fact that Nine Sols is considered one of the most difficult metroivania platformers in existence.   

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whoisjohn/EoyMa5rnj7QmgRjNJqbWLysLq6inktXeVH8k5oeGnHMurthtnnoVS9QdfzVQVoZzmgA.png)
<sub> Although intimidating this first boss encounter has been stalking you for a while and rather than defeat it, the game is preparing you for an encounter that will likely happen again later once you have more power </sub> </center> 

If you are more of a casual player but also appreciate fantastic graphics and sound, I think either of the \

games are going to be right up your alley.   This is a game that can probably be made more difficult but it's still reasonably challenging on the easiest setting.  If you discover that it is too easy at any point you can change it any time you feel like it, and vice versa if it is too hard. 

I'm playing on a Nintendo Switch but the game is available on all platforms as far as I know.  

 <center><sub> all unsourced images are from my own gameplay </center> </sub>

or a radiant, thoughtful starburst, representing a new, safe approach to AI.*

- **Minimalist Design:** *The minimalist, geometric approach, often in monochrome or warm tones, aims to reflect clarity, structure, and trust.*

- **Homage to Claude Shannon:** *The name \
itself is a tribute to Claude Shannon, the 20th-century mathematician who laid the foundation for information theory and \

concepts and outcomes.*\n\n- **Alternative Interpretations:** *Some observers have humorously pointed out that the logo resembles the hand-drawn asterisk/asshole symbol used in Kurt Vonnegut’s Breakfast of Champions to represent [\
](https://youtu.be/fIbQTIL1oCo) and human-centered design, a comparison that fits the company's focus on human-centered AI.*\n\n- **The \

and the logo's simple, restrained aesthetic mirrors this, avoiding overly flashy visuals to signal that it is a serious tool.*\n\nIn summary, the Anthropic logo is designed to reflect a thoughtful and cautious \

body.title: Conqueror of the sea of stars. 2026. Pyrography (burning on wood).
body.body:
![DSC00110.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fieryfootprints/23uQxswmrmjniEg9aoQQPVXJBg8QjFtJwADyxa9kespFdzCi5tKQY87if8pyNmkYn2tqF.JPG)

I finally finished burning this art piece. It took me almost two weeks. Also in the end I picked the longer name for it. I wanted to create the illusion that the ship is sailing (flying?) among the stars. Therefore, the border between the sea surface and the sky is not very clear. As you can see, I left some areas unburned - this is because I wanted to create contrast, but I didn't want to use either acrylic paints or colored pencils in this work. Just pyrography. This painting has several hints to my favorite fantasy books (Berserk manga): 1. The name of the ship is White Hawk. That was the nickname of one of the main characters in Berserk. 2. I tried to replicate the symbol of that character's army flag on the ship's flags, but I couldn't because there was not enough space on the flags.

body.title: Slow Morning on the Balcony After a While / 久しぶりにバルコニーでゆっくり
body.body:
![6B76BA04-4164-4AAE-84DB-0F77C772E16B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/242XyQ7JFyVW5AKAazKNs2g9EvpY9BLixJgbXKj5QYwbQrnhmBKoLqQcoZ26i6EPsReyZ.jpeg)

Lately, my days has been full (for my standard 😉) with business trips, workshops, and various outings, so I hadn’t really had the chance to slowly enjoy my mornings on the balcony watering and seeing plants with a cup of coffee. But finally, today I could!

The strawberries that were still flowering not so long ago have already grown quite large, and I can really feel the season moving forward. The strawberries on my balcony keep producing fruit for a long time every year — sometimes even until December — and this year seems to be an especially good one with so many berries growing. 

These balcony strawberries were planted together with my child in memory of my mother, who passed away three years ago in spring. Somehow, it feels as if she is sending strawberries for us… though at the same time, they are growing so vigorously that they are starting to take over the entire balcony. At the end of the season, I think I’ll transplant part of them into the garden again.

The runner beans, which had been waiting to germinate under the balcony table because I didn’t have enough space for seedlings, suddenly sprouted and stretched up before I noticed. So tomorrow I’ll bring them to the garden and plant them there. This was another vegetable my mother loved very much.

![90590244-4756-4AF2-9B45-A4BC90F70161\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23z7DqtbBaQDCPG73UozwDeFd8Kkz7DPZgXXcu3GxAeVSq6KjN3eLv7xhSAKEjczucscj.jpeg)

The chards that I’m temporarily growing along the edge of pots as seedlings are also doing quite well. I learned this low-effort seedling method from videos Netherlands-based gardener [Vera Greutink](https://www.growntocook.com/). Once they become large enough to withstand the slugs, I’ll transplant them into bigger pots and bring them to the garden.

![85848880-D807-445D-9A54-29398F279E49.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uQn4EAH4M4jhtVLcvCZ2jQcZphGKk77GUAGiPFBbsWZdemk3mq39W6qaDBRd3QDKSdQ.jpeg)

Ah… it's so nice to enjoy slow morning on the balcony.

So happy gardening everyone!

---

![6B76BA04-4164-4AAE-84DB-0F77C772E16B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/242XyQ7JFyVW5AKAazKNs2g9EvpY9BLixJgbXKj5QYwbQrnhmBKoLqQcoZ26i6EPsReyZ.jpeg)

このところ、出張やWS、出かける予定が私にしては詰まっていて、なかなか朝バルコニーでゆっくりしてコーヒーを飲んでといった時間を取れずにいましたが、今日ようやく。

ついこの前まではまだ花を咲かせていたいちごの実がもうずいぶん大きくなっていて、季節が進んでいるのを感じました。バルコニーのいちごは、毎年長いと12月まで実をつけてくれて、今年はさらに当たり年のようでたくさん実がなっています。涼しかった春の気候も良かったのかな？無理せずがんばってねと見守ろうと思います。

このバルコニーのいちごは、3年前に他界した母との思い出に子供と植えたもので、母がドイツにいちごを届けてくれているようでしみじみ・・・・・・・が、ものすごく元気でバルコニーを埋め尽くしつつあり、シーズンの終わりには、また一部を残して庭に移植しようと思っています 😉

育苗スペースが足りず、バルコニーのテーブルの下で発芽するのを待っていたランナービーンの苗は気づいたら発芽して背が伸びていたので、明日庭に植えてきます。これまた母が大好きだった野菜です。

![90590244-4756-4AF2-9B45-A4BC90F70161_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23z7DqtbBaQDCPG73UozwDeFd8Kkz7DPZgXXcu3GxAeVSq6KjN3eLv7xhSAKEjczucscj.jpeg)

一時的に鉢の端に植えて育苗しているチャードも良い感じ。この手間をかけない育苗方法は大好きな[オランダ在住のガーデナーのVera Greutinkさん](https://www.growntocook.com/)の動画で学びました。ナメクジに負けないくらいの大きくなったら鉢に移して、庭に持って行こうと思っています。

![85848880-D807-445D-9A54-29398F279E49.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23uQn4EAH4M4jhtVLcvCZ2jQcZphGKk77GUAGiPFBbsWZdemk3mq39W6qaDBRd3QDKSdQ.jpeg)

ああ、それにしても、朝の静かな時間にゆっくり植物を眺めながら、コーヒーを飲みながらの水やりって、いい時間ですね。

それではみなさん happy gardening!

body.title: Garena Free Fire India: The Mobile Battle Royale Game Winning Every Gamer’s Attention
body.body:
/>

Mobile gaming has changed rapidly over the last few years, but only a few titles have managed to create the kind of excitement that [**Garena Free Fire**](https://ffindiaapk.com/) has built across India. From school students to college gamers and even working professionals, millions of players spend time every day enjoying intense survival battles, quick action rounds, and thrilling team gameplay. The game has become a favorite choice for users who want competitive entertainment without needing expensive gaming devices.

One of the biggest reasons behind its popularity is the smooth experience it delivers on almost every Android smartphone. Unlike many heavy battle royale games that demand high-end hardware, Free Fire works efficiently on mid-range devices. This makes the game accessible to a wider audience, especially in India where budget-friendly smartphones dominate the market.

The Indian version of the game brings extra excitement for local players. Special events, Indian-themed rewards, customized challenges, and optimized servers create a better overall experience. Players feel more connected because the content often reflects local trends, festivals, and gaming interests popular among Indian users.

Every match begins with players landing on an isolated island. Once on the ground, survival becomes the main objective. Gamers search buildings, warehouses, and hidden locations for weapons, ammunition, armor, and medical kits. As the safe zone becomes smaller, players must continue moving while fighting opponents from every direction. The final survivor or surviving squad wins the match.

Unlike long battle royale games that may continue for 30 minutes or more, Free Fire matches are usually completed within 10 minutes. This shorter gameplay format is one of the major reasons players keep returning to the game throughout the day. Quick matches make it easier for users to enjoy gaming during short breaks, travel time, or free moments between daily activities.

The game also offers different playing styles. Some users prefer solo mode where every player fights independently. Others enjoy duo mode with a partner, while many players join squad battles with friends. Squad matches create strong teamwork moments where communication and strategy become extremely important. Reviving teammates, sharing resources, and planning attacks together often decide the outcome of the game.

Another feature that attracts players is the huge collection of characters available in the game. Each character comes with unique abilities that can improve speed, healing, defense, or attack power. Players can combine different skills to create strategies that match their personal gameplay style. This adds variety because every player approaches battles differently.

Weapon customization also plays a major role in making the game entertaining. Sniper rifles, assault rifles, shotguns, SMGs, grenades, and melee weapons all offer different combat experiences. Some players enjoy long-range precision attacks, while others prefer aggressive close-range battles. Learning how to use each weapon properly helps players improve their overall performance during matches.

The graphics of Free Fire may not be ultra-realistic like console games, but they are colorful, clean, and optimized for mobile performance. Smooth frame rates and responsive controls are more important for competitive gaming, and the developers have managed to maintain that balance successfully. Even users with older smartphones can experience stable gameplay without major lag issues.

In India, Free Fire has become more than just a casual mobile game. Many content creators regularly upload gameplay videos, tutorials, live streams, and funny moments on platforms like YouTube and social media. Some players have even built successful online careers through gaming content creation. Tournament competitions and esports events have also increased interest among serious gamers who dream of becoming professional players.

The reward system inside the game keeps players engaged regularly. Daily login bonuses, seasonal events, limited-time outfits, weapon skins, and exclusive collections encourage users to participate actively. During festivals and special occasions, players often receive themed rewards that match Indian celebrations, making the experience feel more personalized.

Another strong point of the game is social interaction. Players can add friends, join guilds, participate in team missions, and communicate through voice chat during battles. This creates a sense of community where players build friendships while enjoying matches together. Many users play the game mainly to spend time with friends online after school or work.

The controls are simple enough for beginners but still offer depth for experienced players. New users can learn movement, aiming, and survival basics quickly, while advanced gamers develop strategies involving positioning, map awareness, and weapon combinations. This balance between simplicity and competition allows the game to attract both casual and skilled players.

Maps inside the game also provide different combat experiences. Some maps feature dense urban areas perfect for close-range combat, while others include open landscapes suitable for sniper battles and tactical movement. Learning map layouts helps players predict enemy movements and survive longer during intense situations.

Another important reason behind the game’s success in India is regular updates. Developers frequently introduce fresh content including new characters, gameplay modes, events, and visual improvements. These updates prevent the experience from becoming repetitive. Players always look forward to discovering the latest features added to the game.

For competitive gamers, ranked mode delivers an exciting challenge. Winning matches increases player rank and unlocks higher competition levels. Reaching top ranks requires skill, consistency, and teamwork. Many players enjoy grinding through ranked seasons to prove their abilities and compete against stronger opponents.

The popularity of Free Fire among Indian gamers continues growing because it successfully combines accessibility, action, and social entertainment. Fast-paced gameplay, exciting survival mechanics, and device-friendly performance make it one of the most preferred battle royale games on mobile platforms today.

Even users who are new to battle royale gaming can quickly understand the mechanics and start enjoying matches. Experienced players, on the other hand, continue improving strategies and exploring advanced techniques. This wide appeal allows the game to maintain a massive player base across different age groups.

As mobile gaming continues expanding in India, Free Fire remains one of the strongest names in the industry. Its quick matches, smooth controls, engaging events, and active player community ensure that gamers always have something exciting waiting every time they launch the game. Whether someone enjoys solo survival challenges or intense squad battles with friends, Free Fire delivers nonstop action that keeps players entertained for hours.

title.title: Other Niche Communities Curation Report #2127
title.body: >\nHello everyone! This is the 2127th compilation post of OCD's latest curation efforts. It has been known that OCD has been supporting leading niche communities under its <b><a href=\
>Community Incubation Program. However, there are still a lot of other niche communities not supported by OCD. This curation initiative will help in supporting those communities.

> This newest curation effort aims to encourage authors to post in appropriate communities even if those communities are not under the incubation program. This will also encourage users to explore more into the different communities in Hive.

How this Works

> OCD curators and community leaders will find posts from other niche communities and recommend them for an upvote. Unlike those communities in the incubation program where curation is focused, this curation initiative is spread out. This will help find undervalued posts from smaller communities that deserve support.

> This will highlight both the author and the community where the post is located. This way, smaller niche communities can focus on growing their subscribers and increasing the engagements within their respective communities. A small boost goes a long way.

> Speaking of boost, here are the curated posts for this batch:

Curated Posts

Farming is a beautiful kind of work because it truly brings joy to the heart, especially when you see the crops you planted growing and eventually bearing fruit. However, farming really requires hard work and patience. Without those two, it’s easy to give up, especially when the plants you’ve worked on die.
Curator: @musicandreview ----- Author: @florecitamejias Community:
>When they turn off my light || Weekend #306\n\n

>
Since 2019, the country has been in the dark; those days are etched in people’s subconscious because of the uncertainty we experienced at that time. I personally experienced it in two places: one in my city, with my family, and another blackout in an unfamiliar city. I still remember the gloom, and it triggers anxiety in my emotional brain because I simply can’t forget it.
Curator: @musicandreview ----- Author: @janaveda Community:
>La Brújula Interior: Cuando el Amor Guía Nuestro Ser (SPA-ENG)\n\n

>
This morning, while browsing the web, I stumbled upon a video that revolved around the ideas of the German philosopher Schopenhauer on the nature of goodness. Initially, I was captivated by the way the narrator presented his arguments, which, incidentally, experts consider extremely pessimistic. Yes, one tends to believe that evil exists outside of oneself. Very few people define themselves as evil. This includes those who boast of belonging to criminal gangs. On the other hand, I observe others who accept the natural inclination toward evil and, consequently, expect to be saved from themselves by the intervention of a redeeming messiah. Let me clarify, I'm not here to attack beliefs or offend religious practitioners. No, heaven forbid! I simply want to establish that, generally, one doesn't see evil reflected in the mirror.
Curator: @minismallholding ----- Author: @yasmarit Community:
>Cuando sientes que la desesperación te consume/ When you feel despair consuming you [ESP/ENG]\n\n

>
Let's first talk about what despair is. In non-technical terms, it is a state in which you feel that nothing makes sense, you lose hope that anything will happen, you feel sad, frustrated, your emotions are low, which makes everything you do, say, or think negative, since you feel that nothing makes sense or that at least there is no escape from what is happening and that nothing good will come of it. It is a state that anyone can fall into at some point in their life, especially when things get difficult, whether due to family problems, financial issues, or anything else that can cause instability and make you fall into despair.
Curator: @edwardstobia ----- Author: @fixie Community:
>Michael Jackson The king of pop - Drawing Fan Art [ENG-ESP]\n\n

>
Hello dear friends, I hope you are all doing well. This Friday afternoon, I want to share with you a drawing I made of the King of Pop, Michael Jackson. The greatest legend of pop music and the most influential artist of the 20th century is now making a comeback, this time with the release of his film, Michael. I haven't had a chance to see it in theaters yet; it premiered yesterday, and I've read very positive reviews. I've always been a fan of the King of Pop, so I have a date at the cinema to see it. I created this drawing using the scribble technique, just loose, circular lines, gradually taking shape with the pen ink on the paper. I hope you like what you're about to see. Let's begin!

title.title: [Movie] K-pop Demon Hunters: A story that will melt your heart
title.body:
I watched this movie with my children, and I can assure you it's an extraordinary film. For me, it's ageless, and despite dealing with complex themes, it's a film that children can enjoy under parental supervision.

![MV5BOTAzMThjYjAtN2JmMC00NGVkLWI0MjMtNTVlNTE2YjM5OTU3XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23tvY8ezGm17VB1ERrR1CodpwbTAQqQUWApEXD1ffjX8BU1s93Y4GeeSWzYKycfyS7fQg.jpg)

It's a very exciting story, as you learn about other cultures and experience very funny situations that will make you smile. I loved it because the characters are very human; they don't try to be perfect but rather show themselves as they are. The story takes place 400 years ago in Korea, where demons attacked humans and stole their souls to feed a Demon King named Gwi-Ma. But everything changed with the arrival of a trio of warriors who used their voices to defeat demons and imprison them behind a barrier called Honmoon.

Today, we have the hunters Rumi, Mira, and Zoey, who are part of the famous K-pop band Huntr/x. These girls are charming, with a personality that captivates both young and old. Rumi, the vocalist, has a complicated past because her father was a demon, and this causes her a lot of problems. Mira is the rebel of the group, and Zoey is the lyricist genius. Together, they are ready to release their new single, \

but Rumi begins to lose her voice, creating a serious problem for all of them.

![MV5BYWJkMDhiZjAtYTIwYS00MjlkLWJjNDQtNGQxNDIwYjU4ZjA5XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23tvZuoGbTB8YtipzhYgPyehq8Qu5fncbDkVdQFmwjpUAEuyELhCSFixDDqs3bffhpy24.jpg)

Meanwhile, Demon King Gwi-Ma is furious, and a demon named Jinu has a plan to form his own K-pop band to steal souls. This is where the excitement begins. Jinu and Rumi grow closer, and he tells her his tragic story, which makes her question her own song.

![MV5BMDQ2YzZiZjAtNzlkZi00MzI0LWEwNmYtYWNjMzkxZGI3OWI4XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23w2kq4W5hvr5BZz4yLPxggRyZ7Vx8GbWtWMthfeKc9xDv1hkQP2SaHYKXXRSyTGeoxmV.jpg)

The movie blends action, music, and a touch of romance, all while the girls fight to protect the human world and grapple with their own secrets. I won't tell you any more so you'll decide to watch it, experience the emotions, and feel the thrill as much as I did. My kids had a blast, not so much for the plot, but for the catchy, fun, and rhythmic music.

![MV5BYzYyNDBiOGItYjhjMC00NTUzLWE0NzQtODY5NjFjZTk4YWE4XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yusmelys/23uQjyo5a23aoqFx4NH7JdaTyoEE2npwK3TX2GCNQYxnWgH8gLLHRiVbSFWSJvHmnx9XK.jpg)

### Thank you for reading. Blessings.

____

title.body:
Agradecida por el detalle de la inclusión. Sin duda alguna los comienzo ante una gran crisis que vivíamos en Venezuela era evidente se sacaba para mantenernos, pero leo las respuestas y veo que eso era pequeñito en comparación con lo que se mueve. Vaya que si me ayudo. Pero llego un momento que pensé hay que crecer y apoyar a los que vienen atrás y no sabía hacerlo, pero mis hijos me decían ¿para qué quieres ser ballena? 

He visto altas y bajas, gente que se va y regresa, gente que solo saca, gente que si aporta, la realidad es que esto es un negocio y como tal es tratado, para otros es un escape una escritura que cura aunque no lo han descubierto. Ahora hay otros lugares del mundo que lo descubrieron como en esa época que lo descubrieron los venezolanos, los que nos quedamos tenemos la oportunidad de ayudar, de ser ejemplo de saber reconocer que es una ayuda, pero también es parte del futuro. 

Juntar nuestro capital para ser ballena, no lo creo, somos un poco egoístas y con lo que nos ha costado,  claro ese no es el tema,  aunque el cuadro nos motiva a seguir, el  nos dice que estamos unos cuántos creciendo a futuro, viendo que hay un camino; que cada quien desde su rincón apoya, motiva y crece. 

Quiero crecer para apoyar a otros, quiero crecer para establecer un futuro, quiero ahorrar para ver que viene. Creo en este espacio y en la gente que lo esta construyendo y aunque suene muy poético; creo que hay algo más allá que solamente intereses, veo el rostro de los participantes cuando logran reunirse en físico, hay una motivación, un amor por compartir, una sensación de complicidad extraña. Desde cada rincón cada uno aporta. Lo siento me he emocionado recordando momentos. Sin estos espacios no hubiese conocido ha maravillosas personas que tenemos inquietudes similares. 

Claro es mi punto de vista, pero vaya 18 participantes uniendo un todo, suena interesante. No tenemos mucho que perder y todo que ganar. Seguiremos aportando y creciendo es lo que yo deseo. Un abrazo para todos.

title.title: Un animal entre los plátanos / An animal among the banana trees
title.body:
<center>

Compré en la calle,
unos plátanos para comer más tarde,
los dejé en un plato grande
y me marché a otra parte. 

Entre los plátanos apareció,
un ser de azul color,
entre ellos se deslizó 
y desde el plato todo vigiló.

>I bought some bananas on the street,
to eat later,
I left them on a big plate
and went off somewhere else.

>Among the bananas appeared
a blue-colored creature,
it slipped in among them
and watched over everything from the plate.

![56681.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23uR1AXfwW2zxecnzz4ZiYZPn7161VZ72dVU4enfo4uQegM2kXbCud2pnxGKg6dF6DEXe.gif)

Cuando lo ví en el plato
entre los amarillos plátanos,
lo tomé, sin agrado
y me lo llevé a otro lado. 

Me fui hasta el jardín
y sin pesar lo dejé ahí,
entre la tierra lo ví partir
y yo, a mi casa volví. 

>When I saw it on the plate
among the yellow bananas,
I picked it up, without pleasure,
and took it somewhere else.

>I went out to the garden
and left it there without regret,
I watched it sink into the soil,
and I went back home. 

![56682.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23xAiMKJn7tERyXziCj9WLw5KAS51CUAa4ePCzhzuXh9bviaC25y2aBNtnZzwSQaoejN2.gif)

Aquel insecto extravagante
regresó con afanes,
se escondió tras una hoja grande
y llegó a la casa rozagante. 

Al ver que el animal regresó,
mucha nostalgia me dio,
una bolsa de té le regale yo 
para que duerma cómodo en esta habitación.

>That quirky little bug
came back in a hurry,
hid behind a big leaf,
and made its way to the house.

>When I saw the little creature return,
I felt a wave of nostalgia,
so I gave it a tea bag
so it could sleep comfortably in this room.

![56683.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marpa/23wgMvJPMyiH6JL6odpC6mLn7bjftH2WByZiyrsoavnvjzvcY7FhFnBr6aFgXXzxunv95.gif)

No se quiso marchar
y yo no lo voy a obligar,
entonces le daré un hogar
donde pueda vivir con tranquilidad.

>He didn't want to leave,
and I'm not going to force him,
so I'll give him a home
where he can live in peace.

</center>

title.title: Tembo Diamalo || Most Players Ignore This Powerful Splinterlands Card
title.body:
![ChatGPT Image May 25, 2026, 10_24_29 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23yJNk4tK3FjX1fvuS4dkwrzDaZ2RfwpuFvoA967WSi1uuHBoBkrBPbbUyv7AE2PuREgE.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)


To gain a good grip in any battle and avoid difficulties it is very important to understand that our deck should contain every type of card especially zero mana cost cards. Many players ignore such cards thinking they are unnecessary but in reality these cards often change the whole match. 

If they are used with the right position and best combination, they provide great support to your team and can prove to be a real battle changer. A question must come to friends minds that what are the benefits of zero mana cards? And why we must hold this in our deck?

Their biggest advantage is that you can use them to fill your empty slots. Often while selecting monsters we use our full mana cost but still two or three slots remain empty. Whether the battle is low mana or high mana, empty slots always become a cause of loss. 

At such times, zero mana cards are the best option because without any extra mana you can complete your team and take benefit from their abilities. They are the flexible cards which helps you in any battle type and also to select when your mana cost reaches its max.

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 095415.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGeEFJv55Dkkx2aVB4BFcGzjuScryrFGnSKq6arf5nF4AMUpV8K1aYTtQse4cAP9rHv.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Especially in low mana battles these cards are very important. When you select only two or three strong monsters in low mana, the mana becomes full but many slots remain empty. In such a situation if you add zero mana cards and place them in the right position your team gets excellent support and a strong combination. This is why these cards often change the direction of the game.

Just as many people ignore these cards their price in the market is also quite high. If we talk about at level 1, its price is around $2 while at max level the same card reaches $4 to $5. The big reason is that zero mana cards can be used in every type of battle, therefore they are always considered valuable and useful.

Today I will talk about the Thambo Diamalo monster card which belongs to the fire element. Its most special feature is its zero mana cost meaning you can use it in low, mid and high mana battles. 

Its health is one which shows its life. Although it is not a very strong monster but it proves excellent for filling empty slots and supporting the team.

![Screenshot 2026-05-25 095433.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vhU15a3erBYmDH9Rk5DNB6DB5xEkqo6mQotgevacppHceVd1x2wq8xGvdvsWyPXaRpM.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

It has speed which makes its attack fast while it is a melee attack monster that attacks the enemy with +1 in every round. Just imagine a monster that comes without mana and also attacks the enemy every round, how beneficial it can be for your deck.

Another special thing is that it has two amazing abilities which are charge and bloodline pact...

Charge Because of this ability this monster can use its melee attack while staying in any position.

Bloodline Pact Under this ability if any allied unit of the same bloodline defeats an enemy the remaining units get +1 power.

Both these abilities are easily available at level 3 which makes this card even more powerful.


![Step 1 Open Hive-Engine.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xAP5USUKcuxDmqrmxQ5yLXZudrrGjywj3pDgQQ8jdCUXsLzTL4SZXJaUycHbY5Yo4LW.png)
![download.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23xyw2uM74x6qu1Azy69rKZG79ou4jF3nQsKJLyBS1qWHb497tsKuZDt64M4Qy69snSx4.gif)

Now lets talk about its rental cost, at level 4 it is available for about 60DEC per day which in my opinion is not very expensive. 

A smart and experienced Splinterlands player always understands such cards, knows their importance and includes them in the deck. Especially zero mana monster cards should never be ignored because they can become real game changers in any battle.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.


![1400.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EppNdx4pfHvBAhyDRLuzxTB7hUfR2bCnbRNf7EiU9SYxCmECi7HXeQW7RLfPCAXn2Hd.gif)

title.title: Niece's birthday at a blue and white balloon fair: A colorful day of boundless joy for children.
title.body:
> ![IMG-20251105-WA0007~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdiktfsTjD2gRsW7y4D6VzRKLziYuEGv9RQoVYE3t9eic/IMG-20251105-WA0007~2.jpg) There are some days in our lives that are no less than a special festival. Especially when there is an opportunity for the whole family to be together, the joy doubles. A few days ago, I had such a wonderful day at my niece's birthday party. None of us wanted to miss this great opportunity for the whole family to celebrate together. So, putting aside all our busy schedules, we joined our family on this special day of our niece. The main attraction of any birthday is its decoration and festive atmosphere. The whole house took on a whole new look around the niece's birthday party. Starting from the living room floor, the surroundings were decorated with numerous beautiful balloons. These blue and white balloons created a magical and festive atmosphere in the whole house. Seeing this balloon fair all around, it seemed that the adults were also feeling better in an instant. ![IMG-20251105-WA0008~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaaJLCabEoLrBU3p1qHw86BezfA2jPzKxUELgDjW6usSF/IMG-20251105-WA0008~2.jpg) However, the biggest attraction and life of this entire event were the children of our house. Their joy knew no bounds when they saw so many colorful balloons filling the house. My children were overwhelmed with joy as soon as they saw the pile of balloons. They sat right in the middle and started playing with the balloons. Sometimes they would blow the balloons, sometimes they would throw them at each other, and sometimes they would hold many balloons together in their chests. Seeing the children's boundless excitement, their simple smiles, and running around the house, the joy of the event hall increased many times. Seeing their innocent joy, our inner tiredness and all the monotony of our mechanical life disappeared in an instant. Truly, there can be no more beautiful sight in this world than the unbridled laughter of children. ![IMG-20251105-WA0009~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcDmu9dsGdJcyzs1guqoaFgrQ4WUhnLi1edw8TjG8wJYg/IMG-20251105-WA0009~2.jpg) These small family get-togethers or reunions strengthen our bond even more. We had a wonderful time all day long with stories, chats, delicious food, and cutting my niece's cake. Finally, we captured some of the colorful and memorable moments of the children, which will be a wonderful memory for the future. Lots of good wishes and love for the niece. ___ |

title.title: [ENG/ESP] A relaxing Sunday filled with family joy.
title.body: > **Happy start to the week, everyone. I sincerely hope this day is beautiful, productive, and filled with little joys that remind you how valuable it is to start a new week with a positive attitude. As for me, I’m kicking off these days with completely renewed energy, because I had a relaxed, peaceful, and very cozy weekend—the kind that reconnects you with rest and lets you recharge your soul. This Sunday, when I opened my eyes, my husband was already in the kitchen making coffee. The warm, familiar aroma wafted through the house, signaling that he was waiting for me to be ready so he could bring me breakfast in bed. That simple gesture, so full of love, made me start the day with a smile. We had planned to watch two movies our son had recommended, so the morning promised to be peaceful and entertaining. After feeding our birds, we settled in to watch the first movie. The truth is, both were really good. Personally, I love action movies, and so does my husband, so we were perfectly in sync with our choice. We had a really nice time, discussing some scenes, laughing at others, and enjoying that time together that’s sometimes so scarce during the week. That afternoon, we still needed to fill up the car with gas for the week’s work. We forgot to do it on Saturday, but today it was unavoidable. We called the gas station in Los Cerritos and, luckily, it was open, so we headed there. The heat was still intense, the kind that forces you to seek shade whenever you can. Even though there were beautiful clouds in the sky, there was no sign of rain. The urban and natural landscape was radiant, full of light and vibrant colors.**

> *Feliz inicio de semana para todos. Deseo de corazón que este día sea hermoso, productivo y lleno de pequeñas alegrías que les recuerden lo valioso que es comenzar una nueva semana con buena actitud. En mi caso, arranco estos días con las energías completamente renovadas, porque tuve un fin de semana relajado, tranquilo y muy hogareño, de esos que te reconcilian con el descanso y te permiten recargar el alma. Este domingo, cuando abrí los ojos, ya mi esposo estaba en la cocina preparando el café. El aroma cálido y familiar se colaba por toda la casa, anunciando que él estaba esperando a que estuviera listo para llevarme el desayuno a la cama. Ese gesto tan sencillo, pero tan lleno de cariño, me hizo empezar el día con una sonrisa. Teníamos planeado ver dos películas que nuestro hijo nos había dejado recomendadas, así que la mañana prometía ser tranquila y entretenida. Después de alimentar a nuestras aves, nos acomodamos para ver la primera película. La verdad es que ambas estaban muy buenas. A mí, en lo particular, me encantan las películas de acción, y a mi esposo también, así que coincidimos perfectamente en la elección. Pasamos un rato muy agradable, comentando algunas escenas, riéndonos de otras y disfrutando de ese tiempo juntos que a veces entre semana se hace tan escaso. En la tarde teníamos pendiente salir a colocar combustible al auto para los trabajos de la semana. El sábado se nos pasó hacerlo, pero ya hoy era inevitable. Llamamos a la bomba de Los Cerritos y, por suerte, estaba abierta, así que hacia allá nos dirigimos. El calor seguía siendo intenso, de esos que te obligan a buscar sombra cada vez que puedes. A pesar de que había nubes hermosas en el cielo, nada indicaba que fuera a llover. El paisaje urbano y natural estaba radiante, lleno de luz y colores vibrantes.*
![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xejy26jsxbLKqtQtK1zMhRXuyS5755ni2BjQSFG3yNPsMwtaUktsaFD6tTWBPvxuSjj.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq9WBxiNUU8CEtG292Ldn7NccKCrAnrvdcAbctSKxMXyLRcvdKDXeFVziEu1K7BPQHz.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq379UWNJe6fa1inkNtH3WoJFN3yqAp4aV26ufjm5ity2jMF3a9196a3cuqDk7kc8Mw.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpLfzgpS4huSeWyvKcKgcwjktSo939jmLwpTnWsvdjmJ2mgd1iffkfCwockfP9r3k6k.jpg)

> **After filling up with gas, we decided to take a stroll around Pampatar Bay. As soon as you enter Pampatar, you feel a special kind of joy—an energy unique to this area that’s always bustling with life. In fact, we had a bit of trouble finding a place to park because there were so many people out enjoying the day.**

> *Después de colocar el combustible, decidimos dar un paseo por la Bahía de Pampatar. Desde que entras a Pampatar se siente una alegría particular, una energía propia de esa zona que siempre está llena de vida. De hecho, nos costó un poco encontrar dónde aparcar, porque había muchísima gente disfrutando del día.*
![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpEJK1j3hTsWDa7qh5fi8PF453MMnRbNpFT2eLcATYCgAwTUeHidi2ULGTpvEi6gfh1.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqL8M2cfWnWGkbrY349aVGrUmVAgrmjxtzRCqjPdaQa9m7ae8uBJzrsij9LqrFXJr4X.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWkMRVngWPJDwGqJvK6iWYH9NGiHhsQ9c6rXgom5ZvC5uxavmAoaPDDsyFQ9zcjdwx.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eokd4SdyYFpQRjmFwhcQyy9r3qD1qpN4GQRLGCrVUNUxrrtHL1CjhEFWwfeGQTEiiyB.jpg)

> **Pampatar Bay is located in the municipality of Maneiro, in the state of Nueva Esparta, on Margarita Island. It is a bay with very calm, crystal-clear waters, beloved by parents because, with no strong waves, it is perfect and safe for young children. Along the bay’s shoreline, there are many places where you can enjoy delicious fresh fish or an irresistible dogfish empanada, which is always a Margarita classic.**

> *La Bahía de Pampatar está ubicada en el municipio Maneiro, en el estado Nueva Esparta, en Isla de Margarita. Es una bahía de aguas muy tranquilas y cristalinas, amada por los padres porque, al no tener un oleaje fuerte, es perfecta y segura para los niños pequeños. A lo largo del borde de la bahía hay muchos lugares donde puedes disfrutar un delicioso pescado fresco o una irresistible empanada de cazón, que siempre es un clásico margariteño.*
![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptaZ8cxb89muj8xAd1q5mrWqmiA8TD4ifhoe6cxTRLNWZmoy1F4QRY25hxJWPi5KYe.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq371hjqVUNhgfXQSVxKyjvQtVJAumXDab9M5SVgGFJa2UqPFCLgU4UzSY2C6bHLVnY.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXJxgQ1SsKsHTrkbmKvEVGFCN7inpWLS71f8Kk9HJsobrqtq69jkJ8aHePqMcUWtc2.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EptazgVtHCfNK1qYTQ6KTbCYvgi3Mpowem2rFVdXsffKE3VAsBhs2GvVoA4Mk2FG41v.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpXJYDPLjkrpUCtRjDUHLndLdUHsy4B6vXboiBfck9m8zYagCeqcc8eyYtohbRK4vtY.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23xVXugvirju2TGeBav3zEZ9kELzRKwskhbGsywhaW7wvKj7A7gST1N4wFLNxp9cMqAgg.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpLgR9dJtJXk3ThQ8GaefNfuzhM3oeoXSXTebtD9Yamn3w2diA4ByrkxkqKpP8Gpp5B.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-25_00-44-15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eo8UMGgQMDPKSwjy8kf5uRETgv6znBsgaB9aGiZkMtQH2mcUcGmSN96ZeGcc1Nvyk38.jpg)

> **You can also take a walk around the area, sit on the benches, and enjoy the truly beautiful ocean views. In this area, there is even a bust of the lawyer and professor Jóvito Villalba, founder of the Republican Party and a native of Pampatar, who is considered one of the best orators in the municipality. I don’t know the whole history of Venezuela, but I remember a few things about him because my son, when he was in high school, had to do a research project and I helped him with his work.**

> *También se puede caminar por los alrededores, sentarse en los bancos y contemplar las vistas frente al mar, que son realmente hermosas. En esta área incluso hay un busto del abogado y profesor Jóvito Villalba, fundador del partido republicano y oriundo de Pampatar, considerado uno de los mejores oradores del municipio. title.title: Del Horno al Corazón: Mi sueño de \
en Caracas 🇻🇪 \n
title.body:
Hola, comunidad de Hive! Soy Darwin Zamora y hoy les escribo desde mi lugar favorito en el mundo: mi panadería, Ebenezer, ubicada en el sector Los Tres Puentes, en la carretera vieja Caracas-Los Teques.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQzSdyT2Qa6MzxFEFTzrXPmPGg4ZeiKSX1YKwKn6bujtf/1779685249175.jpg)


Como muchos emprendedores en Venezuela, sé que cada día es un reto, pero mi pasión por el pan va más allá de un simple negocio. Mi sueño es convertir este horno artesanal de ladrillo en una fuente de esperanza a través de mi proyecto social: \

.

Mi meta es sencilla pero poderosa: que el pan que sale de estas manos llegue también a los niños y abuelitos que más lo necesitan en las calles de mi comunidad.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQCRV7zcnANa6QHM8i5pRDr3gWcriGpAn335aVsCcrNYC/1779685369727.jpg)


Aquí les presento una de nuestras especialidades: las galletas de la casa. Cada empaque de \
representa horas de trabajo y un compromiso con la calidad. Actualmente, estas ventas son el motor que quiero usar para financiar el proyecto social. Mi idea es crear un \

: por cada compra, un porcentaje se destinará a producir pan fresco para donar.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRUEusTBhcqFgJbeATt6MrLCD3vyA23qCFcBsdqHkhEvQ/1779685430424.jpg)


No solo hacemos pan, hacemos momentos de alegría. Estos pancitos dulces que ven aquí son parte de nuestra tradición artesanal. Mi objetivo en Hive es poder conectar con personas que crean en el trabajo honesto y me ayuden a que la Panadería Ebenezer siga creciendo, no solo como negocio, sino como un pilar para mi comunidad.

Gracias a todos por leerme y por el apoyo que siempre brindan a los creadores venezolanos. Hive me está demostrando que la tecnología y el oficio tradicional pueden ir de la mano para cambiar realidades.

¿Cuál es ese pan o dulce que siempre les saca una sonrisa? Los leo en los comentarios.

Con esperanza,  
Darwin Zamora.

body.title: Two-Type Cabbage Salad with Apples and Raisins\\Zwei-Sorten-Kohlsalat mit Äpfeln und Rosinen
body.body:
Hello,my friends!
Today we'll make a vitamin-rich salad with white cabbage, red cabbage, apples, carrots, raisins, and mayonnaise. I've made versions of this salad with just red cabbage, but I liked this version with both types of cabbage better; red cabbage is a bit dry and lacks juice. But red cabbage will make even a simple salad more elegant, that's for sure. Let's go, it'll be beautiful!



![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme3Wbp3q4aA92Q6ALZhEPgpNAnzDUcAiHQE2Re66Q9KD2/1.jpg)


Ingredients:

● White cabbage - 600 g
● Red cabbage - 400 g
● Carrot - 1 pc
● Peeled apples - 2 pcs
● Raisins - 1/2 cup
● Mayonnaise or sour cream-mayonnaise 1:1 - 150 g or more
● Lemon juice - 1 tbsp
● Black pepper, hot pepper, salt, sugar, herbs, and sesame seeds - to taste

1.Shred the red and white cabbage. Now that I have a special double-bladed cabbage shredder, it's easy and simple. Just watch your fingers, the blades are sharp! Place both types of cabbage in a salad bowl, add a pinch of salt and sugar, and lemon juice. Using your hands, begin to vigorously squeeze the cabbage until the juices are released. Let the cabbage rest for a bit while we work on the apples and carrots. Peel the carrots and grate them on a coarse grater. Peel the apples and remove the seeds. Grate the apples on a coarse grater. Now add the apples and carrots to the salad bowl with the cabbage. Rinse and steam the raisins in boiling water. Drain the boiling water and add the raisins to the salad bowl. Add mayonnaise or sour cream, or even a mixture of mayonnaise and sour cream. Want to add unsweetened yogurt as a dressing? Okay, make a salad with it, no problem. Mix the salad, sprinkle with black and ground hot pepper, and add salt and sugar to taste, if needed. Let the two-component cabbage salad sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours; this will make it even more flavorful and juicy.



![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdXqxgKzdWE2Nawg4L2e11EhgMSoGpAgKoP653zUhSni7/2.jpg)


2.Arrange the cabbage salad in individual bowls and serve. A delicious, vitamin-rich salad!



![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPG647C6goJaYpGPTnUfKBZsGkdWYg5aZbGYvodjTLsuj/3.jpg)


Shall we make it?



![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute bereiten wir einen vitaminreichen Salat mit Weißkohl, Rotkohl, Äpfeln, Karotten, Rosinen und Mayonnaise zu. Ich habe diesen Salat auch schon nur mit Rotkohl zubereitet, aber diese Variante mit beiden Kohlsorten schmeckt mir besser; Rotkohl ist etwas trocken und wenig saftig. Aber Rotkohl macht selbst einen einfachen Salat gleich viel eleganter, ganz sicher. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:

● Weißkohl – 600 g
● Rotkohl – 400 g
● Karotte – 1 Stück
● Geschälte Äpfel – 2 Stück
● Rosinen – 1/2 Tasse
● Mayonnaise oder Sauerrahm-Mayonnaise (1:1) – 150 g oder mehr
● Zitronensaft – 1 EL
● Schwarzer Pfeffer, Chili, Salz, Zucker, Kräuter und Sesamsamen – nach Geschmack

1.Rot- und Weißkohl hobeln. Mit meinem speziellen Doppelklingen-Kohlhobel geht das jetzt ganz einfach. Vorsicht mit den Fingern, die Klingen sind scharf! Beide Kohlsorten in eine Salatschüssel geben, eine Prise Salz und Zucker sowie Zitronensaft hinzufügen. Den Kohl mit den Händen kräftig ausdrücken, bis der Saft austritt. Den Kohl kurz ruhen lassen, während wir die Äpfel und Karotten vorbereiten. Schäle die Karotten und raspel sie grob. Schäle die Äpfel, entkerne sie und raspel sie ebenfalls grob. Gib nun die Äpfel und Karotten zusammen mit dem Kohl in die Salatschüssel. Spüle die Rosinen ab und dämpfe sie kurz in kochendem Wasser. Gieße das Wasser ab und gib die Rosinen in die Salatschüssel. Füge Mayonnaise, saure Sahne oder eine Mischung aus beidem hinzu. Du möchtest lieber ungesüßten Joghurt als Dressing verwenden? Kein Problem! Vermische den Salat, bestreue ihn mit schwarzem und gemahlenem Chili und schmecke ihn nach Bedarf mit Salz und Zucker ab. Lass den Krautsalat ein paar Stunden im Kühlschrank ziehen; dadurch wird er noch aromatischer und saftiger.

2.Richte den Krautsalat in Schüsseln an und serviere ihn. Ein köstlicher, vitaminreicher Salat!

Wollen wir ihn zubereiten?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)

body.title: Hay lugares que sostienen más de lo que imaginamos. Ladies of Hive Community Contest #290. [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Hay lugares que sostienen más de lo que imaginamos  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHuxnqXpzcpCoSXD36s8AYFB2LHca7UGzFXT5qLVbQDL/chuotanhls_sunset_6626618_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/sunset-woman-rooftop-portrait-6626618/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive 

Creo que todas las personas necesitamos algún espacio donde sentir que el ruido del mundo disminuye un poco.

Un lugar donde el cuerpo sigue cansado quizás, pero el alma logra respirar mejor.

### 1️⃣ Mi refugio favorito para relajarme  

Todos saben las dificultades que atraviesa actualmente mi país, Cuba.

Pero más allá de las noticias o de lo que pueda explicarse desde afuera, hay cosas que realmente solo se entienden cuando forman parte de la vida diaria. Y algo curioso es que, incluso dentro de circunstancias difíciles, cada persona termina buscando su propia manera de resistir emocionalmente.

Creo que por eso también necesitamos pequeños espacios de renovación.

No tanto física, sino interior.

Para mí, ese lugar es la azotea de mi casa.

Especialmente durante las noches de apagón.

Puede parecer extraño, porque justamente esos momentos suelen venir cargados de agotamiento, calor, incomodidad y estrés acumulado. Pero a veces, cuando subo allí y dejo que la brisa me golpee un poco el rostro mientras observo las luces lejanas de la ciudad, siento algo parecido a la calma.

Como si por un instante todo dejara de correr tan rápido.

Allá arriba no desaparecen los problemas.

Pero sí cambia la manera en que los siento.

Hay noches en las que simplemente me quedo mirando el cielo, escuchando conversaciones lejanas, perros ladrando a la distancia o el sonido del viento moviendo algunas hojas. Y aunque parezcan cosas pequeñas, logran devolverme cierta sensación de equilibrio.

Creo que hay lugares que no solucionan nuestra vida… pero sí nos ayudan a seguir sosteniéndola.

Y para mí, ese lugar es la azotea.

---

### 2️⃣ Si pudiera intercambiar mi vida con alguien famoso  

Si pudiera vivir por un momento la vida de una persona famosa, probablemente elegiría a Audrey Hepburn.

No por el dinero ni por el lujo.

Y honestamente, tampoco por la fama en sí.

Creo que lo que más me llama la atención de ella es la manera en que parecía conservar cierta elegancia emocional incluso dentro de un mundo tan expuesto y superficial como el espectáculo.

Muchas personas la recuerdan por su belleza o por la moda, pero a mí siempre me ha parecido más interesante su sensibilidad.

Su compromiso humanitario.  
Su manera de hablar.  
La calma que transmitía incluso en fotografías simples.

Hay personas famosas que impresionan por lo que muestran.

Y otras que dejan huella por la humanidad que parecen conservar a pesar de todo.

Creo que por eso me gustaría experimentar, aunque fuera por un día, cómo se siente vivir con esa mezcla de gracia, atención hacia otros y fortaleza silenciosa.

---

A veces el verdadero refugio no es un lugar perfecto.

Es simplemente el espacio donde todavía logramos sentirnos un poco más en paz con nosotros mismos.

Gracias por leerme

## Some Places Hold Us Together More Than We Imagine  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXHuxnqXpzcpCoSXD36s8AYFB2LHca7UGzFXT5qLVbQDL/chuotanhls_sunset_6626618_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/sunset-woman-rooftop-portrait-6626618/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 🤍

I believe we all need a place where the noise of the world becomes a little quieter.

A place where the body may still feel tired, but the soul can breathe a little better.

### 1️⃣ My favorite refuge to relax  

Everyone knows about the difficulties my country, Cuba, is currently going through.

But beyond the news or what can be explained from the outside, there are things that can only truly be understood when they become part of everyday life. And something curious happens: even in difficult circumstances, each person ends up searching for their own way to emotionally endure.

I think that is why we also need small spaces for renewal.

Not so much physical renewal, but inner renewal.

For me, that place is the rooftop of my house.

Especially during blackout nights.

It may sound strange because those moments usually come filled with exhaustion, heat, discomfort, and accumulated stress. But sometimes, when I go upstairs and let the breeze touch my face while I look at the distant city lights, I feel something close to peace.

As if for a moment everything stopped moving so fast.

The problems do not disappear up there.

But the way I feel them changes.

There are nights when I simply stay there looking at the sky, listening to distant conversations, dogs barking far away, or the sound of the wind moving the leaves. And although those may seem like small things, they manage to give me back a certain sense of balance.

I think there are places that do not solve our lives… but still help us continue carrying them.

And for me, that place is the rooftop.

---

### 2️⃣ If I could exchange my life with a famous person  

If I could live the life of a famous person for a moment, I would probably choose Audrey Hepburn.

Not because of money or luxury.

And honestly, not even because of fame itself.

What attracts me the most about her is the way she seemed to preserve a certain emotional elegance even within such an exposed and superficial world as entertainment.

Many people remember her for her beauty or fashion, but I have always found her sensitivity more interesting.

Her humanitarian work.  
The way she spoke.  
The calmness she transmitted even in simple photographs.

Some famous people impress because of what they show.

Others leave a mark because of the humanity they manage to preserve despite everything.

I think that is why I would like to experience, even for a day, what it feels like to live with that mixture of grace, attention toward others, and quiet strength.

---

Sometimes the true refuge is not a perfect place.

It is simply the space where we still manage to feel a little more at peace with ourselves.

Thank you for reading 

---

body.title: Los lugares donde una vuelve a sí misma. Ladies of Hive Community Contest # 290 [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---  

## Los lugares donde una vuelve a sí misma  

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive   

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQmfGk41Fj2xg3VVA7Zdq5Giqa4KgQjUp9x9UmMS9Afu/travesia_literaria_reading_10161529_640.png)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/reading-book-woman-houseplant-10161529/)

---

Con el tiempo he descubierto que el verdadero descanso no siempre tiene que ver con dormir más o escapar lejos. A veces tiene más relación con encontrar un espacio, físico o emocional, donde una deja de sentirse exigida por todo.

### Sobre mi refugio favorito para relajarme  

Durante años habría respondido algo muy concreto: una playa tranquila, un viaje, algún lugar silencioso lejos de las preocupaciones diarias.

Pero hoy creo que mi refugio favorito no es exactamente un lugar.

Son ciertos momentos.

Momentos pequeños donde siento que el ruido del mundo baja un poco de volumen.

Puede ser llegar a casa después de un día agotador y quedarme unos minutos en silencio antes de hacer cualquier otra cosa. O sentarme cerca de una ventana mientras anochece y simplemente no tener que responderle nada a nadie por un rato.

También me ocurre cuando leo.

Hay algo profundamente reparador en entrar por un momento en otra historia, en otra vida, y darle descanso a la mente propia.

Creo que después de cierta edad una empieza a valorar mucho más esos espacios sencillos donde no hace falta rendir, explicar, resolver ni sostener nada.

Solo estar.

Y honestamente, en tiempos donde todo parece acelerado y constantemente conectado, encontrar momentos así se ha vuelto casi una necesidad emocional.

---

### Sobre intercambiar mi vida con alguien famoso  

Si soy sincera, no creo que intercambiaría mi vida completamente con ninguna persona famosa.

Hay vidas que desde afuera parecen perfectas: éxito, reconocimiento, dinero, admiración constante. Pero también imagino el peso de vivir siempre observada, opinada y expuesta públicamente.

Y no sé si podría sentirme realmente tranquila viviendo así.

Creo que con el tiempo he aprendido a valorar mucho la privacidad. La posibilidad de tener partes de mi vida que no necesiten ser explicadas ni convertidas en espectáculo.

Si tuviera que elegir a alguien, probablemente admiraría más a esas figuras públicas que han logrado conservar cierta autenticidad y sensibilidad incluso dentro de ambientes donde muchas personas terminan perdiéndose a sí mismas.

Pero aun así, no creo que quisiera dejar de ser quien soy.

Con todas las dificultades, incertidumbres y cansancios que la vida puede traer, también hay algo valioso en construir una historia propia, imperfecta pero real.

Y quizás eso es algo que muchas veces olvidamos cuando idealizamos la vida de otros: toda existencia tiene una parte invisible que no aparece en las fotografías ni en los aplausos.

---

Estas preguntas me hicieron pensar en algo curioso: a veces buscamos refugios fuera de nosotros, cuando en realidad los momentos de mayor calma suelen aparecer precisamente cuando dejamos de intentar cumplir tantas expectativas al mismo tiempo.

Gracias por este espacio de reflexión   

Un abrazo sincero para todas 

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue hecha en DeepL Translate  

---  

🇬🇧 In English  

---  

## The Places Where We Return to Ourselves  

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWQmfGk41Fj2xg3VVA7Zdq5Giqa4KgQjUp9x9UmMS9Afu/travesia_literaria_reading_10161529_640.png)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/reading-book-woman-houseplant-10161529/)

---

Over time, I have discovered that true rest is not always about sleeping more or escaping far away. Sometimes it has more to do with finding a space, physical or emotional, where we stop feeling constantly demanded by everything around us.

### About my favorite refuge to relax  

Years ago, I would have given a very concrete answer: a quiet beach, a trip somewhere peaceful, a place far from everyday worries.

But today, I believe my favorite refuge is not exactly a place.

It is certain moments.

Small moments where the noise of the world seems to lower its volume a little.

It can be arriving home after an exhausting day and sitting quietly for a few minutes before doing anything else. Or sitting near a window at sunset and simply not having to respond to anyone for a while.

I also feel it when I read.

There is something deeply restorative about stepping for a moment into another story, another life, and giving my own mind a rest.

I think that after a certain age, we begin to value much more those simple spaces where there is no need to perform, explain, solve, or hold everything together.

Just be.

And honestly, in times where everything feels accelerated and constantly connected, finding moments like that has become almost an emotional necessity.

---

### About exchanging my life with a famous person  

If I am honest, I do not think I would completely exchange my life with any famous person.

Some lives look perfect from the outside: success, recognition, money, constant admiration. But I also imagine the weight of always being observed, judged, and publicly exposed.

And I do not know if I could truly feel at peace living that way.

Over time, I have learned to value privacy deeply. The possibility of having parts of my life that do not need to be explained or turned into a spectacle.

If I had to choose someone, I would probably admire those public figures who have managed to preserve authenticity and sensitivity even in environments where many people end up losing themselves.

But even then, I do not think I would want to stop being who I am.

With all the difficulties, uncertainties, and exhaustion life can bring, there is still something valuable about building a story of your own—imperfect, but real.

And perhaps that is something we often forget when we idealize other people’s lives: every existence has an invisible side that never appears in photographs or applause.

---

These questions made me reflect on something curious: sometimes we search for refuge outside ourselves, when in reality the moments of greatest calm often appear precisely when we stop trying to meet so many expectations at once.

Thank you for this space for reflection  

A sincere hug to all

body.title: The tragedy of a dog going missing in Vietnam
body.body:
I do not have a dog but I have a couple of friends that do and they are normally very close to their animals.  I think there at times appears to be some sort of dependency issue there that is borderline unhealthy but who am I to judge.  I like their dogs and I am just happy that I don't have to take care of them but still get to enjoy their fluffy company when the dogs are around.  

Recently, a dog that is rather popular in the expat community went missing and it's been a few days and neither the dog nor the body of the dog, deceased, has been found.   This is truly terrible news.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23yTWowmMo6NGWys9n2m21pS8tjFqaY8xyyQhTwjkPFtagCtt6gnLv8YPiWkJQmY74xWq.png)
</center>

The dog's name is \

and he is male and about 3 years old.  He is a kind dog that is really happy to see all of us whenever we turn up and he serves as a sort of warning system because there have been several times that for reasons we cannot understand he will just bark at certain people.  Then for the most part, those same people will end up being irritating and someone that the rest of us just kind of want them to go away.  I love that Sleepy was able to read that about a person long before they would even speak.

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23tGyesXCmELzuKKhT9T66xMVwQLkUw79XYMJAHurqm4uWjuqM3eWYf7wcCFqeDHCrsLB.png)
</center>

Sleepy would always just chill around all of us at a bar that is called \

and for the most part he liked to be pet for a bit but wasn't super needy or jumping on people.  But Sleepy did suffer from something that I think all dogs suffer from and that was he really wanted to wander and myself and some other people would kind of get on the case of the owners about how they at times just wouldn't know where Sleepy was and they didn't seem all that bothered about it.  

Let me tell you why you definitely should be worried about this in Vietnam.  This country still has a dog meat trade.  Dog meat is still eaten in parts of the country and there are restaurants that specialize in it.   I have no idea if this is true or not but apparently Sleepy is the kind of dog that they seek out the most for this sort of thing.   

Sleepy went missing last Tuesday at 2am.  The CCTV on the pub confirms this.  The owner thought nothing of it at the time because his business is near a small park and Sleepy would often go on a little adventure over there to peepeepoopoo, get covered in nettles and then come sauntering back.   Sleepy was never gone for very long, until the one time that he was.

It has now been nearly a week since Sleepy disappeared and while at the start a bunch of us were running around to various parts of the city shouting his name and peering down alleyways -  I was even peering into people's front gates if I heard a dog barking - but after 6 days I don't think very many people are still looking.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabe.radke/23wCBXxM5SLNJpZbcxLVRjdHrq3LnKS5gZyhnyZANjJGd2pCWKRPH3kKjjLyz6oRNGQsn.png)
</center>

A rather large reward has been offered and the word has been spread all over every FB page and even some Russian and Korean apps to let everyone know that this dog is missing.  There are Vietnamese pages have also been filled with notices detailing his name, what he looks like, and the large reward being offered for his return.  

The real tragedy of this is that we all kind of know exactly what the situation is with him.  He was trapped by urban dog poachers in the middle of the night, was likely tranquilized and is now in a crate with a bunch of other dogs headed somewhere to be processed as food.   

I hope there is a special place in hell for the people that do this sort of thing.  I can't imagine how heartless a person could be to kidnap someone's pet and then take it somewhere to be killed an eaten.   The owners are very distraught over this because even though we don't talk about it, we all know that this is likely the case.   

While designer, expensive dogs are sometimes stolen because they are expensive and people want a pet like that, this is not what happens to your run-of-the-mill mongrel like Sleepy.   There is only one place that dogs like him end up and it isn't as a treasured guest in someone's garden.

While I hold my tongue because I know they are hurting there is a side of me that is very upset with the owners.  They know what this country is all about and they know that dogs are in danger of being kidnapped but they still didn't keep their own dog sequestered in the yard or on the property.   

It seems to me that if you live in a country where it is well known that dogs are kidnapped for food that you wouldn't just let your friggin dog wander around unattended.  Yet that is exactly what happened in this situation.  The justification of \

doesn't apply because that is not what we are dealing with here most likely.  We are dealing with a criminal group of people that intentionally target dogs that are wandering around at night and then capture them.   

I don't like to think about how scared Sleepy is right now and how abandoned he feels.  If there are doors in his life he is probably waiting for a familiar face to come along and set him free and he is likely extremely afraid and sad and will remain that way until he is eventually killed.

The owners of Sleepy, I don't think they should get another dog.  They are my friends but I am upset with them for their carelessness.   Of course I am more upset at the actual criminals and I wish I could get my hands on them to slowly torture them to death for their crimes.   

but at the end of the day the responsibility of keeping your dog safe in an environment like this one lies on YOU, the human owner.  

I will be very disappointed in them, perhaps to the point of no longer visiting their establishment if they simply turn around and get another dog.

body.title: Afternoon gift: the sweet fragrance of Bakul flowers.
body.body:
> ![IMG20260523182534~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSWhTaYwHCgN6g9rDahDexG1nn2N16JT5kaHsFniUY7pP/IMG20260523182534~2.jpg) Yesterday afternoon, I suddenly took some time out to go for a walk. As I passed the familiar surroundings and went a little further, a wonderful sweet fragrance wafting through the air made my whole mind feel better. As I looked around carefully, I realized that a huge Bakul tree was standing nearby. While searching for the source of that fragrance, these beautiful Bakul flowers scattered under the tree caught my eye. ![IMG20260523182525~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVS4yEpRxJKBgbaH1FYJNruTpTob2ngKU4qL2jhjJKmBU/IMG20260523182525~2.jpg) ![IMG20260523182523~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmccPMoky3UNArD7yZpUK3WbTFFeSHpUPHfNNVntHyAoTU/IMG20260523182523~2.jpg) The flowers were lying on the ground as if a white carpet was spread all over the place. I could not control my greed anymore. I bent down and picked up some beautiful, fresh Bakul flowers in my palm. After taking the flowers in my hand, the sweet smell seemed to hit my nose even more intensely. The beauty of these small white flowers is truly strange and beautiful, which can fascinate anyone in an instant. This ever-familiar Bakul flower of rural Bengal is associated with hundreds of childhood memories of all of us. The joy of picking these flowers and making garlands with them as a child was completely different. Holding these flowers in my hands at that beautiful moment yesterday afternoon brought back many old memories. In the midst of the busy life of the city, such natural beauty and the fragrance of flowers really bring a strange peace to the mind. ![IMG20260523182533~2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXmhTDjHrs6TX5d7tMMvYSfFwPxLhUKgXJqYtBh8B8Fwo/IMG20260523182533~2.jpg) This small gift of nature made my entire afternoon trip worthwhile. This perfect beauty and sweet fragrance of the flowers attracted me so much that I unknowingly took out my mobile and took several beautiful pictures. After capturing this extraordinary moment, I thought of sharing it with you too. I hope you all will like the pictures of these tender Bakul flowers held in the palm of your hand and this beautiful experience of mine. This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

我乘坐的是A司机开的大巴车，从北土城到廊坊；另一波是C司机，从国贸到廊坊，去程很顺利，返程回来过安检时掉了一个人!!!

平时我坐车的时候，很爱睡觉💤，这次返程打着哈欠和姐妹说了几句，也开始睡了。一觉醒来以为到了目的地，结果群里姐妹说大巴车又返回来了!我还不信，往玻璃外一瞅，就是安检站，交警好像还在喊人，我头扭回来就错过了这个掉的成人长啥样

仔细看完群消息，过安检时国贸师傅喊乘客带着行李和身份证下来过安检，但返回时国贸缺了一个人，师傅喊了好久没有用，也没有乘客电话，在安检又等了不少时间，其他所有国贸乘客不干了，纷纷攘攘说不能再等了，否则到北京后赶不上末班地铁，没办法就开车离开了

等半个多小时后，师傅收到了掉队人的电话，掉队人要求必须做大巴，因为行李在车上(也就无法给掉队人打车，到时候行李少了谁承担；国贸车当时在高速上，我们做的大巴开出快十公里，距离安检站更近些，就掉头返回安检站接人

所以我们全部晚到京一个多小时，因为一个奇葩掉队乘客的疏忽😟

好高冷的猫咪，不搭理人啊

**感谢你的支持和阅读！祝阖家安康！财源滚滚🤑**
