body.title: Khichuri para día lluvioso/Rainy day khichuri(Eng/Esp)
body.body:
![70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcgmaL6P2Lwu44Z5suipG7dJNWRB4C4Fkk2A2GNhb3azy/70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg)



Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well, Alhamdulillah. Today I have come to you with a great recipe. Today's recipe is very tasty and very healthy. To make today's recipe, of course, we will need a net because today I have made khichuri. This is a rainy-day khichuri, and this khichuri is very tasty to eat. You all can eat such khichuri, and it does not take much time to make this khichuri. Let's see how I made khichuri for a rainy day today.

Polao Rice
Moong Dal
Lentils 
Onion
Bay Leaves
Green Chillies
 Turmeric
 Salt
Dry Chilli Powder
Cumin Powder
Dhana Powder
White Oil
Ginger and Garlic Paste

To start cooking today, first I mixed the rice and lentils well and soaked them for half an hour. Of course, I used a pressure cooker to make the khichuri because the khichuri needs to be made much softer. If I make it in a pressure cooker instead of a pan, it helps make it much softer. That's why I first put the chopped onion, green chilies, and bay leaves in the pressure cooker.

![fef75322-cb7c-40c0-b842-ec1bf2da2485.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRDxQbSPwhYW53dqEJF6FPDyATqv91mgSkeEJajk8bhgw/fef75322-cb7c-40c0-b842-ec1bf2da2485.jpg)

![1a996694-49f3-4ec4-b94a-7f0ad4c00ad0.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQEy5ejZDZdbJMhUCyWNNFLMjnzAX8NJ1ZPR2FaHWe2e1/1a996694-49f3-4ec4-b94a-7f0ad4c00ad0.jpg)

![7c1a5bb1-0bb4-4409-963d-b69cfaa098f9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYC68sfYQakgeGcnDWN3TxXsrt4ZNpnY7u72K18dNjGJh/7c1a5bb1-0bb4-4409-963d-b69cfaa098f9.jpg)

Then, after putting everything here, I will put new oil here, and after frying it well, I will put all kinds of hot spices here after frying in oil, and then I will add powdered spices. Then, I have to take time to mix all the spices well, and here I will add water and fry the spices well for five minutes.

![67c2c1b6-3f3b-4862-948e-7f98b514758e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSvMRmeCrgEnxHews4g5okGCp1MyDrrNLoC8JtsFqFNb/67c2c1b6-3f3b-4862-948e-7f98b514758e.jpg)

![85e0ca48-64bb-4d1a-87c9-df4503889d23.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvU2S2i2PTBjWkb6KBgMbzXubm99jnP7zPrqXuNne8DK/85e0ca48-64bb-4d1a-87c9-df4503889d23.jpg)

![5ba1592f-da4b-4f6f-abb7-a0232c7cdc33.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjNE3wZgj6By5FyrmHmTEykp9mgfkFHvufJ4WmNhregH/5ba1592f-da4b-4f6f-abb7-a0232c7cdc33.jpg)

Once the spices are ground, I will add the soaked rice and dal here and then fry them well with a little more oil. There should be no water left. I did this in just ten minutes. After that, my rice will be fully cooked, and I will add water to it.

![1ad6139e-4c1f-4cb8-9cd6-ee77ad129ff6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9ZAKJTgq7hiQLk1eFxvvGRjkNygrt8gyH7wXV8fZiiR/1ad6139e-4c1f-4cb8-9cd6-ee77ad129ff6.jpg)

![bd582aac-1ed4-4ce7-b78a-48e3ae2e539c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXiNPaHzj9jdwXzKjmzH4y7ZmCCf8GFACRqTvbafRd7Bc/bd582aac-1ed4-4ce7-b78a-48e3ae2e539c.jpg)

![d388f7fe-8fa0-41b0-9be7-ea8657f8c46c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6qEYFtnywwxNurgVH11XLpHGrJy9eqL2R3iMo3o8mR7/d388f7fe-8fa0-41b0-9be7-ea8657f8c46c.jpg)

![70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcgmaL6P2Lwu44Z5suipG7dJNWRB4C4Fkk2A2GNhb3azy/70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg)

I have to use twice the amount of water that I use at other times so that my khichdi becomes soft. Then I have to heat the water a little after I have boiled it well, then I will add water, and then I will test the salt and see if it is right. After cooking for about half an hour, my khichdi is ready, and I can take it out and serve it. Of course, today I served it with fried eggs. You can serve it with vegetables or fried brinjal.


![70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcgmaL6P2Lwu44Z5suipG7dJNWRB4C4Fkk2A2GNhb3azy/70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg)

Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también estoy bien, Alhamdulillah. Hoy les traigo una receta estupenda. La receta de hoy es muy sabrosa y muy saludable. Para prepararla, por supuesto, necesitaremos una red, ya que hoy he preparado khichuri. Este es un khichuri ideal para un día lluvioso, y está delicioso. Todos pueden disfrutar de este khichuri, y no lleva mucho tiempo prepararlo. Veamos cómo lo preparé hoy para un día lluvioso.

Arroz Polao
Lentejas Moong
Lentejas
Cebolla
Hojas de laurel
Chiles verdes
Cúrcuma
Sal
Chile en polvo
Comino en polvo
Ciruelas molidas
Aceite vegetal
Pasta de jengibre y ajo

Para empezar a cocinar, primero mezclé bien el arroz y las lentejas y los dejé en remojo durante media hora. Por supuesto, usé una olla a presión para preparar el khichuri, ya que debe quedar mucho más suave. Cocinarlo en olla a presión en lugar de una sartén ayuda a que quede más tierno. Por eso, primero puse la cebolla picada, los chiles verdes y las hojas de laurel en la olla a presión.

![fef75322-cb7c-40c0-b842-ec1bf2da2485.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRDxQbSPwhYW53dqEJF6FPDyATqv91mgSkeEJajk8bhgw/fef75322-cb7c-40c0-b842-ec1bf2da2485.jpg)

![1a996694-49f3-4ec4-b94a-7f0ad4c00ad0.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQEy5ejZDZd bJMhUCyWNNFLMjnzAX8NJ1ZPR2FaHWe2e1/1a996694-49f3-4ec4-b94a-7f0ad4c00ad0.jpg)

![7c1a5bb1-0bb4-4409-963d-b69cfaa098f9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYC68sfYQakgeGcnDWN3TxXsrt4ZNpnY7u72K18dNjGJh/7c1a5bb1-0bb4-4409-963d-b69cfaa098f9.jpg)

Luego, después de poner todo aquí, añadiré aceite nuevo y, tras freírlo bien, pondré todo tipo de especias picantes aquí, y después añadiré especias en polvo. Luego, debo tomarme mi tiempo para mezclar bien todas las especias, y aquí agregaré agua y las sofreiré durante cinco minutos.

![67c2c1b6-3f3b-4862-948e-7f98b514758e.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTSvMRmeCrgEnxHews4g5okGCp1MyDrrNLoC8JtsFqFNb/67c2c1b6-3f3b-4862-948e-7f98b514758e.jpg)

![85e0ca48-64bb-4d1a-87c9-df4503889d23.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVvU2S2i2PT) BjWkb6KBgMbzXubm99jnP7zPrqXuNne8DK/85e0ca48-64bb-4d1a-87c9-df4503889d23.jpg)

![5ba1592f-da4b-4f6f-abb7-a0232c7cdc33.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYjNE3wZgj6By5FyrmHmTEykp9mgfkFHvufJ4WmNhregH/5ba1592f-da4b-4f6f-abb7-a0232c7cdc33.jpg)

Una vez molidas las especias, añadiré el arroz y las lentejas remojadas y las freiré bien con un poco más de aceite. No debe quedar agua. Lo hice en solo diez minutos. Después de eso, mi arroz estará completamente cocido y le añadiré agua.

![1ad6139e-4c1f-4cb8-9cd6-ee77ad129ff6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9ZAKJTgq7hiQLk1eFxvvGRjkNygrt8gyH7wXV8fZiiR/1ad6139e-4c1f-4cb8-9cd6-ee77ad129ff6.jpg)

![bd582aac-1ed4-4ce7-b78a-48e3ae2e539c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXiNPaHzj9jdwXzKjmzH4y7ZmCCf8GFACRqTvbafRd7Bc/bd582aac-1ed4-4ce7-b78a-48e3ae2e539c.jpg)

![d388f7fe-8fa0-41b0-9be7-ea8657f8c46c.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma6qEYFtnywwxNurgVH11XLpHGrJy9eqL2R3iMo3o8mR7/d388f7fe-8fa0-41b0-9be7-ea8657f8c46c.jpg)

![70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcgmaL6P2Lwu44Z5suipG7dJNWRB4C4Fkk2A2GNhb3azy/70e5c666-96d0-43ff-af32-2ec313e1550d.jpg)

Tengo que usar el doble de agua que uso normalmente para que mi khichdi quede suave. Después de que el agua hierva bien, la caliento un poco, le añado agua y luego pruebo la sal para ver si está en su punto. Tras cocinarlo durante media hora, mi khichdi está listo y puedo servirlo. Hoy, por supuesto, lo acompañé con huevos fritos. También se puede servir con verduras o berenjenas fritas.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 24 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/826fe9a3-6a2d-4dfb-8e7a-a0262f190912.jpg) What an amazing day today! We woke up a bit later than usual, then we had breakfast as my wife made us some really nice omelet and then I went to get some much needed mowing of the grass. I let the grass grow out a bit too much as we didn't have a chance to come to Whidbey Island for a while. And for memorial weekend the wait for the ferry was at least an hour and a half so we took a scenic route and drove through the Deception Pass. It still took almost three hours as the memorial traffic was insane. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5cc9f270-3090-4aff-a6b7-62ff07c63139.jpg) Clearly the six dollars a gallon gas has absolutely no effect on how much driving Washington state drivers are doing. After moving the grass I came back to the house and took a shower though I got an earful from my wife for being behind the schedule we agreed to and she had to wait for me. It was well deserved on my part, I did push the time because I wanted to charge the battery for the lawn mower as this super tall grass eats battery like there is no tomorrow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/134efb94-e79f-4536-a3b2-3363b9078248.jpg) Then we went to a historic town of Langley, where we visited our favorite local truffles place. We got a box of truffles, some dark chocolate and a couple of packages of peanuts in dark and milk chocolate and we also got some locally made fudge. Then we visited a local art gallery, where twenty two local artists rent a place to display their work. We also visited a shop where we got some soap, a glass miniature lamp for our daughter and a few little things. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8dec290b-8c3c-4b04-8fff-d9bfa95fdd3c.jpg) Then it was time for some ramen. Ultra Ramen was great as always and it turned out that a Dutch lady that owns the eclectic store where we bought soap also owns with her husband the Ramen place as well. Her husband was there cooking Ramen with a team of young kids of college age. The Dutch lady was there at the store with her adult daughter and was teaching her how to run the store, she was also very friendly and gave us all hugs as we were leaving. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6cfae9ff-65f1-41a4-b9c9-c596f8dd5622.jpg) We walked a bit more around downtown Langley and then went to visit a new place that we never visited before. It was basically a large rhododendron garden of around fifty acres. They have hundreds of varieties of rhododendrons there. I also learned that rhododendron is our state flower. About time as I have been a Washington state resident for almost twenty seven years. We spent a lot of time in Meerkerk Gardens and took a lot of beautiful pictures there. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4818df3f-ae94-478e-b391-580103bd3e3d.jpg) Some of the pictures in this post like the opening image and the image above were actually taken by my wife. She is really good with her iPhone. Then we came back home and I did more mowing of the grass with the recharged battery and then was time for the grand finale: fire, charcoal baked potatoes, corn on the cob, grass fed t-bone steak and smores. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0b7c654b-11d3-4bc3-815a-789270faf965.jpg) It was a long, but a really amazing day. The weather was perfect not too cold and not hot with perfect sun and blue sky!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@seattlea/actifit-seattlea-20260525t044421494z)_

body.title: As I open about 15 Gladius packs, I find myself wondering: is it really important to belong to a guild? Personal opinion
body.body: Why Joining a Guild in Splinterlands Changed My Experience Completely When I first started playing Splinterlands, I thought the game was only about collecting cards, winning battles, and trying to climb the leagues. At the beginning, I played mostly alone and focused only on improving my deck little by little. But after spending more time inside the game, I realized that one of the most important parts of the entire ecosystem is joining a Guild. Honestly, joining a Guild completely changed my experience in Splinterlands. A Guild is much more than just a group of players. It becomes a community where everyone helps each other grow, share strategies, and participate together in one of the most exciting features of the game: Guild Brawls. Before joining a Guild, I did not fully understand how important Brawls were. These battles between guilds allow players to earn rewards like SPS and Merits. The interesting part is that Merits can be used to buy Gladius Cases, which contain some of the most powerful cards in the game. That was one of the moments where I understood why veteran players always recommend joining an active Guild. Gladius cards are extremely strong because many of them have the Bloodlust ability. Every time they eliminate an enemy, all their stats increase, making them even more dangerous during battle. Some matches can completely change because of a single Gladius card. Another thing I noticed after joining a Guild was how much faster I started learning the game.

/> Splinterlands has many mechanics that can feel difficult for new players: * Battle rules * Card positioning * Abilities * Speed mechanics * Team synergies * Economy strategies Trying to understand everything alone can be overwhelming. But inside a Guild, experienced players are always sharing advice, strategies, and recommendations. That support helped me improve much faster than when I was playing alone. I also discovered that the social aspect makes the game much more enjoyable. Instead of simply logging in to play ranked battles every day, now there is a sense of teamwork and motivation. Players prepare for Brawls together, discuss strategies, and celebrate victories as a group. It makes the entire experience feel more alive and less repetitive.

/>

Guild buildings are another important part of the system. As members contribute and upgrade buildings, the entire Guild receives bonuses and advantages. This creates a strong feeling of collaboration because everyone works together to improve the Guild over time.

In my opinion, joining a Guild is almost essential if someone truly wants to experience everything Splinterlands has to offer.

It is not only about earning better rewards or getting stronger cards. It is also about learning faster, meeting other players, becoming part of a community, and enjoying the game in a completely different way.

Playing alone can still be fun, but after joining a good Guild, I honestly feel that Splinterlands became a much deeper and more exciting experience.

body.title: Reflejos entre la habitación y la noche. Entry for Reflection Hunters contest-SMARP- round 273 [EN/ES]
body.body:
## Reflections Between the Room and the Night  
### Reflejos entre la habitación y la noche

---

Hello, friends of the #ShadowHunters community, thanks to our friend @olgavita for inviting us to this initiative in her Reflection Hunters Contest – Round 273.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSp4dBrmNTFNY7A3qPVyAXpweJWYb2sxNZ8QvUibiNg5/screenshot_20260522_044546_01.jpg)

---

As has become routine for me over these past months, once again I find myself alone in this hotel room during the nights, trying to find inspiration and moments to share on Hive. Sometimes, in the middle of silence and repetition, reflections appear where one least expects them.

---

This time, after closing the curtains, I noticed something curious in the glass door leading to the balcony. The crystal reflected the interior of the room while still allowing part of the balcony itself to remain visible. The railing, the corner column, and the darkness outside mixed together with the reflection of the furniture and the television inside the room.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyrmkVrqXxVsqeiRCySMPsP8pRvhKyL3u3JSaQ5FofnG/screenshot_20260522_044551_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYLuYriXDiMBA4CwPdzhdhRATDKFXAe132ddDds4stEd2/screenshot_20260522_044601_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1pzxgpDspf1QcxW2dywuZvS2cU5aiDU8UTMm1R2BThf/screenshot_20260522_044606_01.jpg)

---

Later, I turned slightly and captured another reflection. In the same glass appeared the sofa, another piece of furniture, and even a framed picture hanging on the wall. It created an overlapping image where the room seemed to duplicate itself in the night.

---

I also included a photo of the furniture itself so the interior of the room can be seen directly and compared with the reflected version. Sometimes reflections do not just mirror reality — they transform it into something more interesting and unexpected.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd51KquisBkLv9XybsSMQaH2Vie11n1yntTinm3SX6Knd/screenshot_20260522_044614_01.jpg)

---

The photos were taken with my mobile phone, and for the English version I used Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.  
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---

📢 If you want to see my full process in real time inside Hive and Web3, I’m documenting it here:

👉 Daily Hive Journal 🚀  
https://t.me/diariohive  

There I share progress, mistakes, and results with no filter.

---

- - - 
***Spanish Version***
- - -

---

## Reflejos entre la habitación y la noche

---

Hola, amigos de la comunidad #ShadowHunters, gracias a la amiga @olgavita por convocarnos a esta iniciativa en su Reflection Hunters Contest – Round 273.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWSp4dBrmNTFNY7A3qPVyAXpweJWYb2sxNZ8QvUibiNg5/screenshot_20260522_044546_01.jpg)

---

Como ya se ha vuelto rutina para mí durante estos últimos meses, una vez más me encuentro solo en esta habitación de hotel durante las noches, buscando inspiración y momentos para compartir en Hive. A veces, en medio del silencio y la repetición, los reflejos aparecen donde menos uno los espera.

---

Esta vez, después de cerrar las cortinas, noté algo curioso en el cristal de la puerta corrediza que da acceso al balcón. El vidrio reflejaba el interior de la habitación y al mismo tiempo dejaba visible parte del propio balcón. La baranda, la columna de la esquina y la oscuridad exterior se mezclaban con el reflejo de los muebles y el televisor dentro de la habitación.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcyrmkVrqXxVsqeiRCySMPsP8pRvhKyL3u3JSaQ5FofnG/screenshot_20260522_044551_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYLuYriXDiMBA4CwPdzhdhRATDKFXAe132ddDds4stEd2/screenshot_20260522_044601_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1pzxgpDspf1QcxW2dywuZvS2cU5aiDU8UTMm1R2BThf/screenshot_20260522_044606_01.jpg)

---

Luego me giré un poco y capturé otro reflejo. En el mismo cristal aparecían el sofá, otro mueble e incluso un cuadro colgado en la pared. Se formaba así una imagen superpuesta donde la habitación parecía duplicarse en la noche.

---

También incluí una foto de los muebles directamente para que se pueda apreciar el interior de la habitación y compararlo con la versión reflejada. A veces los reflejos no solo muestran la realidad, sino que la transforman en algo más interesante e inesperado.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd51KquisBkLv9XybsSMQaH2Vie11n1yntTinm3SX6Knd/screenshot_20260522_044614_01.jpg)

body.title: One of the simplest scams and how to avoid it
body.body:
My accounts such as social media accounts, bank accounts, and crypto accounts are always guided by a strong password system which makes it hard for a mere hack except for anyone who wants to hire a professional hacker to shake my account but of what benefit is that when after my bank accounts are hacked, one won't see money inside. Lol
So, yeah, my accounts are not easily hacked due to the way I protect them, and this has kept me clear of being scammed out of my money or having my social media accounts used to scam my friends for money. I have been into *online groove* for a very long time, and I can easily identify phishing links, so I avoid them. Meanwhile, I also get on with a lot of sites that scare a lot of people but I have my way around them and it's very hard for my details to be used to scam me. No, I'm bigger than that.
You know, a lot of people, including some of my friends think that once you register on a site, especially random sites, one is at risk of being scammed. Most times I've shared stuff to earn money online with them and they discarded it because they thought they could be scammed. Meanwhile, they don't even have the money to be scammed. Lol. But I understand too, it's not everyone who has the mind to let out their details on a site, even as low as typing their full name.

# One of the simplest scams and how to avoid it:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXgyw5viEHUDppvN7Meitxo9A2DCuYovBC34YNS9v7gtZ/1002548561.jpg)



As for me, the simplest scam I've seen being played on people is the type where *a friend begs you for money, you give out and within a short time, you'll find out that it's a scam.*


How?


Last month, a female friend reached out to me on WhatsApp asking me for ten thousand naira to tackle an urgent issue. That was really the first time the friend was asking me for help. I was moved but I couldn't dare to just send the money. I had to call, on a real call to the lady to confirm if it was her that's really asking for the help and behold, it came out that her WhatsApp account was hacked and she wasn't the one seeking help from everyone on the contact list.
So whenever someone, even as close as your siblings begs you for money especially a huge amount of money and you smell something fishy, just confirm first if it's actually them because a scammer could actually hack their account, seek financial help and paste a different account to be paid in the money with a nicely cooked up story.

Thanks for reading.

This is my entry to [Indiaunited contest](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-ca3e7ff9610e?referral=kingsleyy)

body.title: Together Nasi Lemak Together signature rendang pork nasi lemak dumplings
body.body:
![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EpGT78XtTi9nww8fd9dtMptRK2GGgHtNVPtKPxvWqyD24dBPLPyFR4FMfMDvQQTjeYi.jpg)
![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EogPjb2kbY8Mxz7TYEgCLCJutqd2vQUSY512SWzgNgiD7c34B4ekQ6Y7TfzSaEoVrvn.jpg)

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EoeFtBVXUgqa9kyWheDWyCA98A82PfZj8Rj81edXsJwXBTWxpkiAFRbPPawUaGNntDB.jpg)


Today, I revisited the Food Place food court, located at Pavilion Mall. The food court is located beside the Oriental Kopi Restaurant. It is time to try another stall.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/Eokcgjj14JWHg3Ts53k6CTbq4fMQK5bJNiybjs5PYhWDFeKQxnDoNu7zTo4rtjXiAmp.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/23ynYbxg3RVG3ipF7u3HCWtdr8hfBqYraGgPQ4h3k328BitmK9nvkVj3zg7HFistpzCPf.jpg)

This time, I try Together signature rendang pork nasi lemak dumplings from the Together Nasi Lemak stall, which cost RM24.90 per portion.

This is a creative fusion between two beloved traditions — Malaysian nasi lemak and Chinese-style rice dumplings (zongzi/bak chang).

Wrapped in bamboo leaves and shaped like a traditional dumpling, the dish combines coconut milk glutinous rice with classic nasi lemak ingredients. Inside, you can see thick slices of rendang pork layered together with sambal, peanuts, ikan bilis, and rich salted egg yolk. The rice absorbs the fragrant oils and sambal during steaming, giving every bite a spicy, savoury, and slightly creamy taste.

What makes this version stand out is the use of pork rendang. Rendang is usually associated with Malay-style slow-cooked beef or chicken, but here the pork belly brings a softer texture and richer fat content that melts into the glutinous rice. The salted egg yolk adds an extra luxurious, almost buttery finish.

Visually, it resembles a traditional Chinese bak chang, but the flavour profile is unmistakably Malaysian nasi lemak — spicy sambal, coconut rice, crunchy peanuts, and anchovies all packed into one dense parcel. It is essentially a “portable nasi lemak.”

Historically, nasi lemak itself is one of Malaysia’s most iconic dishes. It originated as a simple meal for farmers and fishermen, with rice cooked in coconut milk and served with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber, and egg. Over time it evolved from humble roadside packets into a national comfort food with endless modern variations.

The dumpling inspiration comes from Chinese zongzi traditions, where glutinous rice is wrapped in leaves and filled with meats or beans before steaming or boiling. Malaysia’s multicultural food scene often blends Malay, Chinese, and Nyonya influences together, and this dish is a good example of that culinary crossover. The combination of nasi lemak flavours inside a bak chang-style dumpling reflects the way Malaysian food culture constantly reinvents familiar classics.

The branding from Together Nasi Lemak also highlights a nostalgic “grandmother recipe” concept rooted in Nyonya home cooking traditions.


![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EpGT78XtTi9nww8fd9dtMptRK2GGgHtNVPtKPxvWqyD24dBPLPyFR4FMfMDvQQTjeYi.jpg)

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hooiyewlim/EouA7XgwFGQab2yN4ma5igfGrbX3CCDsL2FJ9eivSGjp1Pd81jyYJ6zJZd6A23Qcfm2.jpg)

title.title: ¡Delicioso Omurice con sabor venezolano! 🍛 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos! ¿Como han estado?? Yo la verdad muy ocupada, pero feliz de haber preparado uno de mis almuerzos/cenas favoritos, pues un día cualquiera cansada de preparar algo rápido y queriendo comer algo distinto, recordé que tenía meses sin hacer un Omurice, un platillo japonés que nos fascina, lo hemos visto en varias series de anime y videos de comida típica japonesa, desde entonces lo hacemos en casa, eso si, al estilo venezolano!! Ya que no tengo las técnicas correctas (y algunos ingredientes) para preparar uno como realmente es jajaja, por ello, suelo hacer esta versión, que la verdad queda divino, nos encanta y me alegra muchísimo haberla hecho nuevamente!. Si tú la has preparado en casa y te queda mejor, siéntete libre de comentar como lo preparas, yo encantada de aprender a cocinar mejor y más sabroso!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hey friends! How have you been? I've been really busy, but I'm so happy to have made one of my favorite lunches/dinners. One day, tired of making something quick and wanting to eat something different, I remembered it had been months since I'd made Omurice, a Japanese dish we love. We've seen it in several anime series and videos of typical Japanese food, and ever since then we've been making it at home, Venezuelan style, of course! Since I don't have the right techniques (and some ingredients) to make a proper one, haha, I usually make this version, which is absolutely delicious. We love it, and I'm so glad I made it again! If you've made it at home and yours turns out better, feel free to comment on how you prepare it. I'd love to learn how to cook better and tastier!

>
Ingredientes:
Cebolla Pimentón rojo Ají picante verde Zanahoria Ajo Pechuga de pollo Pimienta negra molida Arroz Salsa de tomate Huevos Plátano

>
Ingredients:
Onion Red bell pepper Green chili pepper Carrot Garlic Chicken breast Ground black pepper Rice Tomato sauce Eggs Plantain

>
Aprovechando que temprano había hecho pollo con aceite de coco, y había quedado un poco de ese sabor y aceite en la sartén, me pareció perfecto cocinar en ella, así que comencé a añadir la cebolla, ajo, pimentón rojo, zanahoria y pollo para comenzar a cocinar a fuego medio. La verdad esto es muy fácil de hacer, lo \

es realmente picar todos los ingredientes jajaja, pero una vez listos, es rápido el proceso, más si la pechuga de pollo la picas esa fina, yo quise que quedaran trozos más grandes esta vez, pero normalmente los hago pequeñitos, cuando está casi listo el pollo solo queda rectificar sal y pasar a preparar el arroz.
ENGLISH

Since I had cooked chicken with coconut oil earlier that day, and there was still some of that flavor and oil left in the pan, it seemed perfect to cook in it. So I started adding the onion, garlic, red bell pepper, carrot, and chicken, and began cooking over medium heat. Honestly, this is very easy to make. The \

part is actually chopping all the ingredients, haha. But once they're ready, the process is quick, especially if you chop the chicken breast finely. I wanted larger pieces this time, but I usually chop them small. When the chicken is almost done, all that's left is to adjust the salt and move on to preparing the rice.

>
Siempre he pensado que esta receta es literalmente un arroz con pollo y salsa de tomate jajajaja, pero bueno, seguimos con el arroz, una vez listo se le añade salsa de tomate, la idea es que quede de color rosado, para luego volver a colocar la sartén con la preparación anterior a fuego bajo, añadir el arroz previamente mezclado con la salsa de tomate y mezclar todo junto hasta obtener una preparación bien uniforme. Los dos últimos pasos son hacer una capa de huevo, yo utilizo un solo huevo por plato, más, la idea de la receta original es que el huevo revuelto cubra todo el arroz, así que si ustedes quieren hacer la tortilla más grande, y se finaliza el plato con unas líneas de salsa de tomate, por supuesto, como buena venezolana, no podía dejar el plátano por fuera, así que este fue mi último paso, hacer unas tajadas para acompañar semejante almuerzo jajaja.
ENGLISH

I've always thought this recipe is literally just chicken, rice, and tomato sauce, hahaha, but anyway, let's get back to the rice. Once it's cooked, add tomato sauce. The idea is for it to turn pink. Then, put the pan with the previous mixture back over low heat, add the rice that's been mixed with the tomato sauce, and mix everything together until you have a smooth, even mixture. The last two steps are to make a layer of egg. I use just one egg per plate, but the original recipe calls for the scrambled egg to cover all the rice, so if you want to make a bigger omelet, that's fine. Finally, drizzle the dish with a few lines of tomato sauce. Of course, being a good Venezuelan, I couldn't leave out the plantain, so that was my last step: making some slices to accompany such a delicious lunch, hahaha.

GRACIAS POR LEER! ❤️ | THANKS FOR READING! ❤️

>
¡Hola!
Soy una chica enamorada de las aventuras, me encanta conocer nuevos lugares y documentar mi experiencia en ellos, me apasiona fotografiar momentos únicos, paisajes y todo lo que tenga que ver con la naturaleza, de hecho soy fotógrafo de turismo paisajístico, también bailarina profesional, adoro cocinar, llevar un estilo de vida saludable y sobre todo #catlover, amo con locura a mis gatos y a mi manada callejera 😸.

title.title: Lo que aprendí demasiado tarde #2: Sobre el cansancio que nadie nota | What I Learned Too Late #2: About the exhaustion nobody notices
title.body:
🇪🇸 En Español  

---

# Lo que aprendí demasiado tarde #2  
## *Sobre el cansancio que nadie nota*  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3txtXXn84U7xRhuTHi2pCE6V7FoNA9i8nv5qDtLUxHq/userbot_food_preparation_7008105_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/food-preparation-bake-flour-hands-7008105/)

---

> Hay cansancios que no empiezan en el cuerpo, sino en la mente.

---

Hola querida comunidad de Holos & Lotus  

Durante muchos años pensé que estar cansada era algo normal.

Tan normal, que dejé de prestarle atención.

Me acostumbré a despertarme ya preocupada por las cosas del día:
la comida,
el agua,
la corriente,
el dinero,
las colas,
la casa,
las cuentas mentales que una hace constantemente para ver cómo estirar lo poco que hay.

Y poco a poco entendí que existe un tipo de agotamiento que no se ve fácilmente desde afuera.

Porque una sigue funcionando.

Sigue cocinando.
Sigue limpiando.
Sigue resolviendo.
Sigue buscando maneras de inventar algo más para ayudar en la casa.

En mi caso, muchas veces las costuras, las artesanías o los dulces caseros no han sido solamente algo que me gusta hacer, sino también una necesidad económica dentro de la realidad que vivimos.

Y en Cuba, vivir constantemente resolviendo termina desgastando más de lo que muchas veces queremos admitir.

---

## El cansancio que se vuelve costumbre  

Creo que una de las cosas más peligrosas del agotamiento es cuando se vuelve rutina.

Porque llega un momento en que una deja de preguntarse si está bien.

Simplemente sigue.

Hay días en que me siento agotada incluso antes de empezar a hacer las cosas.

Pero aun así el día no se detiene.

La ropa sigue acumulándose.
La comida hay que cocinarla igual.
Los apagones cambian todos los horarios.
El agua aparece a veces cuando una menos energía tiene para aprovecharla.

Y entonces el cuerpo aprende a funcionar casi automáticamente.

---

> A veces una sigue adelante no porque tenga fuerzas, sino porque no tiene alternativa.

---

Creo que muchas mujeres de mi generación crecimos viendo eso en otras mujeres.

Madres cansadas que seguían trabajando.
Abuelas que nunca descansaban realmente.
Mujeres acostumbradas a dejarse para último lugar.

Y sin darse cuenta, una termina aprendiendo lo mismo.

Durante años confundí responsabilidad con sacrificio permanente.

Sentía culpa si descansaba demasiado.
Sentía culpa si no lograba terminar todo.
Incluso sentía culpa por estar cansada.

Como si agotarse fuera una especie de debilidad.

Pero los años me han hecho entender algo importante:
el cuerpo también se cansa de resistir.

Y la mente mucho más.

---

## Vivir en alerta constante también agota  

Hay un tipo de cansancio muy difícil de explicar.

No viene solamente del trabajo físico.

Viene de vivir demasiado tiempo pendiente de todo.

Pendiente de cuándo se va la corriente.
Pendiente de si aparecerá el agua.
Pendiente de si alcanza el dinero.
Pendiente de los precios que suben.
Pendiente de resolver lo inmediato antes de pensar siquiera en descansar.

Esa sensación de vivir siempre adaptándose termina agotando emocionalmente.

Porque la mente nunca se relaja completamente.

Incluso cuando una se sienta un momento, sigue pensando en lo próximo que falta.

Y creo que eso es algo que muchas personas fuera de Cuba no logran entender del todo.

Aquí no cansa solamente trabajar.

Cansa organizar la supervivencia todos los días.

---

> El problema de acostumbrarse al cansancio es que llega un momento en que una deja de notar cuánto le pesa.

---

Con el tiempo he aprendido que descansar no es perder el tiempo.

Aunque todavía me cuesta aplicarlo.

Todavía hay días en que siento que debería estar haciendo algo más útil en lugar de detenerme un rato.

Pero ya entendí que vivir agotada permanentemente no debería convertirse en una forma normal de existir.

Y quizás eso fue algo que aprendí demasiado tarde.

---

A veces el cansancio más fuerte no es el que se ve en el cuerpo, sino el que una lleva durante años en silencio.

Gracias por leer  

---

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha con DeepL Translate.  

---

🇬🇧 In English  

---

# What I Learned Too Late #2  
## *About the exhaustion nobody notices*  

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP3txtXXn84U7xRhuTHi2pCE6V7FoNA9i8nv5qDtLUxHq/userbot_food_preparation_7008105_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/food-preparation-bake-flour-hands-7008105/)

---
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQosht52kXhWG95Uxgk5R3Q9VzGAhEGT9RshUQrNcqNbe/thevirtualdenise_garlic_2556022_640.jpg)


> Some kinds of exhaustion do not begin in the body, but in the mind.

---

Hello dear Holos & Lotus community  

For many years, I believed being tired was simply normal.

So normal that I stopped paying attention to it.

I became used to waking up already worried about the day ahead:
food,
water,
electricity,
money,
long lines,
the house,
the constant mental calculations to make limited resources last a little longer.

And little by little, I understood that there is a type of exhaustion that people rarely notice from the outside.

Because you continue functioning.

You continue cooking.
Cleaning.
Solving problems.
Finding ways to create a little extra income for the household.

In my case, sewing, handmade crafts, and homemade sweets have often been more than hobbies. They have also been part of our economic survival inside the reality we live in.

And in Cuba, living in constant survival mode slowly wears people down more than many want to admit.

---

## When exhaustion becomes routine  

I think one of the most dangerous things about exhaustion is when it becomes normal.

Because eventually, you stop asking yourself whether you are okay.

You simply continue.

There are days when I already feel exhausted before even starting.

But the day does not stop.

Laundry continues accumulating.
Meals still need to be prepared.
Power outages change every schedule.
Water sometimes arrives when you barely have the energy to take advantage of it.

And eventually, the body learns to function almost automatically.

---

> Sometimes we continue not because we still have strength, but because we feel we have no other option.

---

I believe many women from my generation grew up watching this in other women.

Tired mothers who kept working.
Grandmothers who never truly rested.
Women who always placed themselves last.

And without realizing it, we learned to live the same way.

For years I confused responsibility with permanent sacrifice.

I felt guilty if I rested too much.
I felt guilty if I did not finish everything.
I even felt guilty for feeling exhausted.

As if tiredness itself were some kind of weakness.

But life has slowly taught me something important:
the body also becomes tired of resisting.

And the mind even more.

---

## Living in constant alert is exhausting too  

There is a kind of exhaustion that is difficult to explain.

It does not come only from physical work.

It comes from living too long being mentally alert about everything.

Alert about electricity cuts.
Alert about water availability.
Alert about whether the money will be enough.
Alert about rising prices.
Alert about solving immediate problems before even thinking about resting.

That constant adaptation slowly becomes emotional exhaustion.

Because the mind never fully relaxes.

Even while sitting quietly, you are still thinking about the next thing that needs attention.

And I think this is something many people outside Cuba cannot fully understand.

Here, it is not only work that becomes exhausting.

Organizing survival every day is exhausting too.

---

> The problem with getting used to exhaustion is that eventually you stop realizing how heavy it truly is.

---

Over time, I have learned that resting is not wasting time.

Although I still struggle with that idea sometimes.

There are still days when I feel I should be doing something more useful instead of stopping for a while.

But I now understand that living permanently exhausted should not become a normal way of existing.

And maybe that was something I learned too late.

---

Sometimes the deepest exhaustion is not the one visible in the body, but the one carried silently for years.

Thank you for reading  

---

The images are from Pixabay.  
The English version was translated using DeepL Translate.

---
Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

title.body:
>Recién que hago este post me entero que esta película esta basada en un libro ¡Wow! Hace dos días vi Project Hail Mary, había visto muchos comentarios positivos de esta película incluso personas diciendo que era igual o mejor de buena que Interestelar y eso me pareció decir MUCHO. Asi que tuve que verla para comprobar esas fuertes declaraciones y debo decir que es una película bastante buena, no aburre, tiene una historia muy hermosa que para nada la esperaba ya que ni siquiera vi trailer de esta película y sobre todo, la ambientación, fotografía, música son excelentes. Pero afirmar que ¿es igual o mejor que interestelar? …No. Creo que es evidente que a nivel de trama interestelar es bastante superior, pero esta película cuenta si propia historia y es bastante interesante y entretenida de ver. > I just found out while writing this post that this movie is based on a book! Wow! Two days ago I saw Project Hail Mary. I had seen many positive reviews of this movie, even people saying it was as good as or better than Interstellar, and that seemed like a lot to me. So I had to see it to verify those strong claims, and I must say it's a pretty good movie. It's not boring, it has a very beautiful story that I wasn't expecting at all since I hadn't even seen a trailer, and above all, the setting, cinematography, and music are excellent. But to say that it's as good as or better than Interstellar? ...No. I think it's obvious that Interstellar is far superior in terms of plot, but this movie tells its own story and is quite interesting and entertaining to watch. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uQjgT2wkJQhgHnsGsBoKjnPWSGVEVHtt8bDq1HTV9gHPAAP2jB4rExRnzi6RF626E5s.png)
[Source](https://slate.com/culture/2026/03/project-hail-mary-movie-ryan-gosling-the-martian.html)

>En esta película de ciencia ficción nuestro protagonista es Ryan Gosling y realmente AMO a ese hombre, en esta historia se llama Ryland Grace y es un profesor de ciencias que despierta en una nave espacial, sin recordar quien es o que hace allí, durante la película vamos viendo escenas que nos van develando quien es Grace y como llego a ese punto. Lo mas inquietante es que Grace esta completamente solo, sus compañeros fallecieron y le toca recordar todo por si mismo. En esta historia Grace termina siendo un héroe obligado, ya que se encuentra en una misión para salvar al mundo de una bacteria que devora estrellas. > In this science fiction film, our protagonist is Ryan Gosling, and I absolutely love that man. In this story, he plays Ryland Grace, a science teacher who wakes up on a spaceship with no memory of who he is or what he's doing there. Throughout the film, we see scenes that gradually reveal Grace's identity and how he got to that point. The most unsettling aspect is that Grace is completely alone; his companions have died, and he has to piece everything back together on his own. In this story, Grace ends up being an unlikely hero, as he finds himself on a mission to save the world from a star-devouring bacterium. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23xA1xZyfkPdvEy3Lg4DcwcHSFeGS4CT2DnztrVJ3CR8VWLNgx98sQZejH5uEwbasvohi.png)
[Source](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/29/movies/project-hail-mary-rocky-alien-voice.html)

>Y después de tanta soledad Grace recibe un mensaje desde una nave alienígena y conoce a quien será su nuevo compañero de viaje, Rocky. > And after so much loneliness, Grace receives a message from an alien spaceship and meets her new travel companion, Rocky. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFU95X49xQrdUoXGoBJyzCfx5SNmE98pxz1e2ytW1QTjT6YYWQrJMMxmKbHr1kPrdXX.png)
[Source](https://hero.fandom.com/wiki/Rocky_(Project_Hail_Mary)?file=Rocky_%28Project_Hail_Mary%29.jpg)

>Rocky, tal cual su nombre parece una roca, es muy gracioso y loco que me diera tanta ternura una criatura que ni siquiera tiene rostro. De alguna manera Grace y Rocky terminan adaptando sus idiomas para poder comunicarse mejor, ambos tienen un objetivo en común y es lograr salvar a sus planetas de la bacteria que devora estrellas. Es simplemente hermoso ver como se va desenvolviendo la amistad entre estos dos. > Rocky, whose name sounds like a rock, is quite funny and strange, and it's amazing how tender I find a creature without even a face. Somehow, Grace and Rocky end up adapting their languages to communicate better. They both share a common goal: to save their planets from the star-devouring bacteria. It's simply beautiful to watch their friendship unfold. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vi5rY3hyoczMSWE91WuyMTjXeRvncfW63PyxMAccVHXkMZ83T4kxrXxTFo5s4Z1Uev3.png)
[Source](https://geektyrant.com/news/the-movie-beautiful-scene-in-project-hail-mary-took-serious-movie-magic-to-pull-off)

>Como les mencioné esta película tiene fotografía muy hermosa, los colores, los escenarios, es visualmente preciosa, escenas que no tienen demasiada “fantasía” tambien se sienten bien adaptadas, con una ambientación sumamente acorde y realmente se agradece, es satisfactorio de ver.


> As I mentioned, this film has very beautiful cinematography; the colors, the settings, it's visually gorgeous. Scenes that don't have too much \

also feel well-adapted, with a very fitting atmosphere, and it's really appreciated; it's satisfying to watch. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EogNNcFX3efogBTScasmQZLUtLhGUCQmaSp8PKATxAarfSsWTV655vZi1RCEJBPe4WK.png)
[Source](https://x.com/SolaceCinema/status/2039410500748943719)

>No les contare el final pero quiero decirles que es el final más bello que he visto en muchísimo tiempo, me reí muchísimo y me encanto… toda la película me la pase bastante mal preparándome para algo malo pero ese final simplemente se ganó mi corazón > I won't tell you the ending, but I want to say that it's the most beautiful ending I've seen in a very long time. I laughed so much and I loved it… I was pretty nervous throughout the whole movie, bracing myself for something bad, but that ending simply won me over.

title.title: Chainsaw Man: Reze Arc | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
title.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. Today I’m bringing you not a series, but a movie that’s part of one of today’s most popular action-fantasy franchises. The return of a gem that promised to revolutionize the genre forever. On the other hand, this is one of only two modern films of this style that I’ve seen in the past year. Based on the famous manga series titled Chainsaw Man, written and illustrated by
>Tatsuki Fujimoto, this feature film—which serves as a sequel to the animated adaptation—was produced by
>MAPPA studio and directed by Tatsuya Yoshihara.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Hoy les traigo, no una serie, sino una película que forma parte de una de las obras de acción y fantasía más populares de la actualidad. El regreso de una joya que prometía revolucionar el género para siempre. Por otra parte, esta es una de las dos únicas películas modernas de este estilo que he visto el año pasado. Basada en la famosa serie de manga titulada Chainsaw Man, la cual está escrita e ilustrada por Tatsuki Fujimoto, este largometraje -que sirve como secuela de la adaptación animada- fue producido por el estudio MAPPA junto con la dirección de Tatsuya Yoshihara.

>

Plot

The film opens with a shot of a narrow city alley as a young Denji walks through it. Suddenly, at a crossroads, he hears the voice of his dear friend Pochita calling him from behind a door at the end of the path. As he runs over, Denji is about to open the door, but Pochita tells him not to open it “under any circumstances.” Suddenly, Denji wakes up from what seemed to have been a strange dream and wonders if he’s still asleep when he sees Power get up with four large horns on her head, instead of the usual two small ones. Denji, along with his partner Aki, takes Power to the “Devil Hunters” Public Safety Headquarters so Makima can examine her.

>

Trama

La película inicia mostrándonos un callejón angosto de la ciudad mientras un pequeño Denji camina por ahí. De repente, en un cruce, escucha la voz de su querido amigo Pochita que lo llama detrás de una puerta que hay al final del camino. Al acercarse corriendo, Denji está por abrir la puerta, pero Pochita le dice que no la abra “por nada en el mundo”. De repente, Denji despierta de lo que pareció haber sido un extraño sueño y se sigue preguntando si sigue dormido al ver a Power levantarse con cuatro grandes cuernos en la cabeza, en vez de los dos pequeños de siempre. Denji, junto con su compañero Aki llevan a Power a la Central de Seguridad Pública de los “Devil Hunters” para que la vea Makima.

> I’ll be honest with you—while I didn’t feel the same excitement as the vast majority of fans, I do admit that I was really happy to hear the news about this movie. When I saw the trailer last year, I was blown away by its animation and audiovisual style, especially since it was so different from what we saw in the anime back then. I was excited not only by the news that they were making a movie, but also by the fact that MAPPA would be continuing with the anime adaptation after three years of no updates. I remember the first time I watched Chainsaw Man back then, since that was when I had just started watching anime as it aired. While I was excited to watch Chainsaw Man, I was really surprised that they hadn’t continued the anime until years later. But what surprised me most of all was the absurd number of comments and opinions claiming it was a “bad adaptation.” I mean, I don’t know what anime they watched, honestly, but what I remember is a very good adaptation that really hooked me and helped me get familiar with the story and some of the characters. It’s true that there were a few animation details, like the use of CGI (3D) in some parts of the anime.

>
Les seré sincero, si bien no tuve la emoción que tuvo la gran mayoría de fanáticos, sí admito que me alegró mucho la noticia de esta película. Cuando llegué a ver el trailer el año pasado me impresionó demasiado su animación y estilo audiovisual, sobre todo porque llegó a ser muy diferente a lo que se llegó a ver en su momento con el anime. No solo me emocionó la noticia de que sacarían una película, sino el hecho de que MAPPA continuaría con dicha adaptación animada luego de tres años sin ninguna novedad. Recuerdo la vez que ví Chainsaw Man en su momento ya que en ese entonces había empezado con esto de ver animes en emisión. Si bien me emocionó ver Chainsaw Man, me extrañó mucho que no le hubieran dado continuación al anime sino ya pasados los años. Pero lo que más me extrañó de todo fue la cantidad absurda de comentarios y opiniones de que fue una “mala adaptación”. O sea, no sé qué anime vieron, la verdad, pero lo que yo recuerdo es una muy buena adaptación que me enganchó bastante y me hizo familiarizarme un poco con su historia y algunos de sus personajes. Si es cierto que hubo uno que otro detalle en su animación como lo fue el uso del CGI (3D) en algunos momentos del anime.

> But personally, I really liked the cinematic style MAPPA brought to the anime, not to mention the way they directed the story from start to finish with transitions and plot twists that really hooked me. But anyway, I don’t want to talk any more about the anime itself since it’s been a long time since I watched it and I don’t remember the entire story very well. Besides, here I’ll be talking about the movie itself, which serves as a pretty perfect continuation of that anime adaptation. You can see this perfectly from the moment it starts. Aside from its cinematic format, the movie also features a more cinematic direction and approach, with fascinating and very detailed shots. But the best part is the plot, which shifts from an ordinary day in our protagonist’s life to suddenly becoming a scene straight out of a romance-comedy anime when Makima asks Denji out on a date. What happens next might seem a bit strange to many, but for me, it held a certain intrinsic value and meaning tied precisely to what the world of cinema always conveys to us.

>
Pero en lo personal me gustó mucho ese estilo cinematográfico que le dió MAPPA al anime, eso sin mencionar la forma en la que dirigieron la historia de principio a fin con transiciones y giros de trama que me engancharon bastante. Pero bueno, no quiero hablar más del anime como tal ya que ha pasado mucho tiempo desde aquella vez que la vi y no recuerdo bien su historia en su totalidad. Además, aquí les hablaré de la película como tal, la cual sirve como una continuación bastante perfecta a dicha adaptación animada. Esto se puede apreciar perfectamente desde el momento en el que empieza. Aparte del formato cine que posee, la película contiene también una dirección y un enfoque más cinematográfico, con planos fascinantes y muy bien detallados. Pero lo mejor es la trama, la cual pasa de un día común y corriente de nuestro protagonista a volverse de repente en una escena sacada de un anime de romance y comedia cuando Makima invita a Denji a una cita. Lo que sucede después puede que sea un tanto extraño para muchos, pero para mí tuvo cierto valor y significado intrínseco relacionado justamente con lo que el mundo del cine nos transmite siempre.

> To give you a little context without giving away too many spoilers, I’ll just say that Makima and Denji’s date basically involves watching several movies back-to-back at the theater. After five seemingly popular choices that neither of them really liked, the evening ends with one last movie that no one else is watching—just the two of them—and that ended up touching their hearts. I think the message is clear here: not all of today’s popular movies have to be liked by everyone. Sometimes, the best movie is the one that “changes your life” forever. This is something I really liked about this film, which features scenes like the one I just described throughout its runtime of over an hour and a half. While it has its fair share of action and comedy, the anime also manages to balance romance and drama in a way that feels quite natural. Not to mention all the fantastical elements the work itself contains, which makes it a bit more special than what is typically found. The curious thing about all this is that, yes, it is a Shōnen-targeted action and fantasy anime.

>
Para darles un poco de contexto sin tener que dar muchos spoilers, solo les diré que dicha cita que tienen Makima y Denji se resume en ver varias películas seguidas juntos en el cine. Entre cinco elecciones aparentemente populares que no les termina de gustar a ninguno de los dos, la velada termina con una última película que nadie más ve -solo ellos dos- y que les terminó llegando al corazón. Creo que el mensaje es claro aquí: no todas las películas populares de la actualidad tienen que llegar a gustarle a todo el mundo. A veces, la mejor película es la que llega a “cambiar tu vida” para siempre. Esto es algo que me gustó mucho de esta película, que posee escenas como la que les acabo de describir a lo largo de su más de hora y media de duración. Si bien tiene su buen repertorio de acción y comedia, el anime logra equilibrar también el romance y el drama de una forma que sea bastante natural. Esto sin contar todos los elementos fantásticos que tiene la obra como tal, lo cual lo hace un tanto más especial de lo que ya llega a ser comúnmente. Lo curioso de todo esto es que, si, es un anime de acción y fantasía de demografía Shōnen.

> This means that the target audience for this film is teenagers, plain and simple. That’s why the plot shifts from what appears to be a typical RomCom—complete with Fanservice—to a film packed with action, chases, and tons and tons of explosions. It’s also why the main cast consists mostly of young adults or teenagers, such as Denji and Reze herself. By the way, as for this girl, I’ll just say that she’s one of the best characters introduced and developed in this film. Of course, we’re talking about the film’s co-lead and main antagonist. So it’s only natural that she has such excellent character development, especially with that amazing ending they give us, which provides a perfect conclusion for a character like Reze. The film also helps highlight this character through both the script and certain visual elements. One of the things that really fascinated me about the script is the story of the country mouse and the city mouse. Not only do they explain this story to us, but they also apply it to the film and its characters in a way that’s hard to forget.

>
Esto quiere decir que el público objetivo de esta obra son los chicos adolescentes como tal. Es por eso que la trama de la película pasa de ser un aparente RomCom con Fanservice y todo a convertirse luego en una obra repleta de acción, persecución y muchas, pero que muchas explosiones. También es por eso que tenemos a un grupo de personajes principales mayormente jóvenes o adolescentes como lo es el caso de Denji o la misma Reze. Por cierto, en cuanto a esta chica, solo les diré que es de los mejores personajes que han presentado y desarrollado en esta película. Claro, estamos hablando de la co-protagonista y a la vez antagonista principal de la película. Así que es normal que tenga su excelente desarrollo, sobre todo con ese grandioso final que nos dan, el cual le da un cierre perfecto a dicho personaje como lo es Reze. La película también nos ayuda a resaltar dicho personaje tanto con el guión como con ciertos elementos visuales. Una de las cosas que me fascinaron bastante del guión es el relato del ratón de campo y el ratón de ciudad. No solo nos explican dicho relato, sino que le dan una aplicación a la película junto con sus personajes de manera que es difícil de olvidar.

> For example, in the case of Denji, our protagonist, he prefers to be a city mouse, who eats well but lives with the high risk of dying at any moment. In contrast, there are several characters in this film who prefer to be country mice, living peacefully and safely, but without the luxuries of the city. The moral is clear here as well: the meaning of life will always be governed by the pleasures and choices each person makes. What’s fascinating about Denji is that he stands out from most generic protagonists in this demographic because of how childlike and innocent he is. Despite having nearly invincible power, he has the disadvantage of being easily manipulated by women like Makima or Reze. And not only that, but this very ease of manipulation makes him a dangerous tool. To explain this, I think I’d need to go into a bit more detail about how the power hierarchy works, the origin of the demons, and their nature in this fictional world. But before that, I’d rather tell you why I think Denji is different from the other protagonists. Or well, not entirely, since he does end up resembling the typical generic protagonist quite a bit.

>
Por ejemplo, en el caso de Denji, nuestro protagonista, él prefiere ser un ratón de ciudad, el cual come bien, pero vive con el alto riesgo de morir en cualquier momento. En cambio, hay varios personajes que vemos en esta película que prefieren ser el ratón de campo, el cual vive tranquilo y con seguridad, pero sin los lujos de la ciudad. La moraleja es clara aquí también, el sentido de la vida siempre se regirá por los placeres y las decisiones que cada uno tenga. Lo fascinante de Denji es que se diferencia de la mayoría de protagonistas genéricos de esta demografía debido a lo infantil e inocente que es. A pesar de tener un poder casi invencible, tiene la desventaja de ser fácilmente manipulable por mujeres como Makima o Reze. Y no solo eso, sino que dicha facilidad de manipulación que tiene lo hace convertirse en una peligrosa herramienta. Para esto creo que haría falta explicar un poco cómo funciona el tema de la escala de poderes, el origen de los demonios y su naturaleza en este mundo ficticio. Pero antes de eso quisiera mejor decirles el por qué pienso que Denji es diferente a los demás protagonistas. O bueno, no del todo ya que si llega a parecerse mucho al típico protagonista genérico.

> But what makes him special is the simple fact that he’s just a hormonal teenager without much of a brain. His way of seeing and living in this world is as straightforward as it gets, boiling down to having enough to eat and sleeping soundly. This outlook on life allows him to make decisions with confidence and live his own life as if tomorrow meant nothing to him. Perhaps that’s why he stands out so much—because he thinks neither of the future nor the past, but simply lives in the present without many worries. In a world where fear becomes a real and devastating danger, that’s fascinating to witness. Because yes, in short, the demons that exist in this world are born from humanity’s greatest fears, as is the case with the Holocaust, for example. Reze may also be a perfect example of this, especially given what we learn about her and her origins at the end of the film. I find the way these fantastical elements intertwine with the personality and identity of every individual we meet in this anime to be fascinating. But what I like most is the way the work itself highlights each character and ultimately destroys them in the end.

>
Pero lo que lo hace especial es el simple hecho de que sea solo un adolescente hormonal y sin mucho cerebro. Su forma de ver y vivir en este mundo es de lo más simple que se pueda escuchar, resumiendose en tener para comer y dormir tranquilo. Dicha visión de su vida lo hace tomar decisiones con seguridad y vivir su propia vida como si el mañana no fuera nada para él. Tal vez por eso destaca bastante, porque no piensa ni en el futuro ni en el pasado, sino que solo vive el presente sin tantas preocupaciones. Eso, en un mundo donde el miedo se convierte en un peligro real y desolador, es muy fascinante de ver. Porque sí, en resumen los demonios que existen en este mundo nacen de los miedos más grandes que tiene la humanidad, como lo es el caso del Holocausto, por ejemplo. Reze puede que sea también un ejemplo perfecto para esto, sobre todo con lo que llegamos a saber de ella y su origen al final de la película. Considero que la forma en la que dichos elementos fantásticos se entremezclan con la personalidad e identidad de cada individuo que conocemos en este anime es fascinante. Pero lo que más me gusta es la forma en la que la misma obra resalta a cada personaje y lo termina destruyendo al final.

> Yeah, call me a masochist or whatever, but I think what makes this anime special is just how bleak the ending is for every single supporting and/or significant character. But hey, that’s just me—I enjoy works that tear you apart inside. I also love it when a work has audiovisual quality that blows your mind. In this case, MAPPA really outdid itself in a way that’s hard to put into words with this film. Aside from the quality and visual details, the color palette, animation style, and fluidity are absurdly improved compared to the anime. It’s obvious that, being a film as such, it has that cinematic approach throughout much of it. But what MAPPA does here is so impressive that it feels like you’re watching a live-action film—but animated. The camera angles and static or moving shots, the transitions, and the composition of each scene are fascinating. But what’s most fascinating, of course, are the visual effects, especially in the film’s action scenes. It’s not for nothing that it’s the best animation studio in history, but the way it constructs and animates the fights is absolutely insane.

>
Si, díganme masoquista o lo que sea, pero considero que lo que hace especial este anime es lo desalentador que es el final de cada personaje secundario y/o relevante que tiene. Pero bueno, ese soy yo que disfruto de las obras que te destruyen por dentro. Así como también me encanta que una obra tenga una calidad audiovisual que te vuelva loco. En este caso MAPPA se lució de una forma que no tiene una descripción exacta con esta película. Aparte de la calidad y los detalles visuales que tiene, la paleta de colores, el estilo de animación y la fluidez mejora de una forma absurda en comparación con el anime. Es evidente que, al ser una película como tal, tenga dicho enfoque cinematográfico en gran parte de la misma. Pero lo que hace MAPPA aquí es tan impresionante que pareciera que estuvieras viendo una película como tal, pero animada. Los enfoques y planos fijos o en movimiento, las transiciones y la composición de cada escenario es fascinante. Pero lo que más fascina, por supuesto, son los efectos visuales, sobre todo en las escenas de acción que tiene la película. No por nada es el mejor estudio de animación de toda la historia, pero la forma en la que construye y anima las peleas es una completa locura.

> The sound effects are excellent too, but they’re nothing compared to the film’s soundtrack. Seriously, there’s one scene in particular that’s truly impressive—not just visually, but because of the soundtrack playing during it. That piano solo in the famous pool scene deserves to have gone so viral on social media. Honestly, I think the film’s soundtrack elevates every scene it plays in to its full glory, as the emotions you feel while watching them are a clear testament to that. Anyway, here’s an animated film that’s definitely worth watching, even if you haven’t seen the anime.
Personally, I give it a 9.5/10 rating in terms of the dark fantasy, action, romance, comedy, and drama genres.

>
Los efectos de sonido son excelentes también, pero nada comparado con la banda sonora que tiene la película. De verdad, hay una escena como tal que llega a impresionar bastante, no solo a nivel visual, sino por la banda sonora que se escucha en la misma. Ese solo de piano que tiene esa famosa escena de la piscina merece que se haya vuelto tan viral en redes sociales. Sinceramente, considero que dicha banda sonora que tiene la película logra elevar a su máximo esplendor cada escenario en el que suena ya que las emociones que uno tiene al verlas son una muestra clara de ello. En fin, les dejo aquí una película animada que sí vale la pena ver, aún si no has visto el anime, inclusive.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 9.5/10 en lo que respecta al género de fantasía oscura, acción, romance, comedia y drama.

>
Tell me, have you seen this anime yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>

body.title: I have a new favourite Pokemon
body.body: I say this now, but now that I am thinking about it if someone was to ask me \

I don't know what to answer.

But after playing Pokemon Polished Crystal, catching every single Pokemon in their Pokédex and completing all the side missions and trainers, one of my all time favourite Pokemon is the alolan moltres.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYS9WengntKrBW5ABArdq3g2KCRd2bb3zknwKKX1PaVon/IMG_9938.jpg 

I am playing this using the Delta app on my iPhone and its been super fun, I am able to save multiple files and put the speed to 3 or 4x so I can do things way faster than regular speed if I am hunting for shiny eggs. One of my favourite emulators that work for apple products, can play Nintendo, Super Nintendo, N64, Gameboy, Gameboy advanced and Nintendo DS with Delta app

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcWjmZf8skQ97BcytNgpLZbHRcVEQbGxWHaiQmq3kycT6/IMG_9940.jpg 

This particular molters has a very powerful ability that works well with its stats. You will notice that the relaxed nature gives it a higher than normal defence stat and a lower than normal speed stat. this works well for 2 reasons. For one the defence protects it from getting rekt hard from physical attacks, and the speed makes it go second. Now why is going second good? Well its Berserk ability makes the sp attack go nice and high when its damaged below half health. Giving it a powerful counter attack when its time to fight back

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmevtU5uyHaio5NdV1PAa9d6wczBH9khxuyukKoD835mEm/IMG_9943.jpg 


This is where Sucker Punch comes in, Sucker Punch is like quick attack or extreme speed making Moltres attack first, so if it's about to get knocked out it can hit hard first no matter what. nasty plot significantly increases its special attack which makes that dark pulse super wild

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSDWPJJh8d8iNgDLoj8oKNcKm6SYNvGNThVrMwXxwGbxm/IMG_9942.jpg 

Now what you see here is something I found that blew my mind, it's the Pokérus virus that boosts stats. I got it randomly and that is right, I made sure to spread that thing among all of my guys. Almost all of my Pokemon are infected (that's a good thing). Now this one with the circle without the legs means this moltres can't spread the virus but it still retains the stat boosting effects.

I really like this Moltres, its such a powerhouse its wild to me how it was able to sweep teams like its nothing. The dark type is wild and spanks so many enemies like they are nothing.

body.title: 🇵🇱 Weekendowe „atrakcje” 😅 / \n🇬🇧 Weekend “attractions” 😅: May 24 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6bfa5c0e-b555-418c-8572-40344056abb4.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/95b3d184-5997-47c3-a01c-41de660a5fc4.jpg)
🇵🇱 Ten weekend miał być spokojny. Ja rozłożony przez infekcję, zatoki kompletnie zawalone, nos nie działa, do tego dziwne osłabienie mięśni i ogólne rozbicie. Szczerze? Najchętniej przeleżałbym cały weekend pod kocem i próbował po prostu dojść do siebie. Los miał jednak trochę inne plany 😅 --- 🇬🇧 This weekend was supposed to be quiet. I was already knocked down by an infection — blocked sinuses, nose completely useless, strange muscle weakness and that overall feeling of being completely drained. Honestly, I could have spent the entire weekend under a blanket just trying to recover. But life apparently had different plans 😅
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c10e1f0a-644f-49e9-9a00-e2acac64e158.jpg)
--- 🇵🇱 Wszystko zaczęło się od kota, który gdzieś podczas swoich okolicznych wędrówek przebił sobie łapę. Żona zawiozła go do weterynarza, rana została oczyszczona, dostał lekką narkozę i wydawało się, że wszystko wraca do normy. W sobotę rano pojechali jeszcze na kontrolę i kolejną porcję antybiotyków przeciw zakażeniu. Po powrocie zaczęło się robić naprawdę niepokojąco. Kot zaczął chwiać się na nogach, miał otwarty pyszczek i bardzo szybki, płytki oddech. Wtedy było już jasne, że sytuacja robi się poważna. --- 🇬🇧 Everything started with our cat, who somehow injured his paw during one of his local adventures. My wife took him to the vet, the wound was cleaned, he received light anesthesia and at first everything seemed fine again. On Saturday morning they went back for a follow-up visit and another dose of antibiotics. But after returning home, things suddenly became really worrying. The cat started losing balance, breathing with his mouth open and taking very rapid, shallow breaths. At that moment it became obvious that this was turning serious.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3c2a6fc7-c713-4939-b3c4-dde83b7ded86.jpg)
--- 🇵🇱 Telefon do weterynarza — niestety usłyszeliśmy, że trzeba rozszerzyć diagnostykę i jechać do kliniki weterynaryjnej w Jaworzu. Więc szybka decyzja, samochód, ekspresówka i jedziemy ratować kota. W klinice wykonano pełną diagnostykę i okazało się, że pojawił się obrzęk płuc. Najprawdopodobniej organizm źle zareagował na narkozę albo któryś z podanych leków. Kot został w klinice, a my wróciliśmy do domu czekać na telefon. O 23 dostaliśmy wiadomość: „stan ciężki, ale stabilny — jeśli przeżyje noc, są szanse że z tego wyjdzie.” To była naprawdę długa noc. --- 🇬🇧 We called the local vet, but unfortunately heard that further diagnostics were needed and we should head to the veterinary clinic in Jaworze. So there was no time to think — car, expressway and full focus on saving the cat. At the clinic they performed a full examination and discovered pulmonary edema. Most likely his body reacted badly either to the anesthesia or one of the medications. The cat stayed at the clinic while we returned home waiting for updates. At 11 PM we got the call: “His condition is serious but stable — if he survives the night, there’s a good chance.” That was a very long night.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e9a019ba-b19b-4e93-94e8-7342c7d81b07.jpg)
--- 🇵🇱 W niedzielę rano znowu klinika. Kot dostał dalsze leczenie — leki zmniejszające obrzęk płuc, namiot tlenowy i pełną kontrolę parametrów. Późnym popołudniem zadzwonił telefon: można odebrać kota. Obrzęk płuc został praktycznie opanowany, oddech wrócił blisko normy, a stan się ustabilizował. Dopiero wtedy wyszło też, że problem prawdopodobnie ma głębsze podłoże kardiologiczne związane z wiekiem. Osłabione serce w połączeniu z narkozą mogło uruchomić cały ten chaos. Staruszek wrócił do domu, od razu rzucił się na miskę z jedzeniem, więc apetyt wrócił 😅 Teraz czeka go wizyta u kociego kardiologa i… definitywny zakaz samotnych wypraw po okolicy. --- 🇬🇧 Sunday morning meant another trip to the clinic. The cat received further treatment — medication to reduce the pulmonary edema, oxygen therapy and constant monitoring. Late in the afternoon we finally got the call: we could bring him home. The pulmonary edema had been reduced almost completely, breathing returned close to normal and his condition stabilized. Only then did it become clear that the real issue was probably an underlying heart condition related to age. A weakened heart combined with anesthesia may have triggered the entire situation. The old guy finally came home, immediately attacked his food bowl, so thankfully his appetite returned 😅 Now he’ll need further cardiology consultations and… a permanent ban on solo neighborhood adventures.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d6e10ac7-9170-4b4b-af21-0f4feb8b64cf.jpg)
--- 🇵🇱 Tak więc weekend pełen „atrakcji” zdecydowanie się udał 😅 Ja zawalony zatokami, kot walczący z obrzękiem płuc i kilkaset kilometrów między domem a kliniką weterynaryjną. Najważniejsze jednak, że wszyscy wróciliśmy do domu. --- 🇬🇧 So yes… this weekend was definitely full of “attractions” 😅 Me struggling with sinus infection, the cat fighting pulmonary edema and hundreds of kilometers between home and the veterinary clinic. But the most important thing is that everyone made it back home.
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ec7a93c7-b047-4cce-b959-7d1b7ce07cd2.jpg)

_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@ptaku/actifit-ptaku-20260525t042250584z)_

昨天上午，我陪着Sheya总算把所有家庭作业都做完了，下午想着让她放松一下，等她睡了午觉后，我们就出门转转。

这几天室外温度太高，不想待在户外，索性就去商场逛逛。可到了商场无非就是不二星球电玩城、萌宠乐园这些地方，后来我在美团上翻看游玩项目，刷到了拼豆体验。

看团购价格也不贵，只要二十多块钱，门店还就在万达商圈，当即就决定带孩子去体验一番。我们先走到万达一楼，打算从这里穿行过去，拼豆店在万达后方金街的二楼。路过的时候刚好看到一家体彩站点，我便买了张刮刮乐。

平日里碰到这类门店，我偶尔都会买上一张二十元的彩票，这类奖项大多都是小奖，中奖几率还算可以。我让Sheya自己挑选，我们一起刮开后，刚好中了二十元奖金。我觉得运气差不多也就这样了，再继续刮也很难中奖，打算就此停手。可她还想再玩一张，于是又让她挑选了一张，没想到这次直接中了五十元。见收获不错，我们便见好就收，拿着奖金去找店铺。

这家拼豆店名叫我嘞个豆，我们找了好一会儿才找到位置。如今金街不少商铺都经营不下去，整条街看着比较萧条。店铺开在二楼，一开始在扶梯下方来回找寻都没找到，后来直接顺着扶梯上楼，刚到二楼入口就看见了门店。

店面不算大，里面隔成了两层。店主年纪轻轻，也就二十来岁，热情上前招呼我们，询问有没有玩过拼豆。我和Sheya都是第一次体验，老板就让我们先在小红书挑选喜欢的像素图案，选好后对照图案上的颜色编码，去自助区拿对应的豆子，同时还给我们配备了拼板等工具，拼板尺寸不够还能拼接使用。简单讲解完玩法，上手难度并不算高。

不过对小朋友来说，格子面积很小，需要逐个对位摆放，特别考验眼力和耐心，一不小心就容易摆放出错。拼接过程里，作品两次意外被碰散，当时心里挺郁闷的，但还是耐着性子一点点复原。前后总共花了两个半小时，才完整拼好了星星人造型，完成之后心里特别有成就感。

最后交由老板帮忙熨烫定型，老板询问我想要哪种熨烫样式，我对此并不了解，就让店家随意处理就行。成品效果看着很不错，装上小链条后就能挂在书包上当做挂件。

这期间店里来了的不少客人，有结伴而来的小情侣，也有独自专心制作大型作品的成年人，大多还是妈妈带着女儿一起来玩，大家都做得十分认真。我觉得这是很不错的亲子休闲方式。久坐两个多小时，我的腰都有些发酸。中途Sheya还跑去和店家的小妹妹一起玩耍，后半段基本都是我帮忙收尾。

整体这次体验还算不错，下次可以让Sheya独立尝试完成。

body.body:
I read both of your posts on The Power of Now and I really liked how they complement each other. In the first one, you focused on the importance of acting in the present and not letting procrastination steal our chances, while in this second one you dive deeper into the inner experience, those loops of thoughts that create noise and pull us away from calm. That honesty gives your writing a lot of strength.  

I also appreciated how you bring Tolle’s ideas down to simple, everyday gestures: breathing, noticing what’s around us, valuing people and community. They’re small steps but very concrete, and they make the book’s message feel close and practical. Compared to the motivational tone of your first post, this one feels more personal and reflective, like you’re sharing your own struggle with the mind.  

Taken together, the two posts give a fuller picture, first the impact of the book as a shift in perspective, and now the way you’re weaving it into your daily life. It feels like a living reading, one that grows with you and invites us to look both inward and outward at the same time.

body.title: Musical Monday “ Lo Feo“ (Liuba Maria Ebia) @rut.hernandez06 esp eng
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfJDg2iVuLpJsqsiSNqi1s8ciSnJEgHigonwhRKdcJgA9/img_2457.png)

https://youtu.be/1lhT1HA2pyk?si=OBzb4uKg6nAx1CTB

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)

English

Hello, hello everyone. I'm back after a long time!! But I come with a lot of energy and desire to share the music again and the love I feel for it. I hope you have had some beautiful months. Coincidentally, the other day was my birthday and well, I was sick so I continue today but well, I hope to get better from the flu. I hope you have a beautiful week so I come to talk to you a little about the song I bring today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)

Lo feo is a song by singer-songwriter Liuba Maria Ebia, it is a song that I remember with great affection since when I was a child in the blackouts my mother or grandmother sang it to me, I even have images of what I imagined when they sang me the song of when I was a child. This is a children's song but I think it's one of the most beautiful children's songs. Since it can even be a song heard by an adult, since the vibe and calm of this song heard is very beautiful.

Lo Feo is about how when you put love to things they change and become beautiful. In the little things that seem ugly to us they can take a turn and become something nice just by fixing them or looking at them with affection.


I hope you like my interpretation, I hope I don't leave hive for a long time and resume my performances in hive. I am grateful for everything I have always and with every community. Today I thank @music-community for making me a space to teach the music I perform.


I hope everyone has a beautiful day and week. A huge hug!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)

Español

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)

Hola hola a todos. Estoy de vuelta después de mucho tiempo!! Pero vengo con mucha energía y ganas de volver a compartir la música y el amor que siento por esta.  Espero que hayan tenido unos hermosos meses. Casualmente antier fue mi cumple y pues estaba enferma asi sigo hoy pero bueno espero mejorar de la gripe. Espero tengan una hermosa semana asi que vengo a hablarle un poco de la canción que traigo hoy.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)

Lo feo es una canción de la cantautora Liuba Maria Ebia, es una canción que recuerdo con mucho cariño ya que cuando era niña en los apagones mi mama o abuela me la cantaban, incluso tengo imágenes de lo que me imaginaba cuando me cantaban la canción de cuando era una niña. Esta es una canción infantil pero me parece de las canciones infantiles mas lindas. Ya que puede ser incluso una canción escuchada por un adulto, ya que la vibra y calma de esta canción escuchada muy hermosa.

Lo Feo trata de como cuando uno le pone amor a las cosas van cambiando y se vuelven bonitas. En las pequeñas cosas que nos parecen feas pueden dar un giro y volverse algo lindo solo con arreglarlas o mirarlas com cariño.

Espero les guste mi interpretación, espero no irme de hive dentro de mucho tiempo y retomar mis performances en hive. Estoy agradecida con todo hive siempre y con cada comunidad. En el día de hoy agradezco a @music-community por hacerme un espacio donde enseñar la música que interpreto. 
Espero que todos tengan un hermoso día y semana. Un abrazo enorme!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR86eHPqNsqWvg7QDstvYUE1TUmBDG4UxZD2mMRqxaGMK/img_2460.jpg)
