body.title: Cómo convertir recompensas digitales en pan real? Mi sueño: \
body.body:
Hola de nuevo, comunidad de Hive! Soy Darwin, panadero en Caracas.

Estoy muy emocionado por el apoyo que he recibido estos días. Pero más allá de aprender código o mejorar mi economía, tengo un sueño que me da vueltas en la cabeza desde que conocí esta plataforma.

Quiero que mi Panadería Ebenezer sea el motor de una iniciativa que he llamado \

. Mi idea es usar una parte de las recompensas que genere aquí con mis publicaciones para producir pan artesanal y entregarlo personalmente a niños y abuelos que pasan hambre en las calles de mi ciudad, Caracas.

Sé que en Hive las ideas con propósito crecen rápido, por eso hoy quiero preguntarles algo productivo para empezar con el pie derecho:

¿Conocen alguna iniciativa o usuario en Hive que ya haga labor social y que me sirva de guía para hacerlo de forma transparente y efectiva?

No quiero que sea solo \

, quiero que sea un proyecto con orden y que la comunidad pueda ver el impacto real. Me encantaría leer sus consejos y experiencias.

¡Gracias por acompañarme en este camino!

DIOS LES BENDIGA

body.title: The Majestic Illuminated Bible [Review]
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779681350881-39d3d03d1cddc2dd.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jongolson/34063d6c)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jongolson/34063d6c)


---

**Note:** This is a repurposed upload of the review I did for my YouTube bible review channel.  I always want to make sure this gets uploaded to the blockchain, as well as YouTube.  Blockchain content is VERY important going forward!!

**Disclaimer:** I more than likely called this the Majestic Illustrated Bible numerous times throughout the review. Apologies for that, as it's the Majestic Illuminated Bible.

I saw this bible on Tim Wildsmith's channel a few months ago and had to take a look at it.  Funny enough, a local bookstore had a copy arrive recently, so I took advantage of the VERY affordable price point and decided to grab a copy.

Let me put a few things out of the way first....This will more than likely never become a daily reader for me. But that's not what I thought it would be either. This to me, is a keepsake.  A historical version of the bible, created with today's technology that allows for this incredible artwork to be treasured for years to come.

Here's the details of the Majestic Illuminated Bible in the KJV:

- Type done by 2K Denmark
- 9.25 font type size
- Over 100 illustrations from Reformation era artist Virgil Solis.
- Single column, paragraph style layout
- Massive margins
- Topical verse finder
- Full color maps
- Ribbon marker
- **Dimensions:** 9.5 x 6.5 x 1.25

It comes in two 'Leatherluxe' colors - Green (in review) and Brown plus a hard cover cloth edition.

**Published by:** Majestic Illuminated / Hatchet Group / Faith Works

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=jongolson/34063d6c)

body.title: Splinterlands: Gifts, battles, and a cruel lesson[Eng-Spn]
body.body:
> Hey Hive and Splinterlands folks, this is so exciting! You sign up for Splinterlands and the first thing you see is a free Archon card! It happened to me just today. Check out my new Archon card, the **Unceasing Sage**! Absolutely awesome! I'm so happy, thanks @thebighigg, it's such a nice gesture. I'm grateful. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23u5ZEecd58aAet9SdecTt4HAiA5mKi6yKcAMhVtRTmP2zkstxyhFTKcEyNLnEdDVkKQk.png) I'm looking for one of the new features in Splinterlands: **The Wheel of Fortune** to spin, but I can't find it. However, I'm going to do some battles and earn my rewards for today. I also learned while forming my attack lineup that to use **The Musketeer A'llan** and other cards, I have to level up some of my Archons. I'll have to set that goal and try to level up my Archons as soon as possible. My first battle today was a complete failure. And my second battle was just as catastrophic. I had to fight against the user @arribaeltelon, and she defeated me in a truly awful way. Hehehe, ugh, how awful. The Tafarian Lion was furious, but @arribaeltelon showed no mercy, hehehe. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/48HftGbDhpFUA9KtUz2G2HRaZU9fLXGnbpNqjMhpqDWkaqtfniyaGZ4uygdUzUuFmP.png) I achieved my first victory! Come on, we can do this! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tGXZm3VuLWQzRYSoUSkNqjuX15zevmV1ropFM16fxZTxMP3Uu9ArSBSP7JBFuatDvZ2.png) After a while, I finally achieved my second victory. Today has been tough, especially since most of my strongholds are blocked. I'm practically defenseless in first place. @arribaeltelon defeated me for the second time, hehehe. This was painful. However, I've now managed three consecutive victories thanks to the protection of **Captain Nim of the Guard**, who has been a great help, given that my strongholds are blocked. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tkmdUbTHuYZoFY8mVsUqA2hwV6Gmg4M8LAFfhpm3TJLq3dnid92YjeDxfL8oyFmYfM1.png) I managed to win my battles with a lot of effort, but today was a bad day in the arena. I absolutely need to level up my Archons to be able to fight my opponents. They seem to be preparing very well, and I can't let my guard down. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tkjm7Y8yb2UvCfh6DrbBapLR2yqTZnAZq1mzqurwRPt7dfTNap4jnkEh6AZmGtvgkAK.png) I was so excited when I finally got my five wins, so it was time to claim my rewards. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23swngj2xM6ydF5xwCntmig568m5QdXSbsF6vu9jW7o4aYACh8jbeH3Zf8sCbrqieokC8.png) My rewards were awesome, guys! I even got an epic card. Now that's real luck! My effort today was totally worth it. The cards I got today as rewards were: *Hungry Ulund* (Common Card): An Ulund-type character with a cost of 5, attack 2, shield 1, and health 3. It's a solid unit for absorbing damage or applying pressure in the mid-game. *Step* (Epic Card): This was the big surprise! This card is a real gem; A rodent with a cost of 4, attack of 1, and health of 3. Its epic rarity usually guarantees special abilities that are very valuable for tactical control. 1 Entry: for a one-card contest, I hope I'm lucky this time. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/angeluxx/23tkpLdu5p2UvEf3T4EqefQEJih1XCkhQkpDiesPNXNYwyny43BsRMddDXSXozhAL49ZH.png) Very happy with my rewards, guys. Although it took me a while to get the wins, my time and effort were worth it. *We invite you to join the fascinating world of Splinterlands. Here's my link to register completely free: https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=angeluxx* ---- >Sources *Screenshots taken from the [Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/) website Character backstories taken from the [Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/) book Thumbnail created in Gemini Translated with Google Translate*

body.title: Beautiful Butterfly: Buying Rising Star NFT \
body.body: This afternoon, I was sleeping and resting when I was woken up by my niece's voice. What she said was \

![Green Red Woman in Nature Photo Collage_20260525_102532_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23uQtsXrnfT2iukzmeKneQreJLtwsuQadu7UiaPuHNZ2K1PahktkHxsdy2HjWztcrmr6a.jpg)

So I was curious and went with my niece to where the big butterfly was. It was resting on the grass by the stream and it was about 6 inches in size. This butterfly has 4 distinct spots on its wings, which are light brown and yellow. What's more, it has a snake-shaped mark on the top of both wings. It's really unique and crazy. 

![IMG_20260524_161337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/EokcDYhw7wCwYv9m7nTnoyUJxPBCwv2oaqEBvacrDhqLXCFzHgD1tjnzjGPqc8Agv9i.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_161400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/EogNo6M7mRN6orh6JHwNb26j5Hb6N7xyygYiXXNMpnBsPpmrpd98Spckwa699CruPAt.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_161353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/EoEqymPfJDBZJhDba7c1Xr1zCkZ7n2Tmd6T4BVSAevFGCRmsySq3rZ7wxeyXDzmKQNw.jpg)

Usually, such big butterflies are not seen in our area. These butterflies can only be found in specially protected national parks. There is a butterfly museum in Pyin Oo Lwin National Park, but since photography and video are not allowed, the public cannot watch the documentary video. I think this butterfly arrived from somewhere else because of the strong winds last night.  I had to take a photo of this rare and beautiful butterfly and share it with my Hive Blog friends so you could see and enjoy it.

![IMG_20260524_163818.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/EqYsghz22xYbFZ8nLPachqi3NwJJ2yZQambQXtYkZe72jGM9yByajk91F1ENSHQFong.jpg)

![IMG_20260524_163213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/Ep3dpaKLUMXo8sP394dydwNdb5xAU4XFDsg4ariaCQQA6K1DZR9eebeYjh9WSerDU7y.jpg)

### Buying Rising Star NFT \

I can't buy Card Packs in Rising Star Game. I don't know what kind of fixes are being made for Card Packs. I've been buying Packs in the game regularly to improve my Profile Status. So, in the meantime, I bought my favorite Cards from the In-game Market. The Card is S68a The Big Guy. 

![Screenshot_20260525_095748_com.kiwibrowser.browser_edit_497253680551203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23wMyiyj69siqMChZKEAYhnR9m9W836aiH5R6h1MP5woBqhBFK6LXqhL8QarmkmUgAi2n.jpg)

The Big Guy is a Seasonal card for Christmas 2023 and is a rare card because it is Animated. You can get this Card in two ways: directly from the Market or by Blending. If you get this card by Blending, it will cost you more than 10 Hives at the current price. I bought this card from the In-game Market for 300,000 Starbits, which only cost 6.8 Hives. So I saved 5 Hives. By purchasing this card, I was able to increase my Profile Status to 1.25k fans, 1.25k skill, 50 luck and 20 IM.  And since this card is unique, it also increases my rank in the game.

![Screenshot_20260525_095845_com.kiwibrowser.browser_edit_497278263738178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/myanmarkoko/23u5Zh7DFDvFvaNaoBAHk1FNZf9WLaK4vXS71twFsyqAEXNyUYzGSEonm9vypPUkD22fW.jpg)

body.title: Why More Players Are Switching to Better Volleyball Knee Pads Australia Options
body.body: I never really thought much about protective gear when it came to volleyball. Shoes felt kinda important, obviously, but things like knee pads always seemed optional to me, like it was no big deal. I mean sure, you can say they help a bit, yet I mostly just played and moved on, without thinking too hard about it. Something serious players wore, not people like us who mostly played weekend games and occasional evening practice. We were training on a harder court than usual, and during one defensive drill I dropped awkwardly while trying to save a low ball. It wasn’t some dramatic injury moment or anything, but I remember instantly feeling that sharp pressure through my knee. I kept playing, because that’s what everyone does. But later that night, walking up stairs suddenly felt way more noticeable than it should’ve. That was the point where I started looking into proper volleyball knee pads australia options instead of pretending I didn’t need them.

>First Look at Volleyball Gear in Australia A few days later, I kind a visited a sports gear warehouse around nearby. The place felt very practical , like nothings too much just ready. There were rows of volleyball stuff, stacked net systems, training equipment here and there, and shelves full of protective accessories. I honestly didn’t expect there to be so many variations of knee pads. Some things I noticed immediately: Lightweight knee pads designed for faster movement Thick padded versions for indoor hard courts Compression-style sleeves with hidden padding Breathable fabric options for longer sessions Different cuts depending on flexibility and support A few days after that, I ended up visiting a sports equipment warehouse that was pretty nearby. The whole place had a sort of practical vibe to it, you know like not flashy at all ,just useful. There were rows of volleyball gear, net systems stacked in uneven columns, then training equipment everywhere, and shelves loaded with protective accessories too. That gave me a bit more confidence in what I was looking at.

>Why I Even Needed Volleyball Knee Pads Australia At first, I kept telling myself I could just “be more careful.” Which sounds logical until you actually start playing properly again. body.title: The best sweet rice beverage I've ever tasted (Esp/Eng)
body.body:
>

[Esp]

¡Saludos amados, espero se encuentren de buena salud!

Hace un tiempo durante mis caminatas he podido apreciar a un antiguo Volkswagen beetle en excelente estado detenido en distintos puntos de la ciudad, sin embargo parece que encontró un lugar donde lleva ya semanas. Es conducido por una chica el cual atiende, el vehículo es descapotable y ella se encuentra sirviendo lo que en mi país se conoce como Chicha al que puedes agregar dulces de tu preferencia.

Siempre he pasado mas no me detuve nunca a comprar su producto. Hoy paseaba con mi hijo menor y él me dijo: - Mami quiero chicha. Ambos veníamos exhaustos de una larga caminata y al ver su cara de \
no me pude negar, así que al fin me acerqué y compré dos de las bebidas que ofrece.

> [Eng] Greetings, my dears, I hope you are all in good health! For some time now, during my walks, I’ve noticed an old Volkswagen Beetle in excellent condition parked at various spots around the city; however, it seems it has found a spot where it’s been for weeks now. It’s driven by a young woman who runs the stall; the car is a convertible and she’s serving what in my country is known as chicha, to which you can add sweets of your choice. I’ve always walked past, but I’ve never stopped to buy anything. Today I was out walking with my youngest son and he said to me: ‘Mummy, I want some chicha.’ We were both exhausted from a long walk and, seeing that ‘please, Mummy’ look on his face, I couldn’t say no, so I finally went over and bought two of the drinks she was selling. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EokecmxQJeQZ9NVbK9m9WusjZrjS7HHDDc7FRacr5KBkGztwFhH9ipbkneeXzVSSqhm.png)

> [Esp] Para los fanáticos del Volkswagen beetle esto les flipará y lo digo porque conozco unos cuantos y a penas ven la imagen sonríen y se asombran incrédulos. La chica maneja el vehículo por toda la ciudad y se estaciona en un lugar, abre el techo del vehículo y se levanta para atender a sus clientes, tiene todo alli dentro, nevera, productos, es increíble y su atención es muy agradable y amorosa.

> [Eng] Volkswagen Beetle fans are going to love this – and I say that because I know a few, and as soon as they see the picture, they smile and look on in amazement. The girl drives the car all over town, parks it somewhere, opens the roof and stands up to serve her customers. She has everything in there – a fridge, products – it’s incredible, and she’s so friendly and lovely to deal with.
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EopuJbNdJuBGQ2u6ZdXwdhw2fkmXRcrMT7KvaKAJqU74KauV23mpqSHHjLYxeAUxRd2.png)

> [Esp] El producto que vende asombra más que el vehículo, de verdad es la chicha más sabrosa que he probado en mi vida y es super concentrada. Al tomarla sentí el cuerpo recuperar la energía perdida de la caminata y la cara de mi hijo, su expresión, era inmensamente feliz, claro, ambos tuvimos un hermoso día de compartir donde pude consentirlo mucho, procurando dejar buenos recuerdos llenos de amor. Así que si vas por la calle un día y encuentras a este particular vehículo, por favor apoya a la chica que lo maneja y no te arrepentirás de haber probado la chicha más rica del mundo. Hoy fue un día hermoso, bendecido, el cual disfruté mucho, vivo la vida en gratitud, disfrutando de lo verdadero, de mis seres queridos, de mi pequeña familia, es lo único que importa. No he podido llevar a diario mi contenido, pero ha sido solo por temas de servicio eléctrico, esperemos con fe ya no sé un problema. Bendiciones para todos vosotros. Namasté.

> [Eng] The product she sells is even more amazing than the vehicle itself; it really is the tastiest chicha I’ve ever tasted in my life, and it’s incredibly strong. As I drank it, I felt my body regain the energy I’d lost from the walk, and my son’s face—his expression—was one of immense happiness. Of course, we both had a wonderful day together, during which I was able to spoil him rotten, making sure to create lovely memories filled with love. So if you’re out and about one day and come across this rather unusual vehicle, please support the girl driving it – you won’t regret trying the tastiest chicha in the world. Today was a beautiful, blessed day, which I thoroughly enjoyed. I live my life with gratitude, savouring what truly matters: my loved ones and my little family—that’s all that counts. I haven’t been able to post my content every day, but that’s only been due to power cuts; let’s hope with faith that this won’t be a problem any longer. Blessings to you all. Namaste. ---

Hi friends, how are you all, I hope you are well and I wish you a long life. Today I am sharing with you a natural insect that I have seen with my own eyes and the name of this insect is Gryllotalpa Insect. This is a very familiar insect to me and I see this insect occasionally. This type of insect usually lives underground and whenever there is any rain, it sometimes comes out from under the ground. As soon as I saw it, I liked it so I took a few pictures with my own mobile and those pictures are presented above for all friends to observe.



A few days ago I saw this insect sitting on the floor in my room at night and it was raining outside. I saw it as a natural insect and it was very beautiful to look at. I saw it through the light of an electric lamp and it was moving from one side to the other on the floor. It was moving very fast and I was able to take a few pictures by turning on the flash light of my mobile. I sometimes see such insects in my room.

body.title: Ligas y Equilibrio [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

Ligas y Equilibrio. Las bandas de resistencia nos brindan beneficios increíbles para todo el cuerpo, debido a la gran cantidad de movimientos que podemos realizar y al bajo impacto que se tiene sobre los músculos, alejándolos de lesiones. Por otra parte; combinar el poder de las ligas, con ejercicios que favorecen el equilibrio, los beneficios serán mayores. Imagínense ustedes realizar bíceps unilateral apoyados en un solo pie; extensiones de tríceps en sentadilla apoyados de la punta de los pies y sentadillas abiertas con apertura de brazos; definitivamente estamos desafiando la estabilidad y activando todo el cuerpo. Sin duda alguna tenemos otra rutina potente, que te permitirá obtener resultados positivos y con menos peligro de lesión. De igual manera; no olvides trabajar a tu ritmo y a medida que avances, puedes incrementar la acción. Vente conmigo y dale movimiento a tu vida. >Resistance Bands and Balance. Resistance bands offer incredible benefits for the entire body, thanks to the wide variety of movements they allow and the low impact on the muscles, which helps prevent injuries. On the other hand, combining the power of resistance bands with exercises that promote balance will yield even greater benefits. Imagine performing one-arm bicep curls while balancing on one foot; tricep extensions in a squat position while balancing on your toes; and wide-legged squats with arms extended—we’re definitely challenging our stability and engaging the entire body. Without a doubt, we have another powerful routine that will help you achieve positive results with a lower risk of injury. Likewise, don’t forget to work at your own pace, and as you progress, you can increase the intensity. Join me and get your life moving.

![1000462079.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AJkSPsZdtCCXeNpfLeWKBB1gxRNiJjeUEkNyCvxsTFh6aQVd9M1XvAKb6tJu2SL.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **SENTADILLA SUMO CON TOQUE DE PISO**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas estilo sumo; codos flexionados con brazos al frente. >[**Warm-up 1**, **SUMO SQUAT WITH FLOOR TOUCH**]() >[Stance]() >Legs spread wide in a sumo stance; elbows bent with arms held in front.
![1000462039.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PupfAnPGj8PLCkhREDXc4p1x31JuqToD2YALjhtveHCREXdpSEMBKxeSdEC2.gif)
[Ejecución]() Activos en la posición indicada; procedemos a flexionar las rodillas, flexionamos el torso y con ambas manos tocamos el piso. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Starting in the position shown, bend your knees, bend forward at the waist, and touch the floor with both hands. Hold this position for 3 minutes.
![1000462041.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKCGMFxnU5Y74rA9QaqX4qVAu8uUEUsytoo6v6vM4rCnC2wVKgws94BSiPMaj76.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **DOBLE RODILLAZO FRONTAL CON TORSIÓN MÁS EXTENSIÓN Y FLEXIÓN DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera; codos flexionados con brazos al frente, manos a nivel del rostro. >[**Warm-up 2**, **DOUBLE FRONT KNEE RAISES WITH TWIST, PLUS ELBOW EXTENSION AND FLEXION**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart; elbows bent with arms in front, hands at face level.
![1000462043.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDhXxPoU8PmS3Pbvw6Tx3kwgZjrfmoz5boy1cSTtZdVrbwxKSrwEEQegpGjXza.gif)
[Ejecución]() Rápidamente; damos el primer rodillazo, acompañado de la flexión lateral del torso y la extensión lateral de ambos codos. Luego; rodillazo frontal con la misma pierna y la extensión de codos se hace igualmente de frente. Todo con ambas piernas durante 3 minutos contínuos. >[Execution]() >Quickly, perform the first knee strike, accompanied by a lateral bend of the torso and a lateral extension of both elbows. Next, perform a front knee strike with the same leg, extending your elbows forward as well. Repeat this sequence with both legs for 3 continuous minutes.
![1000462047.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKDhbV84XVnVLDk1WNoYCW3qccZ1bVW9BVEqrw6bc1Tysq89sgsZoZzLQFHqhK1.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **BÍCEPS UNILATERAL CON LIGA Y APOYO EN UN PIE**]() [Postura]() Ya tenemos de antemano las tobilleras colocadas; pasamos por una de ellas la liga que queda doble. Tomamos ambos mangos con la mano del mismo lado, extendemos el codo; la mano opuesta se coloca en la cadera y se flexiona la pierna que no tiene la liga; quedamos apoyados en una sola pierna. >[**Station 1**, **ONE-ARM BICEPS CURL WITH RESISTANCE BAND AND ONE-FOOT STAND**]() >[Posture]() >We have already put on the ankle straps; we thread the double-looped band through one of them. We hold both handles with the hand on the same side, extend the elbow; the opposite hand is placed on the hip, and the leg without the band is bent; we are balanced on one leg.
![1000462049.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKGa1EbTxeLf7w6xPz7PWzeDfxxPCveHPhhmrCXXzAw2s1ynETNG3uB7rVj3uBb.gif)
![1000462057.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK9PvUWSbSmUy8UZKttoPhhscAMqsJpSpBZRHjUW5ThizZC2VV6ZhmvJixpoVUR.gif)
[Ejecución]() Además de la lógica activación del biceps; ganamos mucho equilibrio y fortalecimiento medio e inferior. Ahora; activos en la posición indicada, solo debemos flexiona y extender el codo para realizar el movimiento de tríceps. 20 repeticiones en 4 series por lado. >[Execution]() >In addition to effectively engaging the biceps, this exercise significantly improves balance and strengthens the core and lower body. Now, with your arms in the correct position, simply bend and straighten your elbows to perform the triceps movement. 20 repetitions in 4 sets per side.
![1000462055.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6XTCJmR8mf9pRw1UMUJuvs1JK42C5iia8A6X8jXJpPmnFs5NmoS2LZiubZSHo.gif)
![1000462059.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKLsmgdFmoFVP4PUzpEmJq6cGsdjUbqiN2DHoXXcwBqCGat2yg7mtnV4yLmHcWS.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **EXTENSIÓN DE TRÍCEPS SOBRE LA CABEZA EN SENTADILLA CON PUNTA DE PIES**]() [Postura]() Pasamos la banda detrás de la columna; tomamos los mangos y adoptamos la postura de sentadilla en punta de pies, colocamos los glúteos sobre los talones. Flexionamos los codos llevando los brazos hacia atrás, manos sobre la cabeza. >[**Station 2**, **OVERHEAD TRICEPS EXTENSION IN A TOE-TIP SQUAT**]() >[Position]() >Pass the band behind your back; grasp the handles and assume a squat position on your toes, placing your glutes over your heels. Bend your elbows, bringing your arms back behind your head.
![1000462061.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK7yFrMby3Qg5NKsKEasRDJJcW6n5PLjJBTEK15Kx9EzxMxrcF6D1wCgVNQsCNA.gif)
[Ejecución]() Desarrollo y fortalecimiento de tríceps, núcleo y piernas; trabajo poderoso. Simplemente; debemos extender y flexionar los codos de forma alterna, siempre manteniendo la postura de sentadilla en punta de pies. 20 repeticiones totales en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Develops and strengthens the triceps, core, and legs; a powerful exercise. Simply put, alternate extending and bending your elbows while maintaining a squat position on your toes. 20 repetitions total, in 4 sets.
![1000462067.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AK7yGSHmMi2Yzh4Dwqy5D7xbr97ovEPNqJC5sJDv72G8TScV221fvKSSgZH143N.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **SENTADILLAS ABIERTAS CON APERTURA LATERAL DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Pasamos la banda por ambas tobilleras; abrimos piernas, cruzamos la banda y la tomamos por sus mangos. Los brazos quedan extendidos hacia abajo casi juntos y el torso recto. >[**Station 3**, **WIDE SQUATS WITH SIDE-WIDE ARM SPREAD**]() >[Posture]() >Thread the band through both ankle loops; spread your legs, cross the band, and hold it by the handles. Your arms should be extended downward, almost touching, and your torso should be straight.
![1000462069.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKGa4mps1eZZjr5G9HrxbXCdoUfxMvmyaSTDuHykhpZLoeTnoZsbWSrvrS9pRX2.gif)
[Ejecución]() Brazos, espalda, abdomen y tren inferior super activos. Para ejecutar el movimiento; realizamos la sentadilla y al mismo tiempo, abrimos los brazos a los lados sintiendo la tensión con las bandas. Nos vamos con 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Your arms, back, abs, and lower body will be working hard. To perform the movement, do a squat while simultaneously spreading your arms out to the sides, feeling the tension in the resistance bands. We’ll do 20 repetitions for 4 sets.
![1000462073.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKCGMqn1CBPPjReebFBXryMHUXYmexjvE3ovLjTrRmcSr2hs3wcA4nWS9CnxYh4.gif)
[**Relajación**, **EXTENSIÓN ALTERNA DE CUÁDRICEPS Y CODOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas separadas al ancho de la cadera, brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Relaxation**, **ALTERNATING QUADRICEPS AND ELBOW EXTENSIONS**]() >[Posture]() >Legs hip-width apart, arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000462075.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/AKF8qf47r76eXTskBnNcdoneHpHPAE9eBrpdF3aDTGxSffryrcByTqChyvLgoL6.gif)
[Ejecución]() Respirando y exhalando; durante 3 minutos de relajación y paz corporal, flexionamos una rodilla, tomamos la pierna con la mano del mismo lado haciendo leve presión. Extendemos al frente el codo del brazo opuesto. >[Execution]() >Breathing in and out; after 3 minutes of relaxation and physical calm, bend one knee, grasp the leg with the hand on the same side, applying gentle pressure. body.title: Different colors Rose flower photography !
body.body:
![Media (16).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfH1SafHj6rHQdtVP3xxGcW632KNoaJmhBPRxS6JBXqcj/Media%20(16).jpg)


Hi good afternoon friends, how are you all? I am back with another flower g photography.Today I am photographing a beautiful flower. The flower is really beautiful and charming.The name of the flower is rose. These flowers are very sweet.There are thousands of varieties of this flowering plant.Roses are said to be a symbol of love.



![Media (13).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ89fFVuQPhrui4AKu5kTNVx5yjc2TtMKynvwLJ3KxoQc/Media%20(13).jpg)

![Media (21).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma4ZJSJHdhovww1SDgFChUjqg51wTjdd7vHgSJgRosnAp/Media%20(21).jpg)

This plant has many qualities. The branches and trunk of the rose tree usually have sharp and hard thorns, which protect the tree from attacks by various animals.

![Media (20).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeFMDuxysbHukWpRMbsyb9boWMzGM4rNPeqR7bFeCb9tK/Media%20(20).jpg)

![Media (19).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma5BP7Bw8h2Fa4EHqsVd1HxwaMRRh9vsHt9j6WqKCKyuy/Media%20(19).jpg)

While wild roses typically have 5 petals, the buds of cultivated and hybrid rose varieties have numerous petals densely and beautifully arranged.

![Media (18).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXU9Q8SmoyvMAC8KhmUGdYFhJ95jqgfdRmchyCFsBj7AU/Media%20(18).jpg)

Roses come in many colors, including red, white, yellow, pink, orange, and mixed or bi-colored. However, there are no blue or black roses in nature.

![Media (17).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcsdcW3EZvxGMwVTaoG1DdAh2gSgFjQVj5x9RWFBEro3g/Media%20(17).jpg)

The sweet fragrance of roses calms and soothes the mind. Perfumes and oils are also made from many varieties of roses. Which brings people closer together. A flower loved by all people.
I hope everyone will like my flower photography. May everyone be well. Thank you.

body.title: Crónica de un viaje en tren (hacia mí misma) [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbWzSWWPmQeyDnm8naNLX82PEgv5XAKN3KwSQiq8dz5Ky/1779680489017.jpg)



***
***
Eran las 2 de la madrugada en la estación de ferrocarril de Camagüey y el aire olía a café de termo, a maletas de cartón y a ese cansancio que precede a los viajes largos. Soy mujer y estaba sola con mis pensamientos cuando acababa de subirme a un tren que no llegará a Matanzas hasta pasadas las 3 de la tarde. Trece horas, más de media vuelta a la isla, y cualquiera diría que era una tortura, pero yo, ahora lo sé, necesitaba exactamente eso.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNyLmvt5Rm4g9cj94eQKwJDnDG7LXundpRTCPWNyHAhfn/1779680846258.jpg)


***
Al principio, el traqueteo era molesto y los asientos de tela gastada no invitaban al sueño, mientras el vagón se movía con esa cadencia impredecible de las vías cubanas. Cerré los ojos, pero el cerebro no se apagaba; al contrario, como si el ruido del tren apagara el ruido del mundo, mis pensamientos empezaban a salir de los escondites donde los había metido. ¿Cuándo había sido la última vez que me había sentado a pensar sin un teléfono en la mano? ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que me permitía simplemente estar?

Pasaron las horas y alrededor de las 5 a.m., mientras el tren cruzaba las sabanas de Florida, ese municipio camagüeyano que parece detenido en el tiempo, podía ver la luna reflejada en los charcos, y allí, en esa penumbra, ocurrió lo que yo llamo \

: empecé a sacar cosas como preocupaciones pequeñas que había disfrazado de urgentes, personas a las que les dedicaba energía que no me devolvían, metas que no eran mías sino que alguien me había vendido como éxito.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR3Wzq1ZGFUhA4ntYScZe8766AFs4A3Ahe7UJCpdBsZnn/1779680845823.jpg)

***
A las 7 de la mañana, el sol asomaba y el paisaje cambiaba mientras íbamos por la provincia de Ciego de Ávila y la luz doraba los campos de caña; fue entonces cuando sentí la claridad. No fue un golpe de inspiración, sino un ordenamiento lento, como quien pone fichas de dominó sobre una mesa, y entonces recordé prioridades reales: mi salud emocional, ese proyecto que dejé a medio hacer, y la llamada pendiente a esa amiga que siempre me entiende.

El calor empezó a apretar después de las 10 a.m., y en la falta de prisa propia del tren está la lección más grande: que cuando te alejas de tu zona de confort y cuando el aire acondicionado de la rutina desaparece, ves todo más claro. Así ves que muchas de tus ansiedades eran solo ruido de fondo, que podías soltar aquello que te pesaba sin que el mundo se acabara, y sobre todo, que te habías descuidado a ti misma.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMzHwHF3umUEzjYoa1X2qRgpqqSRDcm5jiyV67B4roEp/1779680846443.jpg)

***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKdPuVqgVsQ3CSf4QYLQJAvckUjp7vXMyfPaGgZgeLTR/1779680845952.jpg)

***
Sucede que una se acostumbra a funcionar en automático: a levantarse, resolver, apagar incendios, cumplir, callar, y un día te das cuenta de que llevas meses sin preguntarte qué necesitas tú. Ese tren, con su lentitud tercamente cubana, me obligó a hacerme esa pregunta.

Llegué a Matanzas pasadas las 3 de la tarde, bajé con la ropa arrugada, el pelo hecho un desastre y los ojos llenos de algo que solo puedo llamar certeza. Durante trece horas no hice nada \

según los estándares de este mundo, solo pensé, y en ese acto tan simple, tan revolucionario en estos tiempos, se me ordenó la vida más que con cualquier agenda o lista de tareas.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbeDmnD4CH3JmsDVqw1M6LJfFJHjHS1DmUiPT9rtADxG/1779680845556.jpg)

***
Hoy quiero decirles desde esta comunidad de crecimiento que busquen sus propias trece horas en un tren. No tiene que ser un viaje real; puede ser una tarde sin pantallas, una caminata larga, una noche a solas. Pero necesitamos esos momentos de pausa activa, de pensamiento desordenado que lentamente se ordena.

Ese tren me devolvió prioridades, me quitó ruido, y me recordó que para encontrar el camino hay que perderse primero en un vagón de madrugada.

<center>🚂</center>
<center>🚂</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1778037185350.jpg)

### <center>ENGLISH VERSION</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 


## <center> Chronicle of a Train Journey (Toward Myself)</center>



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX46oB6KKHaeEh5ntJtKWdgVBCgwMqSFkNCaFd6hoieVs/1779680489154.jpg)




***
***


It was 2 in the morning at the Camagüey railway station, and the air smelled of coffee from a thermos, of cardboard suitcases, and of that weariness that precedes long journeys. I am a woman, and I was alone with my thoughts when I had just boarded a train that would not reach Matanzas until after 3 in the afternoon. Thirteen hours, more than halfway around the island, and anyone would say it was torture, but I, now I know it, needed exactly that.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNyLmvt5Rm4g9cj94eQKwJDnDG7LXundpRTCPWNyHAhfn/1779680846258.jpg)


***
At first, the rattling was annoying, and the worn fabric seats did not invite sleep, as the carriage moved with that unpredictable cadence of Cuban rails. I closed my eyes, but my brain would not shut off; on the contrary, as if the noise of the train were turning off the noise of the world, my thoughts began to emerge from the hiding places where I had tucked them. When was the last time I had sat down to think without a phone in my hand? When was the last time I allowed myself to simply be?

Hours passed, and around 5 a.m., as the train crossed the savannas of Florida, that Camagüey municipality that seems frozen in time, I could see the moon reflected in the puddles, and there, in that half-light, what I call \

occurred: I began to take out things like small worries I had disguised as urgent, people to whom I gave energy that they did not return, goals that were not mine but that someone had sold me as success.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmR3Wzq1ZGFUhA4ntYScZe8766AFs4A3Ahe7UJCpdBsZnn/1779680845823.jpg)

***
At 7 in the morning, the sun was appearing and the landscape was changing as we went through the province of Ciego de Ávila, and the light gilded the sugarcane fields; it was then that I felt clarity. It was not a stroke of inspiration, but a slow ordering, like someone placing dominoes on a table, and then I remembered real priorities: my emotional health, that project I left half done, and the pending call to that friend who always understands me.

The heat began to intensify after 10 a.m., and in the train's own lack of hurry lies the greatest lesson: when you step out of your comfort zone and when the air conditioning of routine disappears, you see everything more clearly. That way you see that many of your anxieties were just background noise, that you could let go of what weighed you down without the world ending, and above all, that you had been neglecting yourself.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRMzHwHF3umUEzjYoa1X2qRgpqqSRDcm5jiyV67B4roEp/1779680846443.jpg)


***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfKdPuVqgVsQ3CSf4QYLQJAvckUjp7vXMyfPaGgZgeLTR/1779680845952.jpg)


***
The thing is, you get used to functioning on autopilot: getting up, solving problems, putting out fires, complying, keeping quiet, and one day you realize that you have gone months without asking yourself what you need. That train, with its stubbornly Cuban slowness, forced me to ask myself that question.

I arrived in Matanzas after 3 in the afternoon, got off with wrinkled clothes, messy hair, and eyes full of something I can only call certainty. For thirteen hours I did nothing \

by the standards of this world, I just thought, and in that simple act, so revolutionary in these times, my life was put in order more than with any agenda or to-do list.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdbeDmnD4CH3JmsDVqw1M6LJfFJHjHS1DmUiPT9rtADxG/1779680845556.jpg)


***
Today I want to tell you, from this community of growth, to look for your own thirteen hours on a train. It does not have to be a real journey; it can be an afternoon without screens, a long walk, a night alone. But we need those moments of active pause, of disordered thought that slowly falls into place.

That train gave me back my priorities, took away the noise, and reminded me that to find the path, you first have to get lost in a carriage in the early morning.


<center>🚂</center>
<center>🚂</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYweGm8mMxKLmFZYSPAHak3F6Zz1vgqfa4B6ixGv588XE/1778037185465.jpg)

<sub>✨**𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** ✨
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕. 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.

body.title: 卧薪尝胆待佳期
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![dEV6JoqL99AgocPU_mmexport1779620541549.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/dEV6JoqL99AgocPU_mmexport1779620541549/dEV6JoqL99AgocPU_mmexport1779620541549.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

今天上午刚刚结束的周例会振奋人心，因为啥呢？部门引进的新产品出政策了：金黄光护眼灯合作100所，自驾独库公路给假旅游；显微镜150台台湾旅游全包。台湾真的太吸引我了，一直都想去。部门很久未组织旅游激励政策了，上一次迪拜游还是两年前，当然，我是没有赶上的，业务能做的那么好，就不愁了。

显微镜自从去年引进来后，我本是部门销量最高，后来因为上政府采购报账等问题，我还自己买了个CA签章安装后也不能使用，加之，我的奇葩经理不支持，导致后来我自己也没有跟进。部门的销售业绩惨淡，随之这个项目就停滞了。

不过幸好与我合作的单位帮我推荐了业务，竟有不少单位主动找了过来，我自己与厂家对接拿到比部门更低的底价合作了几笔订单，这150台的目标我早已完成。如今部门重新启动这个项目，我又得找寻合作对象了。具体，是自己单独找厂家还是走公司销售渠道容我再斟酌。

上次有提到部门撤并大区的事，下午就发文公告，我们8个大区缩减成5个，所以，我们就成了五大区了，还有点不习惯，经理依然是我们的经理。小道消息说本来总裁有意让他离开，但他偏偏找了几个“分量重”的人物把自己保了下来，不得不说挺有本事的，我们除了名字更换，其他毫无变化，这对他来说是最好不过，对我们来说那就继续煎熬吧！不管在谁手底下干活，不都得努力嘛！

总裁说，感觉大家最近的状态都是乌压压一片死气沉沉，又坦言自己每天都精神抖擞，可不嘛！知天命的年龄每天五公里跑步运动从不间断，办公室走廊总能听到他那高亢的歌声。在他心中，发生天大的事都不可能满脸愁绪，一个人的状态就是最好的风水。

分享今天总裁借用古人激励的一段话：
>天不生无用之人，地不长无名之草；
黄河尚有澄清日，岂可人无得运时；
雪压寒梅头不低，卧薪尝胆待佳期；
终有一日同风起，扶摇直上九万里。 

---

body.title: Photo of Little Moments: A Park, An Article and Beautiful Guests
body.body:
Sometimes I think where is the right place to read an article. Because some texts are not just to be read at the desk. It is necessary to read them in a better place, in a calmer mood. There was an article that I had to read that day. So I asked myself this question: “Where can I read this article where I would enjoy it the most?”


![IMG_2673.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23tvnbsNWeCc3AhvJoCdrS4BTe4wTRb4kPu3fGogMh5bh6SAaNFAimtNZ2n1u2W7xoVFh.jpg)


The answer was actually very obvious. I wanted to go to one of the parks I like to walk. Then I thought I would continue reading by drinking coffee in one of my favorite cafes. So I made a small but very nice plan.


![36EF8C13-102B-4941-95F7-DF33FD526862.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vsScbt88de8jrWtMQs5vNEd7ckojKVV6er4DULtAECXMnEnuDUBZMLa41wia3pvVfbS.jpeg)

![BA5F40BD-52C4-4892-8479-0CAD7CCFF83D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xyNqzNomzVzgMv1CXJwB25j54oX9ZvV32yKs6dkvzfTYSr5xwBiCT8TrJnS3CRSnYoH.jpeg)


I went to the park first. Actually, I didn't go out for a very long and serious walk that day. I wanted to get more fresh air, relax a little and take time for myself. I walked slowly on the roads of the park. The road through the trees, the greenery, the benches and the calm of the people were very good for me. Sometimes in places like this, people's hearts are really lighter.


![5DF84A4F-D1E1-4620-9A8D-BD19A5DE1217.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23wC7rNX5UmUo7nmwDsBEyAizwnmfJ3CzMK5U9P5A9LFk3TjnwDvFvF8hXz7xbypDTSWV.jpeg)

![IMG_2652.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eos1KxfQWf2LP1m9yjHeagdiZtKjgD7xFdyQeZ5zLBnsfaZX37AMdJV16CcBPf4xHue)


Then I sat on one of my favorite benches. I took my article out of my bag and started reading. That moment was very peaceful. There were trees on one side and a light wind on the other. People sometimes realize later how valuable such small moments are. I felt it while sitting on that bench. Even just sitting in a park and reading something can be good for a person's soul.



![IMG_2651.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpQvpAaFWdZvFqve1HjwsU5a9V2KC3sfuMur8nDnEDokmUKcNTqvPhPyeoYG5ogDtio)
![IMG_2658.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eo24aQcjbAnUfH4VCtaGKR7VYC1j5yA8De5ajX9Ge9atrPjVy54CZbsRY69eEJRwo2p.jpeg)

![IMG_2659.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EogMNXRrMQxCmASupRPccMqpHqUKSScKboi3jtJ3yHaSbrHHLwHitkPb1YgAWNTG3FR.jpeg)


My first little guest came while I was reading. A bird came right close to me. I was very happy to see him. I felt as if he was accompanying me. I wanted to take a picture of you because I like to share moments like this. Then my second little guest came. This time a tiny ant was walking on my article. It was such a sweet and unexpected moment that I smiled. An article, a bench, a bird and an ant... In fact, the story of the day became beautiful with such small details.


![IMG_2653.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EokbajU3Hajs6rUSN1YUcKpPxrKYugrCEdQEayhNbydRYXRhbwfUgKByz86dfFBo1ZJ)

![IMG_2654.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep5kK1FEG8iXQyBs8LRhMPmc8XKdjbCbERmkzn8hpZj1eiX6grCtHvJhXhk9DVCjtrj)


After a while, the weather started to cool down a little. So I got up and continued walking. I saw kittens this time before leaving the park. I think there were five or six, but I was able to photograph three of them. They were so cute. Encountering animals on the street in Istanbul always gives me a special joy. They were also a part of this little day.


![IMG_2663.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoiVdQ2L3yCuRYba7m2YMSUWLAejv8Xhpztj8zDmW6CxnXjtXMiniQ68a7tCAHE8KFB)


Then I walked towards the cafe. One of my favorite features of this cafe is that you can choose which cup you want to drink your Turkish coffee in. This little detail seems very pleasant to me. Of course, I chose the swan cup. You can also see it in the photo, it looks really elegant and very beautiful. I bought a chocolate cookie with coffee. It was also very delicious.


![IMG_2667.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoc6WxBYogSUska4tRf8t3S8t86gSUgB19kotpuJo7BURq1WbcD6anL7KYow4SvnBKo.jpeg)


When I sat in the cafe, I continued reading my article. That day, I read more than half of the article in these two beautiful places: first in the park, then in the cafe. I think sometimes you just need to find the right environment to work, read or think. The right environment opens both the mind and heart of the person.


![IMG_2671.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAaAYQCab5UWB8e6gXnEEAWG1oLoEwhT8wq4jhM5BSWxHJiXcsmJYVu9XiJzbDLdCX.jpeg)

![899A85E4-F0E3-4BFA-86B8-E4796C9DABD1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23uFaS3ibsofQTr8NtvvkWwY6hE9qFUU4oWvxHsDGJ4n4F1ck6Hc5QPV1Sx4PVR9hRJeo.jpeg)


I am currently writing this article at 6:30 in the morning, while watching outside on the balcony. I try to notice the little beauties in my life more. Looking at the sky, watching the clouds, seeing the sunrise, paying attention to a flower or a leaf... These may seem like very simple things, but they feel really good.


![IMG_2674.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eokexyx9bGVus2ZwuoFpXDWV45qpb7svEcamtCtRvfPQxahSMQQmq8MhBpGvn9HX9kQ)


Good things don't always happen in life. We all sometimes get tired, sad or can't tell anyone what's going through our minds. But when I try to enjoy such small moments, the effect of bad things decreases a little. Maybe I don't forget, but I lighten it.

So I took these photos to share with you. I hope this little walk, this coffee and these beautiful guests will give you some peace of mind.

See you in a new article.

body.body: > Sundays hold something special for me: they invite me to slow down, breathe more deeply, and listen to my thoughts with calm. For years now, they’ve been that little space in the middle of my routine where I allow myself to reflect on what I’ve experienced, give thanks for the good things, and also embrace what I’m still learning to understand. There are days when I feel like life is moving too fast. Everything happens almost without giving me time to understand it: the changes, the goodbyes, the decisions, even my own thoughts. Sometimes, I look around and everything feels blurry, like those blurry photos that fail to capture an exact moment, but still convey a real emotion.

> Los domingos tienen algo especial para mí: me invitan a bajar el ritmo, a respirar más despacio y a escuchar mis pensamientos con calma. Desde hace años, son ese pequeño espacio en medio de la rutina donde me permito reflexionar sobre lo vivido, agradecer lo bueno y abrazar también aquello que aún estoy aprendiendo a entender. Hay días en los que siento que la vida va demasiado rápido. Todo pasa casi sin darme tiempo de entenderlo: los cambios, las despedidas, las decisiones, incluso mis propios pensamientos. A veces, miro alrededor y todo se siente borroso, como esas fotos movidas que no logran capturar un instante exacto, pero que aun así transmiten una emoción real. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png ![Diseño sin título(84).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23xp6kx3Ztq8HLCFmodDUgBrQexBnrreqavpXqGnt3vRg3CXtMC77k67j1Gs318vSxCf8.jpg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png

> For a long time, I thought that growing up meant knowing exactly where I was going, but now I understand that you can also move forward without such certainty, and keep walking even when the path isn’t entirely clear. Perhaps that is what life is all about: accepting that we won’t always see the whole picture while we’re in the midst of it, but trusting that every step—even the most confusing ones—transforms us into someone new.

> Durante mucho tiempo pensé que crecer era saber exactamente hacia dónde iba, pero ahora entiendo que también se puede avanzar sin tanta certeza, y seguir caminando aunque el camino no se vea del todo claro. Quizás eso sea vivir: aceptar que no siempre veremos el panorama completo mientras estamos dentro de él, pero confiar en que cada paso, incluso los más confusos, nos transforma en alguien nuevo. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png ![photo_2026-05-24_22-50-20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23y8onPZb8kHHRnDNQYDK6GE7AaLyBVHd4goUhmFrMjugeXfwTqacn2sw6M4gK6fBp2PZ.jpg) https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgDbAV1h1SwxoWquPyx7qbdtkfh885LsoLFgpueSS4UHQAXXpa5Dib6ifnYAFdLFrLc.png Las fotos que ilustran esta publicación son de mi archivo personal y se pueden encontrar en mis redes sociales.. body.title: Apostando a los probióticos: Chucrut | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
body.body:
![1000549476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vi4KRugNSjFjxdCcMfc1MAbtcqaJ5PDzffXBSJJvhfTV5oKMfdbn4chRKHnPzwDcsPg.jpg)



<div class=text-justify> 

Ando incursionando en la preparación de fermentos, esto con el propósito de sumar más probióticos a mi dieta. He escuchado mucho hablar sobre las bondades que tienen los probióticos para la salud.

Luego de revisar varias opciones, opté por preparar *chucrut*, un alimento probiótico natural, el cual vi que lleva pocos ingredientes, tan solo repollo y sal sin yodo.

Entonces, como tenía sal rosada y algo de repollo en casa, decidí prepararlo a pesar del temor inicial que causan en mí estas preparaciones donde no se puede controlar cada paso, pues el alimento va trabajando solo hasta fermentar. Se trata de \

, frase muy usada hoy en día.

***¡Vamos a prepararlo!***


> I’ve been experimenting with making fermented foods, with the goal of adding more probiotics to my diet. I’ve heard a lot about the health benefits of probiotics.

> After looking into several options, I decided to make *sauerkraut*, a natural probiotic food that I saw requires only a few ingredients: just cabbage and non-iodized salt.

>So, since I had pink salt and some cabbage at home, I decided to make it despite my initial apprehension about these preparations where you can’t control every step, since the food works on its own until it ferments. It’s all about “trusting the process,” a phrase that’s very popular these days.

>***Let’s make it!***




------------------
#### <center>Ingredientes <sup>(Ingredients)</sup> </center>
------------------------------


<div class=\
> * 240 g de repollo. * Sal sin yodo (2% del peso del repollo: 4.85 gramos de sal; coloqué 5 gramos de sal rosada).

> * 240 g of cabbage. * Non-iodized salt (2% of the cabbage's weight: 4.85 grams of salt; I used 5 grams of pink salt). ------------------ ####
Preparación (How to make it)
------------------------------ * Se lava el repollo y se retira el centro. Se corta el repollo en tiras, se coloca en un bol y se agrega la sal. > Wash the cabbage and remove the core. Cut the cabbage into strips, place it in a bowl, and add the salt. ![1000549471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u64te7cw8RnPWC44GzKBnUpwyUS4WWgC3S7MGioWw23a562q5VB1VaKMzhyEdgVgABa.jpg) ![1000549472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wgPvPQSWpPiXSXGaiU6c59hE5abbFs3Q5ssqYGy5mGhFw5VNpi84iPuANKAq8YKzfMp.jpg) * Se masajea por unos diez minutos. Verás cómo el repollo desprende líquido y va bajando su volumen. >Massage it for about ten minutes. You'll see the cabbage release liquid and shrink in size. ![1000549473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23vi4ADSF6qrzoW1NyhHMCgQF2FvrdqsraQKwQZ11HQuzdQSzNvb7T3gwGTuwBvsiY4De.jpg) * Se coloca el repollo en un envase de vidrio previamente esterilizado. Se cubre con el líquido que botó el repollo después del masaje. Es indispensable que todo el repollo quede cubierto con el líquido. Yo le coloqué el centro del repollo encima para hacer peso. *Recomiendan retirar algunas hojas de repollo antes de cortarlo para cubrir el repollo cortado de modo tal que quede totalmente cubierto por el líquido. En mi caso no fue necesario, puesto que al colocar la tapa, esta empujó el repollo en el líquido y quedó totalmente cubierto.* > Massage the cabbage. Place the cabbage in a previously sterilized glass container. Cover it with the liquid released by the cabbage after massaging. It is essential that all of the cabbage be completely submerged in the liquid. I placed the core of the cabbage on top to weigh it down. >*It is recommended to remove a few cabbage leaves before cutting it to cover the cut cabbage so that it is completely submerged in the liquid. In my case, this wasn’t necessary, since when I put the lid on, it pushed the cabbage into the liquid and it was completely covered.* ![1000549474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xAa7bFsHRNgSJqxLtBJYFNAbX938shjS1ew3WF6vS7h1gzMsmRXRhp4dgJBAtsZsRC5.jpg) *Algo que he aprendido sobre los fermentos es que tienen comportamientos distintos. Así que es muy importante ver cómo se van desarrollando.* > *One thing I've learned about cultures is that they behave differently. So it's very important to watch how they develop.* ![1000549475.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23wX1LPJesG4M5pFCiDsmy7Vut7fpeYStWXajHLZuwmUMwxFhkxTk1EjiiHVFfQzxLeBc.jpg) * El chucrut debe destaparse cada 24 horas para hacerlo \

, cuando se usa un envase con tapa cerrada herméticamente. Debes estar pendiente de la cantidad de burbujas que veas en el envase. Debes dejar respirar esos gases. ![1000549477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23x1HhgXnhsbtijmpLSpoaoJZ6a3gZetewq9aWFcQTQmKq8aefKKHvRBNyLsn39qMgJ3w.jpg) Mi chucrut estuvo listo en 7 días; me gustó su sabor avinagrado y su consistencia crujiente. Tiene un sabor fuerte y bastante profundo. *¡Me gustó el resultado final!* > My sauerkraut was ready in 7 days; I liked its tangy flavor and crunchy texture. It has a strong, rich flavor. *I liked the final result!*
**¡Espero que te guste esta receta, cocina fácil y con sabor**!
**I hope you like it!**

As has become customary for some time now, here I bring you a look at some of the earnings I’ve made on Holozing since I placed my delegation a couple of months ago. Things have been a bit slow due to the price of HIVE, but hey—it’s money that generates itself, so I can’t complain too much.


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anaboadas/23viGSFMVfgikZwXNDrp9dB8dZNz4ktfGFNoJSUXqeW1U2XK8ykji3vTMYdVCKptxMHfj.png)


The truth is that one of the things that caught my attention most about Holozing right from the start was precisely that: the opportunity to generate rewards while the project continues to grow.

Many people still think that Holozing is simply \

but the reality is that the project has been building a rather solid community—and that ends up being one of the most important factors when it comes to making investments within the Web3 ecosystem.

Currently, one of the most common ways to invest in Holozing is by delegating HIVE. Basically, users temporarily lend their HIVE Power to the project and receive periodic rewards in return.


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anaboadas/23tv4MgjNwWDFKVGaSQHrMoTK6hqNx5DaZMuKGGeg3guGaHYgQ3LVV422feo96oWiVLam.png)


This allows users to support the ecosystem's growth while generating tokens or passive income.

For many users within the Hive ecosystem, this has become an interesting way to put their capital to work without the need to be constantly trading.

Of course, as with any investment in cryptocurrencies or blockchain projects, there are also risks involved.


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anaboadas/23u5V1Lohr78AGApvF3R8ARQqGfr4uEKm3BZqxDNGhfZUHVzFkppWfSZVAyisYB1JQcxi.png)


The price of HIVE can fluctuate significantly depending on market conditions, and this directly impacts the actual value of one's earnings.

For instance, you might be receiving substantial token rewards, but if the price of HIVE drops, the perceived value of those earnings changes quite a bit. Even so, many investors within the community view this as a long-term play rather than a way to make quick profits.


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anaboadas/23tv6W4BuHRzUhGWkfcgebtFuafF3uhzBrXEDtiFwunwfmTYFA4g8Fq6m2N5arWNHG585.png)



In addition to delegating HIVE, many users are also accumulating tokens related to Holozing in the hope that they will increase in value in the future. This is a fairly common occurrence in blockchain gaming projects: people try to get in early, before the ecosystem explodes in popularity.

If the video game ends up achieving real success upon its official launch, there is a possibility that the economy surrounding the project could grow tremendously.

There is also an important factor that many people overlook: the Hive community tends to be extremely supportive of projects native to its own ecosystem.

This creates a kind of virtuous circle in which users, content creators, investors, and players all help drive constant activity within the project.


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anaboadas/23vhoLLEMSYaXZ4ZyJjbmk7H2Wjcyo4cymWi3wDvkAfyogeQeCHTK7XhuWxyasg38vTTX.png)


On traditional platforms, building a community like this would cost millions of dollars in marketing but holozing just make it seen easy to my eyes

body.title: 遇上一个好老师
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![2QCXS5qX9SMaaOIG_Screenshot_2026-05-25-11-37-27-374_com.tencent.mm.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/2QCXS5qX9SMaaOIG_Screenshot_2026-05-25-11-37-27-374_com.tencent.mm/2QCXS5qX9SMaaOIG_Screenshot_2026-05-25-11-37-27-374_com.tencent.mm.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

马上阳坨的一年级要结束了，我们也从最初对他们班级的担忧，变成感恩和庆幸。

升小学时，我们选择了离家最近最容易接受的对口小学，有些卷的家庭可能想各种方法送到升学评价更好的小学了。分班，阳坨分的班级竟然没有一个幼儿园的同学，整个年级7个班级，他们幼儿园那么多同学按概率也怎么得有几个同学吧。

结果是，就是他一个人孤独的在一个新的班级。之前还有些担忧，他能不能适应，能不能认识新的同学。

结果约到后面越发现，他这个班级是个宝藏班级。阳坨分到7班，是今年人数增多，额外增加的一个班级，所以用了一个小教室，整个人数也就30~40来人，比其他班级的总人数少不少。人数少，老师关照的就可能跟多。

因为新的班级，所以也是调过来的新的年轻老师。一开始可能对年轻老师有点担忧。

后来发现，他们班主任很年轻的一个男的，很喜欢折腾事。折腾了各种班级活动，各种班级表演和上课比赛之类的~~~反正就是一个，不嫌事多的老师。

这次的六一，老师又自己排了话剧，在全校预选表演，整个一年级又他们班被选上。阳坨也在里表演了一个角色。

不止这次，还有好多，他们班级都是一年级里的第一，总能看到他们班级的身影。

在我看来，其实很多老师已经变成多一事不如少一事，只做好自己教学任务。而很庆幸我们遇到一个好老师。能学好，更能玩好。

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@yellowbird/4j2hsr)

body.title: What happened OKC?  Low scoring game 4 leads to series being tied at 2-2
body.body:
I had previously predicted that if the Thunders were able to hold one particular Spurs player to lower performance that they would be able to win all the rest of the games.   It appears as though they tried shut down Victor Wembanyama as a priority so much that they forgot to actually score points of their own.

Wemby was basically a one-man-army in this thing with his 33 points.  There was plenty of use of the bench and the rest of the team but all eyes were still on him.  It is tough to imagine one player being so dominant that the inability to shut him down means the team is going to excel but man oh man, that is exactly what we saw in the absolute masterclass that San Antonio put on with their 103-82 win over Oklahoma City

<center> https://bloximages.newyork1.vip.townnews.com/winchesterstar.com/content/tncms/assets/v3/editorial/4/3b/43b81d77-bf0b-59b7-a529-f6e8de921fce/6a0beec831f9e.image.jpg?resize=750%2C500
[src](https://bloximages.newyork1.vip.townnews.com/winchesterstar.com/content/tncms/assets/v3/editorial/4/3b/43b81d77-bf0b-59b7-a529-f6e8de921fce/6a0beec831f9e.image.jpg?resize=750%2C500)</center>

It's not like OKC is making any mistakes here.  They are all over Wembanyama like white on rice, but the dude is just so good that he manages to get through no matter how many people they put on him.  The above picture is kind of a humorous example of 'how the hell do you prevent this?\

body.title: 37. 数学和哈希函数
body.body:
哈希函数（散列函数）：任意⻓度的输⼊，通过散列算法，变换成固定⻓度的输出
```js
addmod(uint x, uint y, uint k) returns (uint):
计算 (x + y) % k，加法会在任意精度下执行，并且加法的结果即使超过 2**256 也不会被截取。从 0.5.0 版本的编译器开始会加入对 k != 0 的校验（assert）。

mulmod(uint x, uint y, uint k) returns (uint):
计算 (x * y) % k，乘法会在任意精度下执行，并且乘法的结果即使超过 2**256 也不会被截取。从 0.5.0 版本的编译器开始会加入对 k != 0 的校验（assert）。

MD4 、 MD5、ripemd-160
SHA（Secure Hask Algorithm）密码散列函数家族

SHA家族:
SHA-1
SHA-2 : SHA-224、SHA-256、SHA-384，和SHA-512
SHA-3 : Keccak 算法

keccak256(…) returns (bytes32)  keccak256 computes the Keccak-256 hash of the input.
sha3(...) returns (bytes32)

Solidity provides two methods for encoding data:
    abi.encode:
        Encodes data into bytes with padding
        Preserves all data information
        Safer when dealing with dynamic types
        Produces a longer output due to padding
    abi.encodePacked:
        Performs packed encoding (compressed)
        Produces a shorter output than abi.encode
        More gas efficient
        Risk of hash collisions with dynamic types (collision function)
eg: 
bytes32 s = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(_text, _num, _addr));
//encodePacked一种压缩打包模式，encode则会补零。


sha256(...) returns (bytes32)
ripemd160(...) returns (bytes20) 

ecrecover(bytes32 hash, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) returns (address)
通过椭圆曲线签名来恢复与公钥关联的地址
四个参数
hash: 被签名数据的哈希结果值，r，s，v分别来⾃签名结果串
r = signature[0:64]
s = signature[64:128]
v = signature[128:130] + 27 


% 取模， 整除后的余数
return 561 % 10;  //1
return 56189 % 100; //89
return 56 % 2; //0
```

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/043c5f35-cc86-4bdc-b60b-a320c7fb1bf7.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday was quite rainy, so we had to plan for our time in the yard accordingly. I still had to work anyways, so just like weekdays, we just took breaks between the rain showers. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/70401f25-d259-4575-820f-5638ad449644.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/95512856-e160-478f-bba7-128a0affe826.jpg) As often, Le Chat didn't know what she wanted, outside, inside, somewhere in the middle... ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c04d4c05-8cf7-4e88-b3bc-650ff946130e.jpg) But she did hang out with Kaia and made faces, that's what Le Chat does! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9b4027ac-31ee-4af0-b280-702f3cc227d4.jpg) Since Kaia cannot really walk for some time, our only option for a short walk is the small forest behind the front yard. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4c088826-8c48-46c2-b66e-63ea37d9a32a.jpg) Le Chat was actively seeking Kaia, that happens sometimes. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2eff2bcf-0a6e-45f8-bc08-7e6e702eb4be.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3ed70be6-c9ae-4f5e-9fe2-5ead69abc9e9.jpg) And again we added a few steps in the neighborhood. For the near future, this is probably all the walking we'll be doing with Kaia. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/445e3261-ba27-4bee-8265-5821c93cf1ac.jpg) And that was it for the day's activities, not too exciting again, but like I said, it might be the norm for some time. First time in years I ended up below 10k steps, that sucks. I will try a run on Sunday though if the rain stops early enough. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

body.title: Wyatt's Story, Musical Shadows
body.body:
It's great to be able to write another story and share it with you, my dear friends at Buskeria. This story is about Wyatt, a rapper who, after achieving fame, neglects some aspects of his life. Later, this will cause him some problems that he'll have to fix. Whether he can or not, you'll find out after reading the story. I hope you enjoy it. So, let's begin.

> Qué bien poder hacer otra historia y poder compartirla con ustedes mis queridos amigos de Buskeria. Esta historia la escribí sobre Wyatt, como verán el es un rapero que luego de alcanzar la fama se descuida en algunos aspectos de su vida. Más tarde esto le traerá algunos problemas que deberá reparar. Si podrá o no lo sabrán luego de leer la historia, deseo que les guste. Entonces comenzamos.


<div class=\

> ![1770563455813.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xyRDmWTiBtZ6K9CYcraFz2nqr7NKZJGahXSLwNBcmJo11yYM8CuhUMC9iHk7JGmX86t.jpg) Image created by me in canva Being a rapper opens many doors and opportunities, and Wyatt has proven this to be true. Since he started, he's seen his life change for the better. He's gained recognition from everyone in the music industry and is hailed as a true rapper in every sense of the word. He's had the opportunity to collaborate with the best rappers in Buskeria, and this success has brought him a lot of money and status. His albums sell like hotcakes, as they say. He's reached the pinnacle of what a rapper can aspire to. But behind every summit lies a steep slope, a steep drop. If you don't apply the brakes, you'll crash. Wyatt didn't apply them properly and paid a price, in this case, his health. Once you achieve success, you don't want to lose it, much less see it diminish. You want to stay on top as long as possible; falling isn't an option, and if it were to happen, it would be because of failure. This creates a lot of stress, and Wyatt couldn't handle it completely. Like many others, he started using drugs, and the drugs began to change him, turning him into someone far removed from the skilled rapper he was at the beginning. > Ser rapero te abre muchas puertas y oportunidades, y así lo ha comprobado Wyatt. Desde que comenzó ha visto como su vida ha cambiado para bien. Obtuvo reconocimiento de todos en la música, es aclamado como un rapero de verdad con todas las letras mayúsculas. Ha tenido la oportunidad de colaborar con los mejores raperos de Buskeria, y el éxito le hace ganar mucho dinero y estatus. Sus discos se venden como dice la gente como churros. El ha llegado a estar en la cima a la que puede aspirar un rapero. Pero siempre detrás de la cima hay una colina inclinada hacia abajo, una caída en toda regla. Si no aplicas los frenos pues te estrellas. > Wyatt no los aplicó bien y pagó un precio, en este caso su salud. Una vez que alcanzas el éxito no quieres perderlo y menos verlo reducirse, quieres mantenerte en la cima lo más que puedas, caer no es una opción, y si llegara a suceder pues sería por un fracaso. Esto crea mucho estrés y Wyatt no lo soportó del todo. Empezó como muchos a consumir drogas, las drogas empezaron a cambiarlo, a convertirlo en alguien que distaba del rapero habilidoso del comienzo.

> ![pexels-thongtran95-13826150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uQfVxCwNBgVDF8Mgts671eupCUS31UCSKhomwYSkdmU3kuyiBExxdsW3mp2kQfYGpx8.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) With stress and drugs came the neglect of his own body. He worked long hours all day, starting early to compose his rhymes and still not finishing late into the night. All day long he ate junk food and countless cans of sugary soda. And donuts were everywhere. It was the perfect recipe for a long-term health crisis. Some close friends advised him to abandon that lifestyle, to learn from the experiences of many who had failed because they didn't stop their fall. He was already in freefall, without brakes, but he thought he was still on top. To all this were added excesses: buying things for his so-called friends, expensive gifts for women who only wanted his money and would leave him as soon as they got their cut. The naive guy didn't realize it because he was in that stasis of overwork and drugs. His body began to lose the battle. > Con el estrés y las drogas llegó el descuido de su propio cuerpo. Muchas horas trabajando todo el día, empezaba componiendo bien temprano sus rimas y aún muy tarde en la noche aún no había acabado. En todo el día se la pasaba comiendo comida chatarra y muchas latas de gaseosa azucarada. Y las donas eran por montones. Era la mezcla perfecta para crear una tormenta en su salud a largo plazo. Algunos compañeros cercanos le recomendaron dejar ese estilo de vida, que se fijara en las experiencias de muchos que habían fracasado por no aplicar los frenos en su caída. El ya estaba en caída libre y sin frenos, solo que pensaba que estaba aún en la cima. > A todo esto se sumaron los excesos, compras de cosas para sus supuestos amigo, regalos carísimos para mujeres que lo único que querían del era su dinero, y lo dejarían en cuanto pudieran sacar suficiente pasta. El muy ingenuo no se daba cuenta porque estaba en ese estasis de sobre carga de trabajo y drogas. Su cuerpo empezó a perder la batalla.

> ![pexels-tima-miroshnichenko-6010881.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23u5teDZAASVECLDoQLFpVswWN5BRLirWBnETUyXZdLmpxtXsWJWLj2NscEFAno2f1HXj.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) He started getting thinner and thinner, and he couldn't explain why. He ate a lot, and it was junk food that, in theory, should have made him obese. But the drugs were destroying his body from the inside, which is why he was getting thinner and thinner. When he appeared in public to present a new song, people immediately noticed the difference between what he used to be and what he was now: a weak man with dark circles under his eyes. The strong man who had once been a symbol of rap was gone. With his physical collapse, his popularity and musical performance also declined. He became bedridden, barely able to move. The medical treatments to cure him, plus the excesses of his past, were bankrupting him, since he could no longer sing to generate income. That was the moment of regret, for not having led a healthier life. There wasn't much left to do but wait and see if he could recover from his multiple illnesses and addictions. In that state of distress, he acknowledged that he had neglected the most important thing: his career, but above all, his health. > Empezó a ponerse cada vez más flaco, el no se explicaba por qué. Si comía mucho, y era comida chatarra que en teoría debía ponerlo obeso. Pero las drogas acaban con su cuerpo por dentro, por eso cada vez se estaba haciendo más delgado. Cuando se presento en publico para presentar una nueva canción la gente enseguida notó la diferencia de lo que era antes y lo que era ahora, era un hombre con ojeras y débil. El hombre fuerte que una vez fue símbolo de rapero se había ido. Con el colapso de su cuerpo también calló su popularidad y su rendimiento musical. > Calló en cama, ya casi no podía moverse, los tratamientos médicos para curarlo más los excesos que tuvo en el pasado lo estaban llevando a la quiebra, pues ya no podía cantar para generar más ingresos. Ese fue el momento del arrepentimiento, por no haber llevado una vida más sana. Ya no había mucho que hacer más que esperar a ver si podía recuperarse de sus múltiples enfermedades y adicciones. En ese estado de aflicción reconoció que había descuidado lo más importante su carrea pero sobre todo su salud.

> ![pexels-do-trung-234019-890710.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wzdadMFFUnFyiyWpLQb9TgwVLqa6vviuZCBo3AGRpXrcFDTeYUFYgcS1krmdYjhZ9CS.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) But Buskeria rallied around him; they didn't want to let him fall. They didn't want to lose one of the city's best rappers. Even though he had run out of money, many donated so he could pay for his treatment. They also provided him with psychological support. Despite everything, he was left with health problems, such as liver damage from drug use and diabetes from junk food. But he overcame it, against all odds, because no one expected him to be able to get back on his feet after his fall. He was able to turn the page and return to the music scene. Clean of addictions, but with a heavy burden, because if he was in that state, it was his own doing. Now it was time to start from scratch, to rebuild everything. To demonstrate his transformation, he filmed his first music video in a gym to commemorate his change and to motivate others to lead a healthy life. He will use his example to help future generations of rappers and singers. You can always get back up after a fall if you set your mind to it, and he will try because destiny is not written. > Pero Buskeria se unió en su ayuda, no querían dejarlo caer. No querían dejar perder a uno de los mejores raperos de la ciudad. Aunque a el se le había acabado el dinero muchos donaron para que pudiera pagar sus tratamiento. También lo apoyaron sicológicamente. A pesar de todo quedó con secuelas en su salud, como problemas del hígado por el consumo de drogas y diabetes por la comida chatarra. Pero lo superó, contra todo pronóstico porque nadie esperaba que luego de su caída pudiera levantare. > Pudo pasar pagina, y volvió al ruedo musical. Limpio de adicciones, pero con un gran peso en la condicioncita, porque si estaba a así fue por su propia causa. Tocaba ahora empezar de 0, rehacer todo. Para demostrar su cambio su primer video musical lo hizo en un gimnasio para conmemorar su cambio y para motivar a otros a llevar una vida sana. Usará su ejemplo para ayudar a las futuras generaciones de raperos y cantantes. Siempre se puede volver a subir de la caída si te lo propones, el lo intentará porque el destino no está escrito.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2347).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23y8qepy2qJrEjGs73uE1XMRKtoSvUHZ8k8QzX6Fp8dfgg1ekpNhVBByahW5TPjUMouTt.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.
